śalākāyantrāṇi nirdeṣṭumāha- śalākāyantrāṇyapītyādi| yathāyogapariṇāhadīrghāṇīti pariṇāho vartulatā| teṣāṃ śalākāyantrāṇāṃ madhye| gaṇḍūpadetyādau mukhaśabdo gaṇḍūpadādibhiḥ saha pratyekaṃ sambadhyate; tena gaṇḍūpadamukhe ‘gaṇḍūpadetyādau sādṛśyaṃ ca yantramukhe jñeyam’ iti cakraḥ dve, sarpaphaṇamukhe ‘aśmarīnirdiṣṭaṃ yantramagnavakraṃ sarpaphaṇamukhameva’ iti cakraḥ dve, evaṃ śeṣayorapi| śarapuṅkhaḥ śaraguṇasandhānasthānam| baḍiśo matsyabandhanam| teṣāṃ caturṇāṃ gaṇḍūpadamukhādīnāṃ yathāsaṅkhyena prayojanamāha- eṣaṇetyādi|- eṣaṇaṃ gambhīrapākādau pūyādyanveṣaṇaṃ; vyūhanamūrdhvīkaraṇaṃ chittvottuṇḍitasyoddharaṇārthaṃ, vāraṅgeṇānusaraṇamityeke ‘vyūhanaṃ tu cūrṇitāśmaryādīnāṃ saṅgrahaṇaṃ’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ| ‘vraṇauṣṭhayoḥ sannihitīkaraṇam’ iti gaṇanāthasenaḥ, ‘viparītasthānāṃ māṃsādīnāṃ samyagracanam’ ityaṣṭāṅgasagrahavyākhyāyāminduḥ, ‘vyūhanaṃ prasṛtamāṃsādīnāṃ yathāsthānaṃ vinyāsaḥ’ iti hemādriḥ| masūradaleti masūrasya dalitasya nistuṣakhaṇḍaṃ dalamityucyate| kiñcidānatāgre iti manāgvakrāgre| ṣaṭ kārpāsakṛtoṣṇīṣāṇīti tūlaveṣṭitāgrāṇi, pramārjanakriyāsu proñchanakriyāsu| trīṇi darvyākṛtīnīti darvī dāruhastakaḥ| khallamukhāni nimnamukhāni| jāmbavavadanānīti jambuphalamukhākṛtīni| kolāsthidalamātramukhamiti badarāsthimajjavidalapramāṇaṃ; khallatīkṣṇauṣṭhamiti khallaṃ nimnaṃ madhye boddhavyaṃ, tīkṣṇauṣṭhaṃ tvante| kalāyaparimaṇḍalamiti kalāyamātraṃ parito maṇḍalaṃ vartulam, ubhayato mukulāgramiti dvayorantayoḥ kalikāvadagraṃ; dairghyeṇa tvaṣṭāṅgulaṃ śālākyoktatvāt| gaṇḍūpadamukhādīnāmaṅkuśavadanāntānāṃ ‘atra śalākāyantreṣu tulyarūpāṇāmapi yantrāṇāṃ ṣaḍādisaṅkhyāniyamaḥ prāyastāvataiva karmasamāptiṃ sūcayati’ iti cakraḥ śalākāyantrāṇāṃ tulyākṛtitve'pi dvitvaṣaṭtvādīni kāryāpekṣīṇi||14||
upayantrāṇyapi- rajjuveṇikāpaṭṭacarmāntavalkalalatāvastrāṣṭhīlāśmamudgarapāṇipādatalāṅgulijihvā- dantanakhamukhabālāśvakaṭakaśākhāṣṭhīvanapravāhaṇaharṣāyaskāntamayāni kṣārāgnibheṣajāni ceti ||15||
etāni dehe sarvasmin dehasyāvayave tathā | sandhau koṣṭhe dhamanyāṃ ca yathāyogaṃ prayojayet ||16||

upayantrāṇi nirdeṣṭumāha- upayantrāṇyapītyādi| upayantrāṇīti yantrasamīpavartīni, hīnayantrāṇītyanye ‘upamitāni yantrairityupayantrāṇi’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ| ‘anuyantrāṇi’ iti vāgbhaṭe pāṭhaḥ| rajjuḥ muñjādiviracito guṇaḥ; veṇikā guṇatrayagrathitā; carmāntaṃ carmāvayavaḥ, atra `varmāntam’ ityeke paṭhanti, varma sannāhaḥ; valkalaṃ palāśodumbarādīnāṃ tvak, sā ca bhagnādibandhanayantrārthaṃ; latā pratāninī ‘veli’ iti loke; vastraṃ karpaṭaḥ; aṣṭhīlāśmeti aṣṭhīlā dīrghavartulapāṣāṇaḥ, anye lauhakārāṇāṃ lauhīṃ dīrghavartulabhāṇḍikāmāhuḥ, tayā tulyo'śmā aṣṭhīlāśmā, sa cāṣṭhīlāśmā prasiddhaḥ; mudgaraḥ kāṣṭhādikṛtaḥ, ayamasthividaṣṭaśalyasya cālanārthaṃ; pāṇipādatalamiti talaśabdaḥ pāṇipādābhyāṃ saha pratyekaṃ sambadhyate; aśvakaṭakaḥ ghoṭakakavikācūḍakaṃ, śākhā vṛkṣasya, anayoḥ prayojanaṃ śalyāpanayanīye vakṣyati; ṣṭhīvanaṃ śleṣmādinirasanaṃ; pravāhaṇaṃ vamanavirecanāśrupravartanādi yathāsaṅkhyaṃ kaphapittākṣirajaḥśalyādiṣu; harṣaḥ tuṣṭiḥ; ayaskāntaḥ pāṣāṇaviśeṣaḥ, ākarṣakadrāvakacumbakabhrāmakabhedāccaturvidhaḥ| itiśabdaḥ samāptau, samāptāni yantrāṇīti| svabhāvapācanapramārjanādayo'navabaddhaśalyoddharaṇahetavo rajjvādyupayantreṣvevāntarbhūtā iti pṛthaṅnoktāḥ| tadyathā- pravāhaṇagrahaṇena tāvadaśrukṣavathuprabhṛtīnāmapyatra grahaṇamityādikaṃ boddhavyam||15-16||

yantrakarmāṇi tu- nirghātanapūraṇabandhanavyūhanavartanacālanavivartanavivaraṇapīḍanamārgaviśodhanavikarṣaṇāharaṇāñchanonnamana- vinamanabhañjanonmathanācūṣaṇaiṣaṇadāraṇarjūkaraṇaprakṣālanapradhamanapramārjanāni ‘vartanaṃ bhagnāsthyādīnāṃ yathāyathaṃ sthāpanaṃ, cālanaṃ galādāvavabaddhāsthiśalyādīnāmapanayanaṃ, vivartanaṃ parāṅmukhībhūtasyāsthyāderapavartanam, āñchanamatikṣiptasyāsthnaḥ kuñcitasya vā'ṅgulyāderāyamanaṃ, bhañjanaṃ śalyakarṇāderāpothanaṃ khaṇḍanaṃ vā, dāraṇaṃ viṣasaṃhitānāmasthnāṃ dvidhākaraṇam, ṛjukaraṇaṃ kuñcitasya gātrasya bandhanādinā saralīkaraṇam’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ caturviṃśatiḥ ||17||

kāni punaryantrāṇāṃ karmāṇītyāha- yantrakarmāṇi tvityādi| nirghātanam itaścetaśca vicālya nirharaṇam, itaścetaśca ghaṭṭanamityeke; pūraṇaṃ bastinetraprabhṛtibhistailādinā; bandhanaṃ rajjvādinā; vyūhanam atraivādhyāye vyākhyātaṃ prāk; vartanaṃ visṛtasya vartulīkaraṇaṃ; cālanaṃ sthānāt sthānāntaranayanam, anye śalyakampanamāhuḥ; vivartanaṃ karṇavāyorniṣkāsayitumiṣṭasya karṇalagnasya punarnivartanam, anye yantrasya bhrāmaṇamantare vā; vivaraṇaṃ prakāśanaṃ, māṃsacchedāvakāśadānena vivaraṇamityeke, ‘vivaraṇaṃ prasāraṇam’ iti lakṣmaṇaṭippaṇakenoktaṃ; pīḍanaṃ vraṇasya pūyādinirgamanārthamaṅgulyādinā; mārgaviśodhanaṃ mūtrapurīṣasaṅge; vikarṣaṇaṃ vigṛhya karṣaṇama, anye māṃsādipratibaddhaśalyasya mocanamāhuḥ; āharaṇamānayanam; āñchanam īṣanmukhānayanam, īṣanmukhe ānayanamityarthaḥ; unnamanamadhaḥsthitasya śarakarṇāderūrdhvaṃ nayanaṃ; vinamanaṃ nimnī(namrī)karaṇaṃ; bhañjanaṃ śarakarṇāderāmardanaṃ, samantato mardanamityanye; unmathanaṃ pranaṣṭasya śalyasya mārge śalākādibhirāloḍanam; ācūṣaṇaṃ viṣaduṣṭastanyarudhireṣu śṛṅgālābūbhyāṃ mukhena vā; eṣaṇaṃ gaṇḍūpadamukhena gativraṇotsaṅgaśalyādīnāṃ; dāraṇaṃ śarakarṇādidvidhākaraṇam; ṛjūkaraṇaṃ kuṭilaśalyasya; prakṣālanaṃ toyādibhirvraṇotsaṅgādīnāṃ; pradhamanaṃ śleṣmaśalyasaṅge nāsikāyāṃ nāḍyā cūrṇakṣepaṇaṃ; pramārjanaṃ proñchanaṃ bālāṅgulivastrairakṣirajaḥśalyādiṣu||17||
svabuddhyā cāpi vibhajedyantrakarmāṇi buddhimān | asaṅkhyeyavikalpatvācchalyānāmiti niścayaḥ ||18||
idānīṃ nānāvidhaśalyākāreṇa karmaṇāṃ bahutvāt saṅkhyāyāmaniyamaṃ darśayannāha- svabuddhyā cāpītyādi||18||
tatra, atisthūlam, asāram, atidīrgham, atihrasvam, agrāhi, viṣamagrāhi, vakraṃ, śithilam, atyunnatam, mṛdukīlaṃ, mṛdumukhaṃ, mṛdupāśam, iti dvādaśa yantradoṣāḥ ||19||

yantradoṣān vaktumāha- tatrātisthūlamityādi| asāramaśuddhalohādighaṭitam| agrāhi vikṛtamukham| viṣamagrāhi ekadeśagrāhi| vakram anṛju| śithilaṃ pīḍanākṣamam| atyunnatam ucchritakīlakādi| mṛdukīlaṃ durbalaśalyam| anye tu ‘vakraśithilātyunnatamṛdukīlaṃ’ iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- atra kīlaśabdo vakrādibhiḥ saha pratyekaṃ sambadhyate; tena vakrakīlamityādi yojyam| mṛdupāśaṃ tanupāśam| mṛdumukhaṃ śalyapīḍanāsahamukham| ete prāyeṇa svastikayantrāṇāṃ doṣā boddhavyāḥ||19||
etairdoṣairvinirmuktaṃ yantramaṣṭādaśāṅgulam | praśastaṃ bhiṣajā jñeyaṃ taddhi karmasu yojayet ||20||
yantrasya praśastatvaṃ vaktumāha- etairdoṣairityādi||20||
dṛśyaṃ siṃhamukhādyaistu gūḍhaṃ kaṅkamukhādibhiḥ | nirhareta śanaiḥ śalyaṃ śāstrayuktivyapekṣayā ‘śalyaṃ svastikayantraistu nirhareta bhiṣagvaraḥ’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ||21||

svastikayantrāṇāṃ viṣayabhedaṃ darśayannāha- dṛśyamityādi| dṛśyaṃ darśanagataṃ śalyaṃ, gūḍham adṛśyam| kaṅkamukhādibhiriti atrādiśabdaḥ pradhānavācī, tena kaṅkamukhamādi pradhānaṃ yeṣāṃ tairnirharedityarthaḥ; yadi punarihādiśabdaḥ pradhānavācī na syāttadā kākamukhasya grahaṇaṃ na syāditi| śāstrayuktivyapekṣayeti vividhā apekṣā vyapekṣā, viśiṣṭā apekṣā vā||21||
ni(vi)vartate sādhvavagāhate ca śalyaṃ nigṛhyoddharate ca yasmāt | yantreṣvataḥ kaṅkamukhaṃ pradhānaṃ sthāneṣu sarveṣvadhi(vi)kāri caiva ||22||

kaṅkamukhasya prādhānyaṃ darśayannāha- nivartata ityādi| nivartate sādhviti sādhu jhaṭiti niḥsaratītyarthaḥ, avagāhate praviśati ca sādhu, anyeṣāṃ siṃhamukhādīnāṃ sthūlamukhatvena sādhvavagāhanasādhunivartanābhāvāt; anye vivartate vṛttatvādantarbhramatītyāhuḥ| śalyaṃ nigṛhya gṛhītvā, uddharate ākarṣati| sthāneṣu sarveṣviti sandhidhamanyādiṣu| adhikāri asya kaṅkamukhasya adhikāro'sti nānyasya; anye tu ‘avikāri’ iti paṭhanti, tatrāpi sa eva tātparyārtha iti||22||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne yantravidhirnāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ ||7||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne saptamo'dhyāyaḥ||7||

div.head: śastrāvacāraṇīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ śastrāvacāraṇīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi| śastrāṇāmavacāraṇaṃ śastrāvacāraṇaṃ, tadyasminnadhyāye'sti sa śastrāvacāraṇīyaḥ, taṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1-2||

viṃśatiḥ ‘ekaviṃśatiḥ śastrāṇi| tadyathā- maṇḍalāgrārdhamaṇḍalakarapatra...’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ| vāgbhaṭe (sū. a. 26) sarpāsyaṃ, liṅganāśavyadhanī śalākā, kūrcaḥ, khajaḥ, karṇapālīvyadhanaṃ, karṇavedhanī ceti ṣaṭśastrāṇyadhikānyuktāni| teṣāṃ lakṣaṇāni kramaśo yathā- ‘sarpāsyaṃ ghrāṇakarṇāśaśchedane'rdhāṅgulaṃ phale’ iti| ‘tāmrī śalākā dvimukhī mukhe kuruvakākṛtiḥ| liṅganāśaṃ tayā vidhyet’| sarvavṛttāstāścaturaṅgulāḥ| kūrco vṛttaikapīṭhasthāḥ saptāṣṭau vā subandhanāḥ| saṃyojyo nīlikāvyaṅgakeśaśāteṣu kuṭṭane’, tāḥ sūcyaḥ| ‘ardhāṅgulamukhairvṛttairaṣṭābhiḥ kaṇṭakaiḥ khajaḥ| pāṇibhyāṃ mathyamānena ghrāṇāttena haredasṛk’| ‘vyadhanaṃ karṇapālīnāṃ yūthikāmukulānanam’| ‘bahalāyāśca śasyate| sūcī tribhāgasuṣirā tryaṅgulā karṇavedhanī’ iti | ‘sūcīkūrco vṛttaikamūlo'gre sunibaddhasaptāṣṭasūcikaḥ kuṣṭhaśvitrendraluptasuptādiṣu| khajastvardhāṅgulāyatāṣṭakaṇṭakamukhastāmro lauho vā nāsābhyantaragataśoṇitamokṣārthaḥ| karṇavyadhanaṃ tryaṅgulāyatamaṅgulaśuṣiraṃ ghanaṃ yūthikāmukulāgram” (vṛ. vā. sū. 34)| karṇavyadhanaṃ śuṣirabhāge bheryākṛti iti induḥ śastrāṇi, tadyathā- maṇḍalāgrakarapatravṛddhipatranakhaśastramudrikotpalapatrakārdhadhārasūcīkuśapatrāṭīmukha- śarārimukhāntarmukhatrikūrcakakuṭhārikāvrīhimukhārāvetasapatrakabaḍiśadantaśaṅkveṣaṇya iti ||3||

kiyanti punastāni śastrāṇītyāha- viṃśatirityādi| śastrāṇi maṇḍalāgrādīni; maṇḍalāgre dve sūcyastisraḥ, ityādyavayavāntarabhedena tu bahūnyapi syuḥ| tāni nāmabhirnirdeṣṭumāha- tadyathā maṇḍalāgretyādi| ‘teṣāṃ nāmabhirevākṛtayaḥ prāyeṇa vyākhyātāḥ’, tathā ‘tatra nakhaśastraiṣaṇyāvaṣṭāṅgule’ ityādivākyena śastrāṇāmākāraṃ pramāṇaṃ ca yadyapyagre vakṣyati, tathā'pīhaiva paratantroktaṃ śastrākārapramāṇalakṣaṇaṃ sukhāvabodhārthamupadekṣyāmaḥ| maṇḍalāgramiti maṇḍalamivāgraṃ yasya tanmaṇḍalāgraṃ, tacca dvividham| tathāhi- “yadagre ‘ṣaṭbhāge’ iti pā.| etacca bhālukīvacanamiti cakraḥ| maṇḍalāgralakṣaṇaṃ vāgbhaṭe evaṃ paṭhyate- “maṇḍalāgraṃ phale teṣāṃ tarjanyantarnakhākṛti| lekhane chedane yojyaṃ pothakīśuṇḍikādiṣu”- iti | ‘dve maṇḍalāgre ye prokte ekaṃ vṛttamukhaṃ tayoḥ| tīkṣṇadhāraṃ dṛḍhaṃ kāryamekaṃ tacca kṣurākṛti’ iti bhānumatyāṃ bhojaḥ| “maṇḍalāgraṃ pradeśinyantarnakhavistṛtaphalaṃ, tallekhanacchedanayorvartmarogotsannadantamāṃsadurniviṣṭavraṇagalaśuṇḍikādiṣu prayojyam” (aṣṭāṅgasaṅgraha, sū. a. 34)| ‘antarnakhaṃ māṃsanikaṭaṃ, tadākṛti phalaṃ yasya tattayoktam’ iti tadvyākhyāyāminduḥ maṇḍalaṃ vṛttaṃ kṣurasaṃsthānameva ca| maṇḍalāgrasya jānīyāt pramāṇaṃ tu ṣaḍaṅgulam”- iti| dvidhā maṇḍalāgraṃ- ṣaḍaṅgulapramāṇamekaṃ vṛttamukhaṃ, dvitīyaṃ kṣurākāram| karapatramiti karapatralakṣaṇaṃ vāgbhaṭe evaṃ paṭhyate- “chede'sthnāṃ karapatraṃ tu kharadhāraṃ daśāṅgulam|| vistāre dvyaṅgulaṃ sūkṣmadantaṃ sutsarubandhanam”- iti| “tsarurmuṣṭiḥ, bandhanaṃ grahaṇaṃ, śobhane tsarubandhane yasya tat sutsarubandhanam| abhidhānakośe yadyapi “tsarurasimuṣṭiḥ’ ityabhyadhāyi, tathā'pi muṣṭimātrasyehopalakṣaṇārthatvānmuṣṭāvapyupapannameva” ityaruṇadattaḥ karavat patraṃ yasya tat karapatraṃ, yathā karo'ṅgulibhirācito bhavati tadvadyat kaṇṭakairācitaṃ syāttat karapatramucyate; anye tu karapatraśastraṃ karapatrākārameva, tacca dvādaśāṅgulaṃ ‘dvādaśāṅguladīrghaṃ syāttanu cācitakaṇṭakam| karapatraṃ vijānīyādbhiṣagākṛtimānataḥ’ iti bhojavacanaṃ bhānumatyām tantrāntaravacanāt; nanu, yadi tantrāntarāddvādaśāṅgulaṃ karapatramucyate tarhi svatantre virodhaḥ, kutaḥ? svatantre karapatrasyānirdiṣṭapramāṇatvāt; `śeṣāṇi tu ṣaḍaṅgulāni’- ityanena vākyena ṣaḍaṅgulameva karapatraṃ syānna dvādaśāṅgulam| naivaṃ, ‘teṣāṃ nāmabhirevākṛtayaḥ prāyeṇa vyākhyātāḥ’- ityasmāt sūtrāt prāyaḥśabdo'nuvartate, tenāyamarthaḥ- śeṣāṇi prāyeṇa ṣaḍaṅgulāni, evaṃ śastramāne'nyatrāpyavirodhaḥ| vṛddhipatramiti vṛddheḥ patramiva vṛddhipatraṃ; tacca dvividham- ekamañcitāgraṃ, dvitīyaṃ prayatāgraṃ; dve api saptāṅgulapramāṇe, dvayorapi “ardhapañcāṅgulaṃ vṛntaṃ kāryaṃ sārdhāṅgulaṃ phalam”- iti; anayormadhye'ñcitāgraṃ vṛddhipatraṃ kṣuramāhuḥ ‘atra tantrāntaraṃ ‘saptāṅgulaṃ pramāṇena vṛddhipatraṃ dvilakṣaṇam| añcitaṃ cāyatāgraṃ ca kārayet kuśalo bhiṣak|| saptāṅgulaṃ vibhajyaitat pramāṇaṃ vṛddhipatrayoḥ| ardhamekādhikaṃ vṛntaṃ phalaṃ triṣu ca kārayet’ iti ekādhikamiti ekāṅgulādhikatryaṅgularūpamardham, evaṃ saptāṅgule vṛddhipatre caturaṅgulasya vṛntena gatatvāt tryaṅgulaphalamuktamupapannaṃ bhavati| atraivāyatāgraṃ vṛddhipatraṃ kṣuramāhuḥ, ata eva ‘kṣurakartarikāsandaṃśaiḥ’ ityācāryavacanaṃ kṣurasañjñāntaravacanādupapannaṃ bhavati’ iti cakraḥ| ‘vṛddhipatramiti vṛddhirāyatatvena samṛddhiḥ patre patrākāre phale yasya tadvṛddhipatram’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ| vṛddhipatralakṣaṇaṃ vāgbhaṭe evaṃ paṭhyate- “vṛddhipatraṃ kṣurākāraṃ chedabhedanapāṭane| ṛjvagramunnate śothe, gambhīre ca tadanyathā|| natāgraṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ”- iti| “vṛddhipatraṃ kṣurākāraṃ tattūnnate śvayathau ṛju sūcyagramiṣṭaṃ, viparīte tu pṛṣṭhato'vanatadhāram” (a. saṃ. sū. a. 34)| nakhaśastramiti nakhaśastralakṣaṇaṃ vāgbhaṭe evaṃ paṭhyate- “vakrarjudhāraṃ dvimukhaṃ nakhaśastraṃ navāṅgulam| sūkṣmaśalyoddhṛticchedabhedapracchānalekhane”- iti| “nakhānāṃ chedane kāryaṃ śastramaṣṭāṅgulāyatam| ardhāṅgulaṃ mukhaṃ tasya tīkṣṇadhāraṃ tu kalpayet” iti bhānumatyāṃ bhojaḥ nakhānāṃ chedanāya śastraṃ nakhaśastraṃ, tasya ‘tasya dairghyamaṣṭāṅgulapramāṇaṃ, mukhaṃ cārdhāṅgulam| mudrikāśastraṃ mudrikayā baddhaṃ vṛddhipatratulyalakṣaṇaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ kṣurākāraṃ, tacca loke “kṣurapra” iti prasiddham| utpalapatramiti utpalapatreṇa tulyamutpalapatrakaṃ, ṣaḍaṅguladīrghaṃ, madhye caturaṅgulaṃ vṛntaṃ, phalaṃ dvyaṅgulāyāmamekāṅgulavistṛtam” iti pā. phalaṃ dvyaṅgulāyāmamekāṅgulavistṛtam| mudrikāṃ svayamevāgre ‘atraiva khyātāṅguliśastrāvarodhaḥ’ iti cakraḥ vakṣyati| utpalapatramiva patramasyetyutpalapatrakaṃ, tathā ca tantrāntaraṃ, “tulyamutpalapatreṇa tīkṣṇadhāraṃ samāhitam| ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ pramāṇena śastramutpalapatrakam|| tatphalaṃ tryaṅgulāyāmaṃ kāryamaṅgulavistṛtam”- iti| ardhadhāramiti “ardhadhāraṃ tu kartavyaṃ śastramaṣṭāṅgulāyatam| urasyaṅgulavistāraṃ phale taddvyaṅgulaṃ bhavet” iti bhānumatyāṃ bhojaḥ| ‘urasīti kroḍe’ iti cakraḥ ardhe dharā yasya tadardhadhāraṃ, vakradhāramiti prasiddhaṃ; taccāṣṭāṅgulāyatam, urasyaṅgulavistāraṃ, dvyaṅgulaphalam; anye tu ‘adhyardhadhāram‘ iti paṭhanti, adhikamardhe dhārā yasya tadadhyardhadhāram| sūcī ‘sūcīmagre vakṣyati’ iti pā. agre vakṣyate| kuśapatramiti “tīkṣṇāgraṃ kuśapatrārdhamaṅgulaṃ dairghyataḥ phalam| vṛntaṃ syāttryaṅgulaṃ yasya kuśapatraṃ taducyate” ityuktalakṣaṇam iti hārāṇacandraḥ| “kuśapatre tantrāntaraṃ- vṛntaṃ syāttryaṅgulaṃ madhye kuśapatrasalakṣaṇam” iti cakraḥ| kuśapatrāṭīmukhayorlakṣaṇaṃ vāgbhaṭe evaṃ paṭhyate- “kuśāṭāvadane srāvye dvyaṅgulaṃ syāttayoḥ phalam”- iti| “kuśapatrāṭāmukhe dvyaṅgulaphale” iti vṛddhavāgbhaṭaḥ kuśapatratulyaṃ kuśapatraṃ; tanmānamāha- “dvyaṅgulaṃ rucakaṃ vidyāda(ttrya)ṅgulaṃ phalamucyate| vṛntaṃ syāttrya(dvya)ṅgulaṃ madhye kuśapatrasya lakṣaṇam” iti| āṭī(ṭā) mukhamiti āṭī(ṭā) jalavardhanī nāma pakṣiviśeṣaḥ, tanmukhavanmukhaṃ yasya tadāṭīmukhaṃ; tathā coktaṃ-“vṛntaṃ saptāṅgulaṃ vidyāttasyāgre phalamiṣyate| āṭī(ṭā)mukhaprakāraṃ hi phalamaṅguṣṭhamāyatam- āṭī(ṭā)mukhaṃ vijānīyāttatsrāvaṇavidhau matam”- iti| śarārimukhamiti śarāridīrghacañcuḥ pakṣiviśeṣaḥ, sa dvividhaḥ- dhavalaskandhoḥ raktaśīrṣaśca, dhavalaskandhasya ‘śarārī(riḥ)’ iti sañjñā, tanmukhavanmukhaṃ yasya taccharārimukhaṃ, tasya śastrasya loke kartarīti ‘atra tantrāntaram- ‘ānupūrvyāyatāṃ tīkṣṇāṃ pramāṇena daśāṅgulām| tribhāge kīlayogaṃ hi jānīyāt kartarīṃ bhiṣak’ iti, pāśavatī baddhakīlavatī ca kartarī’ iti cakraḥ| ‘śarārirnāma pakṣī ‘sarala’ iti vijñāyate, tanmukhamiva mukhamasyeti śarārimukham| śarārimukhasādṛśyasyātra ṛjutve tātparyaṃ? natvāyāme, ‘śeṣāṇi tu ṣaḍaṅgulāni’ ityanantarokteḥ’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ| vāgbhaṭe tu śarāryāsyaṃ kartarī ceti pṛthageva śastradvayaṃ paṭhyate| yathā- “srāvye śarāryāsyatrikūrcake”, tathā- ‘snāyusūtrakacacchede kartarī kartarīnibhā”- iti| “kartarī tribhāgapāśā vraṇasnāyukeśasūtracchedanārthā” iti vṛddhavāgbhaṭaḥ| karmāpyubhayorbhinnamevoktaṃ śarāryāsyasya visrāvaṇaṃ, kartaryāśca chedanam| atrāpi śastrāṇāmaṣṭavidhakarmaṇi viṣayabhedakathanāvasare ‘sūcīkuśapatrāṭīmukhaśarārimukhāntarmukhatrikūrcakāni visrāvaṇe’ iti vākyena śarārimukhasya visrāvaṇameva karmoktaṃ, kartaryāstu karma chedanameva| tasmādetacchastradvayaṃ pṛthageva bhavitumarhati sañjñā; tāṃ ca dvādaśāṅgulāṃ calatpāśāṃ kuryāt| antarmukhamiti madhyamukhaṃ, tallakṣaṇamāha- “aṣṭā(saptā)ṅgulaṃ ‘saptāṅgulapramāṇena’ iti bhānumatyāṃ pāṭhaḥ| antarmukhalakṣaṇaṃ vāgbhaṭe evaṃ paṭhyate- ‘tadvadantarmukhaṃ tasya phalamadhyardhamaṅgulam| ardhacandrānanaṃ caitat’- (vā. sū. a. 26) iti pramāṇena jihmādhāreṇa cāplutam| śastramantarmukhaṃ nāma candrārdhamiva ‘candraśṛṅgamivonnatam’ iti pā. codgatam”- iti| trikūrcakamiti trayaḥ kūrcā yasya tat trikūrcakam ‘trayaḥ kūrcāḥ kṣudracchurikā yasya tattrikūrcakam’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ; atra tantrāntaraṃ- “aṅgulāni tathā'ṣṭau ca śastraṃ kāryaṃ trikūrcakam| phalairantarmukhākārairaṅgulairanvi(rāci)taṃ tribhiḥ|| ekaikasya phalasyaiṣāmantaraṃ vrīhisammitam| vṛntaṃ pañcāṅgulāyāmaṃ kāryaṃ rucakabhūṣitam”- iti| kuṭhāriketi kuṭhārikālakṣaṇaṃ vāgbhaṭe evaṃ paṭhyate, - “pṛthuḥ kuṭhārī godantasadṛśā'rdhāṅgulānanā| tayordhvadaṇḍayā vidhyeduparyasthnāṃ sthitāṃ sirām”- iti kuṭhāratulyā kuṭhārikā, atra tantrāntaraṃ “kuṭhārikāyā vṛntaṃ syāt sārdhasaptāṅgulāyatam| phalamardhāṅgulāyāmaṃ godantasadṛśaṃ samam”- iti| vrīhimukhamiti ‘vrīhivistāraṃ mukhamasyeti vrīhimukham’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ| vrīhimukhalakṣaṇaṃ vṛddhavāgbhaṭe evaṃ paṭhyate- “vrīhimukhamadhyardhāṅgulaphalaṃ māṃsalapradeśasirāvyadhārthaṃ vṛddhyudaragulmavidradhyādivyadhanabhedanārthaṃ ca-” iti vrīhimukhamiva mukhaṃ yasya tadvrīhimukham; atra bhojaḥ- “śastraṃ vrīhimukhaṃ kāryamaṅgulāni ṣaḍāyatam| dvyaṅgulaṃ tasya vṛntaṃ syāttatphalaṃ caturaṅgulam| tanmukhaṃ vrīhivistāraṃ tanusaṅgū(mū)ḍhakaṇṭakam”- iti| āreti āreva ārā, ārā carmakārāṇāṃ śastram; atra ārālakṣaṇaṃ vāgbhaṭe evaṃ paṭhyate, - ‘ārā'rdhāṅgulavṛttāsyā tatpraveśā tathordhvataḥ| caturasrā tayā vidhyecchophaṃ pakvāmasaṃśaye| karṇapāliṃ ca bahalām”- iti tantrāntaram- “ārā hyaṣṭāṅgulāyāmā kartavyā tu viśāmpate?| tilapramāṇaṃ tu phalaṃ tasyāḥ kāryaṃ samāhitam| dūrvāṅkuraparīṇāhaṃ vṛntaṃ gopucchasannibham-” iti| vetasapatramiti vetasapatramiva vetasapatram; atra bhoja,- “tīkṣṇamaṅgulavistāraṃ caturaṅgulamāyatam| aṅgulāni tu catvāri vṛntaṃ kāryaṃ vijānatā-” iti| baḍiśamiti baḍiśalakṣaṇaṃ vṛddhavāgbhaṭe evaṃ paṭhyate- “baḍiśo'tyavanatamukhaḥ sūcītīkṣṇāgro grahaṇe galaśuṇḍikārmādeḥ” iti baḍiśatulyaṃ baḍiśaṃ, baḍiśaṃ matsyavedhanamāhuḥ| atra tantrāntaraṃ- “baḍiśe cāpi kartavye pramāṇena ṣaḍaṅgule ‘daśāṅgule’ iti bhānumatyāṃ pāṭhaḥ| svānataṃ tu tayorekamekaṃ nātyānataṃ bhavet|| ardhapañcāṅgulaṃ vṛntaṃ śeṣaṃ kāryaṃ mukhaṃ tayoḥ| ardhacandrākṛti vaktraṃ (mukhaṃ) kāryaṃ nātyānatasya tu|| svānataṃ nāmayettatra ‘tasmāt’ iti pā. baḍiśaṃ ca bhiṣagvaraḥ| vṛntāgrayorantaraṃ syādyāvadardhāṅgulaṃ ma(mi)tam” iti| dantaśaṅkuriti kapālikāśarkarādidantadoṣaharaṇāya śaṅkurdantaśaṅkuḥ; atra bhojaḥ- “kāryaḥ ṣaḍaṅgulayāmo dantaśaṅkurvijānatā dantaśaṅkuśastraṃ vāgbhaṭe dantalekhanakamiti nāmnā prasiddham| tallakṣaṇaṃ ca tatraivaṃ paṭhyate- “ekadhāraṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ prabaddhākṛti caikataḥ| dantalekhanakaṃ tena śodhayeddantaśarkarām”- iti| śaṅkuvacca mukhaṃ tasya kāryamardhāṅgulāyatam|| caturasraṃ samaṃ caiva tīkṣṇadhāraṃ samāhitam| vṛntāgra tasya kartavyaṃ śastravrīhimukhākṛti|| kapālikāṃ śarkarāṃ ca dantasthāṃ tena śodhayet”- iti| eṣaṇīti eṣaṇīlakṣaṇaṃ vāgbhaṭe evaṃ paṭhyate- “gateranveṣaṇe ślakṣṇā gaṇḍūpadamukhaiṣaṇī| bhedanārthe'parā sūcīmukhā mūlaniviṣṭakhā” iti| bhedanaṃ tvatra kṣārāktasūtrapraveśanena’ iti tadvyākhyāyāṃ hemādriḥ| “eṣaṇyau dve suślakṣṇasparśe, tayorekā'ṣṭāṅgulā gatikothaśalyasrāvavatsu vraṇeṣu śuṣirānveṣaṇe, anyā sūcīsaṃsthānā kṣārāktasūtrapratibaddhā nāḍīnāṃ bhagandaragatīnāṃ ca bhedane” (vṛ. vā. sū. a. 34) ‘eṣyate anayā’ iti eṣaṇī; atra tantrāntaraṃ- “vraṇaistāsāṃ parīṇāho mukhaṃ gaṇḍūpadākṛti”- iti||3||

tatra maṇḍalāgrakarapatre ‘ardhamaṇḍalāgramaṇḍalāgrakarapatrāṇi cchedane lekhane ca’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ syātāṃ chedane lekhane ca, vṛddhipatranakhaśastramudrikotpalapatrakārdhadhārāṇi chedane bhedane ca, sūcīkuśapatrāṭī(ṭā)mukhaśarārimukhāntarmukhatrikūrcakāni visrāvaṇe, kuṭhārikāvrīhimukhārāvetasapatrakāṇi vyadhane sūcī ca, baḍiśaṃ dantaśaṅkuścāharaṇe, eṣaṇyeṣaṇe eṣaṇe iti apāṭite'vidīrṇe vā vraṇaśothe bhedanapūrvakameṣaṇe tīkṣṇakaṇṭakamukhī eṣaṇī syādityarthaḥ| pāṭitānāṃ vidīrṇānāṃ vā vraṇānāmeṣaṇe tu yantrādhyāyapaṭhitā gaṇḍūpadākāramukhī eva prayujyate| ānulomye tu prathamayavapatramukhī syāditi jñeyam| ‘anye punaḥ eṣaṇīnāṃ tīkṣṇakaṇṭakamukhatva-prathamayavapatramukhatva-gaṇḍūpadamukhatva-bhedādbahutvaṃ, tena ‘eṣaṇyaḥ eṣaṇe’ iti bahuvacanaṃ paṭhanti’ iti cakraḥ| “ānulomye teṣāmeva (bhagandarādīnāṃ) chedānukrame, ta eva hyeṣaṇyanusāriṇā śastreṇa yathākramamāmūlaṃ chidyante, vakṣyati ca “eṣaṇīṃ dattvā śastraṃ pātayet” iti hārāṇacandraḥ ānulomye ca, sūcyaḥ sīvane; ityaṣṭavidhe karmaṇyupayogaḥ śastrāṇāṃ vyākhyātaḥ “śastrāṇi tu ṣaḍviṃśatirbhavanti| tadyathā- dantalekhanamaṇḍalāgravṛddhipatrotpalapatrādhyardhadhāramudrikākartarīsarpavaktrakarapatrakuśapatrāṭāmukhāntarmukhaśarārimukhatrikūrcaka- kuṭhārikāvrīhimukhaśalākāvetasapatrārākarṇavyadhanasūcīsūcīkūrcakhajaiṣaṇībaḍiśanakhaśastrāṇi ceti| tatra trayamādyaṃ lekhane, vṛddhipatrādīni trīṇi pāṭane, catvāri bhedane, maṇḍalāgrādīnyaṣṭau chedane, kuśapatrādīni pañca pracchāne, kuṭhārikādīni ṣaṭ vyadhane, teṣāmārāvrīhimukhe bhedane chedane ca, sūcyaḥ sīvane, sūcīkūrcaḥ kuṭṭane, khajo mathane, eṣaṇyeṣaṇe bhedane ca, baḍiśo grahaṇe, nakhaśastramuddharaṇe chedyabhedyalekhyapracchāneṣu ca| iti dvādaśavidhe śastrakarmaṇyupayogaḥ” iti (vṛ. vā. sū. a. 34)||4||

teṣāṃ viṣayabhedamaṣṭavidhe karmaṇi darśayitumāha- tatretyādi| tatra teṣu madhye, syātāṃ bhavetām| cakāraḥ karmāntaraṃ samuccinoti| vṛddhipatretyādi| cakārāllekhane ca| sūcī ceti cakāraḥ kuśapatrotpalapatrakādīṃśca vyadhane samuccinoti| nanu, ubhayatrāpyekārthatvāt kimarthaṃ yantraśastrayormadhye baḍiśasya pāṭhaḥ? ucyate, yantrapaṭhitaṃ baḍiśaṃ yathāyogapariṇāhadairghyaṃ, śastrapaṭhitaṃ tu ṣaḍaṅgulameva tīkṣṇakaṇṭakamukhamevetyadoṣaḥ| eṣaṇīti ānulomyamatra visrāvaṇamabhipretaṃ, na tu ṛjukaraṇaṃ; kasmāt? ṛjukaraṇasya śastrakarmasvanirdiṣṭatvāt; yadi kathañcit syāt, tadā śastrakarmaṇāṃ navatvaprasaṅgaḥ, tasmādādya eva pakṣo nyāyya iti; cakārādvyadhane'pi| nanu, eṣaṇī yantraśastrayoḥ paṭhyate, prayojanaṃ cobhayatrāpyeṣaṇameva, tasmādubhayapāṭhe ko viśeṣaḥ? ucyate- yantrapaṭhitāyā eṣaṇyā ākṛtirgaṇḍūpadamukhī, pramāṇaṃ tu yathāyogapariṇāhadairghyaṃ; śastreṣu punareṣaṇyāḥ pramāṇamaṣṭāṅgulam, ākṛtistu tīkṣṇakaṇṭakayavapatramukhī cetyadoṣaḥ| dvyaṅgulādibhedena sūcīnāṃ bahutvāt ‘sūcya’ iti bahutvena nirdeśaḥ||4||

teṣāmatha yathāyogaṃ ‘teṣāṃ yathāyogaṃ grahaṇaṃ karmasu| eṣa śastragrahaṇasamāsaḥ| vṛddhipatraṃ tu’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ| ‘yathāyogamiti yathā bhedyādi śastrakarma yuktaṃ yogyaṃ bhavati tathā śastragrahaṇaṃ vaktavyamityarthaḥ’ iti cakraḥ grahaṇasamāsopāyaḥ karmasu vakṣyate- tatra vṛddhipatraṃ vṛntaphalasādhāraṇe bhāge gṛhṇīyāt, bhedanānyevaṃ sarvāṇi, vṛddhipatraṃ maṇḍalāgraṃ ca kiñciduttānena pāṇinā lekhane bahuśo'vacāryaṃ, vṛntāgre visrāvaṇāni, viśeṣeṇa tu bālavṛddhasukumārabhīrunārīṇāṃ rājñāṃ rājamā(pu)trāṇāṃ ca trikūrcakena visrāvayet, talapracchāditavṛntamaṅguṣṭhapradeśinībhyāṃ vrīhimukhaṃ, kuṭhārikāṃ vāmahastanyastāmitarahastamadhyamāṅgulyā'ṅguṣṭhaviṣṭabdhayā'bhihanyāt ‘viṣṭabdhayeti stambhanābhivardhitavegayā’ iti cakraḥ, ārākarapatraiṣaṇyo mūle, śeṣāṇi tu yathāyogaṃ ‘yathāyogamiti yathā samyagyogaḥ’ iti cakraḥ| atrāha vāgbhaṭaḥ- chedabhedanalekhyārthaṃ śastraṃ vṛntaphalāntare| tarjanīmadhyamāṅguṣṭhairgṛhṇīyāt susamāhitaḥ|| visrāvaṇāni vṛntāgre tarjanyaṅguṣṭhakena ca| talapracchannavṛntāgraṃ grāhyaṃ vrīhimukhaṃ mukhe|| mūleṣvāharaṇārthāni kriyāsaukaryato'param”- (vā. sū. a. 26) iti gṛhṇīyāt ||5||

teṣāmityādi| vṛntaphalasādhāraṇe bhāge iti vṛntaphalayormadhyadeśa ityarthaḥ| evam ityameva, yathā vṛddhipatraṃ vṛntaphalayormadhyadeśe gṛhyate tathā bhedanānyapītyevaṃśabdārthaḥ| bahuśa iti bahūn vārān, ‘sakṛdapaharat’ (sū. a.5) ityasyāpavādaḥ| vṛntāgre vāraṅgāgre, ‘gṛhṇīyāt’ ityadhyāhāraḥ| talapracchāditavṛntamiti hastatalapihitavṛntam; aṅguṣṭhapradeśinībhyāṃ `gṛhṇīyāt’ ityadhyāhāraḥ| aṅguṣṭhaviṣṭabdhayeti aṅguṣṭhāgre viṣṭambhitavegayā| mūlaṃ, tsaru, vāraṅgaṃ, vṛntamiti paryāyāḥ| yathāyogamiti yogānatikrameṇa| tadyathā- kānicidvṛntāgre, kānicidvṛntamadhye, kānicidvṛntamūle, karmayogāpekṣayetyarthaḥ||5||
teṣāṃ nāmabhirevākṛtayaḥ prāyeṇa prāyeṇeti vacanādāgamametattantramāgamāntaraṃ ca śastrākārābhidhāyakaṃ darśayati’ iti cakraḥ vyākhyātāḥ ||6||
saṅkṣepeṇa śastrākāraṃ darśayannāha- teṣāṃ nāmabhirityādi| teṣāṃ śastrāṇām, ākṛtayo lakṣaṇāni, nāmabhireva prāyeṇa vyākhyātāḥ||6||

tatra nakhaśastraiṣaṇyāvaṣṭāṅgule ‘cakrastu ‘nakhavardhanyeṣaṇyau’ iti paṭhati vyākhyāti ca- ‘vardhanī chedanī, ‘vṛdhu’ chedane, ityasmāt sādhyam’ iti| “nakhaśastramaṣṭāṅgulamekato'śvakarṇamukhamanyato vatsadantamukhaṃ sūkṣmaśalyoddhṛtau” (vṛ. vā. sū. a. 34) ityaṣṭāṅgasaṅgrahe, sūcyo vakṣyante, (pradeśinyagraparvapradeśapramāṇā ‘mudrikāyāṃ nibaddhaṃ syādvṛddhipatrasalakṣaṇam| dvyaṅgulaṃ mudrikāśastraṃ kṣurasaṃsthānameva ca” iti bhānumatyāṃ bhālukiḥ| mudrikāśastraṃ vāgbhaṭe'ṅguliśastramiti nāmnā paṭhyate| tallakṣaṇaṃ yathā- ‘kuryādaṅguliśastrakam| mudrikānirgatamukhaṃ phale tvardhāṅgulāyatam| yogato vṛddhipatreṇa maṇḍalāgreṇa vā samam|| tatpradeśinyagraparvapramāṇārpaṇamudrikam| sūtrabaddhaṃ galasrotorogacchedanabhedane”- iti| “aṅgulīśastrakaṃ mudrikānirgatamukhaṃ vṛddhipatramaṇḍalāgrādhyardhadhārānyatamatulyārdhāṅgulāyatadhāraṃ pradeśinīprathamaparvapramāṇāparṇavṛttamudrikaṃ dṛḍhasūtrapratibaddhaṃ kaṇṭharogeṣu prayujyate” (vṛ. vā. sū. a. 34) ityaṣṭāṅgasaṅgrahe mudrikā, daśāṅgulā ‘prastutāni śastrāṇi vyākhyāya, anantaramupayogitvenānupekṣyatvāccharārimukhāvāntarabhedabhinnaṃ śastrāntaramupadiśati- daśetyādinā| kartarī romādicchedārthaḥ śastraviśeṣaḥ’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ śarārimukhī sā ca (yā sā) kartarīti kathyate) | śeṣāṇi tu ṣaḍaṅgulāni ||7||

teṣāṃ pramāṇāni darśayannāha- tatra nakhaśastretyādi| anye tu nakhaśastrasthāne nakhavardhanīti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca- nakhavardhanī nakhacchedanī| sūcyo “vṛttā gūḍhadṛḍhāḥ pāśe tisraḥ sūcyo'tra sīvane| māṃsalānāṃ pradeśānāṃ tryasrā tryaṅgulamāyatā|| alpamāṃsāsthisandhisthavraṇānāṃ dvyaṅgulāyatā|| vrīhivaktrā dhanurvakrā pakvāmāśayamarmasu| sā sārdhadvyaṅgulā” iti vāgbhaṭaḥ (sū. a. 26)| ‘nigūḍhaḥ pāśo yasyāḥ, tasyāṃ pāśasya pārśvayormagnaṃ sūtraṃ na dṛśyate| dhanurvakrā'bhyadhikaṃ na praviśati, praviśatyeva dvitīyena vraṇauṣṭhenāgacchati’ itīnduḥ vakṣyanta iti aṣṭavidhaśastrakarmīye (sū. a. 25) ‘dvyaṅgulā tryaṅgulā’ ityādinā sūcyo vakṣyanta iti| etasyāgre mudrikākartarīśastrayoḥ kecinmānaṃ paṭhanti| taducyate- “pradeśinyagraparvapradeśapramāṇā, mudrikā, daśāṅgulā śarārimukhī sā ca (yā sā ) kartarīti kathyate”- iti| śeṣāṇīti atrāha vāgbhaṭaḥ- bāhulyenāṅgulāni ṣaṭ”, tathā “svonmānārdhacaturthāṃśaphalāni”- iti| bāhulyena prāyeṇa viśeṣapramāṇānuktau tāni śastrāṇi ṣaḍaṅgulāni kāryāṇītyarthaḥ, yatra viśeṣapramāṇamuktaṃ tatra tatpramāṇānyeva kāryāṇi| svonmānārdhacaturthāṃśaphalānīti svaṃ ca tadunmānaṃ ca svonmānam, unmānaṃ dairghyaṃ, tasmādardhaṃ caturthāṃśaṃ vā phalaṃ yeṣāṃ tāni svonmānārdhacaturthāṃśaphalāni nirdiṣṭapramāṇebhyo nakhavardhanyeṣaṇīsūcībhyo'nyāni śeṣāṇi||7||
tāni sugrahāṇi, sulohāni, sudhārāṇi, surūpāṇi, susamāhitamukhāgrāṇi, akarālāni, ceti śastrasampat ||8||

pramāṇākārābhyāṃ śastrāṇi nirdiśya śeṣaśastraguṇasampadaṃ darśayitumāha- tāni sugrahāṇītyādi| sugrahāṇi śobhanavāraṅgāṇi ‘gṛhyate'sminniti graho vāraṅgaṃ’ iti cakraḥ| sulohāni śobhanalohāni| sudhārāṇi śobhanadhārāṇi| susamāhitamukhāni piṇḍīkṛtamukhāni, anye tu suṣṭhu samyagāhitaṃ mukhaṃ yeṣāṃ tāni tathoktāni| akarālāni adanturāṇi| śastrasampat śastraguṇaḥ||8||

tatra vakraṃ, kuṇṭhaṃ, khaṇḍaṃ, kharadhāram, atisthūlam, atyalpam, atidīrgham, atihrasvam, ityaṣṭau śastradoṣāḥ | ato viparītaguṇamādadīta, anyatra karapatrāt; taddhi kharadhāramasthicchedanārtham ||9||

śastradoṣānnirdiśannāha- tatra vakramityādi| kuṇṭhaṃ sthūladhāratvenāromavāhi| khaṇḍam asamagram| kharadhāraṃ karkaśadhāram| atyalpam atitanu ‘atituccham’ iti pā.| ato viparītamiti vakrādiśastrebhyo viparītaguṇam, ṛjutīkṣṇasakalamasṛṇadhārādiguṇam| kiṃ sarvāṇyeva viparītaguṇānyādadītetyāha- anyatra karapatrāditi| kutaḥ punaretat? taddhītyādi|- tacchabdo yasmādarthe, hiśabdo hetau, yasmāt karapatramasthicchedanārthamato hetoḥ kharadhāram||9||

tatra vṛddhavāgbhaṭe tu ‘dhārā punaśchedanānāṃ māsūrī, lekhanānāmardhamāsūrī, vyadhanānāṃ visrāvaṇānāṃ ca kaiśikī’- iti paṭhyate dhārā bhedanānāṃ māsūrī, lekhanānāmardhamāsūrī, vyadhanānāṃ visrāvaṇānāṃ ca kaiśikī, chedanānāmardhakaiśikīti ||10||

aṣṭavidhe karmaṇi sukarmaniṣpādakatvena yathā śastrāṇāṃ sudhāratvaṃ bhavati tathā nirdiśannāha- tatra dhāretyādi| bhedanānāṃ vṛddhipatranakhaśastrādīnām| māsūrī masūradaladhārātanvī ‘masūradhārātanvī’ iti pā.| lekhanānāṃ maṇḍalāgrādīnām| ardhamāsūrī masūradaladhārārdhatanvī ‘masūradaladhārātanvī’ iti pā.| vyadhanānāṃ kuṭhārikādīnām| visrāvaṇānāṃ sūcīkuśapatrādīnām| kaiśikī keśapramāṇā| chedanānāmiti atra chedanāni vṛddhipatrādīnyeva, tāni yadā chedane prayujyante tadā teṣāṃ dhārā ardhakaiśikī ardhakeśapramāṇā tanvī kartavyā||10||

baḍiśaṃ dantaśaṅkuścānatāgre | tīkṣṇakaṇṭakaprathamayavapatramukhyeṣaṇī (gaṇḍūpadākāramukhī atraiṣaṇīlakṣaṇe ‘gaṇḍūpadākāramukhī ca’ iti pāṭho'nārṣaḥ, gaṇḍūpadākāramukhyā eṣaṇyā dhārārahitatvena śastratvābhāvāt| tasmādgaṇḍūpadākāramukhī eṣaṇī yantrameva, tīkṣṇakaṇṭakamukhī prathamayavapatramukhī ceti dvividhameva eṣaṇīśastram| ‘atra śastre baḍiśaṃ paṭhyate yantre ca, ubhayatrāpi cāharaṇaṃ karma kartavyaṃ, tathā eṣaṇyapi śastre yantre ca paṭhyate, eṣaṇaṃ ca ubhayatrāpi karmoktaṃ, tat kathamanayorbhedaḥ ...paraṃ yantrakarmāharaṇameṣaṇaṃ ca śarīrahiṃsāvyatirekeṇa kriyamāṇaṃ jñeyaṃ| śastrakarmāharaṇameṣaṇaṃ ca śarīrahiṃsāyuktaṃ, śastraṃ hi śarīrahiṃsakamiti ‘śasu’ hiṃsāyāmiti dhātvarthādapi bhavati| tena yatrāharaṇe eṣaṇe vā śarīrāvayavahiṃsā tacchastrakarma, śarīrahiṃsakaṃ tu yantrakarma, anenaiva ca karmabhedena yantraśastrayorapi bheda iti paśyāmaḥ’ iti cakraḥ| hārāṇacandrastu ‘baḍiśaṃ dantaśaṅkuścānatāgre tīkṣṇakaṇṭaprathamayavapatramukhe, eṣaṇī gaṇḍūpadākāramukhī’ iti paṭhati vyākhyānayati ca- “śaṅkuḥ kīlaka iveti śaṅkuḥ, dantaśodhanaḥ śaṅkurdantaśaṅkuriti śākapārthivāditvādrūpasiddhiḥ| ānatāgraṃ baḍiśamānatāgraśca dantaśaṅkurityānatāgre ‘napuṃsakamanapuṃsakena’ iti klībaśeṣaḥ| te punastīkṣṇakaṇṭakaprathamayavapatramukhe ityanvayaḥ| tathā ca tīkṣṇakaṇṭakamukhaṃ baḍiśaṃ prathamayavapatramukhaśca dantaśaṅkurityarthaḥ| atra gaṇḍūpadākāramukhatvena śastrābhāve'pyeṣaṇyāḥ śastratvena vyapadeśaḥ praṇidhānadoṣācchatravatkāryakarī bhavatītyākhyātuṃ, ato'vahitenaiṣā praṇidheyeti” ca) ||11||

āharaṇe eṣaṇe ca śastrāṇāṃ dhārāviśeṣaṃ darśayannāha- baḍiśaṃ dantaśaṅkurityādi| atra ānatāgre iti baḍiśasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ, na dantaśaṅkoḥ, kutaḥ? śaṅkutulyatvenaiva tasyānatatvadarśanāt| eṣaṇī trividhā bhavati tīkṣṇakaṇṭakamukhī, prathamayavapatramukhī, gaṇḍūpadākāramukhī ca| anye tu ‘tīkṣṇakaṇṭakaprathamayavapatramukhe’ iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- etadviśeṣaṇadvayaṃ baḍiśadantaśaṅkvoḥ; tena tīkṣṇakaṇṭakamukhaṃ baḍiśaṃ, prathamayavapatramukho dantaśaṅkuḥ, prathamayavapatramukhatvena dantaśaṅkormukhatanutvamākāraśca kathitaḥ, tena gaṇḍūpadākāramukhī ceti cakārādetadviśeṣaṇadvayameṣaṇyāmapi sambadhnanti| anye tu ‘tatra dhārā bhedanānāṃ māsūrī’ ityādigranthaṃ ‘eṣaṇī gaṇḍūpadākāramukhī ca’ iti yāvanna paṭhanti||11||

teṣāṃ pāyanā nirvṛttānāṃ śastrāṇāṃ (agnitaptānāṃ) tatkṣaṇāddravadravyeṣu nirvāpaṇaṃ pāyanā’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ trividhā kṣārodakataileṣu | tatra kṣārapāyitaṃ śaraśalyāsthicchedaneṣu, udakapāyitaṃ māṃsacchedanabhedanapāṭaneṣu, tailapāyitaṃ sirāvyadhanasnāyucchedaneṣu ||12||

tatra pāyanāyāstīkṣṇatvādayo guṇāḥ karmaviśeṣotkarṣahetavo ‘karmaviśeṣasaukaryahetavaḥ’ iti pā. bhavantīti tāmāha- teṣāṃ pāyanetyādi| pāyanā pātuṃ prayojanā, sā ca lauhakārāṇāṃ prasiddhā kecit kṣāratailapāyanayoranārṣatvamācakṣate| kṣārādipāyanānāṃ karmaviśeṣaviṣayaṃ darśayannāha- tatra kṣārapāyitamityādi||12||

teṣāṃ niśānārthaṃ ślakṣṇaśilā māṣavarṇā; dhārāsaṃsthāpanārthaṃ ‘dhārāsampādanārthaṃ’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ śālmalīphalakamiti vāgbhaṭe śastrasaṃsthāpanārthaṃ śastrakośo'pyuktaḥ| yathā- “syānnavāṅgulavistāraḥ sughano dvādaśāṅgulaḥ| kṣaumapatrorṇakauśeyadukūlamṛducarmajaḥ| vinyastapāśaḥ susyūtaḥ sāntarorṇāsthaśastrakaḥ| śalākāpihitāsyaśca śastrakośaḥ susañcayaḥ”- iti| ‘sāntarāṇi savyavadhānāni, ūrṇāsthāni śastrāṇi yasmin sa sāntarorṇāsthaśastrakaḥ’ ityaruṇadattaḥ||13||

sudhārāṇīti prāguktaṃ, kathaṃ dhārā śobhanā kartavyetyatrāha- teṣāmityādi| ślakṣṇā akarkaśā| dhārāsaṃsthāpanārthaṃ sthirīkaraṇārtham| phalakaṃ paṭṭakam| tatrāniśitadhārāṇāṃ niśānārthaṃ ślakṣṇaśilā, niśitānāṃ saṃsthāpanārthaṃ śālmalīphalakam| anye tu ‘teṣāṃ niśānī ślakṣṇaśilikā māṣayūṣaprabhā, dhārāsaṃsthāpanaṃ śālmalīphalakam’ iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- ślakṣṇaśilikā nāpitaśilikā, māṣayūṣaprabhā kṛṣṇakapiletyarthaḥ||13||
bhavati cātra- yadā suniśitaṃ śastraṃ romacchedi susaṃsthitam | sugṛhītaṃ pramāṇena tadā karmasu yojayet ||14||

kathaṃ punaḥ śastraṃ saṃsthāpitadhāraṃ jñātavyamityāha- bhavati cātretyādi| yadā śastraṃ romacchedi bhavati tadā suniśitaṃ bhavati yāvadromāṇi na chinatti tāvanniśātavyamityarthaḥ| susaṃsthitaṃ śobhanākāram| sugṛhītaṃ grahaṇaṃ śastrāṇāṃ prāguktaṃ, tadyathā- ‘vṛddhipatraṃ vṛntaphalasādhāraṇe bhāge gṛhṇīyāt’- ityādi| pramāṇeneti pramāṇena lakṣitaṃ, śastrapramāṇaṃ ‘teṣāṃ nakhaśastraiṣaṇyāvaṣṭāṅgule’- ityādi| anye tu sugṛhītaṃ pramāṇeneti pramāṇena sugṛhītamiti vyākhyānayanti; tatra vṛddhipatrādi vṛntaphalasādhāraṇabhāgādigrahaṇapramāṇenetyarthaḥ| kecit ‘romacchedi’ ityasya sthāne ‘romavāhi ‘roma voḍhuṃ svabhāvo yasyeti romavāhi’ iti cakraḥ - iti paṭhanti||14||
anuśastrāṇi tu tvaksārasphaṭikakācakuruvindajalaukognikṣāranakhagojīśephālikāśākapatrakarīrabālāṅgulaya kuruvindaḥ ‘kurunda’ iti prasiddho'tikaṭhinaḥ pāṣāṇaviśeṣaḥ iti ||15||

aśastrāvacāraṇīyeṣu śiśuprabhṛtiṣvalābhādvā śastrāṇāṃ tatkarmasādhakadravyāntareṇa śastrātideśaṃ kurvannāha- anuśastrāṇītyādi| anuśastrāṇi hīnaśastrāṇi śastrasadṛśāni vā| tvaksāraḥ vaṃśaḥ; kuruvindaḥ pāṣāṇaviśeṣaḥ, yena niśitāni lohāni tīkṣṇāni bhavanti, anye tu kuruvindaṃ lohitāśma ratnapradhānaṃ; gojī gojihvā, anye śākhoṭakamāhuḥ; śephālikā śephālikā mahārāṣṭrabhāṣāyāṃ ‘pārijāta’ iti, hindībhāṣāyāṃ ca ‘hāraśṛṅgāra’ iti khyātā raktavṛntā śāradakusumā; śāko mahāvṛkṣaḥ karkaśapatraḥ; patraśabdo gojīprabhṛtibhiḥ saha pratyekaṃ sambadhyate; karīraḥ aṅkuraḥ||15||

div.ab: śiśūnāṃ śastrabhīrūṇāṃ śastrābhāve ca yojayet | tvaksārādicaturvargaṃ chedye bhedye ca buddhimān ||16|| āhāryacchedyabhedyeṣu nakhaṃ śakyeṣu yojayet | vidhiḥ pravakṣyate paścāt kṣāravahnijalaukasām ‘paścādagnikṣārajalaukasām’ iti pā.||17|| ye syurmukhagatā rogā netravartmagatāśca ye | gojīśephālikāśākapatrairvisrāvayettu tān ||18|| eṣyeṣveṣaṇyalābhe tu bālāṅgulyaṅkurā hitāḥ |19|

teṣāṃ viṣayamāha- śiśūnāmityādi| tvaksārādicaturvargamiti vaṃśasphaṭikakācakuruvindāni| āhāryacchedyabhedyeṣu nakhaṃ śakyeṣviti āhāryādiṣu nakhaśakyeṣu nakhaṃ prayojayedityarthaḥ| netravartma netrapakṣma| eṣyeṣveṣaṇyalābhe tvityādi eṣyeṣu śalyeṣu eṣaṇyā alābhe bālādayo hitāḥ||16-18||-

ab.seg: śastrāṇyetāni matimān śuddhaśaikyāyasāni tu | kārayet karaṇaprāptaṃ karmāraṃ karmakovidam ||19||

idānīṃ śastrāṇāṃ guṇasampatkāraṇaṃ vaktumāha- śastrāṇyetānītyādi| kārayet kartuṃ prayojayet| kaḥ kartuṃ prayojayet? buddhimān vaidya ityarthaḥ| kaṃ? karmāraṃ lauhakāram| kiṃviśiṣṭaṃ karmāraṃ? karaṇaprāptaṃ; karaṇe prāptaṃ svakarmaṇi nipuṇamityarthaḥ| punaḥ kiṃviśiṣṭaṃ? karmakovidaṃ karmapaṇḍitaṃ, yataḥ svakarmaṇi nipuṇamata eva karmakovidam| kāni kārayet? śastrāṇi| etāni pūrvoktāni kimbhūtāni śastrāṇi kārayedityāha- śuddhaśaikyāyasāni tviti; śuddhaṃ malarahitaṃ, śaikyaṃ tīkṣṇam; anye tu śaikyāyasāni sāramayalauhaghaṭitāni| kecicchlokārdhamanyathā paṭhanti;- “kārayet karaṇaiḥ proktaiḥ karmāraiḥ karmakovidaiḥ”- iti, vyākhyānayanti ca- karaṇairupakaraṇaiḥ; śeṣaṃ samam||19||
prayogajñasya vaidyasya siddhirbhavati nityaśaḥ | tasmāt paricayaṃ kuryācchastrāṇāṃ grahaṇe ‘śastrāṇāmāditaḥ’ iti pā. sadā ||20||

prayogajñasyetyādi| prayogaḥ prakṛṣṭo yogaḥ, yojanā, tajjñasya| siddhiḥ ārogyasampādanam| nityaśaḥ sarvadā| paricayaṃ śastragrahaṇābhyāsam| anye ‘pramāṇajñasya vaidyasya’- iti paṭhanti; pramāṇajñasya śastragrahaṇamānajñasya||20||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne śastrāvacāraṇīyo nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ ||8||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne śastrāvacāraṇīyo nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ||8||

div.head: yogyāsūtrīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto yogyāsūtrīyamadhyāyaṃ “kartavyakarmaṇaḥ samyagyogāya tatsadṛśakarmābhyāso yogaḥ, tena yogāya prabhavatīti yogyā| prabhavatītyarthe taddhitaḥ, strītvaṃ svabhāvāt maitrīvat| tasyāḥ sūtraṃ yogyāsūtraṃ| tadadhikṛtya kṛto granthastaṃ tathā” iti cakraḥ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta iti| yogyā samyakkarmābhyāsaḥ, yogyāyāḥ sūtraṃ, tadvidyate yasmin sa tathā; anye tu yogyākhyāpakaṃ sūtraṃ yogyāsūtraṃ, tadadhikṛtya kṛto'dhyāyo yogyāsūtrīyaḥ, taṃ tathā||1-2||

adhigatasarvaśāstrārthamapi śiṣyaṃ yogyāṃ kārayet | snehādiṣu chedyādiṣu ca karmapathamupadiśet | subahuśruto'pyakṛtayogyaḥ ‘yogāya samyagyogāya prabhavatīti yogyaḥ, tadviruddho'yogyaḥ’ iti cakraḥ karmasvayogyo bhavati ||3||

adhigatetyādi| snehādiṣviti ādiśabdāt svedavamanavirecanāsthāpanānuvāsanādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ, chedyādiṣviti ādiśabdādbhedyādīnāṃ saptānāṃ grahaṇaṃ; yadyapyasmin tantre chedyādikarmaṇāṃ prādhānyaṃ tathāpi chedyādiṣvapi prāk snehādi prayujyata iti prāk snehādigrahaṇam; anye ‘chedyādiṣu snehādiṣu ca’ iti paṭhanti| karmapathaṃ kriyāmārgam| kuto'dhigatasarvaśāstrārthamapi śiṣyaṃ yogyāṃ kārayedityāha- subahuśruto'pītyādi| akṛtayogyaḥ akṛtakarmābhyāsaḥ| karmasu kriyāsu||3||

tatra, puṣpaphalālābūkālindakatrapusai(so)rvārukarkārukaprabhṛtiṣu chedyaviśeṣān darśayet, utkartanāpakartanāni ‘utkartanaparikartanāni’ iti pā. copadiśet; dṛtibastiprasevakaprabhṛtiṣūdakapaṅkapūrṇeṣu bhedyayogyāṃ; saromṇi ‘saromṇītyanena lekhyasyānulomakartavyatāṃ sūcayati, pratilome hi lekhye rujāprādurbhāvo raktātipravṛttiśca’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ carmaṇyātate lekhyasya; mṛtapaśusirāsūtpalanāleṣu ca vedhyasya; ghuṇopahatakāṣṭhaveṇunalanālīśuṣkālābūmukheṣveṣyasya; panasabimbībilvaphalamajjamṛtapaśudanteṣvāhāryasya; madhūcchiṣṭopalipte śālmalīphalake visrāvyasya; sūkṣmaghanavastrāntayormṛducarmāntayośca sīvyasya; pustamayapuruṣāṅgapratyaṅgaviśeṣeṣu bandhanayogyāṃ; mṛduṣu māṃsakhaṇḍeṣvagnikṣārayogyāṃ; mṛducarmamāṃsapeśīṣūtpalanāleṣu ca karṇasandhibandhayogyām; udakapūrṇaghaṭapārśvasrotasyalābūmukhādiṣu ca netrapraṇidhānabastivraṇabastipīḍanayogyāmiti ||4||

śalyatantrasya chedyādikarmaprādhānyāt prāk chedyādiyogyāmupadarśayannāha- tatra puṣpaphaletyādi| puṣpaphalaṃ kūṣmāṇḍaḥ, kālindako jonnālaḥ kūṣmāṇḍabhedaḥ, trapusādayaḥ karkaṭībhedāḥ, prabhṛtigrahaṇācchīrṇavṛntādīnāṃ grahaṇam| chedyaviśeṣāniti gotīrthārdhalāṅgalakaprabhṛtīn| utkartanam ūrdhvakartanam, aparakartanam ‘parikartanaṃ’ iti pā. adhaśchedaḥ| dṛtibastītyādi dṛtiḥ carmapuṭakaṃ ‘khallāpadādi carma’ iti pā., bastiḥ mūtrapuṭakaṃ, prasevakaḥ carmakhallapuṭaḥ ‘carmakhallaṭakaḥ’ iti pā., udakapaṅkamiti udakamiśraḥ paṅkaḥ udakapaṅkaḥ| saromṇītyādi| ātate prasārite| mṛtapaśusirāsviti mṛtāḥ paśavo'jādayasteṣāṃ sirāsu| panasetyādi panaso bahiḥkaṇṭakī mahāphalaḥ ‘kaṭahala’ iti loke; panasādīnāṃ phalāni teṣāṃ majjā| madhūcchiṣṭetyādi madhūcchiṣṭaṃ madhusikthakam| śālmalīphalake śālmalīpaṭṭake| pustamayetyādi pustamayaḥ puruṣo vastrādiracito manuṣyaḥ| mṛducarmetyādi māṃsapeśī māṃsavartiḥ| udaketyādi| netrapraṇidhānaṃ netrapraveśanaṃ, bastivraṇabastipīḍanaṃ ca, anayoryogyāṃ kārayet; kva kārayet? udakapūrṇaghaṭapārśvasrotasi; na kevalaṃ jalapūrṇaghaṭapārśvacchidre alābūmukhādiṣu cetyarthaḥ||4||
bhavataścātra- evamādiṣu medhāvī yogyārheṣu yathāvidhi | dravyeṣu yogyāṃ kurvāṇo na pramuhyati karmasu ||5||
bhavataścātretyādi| evamādiṣviti ādiśabdaḥ prakāre, evamprakāreṣu yogyārheṣu puṣpaphalādiṣu||5||
tasmāt kauśalamanvicchan śastrakṣārāgnikarmasu | yasya yatreha sādharmyaṃ tatra yogyāṃ samācaret ||6||

tasmādityādi| yasya karmaṇaḥ, yatra yasmin dravye, sādharmyaṃ sāmyaṃ, tasya tatra yogyāṃ samācarediti| kecidevamādiṣu medhāvītyādiślokasyāgre āpātanikāpūrvaṃ ślokamekaṃ paṭhanti; tadyathā- anuktaṃ yogyāviṣayamupagrahītumāha- ‘dṛṣṭāntamātramuddiṣṭaṃ’- ityādi, sa ca vartamāneṣu pustakeṣu na paṭhyata ityasmābhirupekṣitaḥ||6||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne yogyāsūtrīyo nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ ||9||

div.ab: iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne yogyāsūtrīyo nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ|

ab.seg: athāto viśikhānupraveśanīyamadhyāyaṃ “viśikhā'tra karmamārga ucyate, taduddiśyānupraveśanaṃ| yadi vā viśikhā rathyaiva, tasyāṃ cikitsārthamanupraveśanam” iti cakraḥ| “praśastavartmāparaparyāyo'pi viśikhāśabdo'trāturāvāsavartmamātre pravartate, gamakatvāt” iti hārāṇacandraḥ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi| viśikhā'tra karmamārgaḥ, viśikhāyā(yāṃ) anupraveśanaṃ tadadhikṛtya kṛto'dhyāyo viśikhānupraveśanīyaḥ; taṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1-2||

adhigatatantreṇopāsitatantrārthena dṛṣṭakarmaṇā kṛtayogyena śāstraṃ nigadatā ‘śāstrārthaṃ nigadatā’ pā. rājānujñātena ‘niṣpannena vaidyena prajāpālake rājñi ātmā guṇato darśanīyaḥ, tato rājñā parīkṣya vaidyaḥ prajārakṣārthamanumantavya eṣa dharmaḥ| aniṣpannavaidyaguṇāścikitsāṃ kurvāṇo lokāpakārakatayā rājñā śāsanīyaḥ’ iti cakraḥ nīcanakharomṇā śucinā śuklavastraparihitena chatravatā daṇḍahastena sopānatkenānuddhataveśena sumanasā kalyāṇābhivyāhāreṇākuhakena bandhubhūtena bhūtānāṃ susahāyavatā vaidyena viśikhā'nupraveṣṭavyā ||3||

yādṛśasya vaidyasya karmamārgapraveśādhikārastādṛśaṃ vaktumāha- adhigatatantreṇetyādi| adhigatatantreṇa paṭhitaśāstreṇa| upāsitatantrārthena gurupārśvādabhyastaśāstrārthena, dṛṣṭakarmaṇā dṛṣṭacchedyādisnehādikarmaṇā, kṛtayogyena kṛtakarmābhyāsena, śāstraṃ nigadatā pāṭhārthābhyāṃ niyamenādeśena śāstraṃ vadatā, etena svāvartitaśāstratā uktā bhavati; anye tu ‘śāstrārthaṃ nigadatā’ iti paṭhanti, ‘śāstrāṇi nigadatā’ ityapare| rājānujñātena rājñā abhimatena, rājā hi prajāpālanatatparaḥ, tatpramādādvaidyapratirūpakā rāṣṭraṃ caranti kaṇṭakabhūtā lokasya, tasmādrājñā parīkṣyānujñātena viśikhā'nupraveṣṭavyeti| karmajñatāṃ śāstrajñatāṃ ca vaidyasyābhidhāya bāhyaveśamadhikṛtyāha- nīcanakharomṇetyādi| klṛptatvānnīcamalpaṃ nakhaṃ roma ca yasya tena; nīcanakhatvācchucitā karmasaukaryaṃ ca, nīcaromatvādārjavaṃ, rasavatyāmabādha ityapare| śucineti bāhyasnānādiśaucayuktena, kutaḥ? bāhyaveśādhikārāt; bāhyaśaucāyogālloke vigarhaṇīyaḥ, antaḥśaucaṃ tu sumanasetyanenaiva boddhavyam| śuklavastraparidhānaṃ maṅgalārthaṃ śaucārjavārthaṃ vā| chatravatā ātaparajovarṣāpannagādiniṣedhārthaṃ chatrayuktena| daṇḍahastena daṇḍo'valambanadaṇḍaḥ, tasya dhāraṇaṃ skhalitādiniṣedhārtham| sopānatkena prāṇihitāsahitena, prāṇihitādhāraṇaṃ kaṇṭakādiniṣedhārtham| anuddhataveśena sādhujanaveśena, etenāyuktakāyaveśaniṣedhaḥ; anye tu nānāvastrāṅgarāgamālyānulepanavicitrabhūṣaṇādibhiruddhato veśaḥ, ato viparyayeṇānuddhata iti manyante ‘anuddhatānāmāryāṇāṃ veśo vastrakeśādiracanā anuddhataveśaḥ’ iti cakraḥ| kāyaṃ niyamya mano niyamayannāha- sumanasā śobhanamanasā, akrauryādiguṇayuktamanasetyarthaḥ; daurmanasyaṃ tu yātrāyāṃ na praśasyata iti sumanasā bhavitavyam| vācaṃ niyamayannāha- kalyāṇābhivyāhāreṇeti|- kalyāṇaṃ maṅgalam, abhivyāhāro bhāṣitaṃ, yasya sa tathā; tacca sarvajanahṛdayagrahaṇārtham| kāyavāṅmanaḥsu triṣvapi niyamayannāha- akuhakeneti; kuhakaḥ śāstrahīnaḥ paramaviśvāsakārako māyāvī, na kuhako'kuhakaḥ; anye tvakuhakena avismāpakena, dambhādyayogādavismāpakakāyādiveśenetyarthaḥ| susahāyavatā sādhusahāyena, anyathā'ntaḥpuracāriṇo vaidyasya sahāyadoṣeṇa doṣaḥ syāt; sahāyaścātmarakṣārthamāturaparicaryārthaṃ ca| nanu, prāṇināṃ jīvatāmeva sadyaskarudhiropadeśāt kathaṃ ‘bandhubhūtena bhūtānām’ ityuktaṃ? satyaṃ, vidhiprāpitatvādadoṣaḥ, ālambhayoge paśuhananavat||3||

tato dūtanimittaśakunamaṅgalānulomyenāturagṛhamabhigamya, upaviśya, āturamabhipaśyet spṛśet pṛcchecca | tribhiretairvijñānopāyai rogāḥ prāyaśo veditavyā ityeke; tattu na samyak, ṣaḍvidho hi rogāṇāṃ vijñānopāyaḥ, tadyathā- pañcabhiḥ śrotrādibhiḥ praśnena ceti ||4||

tato dūtanimittetyādi| gamanāya praśnāya vā āgataḥ puruṣo dūtaḥ, nimittamanukūlaṃ surabhivātādi, śakunaṃ pakṣiviśeṣapraśastavākyādi, maṅgalaṃ svastikapūrṇakumbhādi, eṣāmanulomyena praśastatayetyarthaḥ| tribhiretairityādi tribhiretairvijñānopāyairanantaroktairdarśanasparśanapraśnaiḥ| hiśabdo yasmādarthe| śrotrādibhiriti ādiśabdāttvaṅnetrarasanaghrāṇāni gṛhyante||4||

tatra śrotrendriyavijñeyā ‘śabdendriyavijñeyā’ iti pā. viśeṣā rogeṣu vraṇāsrāvavijñānīyādiṣu vakṣyante- ‘tatra saphenaṃ raktamīrayannanilaḥ saśabdo nirgacchati’(sū. a.26) ityevamādayaḥ, sparśanendriyavijñeyāḥ śītoṣṇaślakṣṇakarkaśamṛdukaṭhinatvādayaḥ (sparśaviśeṣā ‘sparśaviśeṣāḥ’ iti hastalikhitapustake na paṭhyate ) jvaraśophādiṣu, cakṣurindriyavijñeyāḥ śarīropacayāpacayāyurlakṣaṇabalavarṇavikārādayaḥ, rasanendriyavijñeyāḥ pramehādiṣu rasaviśeṣāḥ, ghrāṇendriyavijñeyā ‘gandhendriyavijñeyā’ iti pā. ariṣṭaliṅgādiṣu vraṇānāmavraṇānāṃ ca gandhaviśeṣāḥ, praśnena ca vijānīyāddeśaṃ kālaṃ jātiṃ sātmyamātaṅkasamutpattiṃ vedanāsamucchrāyaṃ balamantaragniṃ ‘dīptāgnitāṃ’ iti pā. vātamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ pravṛttimapravṛttiṃ kālaprakarṣādīṃśca viśeṣān | ātmasadṛśeṣu hārāṇacandrastu ‘ātmāsadṛśeṣu’ iti paṭhati vyākhyāti ca- “nanvātmano hīnendriyatve kā gatirityāha- ātmāsadṛśeṣvityādi| ucitāparaparyāyo'yaṃ sadṛśaśabdaḥ ‘sadṛśaṃ same ucite’ iti medinī| tataścātmāsadṛśeṣu ātmano'nuciteṣu ayukteṣu hīneṣvati yāvat, vijñānābhyupāyeṣu vijñānopāyeṣvindriyeṣu satsvityarthaḥ, tatsthānīyairāturāvāsasthaiḥ puruṣairjānīyāt tāṃstānindriyavijñeyān viṣayān bhiṣagityarthaḥ| ‘ātmasadṛśeṣu’ iti prāmādikaḥ pāṭhaḥ” iti| “tribhiretairvijñānopāyairdīrghāyuṣo'lpāyuṣaśca veditavyāḥ| tatra dṛṣṭvā śarīropacayāpacayau varṇavikṛtiṃ chāyāṃ cāturasya bhiṣagjānīyāt, spṛṣṭvā śītoṣṇādīn sparśaviśeṣān viparītāviparītān jvaraśophādiṣu, pṛṣṭvā deśaṃ kālaṃ jātisātmyamātaṅkasamutpattiṃ vedanāsamucchrāyaṃ balābalamagniṃ vātamūtrapurīṣāṇāmapravṛttiṃ pravṛttiṃ ceti” iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ vijñānābhyupāyeṣu tatsthānīyairjānīyāt ||5||

tatra śrotretyādi| śabdendriyavijñeyā viśeṣāḥ santi rogeṣu, te vraṇāsrāvavijñānīyādiṣu vakṣyante iti sambandhaḥ| śarīropacayetyādi upacayaḥ sthaulyam, apacayaḥ kārśyaṃ, balamatrotsāhaḥ| nanu pramehādiṣu rasā madhurādayo makṣikāpipīlikādyupasarpaṇena bhiṣagbhiranumeyāḥ, tat kathaṃ rasanendriyavijñeyā iti? ucyate, nātra bhiṣajāṃ rasanendriyaṃ kintu pipīlikādīnāmityadoṣaḥ| ariṣṭaliṅgādiṣu ye vraṇānāmavraṇānāṃ ca gandhaviśeṣāste ghrāṇendriyavijñeyā ‘gandhendriyavijñeyā’ iti pā. iti sambandhaḥ| deśastrividho jāṅgalānūpasādhāraṇabhedāt| jātiśabdo brāhmaṇādiṣu vartate| kālo dvividho nityaga āvasthikaśca; nityagaḥ ṛtulakṣaṇaḥ; āvasthiko dvividhaḥ- svasthasya bālyādibhedena, vyādhitasya jvarārambhādikālāvasthayā ca| sātmyamiti yadyasya sevitaṃ sat sukhāya sampadyate tattasya sātmyaṃ; tacca dvividhaṃ ceṣṭākhyamāhārākhyaṃ ca; ceṣṭākhyaṃ kāyavāṅmanobhedāttrividham, āhārākhyaṃ rasabhedāt ṣaḍvidham| ātaṅkasamutpattimiti samutpattiḥ kāraṇamucyate, tacca balavadvigrahādi| vedanāsamucchrāyamiti vedanā vātādivedanāstodādayaḥ, tāsāṃ samucchrāya udgatiḥ| balaṃ vyāyāmagamyā śaktiḥ| antaragnimiti kīdṛśo'ntaragniḥ? samo viṣamo mando vā| vātamūtrapurīṣāṇāmityatrādiśabdo lupto jñeyaḥ, tenārtavādhogataraktapittādīnāṃ grahaṇam| kālaprakarṣādīṃśca viśeṣāniti kiyān kalo'smin vyādhāvutpanna ityādīn bhedān, cakārādguhyadeśapravṛttapūyādīnāṃ grahaṇam| anye tu ‘deśakālajātisātmyaṃ’ iti samāsāntaṃ paṭhanti, sātmyaśabdo deśādibhiḥ saha pratyekaṃ sambadhyate; deśastrividho jāṅgalādibhedena, tadvaiparītyena deśasātmyamityādi vyākhyānayanti| apare tu ‘deśakālajātaṃ’ iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- jātaśabdo deśakālābhyāṃ saha pratyekaṃ sambadhyate; deśo bhūmirāturaśca; kasmin deśe jāṅgale'nūpe sādhāraṇe vā'yaṃ doṣaḥ sañcitaḥ? kasmin prakupitaḥ? kasminnayaṃ vyādhirutpanna? iti; tathā, āture'pi galādau kasminnavayave śleṣmasthāne pittasthāne vā?| ātmasadṛśeṣu doṣasadṛśeṣu, vijñānābhyupāyeṣu ṣaḍvidheṣu śrotratvakcakṣūrasanaghrāṇapraśneṣu| tatra vātasadṛśeṣu vijñānābhyupāyeṣu pañcendriyapraśneṣu vraṇe saśabdaphenaraktānilādinirgamanaṃ śravaṇendriyagrāhyaṃ, pāruṣyaraukṣyādikaṃ tvagindriyagrāhyaṃ, bhasmakapotāsthisavarṇatvaṃ cakṣurindriyagrāhyaṃ, kaṭugandhalājagandhāditvaṃ ghrāṇendriyagrāhyaṃ, kaṣāyarasatvaṃ rasanendriyagrāhyaṃ, todanabhedanacchedanādivedanāviśeṣāḥ praśnagrāhyāḥ; pittasadṛśeṣu vijñānābhyupāyeṣu śvayathuvraṇādīnāmauṣṇyaṃ tvagindriyagrāhyaṃ, nīlapītavarṇatvaṃ cakṣurindriyagrāhyaṃ, kaṭvamlarasatvaṃ rasanendriyagrāhyaṃ, tīkṣṇātasīgandhatvaṃ ghrāṇendriyagrāhyam, oṣacoṣaparidāhādikā ‘oṣacoṣaparigrahādikāḥ’ iti pā. vedanāviśeṣāḥ praśnagrāhyāḥ; śleṣmasadṛśeṣu vijñānābhyupāyeṣu snigdhapaicchilyādikaṃ tvagindriyagrāhyaṃ, śvetatvaṃ cakṣurindriyagrāhyaṃ, mādhuryādi rasanendriyagrāhyaṃ, visragandhāditvaṃ ghrāṇendriyagrāhyaṃ, kaṇḍūgurutvādivedanāviśeṣāḥ praśnagrāhyā iti| vaidyo jānīyāditi kān? vyādhīn; adhikāravaśādakṣarairanuktānapi; keṣu satsu? ṣaḍvidheṣvapi vijñānābhyupāyeṣvātmasadṛśeṣu vātapittaśleṣmasadṛśeṣu; kairjānīyāt? tatsthānīyaiḥ teṣāṃ śabdādīnāṃ sthānāni śrotrādīni, teṣvadhikṛtaiḥ śabdasparśarūparasagandhaiḥ tatsthānīyaiḥ; etenaitaduktaṃ- vātādiliṅgairāyurvedeṣvanirdiṣṭanāmadheyānapi vyādhīn kuśāgramatirvaidyo jānīyāditi| pañjikākārastu darśanādiparīkṣāṃ trividhāmeva paṭhati| ‘mithyādṛṣṭā vikārā hi’ ityādiślokānte “tasmāt parīkṣyāḥ satataṃ bhiṣajā siddhimicchatā| yuktyaiva vyādhayaḥ sarvaiḥ(rve) pramāṇairdarśanādibhiḥ”- iti ślokamadhīte, vyākhyānayati ca- darśanādibhirityevaṃ kartavye yat ‘pramāṇaiḥ’ ityadhikaṃ karoti, tadadhikapramāṇaprāptyarthaṃ, tena gandharasaśabdānāmapyavarodhaḥ; ye tvatrākṣaraiḥ ṣaḍvidhāmapi parīkṣāṃ paṭhanti, teṣāṃ samyak śāstrāvabodho nāstīti bhāṣate| ‘ātmasadṛśeṣu vijñānābhyupāyeṣu tatsthānīyairjānīyāt’ ityapi na pañjikākāraḥ paṭhati||5||
evamabhisamīkṣya sādhyān sādhayet, yāpyān yāpayet, asādhyānnaivopakrameta, parisaṃvatsarotthitāṃśca vikārān prāyaśo varjayet ||6||

evamityādi| sādhyaṃ dvividhaṃ- susādhyaṃ, duḥsādhyaṃ ca; asādhyaṃ dvividhaṃ- yāpyaṃ, pratyākhyeyaṃ ca| parisaṃvatsaretyādi parisaṃvatsarotthitāḥ saṃvatsarātītāḥ sarvartu ca mahābalā ye tān parivarjayediti; yadi hyekadoṣajāste bhaveyurevaṃ teṣāṃ taddoṣapraśamanartuṣu praśamo bhavedalpatā vā, sa ca na bhavati, tena teṣāṃ tridoṣajatvādhigamaḥ, atastān parivarjayet; athavā saṃvatsareṇottarottaradhātvanukramādasādhyatvaṃ prāyaśaḥ| prāyaśo bāhulyena, nāvaśyatayā; tena kecidraktagulmādayaḥ saṃvatsarānantaramupakramayogyā bhavanti, arditastu tribhirvarṣaiḥ sādhya iti||6||

bhavati cātra- mithyādṛṣṭā mithyetyādi|- dṛśiratra pratyakṣaparaḥ, pañcendriyavijñānādhikārāt| tadayamarthaḥ- mithyādṛṣṭā yāthātathyenāvijñātāḥ, durākhyātāḥ samyaṅnākhyātāḥ, duḥparimṛṣṭāḥ duṣpṛṣṭhāḥ| pūrveṇaivopalbdhe punarduṣparimṛṣṭeti viśeṣaṇaṃ hriyā jugupsayā vā alpīyaso'pyavayavasya parimṛśyatve'parihāryatvamāviṣkartumityāhuḥ, siddhe satyārambho niyamāyeti nyāyāt” iti hārāṇacandraḥ vikārā hi durākhyātāstathaiva ca | tathā duṣparimṛṣṭāśca mohayeyuścikitsakam ||7||

mithyādṛṣṭā iti rogiṇo vikārā ye mithyādṛṣṭā asamyagdṛṣṭāḥ, tathā durākhyātā rogiṇā na yāthātathyenoktāḥ, tathā duṣparimṛṣṭāḥ duṣparimarśitāḥ ‘durvicāritāḥ’ iti pā., te cikitsakaṃ mohayeyuḥ, evamavijñātā ye rogāstān parivarjayet||7||

tatra sādhyā api vyādhayaḥ prāyeṇaiṣāṃ duścikitsyatamā bhavanti | tadyathā- śrotriyanṛpatistrībālavṛddhabhīrurājasevakakitavadurbalavaidyavidagdhavyādhigopakadaridrakṛpaṇakrodhanānāmanātmavatāmanāthānāṃ ca; evaṃ nirūpya cikitsāṃ kurvan dharmārthakāmayaśāṃsi prāpnoti ||8||

tatra sādhyā ityādi| śrotriyasya vedārthaparipālanaparasya nityaṃ snānādibhirvyādhiparivṛddhiḥ; nṛpaterapi svātantryādyatkiñcanakāritvāt, anye tu saukumāryāt kriyā'sahatvāt; strīṇāṃ lajjayā vegādyuparodhādguhyavyādheraprakāśanācca; bālavṛddhayorvirecanādikriyāyogyatvenālpakriyatvāt, anye tu bālavṛddhavanitāḥ sukumāraśarīratvādbheṣajāsahiṣṇavaḥ; bhīruralpasattvatvānna śaknoti soḍhuṃ kriyāṃ; rājasevakasya rājāyattatvāt; kitavasya vyasanitvāt, kitavo dyūtakāraḥ; durbalasya bālavṛddhayoriva; vaidyavidagdhasyābhimānena nirdiṣṭānyathākāritvāt, vaidyavidagdho vaidyābhimānī, pallavagrāhītyarthaḥ; vyādhigopakasya vyādherakathanādeva; daridrasya dravyābhāvatve auṣadhābhāvāt; kṛpaṇasya lobhena bhaiṣajyānupādānāt; krodhanasya kopena rogaparivṛddheḥ; anātmavato'pathyācaraṇatvāt, anātmavān ajitendriyaḥ; anāthānāṃ paricārakābhāvāt, anāthā ekākinaḥ||8||

bhavati cātra- strībhiḥ sahāsyāṃ saṃvāsaṃ parihāsaṃ ca varjayet | dattaṃ ca tābhyo nādeyamannādanyadbhiṣagvaraiḥ dattaṃ tābhyo na gṛhrīyādannādanyadbhiṣak sadā| vedotpattiḥ śiṣyadīkṣā dānamadhyayanasya ca| prabhāṣaṇaṃ cāgraharamṛtucaryā tathaiva ca| yantraśastrāvacāraṃ ca yogyāsūtrīyameva ca| viśikhānupraveśaṃ ca daśakaḥ pramamo mataḥ’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ||9||

idānīṃ vaidyasya viśikhāyāmantaḥpuracāriṇaḥ pramādadoṣadvāraṃ niyamayannāha,- bhavati cātretyādi| sahāsyāmekatra sthitiṃ, saṃvāsaṃ prativeśavāsitāṃ, parihāsaṃ hāsyam| annādanyaditi annamannapānadravyaṃ gṛhṇīyāt, tasya vṛttihetutvāt; rājñā'numataṃ tu sarvameva gṛhṇīyāditi| saṃvāsamityatra kecit saṃvādamiti paṭhanti||9||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne viśikhānupraveśanīyo nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ ||10||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne viśikhānupraveśanīyo nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ||10||

div.head: kṣārapākavidhyadhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ kṣārapākavidhimadhyāyaṃ pacanaṃ pākaḥ, vidhiravacāraṇaṃ, kṣārasya pākavidhī yatra taṃ kṣārapākavidhim vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi| kṣāraśabdaḥ pākavidhibhyāṃ saha sambadhyate||1-2||
śastrānuśastrebhyaḥ kṣāraḥ pradhānatamaḥ, chedyabhedyalekhyakaraṇāt tridoṣaghnatvādviśeṣakriyāvacāraṇācca ‘chedyādikartṛtvaṃ kṣārasya bhagandaracchedanāḍīdāraṇakuṣṭhalekhanādinā” iti cakraḥ||3||

śastrānuśastrebhya iti śastrāṇi maṇḍalāgrādīni, anuśastrāṇi tvaksārādīni, tebhyaḥ kṣāraḥ pradhānatamaḥ, dve punaranuśastre ‘te punardve anuśastre’ iti pā. agnijalaukākhye pariśiṣṭe; taduktaṃ- ‘vidhiḥ pravakṣyate paścādagnikṣārajalaukasām’(sū. a. 8)’- iti; eṣāṃ trayāṇāmapi prādhānyamasti, ata evaiṣāṃ pṛthagadhyāyaḥ; atra jalaukasaḥ pradhānam, agniḥ pradhānataraḥ, kṣāraḥ pradhānatamaḥ; ‘kṣārādagnirgarīyān’ (sū. a. 12) ityatra yathā na virodhastathā tatraiva vakṣyāmaḥ| kasmāt kṣārasya prādhānyamityata āha- chedyetyādi| chedyādīni karmāṇyagnijalaukasorna sambhavanti, tena tābhyāṃ sakāśāt kṣārasya prādhānyaṃ, tridoṣaghnatvaṃ kṣārasya nānauṣadhisamavāyādityādinā sādhayiṣyati, viśeṣakriyāvacāraṇaṃ yathā pittārśaḥsu viśeṣeṇāvacāraṇam viśeṣakriyāyāṃ pānākhyāyāmapyavacāryate kṣāraḥ, śastrānuśastrāṇi tu pāne nopayujyante, ataḥ siddhamasya viśeṣakriyāvacāraṇaṃ| taduktaṃ vāgbhaṭena- “sarvaśastrānuśastrāṇāṃ kṣāraḥ śreṣṭho bahūni yat| chedyabhedyādikarmāṇi kurute viṣameṣvapi| duḥkhāvacāryaśastreṣu tena siddhimayātsu ca| atikṛcchreṣu rogeṣu yacca pāne'pi yujyate (vā. sū. a. 30)” iti||3||
tatra kṣaraṇāt kṣaṇanādvā kṣāraḥ ||4||

kṣārasya niruktiṃ kurvannāha- tatra kṣaraṇādityādi| kṣaraṇād duṣṭatvaṅmāṃsādicālanāt, śātanādityarthaḥ; anye tu kṣaraṇāddoṣāṇāṃ cālanāt| kṣaṇanāt tvaṅmāṃsādihiṃsanāt| ‘kṣaraṇāt’ ityatra ‘kṣapaṇāt’ iti kecit paṭhanti; kṣapaṇaṃ śodhanamabhipretam||4||

nānauṣadhisamavāyāttridoṣaghnaḥ naca vācyaṃ yadvātaharādikṣāradravyāṇāṃ dagdhatvānna tadguṇānvayo bhasmanīti, dṛṣṭo hi bhasmanyapi prakṛtiguṇānvayaḥ, uktaṃ hi ‘sakṣaudramindīvarabhasmavāri nihanti raktaṃ’ (u. taṃ. a. 45) ityādi” iti cakraḥ, śuklatvāt ‘dahanapacanādikartṛtayā āgneyatvam kṣārasya sphuṭaṃ, pittajayāya svaguṇaṃ saumyatvamasphuṭaṃ sphorayannāha- śuklatvāt saumya iti| saumyatve'pyasya nahi śītatvam, uṣṇatvasyaiva darśanāt| bhūtānāṃ cādṛṣṭaviśeṣayantrito melakaviśeṣaḥ samānāśrayamapi guṇaṃ nārabhate| yathā āmalake amlatvamārabhate noṣṇatvam’ iti cakraḥ saumyaḥ; tasya saumyasyāpi sato dahanapacanadāraṇādiśaktiraviruddhā, āgneyauṣadhiguṇabhūyiṣṭhatvāt ‘sa khalvā...’ iti pā. kaṭuka uṣṇastīkṣṇaḥ pācano vilayanaḥ śodhano ropaṇaḥ śoṣaṇaḥ stambhano ‘stambhanaḥ sirācchedādatipravṛttasya śoṇitasya, kṣāro hi chinnaṃ sirāmukhaṃ pācayitvā śoṇitagatiṃ niruṇaddhi’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ lekhanaḥ kṛmyāmakaphakuṣṭhaviṣamedasāmupahantā puṃstvasya cātisevitaḥ ||5||

kṣāraguṇakarmāha- nānauṣadhisamavāyādityādi| samavāyaḥ saṃyogaḥ; yato'yaṃ kṣāro'nekauṣadhisamavāyāttridoṣaghnaḥ, ataḥ pittārśaḥsvapi yaugikatvamasya| śuklatvāt saumya ityasyāgre kecidapiśabdaṃ luptanirdiṣṭaṃ varṇayanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- na kevalamuṣṇaḥ saumyo'pīti, tenāsya vakṣyamāṇamuṣṇatvamapi na virudhyate| dahanapacanadāraṇaśaktiraviruddhā himānīvat| pācana iti dvividho'pi kṣāraḥ; atra vraṇaśothasya pratisāraṇīyaḥ pācanaḥ, annājīrṇasya pānīyaḥ| vilayanaḥ śophasya vātakaphabhūyiṣṭasya| śodhano duṣṭavraṇasya, ropaṇaḥ śuddhavraṇasya, atra yogaśaktiprabhāvāttilayavakalkavat kṣārasya śodhanaropaṇatvaṃ na virudhyate; śodhana evāyaṃ kṣāraḥ, śuddhastu vraṇaḥ svayameva rohatītyanye; na hi śuddhe vraṇe ropaṇārthaṃ kṣāro'vacāryate sirādikṣaṇanabhayāt, tasmāt pāramparyeṇa ropaṇa iti; kecidasya ropaṇatvaṃ na paṭhantyeva| śoṣaṇo vraṇakledasya| stambhanaḥ śoṇitātipravṛtteḥ| upahantṛśabdaḥ kṛmyādibhiḥ saha pratyekaṃ sambadhyate; kṛmayo bāhyābhyantarāḥ, teṣāṃ dvividhaḥ kṣāra upahantā; āmaḥ apakvarasaḥ, medasaḥ pānīya evopahantā; puṃstvasya śukrasya||5||
sa dvividhaḥ- pratisāraṇīyaḥ, pānīyaśca ||6||

idānīmuktaguṇakarmaṇaḥ kṣārasya dvaividhyaṃ darśayannāha- sa dvividha ityādi| pratisāraṇīyaḥ pratisāraṇārhaḥ; pānīyaḥ pānārhaḥ, kṣārodakamityarthaḥ; ye cānye'pi pākyasarjikāyavakṣārā yathārogaṃ vaktavyāsteṣāṃ cūrṇavaṭakāvalehādiṣu prayogaḥ kartavyaḥ||6||

tatra pratisāraṇīyaḥ kuṣṭhakiṭibhadadrumaṇḍalakilāsabhagandarārbudārśoduṣṭavraṇanāḍīcarmakīla- tilakālakanyacchavyaṅgamaśakabāhyavidradhikṛmiviṣādiṣūpadiśyate atra vidradhiśabdo na paṭhyate hastalikhitapustakeṣu, saptasu ca mukharogeṣūpajihvādhijihvopakuśadantavaidarbheṣu tisṛṣu ca rohiṇīṣu, eteṣvevānuśastrapraṇidhānamuktam ‘kṣāro hi śoṇitena saha sambhūya tāni tāni karmāṇi karotītyāha- eteṣvityādi| eteṣu kuṣṭhādiṣu, cakārāt kaṭhināśrayeṣu tādṛśeṣu kaṭhinotsannavraṇamāṃsādiṣu caivānuśastrapraṇidhānaṃ yathāyogaṃ śastrānuśastrapraṇidhānānantaraṃ kṣārapraṇidhānamuktaṃ pūrvācāryairiti śeṣaḥ”| iti hārāṇacandraḥ||7||

pratisāraṇīyasya viṣayaṃ darśayannāha- tatra pratisāraṇīya ityādi| kiṭibhaḥ kuṣṭhaviśeṣaḥ; tasya pṛthagavidhānaṃ niyamena pratisāraṇīyasādhyatvajñāpanārthaṃ; dadru maṇḍalaṃ dadrumaṇḍalaṃ; kilāsaṃ tvaggataṃ śvitrakuṣṭhaṃ; carmakīlaḥ arśonidānapaṭhitaḥ; nyacchavyaṅgau kṣudraroganidānoktau; bāhyaśabdaḥ vidradhikṛmiviṣaiḥ ‘kṛmiviṣābhyāṃ’ iti pā. pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| viṣādiṣvityādiśabdādvalmīkādīnāṃ grahaṇam| ‘bāhyakṛmiviśeṣādiṣu’ iti kecit paṭhanti| ke te sapta mukharogā yeṣu kṣāra upayujyate, ityāha- upajihvetyādi|- upajihvādīn rogān mukharoganidāne vakṣyati| tisṛṇāṃ rohiṇīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ sannipātaraktajayorasādhyatvajñāpanārtham| kutaḥ punarupajihvādibhyo'nyeṣu mukharogeṣu kṣāro nopayujyata ityāha- eteṣvevetyādi| atrānuśastraṃ kṣāra eva| ‘eteṣvanuśastranipātanam’ iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ||7||
pānīyastu garagulmodarāgnisaṅgājīrṇārocakānāha- śarkarāśmaryābhyantaravidradhikṛmiviṣārśaḥsūpayujyate atrārocakavidradhiśabdau na paṭhyete keṣucitpustakeṣu||8||

pānīyaviṣayaṃ darśayannāha- pānīyastvityādi| garaḥ kṛtrimaṃ viṣaṃ, dūṣīviṣamityanye; agnisaṅgaḥ iti agniḥ sajyate līyate yasmādyena yasmin vā so'gnisaṅgaḥ, tena vātaślaiṣmikagrahaṇīvisūcikālasakavilambikādivikārā gṛhyante; śarkarā vātena bhinnā'śmarī śarkaretyucyate||8||
ahitastu raktapittajvaritapittaprakṛtibālavṛddhadurbalabhrama- madamūrcchātimiraparītebhyo'nyebhyaścaivaṃvidhebhyaḥ ||9||

kṣārasya yeṣvayaugikatvaṃ tānāha- ahitastvityādi| bhramaścakrārūḍhasyeva bhramaṇaṃ, mado viṣamadyaśoṇitottho vikāraḥ pūgaphaleneva mattatā, mūrcchā cetanācyutiḥ, parītaśabdo bhramādibhiḥ saha pratyekaṃ sambadhyate||9||
taṃ cetarakṣāravaddagdhvā parisrāvayet; tasya vistaro'nyatra ||10||

tatra pānīyakṣārapākaṃ vidhiṃ ca saṅkṣepeṇa darśayitumāha- taṃ cetarakṣāravadityādi| itarakṣāravat pratisāraṇīyavat; yathā pratisāraṇīyasya kāṣṭhadāhaḥ ṣaḍguṇodakapākastribhāgāvaśeṣānantaraṃ parisrāvaṇaṃ ca, tadvat pānīyasyāpi pākavidhiḥ srāvaṇaṃ ca dvitīyapākavarjaṃ; pānīyakṣārodakapramāṇamuttamā ‘mātrā tu palatrikarṣārdhapalarūpā uttamamadhyamādhamabaleṣu’ iti cakraḥ mātrā palaṃ, madhyamā karṣatrayam, adhamā ardhapalam| anyatra gulmādiṣvadhyāyeṣu||10||

athetarastrividho athetaro mṛdurmadhyastīkṣṇaśca’ iti pā. mṛdurmadhyastīkṣṇaśca | taṃ cikīrṣuḥ śaradi girisānujaṃ śucirupoṣya ‘śucirupavasanniti kṣāradrumasthitabhūtavighnopaśamārthaṃ, evameva ca grahaṇe bhaiṣajyaṃ guṇayuktaṃ bhavatīti darśayituṃ’ iti cakraḥ praśaste'hani praśastadeśajātamanupahataṃ madhyamavayasaṃ mahāntamasitamuṣkakamadhivāsyāparedyuḥ ‘asitamokṣakaṃ’ iti pā.‘adhivāsyeti samantrabalikarmādinā'dhivāsanaṃ kṛtvā’ iti cakraḥtato'paredyuḥ” iti pā. pāṭayitvā khaṇḍaśaḥ prakalpyāvapāṭya nivāte deśe nicitiṃ hārāṇacandrastu nicitaṃ kṛtvā’ iti paṭhati, vyākhyānayati ca -nicitaṃ kṛtvā rāśīkṛtya’ kṛtvā sudhāśarkarāśca prakṣipya tilanālairādīpayet | athopaśānte'gnau tadbhasma pṛthaggṛhṇīyādbhasmaśarkarāśca | athānenaiva vidhānena kalpena iti pā. kuṭajapalāśāśvakarṇapāribhadrakabibhītakāragvadhatilvakārkasnuhyapāmārgapāṭalānaktamālavṛṣakadalī- citrakapūtīkendravṛkṣāsphotāśvamārakasaptacchadāgnimanthaguñjāścatasraśca kośātakīḥ samūlaphalapatraśākhā dahet | tataḥ kṣāradroṇamudakadroṇaiḥ ṣaḍbhirāloḍya mūtrairvā yathoktairekaviṃśatikṛtvaḥ parisrāvya, mahati kaṭāhe śanairdarvyā'vaghaṭṭayan vipacet | sa yadā bhavatyaccho raktastīkṣṇaḥ picchilaśca tamādāya mahati vastre parisrāvyetaraṃ vibhajya punaragnāvadhiśrayet | tata eva kṣārodakāt kuḍavamadhyardhaṃ vā'panayet | tataḥ kaṭaśarkarābhasmaśarkarākṣīrapākaśaṅkhanābhīragnivarṇāḥ kṛtvā''yase pātre tasminneva kṣārodake niṣicya piṣṭvā tenaiva dvidroṇe'ṣṭapalasammitaṃ śaṅkhanābhyādīnāṃ pramāṇaṃ prativāpya atra guṇotkarṣārthamanuktānyapi dakṣaśakṛdādīnyāvāpyānyāhuḥ- “ślakṣṇaṃ śakṛddakṣaśikhigṛdhrakaṅkakapotajam| catuṣpātpakṣipittālamanohvālavaṇāni ca’ (vā. sū. a. 30) iti prakṣepādhikāre tantrāntarānuśāsanāt’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ, satatamapramattaścainamavaghaṭṭayan vipacet | sa yathā nātisāndro nātidravaśca bhavati tathā prayateta | athainamāgatapākamavatāryānuguptamāyase “āyase pātre iti lauhapātrasyaivātidṛḍhatvena kṣārābhedyatvāt| kiṃvā lauhapātre eva śaktyatiśayaḥ kṣārasya bhavatītyetadvacanādunnīyate’ iti cakraḥ kumbhe saṃvṛtamukhe nidadhyādeṣa madhyamaḥ ||11||

eṣa caivāpratīvāpaḥ kṣāro dvividhaḥ sapratīvāpo'pratīvāpaśca| āvāpānantaraṃ yatpunaḥ śaktyatiśayārthaṃ dīyate sa pratīvāpaḥ| tatrāpratīvāpo mṛduḥ saṃvyūhimasañjñaḥ, sapratīvāpaśca pākyasañjñastīkṣṇaḥ” iti cakraḥ pakvaḥ saṃvyūhimo mṛduḥ ||12||

athetara ityādi| itaraḥ pratisāraṇīyaḥ; athetaro mṛdurityādyatra kecinna paṭhanti| pratisāraṇīyasya pākavidhiṃ nirdeṣṭumāha- taṃ cikīrṣurityādi| taṃ pratisāraṇīyaṃ, cikīrṣuḥ kartumicchuḥ; taṃ cikīrṣurityatra ‘athetaraṃ cikīrṣuḥ’ iti kecit paṭhanti; athaśabdo maṅgalārthaḥ, itaraṃ pratisāraṇīyam| girisānujaṃ parvatoparijātaṃ, “girisānujamiti jāṅgaladeśopalakṣaṇam” ityanye| ‘śucirupoṣya’ ityatra ‘śucirupavasan’ iti kecit paṭhanti| anupahataṃ kṛmidavāgnigarādyanupahatam| asitamuṣkakaṃ ‘asitamokṣakaṃ’ iti pā. kṛṣṇapuṣpamokṣakaṃ, na śvetādipuṣpam| adhivāsya mantravadbalikarmopaharedityarthaḥ| kecidasyāgre “mantreṇānenābhimantrya- agnivīrya! mahāvīrya! mā te vīryaṃ praṇaśyatu| ihaiva tiṣṭha kalyāṇa! mama kāryaṃ kariṣyasi|| mama kārye kṛte paścāddevalokaṃ gamiṣyasi| śvetaraktapuṣpasahasraṃ juhuyāt” iti paṭhanti; ayaṃ ca nibandheṣu na paṭhyate| anye tvatra “prāṅmukhopagatastatra baliṃ dattvā caturdiśam| vṛkṣābhyāśe tato brūyāt prāñjaliḥ prayataḥ śuciḥ|| nivasantīha bhūtāni yānyasmin kāniciddrume| apakrāmantvayaṃ chedyaḥ parārthe ‘pūjanārthe mayā’ iti pā. śvo mayā drumaḥ| evamāmantritaṃ vṛkṣaṃ lājādhūpaiḥ surāsavaiḥ| prabhāte vaikṛtaṃ tatra na paśyecchedayettataḥ| śānte nīhāratimire yugamātrodite ravau| pūrvāgramuttarāgrasthaṃ taṃ taruṃ pāta(ṭa)yeddrutam” “ityadhivāsanamantraṃ paṭhanti, bhoje'pyevameva ‘bhoje'pyayameva’ iti pā. paṭhyate” iti ca vadanti| aparedyuraparasmin dine| khaṇḍaśaḥ prakalpya bahūn khaṇḍān kṛtvā| avapāṭya tān khaṇḍān punaḥ pāṭayitvā; ‘aparedyuḥ pāṭayitvā ityasya sthāne ‘prabhāte vaikṛtamadbhutaṃ na paśyettadopakalpayet’ iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ| vaikṛtaṃ taruśākhābhaṅgādi, adbhutaṃ rudhiravarṣādi, iti ca tasya vyākhyānam| nicitiḥ kāṣṭhānāmauttarādharyeṇāvasthitiḥ; kecidatra ‘citiṃ kṛtvā’ iti paṭhanti, citiṃ dāhasthānamiti vyākhyānayanti| tilanālairādīpayet tilanāladīpanācchaktyatiśayo bhavati| nicitiṃ kṛtvetyasyāgre kecit ‘sudhāśarkarāḥ prakṣipya’ iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- sudhāśarkarāḥ sudhāpāṣāṇāḥ| bhasmaśarkarāśceti ‘kāṣṭharaso bhasmani galito dagdhaḥ śarkarāsadṛśatvādbhasmaśarkarocyate| tathāca nighaṇṭuḥ, - ‘muṣkakāddahyamānāttu rasaḥ pracyavate hi yaḥ| bhasmanā saha saṃyuktaḥ kāṭhinyamupagacchati| tāṃ bhasmaśarkarāmāhuḥ’ ityādi” iti cakraḥ dahyamānārdrakāṣṭharasāccharkarevānyonyasaṃhataṃ bhasmajātaṃ bhasmaśarkaretyucyate, tāṃ ca pṛthak gṛhṇīyāt; pṛthaggrahaṇaṃ bhinnaprayojanārthaṃ; tena bhasmanaḥ kṣārodakakaraṇaṃ, bhasmaśarkarā punaḥ kṣāradravyasamavāpinī| anye tu ‘pṛthak gṛhṇīyāt’ ityasyāgre ‘kaṭaśarkarā bhasmaśarkarāśca’ iti paṭhanti, ‘kaṭaśarkarā adagdhasudhāpāṣāṇāḥ, bhasmaśarkarāstu kṣāradravyaiḥ saha dagdhāścūrṇapāṣāṇāḥ’ iti ca vyākhyānayanti| eṣa dāhakalpaḥ| athānenaivetyādi| athānenaiva vidhānenetyanena nivātadeśanicitistilanāladīpanaṃ ca labhyate, girisānujamityasya jāṅgaladeśopalakṣaṇatvaṃ, tenehāpi kuṭajādīnyapi jāṅgalāni gṛhyante| muṣkakasya kuṭajādīnāṃ caikadeśakalpanatve'pi pṛthagdāhavidhānaṃ kuṭajādibhasmano muṣkakabhasmano bhāgādhikyakhyāpanārthaṃ, bhāgādhikyaṃ ca ‘tataḥ kṣāradroṇamudakadroṇaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ’- ityatra vakṣyāmaḥ| anye tu muṣkakeṇaikenāpi kṣāro bhavatīti pṛthagvidhānaṃ bodhayati| palāśaḥ kiṃśukaḥ; aśvakarṇaḥ pūrvadeśe gandhamuṇḍaḥ pippalasadṛśaḥ aśvakarṇaḥ sarjabhedaḥ” iti cakraḥ| ‘śālabhedaḥ’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ, pāribhadrako devadāruḥ, anye tu raktakusumaḥ kaṇṭakīvṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ svanāmnā prasiddhaḥ, tilvakaḥ svanāmaprasiddhaḥ; indravṛkṣaḥ kuṭaja eva, dvividho hi kuṭajo bṛhatphalaḥ śvetapuṣpaḥ snigdhapatraḥ pumān, aṇuphalavṛntā śyāvāruṇapuṣpā strī; āsphotā sārivā; kośātakī ghoṣakaḥ; sā caturvidhā- bṛhatphalā, alpaphalā, pītapuṣpā, śvetapuṣpā, iti| samūlaphalapatraśākhā iti kuṭajādibhiḥ saha pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| kecit kuṭajādikośātakyantaṃ samasya paṭhanti| tataḥ kṣāradroṇamityādi tato muṣkakakuṭajādidāhānantaram| kṣāradroṇamiti muṣkakabhasmano dvau bhāgau kuṭajādibhasmana eko bhāga iti miśrīkṛtaṃ kṣāradroṇamucyate| udakadroṇaiḥ ṣaḍbhiriti bhasmadravyāt ṣaḍguṇodakaparibhāṣeyam, anayaivānyatrāpi kṣārapākavidhau kṣārakalpanaṃ; pakṣāntaraṃ darśayati- mūtrairvā yathoktairiti dundubhisvanīyakalpoktairityarthaḥ annapānoktairgavādimūtrairityarthaḥ’ iti cakraḥ; tathāhi- ‘gavāṃ mūtreṇa kṣārakalpena parisrāvya vipacet’ (ka. a. 6)- iti; atrāpi kṣārakalpeneti vacanādbhasmadravyānmūtrasya ṣaḍguṇatvamuktam| ekaviṃśatikṛtvaḥ parisrāvyeti ekaviṃśativārān vastreṇa gālayitvā| avaghaṭṭayan cālayan, tāvat pacet sa yadā bhavatyaccho raktastīkṣṇaḥ picchilaśceti| ete'cchādayo guṇāstribhāgāvaśeṣe kṣārodake bhavanti| taṃ kṣārakvātham| ādāya gṛhītvā| itaraṃ vibhajya kṣārabhasmakalkaṃ; ‘itaradvisṛjya’ iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ, tatretarat bhasma kiṭṭabhūtam| adhiśrayet āropayet| tata eva kṣārodakāt kuḍavamadhyardhaṃ vā'panayediti kuḍavamaṣṭau palānyapanayet; adhyardhamityatra kuḍavamiti sambadhyate, tenādhyardhaṃ kuḍavaṃ dvādaśapalāni vā'panayet| anye tvatra dvaiguṇyaṃ na manyante| etacca kṣārodakāpanayanaṃ kaṭaśarkarādīnāṃ niṣekārthaṃ peṣaṇārthaṃ ca; anye tu kaṭaśarkarādīnāṃ bhāgapramāṇajñāpanārthamiti vadanti, tena kaṭaśarkarādīni dravyāṇi pratyekaṃ kuḍavapramāṇānyadhyardhakuḍavapramāṇāni vā āvapedityarthaḥ| tataḥ kaṭaśarkaretyādi kaṭaśarkarā gāṅgeṣṭhī, bhasmaśarkarā atraivādhyāye pūrvaṃ vyākhyātā; anye tu kaṭaśarkarābhasmaśarkarayoranyathā vyākhyānaṃ kurvanti tadapyatraivādhyāye kathitam| kṣīrapāko jalaśuktiḥ| āyase pātre lauhe bhājane, ete agnivarṇāḥ kṛtvā, tasminneva kṣārodake pūrvopanīte kuḍave'dhyardhakuḍave vā, niṣicya prakṣipya| traiṣāṃ ‘athaiṣāṃ’ iti pā. kaṭaśarkarādīnāmanirdiṣṭapramāṇatvāt samā bhāgā ityeke; samabhāgaścātra pratyekamaṣṭau palāni; evaṃ ca dvātriṃśat ‘catvāriṃśatpalāni’ iti pā. palāni bhavanti; etena dvidroṇe'ṣṭapalasammitamityapi pramāṇamanukūlitaṃ bhavati; dvidroṇe ṣoḍaśāṃśaścāvāpabhāgo jñāpito bhavati| anye tvaṣṭapalasammitamiti kaṭaśarkarādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ dve dve pale ityevamaṣṭapalatvaṃ manyante| tanna, śaṅkhanābhipradhānatvādeva kṣārasya; evaṃ ca viśvāmitrabhojoktabhāgakalpanā nirastā; taduktabhāgagrahaṇe'pi śaṅkhanābheraprādhānyaṃ syāt| dvidroṇagrahaṇena tribhāgāvaśeṣaṃ kṣārodakaṃ sarvatra paribhāṣayanti vṛddhāḥ, prāyeṇa hi vimiśritaṃ kṣāradroṇamāhuḥ; udakadroṇaiḥ ṣaḍbhiriti ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikapañcadaśaśatodakapalaiḥ saha vipacedityarthaḥ; tatastasya pacyamānasya taikṣṇyāccharaktapicchilādayo guṇāḥ ṣoḍaśāṃśāvaśiṣṭe ṣaṇṇavatipalapramāṇe bhavanti| anye tu vadanti- na cātra caturbhāgādyavaśeṣaṇādiparibhāṣā vyāpriyate, tasmācchanaiḥ śanaistāvadvipacedyāvadrāgādiguṇayuktaḥ kvātho bhavati kṣārasañjñita iti| ṣaṇṇavatipalapramāṇe tu kṣārodake kaṭaśarkarādīnāṃ samabhāgānāṃ caturthāṃśamāvāpamicchanti ‘caturthāṃśe āvāpamicchanti’ iti pā.||11-12||

pratīvāpe yathālābhaṃ dantīdravantīcitrakalāṅgalīpūtikapravālatālapatrīviḍasuvarcikākanakakṣīrīhiṅguvacātiviṣāḥ samāḥ ślakṣṇacūrṇāḥ śuktipramāṇāḥ pratīvāpaḥ | sa eva sapratīvāpaḥ pakvaḥ pākyastīkṣṇaḥ ||13||

sapratīvāpaṃ pākyasañjñaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ pratipādayannāha- pratīvāpe yathālābhamityādi| pratīvāpe iti kṣipte āvāpe punaraparadravyaprakṣepaḥ pratīvāpaḥ| dravantī dantībhedaḥ, saṃvarīti bhādānake, lāṅgalī kalikā(hā)rikā; pūtīkapravālāḥ kaṇṭakikarañjapallavāḥ, anye tu ‘ciribilvapallavapatraṃ ca’ iti paṭhanti; tālapatrī mūṣalī, kanakakṣīrī ‘kanakakṣīrī ‘kaṅkuṣṭha’ iti vyavahriyate’ iti cakraḥ suvarṇakṣīrī , kaṅguṣṭhamityanye| śuktipramāṇāḥ pratyekamardhapalapramāṇāḥ| sa eva sapratīvāpaḥ pakvaḥ pākyastīkṣṇa iti sa eva saṃvyūhimasañjñaḥ kṣāro dantyādidravyaprativāpena sahitaḥ pakvaḥ pākyasañjño bhavati tīkṣṇaścetyarthaḥ| na cāsya tīkṣṇadoṣaḥ, kutaḥ? atitīkṣṇaḥ kṣārasya doṣaḥ| anye tu ‘sa eva sapratīvāpa’ ityādipāṭhasthāne ‘sa ca pūrvavat pakvastīkṣṇa’ iti paṭhanti||13||
teṣāṃ yathāvyādhibalamupayogaḥ ||14||
teṣāṃ kṣārāṇām||14||
kṣīṇabale kṣīṇabalatvamatra dravakṣayādeva lakṣaṇīyaṃ| taduktaṃ vāgbhaṭe- ‘balārthaṃ kṣīṇapānīye kṣārāmbu punarāvapet’ iti” iti hārāṇacandraḥ tu kṣārodakamāvapedbalakaraṇārtham ||15||

kālavaśāddhīnauṣadhivaśādvā mṛdau kṣāre balakaraṇāyāvāpamāha- kṣīṇabale tvityādi| kṣīṇabale hīnaśaktau kṣāre kṣārodakamāvapet, pūrvakalpena kṛtaṃ kṣārodakaṃ prakṣipet, prakṣipya punarvipacediti| balakaraṇārthaṃ tīkṣṇādiśaktyupacayārtham||15||

bhavataścātra- naivātitīkṣṇo ‘kṣārasyātitīkṣṇatvaṃ vākśatāt prāgeraṇḍanāladāhāt, mṛdutvaṃ cārvāgapyadāhāllakṣaṇīyaṃ| yaduktaṃ ‘yadyeraṇḍajanālameṣa dahati kṣāro varo vākśatāt’ iti | vākśatādyadi dahati tarhi varaḥ śreṣṭho'nyathā tvavaro'titīkṣṇatvena mṛdutvena ceti tātparyam” iti hārāṇacandraḥ na mṛduḥ śuklaḥ ślakṣṇo'tha picchilaḥ | aviṣyandī śivaḥ śīghraḥ kṣāro hyaṣṭaguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ||16||

kṣāraguṇadoṣān pratipādayannāha- bhavataścātra naivātītyādi| atiśabdastīkṣṇamṛduśuklaiḥ saha pratyekaṃ sambadhyate; anatiśuklatvāt prativāpālpatā sūcitā bhavati; anye tvanatiśabdaṃ śuklena sambadhnanti| ślakṣṇaḥ akarkaśaḥ; anye tu ślakṣṇasthāne ‘mṛtsna’ iti paṭhanti, mṛtsnastvagindriyasukhaḥ| aviṣyandī yo'vacārito na prasarpati| śiva iti saumya ucyate; śivasthāne kecit ‘sama’ iti paṭhanti, tatra nātisāndro nātidrava ityarthaḥ| śīghraḥ śīghrakārī| kecit kṣāraguṇeṣu madhye ‘sukhanirgrāhyo doṣaghnaḥ’ iti guṇadvayaṃ paṭhanti; ‘sukhanirgrāhyaḥ sukhanirvartyaḥ, doṣaghno doṣamātrānusārī; doṣaśabdo'tra vyādhau vartate’ iti ca vyākhyānayanti| naivātitīkṣṇa ityādinaivāṣṭasaṅkhyā labdhā, ‘punaraṣṭaguṇa’ iti yat kṛtaṃ tat kaṭurasādiguṇātirekatvaniṣedhārtham||16||
atimārdavaśvaityauṣṇyataikṣṇyapaicchilyasarpitāḥ | sāndratā'pakvatā hīnadravyatā doṣa ucyate ||17||

parihārārthaṃ doṣānadhikṛtyāha- atimārdavetyādi| atiśabdo mārdavaśvaityādibhiḥ saha pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| śvaityaṃ śuklatā| kecit kṣāradoṣān sārdhaślokenādhīyate| tadyathā- “atyauṣṇyamatipaicchilyamatitaikṣṇyaṃ visarpitā| atyarthaṃ mārdavaṃ śvaityamatyarthaṃ sāndrameva ca| hīnauṣadhamavipakvatvaṃ kṣāradoṣā nava smṛtāḥ”- iti| atyarthaṃśabdaḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva saṅkhyā prāptā, punarnaveti saṅkhyākaraṇaṃ kṣārātisevayā puṃstvahantṛtvadoṣasaṅkhyāśaṅkānirāsārtham| kecit kṣāradoṣānna paṭhanti, uktaguṇaviparyayeṇaiva doṣāṇāṃ labdhatvāditi||17||

tatra kṣārasādhyavyādhivyādhitamupaveśya nivātātape deśe'sambādhe'gropaharaṇīyoktena vidhānenopasambhṛtasambhāraṃ, tato'sya tamavakāśaṃ nirīkṣyāvaghṛṣyāvalikhya pracchayitvā ‘avaghṛṣyetyādipakṣatraye pittaduṣṭamuttānamavaghṛṣya, vātaduṣṭamanatyavagāḍhaṃ vā'valikhya, kaphaduṣṭamavagāḍhaṃ ca pracchayitveti vyavasthā” iti cakraḥ, śalākayā kṣāraṃ pratisārayet, dattvā vākśatamātramupekṣeta ||18||

idānīṃ kṣārapratisāraṇavidhimadhikṛtyāha- tatra kṣārasādhyetyādi| kṣārasādhyavyādhivyādhitamiti kṣārasya sādhyo yo vyādhistena vyādhitaṃ duḥkhitam| nivātātape deśe iti niśabdo vātātapābhyāṃ saha pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| asambādhe'saṅkīrṇadeśe, agropaharaṇīyoktena vidhāneneti ‘praśasteṣu tithikaraṇamuhūrtanakṣatreṣu’ (sū. a. 5) ityādikena vidhinā; asya ca kṣāraṃ pratisārayedityanayā kriyayā sambandhaḥ| upasambhṛtasambhāramiti yantraśastrakṣārāgniśalāketyādisamīpasthāpitopakaraṇam| tataḥ sambhṛtasambhārānantaram| asya vyādhitasya, tamavakāśaṃ taṃ pradeśaṃ, nirīkṣyeti vyādhyākāravijñānārtham, avaghṛṣyeti pittaduṣṭam, avalikhyeti vātaduṣṭaṃ suptakaṭhinatvacaṃ, pracchayitveti kaphaduṣṭaṃ kaṇḍūśvayathuprabalaṃ, paścācchalākayā kṣāraṃ pratisārayedityarthaḥ; ‘kṣāraṃ pratisārayet’ ityasya sthāne ‘kṣāraṃ pātayitvā’ iti kecit paṭhanti| kālāvadhiṃ pratipādayati- dattvā vākśatamātramityādi|- vāk laghvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ ‘vākśatamātramiti śatākṣaroccāraṇaparyāptaṃ kālaṃ kṣārāvacāraṇam’ iti pā.; vākśatamātramiti mātragrahaṇenaitadbodhayati- etāvatā kālena yo dahati sa yathoktaguṇaḥ kṣāraḥ| anye mātrasthāne evaśabdaṃ paṭhanti, “vākśatameva nādhikaṃ na nyūnaṃ ca’’ iti ca vyākhyānayanti| idānīṃ kṣārasya pratidoṣaṃ lepapramāṇamavacāraṇakālaṃ ca niyamayannāha- padmapatrasama ityādi| imaṃ ca pāṭhaṃ kecidācāryā na paṭhanti, sa cābhāvāt samagro na likhita iti||18||

div.ab: tasminnipatite vyādhau kṛṣṇatā dagdhalakṣaṇam ‘nipatite iti kṣārāpanīte vyādhau kṛṣṇatā dagdhalakṣaṇaṃ jñeyam, etacca dāhe jñeyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ| vikāropaśamādyudarkajñeyamagre vakṣyati” iti cakraḥ|19|

samyagdagdhalakṣaṇaṃ vaktumāha- tasminnipatita ityādi| vyādhiśabdo'tra duṣṭamāṃsādiṣu vartate, natu duḥkhasañjñike vyādhau; kutaḥ? tatra kṛṣṇatābhāvāt| etattu ‘etattvasāmānyaṃ’ iti pā. sāmānyaṃ samyagdagdhalakṣaṇam|19|-

ab.seg: tatrāmlavargaḥ śamanaḥ sarpirmadhukasaṃyutaḥ ||19||

atha cet sthiramūlatvāt “sthiramūlatvena dagdhalakṣaṇaṃ bhavati naca niḥśeṣavyādhiśātanaṃ, tatrāyaṃ lepaḥ- amlakāñjiketyādi” iti cakraḥ kṣāradagdhaṃ na śīryate | idamālepanaṃ tatra samagramavacārayet ||20||
amlakāñjikabījāni tilān madhukameva ca | prapeṣya samabhāgāni tenainamanulepayet ||21||

samyagdagdhe paścātkarmāha- tatrāmlavarga ityādi| amlavargaḥ sauvīrakatuṣodakadhānyāmlādiḥ| sthiramūlatvāt dṛḍhamūlatvādityarthaḥ| na śīryate na śaṭati| idamiti agre vakṣyamāṇam| tatreti aśīryamāṇe kṣāradagdhe| samagraṃ sarvam| avacārayet prayojayet| tadevālepanamāha- amletyādi| amlakāñjikabījāniti amlakāñjikādhaḥsthitaṃ dravyam| teneti samabhāgapiṣṭenāmlakāñjikabījādinā| enaṃ kṣāradagdham||19-21||

div.ab: tilakalkaḥ samadhuko ghṛtākto vraṇaropaṇaḥ |22|
kṣārakṛtavraṇaropaṇopāyamāha- tilakalka ityādi|22|-

ab.seg: rasenāmlena tīkṣṇena vīryoṣṇena ca yojitaḥ ||22||
āgneyenāgninā tulyaḥ kathaṃ kṣāraḥ praśāmyati | evaṃ cenmanyase vatsa! procyamānaṃ nibodha me ||23||
amlavarjān rasān kṣāre sarvāneva vibhāvayet | kaṭukastatra bhūyiṣṭho lavaṇo'nurasastathā | amlena saha saṃyuktaḥ sa ‘sa tīkṣṇalavaṇo rasaḥ’ iti pā. tīkṣṇalavaṇo rase ||24||

mādhuryaṃ bhajate'tyarthaṃ tīkṣṇabhāvaṃ vimuñcati | mādhuryācchamamāpnoti ‘etacca bahirantaścāmlena kṣāramādhuryānayanāt kṣāravikārahananamucyate| yaduktaṃ carake madātyayacikitsite amlena madyenāntarakṣāravikāraśamanaṃ, tathā hi “kṣāro hi yāti mādhuryaṃ śīghramamlopasaṃhitaḥ” (ca. ci. a. 24) iti| bāhye tu kṣāre śītasparśatvādapi amlaṃ kṣāradāhaṃ hanti| yaduktaṃ viśvāmitre- “yataścoṣṇatamaḥ kṣāraḥ śaityaṃ cāmle rase'dhikam| tasmāt sekapradehābhyāmamlaḥ kṣāraṃ nivartayet” iti” cakraḥ vahniradbhirivāplutaḥ ||25||

agnitulyasya kṣārasyāgneyena kāñjikena kathaṃ śamanamityāśaṅkyāha- rasenetyādi| amlena tīkṣṇena vīryoṣṇenāgneyena rasena yojito'gnitulyaḥ kṣāraḥ kathaṃ praśāmyatītyarthapiṇḍaḥ| uttaramāha- evaṃ cenmanyase vatsetyādi| vibhāvayet jānīyādityarthaḥ| kaṭukastatra bhūyiṣṭha iti tatra pañcarase kṣāre kaṭuko'nurasaḥ, lavaṇastu bhūyiṣṭha iti yojyaṃ; kecit kaṭukameva bhūyiṣṭhaṃ manyante; tanna, yato janā amlabhakṣaṇe mādhuryārthaṃ lavaṇameva rasaṃ prayuñjate, lavaṇavarge kṣārasya paṭhitatvācca, kaṭuvarge cāpaṭhitatvāt; yadyevaṃ ‘sa khalvāgneyauṣadhibhūyiṣṭhatvāt kaṭuka’ iti tarhi katham? ucyate, lavaṇavargapāṭhādeva kṣārasya lavaṇatve siddhe kaṭuka iti vidhyarthameva| sa tīkṣṇalavaṇo rase iti sa kṣāra evaṅguṇaḥ| adbhiḥ pānīyaiḥ āpluto ‘boli(ḍi)ta’ iti loke||22-25||

div.ab: tatra samyagdagdhe vikāropaśamo lāghavamanāsrāvaśca |26|

idānīṃ cikitsāntarakathanāya punaḥ samyagdagdhalakṣaṇamāha- tatra samyagdagdha ityādi| tatreti samyagdagdhādimadhye| lāghavamaṅgānām| kṛte kṣāranirvāpaṇa ete vikāropaśamādayo lakṣaṇānyuttarakālaṃ jñeyāni; “etadvikāropaśamādikaṃ kiñcittātkālikaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ, kiñciduttarakālikam” ityanye|26|-
hīnadagdhe todakaṇḍujāḍyāni vyādhivṛddhiśca |26|

hīnadagdhalakṣaṇamāha- hīnadagdhe ityādi| hīnadagdhe todādayo vātaślaiṣmikāḥ| jāḍyaṃ jaḍatā| anye tvatra ‘durdagdhe todadāhakaṇḍūjāḍyāni vyādhivṛddhiśca’ iti paṭhanti, “tasmin sthāne etāni vātapittaraktakaphaprakopakāryāṇi” iti ca vyākhyānayanti|26|-

ab.seg: atidagdhe dāhapākarāgasrāvāṅgamardaklamapipāsāmūrcchāḥ syurmaraṇaṃ vā ||26||
atidagdhalakṣaṇamāha- atidagdhe dāhetyādi| atidagdhe dāhapākādayaḥ paittikāḥ, rāgo raktatā, aṅgamardo vedanāviśeṣaḥ, klamo glāniḥ||26||
kṣāradagdhavraṇaṃ kṣāradagdhavraṇamiti hīnātidāhajaṃ vraṇaṃ” iti cakraḥ tu yathādoṣaṃ yathāvyādhi copakramet ||27||
kṣāradagdhavraṇavyāpaccikitsāṃ vaktumāha- kṣāradagdhavraṇamityādi| anye tu ‘yathāvidhi yathādoṣam’ iti paṭhanti, “hetuvyādhipratyanīkena vidhinā” iti vyākhyānayanti||27||
atha naite kṣārakṛtyāḥ- tadyathā- durbalabālasthavirabhīrusarvāṅgaśūnodariraktapittigarbhiṇyṛtumatīpravṛddhajvaripramehirūkṣakṣatakṣīṇa- tṛṣṇāmūrcchopadrutaklībāpavṛttodvṛttaphalayonayaḥ ||28||

ataḥ kṣārasya dvividhasyāpi yeṣu pratiṣedhastānāha- atha naite kṣārakṛtyā ityādi| eṣu ca yathādoṣaṃ keṣucideva pratisāraṇīyakṣāraniṣedhaḥ, keṣucit pānīyaniṣedhaḥ, keṣucidubhayaniṣedhaḥ| sarvāṅgaśūnodarīti sarvāṅgena śūno ya udarī tasyaiva kṣāraniṣedhaḥ “plīhodare kṣāravidhānāt” iti cakraḥ kṛtaḥ; kṣata uraḥkṣataḥ, tena kṣīṇaḥ; tṛṣṇāmūrcchopadruta iti upadrutaśabdastṛṣṇāmūrcchābhyāṃ saha pratyekaṃ sambadhyate; klībaḥ kṣīṇaśukraḥ, aśukrasya punaḥ kṣārādhikāra eva nāsti “klībo'trālpaśukraḥ, tasya kṣāraḥ sarvathā puṃstvaṃ hanyāt| aśukrasya puṃstvābhāvādeva na tadbādhā’ iti cakraḥ; udvṛttāpavṛttaphalayonaya iti udvṛttāpavṛttaśabdau phalayonibhyāṃ saha pratyekaṃ sambadhyete; phalamaṇḍaṃ, yonirgarbhāśayaḥ; udvṛttaphalaḥ sthānādūrdhvagatāṇḍaḥ, apavṛttaphalaḥ sthānāt srastāṇḍaḥ; udvṛttayoniḥ sthānādūrdhvagatayoniḥ, apavṛttayoniḥ sthānāt srastayoniḥ; anye tu phalayoniśabdena samuditena garbhāśayamācakṣate, tatrāyamarthaḥ- udvṛttaphalayoniḥ sthānādūrdhvagatagarbhāśayā, apavṛttaphalayoniḥ sthānāt srastagarbhāśayetyarthaḥ; apare tu phalaśabdaṃ rajasi vartayanti, kutaḥ? garbhasya phalasādhanatvāt; tena yasyāḥ yoneḥ sakāśāt phalaṃ raja udvṛttamūrdhvagataṃ apavṛttamadhogatam, sā udvṛttāpavṛttaphalayoniḥ “kecittu phalaśabdenehāntraṃ grāhayantyupacārādgaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa itivat” iti hārāṇacandraḥ||28||
tathā marmasirāsnāyusandhitaruṇāsthisevanīdhamanīgalanābhinakhāntaḥśephaḥsrotaḥsvalpamāṃseṣu ca deśeṣvakṣṇośca na dadyādanyatra vartmarogāt ||29||

vyādhipuruṣaviśeṣeṇa niṣedhamuktvā pradeśaviśeṣeṇa vaktumāha- tathetyādi| taruṇāsthīni ghrāṇakarṇagrīvākṣipuṭeṣu taruṇasañjñānyasthīni; sevanyaḥ sapta, pañca śirasi, ekā jihvāyām, ekā śephasi; dhamanyaścaturviṃśatirnābhiprabhavāḥ; nābhiriti marmagrahaṇādeva nābhiḥ prāptā, punarnābhigrahaṇaṃ nābhyāṃ doṣātiśayasūcanārthaṃ; śepho meḍhraḥ| anuktamupagṛhṇannāha- alpamāṃseṣu ca pradeśeṣu jānupādopari lalāṭādiṣu ca| akṣṇośca na dadyādanyatra vartmarogāditi anyatrānyasmin roge, vartmaroge punarakṣṇorapi kṣāraṃ dadyādityarthaḥ||29||

tatra kṣārasādhyeṣvapi vyādhiṣu śūnagātramasthiśūlinamannadveṣiṇaṃ hṛdayasandhipīḍopadrutaṃ ca kṣāro na sādhayati (durbalabālasthavirādīn pratisāraṇīya ayaṃ pāṭho mudritapustakeṣu na paṭhyate iti) ||30||
