ekadoṣārabdhā api pākakāle sarvadoṣāśliṣṭā bhavantītyāha- vātādityādi| ṛteśabdaḥ kaphāccetyatrāpi sambadhyate| ‘tribhireva śoṇitacaturthaiḥ śarīramidaṃ dhāryate’ (sū. a. 21) iti dvitīyaṃ darśanaṃ darśayannāha- kālāntareṇetyādi| kālāntareṇeti antaraśabdo'trāvadhivācī, prakopaprasarasthānasaṃśrayakālāvadhinā| abhyuditaṃ tu pittamiti samantato bhāvena punarudgataṃ pittaṃ, kṛtvā vaśe vātakaphau vātaśleṣmāṇau hīnau kṛtvā, prasahya balātkāreṇa vaśe kṛtvā, ‘kroḍīkṛtya’ ityanye| mataḥ sammataḥ||7-8||

tatra, āmacchede māṃsasirāsnāyusandhyasthivyāpādanamatimātraṃ śoṇitātipravṛttirvedanāprādurbhāvo'vadaraṇamanekopadravadarśanaṃ kṣatavidradhirvā bhavati | sa yadā bhayamohābhyāṃ ‘bhayamohābhyāmiti bhayādapi pāṭanabhīrūtayā pakvamapyapakvameva dṛḍhayati’ iti cakraḥ pakvamapyapakvamiti manyamānaściramupekṣate vyādhiṃ vaidyastadā gambhīrānugato dvāramalabhamānaḥ pūyaḥ svamāśrayamavadāryotsaṅgaṃ mahāntamavakāśaṃ kṛtvā nāḍīṃ janayitvā kṛcchrasādhyo bhavatyasādhyo veti ||9||

āmaṃ na chindyāt pakvaṃ nopekṣeteti darśayannāha- tatretyādi ‘yadyapyatra vātādīnāṃ trayāṇāmapi kāraṇatvamuktaṃ, tathā'pi pāke kāraṇatayā pittaṃ pradhānameva, pūyaṃ ca śvetatvaghanatvābhyāṃ kaphakāryam| kālāntaraṃ vidāhāvasthā, tatra pittaprakopo vidāhakāraṇatayā pittasya bhavati| vaśe kṛtvā āyattau kṛtvā, śītatvena pākapratibandhakāvabhibhūyeti yāvat| śoṇitaṃ pacatītyanena śoṇitādhāramāṃsādipāko'pi labhyate, śoṇitaṃ tu matāntare doṣatayā prādhānyena sākṣāduktam| etacca matāntaramapratiṣedhenānumatameva| pūrvoktapāke'pi hi pittaprādhānyamastyeva, pākatayā ca śoṇitamapi tatra labhyata eva’ iti cakraḥ| āmacchede iti āmaśabdāt pacyamānasyāpi grahaṇāttatrāpyete doṣāḥ| vyāpādanaṃ hiṃsanam| avadaraṇaṃ vidaraṇam| kṣatavidradhiḥ ‘taistairbhāvairabhihate kṣate vā’ (ni. a. 9) ityādividradhinidānoktaḥ| sa yadetyādi| mohaḥ ajñānam| ciraṃ prabhūtakālam| gambhīrānugataḥ dūrānupraviṣṭaḥ| utsaṅga ivotsaṅgaḥ, vraṇāśaye hi cirakālaṃ pūyāvasthānenāvadāritamantaḥpradeśāntaraṃ nimnamutsaṅgatulyatvāt ‘utsaṅga’ ityucyate; ‘ut ūrdhvaṃ pūyasya saṅga utsaṅgaḥ’ ityanye| avakāśam antarālam||9||
bhavati cātra- yaśchinattyāmamajñānādyaśca ‘atrāmagrahaṇena pacyamānasyāpi grahaṇam’ iti cakraḥ pakvamupekṣate | śvapacāviva mantavyau tāvaniścitakāriṇau ||10||

asyaivārthasya nindārthavādaparaṃ ślokamāha- yaśchinattyāmamityādi| pakvaṃ śophaṃ śastrakarmārham| śvapacāviva caṇḍālāviva| mantavyau jñātavyau| tau dvau| aniścitakāriṇau āmacchedanapakvopekṣaṇāt; ane tu ‘tau narau śvapacatulyāvāturavyāpādanāt| tadvyāpādanaṃ tau kuto vidhata ityāha- aniścitakāriṇau yato'samīkṣya vidhāyinau vaidyau’||10||
prāk śastrakarmaṇaśceṣṭaṃ bhojayedāturaṃ bhiṣak | madyapaṃ pāyayenmadyaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ yo vedanā'sahaḥ ‘'vedanāsahaḥ’ iti pā.||11||
na mūrcchatyannasaṃyogānmattaḥ śastraṃ na budhyate | tasmādavaśyaṃ bhoktavyaṃ rogeṣūkteṣu karmaṇi ||12||
prāṇo ‘prāṇa iti balaṃ, bāhyaprāṇa āhāraḥ, balahetutvāt’ iti pā. hyābhyantaro nṝṇāṃ bāhyaprāṇaguṇānvitaḥ | dhārayatyavirodhena śarīraṃ pāñcabhautikam ||13||

pakve śophe śastrakarmārhe pūrvakarmāha- prāgityādi| iṣṭaṃ hitaṃ hitakāri; anye tviṣṭamabhipretamapathyamapi tadbalādhānārthaṃ bhojayet| yo vedanāṃ na sahate taṃ tīkṣṇaṃ madyaṃ pāyayet paraṃ madyapam| asyaiva ca phalamāha- na mūrcchatyannasaṃyogādityādi| śastraṃ na budhyate śastravedanāṃ na jānātītyarthaḥ| rogeṣūkteṣviti mūḍhagarbhodarārśośmaryādivarjiteṣu, karmaṇi śastraprayoge prāpte, avaśyaṃ dhruvaṃ bhoktavyam| kasmādukteṣu rogeṣu bhojayedityāha- prāṇa ityādi|- prāṇo hyābhyatara iti atrābhyantaraḥ prāṇo balaṃ, taccaujojanitaṃ bhāraharaṇādiśaktilakṣaṇam| bāhyaprāṇaguṇānvita iti bāhyaprāṇo'tra bāhyaṃ balamupacayalakṣaṇaṃ pāñcabhautikāhārajanitaṃ, guṇāḥ śarīradārḍhyādikāḥ, tairanvitaḥ saṃyuktaḥ sannābhyantaraḥ prāṇaḥ śaktilakṣaṇaḥ śarīraṃ dhārayatītyarthaḥ| anye tvanyathā vyākhyānayanti- prāṇo hyābhyantara iti; ‘sampanno yavaḥ’ itivajjātivivakṣayehaikavacanaṃ, tenātrāgniḥ somo vāyuḥ sattvaṃ rajastamaḥ pañcendriyāṇi bhūtātmetyābhyantarāḥ prāṇāḥ, bāhyaprāṇā āgneyasaumyavāyavyadravyāṇi divaso vāyū rātriḥ śabdasparśarūparasagandhāśceti, teṣāṃ guṇāḥ, tairanvito'nugataḥ sannābhyantaraḥ prāṇaḥ śarīraṃ dhārayatītyarthaḥ| tatra bāhyaprāṇasyagnerguṇaiḥ kaṭvamlalavaṇādibhiranugataḥ sannantaragniḥ śarīraṃ dhārayatītyādinā bāhyaprāṇaguṇānugatatvenābhyantaraprāṇasya śarīradhārakatvaṃ darśayanti, asmābhistu vistarabhayānna darśitam| lakṣmaṇaṭippaṇakārastu- ābhyantaraḥ prāṇo'gnīṣomādiḥ, yena prāṇī jīvati, bāhyaprāṇo'nnaṃ, tadguṇāḥ prīṇanādayaḥ, tairanvitaḥ sannābhyāntaraḥ prāṇaḥ śarīraṃ dhārayatītyarthaḥ||11-13||

alpo ‘yo hyutthito'lpo yadi vā mahān syāt kriyāṃ vinā pākamupaiti śothaḥ’ iti pā. mahān vā kriyayā vinā yaḥ samucchritaḥ pākamupaiti śophaḥ | viśālamūlo viṣamaṃ vidagdhaḥ sa kṛcchratāṃ yātyavagāḍhadoṣaḥ ||14||

mahati śophe'lpe vā'pratikriyamāṇe sati bahuṃ doṣamāha,- alpa ityādi| viṣamaṃ vidagdha iti viṣamavidāho viṣamapāka ityarthaḥ| avagāḍhadoṣa iti ābhyantarapūya ityarthaḥ| ‘yo hyutthito'lpo yadi vā mahān vā kriyāṃ vinā pākamupaiti śothaḥ’ iti kecit paṭhanti||14||
ālepavisrāvaṇāśodhanaistu samyak prayuktairyadi nopaśāmyet | pacyeta śīghraṃ samamalpamūlaḥ sa piṇḍitaścopari connataḥ syāt ‘śīghrapākādayo guṇā ālepanādinā doṣakṣapaṇād bhavanti’ iti cakraḥ||15||

śophānāmālepanādikriyāsamūhāvacāraṇe'pi pakvānāmupakramasāphalyaṃ darśayannāha,- ālepanetyādi| pacyeta śīghraṃ samamiti etena samapākatvamuktaṃ, sa śophaḥ, piṇḍito vartulībhavati ‘vartulībhūtaḥ” iti pā.||15||
kakṣaṃ samāsādya yathaiva vahnirvāyvīritaḥ sandahati prasahya | tathaiva pūyo'pyaviniḥsṛto hi māṃsaṃ sirāḥ snāyu ca khādatīha ||16||
pakvasyāpyupekṣaṇe śophasya prāguktameva doṣaṃ dṛṣṭāntena darśayannāha- kakṣamityādi| kakṣastṛṇādibahulaḥ pradeśaḥ| iheti pakvaśophe||16||
ādau vimlāpanaṃ kuryāddvitīyamavasecanam | tṛtīyamupanāhaṃ tu caturthīṃ pāṭanakriyām ||17||
pañcamaṃ śodhanaṃ kuryāt ṣaṣṭhaṃ ropaṇamiṣyate | ete kramā vraṇasyoktāḥ saptamaṃ vaikṛtāpaham ||18||

vraṇasya ṣaṣṭerupakramāṇāṃ sūtrasthāne sūtraṇārthaṃ vimlāpanādīnupakramānnirdiśannāha- ādāvityādi| ādau vimlāpanamaṅgulyādimardanena śophavilayanam| avasecanaṃ jalaukādibhī raktavisrāvaṇam| upanāho bandhanaṃ pācanāya| vaikṛtāpahamiti savarṇakaraṇaromasañjananādi| anye tvanyathā''pātanikāṃ gṛhṇantyanyathaiva ca vyākhyānayanti- tatra vraṇasya ṣaṣṭerupakramāṇāṃ sukhabodhārthaṃ lakṣaṇāntareṇa saptatvaṃ darśayannāha,- ādāvityādi| vimlāpanaśabdo'tra bahiḥpramārjane śophavilayanakare lepapariṣekābhyaṅgasvedādau vartate, na tu mandavedanasya snigdhasvinnasya śophasya dvivraṇīyapaṭhitaveṇunālāṅguṣṭhādimardane| avasecanaṃ visrāvaṇam, avasecanaśabdo'pyatra vamanavirekaśoṇitavisrāvaṇādyantarbahiḥpramārjane vartate, na tu kevala eva visrāvaṇe| evaṃ śeṣeṣvapyupakrameṣūpakramāntarāṇi samāneṣu samānānyantarbhāvyāni||17-18||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne āmapakvaiṣaṇīyo nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||17||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahāvyākhyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ||17||

athāto ‘athāta ālepanavraṇabandhavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ| ‘pūrvādhyāyoktavraṇopakramatayā ālepanaṃ tadanuṣaṅgeṇa ca bandhamabhidhātuṃ ālepanīyo'bhidhīyate| ālepanāmadhikṛtya kṛta ityālepanīyaḥ, tena vraṇabandhavidhānamiha notsūtram| anye tu ‘ālepabandhavidhiṃ’ iti paṭhanti’ iti cakraḥ vraṇālepanabandhavidhimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

ālepa ādya upakramaḥ ‘ālepa ādya upakrama iti śothabheṣajaprayogāpekṣayā''lepasyādyatvamuktaṃ, tena dvivraṇīye'patarpaṇasyādyatvamuktaṃ na virodhi| pradhānatamatvamasya prathamabhūtaśothāvasthāpraśamakatvādeva| taṃ pratirogaṃ vakṣyāma iti iha tu tasya vidhimātraṃ vakṣyāmo na tu tatprayogāniti bhāvaḥ’ iti cakraḥ, eṣa sarvaśophānāṃ sāmānyaḥ pradhānatamaśca, taṃ ca pratirogaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ- tato bandhaḥ pradhānaṃ, tena śuddhirvraṇaropaṇamasthisandhisthairyaṃ ca ||3||

athāta ityādi| eṣa ālepaḥ| nanveṣa ālepa ādya upakramaḥ kathaṃ? dvivraṇīye'patarpaṇasyādyatvena paṭhitatvāt; ucyate- auṣadhadravyebhyo bahirantaḥpramārjanebhya ālepa ādya ityarthaḥ; ādyasamīpatvācchreṣṭhatvādvā''lepa ādya ityucyate| sarvaśophānāṃ sāmānya iti vātādiśophānāṃ tulyaḥ, ālepatvenābhedāt| pradhānatamaśca sarvopakramebhyaḥ āśupīḍāharatvāt| taṃ ca pratirogaṃ vakṣyāma iti tamālepaṃ, pratirogaṃ roge roge, vakṣyāmaḥ kathayiṣyāmaḥ, asmin sthāne cikitsite ca| tataḥ tasmādālepāt| asthisandhisthairyaṃ ceti asthnaḥ sandherdārḍhyaṃ ‘bhavati’ ityādhyāhāraḥ| kecidācāryā imaṃ na paṭhanti||1-3||

tatra ‘praviśati romakūpaiḥ| tasya pramāṇaṃ māhiṣārdracarmotsedhamupadiśanti| ’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ pratilomamālimpet | pratilome hi samyagauṣadhamavatiṣṭhate'nupraviśati romakūpān svedavāhibhiśca sirāmukhairvīryaṃ prāpnoti ||4||
idānīmālepāvacāraṇaṃ tatphalaṃ ca nirdeṣṭumāha- tatretyādi| pratilomamālimpediti lomābhimukhamālimpet| hi yasmādarthe| avatiṣṭhate avasthitiṃ karoti, anupraviśati ca ‘auṣadhaṃ’ ityanuvartate||4||
na ca śuṣyamāṇamupekṣeta, anyatra pīḍayitavyāt | śuṣko hyapārthako rukkaraśca ‘'ruṣkaraśca’ iti pā.||5||

ālepasyāvasthāyāṃ kartavyatāmāha- na cetyādi| anyatra pīḍayitavyāditi pīḍanadravyairmiśrakoktairyo vraṇaḥ pīḍanīyo bhavati tasmādanyatra śuṣyamāṇaṃ nopekṣetetyarthaḥ| hi yasmādarthe| apārthako niṣphalaḥ||5||

sa trividhaḥ- pralepaḥ, pradeha, ālepaśca | pralepapradehayorantaraṃ ‘teṣāmantaraṃ- pralepaḥ śītaḥ’ iti pā. - tatra pralepaḥ śītastanuraviśoṣī viśoṣī vā; pradehastūṣṇaḥ śīto vā bahalo'bahuraviśoṣī ‘abahurbahalo nātibahalaḥ, ālepātkiñcidbahala ityetattātparyam iti hārāṇacandraḥ| ‘bahalo bahuraviśoṣī’ iti pā.| bahalatvenāyaṃ bahirnirgacchadūṣmarodhādvātakaphahantā| taduktaṃ carake “ślakṣṇasūkṣmaghano lepaścandanasyāpi dāhakṛt| tvaggatasyoṣmaṇo rodhācchītakṛccānyathā'guroḥ’ (ca. ci. a. 30) iti cakraḥ ca; madhyamo'trālepaḥ | tatra, raktapittaprasādakṛdālepaḥ; pradeho vātaśleṣmapraśamanaḥ śodhano ropaṇaḥ śophavedanāpahaśca; tasyopayogaḥ kṣatākṣateṣu; yastu kṣateṣūpayujyate sa bhūyaḥ ‘kalka’ iti sañjñāṃ labhate niruddhālepanasañjñaḥ; tenāsrāvasannirodho mṛdutā pūtimāṃsāpakarṣaṇamanantardoṣatā vraṇaśuddhiśca bhavati ||6||

tadbhedānāha- sa trividha ityādi| pralepapradehayorvāstavābhede'pi vyāvahārikaṃ bhedaṃ darśayannāha- tatra ‘teṣāmityādi’ iti pā. pralepa ityādi| antaraṃ bhedaḥ, sthānāsanavat| pralepaṃ lakṣaṇairnirdiśannāha- pralepa ityādi| aviśoṣī apīḍayitavye vraṇaśophe, viśoṣī pīḍayitavye; etena yena kalkena candanavallipyate sa pralepaḥ; anye ‘śītastanuḥ’ ityādilakṣaṇaṃ pradehasya iti vadanti| lakṣaṇaiḥ pradehaṃ nirdiśannāha- pradeha ityādi| uṣṇaḥ śīto veti viṣayāpekṣayā; tatra vātabahule kaphabahule vā uṣṇaḥ, pittaraktabahule śītaḥ| bahalaḥ sthūlaḥ, etena yastu kalkaḥ piṇḍīkṛtya vraṇasyopari dīyate sa pradehaḥ| ‘uṣṇaḥ śīto vā’ ityādilakṣaṇaṃ ‘pralepasya’ iti kecinmanyante| lakṣaṇāntaraṃ nirdiśya kāryabhedaṃ nirdiśannāha- tatretyādi| tatreti tayormadhye| kecidatrālepanasthāne ‘pradeha’ iti paṭhanti, anye tu pradehasthāne ālepaṃ paṭhanti| ālepasya sāmānyaviṣayaṃ darśayannāha- tasyetyādi| kṣatākṣateṣu vraṇavraṇaśopheṣvityarthaḥ| viṣayāntareṇālepasya nāmāntaramāha- yastvityādi| tuśabdo'vadhāraṇe| bhūyaḥśabdo'tra punararthe| niruddhā niṣiddhā| anye tvatra ‘nirodhyālepanasañjñāṃ’ iti paṭhanti; tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ| kalkasañjñasyālepasya karma āha- tenetyādi| āsrāvasannirodha iti āsrāvo raktādyāsrāvaḥ| anantardoṣateti doṣo'tra pūyaḥ, tenābhyantarapūyavarjitatvam| vraṇaśuddhiśceti doṣaduṣṭinivṛttiḥ; cakārādvraṇaropaṇasya grahaṇam||6||
avidagdheṣu śopheṣu hitamālepanaṃ bhavet | yathāsvaṃ doṣaśamanaṃ dāhakaṇḍūrujāpaham ||7||
tvakprasādanamevāgryaṃ māṃsaraktaprasādanam | dāhapraśamanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ rujākaṇḍūvināśanam ||8||
marmadeśeṣu ye rogā guhyeṣvapi tathā nṛṇām | saṃśodhanāya teṣāṃ hi kuryādālepanaṃ bhiṣak ||9||
(ṣaḍbhāgaṃ hārāṇacandrasammato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ paittike snehaṃ caturbhāgaṃ tu vātike | aṣṭabhāgaṃ tu kaphaje snehamātrāṃ pradāpayet) ||10||

ālepasyātmaviṣaye kālāvadhimāha- avidagdheṣvityādi| avidagdheṣvālepanaṃ hitaṃ, vidagdheṣu punaḥ pradeha eva, yasya ‘upanāha’ iti sañjñāntaram| yathāsvaṃ doṣaśamanamiti vātādidoṣeṣu madhye yadālepanaṃ dravyaguṇāpekṣayā yasya doṣasya śamanaṃ bhavet tat tatra hitamityarthaḥ| dāhakaṇḍūrujāpahamiti dāhaḥ pittasya, kaṇḍūḥ kaphasya, rujā vātasya, etā apahanti| dūṣyaprasādanatvamālepasya nirdeṣṭumāha- tvakprasādanamevāgryamiti|- agryaṃ pradhānam| dāhakaṇḍūrujāpahamiti pūrvasminneva śloke dāhādīnāṃ paṭhitatvādiha punaḥ pāṭho dūṣyakṛtā api dāhādayo bhavantīti bodhanārtham||7-10||

tasya ‘tasya pramāṇaṃ mahiṣārdracarmocchrāyāpekṣayā'sthūla iti’ iti pā.| ‘atra mahiṣacarmotsedhatā paraṃ pramāṇaṃ lepasya, tanutvaṃ yadvakṣyamāṇamālepasya taduktamānādapakarṣeṇa’ iti cakraḥ pramāṇaṃ mahiṣārdracarmotsedhamupadiśanti ||11||
tanutvamālepasya guṇaḥ, tanutvaṃ kiṃ pramāṇamityāha- tasyetyādi| pradehastu mahiṣārdracarmocchrāyāpekṣayā sthūla iti| ye tu tanutvaṃ pradehaguṇaṃ manyate, teṣāṃ mate pradehasyaitat pramāṇam||11||

na cālepaṃ rātrau prayuñjīta ‘rātrisvābhāvikaśaityāt saṃvṛtaromakūpāt punarālepane'pi vraṇoṣmā bahiranirgacchannavaruddho vivṛddhaḥ sannitaravraṇe vraṇaśothe vā dāhapākau karotīti bhāvaḥ| yastu pradeho vātaśleṣmaviṣayaḥ sa rātrāvapi deyo'viruddhatvāt| pācanalepastu pācakatvādeva dātavyaḥ, tathā ghṛtapradeho nirvāpaṇatayā dīyata eva kṣīraśītajalādisekaśca, tathā vraṇakalko'pyahorātrasthāyibandhavihita eva’ iti cakraḥ, mā bhūcchaityavihatoṣmaṇastadanirgamādvikārapravṛttiriti ||12||
pradehasādhye vyādhau tu hitamālepanaṃ divā | pittaraktābhighātotthe saviṣe ca viśeṣataḥ ||13||
na ca paryuṣitaṃ lepaṃ kadācidavacārayet | uparyupari lepaṃ ca na kadācit pradāpayet ||14||
ūṣmāṇaṃ vedanāṃ dāhaṃ ghanatvājjanayet sa hi | na ca tenaiva lepena pradehaṃ dāpayet punaḥ | śuṣkabhāvātsa nirvīryo yukto'pi syādapārthakaḥ ||15||

viśiṣṭe kāle ālepāvacāraṇavidhiniṣedhe, kathañcitkriyamāṇe ca doṣamāha- na cetyādi| etenāsya vidhiḥ sūcyate; tena vātaślaiṣmikāpākiśothe rātrau pradeha upayoktavyaḥ, tathā vidahyamāne śothe pradeho deya eva, kṣateṣu kalko'pi rātrau dātavya iti, tathā pittaje śothe vātapittaje ca śatadhautaghṛtābhyaṅgādi dātavyamiti| śaityāvihatoṣmaṇa iti ‘śophasya’ iti śeṣaḥ| tadanirgamāt śophoṣmāniḥsaraṇāt| vikārapravṛttirvikārābhivṛddhiḥ| śaityaruddharomakūpatvādanirgacchannūṣmā ālepenāntarnīto'tyarthaṃ śophaṃ pacatītyarthaḥ| svedavāhibhiḥ sirāmukhaiśca vīryaṃ prāpnotītyata ūrdhvaṃ bahuṣu pratiṣu nibandhapāṭhakramādvyatikrameṇa pāṭhakramo'dhikaśca pāṭho dṛśyate; sa ucyate- “tasya pramāṇaṃ mahiṣārdracarmotsedhamupadiśanti| na ca śuṣyamāṇamupekṣetānyatra pīḍayitavyāt; śuṣko hyapārtho rukkaraśca| sa trividha ālepaḥ pradeho lepaśca| teṣāmantaraṃ- ālepaḥ śītastanuraviśoṣī viśoṣī ca, pradehastūṣṇaḥ śīto vā bahulo bahuraviśoṣī ca, madhyamo lepa iti| viśeṣato raktapittaprasādakṛdālepaḥ; pralepo vātaśleṣmapraśamanaḥ śodhano ropaṇaḥ śophavedanāpahaśca, tasyopayogaḥ kṣatākṣateṣu; yastu kṣateṣūpayujyate sa bhūyaḥ ‘kalka’ iti sañjñā labhate niruddhālepanasañjñaḥ, tenāsrāvasannirodho mṛdutā pūtimāṃsāpakarṣaṇamanantardoṣatā vraṇaśuddhiśca bhavati| ubhayaguṇo lepaḥ| na cālepaṃ rātrau prayuñjīta, mābhūcchaityavihatoṣmaṇastadanirgamādvikārapravṛttiriti| tvakprasādanamevāgryaṃ māṃsaraktaprasādanam| dāhapraśamanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ todakaṇḍūvināśanam|| marmadeśeṣu ye rogā guhyeṣvapi tathā nṛṇām| saṃśodhanāya teṣāṃ hi kuryādālepanaṃ bhiṣak|| avidagdheṣu śotheṣu hitamālepanaṃ bhavet| yathāsvaṃ doṣaśamanaṃ dāhakaṇḍūvināśanam|| ṣaḍbhāgaṃ paittike snehaṃ caturbhāgaṃ tu vātike| aṣṭabhāgaṃ tu kaphaje snehamātrāṃ pradāpayet”- iti| ayaṃ pāṭho vartamāneṣu pustakeṣu sarveṣveva paṭhyata ityasmābhiḥ kramamātraṃ darśitaṃ; na tvayaṃ paṭhanīyaḥ; paṭhanīyaḥ punaḥ prāktanapāṭha eva, sarvapūrvācāryasammatatvāt||12-15||

ata ūrdhvaṃ vraṇabandhanadravyāṇyupadekṣyāmaḥ; tadyathā- kṣaumakārpāsāvikadukūlakauśeyapatrorṇacīnapaṭṭacarmāntarvalkalālābūśakalalatāvidalarajjutūlaphalasantānikālauhānīti ‘... rajjutūlasantānikā ...’ iti pā.‘cakrastu ‘lohādīni’ iti paṭhitvā ādiśabdādaśvabālādīnāṃ grahaṇam’ iti vyākhyānayati| ‘dukūlaṃ valkalaviśeṣodbhavam, patrorṇaṃ patanītikhyātatantubhavaṃ, tūlaphalaṃ śālmalīphalaṃ, tasya tūlaracitāmbaraṃ, bandhārthamupayujyate’ iti cakraḥ| ‘antarvalkalasya ityantarvalkalaṃ, bhūrjodumbarāditvarāditvaṅmadhyam’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ; teṣāṃ vyādhiṃ kālaṃ cāvekṣyopayogaḥ; prakaraṇataścaiṣāmādeśaḥ ||16||

idānīṃ vraṇabandhavidhiḥ prastūyate, sa ca dravyādhīnaḥ, atastānyeva prāgupadeṣṭumāha- kṣaumetyādi| kṣaumam atasītantubhirvyūtaṃ, anye vastrāntaramāhuḥ; kārpāsaṃ kārpāsatanturacitam; āvikam urabhraromavyūtaṃ; dukūlaṃ paṭṭavastram, anye valkalamāhuḥ; kauśeyaṃ kośakārakṛmilālodbhūtaṃ, yat ‘trasara’ iti loke; patrorṇo rallūkākhyaḥ kambalaḥ, anye tu ‘yairharitādīni devāṅgānyupyante te patrorṇāḥ’, ‘dhautakauśeyam’ ityapare, ‘māgadhapauṇḍrakādideśeṣu nāgavṛkṣādayaścatvāro vṛkṣāstatpatrebhyo jātairharitatantubhirūrṇārūpairvayate yattat patrorṇam’ ityeke; cīnapaṭṭaṃ cīnadeśa evotpadyate, taddeśajanāstu ‘cīnayugapaṭṭam’ iti vadanti, sa ca patrorṇasyaiva bhedaḥ, anye netramāhuḥ; carma eṇādīnām, apare carmavadbandhanadravyam, athavā suvarṇapiṣṭikāliptacarmatantubhisturuṣkairyāni vayante tāni carmaśabdenocyante; bāhyavalkalamantyaṃ ca tyaktvā madhyaṃ yadgṛhyate tadantarvalkalam; alābūśakalaṃ tumbīphalakarparikā; latāvidalaṃ śyāmalatādipāṭitārdhaṃ; kecidvidalaśabdaṃ carmādibhiḥ saha sambadhnanti, anye tu vidalaśabdena vaṃśavetrādikambikāmāhuḥ; latāśabdena ca śyāmalatādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ; rajjurmuñjabalvajādivalitaḥ; tūlaphalaṃ śālmalīphalādi; santānikā kṣīrasantānikā, anye ‘kuśalasantānikā’ iti paṭhanti, kuśalasantānikā kolikavṛttiḥ dvitritanturacitā ‘vaya’ iti loke prasiddhā, markaṭavāsaṃ kecidāhuḥ; lohāni suvarṇatrapusīsādīni| kva punasteṣāmupayoga ityāha- teṣāmityādi| teṣāṃ kṣaumādīnām| vyādhiṃ kālaṃ cāvekṣyopayoga iti tatra vātaślaiṣmikaṃ vyādhiṃ kālaṃ ca śītamavekṣya vraṇabandhanadravyāṇāṃ ghanānāmupayogaḥ, raktapaittikaṃ vyādhimuṣṇaṃ ca kālamavekṣya tanūnāmupayogaḥ, cakārādgāḍhasthānamavekṣya ghanānāmupayogaḥ, śithilasthānamavekṣya tanūnāmupayoga iti| vargoktānāṃ vraṇabandhanadravyāṇāṃ saṅkṣepeṇādeśamāha- prakaraṇataścaiṣāmādeśa iti|- prakaraṇataḥ prakaraṇamavekṣya, eṣāṃ vraṇabandhanadravyāṇāmādeśanaṃ; tadyathā- sarpādidaṣṭasyāriṣṭābandho rakṣā(jvā)dibhiḥ, raktātipravṛttau raktanivṛttyarthaṃ santānikayā badhnīyāt, pāṭitaśyāmalatādyairbhagnasandhānāya bandhaḥ kartavyaḥ, lauhaiḥ suvarṇādibhirdantān badhnīyāt, trapvādibhirarbudagranthyādīn, alābuśakalena śirovraṇān badhnīyāt; evamanyeṣāmapi yathārhamādeśanam||16||

tatra kośadāmasvastikānuvellitamu(pra)tolīmaṇḍalasthagikāyamakakhaṭvācīnavibandhavitānagophaṇāḥ ‘bandhānāṃ durvijñeyatayā tantrāntarāṇi jñānārthaṃ likhyante yathākramam| tatra kośe bhojaḥ- “aṅgulyaṅguṣṭhakāgreṣu kūrcakūrparajānuṣu| koṣakaṃ koṣakākāraṃ vraṇabandhaṃ tu yojayet| dāmākṛtiścatuṣpādo bandhaḥ syāddāmasañjñitaḥ| svastikaṃ svastikākāraṃ bandhaṃ kuryāt stanādiṣu| śākhāsu tiryakpatitān prahārādikṛtān bhiṣak| tān prasīvyānubadhnīyādayaṃ jñeyo'nuvellitaḥ’- iti| pratolībandhe vaitaraṇaḥ “pratolī pu(mu)ṭikā proktā jālavadbahurandhrakaḥ| ....... caiva grīvāyāṃ lalāṭe ca prayojayet| sthagikāṃ sthagikākārāṃ meḍhrāṅguṣṭhaṅgulotthitām| yathāsvamauṣadhaiḥ pūrṇāṃ kalpayet susamāhitām”- iti| evaṃ bheṣajapūrṇāṃ kṛtvā paṭṭena badhyata iti kośāt sthagikāyā viśeṣaḥ, kośastu na badhyate| ‘yamakavraṇayoḥ kuryādyamakaṃ maṇḍalākṛtim| khaṭvā tu bahupādā syāccīrābhirbahubhirvṛtā| bandhanaṃ kārayecchaṅkhahanugaṇḍeṣu kovidaḥ| cīnabandhaṃ vijānīyāccīnā(rā)bhirbahubhirvṛtam| vibandho vividho bandhaḥ sa tu pṛṣṭhodarorasi| ūrdhvaṃ tiryagadhaścāpi paṭṭacīrāvṛtaḥ sa tu| vitānaṃ tu vitānābhaṃ mūrdhni kuryāt susaṃsthitam| gophaṇāṃ gophaṇākārāṃ yuñjyānnāsauṣṭhabastiṣu| cibuke cāpi pañcāṅgīṃ hanusandhau visaṅgate| svedayitvā sthite sandhau kuryāt pañcāṅkuśāvṛtām’ iti cakraḥ| “kośo'tra bahirnirgantumicchunā kośakāreṇa dṛṣṭopānto yaḥ ‘koyā’ iti samākhyātaḥ krimikośastadākāro bandhaḥ ‘kośa’ iti vyapadiśyate| dāma māleveti dāma| svastikaḥ prāyeṇa jihvāmūlīyalakṣaṇaḥ kiñcidānatāgro jitvarāṇāṃ dhvajacihnaviśeṣaḥ, tadākāro bandhaḥ svastikaḥ| vellitaṃ vakramanugatamityanuvellitaṃ, tadasyāstītyanuvellitam| akāro matvarthīyaḥ, vakrānupūrvyā kṛto bandha ityarthaḥ| pratolī rathyeva pratolī, yathā ca sā vistṛtatvānnaragajādīnāṃ pracārasukhā tathaivāyamapi bandhaḥ śaithilyādviṇmūtrayorapīti tātparyam| ata eva vakṣyati- grīvāmeḍhrayoḥ pratolīmiti| golo bandho maṇḍalaḥ| sthagikā tāmbūlakaraṅkaḥ ‘biḍīdānī’ iti vijñāyate, tasyāścoparibhāga eveha kramāvanatatvenaupayogikatayā'bhipreyata iti pratīyate, vakṣyati hi- aṅguṣṭhāṅgulimeḍhrāgreṣu sthagikāmiti| bandho'yaṃ kośākhyāddīrghatvena hīyata iti pṛthaktvenopadiśyata ityanusandheyam| dvayorvraṇayoḥ saṃyamano yamaka iti nirucyate| khaṭvākāraścatuṣpādo bandhaḥ khaṭvā| bahubhiścīnāṃśukaiḥ kṛto bandhaścīnaḥ| ūrdhvādhastiryakparikṣiptatvena vividhākāro bandho vibandhaḥ| śirastrākāreṇa vistāro bandho vitānaḥ| kaupīnabandho nāma gophaṇetyucyate svaśāstrasiddhāntāditi gamyate, gudabhraṃśacikitsādau tadarthe gophaṇāśabdaprayogadarśanāt| pañcānāmaṅgānāṃ samāhāraḥ pañcāṅgī, tadyogādbandho'yaṃ pañcāṅgītyucyate” iti hārāṇacandraḥ| aṣṭāṅgasaṅgrahe utsaṅgākhyamadhikaṃ gṛhītvā pañcadaśa bandhāḥ paṭhitāḥ| bandhaviṣayeṣu ca ‘utsaṅgaṃ vilambini, svastikaṃ sandhikūrcabhrūstanāntarakukṣyakṣikapolakarṇeṣu, sthagikāmaṅguṣṭhāṅgulimeḍhrāgramūtravṛddhiṣu, vitānaṃ mūrdhādau pṛthule'ṅge, gophaṇāṃ nāsauṣṭhacibukasandhiṣu’ iti viśeṣaḥ paṭhyate| ‘utsaṅgammutsaṅgamiva, vilambini bāhvādau kaṇṭhādilambamānaṃ| svastikākṛti svastikaṃ yadūrdhvaṃ dakṣiṇādetyādho vāmaṃ yāti punaḥ parivṛtyādho dakṣiṇādūrdhvaṃ vāmaṃ, tatsandhyādiṣu yojyaṃ| kūrco nāma marma, anuvellitaṃ yaddīrghaṃ kṛtvā veṣṭanaṃ, mutolīva mutolī tṛṇamayaḥ phalādhāraḥ, maṇḍalamiva maṇḍalaṃ tadvṛtte'ṅge stanādau, sthagikeva sthagikā lambamānaṃ tāmbūlakaraṅkaṃ, yamakaṃ yadekasmin paṭṭake dvivraṇabandhe madhyaṃ dairghyeṇa vicchidyāpanīyate svedādyabhāvāya, khaṭvā caturbāhu paṭṭakaṃ, cīnaṃ stokavistīrṇā āyatā paṭṭikā, pañcāṅgī yasmin paṭṭe catvāro bāhavaḥ ekā cordhve paṭṭikā’ (a. saṃ. sū. a. 38) ityāṣṭāṅgasaṅgrahavyākhyāyāminduḥ pañcāṅgī ceti caturdaśa bandhaviśeṣāḥ | teṣāṃ nāmabhirevākṛtayaḥ prāyeṇa vyākhyātāḥ ||17||

idānīṃ bandhaviśeṣān saṅkhyayā nirdeṣṭumāha- tatra kośetyādi| eṣāmākāraṃ nirdeṣṭumāha- teṣāmityādi| prāyograhaṇānnāmnaiva sarveṣāmākṛtīrvaktuṃ na śakyate, tasmāt paratantroktalakṣaṇamapyatraiva samyagākṛtivijñānāya ślokairupadekṣyāmaḥ| tadyathā- “pūrayitvauṣadhairbandhaḥ kriyate kośakākṛtiḥ| kośakākhyaḥ sa vijñeyo, vaidyairbandhanavarjitaḥ|| dāmākṛtiṃ catuṣpādāṃ dāmākhyaṃ, svastikaṃ punaḥ| svastikākṛtimāsīvya ‘āsicya’ iti pā., paścādāveṣṭya badhyate|| anuvellitaṃ tadvidyāt, mutolīlakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu| bahvaṅghrirmuṭikākāro jālavadbahurandhrakaḥ|| mutolībandha eṣa syāt sañjñāntaramataḥ śṛṇu| gotuṇḍikāṃ cālanīṃ ca tāmevāhurbhiṣagvarāḥ|| maṇḍalaṃ veṣṭanākāraṃ vidadhyāt, sthagikāṃ punaḥ sthagikāṃ punaḥ| sthagikādibhirāpūrya bheṣajaiḥ paṭṭakena ca’ iti pā.| sthagikāmiva cāpūrya bheṣajaiḥ paṭṭakena ca|| badhyate maṇḍalākāro yamalavraṇayostu yaḥ| bandhaṃ yamakanāmānaṃ bhiṣajo varṇayanti tam|| khaṭvākāraścatuṣpādaḥ khaṭvābandhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ| cīnabandhaṃ vijānīyāccīrābhirbahubhirvṛtam| vibandho vividho bandhaḥ sa ca ṣaṭcīndhi(ri)kāyutaḥ ‘ṣaṭcīrikāyutaḥ’ iti pā.|| jñeyo vitānasañjñastu vitānākārasaṃyutaḥ| pāṣāṇaguḍakotkṣepakāriṇīṃ gophaṇāṃ viduḥ|| tadākṛtiṃ bhiṣakkuryādgophaṇāṃ, pañcakambibhiḥ| pañcāṅgīṃ tu vṛtāṃ kuryāt sandhānāya cikitsakaḥ”- iti||17||

tatra kośamaṅguṣṭhāṅguliparvasu vidadhyāt, dāma sambādhe'ṅge, sandhikūrcakabhrūstanāntaratalakarṇeṣu svastikaṃ, anuvellitaṃ śākhāsu, grīvāmeḍhrayoḥ mu(pra)tolīṃ, vṛtte'ṅge maṇḍalam, aṅguṣṭhāṅgulimeḍhrāgreṣu sthagikāṃ, yamalavraṇayoryamakaṃ, hanuśaṅkhagaṇḍeṣu khaṭvām, apāṅgayoścīnaṃ, pṛṣṭhodaroraḥsu vibandhaṃ, mūrdhani vitānaṃ, cibukanāsauṣṭhāṃsabastiṣu gophaṇāṃ, jatruṇa ūrdhvaṃ pañcāṅgīmiti; yo vā yasmin śarīrapradeśe suniviṣṭo bhavati taṃ tasmin vidadhyāt ||18||

bandhaviṣayamāha- tatretyādi| tatreti caturdaśabandheṣu madhye| parvaśabdo'ṅguṣṭhāṅgulibhiḥ saha sambadhyate| dāma sambādhe'ṅge iti saṅkaṭe'ṅge| sandhikūrcakabhrūstanāntaratalakarṇeṣviti kṣipramarmopariṣṭādubhayataḥ kūrcakaḥ, pādāṅguṣṭhāṅgulyormadhye kṣipramiti marma; bhrūstanāntaramiti antaraśabdaḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate; talamiha hastapādatalam| śākhāsviti śākhāsu sakthibāhuṣu| bāhupārśvodarorupṛṣṭhādikaṃ vṛttamaṅgam| aṅguṣṭhāṅgulimeḍhrāgreṣviti agraśabdo'trāṅguṣṭhādibhiḥ saha pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| hanuśaṅkhagaṇḍeṣviti hanurmukhasandhiḥ, śaṅkho bhrūkarṇayorantaraṃ, gaṇḍo gallaḥ| apāṅgayoścīnamiti apāṅgayornetrāntapradeśayoḥ| hṛdayordhvaṃ stanayormadhyaṃ grīvāmūlādadhastāduraḥ| mūrdhā mastakam| cibukanāsauṣṭhāṃsabastiṣu gophaṇāmiti cibukamoṣṭhādho māṃsāsthipiṇḍikā ‘cibukamoṣṭhādhaḥ, nāsā asthipiṇḍikā’ iti pā., aṃso bāhuśiraḥ, bastirmūtrāśayaḥ| jatruṇa ūrdhvaṃ grīvāmūlādupari| ādyasūtrāt ‘vidadhyāt’ iti kriyāpadaṃ sarvatrānuvartate| uktaṃ deśaniyamaṃ prayojanavaśena vyabhicārayannāha- yo vetyādi| suniviṣṭaḥ śobhanākāraḥ||18||
yantraṇamūrdhvamadhastiryak ca ||19||

bandho mṛdusamāvagāḍhabhedāttrividhaḥ, sa ca yantraṇamantareṇa na sambhavati, ato yantraṇaṃ nirdeṣṭumāha- yantraṇamūrdhvamadhastiryak ceti| yantraṇaṃ paṭṭagrantherbandhanaṃ, taccordhvādibhedena triprakāraṃ, vraṇākṛtīnāṃ nānāvidhatvāt| cakāra ūrdhvādibhedāneva samuccinoti||19||

tatra ghanāṃ kavalikāṃ ‘kavalayati kroḍīkarotīti kavalikā’ iti cakraḥ dattvā vāmahastaparikṣepamṛjumanāviddhamasaṅkucitaṃ mṛdu paṭṭaṃ niveśya badhnīyāt | na ca vraṇasyopari kuryādgranthimābādhakaraṃ ca ||20||

bandhāvacāraṇaṃ nirdiśannāha- tatretyādi|- tatreti vākyopakrame| ghanāṃ kavalikāmiti auṣadhavastrayorantare yā dīyate auṣadhasaṃsthāpanārthamaudumbarāditvak patrāṇi vā, sā ‘kavalikā’ ityucyate; anye dviguṇacaturguṇamṛdukarpaṭaviracitāṃ kavalikāmāhuḥ| vāmahastaparikṣepamiti vāmahastaparikṣepāddṛṣṭyā racito bandho maṅgalamāvahati; anye tu ‘paṭṭe vāmahastaparikṣipte dakṣiṇahastena sādhu bandho niṣpadyate’ ityācakṣate; apare tu vāmadakṣiṇaparikṣepāvubhāvapi uktaṃ hi carake- “bandhastu dvividhaḥ śasto vraṇānāṃ vāmadakṣiṇaḥ” (ca. ci. a. 25) iti viṣaye kartavyau,kriyāsaukaryārthaṃ tu vāmahastaparikṣepa uktaḥ| ṛjutvaṃ sanniveśaviśeṣāpekṣam| anāviddham anākulitam, asaṅkīrṇamityapare| asaṅkucitaṃ valivarjitam| mṛdu komalam| vāmahastaparikṣeparjutvādiguṇayuktaṃ paṭṭaṃ niveśya saṃsthāpya badhnīyādityarthaḥ| ābādhakāraṃ ceti ā samantataḥ pīḍākaraṃ granthiṃ na kuryādityarthaḥ| sa ca vāmadakṣiṇapārśvayostathā pṛṣṭhe'pi kriyamāṇaḥ svapnābādhakaraḥ syāditi||20||

na ca vikeśikauṣadhe atisnigdhe atirūkṣe viṣame vā kurvīta; yasmādatisnehāt kledo, raukṣyācchedo, durnyāsādvraṇavartmāvagharṣaṇamiti asyāgre ‘yuktasnehatvādāśu rohati’ iti tāḍapatrapustake'dhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate||21||

tatrauṣadhakalkavraṇavartyoḥ snigdhādibhāvaṃ niyamayannāha- na cetyādi| vikeśikauṣadhe iti tilakalkamadhughṛtāktavastrasya sūtrasya vā vartirvikeśikā, sā ucyate hi- ‘sapūtimāṃsaṃ sotsaṅgaṃ sagati pūyagarbhiṇam| vraṇaṃ viśodhayecchīghraṃ sthitā hyantarvikeśikā’ iti cakraḥ ca pūtimāṃsotsaṅgagatipūyagarbheṣu vraṇeṣu nikṣipyate; auṣadhamiha auṣadhakalkaḥ, sa ca kevalakalkaḥ pūtimāṃsotsaṅgagatyasthyantarapūyavarjiteṣu vraṇeṣu dīyate; etadviparyayavraṇeṣu punarvikeśikauṣadhakalkayorubhayorapyupayogaḥ| viṣame durnyaste; anye ‘viṣame’ iti na paṭhanti| vikeśikauṣadhayoratisnigdhātirūkṣadurnyastayordoṣaṃ vaktumāha- yasmādatisnehāt kleda iti|- kledo vraṇasyārdratvam| chedaḥ saṃhatayorvraṇauṣṭhayordvidhākaraṇam| durnyāsāt duṣpraveśāt| vraṇavartma vraṇamukham| gayadāsācāryastvanyathā''pātanikāṃ gṛhītvā pāṭhamanyathā paṭhati- “atisnehātirūkṣayorvikeśikauṣadhayordoṣaṃ yuktiyuktasnehato guṇaṃ ca vaktumāha- kasmāt? atisnehāt kledo raukṣyācchedo yuktasnehāt samyaguparoha” iti||21||
tatra vraṇāyatanaviśeṣādbandhaviśeṣastrividho bhavati- gāḍhaḥ, samaḥ, śithila iti ||22||

idānīmuktasaṅkhyakamapi bandhaṃ vraṇākṛtiviśeṣeṇa trividhaṃ darśayannāha- tatretyādi| vraṇāyatanaviśeṣāditi vraṇānāmāyatanaṃ sthānamaṅgapratyaṅgādikaṃ, tadviśeṣādgāḍhādayo bandhaviśeṣā bhavanti| nanu, doṣakālaviśeṣādapyagre bandhaviśeṣāṇāṃ darśitatvāddoṣakālāvapyatra vācyāviti? ucyate, doṣakālau hi vraṇāyatanaviśeṣamātrakarāviti na pṛthaguktau; anye tu vraṇāyatanaviśeṣādityasyāgre cakāro lupto draṣṭavya iti paṭhanti, tenānuktadoṣakālaviśeṣo'pi labhyate, tasmādapi bandhaviśeṣā bhavanti| vraṇāyatanaviśeṣāditi anye'nyathā vyākhyānayanti ‘vraṇānāṃ vātādyārabdhānāṃ viśeṣāttathā''yatanānāṃ sthānānāmaṅgapratyaṅgādikānāṃ kālaviśeṣāttrayo ‘tathā'nuktakālaviśeṣācca’ iti pā. bandhaviśeṣā bhavanti” iti| ‘vraṇāyatanaṃ vraṇākāro vraṇasanniveśa’ ityanye vyācakṣate; idaṃ cāsaṅgatameveti||22||

pīḍayannarujo ‘pīḍayannapi yo rujāṃ na karoti sa gāḍhaḥ, socchvāsa iti nātisaṃlagnaḥ’ iti cakraḥ| socchvāsaḥ ślathaḥ gāḍhaḥ socchvāsaḥ śithilaḥ smṛtaḥ | naiva gāḍho na śithilaḥ samo bandhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||23||
gāḍhādibandhānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ nirdiśannāha- pīḍayannarujo gāḍha iti|- gāḍho bandhaḥ pīḍayannapyavagāḍhamāno'pi na rujati| socchvāsaḥ anavagāḍhakaḥ||23||
tatra sphikkukṣikakṣāvaṅkṣaṇoruśiraḥsu gāḍhaḥ, śākhāvadanakarṇakaṇṭhameḍhramuṣkapṛṣṭhapārśvodaroraḥsu samaḥ, akṣṇoḥ sandhiṣu ca śithila iti ||24||
prāgeva vraṇāyatanaviśeṣādbandhaviśeṣaṃ nirdiśannāha- tatretyādi| sphicau kaṭiprothau, vaṅkṣaṇa ūrusandhiḥ, maḍhro mehanaṃ, muṣko'ṇḍakoṣaḥ||24||

tatra paittikaṃ gāḍhasthāne samaṃ badhnīyāt, samasthāne śithilaṃ, śithilasthāne naiva; evaṃ śoṇitaduṣṭaṃ ca; ślaiṣmikaṃ śithilasthāne samaṃ, samasthāne gāḍhaṃ, gāḍhasthāne gāḍhataraṃ; evaṃ vātaduṣṭaṃ ca ||25||
doṣaviśeṣādbandhaviśeṣaṃ nirdeṣṭumāha- tatretyādi||25||

tatra paittikaṃ śaradi grīṣme dvirahno badhnīyāt, raktopadrutamapyevaṃ; ślaiṣmikaṃ hemantavasantayostryahāt ‘hemante tṛtīye'hni’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ, vātopadrutamapyevam | evamabhyūhya bandhaviparyayaṃ ca kuryāt ||26||

kālaviśeṣādapi bandhaviśeṣaṃ darśayannāha- tatretyādi| dvirahno badhnīyāditi divasasya madhye dvau vārau badhnīyādityarthaḥ| evamabhyūhyeti evamanena prakāreṇa, abhyūhya svayamapi vitarkya, bandhaviparyayaṃ bandhasyānyathātvamavasthāvaśāt kuryāditi| tadyathā- pittaślaiṣmikaṃ dvyahādbadhnīyāt prātargrīṣmaśaradoḥ, hemante paittikamaharahaḥ, varṣādiṣvapi ślaiṣmikaṃ dvyahe sāyamiti||26||

tatra, samaśithilasthāneṣu gāḍhaṃ baddhe vikeśikauṣadhanairarthakyaṃ śophavedanāprādurbhāvaśca, gāḍhasamasthāneṣu śithilaṃ baddhe vikeśikauṣadhapatanaṃ paṭṭasañcārādvraṇavartmāvagharṣaṇamiti; gāḍhaśithilasthāneṣu samaṃ baddhe ca guṇābhāva iti ||27||
gāḍhādisthāne'pyanyathākṛtānāṃ bandhānāṃ doṣaṃ vaktumāha- tatretyādi| cakāro'tra rāgaṃ samuccinoti; gāḍhabandhadoṣo'yam||27||
aviparītabandhe vedanopaśāntirasṛkprasādo mārdavaṃ ca ||28||
yathocitabandhaguṇamāha- aviparītabandha ityādi||28||
abadhyamāno daṃśamaśakatṛṇakāṣṭhopalapāṃśuśītavātātapaprabhṛtibhirviśeṣairabhihanyate vraṇaḥ, vividhavedanopadrutaśca duṣṭatāmupaiti, ālepanādīni cāsya viśoṣamupayānti ||29||
bandhavyatireke doṣaṃ vaktumāha- abadhyamāna ityādi| daṃśo vanamakṣikā, upalaḥ pāṣāṇaḥ, pāṃśurdhūliḥ, ātapo gharmaḥ| duṣṭatāmupaiti vaikṛtaṃ yāti||29||
cūrṇitaṃ mathitaṃ bhagnaṃ viśliṣṭamatipātitam | asthisnāyusirācchinnamāśu bandhena rohati ||30||
sukhamevaṃ vraṇī śete sukhaṃ gacchati tiṣṭhati | sukhaṃ śayyāsanasthasya kṣipraṃ saṃrohati vraṇaḥ ||31||

bandhasyātyantaguṇaṃ ‘bandhasyānvaye guṇaṃ’ iti pā. darśayannāha- cūrṇitamityādi| cūrṇitaṃ bahudhā khaṇḍīkṛtaṃ, mathitaṃ viloḍitaṃ, bhagnaṃ kāṇḍabhagnaṃ, viśliṣṭaṃ sandhicyutam, atipātitaṃ sthānāccyutamavalambamānam| chinnaśabdo'sthyādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| cūrṇitādiṣu gamanāgamanasthānaśayaneṣvapi caturṣu bandhaḥ praśasta ityāha- sukhamityādi| śete svapiti, tiṣṭhati ūrdhvībhūta āste, śayyāsanasthasya sukhaṃ ‘bhavati’ ityadhyāhāraḥ||30-31||

abandhyāḥ pittaraktābhighātaviṣanimittā yadā śophadāhapākarāgatodavedanābhibhūtāḥ kṣārāgnidagdhāḥ pākāt prakuthitapraśīrṇamāṃsāśca ‘prakupitāḥ praśīrṇamāṃsāśca’ iti pā.| ‘pittādijanitāśca yadā todadāhavedanāvantastadā na bandhyāḥ, tena todādiyukte paittike viṣajuṣṭānāṃ ca pittaraktabahutayā śīrṇamāṃsatā bandhena bhavati| pramehiṇaḥ ślathataradhātutvādbandhādatīva prāgunnatatā (?) bhavatītyādyanusaraṇīyam| karṇikā viṣaduṣṭamāsāṅkuraḥ’ iti cakraḥ bhavanti ||32||

yeṣu bandha evānarthakarastān darśayannāha- abandhyā ityādi| nimittaśabdaḥ pittādibhiḥ saha pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| kadā punarete'bandhanīyā ityāha- yadetyādi| todākhyaiva vedanā tayā'bhibhūtā vātānuviddhā ityarthaḥ| atra bandhenātyarthaṃ todotpattireva syāt, tasmānna bandhaḥ kartavya iti| ‘todadāhābhibhūtā’ ityanye paṭhanti| ‘yadā ca śophatodadāharāgapākavedanābhibhūtā’ iti kecit paṭhanti| pākāt prakuthitapraśīrṇamāṃsāśca bhavantīti ye vraṇāḥ pākāt pratisrastamāṃsāśca bhavanti te'pi na bandhyā ityarthaḥ||32||
kuṣṭhināmagnidagdhānāṃ piḍakā madhumehinām | karṇikāśconduruviṣe viṣajuṣṭāśca ye vraṇāḥ ||33||
māṃsapāke na badhyante gudapāke ca dāruṇe | svabuddhyā cāpi vibhajetkṛtyākṛtyāṃśca buddhimān ||34||
deśaṃ doṣaṃ ca vijñāya vraṇaṃ ca vraṇakovidaḥ | ṛtūṃśca parisaṅkhyāya tato bandhānniveśayet ||35||

uktānuktamarthaṃ sukhapāṭhārthaṃ ślokairnirdiśannāha- kuṣṭhināmityādi| kuṣṭhiprabhṛtīnāṃ māṃsapāke sati vraṇā na badhyante| madhumehināṃ piḍakā iti gudapāke ca dāruṇa iti bandho na kārya ityarthaḥ| kṛtyākṛtyān sādhyāsādhyān ‘kṛtyākṛtyān karaṇīyākaraṇīyān’ iti cakraḥ| deśaṃ sphikkukṣikakṣādikam| doṣaṃ vātādikam| vraṇakovido vraṇavidvān ṛtūn śītoṣṇasādhāraṇān| parisaṅkhyāya samyagbuddhvā| niveśayet kuryādityarthaḥ||33-35||
ūrdhvaṃ tiryagadhastācca yantraṇā trividhā smṛtā | yathā ca badhyate bandhastathā vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ ||36||
ghanāṃ kavalikāṃ dattvā mṛdu caivāpi paṭṭakam | vikeśikāmauṣadhaṃ ca nātisnigdhaṃ samācaret ||37||
prakledayatyatisnigdhā tathā rūkṣā kṣiṇoti ca | yuktasnehā ropayati durnyastā vartma gharṣati ||38||
viṣamaṃ ca vraṇaṃ kuryāt stambhayet srāvayettathā | yathāvraṇaṃ viditvā tu yogaṃ vaidyaḥ prayojayet ||39||
pittaje raktaje vā'pi sakṛdeva parikṣipet | asakṛt kaphaje vā'pi vātaje ca vicakṣaṇaḥ ||40||
talena pratipīḍyātha srāvayedanulomataḥ | sarvāṃśca bandhān gūḍhāntān sandhīṃśca viniveśayet ||41||
oṣṭhasyāpyeṣa sandhāne yathoddiṣṭo vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ | buddhyotprekṣyābhiyuktena tathā cāsthiṣu jānatā ||42||
uttiṣṭhato niṣaṇṇasya śayanaṃ cādhigacchataḥ | gacchato vividhairyānairnāsya duṣyati sa vraṇaḥ ||43||
ye ca ‘vraṇā ye syurmāṃsasaṃsthā tvaci jātāstathā vraṇāḥ’ iti pā. syurmāṃsasaṃsthā vai tvaggatāśca tathā vraṇāḥ | sandhyasthikoṣṭhalaprāptāśca sirāsnāyugatāstathā ||44||
tathā'vagāḍhagambhīrāḥ sarvato viṣamasthitāḥ | naite sādhayituṃ śakyā ṛte bandhādbhavanti hi ||45||

kecit suśrutādhyāyino gadyoktasyārthasya vyaktyarthaṃ saṅgrahaślokān paṭhanti- ūrdhvamityādi| viṣamaṃ ca vraṇaṃ kuryāditi vaiṣamyamiha nimnonnatatvena| stambhayet srāvayettatheti stambhanaṃ srāvaṇaṃ ceha pūyasyaiveti| sakṛdeva parikṣipediti ekavārameva paṭṭena ‘paṭṭena’ iti hastalikhitapustake na paṭhyate veṣṭayediti| sarvāṃśca bandhānityādi sarvān bandhān sandhīṃśca sarvān bandhān sandhīṃśca sarvān guptāntān viniveśayet viniyojayet kuryādityarthaḥ| oṣṭhasyetyādi|- eṣa yathoddiṣṭo vidhiroṣṭhasyāpi sandhāne smṛtaḥ| buddhyotprekṣyetyādi| abhiyuktena jānatā vaidyena buddhyā'bhyūhyāsthiṣvapi sandhānāya yathoddiṣṭo vidhiḥ kartavya iti| tathetyādi| avagāḍhatayā gambhīrā ityarthaḥ| gayadāsācāryeṇāyaṃ pāṭho'nārṣa eva kṛtaḥ, tanmatānusāriṇā brahmadevena kvacidvyākhyātaḥ, tābhyāṃ gṛhītatvādasmābhirlikhito vyākhyātaśca kvaciditi||36-45||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne vraṇālepanabandhavidhirnāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||18||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne'ṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ||18||

div.head: vraṇitopāsanīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto ‘anantaraṃ vraṇalepanādhikārāt kṛtavraṇabandhasya vraṇino vihārāhāropadarśanārthaṃ vraṇitopāsanīyo'bhidhīyate| vraṇitopāsanaṃ vraṇitasyāhārācārabhajanaṃ, tadadhikṛtya kṛto'dhyāyo jñeyaḥ’ iti cakraḥ vraṇitopāsanīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
vraṇitasya sañjātavraṇasya, upāsanaṃ sevanaṃ, tacca gṛhaśayyāsanādikaṃ, tadvidyate yasmin sa tathā||1-2||
vraṇitasya prathamamevāgāramanvicchet; taccāgāraṃ praśastavāstvādikaṃ ‘praśastavāstusuniviṣṭaṃ śucyavātātapaṃ ca’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ kāryam ||3||
śayyāsanādikaṃ gṛhasthasya kāryamiti prāgeva gṛhaṃ nirdeṣṭumāha- vraṇitasya prathamamevetyādi| ‘vraṇinaḥ’ ityanye paṭhanti| taccāgāraṃ praśastavāstvādikaṃ kāryam||3||
praśastavāstuni gṛhe śucāvātapavarjite | nivāte na ca rogāḥ syuḥ śārīrāgantumānasāḥ ||4||

yatastasmistathābhūte sthitasya vraṇinaḥ śārīrādayo rogā na bhaveyuriti darśayitumāha- praśastavāstunītyādi| praśastavāstuni gṛha iti vāstuśabdena deśaḥ kathyate, tena praśastadeśe gṛha ityarthaḥ, praśastatvaṃ ca deśasya prāṅnimnatvamudaṅnimnatvaṃ kṛṣṇamṛttikatvaṃ suvarṇamṛttikatvaṃ vetyādikaṃ; ‘gṛhasanniveśārthā bhūmistadadhiṣṭhātṛpuruṣo vā vāstuśabdenocyate’ ityanye; tasya praśastatvaṃ hi marmādirahitatvam||4||
tasmiñ śayanamasambādhaṃ ‘asambādhaṃ natonnatatvādibhirmatkuṇādibhiśca sambādhamārgairasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ svāstīrṇaṃ manojñaṃ prākśiraskaṃ saśastraṃ kurvīta ||5||

śayanasthasya vraṇinaḥ savraṇānyaṅgāni sukhamāsata iti tadeva nirdiśannāha- tasminnityādi| tasminniti agāre| asambādham asaṅkaṭam ‘asaṅkīrṇa’ iti pā., svāstīrṇaṃ śobhanairāstaraṇaistūlīgaṇḍopadhānairācchādanaiścācchāditaṃ, manojñaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ, saśastraṃ śastrasahitaṃ hiṃsranivāraṇārtham||5||
sukhaceṣṭāpracāraḥ syāt svāstīrṇe śayane vraṇī | prācyāṃ diśi sthitā devāstatpūjārthaṃ ca tacchiraḥ ||6||
itthambhūtasya śayanasya guṇamāha- sukhaceṣṭāpracāraḥ syādityādi| ceṣṭāpracāra iti śayanaparivartanādigatiḥ||6||
tasmin suhṛdbhiranukūlaiḥ priyaṃvadairupāsyamāno yatheṣṭamāsīta ||7||
tasmiñśayane yathā vraṇitena sthātavyaṃ tathopadiśannāha- tasminnityādi| suhṛdbhiriti mitraiḥ| anukūlairiti atmano'numa(ga)tavartibhirityarthaḥ| upāsyamānaḥ sevyamānaḥ||7||
suhṛdo vikṣipantyāśu kathābhirvraṇavedanāḥ | āśvāsayanto bahuśaḥ svanukūlāḥ priyaṃvadāḥ ||8||

suhṛdupāsanaphalamāha- suhṛda ityādi| vikṣipanti viśeṣeṇa prerayanti sphoṭayantītyarthaḥ; kathāḥ pūrvapuruṣavṛttāntaprabandharacanāḥ ‘pūrvapuruṣavṛttāntaprabandharatāḥ’ iti pā.; āśvāsayantaḥ sāntvayantaḥ||8||
na ca divānidrāvaśagaḥ syāt ||9||
śayane doṣavantamācāraṃ pariharannāha- na cetyādi||9||
divāsvapnādvraṇe kaṇḍūrgātrāṇāṃ gauravaṃ tathā | śvayathurvedanā rāgaḥ srāvaścaiva bhṛśaṃ bhavet ||10||
kathañciddivāsvapne kṛte doṣamāha- divāsvapnādityādi| atra kaṇḍūgaurave kaphakṛte, śvayathuvedane vātakṛte, rāgaḥ pittajanitaḥ, srāvo raktakṛtaḥ, etena divāsvapnasyākhiladoṣakartṛtvamuktam||10||

utthānasaṃveśanaparivartanacaṅkramaṇoccairbhāṣaṇādyāsvātmaceṣṭāsvapramatto ‘saṃveśanaṃ nidrā, parivartanaṃ pārśvaparivartanaṃ, sthānaṃ daṇḍavadavasthitiḥ, āsanamupaviśyāvasthānam’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ vraṇaṃ saṃrakṣet ||11||

sarvāsvavasthāsu vraṇasaṃrakṣā karaṇīyeti darśayannāha- utthānetyādi| saṃveśanaṃ viśramaṇaṃ, parivartanaṃ vāmadakṣiṇakaṭhyorviloṭanaṃ, caṅkramaṇaṃ gatāgatam, ātmaceṣṭāsūtthānādikāsveva, apramattaḥ ‘vraṇī’ iti śeṣaḥ||11||
sthānāsanaṃ caṅkramaṇaṃ divāsvapnaṃ tathaiva ca | vraṇito na niṣeveta śaktimānapi mānavaḥ ||12||

caturvidhāmapi vraṇinaḥ kāyaceṣṭāṃ niyamayannāha- sthānāsanamityādi| sthānam ūrdhvībhūtasya sthitiḥ, āsanam upaviṣṭasya sthitiḥ| “sthānāsanaṃ caṅkramaṇaṃ yānayānātibhāṣaṇam| vraṇavānna niṣeveta śaktimānapi mānavaḥ” iti kecit paṭhanti| yānayānaṃ rathādigamanam||12||
utthānādyāsanaṃ sthānaṃ śayyā cātiniṣevitā | prāpnuyānmārutādaṅgarujastasmādvivarjayet ||13||
utthānādīnāmatiniṣevaṇāddoṣamāha- utthānetyādi||13||
gamyānāṃ ca strīṇāṃ sandarśanasambhāṣaṇasaṃsparśanāni dūrata eva pariharet ||14||

sāmānyācārānniyamya viśiṣṭaṃ sparśāśrayaṃ vihāramatidoṣakaraṃ pṛthageva nirdiśannāha- gamyānāmityādi| gamyā gamanārhā grāmyadharmayogyā ityarthaḥ, tāśca bhāryāveśyāceṭīprabhṛtayaḥ| sandarśanādiṣu saṃśabda ābhimukhyārthaḥ||14||
strīdarśanādibhiḥ śukraṃ kadāciccalitaṃ sravet | grāmyadharmakṛtāndoṣān so'saṃsarge'pyavāpnuyāt ||15||
kasmādgamyastrīṇāṃ sandarśanādi parihartavyamityāha- strīdarśanādibhirityādi||15||

navadhānyamāṣatilakalāyakulatthaniṣpāvaharitakaśākāmlalavaṇakaṭukaguḍapiṣṭavikṛtivallūraśuṣkaśākājāvikānūpaudaka- māṃsavasāśītodakakṛśarāpāyasadadhidugdhatakraprabhṛtīni navadhānyetyādau dhānyaśabdānugṛhītānāmapi māṣādīnāṃ punarupādānaṃ teṣāṃ purāṇānāmapi niṣedhārtham‘ajāṅgalānūpaudakamāsaṃ ... ’ iti cakrasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ pariharet ||16||

atidoṣakaramāhāraṃ niyamayannāha- navadhānyetyādi| kalāyo'tra tripuṭakaḥ, etena hareṇusatīnakayorapratiṣedhaḥ; niṣpāvaśabdenātra rājaśimbī; haritakamiti “kuṭheraśigrusurasasumukhāsuribhūstṛṇāḥ| mūlakaṃ cukrikā ‘cukrākaścukrikā ceti’ iti pā. ceti vargaṃ haritakaṃ vidu”- iti| atrāmlādayastrayo rasāḥ| guḍapiṣṭavikṛtiriti vikṛtiśabdo guḍapiṣṭābhyāṃ saha sambadhyate| vallūraṃ śuṣkamāṃsam| ajāvikānūpaudakamāṃsavaseti ajāvike prasiddhe; ānūpaśabdo dvividhaḥ- vyutpādito'vyutpāditaśca, tatrāvyutpāditaḥ pañcasu kūlacarādiṣu vartate, atra tu vyutpādita eva grāhyāḥ, tadevāha- anugatā āpo yasmin so'nūpo deśaḥ, taccāriṇastvānūpāḥ; te ca kūlacarāḥ plavāśceti| audakaśabdena punaratra kośasthāḥ pādino matsyāścocyante| vasā śuddhamāṃsasnehaḥ kṛśarā tilataṇḍulamāṣaiḥ kṛtā yavāgūḥ| pāyasaṃ kṣīrasiddhāstaṇḍulāḥ| anye tu ‘ajāṅgalavikārānūpaudakamāṃsaṃ’ iti paṭhanti| yadyapi jāṅgalavargo'ṣṭavidhastathā'pyatra jaṅghālaviṣkirau jāṅgalaśabdenocyete; kutaḥ? tayoḥ pradhānatamatvāt, yathā lavaṇaśabdasyā(bdenā)viśeṣoktāvapi pradhānatvāt saindhavaṃ gṛhyate tadvat, tenātra jaṅghālaviṣkirau vihāyānyeṣāṃ jāṅgalānāṃ pratiṣedha iti| ānūpaudakayorapyajāṅgalatvādeva niṣedhe siddhe punarupādānaṃ tanmāṃsānāmatyarthaṃ doṣavattvapratipādanārtham, ajāṅgalamāṃsavikāreti niṣedhamukhena vidhipraṇayanaṃ jaṅghālaviṣkirayorapyavasthāyāmupayogakhyāpanārthamiti| prabhṛtigrahaṇādvarakoddālakādīnāṃ parihāraḥ||16||
takrānto navadhānyādiryo'yaṃ varga udāhṛtaḥ | doṣasañjanano hyeṣa vijñeyaḥ pūyavardhanaḥ ||17||

eṣāṃ bhinnajātīyānāmapi doṣakaratvaṃ pratipādayannāha- takrānta ityādi| nanu ‘takraprabhṛtīti pariharet’ ityatra prabhṛtigrahaṇādvarakoddālakādīnāṃ grahaṇam, atasteṣāmapi dṣasañjananatvaṃ cāste evaṃ pūyavardhanatvaṃ ca, tat kathaṃ takrānto navadhānyādiriti vicchedaḥ kṛtaḥ| ucyate- varakādibhyo navadhānyādīnāṃ takrāntānāmatyarthaṃ doṣasañjananatvapūyavardhanatvapratipādanārthamiti| nanu navadhānyādau varge kecidvātaharāḥ kecicca pittaharāḥ kecicca kaphaharāstat kathamucyate ‘doṣasañjanana’ iti? naiṣa doṣaḥ, yato'tra doṣaśabdena vraṇaduṣṭirevocyate; yadyapi ‘vraṇaduṣṭirapi yadyapi doṣaduṣṭipūrvikaiva bhavati, tathā'pi dravyamahimnā yāni dravyāṇi vraṇaduṣṭilakṣaṇavyādhikārīṇi tānīhocyante, tena navadhānyādīnāmiha vraṇaduṣṭau kartavyāyāṃ doṣāntarīyakatayā duṣṭerdoṣakaraṇamapi bhavati|’ yathā- mṛt pāṇḍuroge, viruddhāśanaṃ kuṣṭhe, adhyaśanamajīrṇe kartavye doṣamapi tannāntarīyakatayā karoti, taduktaṃ tantrayuktiṣu māṣādīnāṃ duṣṭikartṛtvaṃ- ‘yathā mṛtpiṇḍo'dbhiḥ klidyate, evaṃ māṣatiladugdhaprabhṛtibhirvraṇaḥ’ (u. ta. a. 65) iti cakraḥ vraṇaduṣṭirapi duṣṭaireva doṣaiḥ kriyate tathā'pi na doṣaḥ, kasmāt? nidānadravyāṇāṃ trividhatvāt; tadyathā- kiñcid dravyaṃ doṣakāri kiñcidvyādhikāri, kiñcidubhayakārīti, kiṃ bahunoktena; atra nibandhakārairbahudhā jalpitaṃ, taccāsmābhirvistarabhayānna darśitamiti||17||
madyapaśca maireyāriṣṭāsavasīdhusurāvikārān pariharet ||18||

tatra viśiṣṭaviṣaye'tidoṣakaratvādviśiṣṭaṃ pānadravyaṃ cāgrīkṛtya ‘vargīkṛtya’ iti pā. niṣedhārthamāha- madyapaścetyādi| śastrakarmādāvekavāraṃ madyapasya madyapānamabhihitam, atra tu vraṇe sati niṣedha eva| maireyaṃ surāsavayorekasmin bhājane sandhānam| ariṣṭamabhayāriṣṭādi| āsavāḥ palāsakṣārodakāsavādayo mahākuṣṭhādyabhihitāḥ| sīdhuḥ sasyakaḥ, so'pi nānāprakāraḥ pakvarasikaśītarasikādibhedena| surā lohitavarṇā piṣṭakiṇvakalkena kiñcit kaluṣā| atra kecidācāryā evaṃ bruvate- “yāni madyānyamlādiguṇayuktāni bhavanti tāni sarvāṇyeva vraṇibhirna pātavyāni, yāni punardrākṣārasodbhavāni madyānyamlādiguṇaviparītaguṇāni raktapittādiṣvabhimatāni tāni ca vraṇitasyāvasthāyāṃ kadāciddātavyānītyayaṃ granthakarturabhiprāya” iti||18||

madyamamlaṃ ‘madyasya navadhānyādivarge sākṣāt prabhṛtiśabdādvā niṣedhe'pi bhūridoṣakartutayā punarniṣedhaḥ’ iti cakraḥ tathā rūkṣaṃ tīkṣṇamuṣṇaṃ ca vīryataḥ | āśukāri ca tat pītaṃ kṣipraṃ vyāpādayedvraṇam ||19||
kutaḥ punarmaireyādayaḥ pariharaṇīyā ityāha- madyamityādi||19||

vātātaparajodhūmāvaśyāyātisevanātibhojanāniṣṭabhojanaśravaṇadarśanerṣyāmarṣabhayaśokadhyānarātrijāgaraṇaviṣamāśana- śayanopavāsavāgvyāyāmasthānacaṅkramaṇaśītavātaviruddhādhyaśanājīrṇamakṣikādyā bādhāḥ pariharet ||20||

ābhyantarāśrayāvāhāravihārau niyamya bāhyānapi pariharannāha ‘parihārānāha’ iti pā. - vātātapetyādi| īrṣyā parasampattiṣvasahiṣṇutā| amarṣaḥ krodhaḥ| dhyānam anavaratakāryākāryacintanam| viṣamāśanaśayanamiti viṣamaśabdo'śanaśayanābhyāṃ saha pratyekaṃ sambadhyate; bahustokākālabhojanaṃ viṣamāśanaṃ, rātrijāgaraṇaṃ divāsvapnaśca viṣamaśayanaṃ; tatra viṣamāśayanaṃ niṣiddhamapi punaratyantāpathyakāritvena niyamārtham| śīto vātaḥ| viruddhāśanaṃ samamadhughṛtādikam||20||
vraṇinaḥ samprataptasya kāraṇairevamādibhiḥ | kṣīṇaśoṇitamāṃsasya bhuktaṃ samyaṅna jīryati ||21||
ajīrṇāt pavanādīnāṃ vibhramo balavān bhavet | tataḥ śopharujāsrāvadāhapākānavāpnuyāt ||22||

kutaḥ punarete parihāryā ityāha- vraṇina ityādi| samprataptasyeti samyakprakāreṇa tāpitasya| pavanādīnāmiti vātapittakaphānāmityarthaḥ| vibhramo vyāpadviśeṣaḥ, vātādīnāṃ sthānāntaragamanaṃ vā| śopharuje vātasya, āsrāvaḥ kaphasya, dāhapākau pittasyeti||21-22||

sadā nīcanakharomṇā śucinā śuklavāsasā śāntimaṅgaladevatābrāhmaṇagurupareṇa bhavitavyamiti | tat kasya hetoḥ? hiṃsāvihārāṇi hi mahāvīryāṇi rakṣāṃsi paśupatikuberakumārānucarāṇi māṃsaśoṇitapriyatvāt kṣatajanimittaṃ vraṇinamupasarpanti, satkārārthaṃ jighāṃsūni vā kadācit ||23||

ādhidaivikaṃ viśiṣṭamāgantubādhaṃ parijihīrṣurāha- sadetyādi śāntyādipareṇa śāntyādiratenetyarthaḥ| śiṣyahitārthaṃ guruḥ svayameva praśnaṃ kurvannāha- tadityādi| tat nīcanakharomādikaraṇam| anye ‘api tat kasya hetoḥ’ iti paṭhanti; ‘apiśabdo'tra sānunayapraśne’ iti ca vyākhyānayanti| śiṣyahitatvena svayameva hetusākāṅkṣaṃ praśnaṃ kṛtvā sahetumuttaramāha- hiṃsāvihārāṇītyādi| hiṃsāvihārāṇi vadhakrīḍanāniḥ anye tu ‘hiṃsārthaṃ vihāraśceṣṭā yeṣāṃ tāni hiṃsāvihārāṇi’| hi yasmādarthe, yasmāt kṣatajanimittaṃ vraṇinamupasarpanti, tasmānnīcanakhādīnā bhavitavyamiti| histhāne'nye tuśabdaṃ yasmādarthe paṭhanti| rakṣāṃsi paśupati kuberakumārānucarāṇi maheśvaradhanadakārtikeyānugāni tadādeśakārīṇītyarthaḥ| kṣatajanimittaṃ śoṇitārtham| satkārārthaṃ jighāṃsūni vā kadācit satkārārthaṃ pūjārthamāyuṣmantaṃ vraṇinamupasarpanti gatāyuṣaṃ tu jighāṃsūnīti; anye tvanyathā vyākhyānayanti- ‘kadācidvā jighāṃsūni hantumicchūnyupasarpanti satkārārtham’ iti||23||

bhavati cātra | teṣāṃ satkārakāmānāṃ ‘satkārakāmānāmityanena hiṃsārthino'sādhyāḥ sūcyante, tantrāntare hi hiṃsārthagṛhītā asādhyā uktāḥ’ iti cakraḥ prayatetāntarātmanā | dhūpabalyupahārāṃśca bhakṣyāṃścaivopahārayet ||24||
teṣāṃ satkāradānāyāha- teṣāmityādi| teṣāmanucarāṇāṃ pūjābhilāṣiṇāṃ, prayatetāntarātmanā viśiṣṭo vaidyo dhūpādīnupahārayet dāpayedityarthaḥ| baliḥ paśuvarjitā pūjā, upahāraḥ sapaśurbaliḥ||24||

te tu santarpitā ātmavantaṃ na hiṃsyuḥ ‘na hiṃsyuḥ’ iti vacanena satkārārthagṛhīte'pi yadā balyādinā satkārā na kriyante tadā te'pi hiṃsantīti darśayati’ iti cakraḥ| tasmāt satatamatandrito janaparivṛto nityaṃ dīpodakaśastrasragdāmapuṣpalājādyalaṅkṛte veśmani sampanmaṅgalamano'nukūlāḥ kathāḥ śṛṇvannāsīta ||25||
sampadādyanukūlābhiḥ ‘sampanmaṅgalyuktāmiḥ’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ kathābhiḥ prītamānasaḥ | āśāvān vyādhimokṣāya kṣipraṃ sukhamavāpnuyāt ||26||

teṣāṃ tarpaṇaphalamāha- te tvityādi| ātmavantaṃ rakṣāṃsi hiṃsituṃ na śaknuvanti| ātmavattā tu nīcanakharomādibhirbhavati| atandritaḥ analasaḥ| srak mūrdhārhā puṣpamālā, dāma graiveyakādipuṣpābharaṇaṃ, puṣpāṇi agrathitāni; ādiśabdāccandanādarśavīṇādayaḥ| sampanmaṅgalamano'nukūlā iti anukūlaśabdaḥ sampadādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| sampadādyanukūlatvācchravaṇaphalamāha- sampadādyanukūlābhirityādi||25-26||
ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvavedābhihitairaparaiścāśīrvidhānairupādhyāyā bhiṣajaśca sandhyayo rakṣāṃ kuryuḥ ||27||
aparāmapi kartavyatāmāha- ṛgyajurityādi| āśīrvidhānaiḥ āśīḥkaraṇaiḥ, āśīrvādairityarthaḥ| upādhyāyāḥ purohitāḥ||27||
sarṣapāriṣṭapatrābhyāṃ sarpiṣā lavaṇena ca | dvirahnaḥ kārayeddhūpaṃ daśarātramatandritaḥ ‘saptarātraṃ’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ||28||

makṣikādibhyo ‘makṣikādīnāṃ rakṣādīnāṃ ca’ iti pā. rākṣasādibhyaśca rakṣārthaṃ dhūpamāha- sarṣapāriṣṭetyādi| ariṣṭapatraṃ nimbapatram| lavaṇena saindhavena| dvirahna iti dinasya vāradvayaṃ prātaḥ sāyaṃ ca daśarātram| sarṣapādirakṣoghnanihataujāṃsi rakṣāṃsi naiva punarvraṇinamupasarpanti||28||
chatrāmaticchatrāṃ lāṅgū(ṅga)līṃ jaṭilāṃ brahmacāriṇīṃ lakṣmīṃ guhāmatiguhāṃ vacāmativiṣāṃ śatavīryāṃ sahasravīryāṃ siddhārthakāṃśca śirasā dhārayet ||29||

chatrāmityādi| chatrāticchatre droṇapuṣpīdvayaṃ; lāṅgūlī kapikacchuḥ; jaṭilā māṃsī; brahmacāriṇī ‘brahmacāriṇī brahmayaṣṭiḥ’ iti cakraḥ muṇḍitikā, pattaṅgakāṣṭhamityapare; lakṣmīḥ śamī, lakṣmaṇetyanye, viṣṇukrāntetyapare; guhātiguhe śālaparṇīpṛśniparṇyau; śatavīryā śatāvarī, nīladūrvetyanye; sahasravīryā śvetadūrvā; siddhārthakāḥ sarṣapāḥ||29||
vyajyeta bālavyajanairvraṇaṃ na ca vighaṭṭayet | na tudenna ca kaṇḍūyecchayānaḥ paripālayet ||30||
anyadapyāha- vyajyetetyādi| bālavyajanaiḥ cāmaraiḥ| na ca vighaṭṭayet na cālayet| na tudet na vyathayet| na kaṇḍūyet na kharjūyet, nakhaviṣabhayāt| śayānaṃ svapantam| kecidamuṃ na paṭhanti||30||
anena vidhinā yuktamādāveva niśācarāḥ | vanaṃ keśariṇa''krāntaṃ varjayanti mṛgā iva ||31||
etasya rakṣoghnavidheḥ phalaṃ darśayannāha- anenetyādi||31||

div.ab: jīrṇaśālyodanaṃ snigdhamalpamuṣṇaṃ dravottaram ‘dravāduttaro dravahīna ityarthaḥ, natu dravapradhānaḥ| kiṃvā dravamuttaraṃ śreṣṭhamāntarīkṣādi, taccālpameva vacanāntarājñeyam’ iti cakraḥ| bhuñjāno jāṅgalairmāṃsaiḥ śīghraṃ vraṇamapohati ||32|| taṇḍulīyakajīvantīsuniṣaṇṇakavāstukaiḥ | bālamūlakavārtākapaṭolaiḥ kāravellakaiḥ ||33|| sadāḍimaiḥ sāmalakairghṛtabhṛṣṭaiḥ sasaindhavaiḥ | anyairevaṅguṇairvā'pi mudgādīnāṃ rasena vā ||34|| śaktūn vilepīṃ kulmāṣāñjalaṃ cāpi śṛtaṃ pibet |35|

ab.seg: āhāravidhividheyamadhikṛtyāha- jīrṇaśālyodanamityādi| jīrṇaśālyodanamiti navadhānyaniṣedhādeva purāṇaśālirlabdhaḥ punarjīrṇagrahaṇaṃ prapurāṇaniṣedhārthaṃ; tena varṣoṣitaṃ grāhyam| dravottaramiti dravaḥ uttaro yasmin sa dravottaraḥ, dravapradhāna iti kecidvyākhyānayanti; idaṃ ca vyākhyānaṃ gayadāsācāryo na manyate, kasmāt? vraṇināṃ toyapānaniṣedhāt| taduktaṃ- “vraṇe ca madhumehe ca pānīyaṃ mandamācaret”(sū. a. 45)- iti, tathā bhoje'pi “vraṇodarāsthāpanapīḍitānāṃ pramehiṇāṃ chardyatisāriṇāṃ ca| dravaṃ na dadyādathavā'pi koṣṇaṃ svalpaṃ hitaṃ bheṣajasaṃskṛtaṃ ca”- iti; tathā dvādaśāśanapravicāre'pi- “praklinnadehān vraṇinaḥ śuṣkairmehina eva ca”(u. taṃ. 64) iti, tasmāt dravāduttaro dravottaro dravahīno mūrtapradhāna iti vyākhyeyam| jāṅgalamāṃsabhojanamapi ropaṇakāle bhojanakāle iti pā. dātavyaṃ, “māṃsaṃ māṃsena vardhate” itivacanāt| jīvantī ḍoḍikā, suniṣaṇṇakaḥ śiribālikā, catuṣparṇītyanye| ghṛtabhṛṣṭairiti etena ghṛtenaiva saṃskāro vidheyo nānyairiti| sasaindhavairiti saindhavameva lavaṇeṣu grāhyam| anyairevaṅguṇairveti svāsthyāvṛttikairvraṇyaiśca vetrāgramaṇḍūkaparṇīkarkoṭakaprabhṛtibhiḥ| mudgādīnāṃ rasena veti śamīdhānyeṣu niṣedhavarjaṃ mudgādayaḥ| rasena yūṣeṇa| śaktūniti yathāsātmyaṃ, yavasātmyānāṃ yavaśaktavaḥ, śālyādisātmyānāṃ tallājaśaktava iti| vilepī svalpadravā bahusikthā| kulmāṣā yavapiṣṭamayā utsvinnāḥ||32-35||
divā na nidrāvaśago nivātagṛhagocaraḥ | vraṇī vaidyavaśe tiṣṭhañ śīghraṃ vraṇamapohati ||35||
(vraṇe śvayathurāyāsāt sa ca rāgaśca jāgārāt | tau ca ruk ca divāsvāpāttāśca mṛtyuśca maithunāt) ||36||
evaṃvṛttasamācāro vraṇī sampadyate sukhī | āyuśca dīrghamāpnoti dhanvantarivaco yathā ||37||

yathoktāhārācārānuvartino vraṇitasya phalopadarśanaparaṃ ślokadvayamāha- divetyādi| nivātagṛhagocara iti vātarahitāgāraviṣayaḥ, tatsthāyītyarthaḥ| evamanena prakāreṇa vṛttaḥ prāptaḥ samyagācāra āhāro vihāraśca yena; athavā, evamanena prakāreṇa vṛttasya samācāraḥ samācaraṇaṃ vyavaharaṇaṃ yasya sa evaṃvṛttasamācāraḥ| sampadyate sukhīti sukhībhavatītyarthaḥ| yatheti satyam| kaścidācāryastvanayoḥ ślokayormadhye'muṃ ślokaṃ paṭhati- “vraṇe śvayathurāyāsāt sa ca rāgaśca jāgarāt| tau ca ruka ca divāsvāpāttāśca mṛtyuśca maithunāt”- iti| vyākhyānayati ca- sa ca śvayathuḥ rāgaśca raktatā ca jāgarādrātrijāgarādbhavataḥ, tau ceti śvayathurāgau ruk vyathā ca divāsvapnādbhavanti, tā iti śvayathurāgarujo mṛtyuśca maithunāt sambhavantītyarthaḥ| śrīgayadāsācāyaprabhṛtayastu dvāveva ślokau manyante| imaṃ ca kasmiṃścit pustake pramādapaṭhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā kaścidevāvicitapāṭhavyākhyātā vyākhyānayati| asmiṃścāṅgīkriyamāṇe nirṇītapāṭhavyākhyātṛbhiḥ śrīgayadāsaprabhṛtibhiḥ saha virodhaḥ syāt, tasmādayaṃ na paṭhanīya iti||35-37||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne vraṇitopāsanīyo nāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||19||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne ekonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||19||
athāto hitāhitīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

athāta ityādi| hitāhitānyadhikṛtya pūrvādhyāye purāṇaraktaśālyādīnāṃ hitatvaṃ navadhānyādīnāṃ cāhitatvamuktaṃ, tatra hitāhite vivādaniṣedhena svamatasthāpanārthaṃ hitāhitīyo'bhidhīyate’ iti cakraḥ kṛto'dhyāyo hitāhitāni vā'smin vidyanta iti hitāhitīyaḥ||1-2||

yadvāyoḥ pathyaṃ tat pittasyāpathyamityanena hetunā na kiñciddravyamekāntena hitamahitaṃ vā'stīti kecidācāryā bruvate | tattu na samyak; iha khalu yasmāddravyāṇi svabhāvataḥ ‘svabhāvata iti prakṛteḥ, prakṛtiśca jātipratibaddhasvarūpaṃ| yathā raktaśāle raktaśālitvaṃ, tathā tatra pratibaddhaṃ ca laghutvatrimalāpahatvādi| saṃyogo dravyāṇāṃ melakaḥ, sa ceha dravyaprakṛtyatiriktakāryakārako jñeyaḥ, yathā madhughṛtasamānasaṃyogādiḥ| prakṛtyanuguṇasaṃyogastu prakṛtikāryeṇaiva gṛhītaḥ| saṃyogena ceha sambandhamātrābhidhāyinā deśakālasaṃskāramātrāṇāṃ cātiriktaphalānāṃ grahaṇam’ iti cakraḥ saṃyogataścaikāntahitānyekāntāhitāni hitāhitāni ca bhavanti ||3||

prathamaṃ paramatameva darśayannāha- yadvāyoḥ pathyamityādi| yadvāyoḥ pathyaṃ tat pittasyāpathyamiti tailakāñjikamityādi| itiśabdo'yamādyarthaḥ| ekāntena sātatyena kiñcidapi dravyaṃ hitaṃ nāsti, pittasyāpathyatvāt; tathaikāntenāhitamapi ‘navā ekāntenāhitamasti’ iti pā. nāsti, vāyoḥ pathyatvāt| vāśabdo'tra samuccayārthaḥ| paramataniṣedhārthaṃ svamatamāha- tattvityādi| iheti sauśrute tantre| khalu niścayena| svabhāvataḥ prakṛtitaḥ; yā sarvāvasthāsvaparityājyā sā dravyasya prakṛtiḥ; yathā- vahneruṣṇatvam, apāṃ dravatvamityādi| saṃyogata iti saṃyogaḥ ekadvitryādidravyeṇa saṃhatībhāvaḥ| cakāreṇa saṃyogeṣvapi svabhāvo'pi hetutvena samuccīyate, tathā deśakālamātrāsaṃskārāśca svabhāvānusambaddhāḥ samuccīyante||3||

tatra ‘tatraikāntetyādinā ekāntahitāni, ekāntāhitāni, hitāhitānīti tritayavivaraṇam| ekāntāhitāni svabhāvāt saṃyogācca jātyasātmyatvādeva bhavanti| tatrāgnyādīni svabhāvādviruddhāni, samadhṛtamadhughṛtādīni ca saṃyogādviruddhāni| viṣatulyānīti viṣavadanarthakāritvāt| hitāhitāni tvityādi| yadvāyoruṣṇatvāmlatvādinā pathyaṃ mātuluṅgaṃ tattenaiva pitte samānaguṇatayā apathyam, tathā saṃyogataśca yanmāṃsaṃ tailatakrādisaṃskārādvāyoḥ pathyaṃ tat pittasyāpathyamityādudāhāryam| anena ca prakaraṇena yat prāyaḥ svāsthyānuvṛttikaraṃ tadekantahitaṃ, yattu svāsthyaviruddhaṃ tadekāntāhitaṃ,yattu svāsthyāvihitaṃ rogāvasthāniyatopayogaṃ taddhitāhitaṃ| taccaikadoṣaharaṃ dvidoṣaharaṃ tridoṣaharaṃ vyādhiharaṃ vā, tattadavasthāmātre hitatayā svāsthyāhitatayā ca hitāhitaṃ| nahi daśamūlaṃ tridoṣaharamapi svāsthyahitaṃ| yattu raktaśālyāmalakādi tridoṣaharaṃ, tadapi svāsthye hitatayaikāntahitameva, evaṃ ghṛtaṃ kaphakaramapi svasthaikāntahitatayaikāntahitamevoktam| evamagnyādyapi arśaādau hitamapi svāsthyāhitatayā'hitameva’ iti cakraḥ,ekāntahitāni jātisātmyāt salilaghṛtadugdhaudanaprabhṛtīni; ekāntāhitāni tu dahanapacanamāraṇādiṣu pravṛttānyanalakṣāraviṣādīni, saṃyogādaparāṇi viṣatulyāni bhavanti; hitāhitāni tu yadvāyoḥ pathyaṃ tat pittasyāpathyamiti ||4||

ekāntahitānyeva prathamaṃ darśayannāha- tatraikāntahitānītyādi| tatreti hitāhitadravyeṣu madhye| jātisātmyāditi manuṣyajātisātmyāt| ātmanā dehena saha sthitaṃ dravyamavikāri sātmyaṃ; yaduktaṃ- “ātmā yahyabhimato deha ātmanā saha yat sthitam| na kuryādvikṛtiṃ dravyamupayuktaṃ kathañcana|| sātmyamityucyate tattu” iti| prabhṛtigrahaṇādyavagodhūmādayaḥ| ekāntāhitāni darśayannāha- ekāntāhitānītyādi| etānyagnikṣāraviṣādīnyekāntāhitāni svasthānāṃ, rogiṇāṃ tu rogamātrādyapekṣayā hitānyeveti| saṃyogādityādi| anye tvevaṃ paṭhanti- ‘teṣāmeva saṃyogatastvaparāṇi’ iti, vyākhyānayanti ca- ekāntāhitānīti sambadhyate, tuśabdaścārthaḥ; tena svabhāvasaṃyogānuṣaktairdeśādibhirapyekāntāhitāni bhavanti| hitāhitāni darśayannāha- hitāhitāni tvityādi| asyārthaḥ prāgevātraivādhyāye vyākhyātaḥ||4||

ataḥ ‘etacca raktaśālyādīnāṃ sātmyatvamabhyāsāpekṣaṃ, tenānabhyāsāddeśaviśeṣe āpātato'hitatvaṃ tannodbhāvanīyam’ iti cakraḥ sarvaprāṇināmayamāhārārthaṃ ‘sarvavraṇināṃ’ iti pā. varga upadiśyate; tadyathā- raktaśāliṣaṣṭikakaṅgukramukundakapāṇḍukapītakapramodakakālakāsanakapuṣpakakardamakaśakunāhṛtasugandhakakalama- nīvārakodravoddālakaśyāmākagodhūmayavavaiṇavaiṇahariṇakuraṅgamṛgamātṛkāśvadaṃṣṭrākarālakrakarakapotalāvatittirikapiñjalavartīravartikā mudgavanamudgamakuṣṭhakalāyamasūramaṅgalyacaṇakahareṇvāḍhakīsatīnāścillivāstukasuniṣaṇṇakajīvantītaṇḍulīyakamaṇḍūkaparṇyaḥ, gavyaṃ ghṛtaṃ, saindhavaṃ, dāḍimāmalakamityeṣa vargaḥ sarvaprāṇināṃ ‘sarvavraṇināṃ’ iti pā. sāmānyataḥ pathyatamaḥ ||5||

ata ityādi| raktaśāliḥ svanāmnā prasiddhaḥ| ṣaṣṭiko gauraṣaṣṭikaḥ| kaṅguko gaurakṛṣṇaṣaṣṭikaḥ| mukundakaḥ kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭikaḥ| pāṇḍukaḥ pāṇḍukaśāliḥ, sa ca pāṇḍutuṣayuktaḥ| sugandhako devaśāliḥ| kalamaḥ śāliviśeṣaḥ, ‘kalāviḥ’ iti loke prasiddhaḥ| ete ṣaṣṭikādayaḥ śūkadhānyeṣu| nīvāraḥ prasādi(ti)kādhānyamadhye raktaśūko bhavati, ‘tulajīdhānyam’ iti loke prasiddhaḥ| uddālaka āraṇyakodravaḥ| vaiṇavo veṇuyavaḥ| nīvārādayastu kudhānyeṣu| eṇaḥ kṛṣṇamṛgaḥ| hariṇastāmravarṇo mṛgaḥ| kuraṅgaḥ ‘caturaṅga’ iti loke prasiddhaḥ| mṛgamātṛkā svalpā pṛthūdarā caturaṅgastrī| śvadaṃṣṭrā caturdaṃṣṭro'tiduṣṭaḥ, ‘karkaṭaka’ iti loke| karālaḥ kastūrīmṛgaḥ| tittiriḥ kṛṣṇatittiriḥ| kapiñjalo gauratittiriḥ| vartīraḥ ‘gharghara’ iti loke; vartikā tadbhedaḥ| eṇādayo jāṅgalamṛgamāṃseṣu| lāvādayo jāṅgalapakṣiṣu| maṅgalyāḥ pāṇḍuvarṇā masūrāḥ| hareṇuḥ satīnabhedo vartulakalāyaḥ| āḍhakī tuvarī| satīno vartulakaḥ| mudgādayo vaidalasūpyeṣu| cillī kṣetravāstukaḥ| vāstukaḥ ṭaṅkavāstukaḥ| suniṣaṇṇakaḥ śirivālikā, catuṣparṇītyapare| jīvantī ḍoḍikā| maṇḍūkaparṇī brāhmī| cillīprabhṛtīni śākeṣu| gavyaṃ ghṛtaṃ sneheṣu| saindhavaṃ lavaṇeṣu| āmalakadāḍimau phaleṣu| nanu, nīvārakodravoddālakādīnāṃ vātakaratvādvātāhitatvaṃ syāt, tat kathaṃ hitānītyucyante? naivam; alpavātakaratvādadoṣakaratvavyapadeśa iti||5||
tathā brahmacaryanivātaśayanoṣṇodakasnānaniśāsvapnavyāyāmāścaikāntataḥ pathyatamāḥ ||6||
āhāramaikāntikaṃ nirdiśya vihāraṃ nirdiśannāha- tathetyādi| brahmacaryaṃ strīsevānivṛttiḥ| vyāyāmaḥ svasthasya mātrayā kāle ca pathyatamaḥ| vyāyāmāśceti cakārādvegāvidhāraṇādīnāṃ grahaṇam||6||
ekāntahitānyekāntāhitāni tu prāgupadiṣṭāni, hitāhitāni tu yadvāyoḥ pathyaṃ tat pittasyāpathyamiti ||7||

ekāntetyādi|- ekāntahitāni salilādīni| ekāntāhitāni agnyādīni; etāni pūrvaṃ kathitāni| hitāhitāni tviti tuśabdaścārthe, tena hitāhitāni ca prāgupadiṣṭāni| kāni punastāni hitāhitāni prāgupadiṣṭānītyāha- yadvāyoḥ pathyaṃ tat pittasyāpathyamiti||7||

saṃyogatastvaparāṇi viṣatulyāni bhavanti | tadyathā- vallīphalakavakakarīrāmlaphalalavaṇakulatthapiṇyākadadhitailavirohipiṣṭaśuṣkaśākājāvikamāṃsamadyajāmbavacilicimamatsyagodhāvarāhāṃśca naikadhyamaśnīyāt ‘vallīphalādīnāmādāvante ca payaḥ kālaviśeṣāpekṣasaṃyogaviruddhameva’ iti cakraḥ payasā ||8||

saṃyogatastvityādi| viṣatulyānīti viṣatulyatvenaikāntāhitatvamuktam| kutaḥ? svasthe viṣasyekāntāhitatvāt| tānyeva darśayannāha- tadyathetyādi| vallīphalaṃ kūṣmāṇḍādivallījam, anye śimbyādimāhuḥ; kavakaṃ chatrakaṃ, ‘chatrakabhedaṃ sukhaṇḍakasañjñam’ ityanye; karīro vaṃśāṅkura; amlaphalāni āmrātakādīni; virohi vigatarohaṃ caṇakādikamaṅkuritaṃ ca; piṣṭaṃ taṇḍulapiṣṭaṃ; jāmbavaṃ jambūphalaṃ; cilicimamatsyaḥ śakalī lohitākṣaḥ sarvato lohitarājiḥ prāyo bhūmau carati sthalamīnasañjñakaḥ ‘nalamīnasañjñakaḥ’ iti pā.| naikadhyaṃ naikasmin kāle| etāni vallīphalādīni varāhāntāni samastavyastānyapi payasā saha nāśnīyāt| kecidetasya vargasyānte ‘ajāṅgalaṃ māṃsaṃ svasthānāmanyatra rogopasṛṣṭebhyaḥ’ iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- ajāṅgalaṃ māṃsaṃ jaleśayānūpādibhedena pañcaprakāram||8||
rogaṃ sātmyaṃ ca deśaṃ ca kālaṃ dehaṃ ca buddhimān | avekṣyāgnyādikān bhāvān rogavṛtteḥ prayojayet ||9||

viruddhasyāpi kvacit prayogaṃ darśayannāha- rogamityādi| rogam udarādikam| sātmyam aṣṭavidhaṃ jātyāturauṣadhānnarasadeśartūdakamedataḥ ‘jātyāturarogadhānyarasadeśartrūdakabhedataḥ’ iti pā.| deśamānūpādikam| kālaṃ śītoṣṇavarṣalakṣaṇam| dehaṃ sthūlakṛśamadhyabhedabhinnam| agnyādikān bhāvāniti agnyādikān padārthān| ādiśabdāt prakṛtivayobalasattvādi gṛhyate| rogavṛtteḥ rogiṇa ityarthaḥ| etena buddhimānūhāpohavitarkānugatadhīyukto vaidyo rogādīnavekṣyaikāntāhitamapi rogiṇaḥ prayojayediti| tadyathā- udariṇastilamātraviṣabhakṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇasarpadaṣṭekṣukāṇḍabhakṣaṇaṃ cetyādikaṃ boddhavyam||9||
avasthāntarabāhulyādrogādīnāṃ vyavasthitam | dravyaṃ necchanti bhiṣaja icchanti svastharakṣaṇe ||10||

dvayoranyatarādāne ‘anyataraśabdeneha prakṛtatvāt sannihitatvādvā svastha evābhipreta iti niścīyate, arthāntarāsambhavāt| tathā dvayorviṣadugdhayoḥ svasthenābhyavahāro'nyatarādānaṃ, tasmin dugdhasyaikāntahitatāṃ viṣaṃ caikāntato'hitaṃ vadanti, ‘jātisātmyādekāntāhitatvācca’ iti śeṣaḥ’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ vadanti viṣadugdhayoḥ | dugdhasyaikāntahitatāṃ viṣamekāntato'hitam ||11||

evaṃ yuktaraseṣveṣu yuktaraseṣu dugdhavatprabhāvasaṃsiddhasvasthānuvartirasayukteṣu, nānyathā nānyatra na tadviparīteṣu viṣādiṣvityarthaḥ’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ dravyeṣu salilādiṣu | ekāntahitatāṃ viddhi vatsa suśruta nānyathā ||12||

tasmāddhitāhitatvena vyavasthitaṃ dravyaṃ nāstītyāha- avasthāntarabāhulyādityādi| avasthāntarabāhulyāt avasthāviśeṣāṇāṃ prācuryāt| keṣāmavasthāviśeṣā ityāha- rogādīnām| ādiśabdāt sātmyadeśādīnāṃ grahaṇam| vyavasthitaṃ dravyaṃ necchantīti hitamevedamahitamevedamiti vaidyā necchanti, avasthāviśeṣabāhulyāt| kiṃ sarvatraiva vyavasthitaṃ dravyaṃ necchantītyāha- icchanti svastharakṣaṇa iti|- svastharakṣaṇe punarvyavasthitaṃ dravyaṃ vaidyā icchantyeveti| amumevārthaṃ darśayannāha- dvayorityādi| dvayoḥ svastharogiṇoḥ| anyatarādāna iti sāmānyoktāvapi svasthasyaiva grahaṇam| tena viṣadugdhayormadhye svasthe dugdhasyaikāntahitatāṃ bhiṣajo vadanti, viṣaṃ punarekāntato'hitamiti vadanti| evaṃ yuktaraseṣveṣviti evamanena svasthopayogaprakāreṇa| viddhi jānīhi| nānyatheti nāsvasthopayogaprakāreṇa||10-12||

ato'nyānyapi saṃyogādahitāni vakṣyāmaḥ- navavirūḍhadhānyairvasāmadhupayoguḍamāṣairvā grāmyānūpaudakapiśitādīni nābhyavaharet; na payomadhubhyāṃ rohiṇīśākaṃ jātukaśākaṃ vā'śnīyāt, balākāṃ vāruṇīkulmāṣābhyāṃ, kākamācīṃ pippalīmaricābhyāṃ; nāḍībhaṅgaśākakukkuṭadadhīni ca naikadhyaṃ; madhu coṣṇodakānupānaṃ; pittena cāmamāṃsāni; surākṛśarāpāyasāṃśca naikadhyaṃ; sauvīrakeṇa saha tilaśaṣkulīṃ; matsyaiḥ sahekṣuvikārān; guḍena kākamācīṃ, madhunā mūlakaṃ, guḍena vārāhaṃ madhunā ca saha viruddhaṃ; kṣīreṇa mūlakam, āmrajāmbavaśvāvicchūkaragodhāśca; sarvāṃśca matsyān payasā, viśeṣeṇa cilicimaṃ; kadalīphalaṃ tālaphalena payasā dadhnā takreṇa vā; lakucaphalaṃ payasā dadhnā māṣasūpena vā, prāk payasaḥ payaso'nte vā ||13||

ato'nyānyapītyādi| navavirūḍhadhānyairiti navavirūḍhadhānyādibhiḥ saha grāmyādīnāṃ māṃsādīni nāśnīyādityarthaḥ| navadhānyādibhiḥ samastairvyastairapi grāmyādīnāṃ piśitādīni viruddhānīti| virūḍhaṃ vigatāṅkuramaṅkuritaṃ ca| rohiṇīśākaṃ kaṭukāśākam| jātukaśākaṃ pauṣkaraśākam| balākāṃ vāruṇīkulmāṣābhyāmiti balākā bakabhedaḥ; vāruṇī madyāparaparyāyaḥ, kulmāṣa utsvinnamāṣādiḥ; ābhyāṃ saha balākāṃ nāśnīyāditi yojyam| kākamācīmityādi pippalīmaricābhyāṃ saha kākamācīṃ nāśnīyāditi yojanīyam| nāḍībhaṅgaśākaṃ nāḍīpallavaśākaṃ, kukkuṭastāmracūḍaḥ; etāni dviśastriśo'pi vā nāśnīyāt| madhu ceti na hitamityarthaḥ| pittaṃ kālakhaṇḍalagnam| surā madyabhedaḥ, kṛśarā tilataṇḍulamāṣaiḥ kṛtā yavāgūḥ, pāyasaṃ kṣīrasiddhāstaṇḍulāḥ amūnyapi triśo dviśo vā'pi viruddhāni| sauvīrakeṇeti sauvīrakaṃ kāñjikaviśeṣo virecanādhikāre vakṣyate| ikṣuvikārān guḍādīn| guḍena kākamācīmityādi| anye tvevaṃ paṭhanti- ‘guḍena kākamācīṃ, madhunā mūlakaṃ, vārāhaṃ kṣīreṇa mūlakaṃ ca’ apare tvevaṃ paṭhanti- ‘guḍena kākamācīṃ, madhunā mūlakaṃ, vārāhaṃ ca’; cakārāt ‘madhuna’ iti padaṃ vārāheṇa kākamācyā ca saha sambadhnanti| āmrajāmbavetyādi ‘naikadhyamaśnīyāt’ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ| śvāvit sehikā| sarvāṃśca matsyānityādi, nanu sarvāṃśca matsyān payasā’ ityanenaiva cilicimamatsyavirodhaḥ siddhaḥ tat kimarthaṃ vallīphalādiṣu cilicimatsyasya payasā virodhapāṭha ityāha- viśeṣeṇa cilicimamiti| kadalīphalamityādi tālādibhiḥ saha kadalīphalaṃ nāśnīyādityarthaḥ| lakucetyādi dadhyādibhiḥ saha lakucaphalaṃ nāśnīyādityarthaḥ| kecidatra ‘madhunā ghṛtena ca’ iti paṭhanti, lakucaphalaṃ nāśnīyāditi ca vyākhyānayanti| ayaṃ pāṭho vartamānāsu bahuṣu pratiṣu paṭhyate, na tu nibandheṣu, tasmānna paṭhanīya iti| prāk payasaḥ payaso'nte veti ‘lakucaphalaṃ nāśnīyāt’ iti śeṣaḥ||13||

ataḥ karmaviruddhān vakṣyāmaḥ- kapotān sarṣapatailabhṛṣṭānnādyāt; kapiñjalamayūralāvatittirigodhāścairaṇḍadārvyagnisiddhā eraṇḍatailasiddhā vā nādyāt; kāṃsyabhājane daśarātraparyuṣitaṃ sarpiḥ; madhu coṣṇairuṣṇe vā; matsyaparipacane śṛṅgaveraparipacane vā siddhāṃ kākamācīṃ; tilakalkasiddhamupodikāśākaṃ; nārikelena varāhavasāparibhṛṣṭāṃ balākāṃ; bhāsamaṅgāraśūlyaṃ nāśnīyāditi ||14||

saṃyogaviruddhānabhidhāya karmaviruddhān vaktumāha- ata ityādi| karmaśabdenātra saṃskāro'bhipretaḥ| eraṇḍadārvyagnisiddhā iti eraṇḍadāruharidrāgnisiddhāḥ; ‘eraṇḍadārvagnisiddhā’ ityanye paṭhanti, ‘eraṇḍakāṣṭhavahninā siddhāḥ’ iti ca vyākhyānayanti| nādyāt na khādet| daśarātraparyuṣitamiti daśaniśādināni nivāsitam| madhu coṣṇairiti uṣṇairuṣṇasparśadravyaiḥ, uṣṇasparśatvaṃ cāgnyādijanitaṃ jñeyam| uṣṇe uṣṇakāle grīṣme śaradi cetyarthaḥ| matsyaparipacana iti paripacanaṃ pātramucyate| nārikelenetyādi varāhavasāparibhṛṣṭāṃ balākāṃ nārikeleṇa saha nāśnīyādityarthaḥ| bhāsamiti bhāso gṛdhraviśeṣaḥ svalpatuṇḍo dhūsaravarṇaḥ| yacchūlena viddhvā aṅgāreṣu pakvaṃ tadaṅgāraśūlyam||14||
ato mānaviruddhān vakṣyāmaḥ- madhvambunī madhusarpiṣī mānatastulye nāśnīyāt; snehau madhusnehau jalasnehau vā viśeṣādāntarīkṣodakānupānau ||15||
jalasnehāvityādi āntarīkṣodakānupānau viśeṣato madhusnehau jalasnehau vā nāśnīyāt| tadevaṃ svabhāvāpathyasaṃyogakālasaṃskāramānaiḥ pañcaprakārāṇi viruddhāni nirdiṣṭāni||15||

ata ūrdhvaṃ rasadvandvāni rasato vīryato vipākataśca viruddhāni vakṣyāmaḥ- tatra madhurāmlau rasavīryaviruddhau, madhuralavaṇau ca, madhurakaṭukau ca sarvataḥ, madhuratiktau rasavipākābhyāṃ, madhurakaṣāyau ca, amlalavaṇau rasataḥ, amlakaṭukau rasavipākābhyām, amlatiktāvamlakaṣāyau ca sarvataḥ, lavaṇakaṭukau rasavipākābhyāṃ, lavaṇatiktau lavaṇakaṣāyau ca sarvataḥ, kaṭutiktau rasavīryābhyāṃ kaṭukaṣāyau ‘kaṭukaṣāyau tiktakaṣāyau ca rasataḥ’ iti pā. ca, tiktakaṣāyau rasataḥ ||16||

ata ūrdhvamityādi| madhuralavaṇau ceti cakāreṇa rasavīryaviruddhāviti samuccīyate| sarvata iti rasavīryavipākataḥ; evaṃ sarvatra rasadvandvaprakaraṇe sarvataḥśabdo vyākhyātavyaḥ| madhurakaṣāyau ceti cakāreṇa imāvapi rasavipākābhyāṃ viruddhāviti samuccīyate| kaṭukaṣāyau ceti cakārādetāvapi rasavīryābhyāṃ viruddhāviti| madhurāmlāvityādipāṭhena dadhiśarkarādidvandveṣūpayogārheṣu na virodhaḥ, anyeṣu cānūpayogārheṣu virodha iti sūcitam| śrīgayadāsādaya ācāryā amuṃ pāṭhamanārṣaṃ varṇayanti; kasmāt? ‘ādau madhuramaśrnīyāt’ (sū. a.46) ityādinā sarvarasābhyavahārasya svasthānāmuktatvāt, ‘na caikarasasevāyāṃ’ ityādinā caikarasasevāyā niṣiddhatvāt; tasmānna paṭhanīya evāyaṃ grantha iti| śrībrahmadevastvārṣānārṣacintāmakurvannamuṃ granthaṃ paṭhati vyākhyānayati ca| tatpaṭhitavyākhyātvāt sarvamatadarśibhirasmābhirapi likhitaḥ kvacidvyākhyātaśceti||16||
taratamayogayuktāṃśca bhāvānatisnigdhānatirūkṣānatyuṣṇānatiśītānityevamādīn vivarjayet ||17||

atiśayaguṇayogayuktā māhiṣakṣīrādipadārthā hitā api svasthānāmekāntāhitā bhavantīti darśayannāha- taratametyādi| taratamayogayuktāṃśca bhāvāniti atiśayasnehādiguṇasahitāni dravyāṇītyarthaḥ| tānevātiśayaguṇayuktān vivṛṇvannāha- atisnigdhānityādi| tasmānmāhiṣaṃ dugdhaṃ gavyādatiśayasnigdhaṃ svasthasya samāgnervarjyam, asvasthasya ca tīkṣṇāgneḥ sevyamityādi draṣṭavyam| yuktāṃśceti cakāro'tiśayaguṇayuktānāmapi pathyatamāyuṣyatamavṛṣyatamānāṃ sevanaṃ samuccinoti, eṣāmekāntahitatvāt; ebhyo'nye'tiśayaguṇayuktāḥ svābhāvādevaikāntāhitā iti| evamādīnityādiśabdādanye'pi vīryasañjñakā guṇāḥ picchilaviśadatīkṣṇamṛdavo gṛhyante, tathā gurulaghuvīryaṃ ca| anye tu ‘ādiśabdāduktebhyo'nye'pi sarve guṇā gṛhyante’ iti vadanti||17||

bhavanti cātra- viruddhānyevamādīni vīryato ‘vīryata iti svabhāvataḥ, sa ca svabhāvo dravyarasavīryavipākāśrayo jñeyaḥ, yaduktaṃ ‘yena kurvanti tadvīryam’ iti cakraḥ yāni kānicit | tānyekāntāhitānyeva śeṣaṃ ‘śeṣamekāntahitaikāntāhitādanyatsarvam| viruddhaṃ tu prabhāvādevāsamānaguṇatayāpratīyamānamapi kāryato'viruddhaṃ bhavitumarhati| tataścaikāntāhitamiti śāstrādevāvadhāryate’ iti cakraḥ vidyāddhitāhitam ||18||

amumevārthaṃ sukhabodhārthaṃ saṅgṛhyāha- viruddhānītyādi| vīryata iti vīryaśabdenātra snigdhādayo'ṣṭau guṇā ucyante; athavā viṃśatiguṇāḥ ṣaḍrasā apyucyante, ‘yena kurvanti tadvīryam’ (sū. a.41) iti vacanāt| evamādīnītyukte yāni kāniciditi yat kṛtaṃ tattantrāntaroktāśeṣaviruddhopagrahārtham| anye tvādiśabdāttantrāntaroktāni deśakālamātrādiviruddhāni labhyanta iti manyante| śeṣam ato'nyanmāṣādi hitāhitaṃ jānīyāt, kasyaciddoṣasya prakopatvāt kasyaciddoṣasya haratvāditi||18||
vyādhimindriyadaurbalyaṃ maraṇaṃ cādhigacchati | viruddharasavīryāṇi bhuñjāno'nātmavānnaraḥ ||19||

kiṃ punarviruddhaṃ bhuktaṃ karotītyāha- vyādhimityādi| vyādhimiti ṣāṇḍyāndhyavisarpadakodaravisphoṭakonmādabhagandarādikama ‘ṣāṇḍhyāndhyavīsarpadakodarāṇāṃ visphoṭakonmādabhagandarāṇām| mūrcchāmadādhmānagalāmayānāṃ pāṇḍvāmayasyāmaviṣasya caiva|| kilāsakuṣṭhagrahaṇīgadānāṃ śophāsrapittajvarapīnasānām| santānadoṣasya tathaiva mṛtyorviruddhamannaṃ pravadanti hetum’ iti carakaḥ (sū. a.26), indriyadaurbalyam indriyādhiṣṭhānadaurbalyamindriyaśaktidaurbalyaṃ vā, adhigacchati prāpnoti| viruddharasavīryāṇi bhuñjāna iti rasagrahaṇaṃ dravyavīryaparihārārthaṃ, tenoṣṇasyāpi dugdhasya prayogo bhavati; kṣīradravyasya hyuṣṇatvaṃ tadgatamadhurarasaśaityena virodhinā'pi na duṣyati, evamuṣṇapānīyasyāpīti| anātmavān abuddhimān| anye ‘rasavīryādīn’ iti paṭhanti| teṣāṃ mate vipākayorapi gurulaghusañjñayorvirodho varjanīya iti| pūrvapratipāditādhyāyārthapiṇḍadarśanaparaḥ śloko'yaṃ; tenāsminnadhyāya ‘viruddharasavīryāṇīti atra vairodhikatvenoktānyeva viruddharasāni viruddhavīryāṇi ca yathāyogyatayā ūhanīyāni| na tvatrānukte'pi viruddharasatvādikalpanā| tathāhi sati payo'pi śītamuṣṇena viruddhaṃ syāt, pānakādi madhurāmlarasaṃ rasaviruddhatvādviruddhaṃ syāt’ iti cakraḥ eva yāni viruddhāni dravyāṇyuktāni teṣveva rasavīryavirodho jñeyo, na punarihānuktāni yāni teṣviti||19||

yatkiñciddoṣamutkleśya ‘doṣamutkleśya kṣobhayitvā| na nirharedityanena doṣahārakamadanatrivṛtādibhyo vyāvartakaṃ bhuktamityadhikṛtam| etaccopalakṣaṇaṃ, tena vihāro'pyevaṃlakṣaṇo jñeyaḥ| yaduktaṃ carake- ‘yatkiñciddoṣamākṣubhya na nirharati kāyataḥ| āhārajātamanyadvā tatsarvamahitaṃ smṛtam’ (ca. sū. a.26) iti| rasādiṣvayathārthamiti rasādidūṣakamiti yāvat| kiṃvā rasavīryavipākeṣvayathārthaṃ viruddhamityarthaḥ’| iti cakraḥ bhuktaṃ kāyānna nirharet | rasādiṣvayathārthaṃ vā tadvikārāya kalpate ||20||

na kevalaṃ viruddhabhojanameva vyādhihetuḥ, api tu hitāhitādīnyapīti darśayannāha- yadityādi| yatkiñcidityanena aśeṣamevāhitaṃ saṅgṛhītam| doṣaṃ vātādikam| utkleśya prakopya| na nirharediti madanaphalatrivṛtādivadūrdhvamadho vā nākarṣet, tadvikārāya kalpata iti sambandhanīyam; kalpate sampadyate| na kevalaṃ doṣakarameva vyādhaye bhavati, api tu rasādidhātuduṣṭikaramapi vyādhaye bhavatītyāha- rasādiṣvityādi| rasādiṣvayathārthaṃ veti rasādidhātuṣvayathārthaṃ prayojanaviruddhaṃ rasādīnāṃ jīvanādiprayojanavirodhi rasādidhātudūṣaṇakaramityarthaḥ| doṣaduṣṭikāritvena dhātudūṣaṇakaratvaṃ na labhyate, viśiṣṭaśaktitvāddravyāṇāṃ; tathāhi- kāniciddoṣaduṣṭikarāṇi, kāniciddhātuduṣṭikarāṇīti; tāni cātra na kathayiṣyāmo vistarabhayāt| anye tu vyākhyānayanti- rasādiṣviti ādiśabdādvīryavipākayorgrahaṇaṃ; tena rasavīryavipākeṣu yadbhuktaṃ sadayathārthamanarthakaraṃ vā bhavati, tadvikārasya kalpate| jaijjhaṭācāryastvamuṃ ślokamanārṣaṃ kathayati, gayadāsācāryeṇa cāyamaṅgīkṛtaḥ, ato'smābhirapi likhito vyākhyātaśca||20||

viruddhāśanajān rogān pratihanti virecanam | vamanaṃ śamanaṃ vā'pi pūrvaṃ vā hitasevanam ‘pratihantīti pratipakṣaṃ sat hanti| tena kuṣṭhādipratyanīkaṃ virecanaṃ kuṣṭhādi hanti| evaṃ vamanaśamanayorapi pratyayaṃ vyākhyeyaḥ| pūrvameva mahāprabhāvarasāyanādisevayā na prabhavantyevambhūtā vyādhaya ityarthaḥ’ iti cakraḥ| ‘śuddhiratreṣṭā śamo vā tadvirodhibhiḥ| dravyaistaireva vā pūrva śarīrasyābhisaṃskṛtiḥ’ iti vāgbhaṭaḥ (sū. a.7)||21||

viruddhāśanādutpannānāṃ rogāṇāṃ cikitsāsūtramuddiśannāha- viruddhāśanajānityādi| pratihanti virecanamiti viruddhāśanajavyādhipratyanīkaṃ virecanaṃ pratiśabdena dyotyate; tena kuṣṭhavyādhipratyanīkaṃ virecanaṃ viruddhāśanajaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ hanti, evamanyatrāpi yojanīyam| vamanaṃ śamanaṃ vā'pīti tatra virekavamane bahudoṣāṇāṃ prāṇavatāṃ ca, itareṣāṃ tu śamanamiti| śamanalakṣaṇamucyate- “na śodhayati yaddoṣān samānnodīrayatyapi| samīkaroti kruddhāṃśca tat saṃśamanamucyate”- iti| pūrvaṃ vā hitasevanamiti suvarṇalohādivirodhirogaharaṃ pūrvameva seveta| taduktaṃ “na sajjate hemapāṅge viṣaṃ padmadale'mbuvat” (ca. ci. a. 23)| ‘pūrvaṃ vā hitabhojanam’ ityanye paṭhanti||21||

sātmyato'lpatayā sātmyata ityabhyāsasātmyatayā| alpaṃ hīnaśaktitvādabhibhūtaṃ na karoti kārya| taruṇasya pratyagrabalatvādvitathaṃ bhavati| snigdhasya srotaḥsu na tiṣṭhati doṣaḥ, tathā ca doṣavigamādviruddhaṃ vitathaṃ bhavati| vyāyāminaśca vyāyāmenaiva doṣakṣayaḥ, taduktaṃ- ‘vyāyāmaṃ kurvato nityaṃ viruddhaṃ vitathaṃ bhavet’ iti| balinastu balābhibhūtā eva doṣā na jāyante na kurvanti vā kāryam| yaduktaṃ- ‘balaṃ hyalaṃ nigrahāya doṣāṇāṃ’ (ca. ci. a. 3) iti cakraḥ vā'pi dīptāgnestaruṇasya ca | snigdhavyāyāmabalināṃ viruddhaṃ vitathaṃ bhavet ||22||

viruddhāśanaṃ kurvato'pi kasyacit kuto viruddhāśanajā doṣā na bhavantītyāha- sātmyata ityādi| sātmyādibhirhetubhirviruddhaṃ vitathaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavatīti piṇḍārthaḥ| snigdhavyāyāmabalināmiti snigdhavyāyāmābhyāṃ balināmiti sambadhyate| tenāyamarthaḥ- snigdhadravyābhyavahārabalināṃ balavadagnitvādviruddhaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavati| kecit ‘balinām’ iti padaṃ bhinnaṃ manyante| tenāyamarthaḥ- snigdhānāṃ vyāyāmināṃ balināṃ ca viruddhaṃ vitathaṃ bhavediti| sātmyato'lpatayetyādiślokasyāgre kecidamuṃ ślokaṃ paṭhanti- “vyāyāmaśīlo balavān śiśuśca snigdho'gnimāṃścāpi mahāśanaśca| āpnoti rogānna viruddhajātānabhyāsato vā'lpatayā ca jantuḥ” iti; ayaṃ ca na paṭhanīyaḥ, sarvanibandhakārairapaṭhitatvāt||22||
atha vātaguṇān vakṣyāmaḥ- pūrvaḥ samadhuraḥ snigdho lavaṇaścaiva mārutaḥ | gururvidāhajanano raktapittābhivardhanaḥ ||23||
kṣatānāṃ viṣajuṣṭānāṃ vraṇinaḥ śleṣmalāśca ye | teṣāmeva viśeṣeṇa sadā rogavivardhanaḥ ||24||
vātalānāṃ praśastaśca śrāntānāṃ kaphaśoṣiṇām | madhuraścāvidāhī ca kaṣāyānuraso laghuḥ | dakṣiṇo mārutaḥ śreṣṭhaścakṣuṣyo balavardhanaḥ ||25||
raktapittapraśamano na ca vātaprakopaṇaḥ | viśado rūkṣaparuṣaḥ kharaḥ snehabalāpahaḥ ||26||
paścimo mārutastīkṣṇaḥ kaphamedoviśoṣaṇaḥ | sadyaḥ prāṇakṣayakaraḥ śoṣaṇastu śarīriṇām ||27||
uttaro mārutaḥ snigdho mṛdurmadhura eva ca | kaṣāyānurasaḥ śīto doṣāṇāṃ cāprakopaṇaḥ ||28||
tasmācca prakṛtisthānāṃ kledano balavardhanaḥ | kṣīṇakṣayaviṣārtānāṃ viśeṣeṇa tu pūjitaḥ ||29||

hitasyāpi vātasya diksaṃyogādahitatvaṃ syāditi vātaguṇān nirdiśannāha- atha vātaguṇān vakṣyāma ityādi| “vātasya dakṣiṇottaragatasya doṣaharatvena hitatvaṃ, pūrvapaścimavātasyāhitatvam, ato hitāhitīyādhyāyaparisamāptau vātasya guṇopavarṇanaṃ nirdeṣṭumāha- atha vātaguṇānityādi” ityanye| ‘teṣāmeva viśeṣeṇa vraṇakledavivardhanaḥ’ ityanye paṭhanti| kharaḥ pracaṇḍavegaḥ| anye tvāhāradravyaprakaraṇāditarasaṃyogo'prastuta ityamuṃ vātaguṇopavarṇanagranthaṃ na paṭhantyeva| gayadāsācāryastvasmin hitāhitīyādhyāyapāṭhe pūrvoktaṃ pāṭhaṃ kiyantaṃ parityajyānyaṃ ca pāṭhaṃ kiyantaṃ nikṣipya pūrvoktapāṭhakramavyatikrameṇa ca paṭhati| yāvatā pāṭhena vyatikramastāvantaṃ darśayannāha- “vallīphalakavakakarīrāmlaphalalavaṇakulatthapiṇyākadadhitilatailavirodhi- śuṣkaśākājāvikamāṃsamadyajāmbavacilicimamatsyagodhāvarāhāṃśca naikadhyamaśnīyāt payasā, prāk payaso'nte vā| kapotāṃśca cakrastu gayadāsācāryasammatamamuṃ pāṭhamavalambya vyākhyātavān| ‘saṃskārarūpasaṃyogaviśeṣaviruddhamāha- kapotāṃścetyādi| kapiñjalādyapi saṃskāraviruddham| madhughṛte samadhṛte iti mātrāpradhānasaṃyogaviruddham| deśakālaviśeṣavatsaṃyogaviruddhaṃ- kāṃsyabhājane ityādi| madhu coṣṇamuṣṇārteneti uṣṇārtena puruṣeṇa| pittena cāmamāṃsamiti atrāmasyānupayogādāmamivāmamasamyakpakvaṃ jñeyam|’ iti cakraḥ sarṣapatailabhṛṣṭānnādyāt| kapiñjalamayūralāvatittirigodhāścairaṇḍadārvya(rva)gnisiddhā eraṇḍatailasiddhā vā| madhughṛte samadhṛte| madhu cāntarīkṣodakānupānam| kāṃsyabhājane daśarātraparyuṣitaṃ sarpiḥ| madhu coṣṇamuṣṇena vā| dadhi madyaṃ vā| pittena saha māṃsāni pakvāni, āmāni ca kevalānyapi| surākṛśarāpāyasāṃśca naikadhyamaśnīyāt| sauvīrakeṇa saha tilaśaṣkulīḥ| takreṇa saha madhughṛtamatsyagodhāpṛṣatamāṃsāni ‘madhughṛtadhānāpṛṣatamāṃsāni’ iti pā.| madhunā godhām| matsyān kṣaudrāsavena, pṛṣatamāṃsaṃ vā tenaiva| tathā maireyamādhvīkābhyāṃ bālopodakyā vā matsyān| nekṣuvikṛtīḥ sarvā matsyaiḥ saha| sarpirguḍakākamācīmadhumūlakāni naikadhyam ‘guḍaṃ kākamācyā, madhunā mūlakāni’ iti pā.| madhunā vārāhaṃ, dadhnā kaukkuṭaṃ, madyena balākāṃ, tilakalkena copodikāṃ siddhām| na pippalīṃ matsyavasayā, priyaṅgvanulipto na pāyasamaśnīyāt ‘payasā samamaśnīyāt’ pā. iti| asyāgre ca ‘taratamayogayuktāṃśca bhāvān’ ityādisūtrāṇi paṭhati, tāni ca pūrvasūtraireva samānānīti neha pradarśitāni||23-29||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne hitāhitīyo nāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||20||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne viṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||20||
athāto vraṇapraśnamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

athāta ityādi| vraṇaviṣayaḥ praśno yasmin sa vraṇapraśnaḥ| vraṇaśabdenātra vātādaya ucyante, vraṇakāraṇatvāt; tena vātādiviṣayaḥ praśno yasminnityuktam| anye tu vraṇamāśritya praśno vraṇapraśnaḥ, sa vidyate yasminnityarthe utpannasya īyapratyayasya lopaṃ kṛtvā vraṇapraśnamiti rūpaṃ paṭhanti| tenātra vraṇārambhakāṇāṃ vātādīnāṃ saṅkhyāsvalakṣaṇakarmādīni vraṇasya ca niruktyādi ca vaktavyamityarthaḥ siddhaḥ||1-2||

vātapittaśleṣmāṇa eva ‘evakāro bhinnakramaḥ| tena sambhavahetavaevetyarthaḥ| atra vātādayaḥ śukraśoṇitagatāḥ prakṛtisthatayā garbhasambhave hetavo bhavanti| . . . pralaye iti dehanāśe| raktasyāpi śalyaśāstrapradhānavraṇādhiṣṭhānasya hetuliṅgacikitsitaviśeṣaprayojakatayā prādhānyakhyāpanārthaṃ doṣatulyatayā sambhavādihetutvaṃ niyamayannāha- tadebhirityādi| avirahitamiti kāraṇatayā avirahitam| śoṇitasya dehakāraṇatvamārtavakāraṇatayā vyaktameva| śoṇitasya dehakārakatvādi coktaṃ śāstre “dehasya rudhiraṃ mūlaṃ rudhireṇaiva dhāryate” iti| sākṣāccāsya vātādivat prapañcānabhidhānena pāramārthikīṃ doṣatāṃ pratikṣipati| yadi hi vātādivaddoṣaḥ syāt tadā tenāpi prakṛtiḥ syādityādidūṣaṇamanusartavyam’ iti cakraḥ dehasambhavahetavaḥ | tairevāvyāpannairadhomadhyordhvasanniviṣṭaiḥ śarīramidaṃ dhāryate'gāramiva sthūṇābhistisṛbhiḥ ataśca tristhūṇamāhureke | ta eva ca vyāpannāḥ pralayahetavaḥ | tadebhireva śoṇitacaturthaiḥ sambhavasthitipralayeṣvapyavirahitaṃ śarīraṃ bhavati ||3||

vraṇakāraṇāni vātādīni prathamaṃ saṅkhyādibhirnirdiśannāha- vātapittaśleṣmāṇa ityādi| dehasambhavahetavo dehotpattihetavaḥ| nanu, śukraśoṇite dehotpattihetū ? tat kathaṃ vātādayo dehasambhavahetavaḥ kathyante ? ucyate, avikṛtā vātādayaḥ śukrārtavādisahakāritayā dehajanakā abhipretā ityarthaḥ| śarīrasambhave vātādīnāṃ hetutvaṃ pratipādya sthitikāraṇatvaṃ darśayannāha- tairevetyādi|- taireva vātapittaśleṣmabhiḥ, avyāpannaiḥ prakṛtisthairityarthaḥ| adhomadhyordhvasanniviṣṭairiti yathākrameṇa vātapittakaphaiḥ| dṛṣṭāntamāha- agāramivetyādi|- agāraṃ gṛham| ekīyamatamāha- ataśca tristhūṇamāhureke| cakāro'yaṃ tristhūṇamityatra yojyaḥ, tenāyamarthaḥ- tristhūṇamiti ca ata eva hetoreko ācāryā āhuḥ| dehavināśahetutvamapi vātādīnāṃ nirdiśannāha- ta eva vyāpannā ityādi| cakāro'tra bhinnakrame, tenāyamarthaḥ- ta eva vātādayaḥ, vyāpannāśca vikṛtisthāḥ pralayahetavo vināśahetavo ‘bhavanti’ ityadhyāhāraḥ| anye tu ‘pralaye'pi’ ityapiśabdaṃ paṭhanti| śalyaśāstre vraṇārambhādhiṣṭhānabhūtatvāt kasyaciddūṣyasya prādhānyaṃ darśayannāha- tadityādi|- ebhireva vātapittakaphaiḥ| śoṇitacaturthairiti nanu, pūrvaṃ śoṇitamanupāttaṃ, tatkathamiha sambhavādiṣu śoṇitasyāvirahitatvamuktaṃ? satyaṃ, paramiha śoṇitopādānaṃ kurvannekīyamatamidamiti darśayati, tena vraṇapāke darśanadvayaṃ bhavati; tathāhi- ‘narte'nilādasti rujā’ (sū. a. 17) ityādinā vraṇapāke doṣā eva vyāpriyanta iti darśitaṃ, ‘kālāntareṇābhyuditaṃ tu pittaṃ’ (sū. a. 17) ityādinā punaḥ śoṇitacaturthā eva vraṇapāke vyāpriyanta iti| avirahitaṃ saṃyuktamityarthaḥ||3||
