teṣāmityādi| bhaviṣyatāṃ bhavitukāmānām| amlīkā amlodgāraḥ| sakthisadanam ūruglāniḥ, sphuṭanamivetyeke| āṭopa ādhmānam| pāṇḍurogādīnāmāśaṅkā vikalpaḥ| kāsaśvāsau bhramastandrā nidrendriyadaurbalyaṃ ca ‘jāyate’ iti śeṣaḥ||8||
sthānasaṃśraye samprāptirūpe pūrvarūpaṃ darśayannāha- teṣāṃ tu bhaviṣyatāmityādi| indriyadaurbalyamiti cakṣurādyadhiṣṭhitadoṣeṇa tacchaktivyāghātādaśaktipūrvakarūpādigrahaṇam||8||
jāteṣvetānyeva lakṣaṇāni pravyaktatarāṇi bhavanti ||9||
teṣāṃ sāmānyarūpamāha- jāteṣvityādi| etāni pūrvoktāni||9||

tatra mārutāt pariśuṣkāruṇavivarṇāni viṣamamadhyāni kadambapuṣpatuṇḍikerīnāḍīmukulasūcīmukhākṛtīni ‘nāḍīmukha...’ iti pā. ca bhavanti; tairupadrutaḥ saśūlaṃ saṃhatamupaveśyate kaṭīpṛṣṭhapārśvameḍhragudanābhipradeśeṣu cāsya vedanā bhavanti, gulmāṣṭhīlāplīhodarāṇi cāsya tannimittānyeva bhavanti, kṛṣṇatvaṅnakhanayanadaśanavadanamūtrapurīṣaśca puruṣo bhavati ||10||

viśiṣṭaṃ rūpamāha- tatretyādi| pariśuṣkāṇi anāsrāvīṇi| aruṇāni īṣadraktāni| vivarṇāni vividhavarṇāni| viṣamamadhyāni nimnonnatamadhyāni, kecidatra ‘viṣamadhyāmāni’ iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- viṣamāṇi nimnonnatatvena, dhyāmāni dagdheṣṭikādivastuvarṇāni| tuṇḍikerī vanakārpāsikā, tatpuṣpākṛtīni| anye tvatra “tuṇḍikerīnāḍīmukulasūcīmukhasadṛśāni bhavanti” iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- tuṇḍikerī bimbī, tasyā nāḍī nālikā; mukulaṃ puṣpamukulaṃ; sūcīsīvanadravyam; eṣāṃ mukhasadṛśāni bhavanti| upadrutaḥ abhibhūtaḥ| saṃhataṃ ghanam| upaveśyate viṭsargaṃ kāryate| gulmādīni cāsya tannimittānītyupadravakathanam||10||

tato rūpaṃ darśayannāha- tatra mārutādityādi| tatra ‘arśāṃsi nāma jāyante nāsannipatitaistribhiḥ’ iti sarveṣāmeva (sarvajatvaṃ) utkarṣatastvekadoṣajatvam, uktameva tadasakṛt “dravyamekarasaṃ nāsti, na rogo'pyekadoṣajaḥ| yo'dhikastena nirdeśaḥ kriyate rasadoṣayoḥ” iti| pariśuṣkāruṇavarṇāni paritaḥ śuṣkāṇyanāsrāviṇītyarthaḥ| kaphajānyapi ‘na bhidyante na sravanti ca’ iti vacanāccheṣāṇi sravantyeva| viṣamamadhyāni viṣamo nimnonnatatvena madhyo bhāgo yeṣāṃ tāni| vivarṇāni dagdheṣṭakādivastuvarṇāni| kadambapuṣpākṛtīnīti kadambo vṛkṣakadambaḥ, tasya puṣpaṃ yathā kesarakaṇṭakena nirantaraṃ paripuṭitamiva tathā'rśāṃsyapi nirantaratvakparipuṭanena viṣamavisṛtāni| tuṇḍikerī bimbī, tasyā nāḍī nālikā, mukulaṃ puṣpamukulaṃ, sūcī sevanadravyam, eṣāṃ mukhākṛtisadṛśānīti anena pratanumukhānītyuktam| gulmādīni cāsya tannimittānītyupadravakathanam| kṛṣṇaśabdastvagādibhirvarṇāntaiḥ saha pratyekamabhisambadhyate| evaṃ pittaje'pi pītaśabdaḥ, evaṃ śvetaśabdaḥ śleṣmajeṣu||10||

pittānnīlāgrāṇi tanūni visarpīṇi pītāvabhāsāni yakṛtprakāśāni śukajihvāsaṃsthānāni yavamadhyāni jalaukovakrasadṛśāni praklinnāni ca bhavanti; tairupadrutaḥ sadāhaṃ sarudhiramatisāryate, jvaradāhapipāsāmūrcchāścāsyopadravā bhavanti, pītatvaṅnakhanayanadaśanavadanamūtrapurīṣaśca puruṣo bhavati ||11||
pittādityādi| visarpīṇi prasaraṇaśīlāni| saṃsthānamākāraḥ| yavamadhyānīti pīnamadhyāni mūlāgrayostanūni| praklinnāni kledasrāvīṇi||11||
pittajāni yavamadhyānīti pīnamadhyāni| śukajihvāsaṃsthānāni śukajihvāgratanūni| jalaukovakrasadṛśāni bhinnamukhatvena sūkṣmarandhravanmukhāni| praklinnāni kledasrāvīṇi||11||

śleṣmajāni śvetāni mahāmūlāni sthirāṇi vṛttāni snigdhāni pāṇḍūni karīrapanasāsthigostanākārāṇi, na bhidyante na sravanti kaṇḍūbahulāni ca bhavanti; tairupadrutaḥ saśleṣmāṇamanalpaṃ māṃsadhāvanaprakāśamatisāryate, śophaśītajvarārocakāvipākaśirogauravāṇi cāsya tannimittānyeva bhavanti, śuklatvaṅnakhanayanadaśanavadanamūtrapurīṣaśca puruṣo bhavati ||12||

śleṣmajānītyādi| sthirāṇi kaṭhināni| pāṇḍūni dhūsarāṇi| karīro marudeśātipravṛddho vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, panaso bahiḥ- kaṇṭakiphalaḥ ‘kaṭahala’ iti loke, tasya phalasadṛśāni| analpaṃ bahu| śītajvaraḥ śītapradhānajvaraḥ||12||

kaphajāni mahāmūlāni na pittajavattanumūlāni| sthirāṇi kaṭhināni| na bhidyānte na sravanti raktajavat| māṃsadhāvanaṃ sāndramāṃsakṣālanodakaṃ, tatprakāśaṃ tatsadṛśam| śītajvaraḥ śītapradhāno jvaraḥ||12||

raktajāni nyagrodhaprarohavidrumakākaṇantikāphalasadṛśāni ‘… phalānyatamavarṇasaṃsthānāni’ iti gayadāsasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ pittalakṣaṇāni ca, yadā'vagāḍhapurīṣaprapīḍitāni bhavanti tadā'tyarthaṃ duṣṭamanalpamasṛk sahasā visṛjanti, tasya cātipravṛttau śoṇitātiyogopadravā bhavanti ||13||

raktajānītyādi| nyagrodhapraroho vaṭaprarohaḥ, vidrumaḥ pravālaḥ, kākaṇantikā guñjā cirihiṇṭikā’ iti loke, kākādanītyapare| cakāreṇānubandhabhūtavātakapharūpamanuktamapi samuccīyate| śoṇitātiyogopadravā ākṣepakādayaḥ||13||

raktajānītyādi| nyagrodho vaṭaḥ, tasya prarohaḥ; eṣāmanyatamavarṇasaṃsthānāni ekatamavarṇāni, ekatamasaṃsthānāni| pittalakṣaṇāni ceti āgneyatve raktapittasya caikatvāt| cakāreṇānubandhabhūtavātakapharūpamanuktamapi samuccīyate| taduktaṃ raktārśaḥsu carake- “tatrānubandho dvividhaḥ śleṣmaṇo mārutasya ca| viḍ bhavet kaṭhinaṃ rūkṣaṃ” (ca. ci. 14) ityādi| yavarūpamanuktanirdiṣṭaṃ draṣṭavyam| yavamadhyādayo dharmāḥ saviśeṣaṇāścātisārajvarādayaścopadravā atideśenaiva nirdiṣṭā draṣṭavyāḥ| atyarthaduṣṭamanubandhabhūtavātādidoṣadūṣaṇakṛtakṛṣṇādivarṇam| śoṇitātiyogopadravā ākṣepakādayaḥ||13||
sannipātajāni sarvadoṣalakṣaṇayuktāni ‘sarvalakṣaṇāni yuktāni’ iti gayadāsasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ syāt||14||

sarvadoṣalakṣaṇayuktānīti “sarveṣāṃ cārśaṃsāṃ yāni lakṣaṇāni” iti jejjhaṭaḥ; gayadāsastu ‘sannipātajāni sarvalakṣaṇāni’ iti paṭhati, vyakhyānayati ca- “sarveṣāṃ vātādīnāṃ lakṣaṇāni svabhāvakarmabhūtāni yeṣu tāni tathā” iti||14||

sannipātajāni sarvalakṣaṇānīti nātra sarveṣāṃ vātādīnāṃ lakṣaṇāni, evamasandehārthaṃ ‘tridoṣaliṅgāni’ ityevaṃ brūyāt; kiñca ‘samudāyibhyo'nanyaḥ samudāyaḥ’ ityanena nyāyena saṅkhyābhedaśca na prāpnoti, saṅkhyābhedahetorvātādeḥ kāraṇasya lakṣaṇabhūtatvena dharmāṇāmapyabhedāt| bhedo hi bhedavatāṃ kāraṇabhedādviruddhadharmādhyāsācca| tena sarveṣāṃ vātādīnāṃ lakṣaṇāni svabhāvakarmabhūtāni yeṣu tāni sahajāni| yadāha- teṣāṃ doṣata eva prasādhanamiti| yuktāni samāhitāni, ‘yuja’ samādhau ityasmāt prayogaḥ| atraiva carakaḥ- “sarvo hetustridoṣāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sahajaiḥ samam”- (ca. ci. 14) iti| upadravā apyeṣāṃ sahajānāmiva, atrāpi teṣāṃ sadbhāvāt, anyathā lakṣaṇasāmānyaṃ na syāt| upadravāṇāmapi hi paricchedahetutvāllakṣaṇānīva na tu lakṣaṇānyeva, atrāpi teṣāṃ sadbhāvāt; ata eva ‘tairupadrutaḥ’ iti lakṣaṇebhyaḥ pṛthagupādānamupadravāṇām||14||

sahajāni duṣṭaśoṇitaśukranimittāni, teṣāṃ doṣata eva prasādhanaṃ karttavyam, viśeṣataścaitāni durdarśanāni paruṣāṇi pāṃsūni ‘pāṇḍūni’ iti pā. dāruṇānyantarmukhāni; tairupadrutaḥ kṛśo'lpabhuk sirāsantatagātro'lpaprajaḥ kṣīṇaretāḥ kṣāmasvaraḥ krodhano'lpāgniprāṇaḥ ‘alpāgniḥ’ iti pā. paramalasaśca, tathā ghrāṇaśiro'kṣināsāśravaṇarogī, satatamantrakūjāṭopahṛdayopalepārocakaprabhṛtibhiḥ pīḍyate ||15||

śarīreṇa saha jātānāmarśasāṃ doṣebhyo bhinnaṃ hetuṃ darśayannāha- sahajānītyādi| duṣṭaśoṇitaśukranimittānīti garbhagudārambhakamātraṃ bījaṃ duṣṭaṃ na sarvaṃ, sarvaduṣṭatve hi prajotpattireva na syāt| ‘teṣāṃ doṣata eva prasādhanaṃ kartavyamiti yena doṣeṇa yasya ‘yat’ iti pā. śukraśoṇitaṃ dūṣitaṃ bhavettasya doṣasya lakṣaṇavarṇavedanākṛtibhiḥ prasādhanaṃ vijñānam’ ityeke; anye tu ‘doṣata iti doṣaliṅgaṃ samīkṣya prasādhanaṃ cikitsā’ ityāhuḥ| durdarśanāni duḥkhena dṛśyante, antarvidradhivadityarthaḥ| pāṃsūni dhūsarāṇi| dāruṇāni atiduḥkhakarāṇi||15||

śarīreṇa sahajātānāṃ doṣebhyo bhinnaṃ hetuṃ darśayannāha- sahajānītyādi| gudavalyārambhakaduṣṭaśukraśoṇitabhāgabījānītyarthaḥ| yadāha carakaḥ- “tatra bīje gudavalibījabhāga upataptaḥ sahajānāmarśasāṃ hetuḥ” (ca. ci. 14) iti| ata eva janmanyapratibandhaḥ, anyathā kathametacchukraśoṇitaṃ sakalāvayavaduṣṭaṃ garbhajananāyālaṃ syāt| anye punarāhuḥ- “aviśiṣṭaduṣṭaśoṇitavacanena samudāyaduṣṭirabhipretā| viśeṣeṇa tu gudavalībījabhāge eva, na ca sarvaduṣṭīnāṃ sarvopaghātaśaktayaḥ| evaṃ hi sarvāṅgagatadoṣamadhumehiśoṣaprabhṛtīnāmapatyāni na syureva.... tatraivaṃ “jātaḥ pramehī madhumehinā vā” (ca. ci. 6) iti carakavacanāt| madhumehinaśca sarvāṅgaduṣṭiḥ; yaduktaṃ- “kṛtsnaṃ śarīraṃ niṣpīḍya medomajjavasāyutaḥ| adhaḥ prakramate vāyustenāsādhyāstu vātajāḥ” (ni. 7) iti| na ca sarvāḥ sarvāṅgagataduṣṭayaḥ puṃsāmapatyavighātakāḥ, vātādiprakṛtiṣvapi sarvāṅgārambhakasya bījasya vātādiduṣṭāvapyapatyadarśanāt| tatra ca sakalameva duṣṭaṃ śukraśoṇitaṃ, duṣṭavātādiprakṛtikānāṃ sphuṭitakaracaraṇāde rūkṣālpaśmaśrukeśādeśca sarvāṅgavikārasyopalambhāt| sahajārśaḥsu na sarvāṅgavikāropalambha iti cet; na, “kṛśaḥ sirāsantatagātraḥ kṣīṇaretā” iti rasādiśukrāntadhātukṣayāt, tathā ‘ghrāṇāsyaśirokṣiśravaṇarogī’ tathā ‘kṣāmasvara’ ityādinā sarvāṅgavikāropalambhāt| tathā carake'pi- “kṣāmabhinnasaktajarjarasvaraḥ” (ca. ci. 14) iti| anena sakalavikalatvenopalambhaḥ| carake ‘krodhanaḥ’ ityanena, svatantre ‘pradhyānaparaḥ’ ityanena ca cittaceṣṭāvikṛtiḥ| ‘paramalasaśca’ iti kāyaceṣṭāvikṛtiḥ| “tadevaṃ sakalagātrāvayavagataiva sahajārśaḥsvalpaśukraśoṇitayorduṣṭirastyeva, viśeṣeṇa tu gudavalibījabhāge” iti| teṣāṃ liṅgaṃ cikitsitopayogi darśayannāha- teṣāṃ doṣata evetyādi| yena doṣeṇa śukraśoṇitagena gudavalibhāgo dūṣitastasya doṣasya svabhāvakāryabhūtavarṇanidānākṛtibhiḥ prasādhanaṃ vijñānamityeke| anye tu “doṣata iti lyablope pañcamī, tena doṣaliṅgaṃ samīkṣya prasādhanaṃ cikitsā” ityāhuḥ, liṅgajñānasya cikitsārthatvādeva| idānīṃ vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyena doṣadūṣyarāśeranyatvādviśiṣṭamapyatra liṅgaṃ darśayannāha- viśeṣato durdarśanānītyādi| sāmānyataḥ sarvārśāṃsi vātādivarṇavedanāsaṃsthānādisamānāni viśeṣāt punardurdarśanādīni| sahajatvena vidradhivanmāṃsādyantaravi(pra)śiṣṭatvāt pāyvantargatāni duḥkhena dṛśyante| ataḥ sparśasukhānīti| bhedāśrāvavānnaro yeṣāṃ(?); bhedasrāve cātra kathamiti cet vātajeṣu ‘pariśuṣkāṇi’ iti viśeṣaṇāt, kaphajeṣu ‘nāvabhidyante na sravanti’ iti vacanāccheṣeṣvārdratvaṃ bhedasrāvau cāvagantavyau| tena sarveṣāmevāpākitvaṃ, tadeva kathamiti cet? medobāhulyāt; yaduktaṃ carake- “teṣāṃ punaradhiṣṭhānaṃ medo māṃsaṃ tvak ca” (ca. ci. 14) iti| raktajānāmāgneyatvena pāka iti cet? na, raktārbudavadatrāpi medaso'tirekāt||15||
bhavati cātra- bāhyamadhyavalisthānāṃ pratikuryādbhiṣagvaraḥ | antarvalisamutthānāṃ pratyākhyāyācaret kriyām ||16||
sthānāśrayaṃ sādhyāditvaṃ darśayannāha- bhavati cātretyādi| antarvaliḥ abhyantaravaliḥ| pratyākhyāya asādhyānyetānyarśāṃsīti nirākṛtya||16||

tatrārśasāṃ caturvidhaḥ sādhyayāpyatvādāvupādhibhedaḥ- sthānaṃ, doṣāḥ, janma, kālaśceti| tatra sthānaṃ bāhyādivaliḥ, doṣāḥ- ekadvitridoṣajādi, janma tu sahajādi; kālaḥ punaḥ parisaṃvatsarādi| upadravāsādhyatā'vāraṇīye- “tṛṣṇārocakamūrcchārtaṃ” (sū. 33) ityādi| tatra sthānāśrayaṃ sādhyatvaṃ darśayannāha- bāhyamadhyavalisthānāmityādi| tatra bāhyamadhyavalijānāṃ gudamarmapratyāsannatvāt kṛcchrasādhyatā dvidoṣajatvācca; abhyantaravalijānāṃ tvasādhyatā gudamarmapratyāsannatvāt tridoṣajatvācceti carakāśayaḥ||16||

prakupitāstu doṣā meḍhramabhiprapannā māṃsaśoṇite pradūṣya kaṇḍūṃ janayanti, tataḥ kaṇḍūyanāt kṣataṃ samupajāyate, tasmiṃśca kṣate duṣṭamāṃsajāḥ prarohāḥ picchilarudhirasrāviṇo jāyante kūrcakino'bhyantaramupariṣṭādvā, te tu śepho vināśayantyupaghnanti ca puṃstvaṃ; yonimabhiprapannāḥ sukumārān durgandhān picchilarudhirasrāviṇaśchatrākārān karīrāñjanayanti, te tu yonimupaghnantyārtavaṃ ca; nābhimabhiprapannāḥ sukumārān durgandhān picchilān gaṇḍūpadamukhasadṛśān karīrāñjanayanti; ta evordhvamāgatāḥ śrotrākṣighrāṇavadaneṣvarśāṃsyupanirvartayanti; tatra karṇajeṣu bādhiryaṃ śūlaṃ pūtikarṇatā ca, netrajeṣu vartmāvarodho vedanā srāvo darśananāśaśca, ghrāṇajeṣu pratiśyāyo'timātraṃ kṣavathuḥ kṛcchrocchvāsatā pūtinasyaṃ sānunāsikavākyatvaṃ śiroduḥkhaṃ ca; vakrajeṣu kaṇṭhauṣṭhatālūnāmanyatamasmiṃstairgadgadavākyatā rasājñānaṃ mukharogāśca bhavanti ||17||

meḍhrādiṣvarśāṃsyāha- prakupitāstvityādi| abhiprapannā āśritāḥ| kūrcakinaḥ sūkṣmadīrghāṅkurasantāninaḥ| abhyantaramiti maṇau| upariṣṭāditi bāhyacarmaṇi| puṃstvaṃ śukraṃ puṃścihnaṃ ca| yonimabhiprapannā ityādi abhiprapannā doṣā iti sambandhaḥ| karīrān aṅkurān| nābhimabhiprapannā ityādi doṣā ityatrāpi ‘ityuttaratrāpi’ iti pā. sambadhyate| ta eva doṣā ityarthaḥ| upanirvartayanti janayantītyarthaḥ| tatretyādi| vartmāvarodha iti vartma akṣipuṭaḥ| ghrāṇajeṣvityādi| kṣavathuḥ chikkā| vakrajeṣvityādi| anyatamasmin ekatamasmin sthāne ‘utpanneṣvarśaḥsu ‘sthāneṣvarśaḥsu’ iti pā. ’ iti śeṣaḥ||17||

sthānāntareṣvapyanyairabhyupagatamarśastvamaṅgīkṛtya tatrārśāṃsi nirdiśannāha- prakupitāstvityādi| adhogatā eva meḍhramabhiprapannāḥ| kūrcakinaḥ sūkṣmadīrghāṅkurasantāninaḥ| abhyantaramiti maṇau| upariṣṭāditi bāhyacarmaṇi| upaghnanti ca puṃstvaṃ śukram| adhogatā eva yonimabhiprapannāḥ kandākārān karīrānupajanayantīti sambandhaḥ| ūrdhvamāgatāḥ ‘doṣāḥ’ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ, ghrāṇādiṣvarśāṃsyupanayanti| carake'pyetadastyadhiṣṭhānamarśasāmuktaṃ; tathāhi- “kecidbhūyāṃsameva deśamupadiśantyarśasāṃ galamukhanāsākarṇākṣivartmānitvak ca” (ca. ci. 14) iti||17||
vyānastu prakupitaḥ śleṣmāṇaṃ parigṛhya bahiḥsthirāṇi kīlavadarśāṃsi nirvartayati, tāni carmakīlānyarśāṃsītyācakṣate ||18||
tvagadhiṣṭhānameva carmakīlākhyamarśo darśayannāha- vyānastvityādi| bahiḥ gudauṣṭhādbahiḥ; anye tu ‘bahiḥśabdenānyatrāpi’ iti kathayanti| kīlavat śaṅkutulyānītyarthaḥ||18||

tvaggatameva carmakīlākhyamarśo darśayannāha- vyānastvityādi| śleṣmāṇaṃ parigṛhyeti samprāptiḥ| bahiḥ tvaco bahiḥ, ‘bahirgudauṣṭhāt’ ityeke| anye tu “vyānasya sarvatvagadhiṣṭhānatvādadhogatadoṣakṛtārśassu pūrvamakīrtanāt pūrvamadha-ūrdhvagatadoṣakṛtārśasāṃ kīrtitatvena tiryaggatadoṣārabdhatvād gudauṣṭhādbahiranyatrāpi” ityācakṣate||18||
bhavanti cātra- teṣu kīleṣu nistodo mārutenopajāyate | śleṣmaṇā tu savarṇatvaṃ granthitvaṃ ca vinirdiśet ||19||
pittaśoṇitajaṃ raukṣyaṃ ‘kṛṣṇaraktatvaṃ snigdhatā tathā’ iti pā. kṛṣṇatvaṃ ślakṣṇatā tathā | samudīrṇakharatvaṃ carmakīlasya lakṣaṇam ||20||

teṣāṃ carmakīlānāṃ doṣaliṅgamāha- bhavanti cātretyādi| savarṇatvamiti śleṣmaṇaḥ samānavarṇatetyarthaḥ| granthitvaṃ granthibhāvaḥ| pittetyādi| teṣu carmakīleṣu| raukṣyamityādi pittaśoṇitajaṃ vinirdiśet| samudīrṇakharatvam atīva kaṭhinatvam| carmakīlasya lakṣaṇamiti etadvātādidoṣabhedataścarmakīlasya lakṣaṇamuktam| keciccarmakīlānāṃ doṣaliṅgaṃ na paṭhanti||19-20||
teṣāṃ carmakīlānāṃ doṣaliṅgaṃ kecidadhīyate- teṣu kīleṣu nistoda ityādi||19-20||
arśasāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vyāsāduktaṃ sāmānyatastu ‘durnāmnāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ hyetaduktaṃ saṅkṣepatastu’ iti gayadāsasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ syāt yat | tatsarvaṃ prāgvinirdiṣṭātsādhayedbhiṣajāṃ varaḥ ||21||

idānīṃ sarveṣāmeva meḍhrādijānāṃ vātādilakṣaṇamatideśena nirdiśannāha- arśasāmityādi| arśasāṃ meḍhrādijānāṃ vātādidoṣalakṣaṇaṃ vinā yat saṅkṣepato lakṣaṇamuktaṃ tat sarvaṃ sādhayet jānīyāt cikitsedvā| kathamityāha- prāgvinirdiṣṭāditi; “prāk pūrvaṃ vyāsena pratyekaṃ vātādijārśolakṣaṇamuktaṃ vīkṣyetyarthaḥ” iti gayadāsācāryaḥ; anye tu “saṅkṣepataḥ ṣoḍhā, vyāsato vistareṇa, prāgvinirdiṣṭāt pañcadaśadhā prasarāt sādhayet” iti manyante||21||

idānīṃ sarveṣāmeva meḍhrādijānāṃ carmakīlākhyānāṃ vātādidoṣalakṣaṇamatideśena nirdiśannāha- durnāmnāmityādi| durnāmnāṃ meḍhrādijānāmarśasāṃ saṅkṣepato lakṣaṇaṃ yaduktaṃ vātādidoṣalakṣaṇaṃ vinā sāmānyalakṣaṇamātramabhihitaṃ, tat sādhayejjānīyāt, cikitsecceti cārthaḥ| prāgvinirdiṣṭāditi lyablope pañcamīti kecit| prāgvinirdiṣṭāditi sūtrasthānoditaṃ pratyekaṃ vātādilakṣaṇaṃ vīkṣyetyarthaḥ||21||
arśaḥsu dṛśyate rūpaṃ yadā doṣadvayasya ‘vai doṣayordvayoḥ iti tā. tu | saṃsargaṃ taṃ vijānīyāt saṃsargaḥ sa ca ṣaḍvidhaḥ ||22||

idānīṃ ṣaḍvidheṣvevārśaḥsvata ūrdhvaṃ saṃsargamauṣadhakalpanārthaṃ darśayannāha- arśaḥsvityādi| saṃsargaḥ sa ca ṣaḍvidha iti vātapitte, vātaśleṣmāṇau, pittaśleṣmāṇau, vātaśoṇite, pittaśoṇite śleṣmaśoṇite, evaṃ saṃsargaḥ ṣaḍvidhaḥ| sa ca sūtrasthānoktavraṇavedanālakṣaṇādavagantavyaḥ ‘sūtrasthānoktavarṇavedanālakṣaṇāt’ iti pā.||22||
idānīṃ prakṛtisamasamavetasaṃyogena ṣaḍvidheṣvevārśaḥsvata ūrdhvaṃ saṃsargamauṣadhakalpanārthaṃ darśayannāha- arśaḥsvityādi| sa cātroktapratyekavātādyarśasāṃ liṅgādavagantavyaḥ||22||
tridoṣāṇyalpaliṅgāni yāpyāni tu vinirdiśet | dvandvajāni dvitīyāyāṃ valau yānyāśritāni ca ||23||
kṛcchrasādhyāni tānyāhuḥ parisaṃvatsarāṇi ca | sannipātasamutthāni sahajāni tu varjayet ||24||

idānīṃ yāpyakṛcchrasādhyāsādhyānyarśāṃsi darśayannāha- tridoṣāṇītyādi| dvandvajāni dvidoṣotthāni, tānyapi yāpyānītyarthaḥ| parisaṃvatsarāṇīti paritaḥ saṃvatsaramabhivyāpya sthitāni kṛcchrasādhyānītyarthaḥ| kecit ‘sannipātasamutthāni’ ityādau kṛtvā paṭhanti; sa ca pāṭhaḥ samagro'darśanānna likhitaḥ||23-24||

idānīṃ doṣajanmakāladeśakṛtamasādhyādibhedaṃ darśayannāha- sannipātasamutthānītyādi| janmanā saha jātāni sahajāni| deśakṛtaṃ tu ‘dvitīyāyāṃ balau yānyāśritāni tu| kṛcchrasādhyāni tānyāhuḥ’ iti| parisaṃvatsarāṇi ceti paritaḥ saṃvatsaramabhivyāpyāvasthitānīti kālakṛtaṃ kṛcchratvam| tridoṣāṇyalpaliṅgāni yāpyānīti doṣakṛtaṃ yāpyatvam||23-24||
sarvāḥ syurvalayo yeṣāṃ durnāmabhirupadrutāḥ | taistu pratihato vāyurapānaḥ sannivartate ||25||
tato vyānena saṅgamya jyotirmṛdnāti ‘jyotirasya pramardati’ iti tā. dehinām ||26||

sarvavalivyāpināmarśasāṃ pañcātmakasyāpyagnermahānarthakaratvaṃ darśayannāha- sarvā ityādi| yeṣāṃ dehinām| durnāmabhiḥ arśobhiḥ| taistu arśobhirityarthaḥ| apāno vāyuriti sambandhaḥ| sannivartate sthitiṃ badhnāti na niḥsaratītyarthaḥ| saṅgamya militvā| jyotiḥ pañcātmakamagniṃ, mṛdnāti mandīkaroti| ayaṃ copadravaḥ, prāyeṇa sahajeṣvarśaḥsu jñeyaḥ||25-26||

idānīṃ pratyekaṃ pañcātmakānāṃ vātapittakaphānāṃ prakopayitṛtvāt pañcātmakasyāgnerupaghātakaratvācca mahānarthakaratvaṃ darśayannāha- sarvāḥ syurvalayo yoṣāmityādi| sarvatra sarvavalivyāptirityūrdhvamapahato'pānaḥ sannivartate| ata eva pittakaphābhyāṃ pañcātmakābhyāṃ sarvāṅgagatavyānenāpi saha saṅgamya saṅgato bhūtvā jyotiḥ pañcātmakamagniṃ mṛdnātīti||25-26||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne'rśonidānaṃ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||2||
iti śrīḍalhaṇācāryaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nidānasthāne dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ||2||
iti sauśrute śalyatantre śrīgayadāsaviracitāyāṃ nyāyacandrikāyāṃ pañjikāyāmarśonidānam||2||

div.head: aśmarīnidānam

ab.seg: athāto'śmarīṇāṃ nidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athetyādi| nidānaṃ hetulakṣaṇanirdeśaḥ||1-2||

athārśonidānānantaramaśmarīnidānārambhaḥ vātavyādhāveva ‘vātaviṇmūtrarodhānīm’ (ni. 1) iti arśonidāne'rśasāṃ viḍvātarodhināmuktyā mūtranirodhakameva vyādhimavaśiṣṭatvādadhogatavyādhyupakramācca mahāvyādhisāmānyācca||1-2||
catasro'śmaryo bhavanti; śleṣmādhiṣṭhānāḥ; tadyathā- śleṣmaṇā, vātena, pittena, śukreṇa ceti ||3||

catasra ityādi| catasro'śmaryo bhavantīti chedaḥ| tisra eva śleṣmādhiṣṭhānāḥ, śukrāśmarī tu śukrādhiṣṭhānā; anye tu śukrāśmaryapi śleṣmādhiṣṭhānaiva, ‘śukraṃ tu saumyaṃ’ (śā. 3) iti vacanāt| śleṣmādhiṣṭhānāḥ śleṣmopādānakāraṇāḥ, śleṣmāṇamupādāya bhavantītyarthaḥ| catasro'śmaryo bhavantītyasya vivaraṇaṃ kurvannāha- tadyathetyādi||3||

catasro'śmarya iti prāgeva saṅkhyāpraṇayanaṃ saṅkhyāyā hetuliṅgacikitsopayogitvāt| śleṣmādhiṣṭhānāḥ śleṣmopādānakāraṇāḥ; taduktaṃ- “saṃhantyāpo yathā divyā māruto'gniśca vaidyutaḥ| tadvadbalāsaṃ bastisthamūṣmā saṃhanti sānilaḥ||” iti; tathā śukrāśmaryāṃ śukramevopādanakāraṇamiti na sarvāḥ śleṣmādhiṣṭhānāḥ; tatraike “samudāye vihitaṃ kvacidekadeśe na vartate; yathā “halṅyābbhyo dīrghāt sutisyapṛktaṃ hal” (pā. a. 6/1/68) ityatra dīrghāditi ṅyāporeva viśeṣaṇaṃ na halaḥ, asambhavāt| tathā'trāpi tisṛṣu doṣajāsu śleṣmādhiṣṭhānā iti viśeṣaṇaṃ na śukrāśmaryāḥ, asambhavāt”| anye tu “sā'pi śleṣmādhiṣṭhānaiva, śukraṃ saumyaṃ” (śā. 3) iti vacanāt| catasro'śmarya ityasya vivaraṇaṃ kurvannāha- kaphenetyādi| kaphasyātra prādhānyaṃ darśayituṃ prathamaṃ kapheneti kṛtaṃ, kaphopādānakāraṇatvāt kaphaprābalyataiva; ata evāditastisro doṣajāḥ||3||
tatrāsaṃśodhanaśīlasyāpathyakāriṇaḥ ‘tatrāpathyasevinaḥ śleṣmā mūtreṇa saṃsṛṣṭvā'nupraviśya bastimaśmarīṃ janayati’ iti tā. prakupitaḥ śleṣmā mūtrasampṛkto'nupraviśya bastimaśmarīṃ janayati ||4||
tāsāṃ samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- tatretyādi| mūtrasampṛkto mūtreṇa sahitaḥ||4||
tāsāṃ sthānasaṃśrayalakṣaṇāṃ samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- tatrāpathyakāriṇāmityādi| mūtrasampṛ(sa)kta iti mūtreṇa sahitaḥ mūtreṇaiva saha pravṛtto na gacchati||4||

tāsāṃ ‘tatra jvaro bastipīḍā'rocakomūtrakṛcchraṃ bastiśirasi vedanā śephasi muṣkayośca bastagandhi mūtraṃ ca sāmānyaṃ pūrvarūpaṃ sarvāsāmeva’ iti tā. pūrvarūpāṇi- jvaro bastipīḍārocakau mūtrakṛcchraṃ bastiśiromuṣkaśephasāṃ vedanā kṛcchrāvasādo ‘kṛcchrājjvarāvasādau’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ paṭhati, ‘kṛcchrānmūtrakṛcchrāddhetorbastiśiraḥprabhṛtīnāṃ vedaneti sambandhaḥ’ iti ca vyākhyānayati bastagandhitvaṃ mūtrasyeti ||5||
yathāsvavedanāvarṇaṃ duṣṭaṃ sāndramathāvilam | pūrvarūpe'śmanaḥ kṛcchrānmūtraṃ sṛjati mānavaḥ ayaṃ ślokastāḍapatrapustake na paṭhyate||6||

tāsāṃ pūrvarūpamāha- tāsāmityādi| bastiśiraḥ mūtrāśayoparitano bhāgaḥ, muṣkaḥ aṇḍaṃ, śephaḥ puṃścihnam| kṛcchrāvasādo kaṣṭayuktā'ṅgaglāniḥ| bastigandhitvaṃ bṛhattamacchagalagandhitvam| yathāsvaṃ doṣānatikrameṇa, vedanā varṇaśca yasmin mūtre tattathā| duṣṭaṃ vātādibhiḥ| āvilaṃ kaluṣam| aśmanaḥ aśmaryāḥ||5-6||

sthānasaṃśrayānantaraṃ pūrvarūpaṃ darśayannāha- tāsāṃ pūrvarūpāṇi bhaviṣyantīnāmityādi| anye'tra bastagandhitvaṃ pūrvarūpe paṭhanti; tatra bṛhattamacchagalasyeva gandho'syeti upamānārthe in samāsāntaḥ| anye tu pūrvarūpe'muṃ ślokaṃ paṭhanti- “yathāsvavedanāvarṇaṃ duṣṭaṃ sāndramathāvilam| pūrvarūpe'śmanaḥ kṛcchrānmūtraṃ sṛjati mānavaḥ” iti||5-6||

atha jātāsu nābhibastisevanīmehaneṣvanyatamasmin mehato vedanā mūtradhārāsaṅgaḥ sarudhiramūtratā mūtravikiraṇaṃ gomedakaprakāśamatyāvilaṃ ‘anāvilaṃ’ iti hārāṇacandrasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ sasikataṃ visṛjati; dhāvanalaṅghanaplavanapṛṣṭhayānoṣṇādhvagamanaiścāsya vedanā bhavanti ayaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇapāṭhastāḍapatrapustake na paṭhyate||7||

atha sarvāsāmapi sāmānyaṃ lakṣaṇamāha- athetyādi| jātāsviti sarvāsvapyaśmarīṣu| saṅgo nirodhaḥ| mūtravikiraṇamiti vikiraṇaṃ vikṣepa itaścetaśca gamanam| gomedako maṇiḥ pītaḥ| sasikataṃ vālukāsahitaṃ, visṛjati vimuñcati, ‘mūtraṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ| laṅghanaṃ parikhādīnāṃ, plavanaṃ prataraṇam, uṣṇagamanaṃ gharmagamanam, adhvagamanaṃ dīrghamārgagamanam||7||

atha jātāsu vedaneti śleṣmaśothavātapittajanitāḥ| mūtradhārāsaṅgo'śmaryā mūtramārganirodhāt| sarudhiramūtratā'śmaryā mūtramārgasya kṣatatvāt| mūtravikiraṇaṃ tathaiva mūtramārgaikadeśanirodhāt| aśmanaḥ samānāmaśmarīmāhuḥ| taduktaṃ bhojena- “kaphapittānilāḥ śukraṃ sirābhirbastimāgatāḥ| ghanatāṃ yānti pittena śoṣyamāṇāḥ savāyunā|| lipyamānāḥ punardoṣaiḥ saṃhatāniladūṣitāḥ| tulyatāmaśmanā yānti tasmāttāmaśmarīṃ viduḥ” iti||7||

tatra ‘tatrātyarthaṃ śleṣmalamannamabhyasataḥ’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ śleṣmāśmarī śleṣmalamannamabhyavaharato'tyarthamupalipyādhaḥ parivṛddhiṃ prāpya bastimukhamadhiṣṭhāya sroto niruṇaddhi, tasya mūtrapratighātāddālyate bhidyate nistudyata iva ca bastirguruḥ śītaśca bhavati; aśmarī cātra śvetā snigdhā mahatī kukkuṭāṇḍapratīkāśā madhūkapuṣpavarṇā vā bhavati, tāṃ ślaiṣmikīmiti vidyāt ||8||

idānīṃ śleṣmādyaśmarīṇāṃ pratyekaṃ viśiṣṭalakṣaṇamāha- tatretyādi| śleṣmalamannamabhyavaharataḥ puṃsaḥ śleṣmāśmarī sroto niruṇaddhīti sambandhaḥ| upalipya navaghaṭapaṅkanyāyena| adhiṣṭhāya āśritya| dālyate viśīryata iva sphuṭatīvetyarthaḥ| bhidyate vidīryata iva| nistudyate sūcibhiriva||8||

aśmaryāḥ sāmānyalakṣaṇamabhidhāya doṣeṇa viśiṣṭaṃ darśayannāha- atyarthaśleṣmalamityādi| atyarthaśleṣmakāraṇaṃ samaśanādhyaśanādi| upalipya navaghaṭapaṅkanyāyena| gurutvādadhaḥ parivṛddhiṃ prāpya kālāntareṇa navaghaṭapaṅkanyāyenaiva| evameva vātapittāśmaryorvṛddhiryathoktaśabdenoktā| bastimukhamiti vacanāddoṣo'yaṃ gurutvenādhogāmī bastimukhamadhiṣṭhāya tiṣṭhati| dālyate ityādāvivaśabdo luptanirdiṣṭo draṣṭavyaḥ||8||

pittayutastu śleṣmā saṅghātamupagamya yathoktāṃ parivṛddhiṃ prāpya bastimukhamadhiṣṭhāya sroto niruṇaddhi, tasya mūtrapratīghātādūṣyate cūṣyate dahyate pacyata iva bastiruṣṇavātaśca bhavati; aśmarī cātra saraktā pītāvabhāsā kṛṣṇā bhallātakāsthipratimā madhuvarṇā vā bhavati, tāṃ paittikīmiti vidyāt ||9||

pittayutastvityādi| pittayutaḥ śleṣmā sroto niruṇaddhīti sambandhaḥ| saṅghātamupagamya kāṭhinyaṃ prāpyetyarthaḥ| tasya puruṣasya| mūtrapratīghātāt mūtranirodhāt| ūṣyate samīpāgninaivopatapyate| cūṣyate ākṛṣyata iva| dahyate iva kakṣāgnineva| pacyata iva kṣāreṇeva, utkvāthyata ivetyeke| uṣṇavāta uttaratantre paṭhito mūtrarogaḥ| saraktā īṣadraktā||9||

pittaśmarīlakṣaṇe ūṣyata iti samīpāgnita ivopatapyate| dahyata iva dahyate sākṣādagnineva| pacyate kṣāreṇeva| uṣṇavātaścāsyeti uṣṇavāto mūtrāghātapaṭhitaḥ- “vyāyāmādhvātapaiḥ” (u. ta. 58) ityādinā| saraktā īṣadraktā, upasarjanatvāt sahārthasya, sakṣāramiti yathā||9||

vātayutastu śleṣmā saṅghātamupagamya yathoktāṃ parivṛddhiṃ prāpya bastimukhamadhiṣṭhāya sroto niruṇaddhi, tasya mūtrapratīghātāttīvrā vedanā bhavati, tadā'tyarthaṃ pīḍyamāno dantān khādati, nābhiṃ pīḍayati, meḍhraṃ pramṛdnāti, pāyuṃ spṛśati, viśardhate, vidahati, vātamūtrapurīṣāṇi kṛcchreṇa cāsya mehato niḥsaranti; aśmarī cātra śyāvā paruṣā viṣamā kharā kadambapuṣpavatkaṇṭakācitā bhavati, tāṃ vātikīmiti vidyāt ||10||

vātayutastvityādi| atrāpi pūrvavat sambandhaḥ| dantān khādati parasparaṃ dantapīḍanaṃ karoti| viśardhate gudena kutsitaṃ śabdaṃ karoti; kecit ‘viśardhate’ ityatra ‘vivardhate’ iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca-meḍhraṃ vimardanād vivardhata ityarthaḥ| vidahati vidāhayuktaṃ meḍhraṃ bhavati| mehato muñcata ityarthaḥ| kharā kaṭhinā||10||
vātayuktastu śleṣmetyādinā vātāśmarī| viśardhate gudena kutsitaśabdaṃ karoti| kecididaṃ na paṭhanti| vātādayaśca pramehato'pi kṛcchreṇa nissaranti, vātasyātyarthapīḍākāritvāt||10||

prāyeṇaitāstisro'śmaryo divāsvapnasamaśanādhyaśanaśītasnigdhagurumadhurāhārapriyatvādviśeṣeṇa bālānāṃ bhavanti; teṣāmevālpabastikāyatvādanupacitamāṃsatvācca ‘amāṃsopacayācca’ iti tā. basteḥ sukhagrahaṇāharaṇā bhavanti | mahatāṃ tu śukrāśmarī śukranimittā bhavati ||11||

prāyeṇetyādi| prāyeṇaitāstisro'śmaryo bālānāṃ bhavantīti sambandhaḥ| kasmādityāha- viśeṣeṇa divāsvapnādipriyatvātteṣāmiti; prāyograhaṇādyūnāmapi bodhayati| teṣāmeva bālānām| alpabastikāyatvāditi alpabastitvādalpakāyatvāccetyarthaḥ| alpabastitvāditi āyāmenālpatvam; anupacitabastimāṃsatvācca basterityanena pariṇāhenālpatvamuktam| sukhagrahaṇāharaṇā iti sukhena gṛhyante sukhenāhriyante cāśmaryaḥ||11||

tisro'pyetā bālānāmeva, prāyograhaṇādyūnāmapīti bodhayati| teṣāmevālpabastikāyatvāditi alpabastitvāditi āyāmenālpatvāt| anupacitamāṃsatvāditi pariṇāhenālpatvāt| sukhagrahaṇāharaṇāḥ sukhena gṛhyante ālabhyante, sukhenāhiyante ca| atra karmaṇi lyuṭ| mahatāṃ tu mahāvikārikā yathāvadupacitamāṃsatvād duḥkhagrahaṇāharaṇāśca; mahatāṃ tu śukrāśmarī bhavati||11||

maithunavighātādatimaithunādvā śukraṃ ‘maithunābhighātācchukraṃ’ iti tā. calitamanirgacchadvimārgagamanādanilo'bhitaḥ ‘calitamanirgalat’ iti pā. saṅgṛhya meḍhravṛṣaṇayorantare saṃharati, saṃhṛtya copaśoṣayati; sā mūtramārgamāvṛṇoti ‘mūtramārgamāvṛtya mūtrakṛcchraṃ bastiśirasi vedanāṃ śephasi muṣkayośca śvayathumutpādayati’ iti tā., mūtrakṛcchraṃ bastivedanāṃ vṛṣaṇayośca śvayathumāpādayati, pīḍitamātre ca tasminneva pradeśe pravilayamāpadyate; tāṃ śukrāśmarīmiti vidyāt ||12||

hetusamprāptilakṣaṇāni śukrāśmaryā darśayannāha- maithunetyādi| sā aśmarī| maithunavighātādatimaithunādveti hetuḥ| śukraṃ calitamanirgacchadityādisamprāptiḥ| mūtrakṛcchraṃ bastivedanāmityādi lakṣaṇam| maithunavighātāditi maithunakāryasya śukrasya vighātāt| ‘amaithunāt’ iti kecit paṭhanti; tatra śukrabāhulyaṃ śukracalane hetuḥ| anirgacchat aniḥsarat| ‘anirgacchan’ iti kecit paṭhanti; tatra vāyorviśeṣaṇam| vimārgagamanādanilo'bhitaḥ saṅgṛhyeti vimārgagamanāt unmārgagamanāt, anilo vāyuḥ, abhita ubhayata ūrdhvamadhaścetyarthaḥ, saṅgṛhya vidhārya, meḍhravṛṣaṇayorantare bastidvārasyādha ityarthaḥ, saṃharati vartulīkaroti| vṛṣaṇayośceti cakārādvaṅkṣaṇadeśe'pi, doṣajāsu tvaśmarīṣu vṛṣaṇaśopho nāstyeva| pravilayamāpadyate aśmarī nilīyate'lpatvāt; anye tu punaḥ ‘aśmarīkṛto vṛṣaṇaśothaḥ pravilayamāpadyate’ ityācakṣate||12||

maithunavighātāditi maithunavegavighātādityarthaḥ| yaduktaṃ- “śukrāśmarī tatsravaṇaṃ bhavedvā te te vikārā vihate tu śukre” (u. ta. 55) iti| ‘amaithunāt’ iti kecit paṭhanti| tatra śukrabāhulyaṃ śukracalanahetuḥ| anilo'bhihata ubhayata ūrdhvamadhaśca saṅgṛhya vidhārya, vimārgagamanānmeḍhravṛṣaṇavihitamārgāgamanāt, abhihato meḍhravṛṣaṇayośca, śvayathuṃ śukranirodhena vṛṣaṇayorāpūrṇatvāt; cakārād vaṅkṣaṇadaśe'pi| doṣajāsu pauruṣavṛṣaṇayorupasarge'śmaryāḥ sthitatvādvṛṣaṇaśotho nāstyeva| pīḍitamātre ca tasminnavakāśe...| nāgārjunastu paṭhati- “śarkarā sikatāmeho bhasmākhyo'śmarivaikṛtam”- iti| aśmarīvaikṛtamiti nirvṛttāśmarīvikārā upadravā ityarthaḥ||12||

div.ab: bhavanti cātra- śarkarā sikatā meho bhasmākhyo'śmarivaikṛtam |13|
bhavanti cātretyādi| bhasmākhya iti mūtraśukranāmā uttaratantre mūtrarogaḥ| aśmarīvaikṛtam aśmarīvikārā upadravā ityarthaḥ|13|-

ab.seg: aśmaryā śarkarā jñeyā tulyavyañjanavedanā ||13||
pavane'nuguṇe sā tu niretyalpā viśeṣataḥ | sā bhinnamūrtirvātena śarkaretyabhidhīyate ||14||
aśmaryetyādi| aśmaryā tulyavyañjanavedanā śarkarā jñeyetyarthaḥ ‘jñeyeti sambandhaḥ’ iti pā.| pavana ityādi| sā aśmarī yadā'lpā syāttadā vāte'nuguṇe anukūle sati nireti nirgacchati||13-14||
aśmaryā eva prakāraḥ śarkareti darśayanneke paṭhanti- aśmaryāḥ śarkarā jñeyetyādi||13-14||

div.ab: hṛtpīḍā sakthisadanaṃ kukṣiśūlaṃ ca vepathuḥ | tṛṣṇordhvago'nilaḥ kārṣṇyaṃ daurbalyaṃ pāṇḍugātratā ||15|| arocakāvipākau tu śarkarārte bhavanti ca |16|
śarkarālakṣaṇamāha- hṛtpīḍetyādi| sakthisadanam ūruglāniḥ||15||- kecittvaśmaryā eva śarkarātvenāvasthāntaramāpannāyā lakṣaṇamabhidhīyate- hṛtpīḍetyādi||15||-

ab.seg: mūtramārgapravṛttā sā saktā kuryādupadravān ||16||
daurbalyaṃ sadanaṃ kārśyaṃ kukṣiśūlamarocakam | pāṇḍutvamuṣṇavātaṃ ca tṛṣṇāṃ hṛtpīḍanaṃ vamim ||17||
aśmaryā eva mūtramārgagatāyā lakṣaṇaṃ nirdiśannāha- mūtramārgetyādi| sā aśmarī| saktā anirgatā| daurbalyaṃ balahāniḥ| sadanam aṅgalāniḥ; ‘sphuṭanikā’ ityapare| kārśyaṃ māṃsakṣayaḥ||16-17||
aśmaryā eva mūtramārgamāgatāyā lakṣaṇaṃ nirdiśannāha- mūtramārgapravṛttetyādi||16-17||

div.ab: nābhipṛṣṭhakaṭīmuṣkagudavaṅkṣaṇaśephasām | ekadvārastanutvakko madhye bastiradhomukhaḥ ||18|| bastirbastiśiraścaiva pauruṣaṃ vṛṣaṇau gudaḥ | ekasambandhino hyete gudāsthivivarāśritāḥ ||19|| alābvā ‘alābvāḥ samasaṃsthānaḥ’ iti gayadāsasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ iva rūpeṇa sirāsnāyuparigrahaḥ | mūtrāśayo malādhāraḥ prāṇāyatanamuttamam ||20|| pakvāśayagatāstatra nāḍyo mūtravahāstu yāḥ | tarpayanti sadā ‘tu tā’ iti pā. mūtraṃ saritaḥ sāgaraṃ yathā ||21|| sūkṣmatvānnopalabhyante mukhānyāsāṃ sahasraśaḥ | nāḍībhirupanītasya mūtrasyāmāśayāntarāt ||22|| jāgrataḥ svapataścaiva sa niḥsyandena pūryate | āmukhātsalile nyastaḥ pārśvebhyaḥ pūryate navaḥ ||23|| ghaṭo yathā tathā viddhi bastirmūtreṇa pūryate |24|

idānīmaśmaryā evādhārasya basteḥ sthānasaṃsthānadvārāṇi nirdeṣṭumāha- nābhītyādi| nābhyādīnāṃ madhye bastiriti sthānam| ekadvāra adhomukha ityanenopari dvārābhāvaṃ ‘dvārāsambhavaṃ’ iti pā. sūcayati| tanutvakkaḥ sūkṣmatvak| tanutvakka iti vakṣyamāṇaṃ cālābvā iva rūpeṇeti saṃsthānam| bastiprasaṅgādbastisannihitānāṃ cāpareṣāṃ sthānamāha- bastirityādi| pauruṣaṃ meḍhram| punarbastyavayavamāha- alābvā ivetyādi| parigraha āśrayaḥ| mūtrāśayaparyāyo malādhāra iti| prāṇānāmagnīṣomādīnām, āyatanaṃ sthānam| yathā ca sarvadā'sāvakṣīṇamūtro ‘sa cākṣīṇamūtraḥ’ iti pā. bhavati tathā''ha- pakvāśayagatā ityādi| tā nāḍyo mūtraṃ tarpayanti vivardhayantītyarthaḥ| mūtravāhinyau mūladhamanyau dve, tacchākhābhūtā daśadhā śatadhā sahasradhā ca vibhidyanta iti darśayannāha- sūkṣmatvādityādi| āsāṃ nāḍīnām| yābhirevāyaṃ sirāsnāyubhirāvṛtastābhirevāyaṃ mūtreṇa pūryate iti darśayannāha- nāḍībhirityādi| āmāśayāntarāt āmapakvāśayāntarāt| sa bastiḥ| niḥsyandena upasnehena, pūryate| adhomukhatvena basteranūrdhvamukhasyāpi pūraṇamupamānenāha-āmukhādityādi| nyasto dhṛtaḥ| viddhi jānīhi||18-23||- idānīmaśmaryā evādhārasya basteḥ sthānasaṃsthānadvārāṇi nirdeṣṭumāha- nābhītyādi| nābhyādīnāṃ madhye adhomukha iti sthānam| ekadvāra iti uparidvārāsambhavaṃ sūcayati| sthānapratipādanārthamevānye paṭhanti- bastirbastiśiraścaivetyādi| tatra pauruṣaṃ śukravahanāḍī| ākṛtiḥ- alābvāḥ samasaṃsthāna ityādi| malādhāro malinīkaraṇānmalā doṣāḥ| prāṇānāmagnīṣomādīnāṃ cāyatanaṃ sthānam| yābhirevāyaṃ sirāsnāyubhirāvṛtastābhirevāyaṃ mūtreṇa pūryate iti darśayannāha- nāḍībhirupanītasyetyādi| nāḍībhiriti bahuvacanaṃ pradhānamūtravahanāḍīhṛdayaśākhānāmanekatvāt| āmāśayāntarāt āmāśayāvakāśāt| mūtrasya niḥsyandenopasnehena pūryate| āmapakvāśayasyāpi āmāśayavyapadeśaḥ, ubhayoḥ sthānayorniḥsyandanasya sāmyāt| kecidatra nāḍībhirupanītasyaiva bhāṣyaṃ paṭhanti- pakvāśayagatāstatretyādi| adhomukhatvena basteranūrdhvamukhasyāpi pūraṇamupamānenāha- āmukhādityādi||18-23||-
evameva praveśena vātaḥ pittaṃ kapho'pi vā ||24|| mūtrayuktamupasnehāt praviśya kurute'śmarīm |25|
mūtrapraveśatulyameva vātādīnāmapi praveśaṃ darśayannāha- evamevetyādi| evameva praveśeneti pūrvoktapraveśenetyarthaḥ| upasnehāt samīpakledanāt||24||-

apsu svacchā(sthā)svapi yathā niṣiktāsu nave ghaṭe ||25|| kālāntareṇa paṅkaḥ syādaśmarīsambhavastathā | saṃhantyāpo yathā divyā māruto'gniśca vaidyutaḥ ||26|| tadvadbalāsaṃ bastisthamūṣmā saṃhanti sānilaḥ |27|

nanu, dravarūpatvāt sarveṣāṃ vāyoścāmūrtatvāt kathaṃ ghanatā? tadāha-apsvityādi| niṣiktāsu prakṣiptāsu| paṅkasamatve'pi kathamaśmanā sāmyamityāha- saṃhantītyādi| yathā saṃhanti kāṭhinyaṃ karoti varṣopalān karotītyarthaḥ; kaḥ kāṭhinyaṃ karoti? vāyurvaidyuto'gniśca; kāḥ kaṭhināḥ karoti? āpaḥ jalāni, divyā meghajāḥ; tathā balāsaṃ śleṣmāṇaṃ bastisthaṃ saṃhanti kaṭhinaṃ ‘kaṭhināḥ’ iti pā. karoti; kaḥ? ūṣmā pittamityarthaḥ; kathambhūtaḥ? sānilaḥ savāta ityarthaḥ||25-26||- mūtrapraveśatulyameva praveśaṃ vātādīnāmapi darśayannāha- evameva praveśenetyādi| yathā mūtrasya niḥsyandarūpeṇa praveśastādṛśenaiva praveśena vātādīnāmapi praveśaḥ| mūtrayuktaṃ mūtrasampṛktam| upasnehāt sūkṣmāyanairanupraveśādityarthaḥ| yaduktaṃ carake- “vyapagatakṣutpipāsastu garbho mātaramāśritya vartayatyātmānamupasnehopasvedābhyāṃ garbhāśaye sadasadbhūtāṅgāvayavaḥ” (ca. śā. 6) iti| sārabhūtena rasena sūkṣmalomakūpāyanairāpyāyanamupasnehaḥ| udakādikledādārdrībhāvamupadarśayati| mūtrapittakaphānāmanumārgapraveśāditi svasthatve kathamaśmaryā mūrtimatyāḥ sambhava ityāha- apsu svasthāsvapi yathetyādi| paṅkasamatve'pi kathamaśmanaḥ sāmyamityāha- saṃhantyāpo yathetyādi| āpo divyā meghajāḥ| saṃhanti anilasahito vaidyuto'gniśca karakātvena karoti, tathā kaphamūṣmā pittaṃ sānilamityarthaḥ; bahirapi ca vāyvagnyoreva śoṣaṇatvena dṛṣṭatvāt||24-26||-

ab.seg: mārute praguṇe bastau mūtraṃ samyak pravartate | vikārā vividhāścāpi pratilome bhavanti hi ||27||
mūtrāghātāḥ pramehāśca śukradoṣāstathaiva ca | mūtradoṣāśca ye kecidvastāveva bhavanti hi ||28||

bastigatānāmanyeṣāmapi ‘bastigatānāmapi’ iti pā. vikārāṇāṃ vāyureva heturiti darśayannāha- māruta ityādi| praguṇe anukūle; ‘anuguṇe’ iti kecit paṭhanti, tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ| pratilome viguṇe ‘vikūle’ iti pā.| vāte viguṇe ‘vikūle’ iti pā. sati bastau ye vikārāstānevāha- mūtrāghātā ityādi||27-28||

idānīmalikṛtabastigatāśmarīprasaṅgena bastigatānāmanyeṣāmapi vikārāṇāmanilameva hetuṃ darśayannāha- mārute'nuguṇe ityādi| anuguṇe anile mūtrānuguṇyaṃ, viguṇe sarveṣāmeva vātajānāṃ vikārāṇāṃ sambhavaḥ, tena vātānulomyaṃ yatnataḥ karaṇīyam| tāneva bastivikārān kecicchlokena paṭhanti-mūtrāghātāḥ pramehāścetyādi||27-28||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne'śmarīnidānāṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||3||
iti śrīḍahlaṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nidānasthāne tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ||3||
iti sauśrute śalyatantre nidānasthāne śrīgayadāsaviracitāyāṃ nyāyacandrikāyāṃ pañjikāyāmaśmarīnidānam||3||
athāto bhagandarāṇāṃ nidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athetyādi||1-2||

aśmaryanantaramarśo'śmarīnidānayorgudabastikīrtanādbhagandarasyobhayādhiṣṭhānatvāt; yadāha- “gudabastipradeśadāraṇāt” iti, adhogatavyādhiprakramāt, mahāvyādhiprakramāt, mahāvyādhisāmānyācca bhagandaranidānārambhaḥ||1-2||

vātapittaśleṣmasannipātāgantunimittāḥ śataponakoṣṭragrīvaparisrāviśambūkāvartonmārgiṇo yathāsaṅkhyaṃ pañca bhagandarā bhavanti | te tu bhagagudabastipradeśadāraṇācca ‘bhagandarā’ ityucyante | abhinnāḥ piḍakāḥ, bhinnāstu bhagandarāḥ ||3||
vātapittetyādi| saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva saṅkhyāsiddhau pañcetivacanaṃ śoṇitajādiniṣedhārtham| bhagandaraniruktimāha- te tvityādi||3||

saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva saṅkhyāsiddhau pañceti śoṇitajādiniṣedhārtham| abhinnā piḍikā, bhinnā bhagandaraḥ, piḍikābhedenaiva bhagādipradeśadāraṇānniruktisādhitasyārthasya sambhavāt| tābheva niruktiṃ bhagandaraśabdasya darśayannāha- gudabhagabastipradeśadāraṇāditi||3||
teṣāṃ ‘teṣāṃ pūrvarūpaṃ gudakaṇḍūdāhaśophāgudāyāmaśceti sarveṣāṃ sāmānyam’ iti gayadāsasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ syāt tu pūrvarūpāṇi- kaṭīkapālavedanā kaṇḍūrdāhaḥ śophaśca gudasya bhavati ||4||
pūrvarūpamāha- teṣāṃ tvityādi| teṣāṃ tu pūrvarūpāṇi ‘bhavanti’ ityarthaḥ| kaṭīkapālaḥ kaṭīphalakaḥ||4||

bhagandarāṇāṃ pūrvarūpaṃ darśayannāha- teṣāṃ pūrvarūpamityādi| kaṭīkapālaḥ kaṭīphalakaḥ, tasya vedanāṃ tatsthānāśritena doṣeṇa| gudaśabdena saha kaṇḍvādayaḥ śabdāḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyante| pākārambhe doṣatrayasānnidhyāt kaṇḍvādayaḥ kaphādijāḥ| gudāyāmaśceti gudasyāyāma iva vāyunā| sarveṣāṃ piḍikāśothārambhiṇām| sāmānyamiti anyatrāpi pūrvarūpasya sāmānyatvādevātra viśeṣeṇa sāmānyābhidhānaṃ bhagandarapiḍakānāṃ bhagandarāṇāṃ ca pūrvarūpasya sāmānyatvabodhanārtham| etenāpūrvarūpā piḍikā bhāgandarī na bhavati, kecittvapūrvarūpāṃ bhāgandarīmapi piḍikāmadhīyate||4||

tatrāpathyasevināṃ vāyuḥ prakupitaḥ sannivṛttaḥ sthirībhūto gudamabhito'ṅgule ‘gudamabhito gudadvārādaṅgule dvyaṅgule tryaṅgule vā māṃsaśoṇitamabhipradūṣya’ iti tā. dvyaṅgule vā māṃsaśoṇite pradūṣyāruṇavarṇāṃ piḍakāṃ janayati, sā'sya todādīn vedanāviśeṣāñjanayati, apratikriyamāṇā ca pākamupaiti, mūtrāśayābhyāsagatatvācca vraṇaḥ praklinnaḥ śataponakavadaṇumukhaiśchidrairāpūryate, tāni ca chidrāṇyajasramacchaṃ phenānuviddhamadhikamāsrāvaṃ sravanti ‘phenānuviddhamāsrāvaṃ pravahanti’, vraṇaśca tāḍyate bhidyate chidyate sūcībhiriva nistudyate, gudaṃ cāvadīryate, upekṣite ca vātamūtrapurīṣaretasāmapyāgamaśca taireva chidrairbhavati; taṃ bhagandaraṃ śataponakamityāvakṣate ||5||

pūrvarūpānantaraṃ piḍikotpattipākopadravaniruktīdarśayannāha- tatrāpathyetyādi| sannivṛttau vyāghuṭitaḥ| gudamabhito gudasya sarvataḥ; anye ‘gudasannidhau’ ityāhuḥ| abhyāsaḥ samīpam| śataponakaḥ śūkadoṣaparipaṭhito vyādhiḥ; ‘cālanikā’ iti jejjhaṭaḥ; tannecchati gayī, lokaśāstrayoścālanikāyāṃ śataponakaśabdasyāprasiddhatvāt; ‘aśvapucchabālaracitaṃ śatākṣakaṃ’ ityanye| tudyate vyathyate| tāḍyate daṇḍenevābhihanyata ityarthaḥ| bhidyate tvagvidāryata iva| chidyate dvidhā kriyata iva||5||

pūrvarūpānantaraṃ piḍikotpattyādi darśayannāha- tatrāpathyakāriṇāmityādi| gudamabhito gudasya sarvataḥ| todādīniti ādiśabdena bhedādīnāmavarodhaḥ| śataponakavadaṇumukhairiti śataponakaścālaniketi jejjaṭaḥ; tanna, lokaśāstrayoścālanikāyāṃ śataponakaśabdasyāprasiddheḥ| tena śataponakaḥ śūkadoṣaparipaṭhito vyādhiḥ “chidrairaṇumukhairliṅgaṃ” (ni. 14) ityādi||5||

pittaṃ tu prakupitamanilenādhaḥ preritaṃ pūrvavadavasthitaṃ raktāṃ tanvīmucchritāmuṣṭragrīvākārāṃ ucchritāgrāṃ iti tā. piḍakāṃ janayati; sā'sya coṣādīn vedanāviśeṣāñjanayati; apratikriyamāṇā ca pākamupaiti; vraṇaścāgnikṣārābhyāmiva dahyate, durgandhamuṣṇamāsrāvaṃ sravati, upekṣitaśca vātamūtrapurīṣaretāṃsi visṛjati; taṃ bhagandaramuṣṭragrīvamityācakṣate ||6||
pittaṃ tvityādi| pūrvavadavasthitamiti gudamabhito'ṅgule dvyaṅgule vetyarthaḥ| visṛjati sravati vraṇa iti sambandhaḥ||6||
uṣṭragrīvāsadṛśatvena piḍikāyā uṣṭragrīvaḥ, dhanuḥstambhavat| ūṣādīniti ādiśabdāccoṣādayaḥ||6||

śleṣmā tu prakupitaḥ samīraṇenādhaḥ preritaḥ pūrvavadavasthitaḥ śuklāvabhāsāṃ sthirāṃ kaṇḍūmatīṃ piḍakāṃ janayati, sā'sya kaṇḍvādīn vedanāviśeṣāñjanayati, apratikriyamāṇāṃ ca pākamupaiti, vraṇaśca kaṭhinaḥ saṃrambhī kaṇḍūprāyaḥ picchilamajasramāsrāvaṃ sravati, upekṣitaśca vātamūtrapurīṣaretāṃsi visṛjati; taṃ bhagandaraṃ parisrāviṇamityācakṣate ||7||
śleṣmetyādi| saṃrambhī śophavān| kaṇḍūprāyaḥ kharjūbahulaḥ| parisrāvītyevaṃśīlaḥ parisrāvī||7||
ślaiṣmikapiḍikāsu sthirā kaṭhinā| kaṇḍvādīnityādiśabdādgurutopadehālpavedanatādayaḥ| vraṇaḥ saṃrambhīti śothavān||7||

vāyuḥ prakupitaḥ prakupitau pittaśleṣmāṇau parigṛhyādho gatvā pūrvavadavasthitaḥ pādāṅguṣṭhāgrapramāṇāṃ sarvaliṅgāṃ piḍakāṃ janayati, sā'sya todadāhakaṇḍvādīn vedanāviśeṣāñjanayati, apratikriyamāṇā ca pākamupaiti, vraṇaśca nānāvidhavarṇamāsrāvaṃ sravati, pūrṇanadīśambūkāvartavaccātra samuttiṣṭhanti vedanāviśeṣāḥ; taṃ bhagandaraṃ śambūkāvartamityācakṣate ||8||

‘pūrṇanadīśambūkāvartavannairantaryeṇa vedanā uttiṣṭhanti’ ityeke; anye tu ‘tathāvidhagatyārambhakasya śophasya pūrṇanadyāvartaśambūkāvartākāreṇevāvagatvādavagāḍhavedanā bhavantītyarthaḥ’| śambūkāḥ śaṅkhāḥ||8||

vāyuḥ prakupitaḥ prakupitau pittaśleṣmāṇāviti trayāṇāmapyanubandhitvaṃ darśayati; sarva eva svahetukupitāḥ svatantrā vyaktaliṅgā yathoktaprakopapraśamanāḥ| sā'sya todadāhakaṇḍvādīñjanayatīti pratyekadoṣapaṭhitān todadāhakaṇḍvādīnityarthaḥ| pūrṇanadyāvartaśambūkāvartavadvedanāviśeṣā iti tathāvidhagatyārambhakasya śothasya pūrṇanadyāvartaśambūkāvartakākāreṇaivāvagāḍhatvāt||8||

mūḍhena ‘mūḍhena tu sāsthiśalyamabhyavahṛtaṃ’ iti tā. māṃsalubdhena yadasthiśalyamannena sahābhyavahṛtaṃ yadā'vagāḍhapurīṣonmiśramapānenādhaḥpreritamasamyagāgataṃ gudamapakṣiṇoti tadā kṣatanimittaḥ kotha upajāyate, tasmiṃśca kṣate pūyarudhirāvakīrṇamāṃsakothe bhūmāviva jalapraklinnāyāṃ krimayaḥ sañjāyante, te bhakṣayanto gudamanekadhā pārśvato dārayanti, tasya tairmārgaiḥ kṛmikṛtairvātamūtrapurīṣaretāṃsyabhiniḥsaranti; taṃ bhagandaramunmārgiṇamityācakṣate ||9||

unmārgiṇaḥ samprāpti darśayannāha- mūḍhenetyādi| mūḍhena ajñātena| apakṣiṇoti sakṣataṃ karoti| kothaḥ pūtibhāvaḥ| pārśvato dārayanti pakṣato dārayanti| asyāgre arśobhagandaraṃ kecit paṭhanti; tanna, sarvairnibandhakārairnirākṛtatvāt||9||

unmārgiṇaḥ samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- mūḍhenetyādi| mūḍhenājñena māṃsalolupena| asamyagāgatam unmārgamatyarthaṃ tīkṣṇatvānmāṃsādyavadāryāgatam| kecidatrārśobhagandaramapyācakṣate- kaphapitte tu pūrvotthite ityādi| tanna, apāṭhe'pi sthānaikatvādupadravavat svādhiveśenaiva siddhatvāt||9||
bhavanti cātra- utpadyate'lparuk śophāt ‘'lparukśothā’ iti pā. kṣipraṃ cāpyupaśāmyati | pāyvantadeśe piḍakā sā jñeyā'nyā bhagandarāt ||10||
pāyoḥ syād dvyaṅgule deśe gūḍhamūlā sarugjvarā | bhāgandarīti vijñeyā piḍakā'to viparyayāt ||11||

abhāgandarīṃ bhāgandarīṃ ca piḍakāmāha- bhavanti cātretyādi| pāyvantadeśe piḍakā śophādutpadyata iti sambandhaḥ| alparuk alpavedanā, pāyvantadeśe gudasyānte, anyā bhagandarāt aparā bhagandarebhya ityarthaḥ| etenābhāgandarī piḍakoktā, yato'syā bhagandaro notpadyate| ato'bhāgandaryāḥ piḍakāyāḥ, viparyayāt viparītatvāt, bhāgandarīti bhagandarakarī bhavatītyarthaḥ||10-11||
yānayānānmalotsargāt kaṇḍūrugdāhaśophavān | pāyurbhavedrujaḥ kaṭyāṃ pūrvarūpaṃ bhagandare ||12||

yonetyādi| yānayānāt rathādigamanāt| malotsargāt purīṣatyāgāt| kaṇḍūrugdāhaśophavān pāyurbhavet, tato'nantaraṃ kaṭyāṃ kaṇḍūrugdāhaśophādikaṃ pūrvarūpaṃ bhavet| ayaṃ vā paṭhanīyaḥ pūrvo vā; pūrvarūpagranthadvayaṃ vā paṭhanīyaṃ, pūrvaścāprasiddhaḥ, ayaṃ tu prasiddhaḥ||12||
kecidatrāpi bhāgandarīmapi piḍakāmabhidhīyate- utpadyate'lparukśophetyādi||10-12||
ghorāḥ sādhayituṃ duḥkhāḥ sarva eva bhagandarāḥ | teṣvasādhyastridoṣotthaḥ ‘asādhyastu tridoṣotthaḥ’ iti pā. kṣatajaśca bhagandaraḥ ||13||
tatra keṣāñcidasādhyatvaṃ darśayannāha- ghorā ityādi| ghorā duḥkhapradāḥ| sādhayituṃ duḥkhāḥ kaṣṭasādhyāḥ, ‘bhavanti’ ityadhyāhāraḥ||13||
tatra keṣāñcidasādhyatvaṃ darśayannāha- ghorāḥ sādhayitumityādi||13||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne bhagandaranidānaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ ||4||
iti śrīḍahlaṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nidānasthāne caturtho'dhyāyaḥ||4||
iti sauśrute śalyatantre śrīgayadāsaviracitāyāṃ nyāyacandrikāyāṃ pañjikāyāṃ nidānasthāne bhagandarāṇāṃ nidānam||4||

div.head: kuṣṭhanidānam

ab.seg: athātaḥ kuṣṭhanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athetyādi||1-2||

atha bhagandarānantaramūrdhvādhodhamanīgatarogābhidhāne tiryaggatadhamanīrogapāriśeṣyād viruddhāśanasantarpaṇaikahetujanmatvāt saṃśodhanopakramasādhyatvānmahāvyādhisāmānyācca kuṣṭhanidānārambhaḥ||1-2||

mithyāhārācārasya ‘mithyāhārācārasya pittaśleṣmāṇau prakupitau’ iti tā. viśeṣādguruviruddhāsātmyājīrṇāhitāśinaḥ snehapītasya vāntasya vā vyāyāmagrāmyadharmasevino grāmyānūpaudakamāṃsāni vā payasā'bhīkṣṇamaśnato yo vā majjatyapsūṣmābhitaptaḥ sahasā chardiṃ vā pratihanti, tasya pittaśleṣmāṇau prakupitau parigṛhyānilaḥ pravṛddhastiryaggāḥ sirāḥ samprapadya samuddhūya bāhyaṃ mārgaṃ prati samantādvikṣipati, yatra yatra ca doṣo vikṣipto niścarati tatra tatra maṇḍalāni prādurbhavanti, evaṃ samutpannastvaci doṣastatra tatra ca parivṛddhiṃ prāpyāpratikriyamāṇo'bhyantaraṃ pratipadyate dhātūnabhidūṣayan ||3||

idānīṃ hetumāha- mithyetyādi| mithyāhārācārasya śāstroktavidhibhraṣṭāhārācārasyetyarthaḥ| samprāptimāha- tasyetyādi| tasya mithyāhārācārasyetyādikasya| samudbhūya ākṣipya, samantāt sarvatra; etena sarvadehagatatvaṃ rogasya sūcayati||3||

tasya prāk sthānasaṃśrayasvabhāvān hetvādipurassaraṃ darśayannāha- mithyāhārācārasyetyādi| mithyāśabda āhārācārābhyāṃ saha pratyekamabhisambadhyate| tatra dvādaśāśanapravibhāgoktavidhiviparītavidhirmithyāhāraḥ| ācāraḥ kāya vāṅmanobhedena trividho vihāraḥ, tasya svasthavṛttānāgatābādhavidhānādanyathākaraṇaṃ mithyācāraḥ| te ca prakopahetavaḥ sarveṣāmevātra gṛhyante mithyāhārācārabhedena dvividhyāt| pittaśleṣmāṇau prakupitau prakupitaḥ parigṛhya anila iti tridoṣajatvaṃ samprāptau sūcitaṃ; karmajatvaṃ punarbahmastrīsajjanavadhādibhiḥ parasvaharaṇāntaiḥ sūcayiṣyati| ata eva kuṣṭhānāṃ dvividhaṃ cikitsitaṃ yuktivyapāśritaṃ daivavyapāśritaṃ ca, doṣakarmasambhavatvāt kuṣṭhānām| kecidatra vyādhihetūnadhīyate- viśeṣādguruviruddhāsātmyājīrṇāhitāśina ityādi| yuktaṃ caitat, doṣarogobhayabhedena hetūnāṃ trividhatvāt, bhojādiṣu pāṭhācca| tathāhi bhojaḥ- “sevate yo viruddhānnamajīrṇe karṣatastathā” ityādi| tiryaggāḥ sirā iti nābhiprabhavāstrividhā hi sirāḥ sambhavanti ūrdhvagā adhogāstiryagāśceti| anye tu sirāśabdena dhamanīrapi sādṛśyādāhuḥ| uktaṃ ca “tiryaggāṇāṃ catasṝṇāmekaikā” (śā. 9) ityādi| samuddhūya ākṣipya| bāhyaṃ mārgaṃ pratīti lakṣaṇe dvitīyā| samantāditi sarvadeharogatvamasya sūcayati| ata eva yatra tatra grahaṇamaniyatadehasūcanaṃ; taduktaṃ carake- “ataḥ prabhavāṇyabhinivartamāni kevalaṃ śarīramupatapanti” (ca. ni. 5) iti; kevalamiti sakalaṃ doṣadūṣyagaṇam| tena raso raktaṃ māṃsamambu ca duṣṭamanugṛhyate| taduktaṃ carake- “vātādayastrayo duṣṭāstvagraktaṃ māṃsamambu ca| dūṣayanti sa kuṣṭhānāṃ saptako dravyasaṅgrahaḥ||”; tathā “raktaṃ lasīkā tvaṅmāṃsaṃ dūṣyaṃ doṣāstrayo malāḥ| visarpāṇāṃ samutpattau vijñeyāḥ sapta dhātavaḥ” (ca. ci. 7) iti| tatra ambu lasīkā udakameva| yadāha- “yattu tvagantare vraṇagatamudakaṃ tattu lasīkāśabdaṃ labhate” (ca. śā. 7) iti| tatra visarpasya pittaprabalaṃ saptadravyaṃ, kuṣṭhasya punarmandapittamiti| tathaiva dravyaṃ gurudravyādi, brahmastrīsajjanavadhādikarmaviśeṣo'pi viśeṣa iti| maṇḍalānyupajanayantīti sāmānyaṃ sarvakuṣṭhānāṃ lakṣaṇam| tathā carake'pi- “viruddhānyannapānāni dravasnigdhagurūṇi ca” (ca. ci. 7) ityādi| kuṣṭhasamprāptau bhojaḥ- “praduṣṭopacitā doṣā rasāsṛṅmāṃsasaṃsṛtāḥ| kuṣṭhāni janayantyāśu śarīreṣu śarīriṇām” iti||3||
tasya pūrvarūpāṇi- tvakpāruṣyamakasmādromaharṣaḥ kaṇḍūḥ svedabāhulyamasvedanaṃ vā'ṅgapradeśānāṃ svapanamaṅgānāmasṛkkṛṣṇatvaṃ ca’ iti pā. svāpaḥ kṣatavisarpaṇamasṛjaḥ kṛṣṇatā ceti ||4||
pūrvarūpamāha- tasyetyādi| akasmāt kāraṇaṃ vinā| svāpaḥ sparśājñānam||4||

sthānasaṃśrayalakṣaṇasamprāptau pūrvarūpaṃ- tvakpāruṣyamityādi| lomaharṣātisvedāsvedau ca kuṣṭhajanakadoṣaistiryaksvedavāhiṣu duṣṭeṣu| yaduktaṃ tantrāntare- “pārūṣyaṃ lomaharṣaṇam| atisvedanamasvedaḥ paridāhaśca jāyate||” iti| asṛkkṛṣṇatā doṣairasṛjo duṣṭatvāt| atraiva bhojaḥ- “atisvedo na vā svedaḥ kaṇḍūnistodasuptatāḥ| tvacaḥ pāruṣyamatyarthaṃ romaharṣo vivarṇatā|| śuklatā śoṇitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vraṇānāmaprarohaṇam| dāhapākau ca samprāpte tvaci secanayo hitam(?)|| tasya kuṣṭhāni spaṣṭāni teṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu||” iti||4||

tatra sapta mahākuṣṭhāni, ekādaśa kṣudrakuṣṭhāni, evamaṣṭādaśa kuṣṭhāni bhavanti | tatra mahākuṣṭhānyaruṇodumbararṣya(rkṣa)jihvakapālakākaṇakapuṇḍarīkadadrukuṣṭhānīti | kṣudrakuṣṭhānyapi sthūlāruṣkaṃ mahākuṣṭhamekakuṣṭhaṃ carmadalaṃ visarpaḥ parisarpaḥ sidhmaṃ vicarcikā kiṭibhaṃ (maṃ) pāmā rakasā ceti ||5||

idānīṃ saṅkhyāmāha- tatretyādi| mahattvamuttarottaradhātvanupraveśāt| ekādaśakuṣṭhānāṃ kṣudratvamuttarottaradhātvananupraveśāt| aṣṭādaśa kuṣṭhāni bhavantīti diṅmātramidaṃ darśitaṃ, kuṣṭhānāmaniyatasaṅkhyatvāt; tathā ca carakaḥ- “saptavidho'ṣṭādaśavidho'saṅkhyeyavidho vā” (ca. ni. 5) iti| mahākuṣṭhāni nāmataḥ nāmabhiḥ iti pā. prāha- tatra mahākuṣṭhānītyādi| kṣudrakuṣṭhāni nāmataḥ nāmabhiḥ iti pā. prāha- kṣudrakuṣṭhānyapītyādi||5||

teṣāṃ kuṣṭhānāṃ hetuliṅgacikitsopayoginīṃ kuṣṭhaviśeṣāśrayāṃ saṅkhyāṃ nirdiśannāha- tatra sapta mahākuṣṭhānītyādi| mahattvameṣāmuttarottaradhātvanupraveśāt| dhātvantarapraveśo'pyeṣāṃ bahubahuladoṣārambhāt| ata eva kriyā mahatī mahākuṣṭhe, kṣudre punaralpā| yadāha carakaḥ- “pracchannamalpe kuṣṭhe, mahati ca śastaṃ sirāvyadhanam” (ca. ci. 7) iti| doṣāṇāṃ prābalyaṃ doṣasvabhāvakāryaliṅgaiḥ kuṣṭheṣu jñeyam| atraivārthe kuṣṭhamadhikṛtya rogadoṣayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhūtayostathaiva doṣakāraṇayoranyonyajñāpakabhāve carakaḥ- “kuṣṭhaviśeṣairdoṣā doṣaviśeṣaḥ punaśca kuṣṭhāni| jñāyante te hetuṃ hetuśca tān prakāśayati” (ca. ci. 7) iti| tadyathā- aruṇakuṣṭhaṃ vāyoḥ svabhāvabhūtena raukṣyeṇa todasvāpādinā ca kāryeṇa vātaṃ kāraṇabhūtaṃ jñāpayati| hetuśceti cakāro'pyarthaḥ| tena heturapi tān doṣān prakāśayatīti| hetoḥ kāryasya prakāśena pratibandhaniyamaṃ sūcayati, kāryasya punaḥ prakāśane niyataḥ sambandha iti||5||
sarvāṇi kuṣṭhāni savātāni sapittāni saśleṣmāṇi sakrimīṇi ca bhavanti, utsannatastu doṣagrahaṇamabhibhavāt ||6||

sarveṣveva kuṣṭheṣu sarveṣāmeva doṣāṇāṃ krimīṇāṃ ca sambhavaṃ darśayannāha- sarvāṇītyādi| sarvāṇi kṣudrāṇi mahānti ca| kathaṃ tarhi vātenāruṇamityādītyāśaṅkyāha- utsannatastu doṣagrahaṇamabhibhavāditi; utsannata autkaṭyāt doṣagrahaṇam, abhibhavāt ‘itaradoṣayoḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ||6||

tatra sarveṣveva kuṣṭheṣu sarveṣāmeva doṣāṇāṃ krimīṇāṃ ca sambhavaṃ darśayannāha- sarvāṇītyādi| sarvaṇīti kṣudrāṇi mahānti ca| kathaṃ tarhi vātenāruṇāmityādi? utsannatastu doṣagrahaṇamiti| utsannamiti napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ; tenotsannamutkarṣaḥ| utkarṣadoṣeṇa grahaṇaṃ vātenāruṇamityādi| abhibhavāditi lyablope pañcamī; tena abhibhavamutkarṣaṃ vīkṣya tena doṣeṇa grahaṇam| nanu cotkarṣo hi abhibhavamevāpekṣya bhavatīti abhibhavagrahaṇamantareṇa tadartho labhyata eveti abhibhavagrahaṇaṃ saṃsargajadoṣābhyāṃ grahaṇamityabhilambhayati||6||
tatra vātenāruṇaṃ, pittenodumbararṣya(rkṣa)jihvakapālakākaṇakāni, śleṣmaṇā puṇḍarīkaṃ dadrukuṣṭhaṃ ceti | teṣāṃ mahattvaṃ kriyāgurutvamuttarottaraṃ dhātvanupraveśādasādhyatvaṃ ceti ||7||

yasya doṣasya yasmin kuṣṭhe autkaṭyaṃ tena taddarśayannāha- tatretyādi| tatrāruṇādīnāṃ saptānāṃ mahattvādiṣu hetuṃ darśayannāha- teṣāmityādi| anuśabdena paścādarthavācinā mahatve'sādhyatve'pi kākaṇakavarjaṃ kālāntaraṃ ca sūcyate; kākaṇakaṃ punarutpattāvevāsādhyaṃ, vyādhisvabhāvāt| asādhyatvaṃ ceti cakāro dhātvanupraveśāccetyanantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ; tenānuktamārambhakadoṣamahattvaṃ samuccinoti||7||

tatrāruṇādīnāṃ saptānāṃ mahatve hetuṃ darśayannāha- teṣāṃ tu mahatvamityādi| asādhyatve'pi cāyameva hetuḥ| anuśabdena paścādarthavācinā asādhyatve'pi kāraṇavarjaṃ kālāntaraṃ ca sūcyate| yadāha- “sādhyā yāpyatvamāyānti yāpyāścāsādhyatāṃ tathā| ghnanti prāṇānasādhyāstu narāṇāmakriyāvatām” (sū. 26) ityādi| aruṇaṃ punarutpattāvevāsādhyaṃ, vyādhisvabhāvāt| asādhyatvaṃ ceti cakāro bhinnakrame dhātvanupraveśādityanantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ| tenānukramārambhakadoṣatve mahatvaṃ samuccinoti| bhedo hi bhedavatāṃ kāraṇabhedād viruddhadharmādhyāsādbhavatīti||7||

tatra, vātenāruṇābhāni tanūni visarpīṇi todabhedasvāpayuktānyaruṇāni | pittena pakvodumbaraphalākṛtivarṇānyaudumbarāṇi ‘pakvodumbaravarṇāni’ iti tā., ṛṣya(kṣa)jihvāprakāśāni ‘ṛṣyajihvāprakāśakharatvāni’ iti pā.| ‘ṛṣyajihveva kharāṇi’ iti tā. kharāṇi ṛṣya(kṣa)jihvāni, kṛṣṇakapālikāprakāśāni kapālakuṣṭhāni, kākaṇantikāphalasadṛśānyatīva raktakṛṣṇāni kākaṇakāni asyāgre ‘pacyante’ iti tāḍapatrapustake'dhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ; teṣāṃ caturṇāmapyoṣacoṣaparidāhadhūmāyanāni kṣiprotthānaprapākabheditvāni krimijanma ca sāmānyāni liṅgāni | śleṣmaṇā puṇḍarīkapatraprakāśāni pauṇḍarīkāṇi, atasīpuṣpavarṇāni tāmrāṇi vā visarpīṇi piḍakāvanti ca dadrukuṣṭhāni; tayordvayorapyutsannatā parimaṇḍalatā kaṇḍūścirotthānatvaṃ ceti sāmānyāni rūpāṇi ||8||

tatra mahākuṣṭhānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha- tatra vātenetyādi| ṛṣyajihvāprakāśānīti ṛṣyajihvāyā iva prakāśaḥ sādṛśyaṃ yeṣāṃ tāni kharatvayuktāni, ṛṣyo nīlāṇḍaḥ ‘roru ‘roka’ iti pā. ’ iti prasiddhaḥ; anye ‘ṛkṣa’ iti paṭhanti, ṛkṣo ‘rīcha’ iti loke| kṛṣṇakapālikā kṛṣṇakarkarā| kākaṇantikā guñjā, ‘cirahaṇṭikā’ iti prasiddhā, tatphalavadraktāni madhye kṛṣṇāni| udumbarādīnāṃ pittakṛtatvaṃ darśayannāha- teṣāmityādi| uṣo'nalasamīpa ivopatāpaḥ, pluṣṭasyeva vedanāviśeṣa ityanye; coṣa ācūṣyata iva vedanāviśeṣaḥ, pipāsetyanye; paridāhaḥ sarvato dāhaḥ; dhūmāyanaṃ dhūmopahatasyeva, ‘dhūmodvamanamivāṅgānām’ ityeke| puṇḍarīkadadrukuṣṭhayorlakṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha- śleṣmaṇetyādi| puṇḍarīkaṃ śvetapadmam| dadrukuṣṭhaṃ dvividhaṃ- sitamasitaṃ ca; asitasya mahopakramasādhyatvādanubandhitvaprakarṣācca mahākuṣṭheṣu madhye suśrute pāṭhaḥ, sitadadrukuṣṭhasya sukhasādhyatvāduttarottaradhātvanupraveśābhāvāttathā'tyarthapīḍārahitatvācca carake kṣudrakuṣṭheṣu madhye pāṭha ityadoṣaḥ| dadrusidhmayoḥ suśrutacarakoditayorabhidhānabheda iti jejjhaṭaḥ samādadhati, tannecchati gayī| tayoḥ puṇḍarīkadadrukuṣṭhayoḥ pittakaphakṛtatvaṃ darśayannāha- tayorityādi| parimaṇḍalatā paripūrṇamaṇḍalatā||8||

mahatāṃ kuṣṭhānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha- tatrāruṇānītyādi| tanūni visarpīṇi vividhasarpaṇavanti ca| todādīnyatra vātakāryāṇi| udumbarāṇi pakvodumbaravarṇāni pittajatvāllohitāvabhāsāni| ṛkṣajihvāsādṛśyādṛkṣajihvāni; pṛṣodarāditvādākāranivṛttiḥ| tena vātena kharāṇi śyāvāṇyapi| lohitatvaṃ pittajatvādasya| atra carakaḥ- “karkaśaṃ raktaparyantamantaḥśyāvaṃ savedanam| yadṛkṣajihvāsaṃsthānamṛkṣajihvaṃ taducyate”- (ca. ci. 7) iti| atraiva doṣānubandhamāha carakaḥ- “vātapitte śleṣmapitte vātaśleṣmaṇi vā'dhike| ṛkṣa(ṣya)jihvaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ sidhmakuṣṭhaṃ ca jāyate” (ca. ci. 7) iti kṛṣṇakapālikā kṛṣṇaśarkarā| atra vātānubandho'pyasti| taduktaṃ carake- “vāte'dhikatare kāpālaṃ, pitte tvaudumbaraṃ, kākaṇakaṃ tu tridoṣajam” (ca. ni. 5) iti| udumbarādīnāṃ pittakṛtatvaṃ darśayannāha- teṣāmityādi| sannipātajamapi kāraṇaṃ pittaje paṭhanti, pittotkaṭasannipātajatvāt| ūṣā analasamīpa ivopatāpaḥ| coṣaḥ cūṣaṇamiva, pipāsetyanye| paridāhaḥ sarvato dāhaḥ| dhūmāyanaṃ dhūmodvamanamivāṅgānāṃ, pittopatāpena| pittajeṣu ‘kṛmijanma ca’ iti kecit paṭhanti| puṇḍarīkāṇi sitāni kaphena, pittānubandhena raktāni ca, sitāruṇaṃ hi puṇḍarīkaṃ; taduktaṃ carake- “saśvetaṃ raktaparyantaṃ puṇḍarīkadalopamam| sotsedhaṃ ca sarāgaṃ ca puṇḍarīkaṃ pracakṣate” (ca. ci. 7) iti| dadrukuṣṭhānyatra tantre mahākuṣṭheṣu, bhoje'pi; tathā hi bhojaḥ- “sakaṇḍūpiḍikātmāni vṛttāni bahulāni ca| atasīpuṣpavarṇāni dadrūkuṣṭhāni nirdiśet”- iti| asitadadrūṇāmatra mahākuṣṭheṣu pāṭho mahopakramasādhyatvādeva, sitadadrūstu carake'lpakuṣṭheṣu| tathāhi tatra- “sakaṇḍūrāgapiḍikaṃ dadrūmaṇḍalamudgatam” (ca. ci. 7) iti| suśrute tu sitadadrorvisarpakuṣṭhe'varodhaḥ, ‘visarpīṇi’ iti vacanāt| carake tu mahākuṣṭheṣu sitasidhmasya pāṭhe kāraṇaṃ gaveṣaṇīyam| asitasidhmasya suśrute dadrukuṣṭhe'varodhaḥ| tatra sidhmamanye tu paṭhanti- “kaṇḍvanvitaṃ śvetamapāyi sidhmaṃ vidyāttanuprāyaśaūrdhvakāye” iti| tathā ca bhojaḥ- “tatra śvetaṃ saparuṣaṃ dhvaṃsi kaṇḍūsamanvitaṃ sidhmaṃ, tat kaphasambhūtaṃ tvaggataṃ sucikitsitam” iti| “tayoḥ suśrutacarakoditayordadrūsidhmayorabhidhānabheda eva paraṃ, nābhidheyabhedaḥ” iti jejjaḍaḥ| kaḥ punaretayorumālāmākā(?)kusumasamayorasitasitayorabheda eveti jejjaḍavacanaṃ jaḍatvameva kathayati| na hi sarvatra suśrutacarakācāryayorvastuṣvabhedaḥ, pākādiṣu vastubhedadarśanāt||8||

div.ab: kṣudrakuṣṭhānyata ūrdhvaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ- sthūlāni aruḥ kuṣṭhaṃ sthūlamūlānyarūṃsi sañjāyante sandhiṣu dāruṇāni’ iti tā. sandhiṣvatidāruṇāni sthūlāruṣi ‘sthūlāruṣi sthūlāruṣkasañjñe kuṣṭhe’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ syuḥ kaṭhinānyarūṃṣi |9|
kṣudrakuṣṭheṣu prāk sthūlāruṣkamāha- sthūlānītyādi| sthūlāni sthūlamūlāni| dāruṇāni kṛcchrasādhyāni| arūṃṣi vraṇāḥ|9|-

ab.seg: tvakkocabhedasvapanāṅgasādāḥ kuṣṭhe mahatpūrvayute bhavanti ‘mahākuṣṭhe sarvadehe bhavanti tvaksaṅkocasvedabhedāṅgadāhāḥ’ iti tā.||9||

mahākuṣṭhalakṣaṇamāha- tvakkocetyādi| tvakśabdaḥ kocabhedasvapnaiḥ saha pratyekaṃ sambadhyate; tena tvakkocaḥ tvaksaṅkocaḥ, tvagbhedaḥ tvagvidāraṇaṃ, tvaksvapanaṃ tvaco'cetanatvam, aṅgasādo'ṅgaglāniḥ| kuṣṭhe mahatpūrvayuta iti mahākuṣṭha ityarthaḥ||9||

div.ab: kṛṣṇāruṇaṃ yena bhaveccharīraṃ tadekakuṣṭhaṃ pravadanti kuṣṭham kṛṣṇo deho yasya kṛṣṇāruṇo vā taccaikākhyaṃ kuṣṭhamāhuḥ sukaṣṭam’ iti tā.|10|
ekakuṣṭhamāha- kuṣṇāruṇamityādi|10|-

ab.seg: syuryena kaṇḍūvyathanauṣacoṣāstaleṣu ‘kaṇḍū coṣau todadāhau tu yasya’ iti tā. taccarmadalaṃ vadanti ||10||
carmadalamāha- syuryenetyādi| coṣa ācūṣaṇamiva| taleṣu hastapādataleṣu||10||
visarpavat sarpati sarvato yastvagraktamāṃsānyabhibhūya śīghram | mūrcchāvidāhāratitodapākān kṛtvā visarpaḥ sa bhavedvikāraḥ ||11||
visarpakuṣṭhalakṣaṇamāha- visarpavadityādi| atroktavisarpākhyakuṣṭhasya vakṣyamāṇavisarparogasya ca ciravisarpaṇaśīghravisarpaṇato bhedaḥ||11||

div.ab: śanaiḥ śarīre piḍakāḥ sravantyaḥ ‘yasmin sphoṭāḥ srāvavantastamāhuḥ pārīsarpaṃ tacchanaiḥ sarpamāṇam| vaisarpaṃ syāt sarvataḥ sarpaṇāttu tvagraktādīn vyāpya bhāvān suśīghram’ iti tā. sarpanti yāstaṃ parisarpamāhuḥ |12|
parisarpamāha- śanairityādi|12|-

ab.seg: kaṇḍvanvitaṃ śvetamapāyi sidhma ‘svacchaṃ śvetaṃ kaṇḍumaccāpi sidhmaṃ paridhvaṃsi prāyaśaścordhvakāye’ iti tā. vidyāttanu ‘tanoḥ’ pā. prāyaśa ūrdhvakāye ||12||

sidhmakuṣṭhamāha- kuṇḍvanvitamityādi| apāyi akaṣṭakāri ‘apāyi śītartau vināśītyarthaḥ’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ| prāyaśa ūrdhvakāya iti prāyaḥśabdopādānādadhaḥkāye'pi kadācidbhavati| sidhmakuṣṭhaṃ dvividhaṃ- puṣpikāsidhmaṃ, sidhmaṃ ca; puṣpikāsidhmasya sukhasādhyatvāt suśrute kṣudrakuṣṭheṣu pāṭhaḥ, sidhmasya duḥkhasādhyatvāccarake ‘mahopakramasādhyatvāt’ iti pā. mahākuṣṭhe pāṭha ityadoṣaḥ||12||
rājyo'tikaṇḍvartirujaḥ sarūkṣā bhavanti gātreṣu vicarcikāyām | kaṇḍūmatī dāharujopapannā vipādikā pādagateyameva ||13||

vicarcikāmāha- rājya ityādi| rājyo rekhāḥ, tāśca sarūkṣā bhavanti| kaṇḍvartiḥ kharjūpīḍā, rujo vedanāḥ, atiśabdaḥ kaṇḍvartirugbhyāṃ sambadhyate| gātreṣu pāṇipādeṣu| kaṇḍūmatītyādi| iyameva vicarcikā pādagatā yadā syāttadā vicarcikāsañjñāṃ vihāya vipādikāsañjñāṃ prāpnotītyarthaḥ||13||

div.ab: yat srāvi vṛttaṃ ghanamugrakaṇḍu tat snigdhakṛṣṇaṃ kiṭibhaṃ(maṃ) vadanti |14|
kiṭibhamāha- yadityādi| ‘raktakṛṣṇaṃ’ iti kecit paṭhanti|14|-

sāsrāvakaṇḍūparidāhakābhiḥ ‘sūkṣmā bahvayaḥ piḍakāḥ srāvavatyaḥ pāmetyuktāḥ kaṇḍumatyaḥ sadāhāḥ| saiva sphoṭaistīvradāhairupetā jñeyāḥ pāṇyoḥ kacchurugrā sphicośca’ iti tā. pāmā'ṇukābhiḥ piḍakābhirūhyā ||14|| sphoṭaiḥ sadāhairati saiva kacchūḥ sphikpāṇipādaprabhavairnirūpyā |15|

atha ‘ataḥ’ iti pā. pāmāmāha,- sāsrāvetyādi| sahāsrāvakaṇḍūparidāhakairvartante yāḥ piḍakāstāstathāvidhāḥ, tābhirūhyā pāmeti sambandhaḥ; ye tu ‘sāsrāvakaṇḍūparidāhavadbhiḥ’ iti paṭhanti, te tu vyākhyānayanti- sāsrāvau yau kaṇḍūparidāhau tadyuktaiḥ puruṣaiḥ kṛtvā, aṇukābhiḥ piḍakābhiḥ kṛtvā, pāmā ‘pāmā’ iti kvacitpustake na paṭhyate ūhyā ‘vaidyaiḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| saiva kacchūriti saiva pāṇyoḥ sphijośca tīvradāhaiḥ sphoṭairupagatā kacchūrucyate||14||-

ab.seg: kaṇḍvanvitā ‘kṛtsne dehe piḍakāḥ kaṇḍumatyaḥ saivāsrāvā rakasetyucyate tu’ iti tā. yā piḍakā śarīre saṃsrāvahīnā rakasocyate sā ||15||
rakasāmāha- kaṇḍvanvitetyādi| śarīre sakale kāye||15||

aruḥ ‘tatrāruṣkaṃ rākasaṃ yacca sidhma kaphādhikyādekakuṣṭhaṃ mahacca| pittādhikyāt pārisarpaṃ tu vidyāddṛṣṭastvevaṃ kuṣṭhavargastridoṣaḥ’ iti tā. sasidhmaṃ rakasā mahacca yaccaikakuṣṭhaṃ kaphajānyamūni | vāyoḥ prakopāt parisarpamekaṃ śeṣāṇi pittaprabhavāṇi vidyāt ||16||

idānīṃ kasmin kṣudrakuṣṭhe kasyādhikyamityāha- arurityādi| aruḥ sthūlāruṣkam| śeṣāṇi visarpakiṭibhavicarcikāpāmācarmadalāni| aruḥ sasidhmamityādi| jejjhaṭena svakapolakalpitaḥ śloka iti gayadāso na manyate, yasmādekakuṣṭhaṃ mahākuṣṭhaṃ ca vātādeva bhavati na kaphāt, parisarpaṃ pittāt; pāṭhāntaraṃ cātra ‘aruṣkaṃ’ ityādi paṭhati, taccābhāvānna likhitam||16||

kṣudrakuṣṭhāni darśayannāha- sthūlāruṣkamityādi| sthūlāni aruṃṣi vraṇāḥ| sandhiṣu parvarṇām| sthūlāruṣkaṃ kaphāt| sthūlāruṣkamityasya sānvayaṃ nāma| kṣudrakuṣṭhapaṭhitasyāpi mahākuṣṭhamiti sānvayaṃ nāma, tasmin tvaksaṅkocādīnāṃ sarvāṅgagatvāt| ekakuṣṭhe'pi kṛṣṇāruṇaikavarṇatvena kṛtsnaśarīragasyaikakuṣṭhamiti sānvayaṃ nāma| mahākuṣṭhamekakuṣṭhamapi vātāt, todasvāpatvaksaṅkocādīnāṃ mahākuṣṭhe vātaikakāryatvāt; ekakuṣṭhe'pi kṛṣṇāruṇayorvātakāryatvāt; kaphāditi jejjaṭaḥ| kaṇḍūśoṣāvapi carmadalakuṣṭhe pittāt| tvagraktādīnisyādiśabdānmāṃsābunoravarodhaḥ| prāyaśaścordhvakāye iti prāyaśabdādadhaḥkāye'pi kadācit| sidhmaṃ vātānubandhakaphāt| soṣā kaṇḍūriti saha ūṣākaṇḍūbhyāṃ vartate yā sā tathā| yaiva pāṇyorvicarcī, saiva pādayorvipādikā| avadārayatītyavadāryā “kṛtyaluṭo bahulam” (pā. a. 3/3/113) iti kartari kṛtyaḥ, pādadāriketyarthaḥ| atraiva bhojaḥ- “doṣāḥ pradūṣya tvaṅmāṃsaṃ pāṇipādatalāśritāḥ| piḍakā janayantyāśu dāhakaṇḍūsamanvitāḥ|| dālyate tvak kharā rūkṣā pāṇyorjñeyā vicarcikā pāde vipādikā jñeyā sthānānyatvādvicarcikā||” iti| vicarcīvipādike pittakṛte, pittodrekāt, ‘śeṣāṇi pittaprabhavāṇi’ iti vacanāt; kaphavātāvapyatrāstaḥ, kaṇḍūdāraṇyordarśanāt| saiva pāṇyoḥ sphijośca tīvradāhaiḥ sphoṭairupagatā kacchūruktā| kacchūḥ pittāt, ‘tīvradāhaiḥ’ iti vacanena| sakaṇḍūḥ srāvahīnā| piḍakā rakasā, sā kaphāt| kṣudrakuṣṭheṣu pradhānān doṣānnirdiśannāha- tatrāruṣkamityādi| sthūlāruṣkarakasāsidhmeṣu kapho'dhikaḥ, vātodrekādekakuṣṭhaṃ, vātapittāttu parīsarpaṃ, aparāṇi ca pittādeva nirdiśet| aparāṇīti visarpakiṭibhavicarcīvipādikāpāmāḥ| sakaṇḍūḥ saiva tīvradāhasphoṭā kacchūriti na saṅkhyātirekaḥ| atra jejjaḍena- ekakuṣṭhe mahākuṣṭhe'pi kaphādhikyaṃ ceti svakalpitaślokaḥ- “aruḥ sasidhmaṃ rakasā mahacca yaccaikakuṣṭhaṃ kaphajānyamūni| vātena vidyāt parisarpamekaṃ śeṣāṇi pittaprabhavāṇi vidyāt” iti| tatra mahākuṣṭhe tvaksaṅkocasvāpabhedāṅgasādā vātakṛtāḥ, ekakuṣṭhe'pi kṛṣṇāruṇatvaṃ vātakṛtaṃ; kiñca kaphajatve tu kaṣṭatvamapyasya na syāt, kaphajasya kuṣṭhasya sukhasādhyatvāt; parisarpasyāpi vātakṛtatve srāvasphoṭajanmānupapattiḥ, vātajasyāvidyamānasrāvapākāt| kṣudrakuṣṭheṣu doṣānubandhe carakaḥ- “carmākhyamekakuṣṭhaṃ ca kiṭibhaṃ ca vipādikā| kuṣṭhaṃ cālasakaṃ jñeyaṃ prāyo vātakaphānvitam|| pāmā śatāruṣī sphoṭā dadruścarmadalaṃ tathā| pittaśleṣmādhikāḥ prāyaḥ kaphaprāyā vicarcikā” iti (ca. ci. 7)||9-16||

kilāsamapi kuṣṭhavikalpa ‘kuṣṭhavikāraḥ’ iti tā. eva; tattrividhaṃ- vātena, pittena, śleṣmaṇā ceti | kuṣṭhakilāsayorantaraṃ- tvaggatameva kilāsamaparisrāvi ca | tadvātena maṇḍalamaruṇaṃ paruṣaṃ paridhvaṃsi ca, pittena padmapatrapratīkāśaṃ saparidāhaṃ ca, śleṣmaṇā śvetaṃ snigdhaṃ bahalaṃ kaṇḍūmacca | teṣu sambaddhamaṇḍalamantejātaṃ raktaroma cāsādhyamagnidagdhaṃ ca ||17||

kilāsaṃ nirdiśannāha- kilāsamapītyādi| apiśabdaḥ sambhāvanāyāṃ, tena kilāsaṃ kuṣṭhavikṛtiriti sambhāvyate; anye tu, kimapi kilāsaṃ kuṣṭhavikalpo na bhavatītyapiśabdādāhuḥ; kiṃ tat kilāsaṃ kuṣṭhavikalpo na bhavati? ucyate- tvaggatamaparisrāvi ceti; antaraṃ bhedaḥ| tvaggatamiti kuṣṭhaṃ tvagraktamāṃsamadhiṣṭhāya tvaci darśayatyātmānaṃ, kilāsaṃ tu tvacameva kevalāmadhitiṣṭhatītyarthaḥ| anye tu ‘tvaggatameva kilāsasañjñaṃ, tadeva dhātvanupraveśācchvitrasañjñam’ ityāhuḥ| tathā ca viśvāmitraḥ,- “tvaggataṃ tu yadasrāvi kilāsaṃ tat prakīrtitam| yadā tvacamatikramya taddhātūnavagāhate|| hitvā kilāsasañjñāṃ ca śvitrasañjñāṃ labheta tat”- iti| vātādijānāṃ kilāsānāṃ lakṣaṇamāha- tadvātenetyādi| paridhvaṃsīti ghṛṣṭaṃ sadrajo vimuñcatītyarthaḥ| bahalaṃ sthūlam| ataḥ paramasādhyāvadhāraṇaṃ- teṣvityādi| teṣu vātapittaśleṣmajeṣu kilāseṣu| sambaddhamaṇḍalamiti parasparamabhinnamaṇḍalamityarthaḥ| ante jātam oṣṭhapāṇipādaguhyajam; anye tvatra ‘antarjātaraktaroma ca’ iti paṭhanti; antarmadhye jātāni raktāni lomāni yatra tattathā; te cācāryā ‘agnidagdhaṃ ca’ iti cakāreṇa pāṇipādaguhyauṣṭhajamanuktamapyasādhyaṃ samuccinvanti||17||

tvagdoṣasāmānyāt kilāsaṃ nirdiśannāha- kilāsamapītyādi| apiśabdāt kuṣṭhavikalpo'pi kiñcitkilāsaṃ kuṣṭhavikalpo na bhavatītyāha- kuṣṭhakilāsayorantaramityādi| antaraṃ bhedaḥ| tvaggatameva kilāsaṃ, kuṣṭhaṃ tathā na bhavati; aparisrāvi ca, ‘kuṣṭhaṃ athā na bhavati’ iti śeṣaḥ| yadā tu raktādigataṃ parisrāvi tadā na kilāsasañjñaṃ, kiṃ tarhi kuṣṭhasañjñameva| tasya kuṣṭhāddhetuviśeṣo'pyasti doṣakopanaṃ viruddhādhyaśanādi pāpakarmāpi tatrāntare| tathāhi carakaḥ- “viprān gurūn dharṣayatāṃ” ityādi kuṣṭhahetūnabhidhāya, kuṣṭhādhyāye kilāsahetumapi doṣajananaṃ pāpakarmākhyaṃ cāha- “vacāṃsyatathyāni” (ca. ci. 7) ityādi| atra pṛthakkilāsahetavo na nirdiṣṭāḥ, tasya kuṣṭhaikasambhavatvāt| etāvad dṛśyameva kuṣṭhakilāsayorbhedaṃ viśvāmitrā'pyāha| tathāhi viśvāmitraḥ- “tvaggataṃ tu yadasrāvi kilāsaṃ tat prakīrtitam| yadi tvacamatikramya taddhātūnavagāhate|| hitvā kilāsasañjñāṃ tu kuṣṭhasañjñāṃ labhettadā” iti| tadapi dvividhaṃ vraṇakṛtaṃ, doṣajaṃ ca; tathā ca bhojaḥ- ‘śvitraṃ tu dvividhaṃ proktaṃ doṣajaṃ vraṇajaṃ tathā| tatra mithyopacārāddhi vraṇasya vraṇajaṃ smṛtam|| doṣajaṃ ca dvidhā proktamātmajaṃ parajaṃ tathā| paragātrāsanasparśādyattat parajamucyate|| tadātmajaṃ vijānīyādyaddeheṣvanilādijam| teṣāṃ lakṣaṇavaiśeṣyamuktaṃ śṛṇu mayā'nagha|| raktaṃ bhavati pittena kaphācchvetaṃ sapāṇḍukam| vātāt kṛṣṇāruṇaṃ tāmraṃ rūkṣaṃ tanu ca yadbhavet” iti| carakācāryāśayo'pi rasagatameva kilāsaṃ, tasyottarottaradhātutrayāśritaṃ tu nāmatrayaṃ “dāruṇaṃ vāruṇaṃ śvitraṃ kilāsaṃ nāmabhistribhiḥ| doṣe raktāśrite raktaṃ, tāmraṃ māṃsasamāśrite|| śvetaṃ medaḥśrite śvitraṃ, guru taccottarottaram” (ca. ci. 7) iti| atraivārthe bhālukiḥ- “saṃskārāt sahajāt sthānadoṣācchetatayā'pi tat| kilāsamabhivijñeyaṃ saṃsparśādeva dāhavat|| dāruṇaṃ tattu vijñeyaṃ māṃsadhātusamāśritam| medaḥśritaṃ bhavecchvetaṃ tathā śvitraṃ nirucyate” iti| cikitsābhedo'pi śvitrakilāsayorbhedaṃ kathayatveva; śvitrasya mahatī, laghvī kilāsasya| tasya sādhyāsādhyāvadhāraṇāyāha- sambaddhamaṇḍalamityādi| antejātamiti oṣṭhapāṇipādaguhyajaṃ, raktaroma cāsādhyaṃ kilāsam| tathā kilāsasyāsādhyatve carakaḥ- “saraktaroma bahulaṃ yacca bhinnaṃ parasparam| yacca varṣagaṇotpannaṃ tacchvitraṃ naiva sidhyati” (ca. ci. 7) iti| tathā bhoje'pi- “puṇḍarīkapalāśābhaṃ raktāntaṃ dīrgharoma ca| asādhyamanyathā jātaṃ yacchvitramacirotthitam|| chinnaṃ tu yadbhavecchvitraṃ tat sādhyamiti nirdiśet” iti| prāyeṇātrāpi kecit ‘antarjātaraktaloma’ iti paṭhanti| te punaragnidagdhaṃ ceti cakāreṇa pāṇipādaguhyauṣṭhajaṃ sanucinvanti||17||

kuṣṭheṣu tu tvaksaṅkocasvāpasvedaśophabhedakauṇyasvaropaghātā vātena, pākāvadaraṇāṅgulipatanakarṇanāsābhaṅgākṣirāgasattvotpattayaḥ ‘rāgāḥ śīghrotpattayaḥ’ iti tā. pittena, kaṇḍūvarṇabhedaśophāsrāvagauravāṇi śleṣmaṇā ||18||

kuṣṭhānāṃ saṅkṣepeṇoktatvādanuktamapi doṣaliṅgaṃ darśayannāha- kuṣṭheṣvityādi| vātakāryeṣu svedaścintyaḥ| ‘tvaksaṅkocasvāpāsvedau’ ityanye paṭhanti, tatra nañ svedaniṣedhārthaḥ; ‘vyādhisvabhāvāt svedo'pi syāt’ ityapare| kauṇyaṃ naṣṭakaratā| sattvotpattayaḥ krimīṇāṃ janmāni ‘utpattayaḥ’ iti pā.||18||

kṣudrakuṣṭhānāṃ saṅkṣepeṇoktatvādanuktamapi doṣaliṅgaṃ nirdiśannāha- tatra kuṣṭheṣvityādi| svedameke vātakāryeṣu paṭhanti; tatra svedo vātakāryeṣu cintya eva| svedamanye manyante, kuṣṭhapūrvarūpeṣvapi svedapāṭhāt| vyādhiprabhāvāt svedo'pi syādityapare| śoṣo'ṅgaśoṣaḥ| nisvāpaḥ sparśākṣamatvam| kauṇyaṃ naṣṭakaratā| pittajeṣu jantūtpattiḥ kṛmijanma, pākātiśayāt| kaṇḍūvarṇabhedādayaḥ kaphasya||18||
tatrādibalapravṛttaṃ pauṇḍarīkaṃ kākaṇaṃ cāsādhyam ||19||

teṣāmasādhyatāṃ darśayannāha- tatretyādi| puṇḍarīkamādibalapravṛttaṃ śukraśoṇitadoṣajamasādhyam| nanu cādibalapravṛttamanyadapi kuṣṭhamasādhyameva, yadāha carakaḥ,- “ye cāpi kecit kulajā vikārāstāṃścāpyasādhyān pravadanti tajjñāḥ” (ca. ci. 6) iti; kulajā ityanena duṣṭaśukraśoṇitajā ucyante| puṇḍarīkagrahaṇaṃ sarveṣāmeva mahākuṣṭhānāmupalakṣaṇaṃ; teṣāmevottarottaradhātvanukrameṇa śukradhātorduṣṭijananasāmarthyāt| etena kṣudrakuṣṭheṣvādibalapravṛttatvaṃ nāsti, uttarottaradhātvananukramaṇābhāvena śukradoṣakaraṇe'sāmarthyāt| kākaṇakaṃ cāsādhyam, utpattāveva tridoṣabalapravṛttatvāt; dhātvanukramaṇena hi mahākuṣṭhānāmasthimajjaśukragatānāmasādhyatvamupariṣṭhādeva vakṣyati||19||

teṣāmasādhyatāṃ nirdiśannāha- tatrādibalapravṛttamityādi| puṇḍarīkamādibalapravṛttaṃ śukraśoṇitadoṣajamasādhyam| nanu cādibalapravṛttamanyadapi kuṣṭhamasādhyameva; yadāha carakaḥ- “ye cāpi kecit kulajā vikārāstāṃścāpyasādhyān pravadanti tajjñāḥ (ca. ci. 7) iti; kulajā ityanena duṣṭaśukraśoṇitajānupakṣipati| ucyate- puṇḍarīkagrahaṇaṃ sarveṣāmeva mahākuṣṭhānāmupalakṣaṇaṃ, teṣāmevottarottaradhātvanukrameṇa śukradhātorduṣṭijananasāmarthyāt; etena kṣudrakuṣṭheṣvādibalapravṛttatvaṃ nāsti, uttarottaradhātvanukramaṇābhāvena śukradoṣakaraṇe'sāmarthyāt| kākaṇakaṃ cāsādhyamutpattāveva, tridoṣaprabalapravṛttattvāt| dhātvanukramaṇena hi mahākuṣṭhānāmasthimajjaśukragatānāmasādhyatāmupariṣṭhādeva vakṣati||19||
bhavanti cātra- yathā vanaspatirjātaḥ prāpya kālaprakarṣaṇam kālaṃ krameṇa tu’ iti tā.| antarbhūmiṃ vigāheta mūlairvṛṣṭivivardhitaiḥ ||20||
evaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ samutpannaṃ tvaci kālaprakarṣataḥ | krameṇa dhātūn vyāpnoti narasyāpratikāriṇaḥ ||21||

idānīmapratikāriṇa uttarottaradhātvanukramaṇe dṛṣṭāntaṃ darśayannāha- bhavanti cātretyādi| yathā vanaspatirvṛkṣaḥ, kālaprakarṣaṇaṃ kālādhikyaṃ prāpya, mūlaiḥ kṛtvā, antarbhūmiṃ vigāheteti sambandhaḥ| tvacīti atra tvakśabdena rasa uktaḥ, rasārabdhatvāt; tena rasasthamityarthaḥ||20-21||
idānīmapratikāriṇāmuttarottaradhātvanukramaṇe dṛṣṭāntaṃ darśayannāha- yatā vanaspatirjāta ityādi||20-21||
sparśahāniḥ svedanatvamīṣatkaṇḍūśca jāyate | vaivarṇyaṃ rūkṣabhāvaśca kuṣṭhe tvaci samāśrite ‘tvaksthe vaivarṇyamaṅgeṣu kuṣṭhe raukṣyaṃ ca jāyate’ iti tā.||22||
tvaksvāpo romaharṣaśca svedasyābhipravartanam | kaṇḍūrvipūyakaścaiva kuṣṭhe śoṇitasaṃśrite ||23||
bāhulyaṃ vakraśoṣaśca kārkaśyaṃ piḍakodgamaḥ | todaḥ sphoṭaḥ sthiratvaṃ ca kuṣṭhe māṃsasamāśrite ||24||
daurgandhyamupadehaśca pūyo'tha krimayastathā | gātrāṇāṃ bhedanaṃ cāpi kuṣṭhe medaḥsamāśrite ||25||
nāsābhaṅgo'kṣirāgaśca kṣate ca krimisambhavaḥ | bhavet svaropaghātaśca hyasthimajjasamāśrite ||26||
kauṇyaṃ gatikṣayo'ṅgānāṃ sambhedaḥ kṣatasarpaṇam | śukrasthānagate liṅgaṃ prāguktāni tathaiva ca ||27||
strīpuṃsayoḥ kuṣṭhadoṣādduṣṭaśoṇitaśukrayoḥ | yadapatyaṃ tayorjātaṃ jñeyaṃ tadapi kuṣṭhitam ||28||

dhātugatakuṣṭhānāṃ lakṣaṇamāha- sparśahānirityādi| “prāgeva rasadhātuṃ kroḍīkṛtya doṣāḥ kuṣṭhārambhakāḥ, ato rasadhātulakṣaṇaṃ noktam” ityeke; apare tvakśabdena rasamāhuḥ| jāyata ityatrāpi sambadhyate| vipūyako durgandhatā| śoṇitasaṃśrite iti ‘jāyate’ ityatrāpi sambadhyate| bāhulyaṃ sthūlamaṇḍalatā| sphoṭaḥ tvacaḥ sphuṭanam| sthiratvaṃ kaṭhinamaṇḍalatā| kecidatrānyathā paṭhanti, sa ca pāṭho'bhāvānna likhitaḥ| atrāpi ‘jāyate’ ityadhyāhāraḥ| upadeho malavṛddhiḥ| atrāpi kecidanyathā ślokaṃ paṭhanti, so'pi pāṭho'bhāvānna likhitaḥ| śukragatasya kuṣṭhasya liṅgaṃ darśayannāha- kauṇyamityādi| tadapītyapiśabdāt pūrvoktānyapi rasādimajjāntagatāni liṅgāni bhavanti| kuṣṭhitaṃ sañjātakuṣṭham; anye tu ‘kuṣṭhavat’ iti paṭhanti, kuṣṭhasahitamityarthaḥ; anye ‘kuṣṭhilam’ iti paṭhanti, tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ| yadā strīpuṃsayoḥ kuṣṭhinorbījamupahataṃ syāttadā tayoḥ prajā notpadyate; upataptamātrabījayoḥ punaḥ prajopatāpa ‘prajopatāpayutotpadyate’ iti pā. utpadyate||22-28||

kuṣṭhe tvacīti tvaksthe rasasthite ityarthaḥ| pūrvoktāni ca liṅgāni māṃsaprāpte iti rasaraktagatakuṣṭhaliṅgāni| medaḥsthānagate liṅgaṃ pūrvoktāni ca rasaraktamāṃsamedogataliṅgāni| śukragatasya liṅgaṃ darśayannāha- strīpuṃsayorityādi| kauṇyaṃ karabhaṅgaḥ| aṅgānāṃ bhedo bhaṅgaḥ| tadapītyapiśabdāt pūrvoktānyapi rasādimajjāntagataliṅgāni| apatyakuṣṭhajanakaśukradhātugatakuṣṭhaprasaṅgena āśrayaviśeṣāt pūrvamanuktasyāpatyakuṣṭhajanakasya strīraktadhātugatakuṣṭhasya vacanam| kuṣṭhikaṃ sañjātakuṣṭhaṃ; kuṣṭhilamityanye, tatra kuṣṭhavadityarthaḥ||22-28||
kuṣṭhamātmavataḥ sādhyaṃ tvagraktapiśitāśritam | medogataṃ bhavedyāpyamasādhyamata uttaram ||29||
idānīṃ dhātvanukrame'pi sādhyādibhedaṃ darśayannāha- kuṣṭhamityādi| ātmavato jitendriyasya||29||
idānīṃ dhātvanukrame'pi sādhyādibhedaṃ darśayannāha-kuṣṭhamātmavata ityādi||29||
brahmastrīsajjanavadhaparasvaharaṇādibhiḥ | karmabhiḥ pāparogasya prāhuḥ kuṣṭhasya sambhavam ‘devadravyagurudravyaparasvaharaṇādibhiḥ| pāpmā pāpakṛtāmetat kuṣṭhamityabhiśabditam’ iti tā.||30||
kuṣṭhasya karmajatvaṃ darśayannāha- brahmastrītyādi| sajjanaḥ satpuruṣaḥ| parasvaṃ paradravyam||30||
daivavyapāśrayacikitsārthaṃ karmajatvamathāsya darśayannāha- devadravyetyādi| brahmādibhiḥ saha vadhaśabdaḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyate| pāparogasyeti anenāpi karmajatvameva prakāśitam||30||
mriyate yadi kuṣṭhena punarjāte'pi gacchati | nātaḥ kaṣṭataro rogo yathā kuṣṭhaṃ prakīrtitam ||31||
āhārācārayoḥ proktāmāsthāya mahatīṃ kriyām | auṣadhīnāṃ viśiṣṭānāṃ tapasaśca niṣevaṇāt | yastena mucyate jantuḥ sa puṇyāṃ gatimāpnuyāt ||32||

kuṣṭhaṃ dīrgharogāṇāṃ pradhānamiti janmāntare'pi tadanubandhaṃ darśayannāha- mriyata ityādi| gacchati anugataṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ, kuṣṭhajanakasya karmaṇo'kṣīṇatvāt| āsthāya āśritya| sa puṇyāṃ gatimāpnuyāt, kṣīṇapāpatvāt||31-32||

mriyate yadi kuṣṭhena hetubhūtena lakṣaṇabhūtena vā| punarjāte'pi gacchati kuṣṭhajanakasya karmaṇo'kṣīṇatvāt, saṃsarataśca dhātordoṣaduṣṭatvāt| āhārācārayoriti anena yuktivyapāśrayaṃ cikitsitamuktam| tapasaśca niṣevaṇādityanena daivavyapāśrayamuktam| puṇyāṃ gatimāpnuyāt kṣīṇapāpatvāt||31-32||
prasaṅgādgātrasaṃsparśānniśvāsāt sahabhojanāt | sahaśayyāsanāccāpi vastramālyānulepanāt ||33||
kuṣṭhaṃ jvaraśca śoṣaśca netrābhiṣyanda eva ca | aupasargikarogāśca saṅkrāmanti narānnaram ||34||

saṃsargasambhavapradhānaṃ kuṣṭhamāśritya kuṣṭhiprabhṛtīnāṃ saṃsargaparihāraṃ darśayannāha- prasaṅgādityādi| prasaṅgāditi prasaṅgena abhyāsena kṛtāt, punaḥ punaḥ kṛtādityarthaḥ| idaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ gātrasaṃsparśādibhiḥ sarvaiḥ saha pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| sahaśayyāsanāditi ekaśayyāsanasthiteḥ| mālyaṃ puṣpam| aupasargikarogāḥ śītalikādayaḥ| saṅkrāmanti āviśanti||33-34||

pradhānāśrayiṇo hi vidhayo bhavantīti saṃsargasambhavapradhānakuṣṭhamāśritya kuṣṭhiprabhṛtīnāṃ saṃsargasya parihāraṃ darśayannāha- prasaṅgādityādi| gātrasaṃsparśāt prasaṅgāt prasaṅgena kṛtādatyantābhyāsena kṛtādityarthaḥ| niśvāsādiṣu sarveṣveva prasaṅgāditi viśeṣaṇam| aupasargikā rogāḥ sāmānyādharmapravṛttā masūryādayaḥ| saṅkrāmanti narānnaramāviśanti| tadeva kathaṃ? pāpakṛtāṃ prasaṅgena pāpaṃ saṅkramati; taduktaṃ carake- “naro narakapātī svāttasya sambhāṣaṇādapi” (ca. sū. 1) iti; rogaprabhāvādityanye||33-34||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne kuṣṭhanidānaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ ||5||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nidānasthāne pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ||5||
iti sauśrute śalyatantre śrīgayadāsaviracitāyāṃ nyāyacandrikāyāṃ pañjikāyāṃ nidānasthāne kuṣṭhanidānaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ||5||

div.head: pramehanidānam

ab.seg: athātaḥ pramehanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi||1-2||

athātaḥ pramehāṇāṃ nidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| kuṣṭhānantaraṃ pramehārambhaḥ, apatyasaṅkramyatvenobhayorapyapatyagatvāt, tridoṣārabdhatvasāmānyāt, mahāvyādhitvasāmānyāt, kālāntareṇāsādhyatvasādharmyāccikitsaikatvācca| atrāhurekestrīṇāṃ pramehā na bhavantīti; tathā ca tantrāntare- “rajaḥprasekānnārīṇāṃ māsi māsi viśudhyati| sarvaṃ śarīraṃ doṣāśca na pramehantyataḥ striyaḥ”- iti; etattu na yuktaṃ, sarvantrāprasiddheḥ, pratyakṣavirodhācca||1-2||
divāsvapnāvyāyāmālasyaprasaktaṃ śītasnigdhamadhuramedyadravānnapānasevinaṃ puruṣaṃ jāniyāt pramehī bhaviṣyatīti ||3||

pramehahetumāha- divāsvapnetyādi| prasaktaṃ prakarṣeṇa saktamatiśayenānuṣaṅgiṇam| medyaṃ meduraṃ medojanakamityarthaḥ| puruṣaṃ jānīyāt pramehī bhaviṣyati; tatrāhureke- strīṇāṃ pramehā na bhavanti, tathā ca tantrāntare- “rajaḥprasekānnārīṇāṃ māsi māsi viśudhyati| sarvaṃ śarīraṃ doṣāśca na pramehantyataḥ striyaḥ” iti; etattu na yuktaṃ, sarvatantrāprasiddheḥ pratyakṣavirodhācca||3||
vyādhihetuṃ nirdiśannāha- divāsvapnaprasaktamityādi| prasaktaṃ prakarṣeṇa saktam| medyaṃ meduram| nidānaparivarjanārthametānyevātra pariharaṇīyāni||3||

tasya caivampravṛttasyāparipakvā ‘caivampravṛttasya yadā vātapittaśleṣmāṇo medaścāparipakvamadho gatvā’ iti pā. eva vātapittaśleṣmāṇo yadā medasā sahaikatvamupetya mūtravāhisrotāṃsyanusṛtyādho gatvā bastermukhamāśritya nirbhidyante tadā pramehāñjanayanti ||4||

samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- tasyetyādi| aparipakvā āmāḥ| medaseti atrāpiśabdo lupto draṣṭavyaḥ, tena vasādayo grāhyāḥ; anye ti ‘medaścāparipakvaṃ’ iti paṭhanti, cakoreṇānuktānapi vasādīn samuccinvanti| upetya gatvā| nirbhidyante niḥsarantītyarthaḥ| anye tu ‘vinirbhidyānte’ iti paṭhitvā, ‘tatraiva sthirti kurvanti’ iti tu vyākhyānayanti; apare ‘atidravatvaṃ yānti’ ityāhuḥ||4||

sthānasaṃśrayalakṣaṇāṃ samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- tasya caivampravṛttasyetyādi| medaścāpariṇatamiti asamyakpariṇatam, āmarasavadatisnigdham| vinirbhidyante pratibadhyante, tatraivāspadaṃ kurvantīti yāvat| etena sthānasaṃśraya uktaḥ| tathāhi carake pramehanidāne pramehasamprāptau “trayāṇāmeṣāṃ nidānādiniśeṣāṇāṃ sannipāte kṣipraṃ śleṣmā prakopamāpadyate” ityārabhya yāvat “mūtravahānāṃ srotasāṃ vaṅkṣaṇabastiprabhavāṇāṃ medaḥkledopahitāni gurūṇi mukhānyāsādya pratirudhyante, tadā sthairyamasādhyatāṃ vā janayanti” (ca. ni. 4) iti| sthānasamprāptyanantaraṃ vyaktiṃ darśayannāha- tadā pramehāñjanayantīti||4||

teṣāṃ tu pūrvarūpāṇi- hastapādataladāhaḥ snigdhapicchilagurutā gātrāṇāṃ madhuraśuklamūtratā tandrā sādaḥ pipāsā durgandhaśca śvāsastālugalajihvādanteṣu malotpattirjaṭilībhāvaḥ keśānāṃ vṛddhiśca nakhānām ||5||
pūrvarūpamāha- teṣāmityādi| keśānāṃ jaṭilībhāvo'nyonyamilanaṃ, svedamalabāhulyādrogaprabhāvācca||5||

sthānasaṃśraye pūrvarūpaṃ darśayannāha- teṣāṃ pūrvarūpāṇītyādi| hastatalādidāhaḥ prabhāvāt| snigdhapicchilagurutā gātrāṇāṃ kaphena| madhuraśuklamūtratā ca tenaiva| kecijjaṭilībhāvaṃ keśānāṃ tathā nakhādīnāmativṛddhiṃ pūrvarūpe paṭhanti| tatra jaṭilībhāvaḥ keśānāṃ kaphaje paicchilyena rogaprabhāvādvā; keśaprabhṛtivṛddhiḥ śarīrasyātimalībhāvena, rogaprabhāvādityanye||5||
tatrāvilaprabhūtamūtralakṣaṇāḥ sarva eva pramehā bhavanti ||6||
pramehāṇāṃ sāmānyaṃ lakṣaṇamāha- tatretyādi| āvilaṃ samalam||6||

sāmānyaṃ rūpaṃ pramehāṇāṃ darśayannāha- tatrāviletyādi| tatrāvilatvaṃ mūtrasya pramehadūṣyāṇāṃ medoraktamāṃsamajjāśukrodakavasālasīkaujasāṃ kvacideva pramehe kasyacideva dūṣyasyāvayavamiśrībhāvāt| teṣāmeva ca dūṣyāṇāṃ dravairekībhūtatvānmūtraprabhūtatvam| yadyevamanyeṣāṃ rasādidūṣyāṇāṃ kasmādatra grahaṇaṃ na kṛtam? atraike ‘medaścāparipakvaṃ’ ityatra medonantaramādiśabdo luptanirdiṣṭo draṣṭavya; tena rasādīnāmapyupagrahaḥ; anye tu ‘medaścāparipakvaṃ’ iti cakāreṇa rasādīnanuktānapi samuccinvanti||6||
sarva eva sarvadoṣasamutthāḥ saha piḍakābhiḥ ||7||
teṣāṃ pramehāṇāṃ pramehapiḍakānāṃ ca doṣaṃ nirdiśannāha- sarva evetyādi| etena pramehāṇāṃ pramehapiḍakānāṃ ca kuṣṭhavat sarvadoṣajatvamuktam||7||

teṣāṃ pramehāṇāṃ pramehapiḍikānāṃ ca doṣaṃ nirdiśannāha- sarva eva sarvadoṣasamutthā iti| anena kuṣṭhavat sarveṣāṃ sarvadoṣajatvam| saha piḍikābhiḥ piḍakāśca sarvāḥsarvadoṣasamutthāḥ; taduktamihaiva- “ye yanmayā smṛtā mehāsteṣāmetāsu tanmayāḥ” iti; tena sarvamehānāṃ sarvadoṣajatvaṃ, tatpiḍakānāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ sarvadoṣajatvamiti| amumevārthamupariṣṭādvakṣyati| tathāhi- “vātapittamedobhiranvitaḥ śleṣmā pramehāñjanayati”, tathā “vātapittakaphaśoṇitamedobhiranvitaṃ pittaṃ svamehāñjanayati” tathā “śleṣmapittavasāmajjāmedobhiranvito vāyuḥ svamehāñjanayati”, iti sarvāsāṃ sarvadoṣajatvamapi||7||

tatra, kaphādudakekṣuvālikāsurāsikatāśanairlavaṇapiṣṭasāndraśukraphenamehā ‘kaphādudakekṣusurā.’ iti pā. daśa sādhyāḥ, doṣadūṣyāṇāṃ samakriyatvāt; pittānnīlaharidrāmlakṣāramañjiṣṭhāśoṇitamehāḥ ṣaḍ yāpyāḥ, doṣadūṣyāṇāṃ viṣamaktiyatvāt; vātāt sarpirvasākṣaudrahastimehāścatvāro'sādhyatamāḥ, mahātyayikatvāt ||8||

sarveṣāṃ sarvadoṣajatve'pyutkarṣato doṣagrahaṇaṃ darśayannāha- tatretyādi| udakamehaḥ, ikṣuvālikāmehaḥ ‘ikṣumehaḥ’ iti pā., surāmehaḥ, sikatāmehaḥ, śanairmehaḥ, lavaṇamehaḥ, piṣṭamehaḥ, sāndramehaḥ, śukramehaḥ, phenamehaśceti daśa pramehāḥ sādhyā yadyatiśayena medo dūṣitaṃ na bhavati| doṣadūṣyāṇāṃ samakriyatvāditi atra doṣaḥ śleṣmā, dūṣyāṇi rasamāṃsamedomajjāśukralasīkaujāṃsi, eṣāṃ kaṭutiktakaṣāyādibhiḥ samaiva kriyā| pittādityādi| yāpyā iti atrāpi yadyatiśayena bhedo dūṣitaṃ na bhavati| doṣadūṣyāṇāṃ viṣamakriyatvāditi atra doṣaḥ pittaṃ, dūṣyāṇi rasamāṃsādīni, eteṣāṃ tu viṣamā kriyā pittahantrī rasamāṃsādyutpādiketi| vātādityādi| mahātyayikatvāditi śīghraṃ vināśakāritvāt, mahātyayikatvaṃ punareṣāmuttarottarasārataradhātusrāvakaratvāt; viṣamakriyatvāccetyatrāpi sambadhyate||8||
