utkarṣato doṣagrahaṇāṃ nirdiśannāha- tatra kaphādityādi| tatra kaphasyaiva yathā nānāvidharūpamehābhinirvṛttistathopariṣṭāt svayameva pratipādayiṣyati| atraike carakaṃ vīkṣya śvetaśītamūrtapicchalācchasnigdhagurumadhurasāndraprasādamandeṣu guṇeṣu kaphajeṣūdakamehādiṣu kvacit kañcideva guṇamupavarṇayanti| tatra tanuśītācchaśvetairudakamehaḥ, madhuraśītenekṣuvālikāmehaḥ, acchena pittānurāgiṇā surāmehaḥ, mandamūrtābhyāṃ śanairmehaḥ, kaphavidāhavyaktena guruṇā lavaṇamehaḥ, śuklena piṣṭamehaḥ, sāndrapicchilābhyāṃ sāndramehaḥ, śvetasnigdhābhyāṃ śukramehaḥ, gurusnigdhābhyāṃ phenamehaḥ| ete sādhyāḥ, samakriyatvāddoṣadūṣyāṇām| pittāttu nīlādyāḥ ṣaṭ, pittaguṇaiḥ ṣaḍbhireva yathāsaṅkhyaṃ nīlapītāmlakṣāravisralohitairabhivyajyante| pittajā yāpyāḥ, viṣamakriyatvāddoṣadūṣyāṇām| pittadoṣaharī śītamadhurā medaskarī, medoharā tu laṅghanoṣṇādikā ca pittakarīti doṣadūṣyayorviṣamakriyatvam| vātāttu sarpirmehādayaḥ| tatra sarpirmehaścarake majjamehaḥ, kṣaudrameho madhumehaḥ, vasayā vasāmehaḥ; ityubhayatra samānam| ete asādhyāḥ, viṣamakriyatvāddoṣadūṣyāṇāṃ, mahātyayatvācca; mahātyayatvaṃ ca punareṣāmuttarottarasārataradhātusrāvakatvāt| eṣāṃ tu sādhyāsādhyatvaṃ vyabhicārakaṃ ‘sapūrvarūpāḥ kaphapittamehāḥ’ (ca. ci. 6) ityanenābhimataṃ cikitsate yathāvasaraṃ vakṣyāmaḥ||8||
tatra vātapittamedobhiranvitaḥ śleṣmā śleṣmapramehāñjanayati, vātakaphaśoṇitamedobhiranvitaṃ pittaṃ pittapramehān, kaphapittavasāmajjamedobhiranvito vāyurvātapramehān ||9||
idānīṃ sarveṣāmeva sarvajatvaṃ prakaṭayannāha- tatretyādi||9||
tatra sarveṣāmeva sarvajatvaṃ darśayannāha- tatra vātapittetyādi||9||

tatra, śvetamavedanamudakasadṛśamudakamehī mehati; ikṣurasatulyamikṣuvālikāmehī; surātulyaṃ surāmehī; sarujaṃ sikatānuviddhaṃ sikatāmehī; śanaiḥ sakaphaṃ mṛtsnaṃ śanairmehī; viśadaṃ lavaṇatulyaṃ lavaṇamehī; hṛṣṭaromā piṣṭarasatulyaṃ piṣṭamehī; āvilaṃ sāndraṃ sāndramehī; śukratulyaṃ śukramehī; stokaṃ stokaṃ saphenamacchaṃ phenamehī mehati ||10||

kaphajānāmanukrameṇa lakṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha- tatretyādi| sikatānuviddhaṃ vālukāmiśram| mṛtsnaṃ picchilam| lavaṇatulyaṃ lavaṇāmbutulyam| hṛṣṭaromā prāptaromañcaḥ| puṣṭarasatulyaṃ piṣṭamiśrodakatulyam| āvilamatyarthaṃ kaluṣaṃ, punarvacanāt| mehati mūtrayatītyarthaḥ||10||

tatra śvetamityādi| ikṣuvālikā khaggalikā| sikatānuvuddhaṃ vālukāmiśram| lavaṇatulyaṃ lavaṇāmbutulyam| piṣṭarasatulyaṃ piṣṭamiśrodakatulyam| āvilam atyarthaṃ kaluṣaṃ, punarvacanāt| śukratulyaṃ śukrasadṛśaṃ; carake tu “śukrābhaṃ śukravimiśraṃ vā muhurmehati yo naraḥ| śukramehinamāhustaṃ puruṣaṃ kaphakopataḥ” (ca. ci. 6) iti; atrāpi śukronmiśramiti sakalameva śukrasamaṃ śukrābhaṃ, śukramiśraṃ veti boddhavyaṃ; vāstavaśukrajatve kaphajasyāpyasādhyatvaṃ syāt||10||

ata ūrdhvaṃ pittanimittān vakṣyāmaḥ- saphenamacchaṃ nīlaṃ nīlamehī mehati; sadāhaṃ haridrābhaṃ haridrāmehī; amlarasagandhamamlamehī; srutakṣārapratimaṃ kṣāramehī; mañjiṣṭhodakaprakāśaṃ mañjiṣṭhāmehī; śoṇitaprakāśaṃ śoṇitamehī mehati ||11||

ata ityādi| srutakṣārapratimaṃ galitakṣāradravatulyam| mañjiṣṭhodakaprakāśaṃ śoṇitaprakāśaṃ ca mūtraṃ raktapitte'pi bhavati, tat ko'yaṃ pramehaviśeṣaḥ? atrocyate- raktapitte pramehapūrvarūpaṃ na bhavati, mañjiṣṭhāśoṇitamehayostu pramehapūrvarūpasambhava iti viśoṣaḥ||11||

pittajeṣu nīlaṃ cāṣapakṣasadṛśavarṇam| tatra cāṣa indranīlapakṣaḥ praśastadarśanaḥ; kvacit ‘svarṇacūḍa’ iti| amlarasagandhamiti amlarasaṃ amlasacaritagandhaṃ ca; sa ca pittagandhena visreṇa vidāhasacaratvena| pittasya lohitādruṇānmañjiṣṭhāśoṇitamehau||11||

ata ūrdhvaṃ vātanimittān vakṣyāmaḥ- sarpiḥprakāśaṃ sarpirmehī mehati; vasāprakāśaṃ vasāmehī; kṣaudrarasavarṇaṃ kṣaudramehī; mattamātaṅgavadanuprabandhaṃ ‘anuprabaddhaṃ’ iti pā. hastimehī mehati ||12||
ata ityādi| anuprabandhaṃ satatam||12||

vātaje sarpirmehaścarake majjamehaḥ, kṣaudrameho madhumehaḥ| tasya tu ‘madhumeha’ iti pāribhāṣikamupadravāṇāmabhāvenānyatra(?) bodhanārthamarthabhede'pi śabdamātrābhinnaṃ nāma kṛtam| hastimeho lasīkamehaḥ| carakaḥ punarasya samprāptau vitarate; tadyathā- “yadā tu lasīkāṃ mūtrāśaye'bhivahan” (ca. ni. 4) ityādi||12||

makṣikopasarpaṇamālasyaṃ asyāgre ‘upadravānata ūrdhvaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ’ iti tāḍapatrapustake'dhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ māṃsopacayaḥ pratiśyāyaḥ śaithilyārocakāvipākāḥ kaphaprasekacchardinidrākāsaśvāsāśceti śleṣmajānāmupadravāḥ; vṛṣaṇayoravadaraṇaṃ bastibhedo meḍhratodo hṛdi śūlamamlīkājvarātīsārārocakā vamathuḥ paridhūpanaṃ ‘paridhūmāyanaṃ’ iti pā. dāho mūrcchā pipāsā nidrānāśaḥ pāṇḍurogaḥ pītaviṇmūtranetratvaṃ ceti paittikānāṃ; hṛdgraho laulyamanidrā stambhaḥ kampaḥ śūlaṃ baddhapurīṣatvaṃ ceti ‘śoṣaḥ kāsaḥ śvāsaśceti vātajānāmupadravā bhavanti’ iti tā. vātajānām | evamete viṃśati pramehāḥ sopadravā vyākhyātāḥ ||13||

idānīṃ pratidoṣamupadravān darśayannāha- makṣikopasarpaṇamityādi| avadaraṇaṃ vidaraṇam| amlīkā amlodgāraḥ| vamathuḥ chardiḥ| paridhūpanaṃ samantatastāpaḥ| dāho'gnidagdhasyeva| laulyaṃ sarvarasābhikāṅkṣā vātajagrahaṇīvat||13||

tatra pramehāṇāmupekṣayā pramehātiyogādatipramehaduṣṭamedasāmatipravṛddhadhātukṣayakṛtavātayutapūrvāvasthitakaphapittābhyāṃ copadravā jāyante, tān yathādoṣaṃ darśayannāha- makṣikopasaraṇamityādi| makṣikopasaraṇādayaḥ kāsāntāḥ kaphajānām| makṣikopasaraṇaṃ madhurāhārasya mūtrasvedaśleṣmaṇāṃ madhurībhāvāt| kāsaḥ kaphajānāṃ vātajānāṃ copadraveṣu paṭhyate; tatra sāmarthyāt kaphajakāsasyārdratā, vātajasya tu śuṣkatā| vṛṣṇāvadaraṇādayaḥ pāṇḍurogāntāḥ pittajānām| hṛdrogādayaḥ śvāsāntā vātajānām| laulyaṃ raseṣu gṛddhiḥ, vātajagrahaṇīvadvyādhiprabhāvāt| taduktaṃ vātagrahaṇyāṃ- “gṛddhiḥ sarvarasānāṃ” (ca. ci. 15) iti| idānīṃ prāgrūpaṃ nirdiṣṭamupasaṃharannupadravāṇāṃ pṛthagvyādhitvaṃ nirasyannāha- evamete ityādi| viṃśatipramehāḥ sopadravāḥ saha upadravairvartante, na pṛthagete vyādhaya ityarthaḥ||13||

tatra vasāmedobhyāmabhipannaśarīrasya tribhirdoṣaiścānugatadhātoḥ pramehiṇo daśa ‘nava’ iti tā. piḍakā jāyante | tadyathā- śarāvikā, sarṣapikā, kacchapikā, jālinī, vinatā, putriṇī, masūrikā, alajī, vidārikā, vidradhikā ceti ||14||

piḍakānāmupadravaviśeṣāṇāṃ samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- tatretyādi| vasā māṃsasnehaḥ, ‘sakalaśarīsnehaḥ’ ityanye| abhipannaśarīrasya vyāptaśarīrasya| anugatadhātorvyāptadhātoḥ| piḍakāstu prāyeṇādhaḥkāya eva| tāsāṃ piḍakānāṃ nāmānyāha- tadyathetyādi||14||
śarāvamātrā tadrūpā nimnamadhyā śarāvikā | gaurasarṣapasaṃsthānā tatpramāṇā ca sārṣapī ||15||
sadāhā kūrmasaṃsthānā jñeyā kacchapikā budhaiḥ | jālinī tīvradāhā tu māṃsajālasamāvṛtā ‘māṃsajālasamāśritā’ iti pā.||16||
mahatī piḍakā nīlā piḍakā vinatā smṛtā ayamardhaślokastāḍapatrapustake na paṭhyate| mahatyalpācitā jñeyā piḍakā sā tu putriṇī ||17||
masūrasamasaṃsthānā jñeyā sā tu masūrikā | raktā sitā sphoṭavatī dāruṇā tvalajī bhavet ||18||
vidārīkandavadvṛttā kaṭhinā ca vidārikā | vidradherlakṣaṇairyuktā jñeyā vidradhikā budhaiḥ ||19||

tāsāṃ lakṣaṇāmāha- śarāvamātretyādi| gaurasarṣapasaṃsthānā gaurasarṣapākarā| jālinityādi| yadyapi ‘ye yanmayāsmṛtā mehāsteṣāmetāstu taktṛtāḥ’- ityagre vakṣyate, tathā'pi jālinī pittettarā jñeyā, tadvacanasya bāhulyenoktatvāt| mahatī sthūlā| alpāciteti sūkṣmapiḍakāveṣṭitā||15-19||

paścādbhāvināmupadravāṇāṃ prasaṅgena piḍakānāṃ paścādbhāvinīnāmupadravaviśeṣāṇāṃ samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- tatra vasāmedobhyāmityādi| tatra vasā māṃsasnehaḥ; sakalaśarīrasneha ityanye, piḍakāsamprāptau carake ojograhaṇāt; ojaśca sakalaśarīrasnehaśukrasthitaḥ| taduktaṃ carake- “gurusnigdhāmlalavaṇānyatimātraṃ samaśnatām| dravamannaṃ ca pānaṃ ca nidrāmāsyāmukhāni ca|| tyaktavyāyāmacintānāṃ saṃśodhanamakurvatām| śleṣmā pittaṃ ca medaśca māṃsaṃ cātipravardhate|| tairāvṛtagatirvāyuroja ādāya gacchati| yadā bastiṃ tadā kṛcchro madhumehaḥ pravartate|| samārutasya pittasya kaphasya ca muhurmuhuḥ| darśatyākṛtiṃ gatvā kṣayamāpyāyate punaḥ|| upekṣayā'sya jāyante piḍakāḥ sapta dāruṇāḥ| māṃsaleṣvavakāśeṣu sandhiṣvapi ca marmasu|| śarāvikā kacchapikā jālinī sarṣapī tathā| alajī vinatākhyā ca vidradhī ceti saptamī” (ca. sū. 17) iti; sarvamehaviṣayo'yam, upekṣāmadhumehe vāyorāvaraṇavacanāt| yathā''ha carakaḥ- “śleṣmā pittaṃ ca medaśca māṃsaṃ cāti pravardhate| tairāvṛtagatirvāyuroja ādāya gacchati|| yadā bastiṃ tadā kṛcchro madhumehaḥ pravartate” (ca. sū. 17) iti| vātajeṣu mukhakaṣāyādi ca manāgasti| śeṇitātiyogādikṛteṣu dhātukṣayajeṣu vāyorāvaraṇaṃ nāsti| kiñca sarvamehopadraveṣu “pūtimāṃsapiḍikālajīvidradhyādayaśca tatprasaṅgādbhavanti” (ca. ni. 4) iti vacanāt tasya prasaṅgo hyanuvartate| tathā caraka eva piḍakāheturmadhumeha eva, “upekṣayā” (ca. sū. 17) iti vacanāt| anena hi meheṣvatigurusnigdhāmlalavaṇādibhojanena sahopekṣayā śleṣmādibhiratipravṛddhairāvaraṇaṃ tadaiva madhumehapiḍikāḥ sapta| tasyaivedaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ- “samārutasya pittasya kaphasya ca” (ca. sū. 17) ityādi| ityupekṣāmadhumeho'pi carake'styeva| svāmidāsācāryajaḍanandyādīnāṃ carakaṭīkākārāṇāṃ parokṣatvāt tadvartanaṃ pratyanuyogo nikhilaḥ| piḍikāstu sapta carake, suśrute nava| suśrute ye vinatāmadhīyate, ‘nīlā'vagāḍharujā’ ityādinā, tatpāṭhe tu saṅkhyātirekāt samānatantreṣvapāṭhāt sā na paṭhanīyā| tathāhi bhojaḥ- “śarāvikā sarṣapikā kūrmikā jālinī tathā| kulatthikā'lajī putrī vidārī vidradhī tathā| navaitāḥ piḍikā jñeyā mehināṃ lakṣaṇaiḥ śṛṇu”- iti| tasmāttulyatantrasaṃvādāttathaiva vinatā vihatā'stīti| masūrikaiva bhoje kulatthikā||14-19||

div.ab: ye yanmayāḥ smṛtā mehāsteṣāmetāstu tatkṛtāḥ |20|

piḍakājanakān doṣānāha- ye ityādi| ye yanmayā yaddoṣārabdhāḥ| teṣāṃ pramehāṇām| etā iti piḍakāḥ|20|- nanu jālinī tīvradāhā pittakṛtā, samānatantre'pi pittakṛtatvamasyāḥ, tathāhi bhojaḥ- “parasparaṃ hi sambaddhāḥ piḍakāścaikadeśajāḥ| pittotkaṭā dāhayutā bhṛśarugjālinī” matā- iti; tatkathaṃ ‘ye yanmayāḥ smṛtā mehāsteṣāmetāstu tanmayāḥ’ iti? ucyate- pūrvaṃ piḍakānāmārambhakadoṣākathanāt doṣasvabhāvakāryāṇāṃ ca keṣāñcittāsvanukteranilādidoṣāvadhāraṇārthamidamuktaṃ- ye yanmayā ityādi| tatra tena vacanenāniyama eva niyamo, na punarhi niyamo'pi; kiṃ ca loke bāhulyenaitadvacanaṃ, yathā- chatriṇo yāntīti; achatriṣvapi chatribāhulyāttadvyapadeśaḥ| tathā śāstre'pi “āmāśayotkleśabhavo bhūyiṣṭhaṃ jvara ucyate”, śramaklamādijā jvarā alaṅghanīyā ityukteḥ; jaḍenaivaṃ bahutarameva pralapitam| piḍakālakṣaṇaṃ subodham| piḍakāstu prāyeṇādhaḥkāya eva; yadāha- “kṛcchraṃ śarīraṃ niṣpīḍya medomajjavasāyutaḥ| adhaḥ prakramate vāyustenāsādhyāstu vātajāḥ” iti| vātādidoṣairevādhonītatvāddūṣyāṇāṃ tathā rasāyanīnāṃ ca daurbalyānnordhvamuttiṣṭhante doṣāḥ, ato madhumehināmadhaḥkāye piḍakāḥ prādurbhavanti|20|-

ab.seg: gude hṛdi śirasyaṃse pṛṣṭhe marmaṇi cotthitāḥ | sopadravā durbalāgneḥ ‘durbalasya’ iti pā. piḍakāḥ parivarjayet ||20||

tāsāmasādhyatāṃ darśayannāha- gude hṛdītyādi| aṃso bāhuśiraḥ| sopadravā iti “tṛṭkāsamāṃsasaṅkothamohahikkāmadajvarāḥ| visarpamarmarodhāḥ piḍakānāmupadravāḥ” (ca. sū. 17)| ‘sopadravālpakāyāgneḥ piḍakāḥ parivarjayet’ iti kecit paṭhanti| tatra sopadrava iti puruṣaviśeṣaṇam||20||

tāsāmasādhyatāṃ nirdiśannāha- gude hṛdītyādi| kecidāsāmasādhyatāṃ cikitsite paṭhanti- “asādhyā ūrdhvabhagotthā marmotthāśca viśeṣataḥ”- iti| sopadravā iti saha upadravairvartanta iti sopadravāḥ| te copadravāstāsāṃ carakādavagantavyāḥ| tathāhi carakaḥ- “tṛṭkāsamāṃsakothaśvāsahikkāmadajvarāḥ| visarpamarmasaṃrodhāḥ piḍakānāmupadravāḥ” (ca. sū. 17) iti||20||
kṛtsnaṃ śarīraṃ niṣpīḍya medomajjavasāyutaḥ | adhaḥ prakramate vāyustenāsādhyāstu vātajāḥ ||21||

vātajānāmasādhyatve hetuṃ darśayannāha- kṛtsnaṃ śarīramityādi| kṛtsnaṃ śarīraṃ niṣpīḍyeti niścyotayitvā mūtramārgeṇa samastān dhātūn pravāhayitvetyarthaḥ| vasetyupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena ojolasīkayorgrahaṇam| adhaḥ prakramate adhaḥ sphītībhavati prabalībhavatītyarthaḥ| gayadāsācāryastu āpātanikāpūrvaṃ pramehapūrvarūpāṇāmityādiślokatrayamanyathā paṭhati| asādhyāstviti pūrvahetubhyāṃ ceti tuśabdārthaḥ||21||

vātajānāmasādhyatve hetuṃ darśayannāha- kṛtsnaṃ śarīraṃ niṣpīḍyetyādi| kaphapittameheṣu na kṛtsnaśarīrapīḍanaṃ, tayorniyatadehaviṣayacaratvāt; vasetyupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena ojolasīkayorapyavarodhaḥ| prakramate iti vṛttyādiṣvartheṣu kramaterātmanepadam| yasyāḥ pradhānabhūtadhātukṣayeṇa śarīraṃ durbalībhavati, vapuḥ punaḥ sphītībhavati, tenāsādhyā vātajāḥ; pūrvahetubhyāṃ ceti tuśabdārthaḥ||21||
pramehapūrvarūpāṇāmākṛtiryatra dṛśyate | kiñciccāpyadhikaṃ mūtraṃ taṃ pramehiṇamādiśet ‘tasminbheho bhaviṣyati’ iti pā.||22||
idānīṃ pramehahetuyuktasya puruṣasya sāmānyākāreṇa lakṣaṇamāha- pramehapūrvarūpāṇāmityādi||22||
kṛtsnānyardhāni vā yasmin pūrvarūpāṇi mānave | pravṛttamūtramatyarthaṃ taṃ pramehiṇamādirot ‘pramehaṃ taṃ vinirdiśet’ iti pā.||23||

pramehasya pūrvoktasāmānyalakṣaṇasya śeṣaṃ lakṣaṇamāha- kṛtsnānītyādi| gayadāsastvāpātanikāpūrvaṃ pramehapūrvarūpāṇītyādiślokamanyathā paṭhati; yathā- idānīṃ pramehapiḍakācikitsitanirdeśyamarthaṃ pañcaguṇāśrayaṃ pūrvarūpaśophapiḍakāvasthākhyaṃ pratipādayannāha- pramehapūrvarūpāṇāmityādi| tasminmeho bhaviṣyatīti mehasya tat pūrvarūpam| tatra ca pūrvarūpe'patarpaṇaṃ vanaspatikaṣāyapānādikaṃ ca kartavyam| pravṛttamūtramatyarthamiti rūpajñānam| tatra rūpacikitsāviśeṣaḥ| taduktam- “evamakurvatastasya hīna prathamakarmaguṇasya madhurāhārasya mūtraṃ svedaḥ śleṣmā ca madhurībhavati, pramehaścābhivyakto bhavati, tatrobhayataḥ saṃśodhanam; evamakurvatastasya doṣāḥ pravṛddhā māṃsaśoṇite pradūṣya śothaṃ janayantyupadravāṃśca kāṃścit, tatroktaḥ pratīkāraḥ sirāmokṣaśca; etadapyakurvataḥ piḍakāḥ, tatkarmāpyakurvataḥ pañcatvam ‘pañcamaḥ’ iti pā. ” (ci. 19) iti||23||

idānīṃ pramehapiḍakācikitsitanirdesyamarthaṃ pañcaguṇāśrayaṃ pūrvarūpaśophapiḍikāvasthākhyaṃ pratipādayannāha- pramehapūrvarūpāṇāmitādi| tasminmeho bhaviṣyatīti mehasya tat pūrvarūpam| tatra pūrvarūpe vidite “pūrvarūpeṣvapatarpaṇaṃ vanaspatikaṣāyapānaṃ” (ci. 13) ityādi kartavyam| kṛtsnāṇyardhāni vā yasmin pūrvarūpāṇi mānave pravṛttamūtramatyarthamiti rūpajñānaṃ; yaduktaṃ- “prabhūtāvilamūtralakṣaṇāḥ sarva eva pramehāḥ” iti| atra hi pūrvarūpāṇāmapi vidyamānatvāt kiṃ pūrvarūpāṇāṃ cikitsā rūpasya vetyāha- taṃ pramehiṇamādiśediti| vyādhiprabhāvādeva sakalapūrvarūpāṇāmanuvṛttāvipi nāriṣṭatvam| tatra rūpe cikitsāviśeṣaḥ| taduktaṃ- “tatraivamakurvatasya madhurāhārasya mūtraṃ svedaḥ śleṣmā ca madhurī bhavatī, pramehaścābhivyakto bhavati| tatrobhayataḥ saṃśodhanam| evamakurvatastasyoktā doṣāḥ pravṛddhā māṃsaśoṇitaṃ pradūṣya śothaṃ janayantyupadravāṃśca kāṃścit, tatroktaḥ pratīkāraḥ sirāmokṣaśca| etadapyakurvataḥ piḍakā; tatkarmāpyakurvataḥ pañcatvameva” (ci. 12) iti||22-23||
piḍakāpīḍitaṃ gāḍhamupasṛṣṭamupadravaiḥ | madhumehinamācaṣṭe sa cāsādhyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||24||

sarvapramehāṇāmavasthāntaraprāptānāṃ sajñāntaramasadhyitvaṃ ca darśayannāha- piḍakāpīḍitamityādi| sa ceti cakāra utpattau vātajānāmasādhyatvaṃ samuccinoti| atpattau ca sahajo yāpyatvādasādhyaḥ, pittajaḥ punarasādhyataraḥ, vātajaḥ punarutpattikrameṇāsādhyatamaḥ||24||

upadravāṇāṃ pratyekadoṣanirdiṣṭānāmaśeṣāṇāṃ ca sambhavaṃ darśayannāha- piḍakāpīḍitamityādi| gāḍhamupasṛṣṭamupadravairiti piḍakāśothavidāhe enamupadravāḥ spṛśanti, piḍakānāmupekṣayā tu gāḍhamevopasṛjyate upadravaiḥ; tathā hi piḍakācikitsita evoktam- “evamakurvatastasya doṣāḥ pravṛddhā māṃsaśoṇite pradūṣya śothaṃ janayantyupadravāṃśca kāṃścit” (ci. 12) iti| arthāt pratyekavātādijapramehanirdiṣṭān| tatroktaḥ pratīkāraḥ śothasya vimlāpanādi, dvivraṇīye cāpatarpaṇādi| tatrāpyasādhyasakalopadravaśothapiḍakaḥ sādhyatāṃ nivartate, vā'sādhyatarāsādhyatamatāmetīti piḍakācikitsita eva vistareṇa vakṣyāmaḥ| sa ceti cakāraḥ samutpattau vātajānāmasādhyatvaṃ samuccinoti, kaphajaḥ sahajo yāpyatvādasādhyaḥ, pittajaḥ punarasādhyataraḥ, vātajaḥ punarutpattikrameṇāśādhyatamaḥ; ata evopekṣāmadhumeho yāpayituṃ śakyo nāyāpanāprayoga ityeke| anye punarasādhyānāṃ niyatānāṃ vikalpo nāstīti| yata upekṣayā prayogeṇātidoṣakartukeṇa vā na praśāmyati, na punarniyatāsādhyavikalpa iti| munayo hi śabdāntareṇa prastutasya vastuno'tiśayaṃ dyotayanti na punaruktasyaiva vā, tadyathā- “hantyaṣṭādaśa kuṣṭhāni tathā'ṣṭāvudarāṇi ca” iti| tatrodarāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ vā kuṣṭhānāṃ śabdīyāsādhyatā nānenocyate, kiṃ tarhi prayogaśaktiratiśayavatīti||24||
sa cāpi gamanāt sthānaṃ sthānādāsanamicchati | āsanādṛṇute śayyāṃ śayanāt svapnamicchati ‘suptumicchati’ iti pā.||25||

idānīṃ madhumehino vihārākhyaṃ pañcavidhikriyāśrayaṃ ‘caturvidhakriyāśrayaṃ’ iti pā. liṅgaṃ darśayannāha- sa cāpītyādi| sthānamūrdhvabhavanamicchatīti sambandhaḥ| vṛṇute prārthayate| śayanāt śayyātaḥ||25||

tasyedānīṃ madhumehino vihārākhyaṃ caturvidhakriyāśrayaṃ liṅgaṃ darśayannāha- sa cāpi gamanādityādi| gamanasthānāsanaśayanāni hi sarveṣāmeva vihāraḥ| anyānna tathā'valambate madhumehī, kiṃ tarhi nidrāmeva kevalāmavalambate| atraiva bhojaḥ- “prabhūtamūtraḥ puruṣaḥ pūrvarūpairupadrutaḥ| pramīḍha iti vijñeyo, madhumehī tu vakṣyate|| yasya gātre pramīḍhasya piḍakā jāyate bhṛśam| madhumehī sa vijñeyo yuktaścopadravairbhṛśam” iti||25||

yathā hi varṇānāṃ ‘śuklādivarṇānāṃ’ iti tā. pañcānāmutkarṣāpakarṣakṛtena saṃyogaviśeṣeṇa śabalababhrukapilakapotamecakādīnāṃ varṇānāmanekeṣāmutpattirbhavati, evameva doṣadhātumalāhāraviśeṣeṇotkarṣāpakarṣakṛtena saṃyogaviśeṣeṇa pramehāṇāṃ nānākaraṇaṃ bhavati ||26||

idānīṃ doṣāṇāṃ trayāṇāmapi yathā viṃśatipramehasambhavastathopamānenāha- yatetyādi| pañcānāṃ varṇānāṃ sitaharitakṛṣṇapītaraktānām| utkarṣāpakarṣakṛtena vṛddhihrāsakṛtena| babhruḥ kapilapiṅgalaḥ, kapotaḥ kapotābhaḥ, mecakaḥ śyāmalaḥ| malagrahaṇamupadhātubhūtavasālasīkayorudakasya copalakṣaṇam||26||

idānīṃ doṣatritvāt tribhireva mehairbhavitavyaṃ, bhedo hi bhedavatāṃ kāraṇabhedāt kāryāṇāṃ vā svadharmabhedādbhavatīti kāraṇānāmeva vātādīnāṃ doṣadhātumalāhāraviśeṣeṇa kāryāṇāṃ pramehāṇāṃ bhedaṃ darśayannāha- yathā hītyādi| viśeṣayati parasparato vyāvartayatīti viśeṣaḥ, tena| sa ca kaphādīnāṃ svako guṇaḥ, tathā rasaraktamāṃsamedomajjaśukraujasāṃ ca svaguṇaḥ| malagrahaṇamupadhātubhūtavasālasīkodakasyopalakṣaṇam| āhāraścāpyatraiva ‘medyadravānnapānasevinaṃ’ ityuktaḥ| evameva vyādhisamuddeśīye'pyuktaṃ- “doṣadhātumalasaṃsargādāyatanaviśeṣānnimittaścaiṣāṃ vikalpaḥ” (sū. 24) iti| tatrāyatanaṃ parityajyāhāreṇa vihāramupalakṣya sakala eva vyādhisamuddeśīyokto'rthaḥ pratipāditaḥ||26||
bhavati cātra- sarva eva pramehāstu kālenāpratikurvataḥ ‘apratikāriṇaḥ’ iti pā.| madhumehatvamāyānti tadā'sādhyā bhavanti hi ||27||
idānīṃ sarveṣveva prameheṣu pūrvarūpādīnāmupekṣālakṣaṇamanarthaṃ darśayannāha- bhavati cātretyādi| kālaḥ prathamakriyākālādikaḥ| apratikurvataḥ apratikriyamāṇasya||27||
tatra sarveṣveva prameheṣu pūrvarūpādīnāmupekṣaṇalakṣaṇamanarthaṃ darśayannāha- sarva eva pramehāstvityādi||27||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne pramehanidānaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ ||6||
iti śrīḍahla(lha)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nidānasthāne ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ||6||
iti sauśrute śalyatantre śrīgayadāsaviracitāyāṃ nyāyacandrikāyāṃ pañjikāyāṃ nidānasthāne pramehanidānaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ||6||

div.head: udaranidānam

ab.seg: athāta udarāṇāṃ nidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi||1-2||
pramehānantaramudarārambhaḥ, udakavahasrotoduṣṭisambhavasāmānyāt, tridoṣajasādharmyānmahāvyādhitvasāmānyācca||1-2||
dhanvantarirdharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭho rājarṣirindrapratimo'bhavadyaḥ ‘babhūva’ iti pā.| brahmarṣiputraṃ vinayopapannaṃ śiṣyaṃ śubhaṃ suśrutamanvaśāt saḥ ||3||

yo dhanvantarirabhavat sa suśrutamanvaśāditi sambandhaḥ, śikṣitavānityarthaḥ| dharmabhṛtāṃ dhārmikāṇāṃ madhye| indrapratimo jñānaiśvaryādibhiḥ| brahmarṣirviśvāmitraḥ, rājarṣirapi tapasā brahmarṣitvaṃ prāptavān| vinayopapannaṃ jitendriyam| śubhamiti pūrvoktairanvayavayaḥśīlādiguṇairupetam||3||
brahmarṣiputramiti viśvāmitro hi rājarṣireva brahmarṣitvaṃ tapasā gataḥ| vinayopapannamityanena vinayānvitena guravaḥ praṣṭavyāḥ, vinītasyaivānuśāsanaṃ kartavyamiti darśayati||3||
pṛthak samastairapi ceha doṣaiḥ plīhodaraṃ baddhagudaṃ tathaiva | āgantukaṃ saptamamaṣṭamaṃ ca dakodaraṃ ceti vadanti tāni ||4||

udarāṇāṃ saṅkhyāmāha- pṛthagityādi| pṛthagdoṣaistrīṇi, samastairdoṣairekam; etena catvāri doṣapradhānāni| iheti asmiñchāstre| tānīti udarāṇītyarthaḥ| plīhodarādīni catvāri dūṣyapradhānāni| aṣṭamamiti saṅkhyoktyā plīhodarayakṛddālyudarayoraikyameva jñātavyam||4||

tatra doṣaiścatvāri pṛthagekaśastrīṇi, sānnipātikaṃ ca dūṣyodaramityabhihitam| plīhodaramiti plīhodara eva yakṛdudbhavamapyavarudhyate, hetuliṅgacikitsitasāmānyāt| tatra plīhodare doṣau kaphapitte, dūṣyaṃ raktam| baddhagudamāgantuviśeṣaḥ, pṛthagliṅgacikitsitabhedāt| kṣatāntramapyāgantunimittaṃ kṣataje'bhihitam| dakodaram udakodaram, udakanimittaṃ srotovarodhajātam||4||

div.ab: sudurbalāgnerahitāśanasya saṃśuṣkapūtyannaniṣevaṇādvā | snehādimithyācaraṇācca jantorvṛddhiṃ gatāḥ koṣṭhamabhiprapannāḥ ||5|| gulmākṛtivyañjitalakṣaṇāni kurvanti ghorāṇyudarāṇi doṣāḥ |6|

udarāṇāṃ hetuṃ darśayannāha- sudurbalāgneritādi durbalāgneḥ atyantanaṣṭāgneḥ| ahitāśanasyeti viruddhasamaśanādhyaśanaviṣamāśanasya| snehādītyādiśabdādvamanavirecanāsthāpanānuvāsanaparigrahaḥ| mithyācaraṇaṃ yathoktānuṣṭānaparityāgaḥ| jantoḥ prāṇinaḥ| abhiprapannāḥ prāptā ityarthaḥ| kiṃviśiṣṭānyudaraṇi kurvanti? gulmākṛtivyañjitalakṣaṇāni gulmākṛtyā gulmarūpeṇa vyañjitāni prakaṭitāni lakṣaṇāni yeṣāṃ tāni tathā| punarapi kiṃviśiṣṭāni? ghorāṇi kṛcchratamāni||5||- sthānasaṃśrayasyaiva samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- sadurbalāgnerityādi| ahitāśanasya durbalāgneriti- yadyapi hi vahnermāndyanimittānyanyānyapi santi, tathā'pyahitāśanamevāgnimāndyakāriṣu pradhānam| koṣṭhaṃ gatā iti sthānasaṃśrayaḥ| koṣṭhasthasattve'pi nātiśarīrādīnāmatinivṛttiḥ, udakavahasrotorodhaduṣṭisattvāt, sudurbalāgnitvādidoṣavat(?)| gulmākṛtivyañjitalakṣaṇāni gulmākṛtyā gulmarūpeṇa vardhate| tasya prāgutpattyākṛtirapi gulmena samānā||5||-
koṣṭhādupasnehavadannasāro niḥsṛtya duṣṭo'nilaveganunnaḥ ||6|| tvacaḥ samunnamya śanaiḥ samantādvivardhamāno jaṭharaṃ karoti |7|

samprāpti darśayannāha- koṣṭhādityādi| upasnehavaditi navaghaṭādyupasneho ‘navaghaṭādyupasnehe’ iti pā. yathā'ṇutamasrotobhirbahiḥsravad ‘bahiḥsrāvaḥ’ iti pā. dṛśyate tadvat koṣṭhādannasāro'nnaraso niḥsṛtya, śanaiḥ krameṇa, jaṭharamudarākhyaṃ rogaṃ karotīti sambandhaḥ| koṣṭhaśabdenātrāhārapākādhāra ucyate| kimbhūto'nnasāraḥ? duṣṭaḥ| punaḥ kimbhūtaḥ? anilaveganunno vātavegapreritaḥ| kiṃ kṛtvā? tvacaḥ samunnamya ānaddhāḥ kṛtvā| punaḥ kimbhūto rasaḥ? samantādvivardhamānaḥ samantāt sarvato vṛddhiṃ gacchan||6||- sādhāraṇāṃ samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- koṣṭhādityādi| annasāro rasaḥ| koṣṭhānniḥsṛtyeti koṣṭhaśabdenāhārapākādhāro rasadoṣamūtrapurīṣavibhāgāśrayo grahaṇyabhidhāna ucyate, tatraiva sārākhyarasavibhāgāt| kathaṃ punaretat koṣṭhādantrāṇāṃ randhrābhāvādannarasasya niḥsaraṇamityāha- upasnehavat| nūtanaghaṭādupasneho yathā'ṇubhirbahiḥsrotobhirbahiḥ- sravad dṛśyate tadvat| yadyevaṃ nityamevodarāṇāṃ samprāptiḥ prāpnoti, upasnehena satatamevānnarasasya bahirnirgamanāt; naitadasti, udarārambhakadoṣadūṣitaśarīrasya rasasvedāmbuvahānāṃ srotasāṃ duṣṭeḥ, duṣṭiścaiteṣāṃ saṃvṛttamukhatvena vinivṛttamukhatvena ca; taduktaṃ carake- “svedavāhiṣu duṣṭeṣu pāruṣyaṃ lomaharṣaṇam| atisvedo na vā svedo paridāhaśca jāyate” iti| yadyevamata eva sroto'varodhānniḥsaraṇamavāpnoti| yathā''ha carakaḥ- “ruddhā svedāmbuvāhīni doṣāḥ srotāṃsi sañcitāḥ| prāṇāgnyapānān sandūṣya janayantyudaraṃ nṛṇām” (ca. ci. 13) iti| svedāmbuvāhisroto'varodhe punarambhaḥ| yadāha carakaḥ- “svedastu bāhyeṣu srotaḥsu pratihatagatistiryagavatiṣṭhamānastadevodakamāpyāyayati” (ca. ci. 13) iti| ata eva sarvāṅgakārśyamudariṇāmudarasya punaḥ pūrṇataiva| tasya dūṣyasya doṣān vinā vikārakāritā nāstītyāha- anilaveganunnastvacaḥ samunnamyeti| vṛddherayaṃ hetuḥ| sravan samantādannasāro'bhivardhamāno jaṭharamudaraṃ karoti| taduktaṃ carake- “mande'gnau malinairbhuktairapākāddoṣasañcayaḥ” (ca. ci. 13) ityādi||6||-
tatpūrvarūpaṃ balavarṇakāṅkṣāvalīvināśo jaṭhare hi rājyaḥ ||7|| jīrṇāparijñānavidāhavatyo bastau rujaḥ pādagataśca śophaḥ |8|

pūrvarūpamāha- tadityādi| vināśaśabdo balādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| kāṅkṣā annābhilāṣaḥ| valī tvaksaṅkocaḥ| rājyo rekhāḥ ‘bhavanti’ iti śeṣaḥ| jīrṇāparijñānavidāhavatyo bastau ruja iti jīrṇāparijñānavidāhau vidyete yāsu bastirujāsu tāstathā| jīrṇāparijñānamannapariṇāmāniścayaḥ; jīrṇāparijñānaṃ tu yathāsambhavatvāt puruṣasyaiva jñeyam||7||-
saṅgṛhya pārśvodarapṛṣṭhanābhīryadvardhate kṛṣṇasirāvanaddham ||8|| saśūlamānāhavadugraśabdaṃ satodabhedaṃ pavanātmakaṃ tat |9|
vātodaramāha- saṅgṛhyetyādi||8||-
yaccoṣatṛṣṇājvaradāhayuktaṃ pītaṃ sirā bhānti ca yatra pītāḥ ||9|| pītākṣiviṇmūtranakhānanasya pittodaraṃ tattvacirābhivṛddhi |10|
pittodaramāha- yadityādi| acirābhivṛddhi śīghravardhanaśīlam||9||-
yacchītalaṃ śuklasirāvanaddhaṃ guru sthiraṃ śuklanakhānanasya ||10|| snigdhaṃ mahacchophayutaṃ sasādaṃ kaphodaraṃ tattu cirābhivṛddhi |11|
śleṣmodaramāha- yacchītalamityādi| sthiraṃ kaṭhinam| sasādamaṅgaglāniyuktam||10||-

striyo'nnapānaṃ nakharomamūtraviḍārtavairyuktamasādhuvṛttāḥ ||11|| yasmai prayacchantyarayo garāṃśca duṣṭāmbudūṣīviṣasevanādvā | tenāśu raktaṃ kupitāśca doṣāḥ kurvanti ghoraṃ jaṭharaṃ triliṅgam ||12|| tacchītavātābhrasamudbhaveṣu ‘tacchītavāte bhṛśadurdine ca’ iti pā.| ‘tacchītavātātapadurdineṣu’ iti tā. viśeṣataḥ kupyati dahyate ca sa cāturo mūrcchati samprasaktaṃ pāṇḍuḥ kṛśaḥ śuṣyati tṛṣṇayā ca ||13|| prakīrtitaṃ ‘dūṣyodaraṃ kīrtitametadeva’ iti tā. dūṣyudaraṃ tu ghoraṃ ... |14|

sannipātodaramāha- striya ityādi| striyo'nnapānaṃ nakharomamūtraviḍārtavayuktaṃ yasmai puruṣāya prayacchanti dadati| kimbhūtāḥ striyaḥ? asādhuvṛttā durācārāḥ| strīgrahaṇamatropalakṣaṇaṃ, tenānye'pi sannihitā avivekino grāhyāḥ| arayaḥ śatravaḥ| garān kṛtrimaviṣāṇi yasmai prayacchanti| duṣṭāmbu saviṣamatsyādisambandhāt| viṣameva dāvāgnivātātapādyabhibhavena mandatāṃ gataṃ viṣapītasya vā viṣaṃ dūṣīviṣaṃ; tena nakharomādinā viṣakalpena gareṇa dūṣīviṣeṇa vā''śu śīghraṃ raktaṃ kupitamiti boddhavyam| triliṅgaṃ vātapittaśleṣmaliṅgam| samprasaktaṃ nirantaram| dūṣyudaramiti yadeva sānnipātikodaraṃ tadeva dūṣyudaram, etena na saṅkhyātirekaḥ| ghoraṃ bhayānakaṃ, punarghoraṃ kaṣṭakāri||11-13||- duṣṭāmbudūṣīviṣasevanādveti dūṣīviṣaṃ viṣameva dāvāgnivātātapādyabhibhavena mandatāṃ gatam| tenāśu raktaṃ kupitaṃ viṣasya raktadūṣaṇasvabhāvatvāt, āśukāritvācca| tat śītādiṣu viśeṣeṇa kupyati, dūṣīviṣakopasya tatraiva darśitatvāt| mūrcchatīti viṣasya mūrcchākaratvāt, prasaktaṃ nirantaraṃ mūrcchati| pāṇḍuśca bhavati, raktadoṣāt| dūṣyodarametadeva sānnipātikodaraṃ yadeva tadeva dūṣyodaram| etena na saṅkhyātirekaḥ| dūṣyantīti dūṣyāḥ, “kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam” (pā. a. 3/3/13) iti kapratyayaḥ; tasyodaraṃ, tena kṛtatvāt| atra bhojaḥ- “nakhalomārtavairyuktamannapānaṃ yadā striyaḥ| vaśīkartuṃ prayacchanti tadviṣatvāya kalpate|| dūṣīviṣaṃ sevitaṃ vā tasya raktaṃ prakopayet| raktaṃ viṣeṇa sanduṣṭaṃ trīn doṣān tattu kopayet” iti||7-13||-

... plīhodaraṃ kīrtayato nibodha | vidāhyabhiṣyandiratasya jantoḥ praduṣṭamatyarthamasṛk kaphaśca ||14|| plīhābhivṛddhiṃ satataṃ karoti plīhodaraṃ tat pravadanti tajjñāḥ | vāme ca pārśve parivṛddhimeti viśeṣataḥ sīdati cāturo'tra ||15|| mandajvarāgniḥ kaphapittaliṅgairupadrutaḥ kṣīṇabalo'tipāṇḍuḥ |16|

nibodha jānīhi| abhiṣyandi doṣadhātumalasrotasāṃ kledaprāptijanakam| asṛk kaphaśceti asṛggrahaṇena pittasyāpi grahaṇam| plīhā udarasya vāmapārśvasthitaḥ| eti gacchati| sīdati aṅgaglāniyukto bhavati| atra plīhodare||14-15||- plīhodare vidāhiratatvena raktapittaṃ, tasya pittasya liṅgaṃ mando jvaraḥ; abhiṣyandiratatvena kaphaḥ, talliṅgaṃ mandāgnitvam||14-15||-

ab.seg: savyetarasmin yakṛti praduṣṭe jñeyaṃ yakṛddālyudaraṃ tadeva ||16||

yakṛddālyudarasya plīhodare evāvarodhaṃ darśayannāha- savyetarasminnityādi| savyetarasmin dakṣiṇapārśve| tadeva plīhodaraṃ yakṛddālyudaraṃ jñeyam| kva jñeyamityāha- yakṛti kālakhaṇḍe; kimbhūte? praduṣṭe; etena na saṅkhyātirekaḥ||16||
yakṛddālyudarasya plīhodara evāvarodhaṃ darśayannāha- savyetare ityādi| svyetare dakṣiṇe| tadeva plīhodarameva||16||

div.ab: yasyāntramannairupalepibhirvā bālāśmabhirvā sahitaiḥ ‘pihitaṃ yathāvat’ iti pā. pṛthagvā | sañcīyate tatra malaḥ sadoṣaḥ krameṇa nāḍyāmiva saṅkaro hi ||17|| nirudhyate cāsya gude purīṣaṃ nireti kṛcchrādapi cālpamalpam | hṛnnābhimadhye parivṛddhimeti ta(ya)ccodaraṃ viṭsamagandhikaṃ ca ||18|| pracchardayan baddhagudī vibhāvyaḥ, ... |19|

baddhagudaṃ darśayannāha- yasyetyādi| yasya puruṣasya antraṃ nirudhyata iti sambandhaḥ| kairnirudhyata ityāha- annairityādi| upalepibhiḥ picchilādibhiḥ| vā atra samuccaye| sahitairiti ekatra militaiḥ samuditairityarthaḥ| pṛthagveti ekaikairityarthaḥ| malaḥ purīṣam| sadoṣo doṣatrayasahitaḥ| nāḍyāṃ praṇālikāyām| saṅkaro'vakaraḥ, pracuratṛṇādisamūha ityarthaḥ| nireti niḥsarati| baddhagudī vibhāvyaḥ sa puruṣo baddhagudī jñeyaḥ||17-18||- baddhagudaṃ darśayannāha- yasyāntramannairityādi| upalepibhiḥ picchilādibhiḥ| pihitaṃ yathāvat sakalamityarthaḥ| malaḥ purīṣam| sadoṣaḥ saha doṣairvātādirvartata iti| purīṣamantre krameṇa cīyate saṅkaravat, doṣaireva miśrīkṛtatvāt| taduktaṃ carake- “varcaḥpittakaphān ruddhvā janayatyudaraṃ tataḥ” (ca. ci. 13) iti| atra pā(va)kasthāne antrasya purīṣāyatanasya ruddhatvāt bahu(ddha)gudasambandhamantraṃ gudamucyate| taduktaṃ carake- “pakṣmabālaiḥ sahānnena bhuktairbaddhāyane gude” iti (ca. ci. 13)||17-18||-

...tataḥ parisrāvyudaraṃ nibodha | śalyaṃ yadannopahitaṃ tadantraṃ bhinatti yasyāgatamanyathā vā ||19|| tasmāt sruto'ntrāt salilaprakāśaḥ srāvaḥ sravedvai gudatastu bhūyaḥ | nābheradhaścodarameti vṛddhiṃ nistudyate'tīva vidahyate ca ||20|| etat parisrāvyudaraṃ pradiṣṭaṃ... |21|

parisrāvyudaramāha- tata ityādi| yacchalyamannopahitamannasambaddhaṃ bhuktaṃ, tadantraṃ bhinatti vidārayati| yasya puruṣasya| śalyaṃ śarkarākāṣṭhāsthikaṇṭakādikam| āgatamanyathā veti vāśabdo'vadhāraṇe, tenānyathaiva vilomena tiryagevāgataṃ, natvanulomena| sruto galitaḥ||19-20||- kṣatāntraṃ nirdiśannāha- śalyaṃ yadannopahitamityādi| śalyaṃ śarkarātṛṇakāṣṭhāsthikaṇṭakādi| annopahitaṃ bhuktaṃ pakvāśayādanyathā vilomenāgataṃ, tadantraṃ bhinatti vidārayati| antrāt srutaḥ salilaprakāśaḥ srāvo bhūyo bahuśca, doṣajeṣu punarupasnehasrāveṇālpa eva gudataśca sravate| antrasrāvasya bahirgatatvāt kathaṃ gudataśca srāvaḥ? ucyate- salilabāhulyena tenaiva chidreṇa salilasya pratyāgatvādupasnehādgudasrāvaḥ; taduktaṃ carake- “pūrayan gudamantraṃ ca janayatyudaraṃ tataḥ” (ca. ci. 13) iti| tatastasmāt srāvānnābheradho jaṭharaṃ vṛddhimeti, jalasyādhogāmitvāt| chidrodarajalodarayoradūradoṣatrayavyapadeśaḥ| tathā''ha chidrodare eva carakaḥ- “tadadhonābheḥ prāyo'bhinirvartamānaṃ jalodaraṃ syād, yathābalaṃ ca doṣāṇāṃ rūpāṇi darśayati” (ca. ci. 13) iti| chidrodarajalodarayoradūradoṣatrayayorapi todādivedanā vāyunā mārgāvaraṇādikupitena||19-20||-

ab.seg: ... dakodaraṃ kīrtayato nibodha | yaḥ snehapīto'pyanuvāsito vā vānto virikto'pyathavā nirūḍhaḥ ||21||
pibejjalaṃ śītalamāśu tasya srotāṃsi duṣyanti hi tadvahāni | snehopalipteṣvathavā'pi teṣu dakodaraṃ pūrvavadabhyupaiti ||22||
snigdhaṃ mahat samparivṛttanābhi bhṛśonnataṃ pūrṇamivāmbunā ca | yathā dṛtiḥ kṣubhyati kampate ca śabdāyate cāpi dakodaraṃ ‘cāpyudakodaraṃ tat’ iti pā. tat ||23||

udakodaramāha- dakodaramityādi| dakodaram udakodaramityarthaḥ| tadvahāni toyavahāni| snehopalipteṣvathavā'pi teṣviti snehādipānaṃ vinā'pi teṣu srotaḥsu snehopalipteṣu yadā śītalaṃ jalaṃ pibettadā'pītyarthaḥ| pūrvavaditi kṣatāntrodare yathā salilasyādhogāmitvādadho nābherudarotpattiryathā ca gudādāsrāvastadvaditi; jejjaṭena punaḥ ‘pūrvavadityatrānyānyudarāṇi yathā bhavanti tathedamapi’ iti vyākhyātaṃ, tannecchati gayī| parivṛttanābhi| ucchalitanābhi| dṛtiḥ khallā| kṣubhyati calati| kampate ceti kampanamatiśayena calanam||21-23||

dakodaraṃ darśayannāha- yaḥ snehapīta ityādi| yaḥ śītalamāśu jalaṃ pibet tasya snehapānānuvāsino'ntaḥsnehāvaliptasrotaso'tiśayavatī srotoduṣṭiḥ syāt; vāntaviriktanirūḍhāṇāmatiriktabhāvena vivṛtasrotasāṃ pūrvakarmapradhānakarmamandāgnīnāmatyambusevayā salilavahasrotasāṃ klomamūlānāṃ duṣṭirabhyupeyāt| dakodare eva samprāptivikalpaṃ darśayannāha- snehopalipteṣvityādi| athavā vinā'pi snehādipānaṃ śītalasalilasevākṛtāmudarasrotoduṣṭiḥ, snehopalipteṣvathavā'pi teṣu srotaḥsu dakodaramabhyupeti| pūrvavaditi pūrvavat kṣatāntrodare yathā salilasyādhogāmitvādadhonābherudarābhinirvṛttiḥ| taduktaṃ jalodare eva carake- “tasya rūpāṇi- anne'nākāṅkṣā pipāsā gudasrāvaḥ” ityādi| srotasāṃ duṣṭatvena bahirūpasnehena jalaniḥsaraṇaṃ sarveṣveva samam| pūrvavacchabdasyānya evārtho na punarvyākhyātaḥ||21-23||
ādhmānaṃ gamane'śaktirdaurbalyaṃ durbalāgnitā | śophaḥ sadanamaṅgānāṃ saṅgo vātapurīṣayoḥ | dāhastṛṣṇā ca sarveṣu jaṭhareṣu bhavanti hi ||24||
teṣāmaṣṭānāmapi sāmānyaṃ liṅgaṃ darśayannāha- ādhmānamityādi| jejjaṭena punarete upadravā vyākhyātāḥ; tannecchati gayī||24||
teṣāmaṣṭānāmapi sāmānyaliṅgaṃ darśayannāha- ādhmānamityādi| jaḍena (jejjaṭena) upadravā ete vyākhyātāḥ; tanna, carake vyādhīnāmapi rogasambhavānāmupadravatvena niṣiddhatvāt||24||
ante salilabhāvaṃ hi bhajante jaṭharāṇi tu | sarvāṇyeva parīpākāttadā tāni ‘vidhyettyajeta vā’ iti pā. vivarjayet ||25||
sādhyāsādhyavibhāgamāha- anta ityādi| paripākāt pariṇāmena dakodaratā sarveṣāmeva; anyānyudarāṇi paripākādudakabhāvaṃ bhajante, dakodaraṃ prāgeveti viśeṣaḥ||25||

sādhyāsādhyavibhāgāyāha- ante salilabhāvamityādi| paripākāt parimāṇena jalodaratā sarveṣāmeva| upasnehena niḥsṛtāntra(nna)rasātivṛddhena| sarveṣāmeva upasnehena niḥsṛtāntrarasamūlatvāttadeva kathamanudakatvaṃ? naiṣa doṣaḥ, tatra hyupekṣayā nātimandatvādagneḥ svalpatvāt prāgudarasyānudakatvamityucyate, alpatve'tadvyapadeśāt| tasya ca lakṣaṇaṃ carakeṇoktam- “aśothamaruṇābhāsaṃ saśabdaṃ nātibhārikam| sadā guḍaguḍāvacca sirājālagavākṣitam| nābhiṃ viṣṭabhya pāyau tu vegaṃ kṛtvā praṇaśyati| hṛdvaṅkṣaṇakaṭīnābhigudapratyekaśūlinaḥ|| karkaśaṃ sṛjato vātaṃ nāti mande ca pāvake| lolasyāvirase cāsye mūtre'lpe saṃhate viṣi| ajātodakamityetairyuktaṃ vijñāya lakṣaṇaiḥ| upācaret”- (ca. ci. 13) ityādi| ataḥ paramupasnehavanniḥsṛto'nnaraso nātyacchapicchilākāreṇa sambhavatyudare, sā punaravasthā pacyamānānāmudarāṇām| taduktaṃ carake- “tatra picchotpattau maṇḍalamudaraṃ guru stimitaṃ bhṛśamātatamākoṭitamaśabdaṃ mṛdusparśamapagatarājīkamākrāntaṃ nābhyāṃ parisarpati” (ca. ci. 13) iti| ataḥ paraṃ jātodakamudaraṃ; tasya lakṣaṇamudakodaranirdiṣṭaṃ “snigdhaṃ mahatsamparivṛtanābhi bhṛśonnataṃ pūrṇamivāmbunā ca” iti| carake'pi- “tasya rūpāṇi kukṣeratimātraṃ vṛddhiḥ sirāntardhānagamanamudakapūrṇadṛtisamasaṅkṣobhasparśaṃ ca bhavati| tathāvidhamacikitsyaṃ vidyāt (ca. ci. 13) iti||25||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne udaranidānaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ ||7||

div.ab: iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nidānasthāne saptamo'dhyāyaḥ||7|| iti sauśrute śalyatantre śrīgayadāsaviracitāyāṃ nyāyacandrikāyāṃ pañjikāyāṃ nidānasthāne udarāṇāṃ nidānam||

ab.seg: athāto mūḍhagarbhanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi| mūḍho niruddhagatiḥ| taduktaṃ- ‘sarvāvayavasampūrṇo manobuddhyādisaṃyutaḥ| viguṇāpānasammūḍho mūḍhagarbho'bhidhīyate”- iti||1-2||

athāto mūḍhagarbhanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| udarānantaraṃ mūḍhagarbhanidānārambhaḥ, udarasthāne cchinne śastrakarmasādhyatvasāmānyāt, mahāvyādhitvasāmānyācca| mūḍhaścāsau garbhaśceti mūḍhagarbhaḥ| mūḍho vyāsaktagatiḥ| tathā hi carakaḥ- “mūḍhavātānulomanaṃ” iti, tathā'trāpyanirgacchantamanilasammohitamiti||1-2||

grāmyadharmayānavāhanādhvagamanapraskhalanaprapatanaprapīḍanadhāvanābhighātaviṣamaśayanāsanopavāsavegābhighātātirūkṣa- kaṭutiktabhojanaśokātikṣārasevanātisāravamanavirecanapreṅkholanājīrṇagarbhaśātanaprabhṛtibhirviśeṣairbandhanānmucyate garbhaḥ, phalamiva vṛntabandhanādabhighātaviśeṣaiḥ; sa vimuktabandhano garbhāśayamatikramya yakṛtplīhāntravivarairavasraṃsamānaḥ koṣṭhasaṅkṣobhamāpādayati, tasyā jaṭharasaṅkṣobhādvāyurapāno mūḍhaḥ pārśvabastiśīrṣodarayoniśūlānāhamūtrasaṅgānāmanyatamamāpadya garbhaṃ cyāvayati ‘vyāpādayati’ iti pā. taruṇaṃ śoṇitasrāveṇa; tameva kadācidvivṛddhamasamyagāgatamapatyapathamanuprāptamanirasyamānaṃ viguṇāpānasammohitaṃ garbhaṃ mūḍhagarbhamityācakṣate ||3||

tasya hetuṃ darśayannāha- grāmyadharmetyādi| grāmyadharmo maithunaṃ, yānaṃ rathādi, vāhanamaśvādi, adhvagamanaṃ padbhyāṃ mārgagamanaṃ, praskhalanamākhuḍanādi, prapatanaṃ prāsādādeḥ sakāśādatiśayena patanaṃ, prapīḍanamatiśayena pīḍanaṃ, pradhāvanamatiśayena dhāvanam, abhighātaḥ śastraloṣṭakaśādibhiḥ prahāraḥ, vegābhighāto vātādyavarodhaḥ, preṅkholanaṃ hindolanaṃ, garbhaśātanaṃ bheṣajena garbhapātanam| kecidetadgadyamanyathā paṭhanti, tattvabhāvānna likhitam| bandhanamatra ‘bandhanānnābhināḍībandhanāt’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ garbhāśayapratibaddhāḥ sirāḥ peśyaśca| mocane upamānamāha- phalamityādi| etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati- yathā vṛkṣe'paripakvaṃ phalamabhighātairakāla eva patati, tadvadyathoktapātanahetusāmarthyādaprasavakāla eva garbhaḥ patati| atikramya ullaṅghya| vivaraiḥ antarālaiḥ| avasraṃsamānaḥ adhaḥ patan| koṣṭhaśabdenāmāśayapakvāśayādisthānam| saṅkṣobhaścalanam| tasyāḥ striyāḥ| mūḍho vimārgagāmī ‘vimārgavatīṃ’ iti pā.| anyatamam ekatamam| āpādya nirvartya| taruṇaṃ garbhamapāno mūḍhaḥ san cyāvayatīti ‘vyāpādayatītyarthaḥ’ iti pā. sambandhaḥ| taruṇam aghanāṅgamavyaktacetanam| mūḍhagarbhasya niruktimāha- tamevetyādi| asamyagāgataṃ vilomabhāgenāgatam, avāggamanāt| apatyapathaṃ yonim| anuprāptam āśritam| anirasyamānam aniḥsarantam| sammohitaṃ mūrcchitam||3||

tasya hetuṃ darśayannāha- grāmyadharmetyādi| grāmyadharmo vyavāyaḥ, yātyaneneti pānaṃ rathādi, vāhyata iti vāhanamaśvādi| praskhalanaṃ samucchritādeḥ| prapatanaṃ prapātādeḥ| atra grāmyadharmādayo vegavighātāntā vihāraviśeṣāḥ, atirūkṣādayaḥ punarajīrṇāntā āhāraviśeṣāḥ| garbhaśātanaṃ bheṣajena garbhapātanam| ... tasya kṣobhaḥ koṣṭhasaṅkṣobhaḥ| vāyurapāno mūḍhaḥ vimārgavartī| taruṇam aghanāṅgamavyaktacetanam||3||

tataḥ kīlaḥ ‘saṅkīlaḥ’ iti pā. pratikhuro bījakaḥ parigha iti | tatra, ūrdhvabāhuśiraḥpādo yo yonimukhaṃ niruṇaddhi kīla iva sa kīlaḥ; niḥsṛtahastapādaśirāḥ kāyasaṅgī pratikhuraḥ; yo nirgacchatyekaśirobhujaḥ sa bījakaḥ; yastu parigha iva yonimukhamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati sa parighaḥ; iti caturvidho bhavatītyeke bhāṣante | tattu na samyak; kasmāt? sa yadā viguṇānilaprapīḍito'patyapathamanekadhā prapadyate tadā saṅkhyā hīyate ||4||

tasya cāturvidhyamāha- tata ityādi| tataḥ asamyagāgamanāt| tān prakārān prakaṭayannāha- tatrordhvabāhuśira ityādi| kāyasaṅgī niruddhakāyaḥ| ekaśirobhuja iti eko bhujaḥ śirasā saha yasya nirgacchatītyarthaḥ| parigha iveti parigho'rgalādaṇḍaḥ||4||

“adhaḥ pārśvagato vā'pi tathaivākuñcito'pi vā| yo niḥsṛtya mukhaṃ yonerjñeyaḥ pratikhurastu saḥ|| yonidvārāttu nirgacchedyasyaikāṃśaśirobhujam| tamāhurbījakaṃ nāma mūḍhagarbhacikitsakāḥ|| yonimāśri(vṛ)tya yastiṣṭhet parigho gopuraṃ yathā| tathā'ntagarbhamāyantaṃ vidyāt parighasañjñakam” ityeṣāṃ caturṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ paripaṭhyate nāgārjunīyāt||4||

tatra, kaściddvābhyāṃ sakthibhyāṃ yonimukhaṃ pratipadyate; kaścidābhugnaikasakthirekena; kaścidābhugnasakthiśarīraḥ sphigdeśena tiryagāgataḥ; kaściduraḥpārśvapṛṣṭhānāmanyatamena yonidvāraṃ pidhāyāvatiṣṭhate; antaḥpārśvāpavṛttaśirāḥ kaścidekena bāhunā; kaścidābhugnaśirā bāhudvayena; kaścidābhugnamadhyo hastapādaśirobhiḥ; kaścidekena sakthnā yonimukhaṃ pratipadyate'pareṇa pāyum; ityaṣṭavidhā mūḍhagarbhagatiruddiṣṭā samāsena ||5||

tānevānekaprakārān darśayannāha- tatretyādi| ābhugnaṃ saṅkucitam| ekena sakthnā ‘yonimukhaṃ pratipadyate’ iti sambandhanīyam| ābhugnaṃ sakthiśarīraṃ yasyetyarthaḥ| ‘yonimukhaṃ pratipadyate’ ityatrāpi sambandhanīyam| pidhāya ācchādya| antaḥpārśvāpavṛttaśirāḥ pārśvamadhyanikṣiptaśirāḥ| ekena bāhunā ‘yonimukhaṃ pratipadyate’ iti sambandhanīyam| kaścidityādi atrāpi ‘yonimukhaṃ pratipadyate’ iti sambandhanīyam| kaścidābhugnamadhya ityādi ‘yonimukhaṃ pratipadyate’ ityatrāpi sambandhanīyam| samāsenāṣṭavidhā vistareṇa tu tiryaggrīvorujaṅghāprakāreṇānantāḥ||5||
catuḥsaṅkhyāprakārān tānevānekaprakārānnidarśayannāha- tatra kaściddvābhyāmityādi| samāsenāṣṭavidhāḥ, vistareṇa tiryaggrīvorujaṅghāprakāreṇānantāḥ||5||
tatra dvāvantyāvasādhyau mūḍhagarbhau, śeṣānapi viparītendriyārthākṣepakayonibhraṃśasaṃvaraṇamakkallaśvāsakāsabhramanipīḍitān ‘… kṣepakavātavikārayonibhraṃśa ...’ iti pā. pariharet ||6||

teṣvasādhyānnirdiśannāha- tatretyādi| dvāvantyau saptamāṣṭamāvasādhyau svabhāvenaiva| anyeṣvapyavasthayā'sādhyatvaṃ darśayannāha- śeṣānapītyādi| viparītendriyārthādibhiḥ pīḍitā jananī yairmūḍhagarbhaiste tathāvidhāstān| viparītendriyārthā rūpādyarthagrahaṇabhrāntāḥ| yonibhraṃśo yonibahirgamanam| yonisaṃvaraṇaṃ yonisaṅkocaḥ| prasūtāyā vāyurasṛgārodhya bastiśiraḥprabhṛtiṣu śūlaṃ karoti sa makkallaḥ| bhramaścakrādhirūḍhasyeva bhramaṇam||6||

teṣvasādhyānnirdiśannāha- teṣu dvāvityādi| tatraitau svabhāvenaivāsādhyau| anyeṣvapyavasthāmātrāsādhyatāṃ darśayannāha- śeṣānapītyādi| viparītendriyārthā rūpādyarthagrahaṇabhrāntāḥ| yonibhraṃśo'dhonirgamaḥ| yonisaṃvaraṇaṃ parāsaṅgaḥ, sa ca garbhiṇīvyākaraṇīye vyākhyātaḥ| makkallastu prasūtāyā vāyurasṛgārodhya bastiśiraḥprabhṛtiṣu śūlaṃ karoti sa makkallaḥ ‘makkallaḥ’ iti pā., tatsambhūto'pi vidradhirmakkallaḥ||6||
bhavanti ‘bhavanti cātra’ iti hastalikhitapustake na paṭhyate cātra- kālasya pariṇāmena muktaṃ vṛntādyathā phalam | prapadyate svabhāvena nānyathā patituṃ dhruvam ||7||
evaṃ kālaprakarṣeṇa mukto nāḍīnibandhanāt | garbhāśayastho yo garbho jananāya prapadyate ||8||

svabhāvaprajananakāle yathā mūḍhagarbho na bhavati tathā ślokadvayena darśayannāha- kālasyetyādi| yathā kālasya pariṇāmena kālakṛtaparipākena vṛntānmuktaṃ phalaṃ svabhāvena patituṃ prapadyate patanaṃ prāpnoti, anyathā kālaparipākābhāvena patituṃ na prapadyate patanaṃ na prāpnoti, evaṃ kālaprakarṣeṇa nāḍīnibandhanānmukto yo garbhāśayastho garbhaḥ sa jananāya prapadyate janma prāpnotītyarthaḥ||7-8||
kṛmivātābhighātaistu tadevopadrutaṃ phalam | patatyakāle'pi yathā tathā syādgarbhavicyutiḥ ||9||

mūḍhagarbho yathā bhavati tathā darśayannāha- kṛmivātābhighātairityādi| garbhavicyutirdvividhā ‘garbhavicyutirapi dviprakārā’ iti pā. - dravasya srāvarūpeṇa, ghanāvayavasya pātarūpeṇa| tatra dravasya sravaṇe mūḍhagarbhanāma ‘mūḍhagarbhatā’ iti pā. nāsti, viguṇānilasammohānirgamalakṣaṇasyābhāvāt||9||
ācaturthāttato māsāt prasravedgarbhavicyutiḥ ‘garbhavidravaḥ’ iti pā.| tataḥ sthiraśarīrasya pātaḥ pañcamaṣaṣṭhayoḥ ||10||

paratastvastīti darśayannāha- ācaturthādityādi| garbhavicyutiḥ garbhavimuktiḥ; prasravet srāvarūpā bhavet| etena māsacatuṣṭayaṃ yāvanmūḍhagarbhatā nāstītyuktam| tata ityādi| tataścaturthamāsādūrdhvaṃ sthiraśarīrasya vicyutiḥ ‘garbhavicyutiḥ’ iti pā. pātaḥ pātarūpa bhavet| etena vicyutiriyaṃ na srāvarūpā; tasmāccaturthamāsānantaraṃ ghanāvayavatvānmūḍhagarbho bhavatītyuktam||10||

svabhāvaprajananakāle yathā mūḍhagarbho na bhavati, anyathā tu bhavati, tathā darśayannāha- kālasya pariṇāmenetyādi| tasyākālacyutirapi dviprakārā- dravasya srāvarūpeṇa, ghanāvayavasya pātarūpeṇa| tatra dravasya sravaṇe mūḍhagarbhatā nāsti, viguṇānilasammohanirgamalakṣaṇasyābhāvāt| paratastanneti darśayannāha- ācaturthāttato māsādityādi| prasraved garbhasrāvakarmā(rūpā) vicyutiḥ, nātighanāvayavatvāt| paratastu pātavyapadeśaḥ, kiñcidghanatarāvayavatvāt; natu srāvaḥ, srāvalakṣaṇābhāvāt| pātaḥ pañcamaṣaṣṭhayorityupalakṣaṇaṃ, saptādimāsamapyupalakṣayati| ......carakādiṣu| bhoje tṛtīyamāsa eva cetanābhisambandhaḥ| tathāhi- bhojaḥ- “ātṛtīyāttato māsādgarbhaḥ sravati śoṇitam| ūrdhvaṃ saṃyāvabhūtastu garbho patati yoṣitām” iti| saṃyāvo nāma nātimṛdukaṭhinaḥ samitāśarkarākṛtabhakṣyaviśeṣaḥ| tatra bhojena caturthe māsi sarvāṅgapratyaṅgavibhāgaḥ pravyaktataro bhavati, tena tatrāpi nātikāṭhinyena srāvasādharmyāt sravatītyuktam| kāśyapīye'pyuktam- “ācaturthāttato māsāt prasrutaṃ śoṇitaṃ matam| tataḥ sthiraśarīrastu mūḍhaḥ patati kṛcchrataḥ” iti||7-10||
pravidhyati śiro yā tu śītāṅgī nirapatrapā | nīloddhatasirā hanti sā garbhaṃ sa ca tāṃ tathā ||11||

asādhyamūḍhagarbhagarbhiṇyorlakṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha- pravidhyatītyādi| pravidhyati tāḍayati, atiśayena dhunotītyarthaḥ| anye ‘apaviddhaśirā’ iti paṭhanti; tatrāvanataśīrṣetyarthaḥ| yā strī nirapatrapā lajjārahitā| nīloddhatasirā kṛṣṇoddhatasirā| sā garbhaṃ sa ca tāṃ tatheti sā strī garbhaṃ hanti, sa ca garbhavatīṃ strīṃ hantītyarthaḥ| tathā tena prakāreṇa||11||
asādhyamūḍhagarbhagarbhiṇyorlakṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha- apaviddhaśirā ityādi| apaviddhaśirā avanataśīrṣā| nīlonnatasirā kṛṣṇonnatasirā||11||
garbhāspandanamāvīnāṃ praṇāśaḥ śyāvapāṇḍutā | bhavatyucchvāsapūtitvaṃ śūlaṃ ‘śūnatā'ntarmṛte’ iti pā. cāntarmṛte śiśau ||12||
mānasāgantubhirmāturupatāpaiḥ prapīḍitaḥ | garbho vyāpadyate kukṣau vyādhibhiśca prapīḍitaḥ ||13||
garbhiṇīrakṣārthamantarmṛtasya garbhasyāpakarṣaṇāya tallakṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha- garbhāspandanamityādi| āvī prasavavedanā; athavā āvīśabdena yonermūtrakaphaprasekādīnyāvīliṅgānyucyante||12-13||

mūḍhagarbhasya rakṣaṇārthaṃ mṛtasya punargarbhiṇīrakṣaṇārthaṃ vipātyākarṣaṇāya lakṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha- garbhāspandanamityādi| āviḥ prasavavedanā, tāsāmadarśanam| śūnatā'ntarmṛte śiśāviti utthānatvaṃ mṛtagarbhasyādhmānena| tasyāntargatasya maraṇahetuṃ mānasāgantuvyādhibhedena dvividhaṃ darśayannāha- mānasāgantubhirityādi| anye tvantarmṛtasya arbhakasya lakṣaṇaṃ nirdiśannāha- sa yadavetyādi paṭhanti| sa na paṭhanīyaḥ, mṛtagarbhasya garbhāspandanamityādinaiva paṭhitvāt||12-13||

bastamāravipannāyāḥ vāgbhaṭe tvayaṃ śloko'nyathā paṭhyate| yathā,- “bastidvāre vipannāyāḥ kukṣiḥ praspandate yadi| janmakāle tataḥ śīghraṃ pāṭayitvoddharecchiśum”- iti| “garbhiṇyā mṛtāyā yadi kukṣiḥ praspandate'tyantaṃ calati| kva pradeśe? bastidvāre| kadā? janmakāle garbhaprasavonmukhe kāle| tadā kuśalo vaidyaḥ śīghraṃ kukṣipraspandanādanantaraṃ pāṭayitvā śiśuṃ bālakamuddharet” ityaruṇadattaṭīkā| hārāṇacandrastu ‘bastidvāre vipannāyāḥ’ iti paṭhitvā ‘janmakāle upasthite prasavakāle vipannāyā mṛtāyā yadi kukṣiḥ praspandate, tarhi tatkṣaṇāt bastidvāre bastiṃ dvāraṃ ca pāṭayitvā bhiṣak taṃ garbhamuddharet’ iti vyākhyānayati kukṣiḥ praspandate yadi | tatkṣaṇājjanmakāle taṃ pāṭayitvoddharedbhiṣak ||14||

māturmṛtāyā api jīvato garbhasyāpakarṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha- bastamāretyādi| bastamāraśchagalavanmaraṇam, etena grīvāmoṭanenāśutamamakliṣṭaṃ maraṇamuktaṃ; tena vipannāyā mṛtāyāḥ striya ityarthaḥ| ayamabhiprāyaḥ- yathā bastaṃ nirucchvāsaṃ kṛtvā yājñikā mārayanti, evaṃ yā mṛtā tasyā ityarthaḥ| tatkṣaṇāt ghaṭikādvayamadhye, paratastu garbho'pi mriyata iti bhāvaḥ| anye ‘tatkṣaṇāt’ ityatra ‘muhūrtāt’ iti paṭhanti, tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ| janmakāle navamamāsādikāla ityarthaḥ| taṃ garbhaṃ, pāṭayitvā strīkukṣiṃ vidārya| atra kecit- “yadā so'ntarmṛto garbhaḥ śūno bastirivātataḥ| tenāvṛtāyā nāryāstu kukṣirānahyate bhṛśam|| utkṣipyanta ivāṅgāni mūtrabastiśca bhidyate| kloma plīhā yakṛccaiva phuphphusaṃ hṛdayaṃ tathā|| garbheṇa pīḍitaṃ hyetadūrdhvaṃ prakrāmati striyāḥ| sā śūyate muhyati ca kṛcchrocchvāsā ca jāyate|| pūtigandhastathā svedo jihvā tālu ca śuṣyati| vepate bhrāmyati tathā jīvitaṃ coparudhyate|| etairliṅgairvijānīyānmṛtaṃ garbhaṃ cikitsakaḥ”- iti paṭhanti; tanna paṭhanīyaṃ punaruktatvāt, jejjaṭādibhiḥ parihṛtatvācca| śrībrahmadevena tu kiñcidvyākhyātaṃ, tena tvārṣānārṣacintā na kṛtā||14||

māturmṛtāyā api garbhasya jīvato'pakarṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha- bastamāravipannāyā ityādi| garbhaḥ praspandate yadi jīvato garbhasya spandanaṃ lakṣaṇam| bastamāraḥ chagalamaraṇaṃ grīvāvamoṭanenāśutamamakliṣṭamaraṇam| janmakāle iti navamādimāsakāle ityarthaḥ| muhūrtāditi prāgityadhyāhāryanāḍikādvayāt prāk, parastu garbho mṛta iti||14||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne mūḍhagarbhanidānaṃ nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ ||8||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nidānasthāne'ṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ||8||
iti sauśrute śalyatantre śrīgayadāsaviracitāyāṃ nyāyacandrikāyāṃ pañjikāyāṃ nidānasthāne mūḍhagarbhanidānaṃ nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ||8||

div.head: vidradhinidānam

ab.seg: athāto vidradhīnāṃ nidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi||1-2||

athāto vidradhernidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| mūḍhagarbhānantaraṃ śastrakarmasādhyatvasādharmyāt, antarvidradhāvapyudarotsedhasya sāmānyād vidradherārambhaḥ| nirupādhirvidradhisañjñeti svamataṃ, “śīghravidāhādvidradhiḥ” ityanye; taduktaṃ- “sa vai śīghravidāhitvādvidradhīti nirucyate”- (ca. sū. 17) iti||1-2||
sarvāmaraguruḥ śrīmānnimittāntarabhūmipaḥ | śiṣyāyovāca nikhilamidaṃ vidradhilakṣaṇam ||3||

sarvāmaragururidaṃ nikhilaṃ vidradhīlakṣaṇaṃ śiṣyārthamuvāceti sambandhaḥ| amṛtadānena sarve devā amarāḥ kṛtāḥ, tenāsau dhanvantariḥ sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ gururityarthaḥ| śrīmān jñānātiśayenaiśvaryeṇa ca yukta ityarthaḥ| nimittāntarabhūmipa iti nimitāntareṇa kāraṇāntareṇa nareṣvapi bhaiṣajyāmṛtapradānalakṣaṇena bhūpālatāṃ gata ityarthaḥ| anye tu ‘aputrasya kāśirājasya paramārādhanayā nirvāṇe cittamadhiṣṭhāya ‘nirvāṇāṃ tanūmadhiṣṭhāya’ iti pā. putratvamāpanna’ iti kāraṇāntaraṃ vyākhyānayanti| śiṣyāyovāca śiṣyārthaṃ kathitavānityarthaḥ| nikhilaṃ samastam| idaṃ vakṣyamāṇam| anena dhanvantarisvarūpopavarṇanena vidradhergarīyastvaṃ khyāpitaṃ bhavati||3||
tvagraktamāṃsamedāṃsi pradūṣyāsthisamāśritāḥ | doṣāḥ śophaṃ śanairghoraṃ janayantyucchritā bhṛśam ||4||
mahāmūlaṃ rujāvantaṃ vṛttaṃ cā(vā')pyathavā''yatam | tamāhurvidradhiṃ dhīrā, vijñeyaḥ sa ca ṣaḍvidhaḥ ||5||
pṛthagdoṣaiḥ samastaiśca kṣatenāpyasṛjā tathā | ṣaṇṇāmapi hi teṣāṃ tu lakṣaṇaṃ sampravakṣyate ||6||

samprāptiṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ ca darśayannāha- tvagraktetyādi| bhṛśamityatiśayenocchritā iti sambandhaḥ| dhīrā dhīmantaḥ| etena samprāptiruktā| mahāmūlamityādi sāmānyalakṣaṇamuktaṃ, viśiṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇo'ruṇa ityādi, kāraṇaṃ tu sāmānyaṃ śophakāraṇābhidhānenaivoktam| saṅkhyāmāha- vijñeyaḥ sa ca ṣaḍvidha iti| sa vidradhiḥ| tadeva ṣaḍvidhatvamāha- pṛthagityādi| samastaiścetyekaḥ, kṣatenāpyekaḥ, asṛjā'pyeka iti ṣaṭ||4-6||

sarvāmaraguruḥ śrīmāniti amarāṇāṃ gururiti amṛtoddhāraṃ smārayati; surā hyamṛtena dhanvantariṇoddhṛtena nirjarāmaraṇādamarīkṛtāḥ; ata eva sarvāmaraguruḥ| nimittāntarabhūmipa iti nareṣvapi svabhaiṣajyāmṛtapradānāya bhūpālatāṃ gata iti gamayati| yaduktaṃ prāk- “śalyaṃ mahacchāstravaraṃ gṛhītvā” (sū. 1) ityādi| etasyārthasya anya evādhyāye'pi pratipāditasya punaḥ pratipādanaṃ vidradhergarīyastvabodhanārtham; ata eva mahāvyādhīnāmanantarameva vidradherabhidhānam| vidradhilakṣaṇamiti lakṣyate aneneti lakṣaṇaṃ jñāpako heturiti| tacca lakṣaṇaṃ dvividhaṃ- sāmānyaṃ, viśiṣṭaṃ ca| tatra sāmānyaṃ ‘śothaṃ ghoraṃ mahāmūlam’ iti; viśiṣṭaṃ tu ‘kṛṣṇo'ruṇe vā’ ityādi| kārakahetavastu sāmānyaśothahetvabhidhānenoktāḥ| anye punarāhuḥ- vidradhiṣu paruṣādīni vātādīnāṃ svābhāvikaliṅgāni, kṛṣṇādīni kāryabhūtāni| sa vidradhiriti khyāta iti itiśabdena nirupādhireva vidradhisañjñā saṅketamātrākṛteti||3-6||
kṛṣṇo'ruṇo vā paruṣo bhṛśamatyarthavedanaḥ | citrotthānaprapākaśca vidradhirvātasambhavaḥ ||7||
vātavidradhilakṣaṇamāha- kṛṣṇa ityādi| citrotthānaprapāka iti nānāprakārotthāno ‘nānāprakopapākaścetyarthaḥ’ iti pā. nānāprakārapākaścetyarthaḥ||7||
citrotthānaprapāka iti citrau utthānaprapākau yasya, vāyorviṣamakriyatvāt||7||
pakvodumbarasaṅkāśaḥ śyāvo vā jvaradāhavān | kṣiprotthānaprapākaśca vidradhiḥ pittasambhavaḥ ||8||
pittavidradhimāha- pakvetyādi||8||
paittike jvaradāhau sambhavamātrameva, pacyamāne punaratyantau bhavataḥ||8||
śarāvasadṛśaḥ pāṇḍuḥ śītaḥ stabdho'lpavedanaḥ | cirotthānaprapākaśca sakaṇḍuśca kaphotthitaḥ ||9||
kaphajamāha- śarāvasadṛśa ityādi| śarāvasādṛśyena mahattvamuktam||9||
kaphaje sarāvasadṛśatvena mahattvasūcanam||9||

div.ab: tanupītasitāścaiṣāmāsrāvāḥ kramaśaḥ smṛtāḥ |10|

teṣāṃ vidradhīnāṃ yathākramamāsrāvānāha- tanvityādi| eṣāṃ vātāpittakaphotthānāṃ vidradhīnām|10|- pākānantarasambhavaṃ srāvaṃ darśayannāha- tanupītasitāścaiṣāmityādi| ete trayāṇāṃ vātapittakaphānāṃ yathāsaṅkhyena|10|-
nānāvarṇarujāsrāvo ghāṭālo viṣamo mahān ||10|| viṣamaṃ pacyate cāpi vidradhiḥ sānnipātikaḥ |11|

sānnipātikamāha- nānetyādi| nānāvarṇāḥ kṛṣṇapītaśuklāḥ, nānārujāstodadāhakaṇḍvādyāḥ, nānāsrāvāstanupītaśuklāḥ, te yasya santi sa yathoktaḥ| ghāṭāla iti ghāṭā ūrdhvabhāgo mahān yasyāstīti sa ghāṭālaḥ| viṣamo'sādhyatvāt| viṣamaṃ pacyate cāpīti cirāciragambhīrottānānunnatonnatabhedena ‘… nānatonnatabhedena’ iti pā.||10||- sānnipātikaṃ darśayannāha- nānetyādi| nānāvidhā varṇavedanāsrāvā yasya sa tathā| tatra nānāvarṇāḥ kṛṣṇapītaśuklāḥ; vedanāstodadāhakaṇḍvādikāḥ, nānāsrāvāḥ kṛṣṇapītasitāḥ| viṣamaṃ pacyate cirāciragambhīrottānakṛtena bhedenāsamatvāt| vātaje'pi pākasrāvavaiṣamyamasti, natu gāmbhīryādīnāmapi varṇarujāsrāvāṇām, ata eva vātajasya sādhyatvamuktam| ghāṭāla iti “prāṇisthādāto lajanyatarasyām” (pā. a. 5/2/96) iti lac| atyutthānādgurutvena ghāṭā iva| tathā ca bhojaḥ- “bahudoṣo rasān sarvān rasate yo yadā naraḥ| tasya dehe tvagādīni doṣāḥ sandūṣya dehinaḥ|| kurvanti sarvarūpotthaṃ śothaṃ sarvarujānvitam| viṣamaṃ pāki (?) viṣamaṃ ghāṭālaṃ cirapākinam|| vyāmiśravarṇasrutikaṃ bhiṣaktaṃ parivarjayet” iti||10||-
taistairbhāvairabhihate kṣate vā'pathyasevinaḥ ||11|| kṣatoṣmā vāyuvisṛtaḥ saraktaṃ pittamīrayet | jvarastṛṣṇā ca dāhaśca jāyate tasya dehinaḥ ||12|| eṣa vidradhirāgantuḥ pittavidradhilakṣaṇaḥ |13|

āgantoḥ samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- taistairityādi| taistairiti aśvapatanagū(mū)ḍhaprahārādibhirityarthaḥ; tenāsrutaśoṇitapiccitādīnāṃ ‘srutaśoṇitapiśitādīnāṃ’ iti pā. grahaṇam| kṣate vetyatra taistairbhāvairiti tīkṣṇaprahārādibhirityarthaḥ; anena ca srutaśoṇitānāṃ chinnādīnāṃ grahaṇam| kṣatoṣmā vāyuvisṛto vātena vistāritaḥ| pittavidradhilakṣaṇo ‘bhavati’ ityadhyāhāraḥ||11-12||- abhighātajasyāgantoḥ samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- taistairbhāvairityādi| prapatanaprahārādibhirhate'tyantaduṣṭaśoṇitānām| hate iti mathitādīnāmapyupalakṣaṇam| kṣate iti taistairbhāvairityādibhiḥ| kṣata iti srutaśoṇitānāṃ chinnādīnāmupalakṣaṇam| tatraikatra mathitapiccitayoḥ sirāmārgāvaraṇena vātakopaḥ, anyatra chinnādau dhātukṣayeṇātiraktāsrāvanimittena| tatrābhighātajasyopacārārthaṃ doṣaliṅgaṃ darśayannāha- pittavidradhilakṣaṇa iti| raktaṃ ca raktaje eva sravatīti pittavidradhiliṅgātideśaḥ kṛtaḥ; pītatvasyāvayavavikṛtatvāt||11-12||-
kṛṣṇasphoṭāvṛtaḥ śyāvastīvradāharujājvaraḥ ‘tīvradāharujākaraḥ’ iti pā.||13|| pittavidradhiliṅgastu raktavidradhirucyate |14|

raktavidradhilakṣaṇamāha- kṛṣṇasphoṭāvṛta ityādi||13||- raktaje dāhapākādīnāṃ tīvratvamadhikam| raktasya dūṣyatvāddoṣaliṅgamatideśena nirdiśannāha- pittasya vidradhairliṅgairityādi| bhojaprabhṛtayastu raktavidradhiṃ nādhīyate| anye tviha raktaje'dhikavidhānārthaṃ raktajaṃ paṭhantyeva||13||-

ab.seg: uktā vidradhayo hyete teṣvasādhyastu sarvajaḥ ||14||
bāhyeṣvasādhyamāha- uktā ityādi| sarvajaḥ sānnipātikaḥ||14||
bāhyeṣvasādhyaṃ nirdiśannāha- uktā vidradhaya ityādi| teṣvasādhyatvena tridoṣajaḥ pṛthak kriyate||14||

div.ab: ābhyantarānatastūrdhvaṃ vidradhīn paricakṣate | gurvasātmyaviruddhānnaśuṣkasaṃsṛṣṭabhojanāt ‘saṅkliṣṭabhojanāt’ iti, ‘saṅklinnabhojanāt’ iti ca pā.||15|| ativyavāyavyāyāmavegāghātavidāhibhiḥ | pṛthak sambhūya vā doṣāḥ kupitā gulmarūpiṇam ||16|| valmīkavatsamunnaddhamantaḥ kurvanti vidradhim | gude bastimukhe nābhyāṃ kukṣau vaṅkṣaṇayostathā ||17|| vṛkkayoryakṛti plīhni hṛdaye klomni vā tathā | teṣāṃ liṅgāni jānīyādbāhyavidradhilakṣaṇaiḥ ||18|| āmapakvaiṣaṇīyācca ‘āmapakvaiṣaṇīyena’ iti pā. pakvāpakvaṃ vinirdiśet |19|

antarvidradherhetusamprāptilakṣaṇānyāha- ābhyantarānityādi| saṃsṛṣṭabhojanāt ‘saṅkliṣṭabhojanādduṣṭadeśe bhojanāt’ iti pā. kadaśanabhojanāt| sambhūya militvā| gulmarūpiṇaṃ valmīkavatsamunnaddhaṃ vidradhiṃ kurvantīti sambandhaḥ; gulmarūpiṇaṃ kāṭhinyena, valmīkavatsamunnaddhaṃ sarvata unnatam| gurvasātmyetyādi vidāhibhiriti yāvaddhetuḥ, pṛthak sambhūya veti samprāptiḥ, gulmarūpiṇaṃ valmīkavatsamunnaddhamiti ca sāmānyalakṣaṇam| tatrāpi valmīkavatsamunnaddhatvaṃ pacyamānāvasthāyām| teṣāṃ vātādibhedabhinnānāṃ viśeṣavarṇaliṅgasaṅkhyādikaṃ bāhyavidradhivajjñeyam| jejjaṭastu ābhyantarasyāgantorabhāvameva manyate| teṣāṃ bāhyānāmābhyantarāṇāṃ ca sthānamāha- gude ityādi| gudādiṣu sthāneṣu doṣā vidradhiṃ kurvantīti sambandhaḥ| bastimukhe na tu bastau, tatra māṃsamedasorabhāvāt| vaṅkṣaṇa ūrumūlāśrayaḥ ‘gaṇḍaka’ iti loke| vṛkkau māṃsapiṇḍadvayam (eko vāmapārśvasthitaḥ, dvitīyo dakṣiṇapārśvasthitaḥ ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate )| yakṛt kālakhaṇḍaṃ dakṣiṇapārśvastham| plīhā udaravāmapārśve sthitaḥ| hṛdayaṃ kamalamukulākāramadhomukham| kloma kālakhaṇḍādadhastāt sthitaṃ dakṣiṇapārśvasthaṃ tilakaṃ prasiddham| teṣāmābhyantarāṇāmityarthaḥ||15-18||- adhiṣṭhānaviśeṣeṇa viśeṣaliṅgajñānārthaṃ sādhyāsādhyaviniścayārthaṃ cābhyantarān vidradhīn darśayannāha- ābhyantarānityādi| abhyantarabhavān| pṛthak sambhūya veti samprāptiḥ| āganterābhyantarasya bāhyāgantuvidradhisamprāptyabhidhānenaiva samprāptiruktā| gulmarūpiṇamiti prathamaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ gulmarūpamevābhyantaravidradhīnām| valmīkavatsamunnaddhatvaṃ sarveṣāmeva samānam| śeṣaṃ varṇarujāsrāvādi bāhyavidradhilakṣaṇenaivāvagantavyam| ata evoktaṃ “sarvaśothavikāreṣu vraṇavallakṣayet bhiṣak” (sū. 22) iti| teṣāṃ sādhyāsādhyatvavibhāgārthaṃ lakṣaṇaviśeṣajñānārthaṃ cādhiṣṭhānaṃ nirdiśannāha- gude bastimukhe ityādi| āmapakvaiṣaṇīyācceti cakāro bhinnakrame, āmaṃ pakvaṃ ca vibhāvayediti| āmapakvaiṣaṇīyāditi lyablope pañcamī; tenāmapakvaiṣaṇīyamavekṣyetyarthaḥ||15-18||-

ab.seg: adhiṣṭhānaviśeṣeṇa liṅgaṃ śṛṇu viśeṣataḥ ||19||
gude vātanirodhastu bastau kṛcchrālpamūtratā | nābhyāṃ hikkā tathā''ṭopaḥ kukṣau mārutakopanam ||20||
kaṭīpṛṣṭhagrahastīvro vaṅkṣaṇotthe tu vidradhau | vṛkkayoḥ pārśvasaṅkocaḥ plīhnyucchvāsāvarodhanam ||21||
sarvāṅgapragrahastīvro hṛdi śūlaśca dāruṇaḥ | śvāso yakṛti tṛṣṇā ca pipāsāklomaje'dhikā ||22||

bāhyānāmābhyantarāṇāṃ cādhiṣṭhānaviśeṣeṇa lakṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha- adhiṣṭhānetyādi| āṭopaḥ saṅkṣobhaḥ| pārśvasaṅkocaḥ pārśvotpāṭanamiva| hṛdīti hṛdayotthe vidradhau, sarvāṅgapragrahādaya upadravā bhavantītyarthaḥ| ‘klomni pipāsā’ ityādi pāṭhāntaraṃ kecit paṭhanti, taccābhāvānna likhitam||19-22||

adhiṣṭhānaviśeṣeṇa liṅgaṃ darśayannāha- gude vātanirodha ityādi| tathā āṭopaḥ saṅkṣobhaḥ| klomni pipāsā mukhasya śoṣaḥ; ‘pepīyate payaḥ’ ityanye paṭhanti, tatrātyarthaṃ pīyate paya ityarthaḥ| kukṣau mārutakopanaṃ vidradhikṛtamārganirodhāt| sarvāṅgapragrahaḥ sarveṣāmaṅgānāṃ prakarṣeṇa grahaṇamiva| tīvro dussahaḥ, ūrdhvādhastiryaksirādhiṣṭhānatvāddhṛdayasya||19-22||
āmo vā yadi vā pakvo mahān vā yadi vetaraḥ | sarvo marmotthitaścāpi ‘marmotthitatvācca’ iti pā. vidradhiḥ kaṣṭa ucyate ||23||
tatra marmotthitānāṃ sarvāvasthāsu kaṣṭatvaṃ darśayannāha- āma ityādi| yadi vetara iti itaro'lpaḥ||23||
marmotthitānāṃ sarvāsvavasthāsu kaṣṭatvaṃ darśayannāha- āmo vā yadi vā pakva ityādi||23||
nābheruparijāḥ pakvā yāntyūrdhvamitare tvadhaḥ | jīvatyadho niḥsruteṣu sruteṣūrdhvaṃ na jīvati ||24||
hṛnnābhibastivarjyā ye teṣu bhinneṣu bāhyataḥ | jīvet kadācit puruṣo netareṣu kadācana ||25||

avasthāviśeṣādasādhyatvamāha- nābherityādi| nābheruparijāḥ plīhayakṛtklomakukṣihṛdayajāḥ, pakvā ūrdhvaṃ yānti sravanti| itare gudabastivṛkkavaṅkṣaṇajā adho yānti| eṣu cādhoniḥsruteṣu jīvati, nordhvaniḥsruteṣu| hṛnnābhibastijān varjayitvā ye'nye gudakukṣivaṅkṣaṇavṛkkaplīhayakṛtklomajāsteṣvantarvidradhiṣu bāhyāto bhinneṣu kadāciddaivavaśājjīvet, na punaritareṣvabhyantarato bhinneṣvityarthaḥ| hṛnnābhibastijānāṃ cāsādhyatvamagrevācyam||24-25||
idānīṃ viśiṣṭāvayavavibhāgena sādhyāsādhyatvajñāpanārthamasya srāvanirgamamārgamaviśeṣaṃ darśayannāha- nābheruparijāḥ pakvā ityādi||24-25||
strīṇāmapaprajātānāṃ prajātānāṃ tathā'hitaiḥ | dāhajvarakaro ghoro jāyate raktavidradhiḥ ||26||

ābhyantaraṃ raktajaṃ nārīṇāmeva darśayannāha- strīṇāmityādi| strīṇāṃ raktāvidradhirjāyata iti sambandhaḥ| kimbhūtānāṃ strīṇām? apaprajātānāṃ, patitagarbhaṇāṃ; punarapi kimbhūtānāṃ? prajātānāṃ samyakkālaprasūtānām| ahitaiḥ śītarūkṣāhāravihāraiḥ||26||

div.ab: api samyakprajātānāmasṛk kāyādaniḥsṛtam | raktajaṃ vidradhiṃ kuryāt kukṣau makkallasañjñitam ||27|| saptāhānnopaśāntaścettato'sau samprapacyate |28|

tasyaiva raktavidradherviśeṣamāha- api samyagityādi| makkallasañjñitaṃ makkallajanitaṃ, kāraṇe kāryopacārāt; ghṛtamāyuriti yathā| saptarātramapraśāntaḥ pittoṣmaṇā'ntaḥ pacyate, pakvaścāsādhyaḥ||27||- ābhyantaraṃ raktajaṃ vidradhiṃ nārīṇāmeva darśayannāha- strīṇāmityādi| adhaḥprajātānām akālaprajātānām; ‘apaprajātānāṃ’ ityanye; tatra patitagarbhāṇāmityarthaḥ| prajātānāṃ samyakkāle prajātānāmityarthaḥ| tatrāpi raktanirodhe hetumāha- ahitairiti; śītarūkṣāhāravihāraiḥ| makkallasañjñitaṃ makkalajanitaṃ, kāraṇe kāryopacārāt; ghṛtamāyuriti yathā| tatra saptarātrādanupakrāntaḥ pittoṣmaṇā pacyate| atraivārthe bhojaḥ- “prajātānāṃ tu nārīṇāṃ makkallapratimaḥ sthiraḥ| saptarātrāt paraṃ kukṣau jāyate raktavidradhiḥ|| na cet praśāntaḥ saptāhādahitāśanataḥ kvacit| pacyate pittasaṃsargāttadā varjyo vijānatā” iti| kecidatrāpi “atha majjaparīpākaḥ” ityādikaṃ granthamadhīyate| prāyeṇa hi medosthisamāśraya eva vidradhiḥ sarvaḥ| yadāha- “tvagraktamāṃsamedosthi pradūṣyāsthisamāśritāḥ” iti| bhojenapyuktaṃ “sthitvā'sthni vā samuddhatasyuratyāt(?)| yasyāvapākakarmaṇā(?)'sthi vinirbhidya cirādvā prasavedyadi| vidagdho darśayedrūpaṃ vātādīnāṃ muhurmuhuḥ” iti| sarvavidradhiśeṣaṃ majjapākamicchanti||26-27||-

ab.seg: viśeṣamatha vakṣyāmi spaṣṭaṃ vidradhigulmayoḥ ||28||
gulmadoṣasamutthānādvidradhergulmakasya ca | kasmānna pacyate gulmo vidradhiḥ pākameti ca ||29||
na nibandho'sti gulmānāṃ vidradhiḥ sanibandhanaḥ | gulmākārāḥ svayaṃ doṣā vidradhirmāṃsaśoṇite ||30||
vivarānucaro granthirapsu budbudako yathā | evamprakāro gulmastu tasmāt pākaṃ na gacchati ||31||
māṃsaśoṇitabāhulyāt pākaṃ gacchati vidradhiḥ | māṃsaśoṇitahīnatvādgulmaḥ pākaṃ na gacchati ||32||
gulmastiṣṭhati doṣe sve vidradhirmāṃsaśoṇite | vidradhiḥ pacyate tasmādgulmaścāpi na pacyate ||33||

pṛthak sambhūya vā doṣāḥ kupitā gulmarūpiṇamityatraikarūpatvādantarvidradhigulmayoḥ kuto gulmādasya vidradheḥ pākakṛto viśeṣa ityāha- viśeṣamityādi| viśeṣaṃ bhedam| samutthānaṃ kāraṇaṃ, doṣā eva samutthānaṃ, tacca dvayostulyam| siddhāntamāha- na nibandho'stīti; niścitya bandhātīti nibandho mūlaṃ; tadgulmānāṃ mūlaṃ nāstīti, rasaraktādidūṣyāṇāmabhāvatvāt| kutaḥ punareṣāṃ śopharūpāṇāmapi mūlaṃ nāstītyāha- gulmākārā gulmarūpāḥ, svayamātmanaiva, doṣā vātādayaḥ, na punardūṣyasaṃśrayāḥ| vidradhermūlasambhave hetumāha- vidradhirmāṃsaśoṇite iti; ‘bhavati’ iti śeṣaḥ| tatra kathaṃ pitte kaphe vā drave vātajanitasya gulmasya sthitirityāha- vivarānucara ityādi| yathā'psu budbudakaḥ, evamprakāro vivarānucaraḥ sroto'nusā(cā)rī vātagranthirūpo gulmaḥ, ‘kaphapittayoḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ; tasmāt pūrvoktāddhetoḥ pākaṃ na yāti| amumevārthaṃ niyamayannāha- māṃsaśoṇitabāhulyādityādi| vidradhigulmayormūlasambhavāsambhavābhyāṃ pākāpākau pratipādya sthānaviśeṣādapi hetoḥ pākāpākau pratipādayannāha- gulmastiṣṭhatītyādi| gulmaścāpi na pacyata iti apiśabdena pacyate gulma iti kāyacikitsāyāmuktaṃ gulmapākitvaṃ samuccīyate||28-33||

yat prāguktaṃ “pṛthak sambhūya vā doṣāḥ kupitā gulmarūpiṇam” ityatraikarūpatvādantarvidradhigulmayoḥ kuto gulmādasya vidradheḥ pākakṛto viśeṣa ityāha- viśeṣamatha vakṣyāmītyādi| samutthānaṃ kāraṇaṃ dvayorvidradhigulmayoḥ samānaṃ, tat kiṃ gulmo na pacyata iti saṃśayamutpādya svayameva śiṣyāṇāṃ hitatayā siddhāntamātrasūtraṇamācāryeṇa kṛtam| evaṃ manyate- bhedo hi bhedavatāṃ kāraṇabhedādviruddhadharmādhyāsādvā, tatra kāraṇamabhinnamiti sarvathaivābhedena bhāvitavyamityāśaṅkyopādānakāraṇabhedenānayorbhedameva siddhāntaṃ darśayannāha- na nibandho'stītyādi| niścitya badhnātīti nibandho mūlaṃ rasaraktādi; dūṣyāṇāmabhāvādgulmānāṃ mūlaṃ nāstīti| kutaḥ punareṣāṃ mahattaraśotharūpāṇāṃ mūlaṃ nāstītyāha- gulmākārāḥ svayaṃ doṣā iti|- gulmākārā gulmarūpā ātmanaiva, doṣā vātādayaḥ; na punardūṣyasaṃśrayāḥ| vidradhestu mūlaṃ sahetumāha- vidradhirmāṃsaśoṇite; ‘bhavati’ iti śeṣaḥ| māṃsaśoṇite eva pākahetuḥ; tena cātropagīte| tatra kathaṃ pitte kaphe vā drave vātajanitasya gulmasya sthitirityāha- vivarānucaro gulmo hyapsu budbudako yathā| māṃsaśoṇitabāhulyādityādi| kinniviṣṭo gulmo bhavatītyāha- gulmastiṣṭhati sve doṣa iti; doṣe eva vātapittakaphasthānarūpe| doṣamātrāstitvaṃ punarapsu budbudako yathetyena pratipāditam| gulmaścāpi na pacyata ityapiśabdena pacyate'pi gulma iti kāyacikitsāsiddhaṃ gulmapākitvamuktaṃ samuccīyate| taduktaṃ carake- “raktapittātibāhulyāt kriyāmanupalabhya vā| gulmo yatra vidahyeta śastraṃ tatra bhiṣagjitam” (ca. ci. 5) iti| daivavaśādgulmo'pi kṛtaparigrahaḥ pacyate; sa khalu samūlatvādvidradhireveti dhānvantarīyāṇāṃ matamiti||28-33||

div.ab: hṛnnābhibastijaḥ pakvo varjyo yaśca tridoṣajaḥ |34|

hṛdityādi| etena sānnipātikaḥ pakvo yatra kutracit sthito vidradhirvarjanīyaḥ| kecidgulmavidradhyormānakathanāya ślokaṃ paṭhanti- “muṣṭipramāṇo gulmastu vidradhiśca tataḥ param”- iti; tataḥ paramiti muṣṭeradhika ityarthaḥ|34|-

ab.seg: atha majjaparīpāko ghoraḥ samupajāyate ||34||
so'sthimāṃsanirodhena dvāraṃ na labhate yadā | tataḥ sa vyādhinā tena jvalaneneva dahyate ||35||
asthi(tha) majjoṣmaṇā tena śīryate dahyamānavat | vikāraḥ śalyabhūto'yaṃ kleśayedāturaṃ ciram ||36||
athāsya karmaṇā vyādhirdvāraṃ tu labhate yadā | tato medaḥprabhaṃ snigdhaṃ śuklaṃ śītamatho guru ||37||
bhinne'sthni niḥsravet ‘prasravet’ iti pā. pūyametadasthigataṃ viduḥ | vidradhiṃ śāstrakuśalāḥ sarvadoṣarujāvaham ||38||

prāktanakarmavaśādupekṣaṇādvā yo vidradhiṣvasthyantargataḥ pāko bhavati tasya lakṣaṇamāha- athetyādi| sarvavidradhayo vātādinā yadā'sthyāśritya jāyante, upekṣaṇādanantaraṃ tadgatamajjā ca paripacyate tadetadrūpamuktam| so'sthimāṃsanirodheneti sa majjāparipākaḥ| tataḥ sa vyādhinā teneti tadā sa puruṣaḥ, tena vyādhinā majjaparipākena| asthi(tha)majjoṣmaṇā tena śīryate dahyamānavaditi tena majjoṣmaṇā, atha upekṣaṇādanantaraṃ, śīryate vinaśyati, kiṃvat? dahyamānavat| athāsya karmaṇeti karmaṇā śastrakarmaṇā| vyādhiḥ pūyam||34-38||

hṛnnābhibastijo varjyaḥ etena sānnipātikastu punaḥ pakvo yatra kutracit sthito varjanīyaḥ| yaduktaṃ bhojena “sānnipātiko ya eva vidradhistaṃ vyāmiśravastuṃ pakvameva vivarjayet” iti| “muṣṭipramāṇo gulmastu” ityādi kecit paṭhanti; pūrvairapi sūranandivarāhādibhirgrantho vyākhyātārtha evāyam||34-38||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne vidradhinidānaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ ||9||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nidānasthāne navamo'dhyāyaḥ||9||
iti sauśrute śalyatantre śrīgayadāsaviracitāyāṃ nyāyacandrikāyāṃ pañjikāyāṃ nidānasthāne vidradhīnāṃ nidānam||9||

div.head: visarpanāḍīstanaroganidānam

ab.seg: athāto visarpanāḍīstanaroganidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi||1-2||

athāto visarpāṇāṃ nidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| vidradheranantaraṃ visarpādīnāmārambhaḥ| gambhīrasya vidradheḥ śothaviśeṣasya pratipāditatvenottānasya visarpaśothasyāvaśiṣṭatvād, valmīkavadunnatasya vidradheruktatvādanunnatasya visarpaśothasyāvaśiṣṭatvād, visrāvaṇasya sādharmyācca||1-2||

tvaṅmāṃsaśoṇitagatāḥ kupitāstu doṣāḥ sarvāṅgasāriṇamihāsthitamātmaliṅgam | kurvanti vistṛtamanunnatamāśu visṛtamunnatamāśu’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ paṭhati, ‘visṛtaṃ vistīrṇaṃ, unnataṃ mahāntam’ iti ca vyākhyānayati śophaṃ taṃ sarvato visaraṇācca visarpamāhuḥ ||3||

idānīṃ samprāptihetusvarūpaniruktīrāha- tvaṅmāṃsetyādi| tvaṅmāṃsaśoṇitagatāḥ kupitā doṣāḥ śophaṃ kurvantīti sambandhaḥ| kimbhūtaṃ śophaṃ? sarvāṅgasāriṇam| iha asmiñ śāstre, taṃ visarpamāhuriti sambandhaḥ| punarapi kimbhūtam? asthitam anavasthitaṃ, deśāddeśāntaragamanāt; anye tu āsthitaṃ prāptaṃ; kiṃ tat? ātmaliṅgam; etena vātādiśothaliṅgaṃ ‘vātādidoṣaliṅgaṃ’ iti pā. prāptamityarthaḥ; anye tu ihāsthitaṃ kvacidevāvayave sthitamiti vyākhyānayanti| vistṛtaṃ vistīrṇam| anunnataṃ tanutvācchophasya ‘tanutvaṃ’ iti pā.| visaraṇācceti cakārāt nānāprakāraṃ visarpatīti ‘sarpatīti’ iti pā. samuccīyate| tvaṅmāṃsaśoṇitagatā iti samprāptiḥ| kupitā doṣā iti hetuḥ| sarvāṅgasāriṇamityādi svarūpam| sarvato visaraṇācceti niruktiḥ||3||

teṣāṃ visarpāṇāṃ sthānasaṃśrayasvabhāvasamprāptīḥ pratipādayan pūrvaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha- tvagmāṃsaśoṇitagatā ityādi| sarvāṅgasāriṇaṃ sarvāṅgānusaraṇaśīlam| asthitam anavasthitaṃ, deśāntaragamanāt; “ātmano liṅgamāsthitaṃ samprāptam” ityanye; tena vātādiśothaliṅgaṃ prāptamityarthaḥ, anavasthitatvaṃ punaḥ sarvāṅgānusāritvenaivoktam| vistṛtaṃ vistīrṇam| anunnataṃ tanutvācchophasya| visarpa ityarthasya vyāptyarthena sarvatopariśabdārthena viśabdena viśeṣitavyo'yaṃ prāya iti darśayannāha- taṃ sarvato visaraṇāccetyādi| visaraṇācceti cakāro niruktau viśabdasya vividhārthasya vācitvamapi samuccinoti| tathāhi visarpaniruktau carakaḥ- “vividhaṃ visarpati yato visarpastena sañjñitaḥ| parisarpo'thavā nāmnā sarvataḥ parisarpaṇāt (ca. sū. 17) iti||3||
vātātmako'sitamṛduḥ paruṣo'ṅgamardasambhedatodapavanajvaraliṅgayuktaḥ | gaṇḍairyadā tu viṣamairatidūṣitatvādyuktaḥ sa eva kathitaḥ khalu varjanīyaḥ ||4||

teṣāṃ doṣabhedena viśiṣṭaṃ lakṣaṇāṃ darśayannāha- vātātmaka ityādi| asitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ| aṅgamardo vedanāviśeṣaḥ| idaṃ śuddhavātavisarpalakṣaṇamuktam| gaṇḍairityādi| gaṇḍairagnidagdhasadṛśaiḥ sphoṭairyukta iti sambandhaḥ| atidūṣitatvāt kābhyāṃ? vātapittābhyām| idaṃ pittānugatavātavisarpalakṣaṇamuktam| apare tu sakalenāpi ślokena śuddhavātavisarpalakṣaṇamāhuḥ, tanmate'tidūṣitatvād vātenaiveti boddhavyam||4||

teṣāṃ doṣabhedena viśiṣṭaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ nirdiśannāha- vātātmaka ityādi| vāta ātmā heturyasya sa tathā| kecidvātātmaka eva ‘gaṇḍaiḥ’ ityādi granthamadhīyate| ayaṃ pittānugatena| tantrāntare punaryamagnivisarpa ityucyate| gaṇḍairiti sphoṭairagnidagdhanibhaiścopacīyate| ata evāyamasādhyo dvandvajatvāt||4||
pittātmako drutagatirjvaradāhapākasphoṭaprabhedabahulaḥ kṣatajaprakāśaḥ | doṣapravṛddhihatamāṃsasiro yadā syāt srotojakardamanibho na tadā sa sidhyet ||5||

pittātmaka ityādi| jvarādibhiḥ prabhedāntairbahulaśabdaḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| kṣatajaprakāśa iti raktamiva yaḥ prakāśata ityarthaḥ| pūrvārdhena kevalapittārabdho visarpa uktaḥ| doṣapravṛddhītyādi doṣapravṛddhyā pittakaphavṛddhyā hataṃ māṃsaṃ sirāśca yasmin sa tathā| srotojakardamanibha iti añjanasadṛśakardamadravyatulyaḥ| anenottarārdhena kaphapaittiko visarpa uktaḥ||5||

pittātmako drutagatiḥ drutavisaraṇaśīlaḥ| pittaje jvarādibhiḥ prabhedāntaiḥ saha bahulaśabdaḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyate| kṣatajaprakāśaḥ kṣatajavadraktavat prakāśate| tasyedānīṃ doṣasaṃsargeṇāvasthāyāmasādhyatvaṃ darśayannāha- doṣapravṛttihatamāṃsasira ityādi| doṣo'tra kaphapitte| srotojakardamanibhaḥ añjanasadṛśakardamadravyatulyasambhavapradeśaḥ| asyaiva visarpasya kaphapittajasya carake kardamasañjñā, asādhyatā'pi ca paṭhitā||5||

div.ab: śleṣmātmakaḥ sarati mandamaśīghrapākaḥ snigdhaḥ sitaśvayathuralparugugrakaṇḍuḥ |6|

śleṣmātmaka ityādi| sarati visarpati| kaphavātābhyāṃ granthivisarpaḥ, saḥ asādhya eva| sa purastādeva granthinirdeśa (?) iti nātra nirdiṣṭaḥ; atraiva ‘vātakaphavisarpaliṅgena nirdiṣṭenāvarudhyate’ ityanye|6|- kaphavātābhyāṃ granthivisarpaḥ|6|-

ab.seg: sarvātmakastrividhavarṇarujo'vagāḍhaḥ pakvo na sidhyati ca māṃsasirāpraśātāt ‘māṃsasirāpraṇāśāt’ iti pā.||6||

sānnipātikaṃ darśayannāha- sarvātmaka ityādi| trividhavarṇaruja iti pratyekaṃ vātādidoṣanirdiṣṭakṛṣṇapītasitādivarṇaḥ, vātādidoṣajanitavisarpanirdiṣṭatodadāhakaṇḍvādivedanaśca| avagāḍho'bhyantaramūlaḥ| praśātaḥ ‘praṇāśaḥ’ iti pā. śaṭanaṃ; māṃsasirāpraśātāt parato na sidhyati, māṃsasirāpraśātāt pūrvaṃ kṛcchrataḥ sidhyati||6||

sānnipātikaṃ darśayannāha- sarvātmaka ityādi| trividhavarṇarujo'vagāḍhaḥ pratyekaṃ vātādidoṣanirdiṣṭakṛṣṇapītasitādivarṇaḥ, vātādidoṣajanitavisarpanirdiṣṭatodadāhakaṇḍvādivedanaśca| avagāḍha ityabhyantaramūlaḥ| asya carake antarja iti sañjñā| taduktaṃ carake- “bahiḥśritaḥ śritaścāntastathā cobhayasaṃśritaḥ| visarpo balameṣāṃ tu jñeyaṃ guru yathottaram|| bahirmārgāśritaṃ sādhyamasādhyamubhayāśritam| antaḥprakupitā doṣā visarpatyantarāśrayam|| bahirbahiḥprakupitāḥ sarvatrobhayasaṃsthitāḥ| marmopaghātāt sammohādayanānāṃ vighaṭṭanāt| tṛṣṇātiyogādvegānāṃ viṣamaṃ ca pravartanāt|| vidyāt visarpamantarjamāśu cāgnibalakṣayāt| ato viparyayādbāhyamanyairvidyāt svalakṣaṇaiḥ” (ca. ci. 21) iti| pakvo na sidhyatītyādyamasādhyavidradhilakṣaṇam| māṃsasirāpraṇāśāt parato na sidhyati, māṃsasirāpraṇāśāt pūrvaṃ kṛcchrataḥ sidhyati||6||
sadyaḥkṣatavraṇamupetya narasya pittaṃ raktaṃ ca doṣabahulasya karoti śopham | śyāvaṃ salohitamatijvaradāhapākaṃ sphoṭaiḥ kulatthasadṛśairasitaiśca kīrṇam ||7||

sadya ityādi| doṣabahulasya pittaṃ raktaṃ ca śophaṃ karotīti sambandhaḥ| kiṃ kṛtvā? sadyaḥkṣatavraṇamupetya prāpya| kimbhūtaṃ śophaṃ? śyāvamityādiviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭam| doṣabahulasyeti kuṣṭhavātaraktadipūrvarūpādidoṣadūṣitadhātoḥ, taduktaṃ tayoḥ pūrvarūpe ‘kṣatavisarpaṇam’ (ni. 5) iti; anye tu tridoṣabahulasyetyarthamāhuḥ| kīrṇaṃ vyāptam||7||

sadyaḥkṣatamityādinā kṣatavisarpaḥ| doṣabahulasyeti doṣo bahulo yasya sa tathā; kuṣṭhavātaraktadipūrvarūpādidoṣadūṣitadhātoḥ| taduktaṃ tayoḥ pūrvarūpe- kṣatavisarpaṇamiti| tathaiva bhojaḥ “śastraprahāraistaistaistu vyāladantanakhairapi| kṣate vā'pyathavā bhagne bahudoṣasya dehinaḥ|| raktaṃ pittaṃ ca kupitaṃ vraṇamāśu prapadyate| kurutaste samete tu vraṇaśothaṃ sudāruṇam|| ātataṃ tu tanusphoṭaiḥ kṛṣṇaiḥ pītakasannibhaiḥ| pittavīsarpavaccheṣaṃ tasya liṅgaṃ vinirdiśet” iti||7||
sidhyanti vātakaphapittakṛtā visarpāḥ sarvātmakaḥ kṣatakṛtaśca na siddhimeti | paittānilāvapi ca darśitapūrvaliṅgau sarve ca marmasu bhavanti hi kṛcchrasādhyāḥ ||8||

teṣāṃ sādhyāsādhyātvamāha- sidhyantītyādi| na siddhimeti na sādhyatāṃ yāti| darśitapūrvaliṅgā iti gaṇḍayukto vātavisarpaḥ, srotojakardamanibhaḥ pittavisarpa iti| anye tu ‘pittātmako'ñjanavapuśca tathā na sidhyet’ iti paṭhanti, cakāreṇa gaṇḍairyadā'tiviṣamairityevaṃviśiṣṭo vātiko'pyasādhya iti samuccīyata iti vyākhyānayanti| gaṇḍairyadā tu viṣamairityādinā vātajasya, srotojakardamanibhairityādinā| pittajasyāsādhyatvamuktaṃ yat punarucyate tat kṣatajasyāsādhyatāprasaṅgena, prasaṅgoktaṃ ca na paunaruktyamarhati||8||

teṣāṃ sādhyāsādhyatāṃ nirdiśannāha- sidhyantītyādi| pittātmako'ñjanavapuśceti cakāreṇa gaṇḍairyadā tu viṣamairityevaṃviśiṣṭo vātiko'pyasādhya iti samuccīyate| anye punaravasthāntare vātakaphajasyāsādhyatvaṃ darśayitumanyathā paṭhanti- “paittānilāvapi ca darśitapūrvaliṅgau, kṛcchrāśca marmasu bhavanti hi sarva eva” iti| nanu prāgeva gaṇḍairyadā tu viṣamairityādinā vātajasyāsādhyatvamuktameva, tathā ‘srotojakardamavapuḥ’ ‘ityādinā pittajasya, tat kiṃ ‘paittānilāvapi ca’ ityādinā punarasādhyavacanamuktam? ucyate- kṣatajasyāsādhyatāprakrameṇa paittānilayorapi punarasādhyatāvacanamapūrvavacanaṃ; ata evoktaṃ- “prakramādutthito vādo na yāti punaruktatām| dūṣaṇaṃ dātumadhikaṃ cokte'pi punarucyate” iti||8||

div.ab: śophaṃ na pakvamiti ‘śopho na pakva iti’ iti pā. pakvamupekṣate yo yo vā vraṇaṃ pracurapūyamasādhuvṛttaḥ | abhyantaraṃ praviśati pravidārya tasya sthānāni pūrvavihitāni ‘pūrvagaditāni’ iti ga. tataḥ sa pūyaḥ ||9|| tasyātimātragamanādgatirityataśca nāḍīva yadvahati tena matā tu nāḍī |10|

nāḍīṃ nirdiśannāha- śophamityādi| vraṇamityatropekṣata iti sambandhaḥ| asādhuvṛttaḥ ahitāhārācāraḥ| sthānāni tvagādīni vraṇavāstuśabdābhihitāni| tasya pūyasya| ataśceti cakāro nāḍīniruktipakṣāntarasamuccaye| tāmeva nāḍīniruktimāha- nāḍīva yadvahati tena matā tu nāḍī; yena hetunā nāḍīvat praṇālīvadvahati yāti tena hetunā nāḍī matetyarthaḥ| śophaṃ na pakvamityādi hetuḥ, abhyantaramityādi samprāptiḥ, nāḍīvetyādi niruktiḥ||9|| idānīṃ visarpasaṅkhyāparimitasāmānyāt, śothaprabaddhatvācca nāḍīrnirdiśannāha- śothaṃ na pakvamityādi| pakvameva śothamapakvamiti ya upekṣate, ata evāsādhuvṛttaḥ, vraṇe'pyahitāhāravihārayorativṛttatvāt| sthānāni pūrvagaditānīti tvagādīni vraṇavastuśabdābhihitāni| tāni sthānāni yadā'bhyantaraṃ prakarṣeṇa viśati pūyaḥ, atastvagādyantaniveśāt tasya pūyasya yadatimātraṃ gamanaṃ tato gatiriti gateścottaratra gatirityucyate| ityataśceti cakāro nāḍīgatiniruktipakṣāntaraṃ samuccinoti| yena hetunā nāḍīva praṇālīvajjalaṃ yāti, tenāpi hetunā nāḍī matetyarthaḥ| rogādeva rogaheturogasya nāḍīsañjñakasya samprāptyabhidhānaṃ taddoṣāt||9||-

ab.seg: doṣaistribhirbhavati sā pṛthagekaśaśca sammūrcchitairapi ca śalyanimittato'nyā ||10||

saṅkhyāṃ niyamayannāha- doṣairityādi| doṣaiḥpṛthagiti tisraḥ, ekaśaśca sannipatitairanyā, aparāśca tisraḥ| sammūrcchitairapi ca dvidoṣasaṃyogotthāḥ; anyathā apicakārau nirarthakau syātām| sammūrcchitairmiśrībhūtairityarthaḥ| śalyanimittato'nyā abhighātajā'paretyarthaḥ| gayī tu tribhirdoṣaiḥ pṛthak tisraḥ, ekaśaśca sammūrcchitairanyā sānnipātikī, śalyanimittā ca pañcamīti pañcaiva nāḍya iti vyākhyānayati||10||
tatrāpi kālāntareṇa doṣānubandhe bhedasaṅkhyāniyamanaṃ nidarśayannāha- doṣaistribhirityādi| sammūrcchitairmiśrībhūtaiḥ, taireva sannipatitairityarthaḥ| śalyanimitto'nyā abhighātajā aparā||10||

div.ab: tatrānilāt paruṣasūkṣmamukhī saśūlā phenānuviddhamadhikaṃ sravati kṣapāyām |11|
teṣāṃ vātādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ lakṣaṇamāha- tatrānilādityādi| phenānuviddhaṃ phenamiśram|11|-

ab.seg: tṛṭtāpatodasadanajvarabhedahetuḥ pītaṃ sravatyadhikamuṣṇamahaḥsu pittāt ||11||
tṛṭtāpetyādi| tṛṭtāpādīnāṃ hetuḥ tṛṣādīn karotītyarthaḥ||11||

div.ab: jñeyā kaphādbahughanārjunapicchilāsrā rātrisrutiḥ stimitarukkaṭhinā sakaṇḍūḥ |12|

jñeyā kaphādityādi| bahughanārjunapicchilāsreti vipulasāndradhavalapicchilasrāvetyarthaḥ| atrāsraśabdaḥ srāvavācī cintya eva| anye tu ‘kaphādbahughanārjunapicchilasrut’ iti paṭhanti, tatra srut srāva ityarthaḥ| stimitarugiti mandavedanetyarthaḥ|12|-

ab.seg: doṣadvayābhihitalakṣaṇadarśanena tisro gatīrvyatikaraprabhavāstu vidyāt ||12||
dvandvajā āha- doṣadvayābhihitetyādi| vyatikaraprabhavā dvandvajāḥ; vātapittajā, pittakaphajā, vātakaphajā ceti tisraḥ| gayī tu doṣadvayābhihitetyādi dvandvajānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ na paṭhati||12||
dāhajvaraśvasanamūrcchanavaktraśoṣā yasyāṃ bhavantyabhihitāni ca lakṣaṇāni | tāmādiśet pavanapittakaphaprakopāddhorāmasukṣayakarīmiva kālarātrim ||13||
sānnipātikīmāha- dāhajvaretyādi| asukṣayakarīṃ prāṇāpahāriṇīṃ; kāmiva? kālarātrimiva yamabhaginīmiva||13||
naṣṭaṃ kathañcidanumārgamudīriteṣu ‘aṇumātramudīriteṣu’ iti pā. sthāneṣu śalyamacireṇa gatiṃ karoti | sā phenilaṃ mathitamacchamasṛgvimiśramuṣṇaṃ sraveta sahasā sarujā ca nityam ||14||

div.ab: śalyanimittāṃ darśayannāha- naṣṭamityādi| udīriteṣu sthāneṣu tvagādiṣu| mathitamunmathitamiva| uṣṇamuṣṇasparśaṃ; ‘srāvaṃ’ ityadhyāhāraḥ||14|| tatrānilāt phenānubaddhaṃ phenamiśraṃ kṣapāyāmadhikaṃ sravati, śaityena tatra vātakopāt| pittaduṣṭā ahaḥsvadhikaṃ sravati, divoṣṇena pittakopāt| kaphādbahughanārjunapicchilāsrā vipulasāndradhavalacikkaṇasrāvetyarthaḥ| tatra asraśabdaḥ srāvavācī cintya eva| anye ‘bahughanārjanapicchilasrut’ iti paṭhanti| tatra sravateḥ sampadāditvādbhāve kvip| srut srāva eva| tridoṣajāyāmasukṣayakarīmiva kālarātriṃ yamabhaginīmiva| śalyanimittāṃ darśayannāha- naṣṭaṃ kathañcidityādi| kenā'pi prakāreṇa naṣṭam| anumārgaṃ mārgaṃ lakṣīkṛtya; ‘aṇumārgaṃ’ ityanye paṭhanti; tatrāṇumārgatvenaiva śalyasādṛśyāt kathañciditi nirarthakaṃ syāt| udīriteṣu sthāneṣu tvāgādiṣu| saphenilamiti phenavantaṃ; matvarthe| mathitam unmathitamiva| uṣṇam uṣṇasparśam| ete dharmāstu prasaraṇādau calatā śalyena māṃsādikṣobhena bhavanti| kṣatajānvitatvamapi srāvasya calatā śalyenādhiṣṭhānanāśakṛtatvāditi||11-14|| iti sauśrute śalyatantre visarpanāḍīvraṇanidānaṃ sampūrṇam|

ab.seg: yāvatyo gatayo yaiśca kāraṇaiḥ sambhavanti hi | tāvantaḥ stanarogāḥ syuḥ strīṇāṃ taireva hetubhiḥ ||15||
idānīṃ stanarogāṇāṃ saṅkhyāṃ hetuṃ ca darśayannāha- yāvatya ityādi| yāvatyo yāvatpramāṇā gatayaḥ, yaiśca kāraṇairvātapittakaphasannipātābhighātaiḥ, tāvantaḥ tāvatpramāṇāḥ||15||

athātaḥ stanaroganidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| nāḍīnāmanantaraṃ paribhāṣikatvena stanarogārambhaḥ| stanarogahetusaṅkhye atideśena darśayannāha- yāvantyo gataya ityādi| yairhetubhirvātapittakaphasannipātābhighātairyāvatpramāṇā gatayastaireva kāraṇaistāvatpramāṇāḥ stanarogāḥ||15||

dhamanyaḥ saṃvṛtadvārāḥ kanyānāṃ stanasaṃśritāḥ | doṣāvisaraṇāttāsāṃ ‘doṣāvitaraṇāt’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ paṭhati, doṣāvitaraṇāt saṃvṛtadvāratayā stanāmayārambhakāṇāṃ doṣāṇāmavisarjanāt’ iti ca vyākhyānayati na bhavanti stanāmayāḥ ||16||
idānīṃ samānāyāmapi jātāvasambhūtagarbhāṇāṃ te rogā na bhavantīti darśayannāha- dhamanya ityādi| kanyānāmasambhūtagarbhāṇāṃ strīṇāmityarthaḥ| avisaraṇam aprasaraṇam||16||
idānīṃ samānāyāmapi jātāvasambhūtagarbhāṇāṃ te rogā na bhavantīti darśayannāha- dhamanya ityādi||16||
tāsāmeva prajātānāṃ garbhiṇīnāṃ ca tāḥ punaḥ | svabhāvādeva vivṛtā jāyante sambhavantyataḥ ||17||

tāsāmeva sagarbhāṇāṃ prajātānāṃ ca tā eva dhamanyo vivṛtadvārā bhavantīti darśayannāha- tāsāmevetyādi| prajātānāṃ prasūtānām| tā iti dhamanyaḥ| vivṛtāḥ prasṛtadvārāḥ, jāyante bhavantītyarthaḥ| sambhavantīti ‘stanarogā’ iti śeṣaḥ||17||
tāsāmeva sagarbhāṇāṃ prajātānāṃ ca tā eva dhamanyo vivṛtadvārā bhavantīti darśayannāha- tāsāmevetyādi| tatra hetvantaramapaśyannāha- svabhāvādeveti| sambhavantyato hetoḥ ‘stanarogāḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ||17||
rasaprasādo madhuraḥ pakvāhāranimittajaḥ | kṛtsnadehāt stanau prāptaḥ stanyamityabhidhīyate ||18||

‘sakṣīrau vā'pyadugdhau vā prāpya doṣā’ iti strīkṣīrasya stanarogāṇāṃ hetutvenoktatvāt strīkṣīrasyaiva sambhavamāha- rasaprasāda ityādi|- rasaprasādaḥ rasasya prasādo dhāma sārasteja ityarthaḥ| pakvāhāranimittaja iti prādhānyāt pakvāhāranimittaśabdena rasaḥ kathyate, tena rasaja ityarthaḥ| stanyaniruktimāha- kṛtsnadehādityādi| rasadhātorvyānavikṣiptasya sarvadehagatatvāt||18||
