idānīṃ ‘sakṣīrau vā'pyadugdhau vā’ iti strīkṣīrasya stanarogāṇāṃ hetutvenoktatvāt strīkṣīrasyaiva prabhavaṃ, tasya stanyasya prakṛtibhūtasya vikṛtasya ca prasaṅgena lakṣaṇaṃ ca darśayannāha- rasaprasāda ityādi| rasyasya prasādo rasaprasādaḥ, dhāma sāraḥ, tena madhuratā śuklatā ca| vātādidoṣaduṣṭasya punaḥ kaṣāyatvamamlatvamatimādhuryaṃ vā| pakvaścāsāvāhāraḥ, sa eva nimittaṃ yasya sa tathā, sa tu ‘rasa’ ucyate, prādhānyāt; na punarmalabhūtaṃ viṭ pakvam, aprādhānyādeva; tato jātaṃ, taduktaṃ carake- “rasāt stanyaṃ tathā raktamasṛjaḥ kaṇḍarāḥ sirāḥ” (ca. ci. 15) iti| tathā bhoje'pi- “sirāsnāyurajaḥstanyatvaco gativivarjitāḥ| dhātubhyaścopajāyante tasmātta upadhātavaḥ” iti| tasyedānīṃ ‘stanabhavaṃ stanyaṃ’ ityasyārthasya yogaṃ darśayannāha- kṛtsnāddehādityādi| rasadhātorvyānavikṣiptasya sarvadehagatvāt||18||

div.ab: viśasteṣvapi gātreṣu yathā śukraṃ na dṛśyate | sarvadehāśritatvācca ‘sarvadehāśritatve'pi stanyaṃ lakṣaṇatastathā’ iti hārāṇacandasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ śukralakṣaṇamucyate ||19|| tadeva ceṣṭayuvaterdarśanāt smaraṇādapi | śabdasaṃśravaṇāt sparśāt saṃharṣācca pravartate ||20|| suprasannaṃ manastatra harṣaṇe heturucyate | āhārarasayonitvādevaṃ ‘āhārarasavīryatvāt’ iti tā. stanyamapi striyāḥ ||21|| tadevāpatyasaṃsparśāddarśanāt smaraṇādapi | grahaṇācca śarīrasya śukravat sampravartate ||22|| sneho nirantarastatra prasrave heturucyate |23|

tasya śarīrābhyantarasthasyādṛśyasyāpi prasiddhopamānena pravartane hetuṃ darśayannāha- viśasteṣvapītyādi| śukralakṣaṇaṃ ‘stanyamucyate’ iti śeṣaḥ| kuta ityāha- yathā śukraṃ viśasteṣu chinneṣvapi gātreṣu na dṛśyate, tasmādvitīyaṃ hetumāha- sarvadehāśritatvāditi, śukravat samastaśarīrāśritatvāt| śukradṛṣṭāntena stanyasyābhyantaradarśanaṃ pratipādya tenaiva dṛṣṭāntena sāmagrītastasya pravartanādbahiḥ pratyakṣatāṃ pratipādayannāha- tadevetyādi| tadeva śukraṃ pravartate bahirniḥsarati| saṃharṣād viśiṣṭasparśasaṅkalpalakṣaṇāt| viśiṣṭasparśasaṅkalpe hetucatuṣṭayaṃ darśayannāha- iṣṭayuvaterityādi| iṣṭayuvatidarśanādihetucatuṣṭayena yaḥ saṃharṣaḥ sa suprasanna eva manasi bhavatīti manaso'pi suprasannasya kāraṇatvaṃ darśayannāha- suprasannamityādi| suprasannamīrṣyādyanabhibhūtam| evaṃ stanyamapi striyāḥ pravartate, śukramāhārarasayonitvāt pravartate stanyamapi tathā, tasmāt pravartate| nanu śukramāhārayonyapi saṃharṣāt kāraṇāt pravartate, atra ca kiṃ kāraṇamityāha- tadevetyādi| tadeva stanyaṃ śukravat sampravartate| apatyasaṃsparśādikāraṇacatuṣṭaye'pi sneho mūlakāraṇamiti tadeva darśayannāha- sneha ityādi| prasrave stanyasravaṇe| atrāpi catvāro hetavaḥ, paramiṣṭayuvatisthāne'trāpatyagrahaṇaṃ, mūlahetuharṣasthāne snehaḥ||19-22||- tasya punaḥ śarīrābhyantarasthasya pramāṇairanupalbhyasyāpi prasiddhopamānena pravartane hetvantaraṃ darśayannāha- viśasteṣvapītyādi| viśasteṣu vikṛtteṣu| yat punarantaḥ pratyakṣaṃ na bhavati bahirapi tat pratyakṣaṃ na bhavatītyāśaṅkya sāmagrītastasya bahirāvirbhāvena pratyakṣatāṃ darśayannāha- tadeva ceṣṭayuvaterisyādi| saṃharṣāt iṣṭayuvaterviśiṣṭasparśasaṅkalpalakṣaṇāt| darśanādiṣvapi caturṣvanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ śukrabhāvābhāvāt samaulaṃ kāraṇaṃ harṣasyāpi darśayannāha- suprasannamityādi| suprasannam īrṣyādibhiranabhibhūtam| śukreṇa saha prastutasya stanyasya sādharmyāddhetuṃ darśayannāha- sarvadehāśritatvācceti| ubhayorapi sarvadehāśrayatvādityarthaḥ| atrāpi catvāra eva hetavaḥ| parimiṣṭayuvatisthāne atrāpatyagrahaṇaṃ, maulahetuharṣasthāne tu snehaḥ, suprasannasthāne nirantaraḥ; nirantaro niratiśaya ityarthaḥ||19-22||-

ab.seg: tat kaṣāyaṃ bhavedvātāt kṣiptaṃ ca plavate'mbhasi ||23||
pittādamlaṃ sakaṭukaṃ rājyo'mbhasi ca pītikāḥ | kaphādghanaṃ picchilaṃ ca jale cāpyavasīdati | sarvairduṣṭaiḥ sarvaliṅgamabhighātācca duṣyati ||24||

stanyasya prabhavaṃ pravartanaṃ cābhidhāya prakṛtimabhidhātukāmaḥ parityājyatayā prathamaṃ vikṛtiṃ darśayannāha- tadityādi| kṣiptaṃ ceti cakāreṇānuktamapi tanutvādikaṃ samuccīyate| sakaṭukam īṣattiktaṃ, tikte'pi kaṭuśabdasya pravṛtteḥ| ambhasi ceti cakārānnīlalohitāśca rājyo draṣṭavyāḥ| picchilaṃ ceti cakāreṇa doṣasamplavaḥ sūcyate| avasīdati buḍati| abhighātāt patanapīḍanādikāt||23-24||
yat kṣīramudake kṣiptamekībhavati ‘ekatvaṃ yāti’ iti pā. pāṇḍuram | madhuraṃ cāvivarṇaṃ ca prasannaṃ tadvinirdiśet ||25||
nirdoṣasya stanyasya lakṣaṇamāha- yadityādi| ekībhavati ‘ekatvaṃ yāti’ iti pā. ekatvaṃ yāti milatītyarthaḥ| avivarṇam īṣatpītādivarṇam| prasannaṃ prakṛtistham||25||

stanyasya prakṛtimabhidhāya vikṛtiṃ nidarśayannāha- tadityādi| kṣiptaṃ ca plavate laghutvāt| kṣiptaṃ ceti cakāreṇa tanutvādīnyanuktānyapi samuccīyante| sakaṭukam īṣattiktamityarthaḥ; tikte'pi kaṭukaśabdapravṛtteḥ| rājyo'mbhasi ca pītikā iti cakāro bhinnakrame, tena pītikāśceti draṣṭavyaṃ, tena pittaduṣṭasya nīlalohitāśca rājyo draṣṭavyāḥ| toye cāpyavasīdati gurutvāt majjanāplavanābhyāṃ pradeśe ekībhāvopalambhāt| picchilaṃ ceti cakāreṇātimādhuryādyapi boddhavyam| prasannaṃ tu sādhāraṇaṃ pāṇḍuraṃ madhuraṃ ca| cakāreṇa kaphavardhakatve'pyanayoḥ stanyaprakṛtitvamityabhinirdiśyate| atipāṇḍutvamatimādhuryaṃ ca kaphavṛddhilakṣaṇam| vātakaphadoṣeṇātiviṣyandi| avivarṇam īṣatpītādiprakṛtivarṇam| prasannaṃ prakṛtistham||23-25||
sakṣīrau vā'pyadugdhau vā prāpya doṣaḥ stanau striyāḥ | raktaṃ māṃsaṃ ca sandūṣya stanarogāya kalpate ||26||

stanarogahetuṃ stanyaṃ prakṛtivikṛtibhirabhinirdiśya stanarogasamprāptiṃ darśayannāha- sakṣīrāvityādi| sakṣīrau garbhiṇyāḥ, tasyā dohasyāsambhavāt| adugdhau prasūtāyāḥ, tasyā dohasya sambhavāt| tatra yadā dohyāvadugdhau bhavataḥ, tadā kṣīrabharapīḍitā doṣāḥ kupitāḥ stanarogāya jāyante| stanarogāya kalpate stanarogārthe samartho bhavati||26||
pañcānāmapi teṣāṃ tu hitvā śoṇitavidradhim | lakṣaṇāni samānāni bāhyavidradhilakṣaṇaiḥ ||27||
teṣāmapi saṅkṣepārthaṃ lakṣaṇamatideśena nirdiśannāha- pañcānāmapītyādi| teṣāṃ stanarogāṇām| samānāni tulyāni, ‘bhavanti’ ityadhyāhāraḥ||27||
tatra stanarogahetuṃ stanyaṃ prabhavaprakṛtivikṛtibhirabhinirdiśya stanarogasamprāptiṃ pratipādayannāha- sakṣīrāvityādi||26-27||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne visarpanāḍīstanaroganidānaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ ||10||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nidānasthāne daśamo'dhyāyaḥ||10||
iti sauśrute śalyatantre śrīgayadāsaviracitāyāṃ nyāyacandrikāyāṃ pañjikāyāṃ nidānasthāne daśamo'dhyāyaḥ||10||

div.head: granthyapacyarbudagalagaṇḍanidānam

ab.seg: athāto granthapacyarbudagalagaṇḍānāṃ nidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi||1-2||
vātādayo māṃsamasṛk ca duṣṭāḥ sandūṣya medaśca kaphānuviddham ‘tathā sirāśca’ iti tā.| vṛttonnataṃ vigrathitaṃ tu śophaṃ kurvantyato granthiriti pradiṣṭaḥ ||3||

teṣāṃ hetusamprāptilakṣaṇaniruktīrāha- vātādaya ityādi| vātādayo doṣā duṣṭā māṃsamasṛk ca sandūṣya śophaṃ kurvantīti sambandhaḥ| etena trayo granthaya uktāḥ| medaśca kaphānuviddhaṃ kaphasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ vāyudūṣitatvācchophaṃ karotīti sambandhaḥ| bhoje'pi vātakartṛtvaṃ medogranthāvabhihitam| tathā ca,- “vāyurmedo yadā māṃse saṅkṣipedathavā tvaci| tatra medobhavo granthiḥ śyāvo bhavati kaṇḍulaḥ”- ityādi| ayaṃ caturtho granthiḥ| cakārāt sirājo granthiḥ pañcamo grāhyaḥ| duṣṭā vṛddhiṃ gatā ityarthaḥ| vṛtto vartulaḥ, unnata ucchritaḥ| vigrathito'tyarthaṃ kaṭhinaḥ| vātādayo duṣṭā ityanena hetūpadeśaḥ, māṃsamasṛk ca sandūṣyeti samprāptiḥ, vṛttonnataṃ viprathitaṃ tu śophamiti lakṣaṇopadeśaḥ, ato granthiriti pradiṣṭa iti niruktiḥ||3||

medogranthiḥ asyāgre kiñcidgranthaḥ khaṇḍitaḥ pṛthageva samprāptyā'nvitaḥ; yaduktaṃ bhoje- “vāyurmedo yadā māṃse vikṣipedathavā tvaci| tatra medobhavo granthiḥ śyāvo bhavati kaṇḍuraḥ ‘pāṇḍuraḥ’ iti madhukośe pāṭhaḥ|| kṛśaḥ kṛśe mahān sthūle granthirbhinnaśca pīḍitaḥ| tilakalkanibhaḥ srāvo ghṛtavaccāsya jāyate” iti| sirāgranthestu pṛthageva samprāptiḥ||1-3||
āyamyate vyathyata ‘vyathyati tudyate ca’ iti tā. eti todaṃ pratyasyate kṛtyata ‘mathyati bhidyate ca’ iti tā. eti bhedam | kṛṣṇo'mṛdurbastirivātataśca bhinnaḥ sraveccānilajo'sramaccham ||4||

teṣāṃ vātādijānāṃ pratyekaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ lakṣaṇamāha- āyamyata ityādi| āyamyate vāyorākarṣaṇena dīrgha iva kriyate, ‘granthiḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| vyathyate vidhūyate| eti gacchati| todaṃ vyathām| pratyasyate kṣipyate| kṛtyate chidyate| eti bhedamiti bhedaṃ ca gacchati| amṛduḥ karkaśaḥ| bastirivātataśceti mūtrāśayavaddīrghaḥ| asraṃ rudhiram||4||
āyamyata iti vāyorākarṣaṇena dīrgha iva kriyate| ‘vyadhyate’ ityatra ‘vyāthyati’ ityeke paṭhanti||4||
dandahyate dhūpyati cūṣyate ‘cātimātraṃ’ iti pā. ca pāpacyate prajvalatīva cāpi | raktaḥ sapīto'pyathavā'pi pittādbhinnaḥ sraveduṣṇamatīva cāsram ||5||
dandahyate bhṛśaṃ dahyata iva| dhūpyati cātimātram atiśayena santāpaṃ karoti| pāpacyate bhṛśaṃ pacyata iva| prajvalatīva bhasmībhavatīva||5||
pittagranthau dandahyate bhṛśaṃ dahyata iva| pāpacyate bhṛśaṃ pacyate iva| prajvalatīva prakarṣeṇa jvalatīva||5||
śīto'vivarṇo'lparujo'tikaṇḍūḥ pāṣāṇavat saṃhananopapannaḥ | cirābhivṛddhiśca kaphaprakopādbhinnaḥ sravecchuklaghanaṃ ca pūyam ||6||
avivarṇa īṣadvivarṇaḥ| pāṣāṇavat pāṣāṇa iva ‘kaṭhina’ ityadhyāhāraḥ| saṃhananopapannaḥ saṅghātānvito mahānityarthaḥ||6||
kaphagranthau śīto'vivarṇa iti īṣadvivarṇaḥ| pāṣāṇavat kaṭhinaḥ| saṃhananopapannaḥ saṃhatānvito mahānityarthaḥ||6||
śarīravṛddhikṣayavṛddhihāniḥ snigdho mahānalparujo'tikaṇḍūḥ | medaḥkṛto gacchati cātra bhinne piṇyākasarpiḥpratimaṃ tu medaḥ ||7||

śarīravṛddhikṣayavṛddhihāniriti dehāpyāyanahrāsābhyāmāpyāyanahrāsau yasya sa tathā| gacchati sravati meda iti sambandhaḥ| atra medogranthau bhinne sati, piṇyākasarpiḥpratimaṃ tilakalkastyānaghṛtasadṛśam||7||

śarīravṛddhikṣayavṛddhihāniriti dehāpyāyanahrāsābhyāmāpyāyanahrāsau yasya sa tathā| gacchati cātra bhinne piṇyākasarpiḥpratimaṃ tu bhedaḥ| bhinne sati tilakalkastyānaghṛtasadṛśaṃ medo gacchati sravatītyarthaḥ||7||

div.ab: vyāyāmajātairabalasya taistairākṣipya vāyurhi sirāpratānam | sampīḍya saṅkocya viśoṣya cāpi granthiṃ karotyunnatamāśu vṛttam ||8|| granthiḥ sirājaḥ sa tu kṛcchrasādhyo bhavedyadi syāt sarujaścalaśca | aruk sa evāpyacalo ‘sa evāvicalaḥ’ iti pā. mahāṃśca marmotthitaścāpi vivarjanīyaḥ ||9|| iti granthīnāṃ nidānaṃ samāptam |

ab.seg: sirājasya grantheḥ samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- vyāyāmajātairityādi| vyāyāmajātaiḥ vyāyāmasamūhaiḥ| abalasya puruṣasya| sirāpratānaṃ sirāvistāram| sirājasya kṛcchrasādhyatvamāha- sa tu kṛcchrasādhya ityādi| tasyāsādhyatvamāha- arugityādi| mahāṃśceti cakāreṇa vātādijā apyevaṃrūpā varjanīyāḥ| marmotthitaśceti cakāreṇa arujo'pi vivarjanīyaḥ| anye punaratra “māṃsāsrajaṃ cārbudalakṣaṇena tulyaṃ hi dṛṣṭaṃ tvatha lakṣaṇajñaiḥ”- iti ṣaṣṭhaṃ granthiṃ paṭhanti| tanna, jejjaṭādibhiḥ parihṛtatvāt||8-9||

sirājasya grantheḥ samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- vyāyāmajātairityādi| ayaṃ rujāyuktaḥ kṛcchrasādhyaḥ| sa cārujaścāpyacalo mahāṃśca marmotthitaścāpi vivarjanīyaḥ| taduktamanyatra- “sirājaścirasādhyastu sarvebhyo durupakramaḥ” iti| sa ceti cakāreṇa vātādijo'pyetādṛśalakṣaṇo'sādhya eva| tathā ca bhojaḥ- “durbalasya sirā vāyurmaithunādiprajāgaraiḥ| granthiṃ karoti prathitamākṣipan pariśoṣayan|| sirājālāvṛtaṃ kṛtsnaṃ pīḍayan sarujaṃ calam| pañcaitānarujān granthīnmarmajānacalāṃstyajet|| kapolagalamanyāsu duścikitsyāśca sandhiṣu| asādhyān varjayan sādhyān kṛcchrasādhyāṃśca sādhayet” iti| anye punaratra māṃsāsṛgjaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ granthiṃ paṭhanti- māṃsāsrajaṃ cārbudalakṣaṇena tulyaṃ hi ṣaṣṭhaṃ (dṛṣṭaṃ) tvatha lakṣaṇajñaiḥ” iti| ayamevārthaḥ samānatantreṣvapi pāramparyāt smaryate iti ca vadanti||8-9||
hanvasthikakṣākṣakabāhusandhimanyāgaleṣūpacitaṃ tu medaḥ | granthiṃ sthiraṃ vṛttamathāyataṃ vā snigdhaṃ kaphaścālparujaṃ karoti ||10||

taṃ granthibhistvāmalakāsthimātrairmatsyāṇḍajālapratimaistathā'nyaiḥ ‘jāle jālākāre ādhāre matsyāṇḍaṃ matsyāṇḍajālaṃ, rājadantādiṣu draṣṭavyaṃ| tatsadṛśairmatsyāṇḍajālapratimaiḥ’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ| ananyavarṇairupacīyamānaṃ cayaprakarṣādapacīṃ vadanti ||11||
kaṇḍūyutāste'lparujaḥ prabhinnāḥ sravanti naśyanti bhavanti cānye | medaḥkaphābhyāṃ khalu roga eṣa sudustaro varṣagaṇānubandhī ||12||

idānīmapacyāḥ samprāptyādīnāha- hanvasthītyādi| hanvorasthi hanvasthi; sandhiśabdo hanvasthyādibhirbāhvantaiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate; bāhusandhiśabdena kūrpasandhirucyate; akṣakaṃ koṣṭhakaṃ tasya sandhiḥ, etena grīvāgrakasandhirucyate ‘grīvādhaḥsandhiḥ’ iti pā.; manyā grīvāpaścimabhāgasthā dhamanī| hanvasthītyādisamprāptiḥ, granthiṃ sthiraṃ vṛttamityādilakṣaṇam| taṃ granthibhirityādi taṃ pūrvoktaṃ granthim| ananyavarṇaiḥ samānavarṇaiḥ| upacīyamānaṃ vardhamānam| cayaprakarṣāditi upacayātiśayādityarthaḥ| cayaprakarṣādapacīmiti niruktiḥ| khaluśabdo'pyarthaḥ| tena medaḥkaphau vātādidoṣāntarānuviddhau jñeyau| tathāhi bhojaḥ,- “vātapittakaphā vṛddhā medaścāpi samācitam| jaṅghayoḥ kaṇḍarāḥ prāpya matsyāṇḍasadṛśān bahūn|| kurvanti grathitāṃstebhyaḥ punaḥ prakupito'nilaḥ| tān doṣānūrdhvago ‘tridoṣān’ iti pā. vakṣaḥkakṣāmanyāgalāśritaḥ|| nānāprakārān kurute granthīn sā tvapacī smṛtā| vyāmiśradoṣajātā sā kṛcchrasādhyā prakīrtitā|| tāsāṃ vātottarā rūkṣā vātavedanayā'nvitā| kṣiprapākasamutthānā dāhayuktā tu paittikī|| gūḍhā vā'pākakaṭhinā kaphāt snigdhā'lparukkarā| medo'dhikā ślaiṣmikī ca viśeṣādatimārdavā|| apacī kaṇṭhamanyāsu kakṣāvaṅkṣaṇasandhisu| tāṃ tu mālākṛtiṃ vidyāt kaṇṭhahṛddhanusandhiṣu|| gaṇḍamālāṃ vijānīyādapacītulyalakṣaṇām”- iti| carake gaṇḍamālā gaṇḍe eva paṭhitā “medaḥkaphācchoṇitasañcayottho gaṇḍasya pārśve galagaṇḍa ekaḥ| syādgaṇḍamālā bahubhistu gaṇḍairdīptānale yūni balānvite ca|| sādhyā smṛtā pīnasapārśvaśūlakāsajvaracchardiyutā tvasādhyā” (ca. ci. 12)- iti| anye tu ‘medaḥkaphābhyāṃ punareṣa rogaḥ’ iti paṭhanti; punaḥśabdādadhikārthāddoṣāntarasambandhaḥ sthāpito bhavatīti ca vadanti| tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ| varṣagaṇānubandhī varṣasamūhasambandhītyarthaḥ| etena dīrgharogitvaṃ sūcitam| medaḥkaphābhyāmiti hetūddeśaḥ||10-12||

grantheranantaramapacyārambhaḥ, granthiviśeṣādapacyāḥ, medaḥsamucchrayagranthipratyāsannataśca| tasyāḥ samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- hanvasthikakṣākṣaketyādi| hanvorasthi hanvasthi| sandhiśabdo hanvasthyādibhirbāhvantaiḥ saha pratyekamabhisambadhyate| bāhusandhiśabdena kūrparasandhirucyate| bāhumūlasandheḥ kakṣāśabdenaivopapannatvāt| akṣasandhiḥ grīvādhaḥsandhiḥ| eṣu sandhipradeśeṣūpacitaṃ dūṣyaṃ medaḥ, kaphaśca doṣo granthiṃ karoti| tamupacīyamānaṃ khalu anyairgranthibhirāmalakāsthipramāṇairmīnāṇḍākāraiḥ| cayaprakarṣādapacīti niruktiḥ| ‘cayāpakarṣāt’ iti kecit paṭhanti| sā punarupacayāpacayābhyāmapacīyate| upacayāpacayau darśayannāha- naśyanti bhavanti cānye iti| medaḥkaphābhyāmiti pūrvoktadoṣadūṣyayoreva niyamanam| khaluśabdo'pyarthaḥ, nipātānāmanekārthatvāt| tena medaḥkaphayoreva vātādidoṣāntarasaṃsargaṃ sūcayati| tathāhi bhojaḥ- “vātapittakaphā vṛddhā medaścāpi samācitam| jaṅghayoḥ kaṇḍarāḥ prāpya matsyāṇḍasadṛśān bahūn|| kurvanti grathitāṃstebhyaḥ punaḥ prakupito'nilaḥ| tān doṣānūrdhvago vakṣaḥkakṣāmanyāgalāśritaḥ|| nānāprakārāt kurute granthīn sā tvapacī smṛtā| vyāmiśradoṣajātā sā kṛcchrasādhyā prakīrtitā|| tāsāṃ vātottarā rūkṣā vātavedanayā'nvitā| kṣiprapākasamutthānā dāhayuktā tu paittikī|| gūḍhapākā ca kaṭhinā kaphāt snigdhā'lparuk sthirā| medodhikā ślaiṣmikī ca viśeṣādatimārdavā|| apacī kaṇṭhamanyāsu kakṣāvaṅkṣaṇasandhiṣu| tāṃ tu mālākṛtisamāṃ kaṇṭhahṛddhanusandhiṣu|| gaṇḍamālāṃ vijānīyātadapacītulyalakṣaṇām” iti| sthānakṛta eva bhedo'pacīgaṇḍamālayoḥ, grahaṇyatisārayoriva| gale eva mālāsthānā gaṇḍamālā carakeṇa paṭhitā- “medaḥkaphācchoṇitasañcayotthaḥ| galasya madhye galagaṇḍa ekaḥ syādgaṇḍamālā bahubhistu gaṇḍaiḥ|| sādhyāḥ smṛtāḥ pīnasapārśvaśūlakāsajvaracchardiyutāstvasādhyāḥ” iti| (ca. ci. ) ityapacīnāṃ nidānaṃ sampūrṇam||10-12||

div.ab: gātrapradeśe kvacideva doṣāḥ sammūrcchitā māṃsamabhipradūṣya | vṛttaṃ sthiraṃ mandarujaṃ mahāntamanalpamūlaṃ ciravṛddhyapākam ||13|| kurvanti māṃsopacayaṃ tu śophaṃ tamarbudaṃ śāstravido vadanti |14|

idānīmarbudādīnāṃ samprāptyādīnāha- gātrapradeśe ityādi| kvacideva gātrapradeśe doṣāḥ śophaṃ kurvantīti sambandhaḥ| sammūrcchitā vṛddhiṃ gatāḥ| kvacidevāniyatapradeśe, na punarapacīvaddhanvasthyādisandhiṣveva| apākam avidyamānapākam| māṃsopacayaṃ māṃsasaṅghātam| gātrapradeśe kvacideveti samprāptiḥ| sammūrcchitā doṣā iti hetuḥ| vṛttaṃ sthiramityādi svalakṣaṇam| gayī tu ‘kurvanti māṃsocchrayamatyagādham’ iti paṭhati||13||- apacyanantaramarbudārambhaḥ, medaḥkaphādhikajanmasāmānyāt| tasya samprāptimāha- gātrapradeśa ityādi| kvacidevāniyatapradeśe na punarapacīvaddhanvasthyādiṣveva| sammūrcchitā vṛddhāḥ| apākamiti avidyamānapākam| māṃsocchrayaṃ māṃsasaṅghātam| atyagādhamāṃsaṃ tanmūlatvāt; tasmādeva hetorarbudamapākam; agādhamāṃsocchrayamarbudaṃ jāyate, vastusvabhāvāditi||13||-
vātena pittena kaphena cāpi raktena māṃsena ca medasā ca ||14|| tajjāyate tasya ca lakṣaṇāni grantheḥ samānāni sadā bhavanti |15|
tajjāyate tadarbudaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| tasya ca lakṣaṇāni tasya vātapittakaphamedojasya||14||- teṣāṃ vātapittakaphamedojānāṃ vātādigranthilakṣaṇairlakṣaṇāni samānāni||14||-

doṣaḥ praduṣṭo rudhiraṃ sirāstu sampīḍya saṅkocya gatastvapākam ||15|| sāsrāvamunnahyati māṃsapiṇḍaṃ māṃsāṅkurairācitamāśuvṛddhim | sravatyajasraṃ rudhiraṃ praduṣṭamasādhyametadrudhirātmakaṃ syāt ||16|| raktakṣayopadravapīḍitatvāt pāṇḍurbhavet so'rbudapīḍitastu |17|

raktajasyārbudasya lakṣaṇamāha- doṣaḥ praduṣṭa ityādi| praduṣṭo doṣaḥ sirāsu gato rudhiraṃ sampīḍya saṅkocya māṃsapiṇḍamunnahyatīti sambandhaḥ| unnahyati udbadhnātīva; anye tu ‘praduṣṭo doṣa unnahyati ucchrito bhavati, māṃsapiṇḍamāśuvṛddhiṃ śīghravardhanaśīlaṃ karoti’ iti vyākhyānayanti| apākam īṣatpākam||15-16||- śoṇitajasya lakṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha- doṣaḥ praduṣṭa ityādi| apākamīṣatpākam, īṣadarthe nañ; alomikā piṇḍiketi yathā| doṣa unnahyati ucchrito bhavati| na kevalamunnahyati āśuvṛddhiṃ śīghravṛddhiṃ māṃsapiṇḍaṃ ca karoti| sravedajasram adhiṣṭhānabhūtasirārudhiraṃ; natu pākakṛtam, īṣadeva kledamātralakṣaṇasyāsrāvasyoktatvāt||15-16||-

muṣṭiprahārādibhirardite'ṅge māṃsaṃ praduṣṭaṃ prakaroti śopham ||17|| avedanaṃ snigdhamananyavarṇamapākamaśmopamamapracālyam | praduṣṭamāṃsasya narasya bāḍhametadbhavenmāṃsaparāyaṇasya ||18|| māṃsārbudaṃ tvetadasādhyamuktaṃ... |19|

māṃsajasya samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- muṣṭiprahārādibhirityādi| samupaiti samyaggacchati| bāḍham atiśayena| māṃsaparāyaṇasya māṃsabhakṣaṇaśīlasya| ‘muṣṭiprahārādibhiḥ’ ityatra kecit ‘kāṣṭhaprahārādibhiḥ’ iti paṭhanti||17-18||-

ab.seg: ...sādhyeṣvapīmāni vivarjayettu | samprasrutaṃ marmaṇi yacca jātaṃ srotaḥsu vā yacca bhavedacālyam ||19||
yajjāyate'nyat ‘sañjāyate yat’ iti pā. khalu pūrvajāte jñeyaṃ tadadhyarbudamarbudajñaiḥ | yaddvandvajātaṃ yugapat kramādvā dvirarbudaṃ tacca bhavedasādhyam ||20||

sādhyeṣvapītyādi| sādhyeṣvapīmāni vivarjayediti sādhyeṣu madhye imāni vakṣyamāṇāni vivarjayedityarthaḥ| adhyarbudamapi dvirarbudameva, anye ‘atyarbudaṃ’ iti paṭhanti| yaddvandvajātamityādi dvandvena yugmena jātaṃ dvandvajātaṃ; na kevalamadhyarbudaṃ dvirarbudaṃ, yaddvandvajātaṃ tadapi dvirarbudamityarthaḥ| bhedaśca tayoruparijātatvena pārśvajātatvena ca| etena dvirarbudadvitayamapyasādhyamuktam||19-20||

māṃsajasya samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- kāṣṭhaprahārādibhirityādi| māṃsaparāyaṇasyeti māṃsaikaparasyātimāṃsavṛddhermāṃsajaṃ, tadasādhyaṃ; tathaiva samprasrutādīnyapyasādhyāni| adhyarbudam adhikamarbudam; adhyarbudaṃ yattadapi dvirarbudaṃ, yad dvandvena yugapadeva jātaṃ kramādvā tadadhyarbudaṃ dvirarbudamapi; dvayametadasādhyam| tathā ca bhojaḥ- “arbade tvarbudaṃ jātaṃ dvandvajaṃ vā'nujaṃ ca yat| dvirarbudamiti jñeyaṃ tadasādhyaṃ vinirdiśet” iti||17-20||
na pākamāyānti kaphādhikatvānmedobahutvācca viśeṣatastu | doṣasthiratvādgrathanācca teṣāṃ sarvārbudānyeva nisargatastu ||21||

teṣāṃ pākābhāve hetuṃ darśayannāha- na pākamityādi| granthyādiṣvapi kaphādayaścatvāro hetavaḥ santi, paramarbudeṣu viśeṣataḥ kaphasya medasaścādhikyaṃ tasmāt, tathā viśeṣato doṣasthiratvād doṣakāryasya māṃsocchrayasya tenaiva svarūpeṇa cirakālāvasthitiśīlatvāt, tathā grathanād granthirūpatvātteṣāṃ medaḥprabhṛtīnāṃ; nisargatastviti tuśabdo'pyarthaḥ, tena svabhāvādapyarbudāni pākaṃ na gacchatītyarthaḥ||21||

teṣāṃ pākābhāve hetuṃ darśayannāha- na pākamāyāntītyādi| granthyādiṣvapi kaphādayaścatvāro hetavaḥ, arbudeṣu punaḥ kaphamedasorādhikyamiti viśeṣaḥ, tato na pākamāyānti| sarvāṇyevārbudāni pittaraktakṛtānyapi na pākamāgacchanti, kutaḥ? kaphādhikatvādityādi| viśeṣata iti viśeṣādatra kaphamedasorādhikyāt| tatraivāsiddhatāsādhanadoṣaṃ nirasyannāha- viśeṣato doṣasthiratvāt; kaphakāryasthiratvāt, tathā medaḥkāryake doṣakāryagrathanarūpāt; viśeṣeṇaivātra kaphamedasoḥ kāryasāmarthyenetyarthaḥ| nisargatastu atra tu śabdo'pyarthaḥ, svabhāvādapītyarthaḥ| bhoje'pyuktaṃ- “na pacyate sthiratvācca grathitatvāt svabhāvataḥ” iti| raktajamāṃsajayorapi doṣā evārambhakāḥ santi, tathā'pi tailadagdhavat raktajādivyapadeśa iti||21||
vātaḥ kaphaścaiva gale ‘bhṛśaṃ’ iti pā. pravṛddhau manye tu saṃsṛtya tathaiva medaḥ | kurvanti gaṇḍaṃ kramaśaḥ svaliṅgaiḥ samanvitaṃ taṃ galagaṇḍamāhuḥ ||22||

idānīṃ galagaṇḍasamprāptiṃ darśayannāha- vāta ityādi| vātādayo gaṇḍaṃ kramaśaḥ kurvantīti sambandhaḥ| kiṃviśiṣṭaṃ gaṇḍaṃ? svaliṅgaiḥ samanvitam| vātena kaphena ca galagaṇḍo bhavati, na pittena; svabhāvena pittajasya galagaṇḍasyābhāvāt||22||

medaḥkaphavātārambhasamānārbudānantaraṃ galagaṇḍārambhaḥ| teṣāṃ samprāptiṃ nirdiśannāha- vātaḥ kaphaścetyādi| vātena kaphena ca galagaṇḍo bhavati na pittena, svabhāvena pittajasya galagaṇḍasyābhāvāt, pittajacāturthakavat| taduktaṃ carake- “caturthako darśayati prabhāvaṃ dvividhaṃ jvaraḥ| jaṅghābhyāṃ ślaiṣmikaḥ pūrvaṃ śirasto'nilasambhavaḥ” (ca. ci. 3) iti| atra ca gaṇḍaśabdasya sāmānyaśopharūpakārthavyudāsyarthaṃ svaliṅgairityuktaṃ; tāni tu galagaṇḍasya sāmānyaliṅgāni “nibaddhaḥ śvayathuḥ” ityādīni vakṣyamāṇāni||22||

todānvitaḥ kṛṣṇasirāvanaddhaḥ kṛṣṇo'ruṇo vā pavanātmakastu | medonvitaścopacitaśca kālādbhavedatisnigdhataro'rujaśca ‘bhavet pratistabdhagalo'rujaśca’ iti, ‘bhavet pradigdhe ca gale'rujaśca’ iti ca pā.||23||
pāruṣyayuktaściravṛddhyapāko yadṛcchayā pākamiyāt kadācit vairasyamāsyasya ca tasya jantorbhavettathā tālugalapraśoṣaḥ ||24||
sthiraḥ savarṇo'lparugugrakaṇḍūḥ ‘gururugrakaṇḍūḥ’ iti tā. śīto mahāṃścāpi kaphātmakastu | cirābhivṛddhiṃ kurute cirācca prapacyate mandarujaḥ kadācit ||25||
mādhuryamāsyasya ca tasya jantorbhavettathā tālugalapralepaḥ | snigdho mṛduḥ pāṇḍuraniṣṭagandho medaḥkṛto ‘medaḥśritaḥ’ iti pā. nīrugathātikaṇḍūḥ ||26||

pralambate'lābuvadalpamūlo dehānurūpakṣayavṛddhiyuktaḥ ‘vivardhate hīyati cātra dehaḥ’ iti tā.| gayadāsasammato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ| snigdhāsyatā tasya bhavecca jantorgale'nuśabdaṃ ‘galena’ iti pā. kurute ca nityam ||27||

tasyaiva vātādiviśeṣaliṅgāni nirdiśannāha- todānvita ityādi| aruja iti so'pi vātagalagaṇḍo yadā kālāt kālena kṛtvā medo'nvito bhavati, tadā arujo bhavatītyarthaḥ| yadṛcchayā ajñātahetuniyamena, pākamiyāt gacchet| kadācit na sarvakālam| vātajaṃ kaphajaṃ coktvā medojamāha- snigdha ityādi| gale'nuśabdamanunādaṃ pratiśabdamityarthaḥ||23-27||

tasyaiva vātādiviśeṣaliṅgāni nirdiśannāha- todānvita ityādi| śyāvāruṇyaṃ doṣadūṣyarāśeḥ, na punaravarṇasya vāyoreva| kadāciditi na sarvakālam| yadṛcchayā ajñātahetuniyamena| kaphajaḥ savarṇaḥ prakṛtisamānavarṇaḥ| tālugalapralepaḥ praliptatvam| vivardhate hīyati cātra dehaḥ dehavṛddhihānibhyāṃ lakṣaṇābhyāṃ vivardhate hiyati ca| hīyatīti divāderākṛtigaṇatvāt hidhātuṃ parasmaipadeṣu paṭhanti; tena hīyatīti rūpam| anye tu “vṛddhikṣayāvṛcchati cātra dehaḥ” iti paṭhanti| galena śabdamanunādam||23-27||
kṛcchrācchvasantaṃ mṛdusarvagātraṃ saṃvatsarātītamarocakārtam | kṣīṇaṃ ca vaidyo galagaṇḍinaṃ tu bhinnasvaraṃ caiva vivarjayettu ||28||
idānīṃ galagaṇḍasyāsādhyatāmāha- kṛcchrādityādi||28||
idānīṃ galagaṇḍasyāsādhyatāṃ darśayannāha- kṛcchrācchvasantamityādi||28||
nibaddhaḥ śvayathuryasya muṣkavallambate gale | mahān vā yadi vā hrasvo galagaṇḍaṃ taṃ gaṇḍamiti nirdiśet’ iti pā. tamādiśet ||29||
na sarva eva galāśrayo gaṇḍo galagaṇḍaḥ, kiṃ tarhi kaścideva vakṣyamāṇasvarūpa iti darśayannāha- nibaddha ityādi| niyamena baddho nibaddhaḥ| muṣkavat aṇḍavat||29||

na galāśrayo galagaṇḍaḥ, kiṃ tarhi kaścideva pāribhāṣika iti darśayannāha- nibaddha ityādi| niyamena baddho nibaddhaḥ| muṣkavadaṇḍavat| bhojapyuktaṃ- “mahāntaṃ śothamalpaṃ vā hanumanyāgalāśrayam| lambantaṃ muṣkavaddṛṣṭvā galagaṇḍaṃ vinirdiśet” iti||29||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne galagaṇḍagaṇḍamālāpacyarbudanidānaṃ nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||11||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nidānasthāne ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ||11||
iti sauśrute śalyatantre śrīgayadāsaviracitāyāṃ nyāyacandrikākhyāyāṃ pañjikāyāṃ nidānasthāne ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ||11||
athāto vṛddhyupadaṃśaślīpadānāṃ nidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi||1-2||
muṣkapralambanasya pūrvaṃ prakrāntatvāt, śothasāmānyācca galagaṇḍānantaraṃ vṛddhinidānārambhaḥ||1-2||

vātapittaśleṣmaśoṇitamedomūtrāntranimittāḥ sapta vṛddhayo bhavanti | tāsāṃ ‘teṣāṃ’ ityādi tāḍapatrapustake tathā gayadāsena ca vṛddhiśabdaḥ sarvatra puṃlliṅga eva paṭhyate mūtrāntranimitte vṛddhī vātasamutthe, kevalamutpattiheturanyatamaḥ ||3||

vṛddhīnāṃ saṅkhyāmāha- vātetyādi| saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva saptasaṅkhyāsiddhau saptagrahaṇaṃ dvandvajādivṛddhiniṣedhārthaṃ; tāsāṃ punarasambhavo vyādhisvabhāvāt| dhātumalakṛtāyāmapi vṛddhau doṣasyaiva cikitsārthaṃ sambhavaṃ darśayannāha- tāsāmityādi| vātasamutthe vātāt samyaguttiṣṭhete vṛddhiṃ gacchata ityarthaḥ| jananahetuḥ punaranyatama iti taṃ pratipādayannāha- kevalamutpattiheturanyatama iti| kevalaṃ param, utpatterutpādakasya hetuḥ kāraṇamanyat mūtramantraṃ vā| anye tu anayorvṛddhyoryaṃ utpatterheturvāyuḥ so'nyatamo bhinno jñeyaḥ; etena mūtrasandhāraṇakupito vāyurmūtravṛddheḥ kāraṇaṃ, bhāraharaṇādibhiḥ kupitastvantravṛddherityarthaḥ||3||

vṛddhistu vātādibhedena saptavidhaḥ; saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva saptasaṅkhyāsiddhau saptagrahaṇaṃ dvandvajādivṛddhiniṣedhārthaṃ; teṣāṃ punarasambhavo'pi vyādheḥ svabhāvāt| dhātumalakṛte'pi doṣasyaiva cikitsārthaṃ sambhavaṃ darśayannāha- teṣāṃ mūtrāntranimitte vātasamutthe iti; vātāt samyaguttiṣṭhete, paramutpatterutpādakasya kāraṇamanyat mūtramantraṃ vā| ata evāha- “vāyurapratikāriṇaḥ kālāntareṇa muṣkau samupaiti” iti| śoṇitaje pittadoṣaḥ, medoje kaphaḥ||3||
adhaḥ prakupito'nyatamo hi doṣaḥ phalakośavāhinīrabhiprapadya dhamanīḥ phalakoṣayorvṛddhiṃ janayati, tāṃ vṛddhimityācakṣate ||4||
tāsāṃ samprāptimāha- adhaḥ prakupita ityādi| phalakośayorityanena dvivacanena muṣkadvaya eva vṛddhiriti na jñeyaṃ, kiṃ tarhi ekasminnapi pakṣe vṛddhiriti jñātavyam||4||

teṣāṃ samprāptiṃ nirdiśannāha- adhaḥ prakupita ityādi| phalaṃ ca koṣaśca tayorvāhinīḥ dhamanīḥ; phalakoṣayoriti dvivacanamatantraṃ, tenaikasya ca phalakoṣasya vṛddhirbhavati| taṃ vṛddhimācakṣeta iti kecidvṛddhipadaṃ paṭhanti| tatra ca “kticktau ca sañjñāyām” (pā. a. 3/3/174) ityanena siddho vṛddhiśabdaḥ, sa ca puṃlliṅgaḥ||4||
tāsāṃ bhaviṣyatīnāṃ pūrvarūpāṇi- bastikaṭīmuṣkameḍhreṣu vedanā mārutanigrahaḥ phalakośaśophaśceti ||5||
tāsāṃ pūrvarūpāṇyāha- tāsāmityādi||5||
kecidvṛddhīnāṃ pūrvarūpāṇi paṭhanti- teṣāṃ bhaviṣyatāṃ pūrvarūpāṇītyādi||5||

tatrānilaparipūrṇāṃ bastimivātatāṃ paruṣāmanimittānilarujāṃ vātavṛddhimācakṣate; pakvodumbarasaṅkāśāṃ jvaradāhoṣmavatīṃ cāśusamutthānapākāṃ pittavṛddhiṃ; kaṭhināmalpavedanāṃ śītāṃ ‘kaṭhinaṃ snigdhamalpavedanaṃ śleṣmavṛddhiṃ’ iti tā. kaṇḍūmatīṃ śleṣmavṛddhiṃ; kṛṣṇasphoṭāvṛtāṃ pittavṛddhiliṅgāṃ raktavṛddhiṃ, mṛdusnigdhāṃ kaṇḍūmatīmalpavedanāṃ tālaphalaprakāśāṃ medovṛddhiṃ; mūtrasandhāraṇaśīlasya mūtravṛddhirbhavati, sā gacchato'mbupūrṇā dṛtiriva kṣubhyati mūtrakṛcchravedanāṃ vṛṣaṇayoḥ śvayathuṃ kośayoścāpādayati, tāṃ mūtravṛddhiṃ vidyāt; bhāraharaṇabalavadvigrahavṛkṣaprapatanādibhirāyāsaviśeṣairvāyurabhipravṛddhaḥ ‘vāyuḥ prakupito'ntrasya sthūlasyetarasya vā’ iti tā. prakupitaśca sthūlāntrasyetarasya ‘kṣudrāntrasyaikadeśaṃ’ iti pā. caikadeśaṃ viguṇamādāyādho viguṇaṃ saṅkucitaṃ| ‘dviguṇaṃ’ iti pāṭhāntaram, tatra saṅkocena dviguṇīkṛtamityarthaḥ gatvā vaṅkṣaṇasandhimupetya granthirūpeṇa sthitvā'pratikriyamāṇe ca kālāntareṇa phalakośaṃ praviśya muṣkaśophamāpādayati, ādhmāto bastirivātataḥ pradīrghaḥ sa śopho bhavati, saśabdamavapīḍitaścordhvamupaiti, vimuktaśca punarādhmāyate ‘punarādhamati’ iti, ‘punarādhmāti’ iti ca pā., tāmantravṛddhimasādhyāmityācakṣate ||6||

tāsāṃ vātādijānāṃ lakṣaṇamāha- tatrāniletyādi| ātatām ādhmātām| medovṛddhimiti kaphena saha| mūtretyādi śīlaṃ svabhāvaḥ| kṣubhyati sañcalati| ādhmāto bastiriva paripūrṇo mūtrāśaya iva| ātato vistīrṇaḥ| upaiti udgacchati, vimuktaśca saśabdamevādhmāyate||6||

mūtrasandhāraṇaśīlasya mūtravṛddhirbhavati, paścādvegavighātena ca mūtrapravṛttena vāyunā āpyāyate| adhaḥpradeśe dviguṇamiti ādhārādheyakṛtamiti kecidvyācakṣate| anye viguṇaṃ duṣṭamādāyeti paṭhanti| vaṅkṣaṇasandhimāgamya unnatatvād granthyākāreṇa ca sthānaṃ kṛtvā, upekṣito muṣkakośamupaiti dīrghaḥ, avapīḍitaśca saśabdamūrdhvamuttiṣṭhate, muktaśca saśabdameva ādhmāyate| atraiva bhojaḥ- ativyavāyavyāyāmabhāraplavanalaṅghanaiḥ| vāyuḥ pravṛddhaḥ patanādruddhaścaṅkramaṇena ca|| antraṃ dviguṇamādāya jantornayati vaṅkṣaṇam| vaṅkṣaṇāttu rujāyuktaṃ phalakoṣaṃ prapadyate|| tatra sthitvā cirādvṛddhiṃ karoti na ca śāmyati| sa dīrghakālasaṃvṛddho dīrgho bastirivātataḥ|| cirāvanaddho bhavati pīḍitaśca vilīyate| muktaścādhmāyate bhūyo caryāṃ tāmantrajāṃ viduḥ”| iti vṛddhinidānaṃ samāptam||6||

tatrātimaithunādatibrahmacaryādvā ‘tatra brahmacāriṇīṃ dīrghakarkaśaromāṃ yonirogopasṛṣṭāmalpadvārāmapriyāmakāmāmacaukṣasalilaprakṣālitayoniṃ vā nārīṃ yo'bhigacchet tathā karajadaśanaviṣaśūkanipātanāddhastābhighātāccatuṣpadīgamanādacaukṣasalilaprakṣālanādvā prakupitāḥ’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ| gayadāsenāpyayameva vyākhyātaḥ tathā'tibrahmacāriṇīṃ cirotsṛṣṭāṃ rajasvalāṃ dīrgharomāṃ karkaśaromāṃ saṅkīrṇaromāṃ nigūḍharomāmalpadvārāṃ mahādvārāmapriyāmakāmāmacaukṣasalilaprakṣālitayonimaprakṣālitayoniṃ yonirogopasṛṣṭāṃ svabhāvato vā duṣṭayoniṃ viyoniṃ vā nārīmatyarthamupasevamānasya tathā karajadaśanaviṣaśūkanipātanādbandhanāddhastābhighātāccatuṣpadīgamanādacaukṣasalilaprakṣālanādavapīḍanācchrukravegavidhāraṇānmaithunānte vā'prakṣālanādibhirmeḍhramāgamya aprakṣālanādevaṃvidhādvā'nyasmāt’ iti pā. prakupitā doṣāḥ kṣate'kṣate vā śvayathumupajanayanti, tamupadaṃśamityācakṣate ||7||

vṛddherantaramupadaṃśānāṃ hetvadyabhidhānamāha- tatrātimaithunetyādi| atibrahmacāriṇyā maithunātinivṛttyā saṅkucitakarkaśayonimukhatvāt| cirotsṛṣṭāṃ prabhūtakālatyaktāṃ, atrāpi sa eva hetuḥ| brahmacāriṇyā janmanaḥ prabhṛtyeva maithunābhāvaḥ, cirotsṛṣṭāyāstu kadācidevetyanayorbhedaḥ| rajasvalāyā duṣṭārtavaprasaṅgāt| dīrghakarkaśādiromābhigamane pīḍanābhighātaprasaṅgāt| saṅkīrṇaromā ghanaromā| nigūḍharomā abhyantararomā| alpadvārāyāmapi sa eva hetuḥ| mahādvārāyāṃ śophahetuścinttya eva, tasmāt kecinna paṭhanti| apriyāyāṃ liṅgānutthānenetaścetābhighātaprasaṅgāt| akāmāyāḥ sakthisaṅkocena dvārālpatvāt| acokṣasalilaprakṣālitayoneḥ saliladoṣāt, acokṣamapavitram| aprakṣālitayoneḥ svedamaladoṣāt| yonirogopasṛṣṭāyā rogadoṣānusāreṇa doṣodayāt| svabhāvato vā duṣṭayonervātādaya eva kāraṇam| viyoniṃ hastajaṅghāntaraṃ, tasya karkaśatvāt| karajā nakhāḥ, daśanā dantāḥ, śūkasya ‘saviṣaśūketi śūkaḥ sajanturjalamalaḥ, liṅgavṛddhikarayogo vā’ iti pā. saviṣajalajakīṭasya, nipātanālliṅgādiśarīre pātanādathavā teṣāṃ mardanāt pīḍanāt| catuṣpadyo'jādayo rāsabhyādayo vā, tāsāmapyalpāramyayonitvāt| acokṣasalilaprakṣālanādibhiriti acokṣasalilaprakṣālanamatra liṅgasya na tu yoneḥ||7||

athāta upadaṃśanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| vṛddheranantaramupadaṃśārambhaḥ, sthānapratyāsannatvāt| tatrātimaithunādatibrahmacaryādvā tathā brahmacāriṇīmityādihetuviśeṣā yathāyogaṃ vyākhyeyāḥ| tatra brahmacāriṇyāṃ maithunanivṛtyā saṅkucitakarkaśayonimukhatvāt| dīrghakarkaśaromayonyāmapi dīrghakarkaśaromabhireva sukumārasya niṣpīḍanābhighātaiḥ śothaḥ| yonirogopasṛṣṭāyāṃ yathārogadoṣameva doṣodayāt| alpadvārāyāmapi niṣpīḍanābhighātāt| mahādvārāyāmapi vraṇairniṣpīḍanābhighātāditi kecit paṭhanti| śothahetūnāmapi vaimityaiva(?)| apriyāyāṃ litthānutthānenetaścetaścābhighātena śothaḥ| akāmāyāṃ sakthisaṅkocena dvārālpatvāt| acokṣasalilaprakṣālitayoneḥ maladoṣāt| aprakṣālanena vā svedamalādidoṣāt| rujādibhirabhighātataḥ| catuṣpadīnāṃ yoneralpāmanojñetvāt| taṃ śvayathumupadaṃśamityācakṣate ityanena śiśnagataśophaḥ daṃśanopādhimantareṇāpi saṅketamātreṇaiva ‘upadaṃśa’ ityucyate||7||
sa pañcavidhastribhirdoṣaiḥ pṛthak samastairasṛjā ceti ‘caikaḥ’ iti pā.||8||
teṣāṃ saṅkhyāmāha- sa pañcavidha ityādi| tribhirdoṣaiḥ pṛthagiti trayaḥ, samastairekaḥ, asṛjā caikaḥ, evaṃ pañca||8||
doṣadūṣyāśrayasaṅkhyayā pañcavidhaḥ||8||

tatra vātike pāruṣyaṃ tvakparipuṭanaṃ stabdhameḍhratā paruṣaśophatā vividhāśca ‘vividhavedanāprādurbhāvaśca’ iti tā. vātavedanāḥ; paittike jvaraḥ śvayathuḥ pakvoḍumbarasaṅkāśastīvradāhaḥ kṣiprapākaḥ pittavedanāśca; ślaiṣmike śvayathuḥ kaṇḍūmān kaṭhinaḥ snigdhaḥ śleṣmavedanāśca; raktaje kṛṣṇasphoṭaprādurbhāvo'tyarthamasṛkpravṛttiḥ pittaliṅgānyatyarthaṃ jvaradāhau śoṣaśca, yāpyaścaiva kadācit; sarvaje sarvaliṅgadarśanamavadaraṇaṃ ca śephasaḥ kṛmiprādurbhāvo maraṇaṃ ceti ||9||

teṣāṃ vātādijānāṃ pratyekaṃ lakṣaṇamāha- tatra vātike ityādi| “meḍhrasandhau vraṇāḥ kecit kecit sarvāśrayāḥ smṛtāḥ| kulatthākṛtayaḥ kecit kecinmudgadalopamāḥ|| rujādāhaparītāśca tṛṣṇāmohasamanvitāḥ| śīghraṃ kecidvisarpanti śanaiḥ kecittathā'pare|| strīṇāṃ puṃsāṃ ca jāyante upadaṃśāḥ sudāruṇāḥ”- iti tantrāntare||9||

tatra vārtike vividhāśca vātavedanā iti nānāvidhatodādivedanāḥ| raktaje pittaliṅgāni jvaradāhacoṣādīni| sarvaje avadaraṇaṃ kṛmiprādurbhāvo maraṇaṃ ceti| raktaje'pi kaṭvamlādihetubhī raktakaphakopāt karṇikā jāyate| tathā ca bhojaḥ- “kaṭvamlalavaṇāñjantoḥ pittalasyātisevinaḥ| raktaṃ pradūṣayatyamlaṃ tadduṣṭamanileritam|| karoti mehanaṃ prāpya śvayathuṃ....| kathañcidatyupekṣātastato raktakaphātmikā| karṇikā jāyate tatra sakaṇḍūkā savedanā” iti| kecit suśrutādhyāyinaḥ paṭhanti ‘meḍhrasandhau vraṇāḥ kecit’ ityādikaṃ; tamanārṣamācakṣate, strīṇāṃ copadaṃśā bhavantīti sarvatantreṣvaprasiddheḥ| ityupadaṃśanidānaṃ samāptam||9||

kupitāstu doṣā vātapittaśleṣmāṇo'dhaḥprapannā vaṅkṣaṇorujānujaṅghāsvavatiṣṭhamānāḥ kālāntareṇa pādamāśritya śanaiḥ śophaṃ janayanti, taṃ ślīpadamityācakṣate | tattrividhaṃ- vātapittakaphanimittamiti ||10||

ataḥ paraṃ ślīpadārambhaḥ, upadaṃśasthāne'pi ślīpadasambhavāt; ‘śiśnauṣṭhanāsāsvapi ca kecidicchanti tadvidaḥ’ iti vacanāt| teṣāṃ samprāptiṃ nirdiśannāha- prakupitāstvityādi| prakupitā ityanena sāmarthyādeva hetavo nirdiṣṭāḥ, ahatordoṣasyāduṣṭatvāt| sthānasaṃśrayalakṣaṇā samprāptirapi lakṣaṇameva| tatra pūrvo lakṣaṇodayo doṣadūṣyarāśereva; dūṣyān dūṣayanto doṣāḥ śophaṃ janayanti| taṃ ślīpadamityācakṣate iti pāribhāṣikī nirupādhireva ślīpadasañjñetītiśabdena prakāśayati||10||

tatra, vātajaṃ kharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ paruṣamanimittānilarujaṃ parisphuṭati ca bahuśaḥ; pittajaṃ tu pītāvabhāsamīṣanmṛdu jvaradāhaprāyaṃ ca; śleṣmajaṃ tu śvetaṃ snigdhāvabhāsaṃ mandavedanaṃ bhārikaṃ mahāgranthikaṃ kaṇṭakairupacitaṃ ca ||11||
kaphaje bhārikaṃ gurvityarthaḥ||11||
tatra saṃvatsarātītamatimahadvalmīkajātaṃ prasṛtamiti varjanīyāni ||12||
valmīkajātaṃ valmīkavajjātam, atibahutaraśikharairgranthibhirupacitatvāt; parapadārtheṣu hi pravṛttā śabdā vatimantareṇāpi vatyarthaṃ janayanti||12||

tasyāsādhyāvasthāṃ nirdiśannāha- saṃvatsarātītamityādi| valmīkajātaṃ valmīkavajjātam, atibahutaraśikharairgranthibhirupacitatvāt; parapadārtheṣu hi pravṛttā śabdā vatimantareṇāpi vatyarthaṃ gamayanti||12||
bhavanti cātra- trīṇyapyetāni jānīyācchlīpadāni kaphocchrayāt | gurutvaṃ ca mahattvaṃ ca yasmānnāsti vinā kaphāt ||13||
vātapittaślīpadānyapi kaphādhikānyeveti darśayannāha- trīṇītyādi||13||
vātapittaślīpadānyapi kaphādhikānyeveti darśayannāha- trīṇyapyetānītyādi||13||
purāṇodakabhūyiṣṭhāḥ sarvartuṣu ca śītalāḥ | ye deśāsteṣu jāyante ślīpadāni viśeṣataḥ ||14||

deśaviśeṣa evāsyotpattiṃ darśayannāha- purāṇodakabhūyiṣṭhā ityādi| anūpadeśasya purāṇodakabhūyiṣṭhatā| jāṅgalasyonnatasamabhūtalatvāt salilaṃ patitaṃ na tiṣṭhati, sthitamapi rūkṣoṣṇaśuṣkatvāddeśasya śoṣamupaiti; tena jāṅgaladeśasya śīte'pyaśītatā||14||

deśaviśeṣa evāsyotpattiṃ darśayannāha- purāṇodakabhūyiṣṭhā ityādi| anūpadeśasya purāṇodakabhūyiṣṭhatā; jāṅgalasya tūnnatasamabhūtalatvāt salilaṃ patitaṃ na tiṣṭhati, sthitamapi rūkṣoṣṇaśuṣkatvāddeśasya śoṣamupaitīti jāṅgaladeśasya śīte'pyaśītatā; taduktaṃ- “samāḥ sādhāraṇe” (sū. 35) ityādi; lakṣaṇadvandvametat pañcavidhasyānūpasyāvarodhakam(?) atraiva hi deśaviśeṣeṇa ślīpadānāmutpattiriti||14||
pādavaddhastayoścāpi ślīpadaṃ jāyate nṛṇām | karṇākṣināsikauṣṭheṣu kecidicchanti tadvidaḥ ||15||
ślīpadasya pādābhyāmanyasminnapyaṅge utpattiṃ darśayannāha- pādavaddhastayoścāpītyādi||15||
ślīpadasya pādābhyāmanyasminnapyaṅge utpattiṃ darśayannāha- pādabaddhastayoścāpītyādi| iti ślīpadanidānaṃ samāptam||15||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne vṛddhyupadaṃśaślīpadanidānaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||12||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nidānasthāne dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ||12||
iti sauśrute śalyatantre śrīgayadāsaviracitāyāṃ nyāyacandrikākhyāyāṃ pañjikāyāṃ nidānasthāne dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ||12||

div.head: kṣudraroganidānam

ab.seg: athātaḥ kṣudrarogāṇāṃ nidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

athāta ityādi| yadyapi kṣudrarogeṣu rohiṇīvalmīkādayo mahāvyādhayaḥ santi, tathā'pi kṣudrarogāṇāṃ bahutvāttaireva vyapadeśaḥ; yathā bahuṣu chatriṣu gacchatsu acchatriṣvapi keṣucicchatriṇo yāntīti vyapadeśaḥ, tathā'trāpīti na doṣaḥ| anye tu kṣudrā laghavastilakādyapekṣayā, agnirohiṇīvalmīkādyapekṣayā kṣudrāstīkṣṇāḥ ‘sūkṣmāḥ’ iti pā.; athavā pūrvācāryaprasiddhā nirhetukeyaṃ sañjñā||1-2||

vṛddhyādinidānānantaraṃ kṣudrarogāṇāmārambhaḥ| nidānasya hetulakṣaṇanirdeśasyārambhaḥ, vyādhivarganirdeśasyārambhaḥ, sādharmyāt kṣudrarogapāriśeṣyāt| prathamaṃ hyadhikānāṃ mahāvyādhīnāṃ nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ, tadanu madhyānāṃ mahāvyādhīnāṃ vidradhīnām, anantaraṃ svalpānāṃ kṣudrāṇāṃ nidānamavatiṣṭhati, tannirdiśannāha- athāta ityādi| kṣudratvaṃ punareṣāṃ hetulakṣaṇacikitsālpatvena; yadyevaṃ rohiṇīvalmīkādīnāṃ tridoṣajatvena hetubāhulyād rohiṇyāstāvadihāsādhyatvāt, tathaiva valmīkasya ca kṛcchratvādasādhyatvādvā mahāvyādhitvaprasaṅgaḥ| naitadasti, bāhulyenoktatvāt; tadyathā- chatribāhulyena chatriṇo yāntīti vyapadeśaḥ| advitīyatvena vā kṣudrāḥ, tathā hi- nahi kṣudraroganirdiṣṭeṣu rogeṣvajagallikāgudabhraṃśādiṣu doṣadhātumalasaṃsargād vyabhicarati saṅkhyā, alpatvenāpi kṣudratvaṃ, jejjaḍeneti punariha bahutaramasambaddhaṃ pralapitaṃ, tadvistarabhayādasmābhirdūṣayitumapi nānugaditam||1-2||

samāsena catuścatvāriṃśat ‘saptacatvāriṃśat’ iti tā. kṣudrarogā bhavanti | tadyathā,- ajagallikā, yavaprakhyā, andhālajī, vivṛtā, kacchapikā, valmīkaṃ, indravṛddhā ‘indraviddhā, gardabhikā’ iti tā., panasikā, pāṣāṇagardabhaḥ, jālagardabhaḥ, kakṣā ‘kakṣā, irivellikā, gandhanāmā’ iti tā., visphoṭakaḥ, agnirohiṇī, cippaṃ, kunakhaḥ, anuśayī, vidārikā śarkarārbudaṃ, pāmā, vicarcikā, rakasā, pādadārikā, kadaraṃ, alasendraluptau ‘alasaḥ, rujyā’ iti pā., dāruṇakaḥ, aruṃṣikā, palitaṃ, masūrikā, yauvanapiḍakā, padminīkaṇṭakaḥ, jatumaṇiḥ, maśakaḥ, carmakīlaḥ tāḍapatrapustake carmakīlasthāne nīlikā paṭhyate, tilakālakaḥ, nyacchaṃ, vyaṅgaḥ, parivartikā, avapāṭikā, niruddhaprakaśaḥ sanniruddhagudaḥ, ahipūtanaṃ, vṛṣaṇakacchraḥ, gudabhraṃśaśceti ||3||

saṅkhyāmāha- samāsenetyādi| samāsena saṅkṣepeṇa, vistareṇa pramāṇaṃ tu nāstyeva| śrībrahmadevastu gardabhikerivellikāgandhapiḍikānīlikānāṃ saṅgrahaṇenāṣṭacatvāriṃśaditi paṭhati| śrījejjhaṭena tu gardabhikādayaścatvāro na paṭhitāḥ| pūrvavyākhyātāro'pi suvīranandivārāhādayaḥ samānatantrāpāṭhāt gardabhikādīnāṃ caturṇāṃ pāṭhaṃ garhitaṃ manyante| gayadāsācāyastu samānatantrādarśane'pi sarveṣveva pāṭheṣu pātād gardabhikādīn paṭhati, pāmādīṃśca kṣudratve'pi caturaḥ kuṣṭha eva paṭhati||3||
prathamaṃ saṅkhyāmeva nirdiśannāha- samāsena catuścatvāriṃśat kṣudrarogāḥ| samāsena saṅkṣepeṇa, doṣavikārāṇāmānantyāt; yaduktaṃ- “anuktamapi doṣāṇāṃ liṅgairvyādhimupācaret” (sū. 35) ityādi||3||
snigdhā savarṇā grathitā nīrujā mudgasannibhā ‘granthisannibhā’ iti pā.| kaphavātotthitā jñeyā bālānāmajagallikā ||4||
teṣāṃ pratyekaṃ lakṣaṇamāha- snigdhetyādi| “prāyograhaṇamatra luptanirdiṣṭaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ, tena kvacidabāleṣvapi” ityeke manyante||4||

ajagallikā bālānāmeva “yadā kurvanti sa kālaḥ” (sū. 41) iti bālye eva tadrogadhārāṇasāmarthyaṃ, na punastāruṇyādiṣu vātapiḍikāvat| prāyograhaṇamatra luptanirdiṣṭaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ; tena kvacidabāleṣvapītyeke manyante| atra bhojaḥ- “mārutaḥ kaphamādāya piḍikāṃ māṣamudgayoḥ| tulyāṃ savarṇāṃ tvaṅmāṃse kurute sā'jagallikā” iti||4||
yavākārā sukaṭhinā grathitā māṃsasaṃśritā | piḍakā śleṣmavātābhyāṃ yavaprakhyeti socyate ||5||
yavetyādi| yavākārā sthūlamadhyanimnāntatvena ‘antanimnamadhyonnatatvena’ iti pā.||5||
yavaprakhyāḥ sthūlamadhyatvena yavākārāḥ||5||
ghanāmavaktrāṃ piḍakāmunnatāṃ parimaṇḍalām | andhālajīmalpapūyāṃ tāṃ vidyāt kaphavātajām ||6||
ghanāmityādi| avaktrāmiti alpamukhīm| parimaṇḍalāṃ vartulāmityarthaḥ| andhālajīṃ snāyuprasṛtāntarmukhīm||6||

andhālajī snāyuśritā'ntarmukhī| tathā ca bhojaḥ- “śleṣmānilau śritau snāyuṃ piḍikāṃ parimaṇḍalām| duṣṭau janayato'vaktrāmalpapūyāmakaṇḍurām| āmodumbarasaṅkāśāṃ vidyādandhālajīṃ tu tām” iti| etāsu doṣāḥ svayamācāryeṇa nirdiṣṭā eva; yatra punarācāryeṇa doṣāḥ svayaṃ na nirdiṣṭāstatra doṣāḥ paratantrapratyayena liṅgenaiva nirdiśyante||6||
vivṛtāsyāṃ mahādāhāṃ pakvodumbarasannibhām | vivṛtāmiti tāṃ vidyāt pittotthāṃ parimaṇḍalām ||7||
vivṛtāsyāmityādi| vivṛtāsyāmiti vyāttamukhīm||7||
pittādhikatvenādhikapākādvivṛtāsyatvena vivṛtā||7||
grathitāḥ pañca vā ṣaḍvā dāruṇāḥ kacchaponnatāḥ | kaphānilābhyāṃ piḍakā jñeyā kacchapikā budhaiḥ ||8||
dāruṇāḥ kaṭhināḥ||8||
madhyonnatatvena paryanteṣvanatatvena kāṭhinyena ca kacchapikā| sā kaphavātotthā||8||
pāṇipādatale sandhau grīvāyāmūrdhvajatruṇi | granthirvalmīkavadyastu śanaiḥ samupacīyate ||9||
todakledaparīdāhakaṇḍūmadbhirmukhairvṛtaḥ | vyādhirvalmīka ityeṣa kaphapittānilodbhavaḥ ‘vijñeyaḥ kaphapaittikaḥ’ iti tā.||10||
granthaya ityādi||9-10||

valmīkavaditi bahutaraśikharatvenocchrāyeṇa ca, tathā dūrāvagāḍhadoṣadūṣitadūṣyatayā'ntarmūlatvenāpi valmīkasamatā; ata eva cikitsite avagāḍhamūlaśodhanārthamagnikṣārābhyāṃ prasādhanamuktam| taṃ ca kecit kaphapaittikamicchanti; tanna, todasya kledadāhayoḥ kaṇḍvādīnāṃ ca vātādiliṅgānāṃ darśanāt sānnipātika evāyaṃ; tathā hi bhojaḥ- “sannipātena piḍikā mukhairbahubhirāvṛtā| pāṇipādatale sandhau grīvāyāmūrdhvajatruṣu|| jāyate hi viśeṣeṇa vyādhiṃ valmīkamādiśet” iti| tathā'nyatrāpyuktaṃ- ‘grīvāṃsakakṣe karapādadeśe sandhau gale vā tribhireva doṣaiḥ| granthiḥ sa valmīkavadakriyāṇāṃ jātaḥ krameṇaiva gataḥ pravṛddhim|| mukhairanekaiḥ srutitodavadbhirvisarpavat sarpati connatāgraiḥ| valmīkamāhurbhiṣajo vikāraṃ niṣpratyanīkaṃ cirajaṃ viśeṣāt” iti||9-10||

div.ab: padmapuṣkaravanmadhye ‘padmakarṇivanmadhye’ iti pā. piḍakābhiḥ samācitām | indravṛddhāṃ tu tāṃ vidyādvātapittotthitāṃ bhiṣak ||11|| maṇḍalaṃ vṛttamutsannaṃ saraktaṃ piḍakācitam | rujākarīṃ gadarbhikāṃ tāṃ vidyādvātapittajām |12|

padmetyādi| padmapuṣkaraṃ padmakarṇikā| gayī tvatra gardabhikāṃ paṭhati; yathā- “maṇḍalāṃ vṛttamutsannāṃ ‘vipulotsannāṃ iti pā. saraktāṃ piḍakācitām| rujākarīṃ gardabhikāṃ tāṃ vidyādvātapittajām”||11||- mahāpuṣkaravanmadhye iti puṣkaraṃ varāṭakam| indraviddhā vātapittajā, gardabhikā'pi; sā paṭhyate, sarveṣu samanatantreṣu dṛśyate iti||11||-

ab.seg: karṇau ‘karṇasyābhyantare jātāṃ piḍakāmugravedanām| sthirāṃ panasikāṃ tāṃ tu vidyādvātakaphotthitām’ iti tā. pari samantādvā pṛṣṭhe vā piḍakograruk | śālūkavatpanasikāṃ tāṃ vidyācchleṣmavātajām ||12||

karṇasyābhyantare deśe jātā vātakaphātmikā| samantata iti vacanāt karṇādbahirapīti vyācakṣate, tanna, sarveṣu pādeṣu bahiriti aprāpteḥ| na ca samānatantreṣu bahiriti labhyate| tathāhi bhojaḥ- “kaphavātau prakupitau māṃsamāśritya karṇayoḥ| samantataḥ paristabdhāṃ kurutaḥ piḍakāṃ sthirām|| viṣamāṃ dāhasaṃyuktāṃ vidyāt panasikāṃ tu tām” iti| bhoje'syāṃ vātakaphajāyāṃ dāhaḥ paṭhitaḥ, sa hi vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyārambhādadhiṣṭhānaprabhāvādvā'vagantavyaḥ||12||
hanusandhau samudbhūtaṃ śophamalparujaṃ sthiram | pāṣāṇagardabhaṃ ‘pāṣāṇagardabhamiti brūyāttat kaphapittataḥ’ iti tā. vidyādbalāsapavanātmakam ||13||
hanusandhisamudbhūtamityādinā pāṣāṇagardabhaḥ| sthirakaṭhinapāṣāṇavat kāṭhinyena pāṣāṇagardabhaḥ||13||
visarpavat sarpati yo ‘yaḥ śophastanurapākavān| dāhajvarakaraḥ pittāt’ iti tā. dāhajvarakarastanuḥ | apākaḥ śvayathuḥ pittāt sa jñeyo jālagardabhaḥ ||14||

visarpavat sarpati ya ityādinā jālagardabhaḥ| apākavān īṣatpākavān, īṣadarthe nañ; pittakṛtatvenātyarthaṃ pākābhāvasyāyuktatvādalpapāka ityaṅgīkriyate| pratanustokapākapiḍikājālābhatvāj jālagardabhaḥ| pittādityudbhūtapittāt, pittotkaṭaistribhireva doṣairanyatra paṭhyate| tathāhi bhojaḥ- “pittotkaṭāstrayo doṣā janayanti tvagāśritāḥ| śyāvaraktatanuśothaprapākaṃ bahuvedanam|| visarpiṇaṃ sadāhaṃ ca tṛṣṇājvarasamanvitam| visarpamāhustaṃ vyādhimapare jālagardabham” iti||14||
piḍikāmuttamāṅgasthāṃ vṛttāmugrarujājvarām | sarvātmakāṃ sarvaliṅgāṃ jānīyādirivellikām ||15||

piḍakāmuttamāṅgasthāmityādinā irivellikā| sā ca sarvajā sarvadoṣārabdhetyarthaḥ| sarveṣāṃ vātādidoṣāṇāṃ svabhāvakāryāṇāṃ liṅgadarśanaṃ sannipātena prakṛtisamavāyārabdhatvānmanyante| iyaṃ sarveṣveva pāṭheṣu paṭhyate, na tu samānatantreṣviti pūrvavyākhyātāro manyante||15||
bāhupārśvāṃsakakṣāsu kṛṣṇasphoṭāṃ savedanām | pittaprakopasambhūtāṃ kakṣāmiti vinirdiśet ||16||
bāhupārśvāṃsakakṣetyādinā kakṣā||16||
ekāmevaṃvidhāṃ dṛṣṭvā piṭikāṃ sphoṭasannibhām | tvaggatāṃ pittakopena gandhanāmāṃ pracakṣate ||17||
ekāmetādṛśīṃ kakṣānirdiṣṭasphoṭasadṛśīṃ gandhanāmāṃ vadanti||17||
agnidagdhanibhāḥ sphoṭāḥ sajvarāḥ pittaraktataḥ | kvacit sarvatra vā dehe smṛtā visphoṭakā iti ||18||

agnidagdhanibhāḥ| sphoṭā ityādinā visphoṭakāḥ| anyaiḥ punaramī visarpabhedatvādeṣāṃ na paṭhyante| ata evānyatantrīyairvisarpabhedatvādeṣāṃ doṣabhedena lakṣaṇaṃ paṭhyate| kṣudrarogapāṭhe tu doṣabhedo'tra na yujyate| atrārthe bhojaḥ “pittaṃ raktaṃ ca kupitaṃ vātenātugataṃ tvaci| agnidagdhanibhān sphoṭān kurute sarvadehagān|| sajvarān saparīdāhān vidyādvisphoṭakāṃstu tān” iti||18||
kakṣābhāgeṣu ye sphoṭā jāyante māṃsadāru(ra)ṇāḥ | antardāhajvarakarā dīptapāvakasannibhāḥ ||19||
saptāhādvā daśāhādvā pakṣādvā nghanti mānavam | tāmagnirohiṇīṃ vidyādasādhyāṃ sannipātataḥ ||20||

kakṣābhāgeṣvityādi| asādhyāmiti ata evāsyāścikitsiteṣu na cikitsābhidhānam| ‘māṃsadāraṇā” ityapi pāṭhaḥ| tathāhi tantrāntaram,- “pittotkaṭā nṛṇāṃ doṣāḥ pradīptāṅgārasannibhān| kakṣābhāgeṣu kurvanti tīvradāharujājvarān|| māṃsāvadāraṇān sphoṭān ye hanyuranupakramāt| pakṣāddaśāhādarvāgvā sā jñeyā vahnirohiṇī” iti| tatra vātādhikaiḥ saptāhāt, pittādhikairdaśāhāt, kaphādhikaiḥ pakṣāt||19-20||
kakṣābhāgeṣu ye sphoṭā ityādinā agnirohaṇī| asādhyāmiti ata evāsyāścikitsiteṣu na cikitsābhidhānam||19-20||

div.ab: nakhamāṃsamadhiṣṭhāya pittaṃ vātaśca vedanām ‘dehinām’ iti tā.| karoti dāhapākau ca taṃ vyādhiṃ cippamādiśet ||21|| tadevākṣatarogākhyaṃ tathopanakhamityapi ‘tadevālpatarairdoṣaiḥ kunakhaṃ paruṣaṃ kharam’ iti tā.| abhighātāt praduṣṭo yo nakho rūkṣo'sitaḥ kharaḥ ||22|| bhavettaṃ kunakhaṃ vidyāt kulīnamiti sañjñitam |23|

nakhetyādi| cippamiti tantrāntare'ṅgulīveṣṭhakamiti prasiddham||20-22||- nakhamāṃsamadhiṣṭhāyetyādinā cippaṃ; carake tu akṣatanāmnā'yaṃ vikāraḥ| tathāhi carakaḥ- “rogo'kṣataścarmanakhāntare syānmāṃsāsradūṣī bhṛśadāhapākaḥ” (ca. ci. 12) iti| anye tu “tadevākṣatarogākhyaṃ tathopanakhamityāpi” iti granthamadhīyate||21-22||-
gambhīrāmalpasaṃrambhāṃ savarṇāmuparisthitām ||23|| kaphādantaḥprapākāṃ tāṃ vidyādanuśayīṃ bhiṣak ‘pādasyānuśayīṃ tāṃ tu vidyādantaḥprapākinīm’ iti tā.|24|

gambhīrāmityādi| antaḥpākena gambhīrām| alpasaṃrambhām alpaśothām| uparisthitāṃ mastake sthitām||23||- gambhīrāmalpasaṃrambhāmityādinā anuśayī| upari mūrdhani| saṃrambhaḥ śothaḥ| antaḥpākena gambhīrā||23||-

vidārīkandavadvṛttāṃ kakṣāvaṅkṣaṇasandhiṣu ||24|| raktāṃ vidārikāṃ vidyāt sarvajāṃ sarvalakṣaṇām ‘vidārikāmiti vadet sarujāṃ sarvalakṣaṇām’ iti tā.| ‘vidārīkandavadvṛttā kakṣāvaṅkṣaṇasandhiṣu| raktā vidārikā jñeyā sarvajā sarvalakṣaṇā’ iti gayadāsasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ|25|

vidārīkandavadityādi| vaṅkṣaṇasandhiḥ gaṇḍakaḥ| raktāṃ lohitām| sarvajāṃ sannipātajāṃ; paraṃ tathā'pi sādhyā, na hi sarva eva sannipātajā vyādhayo'sādhyāḥ| sarvalakṣaṇāṃ doṣasamudāyalakṣaṇāṃ, na tu pratyekadoṣalakṣaṇāṃ, doṣebhyo doṣasamudāyasyānyatvāt, cūrṇaharidrāsaṃyogasyeva| anye tu “sarvebhyo vātapittakaphebhyaḥ pṛthak dviśastriśo vā jāyata iti sarvajā ityasyāḥ sāptavidhyaṃ doṣaliṅgaiḥ sūkṣmamatinā'nuktamapyūhyam” ityācakṣate; tannecchati gayī “yena kṣudrarogasāmānyanyāyenāsyāḥ sāptavidhyaṃ na prapadyate, na hi kṣudrarogeṣu ko'pi vyādhiḥ paṭhito yaḥ pratyekādidoṣajaḥ, api ca yadyācāryasya sāptavidhyamabhipretaṃ syāttadā ‘doṣaiḥ saptavidhā tu sā’ iti pāṭhaṃ kuryāt; tantrāntare ceyaṃ vātakaphānvitā paṭhitā, tasmādvātakaphādhikyena hīnapittatayā asyā utpattirjñeyā” iti||24||- vidārīkandavadvṛttāmityādinā vidārī| sarvajā sarvalakṣaṇeti atra vākyārthe pūrvavyākhyātāro vivadante| tatrāhureke- asarvajā asarvalakṣaṇetyubhayatrāpi nañaḥ praśleṣaḥ; anye tu punaḥ asarvajā sarvalakṣaṇeti pūrvapade nañamicchanti praśliṣṭaṃ na punaruttarapade; tathottarapade evāpare nañaḥ praśleṣaṃ prajānante na pūrvapade iti; atrāpyapakṣapātino hi no'yaṃ vākyārthaḥ- sarvajeti sarvaiḥ sannipatitairbhavati; asarvalakṣaṇetyatrāpi sannipātalakṣaṇarahitetyarthaḥ| tena pratyekadoṣadvandvajatvena ṣaḍvidhā, sānnipātikī na bhavatīti samudāyārthaḥ| atra pakṣe'sandehārthamācāryeṇa ‘ṣaḍvidhā dvyekadoṣajā’ iti paṭhitaṃ syāt| asarvajā sarvalakṣaṇetyatrāpi pakṣe sarvairdoṣairna jāyate atha sarvadoṣaliṅgānviteti vadatāṃ liṅginamantareṇāpi liṅgasadbhāvamaṅgīkurvatāṃ liṅgamaniścāyakaṃ syāt| tatra svadoṣādyapekṣiṇī cikitsaiva na syāt, doṣaliṅgasyaiva...| atha sarvāṇi ca tāni lakṣaṇāni tānyavidyamānāni yasyāmiti sannipātajā'pyasampūrṇalakṣaṇetyarthaḥ, tadā sarvatrāsya nyāyasya sāmānyāt asarvalakṣaṇeti na ca vaktavyaṃ bhavet, taduktaṃ “doṣe vibaddhe naṣṭe'gnau sarvasampūrṇalakṣaṇaḥ” (ca. ci. 3) iti| hetvanurūpakopabalena hi sarvatra sarvārdhālpasarvalakṣaṇodaya iti viśeṣaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| tadevaṃ sarvajā sarvalakṣaṇā iti ubhayatrāpyanañeva pakṣaḥ| atrāpi tridoṣajatvenāsādhyatvena vidāryāḥ kṣudrarogacikitsāpraṇayanamanarthakaṃ syāt| na sannipātamātrajā kiṃ tarhi vyastasamastadvandvajatvena saptavidhā sarvalakṣaṇetyatrāpīyameva vyākhyānapakṣaḥ| sa cārthaḥ kṣudrarogasya sāmānyanyāyena nopapadyate| na hi kṣudrarogeṣu ko'pi vyādhiḥ paṭhitaḥ pratyekādidoṣajaḥ| api ca yadyayamabhiprāya ācāryasya syāt tadā'sandehārthaṃ ‘doṣaiḥ saptavidhā tu sā’ iti paṭhitaṃ syāt| tasmāt sānnipātajaiveyaṃ, na cāsādhyā; na hi sarva eva sannipātajo vyādhirasādhyaḥ, yato na sarveṣāmeva doṣāṇāṃ tulyaṃ balaṃ, yathāhetubalameva hi doṣabalābalaṃ; yaduktaṃ- “hetubhirbahubhirjāto balibhirbahulakṣaṇaḥ” (ca. ci. 3) iti, tathā “santatajvara evānyaḥ svalpadurbalakāraṇaḥ” (ca. ci. 3) iti| sannipātajā sarvalakṣaṇopetetyapi viśeṣaṇamarthavat; yena na sarvatra sarvaje vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyārabdhaṃ pratyekadoṣajeṣvapaṭhitameva liṅgaṃ bhavati, kiṃ tarhi samudāyibhyo'nyatvāt samudāyasya cūrṇaharidrāsaṃyoga ivānyānyapi, ata eva vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyārabdhasya sannipātasyāvaśyameva lakṣaṇāni paṭhyante, pratyekadoṣaliṅgebhyo'nyatvādeva teṣāṃ sannipātaliṅgānām; evaṃ cikitsā'pi pṛthageva paṭhyate, tata eva hetoranyatvāddoṣadūṣyasvabhāvasya vyādheḥ| carake tu kaphavātajaiva vidārī paṭhitā; taduktaṃ- “jvarānvitāvaṅkṣaṇakakṣajā yā vartirnirartiḥ kaṭhināyatā ca| vidārikā syāt kaphamārutābhyām” (ca. ci. 12) iti| tatrāpi jvarānviteti vacanena pittamapyanumīyate| yaduktaṃ- “ūṣmā pittādṛte nāsti jvaro nāstyūṣmaṇā vinā” (vā. ci.1) iti| carake'pi pittavacanādvidārikā svalpapittādeva, svatantre paratantre'pi sarvajaivāvagamyate, vidārīcikitsite ca pittakaphaharavimlāpanādyukteḥ| ‘vidārīmiti tāṃ vidyāt sarvajāṃ sarvalakṣaṇām’ iti pāṭhāntare nāsti ko'pi vivādaḥ||24||-

prāpya māṃsasirāsnāyu śleṣmā medastathā'nilaḥ ||25|| granthiṃ kurvanti bhinno'sau madhusarpirvasānibham | sravatyāsrāvamatyarthaṃ ‘karoti’ tā. tatra vṛddhiṃ gato'nilaḥ ‘gataḥ punaḥ’ iti tā.||26|| māṃsaṃ viśoṣya grathitāṃ śarkarāṃ janayet ‘janayatyataḥ’ iti tā. punaḥ | durgandhaṃ klinnamatyarthaṃ nānāvarṇaṃ tataḥ sirāḥ ||27|| sravanti sahasā raktaṃ tadvidyāccharkarārbudam |28|

prāpyetyādi| iyaṃ śarkarāsamprāptiruktā, sā ca śarkarā hetuḥ śarkarārbudasya| kāṭhinyādeva śarkarāsādṛśyena śarkarā| atyagādhocchrāyābhyāmarbudam| nānāvarṇaṃ madhughṛtavasāsannibham| tata ityādi tataḥ śarkarāyāḥ sirā raktaṃ sravantītyarthaḥ| kecit śarkarā śarkarārbudaṃ ceti vyādhidvayaṃ vadanti; tannecchati gayī, saṅkhyātirekāccharkarāyāḥ pṛthaktvenokteradarśanācca||25-27||- prāpya māṃsetyādinā śarkarārbudam| tatra śarkarrāyāṃ kaphānilau doṣau, māṃsasirāsnāyumedāṃsi tu dūṣyāṇi, madhughṛtavasāsadṛśaḥ srāvaḥ| dhātukṣayeṇa vṛddhiṅgato'nilo māṃsaṃ viśoṣya grathitāṃ kaṭhināṃ śarkarāṃ karoti; kāṭhinyādeva śarkarāsādṛśyena śarkarā, avagāḍhocchrāyābhyāmarbudam| tata iti śarkarāyāḥ sirā raktaṃ sravanti| nānāvarṇaṃ madhughṛtavasāsannibhameva, prakrāntatvāt; tatrāntare'pyevamevoktatvāt| tathāhi bhojaḥ- “vāyuḥ śleṣmāṇamādāya medaḥsnāyusirāgataḥ| karoti viṣamaṃ granthiṃ jvaradāhasamanvitam|| avagāḍhaṃ sukaṭhinamarbudaṃ taṃ vidurbudhāḥ| tadeva bhinnaṃ durgandhaṃ ghṛtamedopamaṃ sirāḥ|| sravanti srāvamaniśaṃ tadā taṃ śarkarārbudam” iti| kecit śarkarā arbudaṃ ceti vyādhidvayamācakṣate| tanna, saṅkhyātirekāt, śarkarāyāḥ pṛthaktvenānukteḥ, adarśanācca||25-27||-

ab.seg: pāmāvicarcyau kuṣṭheṣu rakasā ca prakīrtitā ||28||
pāmetyādi| kuṣṭheṣviti kuṣṭhanidāne ityarthaḥ||28||
parikramaṇaśīlasya vāyuratyartharūkṣayoḥ | pādayoḥ kurute dārīṃ sarujāṃ talasaṃśritaḥ ||29||
parītyādi| parikramaṇaśīlasya sarvato bhramaṇasvabhāvasya| dārīmiti vipādikāṃ; ‘viśrāvāku’ iti loke||29||

paribhramaṇaśīlasyetyādinā pādadārī| paribhramaṇaśīlasya sarvato bhramaṇaśīlasya| anye tu vicarcikaiva sthānabhedena pādadārītyucyate vipādiketi ca| tasyāḥ kuṣṭhatvena sarvadoṣajatvaṃ sakrimitvaṃ ceti| pāmārakase tu kuṣṭhanirdiṣṭe kṣudraroge'pīti vākyaśeṣaḥ; tena punarnocyate, punaruktibhayādeva||29||
śarkaronmathite pāde kṣate vā kaṇṭakādibhiḥ | medoraktānugaiścaiva ‘granthiḥ kī(ko)lavadutsanno jāyate kadaraṃ tataḥ’ iti tā. doṣairvā jāyate nṛṇām ||30||
sakīlakaṭhino granthirnimnamadhyonnato'pi vā | kolamātraḥ saruk srāvī jāyate kadarastu saḥ ||31||
śarkaretyādi| śarkarā ghaṭakarparakhaṇḍādayaḥ, tābhirunmathite pīḍite| kīlena sadṛśaṃ sakīlamityavyayībhāvaḥ, sakīlaṃ cāsau kaṭhinaśca sakīlakaṭhinaḥ| ‘hastayorapi’ iti bhojaḥ||30-31||

śarkarābadarastu śarkaronmathite pāde ityādinā| kolavaditi badaravat| bhojābhiprāyeṇa hastayorapīcchanti| tathāhi bhojaḥ- “hastayoḥ pādayoścāpi gambhīrānugataṃ kharam| māṃsakīlaṃ janayataḥ kupitau kaphamārutau|| saśalyamapi taṃ deśaṃ manyate tena pīḍitaḥ| śarkarābadaraṃ kecinmanyante'nye ca kaṇṭakam” iti||30-31||
klinnāṅgulyantarau pādau kaṇḍūdāharuganvitau | duṣṭakardamasaṃsparśādalasaṃ taṃ vinirdiśet ||32||
klinnetyādi| ayaṃ kaphena saśoṇitena||32||
klinnāṅgulyantarau pādāvityādinā alasakaḥ| ayaṃ kaphena saśoṇitena; tatra kaṇḍūḥ kaphasya, śoṇitasya dāharuje||32||
romakūpānugaṃ pittaṃ vātena saha mūrcchitam | pracyāvayati romāṇi tataḥ śleṣmā saśoṇitaḥ ||33||
ruṇaddhi romakūpāṃstu tato'nyeṣāmasambhavaḥ | tadindraluptaṃ khālityaṃ rujyeti ca vibhāvyate ||34||
romakūpānugamityādi| khālityaṃ puṃsāmeva na tu yoṣitām| tathāca videhaḥ- “atyantasukumārāṅgyo rajo duṣṭaṃ sravanti ca| avyāyāmaratā yasmāttasmānna khalitiḥ striyāḥ” iti||33-34||

romakūpānugaṃ pittamityādinā indraluptaṃ; khālityaṃ rujyeti ca tasyaiva sañjñāntaram| tatra khālityaṃ puṃsāmeva, na tu yoṣitāṃ; tathāhi videhaḥ- “atyantasukumārāṅgyo rajo duṣṭaṃ sravanti ca| avyāpāraratā yasmāttasmānna khalitiḥ striyāḥ” iti| asyāyamabhiprāyaḥ- avyāpāreṇa vātapitte na prakupyete, tato na lomapracyavaḥ; rajo vimuktyā ca srotovarodhābhāvāccyutānāmapi punarviroha iti| indralupte bhojaḥ- “pittaṃ sirasi sanduṣṭaṃ lomakūpānugaṃ yadā| tadā romāṇi śīryante tatra śleṣmānilau śritau|| …tadindraluptamityāhuḥ khallīṃ ruhyāṃ ca kecana” iti||33-34||
dāruṇā kaṇḍurā rūkṣā keśabhūmiḥ prapāṭyate | kaphavātaprakopeṇa vidyāddāruṇakaṃ tu tam ||35||

dāruṇenyādi| dāruṇā kaṭhinā| kaṇḍurā kaṇḍūyuktā| prapāṭyate prakarṣeṇa pāṭyate ‘prapuṭyate puṭapuṭāyate’ iti pā.| pittarudhirayorapyanubandho jñeyaḥ, videhavacanān| dāruṇakaṃ ‘pahā ‘aupahā’ iti pā. ’ iti loke||35||

dāruṇā kaṇḍuretyādinā dāruṇakam| tasya kaphavātajasyāpi raktapittābhyāmanubandho videhavacanādeva jñeyaḥ| tathāhi videhaḥ- “yadabhrapaṭalābhāsamarajaskaṃ śirastvaci| pāruṣyaṃ jāyate jantostasya rūpaṃ viśeṣataḥ|| todaiḥ samanvitaṃ vātāt, sakaṇḍūgauravaṃ kaphāt| sapipāsaṃ sadāhārtirāgaṃ pittāttathā'sṛjaḥ” iti| tatrāpi sadāhaṃ pittāt, sārtirāgaṃ raktāt, ārtirhi śoṇitād bhavati| taduktaṃ carake- “raktaṃ hi vyamlatāṃ yāti tacca nāsti na cāsti ruk” (ca. ci. 5) iti| atra tu raktasya pittasya liṅgamanirdiṣṭamavasthāyāṃ draṣṭavyam||35||
arūṃṣi bahuvaktrāṇi bahukledīni mūrdhani | kaphāsṛkkṛmikopena ‘kaphāsṛkpittakopena’ iti tā. nṛṇāṃ vidyādaruṃṣikām ||36||
arūṃṣītyādi| arūṃṣi vraṇān||36||
arūṃṣi bahuvaktrāṇītyādinā aruṃṣikā||36||
krodhaśokaśramakṛtaḥ śarīroṣmā śirogataḥ | pittaṃ ca keśān pacati palitaṃ tena jāyate ||37||

krodhetyādi| krodhādikṛtena śarīroṣmaṇā śirogatena vaikṛtaṃ, pittena punaḥ prākṛtaṃ palitam; anyathā pittoṣmaṇorabhedāt punaruktidoṣaḥ syāt; pañjikākārastu “śarīroṣmā pāvakaḥ, pittaṃ tadāśrayaḥ, etau pittapāvakāvekībhūya keśān pacataḥ; etena kevaloṣmakṛtasya vaikṛtasyādoṣajaprasaṅgo nirākṛtaḥ” iti manyate||37||

krodhāyāsetyādinā palitam| atra śarīroṣmā pittaṃ ceti dvikartṛsamuccaya iti kecit; tadasamyak, bhedo hi- vaikṛtasya palitasya pācakapittoṣmakṛtatvāt, svābhāvikasya prākṛtapittakṛtatvāt; nanu tathā sati palitasyādoṣajaprasaṅgaḥ? na, ūṣmaṇaḥ pittadharmatvāt...tadyathā vaikṛtaḥ pittakṛtaḥ, samadoṣaprakṛtiṣu svābhāvikaḥ; tasmāt samuccitadvikartṛkatvaṃ nānenocyate| pittaprakṛtijaṃ svābhāvikameva, prakṛteralpadoṣatvenāvikāritvādityanekaśo vyākhyātameva||37||
dāhajvararujāvantastāmrāḥ sphoṭāḥ sapītakāḥ ‘savedanāḥ’ iti tā.| gātreṣu vadane cāntarvijñeyāstā masūrikāḥ ||38||

dāhetyādi| tāmratvena śoṇitānubandho'pyeṣāṃ; tathāhi tantrāntaraṃ- “pittaṃ śoṇitasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ yadā dūṣayati tvacam| tadā karoti piḍakāḥ sarvagātreṣu dehinaḥ|| masūramudgamāṣāṇāṃ tulyāḥ kolopamā api| masūrikāstu vijñeyāḥ piḍakā raktapittajāḥ”- iti| etāsāṃ ‘śītalikā’ iti lokāśrayā sañjñā||38||

dāhajvararujāvanta ityādinā masūrikāḥ| tāmratvasarujatvena śoṇitānubandho'pyeṣām|| tathāhi tantrāntare- “pittaṃ śoṇitasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ yadā dūṣayati tvacam| tadā karoti piḍikāṃ sarvagātreṣu dehinām|| masūramudgamāṣāṇāṃ tulyāḥ kolopamā api| masūrikāstu vijñeyāḥ piḍikāḥ pittaraktajāḥ” iti||38||
śālmalīkaṇṭakaprakhyāḥ kaphamārutaśoṇitaiḥ | jāyante piḍakā yūnāṃ vaktre yā ‘yuvānapiḍakā yūnāṃ vijñeyā’ iti tā. mukhadūṣikāḥ ||39||
śālmalītyādi| śālmalīkaṇṭakaprakhyāḥ śālmalīkaṇṭakasadṛśāḥ| yūnāṃ taruṇānām||39||
śālmalīkaṇṭakākārā ityādinā yuvānapiḍikāḥ| yūnāmānanaṃ yūvānanaṃ, tasya piḍikā yuvānapiḍikāḥ| pṛṣodarāderākṛtigaṇatvādekasya nakārasya lopaḥ| mukhe pacante ata eva mukhadūṣikā iti||39||
kaṇṭakairācitaṃ vṛttaṃ ‘vidyānmaṇḍalaṃ pāṇḍu kaṇḍuram’ iti tā. kaṇḍūmat pāṇḍumaṇḍalam | padminīkaṇṭakaprakhyaistadākhyaṃ kaphavātajam ||40||
kaṇṭakairityādi| padminīkaṇṭakaprakhyaiḥ padminīkaṇṭakasadṛśaiḥ| ācitaṃ vyāptam| tadākhyaṃ padminīkaṇṭakākhyam||40||
kaṇṭakairācitamityādinā padminīkaṇṭakam| padminīkaṇṭakavadākhyā yasya tat padminīkaṇṭakākhyam||40||
nīrujaṃ samamutsannaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kapharaktajam | sahajaṃ raktamīṣacca ‘lakṣma caikeṣāṃ lakṣyo jatumaṇīti saḥ’ iti tā. ślakṣṇaṃ jatumaṇiṃ viduḥ ||41||
nīrujamityādi| samaṃ sūkṣmam| utsannamunnatam| sahajaṃ janmabalapravṛttam| ślakṣṇamakarkaśam| jatumaṇiḥ ‘jadula’ iti lokāśrayā tatsañjñā||41||

samamutsannamarujamityādinā jatumaṇiḥ| tasya jaṭula iti lokāśrayā sañjñā| ekeṣāmācāryāṇāṃ matena tu lakṣaṇaṃ strīpuruṣayoraṅgabhedena suphalapradam| sahajaṃ janmabalapravṛttamityarthaḥ| samamutsannamapi ślakṣṇaṃ yato'vaiṣamyakarkaśamityarthaḥ| tathā hi bhojaḥ- “jaṭulaṃ sahajaṃ raktaṃ śleṣmaśoṇitasambhavam| ślakṣṇaṃ ca samudīrṇaṃ ca vidyājjatumaṇiṃ bhiṣak” iti| tathā vaitaraṇe'pi “kṛṣṇaḥ śuklo jatumaṇirjñeyo vātottaraistribhiḥ| arujaṃ tvaparaṃ raktaṃ lakṣmetyāhurbhiṣagvarāḥ” iti||41||
avedanaṃ sthiraṃ caiva yasya gātreṣu dṛśyate | māṣavatkṛṣṇamutsannamanilānmaṣakaṃ vadet ||42||
avedanamityādi| sthiraṃ kaṭhinam||42||

māṣaśabdāt “ive pratikṛtau” (pā. a. 5/3/96) iti kanpratyayaḥ| pṛṣodarāditvānmāṣaśabdākārasya hrasvatvam| sthiraṃ kaṭhinam| atrāpi kaphavātamedobhireva maṣakamārabhyate| taduktaṃ bhoje- “vāterite tvaci yadā pravṛddhe kaphamedasī| ślakṣṇaṃ mṛdu savarṇaṃ ca kuruto maṣakaṃ vadet” iti| atrāpi ślakṣṇatā vāyorlabhyata eva||42||
kṛṣṇāni tilamātrāṇi nīrujāni samāni ca | vātapittakaphocchoṣāttān ‘vātapittakaphodrekāt’ iti pā. vidyāttilakālakān ||43||

kṛṣṇānītyādi| vātapittakaphocchoṣāditi vātapittābhyāṃ kaphasya śoṣādityarthaḥ| anye tu “vātapittāsṛgucchoṣāt” iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- vātapittābhyāṃ raktasya śoṣādityarthaḥ; ata eva tilakālake kārṣṇyam| ‘vātapittakaphodrekāt’ iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ, tasmin pāṭhe kaphodrekalakṣaṇaṃ tilakālake nāsti||43||

kṛṣṇāni tilamātrāṇītyādinā tilakālakaḥ| ‘vātapittakaphocchoṣāt’ iti kecit paṭhanti; anye tu ‘vātapittāsṛgucchoṣāt’ iti paṭhanti| atra vātapittābhyāṃ raktaśoṣaḥ; tathāhi carakaḥ- “yasya pittaṃ prakupitaṃ śoṇitaṃ prāpya śuṣyati| tilakāḥ piplavo vyaṅgā nīlikā cāsya jāyate” (ca. sū. 18) iti| anye tu ‘vātapittakaphodrekāt’ iti paṭhanti| tathā hi tantrāntaraṃ- “mārutaḥ pittamādāya kapharaktasamāśritaḥ| karoti tilamātrāṇi tvaci te tilakālakāḥ” iti| anenāpi tantrāntarārthenāyameva pāṭhaḥ| vātapittakaphocchoṣāditi vātapittāśritayoḥ kaphapittayorucchoṣa eva yato bhavati; ata eva tilakālake pittotpatteḥ (?) tathāhi kaphodrekasya lakṣaṇaṃ kimatra bhaviṣyati||43||
maṇḍalaṃ mahadalpaṃ vā śyāmaṃ vā yadi vā sitam | sahajaṃ nīrujaṃ gātre nyacchamityabhidhīyate ||44||
maṇḍalamityādi| sahajaṃ janmabalapravṛttam| nyacchaṃ lokā lāñchanamiti vadanti; pittaraktānvito vāyurasya kāraṇam||44||

mahadvā yadi vā svalpamityādinā nyacchaḥ| ‘sahajaṃ maṇḍalaṃ’ iti kecidadhīyate| teṣāṃ mate janmabalapravṛttaṃ nyaccham, ata eva nyacchasya paryāye tairuktaṃlāñchanamiti| pittaraktānvito vāyurasya kāraṇaṃ, śyāvānvitatvrānnyacchasyeti||44||

div.ab: samutthānanidānābhyāṃ carmakīlaṃ prakīrtitam |45|
samutthānetyādi| samutthānaṃ samprāptiḥ, nidānaṃ hetulakṣaṇanirdeśaḥ| gayī tu samutthānanidānābhyāmityādi carmakīlapratipādakaṃ vākyameva na paṭhati|45|-
krodhāyāsaprakupito vāyuḥ pittena saṃyutaḥ ||45|| sahasā mukhamāgatya maṇḍalaṃ visṛjatyataḥ | nīrujaṃ tanukaṃ śyāvaṃ mukhe vyaṅgaṃ tamādiśet ||46|| kṛṣṇamevaṅguṇaṃ gātre mukhe vā nīlikāṃ viduḥ |47|

krodhetyādi| “vyaṅgameva sthānāntareṇa varṇāntareṇa ca nīlikā” ityanye||45-46||- krodhāyāsaprakupito vāyurityādinā vyaṅgaḥ| asyaiva nīliketi loke khyātiḥ| tatra tantrāntare “mārutaḥ krodhaharṣābhyāmūrdhvago mukhamāśritaḥ| pittena saha saṃyuktaḥ karoti vadane tvaci|| nīrujaṃ tanukaṃ śyāvaṃ taṃ vyaṅgamiti nirdiśet| kṛṣṇāmevaṅguṇaṃ gātre nīlikāṃ tāṃ vinirdiśet” iti||45-46||-

mardanāt pīḍanāccāti tathaivāpyabhighātataḥ | meḍhracarma yadā vāyurbhajate sarvataścaraḥ ||47|| tadā vātopasṛṣṭaṃ tu carma pratinivartate | maṇeradhastāt kośaśca granthirūpeṇa lambate ||48|| savedanaḥ sadāhaśca pākaṃ ca vrajati kvacit | mārutāgantusambhūtāṃ vidyāttāṃ parivartikām ‘parivartiketi tāṃ vidyāt sarujāṃ vātasambhavām’ iti tā.||49|| sakaṇḍūḥ kaṭhinā cāpi saiva śleṣmasamutthitā |50|

mardanādityādi| atīti mardanapīḍanābhyāṃ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate; samyakkṛtau hi mardanapīḍanau vāyupraśāntikarāveva bhavataḥ| bhajate āśrayati| sarvataścaro vāyurvyānaḥ| carma pratinivartata iti maṇiṃ vihāya sarvato vyāghuṭatītyarthaḥ| kośaḥ carmakośaḥ| saiva parivartiketyarthaḥ||47-49||- mardanādityādi| atyarthamardanāt pīḍanādvā tathā'bhighātādvā sarvataścaro vāyurvyāno meḍhracarma bhajate; atīti pīḍanamardanayorviśeṣaṇaṃ, tayorhi samyakkṛtayorvāyoreva praśamanatvāt; atyarthakaraṇāttayorabhighātāt kalāyāścarmaṇo dūṣakatvāt| carmavātopasṛṣṭatvāt parivartate| carma koṣacarma| parivartiketi paripūrvādvṛteḥ ṇvul| sakaṇḍūḥ kaṭhinā caiva saiva śleṣmānubandhataḥ| tathāhi bhoje- “maṇeradho meḍhracarma vyānastu parivartayet| saśūlatodadāhādyairvijñeyā parivartikā|| ślaiṣmikī kaṭhinā stabdhā kaṇḍūmatyalpavedanā” iti||47-49||-

alpīyaḥkhāṃ ‘alpīyasīṃ yadā harṣādbalādgacchet’ iti pā. yadā harṣādbālāṃ gacchet striyaṃ naraḥ ||50|| hastābhighātādathavā carmaṇyudvartite balāt | mardanātpīḍanādvā'pi śukravegavighātataḥ ||51|| yasyāvapāṭyate carma tāṃ vidyādavapāṭikām |52|

alpīyaḥkhāmityādi| alpīyaḥkhām alpatarayonidvārām| carmaṇyudvartite uttānībhūya vyāghuṭite| yasya carma mardanādibhiravapāṭyate vidīryate tasya tāmavapāṭikāṃ vidyādityarthaḥ| carma kartṛ| udvartate niścitamūrdhvaṃ pravartata ityanye||50-51||- kanyā punaranārtavā'lpatarayonidvāratvādevālpīyaḥkhetyucyate| tatra pakṣāntaraṃ hastābhighātādathavā carmaṇyudvartite; udvartite ūrdhvaṃ pravartite| yasyāvapāṭyate ‘svayaṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ; tenāvadīryate| iyaṃ doṣaistribhirapyanuvartate| tathā hi bhojaḥ- “mardanādabhighātādvā kanyāyoniprapīḍanāt| lakṣyate yadi meḍhrasya carma darbhairiva kṣatam|| avapāṭiketi tāṃ vidyāt pṛthagdoṣaiḥ samanvitām| vātāt saparuṣā rūkṣā tathā nistodakārikā|| pittāt sapītā raktādvā dāhatṛṣṇāsamanvitā| ślaiṣmikī kaṭhinā snigdhā kaṇḍūmatyalpavedanā” iti||50-51||-

ab.seg: vātopasṛṣṭamevaṃ tu carma saṃśrayate maṇim ||52||
maṇiścarmopanaddhastu ‘carmoparuddhastu’ iti tā. mūtrasroto ruṇaddhi ca | niruddhaprakaśe tasminmandadhāramavedanam ‘savedanam’ iti tā.||53||
mūtraṃ pravartate jantormaṇirna ‘maṇirvivriyate na ca’ iti pā. ca vidīryate | niruddhaprakaśaṃ vidyāddurūḍhāṃ ‘sarujaṃ vātasambhavam’ iti pā. cāvapāṭikām ||54||
vātopasṛṣṭamityādi| evamiti mardanapīḍanābhighātādinetyarthaḥ| saṃśrayate samagraṃ śrayate| durūḍhāṃ cāvapāṭikāmiti avapāṭikā'pi durūḍhā niruddhaprakāśākhyāṃ labhate||52-54||

vātopasṛṣṭe meḍhre ityādinā niruddhaprakaśaḥ| evamityatipīḍanābhighātādinā pūrvavat| saṃśrayate samagraṃ śrayate| avapāṭikaiva ca durūḍhā saṅkucitatvāccarmaṇo niruddhaprakāśo bhavati| mandadhāramadenamantardoṣābādhāt tasmin mandadhārā pravartate, maṇiśca nātivivṛto bhavet| atraiva bhojaḥ- “meḍhrānte carmaṇi yadā mārutaḥ kupito bhṛśam| dvāraṃ ruṇaddhi ca śanaiḥ prakāśastu muhurbhavet|| mūtraṃ mūtrayate kṛcchrāt prakāśastu yadā bhavet| vātopasṛṣṭameḍhrastu maṇirna ca vidīryate|| niruṇaddhi prakāśaṃ taṃ vidyādvyādhiṃ sudāruṇam” iti||52-54||
vegasandhāraṇādvāyurvihato gudamāśritaḥ | niruṇaddhi mahatsrotaḥ sūkṣmadvāraṃ karoti ca ||55||
mārgasya saukṣmyāt kṛcchreṇa purīṣaṃ tasya gacchati | sanniruddhagudaṃ vyādhimenaṃ vidyāt sudustaram ||56||
vegasandhāraṇādityādi| vihato niruddhagatiḥ| mahatsroto gudam||55-56||
gudaṃ meḍhrānantaraṃ nirdiśannāha- vegasandhāraṇādityādi| mahatsrotaḥ gudam| niruddhaprakāśavadatrāpi gudacarmasaṅkocāt sanniruddhagudatvam||55-56||
śakṛnmūtrasamāyukte'dhaute'pāne śiśorbhavet | svinnasyāsnāpyamānasya kaṇḍū raktakaphodbhavā ||57||
kaṇḍūyanāttataḥ kṣipraṃ sphoṭāḥ srāvaśca jāyate | ekībhūtaṃ vraṇairghoraṃ taṃ vidyādahipūtanam ||58||

śakṛdityādi| śakṛnmūtrasamāyukte'pāne gude, adhaute akriyamāṇaśauce, śiśo raktakaphodbhavā kaṇḍūrbhavediti sambandhaḥ| kathambhūtasya? svinnasya asnāpyamānasya ca| ekībhūtamapānaṃ vraṇaiḥ ‘saha’ ityadhyāhāryam| ahipūtanaṃ kapharaktajaṃ jñeyam||57-58||

sakṛnmūtretyādinā'hipūtanā| apāne gude svinne śiśorasnāpyamāne akriyamāṇe śauce svedamalotkledena kaṇḍūyanaṃ kapharaktadoṣeṇa sphoṭāśca jāyante| jāyante iti vakṣyamāṇavacanavipariṇāmāt| ekībhūtaṃ vraṇaiḥ ‘saha’ ityādhyāhāryam| sanniruddhagudaviparīto'yaṃ, vraṇaiḥ sahaikībhāvena gudasyātivivṛtatvāt| atra bhojaḥ- “duṣṭastanyasya pānena malasyādhāvanena ca| kaṇḍūdāharujāvadbhiḥ piḍakābhiḥ samācitaḥ|| ahipūtanako nāma yathādoṣaṃ sudāruṇaḥ” iti||57-58||
snānotsādanahīnasya malo vṛṣaṇasaṃśritaḥ | yadā praklidyate svedāt kaṇḍūṃ sañjanayettadā ||59||
tatra kaṇḍūyanāt kṣipraṃ sphoṭāḥ srāvaśca jāyate | prāhurvṛṣaṇakacchūṃ tāṃ śleṣmaraktaprakopajām ||60||
snānotsādanetyādi| utsādanam udvartanam||59-60||
snānotsādanetyādinā vṛṣaṇakacchūḥ| ahipūtanavadvṛṣaṇakacchurapi kapharaktodbhavā||59-60||

pravāhaṇātisārābhyāṃ nirgacchati gudaṃ bahiḥ | rūkṣadurbaladehasya taṃ gudabhraṃśamādiśet asyāgre tāḍapatrapustake ‘ityevaṃ kṣudrarogāṇāṃ sthānaṃ samparikīrtitam| tadavekṣya bhiṣak prājño yathādoṣamupācaret’ ityadhikaḥ śloka upalabhyate||61||
pravāhaṇetyādi| pravāhaṇaṃ prakarṣeṇa nirvāhaṇam| ayaṃ vātakopajaḥ||61||

pravāhaṇātisarābhyāmityādinā gudabhraṃśaḥ| pravāhaṇaṃ prakarṣeṇa nirvāhaṇaṃ; ‘vāha’ prayatne, ityasmāt pravāhaṇamiti rūpam| ativegodīraṇena vātakopaḥ punaratisaraṇena dhātukṣayāt| rūkṣadurbaladehasyeti ubhayatra yojanīyam| carake bhojādiṣu punaratīsāre eva gudabhraṃśaḥ paṭhitaḥ||61||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne kṣudraroganidānaṃ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||13||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nidānasthāne trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ||13||
iti sauśrute śalyatantre śrīgayadāsaviracitāyāṃ nyāyacandrikākhyāyāṃ pañjikāyāṃ nidānasthāne kṣudrarogāṇāṃ nidānam||13||

div.head: śūkadoṣanidānam

ab.seg: athātaḥ śūkadoṣanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

athāta ityādi| śūkadoṣanidānamiti atrādiśabdo luptanirdiṣṭo draṣṭavyaḥ, tena śūkādidoṣanidānamityarthaḥ; ādiśabdācca duṣṭayonigūḍhāntarlomayonidurbhagāgamanamabhighātaścābhipretaḥ| tannecchati gayī, duṣṭayonyādīnāmupadaṃśahetutvāt| śūkaḥ sajantujalamalaḥ, liṅgavṛddhikaro yogo vā; doṣo'tra duṣṭiḥ, asamyakkaraṇādvaikṛtam; athavā doṣo vātādiḥ, vātādikṛto vā vikāraḥ; teṣāṃ lakṣaṇasyaiva nirdeśānnidānaṃ, na tu hetoḥ; hetuḥ punaratra śūka eva, sa ca pratijñāsūtreṇaivābhihitaḥ||1-2||

kṣudrarogānantaraṃ kṣudratvasāmānyāt parivartikādimeḍhrarogapratyāsannatvena ca śūkadoṣanidānārambhaḥ| śūkojalaśūkaḥ, ādipadalopāt| sa tu sajantujalamalaḥ; liṅgavṛddhikarayogo vā, śūkapradhānatvāt| śūkavalliṅgavṛddhikaratvādanyo'pi śūkasamaḥ śūkaḥ, tena vā tasya vā doṣo'tra duṣṭirasamyakkaraṇādvaikṛtam; athavā doṣo vātādiḥ vātādikṛtavikāro vā; doṣaśabdo hi vātādiṣu tatkṛtavyādhiṣvapi vartate, “doṣā api vyādhiśabdaṃ labhante” iti vacanāt| teṣāṃ lakṣaṇasyaiva nirdeśānnidānaṃ, na tu hetoḥ; hetuḥ punaratra śūkadoṣa eva, tasyāpi ca pratipādanamātranirdeśānnidānam||1-2||

liṅgavṛddhimicchatāmakramapravṛttānāṃ śūkadoṣanimittā daśa cāṣṭau ca vyādhayo jāyante | tadyathā sarṣapikā, aṣṭhīlikā, grathitaṃ, kumbhīkā, alajī, mṛditaṃ, sammūḍhapiḍakā, avamanthaḥ, puṣkarikā, sparśahāniḥ, uttamā, śataponakaḥ, tvakpākaḥ, śoṇitārbudaṃ, māṃsārbudaṃ, māṃsapākaḥ, vidradhiḥ, tilakālakaśceti ||3||

teṣāṃ śūkadoṣajānāṃ vyādhīnāṃ sāmānyāṃ samprāptimāha- liṅgetyādi| liṅgavṛddhiḥ sthūlīkaraṇam; āyāmapariṇāhābhyāmityanye āyāmapariṇāhavṛddhirityanye’ iti pā.| vātsyāyanādyuktaliṅgavṛddhikarayogasya ‘… liṅgavṛddhivyatirikto’ iti pā. akramo'nācāraḥ; ‘uttarabastikarmaṇo'nācāra’ ityanye, tannecchati gayī| saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva saṅkhyāyāṃ labdhāyāmaṣṭādaśavacanaṃ saṅkhyeyanirdeśabhrāntinirāsārtham||3||

teṣāṃ śūkadoṣajānāṃ sāmānyāṃ samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- liṅgavṛddhimicchatāmityādinā| vṛddhiḥ sthūlīkaraṇam; āyāmapariṇāhavṛddhirityanye| kramavirodho akramaḥ, nañatra virodhārthaḥ| śūkadoṣanimittāḥ śūkadoṣā eva nimittaṃ kāraṇaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| śūkadoṣa eva nimittamatrocyate, na tu yonidoṣādaya upadaṃśahetava iti| tena ādipadalopasya prayojanameva nāsti| teṣāṃ liṅgavṛddhividhīnāṃ vātsyāyanādau vistara aupaniṣadike draṣṭavyaḥ| tathāhi- “bhallātakāsthijalaśūkamathābjapatramantarvidahya matimān saha saindhavena| etadvirūḍhabṛhatīphalatoyapiṣṭamālepanaṃ mahiṣaviḍvimalīkṛte'ṅge| sthūlaṃ bṛhadvaraturaṅgamatulyamāśu śephaḥ karotyabhimataṃ nahi saṃśayo'sti”| evamādīnāṃ duravacāraṇaṃ śūkadoṣajānāṃ nidānam| anye tu manyante'trāpacārastrividhaḥ- praṇidhānāśrayaḥ, parikarmāśrayaḥ, puruṣāśrayaśca; tathā hi bhālukiḥ- “ekonaviṃśatiḥ śūkadoṣāḥ- praṇidhānadoṣāt, parikarmadoṣāt, puruṣadoṣācca”| tanna, tantreṣu sarveṣvadarśanāt| saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva saṅkhyāyāṃ labdhāyāmaṣṭādaśavacanaṃ sammūḍhapiḍakādīnāṃ samāsanirdeśabhrāntinirāsārtham||3||
gaurasarṣapatulyā tu śūkadurbhagnahetukā | piḍakā kapharaktābhyāṃ jñeyā sarṣapikā budhaiḥ ||4||
śūkadurbhagnahetuketi duravacāritaśūkahetuketyarthaḥ| anye ‘śūkadurbhagahetukā’ iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- śūko duṣṭabhagaśca heturyasyāḥ sā tathā| tannecchati gayī||4||
śūkadurbhagahetuketi kecit paṭhanti| tanna, teṣāmanupadaṃśatvāt||4||
kaṭhinā viṣamairantairmārutasya prakopataḥ | śūkaistu viṣasambhugnaiḥ ‘viṣasaṃyuktaiḥ’ iti pā. piḍakā'ṣṭhīlikā bhavet ‘kaṭhinā viṣamā bha(bhu)gnairvoyunā'ṣṭhīlikā bhavet iti tā.||5||

kaṭhinetyādi| śūkairaṣṭhīlikā bhavediti sambandhaḥ| viṣamaiḥ apraśastaiḥ| antairiti ko'rthaḥ; patitaiḥ| anye tu “viṣamairantairupalakṣitā” iti vyācakṣate; etena viṣamāntasahitetyuktam| viṣasambhugnaiḥ viṣeṇa kṛtvā vakrairityarthaḥ||5||

kaṭhinetyādinā aṣṭhīlikā| kaṭhinā viṣamairbhugnairiti parasparāsaktaiḥ; anye punaratraiva viṣamairlakṣyamāṇairityācakṣate| duḥkhacāritaśūkadoṣahetuḥ punaratra sarvatraivotsarganyāyenāsti| aṣṭhīlikā aṣṭhīlā nāma lohakārāṇāṃ lauhī dīrghavartulā bhāṇḍiḥ||5||

div.ab: śūkairyat pūritaṃ śaśvadgrathitaṃ tat ‘nāma tat kaphāt’ iti tā. kaphotthitam |6|
śūkairityādi| śaśvat pratidinam, etenaikadināntarapūraṇaṃ praśastamicchanti kāmatantrācāryāḥ; nityapūraṇādgrathitanāmno rogasyotpattiḥ|6|- śūkairyat pūritamityādinā grathitam|6|-

ab.seg: kumbhīkā raktapittotthā jāmbavāsthinibhā'śubhā ||6||

kumbhīketyādi| kumbhīkā kumbhīphalamiva| aśubheti śubhā śuklā, tadvirodhenāśubhā kṛṣṇetyarthaḥ| iyamapi duravacāritaśūkajā| ‘āśujā’ iti kecit paṭhanti; tatra śūkapātānantaraṃ śīghraṃ jāyata ityarthaḥ||6||
kumbhīkāḥ kumbhyāḥ phalaṃ kumbhī, phale luk (pā. a. 4/2/163) iti taddhitasya luk, ‘ive prakṛtau’ (pā. a. 5/3/96) iti kan| aśubheti śubhaṃ śuklaṃ, tadvirodhe nañ, tena kṛṣṇetyarthaḥ||6||
alajīlakṣaṇairyuktāmalajīṃ ‘tulyajāṃ tvalajīṃ vidyādyathāproktāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ’ iti tā. ca vitarkayet | mṛditaṃ pīḍitaṃ yattu saṃrabdhaṃ vāyukopataḥ ||7||

alajīlakṣaṇaiḥ pramehapiḍakālajīlakṣaṇairityarthaḥ| iyamapi duṣṭaśūkāvacāraṇājjñeyā| yat punarliṅgaṃ pātitaśūkaṃ sat hastābhyāṃ bhṛśapīḍitam, ata eva vātakopataḥ saṃrabdhaṃ saśophaṃ, tanmṛditākhyarogākrāntaṃ jñeyam||7||

alajīlakṣaṇairityādinā alajī| alajīlakṣaṇairiti pramehapiḍikālakṣaṇairiti śeṣaḥ| sā ca raktā'sitā sphoṭāvṛtetyādinā tulyalakṣaṇā| tatra pramehe jāyamānā pramehadoṣādadhaḥkāye eva viśeṣeṇa, śūkadoṣajā tu raktapittadoṣajā liṅgajaiva| pātitaśūkaṃ liṅgaṃ pāṇibhyāṃ bhṛśaṃ pīḍitaṃ mṛditaṃ; vyādhināmedam||7||

div.ab: pāṇibhyāṃ bhṛśasammūḍhe sammūḍhapiḍakā bhavet |8|

bhṛśasammūḍhe atyarthapiccitāvanate, ‘pātitaśūke liṅge’ ityadhyāhāryam| sammūḍhapiḍakā mṛditaṃ ca vātaraktāt|8|- pātitaśūke liṅge pāṇibhyāṃ bhṛśasammūḍhe piccitāvanate; sammūḍhapiḍakā mṛditaṃ ca vātaraktābhyām|8|-
dīrghā bahvyaśca piḍakā dīryante madhyatastu yāḥ ||8|| so'vamanthaḥ kaphāsṛgbhyāṃ vedanāromaharṣakṛt |9|

bahvyaḥ prabhūtāḥ| avamantho'pi sthūlīkaraṇaśūkakarmāpacāreṇa jñeyaḥ||8||- dīrghā bahvya ityādinā'vamanthaḥ| atra bhālukiḥ- “avamanthakagrasto yo madhye dīrghavidāritaḥ| piḍakābhirbhaved vyāptaḥ śūkakarmāpacārataḥ” iti| sthūlīkaraṇaśūkakarmāpacāraja ityarthaḥ||8||-
pittaśoṇitasambhūtā piḍakā piḍakācitā ||9|| padmapuṣkarasaṃsthānā ‘padmakarṇikasaṃsthānā’ iti tā. jñeyā puṣkariketi sā |10|
padmapuṣkaraṃ padmakarṇikā| eṣā'pi śūkakarmāpacārajā jñeyā||9||- piḍaketyādinā puṣkarikā| padmapuṣkaravat puṣkarikā||9||-

ab.seg: janayet sparśahāniṃ tu śoṇitaṃ śūkadūṣitam ||10||
janayedityādi| sparśahāniṃ sparśahānināmānaṃ vyādhiviśeṣam| śūkadūṣitaṃ śūkena duṣṭiṃ nītam||10||
śūkadoṣādityutsarganyāyena, sparśahāniḥ||10||
mudgamāṣopamā raktā piḍakā raktapittajā | uttamaiṣā ‘vyādhireṣottamo nāma śūkājīrṇanimittajaḥ’ iti tā. tu vijñeyā śūkājīrṇanimittajā ||11||

mudgetyādi| uttamā vyādhiviśeṣaḥ| śūkājīrṇanimittajeti śūkājīrṇaṃ punaḥ punarduravacāritaśūkavikṛtilakṣaṇa eva pariṇāmaḥ, tadeva nimittaṃ, tato jāteti; anye tu “śūkājīrṇaṃ śūkenājīrṇaṃ pratikṣaṇapātitaśūkanimittābhyāṃ raktapitābhyāṃ jāyate” ityāhuḥ||11||
mudgamāṣopametyādinottamā| śūkājīrṇaṃ duravacāritaśūkasalakṣaṇa eva pariṇāmaḥ, tadena nimittaṃ, tato jātā||11||
chidrairaṇumukhairvastu ‘chidrairaṇumukhairliṅgaṃ’ iti, ‘chidrairaṇumukhairyattu citaṃ meḍhraṃ’ iti ca pā. citaṃ yasya samantataḥ | vātaśoṇitajo vyādhirvijñeyaḥ śataponakaḥ ||12||
chidrairityādi| chidraiḥ duravacāritaśūkanimittavātaśoṇitajaiḥ| vastu adhiṣṭhānamityarthaḥ||12||
chidrairaṇumukhairityādinā śataponakaḥ| chidraiḥ duravacāritaśūkanimittavātaśoṇitajaiḥ| citamupacitaṃ, cikitsite lekhanopadeśāt||12||

div.ab: pittaraktakṛto ‘vātapittakṛtaḥ’ iti pā. jñeyastvakpāko jvaradāhavān |13|

pittaraktetyādi| pittaraktakṛta iti duravacāritaśūkajanitapittaśoṇitaja ityarthaḥ| gayī tu duravacāritaśūkadūṣitavātapittaja ityāhaḥ|13|- vātapittaja ityādinā tvakpākaḥ| duravacaritaśūkadūṣitavātapittajaḥ|13|-

ab.seg: kṛṣṇauḥ sphoṭaiḥ saraktaiśca piḍakābhiśca pīḍitam ‘dūṣitam’ iti pā.| yasya vastu rujaścogrā jñeyaṃ tacchoṇitārbudam ||13||
kṛṣṇairityādi| yasya vastu adhiṣṭhānaṃ sphoṭaiḥ piḍakābhiśca pīḍitaṃ bhavati tacchoṇitārbudaṃ jñeyamiti sambandhaḥ| ayamapi duravacāritaśūkebhyaḥ||13||

div.ab: māṃsadoṣeṇa jānīyādarbudaṃ māṃsasambhavam |14|

māṃsetyādi| māṃsadoṣeṇa māṃsavṛddhyā| idamapi duravacāritaśūke liṅge prahārādibhirjāyate|14|- sphoṭairityādinā śoṇitārbudam| ya vastu vraṇavastu tadavagādhocchritamāṃsaśothatvādarbudam| duravacāritaśūke liṅge prahārādibhirmāṃsadoṣeṇetyarthaḥ||14|-
śīryante yasya māṃsāni yatra sarvāśca vedanāḥ ||14|| vidyāttaṃ māṃsapākaṃ tu sarvadoṣakṛtaṃ bhiṣak |15|

śīryante galanti| eṣo'pi duravacāritaśūkadūṣitadoṣajaḥ||14||- śīryante yasyetyādinā māṃsapākaḥ| duravacāritaśūkadūṣitadoṣatrayakṛtasya māṃsapākasya śīryante māṃsāni galanti| sarvā vedanā todadāhakaṇḍvādikāḥ| duravavāritaśūkadūṣitadoṣatrayajaḥ||14||-

ab.seg: vidradhiṃ sannipātena yathoktamabhinirdiśet ||15||
vidradhimityādi| ayamapi duravacāritaśūkadūṣitadoṣatrayajaḥ||15||
vidradhiḥ sānnipātikavidradhilakṣaṇānyevātra jānīyāt| sa tu ‘nānāvarṇarujāsrāva’ (ni. 9) ityādilakṣaṇena vidradhinā vijñeyaḥ||15||
kṛṣṇāni citrāṇyathavā śūkāni saviṣāṇi ca | pātitāni pacantyāśu meḍhraṃ niravaśeṣataḥ ||16||
kālāni bhūtvā māṃsāni śīryante yasya dehinaḥ | sannipātasamutthānaṃ taṃ vidyāttilakālakam ||17||
kṛṣṇānītyādi| kṛṣṇāni kṛṣṇavarṇāni| citrāṇi śuklapītanīlādivarṇānītyarthaḥ| kālāni pariṇatatilaphalavarṇāni| śīryante galanti||16-17||
kṛṣṇānītyādinā tilakālakaḥ| kṛṣṇāni kṛṣṇavarṇāni| citrāṇyathaveti śuklapītanīlādivarṇānītyarthaḥ| kṛṣṇāni pariṇatatilaphalavarṇāni| viśīryante galanti||16-17||
tatra māṃsārbudaṃ yacca māṃsapākaśca yaḥ smṛtaḥ | vidradhiśca na sidhyanti ye ca syustilakālakāḥ ||18||
śūkadoṣajānāmasādhyānnirdiśannāha- tatretyādi| ye ceti cakārāt kadācit sidhyantītyuktam||18||
śūkadoṣajānāmasādhyānnirdiśannāha- tatra māṃsārbudaṃ yaccetyādi| yacceti cakāro bhinnakrame na siddhyanti cetyatra draṣṭavyaḥ, tena cikitsite tu pratyākhyāyopacaraṇam||18||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne śūkadoṣanidānaṃ nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||14||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nidānasthāne caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ||14||
iti sauśrute śalyatantre nidānasthāne śrīgayadāsaviracitāyāṃ nyāyacandrikākhyāyāṃ pañjikāyāṃ śūkadoṣāṇāṃ nidānam||14||

div.head: bhagnanidānam

ab.seg: athāto bhagnānāṃ nidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi||1-2||
atha śūkadoṣānantaraṃ bhagnanidānaṃ hetulakṣaṇanirdeśaḥ, āgantusādharmyādubhayoḥ||1-2||
patanapīḍanaprahārākṣepaṇavyālamṛgadaśanaprabhṛtibhirabhighātaviśeṣairanekavidhamasthnāṃ bhaṅgamupadiśanti ‘bhagnamupadiśanti’ iti pā.||3||

bhagnānāṃ hetuṃ nirdiśannāha- patanapīḍanetyādi| prahāro muṣṭilaguḍakṛpāṇabāṇādīnām, ākṣepaṇamatiśayena cālanaṃ, vyālamṛgadaśanaṃ vyāghrādibhakṣaṇaṃ, prabhṛtigrahaṇādbalavadvigrahādīnāmavarodhaḥ| anekavidhaṃ bahuprakāram||3||
tatra prathamaṃ bhagnānāṃ hetumeva darśayannāha- prapatanapīḍanetyādi| praharaṇaṃ prahāraḥ muṣṭilaguḍakṛpāṇabāṇādīnāṃ; prabhṛtigrahaṇāt balavadvigrahādīnāmavarodhaḥ||3||
tatra ‘tattu’ iti pā. bhaṅga(gna)jātamanekavidhamanusāryamāṇaṃ dvividhamevopapadyate sandhimuktaṃ, kāṇḍabhagnaṃ ca | tatra ṣaḍvidhaṃ sandhimuktaṃ, dvādaśavidhaṃ kāṇḍabhagnaṃ bhavati ||4||

teṣāṃ dvaividhyamāha- tatretyādi| bhagnajātamiti jātaṃ samūhaḥ| anusāryamāṇam anusartuṃ preryamāṇam| ‘anuśriyamāṇaṃ’ ityeke paṭhanti| sandhimuktakāṇḍabhagnayorlakṣaṇamāha- tatra parvaṇītyādi; ayaṃ pāṭho'bhāvānna likhito na ca vyākhyātaḥ||4||

teṣāṃ bhagnānāṃ saṅkṣepeṇa lakṣaṇacikitsārthaṃ viśiṣṭavyādhidvayena dvaividhyameva darśayannāha- tattu bhagnajātamityādi| anekavidhaṃ bahuprakāraṃ bhagnānāṃ jātaṃ, patanādihetūnāmeva nānāvidhatvena tajjanitotpiṣṭādīnāmapi pratyekameva bahuprakāratvāt| ‘anuśriyamāṇaṃ’ ityeke paṭhanti, ‘anusāryamāṇaṃ’ ityanye| pūrvapakṣatvādinā prayojakena tu sarvatra yujyamānamiti(?)| tadeva dvaividhyaṃ darśayannāha- sandhimuktamityādi| tayoreva lakṣaṇamāviṣkurvannāha- tatra parvaṇītyādi| pūrvāparasañcchinno'sthyavayavaḥ kāṇḍaḥ, tayorevāsthikāṇḍayormadhyasandhānaṃ sandhiḥ, tayordvayorapi lakṣaṇacikitsārthamākṛtiviśeṣabhedāntaraṃ darśayannāha- tatra ṣaḍvidhamityādi||4||
tatra sandhimuktam- utpiṣṭaṃ, viśliṣṭaṃ, vivartitam, avakṣiptam, atikṣiptaṃ, tiryakkṣiptamiti ṣaḍvidham ||5||
sandhimuktasya ṣāḍvidhyamāha- tatretyādi| sandhimuktaṃ ṣaḍvidhamiti sambandhaḥ||5||
