jejjaṭasyāpyayamabhiprāyaḥ| gūḍhapadabhaṅgaṭippane'nyathā vyākhyātam- ā gulphakarṇāditi gulphakarṇāvabhivyāpya, āṅatrābhividhau na maryādāyāṃ, sumitasya suniścitaṃ mitasya tasya pramāṇasya ṣaṭsaptatyaṅgulamitasyāṣṭamabhāgaḥ sārdhanavāṅgulamātraṃ, khulakāt pārṣṇibhāgād dvyaṅgulapramāṇāt ‘tryaṅgulapramāṇāt’ iti pā., vibhajya pṛthakkṛtya, ghoṇā nāsā tasyā ṛju yathā bhavati tathā'vakro vedhaḥ kartavyaḥ| tacca vidha vidhāne iti dhāto rūpam, tathā'pi vedhaśabdo'tra vyadhane vartate, dhātūnāmanekārthatvāt| sa ca khulakasyāṅgulatritayamaṣṭamabhāgasya ca sārdhanavāṅgulakamevaṃ sārdhadvādaśāṅgulaparimāṇenendrabastirmarmāpi parihṛtaṃ bhavatyevamuktamindrabastiṃ hitveti| tathā coktaṃ- “trayodaśāṅgule pārṣṇiṃ prati kālāntarāsuhṛt| indrabastirasṛksrāvī māṃsago'rdhāṅgulo bhavet”- iti| akṣimātramaṅguladvayapramāṇamapare bhiṣaja iti vadanti| evaṃ prathamaślokenādhastāddvitīyaślokenendrabasterupariṣṭājjaṅghāyāḥ pāścātyabhāgagatakaṇḍarāyā dvyaṅgulamātro vyadhaḥ kārya iti sthitam; evamanupaśame vāmapārśvajāyāṃ dakṣiṇajaṅghāpṛṣṭhamadhyādindrabasteradhastādūrdhvaṃ vā śastreṇākṣimātraṃ vraṇaṃ kṛtvā, matsyāṇḍajālanibhaṃ medo'panīyagninā dahet, anenetarapārśvajā vyākhyātā, evamubhayapārśvajātāyāmubhayata iti| bhojā'trāha- “vātapittakaphā vṛddhā medaścāpi samācitam| jaṅghayoḥ kaṇḍarāṃ prāpya matsyāṇḍasadṛśān bahūn|| kurvanti granthīn yastebhyaḥ punaḥ prakupito'nilaḥ| doṣastairūrdhvago vakṣaḥkakṣāmanyāgalāśritaḥ|| nānāprakārān kurute granthīn sā tvapacī matā| vyāmiśradoṣotpannāṃ tu kṛcchrasādhyāṃ vinirdiśet|| tāsāṃ vātottarā kṛṣṇā vātikīvedanāyutā|| kṣiprapākasamutthānā dāhayuktā ca paittikī|| gūḍhā'vipākā kaṭhinā kaphāt snigdhā rujākarī|| medodhikā ślaiṣmikī ca viśeṣāt sā samārdavā|| tāṃ tu mālākṛtiṃ manyākaṇṭhahṛddhanusandhiṣu|| galamālāṃ vijānīyādapacītulyalakṣaṇām”- iti| “tasmājjaṅghāyāmeva karmaṇā mūlocchedaḥ kāryaḥ” iti gūḍhapadabhaṅgāt| vāgbhaṭena cobhayatrāpi vyadho darśitaḥ| yathā- “ityaśāntau gadasyānyapārśvajaṅghāsamāśritam| basterūrdhvamadhastādvā medo hṛtvā'gninā ‘hitvā’ iti pā. dahet”- (vā. u. 30) iti||25-26||
maṇibandhopariṣṭādvā kuryādrekhātrayaṃ bhiṣak | aṅgulyantaritaṃ samyagapacīnāṃ nivṛttaye ||27||

hanvasthisandhimanyāgalasthitāpacyāṃ jaṅghāgataṃ karmābhidhāya kakṣākūrparasandhigatāsvapacīṣu bāhugatameva karma vinirdiśannāha- maṇibandhetyādi| atrāpi pūrvavat, “etenetarasakthi bāhū ca vyākhyātau” (śā. 8) iti vacanādindrabasteraṣṭabhāgamakṣimātraṃ vā vihāyāgre rekhātrayaṃ kuryāt| tatrāpi viṃśatyaṅgulajaṅghāyā dvādaśāṅgulāni kiñcidadhiko bhāgena, evaṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulakūrparamaṇibandhamadhye kiñcidadhikāni navāṅgulāni mitvā reṣātrayamaṅgulāntaramiti||27||

div.ab: cūrṇasya kāle pracalākakākagodhāhikūrmaprabhavāṃ masīṃ tu | dadyācca tailena saheṅgudīnāṃ yadvakṣyate ślīpadināṃ ca tailam ||28|| virecanaṃ dhūmamupādadīta bhavecca nityaṃ yavamudgabhojī |29|

vamanavirecanaśirovirecanaistathā sthānāntaragataśastrakṣārānalairantarbahiḥpramārjanābhyāmantarbahiḥśuddhīrnirdiśya saṃśamanaṃ nirdiśannāha- cūrṇasyetyādi|- cūrṇasya kāle ropaṇakāle, pracalākādīnāṃ masīrdadyāt kṣāramityarthaḥ| pracalāko mayūraḥ, kṛkalāsamanye prāhuḥ| iṅgudīnāṃ tailena kṣārameva ‘masīmeva’ iti pā. dadyāt| yāni ca tailāni ślīpade tāni ca dadyāt||28||-

ab.seg: karkārukairvārukanārikelapriyālapañcāṅgulabījacūrṇaiḥ ||29||
vātārbudaṃ kṣīraghṛtāmbusiddhairuṣṇaiḥ satailairupanāhayettu | kuryācca mukhyānyupanāhanāni siddhaiśca māṃsairatha vesavāraiḥ ||30||
svedaṃ vidadhyāt kuśalastu nāḍyā śṛṅgeṇa raktaṃ bahuśo harecca | vātaghnaniryūhapayomlabhāgaiḥ siddhaṃ śatākhyaṃ trivṛtaṃ pibedvā ||31||

karkārukairityādi| karkārukaṃ kūṣmāṇḍaṃ, ervāruḥ grīṣmakarkaṭī, priyālaścāraḥ, pañcāṅgula eraṇḍaḥ| kṣīraghṛtasiddhai raktapittānubandhe| upanāhayet badhnīyāt| vātaghnetyādi| vātaghnā devadārvādayaḥ| tatkvāthakṣīrasauvīrabhāgaistribhiḥ snehacaturguṇairakalkaistailapākaḥ, evameva śatadhā pakvaṃ śatapākam, evaṃ trivṛtaṃ vā majjavarjaṃ ghṛtatailavasābhirvṛtaṃ pūrvakalkavātaharakvāthapayomlaiḥ siddham; evameva śatadhā'patānakavidhānena vā siddhaṃ trivṛtaṃ, tatrāpyayameva sādhanavidhiḥ||29-31||
svedopanāhā mṛdavastu kāryāḥ ‘pathyāḥ’ iti pā. pittārbude kāyavirecanaṃ ca | vighṛṣya codumbaraśākagojīpatrairbhṛśaṃ kṣaudrayutaiḥ pralimpet ||32||
ślakṣṇīkṛtaiḥ sarjarasapriyaṅgupattaṅgarodhrāñjanayaṣṭikāhvaiḥ | visrāvya cāragvadhagojisomāḥ śyāmā ca yojyā kuśalena lepe ||33||
śyāmāgirihvāñjanakīraseṣu drākṣārase saptalikārase ca | ghṛtaṃ pibet klītakasamprasiddhaṃ pittārbudī tajjaṭharī ca jantuḥ ||34||

svedopanāhā ityādi| mṛduḥ svedo dravasvedaḥ, upanāho bandhaḥ kākolyādimṛdudravyakṛtaḥ kṣīrāmlapiṣṭaśca nātyuṣṇaḥ| mṛdukāyavirecanaṃ na śirovirecanamiti vyavacchedaviṣayaḥ| bhṛśaṃ vighṛṣya udumbarādipatraiḥ| tatra śākaḥ kharamasṛṇapatro mahātaruḥ; gojī dārvīpatrikā, śākhoṭaka ityanye| visrāvyetyādi| somaḥ somalatā, kaṭphalamityapare| śyāmetyādi| śyāmā trivṛt, girihvā śvetasyandaḥ, añjanakī nīlāñjanikā śāradaṃ phalaṃ, śrīphaliketi loke| saptalikā yavatiktā| klītaketyādi| yaṣṭīmadhukalkena sāmānyasnehaparibhāṣayā siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ śodhanaṃ pittārbudī pittodarī ca pibet||32-34||
śuddhasya jantoḥ kaphaje'rbude tu rakte'vasikte tu tato'rbudaṃ tat | dravyāṇi yānyūrdhvamadhaśca doṣān haranti taiḥ kalkakṛtaiḥ pradihyāt ||35||
kapotapārāvataviḍvimiśraiḥ sakāṃsyanīlaiḥ śukalāṅgalākhyaiḥ | mūtraistu kākādanimūlamiśraiḥ kṣārapradigdhairathavā pradihyāt ||36||

śuddhasyeti vamanena| alābvā rakte'vasikte'pacyā doṣānūrdhvamadhaśca yāni dravyāṇi jīmūtakīghoṣavatīphaladantīdravantītrivṛdādīni haranti teṣāṃ kalkairlimpet| kāṃsyanīlaḥ kāṃsyamasī| śukaḥ granthiparṇaḥ ‘carmakāravaṭaḥ’ iti pā., lāṅgalākhyā kalikārikā| kākādanī vāyasatindukā| kapotādiviḍvimiśraiḥ kāṃsyanīlādisahitairvāyasatindukāyā mūlayuktairmūtrairvilimpet; athavā kṣārapradigdhaiḥ kṣārasaṃyuktairmūtraiḥ pralimpet; ‘kṣārapraghṛṣṭairathavā’ ityanye; tatra kṣārodakena praghṛṣṭairvā kapotaviḍādibhiḥ pradihyādityarthaḥ||35-36||
niṣpāvapiṇyākakulatthakalkairmāṃsapragāḍhairdadhimastuyuktaiḥ | lepaṃ vidadhyāt kṛmayo yathā'tra mūrcchanti muñcantyatha makṣikāśca ||37||
alpāvaśiṣṭe kṛmibhakṣite ‘kṛmibhiḥ kṛte ca’ iti pā. ca likhettato'gniṃ vidadhīta paścāt | yadalpamūlaṃ traputāmrasīsapaṭṭaiḥ samāveṣṭya tadāyasairvā ||38||
kṣārāgniśastrāṇyasakṛdvidadhyāt prāṇānahiṃsan bhiṣagapramattaḥ | āsphotajātīkaravīrapatraiḥ kaṣāyamiṣṭaṃ vraṇaśodhanārtham ||39||
śuddhe ca tailaṃ vidadhīta bhārgīviḍaṅgapāṭhātriphalāvipakvam | yadṛcchayā copagatāni pākaṃ pākakrameṇopacaredvidhijñaḥ ||40||

niṣpāvetyādi|- niṣpāvaḥ śimbaḥ| vidadhyāt kuryāt| mūrcchanti patanti| muñcantyatha makṣikāśceti ‘kṛmīn’ iti śeṣaḥ| śikharāṇāṃ ca kṛmibhirbhakṣitatvādalpāvaśiṣṭatvam| asakṛt anekavāram| apramattaḥ sāvadhānaḥ| āsphotā sārivā| śuddha ityādi| śuddhe ca ropaṇārthaṃ bhārgyāditailaṃ tailapākakalpena| yadṛcchayetyādi| yadṛcchayā punarākasmikotpāde abhighātādinimitte'buddhipūrvake vā||37-40||

div.ab: medorbudaṃ svinnamatho vidārya viśodhya sīvyedgataraktamāśu | tato haridrāgṛhadhūmarodhrapataṅgacūrṇaiḥ samanaḥśilālaiḥ ||41|| vraṇaṃ pratigrāhya madhupragāḍhaiḥ karañjatailaṃ vidadhīta śuddhe | saśeṣadoṣāṇi hi yo'rbūdāni karoti tasyāśu punarbhavanti ||42|| tasmādaśeṣāṇi samuddharettu hanyuḥ saśeṣāṇi yathā hi vahniḥ |43|
meda ityādi| pataṅgo raktakāṣṭham ‘raktacandanam’ iti pā.| ālaṃ haritālam| karañjatailaṃ vidradhyuktaṃ, tatphalatailamevetyanye||41-42||-

ab.seg: saṃsvedya gaṇḍaṃ pavanotthamādau nāḍyā'nilaghnauṣadhapatrabhaṅgaiḥ ||43||
amlaiḥ samūtrairvividhaiḥ payobhiruṣṇaiḥ satailaiḥ piśitaiśca vidvān | visrāvayet svinnamatandritaśca śuddhaṃ vraṇaṃ cāpyupanāhayettu ||44||
śaṇātasīmūlakaśigrukiṇvapriyālamajjānuyutaistilaistu | kālāmṛtāśigrupunarnavārkagajādināmākarahāṭakuṣṭhaiḥ ||45||
ekaiṣikāvṛkṣakatilvakaiśca surāmlapiṣṭairasakṛt pradihyāt ||46||
tailaṃ pibeccāmṛtavallinimbahaṃsāhvayāvṛkṣakapippalībhīḥ | siddhaṃ balābhyāṃ ca sadevadāru hitāya nityaṃ galagaṇḍaroge ||47||

saṃsvedyetyādi| patrabhaṅgaiḥ pallavaiḥ| anilaghnaṃ vātaharam| eraṇḍādipallavayutaṃ tu śuddhavāte, amlaiḥ kāñjikādibhiḥ pittāvṛte vāyau, kaphāvṛte mūtrakvathitaiḥ; raktāvṛte payobhiḥ kṣīraiḥ, piśitaiśceti piśitarasaiḥ kvathitaiḥ, athavā piśitairmāṃsaiḥ pallavaiḥ saha kvathitairdhātukṣayaje vāyau| visrāvayet jalaukādibhiḥ, ūrumūlasaṃśritasirāvyadhena vā| raktādiharaṇaśuddhaṃ ‘raktāharaṇaśuddhyā śuddhaṃ’ iti pā. galagaṇḍaṃ nirantaraṃ śaṇādibījairupanāhayet| śuddhamiti vacanāt sauśrute'pi raktāharaṇasya śuddhisañjñā; tena “catuṣprakārā saṃśuddhiḥ” (ca. sū. 22) iti carakavacanaṃ tu prāyikaṃ ‘anulomitam’ iti pā. smṛtam| kiṇvaṃ surābījam| kāletyādi| kālā hiṃsrā, gajādināmā hastipippalī, karahāṭaṃ madanaphalam| ekaiṣikā ambaṣṭhā, trivṛdityeke; vṛkṣakaḥ kuṭajaḥ| asakṛt anekavāram| pradihyāt limpet| tailamityādi| haṃsāhvayā haṃsapadī| tailaṃ pibet siddhamiti sambandhaḥ||43-47||
svedopanāhaiḥ kaphasambhavaṃ tu saṃsvedya visrāvaṇameva kuryāt | tato'jagandhātiviṣāviśalyāviṣāṇikākuṣṭhaśukāhvayābhiḥ ||48||
palāśabhasmodakapeṣitābhirdihyāt suguñjābhiraśītalābhiḥ | daśārdhasaṅkhyairlavaṇaiśca yuktaṃ tailaṃ pibenmāgadhikādisiddham ||49||
pracchardanaṃ mūrdhavirecanaṃ ca dhūmaśca vairecaniko hitastu | pākakramo vā'pi sadā vidheyo vaidyena pākaṅgatayoḥ kathañcit ||50||

pittagalagaṇḍābhāvādanantaraṃ kaphajasya cikitsitaṃ darśayannāha- svedetyādi| svedo'tra rūkṣaḥ, upanāhaśca sakṣāramūtraḥ| ajagandhā bovayikā, viśalyā agniśikhavṛkṣaḥ ‘kāṣṭhapāṭalā’ iti pā., viṣāṇikā āvartanikā, śukāhvayaḥ carmakāravaṭaḥ| daśetyādi daśārdhasaṅkhyairlavaṇairiti pañcalavaṇaiḥ| māgadhikādisiddhaṃ pippalyādikvāthakalkābhyāṃ siddham| pākaṅgatayoḥ pākaṃ prāptayorvātakaphajayoḥ||48-50||
kaṭutrikakṣaudrayutāḥ samūtrā bhakṣyā yavānnāni rasāśca maudgāḥ | saśṛṅgaverāḥ sapaṭolanimbā hitāya deyā galagaṇḍaroge ||51||

sarvagalagaṇḍaviṣaye yogaṃ nirdiśannāha- kaṭutriketyādi| bhakṣyā dhānollumbādayaḥ| yavānnāni gṛñjanādīni| samūtrā iti mūtrasvinnaśuṣkāṇāṃ bhakṣyayavāṇāmiti boddhavyam| kaṭutrikamadhubhyāṃ yojanā| rasāśca maudgā mudgayūṣāḥ| saśṛṅgaverāḥ sārdrakā deyāḥ||51||
medaḥsamutthe tu yathopadiṣṭāṃ vidhyet sirāṃ snigdhatanornarasya | śyāmāsudhālohapurīṣadantīrasāñjanaiścāpi hitaḥ pradehaḥ ||52||
mūtreṇa vā''loḍya hitāya sāraṃ prātaḥ pibet sālamahīruhāṇām | śastreṇa vā''pāṭya vidārya cainaṃ medaḥ samuddhṛtya hitāya sīvyet ||53||
majjājyamedomadhubhirdahedvā dagdhe ca sarpirmadhu cāvacāryam | kāsīsatutthe ca tato'tra deye cūrṇīkṛte rocanayā samete ||54||
tailena cābhyajya hitāya dadyāt sārodbhavaṃ gomayajaṃ ca bhasma | hitaśca nityaṃ triphalākaṣāyo gāḍhaśca bandho yavabhojanaṃ ca ||55||

medaḥsamuttha ityādi| yathopadiṣṭāmiti ūrusandhinirdiṣṭām| śyāmetyādi|- śyāmā trivṛt, sudhā sehuṇḍaḥ, lohapurīṣaṃ lohamalam; anye tu lohamagaruṃ vadanti, tathā purīṣaṃ kapotapārāvataviṭ| mūtreṇetyādi| sālasārāditarūṇāṃ sārakalkaṃ karṣamātraṃ gomūtreṇa pibet| jejjaṭastu sārodbhavaṃ bhasma mūtreṇāloḍya pibediti vadati| śastreṇetyādi| dāhe ca madhughṛtāvacāraṇaṃ paścātkarma| kāsīsetyādi| tato'nantaraṃ kāsīsatutthagorocanācūrṇāvacāraṇaṃ vraṇe| sārodbhavaṃ sālasārādisārodbhavam| prakṣālane triphalākaṣāyaśca||52-55||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne granthyapacyarbudagalagaṇḍacikitsitaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||18||

div.ab: iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutaṭīkāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne'ṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|

div.head: vṛddhyupadaṃśaślīpadacikitsitam
div.ab: athāto vṛddhyupadaṃśaślīpadacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1|| yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2|| antravṛddhyā vinā ṣaḍyā vṛddhayastāsu varjayet | aśvādiyānaṃ vyāyāmaṃ maithunaṃ veganigraham ||3|| atyāsanaṃ caṅkramaṇamupavāsaṃ gurūṇi ca |4|
antravṛddhyetyādi| caṅkramaṇaṃ bhramaṇam||1-3||-

tatrādito vātavṛddhau traivṛtasnigdhamāturam ||4|| svinnaṃ cainaṃ yathānyāyaṃ pāyayeta virecanam | kośāmratilvakairaṇḍaphalatailāni vā naram ||5|| sakṣīraṃ vā pibenmāsaṃ tailameraṇḍasambhavam | tataḥ kāle'nilaghnānāṃ kvāthaiḥ kalkaiśca buddhimān ||6|| nirūhayennirūḍhaṃ ca bhuktavantaṃ rasaudanam | yaṣṭīmadhukasiddhena tatastailena yojayet ||7|| snehopanāhau kuryācca pradehāṃścānilāpahān | vidagdhāṃ pācayitvā vā sevanīṃ parivarjayet ||8|| bhindyāttataḥ prabhinnāyāṃ yathoktaṃ kramamācaret |9|

tatretyādi| traivṛtamapatānakaharaṃ vātavyādhyuktaṃ, naraṃ pāyayeteti sambandhaḥ| kāle āvasthike| nirūḍhaṃ ca yaṣṭīmadhukasiddhatailena yojayedanuvāsanakalpavidhinā| yathoktāmityādi| yathā yena prakāreṇokto dvivraṇīyakramastamācaret||4-8||-

pittajāyāmapakvāyāṃ pittagranthikramo hitaḥ ||9|| pakvāṃ vā bhedayedbhinnāṃ śodhayet kṣaudrasarpiṣā | śuddhāyāṃ ca bhiṣagdadyāttailaṃ kalkaṃ ca ropaṇam ||10|| raktajāyāṃ jalaukobhiḥ śoṇitaṃ nirharedbhiṣak ‘abhīkṣṇaṃ nirharedasṛk’ iti pā.| pibedvirecanaṃ vā'pi śarkarākṣaudrasaṃyutam ||11|| pittagranthikramaṃ kuryādāme pakve ca sarvadā |12|
pittajāyāmityādi| kalkaṃ ca ropaṇaṃ dvivraṇīyoktakalkaṃ; gayī tu miśrakādhyāyoktamiti kathayati||9-11||-

ab.seg: vṛddhiṃ kaphātmikāmuṣṇairmūtrapiṣṭaiḥ pralepayet ||12||
pītadārukaṣāyaṃ ca pibenmūtreṇa saṃyutam | vimlāpanādṛte vā'pi śleṣmagrānthikramo hitaḥ ||13||
pakvāyāṃ ca vibhinnāyāṃ tailaṃ śodhanamiṣyate | sumanāruṣkarāṅkoṭhasaptaparṇeṣu sādhitam ||14||

vṛddhimityādi| uṣṇairuṣṇavīryairvacādipippalyādimuṣkakādigaṇaiḥ; anye tu, uṣṇavīryairajagandhādibhirmiśrakoktaiḥ| pītetyādi| gomūtrakvathitasyaiva dāruharidrākaṣāyasya vā pānaṃ, pītadārusthāne keciddevadāruṃ paṭhanti| vimlāpanādityādi| sumanāruṣkarādikalkakaṣāyasiddhaṃ tailam||12-14||

div.ab: medaḥsamutthāṃ saṃsvedya lepayet surasādinā | śirovirekadravyairvā sukhoṣṇairmūtrasaṃyutaiḥ ||15|| svinnāṃ cāveṣṭya paṭṭena samāśvāsya tu mānavam | rakṣan phale sevanīṃ ca vṛddhipatreṇa dārayet ||16|| bhedastataḥ samuddhṛtya dadyāt kāsīsasaindhave | badhnīyācca yathoddiṣṭaṃ śuddhe tailaṃ ca dāpayet ||17|| manaḥśilālalavaṇaiḥ siddhamāruṣkareṣu ca |18|

meda ityādi| surasādinā mūtrapiṣṭena lepaḥ| śirovirecanadravyāṇi pippalīviḍaṅgāpāmārgaśigruśirīṣasiddhārthakādīni saṃśodhanasaṃśamanīyoktāni| tairapi gomūtrapiṣṭaiḥ sukhoṣṇairlepaḥ| svinnāmityādi| yathoddiṣṭaṃ ca badhnīyāt gophaṇayā sthagikābandhena vā||15-17||-

ab.seg: mūtrajāṃ svedayitvā tu vastrapaṭṭena veṣṭayet ||18||
sevanyāḥ pārśvato'dhastādvidhyed vrīhimukhena tu | athātra dvimukhāṃ nāḍīṃ dattvā visrāvayedbhiṣak ||19||
mūtraṃ, nāḍīmathoddhṛtya sthagikābandhamācaret | śuddhāyāṃ ropaṇaṃ dadyādvarjayedantrahaitukīm ||20||
aprāptaphalakoṣāyāṃ vātavṛddhikramo hitaḥ | tatra yā vaṅkṣaṇasthā tāṃ ‘taptayā vaṅkṣaṇasthānaṃ’ iti pā. dahedardhenduvaktrayā ||21||
samyaṅmārgāvarodhārthaṃ kośaprāptāṃ tu varjayet | tvacaṃ bhittvā'ṅguṣṭhamadhye daheccāṅgaviparyayāt ||22||
anenaiva vidhānena vṛddhī vātakaphātmike | pradahet prayataḥ kintu snāyucchedo'dhikastayoḥ ||23||
śaṅkhopari ca karṇānte tyaktvā yatnena sevanīm | vyatyāsādvā sirāṃ vidhyedantravṛddhinivṛttaye ||24||

mūtrajāmityādi| varjayedantrahaitukīṃ ‘kośaprāptām’ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ| vātavṛddhikramo hita iti snehapānādiranuvāsanāntaḥ| tatretyādi| ardhenduvaktrayā śalākayā| tvaca bhittveti tvaṅmātraṃ chittvā| aṅgaviparyayāditi vāmāntravṛddhau ‘vāmāṇḍapravṛddhau’ iti pā. dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhamadhye, dakṣiṇāntravṛddhau ‘dakṣiṇāṇḍapravṛddhau’ iti pā. vāmāṅguṣṭhamadhye| śaṅkhabhruvorantopari karṇalalāṭayormadhye antravṛddhernivṛttaye ‘vaṅkṣaṇasthāyā’ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ, sirāṃ vidhyet||18-24||
upadaṃśeṣu sādhyeṣu snigdhasvinnasya dehinaḥ | sirāṃ vidhyenmeḍhramadhye pātayedvā jalaukasaḥ ||25||
haredubhayataścāpi doṣānatyarthamucchritān | sadyo'pahṛtadoṣasya rukśophāvupaśāmyataḥ ||26||
yadi vā durbalo janturna vā prāptaṃ virecanam | nirūheṇa harettasya doṣānatyarthamucchritān ||27||

upadaṃśeṣvityādi| tatra sirāṃ vidhyedbahudoṣe, alpadoṣe tu jalaukāpātaḥ; pittaraktajayormṛdutvājjalaukasetyanye; jejjaṭastu anavagāḍhe jalaukasā, avagāḍhe sirāvyadha iti| haredityādi| balavato virecyasya vamanavirecanābhyāṃ doṣaharaṇam| yadi vetyādi| durbalāvirecyayoḥ punaratyarthocchritadoṣayordoṣaharaṇānukūlyena nirūheṇa haraṇam| na vā prāptaṃ na yuktamityarthaḥ||25-27||

div.ab: prapauṇḍarīkayaṣṭyāhvavarṣābhūkuṣṭhadārubhiḥ | saralāgururāsnābhirvātajaṃ sampralepayet ||28|| niculairaṇḍabījāni yavagodhūmasaktavaḥ | etaiśca vātajaṃ snigdhaiḥ sukhoṣṇaiḥ sampralepayet ||29|| prapauṇḍarīkapūrvaiśca dravyaiḥ sekaḥ praśasyate |30|
prapauṇḍarīketyādi| saralā trivṛt| niculetyādi| niculo vetasaḥ| prapauṇḍarīkapūrvaiḥ prapauṇḍarīkādibhiḥ, pūrvauktairvātopadaṃśoktaiḥ| sekaḥ pariṣekaḥ||28-29||-

gairikāñjanayaṣṭyāhvasārivośīrapadmakaiḥ ||30|| sacandanotpalaiḥ snigdhaiḥ paittikaṃ sampralepayet | padmotpalamṛṇālaiśca sasarjārjunavetasaiḥ ||31|| sarpiḥsnigdhaiḥ samadhukaiḥ paittikaṃ sampralepayet | secayecca ghṛtakṣīraśarkarekṣumadhūdakaiḥ ||32|| athavā'pi suśītena kaṣāyeṇa vaṭādinā |33|
gairiketyādi| añjanaṃ rasāñjanam| mṛṇālaṃ padmanālam| secayet pariṣecayedityarthaḥ||30-32||-

ab.seg: sālāśvakarṇājakarṇadhavatvagbhiḥ kaphotthitam ||33||
surāpiṣṭābhiruṣṇābhiḥ satailābhiḥ pralepayet | rajanyativiṣāmustāsurasāsuradārubhiḥ ‘saralā’ iti pā.||34||
sapatrapāṭhāpattūrairathavā sampralepayet | surasāragvadhādyośca kvāthābhyāṃ pariṣecayet ||35||
śālaḥ śaṅkuḥ, aśvakarṇaḥ pūrvadeśaprasiddho'śvatthasadṛśaḥ, ajakarṇaḥ ‘piyāsāl’ iti loke| pattūraḥ sirivālikā||33-35||
evaṃ saṃśodhanālepasekaśoṇitamokṣaṇaiḥ | pratikuryāt kriyāyogaiḥ prāksthānoktairhitairapi ||36||
na yāti ca yathā pākaṃ prayateta tathā bhiṣak | vidagdhaistu sirāsnāyutvaṅmāṃsaiḥ kṣīyate dhvajaḥ ||37||
śastreṇopacareccāpi pākamāgatamāśu vai | tadā'pohya tilaiḥ sarpiḥkṣaudrayuktaiḥ pralepayet ||38||
karavīrasya patrāṇi jātyāragvadhayostathā | prakṣālane prayojyāni vaijayantyarkayorapi ||39||

evaṃ pūrvoktaprakāreṇa pratikuryāt, ‘āmopadaṃśam’ ‘vātopadaṃśaṃ’ iti pā. iti śeṣaḥ| prāksthānaṃ sūtrasthānaṃ, tatra miśrakoktaiḥ; apiśabdād dvivraṇīyoktaiḥ| ‘tasmāt saṃśodhanālepasekaśoṇitamokṣaṇaiḥ| pratikuryāt kriyāyogaiḥ prāksthānoktairhitairapi’ iti kecit paṭhanti| tadā'pohya pūyamupahṛtya| prakṣālane vraṇasya karavīrapatrāṇi, teṣāṃ kaṣāya ityarthaḥ; tathaivāparayorvaijayantyarkayoḥ patrāṇāṃ kaṣāyaḥ; vaijayantī agnimanthavṛkṣaḥ ‘araṇikā’ iti pā.||36-39||
saurāṣṭrīṃ gairikaṃ tutthaṃ puṣpakāsīsasaindhavam | rodhraṃ rasāñjanaṃ dārvīṃ haritālaṃ manaḥśilām ||40||
hareṇukaile ca tathā sūkṣmacūrṇāni kārayet | taccūrṇaṃ kṣaudrasaṃyuktamupadaṃśeṣu pūjitam ||41||
saurāṣṭrī tuvaramṛttikā| puṣpaṃ puṣpāñjanam||40-41||

div.ab: jambvāmrasumanānimbaśvetakāmbojipallavāḥ | śallakībadarībilvapalāśatiniśatvacaḥ ||42|| kṣīriṇāṃ ca tvaco yojyāḥ kvāthe triphalayā saha | tena kvāthena niyataṃ vraṇaṃ prakṣālayedbhiṣak ||43|| asminneva kaṣāye tu tailaṃ dhīro vipācayet | gojīviḍaṅgayaṣṭībhiḥ sarvagandhaiśca saṃyutam ||44|| etat sarvopadaṃśeṣu śreṣṭhaṃ ropaṇamiṣyate |45|

jambvāmretyādi| śvetaḥ śvetasyandaḥ; kāmbojikā kūvikā, gayī tu māṣaparṇīmāha| tiniśaḥ syandanaḥ| kṣīriṇo vaṭādayaḥ| asminnityādi| gojī gojihvā| sarvagandhairelādiparipaṭhitaiḥ| sāmānyakaṣāyapākakalpitena caturguṇena kaṣāyeṇa siddhaṃ tilatailamakalkameva, kaṣāyopādānāt, kalkamapyanantaroktauṣadhagaṇāt kartavyamityanye, kaṣāyaśabdasya kalke'pi vṛtteḥ||42-44||-

svarjikātutthakāsīsaṃ śaileyaṃ ca rasāñjanam ||45|| manaḥśilāsamaiścūrṇaṃ vraṇavīsarpanāśanam | gundrāṃ dagdhvā kṛtaṃ bhasma haritālaṃ manaḥśilā ||46|| upadaṃśabisarpāṇāmetacchāntikaraṃ param | mārkavastriphalā dantī tāmracūrṇamayorajaḥ ||47|| upadaṃśaṃ nihantyeṣa vṛkṣamindrāśaniryathā |48|
mārkavo bhṛṅgarājaḥ||45-47||-
upadaṃśadvaye'pyetāṃ pratyākhyāyācaret kriyām ||48|| tayoreva ca yā yogyā vīkṣya doṣabalābalam |49|
upadaṃśayordvayorapi raktasannipātajayostulyakāraṇatvāttulyaiva cikitsā| sannipātaprabhave tu vātādicikitsitamekīkṛtya dadyāt||48||-

ab.seg: upadaṃśe viśeṣeṇa śṛṇu bhūyastridoṣaje ||49||
duṣṭavraṇavidhiṃ kuryāt kuthitaṃ mehanaṃ tyajet | jambvoṣṭhenāgnivarṇena paścāccheṣaṃ dahedbhiṣak ||50||
samyagdagdhaṃ ca vijñāya madhusarpiḥ prayojayet | śuddhe ca ropaṇaṃ dadyāt kalkaṃ tailaṃ hitaṃ ca yat ||51||
upadaṃśe ityādi| kuthitaṃ mehanaṃ tyajediti yāvanmātraṃ mehanaṃ kuthitaṃ bhavettāvanmātraṃ chindyādityarthaḥ| jambvauṣṭhaḥ jambūphalasadṛśamukhāgrā kṛṣṇapāṣāṇaracitā vartiḥ||49-51||
snehasvedopapanne tu ślīpade'nilaje bhiṣak | kṛtvā gulphopari sirāṃ vidhyettu caturaṅgule ||52||
samāpyāyitadehaṃ ca bastibhiḥ samupācaret | māsameraṇḍajaṃ tailaṃ pibenmūtreṇa saṃyutam ||53||
payasaudanamaśnīyānnāgarakvathitena ca | traivṛtaṃ copayuñjīta śasto dāhastathā'gninā ||54||

snehetyādi| sneho'tra śodhanārtha eva, ślīpadānāṃ rūkṣaṇīyatvāt, gayī tu snehasvedopanāhāṃśceti paṭhati| samāpyāyitadehamiti raktāpakarṣeṇa sthāpanāddehasyānukramādāpyāyitasya| bastiratra nirūho'bhipretaḥ| māsamityādi śuṇṭhīkarṣapakvenāṣṭaguṇitena taccaturguṇāvaśiṣṭena payasā bhojanaṃ kuryāt| traivṛtamityādi traivṛtamutpāditaṃ vātavyādhau, taccopayuñjīta snehaprayogakāle||52-54||
gulphasyādhaḥ sirāṃ vidhyecchlīpade pittasambhave | pittaghnīṃ ca kriyāṃ kuryāt pittārbudavisarpavat ||55||
gulphasyetyādi| pittaje ślīpade sirāṃ vidhyet, gulphasyopari caturaṅgulam; anye tu gulphasyādha iti sirāvyadha eva sambadhnanti||55||
sirāṃ suviditāṃ vidhyedaṅguṣṭhe ślaiṣmike bhiṣak | madhuyuktāni cābhīkṣṇaṃ kaṣāyāṇi pibennaraḥ ||56||
pibedvā'pyabhayākalkaṃ mūtreṇānyatamena ca | kaṭukāmamṛtāṃ śuṇṭhīṃ viḍaṅgaṃ dāru citrakam ||57||
hitaṃ vā lepane nityaṃ bhadradāru sacitrakam | viḍaṅgamaricārkeṣu nāgare citrake'thavā ||58||
bhadradārvelukākhye ca sarveṣu lavaṇeṣu ca | tailaṃ pakvaṃ pibedvā'pi yavānnaṃ ca hitaṃ sadā ||59||
pibet sarṣapatailaṃ vā ślīpadānāṃ nivṛttaye | pūtīkarañjapatrāṇāṃ rasaṃ vā'pi yathābalam ||60||
anenaiva vidhānena putrañjīvakajaṃ rasam | prayuñjīta bhiṣak prājñaḥ kālasātmyavibhāgavit ||61||
kevukākandaniryāsaṃ lavaṇaṃ tvatha pākimam | rasaṃ dattvā'tha pūrvoktaṃ peyametadbhiṣagjitam ||62||

sirāmityādi| sirāṃ suviditāmiti kṣipramarmaṇa upari caturaṅgule| madhvityādi| abhīkṣṇaṃ punaḥ punarityarthaḥ| pibedityādi| atra mūtreṇānyatamena ceti aṣṭamūtreṣvekenāpi harītakīṃ seveta| kaṭukāmityādi| anyatamena mūtreṇa pibedityatrāpi sambadhyate| hitamityādi| elukākhyam elavālukam| pibedityādi| kaṇṭakikarañjapatrasvarasaṃ yathābalaṃ analapuruṣādibalānatikrameṇa palamardhapalaṃ paladvayaṃ vā kaṭutailākṣaprakṣepaṃ pibet; kaṇṭakikarañjaḥ pūtīkarañjaḥ, cirabilva ityanye| anenaivetyādi| putrañjīvako'nenaiva nāmnā prasiddhaḥ| kevuketyādi| pākimaṃ lavaṇaṃ viḍalavaṇam| bhiṣagjitam auṣadham||56-62||
kākādanīṃ kākajaṅghāṃ bṛhatīṃ kaṇṭakārikām | kadambapuṣpīṃ mandārīṃ lambāṃ śukanasāṃ tathā ||63||
dagdhvā mūtreṇa tadbhasma srāvayet kṣārakalpavat | tatra dadyāt pratīvāpaṃ kākodumbarikārasam ||64||
madanācca phalāt kvāthaṃ śukākhyasvarasaṃ tathā | eṣa kṣārastu pānīyaḥ ślīpadaṃ hanti sevitaḥ ||65||
apacīṃ galagaṇḍaṃ ca grahaṇīdoṣameva ca | bhaktasyānaśanaṃ caiva hanyāt sarvaviṣāṇi ca ||66||

kākādanīmityādi| kākādanī kālāhiṃsretyarthaḥ| kākajaṅghā etannāmnā prasiddhaiva| kadambapuṣpī alambuṣā muṇḍatiketi loke prasiddhā| mandārī ālī, lambā kaṭukālābuḥ| śukanasā carmakāravaṭaḥ| dagdhvā kṣāraṃ ṣaṅguṇena mūtreṇaikaviṃśativārān srāvayet, kākodumbarikārasaṃ ‘goṣṭhodumbarikārasaṃ’ iti pā. madanaphalakvāthaṃ śukanasāsvarasaṃ ca pratyekaṃ gomūtreṇa samaṃ, pādikamapareṣāṃ matena prakṣipya, kṣārapākakalpakrameṇa vipakvaḥ siddhaḥ, ślīpadaharadraveṇa śāṇādimātrayā pānārhaḥ||63-66||
eṣveva tailaṃ saṃsiddhaṃ nasyābhyaṅgeṣu pūjitama etānevāmayān hanti ye ca duṣṭavraṇā nṛṇām ||67||
kākādanyādīnāṃ kvāthena tathā kākodumbarikārasamadanaphalakvāthaśukanāsāsvaraseṣu pratyekaṃ sameṣu tailaṃ sādhyam||67||
dravantīṃ trivṛtāṃ dantīṃ nīlīṃ śyāmāṃ tathaiva ca | saptalāṃ śaṅkhinīṃ caiva dagdhvā mūtreṇa gālayet ||68||
dadyācca triphalākvāthameṣa kṣārastu sādhitaḥ | adho gacchati pītastu pūrvaiścāpyāśiṣaḥ samāḥ ||69||

dravantīmityādi| dravantī śambarī| trivṛtā trivṛt| dantī dantinī| nīlī śāradaṃ phalaṃ, śrīphaliketi loke| śyāmā vṛddhadārukaḥ| śaṅkhinī yavatiktābhedaḥ| pūrvaiścāpyāśiṣaḥ samā iti pūrvaiḥ pūrvakṣārayogaiḥ saha samāstulyā bhavanti, āśiṣa āśaṃsanāni arthavādāḥ| idamuktaṃ bhavati- ye kecidguṇāḥ pūrvakṣāreṣvabhihitāste'trāpi tulyā jñeyā ityarthaḥ||68-69||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne vṛddhyupadaṃśaślīpadacikitsitaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||19||

div.ab: iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne ekonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||

div.head: kṣudrarogacikitsitam

ab.seg: athātaḥ kṣudrarogacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
tatrājagallikāmāmāṃ jalaukobhirupācaret | śuktiśrughnīyavakṣārakalkaiścālepayedbhiṣak ||3||
śyāmālāṅgalakipāṭhākalkairvā'pi vicakṣaṇaḥ | pakvāṃ vraṇavidhānena yathoktena prasādhayet ||4||

tatretyādi| śuktiḥ jalaśuktiḥ| śrughnī svarjikā| yavaḥ prasiddhaḥ| kṣāraśabdaḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| gayī tu ajagallikāmapakvāṃ yavakṣāraśuktisaurāṣṭrīkalkenālepayet, tato jalaukobhiḥ srāvayet ‘apakvāṃ grāhayet’ iti pā., ālepaścādya upakramaḥ sarvaśophānāmityukteḥ||1-4||
andhālajīṃ yavaprakhyāṃ panasīṃ kacchapīṃ tathā | pāṣāṇagardabhaṃ caiva pūrvaṃ svedena yojayet ||5||
manaḥśilātālakuṣṭhadārukalkaiḥ pralepayet | paripākagatān bhittvā vraṇavat samupācaret ||6||
andhetyādi||5-6||
vivṛtāmindravṛddhāṃ ca gardabhīṃ jālagardabham | irivellīṃ gandhanāmnīṃ kakṣāṃ visphoṭakāṃstathā ||7||
pittajasya visarpasya kriyayā sādhayedbhiṣak | ropayet sarpiṣā pakvān siddhena madhurauṣadhaiḥ ||8||
madhurauṣadhāni kākolyādīni||7-8||
cipya(ppa)muṣṇāmbunā siktamutkṛtya srāvayedbhiṣak | cakratailena cābhyajya sarjacūrṇena cūrṇayet ||9||
bandhenopacareccainamaśakyaṃ cāgninā dahet | madhurauṣadhasiddhena tatastailena ropayet ||10||
kunakhe vidhirapyeṣa kāryo hi bhiṣajā bhavet | upācaredanuśayīṃ śleṣmavidradhivadbhiṣak ||11||

cippamityādi| utkṛtya duṣṭamāṃsaṃ pakvam| cakratailaṃ cakrapīḍitaṃ, hastādipīḍitavyudāsārthaṃ cakragrahaṇam| “cippaṃ śoṇitasekena śodhanaiścāpyupācaret| gatoṣmāṇaṃ tathā cainamuṣṇāmbupariṣecitam|| śastreṇa tu yathāyogamutkṛtya srāvayedvraṇam| śilā tejovatī caiva rocanā ca rasāñjanam|| kalkairetaiśca ‘kalkairetairamlapiṣṭaiḥ’ iti pā. sampiṣṭaiḥ śodhayitvā vraṇaṃ tataḥ| haridrāgurukālīyakalkaiśca sarasāñjanaiḥ|| siddhena tilatailena tatra kurvīta ropaṇam”- iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ| eṣa vidhiḥ cippakramaḥ||9-11||
vidārikāṃ samabhyajya svinnāṃ vimlāpya lepayet | nagavṛttikavarṣābhūbilvamūlaiḥ supeṣitaiḥ ||12||
vraṇabhāvagatāyāṃ vā kṛtvā saṃśodhanakriyām ‘saṃśodhanīṃ kriyām’ iti pā.| ropaṇārthaṃ hitaṃ tailaṃ kaṣāyamadhuraiḥ śṛtam ||13||
pracchānairvā jalaukobhiḥ srāvyā'pakvā vidārikā | ajakarṇaiḥ sapālāśamūlakalkaiḥ pralepayet ||14||
pakvāṃ vidārya śastreṇa paṭolapicumardayoḥ | kalkena tilayuktena sarpirmiśreṇa lepayet ||15||
baddhvā ca kṣīravṛkṣasya kaṣāyaiḥ khadirasya ca | vraṇaṃ prakṣālayecchuddhāṃ tatastāṃ ropayet punaḥ ||16||

vidārikāmityādi| vimlāpyeti aṅguṣṭhādibhiḥ| nagavṛttikaḥ jiṅginī guḍamajjaniketi loke, vṛścikālītyanye| vraṇabhāvetyādi| kaṣāyaiḥ nyagrodhādipaṭhitaiḥ, madhuraiḥ kākolyādibhiḥ| ajakarṇaḥ sarjaḥ| pālāśaḥ śaṭī| pakvāmityādi| picumardo nimbaḥ| kṣīravṛkṣā vaṭodumbaraplakṣapippalagardabhāṇḍāḥ||12-16||

div.ab: medo'rbudavidhānena sādhayeccharkarārbudam | kacchūṃ vicarcikāṃ pāmāṃ kuṣṭhavat samupācaret ||17|| lepaśca śasyate sikthaśatāhvāgaurasarṣapaiḥ | vacādārvīsarṣapairvā tailaṃ vā naktamālajam ||18|| sāratailamathābhyaṅge kurvīta kaṭukaiḥ śṛtam |19|

medo'rbudetyādi| naktamālajatailenāpakvenaiva, ‘kaṭukauṣadhasiddhena’ ityanye| sāratailena śiṃśapāgurusaraladevadārvāditailena| kaṭukauṣadhāni pippalyādīni| ‘sāratailamathābhyaṅge’ ityatra ‘sāralaṃ tailamabhyaṅge’ iti kecit paṭhanti; tatra saralasārasnehaḥ sāmānyasnehaparibhāṣayā paktavyaḥ||17-18||-

ab.seg: pādadāryāṃ sirāṃ viddhvā svedābhyaṅgau prayojayet ||19||
madhūcchiṣṭavasāmajjasarjacūrṇaghṛtaiḥ kṛtaḥ | yavāhvagairikonmiśraiḥ pādalepaḥ praśasyate ||20||
pādetyādi| pūrvamādau snehatvedau kṛtvā paścāt sirāṃ vidhyet| yavāhvo yavakṣāraḥ||19-20||

div.ab: pādau siktvā''ranālena lepanaṃ hyalase hitam | kalkīkṛtairnimbatilakāsīsālaiḥ sasaindhavaiḥ ||21|| lākṣāraso'bhayā vā'pi kāryaṃ syādraktamokṣaṇam | siddhaṃ rase kaṇṭakāryāstailaṃ vā sārṣapaṃ hitam ||22|| kāsīsarocanaśilācūrṇairvā pratisāraṇam |23|
pādāvityādi| śilā manaḥśilā| pratisāraṇaṃ gharṣaṇam||21-22||-

ab.seg: utkṛtya ‘uddhṛtya’ iti pā. dagdhvā snehena jayet kadarasañjñakam ||23||

utkṛtyetyādi| kadaraṃ tu śastreṇotkṛtya agnitaptena tailenaiva dahet, sūkṣmamārgānusāritvāttailasya; anye tu vahnisantaptāḥ sarve'pi snehāḥ sūkṣmamārgānusāriṇo bhavanti, ataḥ sarve'pi snehā grāhyāḥ||23||

div.ab: indralupte sirāṃ mūrdhni snigdhasvinnasya mokṣayet | kalkaiḥ samaricairdihyācchilākāsīsatutthakaiḥ ||24|| kuṭannaṭadārukalkairlepanaṃ vā praśasyate | pracchayitvā'vagāḍhaṃ vā guñjākalkairmuhurmuhuḥ ||25|| lepayedupaśāntyarthaṃ kuryādvā'pi rasāyanam | mālatīkaravīrāgninaktamālavipācitam ||26|| tailamabhyañjane śastamindraluptāpahaṃ param |27|

indralupta ityādi| kuṭannaṭetyādi kuṭannaṭaḥ tagaraḥ| rasāyanavidhānopadeśaṃ kurvannetajjñāpayati- duḥsādhyo'yaṃ vyādhirna śakyate rasāyanamantareṇāpanetuṃ; rasāyanamaṣṭādaśa divyauṣadhayaḥ somaścauṣadharājā| mālatītyādi snehapākakalpaparibhāṣayā jātyādikalkasiddhena kaṭutailena gomūtracaturguṇena śiro'bhyañjyāt||24-26||-

arūṃṣikāṃ hṛte rakte secayennimbavāriṇā ||27|| dihyāt saindhavayuktena vājiviṣṭhārasena tu | haritālaniśānimbakalkairvā sapaṭolajaiḥ ||28|| yaṣṭīnīlotpalairaṇḍamārkavairvā pralepayet | indraluptāpahaṃ tailamabhyaṅge ca praśasyate |30|

arūṃṣikāmityādi| arūṃṣikāṃ tu punarjalaukobhiḥ raktamavasicya nimbakvāthena paritaḥ siktvā, aśvapurīṣarasena bahusaindhavacūrṇena lepayet| mārkavo bhṛṅgarājaḥ| haritālādibhirvā madhukādibhirvā lepayet| indraluptoktasya jātyāditailasyābhyaṅgakaraṇamarūṃṣikāyāḥ śodhanaropaṇam||27-28||-

ab.seg: sirāṃ dāruṇake viddhvā snigdhasvinnasya mūrdhani ||29||
avapīḍaṃ śirobastimabhyaṅgaṃ ca prayojayet | kṣālane kodravatṛṇakṣāratoyaṃ praśasyate ||30||
sirāmityādi| avapīḍya nasye dīyata ityavapīḍaḥ||29-30||

div.ab: upariṣṭāt pravakṣyāmi vidhiṃ palitanāśanam |31|
palitacikitsitamāha- upariṣṭādityādi| upariṣṭānmiśrakokte cikitsite|31|-
masūrikāyāṃ kuṣṭhaghnalepanādikriyā hitā ||31|| pittaśleṣmavisarpoktā kriyā vā sampraśasyate |32|
masūrikāyāmityādi| ādiśabdenodvartanaghṛtādi||31||-
jatumaṇiṃ samutkṛtya maṣakaṃ tilakālakam ||32|| kṣāreṇa pradahedyuktyā vahninā vā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ‘carmakīlaṃ jatumaṇiṃ maśakaṃ tilakālakam| uddhṛtya śastreṇa dahet kṣārāgnibhyāmaśeṣataḥ||’ iti pā.|33|
jatumaṇimityādi| kṣāreṇa kṣāraviṣayeṣu, āgninā akṣārakṛtyeṣu||32||-

ab.seg: nyacchevyaṅge sirāmokṣo nīlikāyāṃ ca śasyate ||33||
yathānyāyaṃ yathābhyāsaṃ lālāṭyādisirāvyadhaḥ | ghṛṣṭvā dihyāttvacaṃ piṣṭvā kṣīriṇāṃ kṣīrasaṃyutām ||34||
balātibalayaṣṭyāhvarajanīrvā pralepanam | payasyāgurukālīyalepanaṃ vā sagairikam ||35||
kṣaudrājyayuktayā limpeddaṃṣṭrayā śūkarasya ca | kapittharājādanayoḥ kalkaṃ vā hitamucyate ||36||
nyacche ityādi| ghṛṣṭvā samudraphenādinā| kṣīriṇo vaṭādayo vṛkṣāḥ pañca, teṣāṃ tvacaṃ piṣṭvā| payasyā arkapuṣpī| kālīyaṃ kṛṣṇacandanam||33-36||

div.ab: yauvane piḍakāsveṣa viśeṣācchardanaṃ hitam | lepanaṃ ca vacārodhrasaindhavaiḥ sarṣapānvitaiḥ ||37|| kustumburuvacālodhrakuṣṭhairvā lepanaṃ hitam |38|
yauvane ityādi| eṣa anantaroktaḥ||37||-

ab.seg: padminīkaṇṭake roge chardayennimbavāriṇā ||38||
tenaiva siddhaṃ sakṣaudraṃ sarpiḥpānaṃ pradāpayet | nimbāragvadhayoḥ kalko hita utsādane bhavet ||39||
padminītyādi| nimbāragvadhayoḥ kalkaḥ kaṣāya utsādane udvartane hito bhavedityarthaḥ| kalke kaṣāyaśabdo vartate, “pañcavidhaṃ kaṣāyakalpanam” (ca. sū. 4) iti vacanāt||38-39||
parivṛttiṃ ghṛtābhyaktāṃ susvinnāmupanāhayet | tato'bhyajya śanaiścarma cānayet pīḍayenmaṇim ||40||
praviṣṭe ca maṇau carma svedayedupanāhanaiḥ | trirātraṃ pañcarātraṃ vā vātaghnaiḥ sālvaṇādibhiḥ ||41||
dadyādvātaharān bastīn snigdhānyannāni bhojayet | vapāṭikāṃ jayedevaṃ yathādoṣaṃ cikitsakaḥ ||42||
parivṛttimityādi| upanāhayet badhnīyāt| abhyajya sarpiṣā| hīnamadhyamottamadoṣabalāpekṣayā ekarātratripañcarātravikalpaḥ||40-42||

div.ab: niruddhaprakaśe nāḍīṃ lauhīmubhayatomukhīm | dāravīṃ vā jatukṛtāṃ ghṛtābhyaktāṃ praveśayet ||43|| pariṣeke vasāmajjaśiśumāravarāhayoḥ | cakratailaṃ tathā yojyaṃ vātaghnadravyasaṃyutam ||44|| tryahāttryahāt sthūlatarāṃ samyaṅgāḍīṃ praveśayet | sroto vivardhayedevaṃ snigdhamannaṃ ca bhojayet ||45|| bhittvā vā sevanīṃ muktvā sadyaḥkṣatavadācaret | sanniruddhagudaṃ rogaṃ valmīkaṃ vahnirohiṇīm ||46|| pratyākhyāya yathāyogaṃ cikitsitamathācaret | visarpoktena vidhinā sādhayedagnirohiṇīm ||47|| sanniruddhagude yojyā niruddhaprakaśakriyā |48|

niruddhetyādi| dāravīṃ kāṣṭhamayīm| jatukṛtāṃ lākṣāmayīm| śiśumāraḥ pādī jalacaraḥ svanāmakhyātaḥ| cakratailaṃ yantrapīḍitaṃ tailaṃ; sevanīṃ bhittvā muktvā vā śastreṇa mūtrasrotaḥsaṅkocakāraṇaṃ carmāvadārayet; tasyāpi dvārasyāvipāke maṇidvāramathaivaṃ dārayet||43-47||-

ab.seg: śastreṇotkṛtya valmīkaṃ kṣārāgnibhyāṃ prasādhayet ||48||
vidhānenārbudoktena śodhayitvā ca ropayet | valmīkaṃ tu bhavedyasya nātivṛddhamamarmajam ||49||
tatra saṃśodhanaṃ kṛtvā śoṇitaṃ mokṣayedbhiṣak | kulatthikāyā mūlaiśca guḍūcyā lavaṇena ca ||50||
ārevatasya mūlaiśca dantīmūlaistathaiva ca | śyāmāmūlaiḥ sapalalaiḥ śaktumiśraiḥ pralepayet ||51||
susnigdhaiśca sukhoṣṇaiśca bhiṣak tamupanāhayet | pakvaṃ vā ‘yadā vijānīyāt’ iti pā. tadvijānīyādgatīḥ sarvā yathākramam ||52||
abhijñāya tataśchittvā pradahenmatimān bhiṣak | saṃśodhya duṣṭamāṃsāni kṣāreṇa pratisārayet ||53||
vraṇaṃ viśuddhaṃ vijñāya ropayenmatimān bhiṣak | sumanā granthayaścaiva bhallātakamanaḥśile ||54||
kālānusārī sūkṣmailā candanāguruṇī tathā | etaiḥ siddhaṃ nimbatailaṃ valmīke ropaṇaṃ hitam ||55||
pāṇipādopariṣṭāttu chidrairbahubhirāvṛtam | valmīkaṃ yat saśophaṃ syādvarjyaṃ tattu vijānatā ||56||

asādhyeṣvapi valmīkāgnirohiṇīprabhṛtiṣu cikitsitaṃ kāryaṃ, “yāvaducchvasiti prāṇī tāvat kāryā pratikriyā| kadā'pi daivayogena dṛṣṭāriṣṭo'pi jīvati” ityuktatvāt| valmīkamityādi| tatra saṃśodhanaṃ kṛtvā ‘auṣadhena’ iti śeṣaḥ| ārevataḥ kiramālakaḥ| śyāmā trivṛdviśeṣaḥ| palalaṃ tilapiṣṭiḥ| upanāhaḥ pācanam| kālānusārī kṛṣṇasārivā||48-56||
dhātryāḥ stanyaṃ śodhayitvā bāle sādhyā'hipūtanā | paṭolapatratriphalārasāñjanavipācitam ||57||
pītaṃ ghṛtaṃ nāśayati kṛcchrāmapyahipūtanām | triphalākolakhadirakaṣāyaṃ vraṇaropaṇam ||58||
kāsīsarocanātutthaharitālarasāñjanaiḥ | lepo'mlapiṣṭo badarītvagvā saindhavasaṃyutā ||59||
kapālatutthajaṃ cūrṇaṃ cūrṇakāle prayojayet | cikitsenmuṣkakacchūṃ cāpyahipūtanapāmavat ||60||
dhātryā ityādi| kāsīsādibhiramlakāñjikādipiṣṭaiḥ pralepanaṃ, badarītvaksaindhavairvā pralepanam| kapālaṃ pakvamṛdbhāṇḍakhaṇḍaḥ| ahipūtanoktaśca dhātrīśodhanavarjaṃ ghṛtapānādiḥ||57-60||
gudabhraṃśe gudaṃ svinnaṃ snehābhyaktaṃ praveśayet | kārayedgophaṇābandhaṃ madhyacchidreṇa carmaṇā ||61||
vinirgamārthaṃ vāyośca svedayecca muhurmuhuḥ | kṣīre mahatpañcamūlaṃ mūṣikāṃ cāntravarjitām ||62||
paktvā tasmin pacettailaṃ vātaghnauṣadhasaṃyutam | gudabhraṃśamidaṃ kṛcchraṃ pānābhyaṅgāt prasādhayet ||63||

gudetyādi| mūṣikāṃ nirgatāntrāṃ kṛtvā mahatpañcamūlasya prasthaṃ kṣīraprasthe triguṇitajale vipacet, kṣīraprasthe'vaśiṣṭai tailakuḍavaṃ dattvā, bhadradārvādikalkapādaṃ kṛtvā, pacet; tadyathābalaṃ pānābhyaṅgābhyāṃ gudabhraṃśaṃ sādhayet||61-63||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne kṣudrarogacikitsitaṃ nāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||20||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne viṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||20||

div.head: śūkarogacikitsitam

ab.seg: athātaḥ śūkadoṣacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
śūkādidoṣacikitsitamiti jñeyam, ādiśabdasya luptatvāt; tatrādiśabdena nidānoktā abhighātanimittā durbhaganimittāścātra jñātavyāḥ||1-2||
saṃlikhya sarṣapīṃ samyak kaṣāyairavacūrṇayet | kaṣāyeṣveva tailaṃ ca kurvīta vraṇaropaṇam ||3||

saṃlikhyetyādi| kaṣāyairiti kaṣāyavṛkṣacūrṇairavacūrṇayet, kaṣāyavṛkṣairmiśrakoktaśodhanakaṣāyasādhanadravyaiścūrṇīkṛtairavacūrṇayedityarthaḥ| teṣu ropaṇakaṣāyasādhanadravyeṣu pādikeṣu jalaṃ caturguṇaṃ dattvā ropaṇaṃ tailaṃ kuryāt||3||
aṣṭhīlikāṃ jalaukobhirgrāhayecca ‘grāhayet kuśalo bhiṣak’ iti pā. punaḥ punaḥ | tathā cānupaśāmyantīṃ kaphagranthivaduddharet ||4||
aṣṭhīlikāmityādi| kaphagrantheriva śastreṇoddharaṇam||4||
svedayedgrathitaṃ śaśvannāḍīsvedena buddhimān | sukhoṣṇairupanāhaiśca susnigdhairupanāhayet ||5||
kumbhīkāṃ pākamāpannāṃ bhindyācchuddhāṃ tu ropayet | tailena triphalālodhratindukāmrātakena tu ||6||
svedayedityādi| śaśvat pratidinam| susnigdhairityupanāhaviśeṣaṇam| tailena triphalādikalkapādena jalacaturguṇasiddhena ropayet||5-6||
grāhayitvā jalaukobhiralajīṃ secayettataḥ | kaṣāyaisteṣu siddhaṃ ca tailaṃ ropaṇamiṣyate ||7||
grāhayitvetyādi| kaṣāyaiḥ kaṣāyavṛkṣakaṣāyaiḥ, kaṣāyavṛkṣāḥ plakṣādayaḥ||7||
balātailena koṣṇena mṛditaṃ pariṣecayet | madhuraiḥ sarpiṣā snigdhaiḥ sukhoṣṇairupanāhayet ||8||
baletyādi| madhurāṇi kākolyādīni||8||
sammūḍhapiḍakāṃ kṣipraṃ jalaukobhirupācaret | bhittvā paryāgatāṃ cāpi lepayet kṣaudrasarpiṣā ||9||
sammūḍhetyādi| paryāgatā pakvā||9||
avamanthe gate pākaṃ bhinne tailaṃ vidhīyate | dhavāśvakarṇapattaṅgasallakītindukīkṛtam ||10||
kriyāṃ puṣkarikāyāṃ tu śītāṃ sarvāṃ prayojayet | jalaukobhirhareccāsṛk sarpiṣā cāvasecayet ||11||
sparśahānyāṃ haredraktaṃ pradihyānmadhurairapi | kṣīrekṣurasasarpirbhiḥ secayecca suśītalaiḥ ||12||
avamanthetyādi| aśvakarṇaḥ pūrvadeśe ‘gandhamuṇḍa’ iti khyāto'śvatthasadṛśaḥ| pattaṅgaṃ raktacandanam||10-12||
piḍakāmuttamākhyāṃ ca baḍiśenoddharedbhiṣak | uddhṛtya madhusaṃyuktaiḥ kaṣāyairavacūrṇayet ||13||
piḍakāmityādi| kaṣāyaiḥ cūrṇairityarthaḥ| śodhanakāle tu śodhanadravyaiścūrṇīkṛtairavacūrṇayet, ropaṇakāle tu ropaṇaireva||13||

div.ab: rasakriyā vidhātavyā likhite śataponake | pṛthakparṇyādisiddhaṃ ca deyaṃ tailamanantaram ||14|| kriyāṃ kuryādbhiṣak prājñastvakpākasya visarpavat |15|

rasakriyetyādi| rasakriyā phāṇitākṛtiḥ, śodhanakāle śodhanadravyakaṣāyakṛtā, ropaṇakāle ropaṇadravyakaṣāyakṛtā| pṛthakparṇyādisiddhaṃ tailaṃ sāmānyasnehaparibhāṣākalpena; pṛthakparṇyādīni miśrake ropaṇaghṛtapaṭhitāni kākolyādivarjitāni| visarpavat pittavisarpavadityarthaḥ||14||-

ab.seg: raktavidradhivaccāpi kriyā śoṇitaje'rbude ||15||
kaṣāyakalkasarpīṃṣi tailaṃ cūrṇaṃ rasakriyām | śodhanaṃ ropaṇaṃ caiva vīkṣya vīkṣyāvacārayet ||16||
hitaṃ ca sarpiṣaḥ pānaṃ pathyaṃ cāpi virecanam | hitaḥ śoṇitamokṣaśca yaccāpi laghu bhojanam ||17||
arbudaṃ māṃsapākaṃ ca vidradhiṃ tilakālakam | pratyākhyāya prakurvīta bhiṣak samyak pratikriyām ||18||
raktetyādi| śoṇitaje arbude liṅgaje raktārbude| vīkṣya vīkṣyeti dvivraṇīyoktāmavasthāṃ samyak nirūpyetyarthaḥ| avacārayet kaṣāyādīnītyarthaḥ||15-18||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne śūkarogacikitsitaṃ nāmaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||21||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne ekaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||21||

div.head: mukharogacikitsitam
div.ab: athāto mukharogacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1|| yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2|| caturvidhena snehena madhūcchiṣṭayutena ca | vātaje'bhyañjanaṃ kuryānnāḍīsvedaṃ ‘kṛtvā nāḍīsvedaṃ’ iti pā. ca buddhimān ||3|| vidadhyādoṣṭhakope tu sālvaṇaṃ copanāhane | mastiṣke caiva nasye ca tailaṃ vātaharaṃ hitam ||4|| śrīveṣṭakaṃ sarjarasaṃ suradāru saguggulu | yaṣṭīmadhukacūrṇaṃ tu vidadhyāt pratisāraṇam ||5|| pittaraktābhighātotthaṃ jalaukobhirupācaret | pittavidradhivaccāpi kriyāṃ kuryādaśeṣataḥ ||6|| śirovirecanaṃ dhūmaḥ svedaḥ kavala eva ca | hṛte rakte prayoktavyamoṣṭhakope kaphātmake ||7|| tryūṣaṇaṃ svarjikākṣāro yavakṣāro viḍaṃ tathā | kṣaudrayuktaṃ vidhātavyametacca pratisāraṇam ||8|| medoje svedite bhinne śodhite jvalano hitaḥ | priyaṅgutriphalālodhraṃ sakṣaudraṃ pratisāraṇam ||9|| etadoṣṭhaprakopānāṃ sādhyānāṃ karma kīrtitam |10|

caturvidhena catuṣprakāreṇa| snehena doṣādyapekṣayā samastavyastena snehapākaparibhāṣayā vātaharakaṣāyamadhūcchiṣṭakalkaśṛtenābhyaṅgaḥ| tataḥ snigdhaṃ nāḍīsvedena yathoktena svedayet| mastiṣkaḥ śirobastiprakāraḥ; badhyata ūrdhvaṃ śirobastiḥ, anavabaddho mastiṣka iti| anye tu paṭhanti ‘mastiṣkye ‘mastakye’ iti pā. caiva nasye ca’ ityādi; atra mastiṣkyaṃ ‘mastakyaṃ’ iti pā. mastiṣke ‘mastake’ iti pā. hitamabhyaṅgatailapicudhāraṇaśirobastyādi| śrīveṣṭakaḥ saralaniryāsaḥ| pratisāraṇaṃ gharṣaṇam| kriyāṃ kuryādaśeṣata iti saṃśodhanasaṃśamanarūpāṃ bāhyāmābhyantarīṃ ca| medoje punarasnehapūrvaṃ svedite bhittvā medaso'pakarṣaṇaṃ, śodhite cāgneravacāraṇaṃ pathyam||1-9||-

dantamūlagatānāṃ tu rogāṇāṃ ‘sādhyānāṃ’ iti pā. karma vakṣyate ||10|| śītāde hṛtarakte tu toye nāgarasarṣapān | niṣkvāthya triphalāṃ mustaṃ gaṇḍūṣaḥ sarasāñjanaḥ ||11|| priyaṅgavaśca mustaṃ ca triphalā ca pralepanam | nasyaṃ ca triphalāsiddhaṃ madhukotpalapadmakaiḥ ||12|| dantapuppuṭake kāryaṃ taruṇe raktamokṣaṇam | sapañcalavaṇaḥ kṣāraḥ sakṣaudraḥ pratisāraṇam ||13|| hitaḥ śirovirekaśca nasyaṃ snigdhaṃ ca bhojanam |14|

dantetyādi| nasyamityādi| śoṇitāvasekaśodhanagaṇḍūṣakupitavātānubandhe snehanaṃ nasyam| tatra kaphānugate madhukādibhiḥ saha triphalāsiddhaṃ tailaṃ nasye prayojyaṃ, śoṇitānugame ca triphalādisaṃsiddhaṃ ghṛtamiti| taruṇe tatkālotpanne| nasyamiti ‘śītādoktasnehena’ iti śeṣaḥ, doṣadūṣyasthānānāmaikyāt||10-13||-

ab.seg: visrāvite dantaveṣṭe vraṇāṃstu pratisārayet ||14||
rodhrapattaṅgayaṣṭyāhvalākṣācūrṇairmadhūttaraiḥ | gaṇḍūṣe kṣīriṇo yojyāḥ sakṣaudraghṛtaśarkarāḥ ||15||
kākolyādau daśakṣīrasiddhaṃ sarpiśca nasyataḥ | śauṣire hṛtarakte tu rodhramustarasāñjanaiḥ ||16||
sakṣaudraiḥ śasyate lepo gaṇḍūṣe kṣīriṇo hitāḥ | sārivotpalayaṣṭyāhvasāvarāgurucandanaiḥ ‘gairikotpalayaṣṭyāhvasārivāgurucandanaiḥ’ iti pā.||17||
kṣīre daśaguṇe siddhaṃ sarpirnasye ca pūjitam | kriyāṃ paridare kuryācchītādoktāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ||18||
visrāvite ityādi| pattaṅgaṃ raktacandanaṃ, madhūttaraiḥ madhupradhānaiḥ| kṣīriṇo vaṭādayaḥ| daśakṣīrasiddhaṃ daśaguṇena gavyakṣīreṇa ghṛtaṃ sādhanīyam||14-18||
saṃśodhyobhayataḥ kāryaṃ śiraścopakuśe tathā | kākodumbarikāgojīpatrairvisrāvayedasṛk ||19||
kṣaudrayuktaiśca lavaṇaiḥ savyoṣaiḥ pratisārayet | pippalīḥ sarṣapāñ śvetānnāgaraṃ naiculaṃ phalam ||20||
sukhodakena saṃsṛjya kavalaṃ cāpi dhārayet | ghṛtaṃ madhurakaiḥ siddhaṃ hitaṃ kavalanasyayoḥ ||21||
śastreṇa ‘vastreṇa’ iti pā. dantavaidarbhe dantamūlāni śodhayet | tataḥ kṣāraṃ prayuñjīta kriyāḥ sarvāśca śītalāḥ ||22||
uddhṛtyādhikadantaṃ tu tato'gnimavacārayet | kṛmidantakavaccāpi vidhiḥ kāryo vijānatā ||23||

saṃśodhyobhayata iti vamanavirecanābhyāmūrdhvamadhaśca kāyaṃ śodhayitvā, śirovirecanena śiraśca saṃśodhayedityarthaḥ| raktapittotthite'pyupakuśe sthāninaḥ kaphasya pratīkārārthaṃ vamanaṃ yuktam| kākodumbarikā kāṣṭhodumbarikā, gojī gojihvā| niculo vetasaḥ| madhurakaiḥ kākolyādibhiḥ||19-23||
chittvā'dhimāṃsaṃ sakṣaudrairebhiścūrṇairupācaret | vacātejovatīpāṭhāsvarjikāyāvaśūkajaiḥ ||24||
kṣaudradvitīyāḥ pippalyaḥ kavalaścātra kīrtitaḥ | paṭolatriphalānimbakaṣāyaścātra dhāvane | hitaḥ śiroviraikaśca dhūmo vairecanaśca yaḥ ||25||
chittvetyādi| tejovatī kākamardanikā| sakṣaudraśca sapippalīkaḥ sukhodake kavalaḥ||24-25||
sāmānyaṃ karma nāḍīnāṃ viśeṣaṃ cātra me śṛṇu | nāḍīvraṇaharaṃ karma dantanāḍīṣu kārayet ||26||
yaṃ dantamabhijāyeta ‘dantamadhijāyeta’ iti pā. nāḍī taṃ dantamuddharet | chittvā māṃsāni śastreṇa yadi noparijo bhavet ||27||
śodhayitvā daheccāpi kṣāreṇa jvalanena vā | bhinattyupekṣite dante hanukāsthi gatirdhruvam ||28||
samūlaṃ daśanaṃ tasmāduddharedbhagnamasthiram | uddhṛte tūttare dante samūle ‘saśūle’ iti pā. sthirabandhane ||29||
raktātiyogāt pūrvoktā rogā ghorā bhavanti hi | kāṇaḥ sañjāyate janturarditaṃ cāsya jāyate ||30||
calamapyuttaraṃ dantamato nāpaharedbhiṣak | dhāvane jātimadanasvādukaṇṭakakhādiram ||31||
kaṣāyaṃ jātimadanakaṭukasvādukaṇṭakaiḥ | yaṣṭyāhvarodhramañjiṣṭhākhadiraiścāpi yat kṛtam ||32||
tailaṃ saṃśodhanaṃ taddhi hanyāddantagatāṃ gatim | kīrtitā dantamūle tu kriyā danteṣu vakṣyate ||33||

sāmānyamityādi| sāmānyaṃ tulyam| yadeva vātādināḍīnāṃ karmoktaṃ tadeva dantanāḍīnāṃ sāmānyamekamityarthaḥ| yaṃ dantamabhijāyetetyādi yaṃ dantamabhi samīpe nāḍī syāttaṃ dantamuddharet| yadi noparijo bhavediti ūrdhvagatadantapaṅktigataścenna bhavati| sthirabandhane dṛḍhataradantaveṣṭane| ‘samūle sthirabandhane’ ityatra ‘śoṇitaṃ samprasicyate’ iti paṭhanti| dhāvane prakṣālane, jātimadanakaṭukasvādukaṇṭakakhādiraṃ kaṣāyamiti; anye tu kaṣāyamāmapūgaphalamiti manyante| svādukaṇṭako gokṣuraḥ, kaṇṭakārivṛkṣamanye||26-33||

div.ab: snehānāṃ kavalāḥ koṣṇāḥ sarpiṣastraivṛtasya vā | niryūhāścānilaghnānāṃ dantaharṣapramardanāḥ ||34|| snaihikaśca hito dhūmo nasyaṃ snigdhaṃ ca bhojanam | raso rasayavāgvaśca kṣīraṃ santānikā ghṛtam ||35|| śirobastirhitaścāpi kramo yaścānilāpahaḥ | ahiṃsan dantamūlāni śarkarāmuddharedbhiṣak ||36|| lākṣācūrṇairmadhuyutaistatastāḥ pratisārayet | dantaharṣakriyāṃ cāpi kuryānniravaśeṣataḥ ||37|| kapālikā kṛcchratamā tatrāpyeṣā kriyā hitā | jayedvisrāvaṇaiḥ svinnamacalaṃ kṛmidantakam ||38|| tathā'vapīḍairvātaghnaiḥ snehagaṇḍūṣadhāraṇaiḥ | bhadradārvādivarṣābhūlepaiḥ snigdhaiśca bhojanaiḥ ||39|| calamuddhṛtya ‘kṛmidantakamityunneyam’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ ca sthānaṃ vidahet suṣirasya ca | tato vidārīyaṣṭyāhvaśṛṅgāṭakakaserukaiḥ ||40|| tailaṃ daśaguṇe kṣīre siddhaṃ nasye hitaṃ bhavet |41|

sarpiṣastraivṛtasya veti vātavyādhipaṭhitasya ‘vātavyādhipratipāditasya’ iti pā.| niryūhāḥ kvāthāḥ| raso māṃsarasaḥ| rasayavāgvo māṃsarasayavāgvaḥ| kṣīraṃ dugdham| santānikā ‘sara’ iti bhāṣā, kṣīrasānnidhyāt santānikāghṛte kṣīrotthe eva| pratisārayet gharṣayedityarthaḥ| uddhṛtadaśanasya sthānaṃ dahecchuddhyarthaṃ śoṇitasrāvaniṣedhārthaṃ ca; suṣirasya ca pūyakṛtacchidrasya ‘sthānaṃ dahet’ iti śeṣaḥ||34-40||-

hanumokṣe samuddiṣṭāṃ kuryāccārditavat kriyām ||41|| phalānyamlāni śītāmbu rūkṣānnaṃ dantadhāvanam | tathā'tikaṭhinān bhakṣyān dantarogī vivarjayet ||42|| sādhyānāṃ dantarogaṇāṃ cikitsitamudīritam |43|

arditavatsamuddiṣṭāmiti ardita iva samuddiṣṭāṃ kriyāṃ kuryāt| samuddiṣṭagrahaṇenaitajjñāpayati- arditoktāmātideśikīṃ “vātavyādhividhinopacaret” (ci.a.5) ityevaṃrūpāṃ vaiśeṣikīṃ vātārditoktāṃ mastiṣkaśirobastinasyadhūmopanāhādikāṃ dvividhāmapi kriyāṃ kuryāditi| sādhyānāṃ dantarogāṇāṃ cikitsitamuktaṃ, śyāvadantadālanabhañjanānāmasādhyatvānnodāhṛtam||41-42||-

jihvāgatānāṃ sādhyānāṃ karma vakṣyāmi siddhaye ||43|| oṣṭhaprakope'nilaje yaduktaṃ prāk cikitsitam | kaṇṭakeṣvanilottheṣu tat kāryaṃ bhiṣajā bhavet ||44|| pittajeṣu vighṛṣṭeṣu niḥsṛte duṣṭaśoṇite | pratisāraṇagaṇḍūṣaṃ nasyaṃ ca madhuraṃ hitam ||45|| kaṇṭakeṣu kaphottheṣu likhiteṣvasṛjaḥ kṣaye | pippalyādirmadhuyutaḥ kāryastu pratisāraṇe ||46|| gṛhṇīyāt kavalāṃścāpi gaurasarṣapasaindhavaiḥ | paṭolanimbavārtākukṣārayūṣaiśca bhojayet ||47|| upajihvāṃ tu saṃlikhya kṣāreṇa pratisārayet | śirovirekagaṇḍūṣadhūmaiścainamupācaret ||48|| jihvāgatānāṃ karmoktaṃ... |49|

jihvetyādi| vighṛṣṭeṣu gojīśephālikādipatraghṛṣṭeṣu, pratisāraṇaṃ madhuraireva kākolyādibhiḥ; gaṇḍūṣo'pi taireva kvathitaiḥ; nasyamapi daśaguṇakṣīraṃ tatkalkasadhitaṃ hitam| likhiteṣu maṇḍalāgrādinā| asṛjaḥ kṣaye asṛjo'vasāne, virāme ityarthaḥ| kṣāro yavakṣāraḥ, tatpradhānaiḥ yuṣaiḥ kṣārayūṣaiḥ| upajihvāmityādi| gaṇḍūṣaḥ kaphavraṇaharadravyeṇa kaphakaṇṭakaharadravyeṇa vā| dhūmaiśca vairecanikadhūmaiḥ| alāsaḥ punaratra kapharaktakṛta āśukāritvāt pratyākhyāyaiva virecanakṣoṇitamokṣaṇakavalaśirovirecanadhūmavamanādibhirupacaryaḥ||43-48||-

... tālavyānāṃ pravakṣyate | aṅguṣṭhāṅgulisandaṃśenākṛṣya galaśuṇḍikām ||49|| chedayenmaṇḍalāgreṇa jihvopari tu saṃsthitām | notkṛṣṭaṃ caiva hīnaṃ ca tribhāgaṃ chedayedbhiṣak ||50|| atyādānāt sravedraktaṃ tannimittaṃ mriyeta ca | hīnacchedādbhavecchopho lālā nidrā bhramastamaḥ ||51|| tasmādvaidyaḥ prayatnena dṛṣṭakarmā viśāradaḥ | galaśuṇḍīṃ tu sañchidya kuryāt prāptamimaṃ kramam ||52|| maricātiviṣāpāṭhāvacākuṣṭhakuṭannaṭaiḥ | kṣaudrayuktaiḥ salavaṇaistatastāṃ pratisārayet ||53|| vacāmativiṣāṃ pāṭhāṃ rāsnāṃ kaṭukarohiṇīm | niṣkvāthya picumandaṃ ca kavalaṃ tatra yojayet ||54|| iṅgudīkiṇihīdantīsaralāsuradārubhiḥ | pañcāṅgīṃ kārayet piṣṭairvartiṃ gandhottarāṃ śubhām ||55|| tato dhūmaṃ pibejjanturdvirahnaḥ kaphanāśanam | kṣārasiddheṣu mudgeṣu yūṣaścāpyaśane hitaḥ ||56|| tuṇḍikeryadhruṣe kūrme saṅghāte tālupuppuṭe | eṣa eva vidhiḥ kāryo viśeṣaḥ śastrakarmaṇi ||57|| tālupāke tu kartavyaṃ vidhānaṃ pittanāśanam | snehasvedau tāluśoṣe vidhiścānilanāśanaḥ ||58|| kīrtitaṃ tālujānāṃ tu... |59|

aṅguṣṭhetyādi| chedayenmaṇḍalāgreṇeti bhāgadvayamardhaṃ ‘bhāgadvayaṃ sārdhaṃ vā’ iti pā. vā parityajya bhāgenaikenārdhena vā chedayet| bhramaścakrārūḍhasyeva bhramaṇam| tamaḥ andhakāradarśanam| prāptaṃ yuktam| kuṭannaṭaḥ śyonākaḥ| kiṇihī kaṭabhī, saralā trivṛt| pañcāṅgīmiti pañcabhiraṅgabhūtairdravyaiḥ kṛtā pañcāṅgī, tām| gandhottarāṃ gandhapradhānām| dvirahnaḥ ahni vāradvayamiti| kṣārasiddheṣu mudgeṣviti kṛto yūṣo yavakṣāreṇa lavaṇīkṛto bhojane hitaḥ pathyaḥ| tuṇḍikerītyādi| viśeṣaḥ śastrakarmaṇīti śastrakarmaṇi viśeṣo ‘niḥśeṣacchede'pi’ iti pā. bhedaḥ| tatra tuṇḍikerī medyā tālupuppuṭako'pi, adhruṣamāṃsasaṅghātau chedyau, māṃsocchrāyatvāllekhyaḥ kurmastato'nurūpāyāmavasthāyāṃ chedyo'pi| tālvityādi| cakāreṇātra tāluśoṣe pittaharo vidhiḥ samuccīyate, pittenāpi tāluśoṣajananāt| kīrtitaṃ tālujānāmiti atra raktārbudasyāsādhyatvāt karma nodāhṛtam||49-58||-

... kaṇṭhyānāṃ karma vakṣyate | sādhyānāṃ rohiṇīnāṃ tu hitaṃ śoṇitamokṣaṇam ||59|| chardanaṃ dhūmapānaṃ ca gaṇḍūṣo nasyakarma ca | vātikīṃ tu hṛte rakte lavaṇaiḥ pratisārayet ||60|| sukhoṣṇan snehagaṇḍūṣān dhārayeccāpyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ | pataṅgaśarkarākṣaudraiḥ paittikīṃ pratisārayet ||61|| drākṣāparūṣakakvātho hitaśca kavalagrahe | agāradhūmakaṭukaiḥ ślaiṣmikīṃ pratisārayet ||62|| śvetāviḍaṅgadantīṣu tailaṃ siddhaṃ sasaindhavam | nasyakarmaṇi yoktavyaṃ tathā kavaladhāraṇe ||63|| pittavat sādhayedvaidyo rohiṇīṃ raktasambhavām | visrāvya kaṇṭhaśālūkaṃ sādhayettuṇḍikerivat ||64|| ekakālaṃ yavānnaṃ ca bhuñjīta snigdhamalpaśaḥ | upajihvikavaccāpi sādhayedadhijihvikām ||65|| ekavṛndaṃ tu visrāvya vidhiṃ śodhanamācaret | gilāyuścāpi yo vyādhistaṃ ca śastreṇa sādhayet ||66|| amarmasthaṃ supakvaṃ ca bhedayedgalavidradhim |67|

śoṇitamokṣaṇādikarmapaccakaṃ sāmānyaṃ sādhyānām| abhīkṣṇaśaḥ vāraṃvāram| pataṅgaṃ raktacandanam| śvetā śvetasyandā| visrāvyetyādi| sādhayettuṇḍikerivaditi tuṇḍikeryāmapi galaśuṇḍīvidhyatideśāt sādhayedgalaśuṇḍīvaditi vācye tuṇḍikerīvidhyatideśo niḥśeṣacchedanārthaḥ, galaśuṇḍīvadatra tribhāgacchedo na kārya iti bodhayati, aśeṣacchedo na punastribhāgādibhiriti| visrāvya jalaukābhiḥ| śirovirecanadhūmalepanakṣārādibhiḥ śodhanam||59-66||-

ab.seg: vātāt sarvasaraṃ cūrṇairlavaṇaiḥ pratisārayet ||67||
tailaṃ vātaharaiḥ siddhaṃ hitaṃ kavalanasyayoḥ | tato'smai snaihikaṃ dhūmamimaṃ dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ ||68||
śālarājādanairaṇḍasāraiṅgudamadhūkajāḥ | majjāno gugguludhyāmamāṃsīkālānusārivāḥ | śrīsarjarasaśaileyamadhūcchiṣṭāni cāharet ||69||
tatsarvaṃ sukṛtaṃ cūrṇaṃ snehenāloḍya yuktitaḥ | ṭiṇṭūkavṛntaṃ sakṣaudraṃ matimāṃstena lepayet ||70||
eṣa sarvasare dhūmaḥ praśastaḥ snaihiko mataḥ | kaphaghno mārutaghnaśca mukharogavināśanaḥ ||71||
pittātmake sarvasare śuddhakāyasya dehinaḥ | sarvaḥ pittaharaḥ kāryo vidhirmadhuraśītalaḥ ||72||
pratisāraṇagaṇḍūṣau dhūmaḥ saṃśodhanāni ca | kaphātmake sarvasare vidhiṃ kuryāt kaphāpaham ||73||
pibedativiṣāṃ pāṭhāṃ mustaṃ ca suradāru ca | rohiṇīṃ kaṭukākhyāṃ ca kuṭajasya phalāni ca ||74||
gavāṃ mūtreṇa manujo bhāgairdharaṇasammitaiḥ | eṣa sarvān kaphakṛtān rogān yogo'pakarṣati ||75||

mukhāvayavagatānnirdiśya sakalavadanagatānnirdiśannāha- vātādityādi| lavaṇaiścūrṇaiḥ pañcalavaṇakṛtaiḥ| tailaṃ vātaharaiḥ siddhaṃ hitaṃ kavalanasyayoḥ vātaharabhadradārvādikalkakaṣāyasiddhaṃ tailaṃ kavale nasye ca hitamityarthaḥ| śālarājādanetyādi śālaphalādimajjānaḥ; śālaḥ śaṅkuḥ, rājādanaḥ kṣīrikā, sāraḥ sāravṛkṣaḥ khadirādiḥ| dhyāmaṃ gandhatṛṇaṃ ‘kattṛṇaṃ’ iti pā., kālānusārivā kālavallī| śrīḥ navanītakhoṭiḥ saralaniryāsaḥ, sarjarasaḥ rālā| snehenāloḍya yuktita iti yāvatā snehena nātighanatvaṃ nātitanutvaṃ lepayogyatā ca bhavati tāvatī snehamātretyarthaḥ| ṭiṇṭukaḥ śyonākaḥ| śuddhakāyasya vamanādibhiḥ| ativiṣādicūrṇadharaṇabhāgaṃ pratidivasaṃ ṣāṇmāsikaṃ gomūtreṇa peyam| dharaṇamānamapi kecit sauśrutīyāḥ paṭhanti; “madhyamā ekonaviṃśatirniṣpāvā dharaṇaṃ tānyardhatṛtīyāni karṣaḥ” (ci.a.31) iti||67-75||
kṣīrekṣurasagomūtradadhimastvamlakāñjikaiḥ | vidadhyāt kavalān vīkṣya doṣaṃ tailaghṛtairapi ||76||
sarveṣveva mukharogeṣvatra doṣādivibhāgena kavalānnirdiśannāha- kṣīrekṣurasetyādi| vīkṣya doṣaṃ doṣakāryamapi ‘rogakāraṇaṃ’ iti pā. rogamityarthaḥ||76||
rogāṇāṃ mukhajātānāṃ sādhyānāṃ karma kīrtitam | asādhyā api vakṣyante rogā ye tatra kīrtitāḥ ||77||
oṣṭhaprakope varjyāḥ syurmāṃsaraktatridoṣajāḥ | dantamūleṣu varjyau tu triliṅgagatisauṣirau ||78||
danteṣu ca na sidhyanti śyāvadālanabhañjanāḥ | jihvāgateṣvalāsastu tālavyeṣvarbudaṃ tathā ||79||
svaraghno valayo vṛndo vidāryalasa eva ca | galauṣṭho māṃsatānaśca śataghnī rohiṇī ca yā ||80||
asādhyāḥ kīrtitā hyete rogā nava daśaiva ca | teṣāṃ cāpi kriyāṃ vaidyaḥ pratyākhyāya samācaret ||81||
oṣṭhajāstrayaḥ, dantamūleṣu dvau, dantabhaveṣu trayaḥ, triliṅgagatiḥ tridoṣaliṅgākṛtirnāḍī, jihvāgateṣvekaḥ, tālunyapyeka eva, svaraghnādayo nava gale, samudāyasaṅkhyā nava daśaiveti||77-81||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne mukharogacikitsitaṃ nāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||22||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne dvāviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||22||

div.head: śophacikitsitam

ab.seg: athātaḥ śophānāṃ cikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
ṣaḍvidho'vayavasamutthaḥ śopho'bhihito lakṣaṇataḥ pratīkārataśca; sarvasarastu pañcavidhaḥ, tadyathā- vātapittaśleṣmasannipātaviṣanimittaḥ ||3||

avayave samuttiṣṭhatīti avayavasamutthaḥ, sthā gatinivṛttau, sthiratvādityarthaḥ ‘sthira ityarthāt’ iti pā.| abhihita uktaḥ| kena? atītena śāstreṇa| cakāro'nuktahetvādisamuccayārthaḥ ‘cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena kārakahetorapīti bodhyam’ iti pā., anye tu lakṣaṇaśabdenaiva hetvādiṃ ‘kārakaheturapyavaruddha ityāhuḥ’ iti pā. nirdiśanti, apare tu asādhyānāmapratīkārasamuccayārthaṃ varṇayanti| sarvaṃ saratīti sarvasaraḥ; gatimattvāt sarvasaraṇayogyaḥ||1-3||

tatrāpatarpitasyādhvagamanādatimātramabhyavaharato vā piṣṭānnaharitakaśākalavaṇāni kṣīṇasya vā'timātramamlamupasevamānasya mṛtpakvaloṣṭakaṭaśarkarānūpaudakamāṃsasevanādajīrṇino vā grāmyadharmasevanādviruddhāhārasevanāt vā hastyaśvoṣṭrarathapadātisaṅkṣobhaṇādayo sitasya doṣā dhātūn pradūṣya śvayathumāpādayantyakhile śarīre ||4||

pañcavidhasyaiva sarvasarasyāhāravihārābhyāṃ sarvāṅgagatadoṣakopahetuṃ nirdiśannāha- tatretyādi| apatarpitaḥ laṅghanavyāyāmavamanādirūkṣādibhirāhāravihāraiḥ karśitaḥ, tasyātyarthamadhvagamanalakṣaṇādvihārāt| piṣṭānnādimatimātramabhyavaharataḥ ityevaṃvidhādāhārāt| haritakaḥ kuṭheraśigrusurasāsumukhāsuribhūtṛṇādiḥ| piṣṭānnagrahaṇena sarvavidhagurvāhārāvarodhaḥ| kṣīṇasya veti svayameva kṛśasyātyarthamamlamupasevamānasya| mṛdādyāhāraratasya; mṛt mṛttikā, pakvaloṣṭaḥ agnipakvaloṣṭaḥ, kaṭaśarkarā agnidagdhaśarkarā, ānūpā mahiṣādayaḥ, audakā matsyādayaḥ| ajīrṇino vetyādi| grāmyadharmo maithunaṃ, sājīrṇasya maithunasevanāt| viruddhaṃ hitāhitīyādhyāye proktam| saṅkṣobhaṇāt calanādityarthaḥ ‘yānajanyādityarthaḥ’ iti pā.| akhile śarīre sakale kāye||4||

div.ab: tatra vātaśvayathuraruṇaḥ kṛṣṇo vā mṛduranavasthitāstodādayaścātra vedanāviśeṣāḥ; pittaśvayathuḥ pītaḥ sarakto vā mṛduḥ śīghrānusāryūṣādayaścātra vedanāviśeṣāḥ; śleṣmaśvayathuḥ pāṇḍuḥ śuklo vā snigdhaḥ kaṭhinaḥ śīto mandānusārī, kaṇḍvādayaścātra vedanāviśeṣāḥ; sannipātaśvayathuḥ sarvavarṇavedanaḥ; viṣanimittastu garopayogādduṣṭatoyasevanāt prakuthitodakāvagāhanāt saviṣasattvadigdhacūrṇenāvacūrṇanādvā saviṣamūtrapurīṣaśukraspṛṣṭānāṃ vā tṛṇakāṣṭhādīnāṃ saṃsparśanāt, sa tu mṛduḥ kṣiprotthāno'valambī calo'calo vā dāhapākarāgaprāyaśca bhavati ||5|| bhavanti cātra- doṣāḥ śvayathumūrdhvaṃ hi kurvantyāmāśayasthitāḥ | pakvāśayasthā madhye ca varcaḥsthānagatāstvadhaḥ ||6|| kṛtsnaṃ dehamanuprāptāḥ kuryuḥ sarvasaraṃ tathā |7|

tatretyādi| aruṇa īṣadraktaḥ| ūṣādayaḥ ūṣacoṣaparitāpādayaḥ| kaṇḍvādayaḥ kaṇḍūrgurutvamityādayaḥ| garopayogo bahirantaśca| prakothaḥ pūtibhāvaḥ, saviṣakīṭādikothaprakuthitodakāvagāhanāt, ayaṃ punarbahireva| saviṣasattvalālāsparśādiviṣāt taddigdhacūrṇenāvacūrṇanādveti saviṣasattvādimiśracūrṇairavadhūlanāt; saviṣasattvacūrṇaṃ vṛścikālīnāmakaṃ ‘vṛścikālīnāmakakṣupabhedacūrṇamiti himavatyatyarthaṃ lokā vadanti’ iti pā. kṣupabhedaṃ kecit kathayanti||5-6||-

ab.seg: śvayathurmadhyadeśe yaḥ sa kaṣṭaḥ sarvagaśca yaḥ ||7||
ardhāṅge'riṣṭabhūtaśca yaścordhvaṃ parisarpati | śvāsaḥ pipāsā daurbalyaṃ jvaraścchardirarocakaḥ ||8||
hikkātīsārakāsāśca śūnaṃ saṅkṣapayanti hi | sāmānyato viśeṣācca teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi bheṣajam ||9||

tasya dehadeśajanmasvabhāvena kṛcchratvādi nirdiśannāha- śvayathurityādi| madhyadeśe yaḥ śvayathuḥ sa sannipātajvaravadviruddhopakramatvāt kaṣṭaḥ| ardhāṅga iti ardhanāsārdhahṛdayārdhanābhiḥ śophāvacchinnaikapakṣaḥ ardhāṅgaḥ, tiryagvā nābhyavacchinnapūrvārdhe'pārārdhe vā| ariṣṭabhūtaḥ ariṣṭavat, bhūtaśabdo'tra upamānārthaḥ, riṣṭābhāsa ityarthaḥ| yaścordhvaṃ parisarpatīti yaḥ śophaḥ pādābhinivṛtta ūrdhvamuparitanakāye parisarpati sa puruṣaviṣaye'riṣṭabhūtaḥ; cakāro bhinnakrame, tena yaścādhaḥ parisarpati uttamāṅgāt sa strīviṣaye'riṣṭabhūtaḥ| uktaṃ ca- “ūrdhvagāmī naraṃ pabhdyāmadhogāmī mukhāt striyam”- iti| ūrdhvamadhyādhaḥsthitaśophe'pi sarvasarābhidhānamekadeśe'pi dagdhe paṭo dagdha itivat| upadraveṇāsādhyatvaṃ nirdiśannāha- śvāsa ityādi| sāmānyata ityādi sāmānyaṃ viśeṣaṃ ca||7-9||
śophinaḥ sarva eva parihareyuramlalavaṇadadhiguḍavasāpayastailaghṛtapiṣṭamayagurūṇi ||10||

tatra vātaśvayathau traivṛtameraṇḍatailaṃ vā māsamardhamāsaṃ vā pāyayet, nyagrodhādikakaṣāyasiddhaṃ sarpiḥ pittaśvayathau, āragvadhādisiddhaṃ sarpiḥ śleṣmaśvayathau, sannipātaśvayathau snuhīkṣīrapātraṃ dvādaśabhiramlapātraiḥ pratisaṃsṛjya dantīdravantīpratīvāpaṃ sarpiḥ pācayitvā pāyayet, viṣanimitteṣu kalpeṣu pratīkāraḥ ||11||

prathamaṃ viśeṣacikitsāmāha- tatretyādi| traivṛtamiti majjavarjaṃ ghṛtādibhistribhirvṛtaṃ trivṛtaṃ, trivṛtameva traivṛtaṃ, svārthiko'ṇ| jejjaṭācāryastu catuḥsnehamāha| māsamardhamāsaṃ vā puruṣabalāpekṣayā doṣabalāpekṣayā vā vikalpaḥ| pātram āḍhakam| amlaṃ kāñjikam| dantīdravantīpratīvāpamiti dravantī cīritapatrā dantībhedaḥ; dantīdravantīkalkaḥ, sa ca snehacaturthāṃśena| sarpiḥ āḍhakapramāṇam||10-11||

ata ūrdhvaṃ sāmānyacikitsitamupadekṣyāmaḥ- tilvakaghṛtacaturthāni yānyuktānyudareṣu tato'nyatamamupayujyamānaṃ śvayathumapahanti, mūtravartikriyāṃ vā seveta, navāyasaṃ vā'haraharmadhunā, viḍaṅgātiviṣākuṭajaphalabhadradārunāgaramaricacūrṇaṃ vā dharaṇamuṣṇāmbunā, trikaṭukṣārāyaścūrṇāni vā triphalākaṣāyeṇa, mūtraṃ vā tulyakṣīraṃ, harītakīṃ vā tulyaguḍāmupayuñjīta, devadāruśuṇṭhīṃ vā, gugguluṃ vā mūtreṇa varṣābhūkaṣāyānupānaṃ vā, tulyaguḍaṃ śṛṅgaveraṃ vā, varṣābhūkaṣāyaṃ mūlakalkaṃ vā saśṛṅgaveraṃ payo'nupānamaharaharmāsaṃ, vyoṣavarṣābhūkaṣāyasiddhena vā sarpiṣā mudgolumbān bhakṣayet, pippalīpippalīmūlacavyacitrakamayūrakavarṣābhūsiddhaṃ vā kṣīraṃ pibet, sahauṣadhamuraṅgīmūlasiddhaṃ vā, trikaṭukairaṇḍaśyāmāmūlasiddhaṃ vā, varṣābhūśṛṅgaverasahādevadārusiddhaṃ vā, tathā'lābūbibhītakaphalakalkaṃ vā taṇḍulāmbunā; kṣārapippalīmaricaśṛṅgaverānusiddhena ca mudgayūṣeṇālavaṇenālpasnehena bhojayedyavānnaṃ godhūmānnaṃ vā; vṛkṣakārkanaktamālanimbavarṣābhūkvāthaiśca pariṣekaḥ; sarṣapasuvarcalāsaindhavaśārṅgeṣṭābhiśca pradehaḥ kāryaḥ; yathādoṣaṃ ca vamanavirecanāsthāpanāni tīkṣṇānyajasramupaseveta, snehasvedopanāhāṃśca; sirābhiścābhīkṣṇaṃ śoṇitamavasecayedanyatropadravaśophāditi ||12||

harītakīcūrṇaprasthādīni trīṇi ghṛtāni tilvakaghṛtaṃ caturṇāṃ pūraṇaṃ yeṣāṃ tāni tilvakacaturthāni; harītakīcūrṇaprasthetyādinā ekaṃ, gavye payasi mahāvṛkṣakṣīretyādi dvitīyaṃ, cavyacitraketyādi tṛtīyaṃ, tilvakaṃ vātavyādhyuktaṃ caturtham| vamanavirecanetyādinā udaroktā eva mūtravartikriyā| navāyasaṃ pramehapiḍakācikitsite paṭhitam| dharaṇaṃ karṣam| kṣāro yavakṣāraḥ| ayo loham| tulyakṣīramiti gomūtraṃ paladvayaṃ, gokṣīramapi dvipalam| tulyaguḍāmiti śophaharadravānupānām| devadāruśuṇṭhīkalkaṃ kṛtvā sukhāmbunā, sāmānyaśophaharadraveṇa sukhoṣṇena vā| saguḍamārdrakaṃ vā karṣamānam| varṣābhūkaṣāyaḥ paladvayamanupānaṃ; varṣābhūḥ raktapunarnavā| vyoṣādikalkasiddhena jalacaturguṇena sarpiṣā mudgolumbān, svinnāḥ kiñcidbhṛṣṭā mudgā mudgolumbāḥ| mayūrakaḥ apāmārgaḥ| sahā māṣaparṇī, muraṅgī śobhāñjanakaḥ| kṣāro yavakṣāraḥ| anuviddhena anugatena, ‘anusiddhena’ iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ| yavānnaṃ godhūmānnaṃ veti sātmyāpekṣo vikalpaḥ| vṛkṣakaḥ kuṭajaḥ, naktamālaḥ mahākarañjaḥ| suvarcalā sūryāvartaḥ| śārṅgeṣṭā kākajaṅghā| pradehaḥ pralepaḥ| ajasraṃ punaḥ punaḥ, upaseveta ‘balavān’ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ| upadravaśophādityatra sarvāṅgaśophāditi kecit| śītoṣṇasnigdharūkṣādyairapraśāmyati śophe sirābhirabhīkṣṇaṃ śoṇitamavasecayedityarthaḥ| avisrāvyaśca sarvāṅgaśophīti kecidamuṃ pāṭhamanārṣamācakṣate; anye'vayavagataṃ sarvasaraṃ śītoṣṇasnigdharūkṣādibhirapraśāmyantaṃ śoṇitāvasecanena sādhayediti viṣayabhedena vidhiniṣedhau caritārthau kurvanti||12||
bhavati cātra- piṣṭānnamamlaṃ lavaṇāni madyaṃ mṛdaṃ divāsvapnamajāṅgalaṃ ca | striyo ghṛtaṃ tailapayogurūṇi śophaṃ jighāṃsuḥ parivarjayettu ||13||
piṣṭānnamityādi| ‘striyo guḍaṃ’ iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ||13||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne śothacikitsitaṃ nāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||23||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne trayoviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||23||

div.head: anāgatabādhāpratiṣedhaḥ

ab.seg: athāto'nāgatābādhāpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

anāgata īṣadāgataḥ, nañ atra īṣadarthe; ābādhā duḥkhaṃ vyādhirityarthaḥ; tasya pratiṣedhaścikitsitam| taccikitsitaṃ svasthavṛttamahorātrikācārakrama ityarthaḥ, yato'horātre'pi ṣaṇṇāmṛtūnāmantarbhāvaḥ||1-2||
utthāyotthāya satataṃ svasthenārogyamicchatā | dhīmatā yadanuṣṭheyaṃ tat sarvaṃ sampravakṣyate ||3||

utthāyotthāyeti vīpsāyāṃ, pratyahamitikartavyatākhyāpanāyetyeke; anye tu utthāyeti abhiyojyetyarthaḥ, abhito yogamabhisaṃyogaṃ kṛtvā; abhiyoga udyamaḥ, utpūrvasya sthādhātorabhiyogārthatvāt| satatam aharaharityarthaḥ; yadā tu utthāyotthāyetyasyāharaha iti vyākhyānaṃ tadā satatamiti vyarthaṃ syāt| ‘yadanuṣṭheyamaskannaṃ’ iti kecit paṭhanti, askannam avaśyamityarthaḥ||3||
tatrādau dantapavanaṃ ‘tatrādito dantakāṣṭhaṃ’ iti pā. dvādaśāṅgulamāyatam | kaniṣṭhikāparīṇāhamṛjvagranthitamavraṇam ‘…granthimathāvraṇam’ iti pā.||4||
ayugmagranthi yaccāpi pratyagraṃ śastabhūmijam | avekṣyartuṃ ca doṣaṃ ca rasaṃ vīryaṃ ca yojayet ||5||
kaṣāyaṃ madhuraṃ tiktaṃ kaṭukaṃ prātarutthitaḥ | nimbaśca tiktake śreṣṭhaḥ kaṣāye khadirastathā ||6||
madhūko madhure śreṣṭhaḥ karañjaḥ kaṭuke tathā | kṣaudravyoṣatrivargāktaṃ satailaṃ saindhavena ca ||7||
cūrṇena tejovatyāśca dantānnityaṃ viśodhayet | ekaikaṃ gharṣayeddantaṃ mṛdunā kūrcakena ca ||8||
dantaśodhanacūrṇena dantamāṃsānyabādhayan | taddaurgandhyopadehau tu śleṣmāṇaṃ cāpakarṣati ||9||

vaiśadyamannābhiruciṃ ‘rucimanneṣu vaiśadyaṃ dantajihvauṣṭhatāluṣu|| pāṭavaṃ saumanasyaṃ ca lāghavaṃ copapādayet|| na ca syādgalatālvoṣṭhajihvārogasamudbhavaḥ| sugandhi vadanaṃ ca syāllālāstambhanameva ca| mukhaprasekaśamanaṃ dharmapuṣṭikaraṃ nṛṇām| lāghavaṃ cendriyāṇāṃ syānnityaṃ khādettato naraḥ| pāṭavaṃ ‘vakrasya’ ityadhyāhāraḥ| prasekaḥ thūtkaraṇam’| iti pā. saumanasyaṃ karoti ca | na khādedgalatālvoṣṭhajihvārogasamudbhave ||10||
athāsyapāke ‘mukhapākaśvāsakāsaśoṣahikkāvamīṣu ca’ iti pā. śvāse ca kāsahikkāvamīṣu ca | durbalo'jīrṇabhaktaśca mūrcchārto madapīḍitaḥ ||11||
śirorujārtastṛṣitaḥ śrāntaḥ pānaklamānvitaḥ | arditī karṇaśūlī ca dantarogī ca mānavaḥ ||12||

śirasa uttamāṅgatvāttatpūrvameva vivṛṇvannāha- tatretyādi| avraṇaṃ koṭarādirahitam| pratthagraṃ navam| trivargāktaṃ trisugandhinā''ktaṃ liptaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ kṛtvā, tenetyadhyāhāraḥ| daurgandhyādyapakarṣaṇaṃ tatphalam; upadehaḥ upalepaḥ| vaiśadyaṃ nirmalatā| madaḥ pūgaphaleneva||4-12||
jihvānirlekhanaṃ raupyaṃ sauvarṇaṃ vārkṣameva ca | tanmalāpaharaṃ śastaṃ mṛdu ślakṣṇaṃ daśāṅgulam ||13||
mukhavairasyadaurgandhyaśophajāḍyaharaṃ sukham | dantadārḍhyakaraṃ rucyaṃ snehagaṇḍūṣadhāraṇam ||14||
jihvetyādi| mṛdu komalam| ślakṣṇaṃ masṛṇam| jāḍyaṃ jaḍatā stabdhatetyarthaḥ||13-14||

div.ab: kṣīravṛkṣakaṣāyairvā kṣīreṇa ca vimiśritaiḥ | bhilloṭakakaṣāyeṇa bhillo rodhraḥ tathaivāmalakasya vā ||15|| prakṣālayenmukhaṃ netre svasthaḥ śītodakena vā | nīlikāṃ mukhaśoṣaṃ ca piḍakāṃ vyaṅgameva ca ||16|| raktapittakṛtān rogān sadya eva vināśayet |17|

kṣīravṛkṣā nyagrodhādayaḥ| kṣīravṛkṣakaṣāyagaṇḍūṣeṇa raktaduṣṭirapi nivartate| bahirmukhaprakṣālanamāha- bhilletyādi| bhilloṭako hi parvate kedārabhūmau prasiddhaḥ| gayī tu bhilloṭakakaṣāyamantarmukhaprakṣālanamāha| āmalakasya kaṣāyeṇa netre prakṣālayet, ubhayaṃ śītodakena vā||15-16||-

ab.seg: sukhaṃ laghu nirīkṣeta dṛḍhaṃ paśyati cakṣuṣā ||17||
mataṃ srotoñjanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ viśuddhaṃ sindhusambhavam | dāhakaṇḍūmalaghnaṃ ca dṛṣṭikledarujāpaham ||18||
tejorūpāvahaṃ caiva sahate mārutātapau | na netrarogā jāyante tasmādañjanamācaret ||19||
bhuktavāñchirasā snātaḥ śrāntaśchardanavāhanaiḥ | rātrau jāgaritaścāpi nāñjyājvarita eva ca ||20||

tato'ñjanāvasaraḥ| sindhuratra nado'bhipretaḥ, tatsambhavaṃ srotoñjanam| viśuddhaṃ malarahitaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mataṃ; kutaḥ? yasmāddṛṣṭerdāhādiharaṃ kledādyapaharaṃ tathā tejorūpakaraṃ; tasmādañjanena dṛḍhaṃ cakṣuṣā paśyati, mārutātapau sahate, netrarogāśca na jāyanta iti yogatantrayuktyā yojanīyam| chardanavāhanairiti bahuvacanena pariśrāntihetavo gṛhyante||17-20||
karpūrajātīkaṅkolalavaṅgakaṭukāhvayaiḥ | sacūrṇapūgaiḥ sahitaṃ patraṃ tāmbūlajaṃ śubham ‘hitam’ iti pā.||21||
mukhavaiśadyasaugandhyakāntisauṣṭhavakārakam | hanudantasvaramalajihvendriyaviśodhanam ||22||
prasekaśamanaṃ hṛdyaṃ galāmayavināśanam | pathyaṃ suptotthite bhukte snāte vānte ca mānave ||23||
raktapittakṣatakṣīṇatṛṣṇāmūrcchāparītinām | rūkṣadurbalamartyānāṃ na hitaṃ cāsyaśoṣiṇām ||24||
karpūretyādi| jātīśabdena jātīphalaṃ kathyate||21-24||
śirogatāṃstathā rogāñchirobhaṅgo'pakarṣati | keśānāṃ mārdavaṃ dairdhyaṃ bahutvaṃ snigdhakṛṣṇatām ||25||
karoti śirasastṛptiṃ sutvakkamapi cānanam | santarpaṇaṃ cendriyāṇāṃ śirasaḥ pratipūraṇam ||26||

śirasaḥ pratipūraṇamiti śūnyabhūtasya śirasaḥ punaḥ pūraṇamityarthaḥ| ‘śirogatāṃstathā rogān’ ityatra ‘keśabhūmigatān rogān’ ityeke paṭhanti; ‘śirasaḥ pratipūraṇaṃ’ ityatra ‘dattaṃ mastakatailakam’ ityapare paṭhanti||25-26||
madhukaṃ kṣīraśuklā ca saralaṃ devadāru ca | kṣudrakaṃ pañcanāmānaṃ samabhāgāni saṃharet ||27||
teṣāṃ kalkakaṣāyābhyāṃ cakratailaṃ vipācayet | sadaiva śītalaṃ jantormūrdhni tailaṃ pradāpayet ||28||

śirobhyaṅgarthaṃ tailamāha- madhukamityādi| kṣīraśuklā kṣīravidārikā| kṣudrakaṃ pañcanāmānamiti alpā pañcamūlī| cakratailaṃ yantrapīḍitatailam| madhukādidravyāṇāṃ kvāthārthaṃ palaśatam, udakasya dvādaśādhikapañcaśatapalāni, tāvat vipacedyāvadviṃśatyadhikaṃ śataṃ bhavati, tato vastrapūtaṃ grāhyaṃ, tena kvāthena tathā taddravyāṇāmeva kalkairaṣṭabhiḥ palaiścakratailasya dvātriṃśatpalāni vipacet, yāvattailapākalakṣaṇāni bhavanti, evamānumānikaṃ kalpanīyam ‘pacanīyam’ iti pā.||27-28||

div.ab: keśaprasādhanī keśyā rajojantumalāpahā |29|
keśaprasādhanī kaṅkatikā ‘kākuṃi’ iti loke| rajo dhūliḥ| jantuḥ yūkā|29|-

ab.seg: hanumanyāśiraḥkarṇaśūlaghnaṃ karṇapūraṇam ||29||
hanvityādi| karṇapūraṇakālasya saṅkhyāṃ śrīvāgbhaṭaḥ prāha- “dhārayet pūraṇaṃ karṇe karṇamūlaṃ vimardayan| rujaḥ syānmārdavaṃ yāvanmātrāśatamavedane” (vā.sū.a.22)- iti||29||
abhyaṅgo mārdavakaraḥ kaphavātanirodhanaḥ | dhātūnāṃ puṣṭijanano mṛjāvarṇabalapradaḥ ||30||

abhyaṅga ityādi| abhyaṅgo'tra sakaladehasya ‘sakalaśarīrakarṇādigataḥ’ iti pā. snehābhyaṅgaḥ| mṛjā śuddhaprabhā, varṇo gaurādiḥ| snehasya sirāmukhādibhiḥ śarīrasantarpaṇakālaṃ kecidatra paṭhanti- “romānteṣvanu dehasya sthitvā mātrāśatatrayam| tataḥ praviśati snehaścaturbhirgacchati tvacam||raktaṃ gacchati mātrāṇāṃ śataiḥ pañcabhireva tu| ṣaḍbhirmāṃsaṃ prapadyeta medaḥ saptabhireva ca||śatairaṣṭābhirasthīni majjānaṃ navabhirvrajet| tatrasthāñchamayedrogān vātapittakaphātmakān” iti||30||
sekaḥ śramaghno'nilahṛdbhagnasandhiprasādhakaḥ | kṣatāgnidagdhābhihatavighṛṣṭānāṃ rujāpahaḥ ||31||
jalasiktasya vardhante yathā mūle'ṅkurāstaroḥ | tathā dhātuvivṛddhirhi snehasiktasya jāyate ||32||
sekaḥ sarvāṅgapariṣekaḥ||31-32||
sirāmukhai romakūpairdhamanībhiśca tarpayan | śarīrabalamādhatte yuktaḥ sneho'vagāhane ||33||
yuktaḥ prayuktaḥ| avagāhanaṃ majjanam||33||
tatra prakṛtisātmyartudeśadoṣavikāravit | tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā matimān yuñjyādabhyaṅgasekayoḥ ||34||
teṣāṃ yogyatāmāha- tatretyādi||34||
kevalaṃ sāmadoṣeṣu na kathañcana yojayet | taruṇajvaryajīrṇī ca nābhyaktavyau kathañcana ||35||
tathā virikto vāntaśca nirūḍho yaśca mānavaḥ | pūrvayoḥ kṛcchratā vyādherasādhyatvamathāpi vā ||36||
śeṣāṇāṃ tadahaḥ proktā agnimāndyādayo gadāḥ | santarpaṇasamutthānāṃ rogāṇāṃ naiva kārayet ||37||
abhyaṅgasya niṣedhamāha- kevalamityādi| āmajvare tatkṛtakampādīnāmapi sambhava ityarthaḥ| pūrvayostaruṇajvaryajīrṇinoḥ; śeṣāṇāṃ viriktānāṃ tadahaḥkriyamāṇe'bhyaṅge'gnimāndyādayo bhavanti||35-37||

div.ab: śarīrāyāsajananaṃ karma vyāyāmasañjñitam | tat kṛtvā ‘kṛtvā'nu’ iti pā. tu sukhaṃ dehaṃ vimṛdgīyāt samantataḥ ||38|| śarīropacayaḥ kāntirgātrāṇāṃ suvibhaktatā | dīptāgnitvamanālasyaṃ sthiratvaṃ lāghavaṃ mṛjā ||39|| śramaklamapipāsoṣṇaśītādīnāṃ sahiṣṇutā | ārogyaṃ cāpi paramaṃ vyāyāmādupajāyate ||40|| na cāsti sadṛśaṃ tena kiñcit sthaulyāpakarṣaṇam | na ca vyāyāminaṃ martyamardayantyarayo balāt ‘bhayāt’||41|| na cainaṃ sahasā''kramya jarā samadhirohati | sthirībhavati māṃsaṃ ca vyāyāmābhiratasya ca ||42|| vyāyāmasvinnagātrasya ‘vyāyāmakṣuṇṇagātrasya’ iti pā. padbhyāmudvartitasya ‘padbhyāmudvartitasya pādāvamarditasya’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ ca | vyādhayo nopasarpanti siṃhaṃ kṣudramṛgā iva ||43|| vayorūpaguṇairhīnamapi kuryāt sudarśanam | vyāyāmaṃ kurvato nityaṃ viruddhamapi bhojanam ||44|| vidagdhamavidagdhaṃ vā nirdoṣaṃ paripacyate | vyāyāmo hi sadā pathyo balināṃ snigdhabhojinām ||45|| sa ca śīte vasante ca teṣāṃ pathyatamaḥ smṛtaḥ | sarveṣvṛtuṣvaharahaḥ pumbhirātmahitaiṣibhiḥ ||46|| balasyārdhena kartavyo vyāyāmo hantyato'nyathā | hṛdi sthānasthito vāyuryadā vaktraṃ prapadyate ||47|| vyāyāmaṃ kurvato jantostadbalārdhasya lakṣaṇam | vayobalaśarīrāṇi deśakālāśanāni ca ||48|| samīkṣya kuryādvyāyāmamanyathā rogamāpnuyāt | kṣayatṛṣṇārucicchardiraktapittabhramaklamāḥ ||49|| kāsaśoṣajvaraśvāsā ativyāyāmasambhavāḥ | raktapittī kṛśaḥ śoṣī śvāsakāsakṣatāturaḥ ||50|| bhuktavān strīṣu ca kṣīṇastṛḍbhramārtaśca varjayet |51|

śarīretyādi| śarīrasyopacayaḥ samyakpuṣṭiḥ| gātrāṇāṃ suvibhaktatā gātrāṇāmiti sarveṣāmaṅgānāṃ, suvibhaktatā susannibiṣṭatā sughaṭitaśarīratetyarthaḥ| mṛjā śuddhiḥ ‘śuddhaprabhā’ iti pā.| śatravo yathā ca vyāyāminaṃ balāddhetorna mardayanti udvartanakāriṇaṃ janaṃ tathā vyādhayo nopasarpanti nābhibhavantītyarthaḥ| sthirībhavati māṃsaṃ ceti upacayalakṣaṇasyāpi balasya heturityarthaḥ| vyāyāmasvinnagātrasyeti gātre svedāgame sati vyāyāmāduparamaḥ kārya ityarthaḥ, anye tu ‘vyāyāmasvinnagātrasya’ ityatra ‘vyāyāmakṣuṇṇagātrasya’ iti paṭhanti| padbhyāmudvartitasya pādābhyāṃ bahukṛtamardanasyetyarthaḥ| viruddhaṃ hitāhitīyādhyāyoktam| vidagdham amlapākam, avidagdhaṃ vidagdhādanyat, tenāmaṃ vidagdhaṃ ca gṛhyate| pariḥ sarvato'rthe| vasante ceti cakāraḥ pathyatamatve hemantādvasantasyāpakarṣaṃ sūcayati| balārdhalakṣaṇaṃ kecidanyathā paṭhanti,- “kakṣālalāṭanāsāsu hastapādādisandhiṣu| prasvedānmukhaśoṣācca balārdhaṃ taddhi nirdiśet”- iti| vayobaletyādi vayo yauvanaṃ, balaṃ śaktyupacayalakṣaṇaṃ, śarīraṃ madhyaṃ sthūlaṃ ca, deśamānūpaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ ca; kālaṃ nityagamāvasthikaṃ ca dvividhamapi, tatra nityage śīte vasante ca, āvasthike yauvane bale sati; aśanāni snigdhabhojanāni; samīkṣya dṛṣṭvā upacayaprabhṛtau vyāyāmaṃ kuryāt| vyāyāmādagnipradīptau satyāṃ sarvarogopaśama iti||38-50||-
udvartanaṃ vātaharaṃ kaphamedovilāpanam ||51|| sthirīkaraṇamaṅgānāṃ tvakprasādakaraṃ param |52|

ab.seg: vyāyāme padbhyāmudvartitasyetyuktasyodvartanasya guṇaṃ nirdiśannāha- udvartanamityādi| udvartanaṃ gātramardanam| vilāpanaṃ dravīkaraṇam||51||
sirāmukhaviviktatvaṃ tvaksthasyāgneśca tejanam ||52||
uddharṣaṇotsādanābhyāṃ jāyeyātāmasaṃśayam | utsādanādbhavet strīṇāṃ viśeṣāt kāntimadvapuḥ ||53||
praharṣasaubhāgyamṛjālāghavādiguṇānvitam | uddharṣaṇaṃ tu vijñeyaṃ kaṇḍūkoṭhānilāpaham ||54||
ūrvoḥ sañjanayatyāśu phenakaḥ sthairyalāghave | kaṇḍūkoṭhānilastambhamalarogāpahaśca saḥ ||55||
tejanaṃ tvaggatasyāgneḥ sirāmukhavivecanam | uddharṣaṇaṃ tviṣṭikayā kaṇḍūkoṭhavināśanam ||56||

siretyādi| tejanaṃ tvaggatasyāgneḥ, sirāmukhavivardhanam| uddharṣaṇam asnehauṣadhacūrṇādibhirgharṣaṇam, anye tu phenakeṣṭakādigharṣaṇam| uddharṣaṇotsādanābhyāṃ jāyeyātāmiti sirāmukhaviviktatvāgnidīpane uddharṣaṇotsādanābhyāmutpadyeyātāṃ;| kecidatra yathāsaṅkhyamāhuḥ- sirāmukhaviviktatvamuddharṣaṇena, tvaksthasyāgnestejanamutsādanena; sasnehakalkenoddharṣaṇamutsādanam| mṛjā śuddhaprabhā| ūrvorūrdhvamadhaśca ‘ūrudvayasyādhaḥ’ iti pā. phenakaḥ, ūruḥ ‘jāṅgha’ iti loke| kaṇḍūkoṭhavināśanamiti iyamiṣṭikoddharṣaṇaguṇoktiḥ||52-56||

div.ab: nidrādāhaśramaharaṃ svedakaṇḍūtṛṣāpaham | hṛdyaṃ malaharaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvendriyavibodhanam ‘sarvendriyaviśodhanam’ iti pā.||57|| tandrāpāpmopaśamanaṃ tuṣṭidaṃ puṃstvavardhanam | raktaprasādanaṃ cāpi snānamagneśca dīpanam ||58|| uṣṇena śirasaḥ snānamahitaṃ cakṣuṣaḥ sadā | śītena śirasaḥ snānaṃ cakṣuṣyamiti nirdiśet ||59|| śleṣmamārutakope tu jñātvā vyādhibalābalam | kāmamuṣṇaṃ śiraḥsnānaṃ bhaiṣajyārthaṃ ‘bhaiṣajyamiti nirdiśet’ iti pā. samācaret ||60|| atiśītāmbu śīte ca śleṣmamārutakopanam | atyuṣṇamuṣṇakāle ca pittaśoṇitakopanam ||61|| taccātisārajvaritakarṇaśūlānilārtiṣu | ādhmānārocakājīrṇabhuktavatsu ca garhitam ||62|| saubhāgyadaṃ varṇakaraṃ prītyojobalavardhanam | svedadaurgandhyavaivarṇyaśramaghnamanulepanam ||63|| snānaṃ yeṣāṃ niṣiddhaṃ tu teṣāmapyanulepanam |64|
nidretyādi| kāmaṃ yatheṣṭam| snānasya niṣedhamāha- tadityādi| yeṣāṃ snānaṃ neṣyate teṣāmanulepanamapi niṣidhyate||57-63||-
rakṣoghnamatha caujasyaṃ saubhāgyakaramuttamam ||64|| sumanombararatnānāṃ dhāraṇaṃ prītivardhanam |65|
rakṣoghnamityādi| ratnāni māṇikyamarakatādīni| asyāgre ādarśaguṇaṃ gorocanādhāraṇaguṇaṃ ca kecidadhīyate; sa cābhāvānna likhitaḥ||64||-
mukhālepāddṛḍhaṃ cakṣuḥ pīnagaṇḍaṃ tathā''nanam ||65|| avyaṅgapiḍakaṃ kāntaṃ bhavatyambujasannibham |66|
mukhetyādi| kāntaṃ kamanīyaṃ manoharamityarthaḥ||65||-
pakṣmalaṃ viśadaṃ kāntamamalojjvalamaṇḍalam ||66|| netramañjanasaṃyogādbhaveccāmalatārakam | yaśasyaṃ svargyamāyuṣyaṃ dhanadhānyavivardhanam ||67|| devatātithiviprāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ gotravardhanam |68|
sāmānyamañjanaguṇamāha- pakṣmalamityādi| pakṣmalaṃ ghanaromānvitam viśadaṃ cippaurahitam| amalojjvalamaṇḍalamiti nirmalojjvalacakṣurbahirbhāgam ‘nirmalamapākaṃ ca tvābahirbhāgam’ iti pā.||66-67||-
āhāraḥ prīṇanaḥ sadyo balakṛddehadhārakaḥ ||68|| āyustejaḥsamutsāhasmṛtyojognivivardhanaḥ |69|
āhāra ityādi| tejo bhrājiṣṇutā, samutsāhaḥ samyakcittavyavasāyaḥ, ojo hṛdisthaṃ prāṇāyatanam||68||-
pādaprakṣālanaṃ pādamalarogaśramāpaham ||69|| cakṣuḥprasādanaṃ vṛṣyaṃ rakṣoghnaṃ prītivardhanam |70|
cakṣuḥprasādanaṃ dṛṣṭiprasādanaṃ, dṛṣṭisaṃyuktapādanibandhananāḍīprasādanatvāt ‘dṛṣṭigata’ iti pā.; prabhāvādityapare| vṛṣyaṃ śukravṛddhikaraṃ, prabhāvāt||69||-
nidrākaro dehasukhaścakṣuṣyaḥ śramasuptinut ||70|| pādatvaṅmṛdukārī ca pādābhyaṅgaḥ sadā hitaḥ |71|
nidretyādi| pādābhyaṅgo'trāpi dṛṣṭipradaḥ pūrvavat||70||-

ab.seg: pādarogaharaṃ vṛṣyaṃ ‘vṛṣyamāyuṣyaṃ cakṣuṣe hitam’ iti pā. rakṣoghnaṃ prītivardhanam ||71||
sukhapracāramojasyaṃ sadā pādatradhāraṇam | anārogyamanāyuṣyaṃ cakṣuṣorupaghātakṛt ||72||
pādābhyāmanupānadbhyāṃ sadā caṅkramaṇaṃ nṛṇām | pāpmopaśamanaṃ keśanakharomāpamārjanam ||73||
harṣalāghavasaubhāgyakaramutsāhavardhanam | bāṇavāraṃ ‘vārabāṇaṃ’ iti pā. mṛjāvarṇatejobalavivardhanam ||74||
pādetyādi| pādatraṃ pādahitaṃ pādukādi| anupānadbhyāṃ pādatrāṇarahitābhyām| bāṇavāraṃ ‘vārabāṇaṃ kañcukaṃ ‘ḍantimpitāṅga’ iti loke’ iti pā. varma||71-74||

div.ab: pavitraṃ keśyamuṣṇīṣaṃ vātātaparajopaham |75|
pavitramityādi| uṣṇīṣaṃ śiroveṣṭanam|75|-
varṣānilarajogharmahimādīnāṃ nivāraṇam ||75|| varṇyaṃ cakṣuṣyamaujasyaṃ śaṅkaraṃ chatradhāraṇam |76|
varṣetyādi| śaṅkaraṃ sukhakaram||75||-

śunaḥ sarīsṛpavyālaviṣāṇibhyo bhayāpaham ||76|| śramaskhalanadoṣaghnaṃ sthavire ca praśasyate | sattvotsāhabalasthairyadhairyavīryavivardhanam ||77|| avaṣṭambhakaraṃ cāpi bhayaghnaṃ ‘rakṣoghnaṃ’ iti pā. daṇḍadhāraṇam |78|

śuna ityādi| sarīsṛpāḥ kṛṣṇasarpādayaḥ| vyālā vyāghrādayaḥ| viṣāṇibhyaḥ śṛṅgibhyaḥ| sattvaṃ sattvaguṇaḥ, utsāho balaṃ, balam ojaḥ, sthairyaṃ acalatvaṃ, dhairyaṃ dhīratvaṃ, vīryaṃ śaktiḥ| avaṣṭambhaḥ avalambanam| bhayaghnaṃ ‘rakṣoghnaṃ rākṣasaghnam’ iti pā. bhayanāśakam||76-77||-

ab.seg: āsyā varṇakaphasthaulyasaukumāryakarī sukhā ||78||
āsyetyādi| āsyā sthitiḥ||78||
adhvā varṇakaphasthaulyasaukumāryavināśanaḥ | atyadhvā viparīto'smājjarādaurbalyakṛcca saḥ ||79||
yattu caṅkramaṇaṃ nātidehapīḍākaraṃ bhavet | tadāyurbalamedhāgnipradamindriyabodhanam ||80||
adhvetyādi| atyadhvā atiśayena mārgagamanam| caṅkramaṇaṃ kuṭilagatyā paribhramaṇam||79-80||
śramānilaharaṃ vṛṣyaṃ puṣṭinidrādhṛtipradam | sukhaṃ śayyāsanaṃ, duḥkhaṃ viparītaguṇaṃ matam ||81||
bālavyajanamaujasyaṃ makṣikādīnapohati | śoṣadāhaśramasvedamūrcchāghno vyajanānilaḥ ||82||

śrametyādi| sukhaṃ śayyāsanaṃ vistṛtamāstīrṇaṃ mṛdugaṇḍopadhānādiyuktam| duḥkhaṃ saṅkocyāsanaṃ ‘duḥkhaśayyāsanaṃ’ iti pā., duḥkhaṃ viparītaguṇam| bālavyajanaṃ cāmarākhyavyajanam| vyajanānilaḥ tālavṛntavāyuḥ||81-82||
prītinidrākaraṃ vṛṣyaṃ kaphavātaśramāpaham | saṃvāhanaṃ māṃsaraktatvakprasādakaraṃ sukham ||83||
prītītyādi| saṃvāhanaṃ sukhakarasparśaḥ, mardanaṃ tu gāḍhaṃ pādābhyāmārabhya ‘pādābhyāṃ ca’ iti pā. kaṭiparyantaṃ, amitaprabhaṭīkākārastu hastābhyāṃ śanaiḥ śanairāhananamiti vadati||83||
pravātaṃ raukṣyavaivarṇyastambhakṛddāhapaktinut | svedamūrcchāpipāsāghnamapravātamato'nyathā ||84||
sukhaṃ vātaṃ praseveta grīṣme śaradi mānavaḥ | nivātaṃ hyāyuṣe sevyamārogyāya ca sarvadā ||85||
ātapaḥ pittatṛṣṇāgnisvedamūrcchābhramāsrakṛt | dāhavaivarṇyakārī ca chāyā caitānapohati ||86||
agnirvātakaphastambhaśītavepathunāśanaḥ | āmābhiṣyandajaraṇo raktapittapradūṣaṇaḥ ||87||
puṣṭivarṇabalotsāhamagnidīptimatandritām | karoti dhātusāmyaṃ ca nidrā kāle niṣevitā ||88||

sukhamityādi| “sukhaṃ pravātaṃ seveta grīṣme śaradi vā'ntarā” ityanye paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- grīṣmaśaradau pravātasevanakālaḥ, paraṃ tayorapi pravātasevanaṃ sāntaram| jyotsnātamasorguṇāḥ punaśchāyānivātaguṇaiḥ sadṛśā jñeyā itīha noktāḥ| adravyatve'pi ātapādīnāṃ prabhāvajaṃ karma; anye punarātapaṃ tejaḥparamāṇupuñjaṃ, chāyāmapi tamaḥparamāṇujāmāhuḥ||84-88||

tatrādita eva nīcanakharomṇā śucinā śuklavāsasā laghūṣṇīṣacchatropānatkena daṇḍapāṇinā kāle hitamitamadhurapūrvābhibhāṣiṇā bandhubhūtena bhūtānāṃ guruvṛddhānumatena susahāyenānanyamanasā khalūpacaritavyaṃ, tadapi na rātrau, na keśāsthikaṇṭakāśmatuṣabhasmotkarakapālāṅgārāmedhyasnānabalibhūmiṣu, na viṣamendrakīlacatuṣpathaśvabhrāṇāmupariṣṭāt ||89||

prātarutthitasya dantakāṣṭhakhādanādīndriyaśarīramanasāmupakārakamantaraṅgamabhidhāya bahiraṅgopacaraṇe saddhṛttamuddiśannāha- tatretyādi| laghūṣṇīṣam alpatanukṛtaṃ śiroveṣṭanaṃ; kecillaghupadaṃ chatreṇopānadā'pi sambandhayanti| upacaritavyam upagamanaṃ kartavyam| utkaraḥ tṛṇādisamūhaḥ; ācchāditakhanitamṛttikādirityapare| yāgārthaṃ nikhāto yūpopalakṣitaḥ pradeśa indrakīlaḥ, indrārthaṃ kīlā nyasyante yasmin deśe sa pradeśa indrakīlaḥ| catuṣpatho mārgacatuṣṭayasaṅgamaḥ| śvabhraṃ gartaḥ||89||
na rājadviṣṭaparuṣapaiśunyānṛtāni vadet, na devabrāhmaṇapitṛparivādāṃśca; na narendradviṣṭonmattapatitakṣudranīcānupāsīta ||90||

paiśunyaṃ sūcakatā, daurjanyamiti yāvat| parivādo doṣakathanam| unmatto vātūlaḥ, patitaḥ svakīyadharmādbhraṣṭaḥ ‘svakīyācārabhraṣṭaḥ’ iti pā., kṣudro laghuḥ, nīcā mlecchādayaḥ| nopāsīta nopaseveta||90||

vṛkṣaparvataprapātaviṣamavalmīkaduṣṭavājikuñjarādyadhirohaṇāni pariharet, pūrṇanadīsamudrāviditapalvalaśvabhrakūpāvataraṇāni, bhinnaśūnyāgāraśmaśānavijanāraṇyavāsāgnisambhramavyālabhujaṅgakīṭasevāśca, grāmāghātakalahaśastrasannipātavyālasarīsṛpaśṛṅgisannikarṣāṃśca ||91||

prapāto ‘prapātaḥ patanasthānaṃ’ iti pā. nirjharapatanam| kūpāntāvataraṇāni pariharediti sambandhaḥ; avidito'jñātasvarūpaḥ; palvalaṃ khātagartaḥ, avataraṇaṃ praveśaḥ; atrāpi pariharediti sambandhaḥ| bhinnaśūnyāgāraṃ patitagṛhaṃ janarahitagṛhaṃ ’patitavijanagṛhaṃ’ iti pā. ca, vijanaṃ nirjanam, araṇyaṃ aṭavī, agnisambhrama ‘agnisambhramo'tyantapradīptatvam’ iti pā. utpātapradīptaḥ, vyālā vyāghrādayaḥ, kīṭā vṛścikādayaḥ, grāmāghāto mārībhayajanyagrāmahananaṃ, sarīsṛpaḥ kṛṣṇasarpaḥ, sannikarṣaṃ naikaṭyaṃ pariharediti sambandhaḥ| pūrvamagnerhemantādāvatiśaityādabhipretasyāpi sevā atyantopāsanaṃ niṣiddham, atra tu grīṣmādau tasya sānnidhyamapi niṣiddhamiti budhyate| tathā pūrvaṃ vyālabhujaṅgayorapi sevā punaḥ punarnikaṭopāsanaṃ niṣiddham, atra tu viśvastayoḥ sānnidhyamapi niṣidhyata iti na paunaruktyam||91||

nāgnigogurubrāhmaṇapreṅkhādampatyantareṇa yāyāt | na śavamanuyāyāt | devagobrāhmaṇacaityadhvajarogipatitapāpakāriṇāṃ ca chāyāṃ nākrameta | nāstaṃ gacchantamudyantaṃ vā''dityaṃ vīkṣeta | gāṃ dhāpayantīṃ dhayantīṃ paraśasyaṃ vā carantīṃ na kasmaicidācakṣīta, na colkāpātotpātendradhanūṃṣi | nāgniṃ mukhenopadhamet | nāpo bhūmiṃ vā pāṇipādenābhihanyāt ||92||
