divāsvapnaṃ vyavāyaṃ ca vyāyāmaṃ krodhamātapam | surātilakulatthāṃśca varjayeddhi viṣāturaḥ ||31||

upadhārya jñātvetyarthaḥ, śubhāśubhaṃ hitāhitaṃ, vārayedviṣārtāneva| phāṇitamityādi| kulatthāṃścetyatra cakāreṇa piṇyākamūlakalasunakalāyakusumbhātasīśiśumārakūrmaniṣpāvajambvāmrātakacūtādikāni ca varjayet||29-31||

prasannadoṣaṃ prakṛtisthadhātumannābhikāṅkṣaṃ `annābhikāmaṃ’ iti pā. samasūtrajihvam | prasannavarṇendriyacittaceṣṭaṃ `prasannakāyendriyavarṇaceṣṭaṃ vaidyastu vidyādaviṣaṃ manuṣyam’ iti pā. vaidyo'vagacchedaviṣaṃ manuṣyam ||32||

aviṣaśca kīdṛśa ityāha- prasannadoṣamityādi| prasannadoṣaṃ svabhāvāvasthitavātādikaṃ, prakṛtisthadhātuṃ dadhatīti dhātavo rasādayo malāśca| annābhikāṅkṣaṃ bhojanābhilāṣiṇaṃ, etena samāgnitvamuktam| samasūtrajihvamiti samasūtrā jihvā yasya sa tathā tam| etaduktaṃ bhavati- nirviṣasya hi puruṣasya cittena saha samasūtratayā `samastaceṣṭāyāṃ’ iti pā. jihvā rasavedinī bhavati, saviṣasya viṣaprabhāveṇa dūṣitacittatvājjihvā rasavedinī na bhavatītyarthaḥ| anena ślokena `samadoṣaḥ samāgniśca’ ityādiślokasya sarva evārtho nibaddhaḥ| vaidyo'vagacchedaviṣaṃ manuṣyamiti uktalakṣaṇaḥ puruṣo'viṣo bhavati, viparītalakṣaṇastu viṣāturaḥ| tathā hi,- “pravṛddhadoṣaṃ vikṛtisthadhātumanannakāṅkṣaṃ kṣatasūtrajihvam| viruddhavarṇendriyacittaceṣṭaṃ vaidyo'vagacchet saviṣaṃ manuṣyam”- iti| `samamūtraviṭkaṃ’ iti kecit paṭhanti, tacca subodham| idaṃ saviṣāviṣalakṣaṇaṃ tīkṣṇatame sthāvaraviṣe sarpadaṣṭe ca draṣṭavyaṃ, natu mandaviṣe cireṇa dhātudūṣaṇakare mūṣikaviṣe kīṭaviṣeṣu ca; ata evottaratra mūṣikakīṭavikalpāviti| jejjaṭastu mūṣikakalpānantaraṃ dundubhisvanīyaṃ kalpaṃ paṭhati||32||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ kalpasthāne dundubhisvanīyakalpo nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ ||6||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ kalpasthāne ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ||6||

div.head: mūṣikakalpaḥ

ab.seg: athāto mūṣikakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi||1-2||
pūrvaṃ śukraviṣā uktā mūṣikā ye samāsataḥ | nāmalakṣaṇabhaiṣajyairaṣṭādaśa nibodha me `tān’ iti pā.||3||
lālanaḥ putrakaḥ kṛṣṇo haṃsiraścikvi(kki)rastathā | chucchundaro'lasaścaiva kaṣāyadaśano'pi ca ||4||
kuliṅgaścājitaścaiva capalaḥ kapilastathā kokilo'ruṇasañjñaśca mahākṛṣṇastathonduraḥ ||5||
śvetena mahatā sārdhaṃ kapilenākhunā tathā | mūṣikaśca kapotābhastathaivāṣṭādaśa smṛtāḥ ||6||
tānevāṣṭādaśabhedān nirdiśannāha- lālana ityādi||3-6||
śukraṃ patati yatraiṣāṃ śukraspṛṣṭaiḥ `śukraghṛṣṭaiḥ’ iti pā. spṛśanti vā | nakhadantādibhistasmin gātre raktaṃ praduṣyati ||7||

nanu `daṣṭarūpaṃ samāsoktaṃ’ iti vakṣyati tatkathaṃ śukraviṣatvamevetyāha- śukramityādi| nakhadantādibhirityādiśabdāt purīṣamūtrābhyāṃ ca; tathā cālambāyane,- “śukreṇātha purīṣeṇa mūtreṇāpi nakhaistathā| daṃṣṭrābhirvā kṣipantīha `vamantīha’ iti pā. mūṣikāḥ pañcadhā viṣam”- iti| kasmiṃścittantrāntare viśeṣo'sti, tathā ca,- “garbhiṇyā mūṣikayā daṣṭe amlādidohadaḥ, ṛtumatyā daṣṭe raktamehanamādhmānaṃ ratiśīlatā ca” ityādi||7||

div.ab: jāyante granthayaḥ śophāḥ karṇikā maṇḍalāni ca | pīḍakopacayaścogro visarpāḥ kiṭibhāni ca ||8|| parvabhedo rujastīvrā mūrcchā'ṅgasadanaṃ `jvaro mūrcchā ca dāruṇā’ iti pā. jvaraḥ | daurbalyamaruciḥ śvāso vamathurlomaharṣaṇam ||9|| daṣṭarūpaṃ samāsoktametadvyāsamataḥ ‘... metacca vyāsataḥ śṛṇu’ iti pā. śṛṇu |10|
sāmānyaṃ mūṣikadaṣṭalakṣaṇamabhidhātumāha- jāyante granthaya ityādi| karṇikā kamalamadhyabījakośākṛtiḥ| parvabhedaḥ sandheḥ sphoṭaḥ| aṅgasadanam aṅgaglāniḥ||8-9||-
lālāsrāvo lālanena hikkā chardiśca jāyate `chardayate’ iti pā.||10|| taṇḍulīyakakalkaṃ tu lihyāttatra samākṣikam |11|

teṣāṃ viśiṣṭaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ cikitsitaṃ ca nirdiśannāha- lālāsrāva ityādi| lālāsrāvacchardihikkā vātakopajā bhavanti| taṇḍulīyakakalkādikaṃ vyādhipratyanīkaṃ cikitsitaṃ, doṣapratyanīkaṃ tu sāmānyacikitsitoktaṃ `taptaghṛtena dagdhvā visrāvayeddaṃśaṃ’ ityādikam; evamanyatrāpi vyādhidoṣapratyanīkaṃ cikitsitaṃ svayamūhanīyaṃ; pratimūṣikoktaṃ tu cikitsitaṃ prāyo vyādhipratyanīkameva||10||-

ab.seg: putrakeṇāṅgasādaśca pāṇḍuvarṇaśca jāyate ||11||
cīyate granthibhiścāṅgamākhuśāvakasannibhaiḥ | śirīṣeṅgudakalkaṃ tu lihyāttatra samākṣikam ||12||

putrakeṇāṅgetyādi| ākhuśāvakasannibhairmūṣikaputrakatulyairgranthibhiraṅgaṃ cīyate vyāpyata ityarthaḥ| ākhuśāvakanibhā granthayaḥ sarvamūṣikadaṃśeṣu jāyante viśeṣeṇa putrakadaṣṭe| nāgārjuno'trāha,- “tena darśayate daṣṭo vyaktaṃ mūṣikaputrakān| etat putrakadaṣṭasya vyaktaṃ bhavati lakṣaṇam”- iti| `śirīṣeṅgudacūrṇaṃ tu’ iti paṭhitvā gayadāsaḥ anayoḥ patracūrṇamiti vyākhyānayati; jejjaṭācāryastu `śirīṣaphalakalkaṃ tu’ iti paṭhati||11-12||
kṛṣṇena `kṛṣṇenāsṛk chardayati durdineṣu viśeṣataḥ’ iti pā. daṃśe śopho'sṛkchardiḥ prāyaśca durdine | śirīṣaphalakuṣṭhaṃ tu pibet kiṃśukabhasmanā ||13||
kṛṣṇenetyādi| granthyādīnyatrāpi sāmānyamūṣikalakṣaṇāni vijñeyāni; evaṃ sarvatronneyam| prāyaśceti vacanādanyatrāpyasṛkcchardiḥ| kiṃśukabhasmanā kiṃśukakusumabhasmodakenetyarthaḥ||13||
haṃsireṇānnavidveṣo jṛmbhā romṇāṃ ca harṣaṇam | pibedāragvadhādiṃ tu suvāntastatra mānavaḥ ||14||
haṃsireṇetyādi| suvāntaḥ suṣṭhu vāntaḥ||14||

div.ab: cikvi(kki)reṇa śiroduḥkhaṃ śopho hikkā vamistathā | jālinīmadanāṅkoṭhakaṣāyairvāmayettu tam ||15|| yavanālarṣabhīkṣāraṃ bṛhatyoścātra dāpayet |16|

cikvireṇetyādi| jālinī kośātakī, ṛṣabhī kapikacchuḥ, bṛhatyośceti cakāreṇa kṣāramityatrāpi sambandhanīyam| kṣāraścātra kṣārodakam| gayadāsastu `jālinīmadanāṅkoṭha’ ityādisthāne `suvānto jālinīkvāthaiḥ sāramaṅkoṭhajaṃ pibet’ iti paṭhati na yavanālādi||15||-

chucchundareṇa `chucchundareṇa viḍbhaṅgo grīvāstambho vijṛmbhaṇam| yavanālarṣabhakṣāraṃ bṛhatyoścātra dāpayet’ iti pā. tṛṭ chardirjvaro daurbalyameva ca ||16|| grīvāstambhaḥ pṛṣṭhaśopho gandhājñānaṃ visūcikā | cavyaṃ harītakī śuṇṭhī viḍaṅgaṃ pippalī madhu ||17|| aṅkoṭhabījaṃ ca tathā pibedatra viṣāpaham |18|

chucchundareṇetyādi| chucchundaradaṣṭalakṣaṇaṃ taccikitsitaṃ ca gayadāso'nyathā paṭhati; yathā- “bhramaśchucchundareṇogro grīvāstambho visūcikā| yavanālarṣabhīkṣāraṃ bṛhatyoścātra dāpayet” iti||16-17||-

grīvāstambho'lasenordhvavāyurdaṃśe rujā jvaraḥ ||18|| mahāgadaṃ sasarpiṣkaṃ lihyāttatra samākṣikam | nidrā kaṣāyadantena hṛcchoṣaḥ kārśyameva ca ||19|| kṣaudropetāḥ śirīṣasya lihyāt sāraphalatvacaḥ | kuliṅgena rujaḥ `rujā srāvo’ iti pā. śopho rājyaśca daṃśamaṇḍale ||20|| sahe sasindhuvāre ca lihyāttatra samākṣike |21|
grīvāstambha ityādi| sahe mudgaparṇīmāṣaparṇyau||18-20||-
ajitenāṅgakṛṣṇatvaṃ `ajitena vamirmūrcchā hṛdgrahaḥ kṛṣṇanetratā’ iti pā. chardirmūrcchā ca hṛdgrahaḥ ||21|| snukkṣīrapiṣṭāṃ pālindīṃ mañjiṣṭhāṃ madhunā lihet |22|
ajitenetyādi| pālindī trivṛt||21||-
capalena bhavecchardirmūrcchā ca saha tṛṣṇayā ||22|| kṣaudreṇa kṣaudreṇalihyāttriphalāṃ’ iti pā. triphalāṃ lihyādbhadrakāṣṭhajaṭānvitām |23|
capalenetyādi| bhadrakāṣṭhaṃ devadāru, jaṭā jaṭāmāṃsī| `jaṭānvitāṃ’ ityatra `ghanānvitām’ iti kecit||22||-

kapilena vraṇe kotho jvaro granthyudgamaḥ satṛṭ ||23|| lihyānmadhuyutāṃ `kṣaudreṇa lihyāntriphalāṃ’ iti pā. śvetāṃ śvetāṃ cāpi punarnavām | granthayaḥ kokilenogrā jvaro dāhaśca dāruṇaḥ `jāyate’ iti pā.||24|| varṣābhūnīlinīkvāthakalkasiddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ pibet |25|

ab.seg: kapilenetyādi| kothaḥ pūtiprādurbhāvaḥ| śvetāṃ śvetasyandāṃ, `śvetāṃ’ ityatra gayadāsaḥ `śreṣṭhāṃ’ iti paṭhati||23-24||

div.ab: aruṇenānilaḥ kruddho vātajān kurute gadān ||25|| mahākṛṣṇena pittaṃ ca śvetena kapha eva ca | mahatā kapilenāsṛk kapotena `kapotenaiva tu trayam’ iti pā. catuṣṭayam ||26|| bhavanti caiṣāṃ daṃśeṣu granthimaṇḍalakarṇikāḥ | piḍakopacayaścograḥ śophaśca bhṛśadāruṇaḥ ||27|| dadhikṣīraghṛtaprasthāstrayaḥ pratyekaśo matāḥ | karañjāragvadhavyoṣabṛhatyaṃśumatīsthirāḥ ||28|| niṣkvāthya caiṣāṃ kvāthasya caturthoṃ'śaḥ punarbhavet | trivṛdgojyamṛtāvakrasarpagandhāḥ `trivṛttiktā'mṛtā’ iti pā. samṛttikāḥ ||29|| kapitthadāḍimatvak ca ślakṣṇapiṣṭāḥ `supiṣṭāni prayojayet’ iti pā. pradāpayet | tat sarvamekataḥ kṛtvā śanairmṛdvagninā pacet ||30|| pañcānāmaruṇādīnāṃ viṣametadvyapohati | kākādanīkākamācyoḥ svaraseṣvathavā kṛtam ||31|| sirāśca srāvayet `mokṣayet’ iti pā. prāptāḥ kuryāt saṃśodhanāni ca |32|

dadhyādīni prasthamātrāṇi, karañjādidravyāṇāṃ dvipalikaṃ bhāgaṃ, salilāḍhakena niṣkvāthya, kvathitaṃ prasthaśeṣaṃ, taistribhiḥ prasthaiḥ saha saṃyojya, trivṛnmūlādikalkapādaṃ ca vipacet; pakvaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ virecanaṃ bhavati| aṃśumatī śālaparṇī, gojī gojihvā, amṛtā guḍūcī, vakraṃ tagaraṃ, sarpagandhā sarpacchatrikā| samṛttikāḥ sakṛṣṇamṛttikāḥ, `ahimṛttikā’ iti kecit paṭhanti, atrāhimṛttikā valmīkamṛttikā; `agavṛttikā’ iti jejjaṭācāryaḥ paṭhati, tatrāgavṛttikā śallakī| dvitīyaṃ ghṛtamāha- kākādanītyādi| kākādanī kṛṣṇaśrīphalikā, kṛtaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ, ghṛtamiti śeṣaḥ| sirā ityādi| prāptā yuktā marmānāśritāḥ| saṃśodhanāni vamanādīni nasyaparyantāni, tānyapi prāptāni; tenāvamyāvirecyayoravarodhaḥ| anye tu viṣāturā avamyā api vamyā eva, `ete'pyajīrṇavyathitā vāmyā ye ca viṣāturā’ iti||25-31||-

ab.seg: sarveṣāṃ ca vidhiḥ kāryo mūṣikāṇāṃ viṣeṣvayam ||32||
aruṇādyāśritaṃ sirāvyadhādikaṃ sāmānyataḥ sarvatrātidiśannāha- sarveṣāmityādi| ayaṃ vidhiḥ sirāvyadhādikaḥ kartavya ityarthaḥ||32||
dagdhvā visrāvayeddaṃśaṃ pracchitaṃ ca pralepayet | śirīṣarajanīkuṣṭhakuṅkumairamṛtāyutaiḥ ||33||

dagdhvetyādi| dagdhvā `ghṛtenāgnitaptena’ iti śeṣaḥ| visrāvayet pracchannena pracchitaṃ daṃśam| śirīṣādibhiḥ kalkairālepayet| tathaiva kecit pracchitaṃ daṃśaṃ visrāvayecchoṇitaṃ śirīṣādikalkairālepayeccetyāhuḥ||33||
chardanaṃ jālinīkvāthaiḥ śukākhyāṅkoṭhayorapi ||34||

div.ab: śodhanaṃ sūtritaṃ dravyairvivṛṇvannāha- chardanamityādi| śukākhyaḥ carmakāravaṭaḥ||34||-

ab.seg: śukākhyākoṣavatyośca mūlaṃ madana eva ca | devadālīphalaṃ caiva dadhnā pītvā viṣaṃ vamet | sarvamūṣikadaṣṭānāmeṣa yogaḥ sukhāvahaḥ ||35||
phalaṃ vacā devadālī kuṣṭhaṃ gobhūtrapeṣitam | pūrvakalpena yojyāḥ `yojyaṃ syātsarvonduraviṣacchidi iti pā. syuḥ sarvonduruviṣacchidaḥ ||36||
aparāvapi vamanayogāvāha- śukākhyetyādi| koṣavatī ghoṣakaḥ| mūlamityatra phalamityanye| phalamityādi| pūrvakalpena dadhnā lehamityarthaḥ||34-36||

div.ab: virecane trivṛddantītriphalākalka iṣyate |37|
virecanamāha- virecane ityādi| dantīsthāne kecinnīlīṃ paṭhanti|37|
śirovirecane sāraḥ śirīṣasya phalāni ca ||37|| hitastrikaṭukāḍhyaśca gomayasvaraso'ñjane |38|
śirovirecane ityādi| sāraḥ śirīṣasya, gayadāsastu śālatamālamadhūkānāmāha| phalāni ceti śirīṣasyeti sambandhaḥ| trikaṭukāḍhyaḥ trikaṭukotkaṭa ityarthaḥ| etacca yogāntaram||37||-

ab.seg: kapitthagomayarasau `kapitthagomayarasaḥ sakṣaudro leha iṣyate’ iti pā. lihyānmākṣikasaṃyutau ||38||
rasāñjanaharidrendrayavakaṭvīṣu vā kṛtam | prātaḥ sātiviṣaṃ kalkaṃ lihyānmākṣikasaṃyutam ||39||
taṇḍulīyakamūleṣu sarpiḥ siddhaṃ pibennaraḥ | āsphotamūlasiddhaṃ vā pañcakāpitthameva vā ||40||

saṃśamanayogānāha- kapitthetyādi| pratyekaṃ kapittharaso gomayarasaśca samadhurlehaḥ| rasāñjanetyādi| kaṭvī kaṭurohiṇī| taṇḍulīyaketyādi| kapitthaphalamūlapuṣpatvakpatrakalkakaṣāyasiddhaṃ pañcakāpitthaṃ ghṛtaṃ sarvamūṣikaviṣaharam||38-40||
mūṣikāṇāṃ viṣaṃ prāyaḥ kupyatyabhreṣvanirhṛtam `abhreṣu nirhṛtaṃ’iti pā.| tatrāpyeṣa vidhiḥ kāryo yaśca dūṣīviṣāpahaḥ ||41||

praśāntakopasyāpyavaśyaṃ vamanādiśodhanaṃ karaṇīyamiti darśayannāha- mūṣikāṇāmityādi| eṣa vidhiḥ vamanavirecanaśirovirecananayanāñjanādiḥ| yaśca dūṣīviṣāpaho vidhiḥ so'pyatra kāryaḥ; etena dūṣīviṣatulyatā mūṣikaviṣasyoktā||41||
sthirāṇāṃ rujatāṃ vā'pi vraṇānāṃ karṇikāṃ bhiṣak | pāṭayitvā yathādoṣaṃ vraṇavaccāpi śodhayet ||42||

idānīmākhuviṣavraṇe karṇikā bhavanti tathā'nyaviṣaduṣṭavraṇe'pi, taccikitsāmuddiśannāha- sthirāṇāmityādi| sthairyeṇa kaphātmakatā, rujatāmityanena vātātmakatā vraṇānāmuktā| karṇikāṃ māṃsakarṇīkam| pāṭayitvā vidārya, pāṭayitvetyatra pācayitveti kecit, pātayitvetyapare| lālanaputrakādimūṣikajātiviśeṣajñānaṃ nānādeśīyalokebhyo'vagantavyam||42||

div.ab: śvaśṛgālatarakṣvṛkṣavyāghrādīnāṃ yadā'nilaḥ | śleṣmapraduṣṭo muṣṇāti sañjñāṃ sañjñāvahāśritaḥ ||43|| tadā prasrastalāṅgūlahanuskandho'tilālavān | atyarthabadhiro'ndhaśca `avyaktabadhirāndhaśca’ iti pā. so'nyonyamabhidhāvati ||44|| tenonmattena daṣṭasya daṃṣṭriṇā saviṣeṇa tu | suptatā jāyate daṃśe kṛṣṇaṃ cātisravatyasṛk ||45|| digdhaviddhasya liṅgena prāyaśaścopalakṣitaḥ |46|

idānīṃ mūṣakasya `mūṣakatva...’ iti pā. catuṣpadajarāyujahiṃsratvasāmānyācchvādīnāṃ viṣaṃ lakṣaṇacikitsitairuddiśannāha- śvaśṛgālatarakṣvṛkṣetyādi| śvā kukkuraḥ, śṛgālaḥ prasiddhaḥ, tarakṣuḥ mṛgaśatrurvyāghraviśeṣaḥ `jarakha’ iti loke, ṛkṣo bhallūko'tilomaśaḥ `rīccha’ iti prasiddhaḥ; ādiśabdādvṛkacitrakādayo hiṃsrāḥ paśavo grāhyāḥ| śvādīnāṃ yadā'nilo vāyuḥ śleṣmapraduṣṭaḥ san, sañjñāvahāśrito sañjñāvahasrotogataḥ, sañjñāṃ samyagjñānaṃ, muṣṇāti harati| samyagjñānaharaṇācca kīdṛśo bhavatītyāha- tadetyādi| prasrastaṃ sthānacyutaṃ lāṅgūlaṃ bāladhirmehanaṃ vā hanuḥ skandhaśca yasya saḥ; prasrastaśabdo lāṅgūlādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambandhanīyaḥ| atilālavān atiśayena lālāsrāvayuktaḥ| atyarthabadhiro'ndhaśca `avyaktabadhirāndhaśca na vyakto badhiro'ndho vetyarthaḥ’ iti pā. atiśayena badhiro'ndho vetyarthaḥ| anyonyamabhidhāvati parasparaṃ daṣṭumabhidhāvati| hanuskandhasthāne `galaskandha `stanaskandha’ iti pā. ’ iti kecit paṭhanti| `pramūḍho'nyatamasteṣāṃ khādan viparidhāvati’ iti atra uttarārdhaṃ kecit paṭhanti| eṣāṃ madhye'nyatama ekatamaḥ pramūḍhaḥ san khādan viśeṣeṇa paridhāvati| tenonmattena daṣṭasyetyādi| tena daṃṣṭriṇā saviṣeṇonmattena daṣṭasya puruṣasya daṃśe suptatā bādhirya jāyate| upalakṣito yukta ityarthaḥ||43-45||-
yena cāpi bhaveddaṣṭastasya ceṣṭāṃ rutaṃ naraḥ ||46|| bahuśaḥ pratikurvāṇaḥ kriyāhīno vinaśyati |47|
atraivāriṣṭamuddiśannāha- yena cāpi bhavedityādi| ceṣṭā kriyā, rutaṃ śabdaḥ, bahuśaḥ anekavāraṃ, pratikurvāṇaḥ anukurvan, kriyāhīnaḥ svakīyakāyādivyāpārarahitaḥ||46||-
daṃṣṭriṇā yena daṣṭaśca tadrūpaṃ yastu paśyati ||47|| apsu `apsu vā''darśabimbe vā tasya tadriṣṭamādiśet’ iti pā. vā yadi vā''darśe'riṣṭaṃ tasya vinirdiśet |48|
idānīmaparamapyariṣṭaṃ nirdiśannāha- daṃṣṭriṇā yenetyādi| taddaṃṣṭrirūpadarśanamariṣṭaṃ maraṇalakṣaṇam||47||-
trasyatyakasmādyo'bhīkṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā `śrutvā dṛṣṭvā'pi’ iti pā. spṛṣṭvā'pi vā jalam ||48|| jalatrāsaṃ tu vidyāttaṃ riṣṭaṃ tadapi `tamapi kīrtayet’ iti pā. kīrtitam |49|

punaraparamapyariṣṭaṃ nirdiśannāha- trasyatītyādi| akasmāt jalatrāsahetuṃ vinā| apiśabdācchrutvā'pi| jalatrāsaṃ jalatrāsarogaṃ jānīyāttasyeti sambandhaḥ| riṣṭamityādi| tadapi jalatrasanamariṣṭaṃ maraṇalakṣaṇaṃ kīrtitaṃ; etaccāriṣṭaṃ daṣṭasya, adaṣṭe jalatrasanāriṣṭasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt| atrārthe tantrāntaram,- “vyādhitena śvādinā daṣṭasya śleṣmā prakupitaścetovāhinīrdhamanīranupraviśya sañjñānāśamāpādayati sadyaḥ kālāntarādvā”; avabhṛte viśeṣataḥ- “tato naraḥ spṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā śrutvā vā jalaṃ trasyati, tasyāpi tadariṣṭaṃ jānīyāt” iti| gayadāsastu `yadi trasyatyadaṣṭo'pi’ ityādi paṭhati||48||-
adaṣṭo vā jalatrāsī na kathañcana sidhyati ||49|| prasupto'thotthito vā'pi svasthastrasto na sidhyati |50|

evamadaṣṭasyāpi jalatrāso'riṣṭameveti darśayannāha- adaṣṭa ityādi| asminnarthe tantrāntaram,- “adaṣṭasyāpi jantorhi jalatrāso bhavedyadi| tasya riṣṭaṃ hi bhiṣajo bruvate viṣacintakāḥ” iti| jalaṃ vinā'pi jalatrāso jāyate śleṣmasañcayāt| tathā coktaṃ,- “buddhisthānaṃ yadā śleṣmā kevalaṃ `kevalaḥ’ iti pā. pratipadyate| tadā buddhau niruddhāyāṃ śleṣmaṇā'dhiṣṭhito naraḥ|jāgrat supto'thavā''tmānaṃ majjantamiva manyate| salile trasyati tadā jalatrāsaṃ tu taṃ viduḥ|| śleṣmaghnaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ śodhanaṃ śamanāni ca| āhārasya vidhānena yāvat sa prakṛtiṃ vrajet”- iti| ayaṃ jalatrāsaḥ kupitakaphasya bhavatīti riṣṭaṃ na bhavati, ata evātra cikitsopadeśaḥ, daṣṭasya tu riṣṭameva| tathā svasthasya suptasya jāgrato vā jalamantareṇa trāso'riṣṭameveti darśayannāha- prasupto'thotthito vā'pītyādi||49||-

daṃśaṃ visrāvya tairdaṣṭe sarpiṣā paridāhitam ||50|| pradihyādagadaiḥ, sarpiḥ purāṇaṃ pāyayeta ca | arkakṣīrayutaṃ hyasya `vā'pi dadyādāśu’ iti pā. dadyāccāpi viśodhanam ||51|| śvetāṃ punarnavāṃ cāsya dadyāddhattūrakāyutām | palalaṃ tilatailaṃ ca rūpikāyāḥ payo guḍaḥ ||52|| nihanti viṣamālarkaṃ meghavṛndamivānilaḥ |53|

idānīṃ cikitsāvasaraḥ- daṃśaṃ visrāvyetyādi| visrāvya niṣpīḍanena srāvayitvā bījabhūtasya viṣasya nāśanārthaṃ, sarpiṣā dāhastu taccheṣanāśanārtham| agadaiḥ mahāgadādibhiḥ, pradihyāt limpet| visrāvitaśoṇitasya vātaśamanārthaṃ bāhyamauṣadhamuddiśyābhyantaramuddiśannāha- sarpirityādi| viśodhanaṃ viśodhanadravyaṃ, tatra kaphādhikye vamanadravyayutaṃ pittādhikye virecanadravyayutamarkakṣīraṃ dadyāt| jejjaṭastu `arkakṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ vā'sya’ iti paṭhati| anye `dadyācchīrṣavirecanaṃ’ iti paṭhanti| śvetāmityādi|- śvetāmiti punarnavāviśeṣaṇam; anye śvetāṃ kaṭabhīmāhuḥ| dhattūrakāyutāṃ dhattūramūlānvitām| gayī tu `dhattūrārdhasamāyutām’ iti paṭhitvā, dhattūramūlasyārdhena yutāmiti vyākhyānayati| anye tu dhattūraphalasaṃyutāmityāhuḥ||50-52||-

mūlasya śarapuṅkhāyāḥ karṣaṃ dhattūrakārdhikam ||53|| taṇḍulodakamādāya peṣayettaṇḍulaiḥ saha | unmattakasya patraistu saṃveṣṭyāpūpakaṃ pacet ||54|| khādedauṣadhakāle tamalarkaviṣadūṣitaḥ | karoti śvavikārāṃstu `karotyanyān vikārāṃstu’ iti pā. tasmiñjīryati cauṣadhe ||55|| vikārāḥ śiśire yāpyā gṛhe vārivivarjite | tataḥ śāntavikārastu snātvā caivāpare'hani ||56|| śāliṣaṣṭikayorbhaktaṃ kṣīreṇoṣṇena bhojayet | dinatraye pañcame vā vidhireṣo'rdhamātrayā ||57|| kartavyo bhiṣajā'vaśyamalarkaviṣanāśanaḥ | kupyet svayaṃ viṣaṃ yasya na sa jīvati mānavaḥ ||58|| tasmāt prakopayedāśu svayaṃ yāvat `yāvanna kupyati’ iti pā. prakupyati |59|

mūlamityādi| dhattūrakārdhikamiti dhattūrakajaṭāyāḥ karṣārdhaṃ deyam| unmattakasya patraistvityādi| dhattūrakasya sapta parṇāni grāhyāṇi, tantrāntaradarśanāt| tasya bhakṣitasya jaraṇakāle yogaprabhavādāturaḥ kukkuraceṣṭā eva karoti| auṣadhapariṇatikāle yāṃśca vikārānāturaḥ karoti teṣu pratīkāramāha- vikārā ityādi| vikārā unmattaśvādidaṣṭotpannāḥ| śiśire śītale vārivivarjite gṛhe yāpyāḥ śamanīyāḥ `gamanīyāḥ’ iti pā.| tata ityādi| kṣīreṇoṣṇena bhojayediti annaṃ gavyenājye(je)na vā bhojayediti gayadāsācāryaḥ| eṣa vidhiḥ śvetāṃ punarnavāmityādikaḥ| ardhamātrayā prāguktamātrātaḥ| kasmādeṣa vidhiḥ kāryo dinatraye pañcame vetyāha- kupyedityādi||53-58||-

bījaratnauṣadhīgarbhaiḥ `kṣiptaratnauṣadhibījaiḥ’ iti pā. kumbhaiḥ śītāmbupūritaiḥ ||59|| snāpayettaṃ nadītīre samantrairvā catuṣpathe | baliṃ nivedya tatrāpi piṇyākaṃ palalaṃ dadhi ||60|| mālyāni ca vicitrāṇi māṃsaṃ pakvāmakaṃ tathā | alakādhipate yakṣa sārameyagaṇādhipa ! ||61|| alarkajuṣṭametanme nirviṣaṃ kuru mācirāt |62|

idānīmalarkaviṣe bhūtānubandho bhavatīti taccikitsārthaṃ savidhivaidikaṃ mantramuddiśannāha- bījaratnauṣadhītyādi| tamalarkajuṣṭam alarkaviṣajuṣṭam| piṇyākaḥ tilakhalī, palalaḥ sasnehastilakalkaḥ| alakāyā nagaryā adhipatiḥ dhanadaḥ, yakṣo devayoniḥ, sārameyagaṇādhipaḥ kukkurasamūhapatiḥ, tasya sambodhane| alakādhipatiryakṣa eva sārameyagaṇādhipatiḥ| alarkaṃ unmattakukkuraḥ||59-61||-
dadyāt saṃśodhanaṃ tīkṣṇamevaṃ snātasya `tīkṣṇamajasraṃ tasya’ iti pā. dehinaḥ ||62|| aśuddhasya surūḍhe'pi vraṇe kupyati tadviṣam |63|
dadyādityādi||62||-

ab.seg: śvādayo'bhihitā vyālā ye'tra `vātapittaprakopaṇāḥ’ iti pā. daṃṣṭrāviṣā mayā ||63||
ataḥ karoti daṣṭastu teṣāṃ ceṣṭāṃ rutaṃ naraḥ | bahuśaḥ pratikurvāṇo na cirānmriyate ca saḥ ||64||

idānīmunmattaśvādiviṣaṃ pratipādayitumunmattavyālānāmunmattatāsūcakaśvaprakāreṇābhihitatvamāha- śvādayo'bhihitā vyālā ityādi| ye'tra daṃṣṭrāviṣā vyālāḥ te śvādayaḥ śvaprakārā unmattaśvasadṛśā mayā pratipāditāḥ, te tu vātapittaprakopaṇadaṃśāsṛkkṛṣṇatvena `daṃśadeśakṛṣṇatvena’ iti pā. purāṇasarpiḥpānena cānumitāḥ||63-64||
nakhadantakṣataṃ vyālairyatkṛtaṃ tadvimardayet | siñcettailena koṣṇena te hi vātaprakopakāḥ ||65||
unmattaśvādicikitsitaṃ sahetukaṃ darśayannāha- nakhadantakṣatamityādi||65||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ kalpasthāne mūṣikakalpo nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ ||7||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne saptamo'dhyāyaḥ||7||

div.head: kīṭakalpaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ kīṭakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
sarpāṇāṃ śukraviṇmūtraśavapūtyaṇḍasambhavāḥ | vāyvagnyambuprakṛtayaḥ kīṭāstu vividhāḥ `trividhāḥ’ iti pā. smṛtāḥ ||3||
sarvadoṣaprakṛtibhiryuktāste pariṇāmataḥ | kīṭatve'pi sughorāḥ `sughorāste’ iti pā. syuḥ, sarva eva caturvidhāḥ ||4||

tatra kīṭān hetulakṣaṇasaṅkhyākarmacikitsitairnirdiśannāha- sarpāṇāmityādi| sarpāṇāṃ darvīkaramaṇḍalirājimatāṃ śukrādipañcasambhavā yathāsaṅkhyaṃ vāyvagnyambuprakṛtayaḥ kīṭāḥ| śavo mṛtasarpaśarīraṃ, tasya pūtiḥ śaṭanam| trīn kīṭān darvīkaramaṇḍalirājilasambandhena vāyvādiprakṛtikramānnirdiśya `viṇmūtrādikramānnirdiśannāha’ iti pā. caturthaṃ svabhāvena karmaṇā ca nirdiśannāha- sarvadoṣetyādi| sarvadoṣasvabhāvairyuktāḥ; pariṇāmataḥ pariṇāmo nāma bhinnajātīyairanekairekībhāvena `bhinnajātaiḥ’ iti pā. kāryasyārambhaḥ, sa cātra darvīkarādibhinnajātīyairvaikarañjākhyāpatyotpādanalakṣaṇaḥ, tasmāt| sughorāḥ tridoṣakopanāḥ, vaikarañjasarpajātiśukrādisambhavatvena| ekīkṛtya saṅkhyāmāha- sarva evetyādi||1-4||

div.ab: kumbhīnasastuṇḍikerī śṛṅgī śatakulīrakaḥ | ucciṭiṅgo'gnināmā ca cicciṭiṅgo mayūrikā ||5|| āvartakastathorabhraḥ sārikāmukhavaidalau | śarāvakurdo'bhīrājiḥ paruṣaścitraśīrṣakaḥ `citramūrdhakaḥ’ iti pā.||6|| śatabāhuśca yaścāpi raktarājiśca kīrtitaḥ | aṣṭādaśeti vāyavyāḥ `aṣṭādaśaiva jñātavyāḥ’ iti pā. kīṭāḥ pavanakopanāḥ ||7|| tairbhavantīha daṣṭānāṃ rogā vātanimittajāḥ |8|

tāneva catuḥprakārān vātādisvabhāvairnirdiśannāha `vātādisvabhāvān’ iti pā. - kumbhīnasa ityādi| ete kīṭakabhedā nānādeśīyalokādavagantavyāḥ, yataḥ suvīranandivarāhajejjaṭagayadāsādibhiḥ ṭīkākārairna vyākhyātāḥ| vātanimittajā rogāstodādayo jvarādayaśca| vātaprakopaṇānāṃ kumbhīnasādīnāṃ madhye śṛṅgyucciṭiṅgaśarāvakurdacitraśīrṣakān varjayitvā śeṣāścaturdaśa mukhasandaṃśaviṣāḥ||5-7||-

kauṇḍinyakaḥ kaṇabhako varaṭī patravṛścikaḥ ||8|| vināsikā brāhmaṇikā bindulo bhramarastathā | bāhyakī picciṭaḥ kumbhī varcaḥkīṭo'rimedakaḥ ||9|| padmakīṭo dundubhiko makaraḥ śatapādakaḥ | pañcālakaḥ pākamatsyaḥ kṛṣṇatuṇḍo'tha `sūkṣmatuṇḍo'tha’ iti pā. gardabhī ||10|| klītaḥ kṛmisarārī ca yaścāpyutkleśakastathā | ete hyagniprakṛtayaścaturviṃśatireva ca ||11|| tairbhavantīha daṣṭānāṃ rogāḥ pittanimittajāḥ |12|

kauṇḍinyaka ityādi| bindulasthāne `viluṭa’ iti kecit| pittanimittajā dāhādayo jvarādayaśca| pittaprakopaṇānāṃ madhye kauṇḍinyakavaraṭībhramarapicciṭavarcaḥkīṭamakaraśatapadapañcālakapākamatsyakṛṣṇatuṇḍān `sūkṣmatuṇḍān’ iti pā. vihāya śeṣāścaturdaśa mukhasandaṃśaviṣāḥ||8-11||-

viśvambharaḥ pañcaśuklaḥ pañcakṛṣṇo'tha `valabhī kapilastathā| sairīyakaḥ pañcakṛṣṇaḥ pracalāko'tha koṭikaḥ’ iti pā. kokilaḥ ||12|| saireyakaḥ pracalako valabhaḥ kiṭibhastathā | sūcīmukhaḥ kṛṣṇagodhā yaśca kāṣāyavāsikaḥ ||13|| kīṭo gardabhakaścaiva `koṭīgardabhakaścaiva’ iti pā. tathā troṭaka eva ca | trayodaśaite saumyāḥ syuḥ kīṭāḥ śleṣmaprakopaṇāḥ ||14|| tairbhavantīha daṣṭānāṃ rogāḥ kaphanimittajāḥ |15|
viśvambhara ityādi| śleṣmanimittajā rogāḥ kaṇḍvādayo jvarādayaśca| śleṣmaprakopiṇāṃ madhye viśvambharapracalākakṛṣṇagodhākāṣāyavāsikāṃścaturo varjayitvā navānye mukhasandaṃśaviṣāḥ||12-14||-

ab.seg: tuṅgīnāso vicilakastālako vāhakastathā ||15||
koṣṭhāgārī krimikaro yaśca maṇḍalapucchakaḥ | tuṇḍa(ṅga)nābhaḥ sarṣapiko valguliḥ śambukastathā ||16||
agnikīṭaśca vijñeyā dvādaśa prāṇanāśanāḥ | tairbhavantīha daṣṭānāṃ vegajñānāni sarpavat ||17||
tāstāśca vedanāstīvrā rogā vai sānnipātikāḥ | kṣārāgnidagdhavaddaṃśo raktapītasitāruṇaḥ ||18||

sarvadoṣaprakṛtikānāha- tuṅgīnāsa ityādi| taiḥ sarvadoṣaprakṛtikaiḥ prāṇanāśanaiḥ kīṭaiḥ| tāstāḥ todadāhakaṇḍvādikā vedanāḥ, rogā jvarādayaḥ| daṃśa ityādi| raktapītaḥ pittena, sitaḥ kaphena, aruṇo vātena| sarvadoṣaprakṛtikānāṃ madhye vāhakasarṣapaśambūkān varjayitvā nava mukhasandaṃśaviṣāḥ||15-18||

div.ab: jvarāṅgamardaromāñcavedanābhiḥ samanvitaḥ | chardyatīsāratṛṣṇāśca dāho mūrcchā vijṛmbhikā ||19|| vepathuśvāsahikkāśca dāhaḥ śītaṃ ca dāruṇam | piḍakopacayaḥ śopho granthayo maṇḍalāni ca ||20|| dadravaḥ karṇikāścaiva visarpāḥ kiṭibhāni ca | tairbhavantīha daṣṭānāṃ yathāsvaṃ cāpyupadravāḥ ||21|| ye'nye teṣāṃ viśeṣāstu tūrṇaṃ teṣāṃ samādiśet | dūṣīviṣaprakopācca tathaiva viṣalepanāt ||22|| liṅgaṃ tīkṣṇaviṣeṣveta... |23|

ab.seg: idānīṃ caturvidhānapi tāṃstīkṣṇamandaviṣabhedena nirdiśannāha- jvarāṅgetyādi| śītaṃ ca dāruṇamityatra cakārāddāho'pi dāruṇa eva| yathāsvaṃ yathākīṭadoṣamityarthaḥ| ye'nye ityādi| teṣāṃ tīkṣṇaviṣāṇāṃ kīṭānāmatroktebhyo ye'nye viśeṣā upadravāsteṣāṃ bhedāṃstūrṇaṃ samādiśediti| teṣāmiti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī, tena tān kṣipraṃ kathayet, kathaṃ? dūṣīviṣaprakopāt dūṣīviṣaprakopaṃ vīkṣya| yapi lupte pañcamīyam| tathaiva viṣalepanāditi lepanamatrāhārastena viṣālepanaṃ viṣāhāraṃ vīkṣyetyarthaḥ||19-22||

div.ab: ...cchṛṇu mandaviṣeṣvataḥ | prasekārocakacchardiśirogauravaśītakāḥ ||23|| piḍakākoṭhakaṇḍūnāṃ janma `koṭhārupiḍakākaṇḍūjanma’ iti pā. doṣavibhāgataḥ |24|
śṛṇu mandaviṣeṣvityādi| śītako alpaṃ śītaṃ, koṭhādīnāṃ janma yathā kīṭadoṣavibhāgena||23||-

yogairnānāvidhaireṣāṃ cūrṇāni garamādiśet ||24|| dūṣīviṣaprakārāṇāṃ `dūṣīviṣaprakopācca’ iti, `dūṣīviṣaprakārāṇāṃ tathaivāpyanulepanāt’ iti ca pā.| asyāgre hārāṇacandrastu `tena pāṇḍuḥ kṛśo'lpāgniḥ kāsaśvāsajvarārditaḥ| jaṭharagrahaṇīrogayakṣmagulmakṣayaiśca saḥ| nipīḍito marmasu ca śūnapādakaro'lasaḥ| svapne mārjaragomāyuvyālān sa nakulān kapīna|| prāyaḥ paśyati nadyādīn śuṣkāṃśca sa vanaspatīn|’ ityadhikaṃ pāṭhaṃ paṭhati tathā cāpyanulepanāt |25|

idānīṃ kīṭadehacūrṇānāṃ nānauṣadhayogāttathā'nulepanato'pi garatvamāha- yogairityādi| athālambāyanoktaḥ kīṭānāṃ sāmānyajñānopāyo likhyate,- “kṛṣṇābhirbindulekhābhiḥ pakṣaiḥ pādairmukhairnakhaiḥ| śūkaiḥ kaṇṭakalāṅgūlaiḥ saṃśliṣṭaiḥ `sannimnaiḥ| iti pā. pakṣaromabhiḥ| svanaiḥ pramāṇaiḥ saṃsthānairliṅgaiścāpi śarīragaiḥ| viṣavīryaiśca kīṭānāṃ rūpajñānaṃ vibhāvyate”- iti| tathā katicit kīṭā viśiṣṭākṛtivarṇādibhistaduktā eva likhyante,- “ajāpratimarūpo yaḥ śūkahīnastvaromaśaḥ| sitaḥ śarakulīrastu kṣveḍacūrṇaviṣaḥ smṛtaḥ|| gairikābho mahākīṭaḥ sapakṣo mārjitodaraḥ| khecaro gudaśūkaśca kauṇḍinya iti sa smṛtaḥ|| kuraṇṭapuṣpavarṇābhaḥ sapakṣo mārjitodaraḥ| tuṇḍaśūkaviṣaḥ kīṭaḥ koṣṭhāgārīti sañjñitaḥ|| lākṣārudhiravarṇābhaḥ śvetabinduvicitritaḥ| kṣudrako hyagnisaṅkāśo bhrājate niśi cāgnivat|| kīṭaḥ khadyota ityukto daṣṭastenāpi dahyate| daṃṣṭrāviṣaḥ śvetabinduḥ sapakṣaḥ ṣaṭpadaḥ khagaḥ|| sa tu vai śambūko nāma kālakaḥ saptamaṇḍalaḥ| catuṣpādo dīrghapatra ullalāṭo bahuprajaḥ|| vṛkṣālayo dantaviṣaḥ kṛkalāsa iti smṛtaḥ| candrābhaḥ kṛkalāso'nyastadbhedastu trikaṇṭakaḥ”- iti| teṣāṃ na kevalaṃ niyamena śūkādidaṃśena viṣaprādurbhāvaḥ, kiṃ tarhi abhyavahāracūrṇānulepanaiśca dūṣīviṣaliṅgaprādurbhāva ityāha- “yaścaitānatti cūrṇairvā cūrṇyate lipyate'thavā| mūtrādibhistasya dūṣīviṣaliṅgaṃ samādiśet”- iti| jejjaṭagayadāsāvatra āpātanikāpūrvakaṃ pāṭhaṃ paṭhataḥ, sa ca vartamānapustakeṣu na dṛśyate||24||-

ab.seg: ekajātīnatastūrdhvaṃ kīṭān vakṣyāmi bhedataḥ ||25||
sāmānyato daṣṭaliṅgaiḥ sādhyāsādhyakrameṇa ca | trikaṇṭaḥ `trikaṇṭakaḥ kuṇī cāpi’ iti pā. kariṇī cāpi hastikakṣo'parājitaḥ | catvāra ete kaṇabhā vyākhyātāstīvravedanāḥ ||26||
tairdaṣṭasya śvayathuraṅgamardo gurutā gātrāṇāṃ daṃśaḥ kṛṣṇaśca bhavati ||27||

idānīṃ vātapittakaphasannipātaprakṛtīn kīṭān nirdiśya, ekajātīyānapyekalakṣaṇacikitsārthaṃ nirdiśannāha- ekajātīnatastūrdhvamityādi| bhedata iti bhedaṃ vīkṣya| trikaṇṭakādayaścatvāraḥ kaṇabhāḥ; kaṇabhatvamekajātitvaṃ, trikaṇṭakādistu bhedaḥ, `kṛkaṇṭaka’ iti kecit| sarva eva kaṇabhāścatuṣpadāḥ kīṭāḥ sādhyāśca||25-27||

pratisūryakaḥ `catuṣpadāḥ kīṭāḥ pratisūryakaḥ’ iti pā., piṅgābhāso, bahuvarṇo, nirūpamo `virūpakaḥ’ iti pā. godhereka iti pañca godherakāḥ `iti pañca’ iti pā.; tairdaṣṭasya śopho dāharujau ca bhavataḥ, godherakeṇaitadeva granthiprādurbhāvo jvaraśca ||28||

pratisūryaka ityādi| kecittu pratisūryaka `catuṣpadāḥ’ iti pā. ityādisthāne evaṃ paṭhanti- “pratisūryaḥ piṅganāso bahulomā mahāśirāḥ| tathā nirūpamaśceti pañca gaudherakāḥ smṛtāḥ|| tairbhavantīha dṛṣṭānāṃ vegajñānāni sarpavat| rujaśca vividhākārā granthayaśca sudāruṇāḥ” iti| gaudherakalakṣaṇaṃ tantrāntare,- “kṛṣṇasarpeṇa godhāyāṃ bhavedyastu catuṣpadaḥ| sarpo gaudherako nāma tena daṣṭo na jīvati”- iti||28||

galagolikā `gogatiḥ’ iti, galagolī, śvetakṛṣṇā iti ca pā. - śvetā, kṛṣṇā, raktarājī, raktamaṇḍalā, sarvaśvetā, sarṣapiketyevaṃ ṣaṭ; tābhirdaṣṭe sarṣapikāvarjaṃ dāhaśophakledā bhavanti, sarṣapikayā hṛdayapiḍā'tisāraśca, tāsu madhye sarṣapikā prāṇaharī ||29||

śatapadyastu- paruṣā, kṛṣṇā, citrā, kapilā, pītikā, raktā, śvetā, agniprabhā, ityaṣṭau; tābhirdaṣṭe śopho vedanā dāhaśca hṛdaye, śvetāgniprabhābhyāmetadeva dāho mūrcchā cātimātraṃ śvetapiḍakotpattiśca ||30||

maṇḍūkāḥ- kṛṣṇaḥ, sāraḥ, kuhako, harito, rakto, yavavarṇābho, bhṛkuṭī, koṭikaścetyaṣṭau; tairdaṣṭasya daṃśe kaṇḍūrbhavati pītaphenāgamaśca vaktrāt, bhṛkuṭīkoṭikābhyāmetadeva dāhaśchardirmūrcchā cātimātram ||31||

maṇḍūkā ityādi| atra bhṛkuṭīkoṭikāvasādhyau| atha maṇḍūkotpattiḥ bhṛkuṭīlakṣaṇaṃ ca tantrāntaroktaṃ paṭhyate,- “varṣamāṇe sṛjecchukraṃ prāvṛṭkāle mahoragaḥ| tataḥ śaratprataptāyāṃ bhūmau maṇḍo jalasya hi| tasmin maṇḍodake jātā maṇḍūkāstena sañjñitāḥ|| maṇḍūko gogatistajjñaiḥ koṭikaḥ parikīrtitaḥ| tena daṣṭasya maraṇaṃ, nāsti tasya pratikriyā”- iti||29-31||
viśvambharābhirdaṣṭe daṃśaḥ sarṣapākārābhiḥ piḍakābhiḥ sarujābhiścīyate, śītajvarārtaśca puruṣo bhavati ||32||
viśvambharābhirdaṣṭa ityādi| viśvambharāśca trayaḥ||32||
ahiṇḍukābhirdaṣṭe todadāhakaṇḍuśvayathavo bhavanti mohaśca; kaṇḍūmakābhirdaṣṭe pītāṅgaśchardyatīsārajvarādibhirabhihanyate; śūkavṛntābhirdaṣṭe kaṇḍūkoṭhāḥ pravardhante śūkaṃ cātra lakṣyate ||33||

ahiṇḍukābhirdaṣṭa ityādi| ahiṇḍukākaṇḍūmakaśūkavṛntānāṃ daṣṭalakṣaṇaṃ kecinna paṭhanti, viśvambharābhedatvena viśvambharāgraheṇa grahaṇāt; anye tu ahiṇḍukādīnāṃ pṛthagdaṣṭalakṣaṇaṃ paṭhanti, pṛthakcikitsitopādānāt||33||

pipīlikāḥ- sthūlaśīrṣā, saṃvāhikā, brāhmaṇikā, aṅgulikā; kapilikā, citravarṇeti ṣaṭ; tābhirdaṣṭe `daṣṭasya koṭhaḥ sparśo'gnidagdhavacca| sarvā eva sādhyāḥ’ iti pā. daṃśe śvayathuragnisparśavaddāhaśophau bhavataḥ ||34||

makṣikāḥ- kāntārikā, kṛṣṇā, piṅgalā, madhūlikā, kāṣāyī, sthāliketyevaṃ ṣaṭ; tābhirdaṣṭasya kaṇḍuśophadāharujo bhavanti, sthālikākāṣāyībhyāmetadeva śyāvapiḍakotpattirupadravāśca jvarādayo bhavanti, kāṣāyī sthālikā ca prāṇahare `tābhirdaṣṭasya dāhaśophau bhavataḥ, sthālikākāṣāyībhyāmetadeva piḍakāśca sopadravā bhavanti’ iti hāraṇacandrasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ||35||
maśakāḥ- sāmudraḥ, parimaṇḍalo, hastimaśakaḥ, kṛṣṇaḥ, pārvatīya iti pañca; tairdaṣṭasya tīvrā kaṇḍūrdaṃśaśophaśca, pārvatīyastu kīṭaiḥ prāṇaharaistulyalakṣaṇaḥ ||36||
nakhāvakṛṣṭe'tyarthaṃ piḍakādāhapākā bhavanti | jalaukasāṃ daṣṭalakṣaṇamuktaṃ cikitsitaṃ ca ||37||
bhavanti cātra- godherakaḥ sthālikā ca ye ca śvetāgnisaprabhe | bhṛkuṭī koṭikaścaiva na sidhyantyekajātiṣu ||38||

idānīmihaikajātyeṣu pañcasvasādhyān nirdiśannāha- godheraka ityādi| sthālikā ceti cakāreṇa kāṣāyī samuccīyate| ye ceti cakāreṇa galagolikeṣu sarṣapikā'pyanuktā samuccīyate| bhṛkuṭī koṭikaścaiveti cakāreṇānuktā jalaukaḥsvindrāyudhā samuccīyate||34-38||
śavamūtrapurīṣaistu saviṣairavamarśanāt | syuḥ kaṇḍūdāhakoṭhāruḥpiḍakātodavedanāḥ ||39||
prakledavāṃstathā srāvo bhṛśaṃ sampācayettvacam | digdhaviddhakriyāstatra yathāvadavacārayet ||40||
eṣāṃ bahiścūrṇāvacūrṇanādau liṅgamuddiśya cikitsāmuddiśannāha- śavamūtrapurīṣairityādi| prakledavāniti saviṣacūrṇāvamṛṣṭapradeśe ityarthaḥ||39-40||
nāvasannaṃ na cotsannamatisaṃrambhavedanam | daṃśādau viparītārti kīṭadaṣṭaṃ subādhakam ||41||

idānīṃ kīṭadaṣṭasya daṃśalakṣaṇena kṛcchratāmuddiśannāha- nāvasannamityādi| nāvasannaṃ nātibhinnaṃ, na cotsannaṃ nātyunnatam, itthambhūtamapi yadatisaṃrambhavedanam atiśayavyathaṃ, daṃśādau viparītārti anugraviṣadaṣṭe tīvrārtirbhavati, ugraviṣadaṣṭe tu mandārtiriti viparītārtiḥ| subādhakaṃ kṛcchrasādhyam||41||
daṣṭānugraviṣaiḥ kīṭaiḥ sarpavat samupācaret | trividhānāṃ tu pūrveṣāṃ `sarpāṇāṃ’ iti pā. traividhyena kriyā hitāḥ ||42||

idānīmugraviṣakīṭānāṃ cikitsāmuddiśannāha- kīṭairdaṣṭānugretyādi| ugraviṣaiḥ prāṇaharaistridoṣaprakṛtibhiḥ| sarpavat sarpadaṣṭāniva, sarpadaṣṭasya sarpavegoktābhiḥ kriyābhirityarthaḥ| trividhānāmiti darvīkaramaṇḍalirājilaśukrādiyonibhedāttriprakārāṇām| pūrveṣām ādyuktānām| traividhyeneti vātādibhedenetyarthaḥ||42||

div.ab: svedamālepanaṃ sekaṃ coṣṇamatrāvacārayet | anyatra mūrcchitāddaṃśāt pākakothaprapīḍitāt ||43|| viṣaghnaṃ ca vidhiṃ sarvaṃ bahuśaḥ `kuryāt saṃśodhanāni ca’ iti pā. śodhanāni ca |44|

idānīṃ sāmānyaṃ cikitsitamāha- svedamālepanamityādi| anyatra mūrcchitāditi mūrcchitaṃ varjayitvā, mūrcchite na kuryādityarthaḥ| viṣaghnaṃ ca vidhiṃ sarvamityādi| saṃśamanavidhiṃ pānanasyābhyaṅgālepanapariṣekāñjanādikaṃ vātādiviṣaharadravyakalpitam| saṃśodhanāni ceti vamanavirekāsthāpanāni, `yathādoṣam’ ityadhyāhāraḥ||43||-

ab.seg: śirīṣakaṭukākuṣṭhavacārajanisaindhavaiḥ `... niśogrāsindhusambhavaiḥ’ iti pā.||44||
kṣīramajjavasāsarpiḥśuṇṭhīpippalidāruṣu | utkārikā sthirādau vā sukṛtā svedane hitā ||45||

idānīṃ vātādidoṣaviṣaharasvedadravyasūtramuddiśannāha- śirīṣetyādi| utkārikā lapsikā| sthirādau śālaparṇyādau| sukṛtā śobhanā kṛtā| etena kṣīrādidravaiḥ śirīṣādidravyāṇāṃ ślakṣṇapeṣitānāṃ mātrākrameṇa nātidravo nālpadravaḥ pāka iti sarvaṃ bodhyate||44-45||

div.ab: na svedayeta cādaṃśaṃ dhūmaṃ vakṣyāmi vṛścike |46|

muktvā kīṭaviṣamityanena hetunā sarveṣveva kīṭeṣu svedaṃ prasaktaṃ kvacinnirasyannāha- na svedayetetyādi| vṛścikaviṣe daṃśaṃ na svedayeta, āṅo vyavahitasyāpi kriyāpadena sambandhāt| tatrāpi kiñcidūṣmasvedamāha- dhūmamityādi| dhūmaśca `śikhikukkuṭabarhāṇi’ ityādinā'gre vaktavyaḥ| na svedayeta cādaṃśamityatra cakāro bhinnakrame dhūmaṃ cetyatra draṣṭavyaḥ; tena mandaviṣavṛścikadaṣṭasyotkārikāsveda ukto na virudhyate|46|-

ab.seg: agadānekajātīṣu pravakṣyāmi pṛthak pṛthak ||46||
kuṣṭhaṃ vakraṃ vacā pāṭhā bilvamūlaṃ suvarcikā | gṛhadhūmaṃ haridre dve trikaṇṭakaviṣe hitāḥ ||47||

idānīṃ vātādibhedena caturvidhaprakṛtīnāṃ saptaṣaṣṭisaṅkhyopetānāṃ cikitsitamabhidhāya vṛścikalūtāvarjaṃ catuḥpañcāśatāmekajātīnāṃ cikitsitaṃ nirdiśannāha- agadānekajātīṣvityādi| vakraṃ tagaraṃ, suvarcikā svarjikākṣāraḥ| trikaṇṭakagrahaṇamaparasajātīyānāṃ kaṇabhaprabhṛtīnāṃ prādhānyādupalakṣaṇam| hita iti agada iti śeṣaḥ||46-47||
rajanyāgāradhūmaśca vakraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ palāśajam | galagolikadṣṭānāmagado viṣanāśanaḥ ||48||
pratisūryakādicikitsāyā vakṣyamāṇatvādgalagolikopakramamāha- rajanītyādi| palāśajaṃ `bījam’ ityadhyāhāryam||48||
kuṅkumaṃ tagaraṃ śigru padmakaṃ rajanīdvayam | agado jalapiṣṭo'yaṃ śatapadviṣanāśanaḥ ||49||
meṣaśṛṅgī vacā pāṭhā niculo rohiṇī jalam | sarvamaṇḍūkadaṣṭānāmagado'yaṃ viṣāpahaḥ ||50||
niculo vetasaḥ, jalaṃ vālakam||49-50||
dhavāśvagandhātibalābalāsātiguhāguhāḥ `vacāśvagandhā’ iti pā.| viśvambharābhidaṣṭānāmagado'yaṃ viṣāpahaḥ ||51||
dhavāśvetyādi| viśvambharābhiḥ tisṛbhiḥ| atibalā kaṅkatikā, atiguhā śāliparṇī, guhā pṛśniparṇī||51||
śirīṣaṃ tagaraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śāliparṇī sahā niśe | ahiṇḍukābhirdaṣṭānāmagado viṣanāśanaḥ ||52||
śirīṣamityādi| sahā mudgaparṇī| niśe piṇḍaharidrādāruharidre||52||

div.ab: kaṇḍūmakābhirdaṣṭānāṃ rātrau śītāḥ kriyā hitāḥ | divā te naiva sidhyanti sūryaraśmibalārditāḥ ||53|| vakraṃ kuṣṭhamapāmārgaḥ śūkavṛntaviṣe'gadaḥ | bhṛṅgasvarasapiṣṭā vā kṛṣṇavalmīkamṛttikā ||54|| pipīlikābhirdaṣṭānāṃ makṣikāmaśakaistathā | gomūtreṇa yuto lepaḥ kṛṣṇavalmīkamṛttikā ||55|| nakhāvaghṛṣṭasañjāte śophe bhṛṅgaraso hitaḥ `nakhāvakṛṣṭe syāllepe mārkavasvaraso hitaḥ’ iti pā.|56|

kaṇḍūmakābhirityādi| kaṇḍūmakābhirdaṣṭāḥ puruṣāḥ| sūryaraśmibhirbalaṃ yeṣāṃ te sūryaraśmibalāḥ kaṇḍūmakāḥ, tairarditāḥ pīḍitāḥ| pipīlikādibhistribhirdaṣṭe gomūtrayuktā kṛṣṇavalmīkamṛttikā| nakhetyādi nakhāvakṛṣṭe nakhodghṛṣṭe sati sañjātaśophe mārkavasya bhṛṅgarājasya raso lepe hitaḥ syāt| gayadāsastu bhṛṅgasvarasapiṣṭā syādityādi paṭhitvā pipīlikāditraye daṣṭe bhṛṅgarājapiṣṭakṛṣṇavalmīkamṛttikālepaṃ pratipādayati; gomūtrayutakṛṣṇavalmīkamṛttikālepanaṃ tu nakhāvakṛṣṭe tathā mārkavasvarasālepanaṃ ca||53-55||-
pratisūryakadaṣṭānāṃ sarpadaṣṭavadācaret |56|
pratisūryaketyādi| ācaret `cikitsitaṃ’ ityadhyāhāraḥ|56|-

ab.seg: trividhā vṛścikāḥ proktā mandamadhyamahāviṣāḥ ||56||
evamekajātīyān kīṭānabhidhāya vṛścikānnirdeṣṭumāha- trividhā vṛścikā ityādi| nanvekajātibhyaḥ pṛthagbhūtā vṛścikā lūtāśca kasmānnirdiśyante iti? ucyate-viṣacikistitaviśeṣāpekṣaḥ pṛthagārambhaḥ||56||
gośakṛtkothajā mandā madhyāḥ kāṣṭheṣṭikodbhavāḥ | sarpakothodbhavāstīkṣṇā ye cānye viṣasambhavāḥ ||57||

tāneva trīnapi kāraṇadharmacikitsitabhedairbhinnān prathamaṃ kāraṇādevāha- gośakṛdityādi| gośakṛdityatra gośabdasyāparapaśūpalakṣaṇatvācchakṛcchabdasyāparamalopalakṣaṇatvādgomahiṣyādiśakṛnmūtrakothajā mandāḥ| ye cānye ityādi| anye'pi ye viṣasambhavāste'pi tīvrāḥ| anye tvevaṃ paṭhanti,- “sarpakothodbhavāstīvrā digdhaviddhaviṣairhate| kothe madhyā gavādīnāṃ śakṛtkothe'varāḥ smṛtāḥ”- iti||57||
mandā dvādaśa madhyāstu trayaḥ pañcadaśottamāḥ | daśa viṃśatirityete saṅkhyayā parikīrtitāḥ ||58||

idānīṃ teṣāṃ pṛthak saṅkhyāmāha- mandā dvādaśetyādi| gayadāsastu- “trayodaśa prāṇaharāstrayo madhyāstathā'pare| mandavīryā daśaikaśca vṛścikā viṣavedibhiḥ|| saptaviṃśatirityete saṅkhyayā parikīrtitāḥ”- iti paṭhati||58||

div.ab: kṛṣṇaḥ śyāvaḥ karburaḥ pāṇḍuvarṇo `kāṇḍavarṇo’ iti pā. gomūtrābhaḥ karkaśo `mecako rūkṣavarṇaḥ’ iti pā. mecakaśca | pīto `śveto rakto’ iti pā. dhūmro romaśaḥ śāḍvalābho raktaḥ śvetenodareṇeti mandāḥ `raktaścaite mandavīryā matāstu’ iti pā.||59|| yuktāścaite vṛścikāḥ pucchadeśe syurbhūyobhiḥ parvabhiścetarebhyaḥ | ebhirdaṣṭe vedanā vepathuśca gātrastambhaḥ kṛṣṇaraktāgamaśca ||60|| śākhādaṣṭe vedanā cordhvameti dāhasvedau daṃśaśopho jvaraśca |61|

idānīṃ mandaviṣāṇāṃ lakṣaṇakarmāṇyāha- kṛṣṇa ityādi| kṛṣṇādayo dvādaśāpi śvetenodareṇopalakṣitāḥ| vedanā cordhvametīti trividhānāmapi vṛścikānāṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇamatra prāyovṛttyā'bhihitam| syurbhūyobhiḥ parvabhiścetarebhya iti itarebhyo vṛścikebhyo mandaviṣā vṛścikā bhūyobhirbahutaraiḥ parvabhirupalakṣitā bhaveyuḥ||59-60||-

raktaḥ pītaḥ kāpilenodareṇa sarve dhūmrāḥ parvabhiśca tribhiḥ syuḥ ||61|| ete mūtroccārapūtyaṇḍajātā madhyā jñeyāstriprakāroragāṇām | yasyaiteṣāmanvayādyaḥ prasūto doṣotpattiṃ tatsvarūpāṃ sa kuryāt ||62|| jihvāśopho bhojanasyāvarodho `rasanasyopaghāto’ iti pā. mūrcchā cogrā madhyavīryābhidaṣṭe `vṛścikairmadhyamaistu’ iti pā.|63|

madhyaviṣāṇāṃ lakṣaṇakarmāṇyāha- rakta ityādi| kapilena saha raktaḥ pītaśceti trayaḥ| ete ca trayo'pyudareṇa dhūmrāḥ| pūrvatra kāṣṭheṣṭikodbhavatvamiha tu sarpamūtroccārādisambhavatvamityubhayahetūpādānād vyastasamastobhayahetūdbhavatvaṃ madhyānāṃ boddhavyam| digdhaviddhasarpadaṣṭānāṃ ca śarīrakothe madhyānāṃ janma matāntareṇa pratipāditameva| triprakāroragāṇāmityādi darvīkarādibhedena triprakārāṇāmeteṣāṃ yasyānvayādyo yādṛk prasūtaḥ sa tatsvarūpāṃ doṣotpattiṃ kuryāt||61-62||-

ab.seg: śvetaścitraḥ śyāmalo lohitābho `lohitaśca kṛṣṇaḥ pītaḥ śuklanīlodarau ca’ iti pā. raktaḥ śveto raktanīlodarau ca ||63||

pīto'rakto `agnyābhāsaḥ kāpilo raktakoṣṭho yo vā yuktaḥ kāpilenodareṇa’ iti, `kṛṣṇaḥ śvetaḥ śvetakṛṣṇau pavitrau raktāgnyābhaścāpyathānyonyacitrau’ iti ca pā. nīlapīto'parastu rakto nīlo nīlaśuklastathā ca | rakto babhruḥ pūrvavaccaikaparvā yaścāparvā parvaṇī dve ca yasya ||64||
nānārūpā varṇataścāpi ghorā jñeyāścaite vṛścikāḥ prāṇacaurāḥ `mṛtyurūpāḥ’ iti pā.| janmaiteṣāṃ sarpakothāt pradiṣṭaṃ dehebhyo vā ghātitānāṃ viṣeṇa ||65||
ebhirdaṣṭe sarpavegapravṛttiḥ sphoṭotpattirbhrāntidāhau jvaraśca | khebhyaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ śoṇitaṃ yāti tīvraṃ tasmāt `paścāt prāṇān muñcati kṣiprameva’ iti pā. prāṇaistyajyate śīghrameva ||66||

tīkṣṇaviṣāṇāṃ lakṣaṇakarmāṇyāha- śvetaścitra ityādi| pūrvavacceti pūrve madhyaviṣā yathā jihvāśophādikārakāstathaivaite'pi jihvāśophādi kurvantītyarthaḥ| ekaparveti dvayorasthnoḥ saṅghātaḥ parva, ekaṃ parva yasya sa tathā| parvaṇī dve ca yasyeti cakāreṇa bahuparvāṇo'pi bhavantīti samuccīyate| khebhya iti khebhyaḥ srotobhyaḥ| ariṣṭamidam||63-66||

div.ab: ugramadhyaviṣairdaṣṭaṃ cikitset sarpadaṣṭavat | ādaṃśaṃ sveditaṃ cūrṇaiḥ pracchitaṃ pratisārayet ||67|| rajanīsaindhavavyoṣaśirīṣaphalapuṣpajaiḥ |68|

idānīṃ cikitsā prastūyate- ugramadhyetyādi| mūrcchā cogrā cetyanena sarpadaṣṭaṣaṣṭhasaptamavegalakṣaṇasya vacanānmadhyaviṣe'pi sarpadaṣṭacikitsā kāryā| ihāparāmapi cikitsāmāha- ādaṃśamityādi| pratisāraṇaṃ gharṣaṇaṃ, tacca duṣṭaraktapravartanārtham| mātuluṅgāmletyādi| mātuluṅgāmlaṃ bījapūrakarasaḥ| surasāgrajaṃ tulasīpallavaṃ, mallikākusumamiti kecit| svede ityādi vātakaphāvajayāya| pāne sarpirityādi| bahuvātasya sarpiḥpānaṃ madhuyutaṃ, bahupittasya kṣīraṃ bahuśarkaraṃ ceti yogadvayam||67||-

ab.seg: mātuluṅgāmlagomūtrapiṣṭaṃ ca surasāgrajam ||68||
lepe, svede sukhoṣṇaṃ ca gomayaṃ hitamiṣyate | pāne kṣaudrayutaṃ sarpiḥ `sarpiśca sakṣaudraṃ’ iti pā. kṣīraṃ vā bahuśarkaram ||69||
daṃśaṃ mandaviṣāṇāṃ tu cakratailena secayet | vidārīgaṇasiddhena sukhoṣṇenāthavā punaḥ ||70||
kuryāccotkārikāsvedaṃ viṣaghnairupanāhayet `viṣaghnairupanāhanaiḥ’ iti pā.| guḍodakaṃ vā suhimaṃ cāturjātakasaṃyutam ||71||
pānamasmai pradātavyaṃ kṣīraṃ vā saguḍaṃ himam | śikhikukkuṭabarhāṇi saindhavaṃ tailasarpiṣī ||72||
dhūmo hanti prayuktastu śīghraṃ vṛścikajaṃ viṣam | kusumbhapuṣpaṃ rajanī niśā vā kodravaṃ tṛṇam ||73||
ebhirghṛtāktairdhūpastu pāyudeśe prayojitaḥ | nāśayedāśu kīṭotthaṃ vṛścikasya ca yadviṣam ||74||

idānīṃ mandaviṣāṇāṃ cikitsāmāha- daṃśamityādi| cakratailaṃ cakrapīḍitaṃ tilatailaṃ, atra cakraśabdopādānaṃ hastādiyantrapīḍananiṣedhārtham| vidārigaṇasiddhenetyādiśabdasya lopādvidāryādigaṇasiddhena, `tailena’ iti śeṣaḥ| kuryāccotkāriketyādi| utkārikā lapsikā| utkārikā tu śirīṣādiviṣaharadravyaiḥ pūrvoktā pūrvakalpitā ca| upanāhayed viṣaghnadravyairupanāhasvedaṃ kuryāt| guḍodakamityādi| barhāṇi picchāni||68-74||
lūtāviṣaṃ ghoratamaṃ durvijñeyatamaṃ ca tat | duścikitsyatamaṃ ayaṃ pāṭho hastalikhitapustake nopalabhyate cāpi bhiṣagbhirmandabuddhibhiḥ ||75||
saviṣaṃ nirviṣaṃ caitadityevaṃ pariśaṅkite | viṣaghnameva kartavyamavirodhi yadauṣadham ||76||

lūtāviṣamādikāraṇalakṣaṇacikitsitairnirdiśannāha- lūtetyādi| ghoratamaṃ kaṣṭasādhyaṃ, durvijñeyatamam atiduḥkhena vijñātuṃ śakyam| tasya durvijñeyatvādeva saṃśaye sati viṣaharameva karaṇīyamityāha- saviṣamityādi| avirodhi dhātubhiḥ saha yanna virudhyate'nnapānaṃ tat; na punaragadakaraṇaṃ, dhātuvirodhāt||75-76||
agadānāṃ hi saṃyogo viṣajuṣṭasya yujyate | nirviṣe mānave yukto'gadaḥ sampadyate'sukham ||77||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena `tasmādyatnena bhiṣajā’ iti. jñātavyo viṣaniścayaḥ | ajñātvā viṣasadbhāvaṃ bhiṣagvyāpādayennaram ||78||
tameva dhātuvirodhaṃ darśayannāha- agadānāmityādi| asukhaṃ kaṣṭam||77-78||
prodbhidyamānastu yathā'ṅkureṇa na vyaktajātiḥ pravibhāti vṛkṣaḥ | tadvaddurālakṣyatamaṃ hi tāsāṃ viṣaṃ śarīre pravikīrṇamātram ||79||
lūtāviṣadurvijñeyatāyāmupamānapramāṇaṃ nirdiśannāha- prodbhidyamāna ityādi| pravikīrṇamātraṃ prathamaṃ vikṣiptamātram, alpavistṛtamityarthaḥ||79||
īṣatsakaṇḍu pracalaṃ sakoṭhamavyaktavarṇaṃ prathame'hani syāt | anteṣu śūnaṃ parinimnamadhyaṃ pravyaktarūpaṃ ca dine dvitīye ||80||
tryaheṇa taddarśayatīha rūpaṃ viṣaṃ caturthe'hani kopameti | ato'dhike'hni prakaroti jantorviṣaprakopaprabhavān vikārān ||81||
ṣaṣṭhe dine viprasṛtaṃ tu sarvān marmapradeśān bhṛśamāvṛṇoti | tat saptame'tyarthaparītagātraṃ vyāpādayenmartyamatipravṛddham ||82||

īṣatsakaṇḍu pracalamityādi| īṣatsakaṇḍu kiñcitkaṇḍūyuktaṃ, pracalaṃ pracalanaśīlam| gayadāsastu prabalamiti paṭhitvā vyākhyānayati- prabalam īṣat prathamadine, dvitīyādiṣu dineṣu tu prabalataraṃ krameṇa prabalatamaṃ ca; yadāha,- “ṣaṣṭhe dine viprasṛtaṃ tu sarvān marmapradeśān bhṛśamāvṛṇoti”- iti| sakoṭhaṃ kiñcit koṭhayuktaṃ, koṭhaśca varaṭīdaṃśasthānaḥ| darśayatīha rūpamiti rūpaṃ cātra tantrāntaroktaṃ jvararomaharṣaraktamaṇḍalādikam| tathā ca vṛddhavāgbhaṭaḥ- “tṛtīye sajvaro romaharṣakṛdraktamaṇḍalaḥ| śarāvarūpastodāḍhyo romakūpeṣu sāsravaḥ”- iti| kopameti unmārgapravṛttaṃ bhavati, tato'dhike pañcamadine unmārgapravṛttaṃ sat viṣakopaprabhavān vikārān karoti| `tṛḍdāhakaṇḍūprabalaṃ’ iti kecit||80-82||
yāstīkṣṇacaṇḍograviṣā hi lūtāstāḥ saptarātreṇa naraṃ nihanyuḥ | ato'dhikenāpi nihanyuranyā yāsāṃ viṣaṃ madhyamavīryamuktam ||83||
yāsāṃ kanīyo viṣavīryamuktaṃ tāḥ pakṣamātreṇa vināśayanti | tasmāt prayatnaṃ bhiṣagatra kuryādādaṃśapātādviṣaghātiyogaiḥ ||84||

tāsāṃ tīkṣṇamadhyamandaviṣāṇāṃ kālāvadhimāha- yāstīkṣṇacaṇḍogretyādi| tīkṣṇaṃ dāhapākasrāvakaraṃ, caṇḍam atikopāṭopakaraṃ; tīkṣṇacaṇḍatvenogramasahyaṃ viṣaṃ yāsāṃ tāstathā| ato'nenaikādaśāhāt parata iti sāmarthyād grāhyam| tathā cālambāyanaḥ,- “lūtāstīkṣṇaviṣā hanyuḥ saptāṣṭanavabhirdinaiḥ| ekādaśāhāt parato viṣaṃ yāsāṃ tu madhyamam”- iti||83-84||

div.ab: viṣaṃ tu lālānakhamūtradaṃṣṭrārajaḥpurīṣairatha cendriyeṇa | saptaprakāraṃ visṛjanti lūtāstadugramadhyāvaravīryayuktam ||85|| sakaṇḍukoṭhaṃ sthiramalpamūlaṃ lālākṛtaṃ mandarujaṃ vadanti | śophaśca kaṇḍūśca pulālikā `pulānikā’ iti pā. ca dhūmāyanaṃ caiva nakhāgradaṃśe ||86|| daṃśaṃ tu mūtreṇa sakṛṣṇamadhyaṃ saraktaparyantamavehi dīrṇam | daṃṣṭrābhirugraṃ kaṭhinaṃ vivarṇaṃ jānīhi daṃśaṃ sthiramaṇḍalaṃ ca ||87|| rajaḥpurīṣendriyajaṃ hi viddhi sphoṭaṃ vipakvāmalapīlupāṇḍum |88|

ab.seg: adhiṣṭhānaviśeṣādapi tāsāṃ viṣaṃ viṣe ca liṅgaṃ darśayannāha- viṣaṃ tu lāletyādi| raja ārtavam, indriyaṃ śukram| sakaṇḍukoṭhamityādi| koṭhaḥ koṭhapiḍakāḥ| śopha ityādi| pulālikā romāñcaḥ| dhūmāyanaṃ dhūmodvamanamivāṅgānām| daṃśaṃ tu mūtreṇetyādi| rajaḥprabhṛtije `daṃśe’ ityadhyāhāraḥ| viddhi jānīhi||85-87||
etāvadetat samudāhṛtaṃ tu vakṣyāmi lūtāprabhavaṃ purāṇam ||88||
sāmānyato daṣṭamasādhyasādhyaṃ cikitsitaṃ cāpi yathāviśeṣam ||89||

idānīmatītānāgatoktaiḥ samānatāṃ viśiṣṭatāṃ ca vibhajannāha- etāvadetadityādi| iyatpramāṇametat prathamādidivasāśrayaṃ lālādyadhiṣṭhānāśrayaṃ ca sarvalūtāviṣayaṃ samudāhṛtamāgamaprasiddhamuktamityarthaḥ| vakṣyāmītyādi| lūtāprabhavaṃ lūtānāmādyutpattikāraṇaṃ, purāṇaṃ purābhavaṃ, sāmānyato vakṣyāmīti sambandhaḥ; tathā daṣṭaṃ daṃśamapyasādhyaṃ sādhyaṃ ca sāmānyato vakṣyāmīti| cikitsitaṃ cetyādi| cikitsitaṃ yathāviśeṣaṃ viśeṣānatikrameṇa; cakārāllakṣaṇamapi viśeṣānatikrameṇa vakṣyāmīti sambandhaḥ||88-89||
viśvāmitro nṛpavaraḥ kadācidṛṣisattamam | vaśiṣṭhaṃ kopayāmāsa gatvā''śramapadaṃ kila ||90||
kupitasya munestasya lalāṭāt svedabindavaḥ | apatan darśanādeva ravestatsamatejasaḥ `hyadhastāttīkṣṇavarcasaḥ’ iti pā.||91||
tṛṇe maharṣiṇā lūne dhenvarthaṃ sambhṛte'pi ca | tato jātāstvimā ghorā nānārūpā mahāviṣāḥ | apakārāya vartante nṛpasādhanavāhane ||92||
yasmāllūnaṃ tṛṇaṃ prāptā muneḥ prasvedabindavaḥ | tasmāllūteti bhāṣyante saṅkhyayā tāśca ṣoḍaśa ||93||

tatprabhavamuddiśannāha- viśvāmitra ityādi| kiletyāgamasaṃvāde| tatsamatejaso ravisamānatejaso vaśiṣṭhasya svedabindavaḥ apatan patitāḥ| dhenvarthaṃ sambhṛte gavādicaraṇārthaṃ sañcite| matāntareṇotpattiranyathā varṇyate,- “anye vadanti bhuktasya duṣṭasyānnasya mūrcchanāt| sambhavanti viṣasphoṭā ye lūtākīṭalakṣaṇam| yathāsvaṃ dhārayantaste lūtākīṭāśca kīrtitāḥ”- ityādi||90-93||

div.ab: kṛcchrasādhyāstathā'sādhyā lūtāstu dvividhāḥsmṛtāḥ | tāsāmaṣṭau kṛcchrasādhyā varjyāstāvatya eva tu ||94|| trimaṇḍalā tathā śvetā kapilā pītikā tathā | ālamūtraviṣā raktā kasanā cāṣṭamī smṛtā ||95|| tābhirdaṣṭe śiroduḥkhaṃ kaṇḍūrdaṃśe ca vedanā | bhavanti ca viśeṣeṇa gadāḥ ślaiṣmikavātikāḥ ||96|| sauvarṇikā lājavarṇā jālinyeṇīpadī tathā | kṛṣṇā'gnivarṇā kākāṇḍā mālāguṇā'ṣṭamī tathā ||97|| tābhirdaṣṭe daṃśakothaḥ pravṛttiḥ kṣatajasya ca | jvaro dāho'tisāraśca gadāḥ syuśca tridoṣajāḥ ||98|| piḍakā vividhākārā maṇḍalāni mahānti ca | mahānto mṛdavaḥ śophā raktāḥ śyāvāścalāstathā ||99|| sāmānyaṃ sarvalūtānāmetadādaṃśalakṣaṇam |100|

ab.seg: ālāviṣā mūtraviṣā ceti dve||94-99||
viśeṣalakṣaṇaṃ tāsāṃ vakṣyāmi sacikitsitam ||100||
trimaṇḍalāyā daṃśe'sṛk kṛṣṇaṃ sravati dīryate | bādhiryaṃ kaluṣā dṛṣṭistathā dāhaśca netrayoḥ ||101||
tatrārkamūlaṃ rajanī nākulī pṛśniparṇikā | pānakarmaṇi śasyante nasyālepāñjaneṣu ca ||102||
śvetāyāḥ piḍakā daṃśe śvetā kaṇḍūmatī bhavet | dāhamūrcchājvaravatī visarpakledarukkarī ||103||
tatra candanarāsnailāhareṇunalavañjulāḥ | kuṣṭhaṃ lāmajjakaṃ vakraṃ naladaṃ cāgado hitaḥ ||104||
ādaṃśe piḍakā tāmrā kapilāyāḥ sthirā bhavet | śiraso gauravaṃ dāhastimiraṃ bhrama eva ca ||105||
tatra padmakakuṣṭhailākarañjakakubhatvacaḥ | sthirārkaparṇyapāmārgadūrvābrāhmyo viṣāpahāḥ ||106||
ādaṃśe pītikāyāstu piḍakā pītikā sthirā | bhavecchardirjvaraḥ śūlaṃ mūrdhni rakte tathā'kṣiṇī ||107||
tatreṣṭāḥ kuṭajośīratuṅgapadmakavañjulāḥ | śirīṣakiṇihīśelukadambakakubhatvacaḥ ||108||
raktamaṇḍanibhe daṃśe piḍakāḥ sarṣapā iva | jāyante tāluśoṣaśca dāhaścālaviṣārdite ||109||
tatra priyaṅguhrīberakuṣṭhalāmajjavañjulāḥ | agadaḥ śatapuṣpā ca sapippalavaṭāṅkurāḥ ||110||
pūtirmūtraviṣādaṃśo visarpī kṛṣṇaśoṇitaḥ | kāsaśvāsavamīmūrcchājvaradāhasamanvitaḥ ||111||
manaḥśilālamadhukakuṣṭhacandanapadmakaiḥ | madhumiśraiḥ salāmajjairagadastatra kīrtitaḥ ||112||
āpāṇḍupiḍako daṃśo dāhakledasamanvitaḥ | raktāyā raktaparyanto vijñeyo raktasaṃyutaḥ ||113||
kāryastatrāgadastoyacandanośīrapadmakaiḥ | tathaivārjunaśelubhyāṃ tvagbhirāmrātakasya ca ||114||
picchilaṃ kasanādaṃśādrudhiraṃ śītalaṃ sravet | kāsaśvāsau ca tatroktaṃ raktalūtācikitsitam ||115||

sāmānyalakṣaṇamabhidhāya tāsāṃ viśeṣalakṣaṇaṃ cikitsite ca bhedaṃ darśayannāha- viśeṣalakṣaṇamityādi| cakārāt pariṣeke'pi| śvetāyā ityādi| rāsnā gandhanākulī| ādaṃśe ityādi| tuṅgaṃ padmakeśaraṃ, punnāga ityapare| vañjulo jalavetasaḥ; jejjaṭastu kambuketi paṭhitvā kiṇihīti vyākhyānayati| raktamaṇḍanime ityādi| `raktapādyā’ iti kvacit, tatrāpi raktāyā eva grahaṇam| picchilamityādi| raktalūtācikitsitaṃ toyacandanādikam||100-115||
purīṣagandhiralpāsṛk kṛṣṇāyā daṃśa eva tu | jvaramūrcchāvamīdāhakāsaśvāsasamanvitaḥ ||116||
tatrailāvakrasarpākṣīgandhanākulicandanaiḥ | mahāsugandhisahitaiḥ pratyākhyāyāgadaḥ smṛtaḥ ||117||
daṃśo dāho'gnivakrāyāḥ srāvo'tyarthaṃ jvarastathā | coṣakaṇḍūromaharṣā `coṣakaṇḍūromaharṣā vidāhaḥ sphoṭajanma ca’ iti pā. dāhavisphoṭasaṃyutaḥ ||118||
kṛṣṇāpraśamanaṃ cātra pratyākhyāya prayojayet | sārivośīrayaṣṭyāhvacandanotpalapadmakam ||119||

idānīṃ sauvarṇikādiṣvasādhyeṣu dvayoḥ kṛṣṇāgnivakrayoḥ kadācitkṛcchrasādhyatvāt kṛcchrasādhyānantaraṃ lakṣaṇaṃ pratyākhyānapūrvakaṃ cikitsitaṃ cāha- purīṣagandhirityādi| sarpākṣī lohitapuṣpā śaṅkhapuṣpībhedaḥ| mahāsugandhiḥ dundubhisvanīyokto'gadaḥ| daṃśe ityādi| coṣasthāne tṛṣṇeti kvacit, saṃyuta ityatra daṃśa iti vibhaktivipariṇāmena yojanīyam| gayadāsastu kṛṣṇāgnivakrayorniyatāsādhyatvamaṅgīkurvan sauvarṇikādikrameṇāgre lakṣaṇamātrameva paṭhati||116-119||
sarvāsāmeva yuñjīta viṣe śleṣmātakatvacam | bhiṣak sarvaprakāreṇa tathā cākṣīvapippalam ||120||

tāsāmuktānāṃ daśānāmapi lūtānāṃ viśiṣṭaṃ cikitsitamabhidhāya sāmānyamapyāha sarvāsāmityādi| sarvaprakāreṇa pānābhyañjanādayaḥ| akṣīvapippalamiti akṣīvāt mahānimbājjātaḥ pippala akṣīvapippalaḥ, anye śobhāñjanājjāta iti manyante| anyatrāpyuktaṃ- “akṣīvājjātasya pippalasya maṇiḥ sarvaviṣāpahaḥ| śelutvaco vā” iti| ālambāyano'pyatrāha,- “lūtāviṣeṣu sarveṣu pānanasyāñjanādinā| prayojyaḥ pippalo'kṣīvajjātaḥ śelutvaco'thavā” iti||120||
kṛcchrasādhyaviṣā hyaṣṭau proktā dve ca yadṛcchayā | avāryaviṣavīryāṇāṃ lakṣaṇāni nibodha me ||121||
dhyāmaḥ sauvarṇikādaṃśaḥ sapheno matsyagandhakaḥ | śvāsaḥ kāso jvarastṛṣṇā mūrcchā cātra sudāruṇā ||122||
ādaṃśe lājavarṇāyā dhyāmaṃ pūti sravedasṛk | dāho mūrcchā'tisāraśca śiroduḥkhaṃ `mūrghni cātyarthavedanā’ iti pā. ca jāyate ||123||
ghoro daṃśastu jālinyā rājimānavadīryate | stambhaḥ śvāsastamovṛddhistāluśoṣaśca jāyate ||124||
eṇīpadyāstathā daṃśo bhavet kṛṣṇatilākṛtiḥ | tṛṣṇāmūrcchājvaracchardikāsaśvāsasamanvitaḥ `tṛṣṇāmūrcchājvaraśvāsadāhakṛt prāṇanāśanaḥ’ iti pā.||125||
daṃśaḥ kākāṇḍikādaṣṭe pāṇḍurakto'tivedanaḥ | tṛṇmūrcchāśvāsahṛdrogahikkākāsāḥ syurucchritāḥ ||126||
rakto mālāguṇādaṃśo dhūmagandho'tivedanaḥ | bahudhā ca viśīryeta dāhamūrcchājvarānvitaḥ ||127||

idānīmasādhyānāmapi parihārārthaṃ lakṣaṇamāha- kucchrasādhyetyādi| dve yadṛcchayeti avāryaviṣavīryāṇāṃ madhye dve ca yadṛcchayā sidhyataḥ| śeṣāṇāmavāryaviṣavīryāṇāṃ ṣaṭsaṅkhyakānāṃ, nibodha jānīhi| dhyāma ityādi| dhyāmo dagdheṣṭakādivarṇaḥ| ghoro daṃśa ityādi| tamovṛddhiḥ punaḥ punastamodarśanam| eṇīpadyā ityādi| viśīryeta śaṭatītyarthaḥ||121-127||
asādhyāsvapyabhihitaṃ pratyākhyāyāśu yojayet | doṣocchrāyaviśeṣeṇa dāhacchedavivarjitam ||128||
kecidasādhyānāmapi cikitsitaṃ paṭhanti- asādhyāsvityādi||128||
sādhyābhirābhirlūtābhirdaṣṭamātrasya `sādhyābhirapi lūtābhiḥ’ iti pā. dehinaḥ | vṛddhipatreṇa matimān samyagādaṃśamuddharet ||129||
idānīṃ kṛcchrasādhyānāṃ tātkālikaṃ cikitsitamāha- sādhyābhirābhirityādi| asyāgre kecidamuṃ pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti- `jāmbvauṣṭhenāgnitaptena dahedākaravāraṇāt `dahedākaraṇāditi’ iti pā. ’- iti||129||
amarmaṇi vidhānajño varjitasya jvarādibhiḥ | daṃśasyotkartanaṃ kuryādalpaśvayathukasya ca ||130||
madhusaindhavasaṃyuktairagadairlepayettataḥ | priyaṅgurajanīkuṣṭhasamaṅgāmadhukaistathā ||131||
sārivāṃ madhukaṃ drākṣāṃ payasyāṃ kṣīramoraṭam | vidārīgokṣurakṣaudramadhukaṃ pāyayeta vā ||132||
kṣīriṇāṃ tvakkaṣāyeṇa suśītena ca secayet | upadravān yathādoṣaṃ viṣaghnaireva sādhayet ||133||

kīdṛśasya daṃśasya chedaṃ kuryādityāha- amarmaṇi vidhānajña ityādi| jvarādibhiḥ asādhyalūtoktaiḥ, `asādhyānāṃ bhiṣak prājño na yuñjīta cikitsitam’ iti| madhusaindhavetyādi| agadaiḥ mahāsugandhyādibhiḥ| tat iti chedādanantaram| samaṅgā varāhakrāntā| tatheti priyaṅgvādibhirapi lepayedityarthaḥ| sārivāmityādi| sārivā utpalasārivā, payasyā arkapuṣpī, kṣīramoraṭaṃ moraṭa eva| ekatra yoge madhukadvayaṃ sthalajajalajabhedena| kṣīriṇāmityādi||130-133||
nasyāñjanābhyañjanapānadhūmaṃ tathā'vapīḍaṃ kavalagrahaṃ ca | saṃśodhanaṃ cobhayataḥ pragāḍhaṃ kuryātsirāmokṣaṇameva cātra ||134||

lūtāsu daśavidhamupakramamāha- nasyāñjanābhyañjanetyādi| abhyañjanasthāne ālepanamiti kecit| saṃśodhanamubhayato vamanavirecanākhyaṃ kuryāt| sirāmokṣaṇamityatra `raktaṃ hareccāpi jalāyukābhiḥ’ iti kecit| etacca sarvaṃ viṣaharaireva daśavidhamapi||134||
kīṭadaṣṭavraṇān sarvānahidaṣṭavraṇānapi | ādāhapākāttān `ādaṃśapākaṃ yatnena cikitset sarpadaṣṭavat’ iti pā. sarvāñcikitsedduṣṭavadbhiṣag ||135||

lūtānāmapi kīṭatvāt sāmānyenaiva kīṭaviṣotthavraṇānāṃ tathā tādṛśānāmahidaṣṭavraṇānāmapi duṣṭavraṇavaccikitsāmāha- kīṭadaṣṭavraṇānityādi| ādāhapākāditi yāvaddāhapākau tiṣṭhataḥ; vinivṛttayośca dāhapākayorvakṣyamāṇo vidhirbhaviṣyati| kvacit `sadāhapākān’ iti pāṭhaḥ| duṣṭavat duṣṭavraṇavat; duṣṭavraṇoktaṃ ca `duṣṭavraṇeṣu kartavyamūrdhvaṃ cādhaśca śodhanam’ ityādi| tatra śodhanaṃ viṣaharadravyaiḥ, tathā lepādikamapi viṣaharameva duṣṭavraṇacikitsitena||135||
vinivṛtte tataḥ śophe karṇikāpātanaṃ hitam | nimbapatraṃ trivṛddantī kusumbhaṃ kusumaṃ madhu ||136||
gugguluḥ saindhavaṃ kiṇvaṃ varcaḥ pārāvatasya ca | viṣavṛddhikaraṃ cānnaṃ hitvā sambhojanaṃ hitam ||137||

nivṛttadāhādau vraṇe yā viṣotpannā karṇikā tasyāścikitsāmāha- vinivṛtte ityādi| karṇikā māṃsakandī, padmakarṇikākāratvāt karṇikā bhaṇyate| tasyāśca śoṇitapittotthāyā mṛdurujāyāḥ pracchanamantareṇaiva pātanaṃ sukaram| tānyeva pātanadravyāṇyāha- nimbapatramityādi| kiṇvaṃ surābījam| etannimbapatrādikaṃ dravyaṃ lepanena karṇikāpātane hitaṃ, tathā viṣavṛddhikaraṃ tilakulatthādyannaṃ varjayitvā yadanyat pātanam sambhojanaṃ tat karṇikāyāḥ pātane hitam| gayadāsastu nimbapatramityasya sthāne `śikhīvaṃśa’ iti paṭhitvā vyākhyānayati- śikhī lāṅgalakī, vaṃśo vaṃśatvak| kiṇvasthāne dantaṃ paṭhati, danto godanto gavāṃ dantaḥ||136-137||
viṣebhyaḥ khalu sarvebhyaḥ karṇikāmarujāṃ sthirām | pracchayitvā madhūnmiśraiḥ śodhanīyairupācaret ||138||
kaphavātotthāyāḥ karṇikāyāścikitsāmāha- viṣebhya ityādi| arujām avidyamānarujāṃ, sthirāṃ kaṭhināṃ| śodhanīyaiḥ nimbapatratrivṛtādibhiḥ, dantīmūlamadanaphalakalkādibhirvā||138||
saptaṣaṣṭhasya kīṭānāṃ śatasyaitadvibhāgaśaḥ | daṣṭalakṣaṇamākhyātaṃ cikitsā cāpyanantaram ||139||

idānīṃ paratantroditasaṅkhyāvipratipattinirāsārthaṃ svatantre vyāsoktasaṅkhyāḥ sukhabodhārthaṃ ca kīṭeṣu daṣṭalakṣaṇacikitsitopadeśena parimāṇamuddiśannāha- saptaṣaṣṭhasyetyādi| saptaṣaṣṭhaśatasya kīṭānāṃ daṣṭalakṣaṇamākhyātaṃ kathitaṃ, vibhāgaśaḥ pratyekaṃ daṣṭalakṣaṇādanantaraṃ cikitsitamapi samākhyātam||139||

div.ab: saviṃśamadhyāyaśatametaduktaṃ vibhāgaśaḥ |140|
idānīṃ pūrvatantrasyādhyāyasaṅkhyāyāḥ parimāṇaṃ yaduddiṣṭaṃ tannirdiṣṭamiti darśayannāha- saviṃśamityādi| etat saviṃśamadhyāyaśataṃ, vibhāgaśaḥ sūtrasthānādivibhāgenoktam|140|-

ab.seg: ihoddiṣṭānanirdiṣṭānarthān vakṣyāmyathottare ||140||

śālākyakaumārakāyacikitsābhūtavidyānāṃ nāmamātreṇehoddiṣṭānāṃ nirdeśābhāvāt kathaṃ jñānamityāha- ihoddiṣṭānityādi| iha viṃśatyadhikādhyāyaśate ye'rthāḥ śālākyādayo nāmamātreṇoddiṣṭā natu prapañcena nirdiṣṭāḥ, tānatha anantaramuttare vakṣyāmi||140||
sanātanatvādvedānāmakṣaratvāttathaiva ca | tathā dṛṣṭaphalatvācca hitatvādapi dehinām ||141||
vāksamūhārthavistārāt pūjitatvācca dehibhiḥ | cikitsitāt puṇyatamaṃ na kiñcidapi śuśrumaḥ ||142||
ṛṣerindraprabhāvasyāmṛtayonerbhiṣagguroḥ | dhārayitvā tu vimalaṃ mataṃ paramasammatam | uktāhārasamācāra iha pretya ca modate ||143||

cikitsitasyopādeyatāmāgamapratyakṣaphalatvābhyāmeva nirdiśannāha- sanātanatvādityādi| cikitsitādanyat puṇyatamaṃ na kimapi śuśrumaḥ na kimapi anu gurupāramparyeṇa śrutavantaḥ| kuta ityāha- sanātanatvādvedānāmiti|- āyurvedāṅgānāṃ śalyādīnāṃ sanātanatvānnityabhavatvādakṛtakatvādityarthaḥ| etenākṛtakatvākhyahetukena doṣābhāveṇa tatproktasya cikitsitasya puṇyatamatvam| tathā akṣaratvādāyurvedāṅgānāṃ śalyādīnāṃ na kṣaratītyakṣaramavicalanātmakamucyate, etāni cāyurvedāṅgānyakṣarāṇi avicalanātmakāni yāthātathyādityarthaḥ, etasmādapi cikitsitaṃ puṇyatamam| āgamapramāṇamabhidhāya pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇamāha- tathā dṛṣṭaphalatvācceti| dṛṣṭaphalamapi kiñcidapuṇyatamaṃ `kiñcit puṇyatamaṃ yathā- asteyādītyāha’ iti pā. yathā steyādītyāha- hitatvādapi dehināmiti| cikitsitādityasya svarūpaviśeṣaṇamāha- vāksamūhārthavistārāditi|- vāksamūhe'rthavistāro yasmin; ata eva pūjitatvācca dehibhiriti dehinaḥ vyādhiparimokṣaṃ svastharakṣaṇamicchanta āyurvedaṃ viśiṣṭapadapadārtharūpaṃ svasukhakāmāḥ pūjayanti| yataścikitsitamuktairhetubhiḥ pavitratamaṃ; tasmādindraprabhāvasya munestaṃ vedamavidyamānapāpalakṣaṇamamalaṃ, paramāṇāṃ mahatāṃ samyaḍyataṃ pūjitaṃ hṛdaye dhāraṇāt| uktāhārasamācāra uktavyādhiparimokṣasvastharakṣaṇāhārācāraḥ| iha ihaloke, pretya paraloke'pi, modate hṛṣyati| gayadāsastu `sanātanatvādvedānāmakṣaratvāttathaiva ca’ itīdṛśaṃ vyākhyānayati- sanātanatvāt nityabhavatvādāyuṣaḥ santānasyopakāryasya nityasadbhāvāttadupahitakārako'pyāyurvedo nityaḥ| tatrāyuṣaḥ santānasyaiva santatinityatāmuddiśannāha akṣaratvāditi|- na kṣarantīti akṣarāṇi akārādayaḥ svarāḥ kādīni ca vyañjanāni; tadghaṭitatvādāyurvedasyāpi nityatvaṃ kāraṇānurūpaṃ kāryamiti kṛtvā||141-143||

div.ab: iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ kalpasthāne kīṭakalpo nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ ||8|| iti bhagavatā śrīdhanvantariṇopadiṣṭāyāṃ tacchiṣyeṇa maharṣiṇā suśrutena viracitāyāṃ suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ pañcamaṃ kalpasthānaṃ samāptam |

ab.seg: iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ kalpasthāne'ṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ||8||

div.head: aupadravikādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāta aupadravikamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

kalpasthānānantaramuttaratantramārabhyate, yena kalpasthāne viṣajasyāgantuvraṇasya viṣamupadravakāri ‘viṣavadupadravakāritvaṃ’ iti pā. nijavraṇasyāpi ripubhiravacāritaviṣamupadravabhūtamiti ‘ripubhiravacāritaviṣasya viṣavadupadravakāritvam’ iti pā. taccikitsitabhihitam, ata upadravacikitsādhikārasāmānyāt sarvopadravacikitsārthamuttaratantrārambhaḥ; athavā saviṃśamadhyāyaśataṃ parisamāpya pariśiṣṭatvāduttaratantraṃ ‘pariśiṣṭabhūtamuttaratantraṃ’ iti pā. pratipādyaṃ bhavati| tasya ca tantrasyopadravānadhikṛtya pravṛttatvānniruktyā aupadravikatvaṃ prāptamapyadhyāye vyavasthitam| taduktaṃ sūtre- ‘adhikṛtya kṛtaṃ’ ityādi| sa ca niruktisampanno'dhyāyaḥ prāk pratipādyo bhavatītyata āha- athāta ityādi| upadravān rogānadhikṛtya kṛto'dhyāya aupadravikaḥ||1-2||

div.ab: adhyāyānāṃ śate viṃśe yaduktamasakṛnmayā | vakṣyāmi bahudhā samyaguttare'rthānimāniti ||3|| idānīṃ tat pravakṣyāmi tantramuttaramuttamam |4|

idānīmārabhyamāṇasyottaratantrasya sambandhaṃ darśayannāha- adhyāyānāmityādi| yadyasmāt kāraṇādviṃśatyadhike'dhyāyaśate punaḥ punaruktaṃ mayā; kiṃ tadityāha- ‘imānarthān bahudhottare vakṣyāmi’ iti; tattasmāt kāraṇādadhunottaratantraṃ pravakṣyāmīti sambandhaḥ| kecit ‘yadviṃśatyadhike proktamadhyāyānāṃ śate mayā’ iti paṭhanti; apare tu ‘śate saviṃśe'dhyāyānāṃ’ iti paṭhanti||3||-

nikhilenopadiśyante yatra ‘tatra’ iti pā. rogāḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ ||4|| śālākyatantrābhihitā videhādhipakīrtitāḥ | ye ca vistarato dṛṣṭāḥ kumārābādhahetavaḥ ||5|| ṣaṭsu kāyacikitsāsu ye coktāḥ paramarṣibhiḥ | upasargādayo rogā ye cāpyāgantavaḥ smṛtāḥ ||6|| triṣaṣṭī rasasaṃsargāḥ svasthavṛttaṃ tathaiva ca | yuktārthā yuktayaścaiva doṣabhedāstathaiva ca ||7|| yatroktā vividhā arthā rogasādhanahetavaḥ |8|

idānīmuttaratantrasya nikhilavyādhiniścayacikitsālakṣaṇāṃ stutiṃ nirdiśannāha- nikhilenetyādi| nikhilena sāmastyena| yatra yasminnuttaratantre| pṛthagvidhā nānāprakārāḥ| ke te nānāprakārā rogā nikhilenottare'bhidhāsyante? ityāha- śālākyaśāstrābhihitā ityādi| videhādhipakīrtitā iti nimipraṇītāḥ ṣaṭsaptatirnetrarogāḥ, na karālabhadraśaunakādipraṇītāḥ| ye ca vistarato haṣṭā iti pārvatakajīvakabandhakaprabhṛtibhiḥ; ‘yācaka’ iti pā. kumārābādhahetavaḥ skandagrahaprabhṛtayaḥ| ṣaṭsu kāyacikitsāsu agniveśabheḍajātūkarṇaparāśarahārītakṣārapāṇīproktāsu| upasargādayo jvarādayaḥ| āgantavaḥ atra unmādādayaḥ| nanu bhūtanimittatvādunmādādīnāṃ kathamāgantukatvaṃ? yataḥ prahārādikṛtā āgantavaḥ; satyaṃ, bāhyanimittatvādunmādādīnāmāgantukatvam| gayī tu, upasargādayaḥ amānuṣopasargādayaḥ, te cāpasmāronmādā bhūtavidyābhihitāḥ, ta evāgantava iti vyākhyānayati| uttaratantre nikhilena rogā eva proktā utānye'pi proktā? iti pṛṣṭa āha- triṣaṣṭī rasasaṃsargā ityādi| yuktārthāḥ pramāṇopapannārthāḥ| yuktayaḥ tantrayuktayaḥ| asyāgre kecit ‘videhādhipatiḥ śrīmān janako nāma viśrutaḥ| ālambhayajñapravaṇaḥ so'yajadbrāhmaṇairvṛtaḥ|| tasya yāgapravṛttasya kupito bhagavān raviḥ|| dṛṣṭiṃ praṇāśayāmāsa so'nutepe mahattapaḥ|| dīptāṃśustapasā tena toṣitaḥ pradadau punaḥ|| cakṣurvedaṃ prasannātmā sarvabhūtānukampayā||’ iti pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca| taṃ ca bṛhatpañjikākāro na paṭhati, tasmānmayā'pi na paṭhito na vyākhyātaśca||4-7||-

ab.seg: mahatastasya tantrasya durgādhasyāmbudheriva ||8||
ādāvevottamāṅgasthān rogānabhidadhāmyaham | saṅkhyayā lakṣaṇaiścāpi sādhyāsādhyakrameṇa ca ||9||

idānīṃ sarvendriyādhiṣṭhānatvena prāṇādhiṣṭhānatvena ca śiraḥ pradhānamataḥ prathamaṃ śiraḥsthān vyādhīn kathayāmīti nirdiśannāha- mahata ityādi| tasya uttaratantrasyādau uttamāṅgasthān rogānabhidadhāmīti sambandhaḥ| ambudheriva samudrasyeva, mahataḥ ativistīrṇasya, durgādhasya agādhasya| saṅkhyayā ṣaṭsaptatyā videhādhipaproktayā, lakṣaṇaiḥ vyañjanaiḥ, cakāreṇa hetucikitsābhyāṃ; sādhyāsādhyakrameṇa ceti sādhyāsādhyaparipāṭyā| athavā lakṣaṇaiḥ hetupūrvarūpopaśayasamprāptibhiḥ; cakāreṇa cikitsitamevānuktaṃ samuccīyate, kecicca kramaśabdenaiva cikitsitaṃ gṛhṇanti||8-9||

div.ab: vidyāddvayaṅgulabāhulyaṃ svāṅguṣṭhodarasammitam | dvyaṅgulaṃ sarvataḥ sārdhaṃ bhiṣaṅnayanabudbudam ||10|| suvṛttaṃ gostanākāraṃ sarvabhūtaguṇodbhavam |11|

tatra sarveṣūttamāṅgastheṣu saṅkhyādibhirvācyeṣu nayanagatarogābhidhānaṃ, sarvendriyāṇāṃ madhye nayanasya pradhānatvāt; tatrāpi nayanasya paṭalavyadhanimittamantaḥpraveśāyāmavistārairmānamākāraṃ ‘mānaṃ kāraṇaṃ ca’ iti pā. ca darśayannāha- vidyādityādi| dvyaṅgulabāhulyamidamantaḥpraveśapramāṇaṃ, dvyaṅgulamānamāha ‘aṅgulamānamāha-’ iti pā. - svāṅguṣṭhodarasammitaṃ; etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati- svāṅguṣṭhodarasammitaṃ yadaṅgulaṃ tadaṅguladvayapramāṇaṃ netrabudbudasyāntaḥpraveśaṃ vidyāt| dvyaṅgulaṃ sārdhamiti ardhatṛtīyāṅgulamityarthaḥ| sarvata iti āyāmato vistaraścetyarthaḥ| nayanabudbudam akṣigolakaḥ| sarvabhūtaguṇodbhavaṃ sarvabhūtebhyastadguṇebhyaścodbhavo yasya tattathāvidhaṃ; sarvabhūtebhyastāvannetrabudbudaṃ sirāsnāyvasthisahitaṃ sāśrumārgaṃ cotpannaṃ, tadguṇebhyaśca raktasitakṛṣṇaguṇā utpannāḥ; etena guṇavadbhūtotpannamityarthaḥ| kecidguṇaśabdena bhūtaprasādaṃ kathayanti; tacca vyākhyānaṃ jejjaṭāya ‘jejjaṭasya’ iti pā. na rocate||10||-
palaṃ bhuvo'gnito raktaṃ vātāt kṛṣṇaṃ sitaṃ jalāt ||11|| ākāśādaśrumārgāśca jāyante netrabudbude |12|

yena bhūtena netrabudbudamārabhyate yena ca raktādaya iti darśayannāha- palamityādi| palaṃ māṃsaṃ, bhuvaḥ pṛthivyāḥ; agnito raktamiti agniguṇādraktaṃ pittarūpaṃ; evaṃ sitaṃ jalādityatrāpi vyākhyeyaṃ; aśrumārgā aśrusrotāṃsi||11||-

ab.seg: dṛṣṭiṃ cātra tathā vakṣye yathā brūyādviśāradaḥ ||12||
netrāyāmatribhāgaṃ tu kṛṣṇamaṇḍalamucyate | kṛṣṇāt saptamamicchanti dṛṣṭiṃ dṛṣṭiviśāradāḥ ||13||

idānīṃ tasminnetrabudbude yaddṛṣṭimaṇḍalaṃ tasya pramāṇaṃ pūrvācāryapratipāditapramāṇānurūpaṃ pratipādayitumāha- dṛṣṭiṃ cetyādi| viśārado videhaḥ| kṛṣṇāt saptamamiti kṛṣṇamaṇḍalāt saptamaṃ bhāgaṃ dṛṣṭimicchanti| dṛṣṭiviśāradāḥ śālākinaḥ| etat pramāṇaṃ paramatamapyapratiṣiddhatvādanumatameva| tasya saptamāṃśasya kiṃ pramāṇaṃ syāditi kathanāya masūradalamātrāmityagre nirdeśaḥ; athavā śālākināṃ paramatamabhidhāya masūradalamātrāmiti svamatamabhidhāsyatyācāryaḥ| yadyevaṃ tarhyāturopakramaṇīye ‘navamastārakāṃśo dṛṣṭiḥ’ iti kathamuktavān? satyaṃ, mahāpuruṣāṇāṃ pūrṇāyuṣāṃ bhinnaviṣayamabhidhānamiti na doṣaḥ, ato'nyānyapi samādhānāni pañjikoktāni santi, tāni vistarabhayānna likhitāni| kecidimaṃ pāṭhamanyathā kṛtvā''pātanikāpūrvakaṃ paṭhanti, sa cābhāvānna likhitaḥ||12-13||
maṇḍalāni ca sandhīṃśca paṭalāni ca locane | yathākramaṃ vijānīyāt pañca ṣaṭ ca ṣaḍeva ca ||14||

idānīṃ nayanasya rogādhiṣṭhānakathanāya maṇḍalādisaṅkhyāmāha- maṇḍalānītyādi| kecidevaṃ paṭhanti- ‘locane maṇḍalānyantān sandhīṃśca paṭalāni ca| jānīyāt kramaśaḥ pañca caturaḥ ṣaṭ ṣaḍeva ca’- iti| eṣa pāṭho nibandhakārairdūṣitaḥ||14||
pakṣmavartmaśvetakṛṣṇadṛṣṭīnāṃ maṇḍalāni tu | anupūrvaṃ tu te madhyāścatvāro'ntyā yathottaram ||15||
tānyeva pañcamaṇḍalānyāha- pakṣmavartmetyādi| pakṣmādīnāṃ pañca maṇḍalāni| te tu maṇḍalā anupūrvaṃ madhyāḥ, yathottaraṃ cāntyāḥ||15||
pakṣmavartmagataḥ sandhirvartmaśuklagato'paraḥ | śuklakṛṣṇagatastvanyaḥ kṛṣṇadṛṣṭigato'paraḥ | tataḥ kanīnakagataḥ ṣaṣṭhaścāpāṅgagaḥ smṛtaḥ ||16||
sandhīnāha- pakṣmetyādi| kanīnakagato nāsāsamīpe'vasthitaḥ ‘nāsāsamīpavyavasthitaḥ’ iti pā., apāṅgago bhrūpucchāntaḥsthitaḥ||16||
dve vartmapaṭale vidyāccatvāryanyāni cākṣiṇi | jāyate timiraṃ yeṣu vyādhiḥ paramadāruṇaḥ ||17||

div.ab: paṭalānyāha- dve ityādi| catvāryanyāni cākṣiṇi aparāṇyapi catvāri paṭalānyakṣiṇi vidyāt| yeṣu caturṣu paṭaleṣu||17||-
tejojalāśritaṃ bāhyaṃ teṣvanyat piśitāśritam | medastṛtīyaṃ paṭalamāśritaṃ tvasthi cāparam ||18|| pañcamāṃśasamaṃ dṛṣṭesteṣāṃ bāhulyamiṣyate |19|

idānīṃ tānyeva timirasyāśrayabhūtāni catvāri paṭalāni cikitsārthaṃ vibhajannāha- teja ityādi| atra tejaḥśabdenālocakatejaḥsamāśrayaṃ ‘samāśritaṃ’ iti pā. sirāgataṃ raktaṃ boddhavyam| jalaṃ tvaggato rasadhātuḥ, bāhyam akṣigolakasya prathamaṃ paṭalaṃ; anyat dvitīyaṃ, bāhulyaṃ sthūlatā||18||-
sirāṇāṃ kaṇḍarāṇāṃ ca medasaḥ kālakasya ca ||19|| guṇāḥ kālāt paraḥ śleṣmā bandhane'kṣṇoḥ sirāyutaḥ |20|

teṣāmeva dhātūnāṃ paṭalāśrayāṇāmupadhātūnāṃ ca karmato ‘kāryatvena’ iti pā. nayane'stivaṃ darśayannāha- sirāṇāmityādi| sirādīnāṃ kālakāsthiparyantānāṃ parā guṇā yathottaramutkṛṣṭāḥ prasādā, akṣṇorbandhane'nyonyasaṃhanane'dhikṛtāḥ|| tathā kālakāt paraḥ kālakāsthnaḥ sakāśācchleṣmā sirāyuto'kṣṇorbandhane para utkṛṣṭo'dhikṛta iti piṇḍārthaḥ| sirāṇāmityatra bahuvacanasyādyarthavācitvāddhamanīnāmapi grahaṇam| kaṇḍarāṇāmityatra kaṇḍarāśabdaḥ snāyuvācakaḥ| anye tu sirādīnāṃ medaḥparyantānāṃ guṇāḥ prasādāḥ kālakasyākṣṇoḥ kṛṣṇabhāgasya bandhane'dhikṛtāḥ| tathā kālāt paraḥ kṛṣṇabhāgādyaḥ paraḥ śuklo bhāgastasya bandhane sirāyutaḥ śleṣmā| kecidetadarthānukūlenaivātra pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti,- ‘sirāṇāṃ kaṇḍarāṇāṃ ca medasaḥ kṛṣṇabandhane| guṇāḥ kālāt paraḥ śleṣmā bandhane'kṣṇoḥ sirāyutaḥ’- iti||19||-
sirānusāribhirdoṣairviguṇairūrdhvamāgataiḥ ||20|| jāyante netrabhāgeṣu rogāḥ paramadāruṇāḥ |21|

idānīṃ netrarogāṇāṃ sāmānyāṃ samprāptimāha- sirānusāribhirityādi| sirā atra netragatāḥ| viguṇaiḥ prakupitaiḥ| netrabhāgeṣu netrāvayaveṣu| netrarājiṣviti kecit paṭhanti; tatra netrāṇyeva rājayo netrarājayaḥ| etena sarvanetrāśrayā api labdhā bhavanti||20||-

ab.seg: tatrāvilaṃ sasaṃrambhamaśrukaṇḍūpadehavat ‘... maśrupūrṇopadehavat’ iti pā.||21||
gurūṣātodarāgādyairjuṣṭaṃ ‘gurūṣācoṣarāgādyaiḥ’ iti pā. cāvyaktalakṣaṇaiḥ | saśūlaṃ vartmakoṣeṣu śūkapūrṇābhameva ca ||22||
vihanyamānaṃ rūpe vā kriyāsvakṣi yathā purā | dṛṣṭvaiva dhīmān budhyeta doṣeṇādhiṣṭhitaṃ tu tat ||23||

pūrvarūpamāha- tatretyādi| āvilam ākulamaśrupūrṇamityarthaḥ ‘maṇḍapūrṇamivetyarthaḥ’ iti pā.| sasaṃrambham īṣacchophayuktam| upadeho malavṛddhiḥ| gurūṣātodarāgādyairjuṣṭamiti atrādiśabdaḥ pratyekaṃ yojyaḥ; tena gurutvādibhiḥ śleṣmaliṅgaiḥ, ūṣādibhiḥ pittaliṅgaiḥ, todādibhiḥ vātāliṅgaiḥ, rāgādibhiḥ śoṇitaliṅgaiḥ, juṣṭaṃ sevitam| nanu yadi gurutvādīni doṣaliṅgāni santi tat kathaṃ pūrvarūpaṃ? yato doṣaviśeṣeṇāvyaktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ pūrvarūpaṃ; ata āha- avyaktalakṣaṇairiti|- gurutvādīnāmapi tatra vyaktatā nāstyevetyarthaḥ| saśūlam īṣacchūlamityarthaḥ| vihanyamānamityādi| rūpe nīlapītādau yena prakāreṇa pūrvamāsīttataḥ svayameva vihanyamānaṃ kriyamāṇavighātam| kriyāsu nimeṣonmeṣādiṣu ceti| anye tu ‘kriyāsvakṣi yathā purā’ ityatra ‘kriyāsvakṣyāgataklamam’ iti paṭhanti| tatrāgataklamam āptaklamaṃ, nirvyāpāramityarthaḥ||21-23||
tatra sambhavamāsādya yathādoṣaṃ bhiṣagjitam | vidadhyānnetrajā rogā balavantaḥ syuranyathā ||24||

pūrvarūpe kriyāṃ nirdiśannāha- tatretyādi| tatra nayane, sambhavaṃ rogāṇāṃ prāgutpattiṃ, āsādya jñātvā, bhiṣagjitam auṣadhaṃ, vidadhyāt| ‘tatra sañcayamāsādya’ iti kecit paṭhanti; tatra sañcayaśabdaścayaprakopaprasarādiṣu vartate||24||
saṅkṣepataḥ kriyāyogo nidānaparivarjanam | vātādīnāṃ pratīghātaḥ prokto vistarataḥ punaḥ ||25||

kiṃ tadbhiṣagjitaṃ pūrvarūpe kuryādityāśaṅkya saṅkṣepavistarābhyāṃ tatra bhiṣagjitamāha- saṅkṣepata ityādi| kriyāṇāṃ saṃśamanasaṃśodhanādīnāmayameva samyagyogaḥ| kiṃ tadityāha- nidānaparivarjanamiti|- nidānānāṃ doṣakārakahetūnāṃ rogakārakahetūnāṃ ca sarvato varjanam| vistareṇa punarvātādīnāṃ pratīghātaḥ kriyāyogaḥ proktaḥ| yenauṣadhaprayogeṇa vātādīnāṃ kopaḥ pratihanyate sa upakrama ukta ityarthaḥ||25||
uṣṇābhitaptasya jalapraveśāddūrekṣaṇāt svapnaviparyayācca | prasaktasaṃrodanakopaśokakleśābhighātādatimaithunācca ||26||
śuktāranālāmlakulatthamāṣaniṣevaṇādvegavinigrahācca | svedādatho dhūmaniṣevaṇācca chardervighātādvamanātiyogāt | bāṣpagrahāt sūkṣmanirīkṣaṇācca netre vikārān janayanti doṣāḥ ||27||

kāni tāni nidānāni yāni parihartavyānītyāha- uṣṇetyādi| atra kecit ‘evaṃ vidāhyāpratikāriṇo'nnaṃ’ ityādi yāvat ‘avākśirotyucchritaśāyitasya jvaropatāpādṛtuparyayācca’ ityantaṃ paṭhanti ‘vidāhyasātmyātiviruddhaśītakṣārāmlatīkṣṇoṣṇagurudravānnaiḥ’ ityādi yāvat ‘evaṃ vidāhyapratikāriṇo'nnaṃ vidagdhamapyudgirato narasya| bāṣpagrahātsūkṣmanirīkṣaṇācca netre vikārān janayanti doṣāḥ iti paṭhanti’ iti pā., sa ca pāṭhaḥ punaruktidūṣaṇabhayānnāṅgīkṛtaḥ||26-27||

div.ab: vātāddaśa tathā pittāt kaphāccaiva trayodaśa | raktāt ṣoḍaśa vijñeyāḥ sarvajāḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ ||28|| tathā bāhyau punardvau ca rogāḥ ṣaṭsaptatiḥ smṛtāḥ |29|

idānīṃ tāneva vikārān vātādisaṅkhyayā nirdiśannāha- vātādityādi| tathā pittāt pittādapi daśaiva ca| bāhyau bahirnimittabhavau| tau kau? eko'bhighātotpannaḥ sanimittaḥ, anyaḥ surarṣigandharvādidarśanābhihataśaktiranimittaḥ||28||-

hatādhimantho nimiṣo dṛṣṭirgambhīrikā ca yā ||29|| yacca vātahataṃ vartma na te sidhyanti vātajāḥ | yāpyo'tha tanmayaḥ kācaḥ sādhyāḥ syuḥsānyamārutāḥ ||30|| śuṣkākṣipākādhīmanthasyandamārutaparyayāḥ |31|

idānīṃ teṣāmeva vikārāṇāṃ vātādibhedena sādhyāsādhyayāpyatvaṃ darśayannāha- hatetyādi| tanmayaḥ vātamayaḥ| sādhyāḥ syuḥ sānyamārutā iti hatādhimanthādayaścatvāro vātajā asādhyāḥ, ekaśca yāpyaḥ, śuṣkākṣipākādayo rogāḥ sānyamārutā anyatovātarogeṇa sahitāḥ pañca sādhyāḥ||29-30||-

asādhyo hrasvajāḍyo yo jalasrāvaśca paittikaḥ ||31|| parimlāyī ca nīlaśca yāpyaḥ kāco'tha tanmayaḥ | abhiṣyando'dhimantho'mlādhyuṣitaṃ śuktikā ca yā ||32|| dṛṣṭiḥ pittavidagdhā ca dhūmadarśī ca sidhyati |33|
asādhya ityādi| pittasambhavau dvau hrasvajāḍyajalasrāvau sādhayitumaśakyau, tathā paittikau parimlāyīnīlākhyau kācau yāpanārhau, abhiṣyandādayaḥ ṣaṭ sādhyāḥ||31-32||-

ab.seg: asādhyaḥ kaphajaḥ srāvo yāpyaḥ kācaśca tanmayaḥ ||33||
abhiṣyando'dhimanthaśca balāsagrathitaṃ ca yat | dṛṣṭiḥ śleṣmavidagdhā ca pothakyo lagaṇśca yaḥ ||34||
krimigranthipariklinnavartmaśuklārmapiṣṭakāḥ ‘krimigranthiḥ pariklinnavartma śuklārma piṣṭakaḥ’ iti pā.| śleṣmopanāhaḥ sādhyāstu kathitāḥ śleṣmajeṣu tu ||35||
asādhya ityādi| tanmayaḥ śleṣmaja ityarthaḥ| kaphajeṣveka evāsādhyaḥ, yāpyo'pyeka eva, abhiṣyandādayaścaikādaśa sādhyāḥ||33-35||
raktasrāvo'jakājātaṃ śoṇitārśovraṇānvitam ‘lambitam’ iti pā.| śukraṃ na sādhyaṃ kācaśca yāpyastajjaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||36||
manthasyandau kliṣṭavartma ‘klinnavartma’ iti pā. harṣotpātau tathaiva ca | sirājātā'ñjanākhyā ca sirājālaṃ ca yat smṛtam ||37||
parvaṇyathāvraṇaṃ śukraṃ śoṇitārmārjunaśca yaḥ | ete sādhyā vikāreṣu raktajeṣu bhavanti hi ||38||
raktasrāva ityādi| raktasrāvastathā'jakā śoṇitārśaḥ kṣataśukrakaṃ ca raktājjātaṃ catuṣṭayamapyasādhyaṃ, tajjo raktajaḥ kāco yāpyaḥ, manthasyandādaya ekādaśa sādhyāḥ||36-38||
pūyāsrāvo nākulāndhyamakṣipākātyayo'lajī | asādhyāḥ sarvajā yāpyaḥ kācaḥ kopaśca pakṣmaṇaḥ ||39||
vartmāvabandho yo vyādhiḥ sirāsu piḍakā ca yā | prastāryarmādhimāṃsārma snāyvarmotsaṅginī ca yā ||40||
pūyālasaścārbudaṃ ca śyāvakardamavartmanī | tathā'rśovartma śuṣkārśaḥ śarkarāvartma yacca vai ||41||
saśophaścāpyaśophaśca pāko bahalavartma ca | aklinnavartma kumbhīkā bisavartma ca sidhyati ||42||

pūyetyādi| pūyāsrāvādayaścatvāro'sādhyāḥ, kācapakṣmakopau yāpyau, vartmāvabandhādaya ekonaviṃśatiḥ sādhyāḥ| kecittu ‘kācaḥ kopaśca pakṣmaṇa’ ityatra ‘yāpyo vartmāvabandhaśca kācaḥ kopaśca pakṣmaṇaḥ| pillākhyaścāpi yo vyādhiḥ sirāsu piḍakā ca yā’ iti paṭhanti| sa ca pāṭhaḥ pañjikayā nirastaḥ, tasmādasmābhirapi parityaktaḥ||39-42||

div.ab: sanimitto'nimittaśca dvāvasādhyau tu bāhyajau |43|
sanimitta ityādi| tau dvāvapi sannipātanimittau vivṛtau|43|-

ab.seg: ṣaṭsaptatirvikārāṇāmeṣā saṅgrahakīrtitā ‘saṅgrahakīrtanā’ iti pā.||43||
ṣaḍityādi| saṅkṣepeṇa kathitā, athavā saṅgraheṇa samyak doṣagraheṇa kathitā||43||
nava sandhyāśrayāsteṣu vartmajāstvekaviṃśatiḥ | śuklabhāge daśaikaśca catvāraḥ kṛṣṇabhāgajāḥ ||44||
sarvāśrayāḥ saptadaśa dṛṣṭijā dvādaśaiva tu | bāhyajau dvau samākhyātau rogau paramadāruṇau | bhūya etān pravakṣyāmi saṅkhyārūpacikitsitaiḥ ||45||

idānīṃ teṣāṃ doṣaviśeṣeṇa saṅgrahaṃ pratipādya sandhyādyāśrayamedenāpi saṅgrahaṃ pratipādayannāha- navetyādi| dvau bāhyajau ‘tau’ iti pā. sarvāśrayatve'pi dṛṣṭyāśritau mantavyau, dṛṣṭeḥ pradhānatamatvāt||44-45||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālakyatantre aupadraviko nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ ||1||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre prathamo'dhyāyaḥ||1||

div.head: saṃdhigatarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ sandhigatarogavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
pūrvasminnadhyāye sandhyādikrameṇa nayanagatarogā abhihitāḥ, ata aupadravikānantaraṃ prāk sandhigatā rogāḥ pratipādyā bhavantītyata āha- athāta ityādi| gataśabda āśrayavacanaḥ||1-2||
pūyālasaḥ sopanāhaḥ srāvāḥ parvaṇikā'lajī | krimigranthiśca vijñeyā rogāḥ sandhigatā nava ||3||
srāvāḥ catvāraḥ pūyāsrāva ityādayaḥ||3||

div.ab: pakvaḥ śophaḥ sandhijaḥ saṃsravedyaḥ sāndraṃ pūyaṃ pūti pūyālasaḥ saḥ |4|
idānīṃ teṣāṃ navānāmapi pratyekaṃ lakṣaṇamāha- pakva ityādi| sandhijaḥ kanīnasandhijaḥ| pūti durgandham| ayaṃ sannipātajaḥ sādhyaśca|4|-

ab.seg: granthirnālpo dṛṣṭisandhāvapākaḥ kaṇḍūprāyo nīrujastūpanāhaḥ ||4||
granthirityādi| nālpo mahānityarthaḥ| apāka īṣatpākaḥ| upanāhaḥ śleṣmopanāhaḥ| kaphajo'yaṃ sādhyaśca||4||
gatvā sandhīnaśrumārgeṇa doṣāḥ kuryuḥ srāvān rugvihīnān kanīnāt | tān vai srāvān netranāḍīmathaike tasyā liṅgaṃ kīrtayiṣye caturdhā ||5||
pākaḥ sandhau saṃsravedyaśca pūyaṃ pūyāsrāvo naikarūpaḥ pradiṣṭaḥ | śvetaṃ sāndraṃ picchilaṃ saṃsravedyaḥ śleṣmāsrāvo nīrujaḥ sa pradiṣṭaḥ ||6||
raktāsrāvaḥ śoṇitotthaḥ saraktamuṣṇaṃ nālpaṃ saṃsravennātisāndram | pītābhāsaṃ nīlamuṣṇaṃ jalābhaṃ pittāsrāvaḥ saṃsravet sandhimadhyāt ||7||

sandhayo netrāntargatāścatvāraḥ| aśrumārgaśabdenātra sirā abhipretāḥ| tathāca videhaḥ,- “aśrusrāvaḥ sirā gatvā netrasandhiṣu tiṣṭhati| tataḥ kanīnakaṃ gatvā cāśru kṛtvā kanīnake|| tataḥ sravatyathāsrāvaṃ yathādoṣamavedanam”- iti| aśrusrāvaśabdenātra tatsahito doṣo'bhidhīyate| kathaṃ caturdhetyāha- pāka ityādi|- naikarūpa iti asya ‘tasya’ iti pā. sannipātajatvādbahurūpatvam| sandhiratra kanīnakasandhiḥ| asādhyo'yam| śveta ityādi|- ayamapyasādhyaḥ| raktetyādi|- asāvapyasādhyaḥ| pītetyādi|- kanīnakasandhimadhyādityarthaḥ| vyādhisvabhāvato vātāsrāvo nāsti, pittajagalagaṇḍacāturthikavat| eṣo'pyasādhyaḥ||5-7||
tāmrā tanvī dāhaśūlopapannā raktājjñeyā parvaṇī vṛttaśophā | jātā sandhau kṛṣṇaśukle'lajī syāttasminneva khyāpitā pūrvaliṅgaiḥ ||8||

tāmretyādi| asādhyo'yam| alajītyādi| tasminneva kṛṣṇaśuklasandhāveva| pūrvaliṅgaiḥ parvaṇīliṅgairityarthaḥ| parvaṇyalajyoḥ sthānasya lakṣaṇasya caikye'pi tanutvasthūlatvābhyāṃ bhedaḥ| tanvī parvaṇī, tataḥ sthūlā punaralajī| iyaṃ sannipātajā asādhyā ca||8||
krimigranthirvartmanaḥ pakṣmaṇaśca kaṇḍūṃ kuryuḥ krimayaḥ sandhijātāḥ | nānārūpā vartmaśuklasya sandhau ‘vartmaśuklāntasandhau’ iti pā. caranto'ntarnayanaṃ dūṣayanti ||9||

krimītyādi| krimīgranthirvartmaśuklayoḥ sandhau bhavati| tatraiva nānārūpāḥ krimayo vartmanaḥ pakṣmaṇaśca sandhiṃ prāptāḥ kaṇḍūṃ janayanti, antaścaranto bhakṣayanto nayanaṃ dūṣayanti| asau kaphajaḥ sādhyaśca||9||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantre sandhigatarogavijñānīyo nāma dvitīyo'dhyayaḥ ||2||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ||2||

div.head: vartmagatarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto vartmagatarogavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
sandhigatarogānantaraṃ ‘vartmaśuklasya sandhau caranto'ntarnayanaṃ dūṣayanti’ iti vartmano'nantaranirdiṣṭatvādvartmagatarogavijñānīyārambho yukta ityata āha- athāta ityādi||1-2||
pṛthagdoṣāḥ samastā vā yadā vartmavyapāśrayāḥ | sirā vyāpyāvatiṣṭhante vartmasvadhikamūrcchitāḥ ||3||
vivardhya ‘vibadhya’ iti pā. māṃsaṃ raktaṃ ca tadā vartmavyapāśrayān | vikārāñjanayantyāśu nāmatastānnibodhata ||4||

samprāptimāha- pṛthagityādi| yadā pṛthak samastā vā adhikamūrcchitā atiśayaprakupitā doṣā vartmavyapāśrayāḥ apaśabdasyopasargasya madhyavacanatvādvartmamadhyagatāḥ sirā vyāpya vartmasvavatiṣṭhante, tadā vartmavyapāśrayān vikārān śīghraṃ janayantīti sambandhaḥ| amuṃ pāṭhaṃ pañjikākāro na paṭhati, jejjaṭapaṭhitatvādasmābhirapi paṭhitaḥ||3-4||

div.ab: utsaṅginyatha kumbhīkā pothakyo vartmaśarkarā | tathā'rśovartma śuṣkārśastathaivāñjananāmikā ||5|| bahalaṃ vartma yaccāpi vyādhirvartmāvabandhakaḥ | kliṣṭakardamavartmākhyau śyāvavartma tathaiva ca ||6|| praklinnamapariklinnaṃ vartma vātahataṃ tu yat | arbudaṃ nimiṣaścāpi śoṇitārśaśca yat smṛtam ||7|| lagaṇo biśanāmā ca pakṣmakopastathaiva ca | ekaviṃśatirityete vikārā vartmasaṃśrayāḥ ||8|| nāmabhiste samuddiṣṭā... |9|
te ca vartmāśrayā rogā ekaviṃśatirabhihitāḥ, atastāneva nāmnā nirdiśannāha- utsaṅginītyādi||5-8||-
...lakṣaṇaistān pracakṣmahe | abhyantaramukhī bāhyotsaṅge'dho vartmanaśca yā ‘piḍakā'bhyantaramukhī bāhyā'dhovartmasaṃśrayā’ iti pā.||9|| vijñeyotsaṅginī nāma tadrūpapiḍakācitā |10|

nāmatastān samuddiśya lakṣaṇairāha- lakṣaṇairityādi| abhyantaramukhī vartmābhyantaramukhī| bāhyeti bahirbhavā iva pratibhāsate, vāstūtsedhena ‘bāhyotsedhena\\’ iti pā. bahirapyunnatatvāt| utsaṅge'dho vartmanaśca yeti adhobhāge yadvartma tasyotsaṅge kroḍe jātā yā, tasyā iva rūpaṃ yāsāṃ, tadrūpābhirvyāptā; iyaṃ sannipātajā sādhyā ca| videhoktamihānuktaṃ kāṭhinyādi cohyam| tathā hi taduktaṃ vacaḥ, - “vartmotsaṅge'pyadho ‘'dhare’ iti pā. jantoḥ sannipātāt prajāyate| abhyantaramukhī sthūlā bāhyataścāpi dṛśyate|| piḍakā piḍakābhiśca citā'nyābhiḥ samantataḥ| utsaṅgapiḍakā nāma kaṭhinā mandavedanā|| sā prabhinnā sravet srāvaṃ kukkuṭāṇḍarasopamam”- iti||9||-
kumbhīkabījapratimāḥ piḍakā yāstu ‘piḍakāḥ pakṣmavartmanoḥ’ iti pā. vartmajāḥ ||10|| ādhmāpayanti bhinnā yāḥ ‘ādhmāyante tu bhinnāśca’ iti pā. kumbhīkapiḍakāstu tāḥ |11|
kumbhīkā dāḍimākāraphalā sthalakumbhī| vartmajā iti bahuvacanād bāhyā eva bhavanti| etāḥ sannipātajā api sādhyāḥ||10||-

ab.seg: srāviṇyaḥ kaṇḍurā ‘kaṇḍūsrāvānvitā’ iti pā. gurvyo raktasarṣapasannibhāḥ | piḍakāśca rujāvatyaḥ pothakya iti sañjñitāḥ ||11||
srāviṇya ityādi| srāviṇyo bahusrāvāḥ| kaṇḍurā iti kaṇḍuyuktāḥ| rujāvatya iti kaphajā api vedanāyuktā ityarthaḥ| imāḥ sādhyāḥ||11||
piḍakābhiḥ susūkṣmābhirghanābhirabhisaṃvṛtā | piḍakā yā kharā sthūlā sā jñeyā vartmaśarkarā ||12||
piḍakābhirityādi| iyaṃ sannipātajā sādhyā ca||12||
ervārubījapratimāḥ `ervārubījapratimā pīḍakā mandavedanā| sūkṣmā kharā ca vartmasthā tadarśoṃvartma kīrtyate’ iti pā. piḍakā mandavedanāḥ | sūkṣmāḥ kharāśca vartmasthāstadarśovartma kīrtyate ||13||
ervārvityādi| ervāruḥ grīṣmakarkaṭī| vartmasthā vartmanāmantarbāhyato'pi tiṣṭhāti| idaṃ sannipātajamapi sādhyam||13||
