dīrgho'ṅkuraḥ kharaḥ stabdho dāruṇo vartmasambhavaḥ | vyādhireṣa samākhyātaḥ śuṣkārśa iti sañjñitaḥ ||14||
dīrgha ityādi| dāruṇaḥ atikaṣṭataraḥ| vartmasambhavo vartmanāmantareva bhavati| ayaṃ vyādhiḥ sannipātajo'pi sādhyaḥ||14||
dāhatodavatī tāmrā piḍakā vartmasambhavā | mṛdvī mandarujā sūkṣmā jñeyā sā'ñjananāmikā ||15||
dāhetyādi| raktajeyaṃ sādhyā ca||15||
vartmopacīyate yasya piḍakābhiḥ samantataḥ | savarṇābhiḥ samābhiśca vidyādbahalavartma tat ||16||
vartmetyādi| etadapi sannipātajaṃ sādhyaṃ ca||16||
kaṇḍūmatā'lpatodena vartmaśophena yo naraḥ | na samaṃ chādayedakṣi bhavedbandhaḥ sa vartmanaḥ ||17||
kaṇḍūmatetyādi| eṣa sannipātajo'pi sādhyaḥ||17||
mṛdalpavedanaṃ tāmraṃ yadvartma samameva ca | akasmācca bhavedraktaṃ kliṣṭavartma tadādiśet ||18||

mṛdvityādi| ‘akasmācca sravedraktaṃ’ iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ, taṃ ca pañjikākāro na manyate| akasmācca kāraṇaṃ vinā dvayamapi vartma raktaṃ bhavet| tathā ca videhaḥ,- “śleṣmaduṣṭena raktena kliṣṭamāṃsamivobhayam| bandhujīvanibhaṃ vartma kliṣṭavartma taducyate”- iti| etadraktajaṃ sādhyaṃ ca||18||
kliṣṭaṃ punaḥ pittayutaṃ vidahecchoṇitaṃ yadā | tadā klinnatvamāpannamucyate vartmakardamaḥ ||19||

kliṣṭamityādi| yadā kliṣṭārambhakaṃ śleṣmaduṣṭaṃ śoṇitaṃ pittayuktaṃ vidahet vidāhaṃ gacchettadā klinnatvamāpannaṃ kliṣṭameva vartmakardama ucyate, klinnatvamāpannamārdratāṃ prāptam| etat kaphapittaraktārabdhatvāt sannipātajaṃ sādhyaṃ ca| ‘kṛṣṇatvamāpannam’ iti kecit paṭhanti, taṃ pāṭhaṃ pañjikākāro nāṅgīkaroti||19||
yadvartma bāhyato'ntaśca śyāvaṃ śūnaṃ savedanam | dāhakaṇḍūparikledi `sakaṇḍūṣāparikledaṃ’ iti pā. śyāvavartmeti tanmatam ||20||
yadvartmetyādi| etadapi sannipātajaṃ sādhyaṃ ca||20||
arujaṃ bāhyataḥ śūnamantaḥ klinnaṃ sravatyapi | kaṇḍūnistodabhūyiṣṭhaṃ klinnavartma taducyate ||21||

arujamityādi| arujamalparujaṃ śūnaṃ ca bāhye, klinnaṃ sravatyapyantareva, kaṇḍūnistodabahulaṃ punarantareva| ayaṃ rogaḥ pillākhyaḥ kenacit kathitaḥ, tat pañjikākāro na manyate| ayaṃ vyādhiḥ kaphajaḥ sādhyaśca||21||
yasya dhautāni dhautāni sambadhyante punaḥ punaḥ | vartmānyaparipakvāni vidyādaklinnavartma tat ||22||

yasyetyādi| yasya rogasya sthānabhūtāni vartmānyasakṛtprakṣālitāni punaḥ sambaddhāni bhavanti pillopadehenāntarbahiśca pākarahitānyapi pākarahitatvāt’ iti pā., tadaklinnavartma jānīyāt| etat sannipātajamapi sādhyaṃ pillākhyaṃ ca| tathā ca videhaḥ- “prakṣālite tathā `'thavā’ iti pā. mṛṣṭe ānahyete punaḥ punaḥ| apariklinnavartmānaṃ pillākhyamiti nirdeśet”- iti| amuṃ dvayamapi dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikapāṭhaṃ sūtre jejjaṭācāryaḥ paṭhati, tannecchati gayadāsaḥ||22||
vimuktasandhi niśceṣṭaṃ vartma yasya na mīlyate | etadvātahataṃ vidyāt sarujaṃ yadi vā'rujam ||23||
vimuktetyādi| niśceṣṭaṃ niṣkriyam| ata eva na nimīlyate na saṅkucatītyarthaḥ| arujam alparujam| idaṃ vātajamasādhyaṃ ca||23||
vartmāntarasthaṃ viṣamaṃ granthibhūtamavedanam | vijñeyamarbudaṃ puṃsāṃ saraktamavalambitam ||24||

vartmetyādi| vartmāntarastham abhyantarasthamityarthaḥ| viṣamaṃ kaṣṭakāri| granthibhūtaṃ granthiriva `granthirivāsaktaṃ’ iti pā.| saraktamavalambitamiti kiñcidraktatā pittena, avalambitatvamarbudatvena| ‘avalambi ca’ iti kecit paṭhanti| sannipātajamapīdaṃ sādhyam||24||
nimeṣaṇīḥ sirā vāyuḥ praviṣṭo vartmasaṃśrayāḥ | cālayatyati `cālayedakṣivartmāni’ iti, `cālayedativartmāni’ iti ca pā. vartmāni nimeṣaḥ sa gado mataḥ ||25||

nimeṣaṇīrityādi| vartmasaṃśrayāḥ nimeṣiṇīḥ sirā vāyuḥ praviṣṭaḥ san vartmāni cālayatīti sambandhaḥ| yadbalena nimeṣonmeṣau syātāṃ tā nimeṣiṇyaḥ sirāḥ| ‘so'gado mata’ iti kecit paṭhanti, tatrāgada avyatha ityarthaḥ| asau vātajo'sādhyaśca||25||
chinnāśchinnā vivardhante vartmasthā mṛdavo'ṅkurāḥ | dāhakaṇḍūrujopetāste'rśaḥ śoṇitasambhavāḥ `śoṇitasambhavam’ iti pā.||26||

chinnā ityādi| ye śoṇitasambhavā mṛdavo vartmasthā aṅkurāśchinnāśchinnāḥ santo vivardhante te'ṅkurā arśaḥ `śoṇitārśaḥ iti sambandhaḥ’ iti pā. śoṇitārśa iti sambandhaḥ| idaṃ śoṇitārśo raktajamasādhyaṃ ca||26||
apākaḥ kaṭhinaḥ sthūlo granthirvartmabhavo'rujaḥ | sakaṇḍūḥ picchilaḥ kolapramāṇo lagaṇastu saḥ ||27||
apāka ityādi| śleṣmajo'yaṃ sādhyaśca||27||
śūnaṃ yadvartma bahubhiḥ sūkṣmaiśchidraiḥ samanvitam | bisamantarjala iva bisavartmeti tanmatam ||28||
śūnamityādi| yathā'ntarjale bisaṃ bisāṇḍaṃ tadvadityarthaḥ| etat sarvajamapi sādhyam||28||
doṣāḥ pakṣmāśayagatāstīkṣṇāgrāṇi kharāṇi ca | nirvartayanti pakṣmāṇi tairghuṣṭaṃ `tairjuṣṭaṃ’ iti pā. cākṣi dūyate ||29||
uddhṛtairuddhṛtaiḥ `utpāṭitaiḥ punaḥ’ iti pā. śāntiḥ pakṣmabhiścopajāyate | vātātapānaladveṣī pakṣmakopaḥ sa ucyate ||30||

doṣā ityādi| nirvartayanti niṣpādayanti| pakṣmāṇi pratibālān| taiḥ pakṣmabhiḥ, akṣi locanaṃ, dūyate upatapyate| uddhṛtairuddhṛtairiti unmūlitairunmūlitairityarthaḥ; atra vīpsayā teṣāṃ punaḥ punarudbhavaḥ khyāpyate| asya pakṣmakopasya ‘upapakṣmamālā’ iti anuktā dvitīyā sañjñā; loke ‘parivāla’ iti vadanti| eṣa rogaḥ sarvajo yāpyaśca||29-30||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantre vartmagatarogavijñānīyo nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||3||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ||3||

div.head: śuklagatarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ śuklagatarogavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
vartmagatarogavijñānīyānantaraṃ vartmamaṇḍalācchuklamaṇḍalasyānantaryāttadgatarogavijñānīyārambho yukta ityata āha- athāta ityādi||1-2||

div.ab: prastāriśuklakṣatajādhimāṃsasnāyvarmasañjñāḥ khalu pañca rogāḥ | syuḥ śuktikā cārjunapiṣṭakau ca jālaṃ sirāṇāṃ piḍakāśca yāḥ syuḥ ||3|| rogā balāsagrathitena sārdhamekādaśākṣṇoḥ khalu śuklabhāge |4|
tāneva rogānnāmabhirāha- prastārītyādi| armaśabdaḥ prastāryādibhiḥ pañcabhiḥ saha sambadhyate| jālaṃ sirāṇāmiti sirāśabdo jālapiḍakābhyāṃ sambadhyate; tena sirājālaṃ, sirāpiḍakāścetyarthaḥ||3||-

ab.seg: prastāri prathitamihārma śuklabhāge vistīrṇaṃ tanu rudhiraprabhaṃ sanīlam ||4||

prastārītyādi| prathitaṃ prakhyātaṃ, vistīrṇaṃ vitataṃ, tanu viralaṃ, rudhiraprabhaṃ raktanibhaṃ, sanīlam īṣannīlam, eteneṣannīlalohitamityarthaḥ| jejjaṭācāryastu videhoktaṃ prastāryarmalakṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā sanīlamityatra vāśabdo lupto draṣṭavyaḥ, tena raktamīṣannīlaṃ vetyartha iti pratipādayati| tathā ca videhavākyaṃ- “samantādvistṛtaḥ śyāvo rakto vā māṃsasañcayaḥ| sannipātena doṣāṇāṃ prastāryarma taducyate”- iti| tridoṣajamidaṃ sādhyaṃ ca||4||

div.ab: śuklākhyaṃ mṛdu kathayanti śuklabhāge saśvetaṃ samamiha vardhate ’samamabhivardhate’ iti pā. cireṇa |5|
śuklākhyamityādi| śuklākhyaṃ śuklanāmārma| mṛdu komalaṃ, saśvetaṃ kiñcicchvetaṃ; śleṣmajamidaṃ sādhyaṃ ca|5|-

ab.seg: yanmāṃsaṃ pracayamupaiti śuklabhāge padmābhaṃ tadupadiśanti lohitārma ||5||
yadityādi| pracayaṃ vṛddhim, upaiti gacchati, padmābham aruṇapadmaprabhaṃ, lohitārma śoṇitārmetyārthaḥ| etadraktajaṃ `sādhyeyaṃ raktajā ca’ iti pā. sādhyaṃ ca||5||

div.ab: vistīrṇaṃ mṛdu bahalaṃ yakṛtprakāśaṃ śyāvaṃ vā tadadhikamāṃsajārma vidyāt |6|
vistīrṇamiti| bahalaṃ sthūlam| etat sannipātajaṃ sādhyaṃ ca|6|-

ab.seg: śukle yat piśitamupaiti vṛddhimetat snāyvarmetyabhipaṭhitaṃ kharaṃ prapāṇḍu ||6||
śukle ityādi| etattridoṣajamapi sādhyam| kharaṃ kharasparśam| ‘snāyvābhaṃ piśitāṃśamupaiti yattu snāyvarma’ ityapi pāṭhaḥ| ‘kharaṃ ca śuklaṃ’ iti kecit paṭhanti||6||

div.ab: śyāvāḥ syuḥ piśitanibhāśca bindavo ye śuktyābhāḥ sitanayane sa śuktisañjñaḥ |7|
śyāvā ityādi| śuktyābhā iti jalaśuktiriva kiñjiddīrghāḥ śuklamaṇḍale ye bindavaḥ sa śuktikāvikāra iti sambandhaḥ| sādhyo'yaṃ pittajaśca|7|-

ab.seg: eko yaḥ śaśarudhiropamastu binduḥ śuklastho bhavati tamarjunaṃ vadanti ||7||
eka ityādi| raktajo'yaṃ sādhyaśca||7||

div.ab: utsannaḥ salilanibho'tha piṣṭaśuklo binduryo bhavati sa piṣṭakaḥ suvṛttaḥ |8|
utsanna ityādi| piṣṭaśuklaḥ taṇḍulapiṣṭavacchuklaḥ, śuklatve'pyacchatvāt salilanibhaḥ, piṣṭakaḥ piṣṭakanāmā| ayaṃ ślaiṣmikaḥ sādhyaśca|8|-

ab.seg: jālābhaḥ kaṭhinasiro mahān saraktaḥ santānaḥ smṛta iha jālasañjñitastu ||8||
jālābha ityādi| anulomavilomavistṛtasirānicayaviracitatvājjālasyeva ābhā yasya sa tathā| rakto lohito lohitajanitaśca, santānaḥ sirāsantānaḥ| eṣa sirājālasañjñito raktajaḥ sādhyaśca||8||

div.ab: śuklasthāḥ sitapiḍakāḥ sirāvṛtā yāstā vidyādasitasamīpajāḥ sirājāḥ |9|
śuklasthā ityādi| sirājāḥ ‘piḍakā’ iti śeṣaḥ| vāstusthitasirāvṛttatvāt sirājāḥ, na tu sākṣāt sirājāḥ| eṣa sannipātajaḥ sādhyaśca|9|-

ab.seg: kāṃsyābho `kāṃsyābho bhavati sirāvṛtaḥ site yo bindurvā sa tu nirujo balāsakākhyaḥ’ iti pā. bhavati site'mbubindutulyaḥ sa jñeyo'mṛdurarujo balāsakākhyaḥ ||9||

kāṃsyābha ityādi| kāṃsyasyeva ābhā yasya sa tathā, sita ityarthaḥ| ambubindutulyaḥ vāribindurivodgatvāt| amṛduḥ kaṭhinaḥ| arujaḥ avyathaḥ| etaddvayamapi kaphajanitatvāt `kaphānilajanitatvāt’ iti pā. nāmānvayena balāsanāmā vikāro balāsaja eva| atraiva videhaḥ,- “mārutotpīḍitaḥ śleṣmā śuklabhāge vyavasthitaḥ| jalabindurivocchūno mṛduḥ kaphasamudbhavaḥ”- iti| pustakāntare cānyathā pāṭhaḥ, yathā- ‘santāno bhavati sirāvṛtaḥ site yo bindurvā sa tu nirujo balāsakākhyaḥ’- iti| īdṛśasya pāṭhasya ṭīkākārā vyākhyāṃ na kurvanti| sādhyo'yaṃ śleṣmajaśca||9||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantre śuklagatarogavijñānīyo nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ ||4||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre caturtho'dhyāyaḥ||4||

div.head: kṛṣṇagatarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ kṛṣṇagatarogavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
śuklagatarogavijñānīyānantaraṃ pratyāsattyā kṛṣṇamaṇḍalagatā rogāḥ pratipādyā ityāta āha- athāta ityādi||1-2||
yat savraṇaṃ śukra(kla)mathāvraṇaṃ vā pākātyayaścāpyajakā tathaiva | catvāra ete'bhihitā vikārāḥ kṛṣṇāśrayāḥ saṅgrahataḥ purastāt ||3||
tāneva kṛṣṇagatarogānnāmabhiḥ prāha- yadityādi| saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva catuḥsaṅkhyāyāṃ labdhāyāṃ catuḥsaṅkhyākaraṇaṃ tantrāntaroddiṣṭātiriktasaṅkhyānirāsārtham| saṅgrahataḥ samyagupādānataḥ||3||
nimagnarūpaṃ hi bhavettu kṛṣṇe sūcyeva viddhaṃ pratibhāti yadvai `yacca’ iti pā.| srāvaṃ sraveduṣṇamatīva ruk ca tat savraṇaṃ śukra(kla)mudāharanti ||4||

tāneva lakṣaṇairnirdiśannāha- nimagnetyādi| nimagnarūpam antaḥpraviṣṭarūpam, īṣaddṛśyarūpamityarthaḥ| sūcyeva viddhamityanena vartulatvaṃ darśitaṃ, raktasyāgneyatvāduṣṇāśrutā atyarthaṃ ca pīḍā bhavati| avraṇaśukle mandarugaśrutā vakṣyate, tasmādasmin sakṣate śukre kṣatayogānnetrasya sukumāratvāccātīva vedanā yuktā| atra videhaḥ- “raktarājīnibhaṃ kṛṣṇe vidrumābhaṃ pralakṣyate| sūcyagreṇaiva tacchukramuṣṇāśrusrāvi savraṇam”- iti| savraṇaṃ sakṣatamityarthaḥ| raktajamidamasādhyaṃ ca||4||
dṛṣṭeḥ samīpe na bhavettu yacca na cāvagāḍhaṃ na ca saṃsraveddhi | avedanāvanna ca yugmaśukraṃ tatsiddhimāpnoti kadācideva ||5||
idānīṃ tasyaivāvasthādvāreṇa kādāciktaṃ sādhyatvaṃ darśayannāha- dṛṣṭerityādi| saṃsraveddhītyatra saṃśabdo'tiśayārthaḥ| avedanāvat mandavedanam||5||
vicchinnamadhyaṃ piśitāvṛtaṃ vā calaṃ sirāsaktamadṛṣṭikṛcca ‘sirāsūkṣmaṃ’ iti pā.| dvitvaggataṃ lohitamantataśca cirotthitaṃ cāpi vivarjanīyam ||6||
uṣṇāśrupātaḥ piḍakā ca kṛṣṇe yasmin bhavenmudganibhaṃ ca śukram | tadapyasādhyaṃ pravadanti kecidanyacca yattittiripakṣatulyam ||7||

tasyaiva kadācitsādhyasya lakṣaṇaṃ pratipādyāsādhyasya lakṣaṇaṃ pratipādayannāha- vicchinnetyādi| vicchinnamadhyamiti vidīrṇamāṃsatvānmadhye sacchidramiva| pakṣāntaramāha- piśitāvṛtaṃ veti, ācchinnamadhyamevonnatamāṃsena veṣṭitaṃ vā| calaṃ sirāsaktamiti yataḥ sirāsaktamata eva calaṃ, sirā hi svabhāvata eva calāḥ; tadāśritaṃ śukramapi calameva; anye tu calaṃ caladiva na tu sākṣāccalameva| adṛṣṭikṛt darśanarodhakṛt| dvitvāggataṃ dvipaṭalāśritam| lohitamantataśceti prānteṣu lohitamityarthaḥ| idānīṃ dvipaṭalāśritasya lakṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha- uṣṇetyādi| kasmiṃścit pustake ‘piḍakā ca pītā’ iti pāṭhaḥ, sa na saṅgacchate ‘tacca saṅgacchate’ iti pā.| tathā ca videhaḥ- “coṣoṣṇasrāvadāhāstu kṛṣṇe ca piḍikodgamaḥ| vyaktamudgaphalākāraṃ śukraṃ dvitvaggataṃ bhavet” iti| ekīyamatamāha- tadityādi| yaccānyacchukraṃ tittiripakṣatulyaṃ tadapyasādhyaṃ kecidvadantīti sambandhaḥ| etat paramatamapyapratiṣiddhatvādanumatameva||6-7||
sitaṃ yadā bhātyasitapradeśe syandātmakaṃ nātirugaśruyuktam | vihāyasīvācchaghanānukāri ‘abhradalānukāri’iti pā. tadavraṇaṃ sādhyatamaṃ vadanti ||8||

idānīṃ savraṇaṃ śukraṃ pratipādyāvraṇaṃ pratipādayannāha- sitamityādi| syandātmakam abhiṣyandakāraṇaṃ vihāyasīva ākāśa iva, acchaghanānukāri pratanumeghakhaṇḍānukārītyarthaḥ| raktajamidaṃ sādhyaṃ ca||8||

div.ab: gambhīrajātaṃ bahalaṃ ca śukraṃ cirotthitaṃ cāpi vadanti kṛcchram |9|

asyaivāvraṇasya śukrasyāvasthābhedena kṛcchratāṃ darśayannāha- gambhīretyādi| evambhūtamavraṇamapi śukraṃ kṛcchraṃ vadantīti sambandhaḥ| gambhīrajātaṃ dvipaṭalāśritamityarthaḥ| jejjaṭācāryastu savraṇāvraṇaśukrasya lakṣaṇaṃ sādhyāsādhyatvaṃ ca viparītakrameṇa paṭhati, mayā tu pañjikākārābhiprāyeṇānenaiva krameṇa paṭhitam|9|-

sañcchādyate `śvetaḥ samākrāmati sarvato hi’ iti pā. śvetanibhena sarvaṃ doṣeṇa yasyāsitamaṇḍalaṃ tu ||9|| tamakṣipākātyayamakṣikopasamutthitaṃ `... makṣirogaṃ sarvātmakaṃ varjayitavyamāhuḥ’ iti pā. tīvrarujaṃ vadanti |10|
idānīṃ pākātyayamāha- sañcchādyata ityādi| akṣikopāt samutthitaṃ syandādutpannamityarthaḥ| eṣa tridoṣajo'sādhyaśca||9||-

ab.seg: ajāpurīṣapratimo rujāvān salohito lohitapicchilāśruḥ | vidārya kṛṣṇaṃ pracayo'bhyupaiti taṃ cājakājātamiti vyavasyet ||10||
ajetyādi| ajāpurīṣapratima iti viśuṣkacchagalīpurīṣatulyaḥ| salohita īṣallohitaḥ| lohitapicchilāśruriti lohitaṃ picchilaṃ cāśru yasya saḥ| pracayaḥ sāmarthyānmedasaḥ| eṣa śleṣmajo'sādhyaśca||10||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantre kṛṣṇagatarogavijñānīyo nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ ||5||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ||5||

div.head: sarvagatarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ sarvagatarogavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

athāta ityādi| sarvagatarogavijñānīyaḥ sarvāśrayarogavijñānīya ityarthaḥ| kṛṣṇamaṇḍalapratyāsattyā dṛṣṭigatarogavijñānīyo yujyate, yaśca dṛṣṭigatarogavijñānīyāt pūrvaṃ sarvagatarogavijñānīyārambhaḥ sa dṛṣṭigatānāṃ timirādīnāmabhiṣyandanimittatvaṃ na syāditi bodhayati, sandhyādigatānāṃ ca syandakāraṇatvaṃ bodhayati||1-2||
syandāstu catvāra ihopadiṣṭāstāvanta eveha tathā'dhimanthāḥ | śophānvito'śophayutaśca pākāvityevamete daśa sampradiṣṭāḥ ||3||
hatādhimantho'nilaparyayaśca śuṣkākṣipāko'nyata eva vātaḥ | dṛṣṭistathā'mlādhyuṣitā sirāṇāmutpātaharṣāvapi sarvabhāgāḥ ||4||
sarvākṣigatarogāṇāṃ saṅkhyāmāha- syandā ityādi| tāvanta eva catvāra eva| prathamaślokena daśa, dvitīyaślokena sapta, evaṃ saptadaśa sarvāśrayāḥ kathitāḥ||3-4||
prāyeṇa sarve nayanāmayāstu bhavantyabhiṣyandanimittamūlāḥ | tasmādabhiṣyandamudīryamāṇamupācaredāśu hitāya dhīmān ||5||

sarveṣāṃ netrarogāṇāmabhiṣyandabhavatvāt tatpratīkārasyāśeṣanayanāmayapratīkārabhūtatvādyatnataḥ pūrvarūpa evāsau pratikaraṇīya ityāha- prāyeṇetyādi| abhiṣyandanimittamūlā iti abhiṣyandāśca tannimittāni ca tānyeva mūlaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathā| nimittaśabdādduṣṭā doṣā doṣakopanāni ca saṅgṛhyante| udīryamāṇam utpadyamānam| ‘abhiṣyandanimittamūlā’ ityatra ‘abhiṣyandasamudbhavā hi’ iti kecit paṭhanti||5||
nistodanaṃ stambhanaromaharṣasaṅgharṣapāruṣyaśirobhitāpāḥ | viśuṣkabhāvaḥ śiśirāśrutā ca vātābhipanne nayane bhavanti ||6||

idānīṃ vātābhiṣyandalakṣaṇamāha- nistodanamityādi| nistodanaṃ sūcyeva vyadhanam| stambhanaṃ stabdhatā| saṅgharṣaḥ karakarimā| śirobhitāpaḥ śirovyathā| ‘viśuṣkabhāvaḥ śiśirāśrutā ca’ ityatra ‘śuṣkālpadūṣikahimāśrutā ca’ iti kecit paṭhanti| tatra dūṣikā netramalam| sādhyo'yam||6||
dāhaprapākau śiśirābhinandā dhūmāyanaṃ bāṣpasamucchrayaśca | uṣṇāśrutā pītakanetratā ca pittābhipanne nayane bhavanti ||7||
pittābhiṣyandalakṣaṇamāha- dāhetyādi| śiśirābhinandā śītābhilāṣaḥ| dhūmāyanaṃ dhūmasyevodvamanaṃ, bāṣpasamucchrayaḥ aśrubāhulyam| ayamapi sādhyaḥ||7||
uṣṇābhinandā gurutā'kṣiśophaḥ kaṇḍūpadehau sitatā'tiśaityam | srāvo muhuḥ picchila eva cāpi kaphābhipanne nayane bhavanti ||8||
śleṣmābhiṣyandalakṣaṇamāha- uṣṇetyādi| upadeho malopaliptatā, sitatā śuklatā; eṣo'pi sādhyaḥ||8||
tāmrāśrutā lohitanetratā ca rājyaḥ samantādatilohitāśca | pittasya liṅgāni ca yāni tāni raktābhipanne nayane bhavanti ||9||
raktābhiṣyandamāha- tāmretyādi| asāvapi sādhyaḥ||9||
vṛddhairetairabhiṣyandairnarāṇāmakriyāvatām | tāvantastvadhimanthāḥ syurnayane tīvravedanāḥ ||10||

adhimanthānāmabhiṣyandarogakṛtatvaṃ darśayannāha- vṛddhairityādi| tāvantaḥ catvāra eva| tīvravedanā ityatra vedanāśabdaḥ sāmānyapīḍāvacanaḥ| tena yathāsvaṃ vātādidoṣavedanāyuktā ityarthaḥ; etenedamuktaṃ bhavati- vātikādabhiṣyandādvātika evādhimanthastīvravātikanistodādisakalavedano bhavati; evaṃ paittikaḥ, ślaiṣmiko, raktotthitaśceti||10||
utpāṭyata ivātyarthaṃ netraṃ nirmathyate tathā | śiraso'rdhaṃ ca taṃ vidyādadhimanthaṃ svalakṣaṇaiḥ ||11||

adhimanthānāṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇamāha- utpāṭyata ityādi| netraṃ nirmathyate tatheti na kevalaṃ netrameva nirmathyate śiraso'rdhaṃ ca tathā nirmathyata iti, ardhaśiraso vedanā ca vyādhisvabhāvāt| svalakṣaṇairvātādīnāṃ svakīyairlakṣaṇaiḥ| kecidatrādhimanthānāṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ na paṭhanti, pañjikāyāṃ paṭhitatvādasmābhiḥ paṭhitam||11||
netramutpāṭyata iva mathyate'raṇivacca yat | saṅgharṣatodanirbhedamāṃsasaṃrabdhamāvilam ||12||
kuñcanāsphoṭanādhmānavepathuvyathanairyutam | śiraso'rdhaṃ ca yena syādadhimanthaḥ sa mārutāt ||13||

adhimanthānāṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇamuktvā vistareṇa viśeṣalakṣaṇamāha- netramityādi| saṅgharṣaḥ karakarimā| anye tu ‘saṃharṣa’ iti paṭhanti, tatra saṃharṣo romāñcaprāyo vedanāviśeṣaḥ| todaḥ sūcīvyadhanamiva vedanā| nirbhedaḥ śastreṇa vidāraṇamiva| māṃsasaṃrabdhaṃ māṃsopacitamityarthaḥ| āvilaṃ samalam| eṣa sādhyaḥ||12-13||
raktarājicitaṃ srāvi vahninevāvadahyate | yakṛtpiṇḍopamaṃ dāhi kṣāreṇāktamiva kṣatam ||14||
prapakvocchūnavartmāntaṃ sasvedaṃ pītadarśanam | mūrcchāśirodāhayutaṃ pittenākṣyadhimanthitam ||15||
pittādhimanthalakṣaṇamāha- raktarājītyādi| dāhi kṣāreṇāktamiva kṣatamiti kṣāraliptakṣatamiva dahanaśīlam| eṣa vyādhiḥ sādhyaḥ||14-15||
śophavannātisaṃrabdhaṃ srāvakaṇḍūsamanvitam | śaityagauravapaicchilyadūṣikāharṣaṇānvitam ||16||
rūpaṃ paśyati duḥkhena pāṃśupūrṇamivāvilam | nāsādhmānaśiroduḥkhayutaṃ śleṣmādhimanthitam ||17||
śleṣmādhimanthalakṣaṇamāha- śophavadityādi| dūṣikā netramalam| ayamapi rogaḥ sādhyaḥ||16-17||
bandhujīvapratīkāśaṃ tāmyati sparśanākṣamam | raktāsrāvaṃ sanistodaṃ paśyatyagninibhā diśaḥ ||18||
raktamagnāriṣṭavacca kṛṣṇabhāgaśca lakṣyate | yaddīptaṃ raktaparyantaṃ tadraktenādhimanthitam ||19||
raktādhimanthalakṣaṇamāha- bandhujīvetyādi| bandhujīvo madhyāhnapuṣpakaḥ, ariṣṭakaṃ kṛṣṇaphalaṃ ‘arīṭhā’ iti loke| asāvapi sādhyaḥ||18-19||
hanyāddṛṣṭiṃ saptarātrāt kaphottho'dhīmantho'sṛksambhavaḥ pañcarātrāt | ṣaḍrātrādvai mārutottho nihānyānmithyācārāt paittikaḥ sadya eva ||20||

idānīṃ vātādyadhimanthānāṃ samyagupacārasādhyānāṃ vaidyāturayoryatnādhānārthaṃ mithyācārāddṛṣṭivināśāvadhiṃ yathādoṣaṃ nirdiśannāha- hanyādityādi| mithyācārāditi padaṃ śleṣmodbhavādyadhimantheṣu sarveṣvapi sambadhyate| dṛṣṭināśakālāvadhirapyatra vyādhisvabhāvāt||20||
kaṇḍūpadehāśruyutaḥ pakvodumbarasannibhaḥ | dāhasaṃharṣatāmratvaśophanistodagauravaiḥ ||21||
juṣṭo muhuḥ sraveccāsramuṣṇaśītāmbu picchilam | saṃrambhī pacyate yaśca netrapākaḥ saśophajaḥ ||22||
saśophapākamāha- kaṇḍvityādi| saṃrambhī śophayuktaḥ||21-22||

div.ab: śophahīnāni liṅgāni netrapāke tvaśophaje |23|
aśophapākamāha- śophetyādi| liṅgāni saśophapākaliṅgānītyarthaḥ| ubhāvapi pākau tridoṣajau sādhyau ca|23|-

ab.seg: upekṣaṇādakṣi yadā'dhimantho vātātmakaḥ sādayati prasahya | rujābhirugrābhirasādhya eṣa hatādhimanthaḥ khalu nāma rogaḥ ||23||
sakalanayanaśoṣalakṣaṇaṃ hatādhimanthaṃ darśayannāha- upekṣaṇādityādi| sādayati avasādayati, śoṣayatītyarthaḥ||23||
antaḥsirāṇāṃ śvasanaḥ sthito dṛṣṭiṃ pratikṣipan | hatādhimanthaṃ janayettamasādhyaṃ vidurbudhāḥ ||24||

dṛṣṭinirgamalakṣaṇaṃ hatādhimanthaṃ darśayannāha- antaḥsirāṇāmityādi| pratikṣipan niṣkāsayannityarthaḥ| yadyapi hatādhimanthalakṣaṇadvitvaṃ jñāyate tathā'pyeka eva, ato na saṅkhyātirekaḥ| jejjaṭācāryastu nayanaśoṣalakṣaṇahatādhimanthasya pāṭhaṃ na paṭhati, dṛṣṭinirgamalakṣaṇasya hatādhimanthasya pāṭhaṃ paṭhati, pañjikākāreṇa ca videhoktaṃ prakāradvayena hatādhimanthalakṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā nyūnatādoṣabhayāt pāṭhadvayamapi paṭhitam| tathā ca videhaḥ- “antargataḥ sirāṇāṃ tu yadā tiṣṭhati mārutaḥ| sa tadā nayanaṃ prāpya śīghraṃ dṛṣṭiṃ nirasyati|| tasyāṃ nirasyamānāyāṃ nirmathnanniva mārutaḥ| nayanaṃ nirvamatyāśu śūlatodādhimanthanaiḥ|| athavā śoṣayedakṣi kṣīṇatejobalānalam| utpadmamiva saṃśuṣkamavasīdati locanam|| hatādhimanthaṃ taṃ vidyādasādhyaṃ vātakopataḥ”- iti||24||
pakṣmadvayākṣibhruvamāśritastu yatrānilaḥ sañcarati praduṣṭaḥ | paryāyaśaścāpi rujaḥ karoti taṃ vātaparyāyamudāharanti ||25||
vātaparyāyamāha- pakṣmetyādi| akṣi locanaṃ, bhrūḥ prasiddhā| paryāyaśaścāpi rujaḥ karoti kadācit pakṣmadvaye, kadācidakṣiṇi, kadācidbhruvīti paryāyaśabdārthaḥ| sādhyo'yam||25||
yat kūṇitaṃ dāruṇarūkṣavartma vilokane cāviladarśanaṃ yat | sudāruṇaṃ yat pratibodhane ca śuṣkākṣipākopahataṃ tadakṣi ||26||

śuṣkākṣipākamāha- yadityādi| kūṇitaṃ nimīlitaṃ, dāruṇaṃ kaṭhinaṃ rūkṣaṃ vartma yasya tattathā| vilokane cāviladarśanamiti yadatidarśane ākuladarśanamityarthaḥ| sudāruṇaṃ yat pratibodhane ceti pratibodhane unmeṣe ca yadatiśayena kaṭhinaṃ; anye sudāruṇaṃ kṛcchronmīlanam| vātiko'yaṃ sādhyaśca||26||
yasyāvaṭūkarṇaśirohanustho manyāgato vā'pyanilo'nyato vā | kuryādrujo'ti bhruvi locane vā tamanyatovātamudāharanti ||27||

anyatovātamāha- yasyetyādi| avaṭuḥ grīvāyāḥ paścimo bhāgaḥ| manyā grīvāyāḥ pārśvayoḥ sirāviśeṣaḥ| anyato veti pṛṣṭhato vetyarthaḥ| anyatovāta iti yathārtheyaṃ sañjñā, yato'nyataḥ sthito vāyuranyato vedanāṃ karoti| vātiko'yaṃ sādhyaśca||27||
amlena bhuktena vidāhinā ca sañchādyate sarvata eva netram | śophānvitaṃ lohitakaiḥ sanīlairetādṛgamlādhyuṣitaṃ vadanti ||28||

amlādhyuṣitamāha- amlenetyādi| vidāhinā veti kaṭukena lavaṇena vetyarthaḥ| lohitakai rāgairityarthaḥ| sanīlaiḥ īṣannīlaiḥ| etādṛk īdṛśamityarthaḥ| amlādhyuṣitam amlajanitapittādhyuṣitam| eṣa rogaḥ paittikaḥ sādhyaśca||28||
avedanā vā'pi savedanā vā yasyākṣirājyo hi bhavanti tāmrāḥ | muhurvirajyanti ca tāḥ samantād vyādhiḥ sirotpāta iti pradiṣṭaḥ ||29||
sirotpātamāha- avedanetyādi| virajyanti viraktā bhavanti prakṛtavarṇā bhavantītyarthaḥ `viśeṣaraktavarṇā bhavantītyarthaḥ’ iti śrīkaṇṭhadattaḥ| raktajo'yaṃ sādhyaśca||29||
mohāt sirotpāta upekṣitastu jāyeta rogastu sirāpraharṣaḥ | tāmrācchamasraṃ `tāmrābhamasraṃ’ iti pā. sravati pragāḍhaṃ tathā na śaknotyabhivīkṣituṃ ca ||30||
sirāharṣamāha- mohādityādi| ayamapi raktajaḥ sādhyaśca||30||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantre sarvagatarogavijñānīyo nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ ||6||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargataśālākyatantre ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ||6||

div.head: dṛṣṭigatarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto dṛṣṭigatarogavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
sarvagatarogavijñānīyānantaraṃ dṛṣṭigatarogāṇāṃ pāriśeṣyādārambho yukta ityata āha- athāta ityādi||1-2||
masūradalamātrāṃ tu pañcabhūtaprasādajām | khadyotavisphuliṅgābhāmiddhāṃ `siddhāṃ iti pā. tejobhiravyayaiḥ ||3||
āvṛtāṃ paṭalenākṣṇorbāhyena vivarākṛtim | śītasātmyāṃ nṛṇāṃ dṛṣṭimāhurnayanacintakāḥ ||4||

tāṃ ca dṛṣṭiṃ cikitsārthaṃ pramāṇākārasvalakṣaṇairnirdiśannāha- masūretyādi| masūradalamātrāmiti masūradalapramāṇāmityarthaḥ| pañcabhūtaprasādajāmiti pañcabhūtānāṃ dhāmabhūtāt sārājjātāmityarthaḥ| pañcabhūtamadhye ekasya prādhānyamāha- iddhāṃ tejobhiravyayairiti; etena tejomayī dṛṣṭirityuktam| khadyotavisphuliṅgābhāmiti khadyoto jyotiriṅgaṇaḥ, visphuliṅgaḥ sukṣmo'gnikaṇaḥ; khadyotavisphuliṅgau taijasāvapi yathā na dahatastathā dṛṣṭirapi na dahati| yadi sā khadyotādisadṛśī tarhi divākaraprakāśādrūpagrahaṇena na bhavitavyamityāha- avyayairiti|- avyayaiḥ upacayāpacayarahitaistejobhirviśiṣṭā| tasya dṛṣṭeḥ kuto bhāsvaratā na dṛśyata ityāha- āvṛtāṃ paṭalenākṣṇorbāhyeneti; āvṛtām ācchāditāṃ, bāhyena tejo jalāśritena| yadyapi bāhyapaṭalāvṛtatvāddṛṣṭe `duṣṭigatabāhyapaṭalāvṛtatvāt’ iti pā. rūpagrahaṇasāmarthyopaghātaḥ prāptaḥ, tathā'pi paṭalasyātyantācchatvāddromakūpavivarāntaratvācca `romakūpavivarāntargatatvācca’ iti pā. tejaḥparamāṇūnāṃ bahiścaratve `bahiḥśarārutve’ iti pā. rūpagrahaṇasāmarthyaṃ dṛṣṭernopahanyata ityāha- vivarākṛtimiti|- vivaraṃ chidraṃ tasyevākṛtiryasyāḥ sā tathā tāṃ, na tu sākṣāttatra chidramasti| vivarākāravacanena punarmṛdutaivoktā, na punaḥ sarvathā śuṣiratvaṃ; tathā ca sati `tadā hi’ iti pā. paṭalānāṃ pratipāditānāmapyanupapattiḥ syāt| dṛṣṭeḥ paṭalacatuṣṭaye'pi rūpagrahaṇasāmarthyamanumātavyaṃ, kālakāsthyāśritābhyantarapaṭalamapi gate doṣe rūpagrahaṇavikṛtilakṣaṇasya timirasyokteḥ| śītasātmyāmiti| nanu śītena tejo'bhihanyate tat kathaṃ śītena sātmyaṃ? ucyate- pṛthagvyavasthitayorjalāgnyorvirodho, na punaḥ sahotpannayorekakāryayoḥ; prabhāvādvā jalāntargatamapyetattejo nopahanyate||3-4||
rogāṃstadāśrayān ghorān ṣaṭ ca ṣaṭ ca pracakṣmahe | paṭalānupraviṣṭasya timirasya ca lakṣaṇam ||5||

pramāṇādibhiścikitsopayogibhirdṛṣṭimabhidhāya tadāśrayarogopavarṇanārthaṃ paṭalacatuṣṭayapraviṣṭatimiralakṣaṇopadeśārthaṃ ca pratipādayannāha- rogānityādi| tadāśrayān dṛṣṭyāśrayānityarthaḥ| ṣaṭ ca ṣaṭ ceti dvādaśetyarthaḥ||5||

div.ab: sirābhirabhisamprāpya vigu'bhyantare bhṛśam | prathame paṭale doṣo yasya dṛṣṭau vyavasthitaḥ ||6|| avyaktāni sa rūpāṇi sarvāṇyeva prapaśyati |7|

prathamapaṭalagatasya timirārambhakadoṣasya samprāptileśapūrvakaṃ lakṣaṇamāha- sirābhirityādi| abhisamprāpya samyaggatvā| viguṇo duṣṭaḥ| abhyantare sarvābhyantare kālakāsthyāśrite prathamapaṭale| sa puruṣaḥ| ‘sarvāṇyeva prapaśyati’ ityatra ‘kadācidatha paśyati’ iti pañjikākāraḥ paṭhati vyākhyānayati ca- kadācinna sarvakālam| etena sthānaviśeṣāddoṣasyālpabalavattoktā, taduttareṣu kramāt balavattvamiti| tānyavyaktarūpāṇyapi vakṣyamāṇarūpabhramaṇāruṇavarṇādiyuktāni vātena, tathā pittenādityakhadyotādīni nīlapītavarṇāni, evaṃ kaphena sitavarṇāni, raktena raktavarṇāni, sannipātena vicitrāṇi| evaṃ dvitīyādipaṭaleṣvapi vyākhyeyam||6||-

ab.seg: dṛṣṭirbhṛśaṃ vihvalati dvitīyaṃ paṭalaṃ gate ||7||
makṣikā maśakān keśāñjālakāni ca paśyati | maṇḍalāni patākāṃśca marīcīḥ kuṇḍalāni ca ||8||
pariplavāṃśca `paripūrvāśca’ iti pā. vividhān varṣamabhraṃ tamāṃsi ca | dūrasthānyapi rūpāṇi manyate ca samīpataḥ ||9||
samīpasthāni dūre ca dṛṣṭergocaravibhramāt | yatnavānapi cātyarthaṃ sūcīpāśaṃ na paśyati ||10||

dvitīyapaṭalagatadoṣalakṣaṇamāha- dṛṣṭirityādi| dvitīyaṃ paṭalaṃ medaḥśritam| bhṛśamiti yādṛśī prathame paṭale tato'dhikaṃ vihvalībhavati| vihvalatvamāha- makṣikā maśakānityādi| makṣikādīnāmabhāve'pi timirārambhakadvitīyapaṭalāśritadoṣaprabhāveṇa makṣikādīni yathādoṣavarṇāni paśyati| jālakāni jantulālāviracitajālakākārāṇi, maṇḍalāni vartularūpāṇi| patākāḥ dhvajān| marīcīḥ mṛgatṛṣṇāḥ| kuṇḍalāni karṇakuṇḍalāni| pariplavāṃśceti nakṣatrādīnāṃ gatīḥ| vividhān ūrdhvādhastiryaggamanena kṛṣṇapītaśuklavarṇadarśanena vā nānāprakārān| varṣaṃ vṛṣṭim| asadrūpagrahaṇe vihvalatvaṃ pratipādya sadrūpagrahaṇe'pi deśāparijñāne dṛśorvihvalatvaṃ pratipādayannāha- dūrasthānītyādi| gocaravibhramāt indriyārthavibhramāt||7-10||

div.ab: ūrdhvaṃ paśyati nādhastāttṛtīyaṃ paṭalaṃ gate | mahāntyapi ca rūpāṇi cchāditānīva vāsasā ||11|| karṇanāsākṣiyuktāni viparītāni vīkṣate `cekṣate’ iti pā.| yathādoṣaṃ ca rajyeta dṛṣṭirdoṣe balīyasi ||12|| adhaḥsthite samīpasthaṃ dūrasthaṃ coparisthite | pārśvasthite tathā doṣe pārśvasthāni na paśyati ||13|| samantataḥ sthite doṣe saṅkulānīva `saṅkulāni ca’ iti pā. paśyati | dṛṣṭimadhyagate doṣe sa ekaṃ manyate dvidhā ||14|| dvidhāsthite tridhā paśyedbahudhā cānavasthite | timirākhyaḥ sa vai doṣaḥ... |15|

tṛtīyapaṭalagatadoṣalakṣaṇamāha- ūrdhvamityādi| tṛtīyaṃ paṭalaṃ māṃsāśritam| ūrdhvaṃ paśyatīti ālokasahāyatvena dṛśa ūrdhvamupalambho nādhastāt| viparītāni karṇādihīnāni| yathādoṣaṃ ceti sāmarthyānmāṃsasthitaśoṇitasahāyena `māṃsasthitaśoṇitasahāyabalavattare doṣe’ iti pā. balavattaradoṣeṇa dṛṣṭau rāga utpadyata ityarthaḥ| ata eva prathamadvitīyapaṭalayoḥ śoṇitābhāvādrāgābhāvaḥ| adhaḥsthite dṛṣṭimaṇḍalādhobhāgasthite doṣe ityarthaḥ| saṅkulānīveti miśrībhūtānīva vasturūpāṇi paśyati| dvidhā sthite ‘doṣe’ iti śeṣaḥ| anavasthite cañcale doṣe| timirākhyaḥ timirasañjñaḥ, rāgaprāptasya ca timirasya ‘kāca’ iti sañjñā||11-14||-

ab.seg: ... caturthaṃ paṭalaṃ gataḥ ||15||
ruṇaddhi sarvato dṛṣṭiṃ liṅganāśaḥ sa ucyate | tasminnapi tamobhūte nātirūḍhe mahāgade ||16||
candrādityau sanakṣatrāvantarīkṣe ca vidyutaḥ | nirmalāni ca tejāṃsi bhrājiṣṇūni `bhrājiṣṇūnīva paśyati’ iti pā. ca paśyati ||17||

caturthapaṭalagatadoṣalakṣaṇamāha- sa ityādi| sa eva timirākhyaḥ, caturthaṃ paṭalaṃ tejojalāśritaṃ prāpto yadā sarvato dṛṣṭiṃ ruṇaddhi tadā liṅganāśa ucyata iti sambandhaḥ| liṅganāśa iti liṅgaṃ cakṣurindriyaśaktiḥ, tasya nāśo yasmin sa liṅganāśo doṣaḥ| tatrāpyalpeṣu doṣeṣu keṣāñcidvastuviśeṣāṇāmupalambho bhavatīti darśayannāha- tasminniti| tasmin liṅganāśe| tamobhūte iti atra bhūtaśabda upamāne| nātiruḍhe nātivṛddhe| mahāgade pradhānendriyatirobhāvakatvāt| nirmalāni ca tejāṃsi agnyādīni, bhrājiṣṇūni anyānyapi dīptimanti yāni vastūni tāni paśyatītyarthaḥ||15-17||

div.ab: sa eva liṅganāśastu nīlikākācasañjñitaḥ |18|

tasyaiva liṅganāśasyāparaṃ sañjñādvayaṃ pratipādayannāha- sa evetyādi| nīlikāviśeṣitā kācasañjñā sañjātā yasya sa tathā| kācasañjñā ca tṛtīye'pi paṭale rāgitimirasya rāgotpattidvāreṇa sūcitā| etena kācatvāt paṭaladvayagatayorapi doṣayoḥ ṣaṭtvaṃ na tu dvādaśatvam| asyāgre kicit ‘yanmayastanmayāni’ ityādipāṭhamāpātanikāpūrvakaṃ paṭhanti, sa cābhāvānna likhitaḥ|18|-
tatra vātena rūpāṇi bhramantīva sa paśyati ||18|| āvilānyaruṇābhāni vyāviddhāni ca mānavaḥ |19|
idānīṃ teṣu paṭaleṣu krameṇa vātādideṣārabdhasya timirasya liṅgāni darśayannāha- vātenetyādi| āvilāni samalāni, aruṇābhāni īṣadraktāni| vyāviddhāni vakrāṇi||18||-
pittenādityakhadyotaśakracāpataḍidguṇān ||19|| śikhibarhavicitrāṇi nīlakṛṣṇāni paśyati |20|
pittajatimiralakṣaṇamāha- pittenetyādi| khadyoto jyotiriṅgaṇaḥ| śakracāpam indradhanuḥ, taḍidguṇo vidyullatā, śikhibarhaḥ mayūrapicchaḥ||19||-
kaphena paśyedrūpāṇi snigdhāni ca sitāni ca ||20|| gauracāmaragaurāṇi śvetābhrapratimāni ca | paśyedasūkṣmāṇyatyarthaṃ vyabhre caivābhrasamplavam ||21|| salilaplāvitānīva parijāḍyāni mānavaḥ |22|

śleṣmajatimiralakṣaṇamāha- kaphenetyādi| gauracāmaragaurāṇīti śvetacāmaravacchuklāni| sitāni ceti sudhautaśuklavastrasadṛśāni| asūkṣmāṇi sthūlāni| vyabhre vigataghane `megharahite’ iti pā.| abhrasamplavaṃ meghānāṃ sarvato gamanam| salilaplāvitānīva parijāḍyānīti sarvataḥ salilaplavaneneva śuklāni stimitāni ca rūpāṇi paśyati||20-21||-
tathā raktena raktāni tamāṃsi vividhāni ca ||22|| haritaśyāvakṛṣṇāni dhūmadhūmrāṇi cekṣate |23|
raktajatimiralakṣaṇamāha- tathetyādi| dhūmadhūmrāṇi dhūmaveṣṭitānīva| yadyapi timirasya raktāntargatadoṣajanyatvādraktajasañjñā na syāt, tathā'pi raktabāhulyādupacārādvā raktajavyapadeśaḥ||22||-

ab.seg: sannipātena citrāṇi viplutāni ca paśyati ||23||
bahudhā vā dvidhā vā'pi sarvāṇyeva samantataḥ | hīnādhikāṅgānyathavā jyotīṃṣyapi ca paśyati `mānavaḥ’ iti pā.||24||

sannipātajatimiralakṣaṇamāha- sannipātenetyādi| citrāṇi nānāvarṇāni viplutāni sarvato'vakīrṇāni| bahudhā bahutvaṃ gatāni, dvidhā dvitvaṃ gatāni, sarvāṇyeva yāvaddraṣṭavyāni rūpāṇi| hīnādhikāṅgānīti na kevalaṃ tṛtīye paṭale hīnādhikāṅgāni paśyati sannipātena punaḥ paṭalāntare'pi hīnādhikāṅgāni paśyati| jyotīṃṣi tārakāṇi||23-24||

div.ab: pittaṃ kuryāt parimlāyi mūrcchitaṃ raktatejasā | pītā diśastathodyantamādityamiva paśyati ||25|| vikīryamāṇān khadyotairvṛkṣāṃstejobhireva ca |26|

nanu vātapittakaphaśoṇitasannipātaiḥ pañcabhiḥ pañcatimirāṇāṃ cottarāvasthāsu kācaliṅganāśasañjñe kṛte, kācāśca ṣaṭ vyākhyeyā iti teṣāṃ ṣaṭtvopapattihetubhūtaṣaṣṭhaparimlāyitimirakathanāya, tathā parimlāyitimirākrāntasya puṃso yādṛśaṃ rūpagrahaṇaṃ bhavati tādṛgrūpakathanāya ca prāha- pittamityādi| mūrcchitaṃ saṃyuktaṃ, raktatejasā raktaprasādena; anye tu raktārthaṃ tejo raktatejaḥ, tena mūrcchitaṃ; etena raktārthaṃ pariṇamyamānarasena saṃyuktamityarthaḥ| īdṛśe ca vyākhyāne nāmānvayaḥ `nāmadvayaṃ’ iti pā. saṅgacchate| yathā parimlāyī kṣayī kathyate tathā ca vakṣyati,- ‘doṣakṣayāt kadācit syāt svayaṃ tatra ca darśanam’ iti, tacca kṣayitvaṃ laṅghanādibhirupabṛṃhakarasakṣayāt `upabṛṃhaṇakarabalakṣayāt pittakṣayāccopapadyate’ iti pā. pittakṣayāccopapadyate| raktajapakṣe raktakṣayopapattirnāsti| kecit ‘raktatejasā’ ityatra ‘bhaktatejasā’ iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- bhaktatejasā āhāraprasādena rasākhyenetyarthaḥ| atra sātyakiprabhṛtīnāṃ matānulomena raktamūrcchitaṃ pittaṃ hyapītyavagantavyam| tathā ca rāgakathanaprastāve sātyakiḥ- “pittaraktotthitā pītāścitritāḥ sannipātajāḥ”- iti| eka evāsau parimlāyī rogo'rāgaprāptaḥ san timirākhyaḥ, rāgaprāptastu kācākhyaḥ, sa eva kiñciddarśananāśakārī liṅganāśaḥ| sarvāṇyeva timirāṇi prathamadvitīyapaṭalagatāni sādhyāni; tṛtīyapaṭalagatāni rāgaprāptyā kācākhyāni bhavanti, tadā yāpyāni||25||-

ab.seg: vakṣyāmi ṣaḍvidhaṃ `ṣaḍvidhaiḥ’ iti pā. rāgairliṅganāśamataḥ param ||26||

tṛtīyarāgitimirasya kācākhyāṃ prāptasya liṅganāśasya ca rāgeṇaiva saṅkhyāṣaṭtvaṃ nirdiśannāha- vakṣyāmītyādi| ṣaḍvidhaṃ ṣaḍbhedabhinnam| tṛtīyapaṭalagataṃ kācākhyāṃ prāptaṃ timiramiti śeṣaḥ| rāgaiḥ vakṣyamaṇaiḥ aruṇādibhiḥ| liṅganāśamataḥ paramiti kācākhyatimirakathanānantaraṃ liṅganāśamapi ṣaḍvidhaṃ vakṣyāmi||26||
rāgo'ruṇo mārutajaḥ pradiṣṭaḥ pittāt parimlāyyathavā'pi nīlaḥ | kaphāt sitaḥ śoṇitajastu raktaḥ samastadoṣo'tha vicitrarūpaḥ `samastadoṣe'tha vicitravarṇaḥ’ iti pā.||27||

tānevāruṇādikān rāgānāha- rāga ityādi| parimlāyī pīta ityarthaḥ| aruṇādirāgaiḥ pañcabhistāvat pañca kācā jñeyāḥ, ṣaṣṭhaḥ kācaśca parimlāyī rogaḥ paraṃ rāgaprāptaḥ| asya ca pītavarṇatā sātyakivacanādavagantavyā| evaṃ ṣaṭ kācāḥ kathitāḥ||27||

div.ab: raktajaṃ maṇḍalaṃ dṛṣṭau sthūlakācānalaprabham `sthūlakācāruṇaprabham’ iti pā.| parimlāyini roge syānmlāyyānīlaṃ ca maṇḍalam ||28|| doṣakṣayāt kadācit syātsvayaṃ tatra ca darśanam |29|

atra pittāt parimlāyītyuktaṃ tasya ca lakṣaṇamanuktaṃ vaktumāha- raktajamityādi| raktajaṃ raktaprasādājjātaṃ raktatejasā jātaṃ vā| sthūlakācānalaprabhamiti bāhulyena sthūlakācābhaṃ, varṇenānalaprabham| anye tu ‘aruṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ dṛṣṭau sthūlakācāruṇaprabhaṃ’ iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca- aruṇam aruṇavarṇaṃ| kīdṛśamaruṇamityāha- sthūlakācāruṇaprabhamiti|- sthūlakācasyevāruṇā prabhā yasya tattathā| eṣa pāṭhaḥ pañjikayā dūṣitaḥ| mlāyi kṣayi| ānīlamiti īṣannīlam| analaprabhatvena ca pītatvamuktameva, tasmāt kiñcinnīlapītamityarthaḥ| anye tu ‘mlāyīnīlam’ iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- mlāyīnīlaṃ pītanīlamityarthaḥ| tatra pītaṃ rasamūrcchitapittajanitaṃ, nīlaṃ punaḥ raktamūrcchitapittajam| atra tṛtīyapaṭalasthe rāge doṣavyādhi(pti)vaśādrāgasya maṇḍalākārataiva, na tu le(re)khādiprakāratvamiti niyamārthaṃ punarmaṇḍalagrahaṇamiti| doṣakṣayādityādi karmakṣayāddoṣakṣaye sañjāte kadācidākasmikaṃ tatra parimlāyini roge darśanaṃ syādityeke; anye tu pittasammūrcchākararasasaṅkṣayāt kṣīṇe doṣe tatra kadāciddarśanaṃ syāditi vyākhyāṃ kurvantīti| ayaṃ yāpyaḥ||28||-

ab.seg: aruṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ vātāccañcalaṃ paruṣaṃ tathā ||29||
pittānmaṇḍalamānīlaṃ kāṃsyābhaṃ pītameva vā | śleṣmaṇā bahalaṃ snigdhaṃ śaṅkhakundendupāṇḍuram ||30||
calatpadmapalāśasthaḥ śuklo bindurivāmbhasaḥ | saṅkucatyātape'tyarthaṃ chāyāyāṃ vistṛto bhavet ||31||
mṛdyamāne ca nayane maṇḍalaṃ tadvisarpati | pravālapadmapatrābhaṃ maṇḍalaṃ śoṇitātmakam ||32||
dṛṣṭirāgo bhaveccitro liṅganāśe tridoṣaje | yathāsvaṃ doṣaliṅgāni sarveṣveva bhavanti hi ||33||

idānīṃ kācākhyāṃ prāptasya timirasya rāgeṇa ṣaṭtvaṃ pratipādya, ṣaḍvidhaṃ liṅganāśamataḥ paraṃ vakṣyāmīti yaduktaṃ tadeva ṣaḍvidhatvaṃ maṇḍalarāgabhedena vivṛṇvannāha- aruṇamityādi| paruṣaṃ kharasparśam| ānīlam īṣannīlaṃ, kāṃsyābham āpāṇḍupītam| bahalaṃ sthūlam| śuklo bindurivāmbhasa ityasyāgre kecit ‘saṅkucatyātape'tyarthaṃ chāyāyāṃ vistṛto bhavet’ iti paṭhanti| liṅganāśe'pi pūrvoktavātādirūpabhramaṇāruṇavarṇādidoṣaliṅgaṃ jñeyamiti darśayitumāha- yathāsvamityādi| yathāsvaṃ doṣaliṅgānīti pūrvoktavātāditimirāṇāṃ rūpabhraṇādilakṣaṇānītyarthaḥ| eṣu liṅganāśeṣu kevalaśleṣmajaliṅganāśaṃ vihāyānye liṅganāśā asādhyāḥ| atra kiñciddarśanāvasthāṃ `darśanānāśāvasthāṃ’ iti pā. prāptaḥ parimlāyyeva rogaḥ ṣaṣṭho liṅganāśo jñeyaḥ| evaṃ ṣaḍ liṅganāśā uktāḥ||29-33||

div.ab: ṣaḍ liṅganāśāḥ ṣaḍime ca rogā dṛṣṭyāśrayāḥ ṣaṭ ca ṣaḍeva ca syuḥ | tathā naraḥ pittavidagdhadṛṣṭiḥ kaphena cānyastvatha dhūmadarśī ||34|| yo hrasvajāḍyo(tyo) `yo hasvajātyo’ iti pā. nakulāndhatā ca gambhīrasañjñā ca tathaiva dṛṣṭiḥ |35|

rāgairaruṇādikaiḥ ṣaḍvidhaṃ liṅganāśamabhidhāyāparān pittavidagdhadṛṣṭyādikān ṣaḍeva nirdiśannāha- ṣaḍityādi| ṣaḍliṅganāśā iti ‘vakṣyāmi ṣaḍvidhaṃ rāgairliṅganāśamataḥ paraṃ’ ityanaineva liṅganāśānāṃ ṣaṭtve prāpte punaḥ ṣaḍiti yatsaṅkhyākaraṇaṃ tanniyamārthaṃ, tena timirakācaliṅganāśānāṃ pṛthak saṅkhyākaraṇaṃ na gaṇanīyaṃ; etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati- ṣaḍ liṅganāśāḥ, ṣaḍime ca rogā vakṣyamāṇāḥ pittavidagdhadṛṣṭyādayaḥ, evaṃ dṛṣṭyāśrayā dvādaśa| ṣaḍime ca rogā iti vakṣyamāṇāḥ pittavidagdhadṛṣṭyādayaḥ| dṛṣṭyāśrayāḥ ṣaṭ ca ṣaḍeva syuriti atrāpi pūrvaśaṅkayā ṣaḍeveti parasmānniyamayati; dvādaśaiva dṛṣṭyāśrayā rogā bhaveyurityarthaḥ| ke te pittavidagdhadṛṣṭyādayaḥ ṣaḍityāha- tathetyādi| tathāśabdo bhinnakrame, kaphena cānya ityatra sambadhyate; tena kaphenāpi vidagdhadṛṣṭiranya ityarthaḥ||34||-

pittena duṣṭena gatena dṛṣṭiṃ pītā bhavedyasya narasya dṛṣṭiḥ ||35|| pītāni rūpāṇi ca manyate yaḥ sa mānavaḥ pittavidagdhadṛṣṭiḥ | prāpte tṛtīyaṃ paṭalaṃ tu doṣe divā na paśyenniśi vīkṣate ca ||36|| (rātrau ‘ayamardhaśloko hastalikhitapustake na paṭhyate’ sa śītānugṛhītadṛṣṭiḥ pittālpabhāvādapi tāni paśyet) |37|
pittavidagdhadṛṣṭerlakṣaṇamāha- pittenetyādi| dṛṣṭena vṛddhena| `baddhena’ iti pā. niśi vīkṣate ceti rātrau śītopakṛtadṛṣṭitvāt pittābhāvaḥ, ato rātrau rūpadarśanam| sādhyo'yam||35-36||-

ab.seg: tathā naraḥ śleṣmavidagdhadṛṣṭistānyeva śuklāni hi manyate tu ||37||
triṣu sthitolpaḥ paṭaleṣu doṣo naktāndhyamāpādayati prasahya | divā sa sūryānugṛhītacakṣurikṣeta `sūryānugṛhītacakṣurīkṣeta’ iti pā. rūpāṇi kaphālpabhāvāt ||38||
kaphavidagdhadṛṣṭerlakṣaṇamāha- nara ityādi| kaphena duṣṭena gatena dṛṣṭiṃ sitā bhavedyasya narasya dṛṣṭiriti tathāśabdārthaḥ| tānyeva rūpāṇi| ayamapi sādhyaḥ||38||
śokajvarāyāsaśirobhitāpairabhyāhatā yasya narasya dṛṣṭiḥ | sadhūmakān paśyati sarvabhāvāṃstaṃ dhūmadarśīti vadanti rogam ||39||
dhūmadarśino lakṣaṇamāha- śoketyādi| śirobhitāpaḥ śirovyathā| ayaṃ pittajaḥ sādhyaśca||39||

div.ab: sa hrasvajāḍyo `hrasvajātyo’ iti pā. divaseṣu kṛcchrāddhrasvāni rūpāṇi ca yena paśyet |40|

hrasvajāḍyalakṣaṇamāha `hrasvajātyalakṣaṇamāha’ iti pā. - sa ityādi| sa puruṣaḥ| yena vikāreṇa| atra divaseṣu paśyediti vacanādrātrau na paśyatītyavagamyate| kecittu ‘rātrau ca śītānugṛhītadṛṣṭiḥ pittālpabhāvādapi tāni paśyet’ iti paṭhanti; taccāsaṅgataṃ, asya naktāndhatājanakatvāt| tathā ca videhaḥ,- “naktamandhāstu catvāro ye purastāt prakīrtitāḥ| teṣāmasādhyo nakulo hrasvajāḍya(tya)stathaiva ca”- iti| atra ca dṛṣṭimadhyagataḥ pīto rāgo jñeyaḥ| asya paṭalacatuṣṭayāśritapittaprabhavatvādasādhyatvam|40|-
vidyotate yena narasya dṛṣṭirdoṣābhipannā nakulasya yadvat ||40|| citrāṇi rūpāṇi divā sa paśyet sa vai vikāro nakulāndhyasañjñaḥ |41|
nakulāndhyalakṣaṇamāha- vidyotata ityādi| doṣābhipannā doṣairvyāptā| citrāṇi sarvadoṣavarṇāni| divā sa paśyediti vacanādrātrau na paśyatītyavagamyate| sarvajo'sādhyaśca||40||-
dṛṣṭirvirūpā śvasanopasṛṣṭā saṅkucyate'bhyantarataśca yāti ||41|| rujāvagāḍhā ca tamakṣirogaṃ gambhīriketi pravadanti tajjñāḥ |42|
gambhīrikāyā lakṣaṇamāha- dṛṣṭirityādi| virūpā vikṛtarūpā| śvasanopasṛṣṭā vātopadrutā| rujāvagāḍhā tīvravedanā| iyamapyasādhyā||41||-
bāhyau punardvāviha sampradiṣṭau nimittataścāpyanimittataśca ||42|| nimittatastatra śirobhitāpājjñeyastvabhiṣyandanidarśanaiśca `abhiṣyandanidarśanaśca’ iti pā.|43|

hetubhedena bāhyau nirdiśannāha- bāhyāvityādi| bahirbhavau bāhyau; yadyapi prāksūtre saṅkṣepeṇopadiṣṭau tathā'pi punariha nimittānimittabhedadvayena samyak prakarṣānnirdiṣṭāvityarthaḥ| tatra sanimittaṃ darśayannāha- nimittata ityādi| tatra tayormadhye, śirobhitāpād viṣapuṣpagandhaspṛṣṭapavanasamparkajātāt, abhiṣyandanidarśanairiti abhiṣyandalakṣaṇairityarthaḥ| ayamasādhyaḥ||42||-

ab.seg: surarṣigandharvamahoragāṇāṃ sandarśanenāpi ca bhāsvarāṇām ||43||
hanyeta dṛṣṭirmanujasya yasya sa liṅganāśastvanimittasañjñaḥ | tatrākṣi vispaṣṭamivāvabhāti vaidūryavarṇā vimalā ca dṛṣṭiḥ ||44||

animittaṃ darśayannāha- surarṣītyādi| animitta iti anupalabhyamānaviśiṣṭasurādidarśananimittaḥ| dṛṣṭiḥ darśanam| liṅganāśa iti darśananāśa ityarthaḥ| ayamapyasādhyaḥ| tasyaivānimittasya lakṣaṇamāha- tatretyādi| tatra animittasañjñake| vispaṣṭamiva viśeṣeṇa prasannamiva| vaidūryavarṇā prakṛtivarṇetyarthaḥ| vimaleti vigatāstimirakācādayo malā yasyāṃ sā tathā| etau sanimittānimittau sarvagatāvapi darśananāśakaratvādanuktāvapi dṛṣṭyāśritau kathitau, ato na saṅkhyātirekaḥ||43-44||
vidīryate sīdati hīyate vā nṛṇāmabhīghātahatā tu dṛṣṭiḥ ||45||
āgantuprastāvādaparamabhighātajamāha- vidīryata ityādi| sīdati avasādaṃ yāti| eṣa bāhyanimittatvāt sannipātāntarbhūtaḥ||45||
ityete nayanagatā mayā vikārāḥ saṅkhyātāḥ pṛthagiha ṣaṭ ca saptatiśca | eteṣāṃ pṛthagiha vistareṇa sarvaṃ vakṣye'haṃ tadanu cikitsitaṃ yathāvat ||46||

samudāyasaṅkhyāmāha- ityeta ityādi| saṅkhyātāḥ samyagākhyātāḥ, samyaggaṇitā vā| iha śālākye| punaḥ ṣaṭsaptatisaṅkhyākāraṇaṃ niyamārthaṃ; tena ṣaṭsaptatireva| etena karālādiproktā saṅkhyā nirākṛtā||46||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre dṛṣṭigatarogavijñānīyo nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ ||7||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre saptamo'dhyāyaḥ||7||

div.head: cikitsitapravibhāgavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaścikitsitapravibhāgavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ `cikitsitapravibhāgīyaṃ’ iti pā. vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ (suśrutāya) ||2||

dṛṣṭigatarogavijñānīyānantaraṃ sarvathā pratipannasakalanayanāmayasya bhiṣajaścikitsā nyāyyeti cikitsāpravibhāgīyārambhaḥ- athāta ityādi| pravibhāgaḥ prakarṣeṇa vibhajanaṃ pṛthakkaraṇamityarthaḥ||1-2||
ṣaṭsaptatirye'bhihitā vyādhayo nāmalakṣaṇaiḥ | cikitsitamidaṃ teṣāṃ samāsavyāsataḥ `samāsādvyāsataḥ\\’ iti pā. śṛṇu ||3||

cikitsā tu dvividhā samāsād vyāsācca; tatra samāsenehādhyāye vibhāgaṃ darśayannāha- ṣaḍityādi| lakṣaṇaiḥ hetupūrvarūparupopaśayasamprāptibhiḥ| samāsāt saṅkṣepādihaivādhyāye; vistarāt punarvātābhiṣyandādiṣu||3||
chedyāsteṣu daśaikaśca nava lekhyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | bhedyāḥ pañca vikārāḥ syurvyadhyāḥ pañcadaśaiva tu ||4||
dvādaśā'śastrakṛtyāśca yāpyāḥ sapta bhavanti hi | rogā varjayitavyāḥ syurdaśa pañca ca jānatā | asādhyau vā bhavetāṃ tu yāpyau cāgantusañjñitau ||5||

tatrāṣṭavidhaśastrakarmaṇāṃ madhye netrāmayeṣu caturvidhaṃ karma prayojyam, ataścaturvidhaśastrakarmārhān vyādhīn samāsārthaṃ vargīkṛtya prāha- chedyā ityādi| dvādaśā'śastrakṛtyāśceti cakārād dvau bāhyajāvaśastrakṛtyau| yāpyā iti snehādikriyayā yāpyatvaṃ, na tu chedyādikriyayā| yāpyasādhyatve ca dvayoravasthāvaśāt| varjayitavyā asādhyā ityarthaḥ||4-5||
arśo'nvitaṃ bhavati vartma tu yattathā'rśaḥ śuṣkaṃ tathā'rbudamatho piḍakāḥ sirājāḥ | jālaṃ sirājamapi pañcavidhaṃ tathā'rma chedyā bhavanti saha parvaṇikāmayena ||6||
tāneva chedyān rogānnāmabhiḥ prāha- arśo'nvitamityādi| pañcavidhamarmeti prastāryarma, śuṣkārma, raktārma, adhimāṃsārma, snāyvarmetyevaṃ pañcavidham||6||
utsāṅginī bahalakardamavartmanī ca śyāvaṃ ca yacca paṭhitaṃ tviha baddhavartma | kliṣṭaṃ ca pothakiyutaṃ khalu yacca vartma kumbhīkinī ca saha śarkarayā ca lekhyāḥ ||7||
lekhyānnāmabhiḥ prāha- utsaṅginītyādi| bahalakardamavartmanītyatra vartmeti padaṃ bahalakardamābhyāṃ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate||7||

div.ab: śleṣmopanāhalagaṇau ca bisaṃ ca bhedyā granthiśca yaḥ kṛmikṛto'ñjananāmikā ca |8|
bhedyānnāmabhiḥ prāha- śleṣmetyādi| bisaṃ bisavartma|8|-
ādau sirā nigaditāstu yayoḥ prayoge pākau ca yau nayanayoḥ pavano'nyataśca ||8|| pūyālasānilaviparyayamanthasañjñāḥ syandāstu yāntyupaśamaṃ hi sirāvyadhena |9|

vyadhyānnāmabhiḥ prāha- ādāvityādi| ādau sirā nigaditāḥ ityādi yayorvikārayoḥ prayoge ādau sirā nigaditāstau vyadhyau, kau tau? sirotpātasirāharṣau| pavano'nyataḥ anyatovātaḥ| manthasañjñā adhimanthāścatvāraḥ; syandā abhiṣyandāstāvanta eva||8||-

ab.seg: śuṣkākṣipākakaphapittavidagdhadṛṣṭiṣvamlākhyaśukrasahitārjunapiṣṭakeṣu ||9||
aklinnavartmahutabhugdhvajadarśiśuktipraklinnavartmasu tathaiva balāsasañjñe | āgantunā''mayayugena ca dūṣitāyāṃ dṛṣṭau na śastrapatanaṃ pravadanti tajjñāḥ ||10||
aśastrakṛtyānāha- śuṣketyādi| hutabhuk dhvajadarśī, dhūmadarśītyarthaḥ||9-10||

div.ab: sampaśyataḥ ṣaḍapi ye'bhihitāstu kācāste pakṣmakopasahitāstu bhavanti yāpyāḥ |11|
yāpyānāha- sampaśyata ityādi| ṣaḍapi ye kācā abhihitāste sampaśyataḥ puruṣasya yāpyā bhavantīti sambandhaḥ|11|-

ab.seg: catvāra eva pavanaprabhavāstvasādhyā dvau pittajau kaphanimittaja eka eva | aṣṭārdhakā rudhirajāśca gadāstridoṣāstāvanta eva gaditāvapi bāhyajau dvau ||11||

asādhyānāha- catvāra ityādi| catvāra eveti hatādhimanthanimiṣagambhīradṛṣṭivātahatavartmākhyāścatvāraḥ| dvāviti hrasvajāḍya(tya)jaladhisrāvākhyau| eka eva kaphasrāvākhyaḥ| aṣṭārdhakā iti catvāra ityarthaḥ| ke te catvāraḥ? raktasrāvājakājātaśoṇitārśovraṇānvitaśukrākhyāḥ| tāvanta eveti catvāra evetyarthaḥ| ke te catvāraḥ? pūyāsrāvanakulāndhyākṣipākātyālajyākhyāḥ| bāhyajau āgantujau||11||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre cikitsitapravibhāgavijñānīyo nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ ||8||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre'ṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ||8||

div.head: vātābhiṣyandapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto vātābhiṣyandapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

cikitsitapravibhāgīyānantaraṃ sarveṣāṃ nayanāmayānāmabhiṣyandamūlatvāt, tatrāpi pittādīnāṃ vātasyaivāvaraṇatvena nidānabhūtatvādādau vātābhiṣyandapratiṣedho yukta ityata āha- athāta ityādi| atrādiśabdo lupto draṣṭavyaḥ, tena vātābhiṣyandādipratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāma ityarthaḥ; pratiṣedhaḥ cikitsitaṃ; evaṃ pittābhiṣyandapratiṣedhādiṣvādiśabdo draṣṭavyaḥ||1-2||

div.ab: purāṇasarpiṣā snigdhau syandādhīmanthapīḍitau | svedayitvā yathānyāyaṃ sirāmokṣeṇa yojayet ||3|| sampādayedbastibhistu samyak snehavirecitau | tarpaṇaiḥ puṭapākaiśca dhūmairāścyotanaistathā ||4|| nasyasnehaparīṣekaiḥ śirobastibhireva ca |5|

tatra sirāvyadhasādhyeṣu pañcadaśasvabhiṣyandādhimanthau paṭhitau, sirāvyadhasādhyānāṃ cākṣirogāṇāṃ śoṇitamūlatvānmūlocchedārthaṃ pūrvaṃ dūṣyanirharaṇaṃ darśayannāha- purāṇetyādi| purāṇaṃ sarpiḥ saṃvatsaroṣitaṃ ghṛtam; anye daśavarṣasthitaṃ ghṛtaṃ purāṇaṃ kathayanti| yathānyāyaṃ yathāśāstramityarthaḥ| tena dṛṣṭeḥ samīpamuttamāṅgamalpaṃ svedayet, dṛṣṭirasvedyā| yathānyāyamiti padaṃ snehapānasirāmokṣābhyāṃ saha yojayet| tena snehopayaugikokto vidhiḥ ‘prāk pācitāmadoṣāya’ ityādiko'vadhāraṇīyaḥ| tenātrāpi doṣavyādhinirāmatāyāmeva sarpiḥpānādayo vidheyāḥ| tathā ca tantrāntaraṃ,- “svedaḥ pralepastiktānnaṃ dhūmo dinacatuṣṭayam| laṅghanaṃ cākṣirogāṇāmāmānāṃ pācanāni ṣaṭ|| añjanaṃ sarpiṣaḥ pānaṃ kaṣāyaṃ gurubhojanam| netrarogeṣu sāmeṣu snānaṃ ca parivarjayet”- iti| videhe'pi,- “prāgevākṣyāmaye bhaktaṃ trirātramaguru smṛtam| upavāsastryahaṃ vā syānnaktaṃ vā'pyaśanaṃ hitam|| tataścaturthe divase vyādhau sañjātalakṣaṇe| yathoktāstu kriyāḥ kāryā nasyasekāñjanādikāḥ”- iti| sirāmokṣeṇetyatra sirā upanāsikā lālāṭyā vā āpāṅgyā vā| dūṣyaharaṇaṃ pratipādya doṣacikitsitamāha- sampādayedityādi| sampādayet yojayet| bastibhiḥ snehabastibhirnirūhairvā| samyagiti hīnamithyātiyogarahitaiḥ| snehavirecitāviti snehavirecanaṃ tu pittasyānugate pittāsṛganugate vā vāyau balavato bahudoṣasya ceti| durbalasyālpadoṣasya ca puruṣasya svasthānagato malāvṛtaḥ svatantro vā bastibhirevāvajetavyaḥ| bastirapi malāvṛte vāte nairūhikaḥ, dhātukṣayaje snaihikaḥ| samyakśabdo bastyādiṣu śirobastyanteṣu sambadhyate| tarpaṇādividhānaṃ kriyākalpe bhaviṣyati| tatra sekaḥ sukhoṣṇaḥ, āścyotanaṃ ca śītameva||3-4||-
vātaghnānūpajalajamāṃsāmlakvāthasecanaiḥ ||5|| snehaiścaturbhiruṣṇaiśca tatpītāmbaradhāraṇaiḥ | payobhirvesavāraiśca sālvaṇaiḥ pāyasaistathā ||6|| bhiṣak sampādayedetāvupanāhaiśca pūjitaiḥ |7|

pūrvaṃ svedayitvetyuktaṃ, tatra dravādisvedānupapādayannāha- vātaghnetyādi| vātaghnāni bhadradārvādīni| uṣṇaiḥ sukhoṣṇaiḥ| uṣṇairiti padaṃ vātaghnādibhiḥ sambadhyate| tatpītāmbaradhāraṇairiti catuḥsnehamitavastradhāraṇairityarthaḥ| sālvaṇairiti sālvaṇasyaikatvāt kathaṃ bahuvacanaṃ? satyaṃ, yaugikairanyairapi dravyaiḥ svedaḥ kārya iti bodhanārthaṃ bahuvacanaṃ, svedayitvā sirāmokṣeṇa yojayedityuktam||5-6||-
grāmyānūpaudakarasaiḥ snigdhaiḥ phalarasānvitaiḥ ||7|| susaṃskṛtaiḥ payobhiśca tayorāhāra iṣyate |8|

na cābhuktavataḥ śastrakarma kuryādityāśaṅkyāhāramāha- grāmyetyādi| phalarasānvitairiti dāḍimāmalakarasasaṃyuktaiḥ| susaṃskṛtaiḥ payobhiriti śatāvarīśṛṅgaveraprabhṛtidravyasaṃskṛtairityarthaḥ| tayoḥ syandādhimanthayoḥ||7||-

tathā copari bhaktasya sarpiḥpānaṃ(ne)praśasyate `bhaktasyopari sarpistau pibetāṃ cāpi mānavau’ iti pā.||8|| triphalākvāthasaṃsiddhaṃ kevalaṃ jīrṇameva vā | siddhaṃ vātaharaiḥ kṣīraṃ prathamena gaṇena vā ||9|| snehāstailādvinā siddhā vātaghnaistarpaṇe hitāḥ |10|

purāṇasarpiṣā snigdhāvityuktaṃ tasya ca ghṛtasyāvacāraṇakālaṃ niyamayannāha- tathetyādi| kevalam asaṃskṛtam| vātaharaiḥ bhadradārvādibhiḥ| jejjaṭācāryastu kākolyādibhirvātaharairityāha| upari pānaṃ pibediti śeṣaḥ| prathamena gaṇena vidārigandhādinā| gayadāsācāryastu sarvatrāpi ghṛtaṃ manyate| tathā ca tadvyākhyānam- “triphalāghṛtaṃ vyādhipratyanīkaṃ, vātaharadevadārvādisiddhaṃ tu doṣapratyanīkaṃ, vātasyaiva pittānubandhe sati vidārigandhādisiddhaṃ”; īdṛśe ca vyākhyāne ‘siddhaṃ vātaharairvā'pi prathamena gaṇena vā’ iti pāṭhaḥ||8-9||-
snaihikaḥ puṭapākaśca dhūmo nasyaṃ ca tadvidham ||10|| nasyādiṣu sthirākṣīramadhuraistailamiṣyate |11|
pūrvaṃ tarpaṇairityuktaṃ, tatra tarpaṇadravyāṇyāha- snaihika ityādi| snaihikaḥ puṭapākaḥ kriyākalpe vakṣyamāṇaḥ| tadvidhaṃ snaihikamityarthaḥ||10||-
eraṇḍapallave mūle tvaci vā''jaṃ payaḥ śṛtam ||11|| kaṇṭakāryāśca mūleṣu sukhoṣṇaṃ secane hitam |12|
āntaramupakramamabhidhāya bāhyamāha- eraṇḍetyādi| secane ityatra cakāro lupto draṣṭavyaḥ; tena na kevalaṃ seke āścyotane cetyarthaḥ| tatra seke sukhoṣṇaṃ, āścyotane ca śītamevetyarthaḥ||11||-
saindhavodīcyayaṣṭyāhvapippalībhiḥ śṛtaṃ payaḥ ||12|| hitamardhodakaṃ seke tathā''ścyotanameva ca |13|
saindhavetyādi| ardhodakamiti ardhamudakaṃ yasmin kṣīre tat kṣīraṃ seke hitaṃ tathā āścyotane ca; na punaḥ pānādau| saindhavādipramāṇaṃ tu kṣīrādaṣṭamāṃśameva||12||-
hīberavakramañjiṣṭhodumbaratvakṣu sādhitam ||13|| sāmbhaśchāgaṃ payo vā'pi śūlāścyotanamuttamam |14|
hrīberetyādi| hrīberaṃ vālakam| vakraṃ tagaram| sāmbha iti caturguṇodakaṃ, ardhodakamiti kecit| āścyotanam akṣipūraṇam||13||-
madhukaṃ rajanīṃ pathyāṃ devadāruṃ ca peṣayet ||14|| ājena payasā śreṣṭhamabhiṣyande tadañjanam |15|
madhukamityādi| kecidamuṃ pāṭhaṃ na paṭhanti||14||-
gairikaṃ saindhavaṃ kṛṣṇāṃ nāgaraṃ ca yathottaram ||15|| dviguṇaṃ piṣṭamadbhistu guṭikāñjanamiṣyate |16|

gairikamityādi| yathottaraṃ dviguṇamiti gairikāddviguṇaṃ saindhavaṃ, saindhavāddviguṇā kṛṣṇā, tato'pi dviguṇaṃ nāgaram| guṭikāñjanamiṣyate iti snaihikapuṭapākādijanitakaphānubandhasya guṭikāñjanam| kecidatrāpyājena payaseti sambadhnanti; tenājapayasā piṣṭamadbhirvā| ‘nāgaraṃ ca yathottaraṃ’ ityatra ‘godantaṃ ca yathottaraṃ’ iti paṭhanti; sa ca pāṭho jejjaṭācāryeṇa dūṣitaḥ||15||-

ab.seg: snehāñjanaṃ hitaṃ cātra vakṣyate tadyathāvidhi ||16||

snehetyādi| yathāvidhīti vidhimanatikramya `vidheranatikramāt’ iti pā., etenāpatarpaṇasirāvyadhakupitavāte'bhiṣyande snehāñjanaṃ hitamityarthaḥ| atraike ‘tāmrapātrasthitaṃ māsaṃ sarpiḥsaindhavasaṃyutaṃ’ `māṃsaṃ sarpiḥ saindhavasaṃyutam’ iti pā. iti snehāñjanamāhuḥ| anye tu ‘vasā cānūpajalajā saindhavena samāyutā’ ityādinā vakṣyamāṇaṃ snehāñjanaṃ kathayanti||16||
rogo yaścānyatovāto yaśca mārutaparyayaḥ | anenaiva vidhānena bhiṣak tāvapi sādhayet ||17||
vātābhiṣyandakriyāmanyasminnapi vātaje'kṣiroge'tidiśannāha- roga ityādi||17||

div.ab: pūrvabhaktaṃ hitaṃ sarpiḥ kṣīraṃ vā'pyatha bhojane | vṛkṣādanyāṃ kapitthe ca pañcamūle mahatyapi ||18|| sakṣīraṃ karkaṭarase siddhaṃ cātra ghṛtaṃ pibet | siddhaṃ vā hitamatrāhuḥ pattūrārtagalagnikaiḥ ||19|| sakṣīraṃ meṣaśṛṅgyā vā sarpirvīratareṇa vā |20|

anyatovātamārutaparyayayoḥ sāmānyāṃ cikitsāmabhidhāya viśeṣacikitsāmāha- pūrvabhaktamityādi| tadeva ghṛtamāha- vṛkṣādanyāmityādi| vṛkṣādanī bandākaḥ, vṛkṣakalambuketyanye| vṛkṣādanyādīnāṃ saptadravyāṇāmatra kaṣāyaḥ| agarbhaṃ ghṛtamidam| siddhamityādi| pattūraḥ sitivāraḥ, ‘sirivālī’ iti loke prasiddhā| ārtagalaḥ kaṇṭakaphalo jalamuktadeśajaḥ, ‘kakubha’ ityanye| agnikaḥ ajamodā| pattūrādīnāṃ kaṣāye kṣīre ca sādhitaṃ sarpiḥ meṣaśṛṅgīkvāthe vā sakṣīre sādhitam| vīrataraḥ śaraḥ vellantaro vā, tasya kvāthe vā sakṣīre sādhitaṃ sarpiranyatovātamārutaparyayayorhitam| idamapi ghṛtatrayamagarbham||18-19||-

ab.seg: saindhavaṃ dāru śuṇṭhī ca mātuluṅgaraso ghṛtam ||20||
stanyodakābhyāṃ kartavyaṃ śuṣkapāke tadañjanam | pūjitaṃ sarpiṣaścātra pānamakṣṇośca tarpaṇam ||21||
ghṛtena jīvanīyena nasyaṃ tailena cāṇunā | pariṣeke hitaṃ cātra payaḥ śītaṃ sasaindhavam ||22||
rajanīdārusiddhaṃ vā saindhavena samāyutam | sarpiryutaṃ stanyaghṛṣṭamañjanaṃ vā mahauṣadham ||23||
vasā vā''nūpajalajā saindhavena samāyutā | nāgaronmiśritā kiñcicchuṣkapāke tadañjanam ||24||

saindhavamityādi| saindhavādidravyatrayāṇāṃ kalkena mātuluṅgādidravyacatuṣkeṇa rasakriyāṃ niṣpādya śuṣkapāke'ñjanaṃ kāryaṃ; yato rasakriyāñjanamidam| pūjitamityādi| sarpiṣo ‘jīvanīyasiddhasya’ iti śeṣaḥ| atra śuṣkapāke nasyaṃ jīvanīyena ghṛtenaiva; aṇunā tailena vā nasyaṃ pūjitam| aṇutailaṃ tu śālākyatantroktaṃ, na punarvātavyādhyuditam| pariṣeke ityādi| śītamiti śṛtaśītamityarthaḥ| sasaindhavamiti saśabda īṣadarthaḥ| rajanīdārusiddhaṃ vetyatra kṣīramiti sambadhyate| saindhavena samāyutam alpasaindhavayuktamityarthaḥ| sarpirityādi|- mahauṣadhaṃ vā ghṛtastrīstanyayuktaṃ pāṣāṇaghṛṣṭamityarthaḥ, añjanaṃ vā| vasetyādi|- ānūpajalajā vā vasā stokasaindhavayuktā kiñcicchuṇṭhīyuktā pāṣāṇaghṛṣṭā satī śuṣkapāke'ñjanamiti sambandhaḥ||20-24||
pavanaprabhavā rogā ye keciddṛṣṭināśanāḥ | bījenānena matimān teṣu karma prayojayet ||25||
idānīṃ vātajeṣu timirakācādiṣveṣaiva kriyā kartavyeti darśayannāha- pavanetyādi| dṛṣṭināśanāḥ timirakācādayaḥ| bījena bījabhūtena| anena vātābhiṣyandoktakarmaṇā| matimān ūhāpohavit||25||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre vātābhiṣyandapratiṣedho nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ ||9||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre navamo'dhyāyaḥ||9||

div.head: pittābhiṣyandapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ pittābhiṣyandapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
vātābhiṣyandapratiṣedhānantaraṃ ‘vātāddaśa tathā pittāt’ iti vacanāt pittābhiṣyandapratiṣedhārambhaḥ- athāta ityādi||1-2||
pittasyande paittike cādhimanthe raktāsrāvaḥ sraṃsanaṃ cāpi kāryam | akṣṇoḥ sekālepanasyāñjanāni paitte ca syādyadvisarpe vidhānam ||3||
pittetyādi| sraṃsanaṃ virekaḥ| pittavisarpavidhānaṃ ‘uśīralāmajjakacandanāni’ ityādipralepāḥ| pūrvavadatrāpyapatarpaṇādibhiḥ kṛtāmapācanasya snehapūrvakaḥ sirāmokṣaḥ||3||

div.ab: gundrāṃ śāliṃ śaivalaṃ śailabhedaṃ dārvīmelāmutpalaṃ rodhramabhram | padmātpatraṃ śarkarā darbhamikṣuṃ tālaṃ rodhraṃ vetasaṃ padmakaṃ ca ||4|| drākṣāṃ kṣaudraṃ candanaṃ yaṣṭikāhvaṃ yoṣitkṣīraṃ rātryanante ca piṣṭvā | sarpiḥsiddhaṃ tarpaṇe sekanasye ‘nāvane ca’ iti pā. śastaṃ kṣīraṃ siddhameteṣu cājam ||5|| yojyo vargo vyasta eṣo'nyathā vā samyaṅnasye'ṣṭārdhasaṅkhye'pi nityam |6|

idānīṃ pittasyābhiṣyandayaugikadravyāṇyāha- gundrāmityādi| gundrā erakābhedaḥ, gavedhuketyanye, śaivalaṃ dūrvā, śailabhedaḥ pāṣāṇabhedaḥ, candanaṃ raktacandanaṃ, rātriḥ haridrā, anantā utpalasārivā, yoṣitkṣīraṃ strīstanyaṃ, śarkarādeḥ sāhacaryāt kalkadravye ikṣuriti ikṣurasena dravakāryam| vyastaḥ asamastaḥ, anyathā vā samasta ityarthaḥ| yadyapi vargatvāt ‘samastaṃ vargamardhaṃ vā yathālābhamathāpi vā’ iti śalyatantroktaparibhāṣayaiva samastavyastatā prāptā, tathā'pi śālākyatantratvādatra punaruktā| nasye aṣṭārdhasaṅkhye catuḥsaṅkhye pratimarṣāvapīḍanasyaśirovirecanākhye||4-5||-

ab.seg: kriyāḥ sarvā pittaharyaḥ praśastāstryahāccordhvaṃ kṣīrasarpiśca nasyam ‘śastā'śeṣā pittahantrī kriyā ca tryahādūrdhvaṃ kṣīrasarpiśca nasyam’ iti pā.||6||

kriyā ityādi| kṣīrasarpiśceti ‘bhojane’ iti śeṣaḥ| nasyamityupalakṣaṇaṃ, tenāścyotanasekāñjanādi gṛhyate| yadyapi ‘paitte ca syādyadvisarpe vidhānaṃ’ ityanenaiva pittaharī kriyā kathitā, tathā'pi tatra vyādhipratyanīkatayoktā, atra tu doṣapratyanīkatveneti na doṣaḥ||6||

div.ab: pālāśaṃ syācchoṇitaṃ cāñjanārthe śallakyā vā śarkarākṣaudrayuktam |7|
raktapittaprasādakāñjanānāṃ rasakriyā prathamā, atastāmāha- pālāśamityādi| pālāśaṃ śoṇitaṃ kiṃśukarasaḥ; anye palāśakhapuramāhuḥ|7|-

ab.seg: rasakriyāṃ śarkarākṣaudrayuktāṃ pālindyāṃ vā madhuke vā'pi kuryāt ||7||

aparāmapi rasakriyāmāha- rasakriyāmityādi| rasakriyāphāṇitākṛtiḥ| tathā coktam- “gṛhītvā kvāthakalpena kvāthaṃ pūtaṃ punaḥ punaḥ| kvāthayet phāṇitākārameṣā proktā rasakriyā” iti| pālindī śyāmā trivṛt, sārivāmanye||7||

div.ab: mustā phenaḥ sāgarasyotpalaṃ ca kṛmighnailādhātribījādrasaśca |8|
aparamapi rasakriyāñjanamāha- mustetyādi| kṛmighnā viḍaṅgāḥ, dhātrī āmalakaṃ, bījaḥ pītasāraḥ ‘bījaka’ iti yāvat, mustādīnāṃ rase rasakriyā kāryā|8|-

ab.seg: tālīśailāgairikośīraśaṅkhairevaṃ yuñjyādañjanaṃ stanyapiṣṭaiḥ ||8||
vartyañjanamāha- tālīśetyādi| kāśīśaileti kecit paṭhanti||8||

div.ab: cūrṇaṃ kuryādañjanārthe raso vā stanyopeto dhātakīsyandanābhyām |9|
cūrṇāñjanamāha- cūrṇamityādi| raso veti rasakriyā vetyarthaḥ| syandano'nenaiva nāmnā prasiddhaḥ| kecit candanābhyāmiti paṭhanti|9|-

ab.seg: yoṣitstanyaṃ śātakumbhaṃ vighṛṣṭaṃ kṣaudropetaṃ kaiṃśukaṃ cāpi puṣpam ||9||
yoṣidityādi| śātakumbhaṃ suvarṇaṃ, tacca yoṣitstanyena ghṛṣṭamañjanam| kṣaudrayuktaṃ vā kiṃśukapuṣpaṃ ghṛṣṭaṃ tāmrapātrādāvañjanam||9||
rodhraṃ drākṣāṃ śarkarāmutpalaṃ ca nāryāḥ kṣīre yaṣṭikāhvaṃ vacāṃ ca | piṣṭvā kṣīre varṇakasya tvacaṃ ca toyonmiśre candanodumbare ca ||10||

rodhramityādi| rodhrādivacāntaṃ nārīkṣīre piṣṭamekamañjanam| varṇako rocanikā; tasyāstvak nārīkṣīreṇa piṣṭā dvitīyamañjanam| anye varṇakatvakśabdena karṇikāravṛkṣasya valkalaṃ kathayanti, tannecchati gayī| toyonmiśre candanodumbare ceti tṛtīyāñjanaṃ, toyonmiśre bālakayukte, candanaṃ kucandanaṃ; pañjikākārastu candanodumbaraṃ bhṛśataraṃ cūrṇitaṃ vastrabaddhaṃ toyaplutamāścyotanāñjanamāha||10||
kāryaḥ phenaḥ sāgarasyāñjanārthe nārīstanye mākṣike cāpi ghṛṣṭaḥ | yoṣitstanye sthāpitaṃ yaṣṭikāhvaṃ rodhraṃ drākṣāṃ śarkarāmutpalaṃ ca ||11||
kṣaumābaddhaṃ pathyamāścyotane vā sarpirghṛṣṭaṃ ‘sarpirbhṛṣṭaṃ’ iti pā. yaṣṭikāhvaṃ sarodhram | toyonmiśrāḥ kāśmarīdhātripathyāstadvaccāhuḥ kaṭphalaṃ cāmbunaiva ||12||

kārya ityādi| aparamāścyotanamāha- nārītyādi| yaṣṭimadhukādidravyamatīva cūrṇitaṃ strīstanyasthāpitaṃ kṣaumavastrāvabaddhamāścyotane hitamityarthaḥ| yaṣṭikāhvaṃ sarodhramiti yaṣṭimadhukarodhre vā ghṛtaghṛṣṭe ‘ghṛtabhṛṣṭe’ iti pā. pūrvavadāścyotanam||11-12||
eṣo'mlākhye'nukramaścāpi śuktau kāryaḥ sarvaḥ syātsirāmokṣavarjyaḥ ||13||
idānīmamlādhyuṣitaśuktyoḥ sāmānyacikitsāmāha- eṣa ityādi| kecidamlādhyuṣitaśuktyoraśastrakṛtyatvādeva sirāmokṣavarjanaṃ siddham, ataḥ ‘śirāmokṣavarjya’ iti pāṭhaṃ na paṭhanti||13||

div.ab: sarpiḥ peyaṃ traiphalaṃ tailvakaṃ vā peyaṃ vā syāt kevalaṃ yat purāṇam |14|
amlādhyuṣite viśeṣacikitsitamāha- sarpirityādi| ādyaṃ ghṛtadvayaṃ saṃśodhanaṃ, purāṇaghṛtaṃ tu saṃśamanam|14|-

ab.seg: doṣe'dhastācchuktikāyāmapāste śītairdravyairañjanaṃ kāryamāśu ||14||
śuktikāyāṃ viśeṣacikitsitamāha- doṣe ityādi| adhastādapāste doṣe ‘virecanena’ iti śeṣaḥ||14||
vaidūryaṃ yat sphāṭikaṃ vaidrumaṃ ca mauktaṃ śāṅkhaṃ rājataṃ śātakumbham | cūrṇaṃ sūkṣmaṃ śarkarākṣaudrayuktaṃ śuktiṃ hanyādañjanaṃ caitadāśu ||15||
tānyeva śītadravyāṇyāha- vaidūryamityādi||15||
yuñjyāt sarpirdhūmadarśī narastu śeṣaṃ kuryādraktapitte vidhānam | yaccaivānyat pittahṛccāpi sarvaṃ yadvīsarpe paittike vai vidhānam ||16||

dhūmadarśinaścikitsitamāha- yuñjyādityādi| raktapitte vidhānamiti raktābhiṣyande pittābhiṣyande ca cikitsitaṃ yaduktaṃ tadityarthaḥ| anyat pittahṛditi pittavidagdhadṛṣṭeryadvidhānaṃ tadatra yojayet| yadvīsarpe paittike vai vidhānamiti pittavisarpoktaṃ vidhānaṃ yojayediti sambandhaḥ||16||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre pittābhiṣyandapratiṣedho nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ ||10||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre daśamo'dhyāyaḥ||10||

div.head: śleṣmābhiṣyandapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ śleṣmābhiṣyandapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
pittābhiṣyandānantaraṃ doṣakrameṇa kaphābhiṣyandapratiṣedhārambhaḥ- athāta ityādi||1-2||

div.ab: syandādhimanthau kaphajau pravṛddhau jayet sirāṇāmatha mokṣaṇena | svedāvapīḍāñjanadhūmasekapralepayogaiḥ kavalagrahaiśca ||3|| rūkṣaistathā''ścyotanasaṃvidhānaistathaiva rūkṣaiḥ puṭapākayogaiḥ | tryahāttryahāccāpyapatarpaṇānte prātastayostiktaghṛtaṃ praśastam ||4|| tadannapānaṃ ca samācareddhi yacchleṣmaṇo naiva karoti vṛddhim |5|

sirāṇāmatha mokṣaṇenetyatrāthaśabdādayamabhiprāyaḥ- kṛtasnehādipūrvakramasya pravṛddhāvasthāyāṃ sirāmokṣaḥ| pūrvakramamāha- svedāvapīḍetyādi| tryahāt tryahāditi atarpaṇapreritadinacatuṣṭayasya tiktadravyasādhitaṃ prātaḥ praśastaṃ ghṛtaṃ, tena snigdhasya tryahāt ‘paścāt’ iti pā. sirāmokṣaḥ| ‘prātastayostiktaghṛtaṃ praśastaṃ’ ityatra ‘tau prātarevānu ghṛtaṃ pibetāṃ’ iti kecit paṭhanti| ‘tadannapānaṃ ca samācareddhi’ ityatra ‘tat prātarannaṃ ca samācareddhi’ iti kecit paṭhanti; prātargrahaṇaṃ dvirannakālaniṣedhārthamiti vyākhyānayanti||3-4||-
kuṭannaṭāsphoṭaphaṇijjhabilvapattūrapilvarkakapitthabhaṅgaiḥ ||5|| svedaṃ vidadhyāt... |6|

svedadravyāṇyāha- kuṭannaṭetyādi| kuṭannaṭaṃ tagaraṃ; phaṇijjhakaḥ tīkṣṇagandhaḥ svanāmnaiva prasiddhaḥ, anye nirguṇḍīmāhuḥ; pattūraḥ śarabālikaḥ, bhaṅgaiḥ patrabhaṅgaiḥ, anye bhaṅgaśabdena pallavānāhuḥ||5||-
... athavā'nulepaṃ barhiṣṭhaśuṇṭhīsurakāṣṭhakuṣṭhaiḥ |6|
anulepadravyāṇyāha- athavetyādi| barhiṣṭhaṃ bālakam|6|-

sindhūtthahiṅgutriphalāmadhūkaprapauṇḍarīkāñjanatutthatāmraiḥ ||6|| piṣṭairjalenāñjanavartayaḥ syuḥ pathyāharidrāmadhukāñjanairvā | trīṇyūṣaṇāni triphalā haridrā viḍaṅgasāraśca samāni ca syuḥ ||7|| barhiṣṭhakuṣṭhāmarakāṣṭhaśaṅkhapāṭhāmalavyoṣamanaḥśilāśca ‘pāṭhānakhavyoṣamanaḥśilāśca’ iti pā.| piṣṭvā'mbunā vā kusumāni jātikarañjaśobhāñjanajāni yuñjyāt ||8|| phalaṃ prakīryādathavā'pi śigroḥ puṣpaṃ ca tulyaṃ ‘tutthaṃ’ iti pā. bṛhatīdvayasya | rasāñjanaṃ saindhavacandanaṃ ca manaḥśilāle laśunaṃ ca tulyam ||9|| piṣṭvā'ñjanārthe kaphajeṣu dhīmān vartīrvidadhyānnayanāmayeṣu |10|

vartyañjanadravyāṇyāha- sindhūtthetyādi| trīṇyūṣaṇānīti trikaṭukamityarthaḥ| barhiṣṭhaṃ vālakam| amarakāṣṭhaṃ devadāru| prakīryaḥ kaṇṭakikarañjaḥ| kecit puṣpamapi prakīryādeveti kathayanti| tathā bṛhatīdvayasya puṣpaṃ phalaṃ ca| ālaṃ haritālam| etā vartyo'rdhaślokasamāpanāḥ pañca tryūṣaṇādidravyairjñeyāḥ| pañjikāyāṃ tu ‘vyoṣamanaḥśilāśca’ ityanantaraṃ ‘mūrvā ca jātīmukulāni cāpi piṣṭvā'mbunaitān vitarettathaiva’ iti paṭhyate; vyākhyānaṃ ca- tryūṣaṇādyaṣṭāṅgamañjanaṃ, barhiṣṭhādi dvādaśāṅgaṃ, athavetyanena vikalpavācinā kaṇṭakikarañjaphalatulyāṃśairvakṣyamāṇairauṣadhairekamañjanaṃ, śigruphalatulyāṃśairvakṣyamāṇairdvitīyamañjanam| ‘sindhūtthahiṅgu’ ityatra kecit ‘sindhuprasūtaṃ’ iti paṭhanti||6-9||-

ab.seg: roge balāsagrathite'ñjanaṃ jñaiḥ kartavyametat suviśuddhakāye ||10||
nīlān yavān gavyapayo'nupītān śalākinaḥ śuṣkatanūn vidahya | tathā'rjakāsphotakapitthabilvanirguṇḍijātīkusumāni caiva ||11||
tatkṣāravatsaindhavatuttharocanaṃ pakvaṃ vidadhyādatha lohanāḍyām | etadbalāsagrathite'ñjanaṃ syādeṣo'nukalpastu phaṇijjhakādau ||12||

roge ityādi| jñairiti kuśalairvaidyairityarthaḥ| etad vakṣyamāṇaṃ kṣārāñjanam| suviśuddhakāye iti sirāvyadhavirekaśirovirekairityarthaḥ| tadeva kṣārañjanaṃ vyutpādayannāha- nīlānityādi| nīlān apakvān ‘nīlān pakvān’ iti pā.| gavyapayo'nupītān kṛṣṇagodugdhabhāvitān, pītāniti vaktavye anupītāniti yat kṛtaṃ tat saptāhaṃ saptāhadvayaṃ vā bhāvanā kāryeti bodhayati| śalākinaḥ śūkayuktān| taditi bhasmetyarthaḥ| nīlayavādibhasmaprasthaṃ, uṣṇodakāḍhakena saha melayitvā punaḥ punarāsrāvayet, yāvat kṣārodakaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ picchilaṃ raktaṃ ca syāt, tadā bhasma vihāya tatra kṣārodake saindhavatuttharocanamāvāpaṃ kṣārodakāddvātriṃśadbhāgaṃ dattvā pacet| kecit saindhavādidravyāṇi bhasmārthaṃ na tu āvāpārthamiti vadanti, tanmate'prativāpameva paktavyam| phaṇijjhakādāvityatrādiśabdāt kusumādayo gṛhyante||11-12||
mahauṣadhaṃ māgadhikāṃ ca mustāṃ ‘mukhyāṃ’ iti pā. sasaindhavaṃ yanmaricaṃ ca śuklam | tanmātuluṅgasvarasena piṣṭaṃ netrāñjanaṃ piṣṭakamāśu hanyāt ||13||
piṣṭakaroge'ñjanamāha- mahauṣadhamityādi| maricaṃ śuklaṃ śobhāñjanabījam||13||

div.ab: phale ‘phalaṃ bṛhatyā magadhodbhavānāmādāya’ iti pā. bṛhatyā magadhodbhavānāṃ nidhāya kalkaṃ phalapākakāle | srotojayuktaṃ ‘srotojayuktaṃ khalu saptarātrāttaduddhṛtaṃ syāttu tathaiva pathyam’ iti pā. ca taduddhṛtaṃ syāttadvattu piṣṭe ... |14|

aparamapyañjanamāha- phale ityādi| phalapākakāle kaṇṭakāriphalamuddhṛtabījaṃ sauvīrāñjanasamabhāgena pippalīkalkena pūrayet, tatkalkaṃ saptarātrādanantaramuddhṛtaṃ mahauṣadhādyañjanavat piṣṭakaroge hitaṃ pathyamityarthaḥ|14|-
...vidhireṣa cāpi ||14|| vārtākaśigrvindrasurāpaṭolakirātatiktāmalakīphaleṣu |15|
kaṇṭakāriphalavidhimanyatrāpi phale'tidiśannāha- vidhirityādi| indrasurā indravāruṇī||14||-
kāsīsasāmudrarasāñjanāni jātyāstathā kṣā(ko)rakameva cāpi ||15|| praklinnavartmanyupadiśyate tu yogāñjanaṃ tanmadhunā'vaghṛṣṭam |16|

ab.seg: praklinnavartmani roge yogāñjanamāha- kāsīsetyādi| jātyāḥ korakaṃ jātīkalikā||15||

div.ab: nādeyamagryaṃ maricaṃ ca śuklaṃ nepālajātā ca samapramāṇā ||16|| samātuluṅgadrava eṣa yogaḥ kaṇḍūṃ nihanyāt sakṛdañjanena |17|

sarveṣāṃ kaphajākṣirogāṇāmupadravabhūtāyāḥ kaṇḍvāścikitsāmāha- nādeyamityādi| nādeyamiti saindhavamityarthaḥ| maricaṃ ca śuklamiti śobhāñjanabījamityarthaḥ; anye śuklameva maricaṃ kathayanti| nepālajātā manaḥśilā||16||-
saśṛṅgaveraṃ suradāru mustaṃ sindhuprabhū(sū)taṃ mukulāni jātyāḥ ||17|| surāprapiṣṭaṃ tvidamañjanaṃ hi kaṇḍvāṃ ca śophe ca hitaṃ vadanti |18|
kaṇḍvāmaparamapyañjanamāha- setyādi||17||-

ab.seg: syandādhimanthakramamācarecca sarveṣu caiteṣu sadā'pramattaḥ ||18||
(viśeṣato nāvanameva kāryaṃ saṃsarjanaṃ cāpi yathopadiṣṭam ayaṃ pāṭho hastalikhitapustake nopalabhyate ) ||19||

idānīṃ balāsagrathitapiṣṭakapraklinnavartmasu viśeṣacikitsāmabhidhāya sāmānyacikitsāmāha- syandetyādi| eteṣu balasagrathitapiṣṭakapraklinnavartmasu| cakārādanyeṣvapi kaphajākṣirogeṣu| apramattaḥ sāvadhānaḥ||18||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre kaphābhiṣyandapratiṣedho nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||11||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ||11||

div.head: raktābhiṣyandapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto raktābhiṣyandapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
vātapittakaphakṛtānabhiṣyandān pratipādya pariśiṣṭaṃ raktābhiṣyandapratiṣedhamāha- athāta ityādi||1-2||
manthaṃ syandaṃ sirotpātaṃ sirāharṣaṃ ca raktajam | ekenaiva vidhānena cikitseccaturo gadān ||3||
manthamityādi| atra manthasya prāgupādānaṃ syandādgarīyastvakhyāpanārtham||3||
vyādhyārtāṃścaturo'pyetān snigdhānkaumbhena sarpiṣā | rasairudārairathavā sirāmokṣeṇa yojayet ||4||

tadeva vidhānamāha- vyādhyārtānityādi| vyādhibhirārtāḥ pīḍitā vyādhyārtāḥ| kaumbhena śatavarṣasthitenetyarthaḥ| rasairudārairathaveti māṃsarasairadhikasnehairvā snigdhānityarthaḥ| dūṣyaharaṇaṃ pratipādayannāha- siretyādi||4||

div.ab: viriktānāṃ prakāmaṃ ca śirāṃsyeṣāṃ viśodhayet | vairecanikasiddhena sitāyuktena sarpiṣā ||5|| (majjñā vā tadvimiśreṇa medasā tacchṛtena vā) |6|

ab.seg: dūṣyaharaṇaṃ pratipādya doṣaharaṇaṃ pratipādayannāha- viriktānāmityādi| śirāṃsīti bahuvacanaṃ pratirogāpekṣayā dūṣye'pahṛte virecanena doṣaharaṇaṃ, tataḥ śirovirecanaṃ; tadapi sarpiṣā natu tailena, ghṛtasya cakṣuṣyatvāt, raktāviruddhatvācca| tasya saṃskāramāha- vairecanikasiddheneti; śirovirecanadravyasiddhena, kecit trivṛtādidravyasiddhenetyāhuḥ| kecidatra ‘majjñā vā tadvipakvena’ ityādipāṭhaṃ paṭhanti, sa cānārṣaḥ||5||
tataḥ pradehāḥ pariṣecanāni nasyāni dhūmāśca yathāsvameva | āścyotanābhyañjanatarpaṇāni snigdhāśca kāryāḥ puṭapākayogāḥ ||6||

antaḥśuddhikaraṃ kriyākramamuktvā bahiḥśuddhikaraṃ kriyākramasaṅgrahamuddiśannāha- tata ityādi| dhūmāśca yathāsvamātmīyānatikrameṇa, raktasya dūṣyasya kaphānubandhe kaphaharadravyavartikṛtāḥ, vātānubandhe tu snaihikāḥ; evamanyatrāpi yathāsvamiti sambandhanīyam| abhyañjanam añjanaṃ; tacca prasādanaṃ raktapitte, savraṇaśukrādau tu ropaṇaṃ; anye punarabhyañjanameva śatadhautaghṛtādinecchanti||6||
nīlotpalośīrakaṭaṅkaṭerīkālīyayaṣṭīmadhumustarodhraiḥ | sapadmakairdhautaghṛtapradigdhairakṣṇoḥ pralepaṃ paritaḥ prakuryāt ||7||
idānīṃ pralepadravyāṇyāha- nīlotpaletyādi| kaṭaṅkaṭerī dāruharidrā| kālīyakaṃ dāruharidrānukāri prasiddham| dhautaghṛtapradigdhaiḥ miśrairityarthaḥ||7||
rujāyāṃ cāpyatibhṛśaṃ svedāśca mṛdavo hitāḥ | akṣṇoḥ samantataḥ kāryaṃ pātanaṃ ca jalaukasām ||8||
ghṛtasya mahatī mātrā pītā cārtiṃ niyacchati | pittābhiṣyandaśamano vidhiścāpyupapāditaḥ ||9||

pariṣecanādyuddiṣṭaṃ yadanirdiṣṭaṃ tatpittābhiṣyandanirdiṣṭadravyairatidiśan kriyākrame'nirdiṣṭaṃ ca nirdiśannāha- rujāyāmityādi| rujo hi bhavanti sirāvyadhādikṛtavātānubandhāt, vātāvṛtādraktādvā; tatra vātajāyāṃ tīvrarujāyāṃ mṛdavaḥ svedāḥ, dūṣyaraktāvarodhādbahuśoṇitajāyāṃ jalaukaḥpātanaṃ; vātajāyāmevāntaramauṣadhaṃ ghṛtasya mahatyā mātrayā pānam; alpaśoṇitajāyāṃ pittābhiṣyandaśamano vidhiḥ| niyacchati nivārayati||8-9||
kaśerumadhukābhyāṃ vā cūrṇamambarasaṃvṛtam | nyastamapsvāntarikṣāsu hitamāścyotanaṃ bhavet ||10||
āścyotanamāha- kaśervityādi| ambarasaṃvṛtaṃ vastraveṣṭitaṃ, nyastaṃ kṣiptaṃ, āntarikṣodakālābhe ākāśaguṇabhūyiṣṭhaṃ bhūmisthamudakaṃ gṛhyate| kecit pariṣekamapyanenaivecchanti||10||
pāṭalyarjunaśrīparṇīdhātakīdhātribilvataḥ | puṣpāṇyatha bṛhatyośca bimbīloṭācca tulyaśaḥ ||11||
samañjiṣṭhāni madhunā piṣṭānīkṣurasena vā | raktābhiṣyandaśāntyarthametadañjanamiṣyate ||12||

raktābhiṣyande'ñjanamāha- pāṭalītyādi| śrīparṇī kāśmarī| dhātrī āmalakī, bimbīloṭo bhilloṭo himādrijo vṛkṣaḥ| virecanādibhirviśuddhadoṣasya puruṣasya śeṣadoṣopaśāntyarthamañjanaṃ yojyaṃ, na punaraśuddhadoṣasyeti||11-12||
candanaṃ kumudaṃ patraṃ śilājatu sakuṅkumam | ayastāmrarajastutthaṃ nimbaniryāsamañjanam ||13||
trapu kāṃsyamalaṃ cāpi piṣṭvā puṣparasena tu | vipulā yāḥ kṛtā vartyaḥ pūjitāścāñjane sadā ||14||

candanamityādi| patraṃ patrakam| añjanaṃ rasāñjanam| puṣparaseneti madhunetyarthaḥ| vipulā yāstā eva manthādiṣu caturṣu lekhanādikarmaṇi sāmarthyāt pūjitā vartayaḥ| taduktaṃ,- “hareṇumātrā vartiḥ syāllekhanasya pramāṇataḥ| prasādanasya cādhyardhā dviguṇā ropaṇasya tu”- iti||13-14||

div.ab: syādañjanaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ sirotpātasya bheṣajam | tadvatsaindhavakāsīsaṃ stanyaghṛṣṭaṃ ca pūjitam ||15|| madhunā śaṅkhanaipālītutthadārvyaḥ sasaindhavāḥ | rasaḥ śirīṣapuṣpācca surāmaricamākṣikaiḥ ||16|| yuktaṃ tu madhunā vā'pi gairikaṃ hitamañjane |17|

manthādīnāṃ caturṇāṃ sāmānyacikitsitamuktvā sirotpāte viśeṣacikitsitamāha- syādañjanamityādi| añjanaṃ rasāñjanaṃ ‘sauvīrāñjanaṃ’ iti pā., ghṛtaṃ gavyaghṛtam| nepālī manaḥśilā| maricaṃ prasiddhaṃ, kecit maricaśabdena sitamaricaṃ śobhāñjanaphalāparaparyāyaṃ vadanti| gairikaṃ svarṇagairikam| etānyañjanānyardhaślaukikānyapyuktāni||15-16||-

ab.seg: sirāharṣe'ñjanaṃ kuryāt phāṇitaṃ madhusaṃyutam ||17||
madhunā tārkṣyajaṃ vā'pi kāsīsaṃ vā sasaindhavam | vetrāmlastanyasaṃyuktaṃ phāṇitaṃ ca sasaindhavam ||18||

sirāharṣa ityādi| phāṇitaṃ madhuyuktamekamañjanamiti; madhuyuktaṃ tārkṣyajaṃ dvitīyamañjanaṃ, tatra tārkṣyajaṃ rasāñjanaṃ; kāsīsaṃ sasaindhavaṃ madhuyuktaṃ tṛtīyamañjanaṃ; vetrāmlastanyasaṃyuktaṃ phāṇitaṃ caturthamañjanaṃ; tatra vetrāmlam amlavetasaṃ, anye tu vetraṃ vetrakarīraṃ, amlam amlavetasam, amlīkā veti vyākhyānayanti; yattu jejjaṭācāryeṇa dūṣitam||17-18||

div.ab: paittaṃ vidhimaśeṣeṇa kuryādarjunaśāntaye | ikṣukṣaudrasitāstanyadārvīmadhukasaindhavaiḥ ||19|| sekāñjanaṃ cātra hitamamlairāścyotanaṃ tathā | sitāmadhukakaṭvaṅgamastukṣaudrāmlasaindhavaiḥ ||20|| bījapūrakakolāmladāḍimāmlaiśca yuktitaḥ | ekaśo vā dviśo vā'pi yojitaṃ vā tribhistribhiḥ ||21|| sphaṭikaṃ vidrumaṃ śaṅkho madhukaṃ madhu caiva hi | śaṅkhakṣaudrasitāyuktaḥ sāmudraḥ phena eva vā ||22|| dvāvimau vihitau yogāvañjane'rjunanāśanau | saindhavakṣaudrakatakāḥ sakṣaudraṃ vā rasāñjanam ||23|| kāsīsaṃ madhunā vā'pi yojyamatrāñjane sadā |24|

raktārjunacikitsāmāha- paittamityādi| paittaṃ pittābhiṣyandoditam| atra arjune| amlaiḥ dhānyāmlādibhiḥ| tatra ikṣukṣaudrādibhiḥ sekāñjane kartavye, amlaiḥ punarāścyotanameva kartavyam| arjune'paramapyāścyotanamāha- sitetyādi| etaiḥ sitādibhirdāḍimāmlaparyantairvyastaiḥ samastairvā yuktito doṣabalāpekṣayā''ścyotanaṃ kāryamiti piṇḍārthaḥ| arjune'ñjanamāha- sphaṭikamityādi| vidṛmaḥ pravālaḥ| arjune'paramapyañjanamāha- saindhavetyādi| saindhavakṣaudrakatakā ityekamañjanaṃ, sakṣaudraṃ vā rasāñjanamityaparaṃ, kāsīsaṃ madhunā vā'pīti tṛtīyamañjanam| atra arjune||19-23||-

lohacūrṇāni sarvāṇi dhātavo lavaṇāni ca ||24|| ratnāni dantāḥ śṛṅgāṇi gaṇaścāpyavasādanaḥ | kukkuṭāṇḍakapālāni laśunaṃ kaṭukatrayam ||25|| karañjabījamelā ca lekhyāñjanamidaṃ smṛtam | puṭapākāvasānena raktavisrāvaṇādinā ||26|| sampāditasya vidhinā kṛtsnena syandaghātinā |27|

lekhyāñjanamāha- lohetyādi| sarvāṇi suvarṇatrapusīsatāmrarajatakṛṣṇalohādijātāni| dhātavo manaḥśilāgairikādayaḥ| lavaṇāni saindhavādīni pañca| ratnāni vaidūryamarakataprabhṛtīni| dantā gavādīnāmaśvādīnāṃ ca| śṛṅgāṇi gavādīnāmeva| avasādano miśrakoktaḥ kāsīsādiḥ| etadanirdiṣṭānāmapi lekhyāñjanasañjñakaṃ jñeyam| aparamapi lekhyāñjanamāha- kukkuṭāṇḍetyādi| lekhyāñjanaṃ kīdṛgvidhasyāturasya prayojyamityāha- puṭapākāvasānenetyādi| raktavisrāvaṇādinā puṭapākāvasānena, syandaghātinā abhiṣyandahananaśīlena, kṛtsnena sakalena vidhinā, sampāditasya samyagyojitasya; sa punarvidhiḥ sirāvyadhavirecanaśirovirecanānyantaḥparimārjanāni; tathā hi,- “tataḥ pradehān pariṣecanāni nasyāni dhūmāśca yathāsvameva| āścyotanābhyañjanatarpaṇāni tathaiva ‘śītāṃśca kuryātpuṭapākayogān’ iti pā. kāryāḥ puṭapākayogāḥ”- iti; lekhyāñjanaṃ prayojanīyamiti piṇḍārthaḥ| ‘puṭapākāvasādena’ iti kecit paṭhanti, puṭapāka evāvasādo'vadhiryasya sa tathā teneti khyānayanti||24-26||-

ab.seg: anenāpaharecchukramavraṇaṃ kuśalo bhiṣak ||27||
imāṃ cikitsāmavraṇe śukre'pyatidiśannāha- anenetyādi| anena lekhyāñjanena pūrvoktena raktavisrāvaṇādyupakrameṇa sampāditasyāturasyāvraṇaṃ śukramapaharediti vākyārthaḥ||27||

div.ab: uttānamavagāḍhaṃ vā karkaśaṃ vā'pi savraṇam | śirīṣabījamaricapippalīsaindhavairapi ||28|| śukrasya gharṣaṇaṃ kāryamathavā saindhavena tu | kuryāttāmrarajaḥśaṅkhaśilāmaricasaindhavaiḥ ||29|| antyāddviguṇitairebhirañjanaṃ śukranāśanam | kuryādañjanayogau vā samyak ślokārdhikāvimau ||30|| śaṅkhakolāsthikatakadrākṣāmadhukamākṣikaiḥ | kṣaudradantārṇavamalaśirīṣakusumairapi ||31|| kṣārāñjanaṃ vā vitaredbalāsagrathitāpaham | mudgān vā nistuṣān bhṛṣṭān śaṅkhakṣaudrasitāyutān ||32|| madhūkasāraṃ madhunā yojayeccāñjane sadā | bibhītakāsthimajjā vā sakṣaudraḥ śukranāśanaḥ ||33|| śaṅkhaśuktimadhudrākṣāmadhukaṃ katakāni ca | dvitvaggate saśūle vā vātaghnaṃ tarpaṇaṃ hitam ||34|| vaṃśajāruṣkarau tālaṃ nārikelaṃ ca dāhayet | visrāvya kṣāravaccūrṇaṃ bhāvayetkarabhāsthijam ||35|| bahuśo'ñjanametatsyācchukravaivarṇyanāśanam |36|

idānīmavraṇaśukracikitsitamabhidhāya savraṇe'pi pūrvaṃ cikitsitamuddiśannāha- uttānamityādi| savraṇamapi śukramuttānamekapaṭalagatam, avagāḍhaṃ vā dvitryādipaṭalagataṃ, raktasrāvaṇetyādinā pūrvoktena vidhinopapādya, lekhayediti samudāyārthaḥ| nanu savraṇasya santarpaṇasādhyatvāt kathaṃ savraṇe lekhanamupayujyate? satyaṃ, karkaśāvasthāyāṃ pūrvaṃ lekhanaṃ prayujyate paścāt santarpaṇamiti na doṣaḥ| ‘karkaśaṃ vāpi savraṇaṃ’ ityatra ‘karṣayeccāpi savraṇaṃ’ iti kecit paṭhanti| etadavasthe eva śukre gharṣaṇamāha ‘etadavasthāyāmeva śukragharṣaṇamāha’ iti pā. - śirīṣabījetyādi| śilā manaḥśilā| kuryādityādi| kau tau ślokārdhikau dvau yogāvityāha- śaṅkhakolāsthītyādi| kolāsthi badarāsthi, katakaṃ śaśapurīṣānukāryambuprasādanaṃ phalaṃ, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu, danto godantaḥ, arṇavamalaṃ samudraphenam| kṣārāñjanamityādi| kṣārāñjanaṃ ‘nīlān yavān gavyapayo'nupītān’ ityādinā śleṣmābhiṣyandoktam| mudgānityādi| mudgān śaṅkhakṣaudrasitāyutānityeko yogaḥ, madhūkasāraṃ madhuneti dvitīyo yogaḥ| bibhītaketyādi| bibhītakāsthimajjā madhunetyeko yogaḥ; śaṅkhādikatakaparyantaṃ madhuneti dvitīyo yogaḥ, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu| kecit śaṅkhaśuktītyatra śaṅkhāśmanteti paṭhanti| dvitvaggata ityādi| dvitvaggate dvipaṭalāśrite śukra ityarthaḥ| kecidamuṃ pāṭhaṃ na paṭhanti, jejjaṭena paṭhitatvādasmābhiḥ paṭhitaḥ| vaṃśajetyādi| vaṃśajo vaṃśakarīraḥ, vaṃśāṅkura iti yāvat| aruṣkarādīnāṃ paripakvāsthi, anye jaṭāmāhuḥ| eteṣāṃ vaṃśajādīnāṃ tilanāladīpitānāṃ bhasma, tacca karabhāsthicūrṇasamaṃ pratyahamākṛṣya, ṣaḍguṇodakenāṣṭaguṇodakena vā niṣkvāthya, pādaśeṣaṃ bahuśo visrāvya, svasthena tena saptāhaṃ karabhāsthicūrṇaṃ bhāvayitvā''tape śoṣayet, taccūrṇaṃ punaśca cūrṇitaṃ kṛtvā, madhvāktenāṅgulyagreṇa śalākayā vā saṅgṛhya śukradeśamātraṃ gharṣayet, tatastriphalodakenākṣi prakṣālayet| śukravaivarṇyanāśanamiti śukrasya vaivarṇyaṃ vināśayati na tu śukraṃ, etena śukrasya kṛṣṇatāmutpādayatītyarthaḥ||28-35||-

ab.seg: ajakāṃ pārśvato viddhvā sūcyā visrāvya codakam ||36||
vraṇaṃ gomāṃsacūrṇena pūrayet sarpiṣā saha | bahuśo'valikheccāpi vartmāsyopagataṃ yadi ||37||

asādhyaśukravaivarṇyanāśanaprasaṅgenāsādhyājakājātasya vaikṛtanāśanārthaṃ cikitsāmāha- ajakāmityādi| kecidamuṃ pāṭhaṃ na paṭhanti, jejjaṭapaṭhitatvādasmābhiḥ paṭhitaḥ| atrājakāyāmavasthāyāṃ lekhanamapi karmātidiśannāha- bahuśo'valikhedityādi| asya ajakājātasya, vartma tuṇḍaṃ ‘oṣṭhaḥ’ iti pā., upagataṃ yadyuccatāṃ prāptaṃ, tadā taṃ bahuśo'valikhet||36-37||

div.ab: saśophaścāpyaśophaśca dvau pākau yau prakīrtitau | snehasvedopapannasya tatra viddhvā sirāṃ bhiṣak ||38|| sekāścyotananasyāni puṭapākāṃśca kārayet |39|

idānīṃ vātapittakaphaśoṇitānāṃ pṛthagabhiṣyandapratiṣedhamabhidhāya sānnipātikānāmapyupadeṣṭumāha- saśopha ityādi| tatreti tayoḥ pākayoḥ| sirāścātra āpāṅgyā aupanāsikā lālāṭhyā vā| āścyotanam akṣipūraṇam||38||-

sarvataścāpi śuddhasya kartavyamidamañjanam ||39|| tāmrapātrasthitaṃ māsaṃ ‘māṃsaṃ sarpiḥsaindhavasaṃyutam’ iti pā. sarpiḥ saindhavasaṃyutam | maireyaṃ vā'pi dadhyevaṃ dadhyuttarakameva vā ||40|| ghṛtaṃ kāṃsyamalopetaṃ stanyaṃ vā'pi sasaindhavam | madhūkasāraṃ madhunā tulyāṃśaṃ gairikeṇa vā ||41|| sarpiḥsaindhavatāmrāṇi yoṣitstanyayutāni vā |42|

tayorañjanāvasthāmuddiśannāha- sarvata ityādi| sarvataścāpi śuddhasyeti antaḥparimārjanabahiḥparimārjanābhyāṃ śuddhasyetyarthaḥ| idaṃ vakṣyamāṇam| tadevāñjanamāha- tāmrapātrasthitamityādi| maireyaṃ surāsavayorekatra sandhānaṃ, dadhi prasiddhaṃ, evamiti pūrvavat tāmrapātrasthitaṃ saindhavacūrṇayuktamityarthaḥ, dadhyuttarakaṃ dadhnaḥ saraḥ| snehāñjanaṃ raktāpakarṣaṇādinā virūkṣitākṣasya yojyaṃ; vātolbaṇapākasya vā maireyaṃ dadhi ca tāmrapātrasthitaṃ saindhavayuktaṃ, pittolbaṇe nātivirūkṣite dadhyuttarakaṃ ca, saśophasya ca raktāsrāvādisampāditasya ghṛtaṃ kāṃsyamalayuktañjanaṃ stanyaṃ vā saindhavayuktamañjanaṃ, madhūkasāraṃ vā gairikeṇa tulyāṃśaṃ madhunā'ñjanaṃ, ghṛtādīni trīṇi stanyenāñjanaṃ, etāni sāvaśeṣaraktayoḥ pākayoryojyāni||39-41||-

ab.seg: dāḍimārevatāśamantakolāmlaiśca sasaindhavām | rasakriyāṃ vā vitaretsamyakpākajighāṃsayā ||42||

rasakriyāmāha- dāḍimetyādi| ārevataḥ kṛtamālakaḥ; ‘airāvata’ iti kecit paṭhanti, tatra airāvato nāraṅgam| sasaindhavām alpasaindhavāṃ, na samasaindhavāmityarthaḥ| rasakriyā phāṇitākṛtiḥ, tasyāśca kalpanā pittābhiṣyandapratiṣedhe vyākhyātā| ‘kolāmlaiśca sasaindhavām’ ityatra ‘kolāmlamadhusaindhavaiḥ’ iti kecit paṭhanti||42||
māsaṃ ‘māṃsaṃ’ iti pā. saindhavasaṃyuktaṃ sthitaṃ sarpiṣi nāgaram | āścyotanāñjanaṃ yojyamabalākṣīrasaṃyutam ||43||
āścyotanamāha- māsamityādi| abalākṣīraṃ strīstanyaṃ, tacca peṣaṇe boddhavyam| etaccāścyotanaṃ saśophe pāke kapholbaṇe||43||
jātyāḥ puṣpaṃ saindhavaṃ śṛṅgaveraṃ kṛṣṇābījaṃ kīṭaśatrośca sāram | etat piṣṭaṃ netrapāke'ñjanārthaṃ kṣaudropetaṃ nirviśaṅkaṃ ‘nirviśaṅkaiḥ’ iti pā. prayojyam ||44||
jātyā ityādi| kṛṣṇābījaṃ pippalītaṇḍulaḥ| kīṭaśatruḥ viḍaṅgaḥ| nirviśaṅkaṃ prayojyamiti pākayorañjanāvasthāyāṃ deyaṃ tadañjanamiti tātparyārthaḥ||44||
pūyālase śoṇitamokṣaṇaṃ ca hitaṃ tathaivāpyupanāhanaṃ ca | kṛtsno vidhiścekṣaṇapākaghātī yathāvidhānaṃ bhiṣajā prayojyaḥ ||45||

pūyālase sannipātaje kriyāmāha- pūyālase ityādi| śoṇitamokṣaṇaṃ ca snehasvedapūrvakameva| upanāhanamiti yathādoṣaharavraṇaśodhanacakṣuṣyadravyakṛtaḥ pralepo bandhanaṃ vā| kṛtsno vidhiriti antaḥśuddhikaro bahiḥśuddhikaraścetyarthaḥ| yathāvidhānamiti hitānatikrameṇetyarthaḥ||45||
kāsīsasindhuprabhavārdrakaistu hitaṃ bhavedañjanameva cātra | kṣaudrānvitairebhirathopayuñjyādanyattu tāmrāyasacūrṇayuktaiḥ ||46||
