idānīmapyekaikamañjanaṃ guṭikādibhedāttriprakāramiti darśayannāha- guṭikārasetyādi| raso'tra ghanaraso rasakriyetyarthaḥ| yathāpūrvaṃ balaṃ teṣāmiti etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati- mahābalānāṃ rogāṇāṃ guṭikāñjanaṃ, madhyānāṃ rasakriyāñjanaṃ, hīnānāṃ cūrṇāñjanam||58||
hareṇumātrā vartiḥ syāllekhanasya pramāṇataḥ | prasādanasya cādhyardhā dviguṇā ropaṇasya ca ||59||
idānīṃ pramāṇāvasaraḥ- hareṇumātrā vartirityādi| hareṇuḥ vartulakalāyaḥ, adhyardhā sārdhakalāyapramāṇetyarthaḥ, dviguṇā dvikalāyapramāṇetyarthaḥ||59||

div.ab: rasāñjanasya mātrā tu yathāvartimitā ‘piṣṭā vartimitā’ iti pā. matā |60|

guṭikāñjanapramāṇamabhidhāya rasakriyāñjanapramāṇamāha- rasāñjanasyetyādi| rasāñjanasya rasakriyāñjanasya, ‘rasāñjanadravyasya’ ityeke, tanmate rasakriyāñjanapramāṇamanyatrānveṣaṇīyam| yathāvartimitā matā iti yathāsvavartipramāṇamātretyarthaḥ| tatra lekhanarasakriyāñjanasya lekhanavartivat pramāṇaṃ, ropaṇasya ropaṇavartivat, prasādanasya prasādanavartivat|60|-

ab.seg: dvitricatuḥśalākāśca cūrṇasyāpyanupūrvaśaḥ ||60||
cūrṇāñjanapramāṇamāha- dvitricaturityādi| anupūrvaśo lekhanādīnāmañjanānāmānupūrvyeṇetyarthaḥ| tatra śalākādvayaṃ lekhanacūrṇasya, tisro ropaṇasya, catasraḥ prasādanasya||60||

div.ab: teṣāṃ tulyaguṇānyeva vidadhyādbhājanānyapi | sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ śārṅgaṃ tāmraṃ vaidūryakāṃsyajam ||61|| āyasāni ca yojyāni śalākāśca yathākramam |62|

idānīmañjanāni kiṅguṇe kimmaye pātre sthāpayitavyāni, tathā kiṅguṇāni kimmayaśalākānītyāha- teṣāmityādi| tulyaguṇānīti sauvarṇe madhuraṃ, rājate amlaṃ, śārṅge meṣaśṛṅgamaye lavaṇaṃ, tāmre lohamaye vā kaṣāyaṃ, vaidūrye kaṭukaṃ, kāṃsye tiktaṃ, śītāñjanaṃ tu nalādimaye, evaṃ samānaguṇāni bhājanāni vidadhyāt kuryāt| śalākāścaiṣāṃ bhājanadravyaguṇena yathākramameva vyākhyātāḥ||61||-
vaktrayormukulākārā kalāyaparimaṇḍalā ||62|| aṣṭāṅgulā tanurmadhye sukṛtā sādhunigrahā |63|

tāsāṃ śalākānāmākāramuddiśannāha- vaktrayormukulākāretyādi| mukulākārā mallikādimukulasyeva nirgacchato yadvanmukhaṃ tadākārā; kalāyaparimaṇḍalatvena tīkṣṇāgratvaniṣedhaḥ; sukṛtā karkaśādidoṣarahitā; sādhunigrahā sukhagrahetyarthaḥ||62||-

ab.seg: audumbaryaśmajā vā'pi śārīrī vā hitā bhavet ||63||

idānīṃ tāmrādijānāṃ śalākānāṃ hitatvaṃ pratipādayannāha- audumbarītyādi| audumbarī tāmramayī, aśmajā vaidūryādipāṣāṇajā, śārīrī śṛṅgādijā, apiśabdāt suvarṇādijā'pi hitetyarthaḥ| tathā ca tantrāntare,- “āyasī ropaṇe, tāmrā lekhye, haimī prasādane| śeṣā api yathādoṣaṃ prayojyā rasakovidaiḥ”- iti| kecit śārīrīśabdena aṅgulimācakṣate, tannecchati gayī||63||
vāmenākṣi vinirbhujya hastena susamāhitaḥ | śalākayā dakṣiṇena kṣipet kānīnamañjanam ||64||
āpāṅgyaṃ vā yathāyogaṃ kuryāccāpi gatāgatam | vartmopalepi vā yattadaṅgulyaiva prayojayet ||65||

vāmenetyādi| nirbhujya vakrīkṛtya| kanīnyāṃ nāsāsamīpe netrāvayave añjanaṃ kānīnaṃ, taccāñjanaṃ kanīnakapradeśādapāṅgaṃ nayet, āpāṅgyaṃ ceti apāṅge netrānte bhavam āpāṅgyaṃ, taccāpāṅgapradeśāt kanīnakapradeśaṃ nayet| paraṃ yathāyogaṃ yathā'tiyogahīnayogau na bhavata ityarthaḥ| evaṃ gatāgatamapi kuryāt| etacchalākayā antarnayanamañjanapraṇidhānaṃ boddhavyam| antarnayanapraṇidhānamabhidhāya bahirañjanapraṇidhānamāha- vartmetyādi| vartmopalepi vartmopalepanayogyam||64-65||

div.ab: akṣi nātyantayorañjyādbādhamāno'pi vā bhiṣak |66|

akṣītyādi| antayoḥ kanīnakāpāṅgayoḥ| nātyañjyāt īṣadañjyāt, kṣatabhayāt| bādhamāno'pi veti bādhāṃ kurvan vaidyo vā nāñjyādityarthaḥ| ‘akṣi nātyantayorañjyāt’ ityatra ‘nātyantamañjayedakṣi’ iti kecit paṭhanti; tatra ca pāṭhe sarvatrāpyatyantāñjananiṣedhaḥ kṛto bhavati|66|-
na cānirvāntadoṣe'kṣṇi dhāvanaṃ samprayojayet ||66|| doṣaḥ pratinivṛttaḥ san hanyād dṛṣṭerbalaṃ tathā |67|

idānīmakāle prakṣālananiṣedhamāha- na cetyādi| na cānirvāntadoṣe iti niścayena samyagyogena na vānto'śrudūṣikādirūpo doṣo yena tasminnityarthaḥ| dhāvanaṃ na samprayojayet prakṣālanaṃ na prayojayet, doṣapratyāvṛttihetutvāt| akālaprakṣālanāt kiṃ syādityāha- doṣa ityādi| pratinivṛttaḥ punarāvṛttaḥ| tathetyakālaprakṣālanaprakāreṇetyarthaḥ||66||-
gatadoṣamapetāśru paśyedyat samyagambhasā ||67|| prakṣālyākṣi yathādoṣaṃ kāryaṃ pratyañjanaṃ tataḥ |68|

kīdṛśaṃ punaścakṣuḥ prakṣālyamityāha- gatadoṣamityādi| pratyañjanaṃ tīkṣṇāñjanena kaṭubhūtanayanasya yadañjanaṃ śītaṃ, tathā śītena jaḍībhūtanayanasya yattīkṣṇamañjanamityarthaḥ| kecidamuṃ pāṭhaṃ na paṭhanti, tannecchati gayī||67||-

ab.seg: śramodāvartaruditamadyakrodhabhayajvaraiḥ ||68||
vegāghātaśirodoṣaiścārtānāṃ neṣyate'ñjanam | rāgaruktimirāsrāvaśūlasaṃrambhasambhavāt ||69||

idānīmañjanasya pūrvāhṇādikān kālān sāmānyena svasthāturayoḥ pratipādya, āvasthikeṣu kāleṣvañjananiṣedhamāha- śramodāvartetyādi| śramādibhirārtānāṃ puruṣāṇāmañjanaṃ neṣyata iti sambandhaḥ| kecidatra ‘śānte bhīte prarudite madyapīte navajvare| uṣṇe vegābhighāte ca nāñjanaṃ sampraśasyate’ iti paṭhanti, tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ| kasmācchramādibhirārtānāmañjanaṃ neṣyata ityāha- rāgarugityādi| saṃrambhaḥ śvayathuḥ||68-69||
nidrākṣaye kriyāśaktiṃ, pravāte dṛgbalakṣayam | rajodhūmahate rāgasrāvādhīmanthasambhavam ||70||
saṃrambhaśūlau nasyānte, śiroruji śirorujam | śiraḥsnāte'tiśīte ca ravāvanudite'pi ca ||71||
doṣasthairyādapārthaṃ syāddoṣotkleśaṃ karoti ca | ajīrṇe'pyevameva syāt srotomārgāvarodhanāt ||72||
doṣavegodaye dattaṃ kuryāttāṃstānupadravān | tasmāt pariharan doṣānañjanaṃ sādhu yojayet ||73||

idānīṃ sāmānyenāñjanavaiguṇyena vyāpadaḥ pradarśya prativaiguṇyaṃ vyāpada āha- nidrākṣaye ityādi| kriyāśaktiṃ nimeṣonmeṣaṇādīnāmaśaktim ‘añjanaṃ karoti’ ityadhyāhāryam| kecit kriyāsaṅgamiti paṭhanti| pravāte ityādi| dṛgbalaṃ dṛṣṭerbalamityarthaḥ| saṃrambhaḥ śvayathuḥ| apārtham akiñcitkaram| etaduktaṃ bhavati- etaiḥ snānādibhiḥ sthirīkṛtasya doṣasya nirharaṇaṃ kartumañjanaṃ na śankotītyarthaḥ| evamevetyapārthakamañjanaṃ syāt doṣotkleśaṃ ca karotītyarthaḥ| upadravān rāgaśophādikān| sādhu yojayediti deśakālāvasthāpekṣamityarthaḥ||70-73||

div.ab: lekhanasya viśeṣeṇa kāla eṣa prakīrtitaḥ |74|
lekhanasyetyādi| lekhanasya lekhanāñjanasyaiṣa pūrvoktaḥ pratiṣedhakālaḥ|74|-
vyāpadaśca jayedetāḥ sekāścyotanalepanaiḥ ||74|| yathāsvaṃ dhūmakavalairnasyaiścāpi samutthitāḥ |75|
akālāñjanakṛtānāṃ vyāpadāṃ cikitsitamāha- vyāpada ityādi| etā rāgarujādyāḥ samutthitā vyāpado yathāsvaṃ sekādibhirjayediti sambandhaḥ||74||-
viśadaṃ laghvanāsrāvi kriyāpaṭu sunirmalam ||75|| saṃśāntopadravaṃ netraṃ viriktaṃ samyagādiśet |76|
idānīṃ lekhanāñjanasya samyagyogalakṣaṇamāha- viśadamityādi||75||-
jihmaṃ dāruṇadurvarṇaṃ srastaṃ rūkṣamatīva ca ||76|| netraṃ virekātiyoge syandate cātimātraśaḥ |77|
lekhanāñjanasyātiyogalakṣaṇamāha- jihmamityādi| jihmaṃ vakraṃ, dāruṇaṃ kaṭhinaṃ, syandate sravati||76||-

ab.seg: tatra santarpaṇaṃ kāryaṃ vidhānaṃ cānilāpaham ||77||
lekhanāñjanātiyogapratīkāramāha- tatretyādi| tatreti lekhanāñjanātiyoge ityarthaḥ||77||

div.ab: akṣi mandaviriktaṃ syādudagrataradoṣavat |78|
lekhanāñjanasya hīnayogamāha- akṣi mandaviriktamityādi| udagrataradoṣavat utkaṭataradoṣayuktam|78|-

ab.seg: dhūmanasyāñjanaistatra hitaṃ doṣāvasecanam ||78||
hīnayogapratīkāramāha- dhūmanasyāñjanairityādi| kecidatra ‘nasyadhūmāñjanālepairjayecchleṣmāṇamīritam’ iti pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti; tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ||78||
snehavarṇabalopetaṃ prasannaṃ doṣavarjitam | jñeyaṃ prasādane samyagupayukte'kṣi nirvṛtam ||79||
prasādanāñjanasya samyagyogamāha- snehetyādi| nirvṛtaṃ sarvakriyākṣamam, upaśāntopadravamiti yāvat||79||

div.ab: kiñjiddhīnavikāraṃ syāttarpaṇāddhi kṛtādati |80|
prasādanāñjanātiyogamāha- kiñcidityādi| tarpaṇādatikṛtāt sakṛdatikṛte prasādanāñjane kiñciddhīnavikāraṃ cakṣuḥ syāditi tātparyārthaḥ|80|-

ab.seg: tatra doṣaharaṃ rūkṣaṃ bheṣajaṃ śasyate mṛdu ||80||
prasādanāñjanātiyogacikitsāmāha- tatretyādi| doṣaharaṃ kaphaharamityarthaḥ| mṛdu mṛduvīryaṃ śītavīryamityarthaḥ; uṣṇena hi nayanaṃ duṣyati na tu prasādyate||80||
sādhāraṇamapi jñeyamevaṃ ropaṇalakṣaṇam | prasādanavadācaṣṭe tasmin yukte'tibheṣajam ||81||

idānīṃ ropaṇāñjanasya samyagyogamatiyogaṃ cātideśenāha- sādhāraṇamityādi| evaṃ ropaṇalakṣaṇamiti prasādanāñjanasya samyagyogātiyogaprakāreṇa ropaṇāñjanasya samyagyogātiyogalakṣaṇaṃ jñeyam| paraṃ sādhāraṇaṃ nātisnigdharūkṣamiti yāvat| anye tu ropaṇalakṣaṇamevaṃ prasādanāñjanavyañjanena sādhāraṇaṃ samānaṃ jñeyamiti vyākhyānayanti| ropaṇāñjanātiyoge cikitsāmāha- prasādanavadityādi| tasmin ropaṇāñjane'tiprayukte prasādanavat prasādanāñjanātiyogavadbheṣajamācaṣṭe brūyāditi piṇḍārthaḥ||81||

div.ab: snehanaṃ ropaṇaṃ vā'pi hīnayuktamapārthakam |82|
idānīṃ prasādanaropaṇayorhīnayogamāha- snehanamityādi| snehanaṃ prasādanāñjanam| apārthakam akiñcitkaram|82|-

ab.seg: kartavyaṃ mātrayā tasmādañjanaṃ siddhimicchatā ||82||

kartavyamityādi| mātrayeti yathā hīnātiyogau na bhavataḥ| siddhiṃ vikāranivṛttim| asyāgre vidyamānapustakeṣu ‘dhūmairnasyāñjanairvā'pi doṣaśeṣaṃ śamaṃ nayet’ iti pāṭho vidyate, sa jejjaṭādibhirna paṭhitaḥ, tasmānna paṭhitavyaḥ||82||
puṭapākakriyadyāsu kriyāsveṣai(kai)va kalpanā | sahasraśaścāñjaneṣu bījenoktena pūjitāḥ ||83||

idānīmañjanoktena madhurarasavarjapañcarasena lekhanāñjanakalpanābījena, tathā tiktakaṣāyeṇa sasnehena ropaṇāñjanakalpanābījena, tathā madhurarasena snehasampannena prasādanāñjanakalpanābījena, puṭapākādyāsu kriyāsvañjaneṣvapi lekhanaropaṇaprasādanakalpanāḥ sahasraprakārāḥ kalpanīyā ityāha- puṭapāketyādi| añjaneṣūktena lekhanaropaṇaprasādanākhyena bījena puṭapākakriyādyāsu kriyāsu tathā'nukteṣvañjaneṣvapyauṣadhakalpanāḥ lekhanaropaṇaprasādanākhyāḥ sahasraśaḥ pūjitā iti piṇḍārthaḥ| puṭapākakriyādyāsvityatra ādiśabdāt sekāścyotanādayo gṛhyante| anye tvañjanoktena hīnayogātiyogacikitsābījena puṭapākādihīnātiyogacikitsitaṃ vyācakṣate, tannecchati gayī||83||
dṛṣṭerbalavivṛddhyarthaṃ yāpyarogakṣayāya ca | rājārhānyañjanāgryāṇi nibodhemānyataḥ param ||84||

idānīṃ rogāpaharaṇaprayogāṇyañjanānyabhidhāya svasthāturahitānyañjanānyāha- dṛṣṭerbalavivṛddhyarthamityādi| dṛṣṭirmasuradalamātrā tacchaktibalādhānārthaṃ svasthena prasādāñjanaṃ kāryam, ātureṇa yāpyarogaprasādanāñjanaṃ kāryaṃ; yāpyarogāśca ‘sampaśyataḥ ṣaḍapi ye'bhihitāstu kācā’ ityādiproktāḥ| kecitpāpmarogakṣayāya ceti paṭhanti, pāpmaśabdena ca srāvaṇaṃ kathayanti||84||
aṣṭau bhāgānañjanasya nīlotpalasamatviṣaḥ | audumbaraṃ śātakumbhaṃ rājataṃ ca samāsataḥ ||85||
ekādaśaitān bhāgāṃstu yojayet kuśalo bhiṣak | mūṣākṣiptaṃ tadādhmātamāvṛtaṃ jātavedasi ||86||
khadirāśmantakāṅgārairgośakṛdbhirathāpi vā | gavāṃ śakṛdrase mūtre dadhni sarpiṣi mākṣike ||87||
tailamadyavasāmajjasarvagandhodakeṣu ca | drākṣārasekṣutriphalāraseṣu suhimeṣu ca ||88||
sārivādikaṣāye ca kaṣāye cotpalādike | niṣecayet pṛthak cainaṃ dhmātaṃ dhmātaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||89||
tato'ntarīkṣe saptāhaṃ plotabaddhaṃ sthitaṃ jale | viśoṣya cūrṇayenmuktāṃ sphaṭikaṃ vidrumaṃ tathā ||90||
kālānusārivāṃ cāpi śucirāvāpya yogataḥ | etaccūrṇāñjanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ nihitaṃ bhājane śubhe ||91||
dantasphaṭikavaidūryaśaṅkhaśailāsanodbhave | śātakumbhe'tha śārṅge vā rājate vā susaṃskṛte | sahasrapākavat pūjāṃ kṛtvā rājñaḥ prayojayet ||92||
tenāñjitākṣo nṛpatirbhavet sarvajanapriyaḥ | adhṛṣyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ dṛṣṭirogavivarjitaḥ ||93||

tānyañjanāni darśayannāha- aṣṭāvityādi| añjanasya sauvīrāñjanasya, srotojarasāñjanasyetyanye; nīlotpalasamatviṣaḥ nīlotpalavarṇasyetyarthaḥ; ‘nīlotpalasugandhinaḥ’ iti kecit paṭhanti| audumbaraṃ tāmrabhāgaṃ, śātakumbhaṃ suvarṇabhāgaṃ, rājataṃ rūpyabhāgam, etena tāmrādīnāṃ pratyekamekaikaṃ bhāgaṃ, evamekādaśa bhāgāḥ pūryante| mūṣā mṛtkalpitā; sā tu dhātuvādināṃ gṛhe prasiddhā| āvṛtaṃ vilīnaṃ, jātavedasi agnau, aṅgāraiḥ dagdhanirvāpitakṛṣṇavarṇakāṣṭhakhaṇḍaiḥ, gośakṛdbhiḥ śuṣkairgopurīṣaiḥ, gavāmiti padaṃ śakṛdrasādiṣu sarpiḥparyanteṣu sambadhyate| mākṣike madhuni, vasā śuddhamāṃsasnehaḥ| antarīkṣe tathā jale pānīye| plotabaddhaṃ karpaṭabaddham| kecicchikyāropitaṃ pānīyamāntarīkṣaṃ kathayanti| viśoṣya saptarātrādanantaraṃ tadañjanaṃ śoṣayitvetyarthaḥ| muktā mauktikaṃ, vidrumaṃ pravālaṃ, kālānusārivā tagaramūlaṃ, jejjaṭastu dvitīyasārivāmāha| śuciriti vaidyaviśeṣaṇam| āvāpya prakṣipya, yogataḥ alpamātrayā| anye tu sauvīrāñjanādīnāṃ caturthāṃśena muktādicūrṇaṃ prakṣipyeti vyākhyānayanti| nihitaṃ nikṣiptam| asano bījakaḥ, śātakumbhe suvarṇamaye, śārṅge meṣaśṛṅgamaye| kecidatra sphaṭikavaidūryādibhājanapāṭhaṃ na paṭhanti; te cātra pātrāṇāṃ tāmrarajatasuvarṇānāṃ śubhabhājanaṃ gṛhṇanti| sahasrapākavat śaṅkhadundubhinirghoṣādinā, pūjyaṃ pūjanīyam| kṛtveti padaṃ nihitamityatra sambandhanīyam| kecit sahasrapākavat pūjāṃ kṛtveti paṭhanti| adhṛṣyaḥ agamyaḥ| sarvabhūtānāṃ devāsuragandharvayakṣarakṣaḥpitṛpiśācanāgānāmaṣṭānām| ‘dṛṣṭirāgavivarjitaṃ’ iti kecit paṭhanti, rāgaśabdena ‘sampaśyataḥ ṣaḍapi ye'bhihitāstu kācā’ iti vyākhyānayanti||85-93||
kuṣṭhaṃ candanamelāśca patraṃ madhukamañjanam | meṣaśṛṅgasya puṣpāṇi vakraṃ ratnāni sapta ca ||94||
utpalasya bṛhatyośca padmasyāpi ca keśaram | nāgapuṣpamuśīrāṇi pippalī tutthamuttamam ||95||
kukkuṭāṇḍakapālāni dārvīṃ pathyāṃ sarocanām | maricānyakṣamajjānaṃ tulyāṃ ca gṛhagopikām ||96||
kṛtvā sūkṣmaṃ tataścūrṇaṃ nyasedabhyarcya pūrvavat | etadbhadrodayaṃ nāma sadaivārhati bhūmipaḥ ||97||

kuṣṭhamityādi| vakraṃ tagaraṃ, ratnāni sapta padmarāgamarakatanīlavavaidūryamuktāpravālahemāni| utpalasya nīlotpalasya, puṣpāṇi kusumāni, bṛhatyoḥ kaṇṭakārīdvayasyāpi kusumāni, tutthamuttamaṃ mayūragrīvākhyaṃ, kecit tutthaṃ kharparikātutthaṃ, uttamaṃ mayūragrīvākhyatutthamiti vyākhyānayanti, gṛhagopikā gṛhagodhikā, gṛhakāriketyanye| nyaset śubhe bhājane prakṣipet| abhyarcya śaṅkhadundubhinirghoṣādinā pūjāṃ kṛtvā| pūrvavat yādṛgguṇaṃ pūrvāñjanaṃ tādṛgguṇametadapi syādityarthaḥ| anye tu pūrvavat śaṅkhadundubhinirghoṣādinā'bhyarcyetyāhuḥ| bhadrodayaṃ bhadrasya kalyāṇasya udayo lābho yasmāttattathā; anye tu bhadra udayo yasyetyāhuḥ||94-97||
vakraṃ samaricaṃ caiva māṃsīṃ śaileyameva ca | tulyāṃśāni samānaistaiḥ samagraiśca manaḥśilā ||98||
patrasya bhāgāścatvāro dviguṇaṃ sarvato'ñjanam | tāvacca yaṣṭīmadhukaṃ pūrvavaccaitadañjanam ||99||

vakramityādi| samānaistaiḥ samagraiśca manaḥśileti samabhāgaiḥ sarvadravyaiḥ samā manaḥśiletyarthaḥ| patrasya bhāgāścatvāra iti ādyadravyāt patrakasya catvāro bhāgāḥ| dviguṇaṃ sarvato'ñjanaṃ sarvasmādeva samuditāñjanacūrṇāddviguṇaṃ sauvīrāñjanam; anye tu añjanaśabdena srotojarasāñjanamāhuḥ| tāvacca yaṣṭīmadhukaṃ sauvīrāñjanapramāṇaṃ yaṣṭīmadhukamityarthaḥ| anye tu sarvadravyasamaṃ yaṣṭīmadhukamicchanti| pūrvavat pūrvamaṣṭau bhāgānañjanasyeti yaduktamañjanaṃ tattulyametadapyañjanaṃ phalaśrutyā śaṅkhādidhvanipūjanena bhājanasthāpanena ca| asyāgre keciduśīrādyañjanaṃ paṭhanti, taccābhāvānna likhitam||98-99||
manaḥśilāṃ devakāṣṭhaṃ rajanyau triphaloṣaṇam | lākṣālaśunamañjiṣṭhāsaindhavailāḥ samākṣikāḥ ||100||
rodhraṃ sāvarakaṃ cūrṇamāyasaṃ tāmrameva ca | kālānusārivāṃ caiva kukkuṭāṇḍadalāni ca ||101||
tulyāni payasā piṣṭvā guṭikāṃ kārayedbudhaḥ | kaṇḍūtimiraśuklārmaraktarājyupaśāntaye ||102||
manaḥśiletyādi| ūṣaṇaṃ maricam||100-102||
kāṃsyāpamārjanamasī madhukaṃ saindhavaṃ tathā | eraṇḍamūlaṃ ca samaṃ bṛhatyaṃśadvayānvitam ||103||
ājena payasā piṣṭvā tāmrapātraṃ pralepayet | saptakṛtvastu tā vartyaśchāyāśuṣkā rujāpahāḥ ||104||

kāṃsyāpamārjanamasītyādi| kāṃsyāpamārjanamasī kāṃsyāpamārjanasyollekhananīlikā, nataṃ tagaramūlaṃ, bṛhatyaṃśadvayānvitaṃ bṛhatīphalayorbṛhatīmūlayorvā ādyadravyādyadaṃśadvayaṃ tena samanvitam||103-104||
pathyātutthakayaṣṭyāhvaistulyairmaricaṣoḍaśā | pathyā sarvavikāreṣu vartiḥ śītāmbupeṣitā ||105||
pathyātutthaketyādi| maricasya ṣoḍaśabhāgo yasyāḥ sā maricaṣoḍaśā vartiḥ| pathyā hitā||105||
rasakriyāvidhānena yathoktavidhikovidaḥ | piṇḍāñjanāni kurvīta yathāyogamatandritaḥ ||106||

sā punaḥ śuṣkā vartirañjane'vacāryamāṇā nayane kṣatādijananītyāśaṅkya tasyāḥ prayogamāha- rasakriyāvidhānenetyādi| rasakriyāvidhānena rasakriyāyā yadvidhānaṃ nātitanu nātighanaṃ śalākopalepakṣamamaṅgulyupalepakṣamaṃ vā tenetyarthaḥ| piṇḍāñjanāni vartyañjanāni śilāpaṭṭakaghṛṣṭāni piṣṭāni vā| etenaitaduktaṃ- na kadācidapi śuṣkavartyā nayanamañjyāditi tātparyārthaḥ| yathāyogamiti yathā nayane kṣatādayo na bhaveyurityarthaḥ| atandritaḥ analasaḥ| kecidamuṃ ślokamanyathā vyākhyānayanti, tacca vistarabhayānna likhitam||106||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre kriyākalpo nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||18||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālakyatantre'ṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ||18||

div.head: nayanābhighātapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto nayanābhighātapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

kriyākalpānantaraṃ śārīradoṣanimittānāṃ nayanāmayānāmuktatvādbāhyanimittasyāvaśiṣṭatvāccikitsārthaṃ nayanābhighātapratiṣedhādhyāyārambho yukta ityata āha- athāta ityādi| abhighātaśabdenātrābhighātajanitā vedanādayaḥ, teṣāṃ pratiṣedhaścikitsitam| sa cābhighāto mūrtena daṇḍādinā amūrtena bhayaśokādinā vā||1-2||

div.ab: abhyāhate tu nayane bahudhā narāṇāṃ saṃrambharāgatumulāsu rujāsu dhīmān | nasyāsyalepapariṣecanatarpaṇādyamuktaṃ punaḥ kṣatajapittajaśūlapathyam ||3|| dṛṣṭiprasādajananaṃ vidhimāśu kuryāt snigdhairhimaiśca madhuraiśca tathā prayogaiḥ |4|

tamevābhighātaṃ mūrtadaṇḍādijaṃ cikitsābhedayoginaṃ darśayannāha- abhyāhate ityādi| narāṇāṃ bahudhā abhyāhate nayane sati saṃrambharāgatumulāsu rujāsu nasyāsyalepādyaṃ karma kṣatajapittajaśūlapathyaṃ yaduktaṃ tathā snigdhādibhirdṛṣṭiprasādajananaṃ vidhiṃ dhīmānāśu kuryāditi piṇḍārthaḥ| bahudhā bahuprakāram| tathā ca videhaḥ,- “tīkṣṇāñjanātiparikliṣṭeṣu netreṣu vātātapadhūmarajavyāpārakīṭamakṣikāmaśakasparśādibhirabhihateṣu salilakrīḍājāgaraṇalaṅghanāplutābhidruteṣu śrāntaklānteṣu bhayārditeṣu divākarāgnicandragrahanakṣatrakramaṇakarmavividharūpaprekṣaṇādyabhihateṣu durbaleṣu netreṣu rāgadāhatodaśophapākagharṣādivedanāsu”- iti| saṃrambharāgābhyāṃ tumulāḥ saṅkulāḥ saṃrambharāgatumulāstāsu| anye tu saṃrambhaśca rāgaśca tumulaśca saṃrambharāgatumulāstāsu; tumulāḥ pracaṇḍāḥ, saṃrambhaḥ śvayathuḥ, ityarthaṃ vadanti| kṣatajapittajaśūlapathyamiti raktābhiṣyandahitaṃ pittābhiṣyandahitaṃ cetyarthaḥ| anye tu abhighātajo hi vāyuḥ śoṇitapittaṃ dūṣayan tābhyāmevāvṛtaḥ śūlaṃ karotīti taddhitamiti vyākhyānayanti| dṛṣṭiprasādanaṃ nayanagolakaprasādanam||3||-

ab.seg: svedāgnidhūmabhayaśokarujābhighātairabhyāhatāmapi tathaiva bhiṣak cikitset ||4||

‘abhyāhate tu nayane bahudhā narāṇām’ ityatra mūrtānāṃ daṇḍādīnāmabhighāte yaccikitsitamabhihitaṃ tadeva cikitsitamamūrtānāmapi svedādīnāmabhighāte'tidiśannāha- svedāgnidhūmabhayetyādi| tathaiva cikitset pūrvoktaprakāreṇa cikitset| evaṃ saptāhādarvāgeva| ‘abhyāhate tu nayane’ ityatra pūrvavākye bahudhātvaṃ mūrtadaṇḍādyabhighātasya bodhyam, ihāmūrtābhighātacikitsitamabhidhīyate||4||

div.ab: sadyohate nayana eṣa vidhistadūrdhvaṃ syanderito bhavati doṣamavekṣya kāryaḥ |5|

idānīṃ pūrvokto vidhiḥ saptāhādarvāgeva kāryastadūrdhvamanyo vidhirityāha- sadyohata ityādi| sadyohate saptāhādarvāgevetyarthaḥ| eṣa vidhiḥ pūrvokto vidhiḥ| tadūrdhvaṃ saptāhādūrdhvam| syanderito vātābhiṣyandokto vidhiḥ|5|-

ab.seg: abhyāhataṃ nayanamīṣadathāsyabāṣpasaṃsveditaṃ bhavati tannirujaṃ kṣaṇena ||5||
idānīṃ kiñcidabhyāhatanayane viśeṣacikitsitamāha- abhyāhatamityādi| āsyabāṣpaṃ mukhaphūtkārajanitoṣmā||5||

div.ab: sādhyaṃ kṣataṃ paṭalamekamubhe tu kṛcchre trīṇi kṣatāni paṭalāni vivarjayettu | syāt piccitaṃ ca nayanaṃ hyati cāvasannaṃ srastaṃ cyutaṃ ca hatadṛk ca bhavettu yāpyam ||6|| vistīrṇadṛṣṭitanurāgamasatpradarśi, sādhyaṃ yathāsthitamanāviladarśanaṃ ca |7|

idānīṃ paṭalāvagāhanaviśeṣeṇābhighātasya sādhyakṛcchrasādhyāsādhyaviśeṣamāha- sādhyaṃ kṣatamityādi| kecidamuṃ pāṭhaṃ na paṭhanti| yādṛṅnayanaṃ yāpyaṃ tādṛgāha- syāt piccitamityādi| avasannam antaḥpraviṣṭaṃ, srastaṃ śithilaṃ, cyutam avalambitaṃ, vistīrṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tathā tanurāgaṃ ca yadasatpradarśi syāt tadapi yāpyam| sādhyamāha- sādhyamityādi||6||-

ab.seg: prāṇoparodhavamanakṣutakaṇṭharodhairunnamyamāśu nayanaṃ yadatipraviṣṭam ||7||
atipraviṣṭanetre cikitsitamāha- prāṇoparodhetyādi| prāṇāyāmena vamanena chikkāpravartanena tathā kaṇṭhanirodhanena vā unnamyamunnamanīyam||7||

div.ab: netre vilambini vidhirvihitaḥ purastāducchiṅghanaṃ śirasi vāryavasecanaṃ ca |8|

atinirgatanayanasya cikitsitamāha- netra ityādi| vilambini atinirgate, vidhirvihitaḥ purastāditi ‘bhinnaṃ netrakarmaṇyamabhinnaṃ lambate tu yat’ ityādinā proktaḥ| ucchiṅghanaṃ nāsikayā vāyorantaḥpraveśanam| vāryavasecanaṃ śītodakapariṣekaḥ|8|-
ṣaṭsaptatirnayanajā ya ime pradiṣṭā rogā bhavantyamahatāṃ mahatāṃ ca tebhyaḥ ||8|| stanyaprakopakaphamārutapittaraktairbālākṣivartmabhava eva kukūṇako'nyaḥ |9|

idānīṃ vakṣyamāṇakukūṇakena ṣaṭsaptateḥ saṅkhyādhikyamityāśaṅkyamānamāha- ṣaṭsaptatirityādi| ya ime nayanajā rogāḥ ṣaṭsaptatiḥ pradiṣṭāste'mahatāṃ bālānāṃ tathā mahatāṃ ca bhavanti| tebhyaḥ ṣaṭsaptativikārebhyaḥ stanyaprakopādibhirbālākṣivartmabhava eva anyaḥ kukūṇaka iti samudāyārthaḥ| bālākṣivartmabhava eva na mahatāmakṣivartmani, anyaḥ aparaḥ| yo'sau kukūṇako bālānāmeva bhavati, sa kaphābhiṣyande avaruddho'to na saṅkhyātirekaḥ| ‘stanyaprakopakaphamārutapittaraktaiḥ’ ityatra ‘stanyaprakopajanitaiḥ piśitodayādvā’ ityanye paṭhanti; apare tu ‘piśitocchrayāt’ iti paṭhanti; tau ca necchati jejjaṭaḥ||8||-

ab.seg: mṛdgāti netramatikaṇḍumathākṣikūṭaṃ nāsālalāṭamapi tena śiśuḥ sa nityam ||9||
sūryaprabhāṃ na sahate sravati prabaddhaṃ, tasyāharedrudhiramāśu vinirlikhecca | kṣaudrāyutaiśca kaṭubhiḥ pratisārayettu mātuḥ śiśorabhihitaṃ ca vidhiṃ vidadhyāt ||10||

idānīṃ tasya kukūṇakasya lakṣaṇamāha- mṛdgātītyādi| nāsālalāṭamapi mṛdgāti| prabaddhaṃ nirantaram| kukūṇakasya sādhanamāha- tasyāharedrudhiramityādi| āharedrudhiraṃ jalaukobhiḥ, vinirlikhet śephālikāpatraiḥ| kaṭubhiḥ trikaṭukādibhiḥ| idānīṃ bālasyauṣadhākṣamatvānmāturevauṣadhamāha- māturityādi| yaḥ stanyarogacikitsite ‘stanye gate vikṛtimāśu bhiṣak’ ityādividhirabhihitaḥ, taṃ śiśoryā jananī tasyā vidadhyāditi piṇḍārthaḥ| anye tu dvayorevābhihitaṃ vidhimicchanti||9-10||

div.ab: taṃ vāmayettu madhusaindhavasamprayuktaiḥ pītaṃ payaḥ khalu phalaiḥ kharamañjarīṇām ||11|| syātpippalīlavaṇamākṣikasaṃyutairvā... |12|

idānīṃ kṣīrapasya bālasya stanyasātmyatvāt stanyayuktameva vamanaṃ nirdiśannāha- taṃ vāmayedityādi| madhusaindhavasaṃyutaiḥ kharamañjarīṇāṃ phalaiḥ saha payaḥ stanyaṃ pītaṃ taṃ bālaṃ vāmayediti sambandhaḥ| kharamañjarīṇāṃ phalaiḥ apāmārgaphalacūrṇaiḥ| syādityādi| pippalīsaindhavādiyutairvā kharamañjarīṇāṃ phalacūrṇaiḥ saha stanyaṃ pītaṃ vamanakṛdbhavedityarthaḥ||11||-
... nainaṃ vamantamapi vāmayituṃ yateta |12|

idānīmutkṛṣṭadoṣatvāt svayaṃ vamantaṃ bālakaṃ vamanayogaṃ dattvā na vāmayedityāha- nainamityādi| enamutkliṣṭadoṣatvātsvayameva vamantaṃ vāmayitumanyaprakāreṇa vāmayituṃ na yateta yatnaṃ na kurvīta, vamanātiyogabhayāt|12|-

ab.seg: dattvā vacāmaśanadugdhabhuje prayojyamūrdhvaṃ tataḥ phalayutaṃ vamanaṃ vidhijñaiḥ ||12||

kṣīrānnādasya tathā'nnādasya ca vamanamāha- dattvā vacāmityādi| aśanadugdhabhuje kṣīrānnādāya pūrvoktameva vamanaṃ vacāṃ dattvā prayojyam| ata ūrdhvaṃ kṣīrānnāvasthāto'nantaramannādasya madanaphalayutaṃ pūrvoktameva vamanaṃ sakṣīramakṣīraṃ vā yojyam||12||

div.ab: jambvāmradhātryaṇudalaiḥ paridhāvanārthaṃ kāryaṃ kaṣāyamavasecanameva cāpi |13|
idānīṃ kukūṇake vartmanaḥ prakṣālanapariṣekārthaṃ kaṣāyamāha- jambvāmradhātryaṇudalairityādi| dhātrī āmalakī, aṇuḥ aśmantakaḥ, paridhāvanārthaṃ prakṣālanārthaṃ, pariṣecanaṃ pariṣeka ityarthaḥ|13|-

ab.seg: āścyotane ca hitamatra ghṛtaṃ guḍūcīsiddhaṃ tathā''hurapi ca triphalāvipakvam ||13||

prakṣālanapariṣekāvabhidhāya pūraṇārthamakalkaghṛtadvayamāha- āścyotane ityādi| āścyotane akṣipūraṇe| atra kukūṇake guḍūcīsvarasena ghṛtacaturguṇena pakvaṃ, idamekamañjanaṃ; triphalākvāthena pakvaṃ, etacca dvitīyam||13||

div.ab: nepālajāmaricaśaṅkharasāñjanāni sindhuprasūtaguḍamākṣikasaṃyutāni | syādañjanaṃ, madhurasāmadhukāmrakairvā ... |14|
adhunā kukūṇake'ñjanamāha- nepālajetyādi| nepālajā manaḥśilā| sindhuprasūtaṃ saindhavam| aparamañjanamāha- syādañjanamityādi| madhurasā mūrvā| etairmūrvādibhistribhirvā'ñjanaṃ syāt|14|-

ab.seg: ... kṛṣṇāyasaṃ ghṛtapayo madhu vā'pi dagdham ||14||

cūrṇāñjanamāha- kṛṣṇāyasamityādi| kṛṣṇāyasaṃ kṛṣṇalohacūrṇam| etat kṛṣṇalohādikaṃ cāntardhūmadagdhaṃ cūrṇāñjanaṃ bhavet| tathā ca videhaḥ,- “lauhacūrṇaṃ ca sarpiśca madhu kṣīraṃ ca dāhayet|| etaccūrṇāñjanaṃ piṣṭaṃ kumārāṇāṃ kukūṇake”- iti||14||
vyoṣaṃ palāṇḍu madhukaṃ lavaṇottamaṃ ca lākṣāṃ ca gaurikayutāṃ guṭikāñjanaṃ vā | nimbacchadaṃ madhukadārvi satāmralodhramicchanti cātra bhiṣajo'ñjanamaṃśatulyam ||15||

guṭikāñjanamāha- vyoṣamityādi| palāṇḍuḥ laśunabhedaḥ, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu, lavaṇottamaṃ saindhavam| guṭikāñjanaṃ vartyañjanam| aparamapi vartyañjanamāha- nimbacchadamityādi| dārvī haridrādvayaṃ; videhadarśanāt| atra kukūṇake añjanamityatra guṭikāśabdo lupto draṣṭavyaḥ; tena guṭikāñjanamityarthaḥ| aṃśatulyaṃ nimbacchadādikaṃ samabhāgamityarthaḥ||15||
srotojaśaṅkhadadhisaindhavamardhapakṣaṃ śukraṃ śiśornudati bhāvitamañjanena | syande kaphadabhihitaṃ kramamācarecca bālasya rogakuśalo'kṣigadaṃ jighāṃsuḥ ||16||

idānīṃ kukūṇakaprasaṅgena bālānāṃ śukralekhanārthamañjanamāha- srotojetyādi| asyāñjanasya kalpanāṃ videhadarśanena vṛddhavaidyā āhuḥ| tadyathā- gavyena dadhnā piṣṭābhyāṃ śaṅkhasaindhavābhyāṃ srotojaṃ rasāñjanamardhapakṣaṃ sārdhasaptarātramasakṛllepayet; tato'nantaraṃ tatsrotojaṃ rasāñjanaṃ piṣṭvā vartiḥ kāryā, sā añjanena śiśoḥ śukraṃ nudati sphoṭayatītyarthaḥ| kecit srotoñjanaśabdena sauvīrāñjanamāhuḥ| kecit ‘śukraṃ śiśornudati bhāvitamañjanena’ ityatra ‘ābhāvitaṃ śiśukaroganudañjanena’ iti paṭhanti| anye tu ‘brāhmīrasena paribhāvitamañjanārthaṃ’ iti paṭhanti, tannecchati gayī| pūrvoktamevauṣadhaṃ śukre'tidiśannāha- syande kaphādabhihitamityādi| kaphādyaḥ syandastatra syande yaḥ kramo'bhihitastaṃ kramaṃ bālasyākṣigadaṃ jighāṃsuryogakuśalo vaidya ācaret kuryāditi sambandhaḥ; jighāṃsuḥ hantumicchuḥ| kecit ‘syande kaphādabhihitaṃ kramaṃ’ ityatra ‘syandakramaṃ kaphavināśanamācarecca’ iti paṭhanti| bālasya kaphādhikyāt kaphasyandakramaṃ vidadhyāt| ācarecceti cakāro bhinnakrame, sa ‘tena’ iti pā. ca kaphavināśanamityatra draṣṭavyaḥ; tato'nyamapyavasthākupitaṃ vātaṃ pittaṃ raktaṃ cānubandhabhūtamihoktamavekṣya vātapittasyandānukramaṃ raktābhiṣyandakramaṃ cāvekṣya yathādoṣaṃ yogamupayojayediti vyākhyānayanti||16||
samudra iva gambhīraṃ naiva śakyaṃ cikitsitam | vaktuṃ niravaśeṣeṇa ślokānāmayutairapi ||17||
sahasrairapi vā, proktamarthamalpamatirnaraḥ | tarkagranthārtharahito naiva gṛhṇātyapaṇḍitaḥ ||18||

kutaḥ punaḥ sa kramo'vasthāviśeṣeṇa svagranthe ācāryeṇa na nibaddha ityāha- samudra iva gambhīramityādi| samudra iva gambhīraṃ cikitsitaṃ ślokānāṃ sahasrairapyayutairniravaśeṣeṇa vaktuṃ naiva śakyamityarthaḥ; ślokānāṃ sahastairapyayutaiḥ ślokakoṭyā'pītyarthaḥ| yadi ślokakoṭyā vaktuṃ na śakyate tarhi kiṃ granthakarturaśaktirityāśaṅkamānamāha- proktamityādi| alpamatirapaṇḍito naro yatastarkagranthārtharahito'taḥ ślokakoṭyoktamapyarthaṃ naiva gṛhṇātīti sambandhaḥ; tarkagranthārtharahitastarkeṇohena yo granthārthaḥ śāstrārthastena rahita ityarthaḥ||17-18||
tadidaṃ bahugūḍhārthaṃ cikitsābījamīritam | kuśalenābhipannaṃ tadbahudhā'bhiprarohati ||19||
tasmānmatimatā nityaṃ nānāśāstrārthadarśinā | sarvamūhyamagādhārthaṃ śāstramāgamabuddhinā ||20||

tadidamityādi| yasmānniravaśeṣeṇa rogāvasthānantyāccikitsitasya vaktumaśakyatvaṃ, śakyatve vā nirūpaṇasya niṣphalatā, tasmāt kāraṇādidaṃ bahugūḍhārthaṃ cikitsāyā bījamīritamiti samudāyārthaḥ| tadeva cikitsābījaṃ kuśalena jñātamanekadhā prarohatītyāha- kuśalenetyādi| kuśalenāvasthāvidā vaidyenābhipannamadhigataṃ tadbahudhā'bhiprarohati| cikitsābījamiti bījamiva bījaṃ, yathaikaṃ bījaṃ subhūmau nikṣiptaṃ mūlakāṇḍaśākhāpallavādinā'nekadhā prarohati tathedamapīti cikitsābījamityarthaḥ| yasmāt kuśalenādhigataṃ cikitsābījamanekadhā prarohati tasmāt kāraṇānmatimatā nityaṃ nānāśāstrārthadarśinā āgamabuddhinā vaidyena sarvamagādhārthaṃ śāstraṃ nityamūhyamiti sambandhaḥ| nānāśāstrāṇi śālākyāni| āgamaḥ āptānāṃ śāstraṃ; tathā coktaṃ,- “siddhaṃ siddhaiḥ pramāṇaistu hitaṃ cātra paratra ca| āgamaḥ śāstramāptānāmāptāstattvārthadarśinaḥ”- iti||19-20||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre nayanābhighātacikitsitaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||19||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre ekonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||19||

div.head: karṇagatarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ karṇagatarogavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
indriyagatarogasāmānyācchravaṇagatarogavijñānīyārambho yukta ityata āha- athāta ityādi| gataśabda āśritaparyāyaḥ||1-2||
karṇaśūlaṃ praṇādaśca bādhiryaṃ kṣveḍa eva ca | karṇasrāvaḥ karṇakaṇḍūḥ karṇavarcastathaiva ca ||3||
kṛmikarṇapratināhau vidradhirdvividhastathā | karṇapākaḥ pūtikarṇastathaivārśaścaturvidham ||4||
karṇārbudaṃ saptavidhaṃ śophaścāpi caturvidhaḥ | ete karṇagatā rogā aṣṭāviṃśatirīritāḥ ||5||

tāneva karṇagatarogānnāmabhiḥ saṅkhyayā cāha- karṇaśūlamityādi| karṇaśūlasya kaṣṭasādhyatvāt prāgeva nirdeśaḥ| vidradhirdvividhaḥ- doṣavidradhiḥ kṣatavidradhiśca; arśaścaturvidhaṃ- vātapittakaphasannipātaiḥ; arbudaṃ saptavidhaṃ- vātena pittena kaphena cāpi raktena māṃsena ca medasā ca, saptamaṃ śālākyatantre; śophaścaturvidhaḥ- vātapittakaphasannipātaiḥ| saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva saṅkhyāyāṃ labdhāyāmaṣṭāviṃśatiriti bhūyaḥ saṅkhyākaraṇaṃ niyamārthaṃ, tena ca videhasaṅkhyayā adhikatvaṃ mā bhūdityarthaḥ||3-5||
samīraṇaḥ śrotragato'nyathācaraḥ samantataḥ śūlamatīva karṇayoḥ | karoti doṣaiśca yathāsvamāvṛtaḥ sa karṇaśūlaḥ kathito durācaraḥ ||6||

karṇaśūlamāha- samīraṇa ityādi| anyathācara iti vimārgagaḥ| samantataḥ śūlamatīva karṇayoḥ karotīti sambandhanīyam| doṣaiḥ kaphapittaraktaiḥ, anye tu vāyoreva vāyvantarāvaraṇādbahuvacanaṃ samarthayanti| svasya svasya doṣasya anatikrameṇa yathāsvam| durācaro duḥkhenopacaryata ityarthaḥ| anye ‘durāsada’ iti paṭhanti, durvāra iti vyākhyānayanti| yadyapi śūlabādhiryavidradhyarśorbudaśophāḥ prāṅnirdiṣṭāstathā'pi karṇarogasaṅgrahārthaṃ sādhyāsādhyavibhāgārthaṃ ca punarnirdiṣṭāḥ; śūlastu vātavyādhinidāne kevalavātaja uktaḥ atra punardoṣairāvṛta iti na paunaruktyam||6||
yadā tu nāḍīṣu vimārgamāgataḥ sa eva śabdābhivahāsu tiṣṭhati | śṛṇoti śabdān vividhāṃstadā naraḥ praṇādamenaṃ kathayanti cāmayam ||7||

karṇanādamāha- yadā tu nāḍīṣvityādi| vimārgamāgataḥ viruddhamārgaṃ prāptaḥ, vimārgo'tra śira eva, vimārgagaḥ tiryaggo yadā tiṣṭhati, (sa evetyevaśabdena kaphādyāvaraṇāvṛtaḥ| anye tu śabdavahāsu nāḍīṣu sa eva vāyurvimārgago yadā niruddhyati) ayaṃ pāṭho hastalikhitapustake nopalabhyate tadā vividhān śabdān naraḥ śṛṇotīti vyākhyānayanti| asya rogasyāpīḍākaratvādarogatvaṃ mā bhūditi dyotanārthamāmayavacanam||7||
sa eva śabdānuvahā yadā sirāḥ kaphānuyāto vyanusṛtya tiṣṭhati | tadā narasyāpratikārasevino bhavettu bādhiryamasaṃśayaṃ khalu ||8||

bādhiryamāha- sa eva śabdānuvahā ityādi| sa eva śuddho vāyuḥ kaphānuyātaḥ kaphānugataḥ| sa evetyatrāpiśabdo lupto draṣṭavyaḥ, tena na kevalaṃ śuddho vāyuḥ śleṣmānvito'pi vetyarthaḥ| vyanusṛtya vividhamārgamāvṛtya| apratikārasevinaḥ cikitsāmakurvataḥ||8||
śramāt kṣayādrūkṣakaṣāyabhojanāt samīraṇaḥ śabdapathe pratiṣṭhitaḥ | viriktaśīrṣasya ca śītasevinaḥ karoti hi kṣveḍamatīva karṇayoḥ ||9||

karṇakṣveḍamāha- śramādityādi| kṣayo dhātukṣayaḥ| kṣveḍaḥ śabdaḥ| karṇanādaḥ kevalavātārabdho nānāvidhaśabdānvitaḥ, karṇakṣveḍastu doṣasaṃsṛṣṭavātārabdho vaṃśaghoṣānukāriśabdānvitaḥ| tathā ca videhaḥ,- “mārutaḥ kaphavātābhyāṃ saṃsṛṣṭaḥ śoṇitena ca| karṇakṣveḍanaṃ sañjanayet kṣveḍanaṃ veṇughoṣavat”- iti; eṣa karṇanādakṣveḍayorbhedaḥ||9||
śirobhighātādathavā nimajjato jale prapākādathavā'pi vidradheḥ | sravettu pūyaṃ śravaṇo'nilāvṛtaḥ sa karṇasaṃsrāva iti prakīrtitaḥ ||10||
karṇasrāvamāha- śirobhighātādityādi| vidradheḥ karṇavidradheḥ||10||

div.ab: kaphena kaṇḍūḥ pracitena karṇayorbhṛśaṃ bhavet srotasi karṇasañjñite |11|
karṇakaṇḍūmāha- kaphenetyādi| karṇayoḥ pracitena sañcitena śleṣmaṇā karṇasrotasi bhṛśamatyarthaṃ kaṇḍūrbhavediti sambandhaḥ|11|-

ab.seg: viśoṣite śleṣmaṇi pittatejasā nṛṇāṃ bhavet srotasi karṇagūthakaḥ ||11||
karṇagūthakamāha- viśoṣita ityādi| srotasi sañcite śleṣmaṇi pittatejasā viśoṣite sati karṇagūthako bhavediti sambandhaḥ||11||
sa karṇaviṭko dravatāṃ yadā gato vilāyito ghrāṇamukhaṃ prapadyate | tadā sa karṇapratināhasañjñito bhavedvikāraḥ śiraso'bhitāpanaḥ ||12||
karṇapratināhamāha- sa karṇetyādi| vilayanaṃ punaḥ snehasvedābhyām| kaphamārutābhyāṃ sannipātena vā videhoktatvāt| śiraso'bhitāpanaḥ sakalaśirovikārakārītyarthaḥ||12||
yadā tu mūrcchantyathavā'pi jantavaḥ sṛjantyapatyānyathavā'pi makṣikāḥ | tadañjanatvācchravaṇo nirucyate bhiṣagbhirādyaiḥ kṛmikarṇako gadaḥ ||13||

kṛmikarṇamāha- yadetyādi| mūrcchanti patanti| jantavo māṃsakothajāḥ kṛmayaḥ| apatyāni sūkṣmakṛmīn| makṣikā mambhaṇākhyā nīlamakṣikāḥ| tadañjanatvādityādi| ādyairbhiṣagbhistadañjanatvācchravaṇaḥ kṛmikarṇako nirukta iti sambandhaḥ| tadañjanatvāt kṛmilakṣaṇatvāt| ādyairbhiṣagbhiḥ videhādibhiḥ| ayaṃ rogaḥ sānnipātikaḥ, videhaproktatvāt||13||
kṣatābhighātaprabhavastu vidradhirbhavettathā doṣakṛto'paraḥ punaḥ | saraktapītāruṇamasramāsravet pratodadhūmāyanadāhacoṣavān ||14||

karṇavidradhimāha- kṣatābhighātaprabhava ityādi| kṣatābhighātaprabhavastu vidradhirbhavediti chedaḥ| etena kṣatavidradhirdarśitaḥ| doṣakṛto'paraḥ doṣajanito dvitīyo vidradhiḥ| etena doṣajo darśitaḥ| sa caturvidhaḥ| kṣatavidradherlakṣaṇamāha- saraktapītāruṇamityādi| asraṃ raktam| dhūmāyanaṃ dhūmodvamanamiva vedanāviśeṣaḥ| coṣavān ācūṣyata iva| doṣavidradherlakṣaṇaṃ doṣaliṅgaireva jñātavyam| saraktapittāruṇetyādinā karṇapākalakṣaṇamuktamiti kecit kathayanti; tacca mahyaṃ na rocate, yato jejjaṭādīnāmīdṛśo'bhiprāyo nāsti||14||

div.ab: bhavet prapākaḥ khalu pittakopato vikothavikledakaraśca karṇayoḥ |15|
karṇapākalakṣaṇamāha- bhavet prapāka ityādi|15|-
sthite kaphe srotasi pittatejasā vilāyyamāne bhṛśasampratāpavān ||15|| avedano vā'pyathavā savedano ghanaṃ sravet pūti ca pūtikarṇakaḥ |16|
pūtikarṇamāha- sthita ityādi| ghanaṃ nirantaraṃ vāraṃvāramityarthaḥ| anye ghanamiti pūyasya viśeṣaṇamāhuḥ| pūti pūyam||15||-

ab.seg: pradiṣṭaliṅgānyaraśāṃsi tattvatastathaiva śophārbudaliṅgamīritam | mayā purastāt prasamīkṣya yojayedihaiva tāvat prayato bhiṣagvaraḥ ||16||
arśaḥśophārbudānyāha- pradiṣṭetyādi| śophārbudaliṅgaṃ śophasya arbudasya ca lakṣaṇamityarthaḥ| tattvataḥ paramārthataḥ| prasamīkṣya jñātvā| prayogajño vaidyaḥ||16||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre karṇagatarogavijñānīyo nāma viṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||20||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||20||

div.head: karṇagatarogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ karṇagatarogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi| pratiṣedhaḥ cikitsitam||1-2||
sāmānyaṃ karṇarodheṣu ghṛtapānaṃ rasāyanam | avyāyāmo'śiraḥsnānaṃ brahmacaryamakatthanam ||3||

karṇarogāṇāṃ sāmānyaṃ cikitsitamāha- sāmānyamityādi| ghṛtapānamatra ūrdhvabhaktikam| aśiraḥsnānaṃ na śiraḥsnānamityarthaḥ| akatthanam abhāṣaṇam| rasāyanamityatra ‘rasāśanam’ iti kecit paṭhanti, māṃsarasena saha bhojanamiti vyākhyānayanti||3||
karṇaśūle praṇāde ca bādhiryakṣveḍayorapi | caturṇāmapi rogāṇāṃ sāmānyaṃ bheṣajaṃ viduḥ ||4||
vātajānāṃ caturṇāṃ karṇaśūlādīnāmekahetutvādekāmeva cikitsāmāha- karṇaśūla ityādi||4||
snigdhaṃ vātaharaiḥ svedairnaraṃ snehavirecitam | nāḍīsvedairupacaretpiṇḍasvedaistathaiva ca ||5||

kiṃ tat sāmānyaṃ cikitsitamityāha- snigdhamityādi| snigdhaṃ snehapānenābhyaṅgena ca| snehavirecitam eraṇḍatailādibhiḥ| svedādhyāye vyāmārdhamātretyādinā nāḍīsvedaḥ proktaḥ; piṇḍasvedaḥ kṛśarāpāyasādibhiḥ||5||
bilvairaṇḍārkavarṣābhūdadhitthonmattaśigrubhiḥ | bastagandhāśvagandhābhyāṃ tarkārīyavaveṇubhiḥ ||6||
āranālaśṛtairebhirnāḍīsvedaḥ prayojitaḥ | kaphavātasamutthānaṃ karṇaśūlaṃ nirasyati ||7||

nāḍīsvedopayogidravyāṇyāha- bilvetyādi| varṣābhūḥ śvetapunarnavā, dadhitthaḥ kapitthaḥ, unmatto dhattūrakaḥ, śigruḥ śobhāñjanakaḥ, viṭapaśākamanye| bastagandhā bobayikā| tarkārī araṇikā, yavaveṇubhiriti veṇuyavaḥ annajātiḥ| bilvairaṇḍādibhiḥ āranālasiddhaiḥ kevalavātārabdhe kaphāvṛtavātārabdhe ca karṇaśūle svedaḥ prayojyaḥ; paraṃ kevalavātaje śūle snehapūrvaḥ svedaḥ, kaphāvṛte punaḥ rūkṣaḥ sveda iti||6-7||
mīnakukkuṭalāvānāṃ māṃsajaiḥ payasā'pi vā | piṇḍaiḥ svedaṃ ca kurvīta karṇaśūlanivāraṇam ||8||
piṇḍasvedopayogidravyāṇyāha- mīnakukkuṭalāvānāmityādi| payasā'pi veti ghanībhūtakṣīrapiṇḍenetyarthaḥ| etairmīnādibhirmāṃsapiṇḍaiḥ pṛthak samastairvā svedaḥ kāryaḥ||8||
aśvatthapatrakhallaṃ vā vidhāya bahupatrakam | tadaṅgāraiḥ susampūrṇaṃ nidadhyācchravaṇopari ||9||
yattailaṃ cyavate tasmāt khallādaṅgāratāpitāt | tat prāptaṃ śravaṇasrotaḥ sadyo gṛhṇāti vedanām ||10||
śuddhavātaje śūle snehaviśeṣasvedamuddiśannāha- aśvatthapatretyādi| khallamiti dvikarṇikākāramityarthaḥ| abhyajya tailena ghṛtena vā, sātyakividehaproktatvāt||9-10||
kṣaumaguggulvagurubhiḥ saghṛtairdhūpayecca tam | bhaktopari hitaṃ sarpirbastikarma ca pūjitam ||11||
karṇasvedasya paścātkarmāha- kṣaumetyādi| kṣaumam atasīvastraṃ, bastiratra śirobastiḥ||11||

div.ab: niranno niśi tatsarpiḥ pītvopari pibet payaḥ | mūrdhabastiṣu nasye ca mastiṣke pariṣecane ||12|| śatapākaṃ balātailaṃ praśastaṃ cāpi bhojane |13|

idānīṃ nirannasya sāyameva asyāgre ‘koṣṇaṃ payonupānaṃ ca tailamapyādiśanti hi- pūrvaṃ śirobastikarma ca pūjitamityuktaṃ’ ityadhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate hastalikhitapustake koṣṇaṃ payo nirdiśannāha- niranna ityādi| nirannaḥ puruṣaḥ| niśi koṣṇaṃ payo'nupānaṃ ca sarpiḥ pibet| mūrdhetyādi| mastiṣkaḥ śirobastiviśeṣaḥ, sa ca snehapicuplotādinā'vacāryate| śatapākaṃ vātavyādhipaṭhitam| balātailaṃ mūḍhagarbhoktaṃ, anye tu balātailameva śatapākaṃ kṛtvopayujyata iti vyākhyānayanti||12||-
kaṇṭakārīmajākṣīre paktvā kṣīreṇa tena ca ||13|| vipacet kukkuṭavasāṃ karṇayostatprapūraṇam |14|
kaṇṭakārīmityādi| kaṇṭakārī catuṣpalapramāṇā, tadaṣṭaguṇaṃ kṣīraṃ, kṣīrāccaturguṇamudakaṃ dattvā vipacet, tena kṣīreṇa kukkuṭavasāṃ kuḍavāpramāṇāṃ pacet, tatkarṇayoḥ prapūraṇam||13||-

ab.seg: taṇḍulīyakamūlāni phalamaṅkolajaṃ tathā ||14||
ahiṃsrākendukānmūlaṃ saralaṃ devadāru ca | laśunaṃ śṛṅgaveraṃ ca tathā vaṃśāvalekhanam ||15||
kalkaireṣāṃ tathā'mlaiśca pacet snehaṃ caturvidham | vedanāyāḥ praśāntyarthaṃ hitaṃ tatkarṇapūraṇam ||16||

aparamapi pūraṇamāha- taṇḍulīyaketyādi| vaṃśāvalekhanaṃ vaṃśāccholanam| kalko dṛṣadi peṣitaḥ, sa cādravaḥ, sa cāṣṭapalapramāṇaḥ, amlaiḥ dadhitakrasurācukramātuluṅgarasaiḥ pratyekamaṣṭāviṃśatyadhikaśatapramāṇaiḥ, snehaścaturvidhaḥ sarpistailavasāmajjasañjño dvātriṃśatpalapramāṇaḥ||14-16||
laśunārdrakaśigrūṇāṃ muraṅgyā mūlakasya ca | kadalyāḥ svarasaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kaduṣṇaḥ karṇapūraṇe ||17||
śṛṅgaverarasaḥ kṣaudraṃ saindhavaṃ tailameva ca | kaduṣṇaṃ karṇayordeyametadvā vedanāpaham ||18||
laśunārdraketyādi| śigruḥ madhuśigruḥ, muraṅgī dvitīyaḥ śobhāñjanakaḥ, kaduṣṇa īṣaduṣṇaḥ| eteṣāṃ laśunādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ svarasā vyastāḥ samastā vā karṇapūraṇe deyāḥ||17-18||
vaṃśāvalekhanāyukte mūtre cājāvike bhiṣak | sarpiḥ pacettena karṇaṃ pūrayet karṇaśūlinaḥ ||19||

vaṃśetyādi| ‘mūtre cājāvike bhiṣak’ ityatra tantrāntaradarśanādviparyayeṇa sarpiḥpākaḥ kartavyaḥ; tena pūrvamāvike mūtre sarpiḥ paktavyaṃ, paścādāja iti| anye tu pūrvamāvikamūtrapakvena sarpiṣā karṇapūraṇaṃ, paścādājena mūtreṇeti viparyayaṃ vyākhyānayanti| kecit sarpiḥ pacedityatra tailaṃ pacediti paṭhanti; tanna, sarvanibandhaiḥ parihṛtatvāt||19||
mahataḥ pañcamūlasya kāṇḍamaṣṭādaśāṅgulam | kṣaumeṇāveṣṭya saṃsicya tailenādīpayettataḥ ||20||
yattailaṃ cyavate tebhyo dhṛtebhyo bhājanopari | jñeyaṃ taddīpikātailaṃ sadyo gṛhṇāti vedanām ||21||
dīpikātailamāha- mahata ityādi| kāṇḍaṃ khaṇḍaṃ, kṣaumeṇa atasīvastreṇa, āveṣṭya ‘tribhāgam’ iti śeṣaḥ| ghṛtebhyo ‘adhomukham’ iti śeṣaḥ| gṛhṇāti apaharati||20-21||
kuryādevaṃ bhadrakāṣṭhe kuṣṭhe kāṣṭhe ca sārale | matimān dīpikātailaṃ karṇaśūlanibarhaṇam ||22||
kuryādevamityādi| cakārādagurvairaṇḍāgnimanthakāṣṭhāni gṛhyante||22||
arkāṅkurānamlapiṣṭāṃstailāktān lavaṇānvitān | sannidadhyāt snuhīkāṇḍe korite tacchadāvṛte ||23||
puṭapākakramāsvinnān pīḍayedārasāgamāt | sukhoṣṇaṃ tadrasaṃ karṇe dāpayecchūlaśāntaye ||24||
kapitthamātuluṅgāmlaśṛṅgaverarasaiḥ śubhaiḥ | sukhoṣṇaiḥ pūrayet karṇaṃ tacchūlavinivṛttaye ||25||
karṇaṃ koṣṇena cukreṇa pūrayet karṇaśūlinaḥ | samudraphenacūrṇena yuktyā cāpyavacūrṇayet ||26||
arkāṅkurānityādi| ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ sarvanibandhakārairanārṣīkṛtastasmānna vyākhyātaḥ||23-26||
aṣṭānāmiha mūtrāṇāṃ mūtreṇānyatamena tu | koṣṇena pūrayet karṇaṃ karṇaśūlopaśāntaye ||27||
aṣṭānāmityādi| aṣṭānāṃ mūtrāṇāmanyatamenaikatamena||27||
mūtreṣvamleṣu vātaghne gaṇe ca kvathite bhiṣak | paceccaturvidhaṃ snehaṃ pūraṇaṃ tacca karṇayoḥ ||28||
mūtreṣvityādi| mūtrāṇi gavādīnāmaṣṭānām| amlāni surāmastvāranālabījapūracukrāṇi| vātaghno gaṇo vidārigandhādiḥ||28||

div.ab: etā eva kriyāḥ kuryāt pittaghnaiḥ pittasaṃyute |29|

vātajakarṇaroge kriyāmabhidhāya pittajakarṇaśūlacikitsāmāha- etā ityādi| etā eva dīpikādayaḥ kriyāḥ| tatra dīpikā aśvatthapatrakhallasnehasarpiṣā karṇapūraṇaṃ; kāñjikenāpi, tasya sparśane pittaharatvāt| pittasaṃyute karṇaśūle ityarthaḥ|29|-

ab.seg: kākolyādau daśakṣīraṃ tiktaṃ cātra hitaṃ haviḥ ||29||
kṣīravṛkṣapravāleṣu madhuke candane tathā | kalkakvāthe paraṃ pakvaṃ śarkarāmadhukaiḥ saraiḥ ||30||

pittajakarṇaśule sāmānyacikitsāmabhidhāya viśeṣacikitsāmāha- kākolyādāvityādi| kākolyādikalkena daśaguṇakṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ hitaṃ, tathā tiktaṃ tiktadravyasaṃskṛtam; anye tu tiktaṃ kuṣṭhacikitsitoktaṃ ghṛtaṃ kathayanti| kṣīravṛkṣā nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaplakṣagardabhāṇḍāḥ, teṣāṃ pallavakvāthena kākolyādikalkena siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ hitam| madhuke candane tatheti pratyekaṃ yaṣṭīmadhukacandanakvāthakalkābhyāṃ siddham| śarkarāmadhukairityatra yaṣṭīmadhukadvitayaṃ, ata eva bahutvam| saraiḥ virecanadravyairityarthaḥ| jejjaṭācāryastu kṣīravṛkṣapravāleṣvityekaṃ yogaṃ kathayati, bimbīkvātha iti dvitīyaṃ; tau ca yogāvanārṣau kathayanti||29-30||
iṅgudīsarṣapasnehau sakaphe pūraṇe hitau | tiktauṣadhānāṃ yūṣāśca svedāśca kaphanāśanāḥ ||31||
śleṣmaśūlasya cikitsāmāha- iṅgudīsarṣapetyādi| sakaphe ‘karṇaśūle’ ityadhyāhāraḥ| tiktetyādi| svedāśca kaphanāśanā iti tāpoṣmasvedā rūkṣāḥ||31||
surasādau kṛtaṃ tailaṃ pañcamūle mahatyapi | mātuluṅgarasaḥ śuktaṃ laśunārdrakayo rasaḥ ||32||
ekaikaḥ pūraṇe pathyastailaṃ teṣvapi vā kṛtam | tīkṣṇā mūrdhavirekāśca kavalāścātra pūjitāḥ ||33||

surasādau kṛtamityādi| tailadvitayametat| mātuluṅgarasa ityādi| mātuluṅgarasādinā ekaikenaiva siddhaṃ tailaṃ pūraṇe pathyamityarthaḥ| tīkṣṇā ityādi| tīkṣṇā mūrdhavirekā iti apāmārgabījādibhiḥ| tīkṣṇāḥ kavalāḥ pippalyādibhiḥ||32-33||

div.ab: karṇaśūlavidhiḥ kṛtsnaḥ pittaghnaḥ śoṇitāvṛte |34|
śoṇitaśūlasya cikitsāmāha- karṇetyādi| kecidamuṃ pāṭhaṃ na paṭhanti|34|-

śūlapraṇādabādhiryakṣveḍānāṃ tu prakīrtitam ||34|| sāmānyato, viśeṣeṇa ‘viśeṣastu’ iti pā. bādhirye pūraṇaṃ śṛṇu | gavāṃ mūtreṇa bilvāni piṣṭvā tailaṃ vipācayet ||35|| sajalaṃ ca sadugdhaṃ ca bādhirye karṇapūraṇam |36|
śūletyādi| pañjikākārastu ‘sajalaṃ ca sadugdhaṃ ca’ ityatra pādikaṃ jaladugdhābhyāṃ iti paṭhati||34-35||-

sitāmadhukabimbībhiḥ siddhaṃ vā''je payasyapi ||36|| bimbīkvāthe vimathyoṣṇaṃ śītībhūtaṃ taduddhṛtam | punaḥ paceddaśakṣīraṃ sitāmadhukacandanaiḥ ||37|| bilvāmbugāḍhaṃ tattailaṃ bādhirye karṇapūraṇam |38|

sitāmadhuketyādi| sitāmadhukabimbībhiḥ kalkitābhiśchāgīkṣīre caturguṇe pakvaṃ tilatailamuṣṇameva bimbīkvāthe mathitvā śītībhūtaṃ pāṇinā''dāya punarapi bilvaphalakvāthe viloḍitaṃ sitaśarkarāyaṣṭīmadhuraktacandanaiḥ kalkīkṛtairdaśaguṇe kṣīre vipacet| kecid ‘bilvāmbugāḍhaṃ’ ityatra ‘bimbyambugāḍhaṃ’ iti paṭhanti||36-37||-

ab.seg: vakṣyate yaḥpratiśyāye vidhiḥ so'pyatra pūjitaḥ ||38||

idānīṃ bādhirye kaphānubandho'pyastītyanāgatāvekṣaṇena saṅkṣepārthamatideśena cikitsāmāha- vakṣyate ya ityādi| so'pyatra pūjita iti ‘navaṃ pratiśyāyamapāsya sarvamupācaret sarpiṣa eva pānaiḥ’ ityādinoktaḥ||38||

div.ab: vātavyādhiṣu yaścokto vidhiḥ sa ca hito bhavet |39|
śuddhavātakṛte punaratītāvekṣaṇena saṅkṣepārthamatideśena nirdiśannāha- vātavyādhiṣvityādi| vātavyādhyukto vidhiḥ nivātabrahmacaryādikaḥ|39|-
karṇasrāve pūtikarṇe tathaiva kṛmikarṇake ||39|| samānaṃ karma kurvīta yogān vaiśeṣikānapi |40|
karma cikitsām||39||-

ab.seg: śirovirecanaṃ caiva dhūpanaṃ pūraṇaṃ tathā ||40||
pramārjanaṃ dhāvanaṃ ca vīkṣya vīkṣyāvacārayet | rājavṛkṣāditoyena surasādigaṇena vā ||41||

kiṃ tat samānaṃ karmetyāha- śirovirecanamityādi| pramārjanaṃ picukūrcikayā karṇaproñchanaṃ, dhāvanaṃ prakṣālanam| vīkṣya vīkṣyeti pratyekaṃ karṇaprasrāvādiṣu doṣadūṣyādimalaviśeṣaṃ ‘doṣadūṣyādibalaviśeṣaṃ’ iti pā. dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvetyarthaḥ| rājavṛkṣāditoyenetyādi| rājavṛkṣādiḥ āragvadhādiḥ||40-41||
karṇaprakṣālanaṃ kāryaṃ cūrṇaireṣāṃ ca pūraṇam | kvāthaṃ pañcakaṣāyaṃ tu kapittharasayojitam ||42||
karṇasrāve praśaṃsanti pūraṇaṃ madhunā saha | sarjatvakcūrṇasaṃyuktaḥ kārpāsīphalajo rasaḥ ||43||
yojito madhunā vā'pi karṇasrāve praśasyate | lākṣā rasāñjanaṃ sarjaścūrṇitaṃ karṇapūraṇam ||44||
saśaivalaṃ mahāvṛkṣajambvāmraprasavāyutam | kulīrakṣaudramaṇḍūkīsiddhaṃ tailaṃ ca pūjitam ||45||

samānaṃ karmābhidhāya vaiśeṣikān yogānāha- karṇetyādi| pañcakaṣāyamasminnevādhyāye ‘tindukānyabhayā rodhraṃ samaṅgā''malakaṃ’ ityādinā paṭhiṣyati, anye tu āragvadhaśirīṣajambusarjāśvakarṇajaṃ pañcakaṣāyacūrṇaṃ kathayanti, tacca ṭīkāpañjikābhyāṃ nāṅgīkṛtam| sarjatvagityādi| kārpāsī vanakārpāsī| śaivalaṃ dūrvā, haṭhamityanye| mahāvṛkṣaḥ sehuṇḍaḥ, prasavāḥ pallavāḥ| kulīraḥ karkaṭaśṛṅgī, maṇḍūkī brāhmībhedaḥ| śaivalādikaṃ prasavaparyantaṃ kaṣāyadravyaṃ, kulīrādikaṃ ca kalkadravyam| pūjitaṃ ‘karṇasrāve karṇapūraṇam’ ityadhyāhāryam||42-45||
tindukānyabhayā rodhraṃ samaṅgā''malakaṃ madhu | pūraṇaṃ cātra ‘cātipathyaṃ syāt’ iti pā. pathyaṃ syātkapittharasayojitam ||46||
tindukānyabhayā rodhramityādi| samaṅgā añjalikārikā, ‘varāhakrāntā’ ityapare| idaṃ pañcakaṣāyacūrṇam||46||

div.ab: rasamāmrakapitthānāṃ madhūkadhavaśālajam | pūraṇārthaṃ praśaṃsanti tailaṃ vā tairvipācitam ||47|| priyaṅgumadhukāmbaṣṭhādhātakīśilaparṇibhiḥ | mañjiṣṭhālodhralākṣābhiḥ kapitthasya rasena vā ||48|| pacettailaṃ tadāsrāvamavagṛhṇāti pūraṇāt |49|

rasamāmretyādi| āmrādipallavānāṃ rasaḥ svarasa eva ekaikaḥ samasto vā karṇapūraṇam, tairvipakvaṃ vā tilatailaṃ pūyasrāve pūraṇam| priyaṅgumadhukāmbaṣṭhetyādi| priyaṅgvādikalkaiḥ kapitthapallavarasena caturguṇena tilatailaṃ siddhaṃ karṇasrāvāpaham| ambaṣṭhā sāṅkuraḍā, śilā manaḥśilā, parṇī śālaparṇī||47-48||-

ghṛtaṃ rasāñjanaṃ nāryāḥ kṣīreṇa madhusaṃyutam ||49|| tatpraśastaṃ cirotthe'pi sāsrāve pūtikarṇake | nirguṇḍīsvarasastailaṃ sindhurdhūmarajo guḍaḥ ||50|| pūraṇaḥ pūtikarṇasya śamano madhusaṃyutaḥ |51|
idānīṃ pūtikarṇasya viśeṣacikitsāṃ yogadvayenāha- ghṛṣṭamityādi||49-50||-

ab.seg: kṛmikarṇakanāśārthaṃ kṛmighnaṃ yojayedvidhim ||51||
kṛmikarṇe vaiśeṣikamāha- kṛmikarṇakanāśārthamityādi| kṛmighno vidhiḥ krimipratiṣedhe ‘karṇapratiṣedhe’ iti pā. vakṣyamāṇaḥ||51||

div.ab: vārtākudhūmaśca hitaḥ sārṣapasneha eva ca |52|
aparamapi viśeṣacikitsitamāha- vārtākudhūma ityādi| pariṇataśuṣkavārtākudhūmasya pānaṃ karṇadhūpanaṃ ca, sārṣapasnehena karṇapūraṇaṃ, tantrāntaroktatvāt|52|-

ab.seg: kṛmighnaṃ haritālena gavāṃ mūtrayutena ca ||52||
gugguloḥ karṇadaurgandhye dhūpanaṃ śreṣṭhamucyate | chardanaṃ dhūmapānaṃ ca kavalasya ca dhāraṇam ||53||

kṛmikṛtadaurgandhyacikitsāmāha- kṛmighnamityādi| kṛmighnaṃ viḍaṅgasāracūrṇaṃ, tacca haritālacūrṇena yutaṃ gomūtreṇa pūraṇaṃ, guggulunā dhūpanam| chardanamityādi| kecicchardanādikaṃ kriyātritayaṃ trayāṇāmāsrāvādīnāṃ hitamāhuḥ; tanna, yataḥ kṛmikṛtadaurgandhyasānnidhyādvidehādiṣvasya ‘videhādiṣvapyadarśanāt’ iti pā. darśanād daurgandhya eva chardanāditritayaṃ hitam||52-53||
karṇakṣveḍe hitaṃ tailaṃ sārṣapaṃ caiva pūraṇam | vidradhau cāpi kurvīta vidradhyuktaṃ cikitsitam ||54||

karṇakṣveḍe hitamityādi| karṇakṣveḍe yat sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ pūraṇe uktaṃ tadvidradhāvapi kurvīta; na kevalaṃ tadeva kurvīta vidradhyuktaṃ cikitsitamapi kurvītetyarthaḥ| vātaje āme savedane vidradhau tilatailena sekaḥ, kaphaje punaḥ sārṣapataileneti||54||
prakledya dhīmāṃstailena svedena pravilāyya ca | śodhayetkarṇaviṭkaṃ tu bhiṣak samyak śalākayā ||55||
karṇagūthacikitsāmāha- prakledyetyādi||55||
nāḍīsvedo'tha vamanaṃ dhūmo mūrdhavirecanam | vidhiśca kaphahṛtsarvaḥ karṇakaṇḍūmapohati ||56||
karṇakaṇḍūcikitsāmāha- nāḍīsveda ityādi| vamanaṃ sasvedavamanaṃ, dhūmo'tra vairecanikaḥ||56||
atha karṇapratīnāhe snehasvedau prayojayet | tato viriktaśirasaḥ kriyāṃ prāptāṃ samācaret ||57||
karṇapratīnāhe cikitsāmāha- athetyādi| kriyāṃ snehasvedanasyādikāṃ, prāptāṃ yuktām||57||

div.ab: karṇapākasya bhaiṣajyaṃ kuryātpittavisarpavat |58|
karṇapāke cikitsāmāha- karṇapākasyetyādi| śītālepanapariṣekādīṃśca taccikitsitoktān kuryāt|58|-
karṇacchidre vartamānaṃ kīṭaṃ kledamalādi vā ||58|| śṛṅgeṇāpahareddhīmānathavā'pi śalākayā |59|
śārīradoṣabhavakarṇagūthapratyākarṣaṇacikitsāprasaṅgenāgantukīṭamalādīnāmākarṣaṇacikitsāmāha- karṇacchidra ityādi| śṛṅgeṇāpaharet ‘ācūṣya’ iti śeṣaḥ||58||-

ab.seg: śeṣāṇāṃ tu vikārāṇāṃ prāk cikitsitamīritam ||59||

idānīṃ śālakyasiddhāntena caturvidhānāmarśasāṃ saptavidhānāmarbudānāṃ caturvidhānāṃ śophānāṃ kiṃ cikitsitamiti pṛṣṭhaḥ śālākyatantrasya nyūnatādoṣaṃ parijihīrṣurāha- śeṣāṇāmityādi| śeṣāṇāṃ caturvidhānāmarśasāṃ, saptavidhānām arbudānāṃ, caturvidhānāṃ śophānāṃ cetyarthaḥ| prāgiti arśaādicikitsite| īritaṃ pratidoṣaṃ pratyavasthaṃ sarvamuktamityarthaḥ||59||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre karṇagatarogapratiṣedho nāmaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||21||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre ekaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||21||

div.head: nāsāgatarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto nāsāgatarogavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi| gataśabda āśrayavacanaḥ, tena nāsāśritarogavijñānamadhikṛtya kṛto'dhyāyo nāsāgatarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ||1-2||
apīnasaḥ pūtinasyaṃ ‘pūtināsaḥ’ iti pā. nāsāpākastathaiva ca | tathā śoṇitapittaṃ ca pūyaśoṇitameva ca ||3||
kṣavathurbhraṃśathurdīpto nāsānāhaḥ parisravaḥ | nāsāśoṣeṇa sahitā daśaikāśceritā gadāḥ ||4||
catvāryarśāṃsi catvāraḥ śophāḥ saptārbudāni ca | pratiśyāyāśca ye pañca vakṣyante sacikitsitāḥ | ekatriṃśanmitāste ‘ekatriṃśatsahitaistaistu’ iti pā. tu nāsārogāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||5||

nāsārogān nāmabhiḥ saṅkhyayā cāha- apīnasa ityādi| saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva saṅkhyāyāṃ labdhāyāṃ bhūyaḥ saṅkhyākaraṇaṃ niyamārthaṃ; tena videhoktasaṅkhyayā adhikatvaṃ mā bhūt| ‘apīnasaḥ pūtipākau pittāsṛk pūyaśoṇitam’ iti kecit paṭhanti||3-5||

div.ab: ānahyate yasya vidhūpyate ca praklidyate śuṣyati ‘pāpacyate klidyati’ iti pā. cāpi nāsā | na vetti yo gandharasāṃśca janturjuṣṭaṃ vyavasyettamapīnasena ||6|| taṃ cānilaśleṣmabhavaṃ vikāraṃ brūyāt pratiśyāyasamānaliṅgam |7|

apīnasalakṣaṇamāha- ānahyata ityādi| ānahyate kaphena pittaśoṣitena ānahyata iva| vidhūpyate dhūmāyata iva, pittāt; praklidyate ārdrībhavati kaphāt; śuṣyati pittāt| gandharasān gandhān rasāṃścetyarthaḥ; anye tu gandhasya rasā gandharasāḥ, rasatergatyarthatvāt; yāthātathyena gandhaṃ jānātītyarthaḥ| vyavasyet jānīyāt| kecidamuṃ pāṭhamanyathā paṭhanti, sa cādarśanānna likhitaḥ||6||-
doṣairvidagdhairgalatālumūle saṃvāsito yasya samīraṇastu ||7|| nireti pūtirmukhanāsikābhyāṃ taṃ pūtināsaṃ pravadanti rogam |8|

pūtināsasya lakṣaṇamāha- doṣairityādi| raktamapi doṣatvena vivakṣitaṃ, tena doṣairiti bahuvacanam| vidagdhaiḥ mūrcchitaiḥ svarūpapracyutairvā| saṃvāsitaḥ pittaśleṣmaraktairātmavikṛtigandhena miśrīkṛtaḥ| nireti nirgacchati, pūtiḥ śaṭitagandho vāyuḥ||7||-
ghrāṇāśritaṃ pittamarūṃṣi kuryādyasmin vikāre balavāṃśca pākaḥ ||8|| taṃ nāsikāpākamiti vyavasyedvikledakothāvapi yatra dṛṣṭau |9|
nāsāpākasya lakṣaṇamāha- ghrāṇāśritamityādi| arūṃṣi vraṇān| vikleda ārdrabhāvaḥ, kothaḥ pūtibhāvaḥ, etau yatra yasmin vikāre, dṛṣṭau darśanaṃ gatau||8||-

ab.seg: caturvidhaṃ dviprabhavaṃ dvimārgaṃ vakṣyāmi bhūyaḥ khalu raktapittam ||9||

raktapittalakṣaṇamanāgatāvekṣaṇena nirdiśannāha- caturvidhamityādi| caturvidhaṃ vātapittakaphasannipātātmakam| dviprabhavaṃ dvau prabhavau yakṛtplīhānau yasya taṃ tathā; anye tu snigdharūkṣoṣṇabhedena dvirutpattikāraṇaṃ manyante; apare tu dviprabhavamāmāśayapakvāśayaprabhavamāhuḥ| dvimārgam adharottaramārgadvayam||9||
doṣairvidagdhairathavā'pi jantorlalāṭadeśe'bhihatasya taistu | nāsā sravet pūyamasṛgvimiśraṃ taṃ pūyaraktaṃ pravadanti rogam ||10||
pūyaraktaṃ doṣāgantunimittaṃ darśayannāha- doṣairityādi| vidagdhaiḥ pittaraktādhikyādviruddhāṃ pariṇatiṃ prāptaiḥ| lalāṭābhighāto'pi viruddhapākaṃ prāpto mantavyaḥ||10||

div.ab: ghrāṇāśrite marmaṇi sampraduṣṭe ‘sampraduṣṭaḥ’ iti pā. yasyānilo nāsikayā nireti ||11|| kaphānuyāto bahuśaḥ saśabdastaṃ rogamāhuḥ kṣavathuṃ vidhijñāḥ |12|
kṣavathurapi doṣajaścāgantujaśca, tatra pūrvaṃ doṣajameva nirdiśannāha- ghrāṇetyādi| ghrāṇāśrite marmaṇi śṛṅgāṭakākhye; ‘ghrāṇāśrite marmaṇi’ ityatra ‘ghrāṇāśrite śleṣmaṇi’ iti kecit paṭhanti||11||-
tīkṣṇopayogādatijighrato vā bhāvān kaṭūnarkanirīkṣaṇādvā ||12|| sūtrādibhirvā taruṇāsthimarmaṇyudghāṭite'nyaḥ kṣavathurnireti |13|
āgantujaṃ kṣavathumāha- tīkṣṇopayogādityādi| atijighrataḥ āghrāyataḥ| bhāvān dravyāṇi| taruṇāsthimarma nāsāvaṃśāsthimarma śṛṅgāṭakasañjñam| udghāṭite ūrdhvaṃ cālite||12||-
prabhraśyate nāsikayaiva yaśca ‘yasya’ iti pā. sāndro vidagdho lavaṇaḥ kaphastu ||13|| prāk sañcito mūrdhani pittataptastaṃ bhraṃśathuṃ vyādhimudāharanti |14|
bhraṃśathorlakṣaṇamāha- prabhraśyata ityādi| prabhraśyate atyarthamadhaḥ patati nāsikayaiva, na mukhena||13||-
ghrāṇe bhṛśaṃ dāhasamanvite tu viniḥsareddhūma iveha vāyuḥ ||14|| nāsā pradīpteva ca yasya jantorvyādhiṃ tu taṃ dīptamudāharanti |15|
dīptalakṣaṇamāha- ghrāṇe bhṛśamityādi| viniḥsaret niryāti| vāyuḥ niśvāsaḥ| pradīpteva jvaliteva nāsā syāt||14||-
kaphāvṛto vāyurudānasañjño yadā svamārge viguṇaḥ sthitaḥ syāt ||15|| ghrāṇaṃ vṛṇotīva tadā sa rogo nāsāpratīnāha iti pradiṣṭaḥ |16|
nāsāpratīnāhalakṣaṇamāha- kaphāvṛta ityādi| nāsā pratinahyate badhyata iva vāteneti nāsāpratīnāhaḥ||15||-
ajasramacchaṃ salilaprakāśaṃ yasyāvivarṇaṃ sravatīha nāsā ||16|| rātrau viśeṣeṇa hi taṃ vikāraṃ nāsāparisrāvamiti vyavasyet |17|
nāsāparisrāvamāha- ajasramacchamityādi| ajasram anavaratam| avivarṇam aviśiṣṭavarṇam| atra roge srāvaḥ śṛṅgāṭakākhyasrotasi pravilāyitāt kaphāt| vyavasyet jānīyāt||16||-
ghrāṇāśrite śleṣmaṇi mārutena pittena gāḍhaṃ pariśoṣite ca ||17|| samucchvasityūrdhvamadhaśca kṛcchrādyastasya nāsāpariśoṣa uktaḥ |18|
nāsāśoṣalakṣaṇamāha- ghrāṇāśrite ityādi| gāḍham atiśayena||17||-
doṣaistribhistaiḥ pṛthagekaśaśca brūyāttathā'rśāṃsi tathaiva śophān ||18|| śālākyasiddhāntamavekṣya cāpi sarvātmakaṃ saptamamarbudaṃ tu |19|

idānīmuktānāmarśaādīnāṃ sāmānyena lakṣaṇamāha- doṣairityādi| pṛthagdoṣaiḥ trīṇyarśāṃsi, sannipātenaikaṃ, evaṃ catvāryarśāṃsi| tathaiva śophāniti śophā api catvāra ityarthaḥ| śālākyasiddhāntamavekṣyeti ‘vātena pittena kaphena cāpi’ ityādinā nidānasthāne ṣaḍarbudāni nirdiṣṭāni, saptamaṃ sarvātmakaṃ śālākyatantre||18||-

ab.seg: rogaḥ pratiśyāya ihopadiṣṭaḥ sa vakṣyate pañcavidhaḥ purastāt ||19||
pratiśyāyasyānāgatāvekṣaṇena saṅkṣepārthaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ nirdiśannāha- roga ityādi||19||

div.ab: (nāsāsrotogatā rogāstriṃśadekaśca kīrtitāḥ |20|

nanu, sarvāṅgagatānāṃ kuṣṭhādīnāmapyatra nāsāyāṃ sambhavo'stīti nāsārogāṇaṃ saṅkhyātirekamāśaṅkyāha- nāsāsrotogatā rogā ityādi| nāsāsrotasi gatā eva ye rogāsta eva mayaikatriṃśaduktāḥ, na punaratra nāsāyāṃ ye bhavanti|20|-

ab.seg: srotaḥpathe yadvipulaṃ kośavaccārbudaṃ bhavet ayaṃ śloko hārāṇacandreṇa na paṭhitaḥ ) ||20||
nāsāgataśophān nāsārbudalakṣaṇena pṛthakkurvannāha- srota ityādi| kośaḥ antaḥpūraṇavastu, yādṛśamasyāntaḥpūraṇavastu tādṛśamantaḥpūraṇakaraṃ vastu śothasya nāstītyarthaḥ||20||
śophāstu śophavijñānā nāsāsrotovyavasthitāḥ | nidāne'rśāṃsi nirdiṣṭānyevaṃ tāni vibhāvayet ||21||

śophāḥ punaḥ kīdṛśā ityāha- śophā ityādi| śopho vijñānaṃ yeṣāṃ te śophavijñānāḥ; athavā prāguktaśophānāmiva vijñānaṃ yeṣāmiti| nidāne'rśāṃsītyādi| eṣa pāṭho dviruktibhayānnibandhakārairna paṭhitaḥ||21||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre nāsāgatarogavijñānīyo nāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||22||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||22||

div.head: nāsāgatarogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto nāsāgatarogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi||1-2||
pūrvoddiṣṭe pūtinasye ca jantoḥ snehasvedau chardanaṃ sraṃsanaṃ ca | yuktaṃ bhaktaṃ tīkṣṇamalpaṃ laghu syāduṣṇaṃ toyaṃ dhūmapānaṃ ca kāle ||3||

apīnasapūtinasyayościkitsāmāha- pūrvoddiṣṭe ityādi| pūrvoddiṣṭe apīnase ityarthaḥ| chardanaṃ vamanaṃ, sraṃsanaṃ virekaḥ| kṛtaśuddherantaḥsaṃsargaṃ niyamayannāha- yuktamityādi| toyasya pānaṃ niyamayannāha- uṣṇaṃ toyamityādi| kāle dhūmapānakāle||3||
hiṅgu vyoṣaṃ vatsakākhyaṃ śivāṭī lākṣā bījaṃ saurabhaṃ kaṭphalaṃ ca | ugrā kuṣṭhaṃ tīkṣṇagandhā viḍaṅgaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ nityaṃ cāvapīḍe karañjam ||4||

tayorevāvapīḍamuddiśannāha- hiṅgu vyoṣamityādi| vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukam| śivāṭī śvetapunarnavā, śephāliketyanye| ugrā vacā, tīkṣṇagandhā śobhāñjanakaḥ| avapīḍya dīyata ityāvapīḍaḥ| kecidamumeva pāṭhamanyathā paṭhanti, sa cādarśanānna likhitaḥ||4||

div.ab: etairdravyaiḥ sārṣapaṃ mūtrayuktaṃ tailaṃ dhīmānnasyahetoḥ paceta |5|

apīnasapūtinasyayoretairevāvapīḍanadravyairnasyārthaṃ tailasādhanamāha- etairdravyairityādi| kecit ‘asmin taile yuktitaḥ sampaceta mañjiṣṭhāṃ vai srotasi mrakṣaṇārthaṃ, iti paṭhanti, sa cācāryairanārṣīkṛtaḥ|5|-
nāsāpāke pittahṛtsaṃvidhānaṃ kāryaṃ sarvaṃ bāhmamābhyantaraṃ ca ||5|| hṛtvā raktaṃ kṣīravṛkṣatvacaśca sājyāḥ sekā yojanīyāśca lepāḥ |6|
nāsāpāke bheṣajamāha- nāsāpāke ityādi| bāhmaṃ lepābhyaṅgapariṣekādi, ābhyantaraṃ punarāhārasnehapānavirecanādi| sājyāḥ saghṛtāḥ||5||-
vakṣyāmyūrdhvaṃ raktapittopaśāntiṃ... |6|

raktapittasyānāgatāvekṣaṇena saṅkṣepārthaṃ cikitsitamāha- vakṣyāmyūrdhvamityādi| ūrdhvaṃ raktapittapratiṣedhe| upaśāntiṃ cikitsitaṃ ‘nāsāpravṛtte jalamāśu deyaṃ saśarkaraṃ nāsikayā payo vā’ ityādikam|6|-

ab.seg: ... nāḍīvatsyāt pūyarakte cikitsā ||6||
pūyaraktasya vidhānamāha- nāḍīvadityādi| pūyarakte nāḍīvat nāḍītulyā cikitsā, yā visarpanāḍīstanarogacikitsite vyākhyātā||6||

div.ab: vānte samyak cāvapīḍaṃ vadanti tīkṣṇaṃ ghūmaṃ śodhanaṃ cātra nasyam |7|

pūyarakte sāmānyāṃ cikitsāmabhidhāya viśeṣacikitsāmāha- vānte ityādi| atra pūyarakte; anye tu ‘atreti nāsāpāke’ iti vyākhyānayanti| kecit ‘vānte samyak’ ityādikaṃ kṣavathau bhraṃśathau ca yojayanti|7|-
kṣepyaṃ nasyaṃ mūrdhavairecanīyairnāḍyā cūrṇaṃ kṣavathau bhraṃśathau ca ||7|| kuryāt svedān mūrdhni vātāmayaghnān snigdhān dhūmān yadyadanyadvitaṃ ca |8|

kṣavathau bhraṃśathau ca cikitsāmāha- kṣepyamityādi| nasyamiti pradhamanamityarthaḥ, pañcavidhatvānnasyasya| mūrdhavairecanīyaiḥ śirovirecanadravyaiḥ| pradhamanena kṣīṇe kaphe vāte ca vṛddhe sati anilaghnān snigdhānityarthaḥ| anyaditi śirobastimastiṣkādikam||7||-

ab.seg: dīpte roge paittikaṃ saṃvidhānaṃ kuryāt sarvaṃ svādu yacchītalaṃ ca ||8||
dīptarogasya cikitsāmāha- dīpte ityādi| saṃvidhānaṃ karmetyarthaḥ, sarvaṃ bāhmābhyantaram||8||
nāsānāhe snehapānaṃ pradhānaṃ snigdhā dhūmā mūrdhabastiśca nityam | balātailaṃ sarvathaivopayojyaṃ vātavyādhāvanyaduktaṃ ca yadyat ||9||

nāsānāhacikitsāmāha- nāsānāhe snehapānamityādi| snehapānam uttarabhaktakam| mūrdhabastiśceti cakārāt sālvaṇopanāhādayo gṛhyante| sarvathaiveti pānābhyaṅgānuvāsanaśirobastimastiṣkādibhiḥ sarvaireva prakāraiḥ| anyat aṇutailādikam||9||
nāsāsrāve ghrāṇataścūrṇamuktaṃ nāḍyā deyaṃ yo'vapīḍaśca tīkṣṇaḥ | tīkṣṇaṃ dhūmaṃ devadārvagnikābhyāṃ māṃsaṃ vā''jaṃ yuktamatrādiśanti ||10||

nāsāsrāvacikitsāmāha- nāsasrāve ityādi| uktaṃ cūrṇaṃ śirovirecanadravyakṛtam| tīkṣṇo'vapīḍo ‘hiṅgu vyoṣaṃ vatsakākhyaṃ’ ityādinā ihaivādhyāye proktaḥ| agnikaḥ citrakaḥ, ajamodāmanye| ājaṃ māṃsaṃ ‘bhojane’ iti śeṣaḥ||10||
nāsāśoṣe kṣīrasarpiḥ pradhānaṃ siddhaṃ tailaṃ cāṇukalpena nasyam | sarpiḥpānaṃ bhojanaṃ jāṅgalaiśca snehaḥ svedaḥ snaihikaścāpi dhūmaḥ ||11||

nāsāśoṣe cikitsāmāha- nāsāśoṣe kṣīrasarpirityādi| kṣīrasarpiḥ ādita uktam| pradhānaṃ śreṣṭham| nasye nasyaviṣaye| aṇukalpena aṇutailavidhānena vātavyādhyuktena| sarpiḥpānam antarbhaktakam| jāṅgalaiḥ eṇādimāṃsaiḥ, snehaḥ sveda ityarthaḥ| snaihiko dhūmo madhūcchiṣṭādibhiḥ||11||
śeṣān rogān ghrāṇajān sanniyaccheduktaṃ teṣāṃ yadyathā saṃvidhānam ||12||
arśaḥprabhṛtīnāṃ cikitsāmāha- śeṣānityādi| śeṣān rogānarśaḥśophādīn, sanniyacchet cikitset| uktaṃ saṃvidhānaṃ sve sve cikitsite||12||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre nāsāgatarogapratiṣedho nāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||23||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||23||

div.head: pratiśyāyapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ pratiśyāyapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi| vātaṃ prati abhimukhaṃ śyāyo gamanaṃ kaphādīnāṃ yatra sa pratiśyāyaḥ| pratiṣedhaḥ cikitsitam||1-2||
nārīprasaṅgaḥ śiraso'bhitāpo dhūmo rajaḥ śītamatipratāpaḥ | sandhāraṇaṃ mūtrapurīṣayośca sadyaḥ pratiśyāyanidānamuktam ||3||

tacca cikitsitamalakṣitānāṃ vyādhīnāṃ na sambhavati, ataḥ pratiśyāyalakṣaṇārthaṃ pūrvaṃ sadyojanakameva nidānaṃ nirdiśannāha- nārīprasaṅga ityādi| nārīprasaṅgo nārīṣvatiśayena pravṛttiḥ| śiraḥ abhitapyate yena sa śirobhitāpaḥ| (śirobhitāpo ayaṃ pāṭho hastalikhitapustake nopalabhyate dhūmādiḥ, rajodhūmacayāśca nāsāpraviṣṭā hetavaḥ)| kecidamuṃ pāṭhaṃ na paṭhanti; tanna, yataḥ sarvanibandhakārairaṅgīkṛto'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ||3||
cayaṃ gatā mūrdhani mārutādayaḥ pṛthak samastāśca tathaiva śoṇitam | prakopyamāṇā vividhaiḥ prakopaṇairnṛṇāṃ pratiśyāyakarā bhavanti hi ||4||

sadyojanakaṃ nidānamabhidhāya cayādikrameṇa| kālāntarajanakamapi nidānamāha- cayamityādi| cayaṃ gatāḥ arthāt sve sve sthāne sañcayaṃ prāptāḥ| mūrdhanīti mūrdhani pratiśyāyakarā bhavantīti yojanīyam| yadi sve sve sthāne citāstat kathaṃ mūrdhani pratiśyāyakarā ityāha- prakopyamāṇā ityādi| vividhaiḥ prakopaṇaiḥ balavadvigrahādibhiḥ krodhādibhirdivāsvapnādibhiśca| anye tu mūrdhani sañcayaṃ prāptā doṣā iti vyākhyānayanti| nanu svasthānavṛddhiḥ sañcayaḥ, vātapittakapharaktānāṃ śirasi sthānaṃ nāsti, tatkathaṃ mūrdhani vātādīnāṃ sañcayaḥ? satyaṃ, ‘yo vāyurvaktrasañcārī’ ityādinā vāyoḥ śirasi sthānamuktaṃ, pittasya tvagdṛṣṭiśceti śirasi sthānadvayaṃ, śleṣmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ śirasi prasiddhameva, sirāṇāṃ sarvagatvādraktasyāpi ‘sarvasaratvāt’ iti pā. śirasi sthānaṃ, tasmāt śirasi sañcayaṃ gatā iti yuktam||4||
śirogurutvaṃ kṣavathoḥ pravartanaṃ tathā'ṅgamardaḥ parihṛṣṭaromatā | upadravāścāpyapare pṛthagvidhā nṛṇāṃ pratiśyāyapuraḥsarāḥ smṛtāḥ ||5||

pratiśyāyasya pūrvarūpamāha- śirogurutvamityādi| kṣavathoḥ pravartanaṃ chikkāyāḥ pravṛttiḥ| aṅgamardo vedanāviśeṣaḥ| parihṛṣṭaromatā ucchūnaromatā, uddharṣitaromāñca iti yāvat| pṛthagvidhā upadravā jvarārocakādayaḥ| puraḥsarā agragāminaḥ, pūrvarūpāṇītyarthaḥ||5||

div.ab: ānaddhā pihitā nāsā tanusrāvapravartinī | galatālvoṣṭhaśoṣaśca nistodaḥ śaṅkhayostathā ||6|| svaropaghātaśca bhavet pratiśyāye'nilātmake |7|
vātajapratiśyāyasya lakṣaṇamāha- ānaddhā pihitetyādi| ānaddhā ādhmātā pūriteva| pihitā rajaḥśūkapūrṇeva||6||-

ab.seg: uṣṇaḥ sapītakaḥ srāvo ghrāṇāt sravati paittike ||7||
kṛśo'tipāṇḍuḥ santapto bhavattṛṣṇāni(bhi)pīḍitaḥ | sadhūmaṃ sahasā vahniṃ vamatīva ca mānavaḥ ||8||
pittapratiśyāyasya lakṣaṇamāha- uṣṇa ityādi| sapītaka īṣatpīta ityarthaḥ| sadhūmamiti sadhūmamiva vahniṃ nāsayā vamatītyarthaḥ| sahasā akasmāt||7-8||

div.ab: kaphaḥ kaphakṛte ghrāṇācchuklaḥ śītaḥ sravenmuhuḥ | śuklāvabhāsaḥ śūnākṣo bhavedguruśiromukhaḥ ||9|| śirogalauṣṭhatālūnāṃ kaṇḍūyanamatīva ca |10|
kaphakṛtapratiśyāyaliṅgamāha- kapha ityādi| kaphakṛte pratiśyāye kaphaḥ sravediti sambandhanīyam||9||-

ab.seg: bhūtvā bhūtvā pratiśyāyo yo'kasmādvinivartate ||10||
sampakvo vā'pyapakvo vā sa sarvaprabhavaḥ smṛtaḥ | liṅgāni caiva sarveṣāṃ pīnasānāṃ ca sarvaje ||11||

sānnipātikasya liṅgaṃ nirdiśannāha- bhūtvetyādi| akasmāt kāraṇaṃ vinā| sarvaje pratiśyāye sarveṣāṃ vātādijānāṃ pratiśyāyānāṃ pīnasānāṃ liṅgāni bhavantīti yojyam| sānnipātikapratiśyāyo'sādhyaḥ, videhoktatvāt||10-11||

div.ab: raktaje tu pratiśyāye raktāsrāvaḥ pravartate | tāmrākṣaśca bhavejjantururoghātaprapīḍitaḥ ||12|| durgandhocchvāsavadanastathā gandhānna vetti ca | mūrcchanti cātra kṛmayaḥ śvetāḥ snigdhāstathā'ṇavaḥ ‘kṛṣṇāḥ’ iti pā.||13|| kṛmimūrdhavikāreṇa samānaṃ cāsya lakṣaṇam |14|

raktajapratiśyāyasya lakṣaṇamāha- raktaje ityādi| uroghātastantrāntaroktalakṣaṇaḥ tena prakarṣeṇa pīḍitaḥ| tadeva tantrāntaroktalakṣaṇaṃ darśayati,- “uraḥkṣataṃ guru stabdhaṃ pūtipūrṇakapho rasaḥ| sakāsaḥ sajvaro jñeya uroghātaḥ sapīnasaḥ”- iti| mūrcchanti patanti| atra raktajapratiśyāye| kṛmayaḥ sūkṣmāḥ| kṛmimūrdhavikāreṇetyādi| kṛmijasya śirorogasya yallakṣaṇaṃ tena samānamasya lakṣaṇamityarthaḥ| kecit ‘mūrcchanti cātra kṛmayaḥ śvetāḥ snigdhāstathā'ṇavaḥ’ iti pāṭhaṃ raktajapratiśyāyalakṣaṇabhinnaṃ paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- atreti eṣu sarveṣveva pratiśyāyeṣu||12-13||-

praklidyati punarnāsā punaśca pariśuṣyati ||14|| muhurānahyate cāpi muhurvivriyate tathā | niḥśvāsocchvāsadaurgandhyaṃ tathā gandhānna vetti ca ||15|| evaṃ duṣṭapratiśyāyaṃ jānīyāt kṛcchrasādhanam |16|
idānīmekadoṣaje'pi pratiśyāye durupacārato doṣāntaraprakopādduṣṭiṃ gatasya liṅgamāha- praklidyatītyādi||14-15||-

ab.seg: sarva eva pratiśyāyā narasyāpratikāriṇaḥ ||16||
kālena rogajananā jāyante duṣṭapīnasāḥ | bādhiryamāndhyamaghrāṇaṃ ghorāṃśca nayanāmayān | kāsāgnisādaśophāṃśca vṛddhāḥ kurvanti pīnasāḥ ||17||

idānīṃ sarveṣāmeva pratiśyāyānāmupekṣayā mithyāhārācāriṇo narasya kālāntareṇa rogāntarārambhakatvaṃ nirdiśannāha- sarva ityādi| sarve eva pratiśyāyāḥ kālena rogajananā bhavanti, tathā ta eva pratiśyāyāḥ krameṇa duṣṭapīnasā jāyante| ke te rogā ityāha- bādhiryamityādi| vṛddhāḥ pratiśyāyā bādhiryādīn kurvantīti piṇḍārthaḥ| pratiśyāyānāṃ pakvatā ‘pakvaṃ ghanaṃ cāpyavalambamānaṃ’ ityādinā jñeyā; etadviparyayeṇa cāmatā| kecidvṛddhasuśrutoktam,- “arucirvirasaṃ vaktraṃ nāsāsrāvo rujā'ratiḥ| śirogurutvaṃ kṣavathurjvaraścāmasya lakṣaṇam|| tanutvamāmaliṅgānāṃ śironāsāsyalāghavam| ghanapītakaphatvaṃ ca pakvapīnasalakṣaṇam”- iti pratiśyāyānāmāmapakvalakṣaṇaṃ paṭhanti||16-17||
navaṃ pratiśyāyamapāsya sarvamupācaret sarpiṣa eva pānaiḥ | svedairvicitrairvamanaiśca yuktaiḥ kālopapannairavapīḍanaiśca ||18||

idānīṃ pratiśyāyānāṃ sāmānyaṃ cikitsitamāha- navaṃ pratiśyāyamityādi| apāsya parityajya| sarveṣāṃ pratiśyāyānāṃ vātātmakatvāt sarveṣāmeva sarpiḥpānam| kālopapannaiḥ āvasthikakālayogyaiḥ| avapīḍanaiḥ nasyabhedaiḥ| kecidatra, ‘pīnasānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ heturyasmāt samīraṇaḥ| kaphapittādhike'pyasmāt mārutaṃ samupakramet|| tasmādabhiṣyandamudīryamāṇamupācaredādita eva dhīmān| ghṛtaiḥ sahiṅgvamlakaṭūṣṇasiddhaiḥ svedairvicitrairvamanaiśca tīkṣṇaiḥ|| kaṭutrikaṃ citrakatintiḍīkaṃ tālīśapatraṃ cavikāmlasañjñam| vicūrṇitaṃ jīrakacūrṇayuktamelācchadatvaksurabhīkṛtaṃ ca|| miśraṃ purāṇena guḍena dadyāttat pīnasānāṃ paripācanārtham| pakvaṃ guḍaṃ cāpi kaṭutrikeṇa ghṛtapragāḍhaṃ pralihet sukhoṣṇam| sarpirguḍābhyāṃ kaṭukaiśca pakvān khādecca śaktūnapi nātiśītān| guḍādhikaṃ cārdrakamādiśanti yuktoṣitaṃ ‘śuktoṣitaṃ’ iti pā. tat paripācanārtham| śirovirekaṃ vamanaṃ ca kecidāme na dātavyamiti bruvanti”- iti paṭhanti| sa ca pāṭho jejjaṭācāryeṇa nāṅgīkṛtaḥ||18||
apacyamānasya hi pācanārthaṃ svedo hito'mlairahimaṃ ca bhojyam | niṣevyamāṇaṃ payasā''rdrakaṃ vā sampācayedikṣuvikārayogaiḥ ||19||

navapratiśyāyasya pākārthaṃ cikitsāmāha- apacyamānasyetyādi| ahimam uṣṇaṃ, bhojyaṃ bhojanam| aparamapi pākārthaṃ yogamāha- niṣevyamāṇamityādi| ārdrakaṃ payasā pāyayem ikṣuvikārayogairvā| ikṣuvikārā guḍādayaḥ| kecit ‘niṣevyamāṇaṃ payasā''rdrakaṃ vā sampācayet tat kaṭukopayogaiḥ’- iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- dugdhena sahārdrakarasaḥ peyaḥ, anye tu dugdhena saha nāgaracūrṇaṃ peyamiti manyante; kaṭukopayogaiḥ kaṭudravyopayogaiḥ| asyāgre kecit ‘grāmyāṇi māṃsāni dadhīni madyaṃ māṣān kulatthān lavaṇaṃ kaṭūni| amlaṃ tathā cāmakamūlakaṃ ca tathā dhanatvaṃ ‘tathā(')tanutvaṃ’ iti pā. taruṇaḥ prayāti’- iti paṭhanti; sa ca na paṭhanīyaḥ, sarvanibandhakāraiḥ parihṛtatvāt||19||
pakvaṃ ghanaṃ cāpyavalambamānaṃ śirovirekairapakarṣayettam | virecanāsthāpanadhūmapānairavekṣya doṣān kavalagrahaiśca ||20||
pakvapratiśyāyasya nibarhaṇamāha- pakvamityādi||20||
nivātaśayyāsanaceṣṭanāni mūrdhno gurūṣṇaṃ ca tathaiva vāsaḥ | tīkṣṇā virekāḥ śirasaḥ sadhūmā rūkṣaṃ yavānnaṃ ‘palānnaṃ’ iti pā. vijayā ca sevyā ||21||
pakvapratiśyāye sevyamāha- nivātetyādi| āsanam upaveśanaṃ, ceṣṭanaṃ krīḍanam| mūrdhno mastakasya| vāso vastram| vijayā harītakī||21||
śītāmbuyoṣicchiśirāvagāhacintātirūkṣāśanavegarodhān | śokaṃ ca madyāni navāni caiva vivarjayet pīnasarogajuṣṭaḥ ||22||
sevyamuddiśya parihāryamāha- śītetyādi||22||
chardyaṅgasādajvaragauravārtamarocakāratyatisārayuktam | vilaṅghanaiḥ pācanadīpanīyairupācaret pīnasinaṃ yathāvat ||23||
idānīṃ sopadravasya pakvapratiśyāyasyāvasthikaṃ cikitsāsūtramāha- chardītyādi| aratiḥ na kvacidavasthitiścetasaḥ||23||
bahudravairvātakaphopasṛṣṭaṃ pracchardayet pīnasinaṃ vayaḥstham | upadravāṃścāpi yathopadeśaṃ svairbheṣajairbhojanasaṃvidhānaiḥ | jayedviditvā mṛdutāṃ gateṣu prāglakṣaṇeṣūktamathādiśecca ||24||

pakvapratiśyāye vamanāvasthāṃ nirdiśannāha- bahudravairityādi| vātakaphopasṛṣṭaṃ pīnasinaṃ bahudravairvāmayediti piṇḍārthaḥ| vayaḥsthaṃ taruṇam| vānte sati kiṃ kuryādityāha- upadravānityādi| yathopadeśaṃ yathākathitam| vakṣyamāṇacikitsāyāḥ kālamuddiśannāha- mṛdutāmityādi| mṛdutāṃ gateṣu alpībhūteṣu, prāglakṣaṇeṣu āmapratiśyāyalakṣaṇeṣu, uktaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ ‘vātike tu pratiśyāye pibet’ ityādikaṃ vidhānamityarthaḥ| kecit ‘viditvā mṛdutāṃ tu teṣāṃ prāglakṣaṇānāṃ vidhimādiśecca’ iti paṭhanti||24||

div.ab: vātike tu pratiśyāye pibet sarpiryathākramam | pañcabhirlavaṇaiḥ siddhaṃ prathamena gaṇena ca ||25|| nasyādiṣu vidhiṃ kṛtsnamavekṣetārditeritam |26|
vātikapratiśyāyasya cikitsāmāha- vātika ityādi| yathākramaṃ snehapānakrameṇetyarthaḥ| prathamo gaṇo vidārigandhādiḥ| kṛtsnaṃ samastam| arditeritaṃ arditacikitsitoktam||25||-

ab.seg: pittaraktotthayoḥ peyaṃ sarpirmadhurakaiḥ śṛtam ||26||
pariṣekān pradehāṃśca kuryādapi ca śītalān | śrīsarjarasapattaṅgapriyaṅgumadhuśarkarāḥ ||27||
drākṣāmadhūlikāgojīśrīparṇīmadhukaistathā | yujyante kavalāścātra vireko madhurairapi ||28||

pittaraktakṛtayoḥ pratiśyāyościkitsāmāha- pittaraktotthayorityādi| madhurakaiḥ kākolyādibhiḥ| kecit ‘pittaraktotthayostiktaiḥ kaṣāyamadhurairghṛtam’ iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- tiktāni paṭolādīni| pariṣekānityādi| pradehāḥ pralepāḥ| śrīriti śrīveṣṭakaḥ navanītadhūpaḥ, ‘guggulī’ iti loke, sarjaraso rālā, pattaṅgaṃ raktacandanaṃ; madhulikā guḍūcī, markaṭatṛṇamapare, gojī gojihvikā, śrīparṇī kāśmīrī| kavalā gaṇḍūṣabhedāḥ| atreti pittaraktotthayoḥ pratiśyāyayorityarthaḥ| madhuraiḥ drākṣāragvadhamadhuśarkarādibhiḥ||26-28||

div.ab: dhavatvaktriphalāśyāmātilvakairmadhukena ca | śrīparṇīrajanīmiśraiḥ kṣīre daśaguṇe pacet ||29|| tailaṃ kālopapannaṃ tannasyaṃ syādanayorhitam |30|

pittaraktakṛtayoḥ pratiśyāyayornasyārthaṃ tailamāha- dhavetyādi| dhavatvagādikalkaistailacaturthāṃśairdaśaguṇe kṣīre tailaṃ pacanīyam| śyāmā trivṛt, tilvakaḥ paṭṭikārodhraḥ| kālopapannaṃ nirāmatākālayogyam| anayoḥ pittaraktotthayoḥ pratiśyāyayoḥ||29||-

ab.seg: kaphaje sarpiṣā snigdhaṃ tilamāṣavipakvayā ||30||
yavāgvā vāmayedvāntaḥ kaphaghnaṃ kramamācaret | ubhe bale bṛhatyau ca viḍaṅgaṃ satrikaṇṭakam ||31||
śvetāmūlaṃ sadābhadrāṃ ‘sahāṃ bhadrāṃ’ iti pā. varṣābhūṃ cātra saṃharet | tailamebhirvipakvaṃ tu nasyamasyopakalpayet ||32||
saralākiṇihīdārunikumbheṅgudibhiḥ kṛtāḥ | vartayaścopayojyāḥ syurdhūmapāne yathāvidhi ||33||

kaphajapratiśyāyacikitsāmāha- kaphaje ityādi| tilamāṣavipakvayā yavāgvā kṛsarayā vāmanīyadravyasiddhayā vāmayet| vāntaśca kaphaghnaṃ kramamannasaṃsarjanākhyamācaret| ubhe ityādi| dvibalādibhiḥ kalkīkṛtaistailaṃ siddhaṃ nasye hitam| trikaṇṭakogokṣurakaḥ| śvetā śvetasyandaḥ| sadābhadrā kāśmarī| saraletyādi| saralā trivṛt, kiṇihī kaṭabhī, dāru devadāru, nikumbhā dantī||30-33||
sarpīṃṣi kaṭutiktāni tīkṣṇadhūmāḥ kaṭūni ca | bheṣajānyupayuktāni hanyuḥ sarvaprakopajam ||34||
rasāñjane sātiviṣe mustāyāṃ bhadradāruṇi | tailaṃ vipakvaṃ nasyārthe vidadhyāccātra buddhimān ||35||

sānnipātikapratiśyāyacikitsāmāha- sarpiṃṣītyādi| sarpīṣi ghṛtāni| kaṭutiktāni kaṭutiktadravyasiddhānītyarthaḥ| kaṭūni ceti cakāreṇa pratyekavātādiyuktā kriyā'pyanuktā samuccīyate| rasāñjane ityādi| atreti sānnipātikapratiśyāye ityarthaḥ||34-35||

div.ab: mustā tejovatī pāṭhā kaṭphalaṃ kaṭukā vacā | sarṣapāḥ pippalīmūlaṃ pippalyaḥ saindhavāgnikau ||36|| tutthaṃ karañjabījaṃ ca lavaṇaṃ bhadradāru ca | etaiḥ kṛtaṃ kaṣāyaṃ tu kavale samprayojayet ||37|| hitaṃ mūrdhavireke ca tailamebhirvipācitam |38|
mustetyādi| tejovatī kākamardanikā, agnikaḥ ajamodā| mustādibhiḥ kṛtaḥ kaṣāyaḥ sānnipātike pratiśyāye hitaḥ; sarveṣu pratiśyāyeṣu hita ityanye||36-37||-

ab.seg: kṣīramardhajale kvāthyaṃ jāṅgalairmṛgapakṣibhiḥ ||38||
puṣpairvimiśraṃ jalajairvātaghnairauṣadhairapi | hime kṣīrāvaśiṣṭe'smin ghṛtamutpādya yatnataḥ ||39||
sarvagandhasitānantāmadhukaṃ ‘sarvagandhāḥ sitā'nantāmadhukaṃ’ iti pā. candanaṃ tathā | āvāpya vipayedbhūyo daśakṣīraṃ tu tadghṛtam ||40||
nasye prayuktamudriktān pratiśyāyān vyapohati | yathāsvaṃ doṣaśamanaistailaṃ kuryācca yatnataḥ ||41||

kṣīramityādi| kṣīraṃ jāṅgalamāṃsādibhyo'ṣṭaguṇaṃ, ardhajale kṣīrādardhaṃ jalaṃ, jāṅgalaiḥ mṛgapakṣibhiḥ eṇādibhirlāvādibhiśca, jalajaiḥ puṣpaiḥ nīlotpalādibhiḥ, vātaghnaiḥ vidārīgandhādibhiḥ, ghṛtamutpādya ‘taddugdhaṃ mathitvā’ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ| sarvagandhā elādiparipaṭhitāḥ| sitā śarkarā, anantā utpalasārivā, candanaṃ raktacandanaṃ, āvāpya prakṣipya| tadghṛtaṃ kṣīramathanādyadutpannaṃ ghṛtaṃ, pratiśyāyān sarvān apohati sphoṭayati| doṣaśamanaiḥ vātapittaśleṣmaharadravyagaṇaiḥ| yathāsvaṃ yathātmīyam| idameva tailaṃ sarveṣāmeva pratiśyāyānām||38-41||
samūtrapittāścoddiṣṭāḥ kriyāḥ kṛmiṣu yojayet | yāpanārthaṃ kṛmighnāni bheṣajāni ca buddhimān ||42||

raktapratiśyāye kṛmisambhavo darśitaḥ, atasteṣāmeva kṛmīṇāṃ yāpanārthaṃ cikitsāmāha- samūtretyādi| kṛmighnā yāḥ kriyā uddiṣṭāstā gomūtrapittayuktā yāpanārthaṃ kartavyāḥ; tathā kṛmighnāni bheṣajāni surasādīni ca kartavyāni| buddhimān ūhāpohavān vaidyaḥ| ye tu sarveṣāmeva pratiśyāyānāṃ kṛmisambhavatvaṃ manyante te'muṃ ślokamīdṛśaṃ vyākhyānayanti- pratyekaṃ vātādipratiśyāye yāḥ kriyā uddiṣṭāstā eva gomūtrapittayuktā yathāsvaṃ kṛmiṣu yojayet||42||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre pratiśyāyapratiṣedho nāma caturviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||24||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre caturviṃśodhyāyaḥ||24||

div.head: śirorogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ śirorogavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
śiro rujati martyānāṃ vātapittakaphaistribhiḥ | sannipātena raktena kṣayeṇa krimibhistathā ||3||

sūryāvartānantavātārdhāvabhedakaśaṅkhakaiḥ | ekādaśaprakārasya ‘sūryovartāvabhedābhyāṃ śaṅkhakena tathaiva ca| daśaprakārasyāpyasya’ iti pā.| ḍalhaṇavyākhyānamapyetatpāṭhāntarānusāreṇaiva jñayam lakṣaṇaṃ sampravakṣyate ||4||

tāneva śirorogān saṅkhyayā āha- śiro rujatītyādi| tribhiriti pṛthagarthadyotanārtham| ‘śiro rujati martyānām’ ityatra kecit ‘śirorogā manuṣyāṇām’ iti paṭhanti| rogaśabdo yadyapi sāmānyavyādhivācakastathā'pi ye pīḍākarā vyādhayaste'tra gṛhyante, tena khālityādīnāmatrānupādānamiti vyākhyānayanti| ekādaśaprakārasyetyādi| ekādaśaivātra śirorogāḥ| anyatovātaśabdena anantavātasya sarvagatanayanarogavijñānīye proktatvāt| brahmadevastu videhādiṣu anantavātasya pṛthak pāṭhāt pṛthagevātra paṭhanīyaḥ, tena caikādaśa śirorogā iti brūte| atra kecidvidehadarśanāt sūryāvartakaviparyayamapi paṭhanti| tathā ca tadvacaḥ- “tatra vātānugaṃ pittaṃ citaṃ śirasi tiṣṭhati| madhyāhne tejasā'rkasya tadvivṛddhaṃ śirorujam|| karoti paittikīṃ ghorāṃ saṃśāmyati dinakṣaye| astaṃ gate prabhāhīne sūrye vāyurvivardhate|| pittaṃ śāntimavāpnoti tataḥ śāmyati vedanā| eṣa pittānilakṛtaḥ sūryāvartaviparyayaḥ”- iti| kecitsuśrutādhyāyino'nena pāṭhena sūryāvartakaviparyayaṃ paṭhanti,- “vātapittāt purojātā rujā'paityaparāhṇataḥ| sūryāvartaḥ sa tu prokto viparīte viparyayaḥ”- iti| asau sūryāvartaviparyayaścāturthikaviparyayavadasūtrito'pi gṛhyate| atra kecit “āluñcayate kampati cāpi mūrdhā sarpanti madhye ca pipīlikā vā| skandhaḥ śiraścāpyavaghūrṇate ca mūrcchā pralāpaśca tathaiva nidrā|| sañjñāpraṇāśaṃ janayedvinidrāṃ prātastataḥ paśyati cāticitram| gṛhṇāti manye hṛdayaṃ ca rūpaiḥ sarvairamībhiḥ samabhidrutastu|| tisro hi rātrīrna sa jātu jīvettaṃ śīrṣakaṃ sampravadanti rogam”- iti paṭhanti| sa ca nibandhakārairnāṅgīkṛtaḥ||1-4||
yasyānimittaṃ śiraso rujaśca bhavanti tīvrā niśi cātimātram | bandhopatāpaiśca bhavedviśeṣaḥ śirobhitāpaḥ sa samīraṇena ||5||
idānīṃ vātikaśirorogalakṣaṇamāha- yasyetyādi| animittam īṣatkāraṇam| tīvravacanāt pitte madhyāḥ rujo, madhyaḥ kaphe iti budhyate| viśeṣa upaśamaḥ| śirobhitāpaḥ śirorogaḥ||5||
yasyoṣṇamaṅgāracitaṃ yathaiva dahyeta ‘bhavecchiro dhūmavatī ca nāsā’ iti pā. dhūpyeta śirokṣināsam | śītena rātrau ca bhavedviśeṣaḥ śirobhitāpaḥ sa tu pittakopāt ||6||
paittikaśirorogalakṣaṇamāha- yasyetyādi||6||
śirogalaṃ yasya kaphopadigdhaṃ guru pratiṣṭabdhamatho himaṃ ca | śūnākṣikūṭaṃ vadanaṃ ca yasya śirobhitāpaḥ sa kaphaprakopāt ||7||

kaphajaśirorogalakṣaṇamāha- śirogalamityādi| upadigdham upaliptaṃ, guru bhārikaṃ, pratiṣṭabdham apracalitarūpamiva, himaṃ śītapūrṇamiva| śirobhitāpaḥ śirorogaḥ| atrānukto'pi viparyaya sevayopaśamo gṛhyate| ‘śirogalaṃ’ ityatra ‘śirobhavaṃ’ iti kecit paṭhanti||7||

div.ab: śirobhitāpe tritayapravṛtte sarvāṇi liṅgāni samudbhavanti ‘muhurbhavanti’ iti pā.|8|
sānnipātikaśirorogalakṣaṇamāha- śirobhitāpe ityādi|8|-

ab.seg: raktātmakaḥ pittasamānaliṅgaḥ sparśāsahatvaṃ śiraso bhavecca ||8||
raktajaśirorogalakṣaṇamāha- raktātmaka ityādi| pittajaśirorogadraktaje sparśāsahatvamadhikam||8||

div.ab: vasābalāsakṣatasambhavānāṃ śirogatānāmiha saṅkṣayeṇa | kṣayapravṛttaḥ śiraso'bhitāpaḥ kaṣṭo bhavedugrarujo'timātram ||9|| saṃsvedanacchardanadhūmanasyairasṛgvimokṣaiśca vivṛddhimeti |10|

kṣayajaśirorogasya liṅgamāha- vasetyādi| vasāśabda upalakṣaṇārthaḥ; tena dehasnehamastiṣkamedomajjāśukrāṇi gṛhyante| ‘vasābalāsakṣatasambhavānāṃ’ ityatra kecit ‘asṛgvasāśleṣmasamīraṇānāṃ’ iti paṭhanti; tannecchati gayī||9||-
nistudyate yasya śiro'timātraṃ sambhakṣyamāṇaṃ sphuṭatīva ‘sphuratīva cantaḥ’ iti pā. cāntaḥ ||10|| ghrāṇācca gacchetsalilaṃ saraktaṃ śirobhitāpaḥ kṛmibhiḥ sa ghoraḥ |11|
kṛmikṛtaśirorogalakṣaṇamāha- nistudyate ityādi| nistudyate śūlyate vyathyata ityarthaḥ| sphuṭatīva śīryata iva||10||-

sūryodayaṃ yā prati mandamandamakṣibhruvaṃ ruk samupaiti gāḍham ||11|| vivardhate cāṃśumatā sahaiva sūryāpavṛttau vinivartate ca | śītena śāntiṃ labhate kadāciduṣṇena jantuḥ sukhamāpnuyācca ||12|| taṃ bhāskarāvartamudāharanti sarvātmakaṃ kaṣṭatamaṃ vikāram |13|

suryāvartamāha- sūryodayamityādi| sūryāpavṛttau sūryāstasamaye| kasmātpravṛttinivṛttī bhavata iti pratipādayan nimirāha,- “svabhāvaśītā tamaso'bhimūlā rātristayodbhūtakaphena mārge| ruddhe marutkopamiyāt prabhāte rujaṃ karotyatra śirobhitāpe|| madhyāhnasūryātapatāpayogāt kaphe vilīne maruti prapanne| svamārgamāyāti tadā dinānte praśāntimāvarta ihārkapūrve” iti| sūryātapavilīnamastuluṅgakāraṇotpannasūryāvarta iti dṛḍhabalācāryaḥ| ‘uṣṇena jantuḥ sukhamāpnuyācca’ iti pāṭhātsūryāvartaviparyayaḥ kathito boddhavyaḥ| kecidatra ‘āvartasañjñaḥ sa ca sūryapūrvovyādhirmataḥ pittasamīraṇābhyām’ iti paṭhanti||11-12||-

doṣāstu duṣṭāstraya eva manyāṃ sampīḍya ghāṭāsu rujāṃ sutīvrām ||13|| kurvanti sākṣibhruvi śaṅkhadeśe sthitiṃ karotyāśu viśeṣatastu | gaṇḍasya pārśve tu karoti kampaṃ hanugrahaṃ locanajāṃśca rogān ||14|| anantavātaṃ tamudāharanti doṣatrayotthaṃ śiraso vikāram |15|
anantavātamāha- doṣāstu duṣṭāstraya ityādi| sātyakiprabhṛtibhistu śiraḥkamparogo'sādhyaḥ paṭhitaḥ; asmiṃstu śāstre sānnipātikaśirorogo'nantavāta evāntarbhavati||13-14||-
yasyottamāṅgārdhamatīva jantoḥ sambhedatodabhramaśūlajuṣṭam ||15|| pakṣāddaśāhādathavā'pyakasmāttasyārdhabhedaṃ tritayādvyavasyet |16|
ardhāvabhedamāha- yasyottametyādi| ‘tasyārdhabhedaṃ pavanāt sapittāt’ iti kecit ‘tritayādvyavasyet’ ityatra ‘dvitayāt’ iti vā pāṭhaḥ||15||-

ab.seg: śaṅkhāśrito vāyurudīrṇavegaḥ kṛtānuyātraḥ kaphapittaraktaiḥ ||16||
rujaḥ sutīvrāḥ pratanoti mūrdhni viśeṣataścāpi hi śaṅkhayostu | sukaṣṭamenaṃ khalu śaṅkhakākhyaṃ maharṣayo vedavidaḥ purāṇāḥ ||17||
vyādhiṃ vadantyudgatamṛtyukalpaṃ bhiṣaksahasrairapi durnivāram ||18||
śaṅkhakalakṣaṇamāha- śaṅkhāśrita ityādi| kṛtānuyātraḥ kṛtānugamaḥ| udgatamṛtyukalpaḥ upastitamṛtyusamaḥ| eṣa vyādhistu tryahānmārayati, tryahādanantaraṃ kuśalenopakrāntaḥ sidhyati||16-18||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre śirorogavijñānīyo nāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||25||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||25||

div.head: śirorogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ śirorogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
vātavyādhividhiḥ kāryaḥ śiroroge'nilātmake | payonupānaṃ seveta ghṛtaṃ tailamathāpi vā ||3||
