vātavyādhividhiriti samasto vātavyādhividhirbāhya ābhyantaro'pi kartavyaḥ; tatra bāhyaḥ snehasvedābhyaṅgapariṣekopanāhaśirobastinasyādiḥ, ābhyantarastu snehapānānuvāsananirūhādiḥ| payonupānamiti vātasya pittānubandhasya ghṛtaṃ, kaphānubandhasya tailam| yadyapi vātavyādhicikitsitātideśenaiva ghṛtatailayoḥ pānaṃ prāptaṃ, tathā'pi niyamārthametadvacanaṃ; athavā payonupānaprāptyarthaṃ; athavā snehādiprayogaparisamāptau prāyogikametadvidhānam||1-3||

div.ab: mudgān kulatthānmāṣāṃśca khādecca niśi kevalān | kaṭūṣṇāṃśca ‘kaṭūṣṇān samasarpiṣkān’ iti pā. sasarpiṣkānuṣṇaṃ cānu payaḥ pibet ||4|| pibedvā payasā tailaṃ tatkalkaṃ vā'pi mānavaḥ |5|

mudgānityādi| mudgānāṃ vātakaratve'pi māṣāṇāṃ śleṣmakaratve'pi vyādhipratyanīkatvādyogaśakteracintyatvāccopayogaḥ| kaṭūṣṇāniti kaṭūṣṇadravyasaṃskṛtān, sasarpiṣkān saghṛtān| tailaṃ tilatailam| tatkalkaṃ mudgādikalkaṃ; anye tilakalkamāhuḥ, tannecchati gayī jejjaṭaśca||4||-

vātaghnasiddhaiḥ kṣīraiśca sukhoṣṇaiḥ sekamācaret ||5|| tatsiddhaiḥ pāyasairvā'pi sukhoṣṇairlepayecchiraḥ | svinnairvā ‘snigdhaiḥ’ iti pā. matsyapiśitaiḥ kṛśarairvā sasaindhavaiḥ ||6|| candanotpalakuṣṭhairvā suślakṣṇairmagadhāyutaiḥ | snigdhasya tailaṃ nasyaṃ syāt kulīrarasasādhitam ||7|| varuṇādau gaṇe kṣuṇṇe kṣīramardhodakaṃ pacet | kṣīraśeṣaṃ ca tanmathyaṃ śītaṃ sāramupāharet ||8|| tato madhurakaiḥ siddhaṃ nasye tat pūjitaṃ haviḥ | tasmin vipakve kṣīre tu peyaṃ sarpiḥ saśarkaram ||9|| dhūmaṃ cāsya yathākālaṃ snaihikaṃ yojayedbhiṣak |10|

ābhyantaravidhiṃ pratipādya bāhyavidhimāha- vātaghnasiddhairityādi| vātaghnāni bhadradārvādīni| seko dhārāsekaḥ| tatsiddhaiḥ pāyasaiḥ vātaharadravyasiddhagokṣīrapāyasairityarthaḥ| lepayet upanāhayet| svinnairvā ‘snigdhaiḥ’ iti pā. matsyapiśitairiti matsyamāṃsaiḥ svinnairvā ‘snigdhaiḥ’ iti pā. śirasyupanāhaḥ| kṛśarairveti tilataṇḍulamāṣakṛtayavāgvopanāhaḥ; kṛśaraśabdo'kārānto'pyasti| candanādibhirvā ślakṣṇapiṣṭairupanāhaḥ| snigdhasyetyādi| snigdhasya kulīrarasacaturguṇe sādhitaṃ tailaṃ nasyaṃ syāditi piṇḍārthaḥ| varuṇādāvityādi| kṣuṇṇe jarjarīkṛte| tasmin vipakve kṣīre tviti varuṇādigaṇasiddhe kṣīre caturguṇe sādhitaṃ kākolyādiprativāpaṃ yat sarpistaccharkarāprakṣepaṃ peyamiti tātparyārthaḥ| anye tu ‘tasmin vipakvaṃ kṣīre ca’ iti paṭhanti; tasmin varuṇādikvāthe kṣīre ca sādhitaṃ sarpiḥ saśarkaraṃ pibediti ca vyākhyānayanti| dhūmaṃ cāsyetyādi| yathākālaṃ yathāvasthaṃ madhūcchiṣṭaprabhṛtibhiḥ snehamiśraiḥ kṛto dhūmaḥ snaihikaḥ||5-9||-
pānābhyañjananasyeṣu bastikarmaṇi secane ||10|| vidadhyāttraivṛtaṃ dhīmān balātailamathāpi vā |11|
pānābhyañjanetyādi| traivṛtam apatānakacikitsitoktaṃ, balātailaṃ mūḍhagarbhacikitsitoktam||10||-

ab.seg: bhojayecca rasaiḥ snigdhaiḥ payobhirvā susaṃskṛtaiḥ ||11||
bhojayedityādi| rasaiḥ māṃsarasaiḥ| susaṃskṛtaiḥ vātaharadravyasādhitaiḥ||11||

div.ab: pittaraktasamutthānau śirorogau nivārayet | śirolepaiḥ sasarpiṣkaiḥ pariṣekaiśca śītalaiḥ ||12|| kṣīrekṣurasadhānyāmlamastukṣaudrasitājalaiḥ |13|

idānīṃ pittajaraktajayostulyacikitsitatvāt saṅkṣepārthamubhayorekaṃ cikitsitamāha- pittaraktetyādi| śirolepaiḥ madhurakādidravyakṛtaiḥ pariṣekaiśca śītalaiḥ kṣīrekṣurasādikṛtaiḥ| tānyeva pariṣekadravyāṇyāha- kṣīrakṣvityādi| sitājalaṃ śarkarodakam||12||-

nalavañjulakahlāracandanotpalapadmakaiḥ ||13|| vaṃśaśaivalayaṣṭyāhvamustāmbhoruhasaṃyutaiḥ ‘śaṅkhaśaivalayaṣṭyāhva...’ iti pā.| śiraḥpralepaiḥ saghṛtairvaisarpaiśca tathāvidhaiḥ ||14|| madhuraiśca mukhālaipairnasyakarmabhireva ca |15|

śirolepadravyāṇyāha- naletyādi| nalaḥ śuṣiraparvā svanāmakhyātaḥ, vañjulo vetasaḥ kahlāraṃ raktotpalaṃ, candanaṃ raktacandanam, utpalaṃ nīlotpalaṃ, śaivalaṃ dūrvā, ambhoruhaṃ padmam| vaisarpaiśca tathāvidhairiti visarpacikitsitoktaiḥ pralepaiḥ (ci. 17); tāni tu uśīralāmajjakacandanasrotojamuktāmaṇigairikāṇi| tathāvidhairiti vacanādraktapittavisarpapralepaprakārairna tu kaphavātavisarpalepadravyaprakārairityarthaḥ| madhuraiḥ kākolyādibhiḥ| nasyamatra madhuradravyasaṃskṛtena snehena kṛtam| pittaraktasamutthānau śirorogau nivārayedityatrāpi sambandhanīyam||13-14||-
āsthāpanairvirekaiśca pathyaiśca snehabastibhiḥ ||15|| kṣīrasarpirhitaṃ nasyaṃ vasā vā jāṅgalā śubhā |16|

idānīṃ raktaje pittaje ca śiroroge vamanaṃ vihāya karmacatuṣṭayaṃ nirdiśannāha- āsthāpanairityādi| āsthāpanādibhiḥ pittaraktasamutthitau śirorogau nivārayediti sambandhaḥ| pathyaśabda āsthāpanādibhistribhiḥ sambandhanīyaḥ| pathyaiḥ hitaiḥ| tena vakṣyamāṇotpalādinā''sthāpanaṃ virecanaṃ ca madhuradravyakṛtaṃ, snehabastayastu madhurakandakṣīraghṛtādikṛtāḥ| kṣīrasarpiratra mathyamānakṣīrotpannanavanītajātam||15||-

ab.seg: utpalādivipakvena kṣīreṇāsthāpanaṃ hitam ||16||
bhojanaṃ jāṅgalarasaiḥ sarpiṣā cānuvāsanam | madhuraiḥ kṣīrasarpistu snehane ca saśarkaram ||17||

āsthāpanopayogidravyāṇyāha- utpaletyādi| sarpiṣā cānuvāsanamityuktaṃ tadeva nirdiśannāha- madhurairityādi| madhuraiḥ kākolyādibhiḥ, pakvamiti śeṣaḥ| kṣīrasarpiḥ kṣīramathanādutthitaṃ, snehane snehabastau, saśarkaraṃ sitaśarkarācūrṇaprakṣepam| anye tu ‘madhuraiḥ kṣīrasarpistu pakvaṃ pāne saśarkaram’ iti paṭhanti, tannecchati gayī||16-17||

div.ab: pittaraktaghnamuddiṣṭaṃ yaccānyadapi taddhitam |18|
idānīṃ saṅkṣepārthamatideśenāparamapi cikitsitamāha- pittaraktaghnamityādi| anyadapi pānālepanasyādi raktapittaghnaṃ yaduddiṣṭaṃ tadatrāpi hitamiti piṇḍārthaḥ|18|-

ab.seg: kaphotthitaṃ śirorogaṃ jayet kaphanivāraṇaiḥ ||18||
śirovirekairvamanaistīkṣṇairgaṇḍūṣadhāraṇaiḥ | acchaṃ ca pāyayetsarpiḥ svedayeccāpyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ ||19||
śiro madhūkasāreṇa snigdhaṃ cāpi virecayet | iṅgudasya tvacā vā'pi meṣaśṛṅgasya ‘meṣaśṛṅgyā ca’ iti pā. vā bhiṣak ||20||

idānīṃ kaphajaśirorogacikitsāmāha- kaphotthitamityādi| kaphotthitaṃ śirorogaṃ kaphanivāraṇairjayediti sambandhaḥ; tāni ca kaphanivāraṇāni śirovirecanādīni| acchaṃ ceti acchaṃ kevalaṃ, vamananirjitakaphasya prakupitavātavijayārthaṃ sarpiḥpānaṃ athavā sarpiḥpānaṃ vamanasya prākkarma| abhīkṣṇaśaḥ punaḥ punaḥ||18-20||
ābhyāmeva kṛtāṃ vartiṃ dhūmapāne prayojayet | ghreyaṃ kaṭphalacūrṇaṃ ca kavalāśca kaphāpahāḥ ||21||
saralākuṣṭhaśārṅgeṣṭādevakāṣṭhaiḥ sarohiṣaiḥ | kṣārapiṣṭaiḥ salavaṇaiḥ sukhoṣṇairlepayecchiraḥ ||22||

śirovirecanāvaśeṣitakaphasyopaśamanārthaṃ dhūmamāha- ābhyāmityādi| ābhyām iṅgudīmeṣaśṛṅgītvagbhyām| kaṭphalacūrṇaṃ ghreyaṃ ghrātavyaṃ, pradhamanaviśeṣo'yam| kaphāpahāḥ kaphaharadravyakṛtāḥ| saraletyādi| kṣārapiṣṭaiḥ kṣārodakapiṣṭaiḥ ‘atra kṣāraḥ pānīyaḥ’ iti pā., salavaṇaiḥ īṣallavaṇaiḥ||21-22||
yavaṣaṣṭikayoścānnaṃ vyoṣakṣārasamāyutam | paṭolamudgakaulatthairmātrāvadbhojayedrasaiḥ ||23||
āhāramāha- yavetyādi| vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukaṃ, kṣāro yavakṣāraḥ, yavaṣaṣṭikayoścānnaṃ trikaṭukena kaṭūkṛtaṃ, yavakṣāreṇa lavaṇitaṃ, paṭolādīnāṃ yūṣaiḥ saha mātrāvadbhojayediti sambandhaḥ||23||

div.ab: śiroroge tridoṣotthe tridoṣaghno vidhirhitaḥ |24|
adhunā tridoṣajaśirorogasya sāmānyāṃ cikitsāmāha- śiroroge ityādi| tridoṣaghno vidhiranantaroktavātādijaśirorogaghno vidhiḥ|24|-

ab.seg: sarpiḥpānaṃ viśeṣeṇa purāṇaṃ vā diśanti hi ||24||
sāmānyacikitsitamabhidhāya viśeṣacikitsitamāha- sarpiḥpānamiti| atra nibandhakārairbahūktaṃ, tacca vistarabhayānna likhitam||24||

div.ab: kṣayaje kṣayamāsādya kartavyo bṛṃhaṇo vidhiḥ | pāne nasye ca sarpiḥ syādvātaghnamadhuraiḥ śṛtam ||25|| kṣayakāsāpahaṃ cātra sarpiḥ pathyatamaṃ viduḥ |26|

kṣayajacikitsāmāha- kṣayaja ityādi| kṣayamāsādya raktādikṣayeṣvanyatamaṃ kṣayamavadhārya, śoṇitādikriyānatikrameṇa cikitsitamityarthaḥ; anye tu kṣayārthaṃ śoṣapratiṣedhamadhyāyamāsādya, yo bṛṃhaṇo vidhirāhārauṣadhākhyaḥ sa kāryaḥ| pāne nasye cetyatra cakāro bhinnakrame sarpiścetyatra draṣṭavyaḥ, tena tailamapi madhuradravyasaṃskṛtaṃ samuccīyate| kṣayakāsāpahaṃ sarpiḥ “kulīraśukticaṭakaiṇalāvān niṣkvāthya vargaṃ madhuraṃ ca kṛtsnam” ityādinā proktam||25||-

ab.seg: kṛmibhirbhakṣyamāṇasya vakṣyate śirasaḥ kriyā ||26||
nasye hi śoṇitaṃ dadyāttena mūrcchanti jantavaḥ | mattāḥ śoṇitagandhena samāyānti yatastataḥ ||27||

idānīṃ krimijaśirorogāvasare sudūravistṛtabahukrimīṇāmutkleśanenāharaṇopāyamuddiśannāha- kṛmibhirityādi| krimibhirbhakṣyamāṇasyeva, bhakṣitasya duḥśakyatvāt; śirasaḥ kriyā vakṣyate iti sambandhaḥ| śoṇitanasyaṃ kṛmīṇāmutkleśanārthaṃ, srotomukhagamanārthaṃ ca| mūrcchanti mūrcchitā bhavanti madayuktā bhavanti| samāyānti samāgacchanti| yatastato nāsāsrotaḥprabhṛtibhiḥ tatra cāgatānāṃ kṛmīṇāṃ kūrcakādibhirnirharaṇaṃ kartavyam||26-27||
teṣāṃ nirharaṇaṃ kāryaṃ tato mūrdhavirecanaiḥ | hrasvaśigrukabījairvā kāṃsyanīlīsamāyutaiḥ ||28||
kṛmighnairavapīḍaiśca mūtrapiṣṭairupācaret | pūtimatsyayutān dhūmān kṛmighnāṃśca prayojayet ||29||

idānīṃ kūrcakādibhiragamyānāṃ krimīṇāṃ nirharaṇārthaṃ cikitsitamāha- teṣāmityādi| mūrdhavirecanaiḥ viḍaṅgamaricāpāmārgaśigrubījādibhiḥ; gayī tu vakṣyamāṇāni hrasvaśigrukabījāni śirovirecanadravyāṇi manyante| hrasvaśigrukabījairityādi| kṛmighnaiḥ viḍaṅgādibhiḥ||28-29||

div.ab: bhojanāni kṛmighnāni pānāni vividhāni ca |30|
āhāramāha- bhojanānītyādi| kṛmighnāni kṛmipratiṣedha paṭhitāni dhānyāmlaprabhṛtīni surasādisaṃskṛtāni|30|-

ab.seg: sūryāvarte vidhātavyaṃ nasyakarmādibheṣajam ||30||

sūryāvartakacikitsāmāha- sūryāvarte ityādi| nasyakarmādītyādiśabdāllepapariṣekakavalagrahaśirobastyādayaḥ| anye tu nasyakarma ādau yasya tannasyakarmādi, tacca vamanaṃ vihāya virekādikarmacatuṣṭayam| ye tu sūryāvartaviparyayaṃ paṭhanti tatrāpīdameva cikitsitam||30||

div.ab: bhojanaṃ jāṅgalaprāyaṃ kṣīrānnavikṛtirghṛtam |31|
āhāraṃ niyamayannāha- bhojanetyādi|31|-

tathā'rdhabhedake vyādhau prāptamanyacca yadbhavet ||31|| śirīṣamūlakaphalairavapīḍo'nayorhitaḥ | vaṃśamūlakakarpūrairavapīḍaṃ prayojayet ||32|| avapīḍo hitaścātra vacāmāgadhikāyutaḥ | madhukenāvapīḍo vā madhunā saha saṃyutaḥ ||33|| manaḥśilāvapīḍo vā madhunā candanena vā |34|

ardhāvabhedakacikitsitamāha- tathā'rdhabhedake ityādi| na kevalaṃ sūryāvarte nasyakarmādibheṣajaṃ jāṅgalaprāyaṃ bhojanaṃ kṣīrānnavikṛtirghṛtaṃ prayojayet tathā'rdhāvabhedake'pi| prāptamanyacca yadbhavediti anyadapi snehasirāvyadhāvapīḍakarṇaśūloktadīpikātailādi yat prāptaṃ yuktaṃ bhavet tat kartavyam| gayī tu anyacchabdena vakṣyamāṇaṃ śirīṣamūlakaphalairityādikamicchati| śirīṣetyādi| anayoḥ sūryāvartārdhabhedakayoḥ| avapīḍya dīyata ityavapīḍo nasyabheda ityarthaḥ| vaṃśetyādi| atreti anayoḥ sūryāvartārdhabhedakayoḥ| madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhukaṃ, manaḥśilāvapīḍo madhunetyeko yogaḥ, candanena ceti dvitīyaḥ| kecidatra candanaśabdena madhūkasāraṃ vyākhyānayanti||31-33||-

ab.seg: teṣāmante hitaṃ nasyaṃ sarpirmadhurasānvitam ||34||

avapīḍairnirjitakaphasya paścātkarmāha- teṣāmityādi| teṣām avapīḍānām, ante avasāne, madhurakānvitaṃ kākolyādigaṇakalkaśṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ nasye prayojyam| anye madhurasāṃ mūrvāṃ manyante| kecitteṣāmityatra tayoriti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- ante'vapīḍānāmavasāne madhurasānvitasarpistayoḥ sūryāvartārdhabhedakayornasye hitaṃ, vātapittottarāvasthāyāṃ ghṛtanasyam||34||

div.ab: sārivotpalakuṣṭhāni madhukaṃ cāmlapeṣitam | sarpistailayuto lepo dvayorapi sukhāvahaḥ ||35|| eṣa eva prayoktavyaḥ śiroroge kaphātmake |36|

idānīṃ śirolepamāha- sārivetyādi| sārivā prasiddhā, utpalaṃ nīlotpalam| amlapeṣitaṃ kāñjikapeṣitam| dvayoḥ sūryāvartārdhāvabhedakayoḥ| ayamapi śirolepo vātapittottarāvasthāyāṃ prayoktavyaḥ| eṣa ityādi| eṣa eveti śirīṣaphalādyavapīḍaḥ kaphanimitte śiroroge prayoktavyaḥ| yadyapi kaphaśirorogasya cikitsoktā tathā'pyavasaraprāptatvāt punaruktā| anye ‘śiroroge kaphātmake’ ityatra ‘kṣayātmake’ iti paṭhanti| tannecchati jejjaṭācāryaḥ| apare tu ‘ebhireva prayoktavyaḥ śiroroge'nilātmake’ iti paṭhanti| ebhireveti anantaroktasārivotpalakuṣṭhādibhiḥ||35||-

anantavāte kartavyaḥ sūryāvartaharo ‘sūryāvarteritaḥ’ iti pā. vidhiḥ ||36|| sirāvyadhaśca kartavyo'nantavātapraśāntaye | āhāraśca vidhātavyo vātapittavināśanaḥ ||37|| madhumastakasaṃyāvaghṛtapūraiśca bhojanam |38|

kecidatrānantavātacikitsitaṃ paṭhanti; tadāha- anantavāte ityādi| madhumastakāḥ ravajukāḥ, saṃyāvaḥ kaṇḍakaghṛtaiścāturjātakakarpūrasugandhaḥ lapsiketi loke, ghṛtapūraḥ ‘ghevara’ iti prasiddhaḥ||36-37||-
kṣīrasarpiḥ praśaṃsanti nasye pāne ca śaṅkhake ||38|| jāṅgalānāṃ rasaiḥ snigdhairāhāraścātra śasyate |39|
śaṅkhakacikitsāmāha- kṣīretyādi| kṣīrasarpiriti arditacikitsite'kṣitarpaṇārthaṃ yaduktam| jāṅgalānāmityatra kecidaudakānāmiti paṭhanti, tannecchati gayī||38||-

ab.seg: śatāvarīṃ tilān kṛṣṇān madhukaṃ nīlamutpalam ||39||
dūrvāṃ punarnavāṃ caiva lepe sādhvavacārayet | mahāsugandhāmathavā pālindīṃ cāmlapeṣitām ||40||
śirolepamāha- śatāvarīmityādi| śatāvaryādibhiḥ kṣīrapiṣṭaiḥ śirolepaḥ| mahāsugandhāmityādi| mahāsugandhā utpalasārivā, sarpasugandhāmapare| pālindī kālavallī| amlaṃ kāñjikam||39-40||

div.ab: śītāṃścātra parīṣekān pradehāṃśca prayojayet |41|
anuktānapyatra pariṣekapradehānnirdiśannāha- śītānityādi| śītapariṣekān śītavīryavidārigandhādikākolyādyutpalādikaṣāyakṛtān, śītapradehāneteṣāmeva kalkairamlapiṣṭaiḥ kṛtān|41|-

ab.seg: avapīḍaśca deyo'tra sūryāvartanivāraṇaḥ ||41||
avapīḍaścetyādi| sūryāvartanivāraṇo'vapīḍaḥ ‘śirīṣamūlakaphalairavapīḍo'nayorhita’ ityādyuktaḥ||41||

div.ab: kṛmikṣayakṛtau hitvā śirorogeṣu buddhimān | madhutailasamāyuktaiḥ śirāṃsyativirecayet ||42|| paścātsarṣapatailena tato nasyaṃ prayojayet |43|

idānīṃ śirorogāṇāṃ sāmānyacikitsāmāha- kṛmītyādi| kṛmikṣayakṛtau śirorogau parityajyānyeṣu śirorogeṣu madhutailasamāyuktaiḥ śirovirecanadravyairbuddhimān vaidyaḥ śirāṃsi ativirecayet, nasyaṃ dadyādityarthaḥ| mūlānilonmūlanatvāt styānabhūtakaphavināśanatvācca sarṣapatailena nasyam| anye tu ‘paścāt sarpiḥ sukhoṣṇaṃ tu nasyatastu praśasyate’ iti paṭhanti; teṣāmayamabhiprāyaḥśirovirecanena kaphe vijite sati vātapittajayārthaṃ sarpirnasyam||42||-
na cecchāntiṃ vrajantyevaṃ snigdhasvinnāṃstato bhiṣak ||43|| paścādupācaretsamyak sirāṇāmatha mokṣaṇaiḥ |44|
idānīmetairapyupāyairyadā śāntiṃ śirorogā na yānti tadā kiṃ kartavyamityāha- na cecchāntimityādi||43||-

ab.seg: ṣaṭsaptatirnetrarogā daśāṣṭādaśa karṇajāḥ ||44||
ekatriṃśad ghrāṇagatāḥ śirasyekādaśaiva tu | iti vistarato dṛ(di)ṣṭāḥ salakṣaṇacikitsitāḥ ||45||
saṃhitāyāmabhihitāḥ saptaṣaṣṭirmukhāmayāḥ | etāvanto yathāsthūlamuttamāṅgagatā gadāḥ | asmiñchāstre nigaditāḥ saṅkhyārūpacikitsitaiḥ ||46||

idānīṃ śālākyatantrasyārthapiṇḍamuktamupasaṃharannāha- ṣaṭsaptatirityādi| daśāṣṭādaśa aṣṭāviṃśatirityarthaḥ| iti śabda uktasmaraṇe| ye vistarato dṛ(di)ṣṭāḥ vistareṇa videhādau bhāṣitāḥ| yathāsthūlaṃ sthūlānatikrameṇa, aṇuśo bhidyamānāḥ punarasaṅkhyeyāḥ| asminniti śālākyaśāstre||44-46||

div.ab: iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre śirorogapratiṣedho nāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||26|| iti śrībhagavatā dhanvantariṇopadiṣṭāyāṃ maharṣiṇā suśrutācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargataṃ śālākyatantraṃ samāptam |

ab.seg: sadbuddheḥ prasavaḥ padaṃ suyaśasaḥ sadvaidyavandyaḥ śriyāmāvāsaḥ sukṛtī kriyāsu nipuṇaḥ śrīḍalhaṇākhyo bhiṣak| śrībhādānakanāthasāhalanṛpasyātīva yo vallabhaḥ śāstraṃ tasya nibandhasaṅgraha iti khyātaṃ dharitrītale| iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ||26||

div.head: navagrahākṛtivijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto navagrahākṛtivijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

śālākyatantrānantaraṃ kaumāratantraṃ prārabhyate- athāta ityādi| bālaśabdo'tra luptanirdiṣṭo draṣṭavyaḥ| tatra grahā bālānāṃ nava, aṣṭau punarabālānāṃ bhūtavidyāyāṃ nirdeṣṭavyāḥ| ākṛtiḥ ākāro liṅgaṃ kāryabhūtaṃ, natu svabhāvākhyam||1-2||
bālagrahāṇāṃ vijñānaṃ sādhanaṃ cāpyanantaram | utpattiṃ kāraṇaṃ caiva suśrutaikamanāḥ śṛṇu ||3||
tatra prathamaṃ kumāratantrasyārthapiṇḍamuddiśannāha- bālagrahāṇāmityādi| vijñānaṃ viśiṣṭajñānam| sādhanaṃ cikitsitam| utpattiḥ prabhavaḥ| kāraṇaṃ hetuḥ||3||
skandagrahastu prathamaḥ skandāpasmāra eva ca | śakunī revatī caiva pūtanā cāndhapūtanā ||4||
pūtanā śītanāmā ca tathaiva mukhamaṇḍikā | navamo naigameṣaśca yaḥ pitṛgrahasañjñitaḥ ||5||

idānīṃ teṣāṃ navagrahāṇāṃ nāmānyāha- skandagraha ityādi| prathamaḥ pradhānamādirvā| navamo naigameṣa iti saṅkhyānirdeśādeva saṅkhyāyāṃ labdhāyāṃ bhūyo navama iti saṅkhyākaraṇaṃ kāśyapāditantrāntaroktādhikasaṅkhyānirākaraṇārtham| pitṛgrahasañjñita iti bālasyānyagrahebhyo rakṣakatvātpiteva grahaḥ saiva sañjñā sañjātā yasya sa tathā| (natu ayaṃ pāṭho hastalikhitapustake nopalabhyate bhūtavidyāvat pitṛlokābhihitagraha iti)||4-5||
dhātrīmātroḥ prākpradiṣṭāpacārācchaucabhraṣṭānmaṅgalācārahīnān | trastān hṛṣṭāṃstarjitān tāḍitān vā pūjāhetorhiṃsyurete kumārān ||6||

kasmādgrahā bālān viśantītyāha- dhātrītyādi| dhātrī stanapāyinī poṣayitrītyarthaḥ, mātā prasavitrī| prākpradiṣṭāpacārāditi prāk śārīrasthāne pradiṣṭo'pacāraḥ akṛtyavidhiḥ māṃsasurādīnāṃ laulyādācaraṇaṃ vā| śaucaṃ mūtrapurīṣādiprakṣālanaṃ, maṅgalaṃ svastikasragdāmadūrvāvacāsarṣapādisparśanam, ācāraḥ pāpavirodhī, trastān udvignān, hṛṣṭān muditān, tarjitān anyena ‘yena kenacit’ iti pā. kenacidvibhīṣitān| tāḍitān abhihatān| kathaṃ pūjā jāyate? kusumādinā bhojanādinā ca| ato hetoḥ dhātrīmātrorapacārāddūṣaṇādyanvitān bālān| pūjā cātropalakṣaṇaṃ; tena ratihetorapi hiṃsyuriti| nanu, dhātrīmātropacārādbālānāmanaparādhitvāt kathaṃ grahahiṃsanaṃ? atrocyate- bālānāṃ prāktanakarmayogata evāpacāraṃ kurutaḥ| kumārānityupalakṣaṇaṃ; tena kumārikā api hiṃsyuḥ| ete grahā ityarthaḥ||6||
aiśvaryasthāste na śakyā viśanto dehaṃ draṣṭuṃ mānuṣairviśvarūpāḥ | āptaṃ vākyaṃ tatsamīkṣyābhidhāsye liṅgānyeṣāṃ yāni dehe bhavanti ||7||

kasmātte grahā dehaṃ viśanto nopalabhyante ityāha ‘nanu pratyakṣāviṣayatvāt kṛtāveśānāṃ grahāṇāṃ kena jñānaṃ bhaviṣyatītyāha-’ iti pā. - aiśvaryetyādi| eṣāṃ grahāṇāṃ yāni liṅgāni bhavanti tāni āptaṃ vākyaṃ samīkṣyābhidhāsye kathayiṣye iti piṇḍārthaḥ| āptaṃ vākyam āptairuktaṃ vākyam; āptāśca yathārthavādinaḥ ‘tattvārthavedinaḥ’ iti pā.||7||
śūnākṣaḥ ‘stabdhākṣaḥ’ iti pā. kṣatajasagandhikaḥ stanadviḍ vakrāsyo hatacalitaikapakṣmanetraḥ | udvignaḥ sululitacakṣuralparodī skandārto bhavati ca gāḍhamuṣṭivarcāḥ ||8||

skandagrahārtalakṣaṇamāha- śūnākṣa ityādi| kṣatajasagandhikaḥ rudhirasamānagandhikaḥ, visragandha ityarthaḥ; anye tu kṣatajaṃ raktaṃ tatsagandhika īṣadrudhiragandhika ityarthaḥ| stanadviṭ stanadveṣī| vakrāsyaḥ vakramukhaḥ| hatacalitaikapakṣmanetra iti hataṃ calitaṃ caikapakṣma netre yasya sa tathā| udvignaḥ udvignacittaḥ| sululitacakṣuḥ kiñcinmilitalocanaḥ| skandārta iti skandavinodanārthaṃ rudreṇa sṛṣṭo grahaḥ tenārtaḥ, skando'tra na punarbhagavān kārtikeyaḥ| gāḍhe muṣṭivarcasī yasya sa tathā| gayadāsastu ‘stabdhāṅgaḥ’ kṣatajasagandhikaḥ stanadviṭ vakrāsyo hatacaraṇaikapakṣmanetraḥ’ iti paṭhitvā ‘stabdhamaṅgaṃ yasya sa tathā, hatāni ekapādaikapakṣmārdhanayanāni yasya sa tathā’ iti vyākhyānayati||8||
niḥsañjño bhavati punarbhavetsasañjñaḥ saṃrabdhaḥ karacaraṇaiśca nṛtyatīva | viṇmūtre sṛjati vinadya jṛmbhamāṇaḥ phenaṃ ca prasṛjati tatsakhābhipannaḥ ||9||

skandāpasmārārtalakṣaṇamāha- niḥsañjña ityādi| saṃrabdhaḥ samyak kalitaḥ san, karacaraṇabhyāṃ hastapādābhyāṃ, nṛtyatīva nartanamiva karoti| vinadya śabdaṃ kṛtvā; kvacit ‘vinamya’ iti pāṭhaḥ, tatra gātravinamanaṃ kṛtvā; viṇmūtre muñcatīti vyākhyānam| tatsakhābhipannaḥ tacchabdena skandaḥ kathyate, tasya sakhā skandāpasmāraḥ, tenākrāntaḥ||9||
srastāṅgo bhayacakito vihaṅgagandhiḥ saṃsrāvivraṇaparipīḍitaḥ samantāt | sphoṭaiśca pracitatanuḥ sadāhapākairvijñeyo bhavati śiśuḥ kṣataḥ śakunyā ||10||

śakunigrahārtalakṣaṇamāha- srastāṅga ityādi| srastāṅgaḥ śithilāṅgaḥ| bhayacakito bhītaḥ| vihaṅgā atra māṃsādā jalacarāśca| saṃsrāvivraṇaparipīḍitaḥ pūyāsrāvivraṇaparipīḍitaḥ| samantāt sarvataḥ| atroktavraṇasphoṭayorvidīrṇāvidīrṇatvena bhedaḥ| kṣataḥ abhibhūtaḥ||10||
raktāsyo haritamalo'tipāṇḍudehaḥ śyāvo vā jvaramukhapākavedanārtaḥ | revatyā vyathitatanuśca karṇanāsaṃ mṛdnāti dhruvamabhipīḍitaḥ kumāraḥ ||11||

revatīgrahārtasya lakṣaṇamāha- raktāsya ityādi| haritamala iti malo'tra viṣṭhā mūtraṃ ca| jvaramukhapākavedanārtaḥ jvarārto mukhapākavedanārtaśca| vyathitatanuriti sarujaśarīraḥ| abhipīḍito revatyā iti sambandhaḥ||11||
srastāṅgaḥ svapiti sukhaṃ divā na rātrau viḍ bhinnaṃ sṛjati ca kākatulyagandhiḥ | chardyā''rto hṛṣitatanūruhaḥ kumārastṛṣṇālurbhavati ca pūtanāgṛhītaḥ ||12||

pūtanāgrahārtalakṣaṇamāha- srastāṅga ityādi| na divā sukhaṃ svapiti na ca rātrau sukhaṃ svapiti| sṛjati muñcati| ‘srastāṅga’ ityatra kecit ‘svasthāṅga’ iti paṭhanti, svasthāṅgo'pi na divā na rātrau svapitīti vyākhyānayanti||12||
yo dveṣṭi stanamatisārakāsahikkācchardībhirjvarasahitābhirardyamānaḥ | durvarṇaḥ satatamadhaḥśayo'mlagandhistaṃ brūyurbhiṣaja ihāndhapūtanārtam ||13||
andhapūtanārtalakṣaṇamāha- ya ityādi| adhaḥśayaḥ adhomukhaśāyī| amlagandhiḥ kāñjikādyamladravyagandhiḥ||13||
udvigno bhṛśamativepate prarudyāt saṃlīnaḥ svapiti ca yasya cāntrakūjaḥ | visrāṅgo bhṛśamatisāryate ca yastaṃ jānīyādbhiṣagiha śītapūtanārtam ||14||
śītapūtanārtalakṣaṇamāha- udvigna ityādi| saṃlīnaḥ samyaglīnaḥ, śayyaikadeśe lagna ityarthaḥ| visrāṅgo visragandhāṅgaḥ| ‘udvigno bhṛśamati’ ityatra kecit ‘ākrandatyaticakitaḥ’ iti paṭhanti||14||
mlānāṅgaḥ surucirapāṇipādavaktro bahvāśī kaluṣasirāvṛtodaro yaḥ | sodvego bhavati ca mūtratulyagandhiḥ sa jñeyaḥ śiśuriha vaktramaṇḍikārtaḥ ||15||

mukhamaṇḍikāgrahārtalakṣaṇamāha- mlānāṅga ityādi| mlānāṅgo durbalamadhyaśarīraḥ| surucirapāṇipādavaktra iti suṣṭhu ruciraṃ śobhanaṃ hastapādavaktraṃ yasya saḥ| vaktramaṇḍikarto mukhamaṇḍikārta ityarthaḥ||15||
yaḥ phenaṃ vamati vinamyate ca madhye sodvegam vilapati cordhvamīkṣamāṇaḥ | jvaryeta pratatamatho vasāsagandhirniḥsañjño bhavati hi naigameṣajuṣṭaḥ ||16||

naigameṣagrahārtalakṣaṇamāha- ya ityādi| madhye madhyāṅge| sodvegaṃ satrāsaṃ, vilapati atiśayena śabdaṃ karoti, ūrdhvamīkṣamāṇaḥ ūrdhvaṃ paśyan| ‘vilapati’ ityatra kecit ‘vihasati’ iti paṭhanti| jvaryeta pratataṃ satatam| vasāsagandhiḥ vasayā tulyagandhiḥ| niḥsañjñaḥ nirgatasamyagjñānaḥ||16||
prastabdho yaḥ stanadveṣī muhyate cāviśanmuhuḥ | taṃ bālamacirāddhanti grahaḥ sampūrṇalakṣaṇaḥ ||17||
sāmpratamasādhyagrahārtalakṣaṇamāha- prastabdha ityādi| prastabdho'tyarthaṃ stabdhāṅgaḥ| muhyate mohaṃ yāti| āviśan āveśaṃ kurvan| muhuḥ vāraṃvāram||17||

div.ab: viparītamataḥ sādhyaṃ cikitsedacirārditam |18|
sādhyagrahārtalakṣaṇamāha- viparītamityādi| viparītaṃ prastabdha stanadveṣādilakṣaṇairanupahatam| acirārditam alpakālapīḍitam|18|-

ab.seg: gṛhe purāṇahaviṣā'bhyajya bālaṃ śucau śuciḥ ||18||
sarṣapān prakiretteṣāṃ tailairdīpaṃ ‘taile dīpaṃ’ iti pā. ca kārayet | sadā sannihitaṃ cāpi juhuyāddhavyavāhanam ||19||
sarvagandhauṣadhībījairgandhamālyairalaṅkratam | agnaye kṛttikābhyaśca svāhā svāheti santatam ||20||

sādhyasya cikitsāmāha- gṛhe ityādi| purāṇahaviṣā jīrṇaghṛtena, abhyajya bālaṃ cupāṭitvā| śucau pavitradeśe, śuciḥ ‘bhiṣag’ iti śeṣaḥ| teṣāṃ tailaiḥ sarṣapāṇāṃ tailaiḥ, dīpaṃ kārayet dīpaṃ prajvālayedityarthaḥ| sadetyādi| juhuyāt homaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ| havyavāhanam agnim| kairjuhuyāt? sarvagandhauṣadhībījairiti; sarvagandhā elādiparipaṭhitāḥ, oṣadhībījani yavadhānyatilādīni, tairjuhuyāt| gandhamālyairalaṅkṛtamagniṃ bālaṃ vā, satataṃ vāraṃvāraṃ na sakṛt| ayaṃ vidhiḥ sarvagrahāṇāṃ sāmānyaḥ| agnaya ityādi| agniṃ hutvā tato madhyāhne baliṃ dadyāt||18-20||
namaḥ skandāya devāya grahādhipataye namaḥ | śirasā tvā'bhivande'haṃ pratigṛhṇīṣva me balim | nīrujo nirvikāraśca śiśurme jāyatāṃ drutam ||21||
tatra yaṃ mantramuccarettamāha- nama ityādi||21||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre navagrahākṛtivijñānīyo nāma (prathamo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||27||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kaumārabhṛtyatantre navagrahākṛtivijānīyo nāma saptaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||27||
athātaḥ skandhagrahapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
navagrahākṛtivijñānīyānantaraṃ vijñātanavagrahākṛteścikitsitamucitaṃ; tatrāpi skandagrahasya prathamatvāttapratiṣedhādhyāya ārabhyate- athāta ityādi||1-2||
skandagrahopasṛṣṭānāṃ kumārāṇāṃ praśasyate | vātaghnadrumapatrāṇāṃ niṣkvāthaḥ pariṣecane ||3||

skandetyādi| upasṛṣṭānāṃ gṛhītānām| drumagrahaṇaṃ viṭapaniṣedhārtham| skandagrahaprabhāveṇa tenāviṣṭe bāle vāyuḥ kupyatīti vātaharaiḥ sekādayaḥ kāryoḥ; athavā vātaghnadrumāḥ svaprabhāveṇa grahāveśamapi nivartayanti, acintyaśaktitvāt||3||
teṣāṃ mūleṣu siddhaṃ ca tailamabhyañjane hitam | sarvagandhasurāmaṇḍakaiḍaryāvāpamiṣyate ||4||

teṣāmityādi| teṣāṃ vātaghnadrumāṇāṃ bilvādīnām| sarvagandhā elādipaṭhitāḥ, surāmaṇḍaḥ surāyā uparyaccho bhāgaḥ, kaiḍaryo mahānimbaḥ| etena bilvādimūlakvāthena elādīnāṃ kalkena siddhaṃ tailamabhyañjane hitamiṣyata iti siddham||4||
devadāruṇi rāsnāyāṃ madhureṣu drumeṣu ca | siddhaṃ sarpiśca sakṣīraṃ pānamasmai prayojayet ||5||
devadāruṇītyādi| madhuradrumā madhuravṛkṣāḥ, madhu(dhū)karājādanādayaḥ| pānam annādasya bālasya||5||
sarṣapāḥ sarpanirmoko vacā kākādanī ghṛtam | uṣṭrājāvigavāṃ caiva romāṇyuddhūpanaṃ śiśoḥ ||6||
kākādanī kākajaṅghā||6||
somavallīmindravallīṃ śamīṃ bilvasya kaṇṭakān | mṛgādanyāśca mūlāni grathitānyeva dhārayet ||7||
somavallītyādi| somavallī guḍūcī, indravallī matsāṇḍakaḥ ‘matsyāṇḍakaḥ’ iti pā. gaṇḍadūrveti loke, mṛgādanī indravāruṇī||7||
raktāni mālyāni tathā patākā raktāśca gandhā vividhāśca bhakṣyāḥ | ghaṇṭā ca devāya balirnivedyaḥ sukukkuṭaḥ skandagrahe hitāya ||8||

baliṃ nirdiśannāha- raktānītyādi| tathā patākā raktetyarthaḥ| raktāśca gandhāḥ kuṅkumādikāḥ| bhakṣyāḥ svastikamodakādayaḥ| devāya skandanāmne, skandagrahe vakṣyamāṇe catvārākhye| hitāya hitārthaṃ bālakasya| baliśca śucinā vaidyena kṛtasnānena śastrahastena rātrau dātavyaḥ||8||
snānaṃ trirātraṃ niśi catvareṣu kuryāt puraṃ śāliyavairnavaistu | adbhiśca gāyatryabhimantritābhiḥ prajvālanaṃ vyāhṛtibhiśca vahneḥ ||9||

snānamityādi| catvareṣu catuṣpatheṣu, apare catvaraśabdena tripathaṃ kathāsthānaṃ cetyāhuḥ| puraṃ maṇḍalam| adbhiśca gāyatryabhimantritābhiḥ snānamiti sambandhanīyam| vyāhṛtibhistisṛbhiḥ saptabhirdaśabhirvā svāhāntābhiḥ| skandagrahe catvarākhye śāliyavairviracitamaṇḍalābhyantarasadmani purābhidhāne, trirātraṃ rātrau balisnānahomāḥ kāryāḥ||9||
rakṣāmataḥ pravakṣyāmi bālānāṃ pāpanāśinīm | ahanyahani kartavyā yā bhiṣagbhiratandritaiḥ ||10||
tapasāṃ tejasāṃ caiva yaśasāṃ vapuṣāṃ tathā | nidhānaṃ yo'vyayo devaḥ sa te skandaḥ prasīdatu ||11||
grahasenāpatirdevo devasenāpatirvibhuḥ | devasenāripuharaḥ pātu tvāṃ bhagavān guhaḥ ||12||
devadevasya mahataḥ pāvakasya ca yaḥ sutaḥ | gaṅgomākṛttikānāṃ ca sa te śarma prayacchatu ||13||
raktamālyāmbaraḥ śrīmān raktacandanabhūṣitaḥ | raktadivyavapurdevaḥ pātu tvāṃ krauñcasūdanaḥ ||14||

rakṣamityādi| rakṣā svastyayanaṃ; mantrāṇāmacintyaśaktitvānmantramayī rakṣā pāpanāśinī| tapasāmityādi| vapuṣāmiti vapuṣāṃ nidhānaṃ sthānamityanena kāmarūpatvamuktam| avyayo nityaḥ| grahāḥ skandagrahādikāḥ, teṣāṃ senā tasyāḥ patiḥ devasenāpatiḥ| devasenāripavo daityāḥ| devadevasya rudrasya, umā pārvatī, kṛttikāḥ ṣaṭsaṅkhyopetāḥ saptarṣibhāryāḥ| śarma sukham| krauñcanāmā parvataḥ taṃ sūdayati nihantīti krauñcasūdanaḥ||10-14||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre skandapratiṣedho nāmā(dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ, ādito')ṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||28||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kaumārabhṛtyatantre skandagrahapratiṣedho nāmā'ṣṭāviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||28||

div.head: skandāpasmārapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ skandāpasmārapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
bilvaḥ śirīṣo golomī surasādiśca yo gaṇaḥ | pariṣeke prayoktavyaḥ skandāpasmāraśāntaye ||3||
skandapratiṣedhānantaraṃ pratyāsattyā skandāpasmārapratiṣedhārambho yujyata ityāha- bilva ityādi| golomī dūrvā||1-3||

div.ab: sarvagandhavipakvaṃ tu tailamabhyañjane hitam | kṣīravṛkṣakaṣāye ca kākolyādau gaṇe tathā ||4|| vipaktavyaṃ ghṛtaṃ cāpi pānīyaṃ payasā saha |5|

sarvetyādi| sarvagandhā elādikāḥ, yathālābhamelādikatvena bilvaśirīṣādīnāṃ kvāthena tailaṃ paktavyam| anye tu ‘gandhamūtravipakvam’ iti paṭhanti; gandhāḥ sarvagandhāḥ pūrvoktāḥ, mūtraṃ gomūtram| kṣīretyādi| kṣīravṛkṣakaṣāye caturguṇe, payasā dugdhena caturguṇena, kākolyādau gaṇe kalkīkṛte snehacaturthāṃśe ghṛtaṃ vipaktavyam| tadghṛtaṃ kiṃ kāryamityāha,- pānīyaṃ pātavyam, ‘annādena’ iti śeṣaḥ| anye tu pānīyaṃ caturguṇaṃ dattvā ghṛtaṃ paktavyamiti manyante, śeṣaṃ pūrvavat||4||-

ab.seg: utsādanaṃ vacāhiṅguyuktaṃ skandagrahe hitam ||5||
gṛdhrolūkapurīṣāṇi keśā hastinakhā ghṛtam | vṛṣabhasya ca romāṇi yojyānyuddhūpane'pi ca ||6||

utsādanamityādi| utsādanam udvartanam| skandagrahe hitamityatra cakāro lupto jñeyaḥ, tena skandagrahe skandāpasmāre ca hitam| (‘etadudvartanaṃ hitam’ ityatrānye ‘etadudvartaneritam’ iti paṭhanti; tanna, utsādanasyānuktatvāt)||5-6||

div.ab: anantāṃ kukkuṭīṃ bimbīṃ markaṭīṃ cāpi dhārayet |7|
anantetyādi| anantā utpalasārivā, kukkuṭī kukkuṭīśarīravat kusumacitrā vallī sphaṭikaracitakukkuṭāṇḍatulyakandā, markaṭī kapikacchuḥ| dhārayet śarīre iti boddhavyam|7|-
pakvāpakvāni māṃsāni prasannā rudhiraṃ payaḥ ||7|| bhūtaudano nivedyaśca skandāpasmāriṇe'vaṭe |8|
pakvetyādi| prasannā surā, rudhiraṃ chāgalasya, payo dugdham| bhūtaudanaḥ bhūtānāmodanaḥ sopahāro baliḥ, utsvinnā māṣavikṛtirbalirityanye| avaṭe gartāyām||7||-

ab.seg: catuṣpathe ca kartavyaṃ snānamasya yatātmanā ||8||
catuṣpathe ityādi| asya bālakasya| yatātmanā upavāsādiyutena| ‘yatātmanā’ ityatra kecit ‘yathāvidhi’ iti paṭhanti; skandapratiṣedhoktasnānavidhāneneti ca vyākhyānayanti||8||
skandāpasmārasañjño yaḥ skandasya dayitaḥ sakhā | viśākhasañjñaśca śiśoḥ śivo'stu vikṛtānanaḥ ||9||

rakṣāmantramāha- skandetyādi| skandasya kārtikeyasya, dayitaḥ abhīṣṭaḥ, sakhā mitraṃ, viśākhasañjña iti skandāpasmārasya dvitīyaṃ nāma| śiśoḥ bālakasya, śivo'stu kalyāṇakṛdbhavatu, vikṛtānano vikṛtamukhaḥ| ‘viśākhasañjñasya’ iti kecit paṭhanti, tatra skandasya viśeṣaṇam||9||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre skandāpasmārapratiṣedho nāma (tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) ekonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||29||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kaumārabhṛtyatantre skandāpasmārapratiṣedho nāmaikonatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||29||

div.head: śakunīpratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ śakunīpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
skandāpasmārapratiṣedhānantaraṃ śakunīpratiṣedhārambhaḥ, skandādigrahapratipādakasūtre'syā evānantaroktatvādityāha- athāta ityādi||1-2||
śakunyabhiparītasya kāryo vaidyena jānatā | vetasāmrakapitthānāṃ niṣkvāthaḥ pariṣecane ||3||
śakunītyādi| abhiparītasya vyāptasya, ‘bālasya’ iti śeṣaḥ| jānatā buddhimatā| niṣkvāthaḥ pariṣecane kārya iti sambandhaḥ||3||

div.ab: kaṣāyamadhuraustailaṃ kāryamabhyañjane śiśoḥ |4|
kaṣāyetyādi| kaṣāyā vaṭādayaḥ, madhurāṇi kākolyādīni; tatra vaṭādīnāṃ kaṣāyaḥ, kākolyādīnāṃ ca kalkaḥ, tābhyāṃ tailaṃ sādhyaṃ; pratyekaṃ vaṭādīnāṃ kākolyādīnāṃ ca kalkakaṣāyau kalpanīyāvityanye|4|-
madhukośīrahrīberasārivotpalapadmakaiḥ ||4|| rodhrapriyaṅgumañjiṣṭhāgairikaiḥ pradihecchiśum |5|
madhuketyādi| utpalaṃ nīlotpalam| pradihet limpet||4||-

ab.seg: vraṇeṣūktāni cūrṇāni pathyāni vividhāni ca ||5||

vraṇeṣvityādi| vraṇeṣu śakunījuṣṭabālakavraṇeṣu| uktāni cūrṇāni dvivraṇīyādhyāye kīrtitāni miśrakoktāni ca śodhanaropaṇāni| pathyāni vraṇitopāsanīyoktāni śālimudgadāḍimasaindhavayavapaṭolādīni; anye tu pathyānīti cūrṇānītyasya viśeṣaṇaṃ kurvanti, tatra śakunījuṣṭabālakavraṇānāṃ sadāhapākaraktasrāvaharāṇi cūrṇāni prayoktavyānīti sambandhanīyam||5||

div.ab: skandagrahe dhūpanāni tānīhāpi prayojayet |6|
skandetyādi| dhūpanāni sarṣapā ityādīni skandagrahoktāni, tānīhāpi śakunyamapi prayojayet|6|-
śatāvarīmṛgairvārunāgadantīnidigdhikāḥ ||6|| lakṣmaṇāṃ sahadevāṃ ca bṛhatīṃ cāpi dhārayet |7|
śatāvarītyādi| mṛgairvāruḥ indravāruṇī, nāgadantī dantinī, sahadevā pītapuṣpā balā, bṛhatī sthūlaphalā||6||-
tilataṇḍulakaṃ mālyaṃ haritālaṃ manaḥśilā ||7|| balireṣa karañjeṣu nivedyo niyatātmanā |8|
tiletyādi| eṣa tilataṇḍulakamityādiko baliḥ| karañjeṣu naktamāleṣu| niyatātmanā saṃyatendriyeṇa ‘karañjeṣu’ ityatrānye ‘nikuñjeṣu’ iti paṭhanti, nikuñjeṣu vaneṣu||7||-

ab.seg: niṣkuṭe ca prayoktavyaṃ snānamasya yathāvidhi ||8||
niṣkuṭe ityādi| niṣkuṭe gṛhopavane, anye niṣkuṭaṃ vanagahanamāhuḥ| yathāvidhīti skandagrahokto vidhiḥ; tena śāliyavaracitamaṇḍale gāyatryabhimantratena jalena snānamiti labhyate||8||

div.ab: skandāpasmāraśamanaṃ ghṛtaṃ cāpīha pūjitam |9|
skandetyādi| ghṛtaṃ devadāruṇi rāsnāyāmityādikaṃ, cakāro'tra somavallayādīnāmapi dhāraṇaṃ samuccinoti| jejjaṭastu skandagrahe dhūpanānītyādikadhūpanapāṭhānte idaṃ ghṛtaṃ paṭhati|9|-

ab.seg: kuryācca vividhāṃ pūjāṃ śakunyāḥ kusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||9||
kuryādityādi| kusumaiḥ śubhairiti jātīpuṣpanīlotpalādibhiḥ||9||
antarīkṣacarā devī sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitā | ayomukhī tīkṣṇatuṇḍā śakunī te prasīdatu ||10||
durdarśanā mahākāyā piṅgākṣī bhairavasvarā | lambodarī śaṅkukarṇī ‘śaṅkhavarṇā’ iti pā. śakunī te prasīdatu ||11||
bālakarakṣāmāha- antarīkṣetyādi||10-11||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre śakunīpratiṣedho nāma (caturtho'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||30||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kaumārabhṛtyatantre śakunīpratiṣedho nāma triṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||30||

div.head: revatīpratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto revatīpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
śakunīpratiṣedhānantaraṃ revatyāmapi mukhapākavacanāt savraṇatvenaikadharmatvācca revatīpratiṣedhādhyāyo yujyata ityāha- athāta ityādi||1-2||
aśvagandhā ca śṛṅgī ca sārivā sapunarnavā | sahe tathā vidārī ca kaṣāyāḥ secane hitāḥ ||3||
aśvagandhetyādi| ajaśṛṅgī karkaṭaśṛṅgī, uttamāraṇītyanye| sahe mudgamāṣaparṇyau| secane hitāḥ pratyekaṃ samuditāśca||3||
tailamabhyañjane kāryaṃ kuṣṭhe sarjarase'pi ca | palaṅkaṣāyāṃ nalade tathā girikadambake ||4||
tailamityādi| sarjaraso rālaḥ, palaṅkaṣā gugguluḥ, naladaṃ jaṭāmāṃsī, giriḥ girikarṇikā; anye girikadambo mahākadambaḥ svanāmakhyātaḥ; etaiḥ kuṣṭhādibhiḥ kalkīkṛtaistailaṃ kāryam||4||
dhavāśvakarṇakakubhadhātakītindukīṣu ca | kākolyādigaṇe caiva pānīyaṃ sarpiriṣyate ||5||

dhavetyādi| aśvakarṇo gardabhāṇḍaḥ, kakubhaḥ arjunaḥ| tatra dhavādikaṣāye kākolyādikalke ca pānīyaṃ sarpiḥ pātavyaṃ ghṛtamiṣyate| anye tu kākolyādigaṇenaiva pānīyaṃ ghṛtamicchanti, dhavāśvakarṇādīni paścāttaile ‘saṅkṣudya taile saṃyacchanti' iti pā. sambandhanti||5||

div.ab: kulatthāḥ śaṅkhacūrṇaṃ ca pradehaḥ sārvagandhikaḥ | gṛdhrolūkapurīṣāṇi yavā yavaphalo ghṛtam ||6|| sandhyayorubhayoḥ kāryametaduddhūpanaṃ śiśoḥ | varuṇāriṣṭakamayaṃ rucakaṃ saindukaṃ tathā ||7|| satataṃ dhārayeccāpi kṛtaṃ vā pautrajīvikam | śuklāḥ sumanaso lājāḥ payaḥ śālyodanaṃ tathā ||8|| balirnivedyo gotīrthe revatyai prayatātmanā |9|

kulatthā ityādi| śaṅkhacūrṇaṃ sudagdhaśaṅkhacūrṇam| sarvagandhā elādikāḥ, taiḥ kṛto lepaḥ sārvagandhikaḥ| gṛdhretyādi| yavāḥ prasiddhāḥ, yavaphalo vaṃśaḥ, anye yavaphalā dugdhiketyāhuḥ| varuṇāriṣṭakamayaṃ varuṇanimbakāṣṭhaghaṭitaṃ, rucakaṃ grīvābharaṇaṃ maṇikasañjñaṃ dhārayet| brahmadevastvariṣṭaṃ phenilamāha| saindukamiti sinduko nirguṇḍī, tatkāṣṭhakṛtaṃ rucakaṃ; tatphalakṛtamityanye| putrañjīvo madhyavartulatīkṣṇāgraphalo jambīrapatro vṛkṣastatkāṣṭhakṛtaṃ rucakaṃ, tatphalakṛtamityanye| kecidatrāragvadhaṃ paṭhanti| śukletyādi śuklāḥ sumanasaḥ śvetakusumāni| nivedyo dātavyaḥ| gotīrthe salilagopathe| prayatātmanā upavāsādipavitreṇa| taduktaṃ,- “sopavāsaḥ śucirnaktaṃ saśastro nirharedbalim” iti||6-8||-

ab.seg: saṅgame ca bhiṣak snānaṃ kuryāddhātrīkumārayoḥ ||9||
nānāvastradharā devī citramālyānulepanā | calatkuṇḍalinī śyāmā revatī te prasīdatu ||10||
upāsate yāṃ satataṃ devyo vividhabhūṣaṇāḥ | lambā karālā vinatā tathaiva bahuputrikā | revatī śuṣkanāmā yā sā te devī prasīdatu ||11||

saṅgama ityādi| saṅgame nadīdvayamelake| rakṣāmantramāha- nānetyādi| aparā devyo vividhabhūṣaṇā yāṃ revatīmupāsate sevante sā devī bho bālaka te tava prasādaṃ karotu loke prasādakarā bhavatu| revatī śuṣkanāmā śuṣkarevatītyarthaḥ||9-11||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre revatīpratiṣedho nāma (pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||31||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kaumārabhṛtyatantre revatīpratiṣedho nāmaikatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||31||
athātaḥ pūtanāpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
revatīpratiṣedhānantaraṃ strīgrahasāmānyāt pūtanāpratiṣedhārambho yujyata ityāha- athāta ityādi||1-2||
kapotavaṅkā'raluko varuṇaḥ pāribhadrakaḥ | āsphotā caiva yojyāḥ syurbālānāṃ pariṣecane ||3||
vacā vayaḥsthā golomī haritālaṃ manaḥśilā | kuṣṭhaṃ sarjarasaścaiva tailarthe varga iṣyate ||4||

kapotavaṅketyādi| kapotavaṅkā kabaḍavaṅketi loke prasiddhā brahmasuvarcalāparaparyāyā| āsphotā sārivā| vayasthā brāhmī, anye guḍūcīmāhuḥ| golomī dūrvā| varga iṣyate iti vargagrahaṇaṃ yathālābhaṃ prakṣepārtham| vacādīnāṃ kalkakaṣāyābhyāṃ tailasādhyam||3-4||
hitaṃ ghṛtaṃ tugākṣīryāṃ siddhaṃ madhurakeṣu ca | kuṣṭhatālīśakhadiracandanasyandane tathā ||5||
devadāruvacāhiṅgukuṣṭhaṃ girikadambakaḥ | elā hareṇavaścāpi yojyā uddhūpane sadā ||6||
gandhanākulikumbhīke majjāno badarasya ca | karkaṭāsthi ghṛtaṃ cāpi dhūpanaṃ sarṣapaiḥ saha ||7||

hitamityādi| tugākṣīrī vaṃśalocanā, madhurakeṣu kākolyādiṣu; kākolyādipāṭhāttugākṣīrī prāptā, pṛthakpāṭho bhāgadvayārthaṃ kuṣṭhatālīśādīnāṃ yathālābhaniṣedhārtho vā, ye tugākṣīrīṃ vaṃśarocanānukāripārthivadravyaṃ manyante tanmate dviruktirnāsti| kalkakaṣāyābhyāṃ siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ hitamiti sambandhaḥ| girikadambako mahākadambaḥ| gandhanākulī sugandhā rāsnā| kumbhikā jalajā| jejjaṭācāryastu na paṭhatyetaddevadārvādiyogadvayamapi, gayī tu paṭhati||5-7||
kākādanīṃ citraphalāṃ bimbīṃ guñjāṃ ca dhārayet | matsyaudanaṃ ca kurvīta kṛśarāṃ palalaṃ tathā | śarāvasampuṭe kṛtvā baliṃ śūnyagṛhe haret ||8||

kākādanīmityādi| kākādanī kākatindukaḥ, ‘kālā’ ityanye; citraphalā indravāruṇī, citrāṇḍiketyanye| matsyaudanaṃ matsyabhaktaṃ; palalaṃ tilapiṣṭam| ‘śūnyagṛhe haret’ ityatra ‘śūnyagṛhetare’ ityanye, tatretare khaṇḍagṛhe| kecidatredṛśaṃ paṭhanti ‘haredbaliṃ cotkuraṭe’ ityādi; tatrotkuraṭaḥ śūnyāgāraḥ, śūnyārāma ityanye||8||
ucchiṣṭenābhiṣekeṇa śiśoḥ snapanamiṣyate | pūjyā ca pūtanā devī balibhiḥ sopahārakaiḥ ||9||
malināmbarasaṃvītā malinā rūkṣamūrdhajā | śūnyāgārāśritā `śūnyārāmāśritā' iti pā. devī dārakaṃ pātu pūtanā ||10||
durdarśanā sudurgandhā karālā meghakālikā | bhinnagārāśrayā devī dārakaṃ pātu pūtanā ||11||
ucchiṣṭenetyādi| ucchiṣṭenābhiṣekeṇa ācamanodakenetyarthaḥ| pūrvakalpena snānam| rakṣāmantraḥ- malinetyādi||9-11||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre (ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||32||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kaumārabhṛtyatantre pūtanāpratiṣedho nāma dvātriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||32||

div.head: andhapūtanāpratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto'ndhapūtanāpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
pūtanāpratiṣedhānantaraṃ pūtanāsāmānyādandhapūtanāpratiṣedhārambho yujyata ityāha- athāta ityādi||1-2||

div.ab: tiktakadrumapatrāṇāṃ kāryaḥ kvātho'vasecane |3|
tiktaketyādi| tiktakadrumā nimbādayaḥ, tatpatrakvāthena pariṣekaḥ kāryaḥ|3|-
surā sauvīrakaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ haritālaṃ manaḥśilā ||3|| tathā sarjarasaścaiva tailārthamupadiśyate | pippalyaḥ pippalīmūlaṃ vargo madhurako madhu ||4|| śālaparṇī bṛhatyau ca ghṛtārthamupadiśyate |5|

suretyādi| sauvīrakaṃ virecanādhyāyopadiṣṭakāñjikaprakāraḥ| atra taile surāsauvīrake tailāt pratyekaṃ caturguṇe, kuṣṭhādīni kalkadravyāṇi caturthāṃśāni| pippalya ityādi| vargo madhurakaḥ kākolyādiḥ, vargagrahaṇaṃ yathālābhaniṣedhārthaṃ, pippalyādīnāṃ kalkakvāthābhyāṃ ghṛtaṃ vipācya śītībhūte ghṛte madhu kṣipet| idaṃ ghṛtaṃ pānāya||3-4||-

ab.seg: sarvagandhaiḥ pradehaśca gātreṣvakṣṇośca śītalaiḥ ||5||
sarvetyādi| pradeho lepaḥ| śītalairanyairapi dravyaiḥ||5||
purīṣaṃ kaukkuṭaṃ keśāṃścarma sarpatvacaṃ tathā | jīrṇāṃ ca bhikṣusaṅghāṭīṃ dhūmanāyopakalpayet ||6||

purīṣaṃ kaukkuṭamiti kukkuṭapurīṣaṃ, keśāṃścarma ca kukkuṭasya, keśāścarma ca mānuṣasyetyeke; kecit carmeti sarpasya vadanti, tena carma tvak kañculikā sarpasya| jīrṇāṃ ca bhikṣusaṅghāṭīmiti bhikṣuratra śākyabhikṣurbauddhākhyaḥ parivrājakaśca, tayorjīrṇasaṅghāṭī jīrṇavastraṃ; tadekadeśo gṛhyate, ekadeśe'pi samudāyapravṛtteḥ; bhikṣuratra śākyabhikṣureveti jejjaṭaḥ||6||
kukkuṭīṃ markaṭīṃ śimbīmanantāṃ cāpi dhārayet | māṃsamāmaṃ tathā pakvaṃ śoṇitaṃ ca catuṣpathe ||7||
nivedyamantaśca gṛhe śiśo rakṣānimittataḥ | śiśośca snapanaṃ kuryāt sarvagandhodakaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||8||
karālā piṅgalā muṇḍā kaṣāyāmbaravāsinī | devī bālamimaṃ prītā saṃrakṣatvandhapūtanā ||9||

kukkuṭīmityādi| kukkuṭī sphaṭikaracitakukkuṭāṇḍasadṛśakandā kukkuṭīśarīravat kusumacitrā vallī| markaṭī kapikacchuḥ, markaṭamūlītyanye, śukaśimbītyapare| anantā sārivā| antaśca khaṇḍagṛhābhyantare| śiśośceti cakārāt dhātryāśca snapanam| sarvagandhā elādikāḥ| devī prītā satī imaṃ bālaṃ rakṣatviti sambandhaḥ||7-9||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre'ndhapūtanāpratiṣedho nāma (saptamo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||33||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kaumārabhṛtyatantre'ndhapūtanāpratiṣedho nāma trayastriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||33||

div.head: śītapūtanāpratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ śītapūtanāpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
andhapūtanāpratiṣedhānantaraṃ pūtanāsāmānyācchītapūtanāpratiṣedhārambho yujyata ityāha- athāta ityādi||1-2||

div.ab: kapitthaṃ suvahāṃ bimbīṃ tathā bilvaṃ pracībalam | nandīṃ bhallātakaṃ cāpi pariṣeke prayojayet ||3|| bastamūtraṃ gavāṃ mūtraṃ mustaṃ ca suradāru ca | kuṣṭhaṃ ca sarvagandhāṃśca tailārthamavacārayet ||4|| rohiṇīsarjakhadirapalāśakakubhatvacaḥ | niṣkvāthya tasminniṣkvāthe sakṣīraṃ vipacedghṛtam ||5|| gṛdhrolūkapurīṣāṇi bastagandhāmahestvacaḥ | nimbapatrāṇi madhukaṃ dhūpanārthaṃ prayojayet ||6|| dhārayedapi lambāṃ ca guñjāṃ kākādanīṃ tathā |7|

kapitthamityādi| suvahā godhāpadī| pracībalo matsyākṣakaḥ, kākajaṅghetyanye| nadībhallātakaṃ nadīpippalikā gaṇḍopalīti paryāyā| sarvagandhā elādikāḥ| atra taile kuṣṭhadvayasya pāṭho bhāgadvayārthaḥ| rohiṇī kaṭphalaḥ| rohiṇyādikvāthe triguṇe kṣīraikabhāge ghṛtaṃ pacet| bastagandhā bothayikā| ahestvacaḥ sarpasya kañcukāḥ| lambā tiktālābūḥ| kākādanī kākatindukā||3-6||-

ab.seg: nadyāṃ mudgakṛtaiścānnaistarpayecchītapūtanām ||7||
devyai deyaścopahāro vāruṇī rudhiraṃ tathā | jalāśayānte bālasya snapanaṃ copadiśyate ||8||
nadyāmityādi| mudgakṛtairannaiḥ mudgakṛtairbhakṣyaiḥ, mudgodaneneti gayī| upahāro baliḥ| jalāśayānte nadyāḥ samīpe||7-8||
mudgaudanāśanā devī surāśoṇitapāyinī | jalāśayālayā devī pātu tvāṃ śītapūtanā ||9||
rakṣāmāha- mudgetyādi||9||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre śītapūtanāpratiṣedho nāma(aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||34||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kaumārabhṛtyatantre śītapūtanāpratiṣedhādhyāyaścatustriṃśattamaḥ||34||
athāto mukhamaṇḍikāpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
śītapūtanāpratiṣedhānantaraṃ strīgrahasāmānyānmukhamaṇḍikāpratiṣedhārambho yujyata ityāha- athāta ityādi||1-2||
kapitthabilvatarkārīvāṃśīgandharvahastakāḥ | kuberākṣī ca yojyāḥ syurbālānāṃ pariṣecane ||3||
kapitthetyādi| tarkārī araṇikā, vāṃśī vaṃśalocanā, kuberākṣī kāṣṭhapāṭalā, peṭiketyanye||3||
svarasairbhṛṅgavṛkṣāṇāṃ `bhṛṅgavṛkṣo bhṛṅgarāja' iti hārāṇacandraḥ tathā'jaharigandhayoḥ | tailaṃ vasāṃ ca saṃyojya pacedabhyañjane śiśoḥ ||4||

bhṛṅgavṛkṣāṇāmiti vātaharabilvādikānāṃ bhṛṅgāḥ patrabhaṅgāḥ, tadupayogikā vṛkṣāḥ| ajaharigandhayoriti bastagandhāśvagandhayoḥ, ajāśvagandhācaturguṇarasena tailaṃ vasāṃ ca saṃyojya yamakaṃ pacediti manyante; ‘ajaharigandhayoḥ’ ityatra ca ‘tathaiva harigandhayā’ iti paṭhanti||4||
madhūlikāyāṃ payasi tugākṣīryāṃ gaṇe tathā | madhure pañcamūle ca kanīyasi ghṛtaṃ pacet ||5||

madhūlikāyāmityādi| madhūlikā markaṭahastatṛṇam| payasi gokṣīre| atra gayī payaḥsvinīti paṭhati; tatra kṣīravidārīgaṇe; tathā madhure kākolyādike, pañcamūle kanīyasi śālaparṇyādike| madhūlikādikalkakvāthābhyāṃ ghṛtaṃ pacet||5||
vacā sarjarasaḥ kuṣṭhaṃ sarpiścoddhūpanaṃ hitam | dhārayedapi jihvāśca cāṣacīrallisarpajāḥ ||6||
varṇakaṃ cūrṇakaṃ mālyamañjanaṃ pāradaṃ tathā | manaḥśilāṃ copaharedgoṣṭhamadhye baliṃ tathā ||7||
pāyasaṃ sapuroḍāśaṃ balyarthamupasaṃharet | mantrapūtābhiradbhiśca tatraiva snapanaṃ hitam ||8||

vacetyādi| cāṣaḥ karṇāyasaḥ, cīralliḥ ‘cilla’ iti loke, cāṣādijihvāṃ dhārayet| varṇako rocanikā kampillaka ityarthaḥ, kaṅkuṣṭhamityanye| mālyaṃ puṣpam| añjanaṃ rasāñjanaṃ, sauvīrāñjanamityanye| pāradaṃ śambhuretaḥ| pūrvakalpena śālyādikṛtamaṇḍale goṣṭhamadhye varṇakādibalimupaharet, anye tu varṇakādidravyāṇi maṇḍalārthaṃ manyante| pāyasaṃ kṣīrasaṃsiddhāstaṇḍulāḥ, puroḍāśaḥ aṣṭākapālaḥ piṣṭamayaḥ kapālopari pakvastṛṇāgninā| mantretyādi mantrapūtābhiḥ gāyatryā abhimantritābhiḥ| tatraiva goṣṭhamadhye||6-8||
alaṅkṛtā rūpavatī subhagā kāmarūpiṇī | goṣṭhamadhyālayaratā pātu tvāṃ mukhamaṇḍikā ||9||
rakṣāmāha- alaṅkṛtetyādi||9||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre mukhamaṇḍikāpratiṣedho nāma(navamo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) pañcatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||35||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kaumārabhṛtyatantre mukhamaṇḍikāpratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ pañcatriṃśattamaḥ||35||
athāto naigameṣapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
mukhamaṇḍikāpratiṣedhānantaraṃ pariśiṣṭhatvānnaigameṣapratiṣedhārambho yukta ityāha- athāto naigameṣapratiṣedhamityādi||1-2||
bilvāgnimanthapūtīkāḥ kāryāḥ syuḥ pariṣecane | surā sabījaṃ dhānyāmlaṃ pariṣeke ca śasyate ||3||
priyaṅgusaralānantāśatapuṣpākuṭannaṭaiḥ | pacettailaṃ sagomūtrairdadhimastvamlakāñjikaiḥ ||4||

bilvāgnimanthetyādi| pūtīkaḥ cirabilvaḥ| ‘surā sabījaṃ dhānyāmlaṃ’ ityatrānye ‘surāsabījadhānyāmlaiḥ’ iti paṭhanti; tathāpāṭhe sabījaṃ dhānyāmlaṃ bījena saha kāñjikamiti| anye tu surāsthāne tatheti paṭhanti| sabījamapyatra sauvīramiti kecit| priyaṅgusaraletyādi| saralā śuklā trivṛt, anantā utpalasārivā, kuṭannaṭaṃ tagaraṃ; tatra priyaṅgvādikalkaṃ caturthāṃśaṃ, dadhyādidravyaiścaturbhiḥ pratyekaṃ samaṃ tailaṃ pacediti kramaḥ||3-4||
pañcamūladvayakvāthe kṣīre madhurakeṣu ca | pacedghṛtaṃ ca medhāvī kharjūrīmastake'pi vā ||5||
pañcamūladvayakvāthe iti pañcamūladvayakvāthe daśamūlakvāthe triguṇe, kṣīre ghṛtasame, kākolyādikalkacaturthāṃśaṃ, kharjūrīmajjacaturthāṃśaṃ vā ghṛtaṃ pānārthaṃ pacedityarthaḥ||5||
vacāṃ vayaḥsthāṃ golomīṃ jaṭilāṃ cāpi dhārayet | utsādanaṃ hitaṃ cātra skandāpasmāranāśanam ||6||
vacāmityādi| vayaḥsthā guḍūcī, brāhmītyanye, golomī dūrvā, jaṭilā māṃsī| utsādanam udvartanam||6||
siddhārthakavacāhiṅgukuṣṭhaṃ caivākṣataiḥ saha | bhallātakājamodāśca hitamuddhūpanaṃ śiśoḥ ||7||
siddhārthaketyādi| akṣatā yavāḥ||7||
markaṭolūkagṛdhrāṇāṃ purīṣāṇi navagrahe | dhūpaḥ supte jane kāryo bālasya hitamicchatā ||8||
markaṭetyādi| markaṭādipurīṣeṇa rātrau supte loke bālasya dhūpanam||8||
tilataṇḍulakaṃ mālyaṃ bhakṣyāṃśca vividhānapi | kumārapitṛmeṣāya vṛkṣamūle nivedayet ||9||
tiletyādi| vividhān svastikamodakādīn| kumārapitṛmeṣāyeti kumārāṇāṃ pitā rakṣaṇātmakatvāt, meṣo naigameṣaḥ, tasmai naigameṣāya| vṛkṣamūle kṣīravṛkṣamūle| nivedayettilādikaṃ balim||9||
adhastādvaṭavṛkṣasya snapanaṃ copadiśyate | baliṃ nyagrodhavṛkṣeṣu tithau ṣaṣṭhyāṃ nivedayet ||10||
ajānanaścalākṣibhraḥ kāmarūpī mahāyaśāḥ | bālaṃ bālapitā devo naigameṣo'bhirakṣatu ||11||
rakṣāmāha- adhastādityādi| snapanaṃ gāyatryabhimantritābhiradbhiḥ| balimapi tilataṇḍulamityādikaṃ vaṭamūle ṣaṣṭhyāṃ nivedayet||10-11||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre naigameṣapratiṣedho nāma(daśamo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||36||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kaumārabhṛtyatantre naigameṣapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśattamaḥ||36||

div.head: grahotpattyadhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto grahotpattimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

navagrahākṛtivijñānaṃ cikitsitaṃ cābhidhāya bālagrahāṇāmutpattiṃ kāraṇaṃ cābhidhātuṃ grahotpattyadhyāyārambho yujyata ityāha- athāta ityādi| grahāṇāṃ skandādīnām, utpattiḥ āgatiḥ prāptiḥ; etena krīḍanārthaṃ niyojanamatrotpattiḥ, nābhūtaprādurbhāvaḥ; kutaḥ? teṣāṃ nityatvāt||1-2||
nava skandādayaḥ proktā bālānāṃ ya ime grahāḥ | śrīmanto divyavapuṣo nārīpuruṣavigrahāḥ ||3||
navetyādi| vigrahaḥ śarīraṃ; tatra ca skandaskandāpasmāranaigameṣāḥ puruṣaśarīrāḥ, śeṣāḥ strīśarīrāḥ||3||
ete guhasya rakṣārthaṃ kṛttikomāgniśūlibhiḥ | sṛṣṭāḥ śaravaṇasthasya rakṣitasyātmatejasā ||4||

ete ityādi| śaravaṇasthasya ātmatejasā rakṣitasyāpi rakṣārthaṃ kṛttikādibhirete skandādayo grahāḥ sṛṣṭā niyojitā ityarthaḥ; guhasya kārtikeyasya, ātmatejasā svaśaktyā| nanu svabhāvarakṣitasya guhasya rakṣakaiḥ kiṃ? ucyate- yathā svaśaktyā anabhibhavanīyasyāpi indrasya anye devā rakṣakāḥ, prabhudharmatvāt; tadvadguhasyāpi anye grahā rakṣakāḥ, prabhudharmatvāt||4||
strīvigrahā grahā ye tu nānārūpā mayeritāḥ | gaṅgomākṛttikānāṃ te bhāgā rājasatāmasāḥ ||5||

strītyādi| strīvigrahā nārīśarīrāḥ, nānārūpā meṣādimukhāḥ, mayā dhanvantariṇā, īritāḥ kathitāḥ| te strīvigrahāḥ| bhāgā aṃśāḥ, rājasatāmasā matā rajastamomayāḥ smṛtāḥ| yadyapi sarvagrahāṇāṃ rajastamomayatvaṃ, tathā'pi strīvigrahāṇāmevātyarthaṃ rajastamoguṇabhūyiṣṭhatvaṃ; tadbhūyiṣṭhatvāccātiśayena hiṃsātmakatvamiti tebhyo bālako rakṣitavyaḥ||5||
naigameṣastu pārvatyā sṛṣṭo meṣānano grahāḥ | kumāradhārī devasya guhasyātmasamaḥ sakhā ||6||

naigameṣa ityādi| naigameṣaḥ puṅgrahaḥ, meṣānana eḍakamukhaḥ, bālakautukāya sṛṣṭaḥ| kumāradhārī kumārapālayitā; ‘kumārahārī’ ityanye paṭhanti, tatra kumārān haratītyarthaḥ| ātmasama ātmatulyaḥ, sakhā mitram| ‘ātmasama’ ityatrānye ‘ātmodbhava’ iti paṭhanti, tatrātmodbhavaḥ putraḥ||6||
skandāpasmārasañjño yaḥ so'gninā'gnisamadyutiḥ | sa ca skandasakhā nāma viśākha iti cocyate ||7||
skandetyādi| apasmāravikāraliṅgaliṅgatavikāritvena skandāpasmāra ityucyate| so'gninā sṛṣṭa iti sambadhyate| viśākha iti skandāpasmārasyāparaṃ nāma||7||
skandaḥ sṛṣṭo bhagavatā devena tripurāriṇā | bibharti cāraparāṃ sañjñāṃ kumāra iti sa grahaḥ ||8||
skanda ityādi| tripurāriṇā rudreṇa sṛṣṭaḥ||8||
bālalīlādharo yo'yaṃ devo rudrāgnisambhavaḥ | mithyācāreṣu `mithyā bāleṣu' iti pā. bhagavān svayaṃ naiṣa pravartate ||9||

guhasya skandādibhyo bhedamāha- bālalīlādhara ityādi| līlā ceṣṭā, rudrāgnisambhava iti rudrasambhavo'gnisambhavaśca| mithyācāreṣu bāleṣvityarthaḥ| svayaṃ na pravartate tadanucarāstu pravartante, kutaḥ? yato'sya devatvādyāgādibhireva tṛptiḥ| ‘bālalīlādhara’ ityatra ‘bālalīlāṭana’ ityanye paṭhanti||9||
kumāraḥ skandasāmānyādatra kecidapaṇḍitāḥ | gṛhṇātītyalpavijñānā bruvate dehacintakāḥ ||10||
kumāra ityādi| kumāraḥ kārtikeyaḥ, skandasāmānyāt skandagrahanāmatulyatvādbālaṃ gṛhṇātīti ye kecidapaṇḍitā dehacintakā vaidyā bruvate te'lpavijñānā apaṇḍitāḥ||10||

div.ab: tato bhagavati skande surasenāpatau kṛte | upatasthurgrahāḥ sarve dīptaśaktidharaṃ guham ||11|| ūcuḥ prāñjalayaścainaṃ vṛttiṃ naḥ saṃvidhatsva vai | teṣāmarthe tataḥ skandaḥ śivaṃ devamacodayat ||12|| tato grahāṃstānuvāca bhagavān bhaganetrahṛt | tiryagyoniṃ mānuṣaṃ ca daivaṃ ca tritayaṃ jagat ||13|| parasparopakāreṇa vartate dhāryate'pi ca | devā manuṣyān prīṇanti tairyagyonīṃstathaiva ca ||14|| vartamānairyathākālaṃ śītavarṣoṣṇamārutaiḥ | ijyāñjalinamaskārajapahomavratādibhiḥ ||15|| narāḥ samyak prayuktaiśca prīṇanti tridiveśvarān | bhāgadheyaṃ vibhaktaṃ ca śeṣaṃ kiñcinna vidyate ||16|| tadyuṣmākaṃ śubhā vṛttirbāleṣveva bhaviṣyati | kuleṣu yeṣu nejyante devāḥ pitara eva ca ||17|| brāhmaṇāḥ sādhavaścaiva guravo'tithayastathā | nivṛttācāraśauceṣu parapākopajīviṣu ||18|| utsannabalibhikṣeṣu bhinnakāṃsyopabhojiṣu | gṛheṣu teṣu ye bālāstān gṛhṇīdhvamaśaṅkitāḥ ||19|| tatra vo vipulā vṛttiḥ pūjā caiva bhaviṣyati | evaṃ grahāḥ samutpannā bālān gṛhṇanti cāpyataḥ ||20|| grahopasṛṣṭā bālāstu duścikitsyatamā matāḥ |21|

ke tarhi bālān gṛhṇantīti pṛṣṭa āha- tata ityādi| tato guharakṣārthaṃ navagraheṣu sṛṣṭeṣu satsu, anantaraṃ surā devāsteṣāṃ senā tasyāḥ patau svāmini guhe kṛte sati, upatasthuḥ āgatāḥ| śaktiḥ āyudhaviśeṣaḥ| ūcuḥ uktavantaḥ| prāñjalayaḥ saṃyojitahastāḥ| enaṃ guhaṃ prati; enamityatra anye deveti guhasambodhanaṃ paṭhanti| kimūcuḥ? vṛttiṃ `vṛttirjīvanaṃ' iti pā. vartanaṃ, naḥ asmākaṃ, saṃvidhatsva kuru, vai sphuṭam| ātmavṛttyarthamupasthitānāṃ grahāṇāṃ kārtikeyena kiṃ kṛtamityāha- teṣāmityādi| tataḥ skandaḥ śivaṃ devamacodayatteṣāṃ grahaṇāmarthe, tato grahavṛttiprārthanādanantaraṃ, skandaḥ kārtikeyaḥ, acodayat prārthitavān| evaṃ grahārthe prārthitaḥ śaṅkaraḥ kiṃ kṛtavānityāha- tata ityādi| tataḥ prārthanānantaraṃ tān grahān prati bhagavān bhaganetrahṛt bhagalocanahārī rudra uktavān| kimuktavānityāha- tiryagityādi| tiryagyonimānuṣadevānāṃ tritayaṃ jagacchabdavācyaṃ, etattritayaṃ parasparamanyonyopakāreṇa vartate, dhāryate'pi ceti cakārāt kriyate ca| tatra tiryagyonayo gavādayaḥ, te manuṣyānupakurvanti vahanādinā; mānuṣāśca māṣādidānena tiryagyonīnupakurvanti| devamānuṣayoḥ parasparopakāramāha- devā ityādi| yathākālaṃ śītoṣṇavarṣādīn `śītoṣṇavarṣādibhiḥ' iti pā. kṛtvā mānuṣān tiryagyonīṃśca prīṇayantīti sambandhaḥ| deveṣu mānuṣopakāramāha- ijyetyādi| ijyā yāgaḥ, añjaliḥ karadvayayojanaṃ, namaskāraḥ praṇāmaḥ, japa oṅkārapūrvakaṃ gāyatryādyāvartanaṃ, homo lakṣādisaṅkhyāhutibhirvahnau havanaṃ, vrataṃ prasiddhaṃ, samyakprayuktaiḥ vedoktavidhānena prayuktaiḥ; ijyāñjaliprabhṛtibhiḥ samyakprayuktairnarāstridiveśvarān devān prīṇayantīti sambandhaḥ| bhāgadheyamityādi| bhāgadheyam aṃśasamūhaḥ, vibhaktaṃ devāditritayena sarvameva vibhajya gṛhītaṃ, śeṣam avaśiṣṭaṃ, kiñcinnāsti yatastattasmādbālagraharakṣārthaṃ sṛṣṭatvādyuṣmākaṃ vṛttirapi bho grahā bāleṣveva bhaviṣyatīti| anaparādheṣu bāleṣu vṛttiṃ kalpayan śambhurapi doṣabhāk syādataḥ sāparādheṣu vṛttimāha- kuleṣvityādi| nejyante na pūjyante, utsanne `utsannabalibhikṣeṣu naṣṭapūjābhikṣeṣu' iti pā. naṣṭe balibhikṣe yeṣu tāni tathā, teṣu vṛttiriti| atra hiṃsanameva vṛttiḥ| pūjā caiveti puṣpādinā bhojanādinā cetyarthaḥ||11-20||-

ab.seg: vaikalyaṃ maraṇaṃ cāpi dhruvaṃ skandagrahe matam ||21||
skandagraho'tyugratamaḥ sarveṣveva yataḥ smṛtaḥ | anyo vā sarvarūpastu na sādhyo graha ucyate ||22||

evamityādi| vaikalyaṃ vikalāṅgatā| dhruvaṃ niścitam| skandetyādi| sarveṣveva graheṣu madhye skandagraho yato'tyugratamaḥ, ata eva tadgṛhītasya dhruvaṃ maraṇaṃ, atha kathañcijjīvati tadā vaikalyamiti| anya ityādi| anyo vā skandāpasmārādikaḥ||21-22||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre grahotpattyadhyāyo nāma(ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) saptatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||37||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kaumārabhṛtyatantre grahetpattyadhyāyaḥ saptatriṃśattamaḥ||37||

div.head: yonivyāpatpratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto yonivyāpatpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

grahotpattyadhyāyānantaraṃ ‘tiryagyoniṃ mānuṣaṃ ca’ iti vacanena yonernāmasaṅkīrtanāt kumārajanmavikārakāraṇatvācca yonervyāpaccikitsitārthaṃ yonivyāpatpratiṣedhādhyāyārambho yujyata ityāha- athāta ityādi| yonivyāpado yonirogāḥ, teṣāṃ pratiṣedhaścikitsitamiti||1-2||

div.ab: pravṛddhaliṅgaṃ puruṣaṃ yā'tyarthamupasevate | rūkṣadurbalabālā yā tasyā vāyuḥ prakupyati ||3|| sa duṣṭo yonimāsādya yonirogāya kalpate |4|

pravṛddhetyādi| rūkṣadurbalabālā yā strī pravṛddhaliṅgamatipralambamehanaṃ puruṣamatiśayena sevate| tasyā vāyuḥ prakopamāpadyate, sa vāyuḥ prakupitaḥ san pittaśleṣmāṇau kopayati, athavā vātaḥ pittaśleṣmāṇau svahetubhiḥ kupitau gṛhītvā yonirogāya kalpate samartho bhavati||3||-
trayāṇāmapi doṣāṇāṃ yathāsvaṃ lakṣaṇena tu ||4|| viṃśatirvyāpado yonernirdiṣṭā rogasaṅgrahe | mithyācāreṇa yāḥ strīṇāṃ praduṣṭenārtavena ca ||5|| jāyante bījadoṣācca daivācca śṛṇu tāḥ pṛthak |6|
teṣāṃ yonirogāṇāṃ sāmānyajñānopāyamāha- trayāṇāmityādi| yathāsvaṃ lakṣaṇena yonirogaṃ jānīyādityarthaḥ||4-5||-

udāvartā tathā vandhyā viplutā ca pariplutā ||6|| vātalā ceti vātotthāḥ, pittotthā rudhirakṣarā | vāminī sraṃsinī cāpi putraghnī pittalā ca yā ||7|| atyānandā ca yā yoniḥ karṇinī caraṇādvayam `caraṇīdvayam' iti pā.| śleṣmalā `ślaiṣmikī sakaphā jñeyā' iti pā. ca kaphājjñeyā, ṣaṇḍākhyā phalinī tathā ||8|| mahatī `mehanī' iti pā. sūcivaktrā ca sarvajeti tridoṣajā |9|

vātajāḥ pañca yonivyāpada āha- udāvartetyādi| udāvartā, vandhyā, viplutā, pariplutā, vātalā, iti pañca vātotthāḥ| pittajāḥ pañcāha- rudhirakṣarā, vāminī, sraṃsinī, putraghnī, pittalā, iti pañca pittotthāḥ| kaphajāḥ pañcocyante- atyānandā, karṇinī, caraṇādvayaṃ, śleṣmalā, iti pañca kaphotthāḥ| sannipātajāḥ pañcocyante- ṣaṇḍī, phalinī, mahatī, sūcivaktrā, sarvajā, iti pañca sannipātajāḥ||6-8||-

ab.seg: saphenilamudāvartā rajaḥ kṛcchreṇa muñcati ||9||
vandhyāṃ naṣṭārtavāṃ vidyādviplutāṃ nityavedanām | pariplutāyāṃ bhavati grāmyadharme rujā bhṛśam ||10||
vātalā karkaśā stabdhā śūlanistodapīḍitā | catasṛṣvapi cādyāsu bhavantyanilavedanāḥ ||11||

vātajānāṃ yonivyāpadāṃ pṛthaglakṣaṇamāha- saphenilamityādi| yā udāvartā yoniḥ sā phenilaṃ phenasahitaṃ raja ārtavaṃ kṛcchreṇa duḥkhena muñcati| viplutā nityaṃ rujāvatī, pariplutā punarvyavāya eva pīḍāvatītyanayorbhedaḥ| vātaletyādi| stabdhā tanaṭiteva| śūlaṃ vātaśūlaṃ, nistodaḥ sūcībhiriva vyadhanam| kiṃ vātalāyāmevānilavedanā bhavanti utānyāsvapītyāha- catasṛṣvityādi| ādyāsu udāvartādiṣvapītyarthaḥ||9-11||
sadāhaṃ prakṣaratyasraṃ yasyāṃ sā lohitakṣarā | savātamudgiredbījaṃ vāminī rajasā yutam ||12||
prasraṃsinī syandate tu kṣobhitā duḥprasūśca yā | sthitaṃ sthitaṃ hanti garbhaṃ putraghnī raktasaṃsravāt ||13||
atyarthaṃ pittalā yonirdāhapākajvarānvitā | catasṛṣvapi cādyāsu pittaliṅgocchrayo bhavet ||14||

sadāhamityādi| asram ārtavaṃ, ‘sadāhaṃ kṣīyate raktaṃ yasyāṃ sā lohitakṣayā’ iti kecit paṭhanti| bījaṃ śukram| udgiret vamet| rajasā yutam ārtavamiśram| syandate sravati, kṣobhitā sañcālitā, duḥprasūḥ duḥkhena prasūyate yā evaṃvidhā yoniḥ sā prasraṃsinīti sambandhaḥ| duḥprasūścetyatrānye ‘duḥprajāyanā’ iti paṭhanti, duṣṭībhūtāpatyamārgeti vyākhyānayanti| sthitamityādi| sthitaṃ sthitaṃ garbhaṃ hanti notpannamātram| catasṛṣu ādyāsu lohitakṣarādiṣu| pittaliṅgocchrayaḥ oṣacoṣādikā vedanāḥ||12-14||
atyānandā na santoṣaṃ grāmyadharmeṇa gacchati | karṇinyāṃ karṇikā yonau śleṣmāsṛgbhyaṃ prajāyate ||15||
maithune'caraṇā `maithune'caraṇī' iti pā. pūrvaṃ puruṣādatiricyate | bahuśaścāticaraṇādanyā bījaṃ na vindati ||16||
śleṣmalā picchilā yoniḥ kaṇḍūyuktā'tiśītalā | catasṛṣvapi cādyāsu śleṣmaliṅgocchritirbhavet ||17||

atyānandetyādi| grāmyadharmeṇa maithunena| karṇikā māṃsakandī| maithunetyādi| pūrvā caraṇī atiricyate maithunācaraṇe'dhikā bhavati; anye ‘maithune'caraṇā pūrvaṃ’ iti paṭhanti, śeṣaṃ samam| puruṣāt pūrvamatiricyate, atyarthaṃ kaṇḍūyata ityarthaḥ| bahuśo aticaraṇāt maithunāt, anyā aticaraṇā, bījaṃ garbhāṅkurajananaṃ, na vindati na prāpnoti| ‘bahuśaścāticaraṇī tayorbījaṃ na tiṣṭhati’ iti kecit paṭhanti, aticaraṇā bahuśo maithunaṃ vrajati, tayoścaraṇāticaraṇayorbījaṃ `tayoścaraṇyaticaraṇyoḥ' iti pā. na tiṣṭhati, sthitiṃ na karotītyarthaḥ| śleṣmaletyādi| ādyāsu atyānandādiṣu śleṣmaliṅgocchritiḥ paicchilyakaṇḍvādikāḥ||15-17||
anārtavastanā ṣaṇḍī kharasparśā ca maithune | atikāyagṛhītāyāstaruṇyāḥ phalinī bhavet ||18||
vivṛtā'timahāyoniḥ sūcīvaktrā'tisaṃvṛtā | sarvaliṅgasamutthānā sarvadoṣaprakopajā ||19||
catasṛṣvapi cādyāsu sarvaliṅgocchritirbhavet | pañcāsādhyā bhavantīmā yonayaḥ sarvadoṣajāḥ ||20||

sānnipātikāḥ pañcocyante| vandhyāṣaṇḍyoḥ sastanatvanistanatve viśeṣataḥ| svarasparśā ceti cakārānmaithunadveṣaniṣedhaḥ| atikāyo bṛhatsādhano narastena gṛhītāyā phalinīti sañjñā, ‘aphalinī’ ityanye paṭhanti, tatra atikāyagṛhītā yā taruṇī sā aphalinī aprajā iti vyākhyā| ativivṛtā mahāyonirucyate| sūcīvaktrā atisaṃvṛtā atyarthasaṅkucitamukhī, saṅkucitamukhetyucyate| sarvaliṅgā sarvacihnā, sarvasamutthānā sarvakāraṇā, yā sā sarvajā kathyate| catasṛṣvityādi| catasṛṣvapi cādyāsu ṣaṇḍīprabhṛtiṣu; sarvaliṅgocchritiriti raukṣyatodādikā vātaliṅgocchritayaḥ, coṣādikāḥ pittaliṅgocchritayaḥ, snehakaṇḍvādikāḥ śleṣmaliṅgocchritayaśca||18-20||
pratidoṣaṃ tu sādhyāsu snehādikrama iṣyate | dadyāduttarabastīṃśca viśeṣeṇa yathoditān ||21||

pratītyādi| sādhyāsu yonivyāpatsu pratidoṣaṃ yaḥ snehādikramaḥ sa iṣyata ityarthaḥ| etena yasya doṣasya yaḥ pratyanīkaḥ snehastena snehena saṃsnehya saṃsvedya tato vamanādīn sādhyāsvavacārayedityarthaḥ| yathoditāniti vātādibhedenetyarthaḥ||21||

div.ab: karkaśāṃ śītalāṃ stabdhāmalpasparśāṃ ca maithune | kumbhīsvedairupacaret sānūpaudakasaṃyutaiḥ ||22|| madhurauṣadhasaṃyuktān veśavārāṃśca yoniṣu | nikṣipeddhārayeccāpi picutailamatandritaḥ ||23|| dhāvanāni ca pathyāni kurvītāpūraṇāni ca |24|

karkaśāmityādi| alpasparśāmiti ativyavāyakruddhavātajanitasuptitvāt| ‘śītalāṃ’ ityatrānye tu ‘tumulām’ `saśūlāṃ' iti pā. iti paṭhanti, tatra śūlatodavedanāsaṅkulāmiti vyākhyā| kumbhīsvedaiḥ ānūpaudakamāṃsavātaghnadravyakvāthapūrṇāṃ kumbhīṃ kṛtvā bhūmau nikhanya tadupari śayyāṃ saṃsthāpyāgnisantaptalauhapāṣāṇaguḍakān kvāthe nikṣipya tadutthitairbāṣpasvedairyonipradeśamātragāmibhirupacaret; anye tu kumbhīṃ vātaharadravyānūpaudakamāṃsapūrṇāṃ sajalāṃ kṛtvā pravṛttoṣmāṇaṃ gṛhṇīyāditi vyākhyānayanti| upanāhaviśeṣamāha- madhuretyādi| madhurāṇi kākolyādīni kalkīkṛtāni, tairyuktān veśavārān kṛtānnavargoktān yoniṣu nikṣipet, picutailaṃ picunā tulakena tailaṃ vātaghnadravyakvāthasiddhaṃ yoniṣu dhārayet| atandrito nirantarakārītyarthaḥ `nistandra ityarthaḥ' iti pā.| picutailaṃ balāśṛtamityanye| dhāvanāni prakṣālanāni| pathyāni vātaharauṣadhasiddhānītyarthaḥ||22-23||-

ab.seg: oṣacoṣānvitāsūktaṃ kuryācchītaṃ vidhiṃ bhiṣak ||24||
śītaṃ vidhiṃ raktapittaharam||24||
durgandhāṃ picchilāṃ cāpi cūrṇaiḥ pañcakaṣāyajaiḥ | pūrayedrājavṛkṣādikaṣāyaiścāpi dhāvanam ||25||
durgandhāṃ pittena, picchilāṃ kaphena| pañca kaṣāyā nyagrodhodumbaraplakṣāśvatthagardabhāṇḍāḥ| taccūrṇena yoniṃ pūrayet| rājavṛkṣādiḥ āragvadhādiḥ||25||
yonyāṃ tu pūyasrāviṇyāṃ śodhanadravyasambhṛtaiḥ | sagomūtraiḥ salavaṇaiḥ śodhanaṃ hitamiṣyate `piṇḍairāpūraṇaṃ hitam' iti pā.||26||
śodhanadravyāṇi miśrakoktāni||26||
bṛhatīphalakalkasya dviharidrāyutasya ca | kaṇḍūmatīmalpasparśāṃ pūrayeddhūpayettathā ||27||
vartiṃ pradadyāt karṇinyāṃ śodhanadravyasambhṛtām | prasraṃsinīṃ ghṛtābhyaktāṃ kṣīrasvinnāṃ praveśayet ||28||
pidhāya veśavāreṇa tato bandhaṃ samācaret | pratidoṣaṃ vidadhyācca surāriṣṭāsavān bhiṣak ||29||
prātaḥ prātarniṣeveta rasonāduddhṛtaṃ rasam | kṣīramāṃsarasaprāyamāhāraṃ vidadhīta ca ||30||
tathāśabdāddhūpanamapi bṛhatīphalādibhireva||27-30||
śukrārtavādayo doṣāḥ stanarogāśca kīrtitāḥ | klaibyasthānāni `klabyotthānāni' iti pā. mūḍhasya garbhasya vidhireva ca ||31||
garbhiṇīpratirogeṣu cikitsā cāpyudāhṛtā | sarvathā tāṃ prayuñjīta yonivyāpatsu buddhimān | apaprajātārogāṃśca cikitseduttarādbhiṣak ||32||

śukretyādi| śukrārtavādayo doṣāḥ śukraśoṇitaśuddhiśārīre salakṣaṇacikitsitā uktāḥ; ādiśabdāddhātrīstanyadoṣāśca| stanarogā visarpanāḍīstanaroganidāne, taccikitsite taccikitsā uktā| klaibyasthānāni `klaibyotthānāni' iti pā. klaibyakāraṇāni kṣīṇabalīyavājīkaraṇoditāni| mūḍhagarbhasyeti sthānānītyatrāpi sambadhyate, tena mūḍhagarbhasya sthānāni kāraṇāni, vidhireva ca kriyā cetyarthaḥ| etaddvayaṃ mūḍhagarbhanidāne taccikitsite coktam| garbhiṇīpratirogeṣviti garbhiṇīpratirogeṣu garbhiṇyā māsānumāsaṃ pratirogeṣu raktasrāvādiṣu cikitsoktā| cikitsā ceti cakārādgarbhiṇyāḥ svasthāyā api cikitsā udāhṛtā garbhiṇīvyākaraṇaśārīre| kecit ‘garbhiṇīpratirogeṣu’ ityatra ‘garbhiṇīpratimāseṣu’ iti paṭhanti| tāṃ cikitsāṃ yonivyāpatsvapi sarvathā prayuñjītetyarthaḥ| apaprajātā akālaprasūtā, tasyā rogān jvarādikān| tānuttarāduttaratantroktajvarādicikitsitāt| rogāṃśceti cakāra uttaratantrādityatra yojanīyaḥ| tenāpaprajātārogānuttarāduttaratantroktāccikitset, cakārādapatānakādīn saṃhitoktena vidhinā cikitsedityarthaḥ| anye tu ‘uttarān’ iti paṭhanti, uttarakālabhāvino'patānakādīn bhiṣak cikitset, ‘svaiścikitsitaiḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ||31-32||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre yonivyāpatpratiṣedho nāma(dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ, ādito')ṣṭatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||38||
uttaratantre dvitīyaṃ kaumāratantraṃ samāptam ||2||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kaumārabhṛtyatantre yonivyāpatpratiṣedhādhyāyo'ṣṭatriṃśattamaḥ||38||

div.head: jvarapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto jvarapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

kumāratantrānantaraṃ kāyacikitsārambhaḥ; yataḥ kumāratantrāvasāne ‘apaprajātārogāṃśca cikitseduttarādbhiṣak’ iti vākye uttarādityanena kāyacikitsitasya sūcitatvāt, athavā kumārāṇāmapi jvarādyutpatau satyāṃ kāyacikitsitasyopayogitvāt| atra kāyaśabdena doṣadhātumalasaṅghāta ucyate, tena kāyasthitānāṃ `tatra sthitānāṃ' iti pā. jvarādīnāṃ cikitsā kāyacikitsā, mañcāḥ krośantītivat| anye kāyaśabdena kāyāgniṃ vadanti, yato'gniṃ `yato'gnivyāptyaiva' iti pā. vyāpya vai jvarādayo bhavanti| apare duṣṭakāyaḥ kāyaḥ tasya cikitsā kāyacikitsetyāhuḥ| tasyāmapi kāyacikitsāyāṃ bahuṣūpadraveṣu rudrakopasambhavatayā jvarasya garīyastvāt pūrvaṃ jvarapratiṣedhārambha ityāha- athāta ityādi| athaśabdo'nantarārthaḥ| kuto'nantaramityāha- ata iti; asmāt pūrvādhyāyādityarthaḥ; ataḥśabdo hetau vā, yato'yaṃ jvaro rudrakopasambhavatayā garīyānato hetorityarthaḥ| pratiṣedhaḥ cikitsā| viḥ viśeṣe vividhaprakāre ca; āṅ abhivyāptau, ābhimukhye vā; vyākhyāsyāmaḥ prakarṣeṇa kathayiṣyāmaḥ||1-2||

div.ab: yenāmṛtamapāṃ madhyāduddhṛtaṃ pūrvajanmani | yato'maratvaṃ samprāptāstridaśāstridiveśvarāt ||3|| śiṣyāstaṃ devamāsīnaṃ papracchuḥ suśrutādayaḥ | vraṇasyopadravāḥ proktā vraṇināmapyataḥ param ||4|| samāsād vyāsataścaiva brūhi no bhiṣajāṃvara |5|

idānīṃ jvarapratiṣedharūpāṃ dhanvantaristutiṃ pratipādayan jvarapratipādanahetukaṃ dhanvantariṃ guruṃ prati śiṣyāṇāṃ praśnamāha- yenāmṛtamapāmityādi| yena dhanvantariṇā| apāṃ madhyāt kṣīrārṇavamadhyāt| uddhṛtam ānītam| pūrvajanmani devatve sati| yato yasmāt| tridaśeśvarāt dhanvantareḥ| amaratvaṃ samprāptāḥ amṛtadānena; tridaśā devā amṛtaprāptyā amaratvaṃ samprāptāḥ| taṃ devaṃ dhanvantarināmānam| āsīnam upaviṣṭam| papracchuḥ pṛṣṭavantaḥ| jejjaṭācāryastu ‘tridaśāstridaśeśvarā’ iti paṭhitvā yato yasmāt dhanvantarestridaśā devā amṛtaprāptyā amaratvaṃ sampraptāḥ santaḥ tridaśeśvarāḥ sañjātā iti vyākhyānayanti| atra yenāmṛtamityādiśloke amṛtāmarayornāma jvarapratiṣedhādau maṅgalārthamuktam| yadyapi prāk suśrutasya praśnakartṛtvena prādhānyaṃ, tathā'pyatra sarveṣāmanugrahāya praśne'dhikāraḥ| kiṃ papracchurityāha- vraṇasyopadravā ityādi| vraṇasyopadravā vedanāvarṇāsrāvādayaḥ| proktā vraṇāsrāvavijñānīyādiṣu| vraṇināmiti vraṇinaḥ puruṣāḥ, teṣāmupadravā jvarātīsārādayaḥ, tān samāsāt saṅkṣepataḥ, vyāsato vistārāt; he bhiṣajāṃvara no'smākaṃ brūhi| anye tu vraṇasyopadravā varṇāsrāvavedanādayaḥ proktāḥ, vraṇināmapi samāsāt proktāḥ; tathā ca- “visarpaḥ pakṣaghātaśca sirāstambho'patānakaḥ| mohonmādau vraṇarujā jvarastṛṣṇā hanugrahaḥ|| kāsaśchardiratīsāro hikkā śvāsaḥ savepathuḥ| ṣoḍaśopadravāḥ proktā vraṇināṃ vraṇacintakaiḥ”- iti; vyāsataścātaḥ paraṃ brūhīti vyākhyānayanti||3-4||-

ab.seg: upadraveṇa juṣṭasya vraṇaḥ kṛcchreṇa sidhyati ||5||
upadravāstu vraṇinaḥ kṛcchrasādhyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | prakṣīṇabalamāṃsasya śeṣadhātuparikṣayāt ||6||
tasmādupadravān kṛtsnān brūhi naḥ sacikitsitān | sarvakāyacikitsāsu ye dṛṣṭāḥ paramarṣiṇā ||7||

na paraṃ vraṇitopadravāṇāmanabhihitatvāt tān prati praśnaḥ, kiṃ tarhi sopadravasya kṛcchreṇa vraṇapraśāntiḥ vraṇitopadravāṇāṃ ca kṛcchrasādhyatvamiti hetudvayena punaḥ śiṣyāṇāṃ praśnamāha- upadraveṇa juṣṭasyetyādi| upadraveṇa jvarādinā yuktasya puruṣasya; anye tu ‘upadraveṇa juṣṭastu’ iti vraṇaviśeṣaṇaṃ paṭhanti, tanmate upadraveṇa vraṇavedanādinā `varṇavedanādinā' iti pā., juṣṭo vyāptaḥ| kṛcchreṇa kaṣṭena| vraṇina upadravā jvarādikāḥ, visarpādikā ityanye| kīdṛśasya vraṇina upadravāḥ kṛcchrasādhyāḥ ityāha- prakṣīṇabalamāṃsasyetyādi| balam utsāhalakṣaṇaṃ, māṃsam upacayalakṣaṇam| śeṣadhātavo medaḥprabhṛtayaḥ, teṣāṃ parikṣayāt; raktasya tu māṃsāśrayatvānmāṃsagrahaṇenaiva grahaṇam| tasmāditi yasmādupadravajuṣṭasyātikṛcchratvaṃ tasmāt kṛtsnān samastānupadravān sacikitsitān no'smākaṃ brūhīti sambandhaḥ| sarvakāyacikitsāsviti sarvasmin kāye cikitsā tāsu| ye dṛṣṭā upadravā jvarādayaḥ| paramarṣiṇā dhanvantariṇā| atra cikitsāśabdena pratikāra ucyate; anye tvatra cikitsāśabdena cikitsāśāstramabhidhāya mūlatantrāṇāmaupadhenavaurabhrādīnāṃ cikitsāśāstrāṇāmavarodhaṃ manyante; apare ‘ṣaṭsu kāyacikitsāsu’ iti paṭhanti, teṣāṃ mate ṣaṭśabdena agniveśabheḍajātūkarṇahārītakṣārapāṇiparāśaraproktāḥ ṣaṭ cikitsā labhyante; atra pakṣe ‘paramarṣiṇā’ ityatra ‘paramarṣibhiḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ||5-7||
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā prābravīdbhiṣajāṃvaraḥ | jvaramādau pravakṣyāmi sa rogānīkarāṭ smṛtaḥ ||8||
rudrakopāgnisambhūtaḥ sarvabhūtapratāpanaḥ | taistairnāmabhiranyeṣāṃ sattvānāṃ parikīrtyate ||9||

teṣāmityādi| teṣāṃ śiṣyāṇām| bhiṣajāṃvaro dhanvantariḥ| jvaramādāvityādi| sa iti jvaraḥ| rogānīkarāḍiti rogasamūhasya rājā| taistairnāmabhiḥ pākalābhitāpakhorakabhramarakādibhiḥ| anyeṣāṃ sattvānāṃ gajāśvādīnām||8-9||
janmādau nidhane caiva prāyo viśati dehinam `dehinaḥ' iti `dehinām' iti ca pā.| ataḥ sarvavikarāṇāmayaṃ rājā prakīrtitaḥ ||10||
idānīmuktameva rogasamūharāṭtvaṃ sahetukaṃ kṛtvā pratipādayati- janmetyādi| prāyo viśeṣeṇa||10||

div.ab: ṛte devamanuṣyebhyo nānyo viṣahate tu tam | karmaṇā labhate yasmāddevatvaṃ mānuṣādapi ||11|| punaścaiva cyutaḥ svargānmānuṣyamanuvartate | tasmātte devabhāvena sahante mānuṣā jvaram ||12|| śeṣāḥ sarve vipadyante tairyagyonā jvarārditāḥ |13|

tiryagyonayastena pīḍitā vipadyanta eveti pratipādayituṃ jvaraprabhāvamāha- ṛte ityādi| ṛte vinā| nānyo viṣahate nānyaḥ soḍhuṃ śaknoti| devāḥ svatapomāhātmyāt sahante; manuṣyāḥ kathaṃ soḍhuṃ samarthāḥ? ucyate- karmaṇetyādi; enaṃ pāṭhaṃ kecinna paṭhanti, īdṛśe krame niścayo nāsti yatsvargāccyuto mānuṣa eva bhavati||11-12||-
svedāvarodhaḥ `svedoparodhaḥ' iti pā. santāpaḥ sarvāṅgagrahaṇaṃ tathā ||13|| vikārā yugapadyasmin jvaraḥ sa parikīrtitaḥ |14|

idānīṃ jvarasya svarūpamāha- svedāvarodha ityādi| svedāvarodhaḥ `svedoparodhaḥ' iti pā. svedānirgamaḥ; etacca prāyikaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ, paittike svedanirgamāt| santāpa iti santāpayatīti saṃśabdānmānaso'pi tāpo'bhipretaḥ; tathā coktaṃ,- ‘santāpo dehamānasa’ iti| sarvāṅgagrahaṇaṃ vedanayā| yugapaditi ekakāle| ‘svedāvarodha `svedoparodhaḥ' iti pā. ’ ityatra ‘vegoparodhaḥ’ ityanye paṭhanti; vegoparodho vātamūtrapurīṣādīnāmanirgamaḥ||13||-
doṣaiḥ pṛthak samastaiśca dvandvairāgantureva ca ||14|| anekakāraṇotpannaḥ smṛtastvaṣṭavidho jvaraḥ |15|
ataḥ paraṃ hetubhedājjvarasyānekatvamāha- doṣairityādi| pṛthak trayaḥ, samastairdoṣairekaḥ, dvandvajāstrayaḥ, āganturekaḥ, evamanekakāraṇotpanno'pi jvaro'ṣṭavidhatvaṃ na tyajati||14||-

doṣāḥ prakupitāḥ sveṣu kāleṣu svaiḥ prakopaṇaiḥ ||15|| vyāpya dehamaśeṣeṇa jvaramāpādayanti hi | duṣṭāḥ svahetubhirdoṣāḥ prāpyāmāśayamūṣmaṇā ||16|| sahitā rasamāgatya rasasvedapravāhiṇām | srotasāṃ mārgamāvṛtya mandīkṛtya hutāśanam ||17|| nirasya bahirūṣmāṇaṃ paktisthānācca kevalam | śarīraṃ samabhivyāpya svakāleṣu jvarāgamam ||18|| janayantyatha vṛddhiṃ vā svavarṇaṃ ca tvagādiṣu |19|

jvarasya samprāptimāha- doṣāḥ prakupitā ityādi| doṣāḥ prakupitāścayānupūrvyā; sveṣu kāleṣu prāvṛṭśaradvasanteṣu ahorātrikeṣu ca; etena prākṛto jvara uktaḥ| svaiḥ prakopaṇairiti balavadvigrahādikrodhādidivāsvāpādibhirvraṇapraśnoktaiḥ| anena ca vaikṛtaḥ| brahmadevastu sannipātaprakopasya hetūnatra pṛthagāha; yathā,- “viṣamādhyaśanātyaśanaṃ lakucāmaphalaṃ śiloccaye salilam| piṇyākamāmamūlakasarṣapaśākaṃ yavaiḥ kṛtā ca surā|| kṛśaśuṣkāmiṣaśākaṃ yāvakamaśanaṃ ca parvate vāsaḥ| vyāpannāmbusurādadhikandaṃ piḍakocchritirdehe|| mṛdviṣagarādibhakṣaṇamanārtavaṃ durdinaṃ purovātaḥ| annaparivartabhūtāveśau pīḍā graharkṣasambhūtā|| anucitabheṣajagandhāghrāṇaṃ pāpasya karmaṇo'bhyāsaḥ| snehasvedādīnāṃ mithyāyogaḥ purākṛtaṃ karma|| strīṇāṃ viṣamaprasavo mithyāyogaḥ prasūtānām| snehasvedādīnāṃ rasāyanasyāpi ca vyāpat|| ete hetava uktāḥ prakopaṇe sannipātasya”- iti| aśeṣeṇa sāmastyena| āpādayanti janayanti| anye ‘doṣāḥ prakupitā gāḍhamapathyāhārasevanaḥ’ iti paṭhanti| atra gāḍhaśabdena prakṛtaḥ, apathyāhārasevina ityanena vaikṛtaḥ| anye jvarasamprāptimanena pāṭhena paṭhanti, tadyathā- duṣṭāḥ svahetubhirityādi| duṣṭāḥ prakupitāścayādirūpeṇa, sveṣu kāleṣu prākṛtaṃ jvaraṃ, svahetubhiradyasamprāptiślokavyākhyātairbalavadvigrahādibhirvaikṛtam| ūṣmaṇā vahnayūṣmaṇā sahitā dhātūṣmaṇā doṣoṣmaṇā vā sahitā doṣā rasaṃ hṛdayasthamāgatya, hutāśanaṃ jaṭharāgniṃ mandīkṛtya, ūṣmāṇamagnereva, paktisthānāt agnisthānāt, bahiḥ nirasya nikṣipya, kevalaṃ sarvaṃ, svakāleṣu ārtaveṣu ahorātrikeṣu ca jvarāgamaṃ janayanti, athavā vṛddhimāgatasya; svavarṇaṃ nakhatvaṅnayanādiṣu janayanti||15-18||-

ab.seg: mithyātiyuktairapi ca snehādyaiḥ karmabhirnṛṇām ||19||
vividhādabhighātācca rogotthānāt prapākataḥ | śramāt kṣayādajīrṇācca viṣātsātmyartuparyayāt ||20||
oṣadhīpuṣpagandhācca śokānnakṣatrapīḍayā `kopānnakṣatrapīḍanāt' iti pā.| abhicārābhiśāpābhyāṃ manobhūtābhiśaṅkayā ||21||
strīṇāmapaprajātānāṃ prajātānāṃ tathā'hitaiḥ | stanyāvataraṇe caiva jvaro doṣaiḥ pravartate ||22||

na kevalamevaṃ svaprakopaṇairvraṇapraśnoktaiḥ prakupitā doṣā jvaramāpādayanti, api tu te'nyairapi kāraṇairityata āha- mithyātiyuktairityādi| mithyātiyuktaiḥ ayathāvidhiyuktairatiyuktaiśca| snehādyaiḥ snehasvedavamanavirecanādikaiḥ| nṛṇāṃ jvaro doṣaiḥ pravartate iti sambandhaḥ; ‘pravartata’ ityatra ‘prakupyati’ iti kecit| vividhādabhighātāt śastraloṣṭrakāṣṭhādiprahārāt| rogotthānāt rogā vidradhyādayasteṣāmutthānāt| śramāt ativyāyāmāt| prapākasteṣāmeva| āmāt ajīrṇāt| kṣayāt rājayakṣmaṇaḥ| sātmyartuparyayāt sātmyaviparyayādṛtuviparyayācca| oṣadhīśabdasyādau viṣaśabdo lupto draṣṭavyaḥ, tena viṣauṣadhīpuṣpagandhāt| nakṣatraṃ janmanakṣatraṃ, tasya pīḍā tathā krūragrahāṇāṃ bādhā tayā| abhicāro yantramantrādyabhipīḍanam, abhiśāpo dvijagurusiddhānāmabhiśapanaṃ, tābhyām| manobhūtābhyāmabhiśaṅkāśabdaḥ sambadhyate, abhiśaṅkā śabdena abhiṣaṅgatvaṃ kathyate; tena mano'bhiṣaṅgeṇa kāmādyabhiṣaṅgeṇetyarthaḥ, bhūtaśabdena devādigrahā ucyante, tena devādigrahābhiṣaṅgeṇetyarthaḥ| apaprajātānām asamyakprasūtānāṃ, prajātānāṃ samyakprasūtānām, ahitaiḥ kṛtvā| stanyasya kṣīrasya, avataraṇe prathamamunmukhībhavane||19-22||
tairvegavadbhirbahudhā samudbhrāntairvimārgagaiḥ | vikṣipyamāṇo'ntaragnirbhavatyāśu bahiścaraḥ ||23||
ruṇaddhi cāpyapāndhātuṃ yasmāttasmājjvarāturaḥ | bhavatyatyuṣṇagātraśca jvaritastena `na ca svidyati sarvataḥ' iti pā. cocyate ||24||

evaṃ jvarahetūnudāhṛtya yathoṣṇagātratvāṃ syāttathā darśayati- tairvegavadbhirbahudhetyādi| taiḥ doṣaiḥ| vegavadbhiḥ prasaraṇaśīlaiḥ| samudbhrāntaiḥ itaścetaśca vikṣiptaiḥ| vimārgagaiḥ tiryaggataiḥ| vikṣipyamāṇaḥ preryamāṇaḥ| antaragnirbahiścaro bhavati ‘romakūpaiḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| apāndhātuṃ svedaṃ, ruṇaddhi| sa eva bahirniḥsṛto'ntaragniryasmādapāndhātuṃ ruṇaddhi tasmādatyuṣṇasarvāṅgo bhavati, yato'tyuṣṇa sarvāṅgaḥ syāttena kāraṇena jvarita ityucyate| anye tu ‘jvaritastena cocyate’ ityatra ‘na ca svidyati sarvaśaḥ’ iti paṭhanti (vyākhyānayanti ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate ca sarvatra na svidyati, ca kvacit svidyatītyarthaḥ)||23-24||
śramo'ratirvivarṇatvaṃ vairasyaṃ nayanaplavaḥ | icchādveṣau muhuścāpi śītavātātapādiṣu ||25||
jṛmbhā'ṅgamardo gurutā romaharṣo'rucistamaḥ | apraharṣaśca śītaṃ ca bhavatyutpatsyati jvare ||26||
sāmānyato, viśeṣāttu jṛmbhā'tyarthaṃ samīraṇāt | pittānnayanayordāhaḥ, kaphānnānnābhinandanam ||27||
sarvaliṅgasamavāyaḥ sarvadoṣaprakopaje | dvayordvayostu rūpeṇa saṃsṛṣṭaṃ dvandvajaṃ viduḥ ||28||

idānīṃ pūrvarūpamāha- śrama ityādi| aratiḥ śayanāsanādau sarvatrāpi sukhābhāvaḥ| nayanaplavo nayanayoraśrupūrṇatā| ātapādiṣvityādiśabdagrahaṇācchayyāsanagrahaṇam| tamaḥ andhakāradarśanam| apraharṣa ānandābhāvaḥ| utpatsyati bhāvini jvare| sāmānyataḥ sarvasminneva jvare| pratyekadoṣajajvare pūrvarūpamāha- viśeṣāttu jṛmbhā'tyarthamityādi| na annābhinandanam annānabhilāṣaḥ||25-28||
vepathurviṣamo vegaḥ kaṇṭhauṣṭhapariśoṣaṇam | nidrānāśaḥ kṣutaḥ stambho gātrāṇāṃ raukṣyameva ca ||29||
śirohṛdgātrarugvaktravairasyaṃ baddhaviṭkatā | jṛmbhā''dhmānaṃ tathā śūlaṃ bhavatyanilaje jvare ||30||

vātādijatvena jvarasya lakṣaṇānyāha- vepathurityādi| vepathuḥ kampaḥ| viṣamo `viṣamo vegaḥ hīnādhikabhāvena' iti pā. vega iti kadācidatiśayitaḥ kadācinmandaśca vegaḥ| kṣutaḥ stambhaḥ kṣut chikkā tasyāḥ stambho'nirgamanaṃ; ‘kṣuta’ ityatra anye ‘kṣava’ iti paṭhanti; tanmate `tanmate vātajvare chikkā sambhavati' iti pā. kṣavaḥ chikkā, stambho gātrasya| nanu, vātajvaramokṣe'pi chikkā syāt, tat kathaṃ jvarāgamamokṣayorjñānam? ucyate- aparavepathvādivātajvaralakṣaṇānāmabhāvājjvaramokṣo boddhavyaḥ| raukṣyameva ceti gātrāṇāṃ (rūkṣagrahaṇenaiva ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacinnopalabhyate kṛṣṇāruṇavarṇayuktamiti jñeyaṃ); cakārāt kṛṣṇaviṇmūtratvaṃ samuccīyate; anye tu ‘gātrāṇāṃ raukṣyameva ca’ ityatra ‘śyāvāṅgamalanetratā’ iti paṭhanti| śirasaḥ pṛthagupādānamatyarthaṃ śirorugbhavatīti jñāpanārtham; anyathā gātrarugityanenaiva tatprāpteḥ| ‘jṛmbhādhmāne bhramaḥ śūlaṃ’ ityanye paṭhanti||29-30||
vegastīkṣṇo'tisāraśca nidrālpatvaṃ tathā vamiḥ | kaṇṭhauṣṭhamukhanāsānāṃ pākaḥ svedaśca jāyate ||31||
pralāpaḥ kaṭutā vaktre mūrcchā dāho madastṛṣā | pītaviṇmūtranetratvaṃ paittike bhrama eva ca ||32||
vega ityādi| ‘pralāpaḥ kaṭutā vaktre’ ityatra ‘pralāpastiktavaktratvaṃ’ iti kecit paṭhanti| madaḥ pūgaphaleneva mattatā||31-32||
gauravaṃ śītamutkleśo romaharṣo'tinidratā | srotorodho rugalpatvaṃ `viḍalpatvaṃ' iti pā. praseko madhurāsyatā ||33||
nātyuṣṇagātratā chardiraṅgasādo'vipākatā | pratiśyāyo'ruciḥ kāsaḥ kaphaje'kṣṇośca `kaphaje'kṣyādiśuklatā' iti pā. śuklatā ||34||

gauravamityādi| gauravaṃ gātrāṇāṃ, utkleśaḥ śleṣmaniṣṭhīvanaṃ, praseko lālāsrāvaḥ, aṅgasādaḥ aṅgaglāniḥ| anye tvevaṃ paṭhanti- ‘staimityaṃ stimito vega ālasyaṃ madhurāsyatā| śuklamūtrapurīṣatvaṃ stambhastṛptirathāpi ca|| gauravaṃ śītamutkleśo romaharṣo'tinidratā| pratiśyāyo'ruciḥ kāsaḥ kaphaje'kṣṇośca śuklatā’ iti| staimityaṃ niścalatvaṃ jvaritasya, vego'pi stimitaḥ satatasthito niścalaḥ, anye tu stimito vego manda udgamaḥ||33-34||

div.ab: nidrānāśo bhramaḥ śvāsastandrā suptāṅgatā'ruciḥ | tṛṣṇā moho madaḥ stambho dāhaḥ śītaṃ hṛdi vyathā ||35|| paktiścireṇa doṣāṇāmunmādaḥ śyāvadantatā | rasanā paruṣā kṛṣṇā sandhimūrdhāsthijā rujaḥ ||36|| nirbhugne kaluṣe netre karṇau śabdaruganvitau | pralāpaḥ srotasāṃ pākaḥ kūjanaṃ cetanācyutiḥ ||37|| svedamūtrapurīṣāṇāmalpaśaḥ sucirāt srutiḥ |38|

ekaikadoṣajaṃ jvaramabhidhāya sānnipātikamāha- nidrānāśa ityādi| bhramaścakrārūḍhasyeva bhramaṇam| tandrālakṣaṇamucyate “indriyārtheṣvasaṃvittirgauravaṃ jṛmbhaṇaṃ klamaḥ| nidrārtasyeva yasyehā tasya tandrāṃ vinirdiśet”- iti| suptāṅgatā gātrāṇāṃ sparśājñatā, moho'tra mūrcchā, madaḥ pūgaphaleneva mattatā, stambhaḥ stabdhatā| unmādo mānaso vikāraḥ| rasanā jihvā, paruṣā karkaśā| sandhimūrdhāsthijā ruja iti sandhirujā mūrdharujā asthirujā ca; anye sandhyādisthāne ‘loṭhanaṃ śiraso rujā’ iti paṭhanti, loṭhanaṃ śiraso vidhūnanam| nirbhugne kuṭile, kaluṣe maline `samale' iti pā.| śabdaruganvitau śabdānvitau ruganvitau ca karṇau bhavataḥ| pralāpaḥ asambaddhabhāṣaṇam| srotasāṃ mukhanāsādirandhrāṇām| kūjanam avyaktaśabdotthānaṃ kaṇṭhe| cetanācyutiḥ cittanāśaḥ| alpaśaḥ sucirāt srutiriti alpamalpaṃ kṛtvā cirakālena niḥsaratītyarthaḥ||35-37||-
sarvaje sarvaliṅgāni... |38|
nidrānāśa ityādipāṭhena vikṛtiviṣamasamavetasya sannipātasya lakṣaṇamabhidhāya prakṛtisamasamavetasya lakṣaṇamāha- sarvaje ityādi| sarvadoṣaje sarvaliṅgāni pratyekavātādijvaroktalakṣaṇāni|38|-

...viśeṣaṃ cātra me śṛṇu ||38|| nātyuṣṇaśīto'lpasañjño bhrāntaprekṣī hatasvaraḥ | kharajihvaḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhaḥ svedaviṇmūtravarjitaḥ ||39|| sāsro nirbhugnahṛdayo `sāsranirbhugnanayanaḥ' iti pā. bhaktadveṣī hataprabhaḥ | śvasannipatitaḥ śete pralāpopadravāyutaḥ ||40|| tamabhinyāsamityāhurhataujasamathāpare |41|

idānīmabhinyāsādisañjñābhiḥ `idānīmanvarthābhiḥ sañjñābhiḥ' iti pā. sannipātabhedamāha- viśeṣamityādi| viśeṣaṃ bhedam| atra sannipātajvare| nātyuṣṇaśītaḥ sādhāraṇāṅgasparśaḥ| bhrāntaprekṣī sarvapadārthāyathārthadarśī| sāsraḥ aśrupūrṇanetraḥ| nirbhugnahṛdayaḥ kuṭilahṛdayaḥ| śvasan śvāsaṃ kurvan| nipatita iva śete, etena vikalāṅga uktaḥ| pralāpa evopadravastena āyuto'tyarthayuktaḥ| taṃ sannipātabhedam||38-40||-

ab.seg: sannipātajvaraṃ kṛcchramasādhyamapare viduḥ ||41||
matabhedena sannipātajvarasya kṛcchrasādhyatvamasādhyatvaṃ cocyate- sannipātajvaramityādi| asamastalakṣaṇatve kṛcchrasādhyatvaṃ, samastalakṣaṇatve vibaddhadoṣatve'gnau ca naṣṭe satyasādhyatvam||41||
nidropetamabhinyāsaṃ kṣīṇamenaṃ hataujasam | sannyastagātraṃ sannyāsaṃ vidyātsarvātmake jvare ||42||
