avaśyaṃ vaktavyatvādasya vastuna eṣa pradeśa ityato'tra vyādhīnāṃ karmajādibhedena traividhyamāha- karmajā vyādhaya ityādi| tatra pathyaratānāṃ `pathyaratānāṃ' iti hastalikhitapustake na paṭhyate sadvṛttaratānāṃ śāstroktāhāravihārasevināṃ hemantaśiśire raktapittādyutpadyate, vasante vātavyādhyutpattiḥ, prāvṛṣi śleṣmavyādhyutpattirityādayo nimittamantareṇa ye cotpadyante te karmajāḥ; yān punarasātmyendriyārthasaṃyogaprajñāparādhapariṇāmalakṣaṇaiḥ mithyāhāravihāraiḥ śāstraviruddhairāsevyamānairdoṣāḥ kupitā vyādhīn janayanti te doṣajāḥ; ubhayahetujāḥ karmadoṣajāḥ|163|-
... karmajāsteṣvahetukāḥ ||163|| naśyanti tvakriyābhiste kriyābhiḥ karmasaṅkṣaye |164|

teṣāṃ madhye karmajānāṃ tatra `sūtreṇa' iti pā. lakṣaṇamāha- karmajāsteṣvahetukāḥ; teṣu karmajādiṣu triṣu karmajā ahetukā doṣāgantuheturahitāḥ| naśyantītyādi te karmajāḥ, tu punaḥ, akriyābhiḥ acikitsābhiḥ, kriyābhiḥ prāyaścittajapahomopahārādirūpābhiḥ| karmasaṅkṣaye vyādhijanakakarmakṣaye| ye vyādhayo'hetukā utpadyante akriyābhiśca karmakṣaye sati naśyanti te karmajā iti sambandhaḥ||163||-

ab.seg: śāmyanti doṣasambhūtā doṣasaṅkṣayahetubhiḥ ||164||
doṣajānāṃ lakṣaṇamāha- śāmyantītyādi| ye doṣasaṅkṣayahetubhiḥ śāmyanti te doṣajā ityarthaḥ||164||
teṣāmalpanidānā ye pratikaṣṭā bhavanti ca | mṛdavo bahudoṣā vā karmadoṣodbhavāstu te ||165||

karmadoṣajānāṃ lakṣaṇamāha- teṣāmityādi| teṣāṃ karmādijānām| alpanidānā alpakāraṇā alpotpādakadoṣāḥ| pratikaṣṭā iti pratiśabda itthambhūtārthe; tenetthambhūtā api ye kaṣṭā bhavanti, bahudoṣārabdhāśca ye mṛdavo bhavanti, te karmadoṣodbhavā vyādhaya iti sambandhaḥ||165||

div.ab: karmadoṣakṣayakṛtā teṣāṃ siddhirvidhīyate |166|

karmadoṣodbhavānāṃ cikitsitamāha- karmetyādi| teṣām ubhayajānām| karmadoṣakṣayakṛtā iti karmakṣayakṛtā yāgadānamantrabalyupahāradevatārādhanagurupūjanādinā, doṣakṣayakṛtā snehasvedanavamanādinā| siddhiḥ sādhanaṃ, vidhīyate kriyate|166|-

ab.seg: duṣyati grahaṇī jantoragnisādanahetubhiḥ ||166||

prakṛtamidānīṃ prastūyate- tatrānutpannātīsārasyāpi grahaṇīrogasambhavamāha- duṣyatītyādi| duṣyati vikṛtiṃ yāti| grahaṇī pittadharā kalā vahnyadhiṣṭhānatvena sañjātā `sañjātā' iti hastalikhitapustake na paṭhyate| jantoḥ prāṇinaḥ, agnisādanahetubhiḥ agninirvāpaṇakāraṇaiḥ, etenātīsāraṃ vinā'pi grahaṇīrogasambhava uktaḥ||166||
atisāre nivṛtte'pi mandāgnerahitāśinaḥ | bhūyaḥ sandūṣito vahnirgrahaṇīmabhidūṣayet ||167||
tasmātkāryaḥ parīhārastvatīsāre viriktavat | yāvanna prakṛtisthaḥ syāddoṣataḥ prāṇatastathā ||168||

utpannātīsārasya yathā grahaṇīrogotpattistathā darśayannāha- atīsāre ityādi| nivṛtte'pīti apiśabdādanivṛtte'pi| bhūyaḥ punarapi| grahaṇīmiti agnyadhiṣṭhānam| tasmādityādi yasmāt punardūṣito vahnirgrahaṇyākhyamadhiṣṭhānaṃ dūṣayati tasmādatīsāre viriktavat parīhāraḥ kārya iti sambandhaḥ| parīhārakālāvadhimāha- yāvadityādi||167-168||
ṣaṣṭhī pittadharā nāma yā kalā parikīrtitā | pakvāmāśayamadhyasthā grahaṇī sā prakīrtitā ||169||
atha keyaṃ grahaṇī yāṃ dūṣito vahnirdūṣayatītyāha- ṣaṣṭhī pittadharetyādi| yā kalā parikīrtitā garbhavyākaraṇe śārīre proktā||169||
grahaṇyā balamagnirhi sa cāpi grahaṇīṃ śritaḥ | tasmāt sandūṣite vahnau grahaṇī sampraduṣyati ||170||

yathā'gnau dūṣite sati grahaṇī praduṣyati tathā darśayati- grahaṇyā ityādi| hi yasmādarthe, yasmādgrahaṇyā agnyadhiṣṭhānabhūtāyā balamagniḥ sa, cāpyagnirgrahaṇīṃ śrito grahaṇīmāśritaḥ, tasmādagnau pradūṣite grahaṇī sampraduṣyatīti||170||
ekaśaḥ sarvaśaścaiva doṣairatyarthamucchritaiḥ | sā duṣṭā bahuśo bhuktamāmameva vimuñcati ||171||
pakvaṃ vā sarujaṃ pūti muhurbaddhaṃ muhurdravam | grahaṇīrogamāhustamāyurvedavido janāḥ ||172||

kaiḥ praduṣyatītyāha- ekaśa ityādi| atyarthamucchritaiḥ atyantavṛddhaiḥ, ekaśo vātādibhiḥ, sarvaśaḥ sarvairdoṣaiḥ, sā grahaṇī duṣṭā satī bhuktamannaṃ, bahuśo bahūn vārān, āmamapakvameva vimuñcati| kiṃ sā duṣṭā satī āmameva paraṃ vimuñcatītyāha- pakvaṃ vetyādi| āyurvedavidaḥ aṣṭāṅgajñāḥ||171-172||
tasyotpattau vidāho'nne sadanālasyatṛṭklamāḥ | balakṣayo'ruciḥ kāsaḥ karṇakṣveḍo'ntrakūjanam ||173||

ato grahaṇīrogasya pūrvarūpamāha- tasyotpattāvityādi| tasya grahaṇīrogasya| vidāho'nne annaṃ bhuktaṃ vidahyatītyarthaḥ| sadanam aṅgasādaḥ, ālasyam anutsāhaḥ, tṛṭ pipāsā, klamo vinā'pi vyāyāmaṃ śramaḥ| karṇakṣveḍaḥ anekavidhahuṅkārādiśabdaśravaṇam| ‘vidāho'nne’ ityatrānye ‘vidāho'ntaḥ’ iti paṭhanti, antaḥkoṣṭhe'nnaṃ vidāhamāpādayatīti vyākhyānayanti ca||173||
atha jāte bhavejjantuḥ śūnapādakaraḥ kṛśaḥ | parvaruglaulyatṛṭchardijvarārocakadāhavān ||174||
udgirecchuktatiktāmlalohadhūmāmagandhikam | prasekamukhavairasyatamakārucipīḍitaḥ ||175||

pūrvarūpānantaraṃ rūpamāha- athetyādi| parvaruk sandhipīḍā, laulyaṃ sarvaraseṣu lolupatvam| udgiret vamet| śuktaṃ cukram| gandhaśabdo lohādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| praseko lālāsrāvaḥ| tamakaḥ śvāsaviśeṣaḥ, anye tu tamakaṃ mohamācakṣate| pīḍitaśabdaḥ prasekādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| atra pāṭhe ‘nirmāso vā kṛśaḥ’ ityanye paṭhanti, tatra nirmāṃsaḥatyantakṣīṇamāṃsaḥ, kṛśaḥ alpamāṃsaḥ| atrārocakaśabdopādānādevāruciḥ prāptā, punararucyabhidhānamasmin roge'ruceravaśyambhāvasūcanārtham||174-175||
vātācchūlādhikaiḥ pāyuhṛtpārśvodaramastakaiḥ | pittāt sadāhairgurubhiḥ kaphāttribhyastrilakṣaṇaiḥ ||176||

ata ūrdhvaṃ vātādibhedena grahaṇīlakṣaṇānyāha- vātādityādi| pāyuḥ gudaḥ, hṛt hṛdayaṃ, pārśve dve; pāyvādimastakāntaiḥ śūlādhikairvātādgrahaṇīrogo jñātavya iti; evaṃ sarvatra sambandhanīyam| ebhireva pāyvādibhiḥ sadāhaiḥ pittādgrahaṇī, gurubhiḥ pāyvādibhiḥ kaphāt, trilakṣaṇairiti śūlādhikaiḥ sadāhairgurubhiḥ pāyvādibhiḥ; tribhyo doṣebhyaḥ, ‘grahaṇī’ iti śeṣaḥ||176||
doṣavarṇairnakhaistadvadviṇmūtranayanānanaiḥ | hṛtpāṇḍūdaragulmārśaḥplīhāśaṅkhī ca mānavaḥ ||177||

kimetaireva lakṣaṇairgrahaṇīrogo jñeyo'thavā'nyairapītyāha- doṣavarṇairityādi| doṣavarṇairiti kṛṣṇāruṇanīlapītaraktāsitapāṇḍubhirnakhaiḥ, tadvaditi kṛṣṇādivarṇairviḍādibhiśca ‘grahaṇīrogo jñeya’ iti śeṣaḥ| hṛtpāṇḍūdarādirogāśaṅkī ca mānavo bhavati, ‘pravardhamāne grahaṇīroge’ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ||177||

div.ab: yathādoṣocchrayaṃ tasya viśuddhasya yathākramam | peyādiṃ vitaret samyagdīpanīyopasambhṛtam ||178|| tataḥ pācanasaṅgrāhidīpanīyagaṇatrayam | pibet prātaḥ surāriṣṭasnehamūtrasukhāmbubhiḥ ||179|| takreṇa vā'tha takraṃ vā kevalaṃ hitamucyate | kṛmigulmodarārśoghnīḥ kriyāścātrāvacārayet ||180|| cūrṇaṃ hiṅgvādikaṃ cātra ghṛtaṃ vā plīhanāśanam |181|

ata ūrdhvaṃ grahaṇīrogacikitsitamāha- yathetyādi| doṣocchrayo doṣodrekaḥ| tasyeti grahaṇīrogiṇaḥ| tatra yathādoṣocchrayaṃ viśuddhasyeti vātodreke nirūheṇa, pittodreke virekeṇa, kaphodreke vamanena| yathākramamiti yathāsvaṃ śuddhiprakaraṇoktakrameṇetyarthaḥ| peyādimityādiśabdāt vilepīyūṣamṛdvodanādikam| vitaret dadyāt| samyak yathoktam| dīpanīyopasambhṛtamiti pañcakolādyagnidīpanadravyayuktam| ‘yathādoṣocchrayaṃ’ ityatrānye ‘yathādoṣabalaṃ’ iti paṭhanti, tatra doṣabalānatikrameṇa viśuddhasyetyarthaḥ| tata ityādi| tata iti peyādikramānantaram| pācanasaṅgrāhidīpanīyagaṇatrayamiti gaṇaśabdaḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate; tena pācanadravyagaṇo haridrādiḥ, saṅgrāhīgaṇaḥ ambaṣṭhādiḥ, dīpanīyagaṇaḥ pippalyādiḥ; etadgaṇatrayaṃ doṣakālasātmyādyapekṣayā surāriṣṭādibhistakrāntaiḥ prātaḥ pibedityarthaḥ| takraṃ vetyādi saṅgrāhidīpanīyalaghutvāt “ekā śāntiranekasya” iti vacanāt| krimyādighnī kriyā'trāpi karaṇīyetyāha- krimītyādi| atreti grahaṇīroge| avacārayet prayojayet| nanu, grahaṇīrogo vātādibhedena caturvidhaḥ proktaḥ, tatkathaṃ cikitsitaṃ tathā noktaṃ? ucyate- yathādoṣocchrayamityatrāpyanuvartanīyam; tena krimyādighnī kriyā yathādoṣocchrayamavacārayediti na doṣaḥ| hiṅgvādicūrṇādikaṃ grahaṇyāmapyatidiśannāha- cūrṇamityādi| hiṅgvādicūrṇaṃ mahāvātavyādhyuktaṃ, ghṛtaṃ vā plīhanāśanamiti ṣaṭpalādikaṃ, avacārayedityatrāpi sambadhyate||178-180||-
kalkena magadhādeśca cāṅgerīsvarasena ca ||181|| caturguṇena dadhnā ca ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ hitaṃ bhavet |182|

ab.seg: cāṅgerīghṛtamāha- kalkenetyādi| magadhādeḥ pippalyādeḥ| cāṅgerī amlapatrikā, tasyāḥ svarasena snehacaturguṇena, pippalyādikalkena snehacaturthāṃśena, dadhnā ca caturguṇena, siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ hitaṃ bhavedityarthaḥ||181||
sarvathā dīpanaṃ sarvaṃ grahaṇīrogiṇāṃ hitam ||182||
idānīṃ grahaṇīroge'śeṣasaṅgrahārthamāha- sarvathetyādi| sarvathā sarvaprakāreṇa| dīpanam agnidīpanam; yat agnidīpanaṃ tatsarvaṃ grahaṇīrogiṇāṃ sarvathā hitamiti sambandhaḥ||182||
jvarādīnavirodhācca sādhayet svaiścikitsitaiḥ ||183||

ato'nantaraṃ grahaṇīrogopadravāṇāṃ jvarārocakādīnāṃ pratikāramāha- jvarādīnityādi| jvarādīnityādiśabdādarocakaśūlakarapādaśophādīnāṃ grahaṇam| avirodhācceti ‘mūlavyādheḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| yadyapi nibandhakārairayamadhyāyo vyastapāṭhena paṭhitastathā'pi mayā madguruṇā yena krameṇopadiṣṭastathā'yaṃ paṭhito vyākhyātaśca||183||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre'tisārapratiṣedho nāma (dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||40||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargatakāyacikitsāyāmatisārapratiṣedhādhyāyaścatvāriṃśattamaḥ||40||

div.head: śoṣapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ śoṣapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

atīsārapratiṣedhānantaraṃ śoṣe'pyatīsārasambhūterathavā jvarātīsārābhyāṃ śoṣasyotpatteḥ śoṣapratiṣedhārambho yukta ityata āha- athāta ityādi| athetyādikaṃ pūrvavadvyākhyeyam| śoṣapratiṣedhaṃ śoṣacikitsitam||1-2||
anekarogānugato bahurogapurogamaḥ | durvijñeyo durnivāraḥ śoṣo vyādhirmahābalaḥ ||3||

nanu, śoṣacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti pratijñāṃ kṛtvā nidānābhidhāne ko hetuḥ? ucyate- ajñātarogasya vaidyasya cikitsāyāṃ pragalbhyaṃ na syādato nidānārambha iti; tathā coktaṃ- “rogamādau parīkṣeta tato'nantaramauṣadham”- iti| prāgeva vikārasvabhāvābhidhānāya vākyamāha- anekarogānugata ityādi| anekarogā upadravasañjñakāḥ, tairanugata āśritaḥ| bahavo rogāḥ śvāsakāsāṅgasādakaphasaṃsravādayaḥ, purogamāḥ pūrvarūpatvenopasthitā yasya sa tathā| durvijñeya iti tridoṣaliṅgatvādaṃśāṃśabalavikalpanābhiḥ prakupitadoṣāṇāṃ liṅgadarśanāt| durnivāra iti doṣāṇāṃ parasparaviruddhopakramatvāt; durnivāratvācca kṛcchro'yaṃ mahābalaḥ||3||
saṃśoṣaṇādrasādīnāṃ śoṣa ityabhidhīyate | kriyākṣayakaratvācca kṣaya ityucyate punaḥ ||4||
rājñaścandramaso yasmādabhūdeṣa kilāmayaḥ | tasmāttaṃ rājayakṣmeti kecidāhuḥ `kecidāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ' iti pā. punarjanāḥ ||5||

idānīmasya vyādheryathā śoṣakṣayarājayakṣmeti nāmāni tathā''ha- saṃśoṣaṇādrasādīnāmityādi| kriyā cikitsā, kāyavāṅmānasaṃ vā karma, tasya kṣayakaratvāt| rājña iti ‘dvijānāṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ| candramasaḥ candrasya, āmayo yakṣmā rogaḥ, keciditi ātreyaprabhṛtayaḥ; yasmādeṣa āmayo dvijānāṃ rājñaścandramasaścandrasyābhūttasmāt taṃ rogaṃ kecit punarjanā rājayakṣmeti bruvate; yato'yaṃ yakṣmā rogo rogāṇāṃ rājā ato rājayakṣmeti vāgbhaṭo vyākhyānayati| kileti vārtāyām| evaṃ khalu yathā `yathā' iti mudritapustake na paṭhyate śrūyate- pūrvaṃ dakṣanāmā prajāpatirabhūt, tasya bahvayo duhitaro babhūvuḥ, tena ca saptādhikā viṃśatiḥ kanyakāścandrāya vivoḍhe `vivoḍhuṃ' iti pā. dattāḥ, sa candramāstāsu madhye rohiṇyāmevānurakto babhūva, tataśca saśokābhiraśvinyādibhirduhitṛbhirātmapitari dakṣasañjñake candrasya rohiṇyāmāsaktivṛttānto `candravṛttāntaḥ' iti pā. niveditaḥ, tato duhitṝṇāṃ vārtāmākarṇya, candramāhūya, sarvāsvapi nijaputrīṣu samatayā vartanāya candro'bhihitaḥ, sa ca tatheti `tathetyupakramyāpi' iti pā. svīkṛtyāpi svagurorvacanamanādṛtya na tāsu samavartata, tato dakṣaprajāpateḥ krodho niśvāsarūpeṇa mūrtimān bhūtvā niḥsṛtya yakṣmarūpeṇa rohiṇyāmatiprasaṅgenāvilaṃ candramāviśat, tato'sau tena rogeṇābhibhūtaḥ san gataprabho gatotsāhaśca sañjātaḥ, guruvacanātikrameṇa doṣaṃ matvā tameva dakṣanāmānaṃ guruṃ śaraṇaṃ gatavān, tato'nantaraṃ devavaidyābhyāmaśvibhyāṃ sa cikitsitaḥ, tataḥ prāptabalaścandro (rarājātīva suprabhaḥ) laghvaguruprasādo'śvibhyāṃ cikitsito'bhūt `api yāpyo'bhūt' iti pā.| evaṃ ca sati karmadoṣajo vyādhiriti darśitam||4-5||

div.ab: sa vyastairjāyate doṣairiti kecidvadanti hi |6|
ekīyamatenāsya vyādheḥ pṛthagdoṣajatvamāha- sa vyastairityādi| sa vyādhiḥ| vyastaiḥ pṛthagbhūtaiḥ|6|-

ab.seg: ekādaśānāmekasmin sānnidhyāttantrayuktitaḥ ||6||
kriyāṇāmavibhāgena prāgekotpādanena ca | eka eva mataḥ śoṣaḥ sannipātātmako hyataḥ ||7||

paramatanirākaraṇāya svamatamāha- ekādaśānāmityādi| ekādaśānāmiti svarabhedaśūlādīnām| ekasminniti rājayakṣmaroge; anye tu rājayakṣmātura iti vyākhyānayanti, sānnidhyāditi vidyamānatvāt| tantrayuktitaḥ arthayuktitaḥ `tantrayuktita ityarthāpatteḥ' iti pā.; anye tantretyatra tatreti paṭhanti; tatra tasmin, yuktito yuktivaśāditi vyākhyānayanti| kā sā yuktiḥ? yadvaśenaika eva śoṣa ityāha- kriyāṇāmavibhāgeneti|- cikitsānāmapṛthaktvena darśitatvādityarthaḥ| ekatve tṛtīyaṃ hetumāha- prāgekotpādanena ceti|- yasmāt pūrvaṃ dakṣeṇa kruddhenaikasyotpādanaṃ kṛtam| hiḥ yasmādarthe; yasmāt śoṣasyaikatve hetutritayamatroktam, ata eka eva śoṣaḥ sannipātātmako mata iti sambandhaḥ||6-7||

div.ab: udrekāttatra liṅgāni doṣāṇāṃ nipatanti hi |8|

nanu, yadi sannipātātmaka eka evāyaṃ tat kathamatra ekaikadoṣapṛthagliṅgajñānamityāha `anekadoṣapṛthagliṅgajñānaṃ' iti pā. - udrekādityādi| udrekāt ādhikyāt| tatra śoṣe| hiśabdo hetau, sa ca heturbahuprakāro'pi caturvidhatvaṃ na tyajati|8|-
kṣayādvegapratīghātādāghātādviṣamāśanāt ||8|| jāyate kupitairdoṣairvyāptadehasya dehinaḥ |9|

tameva caturvidhaṃ hetumāha- kṣayādvegapratīghātādityādi| kṣayāt rasādiśukrāntānāṃ dhātūnāṃ kṣayāt| vegapratīghātāt vātamūtrapurīṣādīnāṃ pravṛttyunmukhānāmavarodhāt| āghātāt patanāditaḥ, ayathābalamārambhāditi boddhavyam| viṣamāśanāditi aprāptātītakālabahvalpabhojanāt| kṣayādityādihetubhiḥ kupitairdoṣairvyāptadehasya śoṣo jāyate iti sambandhaḥ| anye tvevaṃ paṭhanti- ‘vegāghātāt pūraṇādvā saṅghātāt saṅkṣayādapi’ iti; vyākhyānayanti ca- pūraṇaṃ viṣamāśanamabhipretaṃ, saṅghāto'tra sāhasaḥ, śeṣaṃ pūrvavadvyākhyeyam||8||-

ab.seg: kaphapradhānairdoṣairhi ruddheṣu rasavartmasu ||9||
kaphapradhānairityādi| kaphapradhānaiḥ utkaṭakaphaiḥ| hiśabdo hetau| rasavartmasvityatrādiśabdo lupto jñeyaḥ; vartma mārgaḥ, tena rasādivāhinīṣu dhamanīṣvityarthaḥ||9||
ativyavāyino vā'pi kṣīṇe retasyanantaram | kṣīyante dhātavaḥ sarve tataḥ śuṣyati mānavaḥ ||10||

aparaprakāreṇa dhātukṣayādrājayakṣmasambhavaṃ darśayannāha- atītyādi| ativyavāyinaḥ atyarthaṃ grāmyadharmasevinaḥ| kṣīṇe retasi śukre, śukrakṣayaśca meḍhravṛṣaṇavedanetyādinā jñeyaḥ| anantaraṃ retasaḥ kṣayādityarthaḥ| kṣīyante dhātavaḥ sarve iti paraṃ yadi strībhyo na nivartate| nanu, rasavartmarodhādrasena raktasyābṛṃhaṇāttadapacayaḥ raktāpacayācca māṃsasyāpacaya ityādipūrvapūrvadhātukṣīṇatayā kṛtvā śukrasya yuktaḥ kṣayaḥ, śukrakṣaye tu pūrvadhātūnāṃ kathaṃ kṣayaḥ? ucyate- yathā mahājalādhāraparikṣaye tatra praviśatāṃ jalaprāyāṇāṃ (jantūnāṃ) kṣayastadvadatrāpīti| svamārgāvarodhādraso'sañcaran kiṃ karoti? hṛdaye vidahyate, kāsavegena mukhamārgāt picchilabahalavisraharitapītaśvetaḥ pravartate||10||
bhaktadveṣo jvaraḥ śvāsaḥ kāsaḥ śoṇitadarśanam | svarabhedaśca jāyeta ṣaḍrūpe rājayakṣmaṇi ||11||
idānīṃ madhyabaladoṣārabdhasya śoṣasya ṣaḍrūpāṇi darśayannāha- bhaktadveṣo jvara ityādi| svarabhedaḥ ghargharādisvaraḥ||11||
svarabhedo'nilāñchūlaṃ saṃlocaścāṃsapārśvayoḥ | jvaro dāho'tisāraśca pittādraktasya cāgamaḥ ||12||
śirasaḥ paripūrṇatvamabhaktacchanda eva ca | kāsaḥ kaṇṭhasya coddhvaṃso vijñeyaḥ kaphakopataḥ ||13||

ṣaḍrūpāṇi nirdiśya doṣabhedenaikādaśarūpāṇi balavatsamadoṣārabdhasya śoṣasya darśayannāha- svarabheda ityādi| saṃloco luñcanamiva, aṃsayoḥ pārśvayoḥ; ‘saṃloca’ ityatrānye ‘saṅkoca’ iti paṭhanti, tatra saṅkocanamivetyarthaḥ| śirasaḥ paripūrṇatvaṃ ‘kaphena’ iti śeṣaḥ| abhaktacchando bhaktāruciḥ| kaṇṭhasya coddhvaṃsaḥ kaṇṭhabhaṅgaḥ; anye uddhvaṃsa utkāsiketi vyākhyānayanti| svarabhedādiliṅgatrayaṃ rājayakṣmaṇi vātena, jvarādīni catvāri pittena, śirasaḥ paripūrṇatvādīni catvāri kaphena; evaṃ ṣaḍrūpāṇyapi vātādibhedena jñeyāni||12-13||
ekādaśabhirebhirvā ṣaḍbhirvā'pi samanvitam | (kāsātīsārapārśvārtisvarabhedārucijvaraiḥ ||14||
tribhirvā pīḍitaṃ liṅgairjvarakāsāsṛgāmayaiḥ) | jahyācchoṣārditaṃ jantumicchan suvipulaṃ yaśaḥ ||15||

idānīṃ `bahurūpo rājayakṣmā asādhyastamāha' iti pā. rūpaprastāvādbahurūpānvitasyāsādhyatvamāha- ekādaśabhirityādi| etairebhiḥ svarabhedo'nilācchūlamityādikaiḥ, ṣaḍbhirvā'pīti bhaktadveṣo jvara ityādibhiḥ, apiśabdāttribhirvā śvāsakāsāsṛgāmayaistantrāntaroktaiḥ, samanvitamiti samuccīyate| jahyāditi tyajet, paraṃ vahnau mande balamāṃsakṣaye satīti boddhavyam| nanu, sarvarūpādardhatrirūpau laghutarau, tatkathaṃ tāvapyasādhyau? ucyate- balavahnayapacaye kālaprakarṣāttayorapi mahattvāt; etena sarvarūpopapanna evāsādhyaḥ, itarau tu kālaprakarṣeṇeti| ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ pustakāntareṣvanyathā paṭhyate, sa ca nibandhakārairna paṭhitaḥ||14-15||
vyavāyaśokasthāviryavyāyāmādhvopavāsataḥ | vraṇoraḥkṣatapīḍābhyāṃ śoṣananye vadanti hi ||16||

ekīyamatena śoṣabhedānnirdiśannāha- vyavāyaśoketyādi| vyavāyaḥ strīsevā, śokaḥ putrādiviyogena cittodvegaḥ, sthāviryaṃ vṛddhatvaṃ; anye vārdhakyamiti paṭhanti, tatrāpyeko'rthaḥ; vyāyāmaḥ śarīrāyāsajanakaṃ karma; adhvā dīrghamārgāṭanaṃ; vyavāyādyupavāsāntairhetubhistathā vraṇapīḍayā uraḥkṣatapīḍayā cānye śoṣān vadantīti sambandhaḥ||16||
vyavāyaśoṣī śukrasya kṣayaliṅgairupadrutaḥ | pāṇḍudeho yathāpūrvaṃ kṣīyante cāsya dhātavaḥ ||17||

vyavāyaśoṣiṇo lakṣaṇānyāha- vyavāyetyādi| śukrasya kṣayaliṅgairiti ‘śukrakṣaye meḍhravṛṣaṇavedanā’ ityādibhiḥ| yathāpūrvamiti yathāpūrvaṃ tatra śukrasya pūrvaṃ majjā, majjño'sthi, asthno medaḥ, medaso māṃsaṃ, māṃsasya raktamityevaṃ kṣīyante dhātavaḥ prāgvadeva darśitanyāyāt, paraṃ yadi strībhyo na nivartate||17||
pradhyānaśīlaḥ srastāṅgaḥ śokaśoṣyapi tādṛśaḥ | vinā śukrakṣayakṛtairvikārairabhilakṣitaḥ ||18||
śokaśoṣiṇamāha- pradhyānaśīla ityādi| pradhyānaśīlaḥ cintāparaḥ, srastāṅgaḥ avasannagātraḥ| tādṛśa iti vyavāyaśoṣitavadabhilakṣitaḥ, paraṃ śukrakṣayakṛtairliṅgairvinā; etena pāṇḍudeha ityarthaḥ||18||
jarāśoṣī kṛśo mandavīryabuddhibalendriyaḥ | kampano'rucimān `śvasano' iti pā. bhinnakāṃsyapātrahatasvaraḥ(naḥ) ||19||
ṣṭhīvati śleṣmaṇā hīnaṃ gauravārucipīḍitaḥ `tathaivārucipīḍitaḥ' iti `tathaivāratipīḍitaḥ' iti ca pā.| samprasrutāsyanāsākṣaḥ suptarūkṣamalacchaviḥ ||20||

jarāśoṣiṇamāha- jarāśoṣī kṛśo mandetyādi| mandaśabdo vīryādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate, vīryaṃ śaktiḥ, balam ojo hṛdi sthitaṃ saptadhātudhāmabhūtam| punararucikathanamatyantārocakakhyāpanārtham `punararucikaraṇaṃ' iti pā.| samprasrutetyādi samprasrutaśabda āsyādibhistribhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| āsyaṃ mukhakuharam, akṣi locanam| suptarūkṣatvaṃ prabhāyāḥ, rūkṣatvaṃ ca malasya; yadyapi satparūkṣatvaṃ tvaci bhavati na prabhāyāṃ, tathā'pi ‘mañcāḥ krośanti’ itivadupacārāt prabhāyāṃ boddhavyam| jejjaṭācāryastu jarāśoṣiṇo lakṣaṇamatra na paṭhati, saptatestūrdhvaṃ kṣīyamāṇetyādinā āturopakramaṇīye uktatvāt||19-20||
adhvapraśoṣī srastāṅgaḥ sambhṛṣṭaparuṣacchaviḥ | prasuptagātrāvayavaḥ śuṣkaklomagalānanaḥ ||21||

adhvaśoṣiṇamāha- adhvapraśoṣītyādi| srastāṅgaḥ śithilagātrāvayavaḥ| prasuptamātrāvayava ityanena akarmaṇyaśarīrapradeśa uktaḥ| śuṣkaśabdaḥ klomādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate; kloma tilakam, ānanaṃ mukhakuharam| sambhṛṣṭaparuṣacchaviriti dagdhasyeva paruṣā chaviryasyetyarthaḥ; kecit ‘sambhṛṣṭaparuṣacchaviḥ’ ityatra ‘saṃsṛṣṭaparuṣacchaviḥ’ iti paṭhitvā saṃsṛṣṭā paruṣā chaviḥ yasya sa iti vyākhyānayanti| yadyapi jarāśoṣyanantaraṃ vyāyāmaśoṣī vācyo nādhvaśoṣī, tathā'pyadhvaśoṣilakṣaṇānāṃ vyāyāmaśoṣiṇyatideśāt pūrvamatrādhvaśoṣi nirdiṣṭaḥ| yadyevaṃ tarhi vyāyāmaśoṣilakṣaṇānyeva kuto'dhvaśoṣiṇi nātidiśyante? satyam, uraḥkṣataliṅgānāmadhikānāṃ vyāyāmaśoṣiṇi sadbhāvāt| kecidatra ‘tṛḍaṅgamardadaurbalyapāruṣyairardito'dhvanā’ iti pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti, tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ||21||
vyāyāmaśoṣī bhūyiṣṭhamebhireva samanvitaḥ | uraḥkṣatakṛtairliṅgaiḥ saṃyuktaśca kṣatādvinā ||22||

vyāyāmaśoṣiṇamāha- vyāyāmaśoṣī bhūyiṣṭhamityādi| ebhireveti anantaroktaiḥ adhvaśoṣilakṣaṇairityarthaḥ| upavāsaśoṣilakṣaṇaṃ doṣadhātumalakṣayavṛddhivijñānīyoktaṃ ‘tatra vātalāhārasevina’ ityādikaṃ jñātavyam||22||
raktakṣayādvedanābhistathaivāhārayantraṇāt | vraṇitasya `vraṇitasya bhavecchoṣo doṣaiḥ sādhyatamaḥ sa ca' iti hastalikhitapustake pāṭha upalabhyate bhavecchoṣaḥ sa cāsādhyatamaḥ smṛtaḥ ||23||

vraṇaśoṣilakṣaṇamāha- raktakṣayādityādi| vraṇaśoṣiṇo vaiśeṣikalakṣaṇānupadeśāt sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ jñeyam| yadyevaṃ kuto'sya pṛthagabhidhānamiti cet, viśiṣṭakāraṇatayā asādhyatamatvakhyāteḥ `sādhyatamatvakhyāteḥ' iti pā.||23||

div.ab: vyāyāmabhārādhyayanairabhighātātimaithunaiḥ | karmaṇā cāpyurasyena `karmabhiścāpyanaurasyairvakṣo' iti pā. vakṣo yasya vidāritam | tasyorasi kṣate raktaṃ pūyaḥ śleṣmā ca gacchati ||24|| kāsamānaśchardayecca pītaraktāsitāruṇam | santaptavakṣāḥ so'tyarthaṃ dūyanātparitāmyati ||25|| durgandhavadanocchvāso bhinnavarṇasvaro naraḥ |26|

uraḥkṣataśoṣiṇamāha- vyāyāmetyādi| karmaṇā cāpyurasyeneti dhanurākarṣaṇādinetyarthaḥ| kṣate atidārite| asitam īṣatkṛṣṇam, aruṇam īṣadraktam| dūyanāt ativedanāt, paritāmyati mohaṃ yāti| durgandhaśabdo vadanocchvāsābhyāṃ sambadhyate||24-25||-
keṣāñcidevaṃ śoṣo hi kāraṇairbhedamāgataḥ ||26|| na tatra doṣaliṅgānāṃ samastānāṃ nipātanam |27|

ekīyamatamāha- keṣāñcidityādi| keṣāñcidācāryāṇāṃ mate evaṃ vyavāyādibhiranekaiḥ kāraṇaiḥ kṛtvā hi yasmāt śoṣo bhedamāgataḥ; ata eka eva svamate śoṣo netare vyavāyādijāḥ| kuto vyavāyādijāḥ śoṣā na bhavantītyāha- na tatretyādi| tatra teṣu vyavāyādijeṣu||26||-

ab.seg: kṣayā eva hi te jñeyāḥ pratyekaṃ dhātusañjñitāḥ ||27||

yadi te vyavāyādijāḥ śoṣāḥ na bhavanti tarhi kinnāmadheyā bhavantītyāha- kṣayā evetyādi| te vyavāyādijāḥ kṣayā eva, kiṃviśiṣṭāḥ? pratyekaṃ dhātusañjñitāḥ dhātukṣayasañjñakā ityarthaḥ| yataḥ śukramārabhya vilomena vyavāyādibhirdhātūnāṃ yathāpūrvaṃ saṅkṣayāt||27||
cikitsitaṃ tu teṣāṃ hi prāguktaṃ dhātusaṅkṣaye ||28||
teṣāṃ kiñciccikitsitamāha- cikitsitaṃ tu teṣāmityādi| dhātusaṅkṣaye doṣadhātumalakṣayavṛddhivijñānīyādhyāye||28||
śvāsāṅgasādakaphasaṃsravatāluśoṣacchardyagnisādamadapīnasapāṇḍunidrāḥ | śoṣe bhaviṣyati bhavanti sa cāpi jantuḥ śuklekṣaṇo bhavati māṃsaparo riraṃsuḥ ||29||
svapneṣu kākaśukaśallakinīlakaṇṭhagṛdhrāstathaiva kapayaḥ kṛkalāsakāśca | taṃ vāhayanti sa nadīrvijalāśca paśyecchuṣkāṃstarūn pavanadhūmadavārditāṃśca ||30||

idānīmekīyamataṃ pradarśya samprāptyanantaraṃ rājayakṣmaṇaḥ pūrvarūpāṇyāha- śvāsāṅgasādakaphasaṃsravetyādi| aṅgasādaḥ aṅgānāmanutsāhaḥ, agnisādaḥ agnimāndyam| madaḥ pūgaphaleneva mattatā| māṃsaparo māṃsābhilāṣī| riraṃsuḥ rantumicchuḥ| śallakī godhānukārī vajraśakalaḥ, ‘śallaka’ iti loke prasiddhaḥ, nīlakaṇṭho mayūraḥ, gṛdhraḥ āmiṣāśī yojanadṛṣṭiḥ| kapayo vānarāḥ| kṛkalāsaḥ kṛkaṇṭakaḥ ‘giragiṭa’ iti pūrvadeśīyā bhāṣante| taṃ śoṣiṇaṃ, vāhayanti prāpayanti sa śoṣī| nanu, samprāptyanantaraṃ pūrvarūpeṣu vaktavyeṣu kathaṃ rūpāṇyabhidhāya pūrvarūpopādānaṃ kṛtam? ucyate- rūpāṇyavyaktāni pūrvarūpāṇyasyeti pratipādanārtham||29-30||
mahāśanaṃ kṣīyamāṇamatīsāranipīḍitam | śūnamuṣkodaraṃ caiva yakṣmiṇaṃ parivarjayet ||31||
varjyamāha- mahāśanamityādi| muṣko vṛṣaṇam| ‘yakṣmiṇam’ ityatrānye ‘śoṣiṇam’ iti paṭhanti||31||

div.ab: upācaredātmavantaṃ dīptāgnimakṛśaṃ navam `naraṃ' iti pā.|32|
upakramyamāha- upācaredātmavantamityādi| ātmavantaṃ jitendriyam|32|-

ab.seg: sthirādivargasiddhena ghṛtenājāvikena ca ||32||
snigdhasya mṛdu kartavyamūrdhvaṃ cādhaśca śodhanam | āsthāpanaṃ tathā kāryaṃ śirasaśca virecanam ||33||
tadeva cikitsitamāha- sthirādivargasiddhenetyādi| sthirādiḥ vidārigandhādiḥ| mṛdu yat karśanaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ| āsthāpanaṃ nirūhaḥ| tatheti mṛdvityarthaḥ| śiraso virecanaṃ nasyam||32-33||

div.ab: yavagodhūmaśālīṃśca rasairbhuñjīta śodhitaḥ |34|
śodhitasya paścātkarma āha- yavagodhūmetyādi| rasaiḥ jāṅgalamāṃsarasaiḥ|34|-

ab.seg: dṛḍhe'gnau bṛṃhayeccāpi nivṛttopadravaṃ naram ||34||
bṛṃhaṇaviṣayamāha- dṛḍhe'gnāvityādi| nivṛttopadravamiti praśāntasvarabhedādikamityarthaḥ||34||
vyavāyaśoṣiṇaṃ prāyo bhajante vātajā gadāḥ | bṛṃhaṇīyo vidhistasmai hitaḥ snigdho'nilāpahaḥ ||35||
idānīṃ vyavāyaśoṣiṇo viśiṣṭaṃ cikitsitamāha- vyavāyetyādi| ‘vyavāyaśoṣiṇam’ ityādivākyaṃ kecinnecchanti, ‘kriyāṇāṃ cāvibhāgena’ ityuktasya vyāghātāt||35||
kākānulūkānnakulān biḍālān gaṇḍūpadān vyālabileśayākhūn | gṛdhrāṃśca dadyādvividhaiḥ pravādaiḥ `prakāraiḥ' iti pā. sasaindhavān sarṣapatailabhṛṣṭān ||36||
deyāni māṃsāni ca jāṅgalāni mudgāḍhakīsūparasāśca `mudgāḍhakīyūṣarasāśca' iti pā. hṛdyāḥ | kharoṣṭranāgāśvatarāśvajāni deyāni māṃsāni sukalpitāni ||37||
māṃsopadaṃśāṃśca pibedariṣṭān mārdvīkayuktān madirāśca sevyāḥ | arkāmṛtākṣārajaloṣitebhyaḥ kṛtvā yavebhyo vividhāṃśca bhakṣyān ||38||
khādet, pibet sarpirajāvikaṃ vā kṛśo yavāgvā saha bhaktakāle | sarpirmadhubhyāṃ trikaṭu pralihyāccavyāviḍaṅgopahitaṃ kṣayārtaḥ ||39||

śoṣiṇāṃ yāni māṃsānyādeyāni tānyāha- kākānulūkānnakulānityādi| biḍālā grāmyādibhedena ṣaṭprakārā mārjārāḥ; tathā ca- “grāmyo vanyastoyajātaḥ pakṣimārjāravijjakau| sugandhavṛṣaṇaśceti mārjārāḥ ṣaṭ prakīrtitāḥ”- iti| vyālā vyāghrādayaḥ, bileśayāḥ śvāvicchallakīprabhṛtayaḥ ākhuratra vṛkṣamūṣikaḥ| vividhaiḥ pravādairiti “kākāṃstittiriśabdena matsyaśabdena coragān| bhṛṣṭamatsyāntraśabdena dadyādgaṇḍūpadānapi” ityādibhirnānāprakārairvacanaiḥ| evaṃ prakāreṇa dāne `evamprakāradānaiḥ' iti pā. kiṃ prayojanamiti cet? ajugupsayā bhakṣaṇaṃ bhakṣitasya cānullekhanam| tathā coktaṃ- “jānan jugupsurnaivādyādbhuktaṃ vā punarullikhet| tasmācchadmopasiddhāni māṃsānyetāni dāpayet”- iti| jāṅgalāni jaṅghālaviṣkirapratudajāni, śeṣajāṅgalavargāṇāmatra viśeṣeṇābhidhānat| yadyapi jāṅgalaśabdenaiva gṛdhrādayo'pi labdhāḥ, tathā'pyatyantabṛṃhaṇatvādgṛdhrādīnāṃ pṛthagupādānam| mudgāḍhakīsūparasāḥ srotaḥśuddhikatvāddeyāḥ| nāgo hastī, aśvataro veśaraḥ| sukalpitāni veśavārīkṛtāni nānāprakāraprakalpitāni `nānyaprakārakalpitāni' iti| tathā ca vṛddhabhojaḥ- “kharoṣṭrāśvataraṃ nāgaṃ māṃsaṃ māṃsābhivṛddhaye| dadyānmāhiṣaśabdena vesavārīkṛtaṃ bhiṣak”- iti| māṃsopadaṃśānariṣṭān abhayāriṣṭaprabhṛtīn, mārdvīkayuktān drākṣāsavayuktān, madirā madyam| bhakṣyānnirdeṣṭumāha- arkāmṛtakṣārajaloṣitebhya ityādi| arkaguḍūcīkṣārapānīyoṣitebhyo yavebhyo bhakṣyān kṛtvā khādediti sambandhaḥ| uṣitebhyo rātrau sthitebhyaḥ| arkādibhasma caturguṇena jalena gālayitvā pacedyāvadardhāvaśiṣṭaṃ bhavati| tathā coktaṃ- “pānāya bhojanāyātha bhasma srāvyaṃ caturguṇe| jale'rdhamavaśiṣṭe(ṣṭaṃ) tu kṣārāmbho grāhyamiṣyate”- iti| pibedityādi| ajāvikaṃ veti ājaṃ vā āvikaṃ vetyarthaḥ| ajetyatra hrasvatvaṃ chando'nurodhāt| bhaktakāle bhojanakāle| sarpirmadhubhyāmityādi| upahitaṃ saṃyuktam||36-39||

div.ab: māṃsādamāṃseṣu ghṛtaṃ ca siddhaṃ śoṣāpahaṃ kṣaudrakaṇāsametam |40|
māṃsādamāṃseṣvityādi| māṃsādā gṛdhrādayaḥ, tanmāṃsarase caturguṇe siddhaṃ sarpiḥ kṣaudrapippalīyuktaṃ śoṣāpahaṃ bhavati| kṣaudrakaṇetyatra dantikaṇeti kecit paṭhanti|40|-
drākṣāsitāmāgadhikāvalehaḥ sakṣaudratailaḥ kṣayarogaghātī ||40|| ghṛtena cājena samākṣikeṇa turaṅgagandhātilamāṣacūrṇam |41|
drākṣetyādi| avaleho'yam|41|-

ab.seg: sitāśvagandhāmagadhodbhavānāṃ cūrṇaṃ `kalkaṃ' iti pā. ghṛtakṣaudrayutaṃ pralihyāt ||41||
sitāśvagandhetyādi| sitā śarkarā, magadhodbhavā pippalī||41||

div.ab: kṣīraṃ pibedvā'pyatha vājigandhāvipakvamevaṃ labhate'ṅgapuṣṭim |42|
kṣīramityādi| vājigandhāvipakvaṃ sāmānyakṣīrapākaparibhāṣayā| vājigandhā aśvagandhā|42|-

ab.seg: tadutthitaṃ kṣīraghṛtaṃ sitāḍhyaṃ prātaḥ pibedvā'pi payonupānam ||42||
tadutthitaṃ kṣīraghṛtamityādi| tadutthitam aśvagandhāvipakvakṣīrotthaṃ, kṣīraghṛtaṃ kṣīradviloḍitādudbhūtaṃ ghṛtam||42||

div.ab: utsādane cāpi turaṅgagandhā yojyā yavāścaiva punarnave ca |43|

udvartanamupacaryārthamāha- utsādane ityādi| utsādanam udvartanam| turaṅgagandhā aśvagandhā| punarnave śvetarakte dve| nanu, śoṣe bṛṃhaṇamupayujyate, etāśca vilekhanāḥ, tataḥ kathaṃ tadupayogaḥ? satyaṃ, bāhyopayogena teṣāṃ bṛṃhaṇatvenopayogāt|43|-
kṛtsne vṛṣe tatkusumaiśca siddhaṃ sarpiḥ pibetkṣaudrayutaṃ hitāśī ||43|| yakṣmāṇametat prabalaṃ ca kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ ca hanyādapi pāṇḍutāṃ ca |44|

kṛtsne ityādi| kṛtsne vṛṣe iti samūlapatraśākhāṅkure| vāsakāṅgebhyaḥ kvāthe, tatkusumaiḥ vāsakapuṣpaiḥ, ‘kalkīkṛtaiḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| siddhaṃ sarpiriti caturguṇakvāthena puṣpakalkenāṣṭamabhāgena ca| tathā coktaṃ,- “śaṇasya kovidārasya vṛṣasya ca pṛthak pṛthak| kalkāḍhyatvānna śaṃsanti puṣpakalpaṃ catuṣpalam”- iti||43||-

śakṛdrasā gośvagajāvyajānāṃ kvāthā mitāścāpi tathaiva bhāgaiḥ ||44|| mūrvāharidrākhadiradrumāṇāṃ kṣīrasya bhāgastvaparo ghṛtasya | bhāgān daśaitān vipacedvidhijño dattvā trivargaṃ madhuraṃ ca kṛtsnam ||45|| kaṭutrikaṃ caiva sabhadradāru ghṛtottamaṃ yakṣmanivāraṇāya |46|

śakṛdrasā ityādi| gośvagajāvicchagalīnāṃ pratyekaṃ śakṛdrasāḥ, tathaiva mūrvāharidrākhadiradrumāṇāṃ kvāthabhāgairmitāḥ svalpā bhāgāḥ, tathā kṣīrasyāparo navamo bhāgaḥ, ghṛtasya daśama iti , etān daśabhāgān trivargādikena kalkena vipacediti sambandhaḥ| mūrvā corasnāyuḥ| khadiradrumāṇāmiti drumagrahaṇaṃ madhyamavayasaḥ khadirasya grahaṇārtham| trivargaḥ triphalā| madhuraṃ ca kṛtsnaṃ kākolyādikam; apare'ṣṭavargamāhuḥ||44-45||-

ab.seg: dve pañcamūlyau varuṇaṃ karañjaṃ bhallātakaṃ bilvapunarnave ca ||46||
yavān kulatthān badarāṇi bhārgīṃ pāṭhāṃ hutāśaṃ samahīkadambam | kṛtvā kaṣāyaṃ vipaceddhi tasya ṣaḍbhirhi pātrairghṛtapātramekam ||47||
vyoṣaṃ mahāvṛkṣapayo'bhayāṃ ca cavyaṃ surākhyaṃ lavaṇottamaṃ ca | etaddhi śoṣaṃ jaṭharāṇi caiva hanyāt pramehāṃśca sahānilena ||48||

dve pañcamūlyāvityādi| dve pañcamūlyau daśamūlamityarthaḥ| bilvasya pṛthakpāṭhādatra phalaṃ grāhyam| hutāśaḥ citrakaḥ, mahīkadambo muṇḍitikā| kṛtvā kaṣāyamiti daśamūlādīnāmaṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikāni saptaśatapalāni caturguṇenāmbhasā niṣkvāthya caturbhāgāvaśiṣṭaḥ kvātho grāhyaḥ| tasya kvāthasya, pātraiḥ āḍhakaiḥ| kalkadravyāṇyāha- vyoṣamityādi| vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukaṃ, mahāvṛkṣapayaḥ sehuṇḍakṣīraṃ, surākhyaṃ devadāru, lavaṇottamaṃ saindhavam; kecit ‘lavaṇottamam’ ityatra ‘magadhodbhavāṃ’ iti paṭhitvā pippalīmiti vyākhyānayanti| pramehāṃśca sahānileneti vātikānapipramehān hantītyarthaḥ; etacca stutiparaṃ `stutivacaḥ' iti pā., vātikamehānāmasādhyatvāt||46-48||
gośvāvyajebhaiṇakharoṣṭrajātaiḥ śakṛdrasakṣīrarasakṣatotthaiḥ | drākṣāśvagandhāmagadhāsitābhiḥ siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ yakṣmavikārahāri ||49||

gośvāvyajebhaiṇetyādi| gośvādīnāṃ śakṛdrasakṣīramāṃsarasarudhiraiḥ drākṣādīnāṃ kalkena siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ yakṣmavikārān hantīti sambandhaḥ| ibhā hastinī, eṇaḥ kṛṣṇasāraḥ| kṣīraṃ yathāsambhavaṃ grāhyaṃ, na tu sarveṣām||49||
elājamodāmalakābhayākṣagāyatryariṣṭāsanaśālasārān | viḍaṅgabhallātakacitrakogrākaṭutrikāmbhodasurāṣṭrajāṃśca ||50||
paktvā jale tena paceddhi sarpistasmin susiddhe tvavatārite ca | triṃśatpalānyatra sitopalāyā dattvā tugākṣīripalāni ṣaṭ ca ||51||
prasthe ghṛtasya dviguṇaṃ ca dadyāt kṣaudraṃ tato manthahataṃ vidadhyāt | palaṃ palaṃ prātarataḥ pralihya paścāt pibet kṣīramatandritaśca ||52||
etaddhi medhyaṃ paramaṃ pavitraṃ cakṣuṣyamāyuṣyamatho yaśasyam | yakṣmāṇamāśu vyapahanti caitat pāṇḍvāmayaṃ caiva bhagandaraṃ ca ||53||
śvāsaṃ ca hanti svarabhedakāsahṛtplīhagulmagrahaṇīgadāṃśca | na cātra kiñcit parivarjanīyaṃ rasāyanaṃ caitadupāsyamānam ||54||

elājamodetyādi| elādikān surāṣṭrajāntān kaṣāyakalpena vipācya, tena kvāthena sarpirvipacediti sambandhaḥ| tasmin kvāthe siddhe pūte śarkarāyāstriṃśatpalāni dadyāt, tugākṣīryāśca ṣaṭpalāni, tathā ghṛtasya prasthe dviguṇaṃ dviprasthamitaṃ kṣaudraṃ dadyāt| akṣaṃ bibhītakaṃ, gāyatrī khadiraḥ, ariṣṭo nimbaḥ, asano bījakaḥ, śālaḥ prasiddhaḥ, sāraśabdaḥ khadirādibhiḥ sambadhyate| ugrā vacā, ambhodo mustaṃ, surāṣṭrajā tuvaramṛttikā| tugākṣīrī vaṃśalocanam; anye vaṃśalocanānukāripārthivadravyamāhuḥ| manthahataṃ khajaviloḍitam| ato asmādrasāyanāt| atandritaḥ analasaḥ| medhyaṃ medhājanakam||50-54||

div.ab: plīhodaroktaṃ vihitaṃ ca sarpistrīṇyeva cānyāni hitāni cātra |55|

atra rasāyane'parāṇyapi ghṛtānyatideśenāha- plīhodaroktaṃ vihitamityādi| plīhodaroktaṃ ṣaṭpalakaṃ, trīṇyeva cānyāni udaroktānyeva; tadyathā- ekaṃ ‘harītakīcūrṇaprasthaṃ’ ityādikaṃ, dvitīyaṃ ‘gavye payasi mahāvṛkṣakṣīram’ ityādi, tṛtīyaṃ ‘cavyacitrakadantyativiṣā’ ityādikam| atra śoṣe| etāni srotovarodhaśāntyarthaṃ recanatvena hitāni|55|-

ab.seg: upadravāṃśca svaravaikṛtādīn jayedyathāsvaṃ prasamīkṣya śāstram ||55||
svarabhedādīnāṃ cikitsitamatideśenāha- upadravāṃśca svaravaikṛtādīnityādi| yathāsvaṃ yasya yadātmīyaṃ svarabhedādiśāstraṃ, tat prasamīkṣyetyarthaḥ||55||
ajāśakṛnmūtrapayoghṛtāsṛṅmāṃsālayāni pratisevamānaḥ | snānādinānāvidhinā jahāti māsādaśeṣaṃ niyamena śoṣam ||56||

idānīmajāyāḥ sarvaprakāreṇopayogamāha- ajāśakṛnmūtretyādi| ajāśakṛdādikaṃ yathāsambhavaṃ snānādividhinā puruṣaḥ sevamāno'śeṣaṃ śoṣaṃ māsājjahātīti sambandhaḥ| ajāśabdaḥ śakṛdādibhirālayāntaiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| ālayaṃ gṛham, ajānāmeva||56||
rasonayogaṃ vidhivat kṣayārtaḥ kṣīreṇa vā nāgabalāprayogam | seveta vā māgadhikāvidhānaṃ tathopayogaṃ jatuno'śmajasya ||57||
rasonayogamityādi| vidhivat yathāśāstram| kṣīreṇeti nāgabalāprayogamāgadhikāvidhānābhyāṃ sambadhyate| tatheti kṣīreṇetyarthaḥ| jatunaḥ aśmajasya śilājatunaḥ||57||

div.ab: śokaṃ striyaṃ krodhamasūyanaṃ ca tyaje... |58|
idānīṃ parihāryamāha- śokaṃ striyamityādi| krodhaḥ parābhidrohalakṣaṇaḥ; asūyanaṃ paraguṇeṣu doṣāropaṇam|58|-

ab.seg: ...dudārān viṣayān bhajeta | vaidyān dvijātīṃstridaśān gurūṃśca vācaśca puṇyāḥ śṛṇuyāddvijebhyaḥ ||58||

idānīṃ daivavyapāśrayāṃ cikitsāmāha- udārānityādi| udārā viṣayā dharmāviruddhā manonukūlāśca śabdādayaḥ| bhajeta seveta| dvijātīn viprān, tridaśān devān, gurūn pitṛmātṛprabhṛtīn| puṇyā vāco vedoktā rudrastutiprabhṛtayaḥ||58||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre (tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ, ādita) ekacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||41||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre śoṣapratiṣedhanāmaikacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||41||

div.head: gulmapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto gulmapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
śoṣapratiṣedhānantaraṃ riṣṭoktakramānukrameṇa gulmapratiṣedhārambho yujyata ityāha- athāto gulmapratiṣedhamityādi||1-2||
yathoktaiḥ kopanairdoṣāḥ kupitāḥ koṣṭhamāgatāḥ | janayanti nṛṇāṃ gulmaṃ sa pañcavidha ucyate ||3||

tatra nidānānantarayīkatvāt pratiṣedhasyādau gulmānāṃ hetusamprāptisaṅkhyā āha- yathoktairityādi| yathoktaiḥ kopanaiḥ vraṇapraśnoktairbalavadvigrahādikrodhādidivāsvapnādibhiḥ| āmapakvāgniraktamūtrāśayahṛdayoṇḍukaphupphusāśca koṣṭhaśabdavācyāḥ, tathā coktam- ‘sthānānyāmāgnipakvānāṃ mūtrasya rudhirasya ca| hṛduṇḍukaḥ phupphusaśca koṣṭha ityabhidhīyate’ iti| gulmaḥ pañcavidhaḥ pṛthagdoṣaiḥ trayaḥ, samastaiḥ ekaḥ, raktena aparaḥ, evaṃ pañcavidhaḥ| etacca prāyovacanaṃ, dvandvajagulmānāṃ sadbhāvāt| tathā coktam- “vyāmiśraliṅgānaparāṃstu gulmāṃstrīnādiśedbheṣajakalpanārtham”- iti, tathā vraṇapraśnoktaprasaratayā pañcadaśaprakāragulmasambhavāt| yathoktaiḥ kopanairityādirhetuḥ, doṣāḥ kupitā ityādiḥ samprāptiḥ, sa pañcavidha ityeṣā saṅkhyā||3||
hṛdbastyorantare granthiḥ sañcārī yadi vā'calaḥ | cayāpacayavān vṛttaḥ sa gulma iti kīrtitaḥ ||4||

gulmasya rūpamāha- hṛdbastyorantare granthirityādi| hṛdbastyoḥ hṛdaye ca bastau ca, vā tayorevāntare; tena sarvamudaramākṣiptam| sañcārī calanaśīlaḥ, vātādhikyāt| acala ekasthānaśāyī, vāyoralpatvāt| cayāpacayavān kadācidupacitaḥ kadācidapacita iti, vicitrakriyatvādvāyoḥ| vṛtto vartulaḥ| kecit ‘hṛnnābhyorantare’ iti paṭhanti; te ca nābhigrahaṇenaiva sāmīpyādbastiṃ gṛhṇanti| ‘cayāpacayavān’ ityatra ‘sthiropacayavān’ iti kecit paṭhanti, sthira upacayo vṛddhiryasya sa iti ca vyākhyānayanti||4||

div.ab: pañca gulmāśrayā nṝṇāṃ pārśve hṛnnābhibastayaḥ |5|
idānīṃ tatrāpyudare pañcagulmāśrayānāha- pañca gulmāśrayā ityādi| subodhametat| kārtikakuṇḍastvenaṃ pāṭhaṃ ‘sa vyastairjāyate doṣaiḥ’ ityādivākyādanantaraṃ paṭhati|5|-
gupitānilamūlatvādgūḍhamūlodayādapi `kupitānilamūlatvāt' iti pā.||5|| gulmavadvā viśālatvādgulma ityabhidhīyate |6|

atha gulmaniruktimāha- gupitānilamūlatvādityādi `kupitānilamūlatvāt' iti pā.| gupitānilamūlatvāt `kupitānilamūlatvāt' iti pā. ākulīkṛtavāyumūlatvāt, etena sarvagulmānāṃ vāyuḥ kāraṇam| gūḍhamūlodayāditi gūḍhamūlāḥ kandādayaḥ, teṣāmivodayādutpatteḥ; anye tu gūḍhamūlo guptakāraṇa udayo yasya sa tathā tasmāt, mūlasya vāyorgūḍhatvamāvṛtatvamucyate tatprakopadvaividhyāt; tathā ca- “vāyordhātukṣayāt kopo mārgasyāvaraṇena ca”- iti| gulmavat manuṣyādisaṃhativat `vanaspatyādisaṃhativat' iti pā.| viśālatvāt vistīrṇatvāt| etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati- yathā saṃhativiśeṣeṇāvasthitā manuṣyavṛkṣādayo gulmavyapadeśaṃ bhajante- manuṣyagulmo vṛkṣagulma iti, evamatrāpi dṛṣṭāntatrayaṃ gulmasya doṣatrayodbhavatvapradarśanārtham| ‘gupitānilamūlatvāt’ ityatra ‘kupitānilamūlatvāt’ iti kecit paṭhanti| tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ| ‘gūḍhamūlodayāt’ ityatrāpare ‘gūḍhagūlmodayāt’ iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- gūḍhasya latādivṛtasya `latādicchannasya' iti pā. gulmasyeva vartulaviṭapasyeva udayādutpattergulma ityarthaḥ||5||-
sa yasmādātmani cayaṃ gacchatyapsviva budbudaḥ ||6|| antaḥ sarati yasmācca na pākamupayātyataḥ |7|

idānīṃ yathā na pacyate gulmastathā''ha- sa yasmādityādi| sa gulmo yasmāt kāraṇādātmani svāvayave cayaṃ nicayaṃ gacchati yāti; apsviva budbuda udgacchati udgatiṃ yāti, tathā gulmarūpo'pi doṣaḥ svāvayave udgacchati udgatiṃ yāti; antaḥ abhyantare, sarati bhrāmyati| evambhūtaḥ prāyeṇa vātiko bhavati, sa ca na pacyate; itare ca gulmā yadā raktādidūṣyamadhiṣṭhāya avatiṣṭhante tadā kadācit pacyante| tathā coktam- “raktapittātivṛddhatvāt kriyāmanupalabhya vā| yadi gulmo vidahyeta śastraṃ tatra bhiṣagjitam”- iti| athaivamantarvidradhergulmasya ca śīghramandapākitvena bhedaḥ||6||-
sa vyastairjāyate doṣaiḥ samastairapi cocchritaiḥ ||7|| puruṣāṇāṃ tathā strīṇāṃ jñeyo raktena cāparaḥ |8|

idānīṃ ‘sa pañcavidha ucyate’ ityasyaiva vivaraṇamāha- sa vyastairjāyate doṣairityādi| sa gulmaḥ, vyastaiḥ ekaikaiḥ; ucchritaiḥ prakupitaiḥ, raktena ārtavaraktena; cakārāt dhāturaktenāpi gulmo jāyate, sa ca puṃsāṃ strīṇāṃ ca bhavati; tasya ca pṛthagupādānaṃ na kṛtaṃ, paittikagulmasamānalakṣaṇatayā tatraivāvarodhāt||7||-

ab.seg: sadanaṃ madantā vahnerāṭopo'ntravikūjanam ||8||
viṇmūtrānilasaṅgaśca sauhityāsahatā tathā | dveṣo'nne vāyurūrdhvaṃ ca pūrvarūpeṣu gulminām ||9||
gulmapūrvarūpāṇyāha- sadanamityādi| āṭopa udarāpūraḥ| saṅgo nirodhaḥ| sauhityāsahatā tṛptyakṣamatvam| vāyuḥ ūrdhvaṃ santatodgāra ityarthaḥ||8-9||
hṛtkukṣiśūlaṃ mukhakaṇṭhaśoṣo vāyornirodho viṣamāgnitā ca | te te vikārāḥ pavanātmakāśca bhavanti gulme'nilasambhave tu ||10||

vātagulmalakṣaṇamāha- hṛtkukṣiśūlamityādi| viṣamāgnitā ceti cakārānmukhavairasyaṃ grāhyam| te te vikārāḥ stambhakampādayaḥ| kecidvātagulmalakṣaṇaṃ ‘ādhmānaśūle bhavato'timātraṃ’ ityādinā pāṭhena paṭhanti; sa `so'pyabhāvānna likhitaḥ' iti pā. cābhāvānna likhitaḥ||10||
svedajvarāhāravidāhadāhāstṛṣṇā'ṅgarāgaḥ kaṭuvaktratā ca | pittasya liṅgānyakhilāni yāni pittātmake tāni bhavanti gulme ||11||

pittagulmalakṣaṇamāha- svedetyādi| āhāravidāhaḥ bhuktamātrasyāhārasyāmlikādisadbhāvaḥ| pittasya liṅgāni bhramamadamūrcchādīni| pittagulmalakṣaṇamapi kecidanyapāṭhena paṭhanti| yathā- ‘amlībhavatyannamatho jvaraśca dāhaḥ pipāsā kaṭuvaktratā ca| pittasya liṅgāni ca kīrtitāni bhavanti pittaprabhave tu gulme’ iti||11||
staimityamanne'ruciraṅgasādaśchardiḥ praseko madhurāsyatā ca | kaphasya liṅgāni ca yāni tāni bhavanti gulme kaphasambhave tu ||12||

kaphagulmalakṣaṇamāha- staimityamityādi| staimityaṃ stimitatā| anne aruciḥ annānabhilāṣaḥ| praseko lālāsrāvaḥ| kaphasya liṅgāni gauravaśaityādīni| kaphagulmamapi kecit “anne na lipsā gurugātratā ca chardiḥ praseko madhurāsyatā ca” ityādipāṭhena paṭhanti, so'pyabhāvānna darśitaḥ||12||

div.ab: sarvātmakaḥ sarvavikārayuktaḥ so'sādhya uktaḥ, ... |13|

sannipātagulmalakṣaṇamāha- sarvātmaka ityādi| sarvavikārayuktaḥ pratyekavātādigulmoktalakṣaṇasahitaḥ| ‘sarvātmake sarvarujopapattiḥ’ iti kecit paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- sarvaliṅgopapattiriti vaktavye sarvarujopapattiriti yatkṛtaṃ tanmahārujatvapratipādanārtham `tanmahārujāsūcanārtham' iti pā.| kecidatra nicayagulmaṃ purīṣalasikāraktajanyaṃ dakṣiṇapārśvāśritaṃ paṭhanti| tasya viśeṣa ucyate,- “sirājālaparicchanno dāharāgajvarānvitaḥ| kūrmavadraktaparyantastridoṣaḥ sa na sidhyati”- iti| kecicca gulmāvasthāviśeṣamupastambhanāmāntaraṃ `gulmāvasthāviśeṣaprāptyā nāmāntaraṃ' iti pā. paṭhanti- “payo hyamlasamāyuktaṃ dadhibhāvaṃ vrajedyathā| yatnahīnasya gulmo'pi tathopastambhatāṃ vrajet|| ambhovahe stambhayitvā srotasī koṣṭhasaṃśritaḥ| udare prati santiṣṭhedupastambhaṃ tu taṃ viduḥ”- iti|13|-

ab.seg: ... kṣatajaṃ pravakṣye | navaprasūtā'hitabhojanā yā yā cāmagarbhaṃ visṛjedṛtau `prasavedathartau' iti pā. vā ||13||
vāyurhi tasyāḥ parigṛhya raktaṃ karoti gulmaṃ sarujaṃ sadāham | paittasya liṅgena samānaliṅgaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ cāpyaparaṃ nibodha ||14||
na spandate nodarameti vṛddhiṃ bhavanti liṅgāni ca garbhiṇīnām | taṃ garbhakālātigame cikitsyamasṛgbhavaṃ gulmamuśanti tajjñāḥ ||15||

ārtavaraktajagulmaṃ hetvādibhirāha- kṣatajamityādi| kṣatajaśabdenārtavaraktamucyate `kṣatajaśabdenātra raktamucyate' iti pā., kāraṇe kāryopacārāt| āmagarbha; ṣaṇmāsaṃ yāvat| ṛtāvityatrāpi ahitabhojaneti sambadhyate| paittasya pittajagulmasya| viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣam| nibodha jānīhi| na spandate na calati, ‘aṅgaiḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| anye tu parato niṣedhasyobhayatra sambandhāt spandate ityeva varṇayanti; tena piṇḍitaḥ spandata evetyarthaḥ; tathā coktam- ‘yaḥ spandate piṇḍita eva nāṅgaiḥ’ (ca. ci. a.5)- iti| garbhiṇīnāṃ liṅgāni śramādīni sadanāntānyatra vyādhisvabhāvādbhavanti| taṃ raktagulmam| garbhakālātigame prasūtikāle'tikrānte; prasūtikālādanantaraṃ piṇḍībhūte raktagulme snehādinopaskṛtadehāyāḥ sukhasādhyatvam| uktaṃ ca- “jvare tulyartudoṣatvaṃ pramehe tulyadūṣyatā| raktagulme purāṇatvaṃ sukhasādhyasya lakṣaṇam `hetavaḥ' iti pā. ” iti| kecidevaṃ vyākhyānayanti- ‘māse vyatīte daśame cikitsyaḥ’ iti vaktavye ‘taṃ garbhakālātigame cikitsyam’ iti yatkṛtaṃ tadraktagulme samyagupacite `samyak jñāte' iti pā. prasūtikālādarvāgapi cikitsā karaṇīyeti bodhayati||13-15||
vātagulmārditaṃ snigdhaṃ yuktaṃ snehavirecanaiḥ | upācaredyathākālaṃ nirūhaiḥ sānuvāsanaiḥ ||16||

ataḥ paraṃ cikitsāmāha- vātagulmārditamityādi| snigdhamavasthāpekṣayā caturbhirapi snehaiḥ| yathākālamiti ‘pakṣādvireko vāntasya’ ityādinoktasya kālasyānatikrameṇetyarthaḥ; ‘yathākālaṃ’ ityatra ‘yathāyogaṃ’ iti paṭhitvā yathāvasthamiti vyākhyā nayanti||16||
pittagulmārditaṃ snigdhaṃ kākolyādighṛtena tu | viriktaṃ madhurairyogairnirūhaiḥ samupācaret ||17||
pittagulmārditamityādi| madhurairyogaiḥ āragvadhādibhiḥ kṣīraśarkarādibhiśca; anye tu ‘bhittvā dvidhekṣum’ ityādyuktairmadhurairyogairiti vyākhyānayanti| nirūhaiḥ samupācarenmadhuraireva||17||
śleṣmagulmārditaṃ snigdhaṃ pippalyādighṛtena tu | tīkṣṇairviriktaṃ tadrūpairnirūhaiḥ samupācaret ||18||

śleṣmagulmārditamityādi| tīkṣṇaiḥ dantīdravantīprabhṛtībhiḥ| tadrūpairnirūhaistīkṣṇaiḥ ‘āragvadhādibhiḥ kvāthaḥ’ ityādibhirityarthaḥ| sarvagulmeṣu snehasvedau prayojyau, vātārabdhatvāt `vātasadbhāvāt' iti pā.||18||

div.ab: sannipātotthite gulme tridoṣaghno vidhirhitaḥ |19|

sannipātotthite gulme ityādi| nanu, pūrvaṃ sānnipātiko gulmo'sādhya uktaḥ, tat kathaṃ tridoṣaghno vidhirhita ityucyate? satyaṃ, yathā `yasmāt' iti pā. viṣamasannipātajo gulmo'sādhyastathā samasannipātajo'bhinavo balavati puruṣe kṛcchrasādhyaḥ, ato'tra cikitsitamuktam| tathā coktaṃ- “sannipātotthito gulmaścirottho'samadoṣajaḥ| varjanīyo'nyathā kṛcchrasādhyo balavato mataḥ”- iti|19|-

ab.seg: pittavadraktagulminyā nāryāḥ kāryaḥ kriyāvidhiḥ ||19||
viśeṣamaparaṃ cāsyāḥ śṛṇu raktavibhedanam | palāśakṣāratoyena `palāśabhasmatoyena' iti pā. siddhaṃ sarpiḥ prayojayet ||20||
dadyāduttarabastiṃ ca pippalyādighṛtena tu | uṣṇairvā bhedayedbhinne vidhirāsṛgdaro hitaḥ ||21||

pittavadraktagulminyā ityādi| pittavat pittagulmavat| pittagulmacikitsayā pratikṛtasya `mṛdukṛtasya' iti pā. raktagulmasya viśeṣacikitsāmāha- viśeṣamaparaṃ cāsyā ityādi| palāśakṣāratoyena palāśabhasmagālitena jalena| kecittoyaśabdaṃ kvāthe varṇayanti `vartayanti' iti pā.| sa ca kṣārakvāthaḥ snehopayogoktavidhinā kāryaḥ| pippalyādigaṇakalkakvāthābhyāṃ sādhitaghṛtena| uṣṇairiti pippalyādiprabhṛtibhiḥ| vidhirāsṛgdara iti raktapittokto vidhiḥ; kuta etat? asṛgdare raktapittavidhyatideśāt; asṛgdaravidhyatideśena raktapittavidhyatideśaṃ kurvannetajjñāpayati- adhogataraktapittacikitsitamatra kāryamiti||19-21||
ānūpaudakamajjāno vasā tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ dadhi | vipakvamekataḥ śastaṃ vātagulme'nuvāsanam ||22||

vātagulme'nuvāsanamuddiśannāha- ānūpaudakamajjāna ityādi| ānūpā gajagavayādayaḥ, audakā matsyādayaḥ| vasā'pi ānūpādīnāmeva| vipakvamekata iti etacca snehamekīkṛtya vipakvam, arthādvātaharairdravyairiti boddhavyam||22||

div.ab: jāṅgalaikaśaphānāṃ tu vasā sarpiśca paittike |23|

paittike gulme'nuvāsanamāha- jāṅgalaikaśaphānāmityādi| atra jāṅgalaśabdena jaṅghālaviṣkirau pradhānatayā gṛhyete| ekaśaphā aśvaveśarādayaḥ| vasā sarpiśceti atrāpi vipakvamiti sambadhyate| tenaitaddvayaṃ pittaharairdravyairvipakvaṃ paittike gulme'nuvāsanaṃ yojyamiti|23|-

ab.seg: tailaṃ jāṅgalamajjāna evaṃ gulme kaphotthite ||23||
kaphagulme'nuvāsanamāha- tailaṃ jāṅgalamajjāna ityādi| evamiti kaphaharadravyairvipakvamanuvāsanaṃ śastamityarthaḥ||23||
dhātrīphalānāṃ svarase ṣaḍaṅgaṃ vipacedghṛtam | śarkarāsaindhavopetaṃ taddhitaṃ vātagulmine ||24||

vātādijagulmeṣvanuvāsanamabhidhāya vātāpahaghṛtānyāha `aparāṇi ghṛtānyāha' iti pā. - dhātrīphalānāmityādi| dhātrīphalānāṃ svarase caturguṇe; ṣaḍaṅgamiti ṣaṭpalakaṃ; tenātra pañcakolayavakṣārakalkamiti labhyate| śarkarāsaindhavopetamiti śarkarāsaindhavaprakṣepayuktaṃ tadghṛtaṃ vātagulmine hitamityarthaḥ||24||
citrakavyoṣasindhūtthapṛthvīkācavyadāḍimaiḥ | dīpyakagranthikājājīhapuṣādhānyakaiḥ samaiḥ ||25||
dadhyāranālabadaramūlakasvarasairghṛtam | tatpibedvātagulmāgnidaurbalyāṭopaśūlanut ||26||

citrakādighṛtamāha- citrakavyoṣetyādi| pṛthvīkā hiṅgupatrikā, ‘kṛṣṇajīraka’ ityanye; dīpyakaḥ ajamodā, granthikaṃ pippalīmūlam| samairiti ‘kalkīkṛtaiḥ’ ityadhyāhāryam| dadhyādīni mūlakasvarasāntāni pratyekaṃ ghṛtāccaturguṇāni||25-26||
hiṅgusauvarcalājājīviḍadāḍimadīpyakaiḥ | puṣkaravyoṣadhānyāmlavetasakṣāracitrakaiḥ ||27||
śaṭīvacājagandhailāsurasaiśca vipācitam | śūlānāhaharaṃ sarpirdadhnā cānilagulminām ||28||

hiṅgvādyaṃ ghṛtamāha- hiṅgusauvarcaletyādi| dhānyaṃ dhānyakam| ajagandhā bovayikā| surasaḥ tulasī| hiṅgvādīnāṃ surasāntānāṃ kalke dadhnā caturguṇena vipācitaṃ sarpiḥ śūlādiharamiti sambandhaḥ||27-28||
viḍadāḍimasindhūtthahutabhugvyoṣajīrakaiḥ | hiṅgusauvarcalakṣārarugvṛkṣāmlāmlavetasaiḥ ||29||
bījapūrarasopetaṃ sarpirdadhicaturguṇam | sādhitaṃ dādhikaṃ nāma gulmahṛt plīhaśūlajit ||30||
dādhikasañjñaṃ ghṛtamāha- viḍadāḍimasindhūtthetyādi| hutabhuk citrakaḥ| kṣāro yavakṣāraḥ, ruk kuṣṭhaṃ, vṛkṣāmlaṃ tintiḍīkam| bījapūrakaraso'tra caturguṇaḥ, dravadravyatvāt||29-30||
rasonasvarase sarpiḥ pañcamūlarasānvitam | surāranāladadhyamlamūlakasvarasaiḥ saha ||31||
vyoṣadāḍimavṛkṣāmlayavānīcavyasaindhavaiḥ | hiṅgvamlavetasājājīdīpyakaiśca samāṃśikaiḥ ||32||
siddhaṃ gulmagrahaṇyarśaḥśvāsonmādakṣayajvarān | kāsāpasmāramandāgniplīhaśūlānilāñjayet ||33||

rasonādighṛtamāha- rasonasvaraso ityādi| pañcamūlarasānvitamiti bilvādipañcamūlakvāthānvitam| āranālaṃ kāñjikaṃ, dadhyamlaṃ dadhimastu| dīpyakaḥ ajamodā| rasonasvarasādimūlakasvarasāntaiḥ ṣaḍbhirdravairghṛtasamaiḥ, vyoṣādidravyaiḥ kalkitaiḥ sarpiścaturthāṃśaiḥ, siddhaṃ sarpirgulmādīn jayediti sambandhaḥ||31-33||
dadhi sauvīrakaṃ sarpiḥ kvāthau mudgakulatthajau | pañcāḍhakāni vipacedāvāpya dvipalānyatha ||34||
sauvarcalaṃ sarjikāṃ ca devadārvatha saindhavam | vātagulmāpahaṃ sarpiretaddīpanameva ca ||35||

dadhi sauvīrakamityādi| dadhyādīni catvāri pṛthagāḍhakapramāṇāni, sauvarcalādīni dvipalānyāvāpya sarpirāḍhakaṃ vipacet, ayamatra siddhaḥ pāṭhaḥ, pāramparyāvicchedasmaraṇāt| vartamānapustakeṣu cāyaṃ paṭhyate- kulatthamūlakakvāthetyādi||34-35||

div.ab: tṛṇamūlakaṣāye tu jīvanīyaiḥ pacedghṛtam | nyagrodhādigaṇe vā'pi gaṇe vā'pyutpalādike ||36|| raktapittotthitaṃ ghnanti ghṛtānyetānyasaṃśayam |37|

pittajaraktajagulmayorghṛtānyāha- tṛṇamūlakaṣāye ityādi| atra tṛṇamūlaśabdāttṛṇapañcamūlakaṣāye iti boddhavyam| jīvanīyairiti kākolyādibhiḥ kalkīkṛtairityarthaḥ| nyagrodhādigaṇe kvāthīkṛte iti jñeyam| vā'pītvapiśabdo jīvanīyaiḥ pacedghṛtamiti samuccinoti| etamutpalādāvapi grāhyam| raktapittotthitaṃ ‘gulmaṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ||36||-

ab.seg: āragvadhādau vipaceddīpanīyayutaṃ ghṛtam ||37||
kṣāravarge paceccānyat pacenmūtragaṇe'param | ghnanti gulmaṃ kaphodbhūtaṃ ghṛtānyetānyasaṃśayam ||38||

kaphagulme ghṛtānyāha- āragvadhādau vipacedityādi| āragvadhādāviti kvāthīkṛte| dīpanīyayutamiti pippalyādikalkayutam| ekaṃ ghṛtam| kṣāravarge iti muṣkakādārabhya yāvaccatasraḥ kośātakīriti kṣāravarge, muṣkakādigaṇe ityanye vyākhyānayanti| atrāpi dīpanīyayutamiti sambadhyate, tena kṣāravargadrave `kṣāravargadvaye' iti pā. pippalyādikalkayutaṃ ghṛtaṃ pacedityarthaḥ; dvitīyaṃ ghṛtamityarthaḥ| pacenmūtragaṇe'paramiti mūtragaṇe gomūtrādike'ṣṭasaṅkhyāke'paraṃ tṛtīyaṃ ghṛtam| atrāpi dīpanīyayutamiti sambadhyate| ‘mūtragaṇe'param’ ityatrānye ‘dīpanīyagaṇe'param’ iti paṭhanti, tacca ṭīkākārā anārṣaṃ varṇayanti| kecididaṃ kaphagulmacikitsitaṃ vātagulmacikitsānantaraṃ paṭhitvā vātāvarakaṃ kaphaśāntaye kaphahantṝṇyapi ghṛtāni vātagulme śastānīti vyākhyānayanti||37-38||

div.ab: yathādoṣocchrayaṃ cāpi cikitsetsānnipātikam |39|

evaṃ ghṛtānyabhidhāyādhunā sānnipātike doṣodrekeṇa ghṛtacūrṇādibhiścikitsitamāha- yathetyādi| yathādoṣocchrayaṃ yo yo doṣa ucchrita utkaṭastaccikitsayā cikitsedityarthaḥ| ‘yathādoṣocchrayaṃ’ ityatrānye ‘yathādoṣabalaṃ’ iti paṭhanti; tatrāpyeko'rthaḥ|39|-
cūrṇaṃ hiṅgvādikaṃ vā'pi ghṛtaṃ vā plīhanāśanam ||39|| pibedgulmāpahaṃ kāle sarpistailvakameva vā |40|

tacca yathādoṣocchrayaṃ cikitsitaṃ vāte jite sati kāryamiti vātaharavidhimāha- cūrṇamityādi| cūrṇaṃ hiṅgvādikamiti hiṅgutrikaṭuketyādinā vātavyādhyuktam| ghṛtaṃ vā plīhanāśanamiti ṣaṭpalakamityarthaḥ| yadyapi ṣaṭpalaṃ ghṛtaṃ tantrāntare kaphagulmaharatvena darśitaṃ, tathā'pyatra vilakṣaṇaikadravyatvādvātagulmaharatvam| kāle utpannamātra eva ṣaṭpalakaṃ ghṛtaṃ hitaṃ, kāle avasthāyāmityanye| sarpistailvakamiti tilvakaḥ paṭṭikārodhraḥ, tena saṃskṛtaṃ tailvakaṃ, vātavyādhyuktaṃ vā||39||-

ab.seg: tilekṣurakapālāśasārṣapaṃ yāvanālajam ||40||
bhasma mūlakajaṃ cāpi gojāvikharahastinām | mūtreṇa mahiṣīṇāṃ ca pālikaiścāvacūrṇitaiḥ ||41||
kuṣṭhasaindhavayaṣṭyāhvanāgarakṛmighātibhiḥ | sājamodaiśca daśabhiḥ sāmudrācca palairyutam ||42||
ayaḥpātre'gninā'lpena paktvā lehya(ha)mathoddharet | tasya mātrāṃ pibeddadhnā surayā sarpiṣā'pi vā ||43||
dhānyāmlenoṣṇatoyena kaulatthena rasena vā | gulmān vātavikārāṃśca kṣāro'yaṃ hantyasaṃśayam ||44||

pānīyaṃ kṣāramāha- tiletyādi| ikṣurakaḥ kokilākṣakaḥ| nāgarakasthāne kecittryūṣaṇaṃ paṭhanti| kṛmighāti viḍaṅgam| tilādīnāṃ mūlakāntānāṃ bhasma gavādimūtragaṇena caturguṇena kṣārakalpena parisrāvya kuṣṭādibhirajamodāntaiḥ pālikeḥ sāmudrāt samudralavaṇāddaśabhiḥ palaiścūrṇitairyutaṃ lauhapātre mṛdunā cāgninā lehyaṃ `āloḍya' iti pā. paktvā uddharediti sambandhaḥ| anye tu vyākhyānayanti- tilādibhasmapalaśataṃ gavādimūtreṇa caturguṇena niṣkvāthya pādabhāgikamavaśeṣya, taccaturthāṃśaṃ kuṣṭhādicūrṇamāvāpya tāvat pacedyāvallehyaṃ bhavati| dadhnetyādyanekāvaloḍanadravyopadeśo doṣakālāgnyapekṣayā| vātavikārān tūnīprabhṛtīn||40-44||
svarjikākuṣṭhasahitaḥ kṣāraḥ ketakijo'pi vā | tailena śamayet pīto gulmaṃ pavanasambhavam ||45||

ślokena yogadvayamāha- svarjiketyādi| kṣāro yavakṣāraḥ| tatra svarjikākuṣṭhasahito yavakṣārastailenetyeko yogaḥ; ketakijo'pi vetyatrāpi kṣāra iti sambadhyate, tena ketakijo'pi vā kṣārastaileneti dvitīyo yogaḥ| gauḍāstu ketakikṣāraḥ svarjikākuṣṭhasahitastailenetyekameva yogaṃ manyante||45||

div.ab: pītaṃ sukhāmbunā vā'pi svarjikākuṣṭhasaindhavam |46|
kṣārāvalehamabhidhāya cūrṇamāha- pītamityādi| sukhāmbunā īṣaduṣṇodakena| gulmaṃ hantītyatrāpi sambadhyate|46|-

vṛścīva(ra)murubūkaṃ `pṛthvīkāmurubūkaṃ ca' iti pā. ca varṣābhūrbṛhatīdvayam ||46|| citrakaṃ ca jaladroṇe paktvā pādāvaśeṣitam | māgadhīcitrakakṣaudralipte kumbhe nidhāpayet ||47|| madhunaḥ prasthamāvāpya pathyācūrṇārdhasaṃyutam | busoṣitaṃ `tuṣoṣikaṃ iti pā. daśāhaṃ tu jīrṇabhaktaḥ pibennaraḥ ||48|| ariṣṭo'yaṃ jayedgulmamavipākamarocakam |49|

vṛścīvādyariṣṭamāha- vṛścīvetyādi vṛścīvaḥ śuklapunarnavā| urubūkaḥ śuklairaṇḍaḥ| varṣābhūḥ raktapunarnavā| bṛhatīdvayamiti ekā aṇuphalā `caṇakaphalā' iti pā., dvitīyā kaṇṭakinī sthūlaphalā| vṛścīvādīnāṃ citrakāntānāmāḍhakam; anye palaśataṃ manyante, droṇe'mbhasi palaśatamityādiparibhāṣitatvāt| pādāvaśeṣitaṃ caturthāṃśāvaśiṣṭaṃ kvāthaṃ, magadhādipramāṇaṃ yāvanmātreṇa kumbhasya samyaglepanaṃ bhavati, pathyācūrṇārdhasaṃyuktaṃ harītakīcūrṇāṣṭapalasaṃyutam| busoṣitaṃ busamadhye sthitam| jīrṇabhaktaḥ pariṇatāhāraḥ laghukoṣṭha iti yāvat| pibet prātareva||46-48||-

pāṭhānikumbharajanītrikaṭutriphalāgnikam ||49|| lavaṇaṃ vṛkṣabījaṃ ca tulyaṃ syādanavo guḍaḥ | pathyābhirvā yutaṃ `pathyābhiḥ sahitaṃ cūrṇaṃ' iti pā. cūrṇaṃ gavāṃ mūtrayutaṃ pacet ||50|| guṭikāstadghanībhūtaṃ kṛtvā khādedabhuktavān | gulmaplīhāgnisādāṃstā nāśayeyuraśeṣataḥ ||51|| hṛdrogaṃ grahaṇīdoṣaṃ pāṇḍurogaṃ ca dāruṇam |52|

pāṭhetyādi| nikumbhā dantī| agnikaḥ citrakaḥ, ‘agnimantha’ ityanye, ‘moraṭa’ ityapare| vṛkṣabījam indrayavaḥ| anavaṃ guḍaṃ purāṇaṃ guḍam| pāṭhādicūrṇaṃ samapurāṇaguḍayutaṃ svādet, athavā tadeva cūrṇaṃ harītakībhiḥ saha gomūtreṇa pacet, taṃ ca ghanībhūtaṃ guṭikāḥ kṛtvā prātareva khādet| harītakīpramāṇaṃ cūrṇāccaturthāṃśaṃ, gomūtraṃ tu caturguṇam||49-51||-
saśūle sonnate'spande dāhapākaruganvite ||52|| gulme raktaṃ jalaukobhiḥ sirāmokṣeṇa vā haret |53|

idānīmavasthāyāṃ gulme raktamokṣaṇamāha- saśūle ityādi| aspande acale| pākaruganvite pākavedanāyukte, jalaukobhī raktaṃ haret gulmasthāne eva, sirāmokṣeṇa tu bāhvoḥ, tantrāntaroktatvāt| kecit ‘alābupātanaṃ cāpi gulme śastaṃ kaphātmake’ iti paṭhanti||52||-
sukhoṣṇā jāṅgalarasāḥ susnigdhā vyaktasaindhavāḥ ||53|| kaṭutrikasamāyuktā hitāḥ pāne tu gulminām |54|
gulmināṃ jāṅgalarasya pānamāha- sukhoṣṇā ityādi| sukhoṣṇā īṣaduṣṇāḥ| jāṅgalarasā jāṅghālaviṣkiramāṃsarasāḥ saṃskṛtāḥ| susnigdhāḥ samyak snehasaṃskṛtāḥ| hitā iti ‘yathādoṣaṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ||53||-
peyā vātaharaiḥ siddhāḥ kaulatthā saṃskṛtā rasāḥ ||54|| khalāḥ sapañcamūlāśca gulmināṃ bhojane hitāḥ |55|

bhojanārthamāha- peyetyādi| vātaharaiḥ bhadradārvādibhiḥ| saṃskṛtāḥ snehādibhiḥ| khalāḥ kapitthadāḍimatakraśākādisaṃskṛtāḥ ‘kacilā’ iti prasiddhāḥ| sapañcamūlāḥ pañcamūlasahitāḥ, etena pañcamūlasahitaiḥ kapitthādibhiḥ kṛtā ityarthaḥ| bhojane hitā yathādoṣamityupaskāraḥ||54||-

ab.seg: baddhavarconilānāṃ tu sārdrakaṃ kṣīramiṣyate ||55||
avasthāvaśena gulme bhojanaviśeṣamāha- baddhetyādi| baddhavarconilānāṃ niruddhapurīṣavāyūnām| sārdrakam ārdrakasahitam| iṣyate ‘bhojane’ iti śeṣaḥ||55||

div.ab: kumbhīpiṇḍeṣṭakāsvedān kārayet kuśalo bhiṣak |56|
āntaropacāramabhidhāyāvasthāyāṃ bāhyopacāraṃ svedamāha- kumbhīpiṇḍeṣṭakāsvedānityādi| kumbhīprabhṛtisvedāḥ svedādhyāye abhihitāḥ| nipuṇatayā svedān kārayet|56|-
gulminaḥ sarva evoktā durvirecyatamā bhṛśam ||56|| ataścaitāṃstu susvinnān sraṃsanenopapādayet |57|
vātaśleṣmātmake saśūle kaṭhine ca gulme gulmino virekamāha- gulmina ityādi| sukhinnāniti sneho hi svedenaivākṣiptaḥ, tena samyak snigdhasvinnān| sraṃsanena virekeṇa| upapādayet yojayet||56||-

vimlāpanābhyañjanāni `vilepanābhyañjanāni' iti pā. tathaiva dahanāni ca ||57|| upanāhāśca kartavyāḥ sukhoṣṇāḥ sālvaṇādayaḥ | udaroktāni sarpīṃṣi mūtravartikriyāstathā `cūrṇavartikriyāstathā' iti pā.||58|| lavaṇāni ca yojyāni yānyuktānyanilāmaye |59|

kiṃ gulme vireka eva kāryaṃ utānyadapītyāha- vimlāpanābhyañjanānītyādi| vimlāpanam aṅgulyādinā gulmasya mardanaṃ, dahanaṃ jāmbavauṣṭhādinā| sālvaṇādaya ityatra ādiśabdaḥ prakāre; tena sālvaṇaprakārā anye'pyupanāhasvedāḥ pacyamānābhimukhe gulme kāryāḥ| udaroktāni sarpīṃṣi ‘harītakīcūrṇaprasthaṃ’ ityādikāni| mūtravartikriyāstatheti udaroktā ‘vamanaśirovirecanadravyāṇāṃ’ ityādikāḥ| lavaṇāni patralavaṇasnehalavaṇakalyāṇalavaṇāni| anilāmaye vātavyādhau| kecit ‘sarpīṃṣi’ ityasyāgre ‘cūrṇāni’ iti paṭhitvā nārācakādaya iti vyākhyānayanti||57-58||-
vātavarconirodhe tu sāmudrārdrakasarṣapaiḥ ||59|| kṛtvā pāyau vidhātavyā vartayo maricottarāḥ |60|
idānīṃ mūtravartiprayogāvasthāmaparavartiṃ cāha- vātetyādi| sāmudraṃ samudralavaṇaṃ, samudraphenamapare| maricottarā maricapradhānāḥ||59||-
dantīcitrakamūleṣu tathā vātahareṣu ca ||60|| kuryādariṣṭān sarvāṃśca ślokasthāne yatheritān |61|

dantīcitrakamūleṣvityādi| vātahareṣu vidārigandhāprabhṛtiṣu| ślokasthāne yatheritāniti yathā sūtrasthāne virecanakalpe āsavakaraṇamuktaṃ, tenaiva prakāreṇātrāpi dantyādikvāthe'riṣṭānāsavān kuryāt| anye tu ‘ślokasthāne’ ityatra dvitīyaṃ sthānaśabdaṃ luptaṃ varṇayanti, luptasthānaśabdena gulmapratiṣedhaṃ gṛhṇanti| tenātroktavṛścīvādyariṣṭavaddantyādikvāthe madhupathyācūrṇaprakṣepeṇāriṣṭakaraṇaṃ, sūtrasthānoktaprakāreṇa vā''savakaraṇam||60||-

ab.seg: svādedvā'pyaṅkurān bhṛṣṭān pūtīkanṛpavṛkṣayoḥ ||61||

svādedityādi| aṅkurān komalapallavān| bhṛṣṭāniti ‘snehena’ iti śeṣaḥ; anye agninā bhṛṣṭānityāhuḥ, tanmate vātakāriṇo'pyaṅkurā vyādhipratyanīkatvādgulme hitāḥ| pūtīkaḥ cirabilvaḥ, nṛpavṛkṣo girimālakaḥ||61||

div.ab: ūrdhvavātaṃ manuṣyaṃ ca gulminaṃ na nirūhayet |62|
idānīṃ gulme hitasyāpi nirūhasyāvasthāyāṃ niṣedhamāha- ūrdhvavātamityādi| ūrdhvavātam ūrdhvavātayuktaṃ gulminaṃ manuṣyaṃ na nirūhayediti sambandhaḥ| kecidimaṃ pāṭhaṃ na paṭhanti|62|-

ab.seg: pibettrivṛnnāgaraṃ vā saguḍāṃ vā harītakīm ||62||
gugguluṃ trivṛtāṃ dantīṃ dravantīṃ saindhavaṃ vacām | mūtramadyapayodrākṣārasairvīkṣya balābalam ||63||

pibedityādi| pibediti vakṣyamāṇena mūtramadyādidraveṇa; anye pānīyena pibedityāhuḥ| trivṛnnāgaramityeko yogaḥ, saguḍāṃ vā harītakīmiti dvitīyaḥ| guggulumityādi| dravantī cīritapatrā dantībhedaḥ| payaḥ dugdhaṃ, drakṣārasaḥ drākṣāsvarasaḥ| vīkṣya balābalamiti ‘doṣādīnāṃ’ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ| atrāpi pibediti sambandhanīyam||62-63||

div.ab: evaṃ pīlūni bhṛṣṭāni `piṣṭāni' iti pā. pibet salavaṇāni tu |64|
evamityādi| evamiti mūtrādibhirityarthaḥ| (bhṛṣṭāni snehena ayaṃ pāṭho hastalikhitapustake nopalabhyate )|64|-
pippalīpippalīmūlacavyacitrakasaindhavaiḥ ||64|| yuktā hanti surā gulmaṃ śīghraṃ kāle prayojitā |65|
pippalītyādi| surā paiṣṭī| hantītyatra śīghramiti sambadhyate| kāle ādhmānādikāyāmavasthāyām||64||-
baddhaviṇmāruto gulmī bhuñjīta payasā yavān ||65|| kulmāṣān vā bahusnehān bhakṣayellavaṇottarān |66|
baddhetyādi| payasā dugdhena| yavān vāṭyādikṛtān| kulmāṣān yavapiṣṭamayān bhakṣyān| lavaṇottarān saindhavapradhānān||65||-
athāsyopadravaḥ śūlaḥ `śūlaṃ' iti pā. kathañcidupajāyate ||66|| śūlaṃ `śūlaṃ nikhānitamiva sukhaṃ yena na vettyasau' iti pā. nikhānitamivāsukhaṃ yena tu vettyasau |67|
idānīṃ gulmopadravamāha- athetyādi| asya gulmasya, upadravaḥ paścātkālabhāvī kathañcit svahetubhirityarthaḥ| śūla upajāyate| śūlaṃ nikhānitamiva kīlakaṃ nikhānitamivetyarthaḥ||66||-

tatra viṇmūtrasaṃrodhaḥ kṛcchrocchvāsaḥ sthirāṅgatā ||67|| tṛṣṇā dāho bhramo'nnasya vidagdhaparivṛddhitā | romaharṣo'ruciśchardirbhuktavṛddhirjaḍāṅgatā ||68|| vāyvādibhiryathāsaṅkhyaṃ miśrairvā... |69|

tasyaivopadravasya doṣaviśeṣeṇa liṅgaṃ saṅkhyāṃ cāha- tatretyādi| tatretyupadrave śūle| sthirāṅgatā kaṭhināṅgatā| annasya vidagdhaparivṛddhitā annasya vidāhe śūlasya parivṛddhirbhavatītyarthaḥ| bhuktavṛddhiriti bhuktasya vṛddhiḥ bhuktamātre śūlasya vṛddhirbhavatītyarthaḥ| jaḍāṅgatā aṅgānāṃ jaḍatā| miśrairiti dvandvaiḥ sānnipātikaiścetyarthaḥ| viṇmūtrasaṃrodha ityādikaṃ vātajaśūlalakṣaṇaṃ, tṛṣṇādāha ityādikaṃ pittajaśūlalakṣaṇaṃ, romaharṣo'rucirityādikaṃ śleṣmajaśūlalakṣaṇaṃ, dvidoṣaliṅgaṃ dvandvaiḥ, sarvaliṅgaṃ samastaiḥ||67-68||-

...vīkṣya yojayet | pathyātrilavaṇaṃ kṣāraṃ hiṅgutumburupauṣkaram ||69|| yavānīṃ ca haridrāṃ ca viḍaṅgānyamlavetasam | vidārītriphalā'bhīruśṛṅgāṭīguḍaśarkarāḥ ||70|| kāśmarīphalayaṣṭyāhvaparūṣakahimāni ca | ṣaḍgranthātiviṣādārupathyāmaricavṛkṣajān ||71|| kṛṣṇāmūlakacavyaṃ ca nāgarakṣāracitrakān | uṣṇāmlakāñjikakṣīratoyaiḥ ślokasamāpanān ||72|| yathākramaṃ vimiśrāṃśca dvandve sarvāṃśca sarvaje |73|

ataḥ paramupadravaśūlasya `upadravaliṅgasya' iti pā. cikitsitamāha- vīkṣyetyādi| vīkṣyeti vātādibhedena śūlamityarthaḥ| trilavaṇaṃ saindhavasauvarcalabiḍāni| kṣāro yavakṣāraḥ| abhīruḥ śatāvarī, śṛṅgāṭī jalajaṃ dravyaṃ trikaṇṭakaphalaṃ| guḍaśarkarā gāṅgeṭīphalam `gāṅgeṭī balā' iti pā.| himaṃ candanam| ṣaḍgranthā vacā| vṛkṣaja indrayavaḥ| mūlakaṃ pippalīmūlam| uṣṇaśabdo'mlakāñjikādibhiḥ sambadhyate| ślokasamāpanān ‘yogān’ iti śeṣaḥ| yathākramamiti pathyādyamlavetasāntamuṣṇāmlakāñjikena vātike, vidāryādihimāntumuṣṇakṣīreṇa paittike, ṣaḍgranthādicitrakāntamuṣṇatoyena ślaiṣmike; vimiśraṃ dvandve iti pathyādividāryādī vātapaittike, pathyādiṣaḍgranthādī vātaślaiṣmike, vidāryādiṣaḍgranthādī pittaślaiṣmike, sarvāṃśca pathyādīn trīn sannipāte||69-72||-
tathaiva sekāvagāhapradehābhyaṅgabhojanam ||73|| śiśirodakapūrṇānāṃ bhājanānāṃ ca dhāraṇam | vamanonmardanasvedalaṅghanakṣapaṇakriyāḥ ||74|| snehādiśca kramaḥ sarvo viśeṣeṇopadiśyate |75|

kimetadevopadravaśūle kāryamutānyadapītyāha- tathaivetyādi| tathaiveti yathāsaṅkhyamityarthaḥ| tena sekādikaṃ vātike, śiśirodakādikaṃ paittike, vamanādikaṃ ślaiṣmike| snehādikramaśca yathādoṣaṃ yathāvasthaṃ sarveṣāmeva, dvandvaje dvayaṃ, sānnipātike samastam| kṣapaṇakriyā anyā api kaphakṣayakarī||73-74||-
vallūraṃ mūlakaṃ matsyān śuṣkaśākāni vaidalam ||75|| na khādedālukaṃ gulmī madhurāṇi phalāni ca |76|

gulmopadravamabhidhāya gulme varjyamāha- vallūraṃ mūlakamityādi| vallūraṃ śuṣkamāṃsam| vaidalaṃ mudgavanamudgādikam| ālukaṃ piṇḍālukādibhedenānekaprakāram| madhurāṇi phalāni kṣīravṛkṣaphalāni cocamocādīni ca| cakārādevaṃvidhānyanyānyapi varjyāni| asyāgre kecit ‘laghvannaṃ dīpanaṃ snigdhamuṣṇaṃ vātānulomanam| bṛṃhaṇaṃ ca bhavedyacca taddhitaṃ sarvagulminām|| sthāne'vaseko raktasya bāhumadhye sirāvyadhaḥ| svedo'nulomanaṃ caiva praśastaṃ sarvagulminām’ ityādikaṃ paṭhanti; sa cābhāvānna likhitaḥ| (iti ayaṃ pāṭho mudritapustake nopalabhyate ḍahlaṇenānyagranthadarśanāduktam)||75||-
vinā gulmena yacchūlaṃ gulmasthāneṣu jāyate ||76|| nidānaṃ tasya vakṣyāmi rūpaṃ ca sacikitsitam |77|

gulmopadravaṃ śūlamabhidhāyedānīṃ kevalaṃ śūlamāha- vinetyādi| gulmasthāneṣu gulmapratiṣedhokteṣu| anye ‘vinā gulmena’ ityādiślokaṃ parityajya ‘athātaḥ śūlapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ’ iti pratijñāṃ paṭhitvā vātamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ nigrahādityādinā pṛthageva śūlādhyāyaṃ paṭhanti; te ca pūrvaparipāṭīṃ tyajanti| apare vinā gulmenetyādikaṃ samastamapi asau śrutaṃ bhaṇitvā parityajanti| asmābhistu sarvamatānusāribhirjejjaṭābhiprāyeṇa paṭhitaḥ||76||-

ab.seg: vātamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ nigrahādatibhojanāt ||77||
ajīrṇādhyaśanāyāsaviruddhānnopasevanāt | pānīyapānāt kṣutkāle virūḍhānāṃ ca sevanāt ||78||
piṣṭānnaśuṣkamāṃsānāmupayogāttathaiva ca | evaṃvidhānāṃ dravyāṇāmanyeṣāṃ copasevanāt ||79||
vāyuḥ prakupitaḥ koṣṭhe śūlaṃ sañjanayedbhṛśam | nirucchvāsī bhavettena vedanāpīḍito naraḥ ||80||

śūlasya hetuṃ samprāptiṃ cāha- vātamūtrapurīṣāṇāmityādi| nigrahāt vegakāle'varodhāt| ajīrṇam āmavidagdhādibhedabhinnam| adhyaśanaṃ sājīrṇabhojanam| āyāsaḥ śarīrāyāsajanakaṃ karma| viruddhānnaṃ hitāhitīyoktam| virūḍhānāṃ vigatarohāṇāmaṅkuritānāṃ vā| evaṃvidhānāṃ doṣaprakopaṇānām| koṣṭhe sarvasminnudare| nirucchvāsaḥ niruddhocchvāsaḥ| tena śūlena| vātamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ nigrahādityādiranyeṣāṃ copasevanādityanto hetuḥ, vāyuḥ prakupita ityādiśca samprāptiḥ||77-80||
śaṅkusphoṭanavattasya `śaṅkvāsphoṭanavat' iti pā. yasmāttīvrāśca vedanāḥ | śūlāsaktasya lakṣyante tasmācchūlamihocyate ||81||

tat kasmācchūlamucyata ityāha- śaṅkvityādi| śaṅkusphoṭanavat kīlakāhananavattīvrā vedanāḥ, tasya vyādhitasya, śūlāsaktasya śūlinaḥ; etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati- yathā kasyacit kīlakāhananena `kaṇṭakahananeneva' iti pā. tīvrā vedanā lakṣyate tadvattasya yasmādvedanā lakṣyate tasmācchūlamihocyate||81||
nirāhārasya yasyaiva tīvraṃ śūlamudīryate | prastabdhagātro bhavati kṛcchreṇocchvasitīva ca ||82||
vātamūtrapurīṣāṇi kṛcchreṇa kurute naraḥ | etairliṅgairvijānīyācchūlaṃ vātasamudbhavam ||83||
vātaśūlalakṣaṇamāha- nirāhārasyetyādi||82-83||

div.ab: tṛṣṇā dāho mado mūrcchā tīvraṃ śūlaṃ tathaiva ca | śītābhikāmo bhavati śītenaiva praśāmyati ||84|| etairliṅgairvijānīyācchūlaṃ pittasamudbhavam |85|
pittaśūlalakṣaṇamāha- tṛṣṇetyādi| śītābhikāmaḥ śītābhilāṣaḥ| praśāmyati ‘śūlaṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ||84||-

ab.seg: śūlenotpīḍyamānasya hṛllāsa upajāyate ||85||
atīva pūrṇakoṣṭhatvaṃ tathaiva gurugātratā | etacchleṣmasamutthasya śūlasyoktaṃ nidarśanam ||86||
kaphaśūlalakṣaṇamāha- śūlenetyādi| hṛllāsaḥ thūtkaraṇam| nidarśanaṃ lakṣaṇam||85-86||

div.ab: sarvāṇi dṛṣṭvā rūpāṇi nirdiśetsānnipātikam | sannipātasamutthānamasādhyaṃ taṃ vinirdiśet ||87|| śūlānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ... |88|

sānnipātikaśūlalakṣaṇamāha- sarvāṇītyādi| nanu, kaiścit pūrvācāryairdoṣabhedena niyataṃ sthānaṃ śūlasyoktam| tathāhi- “vātātmakaṃ bastigataṃ vadanti, pittātmakaṃ cāpi vadanti nābhyām| hṛtpārśvakukṣau kaphasanniviṣṭaṃ, sarveṣu deśeṣu ca sannipātāt”- iti; tat kathamatra tathā noktam| satyaṃ, kupitadoṣāṇāṃ svāśaye parāśaye ca vyādhyutpādakatvānna niyataṃ sthānamasti, atastathā noktam||87||-
...cikitsāṃ tu nibodha me | āśukārī hi pavanastasmāttaṃ tvarayā jayet ||88|| tasya śūlābhipannasya sveda eva sukhāvahaḥ |89|

cikitsāmityādi| nibodha jānīhi| me matsakāśāt| āśukārītyādi| āśukārī śīghramatyayakāritvāt| hi yasmāt| taṃ vātam| tasyetyādi|- tasya puruṣasya, śūlābhipannasya vātikaśūlakrāntasya; anye tu tasya vātasya yacchūlaṃ tena ākrāntasyetyāhuḥ||88||-

ab.seg: pāyasaiḥ kṛśarāpiṇḍaiḥ snigdhairvā piśitairhitaḥ ||89||
sa ca svedaḥ kairdravyaiḥ kārya ityāha- pāyasairityādi| pāyaso dugdhasiddhāstaṇḍulāḥ| kṛśarāpiṇḍaiḥ tilataṇḍulamāṣakṛtayavāgūpiṇḍaiḥ| hita iti ‘sveda’ iti śeṣaḥ||89||
trivṛcchākena vā snigdhamuṣṇaṃ bhuñjīta bhojanam | cirabilvāṅkurān vāpi tailabhṛṣṭāṃstu bhakṣayet ||90||
vaihaṅgāṃśca rasān snigdhān jāṅgalān śūlapīḍitaḥ | yathālābhaṃ niṣeveta māṃsāni bilaśāyinām ||91||

bhojanamāha- trivṛcchākenetyādi| snigdhādiguṇaṃ bhojanaṃ trivṛcchākena saha bhuñjīteti piṇḍārthaḥ| cirabilvāṅkurānityādi| aṅkurāḥ śuṅgāḥ| vaihaṅgāṃścetyādi| jāṅgalān vaihaṅgān, lāvādikṛtānityarthaḥ| bileśayāḥ śvāvicchallakādayaḥ||90-91||
surā sauvīrakaṃ cukraṃ mastūdaśvittathā dadhi | sakālalavaṇaṃ peyaṃ śūle vātasamudbhave ||92||

surā sauvīrakamityādi| surā piṣṭabhavā| sauvīrakaṃ kāñjikabhedaḥ| cukraṃ śuktam| mastu dadhimastu| udaśvit ardhodakaṃ takram| tatheti yathālābhamityarthaḥ| kālalavaṇaśabdena yadyapi nirgandhasauvarcalamucyate, tathā'pyatra gandhavatsauvarcalaṃ grāhyaṃ, tantrāntaroktatvāt||92||
kulatthayūṣo yuktāmlo lāvakīyūṣasaṃskṛtaḥ | sasaindhavaḥ samarico vātaśūlavināśanaḥ ||93||
kulatthayūṣa ityādi| yuktaṃ mātrayopahitamamlaṃ dāḍimādikaṃ yatra sa yuktāmlaḥ| lāvakīyūṣasaṃskṛta iti lāvakena kṛto yūṣo lāvakīyūṣaḥ, tena saṃskṛtaḥ||93||

div.ab: viḍaṅgaśigrukampillapathyāśyāmāmlavetasān | surasāmaśvamūtrīṃ `surasāmaśvakarṇaṃ ca' iti pā. ca sauvarcalayutān pibet ||94|| madyena vātajaṃ śūlaṃ kṣiprameva praśāmyati |95|
viḍaṅgetyādi| śigruḥ viṭapaśākaṃ, śobhāñjanamapare| śyāmā aruṇamūlā trivṛt| surasā tulasī| aśvamūtrī śallakī||94||-

pṛthvīkājājicavikāyavānīvyoṣacitrakāḥ ||95|| pippalyaḥ pippalīmūlaṃ saindhavaṃ ceti cūrṇayet | tāni cūrṇāni payasā pibet kāmbalikena vā ||96|| madhvāsavena cukreṇa surāsauvīrakeṇa vā | athavai(cai)tāni cūrṇāni mātuluṅgarasena vā ||97|| tathā badarayūṣeṇa bhāvitāni punaḥ punaḥ | tāni hiṅgupragāḍhāni saha śarkarayā pibet ||98|| saha dāḍimasāreṇa vartiḥ kāryā bhiṣagjitā | sā vartirvātikaṃ śūlaṃ kṣiprameva vyapohati ||99|| guḍatailena vā līḍhā pītā madyena vā punaḥ |100|

pṛthvīketyādi| pṛthvīkā hiṅgupatrikā| ajājī uttarāpathe jīrakaviśeṣaḥ| kāmbalikena dadhimastvamlasiddhayūṣeṇa| cukraṃ śuktam| sauvīrakaṃ virecanadravyavikalpakathitam| pakṣāntaramāha- athavetyādi| etāni pūrvoktāni cūrṇāni, bījapūrakarasena badarayūṣeṇa vā punaḥ punarbhāvitāni hiṅgūtkaṭāni śarkarayā saha mātuluṅgarasenaiva pibediti piṇḍārthaḥ| saha dāḍimasāreṇetyādi|- taireva cūrṇairdāḍimasāreṇa saha bhiṣagjitā vaidyena vartirvā kāryā| sā ca vartirguḍatailena līḍhā madyena vā pītā satī vātikaṃ śūlaṃ kṣiprameva hantītyarthaḥ||95-99||-
bubhukṣāprabhave śūle laghu santarpaṇaṃ hitam ||100|| uṣṇaiḥ kṣīrairyavāgūbhiḥ snigdhairmāṃsarasaistathā |101|
bubhukṣāprabhave ityādi| laghviti mātrayā svabhāvena ca| santarpaṇaṃ bhojanam| uṣṇairiti kṣīrādibhiḥ sambadhyate||100||-

vātaśūle samutpanne rūkṣaṃ snigdhena bhojayet ||101|| susaṃskṛtāḥ pradeyāḥ syurghṛtapūrā viśeṣataḥ | vāruṇīṃ ca pibejjantustathā sampadyate sukhī ||102|| etadvātasamutthasya śūlasyoktaṃ cikitsitam |103|

vātetyādi| susaṃskṛtāḥ śuṇṭhīmaricādibhiḥ| pradeyā dātavyāḥ| ghṛtapūrā ghṛtapūpā ityarthaḥ| vāruṇī surā| tathā tena prakāreṇa| sukhī sampadyate sukhī bhavatītyarthaḥ| upasaṃhāramāha- etadvātasamutthasyetyādi||101-102||-

ab.seg: atha pittasamutthasya kriyāṃ vakṣyāmyataḥ param ||103||
sa sukhaṃ chardayitvā tu pītvā śītodakaṃ naraḥ | śītalāni ca seveta sarvāṇyuṣṇāni varjayet ||104||

vātaśūlopakramamabhidhāyedānīṃ pittaśūlacikitsāmāha- athetyādi| atheti vākyālaṅkāre, vākyopakrame ityanye| tadeṣa cikitsitamāha- sa ityādi| sa pittaśūlī naraḥ, śītodakaṃ pītvā, sukhaṃ yathā bhavati tathā chardayitvā, śītalāni bhajeta, uṣṇāni sarvāṇi varjayediti piṇḍārthaḥ||103-104||
maṇirājatatāmrāṇi bhājanāni ca sarvaśaḥ | vāripūrṇāni tānyasya śūlasyopari nikṣipet ||105||
maṇirājatatāmrāṇītyādi| rājataṃ rūpyamayam| sarvaśa āmukhāt| asya pittaśūlinaḥ||105||
guḍaḥ śāliryavāḥ kṣīraṃ sarpiḥpānaṃ virecanam | jāṅgalāni ca māṃsāni bheṣajaṃ pittaśūlinām ||106||
rasān seveta pittaghnān pittalāni vivarjayet | pālāśaṃ dhānvanaṃ vā'pi pibedyūṣaṃ saśarkaram ||107||

guḍetyādi| pittaghnān rasān jāṅgalavarge yāni nirdiṣṭāni pittaharāṇi māṃsāni tatkṛtān rasānityarthaḥ| pittalānītyādi| pittalāni annapānādīni| pālāśaṃ yūṣaṃ māṃsādamāṃsarasamityarthaḥ| dhānvanaṃ jāṅgalamāṃsarasam||106-107||
paruṣakāṇi mṛdvīkākharjūrodakajānyapi | tat pibeccharkarāyuktaṃ pittaśūlanivāraṇam ||108||
parūṣakāṇītyādi| parūṣakāṇi parūṣakaphalāni| udakajāni padmāni||108||
aśane bhuktamātre tu prakopaḥ ślaiṣmikasya ca | vamanaṃ kārayettatra pippalīvāriṇā bhiṣak ||109||

ślaiṣmikaśūlacikitsāmāha- aśane ityādi| aśane bhojane| ślaiṣmikasya śleṣmaśūlasya| tatra śleṣmaśūle| pippalīvāriṇā pippalīyuktapānīyena, anye vāriśabdaṃ kvāthe vartayanti, apare pippalīśabdena madanaphalabījāni kathayanti||109||
rūkṣaḥ svedaḥ prayojyaḥ syādanyāścoṣṇāḥ kriyā hitāḥ | pippalī śṛṅgaveraṃ ca śleṣmaśūle bhiṣagjitam ||110||
rūkṣaḥ svedaḥ prayojya ityādi|- rūkṣaḥ svedaḥ snigdharahitaḥ karīṣādikṛtaḥ| pippalīśṛṅgaveraprayogaścūrṇakalkakvāthādividhinā||110||
pāṭhāṃ vacāṃ trikaṭukaṃ tathā kaṭukarohiṇīm | citrakasya ca niryūhe `niryūhaṃ' iti pā. pibedyūṣaṃ sahārjakam ||111||
pāṭhāmityādi| pāṭhādīni dravyāṇi cūrṇitāni kalkitāni vā citrakasya niryūhe kvāthe pibedityeko yogaḥ| yūṣaṃ sahārjakamiti dvitīyo yogaḥ| yūṣaṃ śūlaharaśimbidhānyayūṣam| arjakaḥ kuṭherakaḥ||111||
eraṇḍaphalamūlāni mūlaṃ gokṣurakasya ca | śālaparṇīṃ pṛśniparṇīṃ `śāliparṇī pṛṣṭhaparṇī' iti pā. bṛhatīṃ kaṇṭakārikām ||112||
dadyācchṛgālavinnāṃ ca sahadevāṃ tathaiva ca | mahāsahāṃ kṣudrasahāṃ mūlamikṣurakasya ca ||113||
etat sambhṛtya sambhāraṃ jaladroṇe vipācayet | caturbhāgāvaśeṣaṃ tu yavakṣārayutaṃ pibet ||114||
vātikaṃ paittikaṃ vā'pi ślaiṣmikaṃ sānnipātikam | prasahya nāśayecchūlaṃ chinnābhramiva mārutaḥ ||115||

eraṇḍadvādaśakamāha- eraṇḍetyādi| śṛgālavinnā pṛśniparṇībhedaḥ| mahāsahā māṣaparṇī| kṣudrasahā mudgaparṇī| ikṣurakaḥ kokilākṣakaḥ| sambhṛtya ekīkṛtya| eraṇḍādidravyasambhāraḥ catuḥṣaṣṭipalapramitaḥ; tulāpramita ityanye| prasahya balātkāreṇa| pibedityanenābhyavahāreṇātra sūcyate; tena tṛṣṇāyāṃ pānamācamanaṃ vā tena kāryam, anyathā droṇacaturthāṃśasya sādhitasya jalasyāparakvāthavat paladvayapāne vaiyarthyaṃ syāt| yadyapyayaṃ yogaḥ sarvaśūlaharastathāpyatyantakaphaśūlaharatvādatroktaḥ| kecit ‘mūlaṃ cekṣurakasya’ ityatra ‘dadyāccaivekṣuvālikām’ iti paṭhitvā khaggalīmiti vyākhyānayanti||112-115||

div.ab: pippalī svarjikākṣāro yavāścitraka eva ca | sevyaṃ caitat samānīya bhasma kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ ||116|| taduṣṇavāriṇā pītaṃ śleṣmaśūle bhiṣagjitam |117|
pippalītyādi| sevyam uśīraṃ, tat bhasma||116||-

ab.seg: ruṇaddhi mārutaṃ śleṣmā kukṣipārśvavyavasthitaḥ ||117||
sa saṃruddhaḥ karotyāśu sādhmānaṃ `dhmānaṃ guḍaguḍāyanam' iti pā. guḍguḍāyanam | sūcībhiriva nistodaṃ kṛcchrocchvāsī tadā naraḥ ||118||
nānnaṃ vāñchati no nidrāmupaityartinipīḍitaḥ | pārśvaśūlaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ kaphānilasamudbhavaḥ ||119||

yadyapi catvāraḥ śūlāḥ, tathāpi doṣadhātumalasaṃsargādāyatanaviśeṣānnimittataścaiṣāṃ vikalpa iti kṛtvā pārśvādiśūlamāha- ruṇaddhītyādi| sa vāyuḥ| ādhmānam udarāpūraḥ| guḍguḍāyanamatra avyaktaśabdaḥ| no nidrāmupaiti na nidrāṃ prāpnotītyarthaḥ||117-119||

div.ab: tatra puṣkaramūlāni hiṅgu sauvarcalaṃ viḍam | saindhavaṃ tumburuṃ pathyāṃ cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā tu pāyayet ||120|| pārśvahṛdbastiśūleṣu yavakvāthena saṃyutam | sarpiḥ plīhodaroktaṃ vā ghṛtaṃ vā hiṅgusaṃyutam ||121|| bījapūrakasāraṃ vā payasā saha sādhitam | eraṇḍatailamathavā madyamastupayorasaiḥ ||122|| bhojayeccāpi payasā jāṅgalena rasena vā |123|

pārśvaśūle cikitsitamāha- tatretyādi| puṣkaramūlādīni dravyāṇi cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā pārśvādiśūleṣu yavakvāthena saṃyutaṃ pāyayediti piṇḍārthaḥ| yadyapyayaṃ yogo'patantrake'pi paṭhitaḥ, tathā'pyatrāmlavetasābhāvāt punaḥ paṭhitaḥ| sarpiḥ plīhodaroktamityādi plīhodaroktaṃ sarpiḥ ṣaṭpalaṃ, hiṅgusaṃyutaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā asiddhameva| payasā kṣīreṇa, sādhitaṃ kvāthitaṃ, bījapūrakasāraṃ bījapūrakaphalabījam, atrāpi pāyayediti sambadhyate| kecit ‘bījapūrakasāraṃ ca’ ityatra ‘pibedbījakasāraṃ ca’ iti paṭhanti| eraṇḍatailamityādi|- eraṇḍatailaṃ vā madyādibhiryathāsātmyaṃ yathādoṣaṃ ca prātareva pibet, jīrṇe ca kṣīreṇa jāṅgalarasena vā bhojayet||120-122||-

ab.seg: prakupyati yadā kukṣau vahnimākramya mārutaḥ ||123||
tadā'sya bhojanaṃ bhuktaṃ sopastambhaṃ na pacyate | ucchvasityāmaśakṛtā śūlenāhanyate muhuḥ ||124||
naivāsane na śayane tiṣṭhan `tiṣṭhan sa' iti `tiṣṭhanna' iti ca pā. vā labhate sukham | kukṣiśūla iti khyāto vātādāmasamudbhavaḥ ||125||
kukṣiśūlamāha- prakupyatītyādi| ākramya mandīkṛtya| sopastambhaṃ stabdhatānvitam| ucchvasiti ucchvāsaṃ karoti ‘puruṣa’ iti śeṣaḥ| āmaśakṛtā apakvapurīṣeṇa| tiṣṭhan ūrdhvībhavan||123-125||
vamanaṃ kārayettatra laṅghayedvā yathābalam | saṃsargapācanaṃ kuryādamlairdīpanasaṃyutaiḥ ||126||

kukṣiśūle cikitsāmāha- vamanaṃ kārayettatretyādi| tatra kukṣiśūle| yathābalaṃ balasyānatikrameṇa| saṃsargapācanaṃ peyādikramapācanam| amlaiḥ dāḍimatakrādibhiḥ| dīpanasaṃyutairiti pañcakolayutaiḥ||126||

div.ab: nāgaraṃ dīpyakaṃ cavyaṃ hiṅgu sauvarcalaṃ viḍam | mātuluṅgasya bījāni tathā śyāmorubūkayoḥ ||127|| bṛhatyāḥ kaṇṭakāryāśca kvāthaṃ śūlaharaṃ pibet |128|

kvāthamāha- nāgaraṃ dīpyakamityādi| nāgarādikvāthaṃ hiṅgusaurvacalaviḍaprakṣepaṃ pibediti piṇḍārthaḥ| bījānītiśabdo mātuluṅgādibhiḥ kaṇṭakārīparyantaiḥ saha sambadhyate| śyāmā vṛddhadārakaḥ| urubūkaḥ raktairaṇḍaḥ, śuklairaṇḍamapare| bṛhatī aṇuphalā sthūlaphalā vā||127||-

ab.seg: vacā sauvarcalaṃ hiṅgu kuṣṭhaṃ sātiviṣā'bhayā ||128||
kuṭajasya ca bījāni sadyaḥśūlaharāṇi tu | virecane `virecanaṃ' iti pā. prayuñjīta jñātvā doṣabalābalam ||129||

kukṣiśūle virecanamāha- vacetyādi| vacādīni kuṭajabījāntāni sadyaḥśūlaharāṇi virecane doṣabalābalaṃ jñātvā prayuñjīteti piṇḍārthaḥ| doṣabalābalamityatrādiśabdo lupto draṣṭavyaḥ, tena prakṛtyādīnapi jñātvetyarthaḥ||128-129||

div.ab: snehabastīnnirūhāṃśca kuryāddoṣanibarhaṇān |130|
kiṃ kukṣiśūle virecanameva yujyate utānyadapītyāha- snehabastīnityādi|130|-
upanāhāḥ snehasekā dhānyāmlapariṣecanam ||130|| avagāhāśca śasyante yaccānyadapi taddhitam |131|

ab.seg: kukṣiśūle upanāhādisvedasya praśastatvamāha- upanāhā ityādi| upanāhāḥ sālvaṇāprakārāḥ| dhānyāmlaṃ kāñjikam| avagāho vātaharadravapūrṇadroṇyādinimajjanam| yaccānyadapītyādi| taddhitaṃ kukṣiśūlahitaṃ yadanyadapi bhavati tadasya śasyate ityarthaḥ||130||
kaphapittāvaruddhastu māruto rasamūrcchitaḥ ||131||
hṛdisthaḥ kurute śūlamucchvāsārodhakaṃ `ucchvāsarodhakaṃ' iti pā. param | sa hṛcchūla iti khyāto rasamārutasambhavaḥ ||132||

hṛcchūlamāha- kaphetyādi| avaruddho ruddhaḥ| rasamūrcchito rasasaṃyutaḥ| ucchvāsārodhakaṃ ucchvāsasya āsamantādrodhakamityarthaḥ| etaddhṛcchūlaṃ yasmāddhṛdrogavilakṣaṇaṃ tasmāddhṛdrogādbhinnaṃ, tathā samprāptibhedācca||131-132||

div.ab: tatrāpi karmābhihitaṃ yaduktaṃ hṛdvikāriṇām |133|
hṛcchūle hṛdrogoktāṃ kriyāmatidiśannāha- tatrāpi karmābhihitamityādi| yaddhṛdvikāriṇāṃ hṛdrogiṇāṃ karmoktaṃ tadatrāpi hṛcchūle'bhihitamiti piṇḍārthaḥ|133|-

ab.seg: saṃrodhāt kupito vāyurbastimāvṛtya tiṣṭhati ||133||
bastivaṅkṣaṇanābhīṣu tataḥ śūlo'sya jāyate | viṇmūtravātasaṃrodhī bastiśūlaḥ sa mārutāt `sañjñitaḥ' iti pā.||134||
bastiśūlamāha- saṃrodhādityādi| saṃrodhāt mūtrapurīṣādīnāmityarthaḥ| bastiḥ mūtrādhāraḥ, vaṅkṣaṇaḥ gaṇḍakaḥ||133-134||
nābhyāṃ vaṅkṣaṇapārśveṣu kukṣau meḍhrāntramardakaḥ | mūtramāvṛtya gṛhṇāti mūtraśūlaḥ sa mārutāt `sañjñitaḥ' iti pā.||135||

mūtraśūlamāha- nābhyāmityādi| yadā meḍhrāntramardako vāyurāvṛtya avarudhya mūtraṃ gṛhṇāti ‘yadā meḍhrāntramardaka iti meḍhre mūtrāntraṃ meḍhrāntraṃ, tadgṛhṇāti yaḥ sarvathā evaṃvidho vāyurāvṛtya' iti pā., tadā nābhyādiṣu śūlo jāyate| sa ca mārutāt mūtraśūlo jñeyaḥ||135||
vāyuḥ prakupito yasya rūkṣāhārasya dehinaḥ | malaṃ ruṇaddhi koṣṭhasthaṃ mandīkṛtya tu pāvakam ||136||
śūlaṃ sañjanayaṃstīvraṃ srotāṃsyāvṛtya tasya hi | dakṣiṇaṃ yadi vā vāmaṃ kukṣimādāya jāyate ||137||
sarvatra vardhate kṣipraṃ bhramannatha `śūlaṃ tatra saghoṣavat' iti pā. saghoṣavān | pipāsā vardhate tīvrā bhramo mūrcchā ca jāyate ||138||
uccārito mūtritaśca na śāntimadhigacchati | viṭśūlametajjānīyādbhiṣak paramadāruṇam ||139||

purīṣaśūlamāha- vāyurityādi| evambhūtasya dehino vahniṃ mandīkṛtya srotāṃsi cāvṛtya prakupito vāyustīvraṃ śūlaṃ sañjanayan koṣṭhasthaṃ malaṃ ruṇaddhi, tasya ca dakṣiṇaṃ vāmaṃ vā kukṣiṃ gṛhītvā śūlāya `śūlo jāyate' iti pā. jāyate, sa ca sarvatra bhraman ghoṣavān śabdayukto vardhate iti piṇḍārthaḥ| uccāritaḥ sañjātapurīṣavegaḥ| nādhigacchati na prāpnoti| paramadāruṇam atiśayakaṣṭakāri||136-139||
kṣipraṃ doṣaharaṃ kāryaṃ bhiṣajā sādhu jānatā | svedanaṃ śamanaṃ caiva nirūhāḥ snehabastayaḥ ||140||
pūrvoddiṣṭān pāyayeta yogān koṣṭhaviśodhanān | udāvartaharāścāsya kriyāḥ sarvāḥ sukhāvahāḥ ||141||
idānīṃ bastiśūladīnāṃ sāmānyacikitsāmāha- kṣipramityādi| doṣaharaṃ śodhanam| sādhu śobhanam| śamanaṃ saṃśamanam||140-141||
atimātraṃ yadā bhuktaṃ pāvake mṛdutāṃ gate | sthirībhūtaṃ tu tatkoṣṭhe vāyurāvṛtya tiṣṭhati ||142||
avipākagataṃ hyannaṃ śūlaṃ tīvraṃ karotyati | mūrcchā''dhmānaṃ vidāhaśca hṛdutkleśo vilambikā ||143||
viricyate chardayati kampate'tha vimuhyati | avipākādbhavecchūlastvannadoṣasamudbhavaḥ ||144||
atimātramityādi| avipākagatam avipākaṃ prāptam||142-144||
vamanaṃ laṅghanaṃ svedaḥ pācanaṃ phalavartayaḥ | kṣārāścūrṇāni `kṣāracūrṇāni' iti pā. guṭikāḥ śasyante śūlanāśanāḥ ||145||
tasya cikitsitamāha- vamanamityādi||145||
gulmāvasthāḥ kriyāḥ kāryā yathāvat sarvaśūlinām ||146||
idanīmupasaṃhāramāha- gulmāvasthā ityādi| yathāvat yathāvastham||146||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāya cikitsātantre gulmapratiṣedho nāma (caturtho'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) dvicatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||42||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāmuttaratantre kāyacikitsāyāṃ gulmapratiṣedho nāma dvicatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||42||

div.head: hṛdrogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto hṛdrogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
gulmapratiṣedhānantaraṃ sthānasāmīpyānnāmasaṅkīrtanādvā hṛdrogapratiṣedho yukta ityata āha- athāta ityādi||1-2||
vegāghātoṣṇarūkṣānnairatimātropasevitaiḥ | viruddhādhyaśanājīrṇairasātmyaiścāpi(ti) bhojanaiḥ ||3||
dūṣayitvā rasaṃ doṣā viguṇā hṛdayaṃ gatāḥ | kurvanti hṛdaye bādhāṃ hṛdrogaṃ taṃ pracakṣate ||4||

idānīṃ pratijñānantaraṃ pūrvavaddhṛdrogasya hetusamprāptī āha- vegetyādi| etairvegāghātādihetubhirviguṇāḥ kupitā doṣā hṛdayaṃ gatvā rasaṃ dūṣayitvā hṛdaye bādhāṃ kurvanti, taṃ hṛdrogaṃ pracakṣate ācāryā iti sambandhaḥ| vegāghāta ityatra āghātaśabdo dvirāvartayitavyaḥ, tena vegāghāta āghātaśca; tatra vegāghāto vegāvarodhaḥ, āghāto laguḍādiprahāraḥ| viruddhaṃ hitāhitīyoktam, adhyaśanaṃ sājīrṇabhojanam, ajīrṇam āmavidagdhādikam| bādhāgrahaṇaṃ bādhāvaicitryajñāpanārtham| vegāghātādirasātmyabhojanānto hetuḥ, dūṣayitvetyādikā samprāptiḥ| hṛdroge pūrvarūpānabhidhānamavyaktalakṣaṇānāmeva pūrvarūpatvenābhimatatvāt; anye jātimātraparicchedāt pūrvarūpāvagamaḥ||3-4||
caturvidhaḥ sa doṣaiḥ syāt kṛmibhiśca `pañcamaḥ krimibhistathā| pṛthagliṅgaṃ pravakṣyāmi' iti pā. pṛthak pṛthak | lakṣaṇaṃ tasya vakṣyāmi cikitsitamanantaram ||5||

tasya saṅkhyāmāha- caturvidha ityādi| sa hṛdrogaḥ| doṣaiḥ ekaikaiḥ sannipatitaiśca, kṛmibhiriti kṛmibhiḥ sahetyarthaḥ| nanu, tantrāntare pañca hṛdrogāḥ paṭhitāḥ, tat kathamatra catvāraḥ? satyaṃ, tridoṣahṛdrogottarāvasthaiva kṛmihṛdrogaḥ, tena na pañca hṛdrogāḥ| pṛthak pṛthagityādi| anantaraṃ lakṣaṇānantaramityarthaḥ||5||
āyamyate mārutaje hṛdayaṃ tudyate pīḍyate' iti pā. tathā | nirmathyate dīryate ca sphoṭyate pāṭyate'pi ca ||6||
vātikahṛdrogalakṣaṇamāha- āyamyata ityādi| āyamyate dīrghīkriyata iva, mārutaje hṛdroge, tudyate pratodena vyathyata iva, nirmathyate viloḍyata iva, dīryate ārayeva, pāṭyate dvidhā kriyata iva||6||
tṛṣṇoṣādāhacoṣāḥ syuḥ paittike hṛdayaklamaḥ | dhūmāyanaṃ mūrcchā ca svedaḥ śoṣo mukhasya ca ||7||
paittikahṛdrogalakṣaṇamāha- tṛṣṇetyādi| ūṣā prādeśiko dāhaḥ| coṣaḥ cūṣyata iva vedanāviśeṣaḥ| paittike pittaje hṛdroge| dhūmāyanaṃ dhūmodvamanamiva||7||
