gauravaṃ kaphasaṃsrāvo'ruciḥ stambho'gnimārdavam | mādhuryamapi cā''syasya balāsāvatate hṛdi ||8||
ślaiṣmikahṛdrogalakṣaṇamāha- gauravamityādi| stambho jaḍimā| balāsāvatate śleṣmacchanne||8||
utkleśaḥ ṣṭhīvanaṃ todaḥ śūlo hṛllāsakastamaḥ | aruciḥ śyāvanetratvaṃ śoṣaśca kṛmije bhavet ||9||

tridoṣajahṛdrogalakṣaṇamāha- utkleśa ityādi| ṣṭhīvanaṃ thūtkaraṇam| hṛllāso lālāsrutiḥ| tamaḥ andhakāradarśanaṃ śvāso vā| tama ityatra ‘sānnipātike bhavet’ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ| tatra todaśūlau vātena, utkleśahṛllāsaṣṭhīvanāni śleṣmaṇā, tamaḥ pitteneti| kecit ‘aruciḥ śyāvanetratvaṃ śoṣaśca kṛmije bhavet’ ityantaṃ sānnipātikahṛdrogalakṣaṇaṃ manyante| tridoṣajahṛdrogasyaivāpacārāt krimīn prāptasya lakṣaṇamāha- arucirityādi| kṛmije iti tridoṣajahṛdroga evāpacāreṇottarāvasthāyāṃ kṛminipātāt kṛmija ityucyate| tathā ca tantrāntaram- “tridoṣaje tu hṛdroge yo durātmā niṣevate| tilakṣīraguḍādīni granthistasyopajāyate|| marmaikadeśe saṅkledaṃ rasaścāpyupagacchati| saṅkledāt kṛmayaścāsya bhavantyupahatātmanaḥ”- iti, ato na saṅkhyātirekaḥ| kecit sānnipātiko hṛdrogo vyādhisvabhāvānna bhavatyevetyāhuḥ; tanna, samānatantre tridoṣajadarśanāt||9||

div.ab: bhramaklamau sādaśoṣau jñeyāsteṣāmupadravāḥ |10|

vātādijānāṃ kṛmihīnānāṃ hṛdrogiṇāmupadravānāha- bhrametyādi| bhramaḥ cakrārūḍhasyeva bhramaṇaṃ, klamaḥ anāyāsaḥ śramaḥ| sādaḥ aṅgasādaḥ| śoṣo mukhasya dhātūnāṃ ca| yadyapi bhramādayo vātapittātmakāstathā'pi vyādhisvabhāvācchlaiṣmike'pi bhavanti|10|-

ab.seg: kṛmije kṛmijātīnāṃ ślaiṣmikāṇāṃ ca ye matāḥ ||10||
kṛmijasyopadravānāha- kṛmije kṛmijātīnāmityādi| ślaiṣmikāṇāmiti kṛmijātīnāmityasya viśeṣaṇam| tena ślaiṣmikāṇāṃ kṛmijātīnāṃ ya eva upadravāsta eva kṛmije hṛdroge matā ityarthaḥ||10||
vātopasṛṣṭe hṛdaye vāmayet snigdhamāturam | dvipañcamūlakvāthena sasnehalavaṇena tu ||11||
pippalyelāvacāhiṅguyavabhasmāni saindhavam | sauvarcalamatho śuṇṭhīmajamodāṃ ca cūrṇitam ||12||
phaladhānyāmlakaulatthadadhimadyāsavādibhiḥ | pāyayeta viśuddhaṃ ca snehenānyatamena vā ||13||

idānīṃ vātahṛdrogacikitsāmāha- vātopasṛṣṭe ityādi| vātopasṛṣṭe hṛdaye vātahṛdroge ityarthaḥ| yadyapi vāte vamanaṃ na śastaṃ, tathā'pi vātasya kaphasthānagaṇatvādatra vamanaṃ śastameva, tathā pittaje'pi| vamanānantaraṃ yat kāryaṃ tadāha- pippalītyādi| yavabhasma yavakṣāraḥ| phalāni mātuluṅgādiphalāni, teṣāṃ raso'bhipretaḥ| madyāsavau madyavargoktau| snehenānyatamena vā catuḥsnehamadhye ekena snehenetyarthaḥ||11-13||
bhojayejjīrṇaśālyannaṃ jāṅgalaiḥ saghṛtai rasaiḥ | vātaghnasiddhaṃ tailaṃ ca dadyādbastiṃ pramāṇataḥ ||14||
vātahṛdroge pathyamāha- bhojayedityādi| kiṃ vātahṛdroge etadeva kāryamutānyadapītyāha- vātaghnasiddhamityādi| vātaghnasiddhaṃ bhadradārvādipakvam| pramāṇataḥ yathāpramāṇam||14||

div.ab: śrīparṇīmadhukakṣaudrasitotpalajalairvamet | pittopasṛṣṭe hṛdaye seveta madhuraiḥ śṛtam ||15|| ghṛtaṃ kaṣāyāṃścoddiṣṭān pittajvaravināśanān |16|

pittahṛdroge vamanamāha- śrīparṇītyādi| śrīparṇī kāśmarī, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu, sitā śarkarā, utpalaṃ kuṣṭham| atra jalaśabdo na kvāthatvena sarvatra sambandhanīyaḥ, kṣaudrādīnāṃ kvāthe'nupayogāt| seveta madhurairityādi| madhuraiḥ śṛtaṃ kākolyādibhiḥ pakvam| pittajvaravināśanān kaṣāyān ‘candanośīraśrīparṇī’- ityādinoktān||15||-
tṛptasya ca rasairmukhyairmadhuraiḥ `jāṅgalaiḥ' iti pā. saghṛtairbhiṣak ||16|| sakṣaudraṃ vitaredbastau `vitaredbasti' iti pā. tailaṃ madhukasādhitam |17|
pittahṛdroge snehabastimāha- tṛptasyetyādi| rasairmukhyaiḥ eṇādimāṃsarasaiḥ| madhuraiḥ amlādisaṃskṛtaiḥ| madhukasādhitamekenaiva yaṣṭīmadhukena pakvaṃ; anye jīvanīyasādhitamāhuḥ||16||-

ab.seg: vacānimbakaṣāyābhyāṃ vāntaṃ hṛdi kaphātmake ||17||
cūrṇaṃ tu pāyayetoktaṃ vātaje bhojayecca bhojayeddhṛtam' iti pā. tam | phalādimatha mustādiṃ triphalāṃ vā pibennaraḥ ||18||
śyāmātrivṛtkalkayutaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā'pi virecanam | balātailairvidadhyācca `balatailaṃ vidadhyāt' iti pā. bastiṃ bastiviśāradaḥ ||19||

ślaiṣmikahṛdroge cikitsāmāha- vacetyādi| śleṣmahṛdroge vacānimbakaṣāyābhyāṃ vāntaṃ vātaje hṛdroge uktaṃ ‘cūrṇaṃ pippalyelā’- ityādikaṃ pāyayediti piṇḍārthaḥ| na kevalaṃ taccūrṇaṃ pāyayet bhojayecca tamiti taṃ vātaje hṛdroge uktaṃ cūrṇaṃ bhojayecca bhaktena saha khādedityarthaḥ| phalādimatha mustādimityādi|- phalādiḥ madanaphalādiḥ saṃśodhanasaṃśamanīyoktaḥ| mustādiḥ dravyasaṅgrahaṇīyoktaḥ| śyāmātrivṛtkalkayutamityādi|- śyāmā vṛddhadārakaḥ| atra pibediti sambadhyate| balātailairityādi| vātādicikitsitaṃ sarvamevānuktamapi tridoṣaje kāryam||17-19||
kṛmihṛdrogiṇaṃ snigdhaṃ bhojayet piśitaudanam | dadhnā ca palalopetaṃ tryahaṃ, paścādvirecayet ||20||
sugandhibhiḥ salavaṇairyogaiḥ sājājiśarkaraiḥ | viḍaṅgagāḍhaṃ dhānyāmlaṃ pāyayetāpyanantaram ||21||
hṛdayasthāḥ patantyevamadhastāt krimayo nṛṇām | yavānnaṃ vitareccāsya saviḍaṅgamataḥ param ||22||

kṛmihṛdrogacikitsāmāha- kṛmihṛdrogiṇamityādi| piśitaudanaṃ sapalalaṃ dadhnā saha krimihṛdrogiṇaṃ tryahaṃ bhojayet kṛmīṇāmutkleśanārthaṃ; piśitaṃ māṃsaṃ, palalopetaṃ bhṛṣṭatilacūrṇayuktam| krimyutkleśānantaraṃ kiṃ kuryādityāha- paścādityādi| sugandhibhiryogaiḥ virecanakalpoktaiḥ ‘śarkarākṣaudrasaṃyuktaṃ’ ityādibhiḥ| salavaṇairyogairiti ‘samāstrivṛnnāgarakābhayāḥ syuḥ’ ityādibhiḥ| sājājiśarkarairiti sugandhiyogasalavaṇayogaviśeṣaṇaṃ, sājājikānāṃ vairecanikānāmanirdeśāt; tena, ajājiśarkarāsahitaiḥ sugandhibhiryogairathavā salavaṇairapyajādiyuktairvirecayet| pītavirekasyānupānamāha- viḍaṅgagāḍhamityādi| viḍaṅgagāḍhaṃ viḍaṅgotkaṭam| dhānyāmlaṃ kāñjikam| evaṃ pūrvoktena vidhānena| kecit ‘salavaṇaiḥ’ ityatra ‘sapalalaiḥ’ iti paṭhitvā sabhṛṣṭatilakalkaiḥ sugandhibhiryogairvirecayediti vyākhyānayanti| kṛmihṛdroge vamanaṃ na yojyaṃ, kṛmijarjarahṛdayatvāt; ata eva sugandhiyogairvirecanamuktaṃ, vamanaśaṅkābhayāt| dhānyāmlapānādanantaraṃ `virecanādanantaraṃ' iti pā. kiṃ kuryādityāha- yavānnaṃ vitaredityādi| vitaret dadyāt| ata iti virekāt||20-22||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre hṛdrogapratiṣedho nāma (pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||43||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre hṛdrogapratiṣedho nāma tricatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||43||

div.head: pāṇḍurogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ pāṇḍurogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

hṛdrogapratiṣedhānantaraṃ saṅkhyāsāmyāt tīkṣṇāmlakaṭukādihṛdrogacikitsitasya hetutvāt pāṇḍurogapratiṣedhārambho yukta ityāha- athāta ityādi| atrādiśabdadvayaṃ luptaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ, tena pāṇḍvādirogādipratiṣedhamiti| tatra prathamenādiśabdena kṛṣṇapītamiśrā varṇā grāhyāḥ, kāmalādayo dvitīyena; apare tu pāṇḍuvarṇādhikyāt sarve eva pāṇḍurogāḥ procyanta iti matvā ekamevādiśabdaṃ luptaṃ varṇayanti; te ca ādiśabdāt kāmalādīn gṛhṇanti| apare tvādiśabdaṃ vinā'pi kāmalādīn gṛhṇanti, pāṇḍurogāntarbhāvātteṣāmiti||1-2||
vyavāyamamlaṃ lavaṇāni madyaṃ mṛdaṃ divāsvapnamatīva tīkṣṇam | niṣevamāṇasya vidūṣya raktaṃ kurvanti doṣāstvaci pāṇḍubhāvam ||3||

pāṇḍurogasya hetusamprāptī āha- vyavāyamamlamityādi| vyavāyādīni niṣevamāṇasya puruṣasya duṣṭā doṣā raktaṃ vidūṣya tvaci pāṇḍubhāvaṃ kurvantīti piṇḍārthaḥ| vyavāyaḥ strīsevā, sa ca sarvadoṣaprakopakaḥ, anye tu vātapittaprakopakatvaṃ vyavāyasya manyante bhāraharaṇādau krodhādau ca tatpāṭhāt| amlalavaṇayoḥ pittakaphakaratvam| mṛttikā sarvadoṣaprakopaṇī, nānāvidhatvāt; tathā coktam,- “kaṣāyā mārutaṃ, pittamūṣarā, madhurā kapham| kopayenmṛdrasādīṃśca raukṣyādbhuktaṃ virūkṣayet”- iti| divāsvapnaḥ tridoṣaprakopakaḥ| tīkṣṇaṃ pittakopi| evaṃ yathāsvaṃ yathāsambhavaṃ heturuktaḥ| vidūṣya raktamityādikā samprāptiḥ| atīva tīkṣṇamityatra ādiśabdo lupto draṣṭavyaḥ; tena piṣṭapayomāṣatilādīnāṃ grahaṇam| kecit ‘mṛnmadyamatsyāmiṣatīkṣṇapiṣṭapayodivāsvapnatilekṣumāṣān| niṣevamāṇasya’- iti paṭhanti, śeṣaṃ samam| te'pi luptādiśabdāt vyavāyādīni gṛhṇanti| apare ‘atīva tīkṣṇam’ ityatra ‘atīvarūkṣam’ iti paṭhanti||3||

div.ab: pāṇḍvāmayo'ṣṭārdhavidhaḥ pradiṣṭaḥ pṛthaksamastairyugapacca doṣaiḥ |4|

saṅkhyāmāha- pāṇḍvityādi| aṣṭārdhavidhiḥ caturvidhaḥ; kathaṃ caturvidha ityāha- pṛthagityādi| pṛthagdoṣaiḥ trayaḥ, samastaiḥ ekaḥ| yugapaditi padaṃ doṣatrayasyaikakālaprakopasūcanārtham| yadyapi tantrāntare mṛjjaḥ pāṇḍurogaḥ pañcamaḥ kathitaḥ, tathā'pyatra mṛjjastridoṣaja evāntarbhūtaḥ, vakṣyamāṇāśca kāmalādayaḥ pāṇḍurogasyaiva paryāyāḥ; ato'tra catvāra eva| kecit pāṇḍvāmayastvaṣṭavidha iti paṭhanti| tanmate pṛthagdoṣaiḥ trayaḥ, samastaiḥ ekaḥ, mṛdbhakṣaṇāt ekaḥ, dve kāmale ca, eko halīmakaḥ, evaṃ pāṇḍurogo'ṣṭavidhaḥ| tathā ca tantrāntaram- “vātena pittena kaphena cāpi tridoṣamṛdbhakṣaṇasambhavaḥ syāt| dve kāmale caikahalīmakaśca sa cāṣṭadhaivaṃ tviha pāṇḍurogaḥ”- iti|4|-

ab.seg: sarveṣu caiteṣviha pāṇḍubhāvo yato'dhiko'taḥ khalu pāṇḍurogaḥ ||4||
yadyapi vātādibhedena kṛṣṇādivarṇatvamabhidhāsyati, tathā'pyasya vikārasya pāṇḍuvarṇādhikyāt pāṇḍurogavyapadeśa iti darśayannāha- sarveṣu caiteṣviha pāṇḍubhāva ityādi||4||
tvaksphoṭanaṃ ṣṭhīvanagātrasādau mṛdbhakṣaṇaṃ prekṣaṇakūṭaśothaḥ | viṇmūtrapītatvamathāvipāko bhaviṣyatastasya puraḥsarāṇi ||5||

idānīṃ pāṇḍurogapūrvarūpāṇyāha- tvagityādi| tvaksphoṭaḥ tvacāṃ sphuṭanam| ṣṭhīvanaṃ thūtkaraṇam| yadyapyatra mṛdbhakṣaṇaṃ kathitaṃ, tathā'pi mṛdbhakṣaṇe icchā gamyate| prekṣaṇam akṣi| avipāka āhārasya| puraḥsarāṇi agresarāṇi||5||

sa kāmalāpānakipāṇḍurogaḥ kumbhāhvayo lāghara(va)ko'lasākhyaḥ | vibhāṣyate lakṣaṇamasya kṛtsnaṃ nibodha vakṣyāmyanupūrvaśastat `tam' iti pā.| `atra kāmaleti kāmaśabdo'yaṃ sādhāraṇaśabdaviśeṣātsvalpe bhaktādyabhilāṣe pravartate, taṃ lātīti kāmalā| duṣṭatvena kutsito'pāno'pānakaḥ, so'syāstīti apānakī, kāmalakākhyo'pānakipāṇḍurogaḥ kāmalāpānakipāṇḍurogaḥ| kumbhakāmalakākhyo'pānakipāṇḍurogastvatra kumbhāhvaya ucyate, bhīmo bhīmasena itivat| rogasyāsya kumbhakāmaleti sañjñā tantrāntare upadiśyate| sa eva punarjvarādibhirlāghavaṃ karoti, satyapi sāmarthyo karmasvanutsāhaṃ ca janayatītyalasākhyo'pānakipāṇḍurogastu lāghavaka ucyate’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ||6||

tasyaiva pāṇḍurogasya paryāyānāha- sa ityādi| sa rogaḥ kāmalādikābhiḥ sañjñābhirvibhāṣyate vividhaṃ bhāṣyate| asyeti kāmalādiparyāyairnirdiṣṭasya rogasya| anupūrvaśaḥ pūrvaṃ pūrvamanupūrveṇetyarthaḥ| taṃ pāṇḍurogam||6||
kṛṣṇekṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇasirāvanaddhaṃ tadvarṇaviṇmūtranakhānanaṃ ca | vātena pāṇḍuṃ manujaṃ vyavasyedyuktaṃ tathā'nyaistadupadravaiśca ||7||
vātikapāṇḍurogalakṣaṇamāha- kṛṣṇekṣaṇamityādi| kṛṣṇekṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇākṣikam| tadvarṇaviṇmūtranakhānanaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaviṇmūtranakhamityarthaḥ| tadupadravaiḥ vātopadravaiḥ||7||
pītekṣaṇaṃ pītasirāvanaddhaṃ tadvarṇaviṇmūtranakhānanaṃ ca | pittena pāṇḍuṃ manujaṃ vyavasyedyuktaṃ tathā'nyaistadupadravaiśca ||8||
paittikapāṇḍurogalakṣaṇamāha- pītetyādi| tadvarṇaṃ pītavarṇam| tadupadravaiḥ pittopadravairityarthaḥ||8||
śuklekṣaṇaṃ śuklasirāvanaddhaṃ tadvarṇaviṇmūtranakhānanaṃ ca | kaphena pāṇḍuṃ manujaṃ vyavasyedyuktaṃ tathā'nyaistadupadravaiśca ||9||
ślaiṣmikapāṇḍurogalakṣaṇamāha- śukletyādi| tadvarṇaṃ śuklavarṇaṃ, tadupadravaiḥ kaphopadravaiḥ||9||

div.ab: sarvātmake sarvamidaṃ vyavasyed... |10|
sānnipātikapāṇḍurogalakṣaṇamāha- sarvātmake sarvamidamityādi| sarvātmake sānnipātike pāṇḍuroge, sarvaṃ samastam, idaṃ vātādija pāṇḍurogalakṣaṇaṃ, vyavasyet jānīyāt|10|-

... vakṣyāmi liṅgānyatha kāmalāyāḥ | yo hyāmayānte sahasā'nnamamlamadyādapathyāni ca tasya pittam ||10|| karoti pāṇḍuṃ vadanaṃ viśeṣāt pūrveritau `tandrāvilatvaṃ prathamoditāṃśca' iti pā. tandribalakṣayau ca |11|

idānīṃ pāṇḍurogaparyāyabhūtāyā api kāmalāyā lakṣaṇamāha- vakṣyāmītyādi| nanu, yadi pāṇḍurogasya paryāyaḥ kāmalā, tat kathaṃ tasya lakṣaṇānyuktāni? satyaṃ, yathā pāṇḍurogāṇāṃ vātādijānāṃ pratisvaṃ bhedo vidyate tathā'syāpīti na doṣaḥ; etena kāmalādīnāṃ sañjñānāṃ viśiṣṭāvasthāviṣayatvādviśiṣṭatvaṃ, paryāyatvaṃ pāṇḍurogatvāparityāgāt| tānyeva liṅgānyāha- ya ityādi| ‘vakṣyāmi liṅgānyatha kāmalāyā’ ityabhidhāya kāmalākāraṇavacanaṃ bhaviṣyantyā api tasyāḥ parijñānārtham| āmayānte pāṇḍurogānte anyarogānte ca| sahasā śīghram| annamamlam amlabhojanam| pāṇḍumityatra dehamiti śeṣaḥ| ‘pūrveritau tandribalakṣayau ca’ iti śārīrasthāne garbhavyākaraṇādhyāye tandrā kathitā, sūtrasthāne doṣādikṣayavṛddhyadhyāye balakṣaya ityarthaḥ| nanu, tandrāśabdasya vyutpāditatvāt kathaṃ tandribalakṣayāviti? satyaṃ, kṛṣyāderākṛtigaṇatvenekpratyayāntatvena sādhu| anye ‘tandrā'balatvaṃ prathamoditaṃ ca’ iti paṭhanti; tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ| apare 'prathamoditāṃśca' iti paṭhanti; te ca pāṇḍurogoktaliṅgaviśeṣān gṛhṇanti| ‘pāṇḍuvadanam’ ityatra ‘pītavadanam’ iti kecit paṭhanti, taṃ cānārṣaṃ ṭīkākārā bhāṣante||10||-

ab.seg: bhedastu tasyāḥ khalu kumbhasāhvaḥ śopho mahāṃstatra ca parvabhedaḥ ||11||
idānīṃ kāmalābhedamāha- bheda ityādi| tatreti kumbhasāhve| parvabhedaḥ sandhipīḍā| kumbhasāhvaḥ tantrāntare kumbhakāmaleti kathyate||11||

div.ab: jvarāṅgamardabhramasādatandrākṣayānvito lāghara(va)ko'lasākhyaḥ |12|

tasyaiva kumbhasāhvasyāvasthāyāṃ sañjñāntaramāha- jvarāṅgamardetyādi| sa eva kumbhasāhvo jvarādiyukto lāgharako'lasākhyaḥ syāditi piṇḍārthaḥ| lāgharakaḥ kathyate alasakaśca kathyata ityarthaḥ| aṅgamardo vedanāviśeṣaḥ, sphuṭaniketyapare| anye pāṇḍuroga eva jvarādiyuktaḥ kumbhasāhvaḥ kathyata iti manyante| asyaiva avasthābhedaṃ `avasthāviśeṣaḥ pānakīti' iti pā. pānakīti tantrāntarīyāḥ paṭhanti| tadyathā- “santāpo bhinnavarcastvaṃ bahirantaśca pītatā| pāṇḍutā netrarogaśca pānakīlakṣaṇaṃ vadet”- iti|12|-

ab.seg: taṃ vātapittāddharipītanīlaṃ `vāta pittābhiparītaliṅga' iti pā. halīmakaṃ nāma vadanti tajjñāḥ ||12||

idānīṃ halīmakalakṣaṇamāha- tamityādi| taṃ pāṇḍurogam| kumbhasāhvo yadā haritapītanīlaḥ syāt, tadā tajjñāḥ kāyacikitsāvido halīmakaṃ nāma vadanti| hari haritaṃ, nīlaṃ śyāvam| kecittu ‘taṃ vātapittābhiparītaliṅgaṃ’ iti paṭhitvā vātapittābhyāmabhiparītaṃ sambaddhaṃ liṅgaṃ yasya tatheti vyākhyānayanti||12||
upadravāsteṣvaruciḥ pipāsā chardirjvaro mūrdharujā'gnisādaḥ | śophastathā kaṇṭhagato'balatvaṃ mūrcchā klamo hṛdyavapīḍanaṃ ca ||13||
idānīṃ pāṇḍurogopadravānāha- upadravā ityādi| teṣu pāṇḍurogeṣu| mūrdharujā śirovyathā| abalatvaṃ nirbalatvam| sopadravasya pāṇḍurogasya kṛcchrasādhyatvamasādhyatvaṃ ca yathāvasthaṃ boddhavyam||13||
sādhyaṃ tu pāṇḍvāmayinaṃ samīkṣya snigdhaṃ ghṛtenordhvamadhaśca śuddham | sampādayet kṣaudraghṛtapragāḍhairharītakīcūrṇayutaiḥ prayogaiḥ ||14||
pibedghṛtaṃ vā rajanīvipakvaṃ yattraiphalaṃ tailvakameva vā'pi | virecanadravyakṛtaṃ pibedvā yogāṃśca vairecanikān ghṛtena ||15||

idānīṃ cikitsitamāha- sādhyamityādi| sādhyapāṇḍurogajñānaṃ vakṣyamāṇāsādhyalakṣaṇaviparyayādariṣṭalakṣaṇavaiparītyācca| ghṛteneti kaṭvarakalyāṇakadādhikamahātiktapañcagavyādinā, anye kevalenaiva gavyaghṛtenetyāhuḥ| yadatra pāṇḍurogeṣu ghṛtenaiva snehanamuktaṃ tatteṣāṃ pittabhūyiṣṭhatvādraktadūṣyatvācca| yadyapi pāṇḍuroge ūrdhvaśodhanaṃ niṣiddhaṃ, tathā'pi ṛtudeśaprakṛtikālaśarīrāpekṣayā mṛdu vamanaṃ deyam| tathā ca tantrāntaram,- “kālaṃ ca deśaprakṛtī śarīraṃ samīkṣya dadyādvamanaṃ vidhijñaḥ| vāntasya tīkṣṇānyanulomanāni kalpopadiṣṭāni bhiṣagvidadhyāt”- iti| vamanānantaraṃ vakṣyamāṇaiḥ śāliprabhṛtibhiḥ kṛtasaṃsarjanakramasya doṣaśamanārthamāha- sampādayedityādi| śuddhaṃ pāṇḍurogiṇamevambhūtaiḥ prayogairvakṣyamāṇayogaiḥ śeṣadoṣaśamanārthaṃ sampādayet samyak yojayedityarthaḥ| nanu, sarpirmadhuharītakīyuktamekamevāyorajoyogamabhidhāsyati, tat kathaṃ prayogairiti bahuvacanaṃ? satyaṃ, pradeśāntaroktānāṃ navāyasaprabhṛtīnāmatra śastatvāt| pibedghṛtaṃ vetyādi| rajanīvipakvaṃ haridrākalkasādhitam|traiphalaṃ triphalāsādhitam| tailvakamiti tilvakaḥ paṭṭikārodhraḥ, tena sādhitamityarthaḥ; anye tailvakaṃ vātavyādhyuktamāhuḥ| virecanadravyakṛtamityādi|- trivṛdādisaṃskṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ; vairecanikān yogān virecanadravyavikalpoktān, tāṃśca ghṛtena pibet||14-15||
mūtre nikumbhārdhapalaṃ vipācya pibedabhīkṣṇaṃ kuḍavārdhamātram | khādedguḍaṃ vā'pyabhayāvipakvamāragvadhādikvathitaṃ `abhayāvimiśraṃ' iti pā. pibedvā ||16||

idānīṃ pāṇḍuroge'parāṇyapi virecanānyāha- mūtre ityādi| nikumbhā dantī, tasyā ardhapalaṃ mahiṣīmūtre ṣoḍaśaguṇe vipācya, caturbhāgāvaśiṣṭaṃ kuḍavārdhamātraṃ paladvayamātraṃ, virekāya pibedityarthaḥ| guḍa ikṣuvikṛtiḥ| abhayāvipakvaṃ harītakīkvāthavipakvaṃ, anye abhayāvipakvaṃ guḍakaṃ saharītakīprabhṛtikamāhuḥ| apare ‘abhayāvimiśram’ iti paṭhanti| muhurvairecanikayoganirdeśāt `bahuvirekayoganirdeśāt' iti pā. pāṇḍuroge virecanasyātyantahitatvaṃ jñeyam||16||
ayorajovyoṣaviḍaṅgacūrṇaṃ lihyāddharidrāṃ triphalānvitāṃ vā | sarpirmadhubhyāṃ vidadhīta vā'pi śāstrapradeśābhihitāṃśca yogān ||17||

kiṃ pāṇḍuroge pūrvoktameva kāryamutānyadapītyāha- aya ityādi| ayorajovyoṣaviḍaṅgacūrṇamityeko yogaḥ| haridrāṃ triphalānvitāmiti dvitīyo yogaḥ| ayorajo lohacūrṇam| vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukam| ‘lihyāt’ ityātra ‘madhusarpirbhyām’ iti sambandhanīyam| haridrāṃ piṇḍaharidrām| kecit haridrāśabdena ādau dāruśabdalopāt dāruharidrāṃ gṛhṇanti| vidadhīta vā'pītyādi| vidadhīta kurvīta| śāstrapradeśābhihitāṃśca yogān śāstre'nyapradeśoktān navāyasādīn||17||

div.ab: harecca doṣān bahuśo'lpamātrān śvayeddhi doṣeṣvatinirhṛteṣu |18|

idānīṃ pāṇḍuroge yat śodhanamuktaṃ tadalpamātrayā kartavyamityāha- harecca doṣānityādi| bahuśo bahūn vārān| alpamātrān stokastokān| kasmāt stokān stokān haredityāha- śvayeddhi doṣeṣvityādi| śvayet śvayathuṃ prāpnuyāt| hi yasmādarthe| atra pāṭhāntaraṃ- ‘harecca doṣān bahuśo'lpamātrān śuddheṣu doṣeṣvabhinirhṛteṣu’ iti| śuddheṣu duṣṭirahiteṣu; abhinirhṛteṣvityabhiśabdaḥ samyagarthaḥ, atiyogasyāniṣṭatvāt|18|-

ab.seg: dhātrīphalānāṃ rasamikṣujaṃ ca manthaṃ pibet kṣaudrayutaṃ hitāśī ||18||

dhātrīphalānāmityādi| dhātrīphalānāmāmalakaphalānāṃ svarasaṃ kṣaudrayutaṃ pibedityeko yogaḥ| ikṣujaṃ rasaṃ kṣaudrayutamiti dvitīyaḥ| manthamiti “śaktavaḥ sarpiṣā'bhyaktāḥ śītavāripariplutāḥ”- ityādyuktalakṣaṇaṃ kṣaudrayutamiti tṛtīyaḥ| tathā ca tantrāntaram- “pibet suśītalān manthān ghṛtāktān madhusaṃyutān| sakṣaudraṃ vā rasaṃ dhātryā ikṣorvā'pi hitāśanaḥ”- iti| tantrāntare pāṇḍuroge manthaśabdena viśiṣṭo mantha ucyate| tadyathā- “dhātrīphalarase śaktūnikṣūṇāṃ ca rase tathā| pāṇḍurmadhusamāyuktaṃ pibenmanthaṃ suśītalam”- iti||18||

div.ab: ume bṛhatyau rajanīṃ śukākhyāṃ kākādanīṃ cāpi sakākamācīm | ādāribimbīṃ sakadambapuṣpīṃ vipācya sarpirvipacet kaṣāye ||19|| tat pāṇḍutāṃ hantyupayujyamānaṃ kṣīreṇa vā māgadhikā yathāgni |20|

ume ityādi| śukākhyā carmakāravaṭaḥ, anye śukaśimbāmāhuḥ| kākādanī kākatindukaḥ| ādāribimbīṃ sakadambapuṣpīmityādi|- ādārī vellantarasadṛśapuṣpā āliriti loke, bimbī rāsnānukāriviṭapā lohitaphalā ca; kārtikakuṇḍastu ādāriśimbī āuliriti prasiddheti vyākhyānayati| kadambapuṣpī bhūmikadambaḥ, alambuṣāmapare| etāni kaṣāyakalpena vipācya, tasmin kaṣāye sarpirghṛtaṃ vipacet| kṣīreṇa vetyādi| māgadhikā vā kṣīreṇa saha yathāgni upayujyamānā paṇḍutāṃ hantītyarthaḥ||19||-

ab.seg: hitaṃ ca yaṣṭīmadhujaṃ `yaṣṭīmadhukaṃ' iti pā. kaṣāyaṃ cūrṇaṃ samaṃ vā madhunā'valihyāt ||20||

hitaṃ cetyādi| yaṣṭīmadhukakaṣāyaṃ madhunā samamityeko yogaḥ| cūrṇaṃ vā yaṣṭīmadhukasya madhunā samaṃ madhunā saha lihyāditi dvitīyaḥ| anye ‘cūrṇaṃ samaṃ vā madhunā'valihyāt’ ityatra ‘cūrṇaṃ lihedvā madhunā dvitīyam’ iti paṭhanti; tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ||20||
gomūtrayuktaṃ triphalādalānāṃ dattvā''yasaṃ cūrṇamanalpakālam | pravālamuktāñjanaśaṅkhacūrṇaṃ lihyāttathā kāñcanagairikottham ||21||

gomūtrayūktamityādi| triphalādalānāṃ cūrṇamāyasaṃ cūrṇaṃ dattvā gomūtrayuktamanalpakālaṃ cirakālaṃ lihyāt| triphalādalānāmiti dalaśabdaḥ aṣṭhīlāparihārārtham| anye ‘gomūtrayuktaṃ triphalādalānāṃ’ ityatra ‘gomūtrapītatriphalādalānāṃ’ iti paṭhanti, gomūtrabhāvitatriphalādalānāmiti vyākhyānayanti| pravāletyādi| pravālo vidrumaḥ, muktā mauktikam, añjanaṃ rasāñjanam| tatheti gomūtrayuktamanalpakālaṃ lihyādityarthaḥ| kāñcanagairikotthamityatrāpi tatheti sambadhyate; tena suvarṇagairikacūrṇaṃ gomūtrayutaṃ cirakālaṃ lihyādityarthaḥ| ‘gomūtrapītāṃ triphalāṃ sapiṣṭāṃ’ iti kecit paṭhanti, gomūtrapītāṃ gomūtrabhāvitāṃ madhunā avalihyāditi vyākhyānayanti||21||
ājaṃ śakṛtsyāt `śakṛddhara' iti pā. kuḍavapramāṇaṃ viḍaṃ haridrā lavaṇottamaṃ ca | pṛthak palāṃśāni samagrametaccūrṇaṃ hitāśī madhunā'valihyāt ||22||
ājamityādi| ājaṃ śakṛt chāgalīpurīṣam| kuḍavapramāṇaṃ catuṣpalamātram| viḍaṃ lavaṇam| lavaṇottamaṃ saindhavam| pṛthakpalāṃśāni viḍādīni pṛthakpalamātrāṇītyarthaḥ| samagraṃ samastam||22||
maṇḍūralohāgniviḍaṅgapathyāvyoṣāṃśakaḥ sarvasamānatāpyaḥ | mūtrāsuto'yaṃ `mūtrāyuto'yaṃ' iti pā. madhunā'valehaḥ pāṇḍvāmayaṃ hantyacireṇa ghoram ||23||

idānīṃ pāṇḍuroge siddhatamaṃ yogamāha- maṇḍūretyādi| maṇḍūraṃ lohakiṭṭānukāri dravyam| agniḥ citrakaḥ| vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukam| maṇḍūrādīnāṃ vyoṣaparyantānāmaṃśaḥ samo bhāgo yasmin sa tathetyarthaḥ| tāpyo mākṣikadhātuḥ| mūtrāsutaḥ mūtre uṣitaḥ mūtrasandhita ityarthaḥ||23||
bibhītakāyomalanāgarāṇāṃ cūrṇaṃ tilānāṃ ca guḍaśca mukhyaḥ | takrānupāno `takrānupānaṃ vaṭakāprayuktaṃ' iti pā. vaṭakaḥ prayuktaḥ kṣiṇoti ghorānapi pāṇḍurogān ||24||

aparamapi siddhatamaṃ yogamāha- bibhītaketyādi| ayomalaṃ lohasiṅghāṇakam| tilānāṃ kṛṣṇatilānāmapi cūrṇam| guḍaśca mukhya iti sarvasamo guḍo nārdhaguḍa ityarthaḥ| kṣiṇoti hanti| yadyapyetadyogadvayamanārṣaṃ tathā'pi siddhatamatvenāsmadgurusammatatvādasmābhiḥ paṭhitam||24||
sauvarcalaṃ hiṅgu kirātatiktaṃ kalāyamātrāṇi sukhāmbunā vā | mūrvāharidrāmalakaṃ ca lihyāt sthitaṃ gavāṃ saptadināni mūtre ||25||
mūlaṃ balācitrakayoḥ pibedvā pāṇḍvāmayārto'kṣasamaṃ hitāśī | sukhāmbunā vā lavaṇena tulyaṃ śigroḥ phalaṃ kṣīrabhujopayojyam ||26||

sauvarcalamityādi| sauvarcalādīnāmekatvena nirdiṣṭānāṃ bahuvacanāntaṃ kalāyamātrāṇīti viśeṣaṇaṃ sauvarcalādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ kalāyamātreti pramāṇabodhanārtham| sukhāmbunā vā īṣaduṣṇāmbunā, ‘lihet’ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ| vāśabdo'tra yogāpekṣayā| mūrvetyādi| mūrvādikaṃ saptadināni gavāṃ mūtre sthitaṃ lihyāt| mūrvā corasnāyuḥ| balācitrakayoḥ samuditayormūlakalkaṃ vā karṣasamaṃ hitāśī pāṇḍurogārto mūtreṇa sukhāmbunā vā pibedityarthaḥ| kārtikakuṇḍastu ‘mūrvāharidrāmalakaṃ pibedvā sthitaṃ gavāṃ saptadināni mūtre’ iti paṭhati; tatra tantrayuktivaśāt ‘yatra tat’ iti padaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ, tena yatra mūrvādikaṃ sthitaṃ tat pibedityarthaḥ| tathā ca tantrāntaram- “niśāmalakamūrvābhirbhāvitaṃ sapta vāsarān| gomūtraṃ pibataḥ pāṇḍuḥ kāmalā ca praṇaśyati”- iti| sukhāmbunā uṣṇodakena| lavaṇena saindhavena| tulyaṃ samam| śigroḥ phalaṃ śobhāñjanakaphalam| kalāyamātramityanuvartanīyaṃ, saindhavasyāpi hiṅguvadadhikamātrasyānabhimatatvāt| kṣīrabhujā dugdhāśanena| upayojyaṃ pānādividhinā||25-26||
nyagrodhavargasya pibet kaṣāyaṃ śītaṃ sitākṣaudrayutaṃ hitāśī | śālādikaṃ cāpyatha sāracūrṇaṃ dhātrīphalaṃ vā madhunā'valihyāt ||27||

nyagrodhavargasyetyādi| nyagrodhavargasya nyagrodhādigaṇasya| kaṣāyaṃ kvāthapākaparibhāṣayā kvathitam| śālādikaṃ cā'pyatha sāracūrṇamityādi| śālasārādicūrṇaṃ madhunā avalihyāt, āmalakacūrṇaṃ vetyarthaḥ||27||

div.ab: viḍaṅgamustatriphalājamodaparūṣakavyoṣavinirdahanyaḥ | cūrṇāni kṛtvā guḍaśarkare ca tathaiva sarpirmadhunī śubhe ca ||28|| sambhārametadvipacennidhāya sārodake sāravato gaṇasya | jātaṃ ca lehyaṃ matimān viditvā nidhāpayenmokṣakaje samudge ||29|| hantyeṣa lehaḥ khalu pāṇḍurogaṃ saśothamugrāmapi kāmalāṃ ca |30|

viḍaṅgamustatriphaletyādi| etāni viḍaṅgādidravyāṇi cūrṇīkṛtāni `cūrṇāni kṛtvā' iti pā., sāravato gaṇasya sārodake śālāsārādigaṇasārakvāthe, nidhāya nikṣipya, tathā śubhe nirmale kṛtvā guḍaśarkare sarpirmadhunī ca nikṣipya, aikadhyaṃ tāvat pacet yāvallehyaṃ syāt, tataśca sañjātalehyaṃ viditvā matimān vaidyo mokṣakaje samudge mokṣakamaye sampuṭe nidhāpayet nikṣipediti piṇḍārthaḥ| vinirdahanī citrakaḥ| guḍaśarkarāviḍaṅgādidravyacūrṇapramāṇaṃ sārodakacaturthāṃśena, madhusarpiḥpramāṇamapi tathaiva| nanu, uṣṇayogena madhu virudhyate, tat kathaṃ madhunā sahāvalehapākaḥ? satyam, uṣṇena saha madhuno'bhyavahāre virodho na pāke; tathā ca tantrāntaraṃ- ‘sakṣaudrāṃ śarkarāṃ paktvā’ ityādi| yadyapyatra pāṇḍurogacikitsitaṃ sāmānyenoktaṃ, tathā'pyetadeva cikitsitaṃ dravyasvarūpeṇa vikalpya yathādoṣaṃ yojyam| tathā ca tantrāntaram- “pāṇḍurogapraśāntyarthamidamuktaṃ cikitsitam| vikalpyaivaṃ ca bhiṣajā yathādoṣabalaṃ prati|| snehaprāyaṃ pavanaje, tiktaśītaṃ tu paittike| ślaiṣmike kaṭurūkṣoṣṇaṃ, miśraṃ syāt sānnipātike” (ca. ci. 16) iti||28-29||-

ab.seg: saśarkarā kāmalināṃ tribhaṇḍī hitā gavākṣī saguḍā ca śuṇṭhī ||30||
ataḥ paraṃ kāmalācikitsitamāha- saśarkaretyādi| tribhaṇḍī trivṛt, saśarkarā kāmalināṃ hitā| gavākṣī indravāruṇī, sā saguḍā hitā, śuṇṭhyapi saguḍā||30||

div.ab: kāleyake cāpi ghṛtaṃ vipakvaṃ hitaṃ ca tat syādrajanīvimiśram |31|
kāleyake ityādi| kāleyakaṃ dāruharidrānukāri dravyaṃ, tatkalkasādhitaṃ ghṛtaṃ, rajanīvimiśraṃ haridrācūrṇaprakṣepayutam|31|-

ab.seg: dhātuṃ nadījaṃ jatu śailajaṃ vā kumbhāhvaye mūtrayutaṃ `kṣaudrayutam' iti pā. pibedvā ||31||
kumbhāhvayacikitsāmāha- dhātumityādi| nadījaṃ dhātuṃ suvarṇamākṣikam| tacca mūtrayutaṃ pibet| jatu śailajaṃ veti śilājatu vā mūtrayutaṃ pibet||31||

div.ab: mūtre sthitaṃ saindhavasamprayuktaṃ māsaṃ pibedvā'pi hi lohakiṭṭam |32|

mūtre sthitamityādi| gomūtre māsamuṣitaṃ lohakiṭṭaṃ lohamalaṃ tenaiva mūtreṇa cūrṇitaṃ saindhavayuktaṃ kumbhāhvaye pibet| lohakiṭṭamityatra hiraṇyakiṭṭamiti kecit paṭhanti; tannecchanti nibandhakārāḥ, hiraṇyasyāmalatvāt|32|-

ab.seg: dagdhvā'kṣakāṣṭhairmalamāyasaṃ vā gomūtranirvāpitamaṣṭavārān ||32||
vicūrṇya līḍhaṃ madhunā'cireṇa kumbhāhvayaṃ pāṇḍugadaṃ nihanyāt | sindhūdbhavaṃ vā'gnisamaṃ ca kṛtvā kṣiptvā ca mūtre sakṛdeva taptam ||33||
lauhaṃ ca kiṭṭaṃ bahuśaśca taptvā nirvāpya mūtre bahuśastathaiva | ekīkṛtaṃ gojalapiṣṭametadaikadhyamāvāpya pacedukhāyām ||34||
yathā na dahyeta tathā viśuṣkaṃ cūrṇīkṛtaṃ peyamudaśvitā tat | takraudanāśī vijayeta rogaṃ pāṇḍuṃ tathā dīpayate'nalaṃ ca ||35||

kumbhāhvaye siddhatamaṃ yogamāha- dagdhvetyādi| sindhūdbhavaṃ saindhavam| agnisamaṃ kṛtvā bibhītakāgninā agnivarṇaṃ kṛtvetyarthaḥ| sakṛt ekavāram| lauhaṃ ca kiṭṭamiti lohasiṃhāṇakamityarthaḥ| nirvāpya nirvāpittaṃ kṛtvā| ekīkṛtaṃ samabhāgena miśrīkṛtaṃ, gojalapiṣṭaṃ nirvāpaṇāvaśiṣṭapañcaguṇe gomūtre piṣṭam, ukhāyāṃ sthālyāṃ nikṣipya, mukhaṃ pidhāya, yathā bāṣpo bahirna niḥsarati yathā na dahyeta tathā vipacet| tataśca viśuṣkaṃ cūrṇīkṛtamudaśvitā mathitena saha peyam| jīrṇe ca takraudanaṃ bhojayedityarthaḥ| ayamasauśruto'pi pūrvoktahetutvādasmābhiḥ paṭhitaḥ| asya yogasya tantrāntare bibhītakalavaṇamiti sañjñā||32-35||

div.ab: drākṣāguḍūcyāmalakīrasaiśca siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ lāghara(va)ke hitaṃ ca |36|
idānīṃ lāgharacikitsāmāha- drākṣetyādi|36|-

ab.seg: gauḍānariṣṭān madhuśarkarāśca mūtrāsavān kṣārakṛtāṃstathaiva ||36||
snigdhān rasānāmalakairupetān kolānvitān vā'pi hi jāṅgalānām | seveta śophābhihitāṃśca yogān pāṇḍvāmayī śāliyavāṃśca nityam ||37||

idānīṃ tantrāntaroktān sarvānevābhayāriṣṭādīn bhojanaṃ ca saṅgṛhṇannāha- gauḍānityādi| gauḍānariṣṭān abhayāriṣṭādīn| madhuśarkarāśceti madhuśabdena madhvāsavaḥ, sa ca lohāriṣṭaprabhṛtikaḥ; śarkarāśabdena śarkarāsavaḥ| mūtrāsavān kuṣṭhacikitsitoktān| kṣārakṛtānāsavān ślīpadapaṭhitān| snigdhān rasān snehabhṛṣṭān jāṅgalānāṃ māṃsarasān; āmalakairupetān āmalakaphalasaṃskṛtān, kolānvitān veti badarasaṃskṛtān; vikalpābhidhānaṃ sātmyāpekṣayā| śophābhihitān yogān devadāruśuṇṭhīrasādikān| śālayo raktaśālyādayaḥ||36-37||
śvāsātisārārucikāsamūrcchātṛṭchardi śūlajvaraśophadāhān | tathā'vipākasvarabhedasādān jayedyathāsvaṃ prasāmīkṣya śāstram ||38||

pāṇḍurogopadravacikitsāmāha- śvāsetyādi| etān śvāsādīnupadravān, yathāsvaṃ śāstraṃ yathātmīyaṃ cikitsāśāstraṃ prasamīkṣya jayet| kecidamuṃ pāṭhamanyathā paṭhanti,- ‘tṛṣṇāṃ jvaraṃ chardimathātisāraṃ mūrcchāṃ kṣayaṃ śvāsamanannalipsām `śvāsamanalpaśotham' iti pā.| tathā'vipākasvarabhedasādān jayedyathāvat prasamīkṣya śāstram’- iti| nanu, jvarātisārānvitasya tasyāsādhyatvena vakṣyamāṇatvāt kuto jvarātisārayościkitsātideśaḥ? ucyate, acirotthitayostayoḥ satoḥ pāṇḍurogiṇaḥ pratikāryatvāt||38||
anteṣu śūnaṃ parihīnamadhyaṃ mlānaṃ tathā'nteṣu ca madhyaśūnam | gude ca śephasyatha muṣkaśūnaṃ `muṣkayośca śūnaṃ, pratāmyantamasañjñakalpam' iti pā. pratāmyamānaṃ ca visañjñakalpam ||39||
vivarjayet pāṇḍukinaṃ yaśo'rthī tathā'tisārajvarapīḍitaṃ ca ||40||

idānīmanupakramyasya pāṇḍurogiṇo lakṣaṇamāha- anteṣu śūnamityādi| anteṣu hastapādamukheṣu| parihīnamadhyaṃ kṛśamadhyakāyam| mlānaṃ kṛśam| gude ca śephasītyatrāpi śūnamiti sambandhanīyaṃ, śepho yoniliṅgam| muṣkaśūnam aṇḍakoṣaśūnam| yadyapi madhyaśūnamityanenaiva gudādiśophaḥ prāptaḥ, tathā'pyante mlānatāṃ vinā'pi gudādiśophī tyājya iti darśanārthaṃ gudādiśophakathanam| pratāmyamānaṃ mūrcchantam| visañjñakalpaṃ vecetanaprāyam| yadyapi mūrcchāyena visañjñakalpamiti prāptaṃ, tathā'pyabhidhānaṃ visañjñakalpasya viśeṣeṇāsādhyatāpratipādanārtham| atisārajvarapīḍitam atisārajvarābhyāṃ pīḍitamityarthaḥ| yadyapi pānakīhalīmakacikitsitaṃ noktaṃ, tathā'pi pāṇḍurogacikitsitaṃ tayorapi kartavyam||39-40||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre pāṇḍurogapratiṣedho nāma (ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) catuścatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||44||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre pāṇḍurogapratiṣedho nāma catuścatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||44||

div.head: raktapittapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto raktapittapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
pāṇḍurogapratiṣedhānantaraṃ dūṣyasāmyādraktapittapratiṣedhārambho yukta ityata āha- athāta ityādi||1-2||

div.ab: krodhaśokabhayāyāsaviruddhānnātapānalān | kaṭvamlalavaṇakṣāratīkṣṇoṣṇātividāhinaḥ ||3|| nityamabhyasato duṣṭo rasaḥ pittaṃ prakopayet | vidagdhaṃ svaguṇaiḥ pittaṃ vidahatyāśu śoṇitam ||4|| tataḥ pravartate raktamūrdhvaṃ cādho dvidhā'pi vā |5|

nidānānantarīyakatvāt pratiṣedhasyādau raktapittanidānabhūte hetusamprāptī āha- krodhaśokabhayāyāsetyādi| krodhādīni nityamabhyasyato niṣevamāṇasya puruṣasya duṣṭiṃ gato rasaḥ pittaṃ prakopayet, tataśca vidagdhaṃ duṣṭaṃ pittaṃ svaguṇaiḥ tīkṣṇoṣṇādibhiḥ śoṇitaṃ vidahati pradūṣayati, tata ūrdhvamadho vā raktaṃ pravartata iti piṇḍārthaḥ| tīkṣṇamuṣṇakaṭvamlalavaṇakṣāravyatiriktaṃ jyotiṣmatyapāmārgaphalādikam| āyāsaḥ śramaḥ| viruddhānnaṃ hitāhitīyoktam| krodhaśoketyādiḥ hetuḥ, nityamabhyasyata ityādiḥ samprāptiḥ| ‘kaṭvamlalavaṇa’- ityatra kecit ‘tīkṣṇamuṣṇāmlalavaṇaṃ divāsvapnaṃ vidāhi yat’ iti paṭhanti||3-4||-

ab.seg: āmāśayādvrajedūrdhvamadhaḥ pakvāśayādvrajet ||5||
vidagdhayordvayoścāpi `vidagdhayoścāpyubhayoḥ' iti pā. dvidhābhāgaṃ `dvidhāmārga' iti pā. pravartate | kecit sayakṛtaḥ plīhnaḥ pravadantyasṛjo gatim ||6||

tadraktaṃ yathordhvamadho vā dvidhā'pi vā pravartate tathā darśayannāha- āmāśayādityādi| yadyapi raktasya yakṛtplīhasthānatvādāmāśayapakvāśayābhyāṃ pravartanaṃ na sambhavati, tathā'pi prakupitaraktasya tatrāpi gamanāt pravartanaṃ tābhyāṃ sambhavatyeva| vidagdhayoścāpyubhayoriti duṣṭayorāmapakvāśayayorityarthaḥ| tayośca duṣṭiḥ duṣṭarudhirasaṃyogāt| ekīyamatamāha- kecidityādi| sayakṛtaḥ kālakhaṇḍasahitāt| etadapyanumatam, apratiṣedhāt| asmin pāṭhe aṅgīkṛte'pi pūrvavākyena saha na virodhaḥ, yato yakṛtplīhābhyāmeva raktaṃ pravartate paramāmapakvāśayamadhiṣṭhāya||5-6||

div.ab: ūrdhvaṃ sādhyamadhoyāpyamasādhyaṃ yugapadgatam `yugapadgatiḥ' iti pā.|7|

triprakārasya raktapittasya sādhyayāpyāsādhyatvamāha- ūrdhvamityādi| ūrdhvaṃ sādhyamiti yadā daurbalyādyupadravahīnaṃ māṃsaprakṣālanābhamityādyasādhyalakṣaṇarahitamekadoṣānugaṃ bhavati tadā sādhyaṃ, yadā tu tadeva śāntiṃ gatvā punarbhavati mārgāntaraṃ vā yāti alpopadravam alpāsādhyalakṣaṇayuktaṃ dvidoṣānugaṃ ca bhavati tadā yāpyaṃ, yadā ca bahūpadravayuktaṃ bahvasādhyalakṣaṇayuktaṃ tridoṣānugataṃ ca bhavati tadā asādhyam| adho yāpyamiti alpopadravamasādhyalakṣaṇahīnaṃ dvidoṣānugaṃ ca bhavati tadā adhogaṃ yāpyaṃ; yadā ca tridoṣānugamasādhyalakṣaṇayuktaṃ tadā varjyaṃ, yadā caikadoṣānugaṃ nirupadravaṃ varjyalakṣaṇāsaṃyuktaṃ tadā sādhyam| asādhyaṃ yugapadgatamiti yadā tridoṣānugaṃ bahūpadravamasādhyalakṣaṇayuktaṃ bhavati tadā asādhyaṃ, yadā cānyathā tadā yāpyamityarthaḥ| yugapadgatam ubhayamārgapravṛttamityarthaḥ|7|-
sadanaṃ śītakāmitvaṃ kaṇṭhadhūmāyanaṃ vamiḥ ||7|| lohagandhiśca niḥśvāso bhavatyasmin bhaviṣyati |8|
atha pūrvarūpamāha- sadanamityādi| sadanam aṅgamlāniḥ| kaṇṭhadhūmāyanaṃ kaṇṭhe dhūmodvamanamiva vedanetyarthaḥ| asmin raktapitte||7||-

ab.seg: bāhyāsṛglakṣaṇaistasya saṅkhyādoṣocchritīrviduḥ ||8||

raktapittasya saṅkhyāṃ doṣocchrayaṃ cātideśenāha- bāhyāsṛglakṣaṇaistasyetyādi| bāhyāsṛglakṣaṇairiti śoṇitavarṇanīyoktaiḥ ‘phenilamaruṇam’ ityādibhiḥ, tasya raktapittasya, saṅkhyā saptavidhā| nanu, pittena vi dagdhena vidagdhaṃ raktaṃ raktapittamucyate, tat kathaṃ pittādapi pṛthaguddiśyate? ucyate, tadraktāntareṇa saṃsargāt| doṣocchritiḥ doṣādhikyam||8||

daurbalyaśvāsakāsajvaravamathumadāstandritādāhamūrcchā bhukte cānne vidāhastvadhṛtirapi sadā hṛdyatulyā ca pīḍā | tṛṣṇā kaṇṭhasya bhedaḥ śirasi ca davanaṃ `tapanaṃ' iti pā. pūtiniṣṭhīvanaṃ ca dveṣo bhakte'vipāko viratirapi rate raktapittopasargāḥ ||9||

idānīṃ raktapittopadravānāha- daurbalyaśvāsakāsetyādi| vamathuḥ chardiḥ| madaḥ pūgaphaleneva mattatā| adhṛtiḥ asantoṣaḥ| atulyā asādhāraṇā| kaṇṭhasya bhedaḥ kaṇṭhakṣaṇanam| śirasi ca davanaṃ santāpaḥ| viratirapi rateḥ sukhasyāpi vināśo bhavatītyarthaḥ| upasargā upadravāḥ| ‘bhukte cānne vidāha’ ityatra ‘bhukte ghoro vidāha’ ityanye paṭhanti| tatra saptamī ṣaṣṭhyarthe, tena bhuktasya āhārasya ghoro mahān vidāha ityarthaḥ| ‘kaṇṭhasya bheda’ ityatra ‘koṣṭhasya bheda’ ityapare paṭhanti; koṣṭhaśabdena koṣṭhastho malastasya bheda iti ca vyākhyānayanti| tadetat pāṭhadvayamūrdhvādhaḥpravṛttirūpaṃ yathāsambhavaṃ boddhavyaṃ, ekatra dvayorapyanaupayikatvāt| śirasi ca davanamityatra ‘pravitatasiratā’ iti kecit paṭhanti, sirātatagātrateti vyākhyānayanti| ‘viratirapi rateḥ’ ityatra apare ‘vinatirapi bhavet’ iti paṭhanti; vinatiḥ śarīrasya vinamanam| apare ‘vikṛtirapi bhavet’ iti paṭhanti, tatrāpi kāyasyākuñcanātmikā vikṛtirityarthaḥ||9||

māṃsaprakṣālanābhaṃ kvathitamiva ca yat kardamāmbhonibhaṃ vā medaḥpūyāsrakalpaṃ `medaḥpūyāsthikalpaṃ' iti pā. yakṛdiva yadi vā pakvajambūphalābham | yat kṛṣṇaṃ yacca nīlaṃ bhṛśamatikuṇapaṃ yatra coktā vikārāstadvarjyaṃ raktapittaṃ surapatidhanuṣā yacca tulyaṃ vibhāti ||10||

asādhyaraktapittalakṣaṇamāha- māṃsaprakṣālanābhamityādi| māṃsaprakṣālanābhaṃ māṃsadhāvanatoyābham| kardamāmbhonibhaṃ kardamena miśritaṃ yadambhastoyaṃ tannibham| medaḥpūyāsrakalpaṃ medaḥpūyaraktasadṛśamityarthaḥ| atikuṇapaṃ śaṭitaśavagandhi| uktā vikārā daurbalyaśvāsādayaḥ, ‘prabhūtā’ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ| tadvarjyamiti ūrdhvadhomārgatvena sādhyaṃ yāpyaṃ ca yaduktaṃ bhavati tadapyevaṃvidham asādhyam| surapatidhanuḥ indradhanuḥ| ‘kvathitamiva ca yat’ ityatra ‘kvathitamiva yakṛt’ iti paṭhitvā pakvakālakhaṇḍatulyamiti vyākhyānayanti||10||
nādau saṅgrāhyamudriktaṃ yadasṛgbalino'śnataḥ | tat pāṇḍugrahaṇīkuṣṭhaplīhagulmajvarāvaham ||11||

ādau balavati raktapitte saṅgrahaṇaniṣedhamāha- nādau saṅgrāhyamudriktamityādi| yat raktapittam, udriktam atiśayena vṛddhiṃ gataṃ, tadbalayuktasyāśnataśca puruṣasyādau na saṅgrāhyaṃ; yasmāttadādau saṅgṛhītaṃ sat pāṇḍvādirogāvahaṃ bhavati||11||
adhaḥpravṛttaṃ vamanairūrdhvagaṃ ca virecanaiḥ | jayedanyataradvā'pi kṣīṇasya śamanairasṛk ||12||

tarhi tatra kiṃ kuryādityāha- adhaḥpravṛttaṃ vamanairityādi| saṃśodhanārhasya balavato narasyādhogaṃ raktapittaṃ bahudoṣaṃ vamanairjayet, evaṃvidhasyordhvagaṃ virecanairityarthaḥ| nanu, adhogaṃ vātānugaṃ bhavati, ūrdhvagaṃ ca kaphānugaṃ, tat kathaṃ tayorvamanavirecane yujyete? satyaṃ, vyādhipratyanīkatvādyujyete eva; tathā ca tantrāntaraṃ- “adhogaṃ vamanairdhīmānūrdhvagaṃ recanairjayet”- iti| anyataradveti ūrdhvagamadhogaṃ vā kṣīṇasya puruṣasya śamanairjayediti na vamanavirekaiḥ; tathā ca tantrāntaram- “ūrdhvagaṃ vā'pyadhogaṃ vā kṣīṇasya śamanairjayet”- iti||12||
atipravṛddhadoṣasya pūrvaṃ lohitapittinaḥ | akṣīṇabalamāṃsāgneḥ kartavyamapatarpaṇam ||13||
idānīṃ saṃśodhanārhasya laṅghanamapi hitamiti darśayannāha- atipravṛddhadoṣasyetyādi| apatarpaṇaṃ laṅghanam||13||
laṅghitasya tataḥ peyāṃ vidadhyāt svalpataṇḍulām | rasayūṣau pradātavyau surābhisnehasaṃskṛtau | tarpaṇaṃ pācanaṃ lehān sarpīṃṣi vividhāni ca ||14||

laṅghanādanantaraṃ kiṃ kuryādityāha- laṅghitasyetyādi vidadhyāt kuryāt| kiṃ raktapitte peyāmeva vidadhyādutānyadapītyāha- tarpaṇamityādi| tarpaṇamiti mṛdvīkāmadhukādisādhitajalena saśarkareṇāloḍitāḥ saghṛtakṣaudrā lājaśaktavaḥ| pācanaṃ hrīberacandanośīraparpaṭamustasādhitajalapānam| lehāniti vakṣyamāṇān madhukaśobhāñjanakādipuṣpaiḥ kṛtān saghṛtakṣaudrān| vividhāni sarpīṃṣi vāsāghṛtādīni| tatrādhoge peyā hitā yadi māruto balī na syāt, mārutaścedbalī bhavati tadā māṃsarasa eva; ūrdhvage ca tarpaṇaṃ hitam| tathā ca tantrāntaram- “adhovahe yavāgvādi na cet syānmāruto balī| ūrdhvage tarpaṇaṃ śastaṃ yathādoṣamathāpi vā”- iti| kecit ‘laṅghitasya tato yuktyā laghvannamavacārayet’ iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- yuktyā mātrayā pratyanīkaṃ cetyarthaḥ||14||
drakṣāmadhukakāśmaryasitāyuktaṃ virecanam | yaṣṭīmadhukayuktaṃ ca sakṣaudraṃ vamanaṃ hitam ||15||

pūrvamuddiṣṭaṃ yadvamanavirecanaṃ tayordravyāṇyāha- drākṣāmadhukakāśmaryetyādi| drākṣādiyuktaṃ virecanadravyakalpoktaṃ mṛdu virecanaṃ, yaṣṭīmadhukakṣaudrayuktaṃ vamanadravyavikalpoktaṃ mṛdu vamanaṃ hitam||15||
payāṃsi śītāni rasāśca jāṅgalāḥ satīnayūṣāśca saśāliṣaṣṭikāḥ | paṭolaśelūsuniṣaṇṇayūthikāvaṭātimuktāṅkurasinduvārajam ||16||
hitaṃ ca śākaṃ ghṛtasaṃskṛtaṃ sadā tathaiva dhātrīphaladāḍimānvitam | rasāśca pārāvataśaṅkhakūrmajāstathā yavāgvo vihitā ghṛtottarāḥ ||17||
santānikāścotpalavargasādhite kṣīre praśastā madhuśarkarottarāḥ | himāḥ pradehā madhurā gaṇāśca ye ghṛtāni pathyāni raktapittinām ||18||

vamanavirecanadravyāṇyabhidhāya bhojanadravyāṇi pratipādayati- payāṃsītyādi| śītāni utpalādidravyakvathitaśītāni, tāni tu pittaprāye| jāṅgalarasā eṇādilāvādikṛtāḥ, te ca vātānubandhe| satīnayūṣā vartulakalāyayūṣāḥ, te ca kaphānuge raktapitte hitāḥ| paṭoletyādi| śelūḥ dakṣiṇāpathajaṃ śākaṃ, śleṣmāntakamapare| suniṣaṇṇakaḥ śiravālikā, catuṣparṇītyapare| atimukta āvantakaḥ| aṅkurāḥ komalapallavāḥ paṭolādīnām| sinduvāraḥ nirguṇḍī| etānyapi śākāni kaphānuge śastānīti| paṭoletyatra kecit jīvantīti paṭhanti| rasāścetyādi| jāṅgalarasābhidhānenaiva pārāvatarasasyāpi parigrahe tadabhidhānaṃ viśeṣeṇa raktapitte hitatvāpādanārtham| dhātrīdāḍime saṃskārārtham| yavāgvaḥ abhihitāḥ| santānikā ghṛtasyoparitanaḥ styāno bhāgaḥ| ghṛtottarā ghṛtapradhānāḥ| himāḥ pradehā ityādi| himāḥ pradehāḥ śītā lepāḥ; te ca nyagrodhādiprabhṛtiśītalagaṇakṛtāḥ| madhurā gaṇāḥ kākolyādayaḥ| te ca pānādinā yojyāḥ| ghṛtāni madhuragaṇasādhitāni tantrāntarasaṃvādāt| pathyāni hitāni||16-18||
madhūkaśobhāñjanakovidārajaiḥ priyaṅgukāyāḥ kusumaiśca cūrṇitaiḥ | bhiṣagvidadhyāccaturaḥ samākṣikān hitāya lehānasṛjaḥ praśāntaye ||19||
lihyācca dūrvāvaṭajāṃśca pallavān madhudvitīyān sitakarṇikasya 'śṛtasya' iti pā. ca | hitaṃ ca kharjūraphalaṃ samākṣikaṃ phalāni cānyānyapi tadguṇānyatha ||20||

madhūketyādi| madhūkādipuṣpairekaikaiścūrṇitaistrayo `madhūkaśobhāñjanakovidārajaiḥ kusumaistrayo lehāḥ' iti pā. lehāḥ, priyaṅgukāyāḥ kusumaiścaturtho lehaḥ| aparānapi lehānāha- lihyādityādi| dūrvāvaṭapallavān madhudvitīyān lihyādityeko yogaḥ| sitakarṇikaḥ śvetakarṇikāraḥ, tasyāpi pallavān madhudvitīyān lihyāditi dvitīyo yogaḥ| kecit samuditamekaṃ yogaṃ manyante; tannecchanti nibandhakārāḥ, samānatantrasaṃvādāt| ‘dūrvāvaṭajāṃśca pallavān’ ityatrāpare ‘dugdhadrumapallavān’ iti paṭhitvā vaṭādipallavāniti vyācakṣate| kiṃ raktapitte etadeva hitamutānyadapītyāha- hitamityādi| samākṣikaṃ samadhu| anuktasaṅgrahāyāha- phalāni cānyānyapītyādi| anyāni phalāni kāśmaryādīni| tadguṇāni kharjūraphalatulyaguṇāni||19-20||

div.ab: raktātisāraproktāṃśca yogānatrāpi yojayet |21|

idānīṃ raktapitte'tideśena cikitsāmāha- raktātīsāraproktāṃścetyādi| raktātīsāraproktān yogān ‘priyālamallikā’ ityādīn| asyāgre kārtikakuṇḍaḥ ‘nīlotpalānāṃ madhunā bhasma vā'pi parisrutam’ ityādiyogaṃ paṭhati, sa ca jejjaṭācāryeṇa ‘sakṣaudramindīvarabhasma’ ityādinā agre paṭhitaḥ|21|-

ab.seg: śuddhekṣukāṇḍamāpothya nave kumbhe himāmbhasā ||21||
yojāyitvā kṣipedrātrāvākāśe sotpalaṃ tu tat | prātaḥ srutaṃ kṣaudrayutaṃ pibecchoṇitapittavān ||22||

śuddhekṣukāṇḍamāpothyetyādi| śuddhekṣukāṇḍāni nirvalkalekṣukāṇḍāni, āpothya avakṣudya| himāmbhasā yojayitvetyādi śītalajalena yojayitvā nave ghaṭe rātrāvākāśe nirāvaraṇasthāne kṣipet dhārayet, tataśca prātaḥkāle srutaṃ gālitaṃ nīlotpalacūrṇamadhubhyāṃ yutaṃ śoṇitapittavān naraḥ pibet||21-22||
pibecchītakaṣāyaṃ vā jambvāmrārjunasambhavam | udumbaraphalaṃ piṣṭvā pibettadrasameva vā ||23||
pibedityādi| pibedityatra madhuyutamityanuktamapi sambadhyate, samānatantrasaṃvādāt| udumbaraphalamityādi| udumbaraphalaṃ piṣṭvā tadrasaṃ gṛhītvā madhuyutaṃ pibet||23||
trapuṣīmūlakalkaṃ vā sakṣaudraṃ taṇḍulāmbunā | pibedakṣasamaṃ kalkaṃ yaṣṭīmadhukameva vā ||24||
candanaṃ madhukaṃ rodhramevameva samaṃ pibet | karañjabījamevaṃ vā sitākṣaudrayutaṃ pibet ||25||
majjānamiṅgudayasyaivaṃ pibenmadhukasaṃyutam | sukhoṣṇaṃ lavaṇaṃ bījaṃ kārañjaṃ dadhimastunā ||26||
pibedvā'pi tryahaṃ martyo raktapittābhipīḍitaḥ | raktapittaharāḥ śastāḥ ṣaḍete yogasattamāḥ ||27||

idānīṃ raktapitte siddhatamān ṣaḍyogānāha- trapusīmūlakalkamityādi| sakṣaudraṃ karṣonmitamadhusahitaṃ, taṇḍulāmbunā kalkāccaturguṇenetyarthaḥ| akṣasamaṃ karṣapramāṇaṃ, evameveti sakṣaudraṃ taṇḍulāmbunetyarthaḥ| karañjabījādiyogadvayaṃ kaphānubandhe ūrdhvage śastam| majjānamiṅgudasyetyādi sitāmadhuyutameva(ka)meva pibedityarthaḥ||24-27||

div.ab: pathyāścaivāvapīḍeṣu ghrāṇataḥ prasrute'sṛji |28|
anantaroktāḥ ṣaḍyogā ghrāṇage rakte'vapīḍane'pi yojyā ityāha- pathyā ityādi| pathyā hitāḥ, anantaroktāḥ trapusīmūlakalkamityādi ṣaḍyogāḥ iti śeṣaḥ|28|-

ab.seg: atinisrutarakto vā kṣaudrayuktaṃ pibedasṛk | yakṛdvā bhakṣayedājamāmaṃ pittasamāyutam ||28||
asṛgiti śarīradhātusāmānyāt eṇādīnāmityarthaḥ| yakṛt kālakhaṇḍam||28||

div.ab: palāśavṛkṣasvarase vipakvaṃ sarpiḥ pibet kṣaudrayutaṃ suśītam | vanaspatīnāṃ svarasaiḥ kṛtaṃ vā saśarkaraṃ kṣīraghṛtaṃ pibedvā ||29|| drākṣāmuśīrāṇyatha padmakaṃ sitā pṛthakpalāṃśānyudake samāvapet | sthitaṃ niśāṃ tadrudhirāmayaṃ jayet pītaṃ payo vā'mbusamaṃ hitāśinaḥ ||30|| turaṅgavarcaḥsvarasaṃ samākṣikaṃ pibet sitākṣaudrayutaṃ vṛṣasya vā | lihettathā vāstukabījacūrṇaṃ kṣaudrānvitaṃ taṇḍulasāhvayaṃ vā ||31|| lihyācca lājāñjanacūrṇamekamevaṃ sitākṣaudrayutāṃ tugākhyām | drākṣāṃ sitāṃ tiktakarohiṇīṃ ca himāmbunā vā madhukena yuktām ||32|| pathyāmahiṃsrāṃ rajanīṃ ghṛtaṃ ca lihyāttathā śoṇitapittarogī |33|

vanaspatīnāṃ vaṭādīnām| kṣīraghṛtaṃ kṣīrotthaṃ ghṛtam| payo vā'mbusamamiti dugdhaṃ jalaṃ ca tulyamityarthaḥ| kecidevaṃ paṭhanti- ‘vāsākaṣāyaṃ sasitaṃ pibedvā turaṅgavarcaḥsvarasaṃ samākṣikam’ iti| lihettathā vāstukabījacūrṇamityādi|- vāstukabījacūrṇaṃ ṭaṅkavāstukabījacūrṇaṃ kṣaudrānvitaṃ lihet| taṇḍulasāhvayaṃ veti taṇḍulīyaṃ kṣaudrānvitaṃ vā lihyādityarthaḥ| kecidevaṃ paṭhanti- ‘sataṇḍulīyaṃ madhunā'valehayet sitāyutaṃ vāstukamūlameva vā’ iti| lihyāccetyādi| lājā bhṛṣṭadhānyāni| añjanaṃ rasāñjanam| ekaṃ pradhānaṃ, evaṃ kṣādreṇetyarthaḥ| ‘lājāñjanacūrṇam’ ityatra ‘kālāñjanacūrṇam’ iti kecit paṭhanti; tatra kālāñjanaṃ sauvīrāñjanam| sitākṣaudrayutamityādi| tugākhyā vaṃśarocanānukāri pārthivaṃ dravyaṃ, anye vaṃśarocanāmāhuḥ; tāṃ ca śarkarākṣaudrayutāṃ lihyāt| drākṣāṃ sitāmityādi| drākṣādīni trīṇi dravyāṇi yaṣṭīmadhukena yutāni śītodakena vā lihyāt| pathyāmityādi| pathyā harītakī, rajanī haridrā, etāni harītakīprabhṛtīni dravyāṇi ghṛtena saha lihyāt| ayaṃ yogaḥ kaṇṭhage prasṛte ca raktapitte yojyaḥ| kecit ‘rajanīṃ ghṛtaṃ ca’ ityatra ‘rajanīdvayaṃ ca’ iti paṭhanti, te ca śītodakenaiva lehyamicchanti; ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ samānatantravirodhādanyāyyaḥ||29-32||-
vāsākaṣāyotpalamṛtpriyaṅgurodhrāñjanāmbhoruhakeśarāṇi ||33|| pītvā sitākṣaudrayutāni jahyāt pittāsṛjo vegamudīrṇamāśu |34|

idānīṃ vegavati raktapitte siddhatamaṃ yogamāha- vāsākaṣāyotpaletyādi| utpalaṃ nīlotpalaṃ mṛt kedāramṛttikā, ambhoruhakeśaraṃ padmakeśaram| kalpanāmāha- pītvā sitākṣaudrayutāni jahyādityādi| vāsākaṣāyamutpalamṛdādicūrṇaprakṣepaṃ sitākṣaudrayutaṃ pītvā naro raktapittasyodīrṇamudriktaṃ vegamāśu jahyāt śīghraṃ parityajet||33||-
gāyatrijambvarjunakovidāraśirīṣarodhrāśanaśālmalīnām ||34|| puṣpāṇi śigrośca vicūrṇya leho madhvanvitaḥ śoṇitapittaroge |35|
gāyatrijambvarjunakovidāretyādi| gāyatrī khadiraḥ, arjunaḥ kakubhaḥ, kovidāraḥ kāñcanāraḥ, aśano bījakaḥ| śigruḥ śobhāñjanakaḥ||34||-
sakṣaudramindīvarabhasmavāri karañjabījaṃ madhusarpiṣī `madhu śarkarā ca' iti pā. ca ||35|| jambvarjunāmrakvathitaṃ ca toyaṃ ghnanti trayaḥ pittamasṛk ca yogāḥ |36|

idānīṃ raktapitte trīn yogānāha- sakṣaudramindīvarabhasmetyādi| indīvarabhasmavāri indīvarakṣārodakaṃ sakṣaudraṃ pibedityeko yogaḥ| karañjabījaṃ madhusarpiṣā ceti karañjabījaṃ madhusarpiṣā vā lihyāditi dvitīyo yogaḥ| jambvarjunāmrakvathitaṃ toyamityādi|- jambvādikvathitaṃ toyaṃ sakṣaudraṃ pibediti tṛtīyo yogaḥ| eṣu madhye antyau `ādyau yogau kaṇṭhanetrasthite' iti pā. yogau kaṇṭhāntaḥsthite raktapitte yojyau||35||-
mūlāni puṣpāṇi ca mātuluṅgyāḥ piṣṭvā pibettaṇḍuladhāvanena ||36|| ghrāṇapravṛtte jalamāśu deyaṃ saśarkaraṃ nāsikayā payo vā |37|

mūlānītyādi| mātuluṅgo bījapūrakaḥ, ‘madhukarkaṭī’ iti anye| ghrāṇapravṛtte jalamāśu deyamityādi| ghrāṇapravṛtte raktapitte saśarkaraṃ pānīyaṃ dugdhaṃ vā saśarkaraṃ nāsikayā deyam| kecit ‘nāsikayā’ ityatra ‘nāsikayoḥ’ iti paṭhanti||36||-

ab.seg: drākṣārasaṃ kṣīraghṛtaṃ pibedvā saśarkaraṃ cekṣurasaṃ himaṃ vā ||37||

ghrāṇapravṛtte'paramapi nasyayogamāha- drākṣārasamityādi| drākṣārasaṃ saśarkaraṃ nāsikayā pibet, kṣīraghṛtaṃ kṣīramathanodbhūtaṃ tadvā saśarkaraṃ nāsikayā pibet, ikṣurasaṃ himaṃ vā tathaiva pibet, itthaṃ trayo yogāḥ kalpanīyāḥ| tathā ca tantrāntaraṃ- “drākṣārasasya nasyaṃ nasyaṃ vā kṣīrasarpiṣaḥ sapadi| ikṣo rasasya nasyaṃ saśarkaraṃ raktanudbhavati”- iti||37||

div.ab: śītopacāraṃ madhuraṃ ca kuryādviśeṣataḥ śoṇitapittaroge |38|
sarvatantroktacikitsāsaṅgrahārthamāha- śītopacāramityādi| śītopacāraṃ dāhādiṣu bāhye'pi kuryāditi|38|-
drākṣāghṛtakṣaudrasitāyutena vidārigandhādivipācitena ||38|| kṣīreṇa cāsthāpanamagryamuktaṃ hitaṃ ghṛtaṃ cāpyanuvāsanārtham |39|

raktapitte āsthāpanārthaṃ kṣīramanuvāsanārthaṃ ca ghṛtamāha- drākṣetyādi| vidārigandhādigaṇasādhitena kṣīreṇa ghṛtakṣaudrasitāyutenāsthāpanaṃ raktapitte'gryamuktaṃ, tathā cānuvāsanārthaṃ ghṛtaṃ hitam| tacca ghṛtaṃ yaṣṭīmadhukasādhitaṃ, apakvasya snehasya vyāpatkaratvāt| anye vidārigandhādisādhitakṣīreṇa ghṛtapākamicchanti||38||-

priyaṅgurodhrāñjanagairikotpalaiḥ suvarṇakālīyakaraktacandanaiḥ ||39|| sitāśvagandhāmbudayaṣṭikāhvayairmṛṇālasaugandhikatulyapeṣitaiḥ | nirūhya cainaṃ payasā samākṣikairghṛtaplutaiḥ śītajalāvasecitam ||40|| kṣīraudanaṃ bhuktamathānuvāsayedghṛtena yaṣṭīmadhusādhitena ca | adhovahaṃ śoṇitameṣa nāśayettathā'tisāraṃ rudhirasya dustaram ||41|| virekayoge tvati caiva śasyate... |42|

apare'pi raktapitte āsthāpanānuvāsane āha- priyaṅgurodhrāñjanagairikotpalairityādi| añjanaṃ sauvīrāñjanam| gairikaṃ sāmānyagairikam| utpalaṃ nīlotpalaṃ; nāgakeśaramapare| suvarṇaṃ suvarṇagairikam, antalopāt| kālīyakaṃ dāruharidrānukāri dravyam| ambudo mustā| yaṣṭikāhvayo madhuyaṣṭikā| mṛṇālaṃ padmakeśaram| saugandhikaṃ kumudabhedaḥ| priyaṅgvādibhiḥ saugandhikāntaistulyaiḥ peṣitaiḥ kalkīkṛtaiḥ samaghṛtaiḥ payasā sahainaṃ raktapittinaṃ nirūhayet| tataśca śītalajalāvasecitaṃ kṣīraudanaṃ bhuktaṃ puruṣaṃ yaṣṭīmadhukasādhitena ghṛtenānuvāsayet| adhovahaṃ śoṇitamadhogaṃ raktapittam| eṣa āsthāpanānuvāsanaprayogaḥ| atisāraṃ rudhirasyeti raktātisāramityarthaḥ| virekayoge tvatīti virekātiyoge||39-41||-

ab.seg: ... vāmyaśca rakte vijite balānvitaḥ ||42||

vāmyaśca rakte ityādi| nirūhanānuvāsanābhyāṃ vijite raktapitte sati balānvitaḥ puruṣo vāmyo vāmanīyaḥ, adhomārgapravṛttinivāraṇārtham| atra kārtikakuṇḍena bahūktaṃ, tacca granthagauravabhayāt parihṛtam||42||

div.ab: evaṃvidhā uttarabastayaśca mūtrāśayasthe rudhire vidheyāḥ |43|
viśiṣṭasthānage raktapitte viśiṣṭacikitsāmāha- evaṃvidhā uttaratabastayaścetyādi| evaṃvidhā anantaroktāsthāpanānuvāsanatulyāḥ| mūtrāśayasthe bastisthe mūtrasrotaḥpravṛtte ca|43|-

ab.seg: pravṛttarakteṣu ca pāyujeṣu kuryādvidhānaṃ khalu raktapaittam ||43||
arśasaḥ atipravṛttau ca raktapittacikitsitamatidiśannāha- pravṛttarakteṣvityādi| pāyujeṣu arśaḥsu||43||
vidhiścāsṛgdare'pyeṣa strīṇāṃ kāryo vijānatā | śastrakarmaṇi raktaṃ ca yasyātīva pravartate ||44||

vidhiścāsṛgdare'pyeṣa ityādi| eṣa vidhiḥ adhogaraktapittaghno vidhiḥ| vijānatā vaidyena asṛgdare kāryaḥ| na kevalamasṛgdare eva eṣa vidhiḥ kāryaḥ kintu yasya śastrakarmaṇi kṛte atiraktaṃ pravartate tasyāpyeṣa eva vidhiḥ kāryaḥ| kecidatraivāsṛgdaralakṣaṇaṃ paṭhanti| tadyathā- ‘dahedadho vaṅkṣaṇadeśamasyāḥ śroṇīṃ ca pṛṣṭhaṃ ca tathaiva vṛkkau `kukṣiṃ' iti pā.| asṛgdaraṃ cāpi karoti nāryā garbhāśayārtiṃ tvacireṇa ghorām’- iti| ye tvatra paṭhanti te śukraśoṇitaśuddhāvasṛgdaralakṣaṇaṃ na paṭhanti||44||
trayāṇāmapi doṣāṇāṃ śoṇite'pi ca sarvaśaḥ | liṅgānyālokya kartavyaṃ cikitsitamanantaram ||45||

kiṃ raktapittaghno vidhiḥ raktapittākhye roge'sṛgdare śastrakarmaṇyatiraktapravṛttau cāviśeṣeṇaiva kārya uta kiñcidapekṣyetyāha- trayāṇāmapi doṣāṇāmityādi| trayāṇāmapi doṣāṇāṃ pṛthagdvandvasamastānāṃ liṅgāni śoṇitavarṇanīyoktāni śoṇite sarvaśa ālokyānantaraṃ cikitsitaṃ kartavyaṃ, asṛgdare vā śastrakarmaṇi raktātipravṛttau raktapittaghno vidhiḥ kārya ityarthaḥ| atrādhovahasya nāśanaṃ yāpanaṃ vā'bhipretaṃ, tena sānnipātikasyākṣīṇamāṃsāgneryāpyatvamabhipretam| atra kārtikakuṇḍa āpātanikāpūrvaṃ garbhiṇītyādipāṭhaṃ paṭhati, sa cābhāvānna likhitaḥ||45||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre raktapittapratiṣedho nāma (saptamo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) pañcacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||45||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantre kāyacikitsāyāṃ pañcacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||45||

div.head: mūrcchāpratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto mūrcchāpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi||1-2||
kṣīṇasya bahudoṣasya viruddhāhārasevinaḥ | vegāghātādabhīghātāddhīnasattvasya vā punaḥ ||3||
karaṇāyataneṣūgrā bāhyeṣvābhyantareṣu ca | niviśante yadā doṣāstadā mūrcchanti mānavāḥ ||4||
hṛtpīḍā jṛmbhaṇaṃ glāniḥ sañjñānāśo balasya ca | sarvāsāṃ pūrvarūpāṇi, yathāsvaṃ `yathāsvamupalakṣayet' iti pā. tā vibhāvayet ||5||

idānīṃ doṣajamūrcchāyā hetusamprāptī āha- kṣīṇasyetyādi| evambhūtasya puruṣasya vegāghātādibhirhetubhirugrā doṣā yadā bāhyābhyantareṣu karaṇāyataneṣu niviśante tadā mānavā mūrcchantīti piṇḍārthaḥ| hīnasattvasya alpasattvasya| karaṇāyataneṣu buddhīndriyakarmendriyamanobuddhyahaṅkārasthāneṣu| ugrā atipravṛddhāḥ prasṛtāśca| bāhyeṣvābhyantareṣu ceti bāhyakaraṇāyatanāni karmendriyāṇi, ābhyantarakaraṇāyatanāni manobuddhyahaṅkārasthānāni| ābhyantarakaraṇāyatanasya hṛdayasyaikatvāt kathaṃ bahuvacanaṃ? satyaṃ, antaḥsañjñāvahanāḍīnāmapyantaḥkaraṇāyatanatvenābhimatatvāt| niviśante avatiṣṭhante| apare karaṇāyatanaśabdenaiva karaṇāni kathayanti, upacārāt| tena bāhyābhyantareṣu karaṇeṣu yadā doṣā niviśante tadā mānavā mūrcchantītyarthaḥ| anye tvanyathā vyākhyānayanti- karaṇāyataneṣu yadā doṣā niviśante tathā bāhyābhyanareṣu karaṇeṣu niviśante tadā mānavā mūrcchantīti||3-5||

div.ab: sañjñāvahāsu nāḍīṣu pihitāsvanilādibhiḥ | tamo'bhyupaiti sahasā sukhaduḥkhavyapohakṛt ||6|| sukhaduḥkhavyapohācca naraḥ patati kāṣṭhavat | moho mūrccheti tāṃ prāhuḥ... |7|

yayā prakriyayā mānavo mūrcchati tāmāha- sañjñetyādi| sukhaduḥkhavyapohakṛt sukhaduḥkhanāśakṛt, sukhaduḥkhanāśaśca sañjñānāśāt; sañjñānāśastu sañjñāvahanāḍīpidhānāt| anye sukhaduḥkhe sattvarajasī, tayorvyapoho nāśastaṃ karotīti vyākhyānayanti||6||-

ab.seg: ... ṣaḍvidhā sā prakīrtitā ||7||
vātādibhiḥ śoṇitena madyena ca viṣeṇa ca | ṣaṭsvapyetāsu 'tāsu ṣaṭsvapi' iti pā. pittaṃ hi prabhutvenāvatiṣṭhate ||8||

saṅkhyāmāha- ṣaḍvidhetyādi| ye tantrāntarīyā vātādibhiḥ śoṇitena ca caturvidhāṃ mūrcchāmicchanti teṣāmayamāśayaḥ- madyaviṣayostvanantaroktapāṇḍurogavat pṛthagupādānaṃ, tena svamate ṣaḍvidhaiva mūrcchā| sarvāsvapi murcchāsu pittaṃ kartṛtvena pradhānamityāha- ṣaṭsvityādi| prabhutvenāvatiṣṭhate itaradoṣāvākramya vartata ityarthaḥ| vegāghātādiḥ hetuḥ; karaṇāyataneṣvityādiḥ sampraptiḥ||7-8||

div.ab: apasmāroktaliṅgāni tāsāmuktāni tattvataḥ |9|

vātādijānāṃ tisṛṇāṃ liṅgamapasmāroktaliṅgātideśenāha- apasmāretyādi| apasmāroktaliṅgāni yathāsvaṃ tāsāṃ jānīyādityarthaḥ| kecit ‘apasmāroktaliṅgāni’ ityatra ‘apasmāreṇa liṅgāni’ iti paṭhitvā vyākhyānayanti- dantanakhakhādanākṣivaikṛtalālāsrāvādirahitānyapasmāreṇa tulyāni lakṣaṇāni yathāsvamupalakṣayedityarthaḥ| tathā ca tantrāntaraṃ,- “sarvākṛtiḥ sannipātādapasmāra ivāgataḥ| sa jantuṃ pātayatyāśu vinā bībhatsaceṣṭitaiḥ”- iti|9|-
pṛthivyambhastamorūpaṃ raktagandhaśca `raktagandhastadanvayaḥ' iti pā. tanmayaḥ ||9|| tasmādraktasya gandhena mūrcchanti bhuvi mānavāḥ |10|

vātajādīnāṃ tisṛṇāṃ liṅgānyatidiśya raktajāyāḥ samprāptiṃ lakṣaṇaṃ cāha- pṛthivītyādi| pṛthvī ambhaśca dvayamapi tamorūpaṃ `tamorūpamiti tamaḥsvarūpam' iti pā. tamobahulaṃ; tathā coktaṃ purā- ‘tamobahulā pṛthivī, sattvatamobahulā āpaḥ’ iti, raktagandhaśca `raktagandhastadanvayaḥ' iti pā. tanmaya iti pṛthivyambhaḥsamudbhavaḥ; pāñcabhautike'pi rakte pṛthivyambhasoḥ prādhānyāt| mūrcchanti bhuvi mānavā ityetena gandhasya tamobahulatvamuktam| nanu, gandhaḥ pārthivastatkathaṃ pṛthivyambhaḥsamudbhava ityucyate? satyaṃ, parasparopakāryatvāt `athākāśapavanetyādau apāṃ caturguṇatvena darśitatvāt kathaṃ tadanvayenāpi gandho vyapadiśyata iti cet? na, parasparopakārādityukteḥ| evamapi bhūtāntare pṛthivīnimittatvādgandhasyeti vyākhyānaṃ' `kārtikakuṇḍāt' iti pā.| mūrcchanti bhuvi mānavā iti ye mānavā pṛthivīguṇabahulāstāmasā ityarthaḥ| nanu, yadi raktagandho mūrcchājanakaḥ, tarhi kimiti sarveṣāmeva na mūrcchāmutpādayati? satyaṃ, ye hīnasattvāsteṣāṃ mūrcchāmutpādayati na sarveṣām| apare ‘raktagandhaśca tanmaya’ ityanyathā vyācakṣate, tadyathā- tanmayaḥ pṛthivyambhomayaḥ; atra yathāsambhavaṃ vyākhyānaṃ; tena raktamambhomayaṃ, dravatvāt; gandhaśca pṛthivīmayaḥ, pārthivatvādgandhasya; tena tamobhūyiṣṭhāyāḥ pṛthivyāḥ sakāśādgandhasya jātatvādgandho'pi tamobahula eva, kāraṇānurūpatvāt kāryasya; śeṣaṃ samam| anye tu ‘pṛthivyambhastamorūpaṃ raktaṃ gandhaśca tanmaya’ iti paṭhanti; pṛthivī cāmbhaśca pṛthivyambhasī, tayoḥ sambandhi yattamaḥ, tadrūpaṃ tadbahulaṃ tallakṣaṇaṃ vā raktaṃ, gandhaśca tanmaya iti tamomaya ityarthaḥ; tamobahulapṛthivyutpannatvādgandhasya| etena tamobhūyiṣṭhapṛthivyambhautpannaraktasya dhātujanitatvādgandhasya svayaṃ tamobhūyiṣṭhatvācca raktagandho mānavairāghrātaḥ san hṛdyavasthitaṃ tamo vardhayan mūrcchāmāpādayati, ‘sarvabhāvānāṃ sāmānyaṃ vṛddhikāraṇam’ ityuktatvāt| nanu, tamobahulatvādraktaṃ mūrcchājanakaṃ tarhi tamobhūyiṣṭhe ete pṛthivyambhasī kuto mūrcchāṃ notpādayataḥ? satyaṃ, pṛthivyambhasī sātmyatayā svarūpataśca mūrcchāṃ notpādayataḥ| anye tu paṭhanti- pṛthivyambhastamorūpaṃ raktagandhena tu trayam’ iti; vyākhyānayanti ca- pṛthivyambhastamasāṃ rūpaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ yasya raktasya tatpṛthivyambhastamorūpaṃ; raktagandhena kṛtvā tu punastrayaṃ sattvarajastamasāṃ guṇānāṃ tritayaṃ ‘rakte jñāyate’ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ| nanu, gandhena kṛtvā kathaṃ guṇānāṃ tritayaṃ rakte jñāyate iti cet? satyaṃ, rakte gandho visro vartate, gandhaśca guṇaviśeṣaḥ, uktaṃ ca,- “teṣāṃ viśeṣāḥ śabdasparśarūparasagandhāḥ”- iti, te ca viśeṣāstriguṇāḥ; uktaṃ ca,- “sarva evaite viśeṣāḥ sattvarajastamomayā bhavanti” iti| kintvatra tamoguṇasyādhikyaṃ jñeyam| etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati- pṛthivyambhastamaḥsvalakṣaṇasya raktasya gandhena triguṇena tamoguṇaviśiṣṭena mānavā mūrcchanti||9||-

ab.seg: dravyasvabhāva ityeke dṛṣṭvā yadabhimuhyati ||10||
svamataṃ pradarśya paramatamāha- dravyasvabhāva ityeke ityādi||10||
guṇāstīvrataratvena `tīvratamatvena' iti pā. sthitāstu viṣamadyayoḥ | ta eva tasmājjāyeta mohastābhyāṃ yatheritaḥ ||11||

viṣamadyotthe āha- guṇā ityādi| ta eva guṇā rūkṣādayaḥ| moho mūrcchā| tābhyāṃ viṣamadyābhyām| yatherito `yatherita iti svaiḥ svairvikārairviṣakalpapānātyayayoryathākathitairityarthaḥ' iti pā. yathākathita ityarthaḥ| atha viṣamadyavikārayoḥ `viṣamadyādhikārayoḥ' iti pā. sāmānyenaiva mūrcchāpraṇayanāt kathamatra viśiṣṭamabhidhānam? ucyate- tatra itaralakṣaṇaiḥ saha tadgrahaṇārtham| nanu, yadi viṣamadyayostulyā guṇāḥ sthitāḥ, tat kimiti viṣavanmadyaṃ māraṇātmakaṃ na syāt? satyaṃ, madye teṣāṃ guṇānāmanatitīvratvenāvasthānāt| yadyevaṃ tarhi ‘guṇāstīvrataratvena sthitāstu viṣamadyayoḥ’ iti kathaṃ na vyāhanyate? satyaṃ, tīvrataraśabdādagre tīvraśabdo madhye lupto draṣṭavyaḥ| tena viṣe tīvrataratvena te guṇāḥ sthitāḥ, madye tīvratvenetyarthaḥ| tathā ca tantrāntaram,- “viṣasya ye guṇā dṛṣṭāḥ sannipātaprakopaṇāḥ| ta eva madye dṛśyante viṣe tu balavattarāḥ|| ta eva tasmāttābhyāṃ `tasya tābhyāṃ' iti pā. tu mohau syātāṃ yatheritau” (ca. ci. 24)- iti||11||

div.ab: stabdhāṅgadṛṣṭistvasṛjā gūḍhocchvāsaśca mūrcchitaḥ |12|
rudhirajamūrcchālakṣaṇamāha- stabdhāṅgadṛṣṭistvasṛjetyādi| stabdhaśabdo'ṅgadṛṣṭibhyāṃ sambadhyate| gūḍhocchvāsaḥ aspaṣṭaśvāsaḥ|12|-

ab.seg: madyena vilapaṃśchete naṣṭavibhrāntamānasaḥ | gātrāṇi vikṣipan bhūmau jarāṃ yāvanna yāti tat ||12||
madyajamūrcchālakṣaṇamāha- madyenetyādi| vilapanniti vilāpaṃ kurvan| naṣṭavibhrāntamānasa iti naṣṭamānasaḥ apasmaraṇaḥ `apasmaraṇayuktaḥ' iti pā. vibhrāntamānaso vikṣiptacetāḥ| jarāṃ pākam||12||
vepathusvapnatṛṣṇāḥ syuḥ stambhaśca viṣamūrcchite | veditavyaṃ tīvrataraṃ yathāsvaṃ viṣalakṣaṇaiḥ ||13||

viṣajamūrcchālakṣaṇamāha- vepathusvapnatṛṣṇāḥ syurityādi| vepathuḥ kampaḥ| stambhaḥ stabdhatā| veditavyamityādi| mūlādikandāntasya viṣasya yathāsvaṃ yāni lakṣaṇāni taiḥ kṛtvā viṣamūrcchitasya puṃso yathāsvaṃ yathātmīyaṃ viṣaṃ jñeyam||13||
sekāvagāhau maṇayaḥ sahārāḥ śītāḥ pradehā vyajanānilāśca | śītāni pānāni ca gandhavanti sarvāsu mūrcchāsvanivāritāni ||14||

ataḥ paraṃ cikitsitamāha- sekāvagāhāvityādi| maṇayaḥ sahārā iti maṇayo muktāsphaṭikaprabhṛtayaḥ| te ca sahārā hārāropitā hitā ityarthaḥ| vyajanānilā vyajanānāṃ vāyavaḥ| śītāḥ pradehāḥ candanotpalaprabhṛtikṛtāḥ pralepāḥ| śītāni pānāni ca gandhavantīti yāni śītāni gandhavanti ca pānāni tānītyarthaḥ| anivāritāni praśastāni||14||
sitāpriyālekṣurasaplutāni drākṣāmadhūkasvarasānvitāni | kharjūrakāśmaryarasaiḥ śṛtāni pānāni sarpīṃṣi ca jīvanāni ||15||

tānyeva śītāni gandhavanti ca pānānyāha- sitāpriyālekṣurasaplutānītyādi| kharjūrakāśmaryarasaiḥ śṛtāni sitāpriyālādiyutāni pānāni pānakāni sarvāsvanivāritāni| na kevalaṃ pānānyevānivāritāni sarpīṃṣi ca jīvanānīti kākolyādisiddhānītyarthaḥ| kecit pānānītyatra siddhānīti paṭhanti, te ca ghṛtaviśeṣaṇaṃ manyante||15||
siddhāni varge madhure payāṃsi sadāḍimā jāṅgalajā rasāśca | tathā yavā lohitaśālayaśca mūrcchāsu pathyāśca sadā satīnāḥ ||16||

kimetānyeva sarvamūrcchāsu hitānyutānyānyapītyāha- siddhānītyādi| madhure varge kākolyādau| payāṃsi sarvāṇyapi dugdhāni, sarveṣāṃ kṣīrāṇāṃ mūrcchāharatvāt| sadāḍimā dāḍimena saṃskṛtāḥ, jāṅgalajā rasāḥ| mūrcchāsu ye bhojane hitāstānāha- tathetyādi| pathyā hitāḥ, ‘bhojane’ iti śeṣaḥ| satīno vartulakalāyaḥ||16||
bhujaṅgapuṣpaṃ maricānyuśīraṃ kolasya madhyaṃ ca pibet samāni | śītena toyena `satīnatoyena' iti pā. bisaṃ mṛṇālaṃ kṣaudreṇa kṛṣṇāṃ sitayā ca pathyām ||17||

bhujaṅgapuṣpamityādi| bhujaṅgapuṣpaṃ nāgakeśaram| kolasya madhyaṃ badaramajjā| etāni bhujaṅgapuṣpādīni samāni tulyāni śītatoyena saha pibet| na kevalametānyeva śītatoyena saha pibet bisaṃ mṛṇālaṃ cāpi śītatoyena pibet; bisaṃ bisendrakaṃ, mṛṇālaṃ padmanālam| kṣaudreṇa kṛṣṇāmiti madhunā saha pippalīṃ pibedityarthaḥ; anye lihediti manyante| sitayā ca pathyāmiti harītakīṃ śarkarayā saha pibedityarthaḥ||17||
kuryācca nāsāvadanāvarodhaṃ kṣīraṃ pibedvā'pyatha mānuṣīṇām | mūrcchāṃ prasaktāṃ tu śirovirekairjayedabhīkṣṇaṃ vamanaiśca tīkṣṇaiḥ ||18||

ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ kuryādityāha- kuryādityādi| nāsāvaktrayoravarodhena vyāghuṭyāntaḥ `agtaḥ pravṛddho' iti pā. praviṣṭo māruto ruddhāni srotāṃsi vivṛṇvan mūrcchāmapahanti; nārīkṣīraṃ cātiśītalatvāt| mūrcchāmityādi| prasaktāṃ bhūyo bhūyo'nusaṅginīm| śirovirekaiḥ nasyaiḥ| abhīkṣṇaṃ punaḥ punaḥ| yadyapi sarvamūrcchāyāṃ pittaṃ pradhānaṃ, tīkṣṇe nasyavamane na yukte'sya, tathā'pi sañjñāvahasrotonirodhaśāntikaratvād vyādhipratyanīkatvācca hite eva| kecit ‘tīkṣṇaiḥ’ ityatra ‘pathyaiḥ’ iti paṭhanti; tatra pittaśleṣmaharairityarthaḥ||18||

div.ab: harītakīkvāthaśṛtaṃ `harītakīkvāthaghṛtaṃ pibedvā' iti pā. ghṛtaṃ vā dhātrīphalānāṃ svarasaiḥ kṛtaṃ vā | drākṣāsitādāḍimalājavanti śītāni nīlotpalapadmavanti ||19|| pibet kaṣāyāṇi ca gandhavanti pittajvaraṃ yāni śamaṃ nayanti |20|

harītakīkvāthaśṛtamityādi| harītakīkvāthena śṛtaṃ siddhaṃ harītakīkvāthaśṛtam| dhātrīphalānām āmalakaphalānāṃ svarasaiḥ| drākṣāsitetyādi| yāni kaṣāyāṇi śrīparṇyādikṛtāni pittajvaraṃ śamaṃ nayanti tāni drākṣāsitādāḍimalājavanti tatpradhānāni pibet| nīlotpalapadmavanti nīlotpalapadmapradhānāni| gandhavanti gandhadravyāḍhyāni| nīlotpalapadmavantītyādikaṃ pittajvaraharakaṣāyaviśeṣaṇam||19||-
prabhūtadoṣastamaso'tirekāt sammūrcchito naiva vibudhyate yaḥ ||20|| sannyastasañjño bhṛśaduścikitsyo jñeyastadā buddhimatā manuṣyaḥ |21|

idānīṃ mūrcchāyā avasthāyāṃ sañjñāntaramāha- prabhūtadoṣa ityādi| yaḥ prabhūtadoṣo manuṣyaḥ sammūrcchitaḥ san tamaso'tirekānnāvabudhyate nāvabodhaṃ prāpnoti sa duścikitsyo matimatā vaidyena sannyastasañjño jñeya iti piṇḍārthaḥ| sannyastasañjña iti mṛtyumukhe vartamānatvāt sannyasta iva sannyastaḥ||20||-
yathā''maloṣṭaṃ salile niṣiktaṃ samuddharedāśvavilīnameva ||21|| tadvaccikitsettvarayā bhiṣaktamasvedanaṃ mṛtyuvaśaṃ prayātam |22|
idānīṃ sannyastasya śīghraṃ pratīkārāya dṛṣṭāntamāha- yathā''maloṣṭamityādi| āmaloṣṭam āmamṛtpiṇḍam| taṃ sannyastasañjñam| asvedanaṃ prasvedarahitam||21||-
tīkṣṇāñjanābhyañjanadhūmayogaistathā nakhābhyantaratotrapātaiḥ ||22|| vāditragītānunayairapūrvairvighaṭṭanairguptaphalāvagharṣaiḥ |23|

kaiścikitsedityāha- tīkṣṇāñjanābhyañjanetyādi| tīkṣṇaśabdo'ñjanādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| totrāṇi sūciprakārāṇi| vāditraṃ vīṇādi| anunayaḥ sāntvanāpūrvakaṃ `śāntipūrvakaṃ' iti pā. vacanādi| vighaṭṭanaiḥ vividhaprakāreṇa cālanaiḥ| guptaphalāvagharṣaiḥ kapikacchūphalāvagharṣaṇaiḥ| anye guptaphalaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ, tasyāvagharṣaṇaiḥ pīḍanairityarthaḥ| kecidvighaṭṭanairityatra ‘vismāpanaiḥ’ iti paṭhanti; tatra āścaryakārakairityarthaḥ| etairupacāraiḥ upācaret āsañjñāprāpteḥ||22||-

ab.seg: ābhiḥ kriyābhiśca na labdhasañjñaḥ sānāhalālāśvasanaśca varjyaḥ ||23||
ābhiḥ kriyābhirityādi| ābhiḥ kriyābhiḥ anantaroktābhistīkṣṇāñjanādibhiḥ| sānāhalālāśvasanaśca ānāhādiyuktaḥ; śvasanaḥ śvāsa ityarthaḥ||23||

prabuddhasañjñaṃ vamanānulomyaistīkṣṇairviśuddhaṃ laghupathyabhuktam | phalatrikaiścitrakanāgarāḍhyaistathā'śmajātājjatunaḥ prayogaiḥ | saśarkarairmāsamupakrameta viśeṣato jīrṇaghṛtaṃ sa pāyyaḥ ||24||

tīkṣṇāñjanādibhirlabdhasañjñe sannyāsini paścātkarmāha- prabuddhetyādi| tīkṣṇāñjanādibhiḥ prabuddhasañjñaṃ sannyāsinaṃ tīkṣṇairvamanānulomyairvamanavirecanairviśuddhaṃ, annasaṃsarjanakrameṇa ca laghupathyabhuktaṃ, triphalācitrakaśuṇṭhībhāvitaiḥ saśarkaraiḥ śilājatuprayogaiḥ vajrakavaṭakakalpanayā kalpitairmāsaṃ yāvadupakrameta, śeṣadoṣopaśamanārtham| jīrṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ daśābdikaṃ pāyyaḥ pāyayitavyaḥ||24||
yathāsvaṃ ca jvaraghnāni kaṣāyāṇyupayojayet | sarvamūrcchāparītānāṃ viṣajāyāṃ viṣāpaham ||25||

yathāsvaṃ ca jvaraghnānīti yathāsvaṃ yathādoṣaṃ jvareṣu yāni kaṣāyāṇyuktāni tāni taddoṣajamūrcchāsvapi `sarvadoṣajamūrcchāsvapi' iti pā. yojyāni| viṣāpahamiti kalpasthānoktaṃ viṣamohaśamanaṃ nasyāñjanādikam||25||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre mūrcchāpratiṣedho nāma (aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) ṣaṭcatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||46||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantre ṣaṭcatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||46||

div.head: pānātyayapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ pānātyayapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

mūrcchāpratiṣedhānantaraṃ pittapradhānasāmyāt asaṃvittijanakasāmyācca pānātyayapratiṣedhārambho yukta ityata āha- athāta ityādi| pānātyaya ityatra ādiśabdo lupto jñeyaḥ, tena paramadādīnāṃ grahaṇam||1-2||
madyamuṣṇaṃ tathā tīkṣṇaṃ sūkṣmaṃ viśadameva ca | rūkṣamāśukaraṃ caiva vyavāyi ca vikāśi ca ||3||

tatrādau madyaguṇapraṇayanaṃ `idānīṃ pūrva madyaguṇānāha'- iti pā., evaṅguṇamapi madyaṃ mithyopayuktaṃ pānātyayādikaṃ karotīti pratipādanārtham madyaguṇapratipādanaṃ' iti pā.| madyamityādi| āśukaraṃ śīghrakāri| vyavāyi sarvaṃ dehaṃ vyāpya paścāt pākaṃ yāti| vikāśi sandhibandhavimocakam| yadyapi sūtrasthāne madyaguṇā uktāstathā'pyadhikakhyāpanārthamatrāpyuktāḥ||3||
auṣṇyācchītopacāraṃ tattaikṣṇyāddhanti manogatim | viśatyavayavān saukṣmyādvaiśadyātkaphaśukranut ||4||
mārutaṃ kopayedraukṣyādāśutvāccāśukarmakṛt `āśukāri tat' iti pā.| harṣadaṃ ca vyavāyitvādvikāśitvādvisarpati ||5||

madyaguṇānabhidhāya karmāṇyāha- auṣṇyādityādi| ‘auṣṇyācchītopacāram’ ityanena pittakopitvaṃ sūcitam| manogatiṃ bāhyādhyātmikāṃ karaṇaprāptim| avayavān hṛdayaujaḥprabhṛtīn| harṣadaṃ manoharṣakaraṃ; na tu puṃstvadaṃ, śukraharatvāt||4-5||
tadamlaṃ rasataḥ proktaṃ laghu rocanadīpanam | kecillavaṇavarjyāṃstu rasānatrādiśanti hi ||6||

madyasya karmābhidhāya rasamāha- tadamlaṃ rasata ityādi| tat madyam| amlam amlarasotkaṭaṃ, tena itare'pi pañcarasā anurasatvena madye boddhavyāḥ| tathā coktam,- “madyasya ṣaḍrasatve'pi vyakto'mlo rasa ucyate”- iti| ekīyamatamāha- kecillavaṇavarjyānityādi||6||
snigdhaistadannairmāṃsaiśca bhakṣyaiśca saha sevitam | bhavedāyuḥprakarṣāya balāyopacayāya ca ||7||

evaṅguṇamapi madyaṃ yathā sevyamānaṃ guṇāya bhavati tathā''ha snigdhaistadannairityādi| snigdhairityupalakṣaṇaṃ; tena itare'pi madyaviparītaguṇāḥ śītādayo jñeyāḥ| tat madyam| balāya ojase, upacayāya ca māṃsopacayāya||7||
kāmyatā manasastuṣṭirdhairyaṃ tejo'tivikramaḥ | vidhivat sevyamāne tu madye sannihitā guṇāḥ ||8||
anantaroktavidhinā sevyamānena madyena kāmyatādayo'pi guṇā bhavantīti darśayannāha- kāmyatetyādi| kāmyatā kamanīyatvam| tejaḥ prabhā| sannihitāḥ samyagavasthitāḥ||8||
tadevānannamajñena sevyamānamamātrayā | kāyāgninā hyagnisamaṃ sametya kurute madam ||9||

vidhirahitaṃ sevyamānaṃ madyaṃ yat karoti tadāha- tadevānannamityādi| tadeva madyam, agnisamaṃ vahnitulyam, ajñena uktamadyapānavidhānānabhijñena, anannam annarahitam atimātrayā ca sevyamānaṃ, kāyāgninā jaṭharānalena, sametya militvā, madaṃ kurute iti piṇḍārthaḥ||9||
madena karaṇānāṃ tu bhāvānyatve kṛte sati | nigūḍhamapi bhāvaṃ svaṃ prakāśīkurute'vaśaḥ ||10||

madenāvaśaḥ puruṣo yat karoti tadāha- madenetyādi| karaṇānāṃ manobuddhīndriyāṇāṃ, bhāvānyatve svarūpānyathātve kṛte sati, nigūḍhamapi saṃvṛtamapi, bhāvam abhiprāyaṃ, svam ātmīyaṃ prakāśīkurute prakaṭīkurute, avaśo madaparavaśa iti piṇḍārthaḥ||10||

div.ab: tryavasthaśca mado jñeyaḥ pūrvo madhyo'tha paścimaḥ |11|
atha katiprakāro mada ityāha- tryavasthaścetyādi| tryavasthaḥ triprakāraḥ| te ca trayaḥ prakārāḥ pūrvādayaḥ|11|-

ab.seg: pūrve vīryaratiprītiharṣabhāṣyādivardhanam ||11||
pūrvamadalakṣaṇamāha- pūrve ityādi| pūrve prathame made, vīryam utsāhalakṣaṇaṃ, ratiḥ harṣaḥ, prītiḥ tṛptiḥ, harṣaḥ tuṣṭiḥ; ādiśabdāt hāsyādayaḥ||11||

div.ab: pralāpo madhyame moho `harṣaḥ' iti pā. yuktāyuktakriyāstathā |12|
madhyamadalakṣaṇamāha- pralāpa ityādi| yuktāyuktakriyā iti kadācidayuktāḥ kadācidyuktāḥ kriyā ityarthaḥ|12|-

ab.seg: visañjñaḥ paścime śete naṣṭakarmakriyāguṇaḥ ||12||

paścimamadalakṣaṇamāha- visañjña ityādi| paścime paścimamade| naṣṭakarmakriyāguṇa iti naṣṭāni karmāṇi kriyāguṇāḥ kriyāphalāni ca yasya sa tathā; atra guṇaśabdaḥ phale vartate| kecit, ‘buddhismṛtiprītikaraḥ sukhaśca pānānnanidrārucivṛddhihetuḥ| sampāṭhagītasvaravardhanaśca prokto'tiramyaḥ prathamo mado hi|| avyaktabuddhismṛtivāgviceṣṭaḥ sonmattalīlākrutirapraśāntaḥ| ālasyanidrābhihato muhuśca madhyena mattaḥ puruṣo madena|| gacchedagamyāṃ na gurūṃśca manyet khādedabhakṣyāṇi ca naṣṭasañjñaḥ| brūyācca guhyāni hṛdisthitāni matto madena pravareṇa martyaḥ’ iti paṭhanti; vyākhyānayanti ca- avyaktabuddhismṛtivāgiti aspaṣṭabuddhismaraṇavacanaḥ; viceṣṭo vigatakāyaparispandaḥ, sonmattalīlākṛtiriti saha unmattalīlākṛtibhyāṃ vartate iti tathā unmattakrīḍākāra ityarthaḥ| ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ pūrvo vā paṭhanīyaḥ, na tu pāṭhadvayaṃ paṭhanīyam||12||
ślaiṣmikānalpapittāṃśca snigdhānmātropasevinaḥ `māṃsopasevinaḥ' iti pā.| pānaṃ na bādhate'tyarthaṃ viparītāṃstu bādhate ||13||
idānīṃ puruṣaviśeṣeṇa sevyamānaṃ madyaṃ nātibādhāṃ kurute ityāha- ślaiṣmikānalpapittāṃścetyādi| viparītān pittādhikarūkṣātimātrasevinaḥ||13||
nirbhaktamekāntata eva madyaṃ niṣevyamāṇaṃ manujena nityam | utpādayet kaṣṭatamān vikārānāpādayeccāpi śarīramedam ||14||

nirbhaktamekāntata eva madyamityādi| nirbhaktam āhārarahitam| śarīrabhedaṃ dehanāśam| yadyapyayamarthastadevānannamityādinaivoktaḥ tathā'pi nirbhaktamiti yadatra punaruktaṃ tannirbhaktapānasyātigarhitatvakhyāpanārtham||14||
kruddhena bhītena pipāsitena śokābhitaptena bubhukṣitena | vyāyāmabhārādhvaparikṣatena vegāvarodhābhihatena cāpi ||15||
atyamlabhakṣyāvatatodareṇa sājīrṇabhuktena tathā'balena | uṣṇābhitaptena ca sevyamānaṃ karoti madyaṃ vividhān vikārān ||26||

idānīṃ kruddhādibhiḥ sevyamānaṃ madyaṃ vikārān janayatīti pratipādayitumāha- kruddhenetyādi| vyāyāmabhārādhvaparikṣateneti vyāyāmādibhiḥ parikhinnenetyarthaḥ| abhihatena pīḍitena| atyamlabhakṣyāvatatodareṇa atyamlabhakṣaṇāvṛtajaṭhareṇa||15-16||
pānātyayaṃ paramadaṃ pānājīrṇamathāpi vā | pānavibhramamugraṃ ca teṣāṃ vakṣyami lakṣaṇam ||17||
ke te vividhā vikārāstānāha- pānātyayamityādi||17||

div.ab: stambhāṅgamardahṛdayagrahatodakampāḥ pānātyaye'nilakṛte śiraso rujaśca | svedapralāpamukhaśoṣaṇadāhamūrcchāḥ pittātmake vadanalocanapītatā ca ||18|| śleṣmātmake vamathuśītakaphaprasekāḥ sarvātmake bhavati sarvavikārasampat |19|
idānīṃ pānātyayasya vātādibhedena lakṣaṇamāha- stambhetyādi| stambhaḥ stabdhatā|18|-
ūṣmāṇamaṅgagurutāṃ virasānanatvaṃ śleṣmādhikatvamaruciṃ malamūtrasaṅgam ||19|| liṅgaṃ parasya tu madasya vadanti tajjñāstṛṣṇāṃ rujāṃ śirasi sandhiṣu cāpi bhedam |20|

paramadalakṣaṇamāha- ūṣmāṇamityādi| virasānanatvaṃ virasamukhatvam| śleṣmādhikatvaṃ kaphotkarṣatvam `kaphautkaṭyaṃ' iti pā.| parasya tu madasya paramadasyetyarthaḥ| bhedamiti bheda iva bhedaḥ| paramadādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ doṣatrayajanitatvāt pṛthagdoṣaliṅgaṃ noktam||19||-
ādhmānamudgiraṇamamlaraso vidāho'jīrṇasya pānajanitasya vadanti liṅgam ||20|| jñeyāni tatra bhiṣajā suviniścitāni pittaprakopajanitāni ca kāraṇāni |21|
pānājīrṇalakṣaṇamāha- ādhmānamityādi| udgiraṇaṃ chardiḥ| ajīrṇasya pānajanitasya pānājīrṇasya| kāraṇāni lakṣaṇāni, kāraṇasyāpi vyādhilakṣaṇatvāt||20||-
hṛdgātratodavamathujvarakaṇṭhadhūmamūrcchākaphasravaṇamūrdharujo vidāhaḥ ||21|| dveṣaḥ surānnavikṛteṣu ca teṣu teṣu taṃ pānavibhramamuśantyakhilena dhīrāḥ |22|
pānavibhramalakṣaṇamāha- hṛdityādi| vamathuḥ chardiḥ, kaṇṭhadhūmaḥ kaṇṭhe dhūmodvamanamiva `dhūmodvahanamiva' iti ‘dhūmodgamanamiva’ iti ca pā., mūrdharujā śiraḥpīḍā||21||-
hīnottarauṣṭhamatiśītamamandadāhaṃ tailaprabhāsyamati(pi)pānahataṃ vijahyāt ||22|| jihvauṣṭhadantamasitaṃ tvathavā'pi nīlaṃ pīte ca yasya nayane rudhiraprabhe ca |23|

idānīmasādhyalakṣaṇamāha- hīnottarauṣṭhamityādi| hīnottarauṣṭhaḥ svabhāvauṣṭhādalpauṣṭhaḥ| amandadāhaṃ tīvradāham| kadācidatiśītaṃ kadācittīvradāham| pānahataṃ pānapīḍitam| vijahyāt tyajet| asitaṃ kṛṣṇam| pīte pītavarṇe||22||-

ab.seg: hikkājvarau vamathuvepathupārśvaśūlāḥ kāsabhramāvapi ca pānahataṃ bhajante ||23||
idānīmupadravānāha- hikkājvarāvityādi| vamathuḥ chardiḥ, vepathuḥ kampaḥ||23||

div.ab: teṣāṃ nivāraṇamidaṃ hi mayocyamānaṃ vyaktābhidhānamakhilena vidhiṃ nibodha |24|
teṣāṃ nivāraṇamityādi| teṣāṃ pānātyayādīnām|24|-
madyaṃ tu cukramaricārdrakadīpyakuṣṭhasauvarcalāyutamalaṃ `dīpyakāḍhyaṃ' iti pā. pavanasya śāntyai ||24|| pṛthvīkadīpyakamahauṣadhahiṅgubhirvā sauvarcalena ca yutaṃ vitaret sukhāya |25|
tameva vidhimāha- madyamityādi| dīpyakaḥ ajamodā, yavānītyapare| sauvarcalāyutam īṣatsauvarcalayuktam| alaṃ samartham| pavanasya vātajamadātyayasya| vitaret dadyāt||24||-
āmrātakāmraphaladāḍimamātuluṅgaiḥ kuryācchubhānyapi ca ṣāḍavapānakāni ||25|| seveta vā phalarasopahitān rasādīnānūpavargapiśitānyapi gandhavanti |26|

kiṃ madātyaye madyameva sevyamutānyadapītyāha- āmrātakāmretyādi| dāḍimamatra amlameva| ṣāḍavo yūṣaviśeṣaḥ| āmrātakādibhiḥ kvathitairikṣuvikārayutaiḥ ṣāḍavaḥ kāryaḥ| tathā ca tantrāntare ṣāḍavakalpanā,- “yutamikṣuvikāreṇa kvathitaṃ cūtajaṃ phalam| ghṛtaśuṇṭhītilayutaṃ vijñeyo ghanaṣāḍavaḥ”- iti| phalarasopahitān mātuluṅgarasayuktān| rasādīn māṃsarasayūṣādīn| ānūpavargapiśitāni kūlacarādivargamāṃsāni| gandhavantīti prabhūtahiṅgujīrakādiyutāni||25||-

ab.seg: pittātmake madhuravargakaṣāyamiśraṃ madyaṃ hitaṃ samadhuśarkaramiṣṭagandham ||26||
pittajamadātyayacikitsāmāha- pittātmake madhuravargakaṣāyamiśramityādi| madhuravargo guḍūcīvarjitaḥ kākolyādiḥ, tantrāntarasaṃvādāt| iṣṭagandham elātvakpatrakādyaiḥ surabhīkṛtam||26||
pītvā ca madyamapi cekṣurasapragāḍhaṃ niḥśeṣataḥ kṣaṇamavasthitamullikhecca | lāvaiṇatittirirasāṃśca pibedanamlān maudgān sukhāya saghṛtān sasitāṃśca yūṣān ||27||

pittātmake madātyaye vamanamāha- pītvetyādi| ullikhet vamet| yadyapi pitte vamanaṃ na kāryaṃ tathā'pi pittasya kaphasthānagatatvādvamanaṃ hitameva, vyādhipratyanīkatvādvā| kiṃ pittātmake etadeva kāryamutānyadapītyāha- lāvaiṇatittirirasānityādi| kecit ‘maudgān sukhāya saghṛtān sasitāṃśca yūṣān’ ityatra ‘maudgān saśarkaraghṛtān sa hitāya yūṣān’ iti paṭhanti; sa iti pittapānātyayīti ca vyākhyānayanti||27||
pānātyaye kaphakṛte kaphamullikhecca madyena bimbividulodakasaṃyutena | seveta tiktakaṭukāṃśca rasānudārān yūṣāṃśca tiktakaṭukopahitān hitāya ||28||

kaphajamadātyayacikitsāmāha- pānātyaye kaphakṛte ityādi| bimbī oṣṭhopamaphalā vidulo vetasaḥ| kaphamadātyaye'paramapyauṣadhamāha- sevetetyādi| tiktakaṭukān tiktakaṭukadravyasaṃskṛtān| rasān māṃsarasān; udārān jāṅgalajān, medaskānityarthaḥ| yūṣān mudgādiyūṣān| tiktāni durālabhādīni, kaṭukāni pippalyādīni, upahitān saṃskṛtān||28||

div.ab: pathyaṃ yavānnavikṛtāni ca jāṅgalāni śleṣmaghnamanyadapi yacca niratyayaṃ syāt |29|

śleṣmajapānātyaye'paramapi yaddhitaṃ tadāha- pathyamityādi| pathyaṃ hitam| yavānnavikṛtāni yavānnāni vividhaprakāraiḥ kṛtānītyarthaḥ| atra annaśabdaḥ peyalehyavyavacchedakaḥ| jāṅgalāni jāṅgalamāṃsāni| niratyayaṃ nirdoṣam|29|-

ab.seg: kuryācca sarvamatha sarvabhave vidhānaṃ dvandvodbhave dvayamavekṣya yathāpradhānam ||29||

sannipātajadvandvajamadātyayacikitsāmāha- kuryādityādi| sarvaṃ pratyekadoṣajapānātyayacikitsitam| sarvabhave sannipātodbhave| dvandvabhave dvandvaje| yathāpradhānaṃ yogapradhānamityarthaḥ; etena samasannipāte sarvapradhānaṃ kāryam, ekatamādhike ca tatpradhānamityarthaḥ; evaṃ dvandvaje'pi||29||

div.ab: sāmānyamanyadapi yacca samagramagryaṃ vakṣyāmi yacca manaso madakṛt sukhaṃ ca |30|
sāmānyamanyadapītyādi| anyadapi yat sāmānyaṃ manaso harṣakṛt vakṣyāmi tat samagramapi sarveṣāmagryaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sukhaṃ ca, sukhahetutvādityarthaḥ|30|-

tvaṅgāgapuṣpamagadhailamadhūkadhānyaiḥ ślakṣṇairajājimaricaiśca kṛtaṃ samāṃśaiḥ ||30|| pānaṃ kapittharasavāriparūṣakāḍhyaṃ pānātyayeṣu vidhivatsrutamambarānte | hrīverapadmaparipelavasamprayuktaiḥ puṣpairvilipya karavīrajalodbhavaiśca ||31|| piṣṭaiḥ sapadmakayutairapi sārivādyaiḥ sekaṃ jalaiśca vitaredamalaiḥ suśītaiḥ | tvakpatracocamaricailabhujaṅgapuṣpaśleṣmātakaprasavavalkaguḍairupetam ||32|| drākṣāyutaṃ hṛtamalaṃ madirāmayārtaistatpānakaṃ śuci sugandhi narairniṣevyam | piṣṭvā pibecca madhukaṃ kaṭurohiṇīṃ ca drākṣāṃ ca mūlamasakṛt trapuṣībhavaṃ yat ||33|| kārpāsinīmatha `kārpāsamūlamatha' iti pā. ca nāgabalāṃ ca tulyāṃ pītvā sukhī bhavati sādhu suvarcalāṃ ca |34|

pānātyayacikitsāmāha- tvagityādi| nāgapuṣpaṃ nāgakeśaram, elā sūkṣmailā, ajājī uttarāpathe prasiddho jīrakaviśeṣaḥ| samāṃśaiḥ tulyabhāgaiḥ| pānaṃ pānakam| kapittharasaḥ kapitthasvarasaḥ| srutaṃ gālitam| ambarānte vastrānte| hrīveretyādi| hrīverādiyuktaiḥ karavīrajalodbhavaiḥ puṣpaiḥ piṣṭairvilipya padmakayutaiḥ sārivādibhiśca pralipya, amalaiḥ suśītaiśca jalaiḥ sekaṃ vitaret dadyāditi piṇḍārthaḥ| hrīveraḥ vālakam| padmakaṃ padmakāṣṭhaṃ, jalodbhavapuṣpatvena padmasya parigrahāt| kārtikakuṇḍastu ‘sapadmakayutaiḥ’ ityanena padmakasahitapriyaṅgvādyabhidhāya tena yuktaiḥ karavīrādipuṣpairhrīberādiyuktairiti vyākhyānayati, padmakaṃ jalajaṃ manyate| paripelavo vanyakaḥ| jalodbhavaiḥ nīlotpalaprabhṛtibhiḥ| sapadmakayutairapi sārivādyairiti sapadmakaḥ padmakasahitaḥ priyaṅgvādiḥ, tena yutaiḥ sārivādibhirityarthaḥ| tvagityādi|- tvak vanavāsikātvak| śleṣmātakaprasavaṃ bahuvārapuṣpam| hṛtamalaṃ vastragālitam| madirāmayārtaiḥ pānātyayapīḍitaiḥ| sugandhiśobhanagandhi| kecit tvakpatraśabdena tvakpatrikāmāhuḥ| piṣṭvetyādi| asakṛditi sādhviti ca padaṃ piṣṭvetyatra sambandhanīyam| madhukādistrapusīmūlānta eko yogaḥ| kārpāsinīmityādiḥ sādhusuvarcalāṃ cetyanto dvitīyaḥ| kārpāsinī vanakārpāsinī| suvarcalā sūryabhaktā| kārpāsinīmatha cetyatra kārpāsamevamatheti kecit paṭhanti, kārpāsaṃ kārpāsīmūlaṃ, evamasakṛt piṣṭveti ca vyākhyānayanti||30-33||-
kāśmaryadāruviḍadāḍimapippalīṣu drākṣānvitāsu kṛtamambuni pānakaṃ yat ||34|| tadbījapūrakarasāyutamāśu pītaṃ śāntiṃ parāṃ paramade tvacirāt karoti |35|
paramade cikitsāmāha- kāśmaryetyādi| kāśmaryaṃ gambhārīphalaṃ, kṛtaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ, ambuni pānīye||34||-

ab.seg: drākṣāsitāmadhukajīrakadhānyakṛṣṇāsvevaṃ kṛtaṃ trivṛtayā ca pibettathaiva ||35||
sauvarcalāyutamudārarasaṃ phalāmlaṃ bhārgīśṛtena ca jalena hito'vasekaḥ ||36||

paramade pānakāntaramāha- drākṣetyādi| drākṣādiṣu dravyeṣu evaṃ bījapūrakarasasaṃskāreṇa kṛtaṃ pānakaṃ trivṛtayā trijaṭayā ca kṛtaṃ pānakaṃ pibet| tathaiva sauvarcalāyutamityādi|- udārarasaṃ jāṅgalamāṃsarasaṃ, sauvarcalāyutam īṣatsauvarcalāyutaṃ, dāḍimādyamlaphalenāmlaṃ tathaiva pibedityarthaḥ| avasekaḥ pariṣekaḥ||35-36||
ikṣvākudhāmārgavavṛkṣakāṇi kākāhvayodumbarikāśca dugdhe | vipācya tasyāñjalinā vameddhi madyaṃ pibeccāhni gate tvajīrṇe ||37||

pānājīrṇacikitsāmāha- ikṣvākvityādi| ikṣvākvādīni dravyāṇi kṣīrapākavidhānena dugdhe vipācya tasya kuḍavenājīrṇe pānājīrṇe vameta, tataśca ahni divase gate atīte sati madyaṃ pibet agnidīpanārtham| ikṣākuḥ tiktālābūḥ| dhāmārgavaḥ pītaghoṣaḥ| vṛkṣakaḥ kuṭajaphalam| kākāhvayā udumbarikāgo(kā)ṣṭhodumbarikā| anye gate tvajīrṇe apagate pānājīrṇe iti vyākhyānayanti||37||

div.ab: tvakpippalībhujagapuṣpaviḍairupetaṃ seveta hiṅgumaricailayutaṃ phalāmlam | uṣṇāmbusaindhavayutāstvathavā viḍatvakcavyailahiṅgumagadhāphalamūlaśuṇṭhīḥ ||38|| hṛdyaiḥ khaḍairapi ca bhojanamatra śastaṃ... |39|

kimmayaṃ madyaṃ pānājīrṇe pibedityāha- tvagityādi| tvakpippalīprabhṛtiyutaṃ madyaṃ seveta, tathā hiṅgumaricādiyutaṃ madyaṃ seveta| bhujagapuṣpaṃ nāgapuṣpam| phalāmlaṃ dāḍimabījapūrakādibhiramlīkṛtaṃ madyam| uṣṇāmbusaindhavayutā ityādi| atrāpi seveteti sambadhyate| magadhāphalamūlamiti pippalyāḥ phalamūlamityarthaḥ| bhojanamāha- hṛdyairityādi| khaḍā yūṣaviśeṣāḥ| atra pānājīrṇe| ‘hṛdyaiḥ’ ityatra ‘madyaiḥ’ ityanye paṭhanti| apare ‘khaḍaiḥ’ ityatra ‘phalaiḥ’ iti paṭhanti| ‘viḍatvak’ ityatra ‘yathoktaṃ’ iti kecit paṭhanti||38||-

ab.seg: ... drākṣākapitthaphaladāḍimapānakaṃ yat | tat pānavibhramaharaṃ madhuśarkarāḍhyamāmrātakolarasapānakameva cāpi ||39||
kharjūravetrakakarīraparūṣakeṣu `kharjūravetrakaravīraparūṣakeṣu' iti pā. drākṣātrivṛtsu ca kṛtaṃ sasitaṃ himaṃ vā | śrīparṇiyuktamathavā tu pibedimāni yaṣṭyāhvayotpalahimāmbuvimiśritāni ||40||
kṣīripravālabisajīrakanāgapuṣpapatrailavālusitasārivapadmakāni | āmrātabhavyakaramardakapitthakolavṛkṣāmlavetraphalajīrakadāḍimāni ||41||

pānavibhramacikitsāmāha- drākṣākapitthetyādi| atra phalaśabdena viśiṣṭāni mātuluṅgādiphalāni gṛhyante| na kevalaṃ drākṣādipānakaṃ madhuśarkarāḍhyaṃ pānavibhrame śastam, āmrātakolarasapānakamapi| athavā kharjūrādiṣu kṛtaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ saśarkaraṃ śrīparṇīyuktaṃ himaṃ pānakaṃ pānavibhrame śastam| karīro marudeśajaḥ, tasya phalam| śrīparṇīyuktaṃ kāśmarīphalayuktam| athavetyādi|- athavā imāni kṣīripravālādīni dāḍimāntāni yaṣṭyāhvayotpalahimāmbuvimiśritāni atra pānavibhrame pibet| yaṣṭyāhvayotpalahimāmbuvimiśritānīti yaṣṭīmadhunīlotpalayuktaṃ yat himāmbu tena vimiśritānītyarthaḥ| kṣīripravālā vaṭādipallavāḥ| bhavyaṃ tālaphalapramāṇam uttarāpathajam, anye karmaraṅgamāhuḥ||39-41||
seveta vā maricajīrakanāgapuṣpatvakpatraviśvacavikailayutān rasāṃśca | sūkṣmāmbarasrutahimāṃśca sugandhigandhān pānodbhavānnudati saptagadānaśeṣān ||42||

idānīṃ pānātyayādīnāṃ cikitsāmāha- sevetetyādi| rasān māṃsarasān| samagrān sampūrṇān; sampūrṇatvaṃ caiṣāṃ maricādibhiḥ sarvairevānvitatvam| sūkṣmāmbarasrutahimān sūkṣmavastragālitaśītānityarthaḥ| sugandhigandhān atyarthamagurvādidhūpitān| nudati sphoṭayati| pānodbhavān saptagadān catvāro madātyayāḥ, trayaśca paramadapānājīrṇapānavibhramāḥ, pānātyayaprabhavatvātteṣāṃ; evaṃ sapta||42||
pañcendriyārthaviṣayā mṛdupānayogā hṛdyāḥ sukhāśca manasaḥ satataṃ niṣevyāḥ `niyojyāḥ' iti pā.| pānātyayeṣu vikaṭorunitambavatyaḥ pīnonnatastanabharānatamadhyadeśāḥ ||43||
prauḍhāḥ striyo'bhinavayauvanapīnagātryaḥ sevyāśca pañcaviṣayātiśayasvabhāvāḥ ||44||
