kolamajjāmityādi| kolamajjā badaramajjā, majjāśabda ākārānto'pyasti, tena majjāmiti sādhupāṭhaḥ| ‘tālamūlam’ ityatra ‘tālamūlīm’ iti kecit paṭhanti; tatra tālamūlīmuṣalī| nīcaiḥkadambabījamityādi| nīcaiḥkadambabījaṃ laghukadambabījam| ‘taṇḍulāmbunā’ ityatra ‘peyam’ ityadhyāhāryam| kecit ‘nīpaṃ kadambaṃ raktaṃ ca tat pītaṃ taṇḍulāmbunā’ iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- nīpaṃ bṛhatkadambaphalaṃ, kadambaṃ laghukadambavṛkṣaphalaṃ, raktamiti viśeṣaṇādanayoḥ pakvayorgrahaṇaṃ yataḥ paripakvaṃ raktaṃ bhavati, piṣṭaṃ pāne deyamiti yāvat| apare tu taṇḍulāmbunā pītaṃ sudāruṇān śvāsān hantīti yojayanti| ye pūrvaṃ pañcalehaprastāve ‘nīcaiḥkadambabījāni’ iti paṭhanti tanmate'pyatra na punaruktatā, yataḥ pūrvaṃ madhusarpirbhyāṃ vilihan śvāsān hantīti lehaḥ, atra tu taṇḍulāmbunā pānam||39||-
drākṣāṃ harītakīṃ kṛṣṇāṃ karkaṭākhyāṃ durālabhām ||40|| sarpirmadhubhyāṃ vilihan hanti śvāsān sudāruṇān |41|
drākṣāṃ harītakīmityādi| kṛṣṇā pippalī| karkaṭākhyā karkaṭaśṛṅgī||40||-
haridrāṃ maricaṃ drākṣāṃ guḍaṃ rāsnāṃ kaṇāṃ śaṭīm ||41|| lihyāttailena `tailena vilihan hanyācchvāsān pāṇaharānapi' iti pā. tulyāni śvāsārto hitabhojanaḥ |42|
haridrāmityādi| kaṇā pippalī| kecidamuṃ pāṭhamanyathā paṭhanti, sa cābhāvānna darśitaḥ||41||-
gavāṃ purīṣasvarasaṃ madhusarpiḥkaṇāyutam `madhumāgadhikāyutam' iti pā.||42|| lihyācchvāseṣu kāseṣu vājināṃ vā śakṛdrasam |43|
gavāṃ purīṣasvarasamityādi| gośakṛdrasapippalyau madhughṛtābhyāṃ lihyāt, aśvaśakṛdrasapippalyau vā madhughṛtābhyāṃ lihyāt||42||-
pāṇḍurogeṣu śotheṣu ye yogāḥ samprakīrtitāḥ ||43|| śvāsakāsāpahāste'pi kāsaghnā ye ca kīrtitāḥ |44|

idānīṃ pāṇḍurogādyuktayogānatrāpyatidiśannāha- pāṇḍurogeṣvityādi pāṇḍurogādipratiṣedheṣu ye yogāḥ kathitāste'pi śvāsakāsāpahāḥ, kāsaghnā ye ca kīrtitāste'pi| kecidamuṃ pāṭhaṃ na `anyathā paṭhanti' iti pā. paṭhanti||43||-
bhārgītvak tryūṣaṇaṃ tailaṃ haridrāṃ kaṭurohiṇīm ||44|| pippalīṃ maricaṃ caṇḍāṃ gośakṛdrasameva ca |45|
bhārgītvagityādi| atra lihyāditi sambandhanīyam||44||-
talakoṭasya bījeṣu pacedutkārikāṃ śubhām ||45|| sevyamānā nihantyeṣā śvāsānāśu sudustarān |46|
talakoṭasyetyādi| talakoṭaḥ aṅkoṭhaḥ| utkārikā lapsikā| kecit ‘bhārgītvak’ ityādikaṃ ‘talakoṭasya bījeṣu’ itiparyantamutkārikāryaṃ manyante||45||-

ab.seg: purāṇasarpiḥ pippalyaḥ kaulatthā jāṅgalā rasāḥ ||46||
surā sauvīrakaṃ hiṅguḥ mātuluṅgaraso madhu | drākṣāmalakabilvāni śastāni śvāsihikkinām ||47||
idānīṃ śvāse hikkāyāṃ cānyadapi yaddhitaṃ tadāha- purāṇasarpirityādi| kaulatthāḥ kulatthaiḥ saṃskṛtāḥ| jāṅgalā rasā eṇādīnāmeva māṃsarasāḥ| sauvīrakaṃ virecanakalpoktam||46-47||

div.ab: śvāsahikkāparigataṃ snigdhaiḥ svedairupācaret | āktaṃ `yuktaiḥ' iti `yuktaṃ' iti ca pā. lavaṇatailābhyāṃ tairasya grathitaḥ kaphaḥ ||48|| khastho vilayanaṃ yāti mārutaśca praśāmyati |49|

śvāse tatprasaṅgena ca hikkāyāmapi tulyaṃ pratīkāramāha- śvāsahikkāparigatamityādi| śvāsahikkāparigataṃ śvāsahikkāvyāptam| snigdhaiḥ svedaiḥ sālvaṇaprabhṛtibhiḥ| āktaṃ lavaṇatailābhyāṃ saindhavatilatailābhyāṃ cuppaṭitam āturamityarthaḥ| taiḥ snigdhasvaideḥ| grathitaḥ ghanībhūtaḥ| khasthaḥ srotaḥsthitaḥ| vilayanaṃ dravabhāvam||48||-

svinnaṃ `snigdhaṃ' iti pā. jñātvā tataścaiva bhojayitvā rasaudanam ||49|| vātaśleṣmavibandhe vā bhiṣag dhūmaṃ prayojayet | manaḥśilādevadāruharidrācchadanāmiṣaiḥ ||50|| lākṣorubūkamūlaiśca kṛtvā vartīrvidhānataḥ |51|

svede kṛte'pi yadā vātakaphānubandho nopaśāmyati tadā kiṃ kartavyamityāha- svinnamityādi| svinnaṃ jñātvā rasaudanaṃ bhojayitvā vātakaphānubandhe sati yuktaṃ dhūmaṃ prayojayediti piṇḍārthaḥ| keṣāṃ dhūmaṃ prayojayedityāha- manaḥśiletyādi| chadanaṃ patrakam, āmiṣaṃ gugguluḥ| urubūkamūlaṃ raktairaṇḍamūlam| vidhānataḥ dhūmanasyakavalagrahacikitsitoktavidhānena||49-50||-

ab.seg: sarpiryavamadhucchiṣṭaśālaniryāsajaṃ `sarpirnavamadhūcchiṣṭa ...' iti pā. tathā ||51||
aparamapi dhūmamāha- sarpirityādi| madhūcchiṣṭaṃ madanam| śālaniryāso rālā| sarpiryavādijaṃ dhūmaṃ tathā tenaiva prakāreṇa prayojayediti piṇḍārthaḥ||51||

div.ab: śṛṅgabālakhurasnāyutvak samastaṃ gavāmapi |52|
aparāṇyapi dhūmadravyāṇyāha- śṛṅgabālakhuretyādi| gavāṃ śṛṅgādikaṃ tvakparyantaṃ samastamapi dhūmārthaṃ prayojayet| snāyuḥ dhanurjyābandhanārthaṃ dravyaṃ ‘nahāru’ iti loke|52|-

ab.seg: turuṣkaśallakīnāṃ ca gugguloḥ padmakasya ca ||52||
turuṣketyādi| turuṣkaḥ sihlakaḥ| turuṣkādipadmakāntānāṃ vā dhūmaṃ prayojayet||52||

div.ab: ete sarve sasarpiṣkā dhūmāḥ kāryā vijānatā |53|
pūrvoktadhūmānāmupasaṃhāramāha- eta ityādi| ete pūrvoktā dhūmāḥ sasarpiṣkāḥ saghṛtā vijānatā vaidyena kāryāḥ|53|-

ab.seg: balīyasi kaphagraste vamanaṃ savirecanam ||53||
śvāsihikkināmavasthāyāṃ virecanamāha- balīyasītyādi| balīyasi balayukte puruṣe, vamanaṃ savirecanaṃ ‘mṛdu hitam’ ityatrādhyāhāryam||53||
durbale caiva rūkṣe ca tarpaṇaṃ hitamucyate | jāṅgalorabhrajairmāṃsairānūpairvā susaṃskṛtaiḥ ||54||

durbale ityādi| tarpaṇaṃ santarpaṇam| kaistarpaṇaṃ prayoktavyamityāha- jāṅgalorabhrajairityādi| jāṅgalā eṇādayo lāvādayaśca| urabhro meṣaḥ| ānūpāḥ kacchapādayaḥ| susaṃskṛtaiḥ sūdaśāstroktavidhinā||54||
nidigdhikāṃ cāmalakapramāṇāṃ hiṅgvardhayuktāṃ madhunā suyuktām | lihannaraḥ śvāsanipīḍito hi śvāsaṃ jayatyeva balātryaheṇa ||55||

idānīṃ śvāse siddhatamaṃ yogamāha- nidigdhikāmityādi| nidigdhikā kaṇṭakārī, tāṃ kalkīkṛtāmāmalakapramāṇāṃ tadardhapramāṇena hiṅgunā madhunā ca yuktāṃ śvāsapīḍito naraḥ puruṣo lihan balāt śvāsamāśu tryahājjayediti sambandhaḥ| etat sarvaśvāsacikitsitaṃ sāmānyamapi dravyasvarūpamabhisamīkṣya viśeṣādūhyamiti||55||
yathā'gniriddhaḥ pavanānuviddho `khalu kāṣṭhasaṅghaiḥ' iti pā. vajraṃ yathā vā surarājamuktam | rogāstathaite khalu durnivārāḥ śvāsaśca kāsaśca vilambikā ca ||56||
śvāsasya tatprasaṅgena ca kāsādīnāmapi duḥkhopacaryatvakhyāpanārthamāha- yathā'gniriddha ityādi| iddhaḥ dīptaḥ| pavanānuviddho vātasahitaḥ||56||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre hikkāśvāsapratiṣedho nāma (trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) ekapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||51||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantre hikkāśvāsapratiṣedho nāmaikapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||51||

div.head: kāsapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ kāsapratiṣedhamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
śvāsapratiṣedhānantaraṃ vātakaphaprādhānyatvasāmyāttulyacikitsitatvācca kāsapratiṣedhārambhaḥ- athāta ityādi||1-2||
uktā ye hetavo nṝṇāṃ rogayoḥ śvāsahikkayoḥ | kāsasyāpi ca vijñeyāsta evotpattihetavaḥ ||3||
idānīmatideśena kāsahetūnāha- uktā ityādi||3||
dhūmopaghātādrajasastathaiva vyāyāmarūkṣānnaniṣevaṇācca | vimārgagatvādapi bhojanasya vegāvarodhāt kṣavathostathaiva ||4||
prāṇo hyudānānugataḥ praduṣṭaḥ sambhinnakāṃsyasvanatulyaghoṣaḥ | nireti vaktrāt sahasā sadoṣaḥ kāsaḥ sa vidvadbhirudāhṛtastu ||5||

kāsasya samprāptiniruktī āha- prāṇa ityādi| prāṇo vāyuḥ, udānānugata udānavāyumilitaḥ, ūrdhvagatitvādudānasya, praduṣṭaḥ kopamāpannaḥ san, sambhinnakāṃsyasvaratulyaghoṣa iti jarjaritakāṃsyaśabdānukārī svaraḥ, nireti nirgacchati| sadoṣaḥ saduṣṭirityarthaḥ; duṣṭiścātra tādṛgvidhaśabdaprāṇavāyunirgamanātmikaiva; kecit ‘sadoṣa’ ityatra ‘saghoṣa’ iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- saghoṣaḥ tādṛgvidhaprāṇanirgamanotthasvarayuktaḥ| sa prāṇo vāyuḥ ‘kāsa’ ityudāhṛtaḥ||4-5||
sa vātapittaprabhavaḥ kaphācca kṣatāttathā'nyaḥ kṣayajo'paraśca | pañcaprakāraḥ kathito bhiṣagbhirvivardhito yakṣmavikārakṛt syāt ||6||

kāsasaṅkhyāmāha- sa vātapittaprabhava ityādi| sa iti kāsaḥ| kṣatāt kṣatajaḥ| kṣayajaḥ śukrakṣayajaḥ| saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva saṅkhyāyāṃ siddhāyāṃ pañcaprakāra iti saṅkhyākaraṇaṃ niyamārtham| tena vātādikṛtakāsasya pañcaprakārāḥ, na punarnimittāntarabhedādbhedaḥ| yakṣmavikārakṛt rājayakṣmakṛt, rogasyāpi vyādhikāraṇatvāt| yadyapi kṣayādutpannakāsasya kṣayakartṛtvaṃ na sambhavati, tathā'pi pūrvāvasthāto'dhikaṃ kṣayaṃ karoti, ataḥ kṣayajakāsasyāpi kṣayakartṛtvam, athavā bahuṣu chatriṣu gacchatsu keṣucidacchatriṣvapi chatriṇo yāntīti vyapadeśavat kṣayajakāsasyāpi kṣayakartṛtvavyapadeśaḥ| kecit ‘pañcaprakāraḥ paṭhito bhiṣagbhirviśeṣato lakṣaṇataḥ purāṇaiḥ’ iti paṭhanti||6||
bhaviṣyatastasya tu kaṇṭhakaṇḍūrbhojyoparodho galatālulepaḥ | svaśabdavaiṣamyamarocako'gnisādaśca `saśabdavaiṣamya...' iti pā. liṅgāni bhavantyamūni ||7||

kāsapūrvarūpamāha- bhaviṣyatastasyetyādi| bhojyoparodhaḥ grāsasya gale saṅgaḥ| svaśabdavaiṣamyamiti īṣatprakṛtisvaravaikṛtam| agnisādaḥ agnimāndyam| kecit kāsapūrvarūpaṃ na paṭhanti, rūpāṇāmevāvyaktānāṃ prāgrūpasadbhāvāt; tanna, samānatantravirodhāt||7||
hṛcchaṅkhamūrdhodarapārśvaśūlī kṣāmānanaḥ kṣīṇabalasvaraujāḥ | prasaktamantaḥkaphamīraṇena `prasaktavegaśca samīraṇeva' iti pā. kāsettu śuṣkaṃ svarabhedayuktaḥ ||8||

vātakāsalakṣaṇamāha- hṛcchaṅkhamūrdhodaretyādi| kṣāmānanaḥ kṣīṇamukhakriyaḥ| kṣīṇabalasvaraujā iti balaṃ karmanirvartanakṣamatā, ojo hṛdi sthitaṃ prasiddhameva| prasaktamityādi| prasaktaṃ yathā bhavati tathā'ntaḥkaphaṃ yathā bhavati śuṣkaṃ ca yathā bhavati tathā kāsedityarthaḥ; prasaktaṃ nirantaraṃ, antaḥkapham abhyantarakaphaṃ, śuṣkaṃ śleṣmarahitam| īraṇena vāyunā| svarabhedayukto bhinnasvara ityarthaḥ| ‘hṛcchaṅkhamūrdhodarapārśvaśūlam’ iti kecit paṭhanti, tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ||8||
urovidāhajvaravaktraśoṣairabhyarditastiktamukhastṛṣārtaḥ | pittena pītāni vamet kaṭūni kāset sa pāṇḍuḥ paridahyamānaḥ ||9||
pittakāsalakṣaṇamāha- urovidāhajvaretyādi| abhyarditaḥ pīḍitaḥ| tiktamukho nimbādibhakṣaṇeneva| pāṇḍutvamatra pittakṛtaṃ boddhavyaṃ, tena pāṇḍuḥ pītavarṇaḥ| paridahyamāno dāhayuktaḥ||9||
pra(vi)lipyamānena mukhena sīdan śirorujārtaḥ kaphapūrṇadehaḥ | abhaktaruggauravasādayuktaḥ kāseta `kāsedbhṛśaṃ' iti pā. nā sāndrakaphaṃ kaphena ||10||

kaphakāsalakṣaṇamāha- pralipyamānenetyādi| pralipyamānena mukhena śleṣmaṇā lipyamānena mukhena| sīdan patan| śirorujārtaḥ śirovyathāpīḍitaḥ; yadyapi śirorujā vātajanyā ato vātika eva kāse sambhavati, tathā'pi kaphaje'pi kāse vāyusadbhāvāt śirorujā yuktaiva| kaphapūrṇadehaḥ guruśarīra ityarthaḥ| abhaktaruk bhojanāruciḥ| sādaḥ aṅgaglāniḥ| nā puruṣaḥ||10||
vakṣo'timātraṃ vihataṃ tu yasya vyāyāmabhārādhyayanābhighātaiḥ | viśliṣṭavakṣāḥ sa naraḥ saraktaṃ ṣṭhīvatyabhīkṣṇaṃ kṣatajaṃ `kṣatajaḥ sa uktaḥ' iti pā. tamāhuḥ ||11||

uraḥkṣatakāsalakṣaṇamāha- vakṣo'timātramityādi| vakṣaḥ stanayorantarālaṃ, anye tu jatrukroḍapārśvānāmantarālaṃ vakṣa ityāhuḥ| vihataṃ viśeṣeṇa pīḍitam| abhighāto laguḍaprahārādiḥ| viśliṣṭavakṣāḥ avasannavakṣāḥ| saraktaṃ ṣṭhīvati ‘kaphaṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ| tasyāvasthāyāmasādhyatvamāha- sa ityādi| sa kṣatajakāsī| uraḥkṣatasya uraḥkṣatajakāsasya cāyaṃ bhedaḥ- uraḥkṣatī pūrvameva saraktādikaṃ kaphaṃ ṣṭhīvati, uraḥkṣatajakāsī tu pūrvaṃ śuṣkaṃ kāsate paścāt saśoṇitaṃ ṣṭhīvati| tathā coktaṃ- “rūkṣasyoraḥkṣataṃ vāyurgṛhītvā kāsamāvahet| sa pūrvaṃ kāsate śuṣkaṃ tataḥ ṣṭhīvet saśoṇitam” (ca. ci. 18) iti| kiñca uraḥkṣate gātraśūlādīni lakṣaṇāni pūrvameva bhavanti, tajjakāse tvasādhyāvasthāyāmevetyato'pi bhedaḥ||11||

div.ab: sa gātraśūlajvaradāhamohān prāṇakṣayaṃ copalabheta kāsī | śuṣyan viniṣṭhīvati durbalastu prakṣīṇamāṃso rudhiraṃ sapūyam ||12|| sasarvaliṅgaṃ `taṃ sarvaliṅgaṃ' iti pā. bhṛśaduścikitsyaṃ cikitsitajñāḥ kṣayajaṃ vadanti `tamāhuḥ' iti pā.|13|

kṣayajakāsalakṣaṇamāha- śuṣyannityādi| ‘viniṣṭhīvati’ iti padaṃ rudhiraṃ sapūyamityatra sambadhyate| sasarvaliṅgamiti saha sarvairliṅgairvartate yaḥ sa sasarvaliṅgaḥ sarvadoṣaliṅgayukta ityarthaḥ| cikitsitajñāḥ kāyacikitsāvidaḥ| kṣayajaṃ śukrakṣayajam| yadyapi sāmānyakṣayaśabdena rasādikṣayaḥ prāptastathā'pyatra śukrakṣayo grāhyaḥ, tajjanitatvāt kṣayakāsasya sarvadhātukṣayasya ca| yadyapi kṣayasya kṣayakāsasya ca bhedo nopalabhyate, tathā'pi kṣaye yāni kāsajvarādīni lakṣaṇāni bhavanti tānyekadoṣārabdhāni, kṣayajakāse punastāni tridoṣārabdhānītyato bhedaḥ| tathā ca tantrāntaram,- “kṣaye kāsādikaṃ liṅgamekadoṣakṛtaṃ matam| tadeva tatkṛte kāse sarvadoṣānvitaṃ budhaiḥ”- iti||12||-

ab.seg: vṛddhatvamāsādya bhavettu `bhavatyatho vai' iti pā. yo vai yāpyaṃ tamāhurbhiṣajastu kāsam ||13||
idānīṃ kāsasyāvasthāyāṃ yāpyatvamāha- vṛddhatvamityādi| vṛddhatvaṃ sthaviratvam||13||
śṛṅgīvacākaṭphalakattṛṇābdadhānyābhayābhārgyamarāhvaviśvam | uṣṇāmbunā hiṅguyutaṃ tu pītvā baddhāsyamapyāśu jahāti kāsam ||14||

idānīṃ sāmānyaṃ kāsacikitsitamāha- śṛṅgīvacākaṭphalakattṛṇābdetyādi| śṛṅgī karkaṭaśṛṅgī| abdaṃ mustā| amarāhvo devadāruḥ| baddhāsyaṃ cirakālaṃ `baddhasthitikaṃ' iti pā. vyāpya āsye sthitikaraṃ, cirakālānubaddhamiti tātparyārthaḥ| atra pūrvaṃ sāmānyacikitsākaraṇaṃ kāse āśu cikitsā kartavyeti dyotanārtham| madhuparpaṭaka rahitaḥ kaṭphalādirayam||14||
phalatrikavyoṣaviḍaṅgaśṛṅgīrāsnāvacāpadmakadevakāṣṭhaiḥ `rāsnābalāpadmakadevakāṣṭhaiḥ' iti pā.| lehaḥ samaiḥ kṣaudrasitāghṛtāktaḥ kāsaṃ nihanyādacirādudīrṇam ||15||
phalatrikavyoṣaviḍaṅgetyādi| phalatrikaṃ triphalā, vyoṣaṃ trikaṭu, devakāṣṭhaṃ devadāru||15||
pathyāṃ sitāmāmalakāni lājāṃ samāgadhīṃ cāpi vicūrṇya śuṇṭhīm | sarpirmadhubhyāṃ vilihīta kāsī sasaindhavāṃ voṣṇajalena kṛṣṇām ||16||

pathyāmityādi| pathyādīni cūrṇayitvā madhughṛtābhyāṃ kāsī vilihītetyarthaḥ| kecit pathyādikaṃ lājaparyantamekaṃ yogaṃ, samāgadhīṃ vā'pi vicūrṇya śuṇṭhīmiti dvitīyaṃ yogaṃ manyante| sasaindhavāmityādi| kṛṣṇā pippalī; ‘uṣṇajalena’ ityatra ‘pibet’ ityadhyāhāryaṃ, samānatantradarśanāt| tathā ca- “pibet sasaindhavāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ kāsaghnīṃ koṣṇavāriṇā”- iti||16||
khādedguḍaṃ nāgarapippalībhyāṃ drākṣāṃ ca sarpirmadhunā'valihyāt | drākṣāṃ sitāṃ māgadhikāṃ ca tulyāṃ saśṛṅgaveraṃ madhukaṃ tugāṃ ca ||17||
lihyādghṛtakṣaudrayutāṃ samāṃśāṃ sitopalāṃ vā maricāṃśayuktām | dhātrīkaṇāviśvasitopalāśca sañcūrṇya maṇḍena pibecca dadhnaḥ ||18||

yogadvayamāha- khādedguḍamityādi| nāgarapippalībhyāṃ ‘yuktaṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ| drākṣāṃ sitāmityādi| drākṣāmityādiko māgadhikāṃ ca tulyāmityetatparyanta eko yogaḥ| atra ca ‘khādet’ iti sambandhanīyaṃ, samānatantradarśanāt| tathā ca,- “śarkarāmāgadhīdrākṣāḥ kāsī khādet samāṃśikāḥ”-iti| saśṛṅgaveramityādikaḥ ghṛtakṣaudrayutaṃ samāṃśamityanto dvitīyo yogaḥ| tugā vaṃśalocanā, anye vaṃśalocanānukāri pārthivaṃ dravyamāhuḥ| sitopalāmityādirmaricāṃśayuktāmitiparyantastṛtīyaḥ| sitopalāṃ śarkarāṃ, maricāṃśayuktāṃ maricabhāgayuktām| atrāpi lihyāditi sambandhanīyam| dhātrīkaṇetyādi| dhātrī āmalakīphalaṃ, kaṇā pippalī, viśvaṃ śuṇṭhī, sitopalā śarkarā| dadhno maṇḍena mastunā||17-18||
hareṇukāṃ māgadhikāṃ ca tulyāṃ `mukhyaṃ' iti pā. dadhnā pibet kāsagadābhibhūtaḥ | ubhe haridre suradāruśuṇṭhīṃ gāyatrisāraṃ ca pibet samāṃśam ||19||
bastasya mūtreṇa sukhāmbunā vā dantīṃ dravantīṃ ca satilvakākhyām `sātilvakāṃśām' iti pā.| bhṛṣṭāni sarpīṃṣyatha bādarāṇi khādet palāśāni sasaindhavāni ||20||

hareṇukāmityādi| gāyatrisāraḥ khadirasāraḥ| ubhe haridre ityādirbastasya mūtreṇeti paryantameko yogaḥ| sukhāmbunā vetyādirdvitīyaḥ; sukhāmbu uṣṇodakam| dravantī cīritapatrā dantībhedaḥ| satilvakākhyāmiti paṭṭikālodhrasahitāmityarthaḥ| bhṛṣṭāni sarpīṃṣītyādi| bādarāṇi palāśāni badarīpatrāṇi||19-20||

div.ab: kolapramāṇaṃ prapibeddhi hiṅgu sauvīrakeṇāmlarasena vā'pi |21|

kolapramāṇamityādi| kolapramāṇaṃ karṣapramāṇam| sauvīrakeṇa kāñjikena| amlarasena bījapūrakarasena| yadyapi hiṅgu alpapramāṇameva hitaṃ, tathāpyardhakarṣapramāṇaṃ hiṅgu prayujyate, rogaviśeṣeṇādhikapramāṇasyāpi hitatvāt| kecit ‘sauvīrakeṇāmlarasena vā'pi’ ityatra ‘sauvīrakeṇāpi samātuluṅgam’ iti paṭhitvā bījapūrakeṇa saha hiṅgu pibediti vyākhyānayanti|21|-
kṣaudreṇa lihyānmaricāni vā'pi bhārgīvacāhiṅgukṛtā ca vartiḥ ||21|| dhūme praśastā ghṛtasamprayuktā veṇutvagelālavaṇaiḥ kṛtā vā |22|
kṣaudreṇetyādi| dhūme dhūmaviṣaye, praśastā hitā, vartiḥ ‘ṣoḍaśāṅgulanetranyastā pītā satī’ iti śeṣaḥ| veṇutvak vaṃśacchallī| lavaṇaiḥ saindhavaiḥ||21||-
musteṅgudītvaṅmadhukāhvamāṃsīmanaḥśilālaiśchagalāmbupiṣṭaiḥ ||22|| vidhāya vartīśca payo'nupānaṃ dhūmaṃ pibedvātabalāsakāsī |23|

aparāṇyapi dhūmadravyāṇyāha- mustetyādi| iṅgudītvak iṅgudīvalkalam| ālaṃ haritālam| chagalāmbu chāgamūtram| vidhāya kṛtvā| payonupānaṃ dugdhānupānam| dhūmaṃ pibet pūrvoktavidhānena| yadyapi pūrvoktayogānāṃ doṣāpekṣayā viṣayo noktaḥ, tathā'pi yogānāṃ rasādīn buddhvā yathādoṣaṃ vaidyaḥ pūrvoktayogān prayojayet||22||-

ab.seg: pibecca sīdhuṃ maricānvitaṃ vā tenāśu kāsaṃ jayati prasahya ||23||
pibecca sīdhumityādi| sīdhuḥ śasyakaḥ| tena maricānvitasīdhunā| jayati ‘ātura’ iti śeṣaḥ| prasahya haṭhāt||23||

div.ab: drākṣāmbumañjiṣṭhapurāhvayābhiḥ kṣīraṃ śṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ māhiṣasamprayuktam' iti pā. mākṣikasamprayuktam |24|

drākṣāmbumañjiṣṭhetyādi| ambu vālakam| purāhvayā śallakī, guggulumapare| kṣīramityatra ‘pibet’ iti śeṣaḥ| ‘kecit mañjiṣṭhaśuṇṭhījalagostanībhiḥ kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ mākṣikasaṃyutaṃ vā’ itīdṛśaṃ pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti|24|-

ab.seg: nidigdhikānāgarapippalībhiḥ khādecca mudgānmadhunā susiddhān ||24||

nidigdhiketyādi| susiddhān supakvān mudgān nidigdhikādibhiścūrṇitābhiḥ sārdhaṃ madhunā ca khādediti| tathā ca,- “kṣudrāmṛtānāgarapippalībhiḥ khādecca mudgānatha mudgān sahasādhu pakvān' iti pā. sādhusiddhān” iti| kecit ‘nidigdhikāmūlasamāṃśasiddhān’ iti paṭhanti, tatra kaṇṭakārīmūlatulyabhāgena saha svinnānityarthaḥ| apare ‘kaṭukopagāḍhān’ iti paṭhitvā trikaṭupragāḍhāniti vyākhyānayanti||24||
utkārikāṃ sarpiṣi nāgarāḍhyāṃ paktvā samūlaistruṭikolapatraiḥ | ebhirniṣeveta kṛtāṃ ca peyāṃ tanvīṃ suśītāṃ madhunā vimiśrām ||25||

utkārikāmityādi| utkārikāṃ lapsikām| nāgarāḍhyāṃ śuṇṭhyadhikām| atrāpi ‘khādet’ iti sambandhanīyam| ‘truṭikolapatraiḥ’ ityatra ‘vaṭakolapatraiḥ’ ityanye paṭhanti| ebhirityādi| ebhiriti pūrvoktaiḥ utkārikādidravyaiḥ| tanvīm `tanvīmalpasaṃskārāṃ viralasikthāṃ ca' iti pā. alpasikthāṃ bahudravām||25||
yat plīhni sarpirvihitaṃ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ tadvātakāsaṃ jayati prasahya | vidārigandhādikṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā rasena vā vāsakajena pakvam ||26||

sāmānyacikitsitamabhidhāyedānīmatideśena vātakāsacikitsitamāha- yat plīhni sarpirityādi| ṣaḍaṅgaṃ ṣaṭpalaṃ ṣaṭpalasya ṣaḍaṅgākhyā dvitīyā sañjñeti pratipādanārthaṃ ṣaḍaṅgakathanam| tacca ṣaṭpalapramāṇaṃ paktavyam| vidārigandhādigaṇakvāthakalkasaṃskṛtam| rasena kvāthena||26||

div.ab: virecanaṃ snaihikamatra coktamāsthāpanaṃ cāpyanuvāsanaṃ ca | dhūmaṃ pibet snaihikamapramattaḥ pibet sukhoṣṇaṃ ghṛtameva cātra ||27|| hitā yavāgvaśca raseṣu siddhāḥ payāṃsi lehāḥ saghṛtāstathaiva |28|

virecanamityādi| atra vātakāse| āsthāpanaṃ nirūhaṇam| nanu, kāse bastiniṣedhāt kathamatrāsthāpanamucyate? satyaṃ; niṣiddhamapyāsthāpanaṃ vātakāse prayujyate, doṣapratyanīkatvāt| dhūmaṃ pibedityādi| atra ‘yathoktavidhinā’ iti śeṣaḥ| snaihikaṃ madhūcchiṣṭasarjarasavasādibhiḥ kṛtam| apramattaḥ sāvadhānaḥ| sukhoṣṇam īṣaduṣṇam| ghṛtam asaṃskṛtam| atra vātakāse'nyadapi yaddhitaṃ tadāha- hitā yavāgvaścetyādi| raseṣu siddhāḥ māṃsaraseṣu siddhāḥ| payāṃsi vātaharadravyasiddhāni| lehāḥ pūrvoktāḥ||27||-

pracchardanaṃ kāyaśirovirekāstathaiva dhūmāḥ kavalagrahāśca ||28|| uṣṇāśca lehāḥ kaṭukā nihanyuḥ kaphaṃ viśeṣeṇa viśoṣaṇaṃ ca | kaṭutrikaṃ cāpi vadanti pathyaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṛmighnasvarase vipakvam ||29|| nirguṇḍipatrasvarase ca pakvaṃ sarpiḥ kaphotthaṃ vinihanti kāsam | pāṭhāviḍavyoṣaviḍaṅgasindhutrikaṇṭarāsnāhutabhugbalābhiḥ ||30|| śṛṅgīvacāmbhodharadevadārudurālabhābhārgyabhayāśaṭībhiḥ | samyagvipakvaṃ dviguṇena sarpirnidigdhikāyāḥ svarasena caitat ||31|| śvāsāgnisādasvarabhedabhinnānnihantyudīrṇānapi `jayati' iti pā. pañca kāsān |32|

kaphakāsacikitsitamāha- pracchardanamityādi| pracchardanaṃ vamanam| kāyaśirovirekā iti kāyavireko virecanaṃ, śirovireko nasyabhedaḥ; sa ca pippalyādikṛtaḥ| tathaiva dhūmā virecanā ityarthaḥ| uṣṇā lehāḥ kaṭudravyakṛtā ityarthaḥ| kaṭukāḥ kaphaharakaṭukadravyakṛtāḥ| kaphaṃ kaphakāsaṃ, kāraṇe kāryopacārāt| viśoṣaṇaṃ laghurūkṣālpabhojanam, anye nānāprakāralaṅghanamāhuḥ; tathā coktam,- “catuḥprakārā saṃśuddhiḥ pipāsā mārutātapau| pācanānyupavāsaśca vyāyāmaśceti laṅghanam”- iti| pathyaṃ hitam| kṛmighnasvarase vipakvamārdraviḍaṅgasvarasavipakvaṃ, svarasālābhe ca pūrvoktakalpanayā saviḍaṅgacūrṇaṃ rātriparyuṣitaṃ jalaṃ grāhyam| anye tu kṛmighnaśabdena kṛmighnāni yāni dravyāṇi surasādīni tānyāhuḥ| nirguṇḍipatrasvarase ca pakvamityādi nirguṇḍipatrasvarase nīlasindhuvārasvarase, nīlasindhuvāraśca śephāliketi loke| pāṭhetyādi| vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukam| sindhu saindhavam| trikaṇṭo gokṣurakaḥ| hutabhuk citrakaḥ| ambhodharaḥ mustam| svarabhedabhinnān kāṃsyapātrādisvarabhedena bhinnān| pañca kāsān hantīti stutivākyaṃ, tasmāt kaphakāsaṃ hantīti jñātavyaṃ, kaphakāsaprastāvāt| yadyapi vātakāsānantaraṃ pittakāsābhidhānaṃ yuktaṃ na kaphakāsābhidhānaṃ `kaphakāsacikitsitasya kṣayajahitatvapratipādanārthaṃ iti pā., tathā'pi kaphakāsapratikārasyobhayahitatvapratipādanārthaṃ kathanam||28-31||-

ab.seg: vidārigandhotpalasārivādīn niṣkvāthya vargaṃ `vargān' iti pā. madhuraṃ ca kṛtsnam ||32||
ghṛtaṃ pacedikṣurasāmbudugdhaiḥ kākolivarge ca saśarkaraṃ tat | prātaḥ pibet pittakṛte ca kāse ratiprasūte kṣataje ca kāse ||33||

idānīṃ pittajakṣayajakṣatakāsānāṃ cikitsitamāha- vidārigandhetyādi| ādiśabdo vidārigandhādibhiḥ saha pratyekaṃ sambadhyate; tena vidārigandhādiḥ, utpalādiḥ, sārivādiśca| madhuraṃ vargaṃ kākolyādikam| kṛtsnaṃ samagram| atrāpi niṣkvāthyeti sambadhyate| dravapramāṇaṃ ca pratyekaṃ snehasamam| tathā ca paribhāṣā- “pañcaprabhṛti yatra syurdravāṇi snehasaṃvidhau| tatra snehasamānyāhurarvākca syāccaturguṇam”- iti| kākolivarge ‘kalkīkṛte’ iti śeṣaḥ| saśarkaraṃ śarkarāprakṣepam| prātaḥ pūrvāhṇe, pittādikāse pibet||32-33||
kharjūrabhārgīmagadhāpriyālamadhūlikailāmalakaiḥ samāṃśaiḥ | cūrṇaṃ sitākṣaudraghṛtapragāḍhaṃ trīn hanti kāsānupayujyamānam ||34||

kharjūrabhārgītyādi| priyālaḥ cāraḥ| madhūlikā markaṭakaḥ| samāṃśaiḥ tulyapramāṇaiḥ| trīn kāsān pittoraḥkṣatakṣayajān| kharjūrādibhistulyabhāgaiḥ kṛtaṃ cūrṇaṃ sitākṣaudraghṛtapragāḍhaṃ lehatvenopayujyamānaṃ trīn kāsān hantīti piṇḍārthaḥ| pittakāsacikitsitaṃ yadatroraḥkṣatakṣayakāsābhyāṃ sahaiva kathitaṃ tadubhayatulyacikitsitakhyāpanārtham||34||
raktāharidrāñjanavahnipāṭhāmūrvopakulyā vilihet samāṃśāḥ | kṣaudreṇa kāse kṣataje kṣayotthe pibedghṛtaṃ cekṣurase vipakvam ||35||

raktetyādi| raktā mañjiṣṭhā, añjanaṃ sauvīrāñjanaṃ, samānatantradarśanāt, vahniḥ ajamodā, mūrvā corasnāyuḥ, upakulyā pippalī| samāṃśāḥ tulyabhāgāḥ| mañjiṣṭhādīni pippalyantāni dravyāṇi tulyabhāgāni cūrṇīkṛtāni kṣataje kṣayotthe ca kāse madhunā vilihet, cakārāt pittakāse'pi; ikṣurase vipakvaṃ vā ghṛtaṃ pibediti piṇḍārthaḥ||35||

div.ab: cūrṇaṃ pibedāmalakasya vā'pi kṣīreṇa pakvaṃ saghṛtaṃ hitāśī |36|

teṣāmaparamapi cikitsitamāha- cūrṇamityādi| āmalakasya cūrṇaṃ saghṛtaṃ vipakvaṃ hitāśī kṣīreṇa saha pibediti sambandhaḥ| ‘hitāśī’ ityatra ‘hitāya’ iti kecit paṭhanti; tatra kāsaśāntaye iti vyākhyānam|36|-
cūrṇāni godhūmayavodbhavāni kākolivargaśca kṛtaḥ susūkṣmaḥ ||36|| kāseṣu peyastriṣu kāsavadbhiḥ kṣīreṇa sakṣaudraghṛtena vā'pi |37|

pittajādikāsatraye'paramapi cikitsitamāha- cūrṇānītyādi| godhūmādicūrṇāni cūrṇīkṛtaḥ kākolyādigaṇaśca madhughṛtayuktena dugdhena pittoraḥkṣatakṣayajakāsavadbhiḥ puruṣaiḥ peya ityarthaḥ| kecidgodhūmacūrṇādicūrṇatrayaṃ yathākramaṃ triṣu kāseṣu tribhireva kṣīrādibhirdravaiḥ peyamicchanti||36||-

ab.seg: guḍodakaṃ vā kvathitaṃ pibeddhi kṣaudreṇa śītaṃ maricopadaṃśam ||37||

guḍodakamityādi| guḍodakaṃ śītakaṣāyavidhinā gṛhītaṃ, kvathitamiti pakvamityarthaḥ; etena śītakaṣāyīkṛtasya guḍodakasya paścātkiñcitpakvasya śītībhūtasya kṣaudreṇa saha pānamityarthaḥ| veti vikalpastu pūrvayogāpekṣayā| maricopadaṃśaṃ samaricabhakṣaṇam||37||
prasthatrayeṇāmalakīrasasya śuddhasya dattvā'rdhatulāṃ guḍasya | cūrṇīkṛtairgranthikacavyajīravyoṣebhakṛṣṇāhapuṣājamodaiḥ ||38||
viḍaṅgasindhutriphalāyavānīpāṭhāgnidhānyaiśca picupramāṇaiḥ | dattvā trivṛccūrṇapalāni cāṣṭāvaṣṭau ca tailasya pacedyathāvat ||39||
taṃ bhakṣayedakṣaphalapramāṇaṃ yatheṣṭaceṣṭastrisugandhiyuktam | anena sarve grahaṇīvikārāḥ saśvāsakāsasvarabhedaśothāḥ ||40||
śāmyanti cāyaṃ ciramantaragnerhatasya puṃstvasya ca vṛddhihetuḥ | strīṇāṃ ca vandhyāmayanāśanaḥ syāt kalyāṇako nāma guḍaḥ pratītaḥ ||41||

div.ab: kalyāṇaguḍamāha- prasthatrayeṇetyādi| śuddhasya nirmalasya| ardhatulāṃ pañcāśatpalāni| granthikaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ, vyoṣaṃ trikaṭu, ibhakṛṣṇā hastipippalī, sindhu saindhavaṃ, agniḥ citrakaḥ| picupramāṇaiḥ karṣapramāṇaiḥ; ‘palapramāṇaiḥ’ ityanye paṭhanti; tanna, samānatantravirodhāt| ‘dattvā trivṛccūrṇapalāni cāṣṭau’ ityatra ‘īṣattailabhṛṣṭāni’ iti śeṣaḥ, trivṛto recanīyatāsphoṭanārthaṃ vṛddhapāramparyasmaraṇāt| yathāvat mṛdumadhyakrūrakoṣṭhakramānurūpaṃ kharamṛdumadhyapākenetyarthaḥ| ayamiti kalyāṇakaḥ| puṃstvasya śukrasya, atrāpi hatasyeti sambadhyate| kalyāṇaka iti kalyāṇakaraṇāt||38-41||-

ab.seg: dvipañcamūlebhakaṇātmaguptābhārgīśaṭīpuṣkaramūlaviśvān | pāṭhāmṛtāgranthikaśaṅkhapuṣpīrāsnāgnyapāmārgabalāyavāsān ||42||
dvipālikān nyasya `dvipālikāṃśāṃśca' iti pā. yavāḍhakaṃ ca harītakīnāṃ ca śataṃ gurūṇām | droṇe jalasyāḍhakasaṃyute ca kvāthe kṛte pūtacaturthabhāge ||43||
pacettulāṃ śuddhaguḍasya dattvā pṛthak ca tailāt kuḍavaṃ ghṛtācca | cūrṇaṃ ca tāvanmagadhodbhavāyā deyaṃ ca tasminmadhu siddhaśīte ||44||
rasāyanāt karṣamato vilihyāddve cābhaye nityamathāśu hanyāt | tadrājayakṣmagrahaṇīpradoṣaśophāgnimāndyasvarabhedakāsān ||45||
pāṇḍvāmayaśvāsaśirovikārān hṛdrogahikkāviṣamajvarāṃśca | medhābalotsāhamatipradaṃ ca cakāra caitadbhagavānagastyaḥ ||46||

agastyāvalehamāha- dvipañcamūletyādi| dvipañcamūlaṃ daśamūlam| ibhakaṇā gajapippalī| ātmaguptā kapikacchūḥ| granthikaṃ pippalīmūlam| agniḥ citrakaḥ| yavāso dhanvayavāsakaḥ, pūrvapadalopāt| nyasya prakṣipya| yavāḍhakaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭipalāni| gurūṇām atisthūlānām| jaladroṇe dvādaśādhikapañcaśatapaleṣu| dvipañcamūlādīn pratyekaṃ dvipalapramāṇān yavāḍhakaṃ ca tathā harītakīśataṃ jaladroṇe prakṣipya tāvat pacedyāvat pādāvaśeṣitaṃ, tataśca tasmin kaṣāye vastrapūte guḍatulāṃ śuddhasvinnaharītakīśataṃ tathā ghṛtatailayoḥ pratyekamaṣṭau palāni prakṣipya pacet yāvattantumattvājjalapatitaṃ na śīryate, tataśca pippalīcūrṇaṃ catuṣpalaṃ madhu cāṣṭapalapramāṇaṃ dattvā sthāpayet, tataḥ tasmādrasāyanāt, kalkam ardhapalapramāṇaṃ lihyāt, harītakīdvayaṃ ca khādet| etadrasāyanaṃ bhagavatā agastyena kṛtam||42-46||
kulīraśuktīcaṭakaiṇalāvānniṣkvāthya vargaṃ madhuraṃ ca kṛtsnam | pacedghṛtaṃ tattu niṣevyamāṇaṃ hanyāt kṣatotthaṃ kṣayajaṃ ca kāsam ||47||
śatāvarīnāgabalāvipakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ vidheyaṃ ca hitāya kāsinām ||48||

div.ab: kulīraśuktītyādi| kulīraḥ karkaṭaḥ, śuktiḥ jalaśuktiḥ, caṭako grāmacaṭakaḥ, eṇaḥ kṛṣṇamṛgaḥ, madhuravargaḥ kākolyādiḥ, kṛtsnaṃ samagram| kecit ‘niṣkvāthya vargairmadhuraistathā'nyaṃ’ iti paṭhitvā kākolyādisahitāni lāvādīni niṣkvāthya tathā anyairmadhurairjīvanīyaiḥ kalkīkṛtairghṛtaṃ pacediti vyākhyānayanti| cakārāt pittajakāsamapi| śatāvarīnāgabaletyādi| kecit śatāvarīnāgabalākalke `śatāvarīnāgabalādikvāthe' iti pā. ghṛtaṃ siddhamicchanti; tanna, samānatantravirodhāt||47-48||-

ab.seg: iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre kāsapratiṣedho nāma (caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) dvipañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||52||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantre kāsapratiṣedho nāma dvipañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||52||

div.head: svarabhedapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ svarabhedapratiṣedhamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
śvāsakāsapratiṣedhānantaramūrdhvagatatvasāmānyāt śvāsakāsacikitsitasādhyatvācca svarabhedapratiṣedhārambho yukta ityata āha- athāta ityādi| svarabhedaḥ svaropaghātaḥ||1-2||
atyuccabhāṣaṇaviṣādhyayanātigītaśītādibhiḥ `... viṣādhyayanābhighāta ...' iti pā. prakupitāḥ pavanādayastu | srotaḥsu te svaravaheṣu gatāḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ hanyuḥ svaraṃ bhavati cāpi hi ṣaḍvidhaḥ saḥ ||3||

svarabhedahetusamprāptisaṅkhyā āha- atyuccabhāṣaṇetyādi| adhyayanam anavarataṃ vedādipāṭhaḥ| atigītaṃ nirantaraṃ maṅgalādigānam| śītādibhirityatrādiśabdāt pittakaphakopahetavo gṛhyante| yadatra atyuccabhāṣaṇādīnāṃ vātakopahetūnāmeva sākṣāt kathanaṃ kṛtaṃ na pittakaphakopahetūnāṃ tat svaropaghātakartṛtve vāyoḥ prādhānyakhyāpanārtham| anye tu śītādītyatra ādiśabdena gurulaghusnigdharūkṣādīn guṇān gṛhṇanti| svaravaheṣu srotaḥsu śabdavāhinīṣu dhamanīṣu, te vātādayaḥ, gatāḥ prāptāḥ, pratiṣṭhāṃ sthitim| ṣaḍvidhaḥ ṣaṭprakāraḥ; pṛthak vātādibhistrayaḥ, sannipātenaikaḥ, medaḥkṣayābhyāṃ pratyekamekaḥ; evaṃ ṣaṭprakāraḥ| nanu, samānatantre ‘vātāt pittāt kaphāt kāsādraktavegāt sapīnasāt’ (ca. ci. 8) ityatra yathā ṣaḍvidhaḥ svarabheda uktastena sārdhaṃ kathaṃ na virodhaḥ| satyaṃ, kāsajapratiśyāyajayorliṅgatvenoktatvādgrahaṇaṃ, raktajasya tu kaphagrahaṇenaiva grahaṇaṃ, yato raktaṃ kaphayuktaṃ svarabhedaṃ karoti samānatantroktatvāt| yadyevaṃ tarhi kathaṃ na saṅkhyādhikyaṃ? styaṃ, kāsajapratiśyāyajayorvātikatvena grahaṇam| atyuccabhāṣaṇetyādiko hetuḥ, prakupitāḥ pavanādaya ityādikā samprāptiḥ, bhavati cāpi hi ṣaḍvidhaḥ sa iti saṅkhyā||3||

div.ab: vātena kṛṣṇanayanānanamūtravarcā bhinnaṃ śanairvadati gadgadavat svaraṃ ca |4|

vātikasvarabhedalakṣaṇamāha- vātenetyādi| kṛṣṇaśabdo nayanādibhirvarcaḥparyantaiḥ sambadhyate| bhinnam anavasthitam| uktaṃ ca tantrāntare- “svarabhedo bhavedvātādrūkṣaḥ kṣāmaścalaḥ svaraḥ” (ca. ci. 8)- iti| ‘gadgadavat svaram’ ityatra kecit ‘gardabhavat svaraṃ’ iti paṭhanti|4|-

ab.seg: pittena pītavadanākṣipurīṣamūtro brūyādgalena paridāhasamanvitena `ca vidāhasamanvitena' iti pā.||4||
pittajasvarabhedalakṣaṇamāha- pittenetyādi| pītaśabdo vadanādibhirmūtrāntaiḥ sambadhyate| 'sa vidāhasamanvitena’ iti kecit paṭhanti, tatra sa iti svarabhedī puruṣaḥ||4||

div.ab: kṛcchrāt kaphena satataṃ kapharuddhakaṇṭho mandaṃ śanairvadati cāpi divā viśeṣaḥ `viśeṣāt' iti pā.|5|

kaphajasvarabhedalakṣaṇamāha- kṛcchrādityādi| satatam anavaratam| kapharuddhakaṇṭhaḥ śleṣmāvṛtakaṇṭhaḥ| mandaṃ śanairiti mandaṃ mandamityarthaḥ| divā viśeṣa iti divase viśeṣo bhavet, kaphakṣayāt| ‘divā viśeṣāt’ iti kecit paṭhanti; rātrau tāvat kapharuddhakaṇṭhatvānna vadatyeva, divā punaḥ kaphāpacayādviśeṣo bhavati, tasmācca viśeṣānmandaṃ mandaṃ vadatīti vyākhyānayanti|5|-

ab.seg: sarvātmake bhavati sarvavikārasampadavyaktatā ca vacasastamasādhyamāhuḥ ||5||

sānnipātikasvarabhedalakṣaṇamāha- sarvātmaka ityādi| sarvātmake sannipātotthasvarabhede| sarvavikārasampad vātādiliṅgaprādurbhāvaḥ| avyaktatā ca vacasaḥ aspaṣṭavāktvam| taṃ sānnipātikasvarabhedam||5||

div.ab: dhūpyeta vāk kṣayakṛte kṣayamāpnuyācca vāgeṣa cā(vā)pi hatavāk parivarjanīyaḥ |6|
kṣayajasvarabhedalakṣaṇamāha- dhūpyetetyādi| dhūpyeta mukhāddhūmamivodvamati, ‘bruvan’ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ| kṣayamāpnuyād vāgiti vacanakṣayaṃ prāpnuyāt ‘vātāt’ iti śeṣaḥ|6|-

ab.seg: antargalaṃ `antargatasvaraṃ' iti pā. svaramalakṣyapadaṃ cireṇa medaścayādvadati `medo'nvayāt' iti pā. digdhagalauṣṭhatāluḥ ||6||
kṣīṇasya vṛddhasya kṛśasya cāpi cirotthito yaśca sahopajātaḥ | medasvinaḥ sarvasamudbhavaśca svarāmayo yo na sa siddhimeti ||7||

medojasvarabhedalakṣaṇamāha- antargalamityādi| antargalaṃ galasyāntare| svaraṃ vadati śabdaṃ karoti| ‘antargataṃ’ iti kecit paṭhanti, tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ| yato'ntargalaṃ svaraṃ vadati ata eva alakṣyapadamiti, na lakṣyante padāni yasyetyarthaḥ| bhedaścayāt medovṛddheḥ| digdhaṃ medodigdhaṃ galauṣṭhatālu yasya sa tathā| ‘medo'nvayāt’ iti kecit paṭhanti||6-7||
snigdhān svarāturanarānapakṛṣṭadoṣān nyāyena tān `saṃyojayet' iti pā. vamanarecanabastibhiśca | nasyāvapīḍamukhadhāvanadhūmalehaiḥ sampādayecca vividhaiḥ kavalagrahaiśca ||8||

svarabhedasya sāmānyacikitsāmāha- snigdhānityādi| yadyapi kaphajamedojayoḥ svarabhedayorapatarpaṇasādhyatvāt snehanaṃ na yuktaṃ, tathā'pi yathādoṣapratyanīkairyathādoṣapratyanīkasādhitaiśca snehaiḥ snehanaṃ yuktameva, athavā medaḥkaphajayorapi vāyusadbhāvāt snehanopadeśaḥ| apakṛṣṭadoṣān ākṛṣṭadoṣān; atra vamanavirecanabastibhiriti sambadhyate| nyāyena yathāvidhītyarthaḥ| vamanādibhirapakṛṣṭadoṣān svarabhedāturān kiṃ kuryādityāha- nasyāvapīḍetyādi| avapīḍya dīyate ityavapīḍo nasyabhedaḥ| mukhadhāvanaṃ gaṇḍūṣādi| sampādayet yojayet| vividhaiḥ doṣapratyanīkatvena nānāprakāraiḥ| kavalagrahaiḥ gaṇḍūṣabhedaiḥ| tathā ca- “sukhaṃ sañcāryate yā tu gaṇḍūṣe sā prakīrtitā| asañcāryā tu yā mātrā kavale sā prakīrtitā `bhiṣagvaraiḥ' iti pā. ”- iti||8||

div.ab: yaḥ śvāsakāsavidhirādita eva coktastaṃ cāpyaśeṣamavatārayituṃ yateta |9|
anyadapi svarabhedacikitsitamatideśenāha- ya ityādi| śvāsakāsapratiṣedhe sāmānyenādau yaḥ śvāsakāsavidhiruddiṣṭastaṃ vidhiṃ samastamapi yathādoṣaṃ kartuṃ yateteti piṇḍārthaḥ|9|

ab.seg: vaiśeṣikaṃ ca vidhimūrdhvamato vadāmi taṃ vai svarāturahitaṃ nikhilaṃ nibodha ||9||
vaiśeṣikamityādi| ata iti sāmānyacikitsānantaram| taṃ vai svarāturahitamiti svarabhedāturahitam| nibodha jānīhi||9||

div.ab: svaropaghāte'nilaje bhuktopari ghṛtaṃ pibet | kāsamardakavārtākamārkavasvarase śṛtam ||10|| pītaṃ ghṛtaṃ hantyanilaṃ siddhamārtagale rase |11|
tameva vaiśeṣikavidhimāha- svaropaghāta ityādi| bhuktopari bhojanopari| mārkavo bhṛṅgarājaḥ, śṛtaṃ pakvam| anilaṃ vātajasvarabhedam, upacārāt| ārtagalaḥ kakubhaḥ||10||-
yavakṣārājamodābhyāṃ citrakāmalakeṣu vā ||11|| devadārvagnikābhyāṃ vā siddhamājaṃ samākṣikam |12|
aparamapi vātaje ghṛtatrayamāha- yavakṣārājamodābhyāmityādi| agniko ajamodā| ājaṃ ‘ghṛtaṃ’ śeṣaḥ| samākṣikaṃ samadhu| atrāpi pītamiti yojyam||11||-

ab.seg: sukhodakānupāno vā sasarpiṣko guḍaudanaḥ ||12||
vātike pathyayogamāha- sukhodakānupāna ityādi| sukhodakam īṣaduṣṇodakam| kecidamuṃ yogaṃ paittike manyante; tanna, samānatantreṣu vātikasvarabheda eva prayuktatvāt||12||

div.ab: kṣīrānupānaṃ pitte tu pibet sarpiratandritaḥ |13|
paittikasvarabhedacikitsāmāha- kṣīrānupānamityādi| atandritaḥ analasaḥ|13|-

ab.seg: aśnīyācca sasarpiṣkaṃ yaṣṭīmadhukapāyasam ||13||
paittike pathyayogamāha- aśnīyādityādi| yaṣṭīmadhukapāyasamiti yaṣṭīmadhukasādhitakṣīrasiddhāṃstaṇḍulān; athavā yaṣṭīmadhukānvitaṃ pāyasaṃ yaṣṭīmadhukapāyasam||13||
lihyānmadhurakāṇāṃ vā cūrṇaṃ madhughṛtāplutam | śatāvarīcūrṇayogaṃ balācūrṇamathāpi vā ||14||
lihyādityādi| madhurakāṇāṃ kākolīprabhṛtīnām| śatāvarīcūrṇayogamiti śatāvarīcūrṇasya yogaḥ saṃyogo yatra tattathā, atrāpi madhughṛtāplutaṃ lihyāditi sambandhanīyam||14||
pibet kaṭūni mūtreṇa kaphaje svarasaṅkṣaye | lihyādvā madhutailābhyāṃ bhuktvā khādet kaṭūni vā ||15||

kaphajasvarabhedacikitsāmāha- pibedityādi| kaṭūni trikaṭukādīni| mūtreṇa gomūtreṇa prādhānyāt| svarasaṅkṣaye svarabhede| lihyādvā madhutailābhyāmityādi madhutailābhyāṃ vā kaṭūni trikaṭukaprabhṛtīni lihyāt, bhuktvā vā tāni khādet||15||

div.ab: svaropaghāte medoje kaphavadvidhiriṣyate |16|
medojasvarabhede kaphajacikitsāmatidiśannāha- svaropaghāta ityādi| kaphavat kaphajasvarabhedavat|16|-

ab.seg: sarvaje kṣayaje cāpi pratyākhyāyācaret kriyām ||16||

sānnipātikakṣayajayorasādhyayorapi cikitsā kartavyetyāha- sarvaja ityādi| pratyākhyāya asādhyatvena nirākṛtya| ācaret kuryāt| kriyāmiti sānnipātike sarveṣāṃ vātādisvarabhedānāṃ sarvameva cikitsitaṃ kāryaṃ, kṣayaje tu kṣayoktamiti; kecidubhayorapi sāmānyacikitsitaṃ kuryādityāhuḥ||16||
śarkarāmadhumiśrāṇi śṛtāni madhuraiḥ saha | pibet payāṃsi yasyoccairvadato'bhihataḥ svaraḥ ||17||

atyuccabhāṣaṇotthasvarabhedasya vātātmakatve'pi nimittabhedamāśritya viśiṣṭāṃ cikitsāmāha- śarkaretyādi| madhuraiḥ kākolyādibhiḥ śṛtāni payāṃsi śarkarāmadhumiśrāṇi pibediti piṇḍārthaḥ| payāṃsītyatra bahuvacanaṃ gomahiṣyajānāṃ kṣīraparigrahāya||17||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre chardipratiṣedho nāma (pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) tripañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||53||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre svarabhedapratiṣedho nāma tripañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||53||

div.head: kṛmirogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ kṛmirogapratiṣedhamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
ajīrṇādhyaśanāsātmyaviruddhamalināśanaiḥ | avyāyāmadivāsvapnagurvatisnigdhaśītalaiḥ ||3||
māṣapiṣṭānnavidalabisaśālūkaserukaiḥ | parṇaśākasurāśuktadadhikṣīraguḍekṣubhiḥ ||4||
palalānūpapiśitapiṇyākapṛthukādibhiḥ | svādvamladravapānaiśca śleṣmā pittaṃ ca kupyati ||5||
kṛmīn bahuvidhākārān karoti vividhāśrayān | āmapakvāśaye teṣāṃ kaphaviḍjanmanāṃ punaḥ | dhamanyāṃ raktajānāṃ ca prasavaḥ prāyaśaḥ smṛtaḥ ||6||

keṣāñcit kṛmīṇāṃ sāmānyaṃ hetumāha- ajīrṇetyādi| ajīrṇam āmavidagdhādibhedabhinnaṃ, adhyaśanam ajīrṇabhojanaṃ asātmyaṃyat sevitaṃ sukhārthaṃ na sampadyate, viruddhaṃ hitāhitīyoktaṃ, malinaṃ samalam| piṣṭānnaṃ taṇḍulapiṣṭādi, vidalaṃ makuṣṭhādi, bisaṃ bisāṇḍakaṃ, śālūḥ padmakandaḥ| parṇaśākaṃ patraśākaṃ, sūktaṃ sandhānakaviśeṣaḥ| palalaḥ tilakalkaḥ , ānūpapiśitam ānūpamāṃsaṃ, piṇyākaṃ yantrapīḍitatilakhalī, 'pītā' iti loke, pṛthukaḥ cipiṭakaḥ ādiśabdādevamprakārā anye'pi| bahuvidhākārān vividhākārān| vividhāśrayāniti nānāprakārāśrayānityarthaḥ| prasava utpattiḥ| prāyograhaṇādanyatrāpi sambhavo jñātavyaḥ| kecidatra ajīrṇādhyaśanādikaṃ hetugaṇaṃ na paṭhanti, teṣāṃ ca hetvavagatirvakṣyamāṇāt 'kṣīrāṇi māṃsāni' ityādipratiṣedhavidhānāt; mayā tu sukhabodhārthaṃ hetugaṇaḥ paṭhitaḥ| apare tu ‘ajīrṇabhojī madhurāmlanityo dravapriyaḥ piṣṭaguḍopabhoktā| vyāyāmajātāni ‘vyāyāmavarjī ca divāśayāno viruddhabhuk saṃlabhate krimīṃstu' iti mādhavanidāne pā. ca varjyamānaḥ svapnādivān vai labhate krimīnnā' iti paṭhanti||1-6||
viṃśateḥ kṛmijātīnāṃ trividhaḥ sambhavaḥ smṛtaḥ | purīṣakapharaktāni, tāsāṃ vakṣyāmi vistaram ||7||

idānīṃ viṃśatisaṅkhyānāmapi kṛmijātīnāṃ kāraṇatraividhyamāha- viṃśaterityādi| jātigrahaṇaṃ kṛmīṇāmānantyakhyāpanārthaṃ; taccānantyaṃ viṃśatyāmevāvaruddhaṃ, ato viṃśatisaṅkhyākaraṇaṃ sārthakam| sambhavaḥ kāraṇam| kastrividhaḥ sambhava ityāha- purīṣetyādi| nanu, ajīrṇādhyaśanādayo hetava uktāḥ , kathaṃ purīṣādayaśca ucyante? satyaṃ, ajīrṇādayaḥ purīṣādīnāṃ hetavaḥ, purīṣādayaśca kṛmīṇāmiti| yadyapi kṛmyārambhakā na purīṣādayaḥ , tathā'pyupacārāt purīṣādīnāmapi kṛmyārambhakatvam| purīṣādyadhiṣṭhitā doṣāḥ purīṣādi, ghṛtādidagdhavat; etenājīrṇādibhiḥ prakupitā doṣāḥ purīṣādīnyadhiṣṭhāya kṛmīn janayanti tāsāṃ kṛmijātīnām| kecit ‘vistaraṃ’ ityatra ‘lakṣaṇaṃ’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ savyākhyānaṃ paṭhanti; tacca śiṣyabuddhivyākulatvahetutvāt parityaktam||7||
ajavā vijavāḥ `ayavā viyavāḥ' iti pā. kipyāścipyā gaṇḍūpadāstathā | cūravo dvimukhāścaiva jñeyāḥ sapta purīṣajāḥ ||8||
purīṣajakṛmināmānyāha- ajavā ityādi| ajavādayo dvimukhāntāḥ sapta purīṣajāḥ kṛmayaḥ||8||
śvetāḥ sūkṣmāstudantyete gudaṃ pratisaranti ca | teṣāmevāpare pucchaiḥ pṛthavaśca bhavanti hi ||9||
śūlāgnimāndyapāṇḍutvaviṣṭambhabalasaṅkṣayāḥ | prasekārucihṛdrogaviḍbhedāstu purīṣajaiḥ ||10||

purīṣajānāṃ lakṣaṇamāha- śvetā ityādi| ya ete purīṣajāḥ kṛmayaḥ śvetāḥ sūkṣmāśca bhavanti, te bāhulyenāddaṣṭavaśādgudaṃ tudanti pratisaranti ca| teṣāmeva saptānāṃ madhye apare pucchaiḥ pṛthavo bhavanti| purīṣajaiḥ saptabhiḥ kṛmibhiḥ śūlāgnimāndyādayo bhavanti| viṣṭambho guḍaguḍāśabdaḥ| praseko lālāsrāvaḥ| viḍbhedaḥ dravapurīṣatā||9-10||
raktā gaṇḍūpadā dīrghā gudakaṇḍūnipātinaḥ | śūlāṭopaśakṛdbhedapaktināśakarāśca te ||11||
teṣāmeva saptānāṃ purīṣajānāṃ madhye gaṇḍūpadānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ karma cāha- raktā ityādi| paktināśakarā agnināśakarāḥ, kāraṇe `upacārāt' iti pā. kāryopacārāt||11||
darbhapuṣpā mahāpuṣpāḥ pralūnāścipiṭāstathā | pipīlikā dāruṇāśca kaphakopasamudbhavāḥ ||12||
kaphakṛmināmānyāha- darbhapuṣpā ityādi| darbhapuṣpādikā dāruṇaparyantāḥ kaphakopajāḥ ṣaṭ kṛmayaḥ||12||
romaśā romamūrdhānaḥ sapucchāḥ śyāvamaṇḍalāḥ | rūḍhadhānyāṅkurākārāḥ śuklāste tanavastathā ||13||
teṣāmākṛtimāha- romaśā ityādi| romaśāḥ sarvato romānvitāḥ| romamūrdhānaḥ saromamastakāḥ| śyāvamaṇḍalāḥ śyāmamaṇḍalayuktāḥ||13||

div.ab: majjādā netraleḍhārastāluśrotrabhujastathā |14|
teṣāmeva karmaviśeṣeṇa sañjñāntaramāha- majjādā ityādi|14|-

ab.seg: śirohṛdrogavamathupratiśyāyakarāśca te ||14||
teṣāṃ sarveṣāmeva karmāṇyāha- śirohṛdrogetyādi| rogaśabdaḥ śirohṛdbhyāṃ sambadhyate, tena śirorogo hṛdrogaśca, vamathuḥ chardiḥ| cakārāt anyānapi kaphajavyādhīn kurvanti| te kaphajāḥ kṛmayaḥ||14||
keśaromanakhādāśca dantādāḥ kikkiśāstathā | kuṣṭhajāḥ saparīsarpā jñeyāḥ śoṇitasambhavāḥ ||15||
raktajakṛmināmānyāha- keśarometyādi| keśādādyāḥ parīsarpāntāḥ sapta raktajāḥ kṛmayaḥ||15||

div.ab: te saraktāśca kṛṣṇāśca snigdhāśca pṛthavastathā |16|
teṣāmākṛtimāha- ta ityādi| te raktajāḥ kṛmayaḥ| pṛthavaḥ sthūlāḥ|16|-

ab.seg: raktādhiṣṭhānajān prāyo vikārān janayanti te ||16||
teṣāṃ karmāṇyāha- raktādhiṣṭhānajānityādi| raktādhiṣṭhānajān vyādhisamuddeśīyoktān kuṣṭhavisarpapiḍakādīn||16||

div.ab: māṣapiṣṭānnavidalaparṇaśākaiḥ purīṣajāḥ | māṃsamāṣaguḍakṣīradadhitailaiḥ kaphodbhavāḥ ||17|| viruddhājīrṇaśākādyaiḥ śoṇitotthā bhavanti hi | jvaro vivarṇatā śūlaṃ hṛdrogaḥ sadanaṃ bhramaḥ ||18|| bhaktadveṣo'tisāraśca sañjātakṛmilakṣaṇam |19|
purīṣajādikṛmīṇāṃ sāmānyakāraṇamabhidhāyedānīṃ viśeṣakāraṇamāha- māṣapiṣṭānnavidaletyādi| piṣṭānnaṃ taṇḍulādipiṣṭajam||17-18||-
dṛśyāstrayodaśādyāstu kṛmīṇāṃ parikīrtitāḥ ||19|| keśādādyāstvadṛśyāste dvāvādyau parivarjayet |20|

idānīṃ kṛmīṇāṃ dṛśyādṛśyatvena sādhyāsādhyatvena ca vibhāgakaraṇārthamāha- dṛśyā ityādi| ādyāstrayodaśeti ajavādyā dāruṇāntā ityarthaḥ| keśādādyā iti keśādādyāḥ parīsarpāntā raktajāḥ kṛmaya ityarthaḥ| dvāvādyāviti raktajāpekṣayaiva ādyau, tena keśādaromādāvityarthaḥ| tathā coktam- “asādhyau dvau tu vijñeyau romakeśādasañjñitau” iti||19||-
eṣāmanyatamaṃ jñātvā jighāṃsuḥ snigdhamāturam ||20|| surasādivipakvena sarpiṣā vāntamāditaḥ | virecayettīkṣṇatarairyogai ... |21|

nidānamabhidhāyedānīṃ cikitsāvasaraḥ- eṣāmanyatamamityādi| eṣāṃ krimīṇāṃ madhye anyatamamekatamaṃ jighāṃsuḥ, snigdhamāturaṃ surasādigaṇavipakvena sarpiṣā snigdhamāturaṃ jñātvā, āditaśca vāntaṃ tīkṣṇatarairyogaiḥ kaphaghnairvirecanakalpoktairvirecayediti piṇḍārthaḥ| ‘duṣṭe ca koṣṭhe kṛmibhirmanuṣyaṃ na vāmayet’ ityādinā kṛmiyuktasya puṃso vamananiṣedhaḥ, tathā'pi kṛmiyuktasya prathamāvasthāyāṃ vamanaṃ śastam, ato vāntamādita ityuktam||20||-

ab.seg: ... rāsthāpayecca tam ||21||
yavakolakulatthānāṃ surasādergaṇasya ca | viḍaṅgasnehayuktena kvāthena lavaṇena ca ||22||

virekānantaraṃ kiṃ kuryādityāha- āsthāpayedityādi| tam āturaṃ yavakolādīnāṃ kvāthena tathā surasādigaṇasya kvāthena viḍaṅgasādhitasnehayuktena saindhavalavaṇānvitenāsthāpayediti piṇḍārthaḥ| gaṇasya ceti cakārāt surasādikalko'pi grāhyaḥ||21-22||

div.ab: pratyāgate nirūhe tu naraṃ snātaṃ sukhāmbunā | yuñjyāt kṛmighnairaśanaistataḥ śīghraṃ bhiṣagvaraḥ ||23|| snehenoktena cainaṃ tu yojayet snehabastinā |24|

āsthāpanānantaraṃ kiṃ kuryādityāha- pratyāgata ityādi| pratyāgate vyāghuṭite patite ityarthaḥ| sukhāmbunā uṣṇodakena| kṛmighnairaśanaiḥ kṛmighnadravyasādhitaiḥ svabhāvataḥ kṛmighnaiśca| snehenoktena viḍaṅgasādhitasnehena| snehabastinā anuvāsanena||23||-

ab.seg: tataḥ śirīṣakiṇihīrasaṃ kṣaudrayutaṃ pibet ||24||
ato'nantaraṃ kṛtānnasaṃsargaḥ kiṃ kuryādityāha- tata ityādi| tata iti anuvāsanānantaram| kiṇihī kaṭabhī||24||

div.ab: kevūkasvarasaṃ vā'pi pūrvavattīkṣṇabhojanaḥ |25|
pānāntaramāha- kevūketyādi| kevūkaḥ ‘kesura `kejaka' iti pā. ’ iti nāmnā prasiddhaḥ| pūrvavaditi kṣaudrayutamityarthaḥ| tīkṣṇabhojanaḥ tīkṣṇadravyasaṃskṛtāhāraḥ|25|-

ab.seg: palāśabījasvarasaṃ kalkaṃ vā taṇḍulāmbunā ||25||
aparamapi pānayogamāha- palāśabījetyādi| palāśabījasvarasaṃ kalkaṃ veti palāśabījakalkaṃ vā taṇḍulāmbunā pibedityarthaḥ||25||
pāribhadrakapatrāṇāṃ kṣaudreṇa svarasaṃ pibet | pattūrasvarasaṃ vā'pi pibedvā surasādijam ||26||
aparamapi pānayogamāha- pāribhadrakapatrāṇāmityādi| pāribhadraḥ parvatanimbaḥ| pattūraḥ śiravālikā| surasādikaḥ surasādigaṇaḥ||26||

div.ab: lihyādaśvaśakṛccūrṇaṃ vaiḍaṅgaṃ vā samākṣikam |27|
kṛmighnamavalehayogamāha- lihyādityādi| aśvaśakṛccūrṇaṃ ghoṭakapurīṣacūrṇam| vaiḍaṅgaṃ viḍaṅgacūm| ‘vaiḍaṅgam’ ityatra ‘baiḍālam’ iti kecit paṭhanti; tatra biḍālaviṭcūrṇamiti vyākhyānam|27|-
patrairmūṣikaparṇyā vā supiṣṭaiḥ piṣṭamiśritaiḥ ||27|| khādet pūpalikāḥ pakvā dhānyāmlaṃ ca pibedanu |28|

krimighnapūpalikāmāha- patrairmūṣikaparṇyā vetyādi| mūṣikaparṇī dantī, anye mūṣikakarṇākhyaṃ dravyāntaramāhuḥ| piṣṭamiśritaiḥ yavapiṣṭamiśritaiḥ, tasya viśeṣeṇa krimiharatvāt| dhānyāmlaṃ kāñjikam| anviti pūpalikābhakṣaṇānantaram| yadyapi ‘kṣīrāṇi māṃsāni ghṛtāni ca’ ityādigranthoktādamlavarjanādatra kāñjikasyāpi varjanaṃ prāpnoti, tathā'pi kāñjikasya prāyogikatvāt krimiharatvāccātra kāñjikānupānaṃ, tathā hi guṇopavarṇane kāñjikaṃ kṛmighnatvena dṛṣṭam||27||-
surasādigaṇe pakvaṃ tailaṃ vā pānamiṣyate ||28|| viḍaṅgacūrṇayuktairvā piṣṭairbhakṣyāṃstu kārayet `viḍaṅgacūrṇapiṣṭābhyāṃ tasmin bhakṣyaṃ tu kārayet' iti pā.|29|
kṛmighnatailamāha- surasādigaṇe ityādi| tailamiti surasādigaṇe ‘kvāthakalkīkṛte’ iti śeṣaḥ| viḍaṅgetyādi| piṣṭaiḥ yavādipiṣṭaiḥ| bhakṣyān laḍḍūkādīn| vikalpavidhānaṃ pūrvayogāpekṣayā||28||-

ab.seg: tatkaṣāyaprapītānāṃ tilānāṃ snehameva vā ||29||
tatkaṣāyaprapītānāmityādi| tatkaṣāyaprapītānāṃ viḍaṅgakvāthabhāvitānām| atrāpi kārayediti sambandhanīyam||29||

div.ab: śvāvidhaḥ śakṛtaścūrṇaṃ saptakṛtvaḥ subhāvitam | viḍaṅgānāṃ kaṣāyeṇa traiphalena tathaiva ca ||30|| kṣaudreṇa līḍhvā'nupibedrasamāmalakodbhavam | akṣābhayārasaṃ vā'pi... |31|

śvāvidha ityādi| śvāvidhaḥ seḍhāyāḥ, śakṛt viṣṭhā, tasyāścūrṇaṃ saptavārān viḍaṅgakvāthena bhāvitaṃ punastriphalākvāthena tathaiva bhāvitaṃ, kṣaudreṇa līḍhvā, anu paścāt, āmalakodbhavaṃ bibhītakodbhavaṃ vā harītakīrasaṃ vā'pi kṣaudreṇa pibediti sambandhaḥ||31||-

ab.seg: ... vidhireṣo'yasāmapi ||31||

amumeva vidhi lauhacūrṇānāmapyatidiśannāha- vidhirityādi| eṣa vidhiḥ śvāvidhaḥ śakṛccūrṇavidhiḥ| ayasāmapīti trapusīsatāmrarajatakṛṣṇalohānāmapi| etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati- pratyekaṃ lohādicūrṇānāṃ śvāvitpurīṣacūrṇavidhānavadvidhiḥ kāryaḥ||31||

div.ab: pūtīkasvarasaṃ vā'pi pibedvā madhunā saha | pibedvā pippalīmūlamajāmūtreṇa saṃyutam ||32|| saptarātraṃ pibeddhṛṣṭaṃ trapu vā dadhimastunā |33|

ab.seg: pūtīkaḥ cirabilvaḥ| pibedityādi| ajāmūtreṇa chāgamūtreṇa| pibeddhṛṣṭamityādi| trapu raṅgaṃ, ‘kathīra’ iti loke| dadhimastugrahaṇam anyamastuniṣedhārthaṃ; anye ‘dadhimastunā’ ityatra dadhigrahaṇaṃ kūrcikāmastuparihārārthamiti vyākhyānayanti| tanna, dadhimastugrahaṇena kūrcikāmastugrahaṇamasambhavaṃ, sarvanibandhavirodhāt samānatantravirodhācca||32||
purīṣajān kaphotthāṃśca hanyādevaṃ kṛmīn bhiṣak ||33||
yat pūrvametaccikitsitamuktaṃ tat purīṣakaphajānāṃ kāryamiti darśayannāha- purīṣajānityādi| evamiti pūrvoktena vidhinetyarthaḥ||33||
śirohṛdghrāṇakarṇākṣisaṃśritāṃśca pṛthagvidhān | viśeṣeṇāñjanairnasyairavapīḍaiśca sādhayet ||34||

purīṣakaphajānāṃ sāmānyacikitsitamabhidhāyedānīṃ kaphajānāmāśrayaviśeṣeṇa cikitsāmāha- śirohṛdghrāṇetyādi| śiraḥprabhṛtisaṃśritān nānāprakārān kṛmīn viśeṣeṇāñjanādibhiḥ sādhayediti piṇḍārthaḥ| cakārāt gaṇḍūṣakavalagrahādibhirapi| anye tu yadyapyañjanādikaṃ sāmānyenoktaṃ, tathā'pyañjanaṃ netrasthe, nasyāvapīḍau ghrāṇaśiraḥsaṃśrite ca, viśeṣeṇāñjanādīnāṃ netrādijakṛmiharatvāt; hṛdgatānāṃ karṇagatānāṃ cārthavaśādeva kṛmijahṛdrogakṛmikarṇakacikitsitaiścikitsā kāryā; cakārāt śiraḥsthitānāṃ kṛmīṇāṃ kṛmiśirorogacikitsitaiścikitsā kāryeti gṛhyata iti vyākhyānayanti| ‘saṃśritān’ ityatra ‘vraṇajān’ iti kecit paṭhanti; anye ‘saṃśritān’ ityatra ‘saṃsṛtān’ iti paṭhanti; karṇasthāne ca vaktraṃ paṭhanti||34||
śakṛdrasaṃ turaṅgasya suśuṣkaṃ bhāvayedati | niṣkvāthena viḍaṅgānāṃ cūrṇaṃ pradhamanaṃ tu tat ||35||

śiraḥ prabhṛtisaṃśritakṛmighnaṃ pradhamanamāha- śakṛdrasamityādi| śakṛdrasaṃ turaṅgasyeti ghoṭakapurīṣasya rasamityarthaḥ| suśuṣkamiti purīṣarasasya viśeṣaṇam| pradhamanamiti nāsāyāṃ cūrṇaprakṣepaṇaṃ jñeyam||35||
ayaścūrṇānyanenaiva vidhinā yojayedbhiṣak | sakāṃsyanīlaṃ tailaṃ ca nasyaṃ syātsurasādike ||36||

amumeva pradhamanavidhiṃ lohacūrṇeṣvatidiśannāha- ayaścūrṇānītyādi| aneneti ghoṭapurīṣasvarasapradhamanavidhānena| sakāṃsyanīlaṃ kāṃsyāpamārjanamasīsahitam| ‘surasādike’ ityatra ‘vipakvaṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ| tena surasādigaṇakvāthavipakvaṃ tailaṃ kāṃsyamasīsahitaṃ nasyaṃ syāditi| tathā coktāṃ,- ‘surasādiśṛtaṃ tailaṃ nasyaṃ kāṃsyamalānvitam’- iti||36||

div.ab: indraluptavidhiścāpi vidheyo romabhojiṣu |37|
romādādīnāmatideśena cikitsāmāha- indraluptetyādi| romabhojiṣu romādeṣu| cakāreṇa keśabhojiṣvapīndraluptavidhiḥ kārya iti samuccīyate|37|-

ab.seg: dantādānāṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ vidhānaṃ mukharogikam ||37||

dantādānāmapyatideśena cikitsitamāha- dantādānāmityādi| mukharogikaṃ kṛmidantoktaṃ, viśeṣeṇa kṛmidantoktacikitsitasya dantānāṃ hitatvāt| yadyapi romādadantādānāṃ raktajatvāt raktajasāmānyacikitsānantaramindraluptavidhyādikaṃ viśeṣacikitsitaṃ kartumucitaṃ bhavati, tathā'pi kaphajā api romadantabhakṣaṇaṃ kurvantīti pravyaktakaṭukaṃ bhojanaṃ hitaṃ bhavediti pratipādanārthaṃ romadantādānāṃ prathamaṃ cikitsitamuktam||37||

div.ab: raktajānāṃ pratīkāraṃ kuryāt kuṣṭhacikitsite |38|
idānīṃ sāmānyacikitsitaṃ raktajānāmatideśenāha- raktajānāmityādi| ‘kuṣṭhacikitsite’ ityatra pūrvoktameva samuddiṣṭamiti padaṃ sambandhanīyam| kecit ‘kuṣṭhacikitsitāt’ iti paṭhanti|38|-

ab.seg: surasādiṃ tu sarveṣu sarvathaivopayojayet ||38||
surasādiṃ tu sarveṣvityādi| sarveṣu purīṣajādiṣu| sarvathaiva annapānasnānādividhinā||38||

div.ab: pravyaktatiktakaṭukaṃ bhojanaṃ ca hitaṃ bhavet |39|
bhojane vidhyantaramāha- pravyaktetyādi| pravyaktatiktakaṭukamiti tiktakaṭukotkaṭamityarthaḥ|39|-

ab.seg: kulatthakṣārasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ kṣārapānaṃ ca pūjitam `kulatthakvāthasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ kṣīrapānaṃ ca pūjitam' iti pā.||39||

pāne'pi vidhyantaramāha- kulatthetyādi| kulatthakṣārasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ kulatthabhasmodakasaṃyuktam? kṣārapānaṃ yavakṣārapānaṃ, tathā coktaṃ viśvāmitreṇa- ‘yāvaśūkasya pānaṃ tu kulatthakṣāravāriṇā’- iti| kecit ‘kulatthakṣāra...’ ityatra ‘viḍaṅgakṣāra...’ iti paṭhanti||39||
kṣīrāṇi māṃsāni ghṛtāni caiva dadhīni śākāni ca parṇavanti | samāsato'mlānmadhurān himāṃśca kṛmīn jighāṃsuḥ parivarjayettu ||40||

pravṛttilakṣaṇaṃ cikitsitamabhidhāyedānīṃ nivṛttilakṣaṇaṃ cikitsitamāha- kṣīrāṇi māṃsānītyādi| yadyapi ‘saṅkṣepataḥ kriyāyogo nidānaparivarjanam’ iti vākyādeva kṣīrādīnāṃ niṣedhavidhiḥ siddhaḥ, tathā'pi kṣīrādīnāṃ pratiṣedhakaraṇaṃ niyamārthaṃ; tena kṛmīṇāṃ nidānamapi kṣīrādikaṃ madātyaye madyavadbheṣajaṃ mā bhūdityarthaḥ||40||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre kṛmipratiṣedho nāma (ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) catuḥpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||54||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantre kṛmipratiṣedho nāma catuḥpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||54||

div.head: udāvartapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāta udāvartapratiṣedhamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

kṛmipratiṣedhānantaraṃ kṛmicikitsitasya kaṭutiktakaṣāyāderudāvartahetutvādudāvartapratiṣedhārambho yukta ityata āha- athāta ityādi| ut ūrdhvaṃ vātaviṇmūtrādīnāṃ āvarto bhramaṇaṃ yasmin roge sa udāvartaḥ; anye purīṣaṃ vāyunā vartulīkṛtamudāvartaṃ manyante, lokaprasiddhatvāt||1-2||
adhaścordhvaṃ ca bhāvānāṃ pravṛttānāṃ svabhāvataḥ | na vegān dhārayet prājño vātādīnāṃ jijīviṣuḥ ||3||

vegadhāraṇasyaikāntenodāvartahetutvādvegadhāraṇaniṣedhamāha- adhaścordhva cetyādi| adhobhāvā mūtrādayaḥ ūrdhvabhāvā udgārādayaḥ, teṣāṃ bhāvānāṃ vātādīnāṃ vegān na dhārayet| kimbhūtānāṃ? svabhāvataḥ pravṛttānāṃ, prakṛtyaiva svāśayacyutānāmityarthaḥ| etenaite'pravṛttā balānnodīraṇīyā iti sūcayati| jijīviṣuḥ jīvitumicchuḥ puruṣaḥ| kecit ‘prājñaḥ’ ityatra ‘prāptān’ iti paṭhanti| te ca vyākhyānayanti- vegagrahaṇenaiva prāptāniti prāptaṃ yasmādaprāpto vego na bhavati, ataḥ prāptagrahaṇamadhikaṃ `prāptagrahaṇamadhikaṃ sat keṣāñcit' iti pā., tenādhikena prāptagrahaṇena keṣāñcit prāptā api vegā dhāraṇīyā ityarthādhikyamāvedayati; tathā ca tantrāntare- “imāṃstu dhārayedvegān hitaiṣī pretya ceha ca| lobherṣyādveṣamātsaryarāgādīnāṃ yatendriyaḥ `jitendriyaḥ' iti pā. ”- iti| tacca vyākhyānaṃ na yuktaṃ, yasmādviśeṣābhidhānādeva lobhādīnāṃ vegadhāraṇaṃ siddhaṃ; tasmāt prāptān unmukhībhūtāniti vyākhyānaṃ yuktam| anye tu vātādīnāṃ prāptān yuktān vegān na dhārayet, na tu sāhasādivegān na dhārayediti vyākhyānayanti||3||
vātaviṇmūtrajṛmbhāśrukṣavodgāravamīndriyaiḥ | vyāhanyamānairuditairudāvarto nirucyate ||4||

udāvartasya niruktidvārā kāraṇānyāha- vātaviṇmūtretyādi| aśru netrodakaṃ, kṣavaḥ chikkā; indriyamatra śukramabhipretaṃ, ‘śukrāśmarī tatsravaṇaṃ bhavedvā’ ityādivakṣyamāṇavacanāt; abhidhāne cendriyaśabdaḥ śukre dṛṣṭaḥ; tathāca tadvacaḥ- “śrotravāgādi sattvaṃ ca śukraṃ cendriyamucyate”- iti| vyāhanyamānaiḥ avarudhyamānaiḥ| uditairiti ūrdhvagataiḥ||4||

div.ab: kṣuttṛṣṇāśvāsanidrāṇāmudāvarto vidhāraṇāt |5|

anyeṣāmapi vidhāraṇādudāvartasambhavamāha- kṣuttṛṣṇetyādi| vātaviṇmūtrādikāt kṣuttṛṣṇādīnāṃ bhinnapāṭho vātādīnāṃ sannihitakāraṇatvaṃ tathā kṣudādīnāṃ viprakṛṣṭakāraṇatvaṃ sūcayati; athavā anena bhinnapāṭhena vakṣyamāṇaṃ hetumāhārāśritaṃ sūcayati| yathā- “vāyuḥ koṣṭhānugo rūkṣaiḥ kaṣāyakaṭutiktakaiḥ” ityādi| ye kṣudādīnāṃ bhinnapāṭhaṃ na paṭhanti; tanmate īdṛśaḥ pāṭhaḥ,- ‘vātaviṇmūtrajṛmbhāśrukṣavodgāravamīndriyaiḥ| kṣuttṛṣṇāśvāsanidrāṇāṃ dhṛtyodāvartasambhavaḥ’ iti| dhṛtyā dhāraṇenetyarthaḥ| nanu, adhovegarodhādapānaprakopādudāvartasambhavo yuktaḥ, aśrujṛmbhādivegadhāraṇāt kathaṃ tasyotpattiḥ ? satyaṃ, aśrujṛmbhādivegarodhāt koṣṭhagato vāyuryadā bhavati tadā'pānaprakopādudāvartasambhavaḥ|5|-

ab.seg: tasyābhidhāsye vyāsena lakṣaṇaṃ ca cikitsitam ||5||
tasyābhidhāsye ityādi| tasya udāvartasya| abhidhāsye kathayiṣyāmi| vyāsena vistareṇa||5||

div.ab: trayodaśavidhaścāsau bhinna etaistu kāraṇaiḥ |6|
tasya saṅkhyāmāha- trayodaśavidha ityādi| bhinno bhedaṃ gataḥ| etaiḥ kāraṇaiḥ pūrvoktairvātaviṇmūtrādibhiḥ|6|-

ab.seg: apathyabhojanāccāpi vakṣyate ca tathā'paraḥ ||6||
vātādivegarodhāttrayodaśodāvartānabhidhāyedānīṃ kāraṇabhedādaparamapyāha- apathyetyādi| aparo vātādyavarodhajebhyo'nyaḥ||6||

div.ab: ādhmānaśūlau hṛdayoparodhaṃ śirorujaṃ śvāsamatīva hikkām | kāsapratiśyāyagalagrahāṃśca balāsapittaprasaraṃ ca ghoram ||7|| kuryādapāno'bhihataḥ svamārge hanyāt purīṣaṃ mukhataḥ kṣipedvā |8|

ab.seg: vātajodāvartalakṣaṇamāha- ādhmānaśūlāvityādi| hṛdayoparodhaṃ hṛdayāvaraṇam| balāsapittaprasaraṃ śleṣmapittaprasaraṇam| abhihataḥ avaruddhaḥ| svamārge gude| hanyāt purīṣaṃ purīṣakṣayaṃ kuryāt kṣipedvetyatrāpi purīṣamiti sambandhanīyam| galagrahāṃśceti cakārāt krimyādīnāṃ samānatantranirdiṣṭānāṃ grahaṇam| apānāvarodhena prāṇādīnāmapi prakopāt śirorukkāsādisambhavo yuktaḥ||7||

div.ab: āṭopaśūlau parikartanaṃ ca saṅgaḥ purīṣasya tathordhvavātaḥ ||8|| purīṣamāsyādapi vā nireti purīṣavege'bhihate narasya |9|

purīṣajodāvartalakṣaṇamāha- āṭopaśūlāvityādi| āṭopa udarāpūraḥ| parikartanaṃ gudameḍhrabastyādiṣu kṛntanamiva vedanā| ūrdhvavāto bahūdgāratā| āsyāt mukhāt| nireti nirgacchati| parikartanaṃ ceti cakārāt piṇḍikodveṣṭanādayaḥ||8||-

ab.seg: mūtrasya vege'bhihate narastu kṛcchreṇa mūtraṃ kurute'lpamalpam ||9||
meḍhre gude vaṅkṣaṇabastimuṣkanābhipradeśeṣvathavā'pi vaṅkṣaṇamuṣkayośca' iti pā. mūrdhni | ānaddhabastiśca `ānaddhabasteḥ' iti pā. bhavanti tīvrāḥ śūlāśca śūlairiva bhinnamūrteḥ ||10||

mūtrodāvartalakṣaṇamāha- mūtrasyetyādi| vaṅkṣaṇam udarorusandhiḥ| muṣkau aṇḍau| mūrdhni uttamāṅge| ānaddhabastiḥ ādhmātamūtrādhāraḥ| ‘ānaddhabasteḥ’ iti kecit paṭhanti, te ca ānaddhabastermūrdhni śūlā bhavantīti yojayanti| tanna, samānatantravirodhāt| bhinnamūrteḥ bhinnaśarīrasya `viddhaśarīrasya' iti pā.||9-10||
manyāgalastambhaśirovikārā jṛmbhopaghātāt pavanātmakāḥ syuḥ | śrotrānanaghrāṇavilocanotthā bhavanti tīvrāśca tathā vikārāḥ ||11||

jṛmbhodāvartalakṣaṇamāha- manyetyādi| stambhaśabdo manyāgalābhyāṃ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| galastambho galagrahaḥ| śirovikārāḥ sūryāvartādayaḥ| pavanātmakāḥ kampasuptyādayaḥ, cakārāt arucivibhramādayaśca||11||
ānandajaṃ śokasamudbhavaṃ vā netrodakaṃ prāptamamuñcato hi | śirogurutvaṃ nayanāmayāśca bhavanti tīvrāḥ saha pīnasena ||12||
aśrujodāvartalakṣaṇamāha- ānandajamityādi| netrodakam aśru, prāptaṃ pravṛttyunmukham| pīnaso'tra pratiśyāyaḥ, samānatantradarśanāt| cakārāt pratiśyāyādayaḥ||12||
bhavanti gāḍhaṃ kṣavathorvighātācchirokṣināsāśravaṇeṣu rogāḥ | kaṇṭhāsyapūrṇatvamatīva todaḥ kūjaśca vāyoruta vā'pravṛttiḥ ||13||

chikkājodāvartalakṣaṇamāha- bhavantītyādi| kṣavathorvighātāt chikkāvarodhāt| kaṇṭhāsyapūrṇatvamiti kaṇṭhamukhe vāyunā pūrṇe iva bhavataḥ| atīva todaḥ atīva vyathā, kaṇṭhamukhayoreva| kecit ‘kaṇṭhasya’ iti paṭhanti, tanmate kaṇṭhasyaiva pūrṇatvaṃ todaśca| kūjaḥ avyaktavacanam| vāyorapravṛttiḥ ucchvāsāvarodhaḥ| uta vā athavetyarthaḥ| cakārāt manyāstambhādayaḥ||13||

div.ab: udgāravege'bhihate bhavanti ghorā vikārāḥ pavanaprasūtāḥ |14|
udgārajodāvartalakṣaṇamāha- udgāravega ityādi| ghorāḥ kaṣṭatarāḥ| "ghorāḥ" ityatra "jantoḥ" iti kecit paṭhanti| pavanaprasūtāḥ kampahikkāhṛdvibandhādayaḥ|14|-

ab.seg: chardervighātena bhavecca kuṣṭhaṃ yenaiva doṣeṇa vidagdhamannam ||14||

chardijodāvartalakṣaṇamāha- chardervighātenetyādi| kuṣṭhagrahaṇamatra śītapittakopādyupalakṣaṇārtham| yenaiva doṣeṇa vidagdhamannamiti yenaiva vātādyanyatamena doṣeṇa vidagdhaṃ duṣṭamannaṃ bhavettaddoṣādhikameva kuṣṭhaṃ syādityarthaḥ| cakārāt arocakādayaḥ||14||
mūtrāśaye pāyuni `vā gudamuṣkayośca' iti pā. muṣkayośca śopho rujo mūtravinigrahaśca | śukrāśmarī tatsravaṇaṃ bhavedvā te te vikārā vihate tu śukre ||15||

śukrajodāvartalakṣaṇamāha- mūtrāśaya ityādi| mūtrāśaye bastau, pāyuni gude, śophaḥ śvayathuḥ; rujo'pi mūtrāśayādiṣveva bhavanti| mūtravinigraho mūtrāpravṛttiḥ| tatsravaṇaṃ śukrasravaṇaṃ, samānatantrapratyayāt| te te vikārā iti hṛtpīḍāṅgamardādayaḥ śukravegavighātajāḥ samānatantroktāḥ||15||

div.ab: tandrāṅgamardārucivibhramāḥ syuḥ `tandrāṅgamardāvaruciḥ śramaśca' iti pā. kṣudho'bhighātāt kṛśatā ca dṛṣṭeḥ |16|

kṣujjodāvartalakṣaṇamāha- tandretyādi| tandrā vaikārikī nidrā; aṅgamardaḥ aṅgodveṣṭanamiva vedanā, sphuṭaniketyanye; vibhramaḥ atyarthaṃ cakrārūḍhasyeva bhramaṇam| kṛśatā ca dṛṣṭeḥ dṛṅmāndyam cakārāt daurbalyādayastantrāntaroktā grāhyāḥ|16|-

ab.seg: kaṇṭhāsyaśoṣaḥ śravaṇāvarodhastṛṣṇābhighātaddhṛdaye vyathā ca ||16||
tṛṣṇājodāvartalakṣaṇamāha- kaṇṭhāsyaśoṣa ityādi| śravaṇāvarodho bādhiryam| cakārāt śramasvedādayaḥ samānatantroktāḥ||16||

div.ab: śrāntasya niḥśvāsavinigraheṇa hṛdrogamohāvathavā'pi gulmaḥ |17|
ucchvāsajodāvartalakṣaṇamāha- śrāntasyetyādi| śrāntasya drutagamanādinā `dhāvanādinā' iti pā. khinnasya| śrāntasyetyanenāśrāntasya śvāsadhāraṇādapi pīḍā na bhavatīti sūcyate| moho vaicittyam|17|-

ab.seg: jṛmbhā'ṅgamardo'ṅgaśirokṣijāḍyaṃ nidrābhighātādathavā'pi tandrā ||17||
nidrājodāvartalakṣaṇamāha- jṛmbhetyādi| jāḍyaśabdo'ṅgādibhiḥ sambadhyate; jāḍyam apāṭavaṃ, gauravamiti tātparyārthaḥ||17||
tṛṣṇārditaṃ parikliṣṭaṃ kṣīṇaṃ śūlairabhidrutam | śakṛdvamantaṃ matimānudāvartinamutsṛjet ||18||

parityājyodāvartalakṣaṇamāha- tṛṣṇārditamityādi| parikliṣṭam atyarthamavasannaṃ, kriyārahitamiti yāvat; anye samantato bhāvena kleśamupagataṃ parikliṣṭaṃ manyante| abhidrutaṃ pīḍitam| utsṛjet parityajet||18||

div.ab: sarveṣveteṣu vidhivadudāvarteṣu kṛtsnaśaḥ | vāyoḥ kriyā vidhātavyāḥ svamārgapratipattaye ||19|| sāmānyataḥ pṛthaktvena kriyāṃ bhūyo nibodha me |20|

ab.seg: sarvadodāvarteṣu vāyoḥ sadbhāvāt sāmānyena vātaharīṃ kriyāmāha- sarveṣveteṣvityādi| vidhivat yathāvidhi| kṛtsnaśaḥ sāmastyena| kriyāḥ snehasvedādikāḥ| svamārgapratipattaye vāyorātmamārgapravartanāya| sāmānyataḥ sāmānyena| ‘sarveṣu’ ityatra ‘navasu’ iti paṭhitvā vātajodāvartādiṣu navasaṅkhyeṣu vāyoḥ kriyā vidhātavyeti vyākhyānayanti; tanna, bubhukṣodbhavādiṣvapi caturṣūdāvarteṣu vāyoḥ sadbhāvādvātaharī kriyā kriyata `vidhātavyā' iti pā. iti| pṛthaktvena kriyāmityādi| pṛthaktvena pratyekam||19||
āsthāpanaṃ mārutaje snigdhasvinne viśiṣyate ||20||
āsthāpanamityādi| āsthāpanaṃ nirūhaḥ, taccānulomikavātaharadravyakṛtam| snigdhasvinne ‘āture’ iti śeṣaḥ| viśiṣyate viśiṣṭaṃ bhavati, viśeṣeṇa kriyata iti tātparyārthaḥ||20||

div.ab: purīṣaje tu kartavyo vidhirānāhiko bhavet |21|
purīṣaja ityādi| ānāhiko vidhiḥ phalavartyādiko vātavyādhyukto visūcyāṃ vakṣyamāṇo vā| tuśabdāt anuktamanyadapi parīṣānulomanaṃ kartavyam|21|-

sauvarcalāḍhyāṃ madirāṃ mūtre tvabhihate pibet ||21|| elāṃ vā'pyatha madyena kṣīraṃ vā'pi pibennaraṃ | dhātrīphalānāṃ svarasaṃ sajalaṃ vā pibettryaham ||22|| rasamaśvapurīṣasya gardabhasyāthavā pibet | māṃsopadaṃśaṃ madhu vā pibedvā sīdhu gauḍikam ||23|| bhadradāru ghanaṃ mūrvā haridrā madhukaṃ tathā | kolapramāṇāni pibedāntarikṣeṇa vāriṇā ||24|| duḥsparśāsvarasaṃ vā'pi kaṣāyaṃ kuṅkumasya ca | ervārubījaṃ toyena pibedvā'lavaṇīkṛtam ||25|| pañcamūlīśṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ drākṣārasamathāpi vā |26|

sauvarcalāḍhyāmityādi| sauvarcalāḍhyāṃ sauvarcalotkaṭām| madirāṃ madyam| tuśabdāt sarpiṣo'vapīḍanādikaṃ samānatantroktaṃ grāhyam| kiṃ madirāmeva pibedathavā'nyadapītyāha- elāmityādi| dhātrīphalānāṃ svarasaṃ sajalaṃ veti na kevalaṃ dugdhaṃ pibedāmalakarasaṃ sodakaṃ pibedityarthaḥ| ‘gardabhasya’ ityatrāpi ‘purīṣarasam’ iti sambadhyate| māṃsopadaṃśaṃ māṃsabhakṣaṇasahitaṃ, madhu madyam| tacca drākṣodbhavaṃ, samānatantradarśanāt| tathā ca tadvacaḥ,- “drākṣodbhavaṃ cāpi pibenmadyaṃ māṃsopadaṃśakam”- iti| gauḍikaṃ sīdhu guḍakṛtaṃ sasyakam; atrāpi māṃsopadaṃśamiti sambadhyate| bhadradārvityādi| bhadradāru devadāru| ghanaṃ mustā| mūrvā corasnāyuḥ| madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu| kolapramāṇāni ardhakarṣapramāṇāni| duḥsparśā durālabhā| ervāruḥ grīṣmakarkaṭikā| alavaṇīkṛtam īṣatsaindhavayuktam| pañcamūlī laghupañcamūlaṃ, samānatantrasaṃvādāt; tathā coktam- “laghunā pañcamūlena śṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ pibennaraḥ”- iti||21-25||-

ab.seg: yogāṃśca vitaredatra pūrvoktānaśmarībhidaḥ ||26||
mūtrakṛcchrakramaṃ cāpi kuryānniravaśeṣataḥ | bhūyo vakṣyāmi yogān yān mūtrāghātopaśāntaye ||27||

idānīṃ mūtrajodāvarte aśmarīmūtrakṛcchramūtrāghātacikitsitānyatidiśannāha- yogāṃśca vitaredityādi| vitaret dadyāt| atra mūtrajodāvarte| pūrvoktān ‘kuśaḥ kāśaḥ śaraḥ’ ityādinā'śmarīcikitsitoktān| bhūyaḥ atiśayena| ‘vakṣyāmi yān yogān' ityatrāpi ‘tān kuryāt’ iti sambadhyate||26-27||

div.ab: snaihaiḥ svedairudāvartaṃ jṛmbhājaṃ samupācaret |28|
jṛmbhaṇajodāvartacikitsitamāha- snehairityādi| snehaiḥ svedairiti padadvaye'pi bahuvacanāccaturbhiḥ snehaiścaturbhiśca svedairityarthaḥ|28|-

ab.seg: aśrumokṣo'śruje kāryaḥ snigdhasvinnasya dehinaḥ ||28||
aśrujodāvartacikitsāmāha- aśrumokṣa ityādi| aśrumokṣaḥ aśruniḥsāraṇam| atra luptacakāranirdeśāttīkṣṇabhañjanādikaṃ vakṣyamāṇamatrāpi sambandhanīyam||28||

div.ab: tīkṣṇāñjanāvapīḍābhyāṃ tīkṣṇagandhopaśiṅghanaiḥ | vartiprayogairathavā kṣavasaktiṃ pravartayet ||29|| (tīkṣṇauṣadhapradhamanairathavā''dityaraśmibhiḥ||) |

kṣavajodāvartacikitsitamāha- tīkṣṇāñjanāvapīḍābhyāmityādi| tīkṣṇaśabdo'ñjanāvapīḍābhyāṃ saha sambadhyate| avapīḍo nasyabhedaḥ| tīkṣṇagandhopaśiṅghanaiḥ maricādicūrṇāvaghrāṇaiḥ| vartiprayogā dhūmavartiprayogāḥ| atra luptādiśabdāt arkaraśmivilokanādayo gṛhyante| tathā ca- “tīkṣṇadhūmāñjanāghrāṇanāvanārkavilokanaiḥ| pravartayet kṣutiṃ saktām”- ityādi| kṣavasaktiṃ chikkāyā apravartanam| kecittīkṣṇāñjanāvapīḍābhyāmiti padamaśrujodāvarta eva manyante na kṣavaje, anaupayikatvāttantrāntaravirodhācca||29||-
udgāraje kramopetaṃ snaihikaṃ dhūmamācaret ||30|| surāṃ sauvarcalavatīṃ bījapūrarasānvitām |31|
udgāraje kramopetamityādi| kramopetaṃ dhūmanasyakavalagrahacikitsitoktakramasaṃyuktam| kimudgāraje snaihikaṃ dhūmamevācaredutānyadapītyāha- surāmityādi||30||-
chardyāghātaṃ yathādoṣaṃ samyak snehādibhirjayet ||31|| sakṣāralavaṇopetamabhyaṅgaṃ cātra dāpayet |32|

ab.seg: chardyāghātamityādi| chardyāghātaṃ chardyāghātajamudāvartaṃ, kāraṇekāryopacārāt| yathādoṣaṃ doṣasyānatikrameṇa| ādiśabdāt vamanādayaḥ| sakṣāralavaṇopetam īṣadyavakṣārasaindhavasaṃyuktaṃ; yadyapi tantrāntare tailābhyaṅga uktastathā'pyatra vṛddhasampradāyāddhṛtābhyaṅgaḥ kāryaḥ| cakārāt vyāyāmopavāsādayo gṛhyante| 'vamyāghātaṃ' iti kecit paṭhanti||31||
bastiśuddhikarāvāpaṃ caturguṇajalaṃ payaḥ ||32||
āvārināśāt kvathitaṃ pītavantaṃ prakāmataḥ | ramayeyuḥ ramayeran' iti pā. priyā nāryaḥ śukrodāvartinaṃ naram ||33||

bastiśuddhikarāvāpamityādi| bastiśuddhikarāvāpaṃ kūṣmāṇḍakatṛṇapañcamūlādiprakṣepam| prakṣepadravyapramāṇaṃ kṣīrāṣṭāṃśena| payaḥ kṣīram| prakāmataḥ svecchayā nāryaḥ śukrodāvartinaṃ naraṃ ramayeyuḥ bhajeyuḥ| yadatra ramaṇe strīṇāṃ kartrītvenābhidhānaṃ tat śukrodāvartino harṣādhikyasañjananārtham| priyā manonukūlāḥ| luptacakārāt tāmracūḍādayastantrāntaroktā grāhyāḥ||32-33||

div.ab: kṣudvighāte hitaṃ snigdhamuṣṇamalpaṃ ca bhojanam |34|
kṣudvighāte hitamityādi| cakārāt laghvapi|34|-

ab.seg: tṛṣṇāghāte pibenmanthaṃ yavāgūṃ vā'pi śītalām ||34||
tṛṣṇāghāte pibenmanthamityādi| manthaḥ saghṛtaśītalajalaplutāḥ saktavaḥ| yavāgūratra peyā| apiśabdāt śītalajalāvagāhapānādikaṃ grāhyam||34||

div.ab: bhojyo rasena viśrāntaḥ śramaśvāsāturo naraḥ |35|
bhojyo rasenetyādi| bhojyo bhojayitavyaḥ rasena māṃsarasena|35|-

ab.seg: nidrāghāte pibet kṣīraṃ svapyācceṣṭakathā `svapyācceṣṭakathārataḥ' iti pā. naraḥ ||35||

nidrāghāte pibet kṣīramityādi| kṣīraṃ gokṣīraṃ na māhiṣaṃ, pradhānakalpanāśrayaṇāt samānatantradarśanācca| tathā ca tantrāntaram,- “nidrāghāte pibet kṣīraṃ gostanādathavā naraḥ”- iti| iṣṭakathā anukūlakathāḥ `anuraktajanakathāḥ' iti pā., ‘śṛṇuyāt’ iti śeṣaḥ| ‘iṣṭakathārataḥ’ iti pāṭhāntaram| svapyāt nidrāṃ gacchet||35||
ādhmānādyeṣu rogeṣu yathāsvaṃ prayateta hi | yacca yatra bhavetprāptaṃ tacca tasmin prayojayet ||36||

udāvartacikitsitamabhidhāyedānīṃ tadupadravacikitsitamāha- ādhmānādyeṣu rogeṣvityādi| ādhmānādyeṣu vegāvarodhajāteṣu| ādiśabdāt śūlaparikartikāpurīṣasaṅgādīnāṃ grahaṇam| yathāsvaṃ yasyādhmānāderyadātmīyamauṣadhaṃ vātavyādhyādicikitsitoktaṃ tena prayateta prayatnaṃ kurvīta| anyadapyucitaṃ cikitsitamādhmānādiṣu kāryamityāha- yaccetyādi| yadauṣadhaṃ yasmin ādhmānādau prāptaṃ yuktam||36||

div.ab: vāyuḥ koṣṭhānugo rūkṣaiḥ kaṣāyakaṭutiktakaiḥ | bhojanaiḥ kupitaḥ sadya udāvartaṃ karoti hi ||37|| vātamūtrapurīṣāsṛkkaphamedovahāni vai | srotāṃsyudāvartayati purīṣaṃ cātivartayet ||38|| tato hṛdbastiśūlārto gauravārucipīḍitaḥ | vātamūtrapurīṣāṇi kṛcchreṇa kurute naraḥ ||39|| śvāsakāsapratiśyāyadāhamohavamijvarān | tṛṣṇāhikkāśirorogamanaḥśravaṇavibhramān ||40|| labhate ca bahūnanyān vikārān vātakopajān |41|

‘apathyabhojanāccāpi vakṣyate ca tathā'paraḥ’ iti yaduktaṃ tasyāvasaraḥ- vāyurityādi| koṣṭhānugo vāyuratra apānaḥ, samānatantradarśanāt| tasya lakṣaṇamāha- vātetyādi| udāvartayati ūrdhvāmāvartayati, adhovahāni srotāṃsyūrdhvavahāni karotītyarthaḥ| purīṣaṃ cātivartayediti, uṣṭrādipurīṣavat kaṭhinaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ| tataḥ tasmāddhetoḥ| vibhramo vyāpadviśeṣaḥ| anyān ādhmānapratyādhmānādīn||37-40||-
taṃ tailalavaṇābhyaktaṃ snigdhaṃ svinnaṃ nirūhayet ||41|| doṣato bhinnavarcaskaṃ bhuktaṃ cāpyanuvāsayet |42|

tasya cikitsitamāha- taṃ tailetyādi| tam udāvartinam| doṣata ityādi| bhinnavarcaskaṃ nirūhabhinnapurīṣaṃ puruṣaṃ doṣamapekṣya bhuktavantamanuvāsayediti sambandhaḥ| kecidatrānuvāsanaṃ niruhātiyogavyāpatpraśamanārthaṃ manyante; tanna, samānatantravirodhāt; tathā ca,- “udāvarte tvapathyotthe sunirūḍhaṃ tato bhiṣak| yathādoṣaṃ bhuktavantamāśu caivānuvāsayet”- iti| kecit ‘bhinnavarcaskaṃ’ ityatra ‘bhinnavarcāṃsi’ iti paṭhitvā anulomanīyāni bhuktavantamiti vyākhyānayanti||41||-
na cecchāntiṃ vrajatyevamudāvartaḥ sudāruṇaḥ ||42|| athainaṃ bahuśaḥ svinnaṃ yuñjyāt snehavirecanaiḥ |43|
nirūhānuvāsanābhyāmapyapraśāmyatyudāvarte cikitsitamāha- na cecchāntimityādi| evaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā| enam udāvartinam| svinnaṃ snigdhasvinnam, ādilopāt| snehavirecanaireraṇḍatailādibhiḥ||42||-

ab.seg: pāyayeta trivṛtpīluyavānīramlapācanaiḥ ||43||
hiṅgukuṣṭhavacāsvarjiviḍaṅgaṃ vā dviruttaram | yogāvetāvudāvartaṃ śūlaṃ cānilajaṃ `cāpi niyacchataḥ' iti pā. hataḥ ||44||

apathyajodāvarte yogadvayamāha- pāyayetetyādi| pīluḥ uṣṭrapriyo guḍaphalaḥ, bhādānake ‘pīlu’ iti prasiddhaḥ| amlapācanaiḥ amlaṃ kāñjikaṃ, pācanāni citrakādīni, taiḥ saha pāyayedityarthaḥ| trivṛdādiḥ eko yogaḥ, hiṅgvādistu dvitīyaḥ| svarjī svarjikākṣāraḥ| dviruttaramiti ādyācca dravyāduttarottaraṃ dravyaṃ dviguṇaṃ grāhyam| dviruttaramiti padaṃ na pūrvayoge sambandhanīyaṃ, ‘dviruttarā hiṅguvacā sakuṣṭhā’ ityādinā tantrāntare darśitatvāt| yavānīrityatra yavāgūmiti kecit paṭhanti| apare ‘amlapācanaiḥ’ ityatra 'amlapānakaiḥ' iti paṭhitvā amladravairiti vyākhyānayanti||43-44||

div.ab: devadārvagnikau kuṣṭhaṃ śuṇṭhīṃ `vacāṃ' iti pā. pathyāṃ palaṅkaṣām | pauṣkarāṇi ca mūlāni toyasyardhāḍhake pacet ||45|| pādāvaśiṣṭaṃ tat pītamudāvartamapohati |46|

devadārvagnikāvityādi| agnikaḥ ajamodā| pathyā harītakī| palaṅkaṣā gugguluḥ| ardhāḍhakaṃ dvātriṃśatpalāni, pādāvaśiṣṭam aṣṭapalapramitaṃ, vṛddhavaidyavyavahārāttantrāntaradarśanācca| tathā ca tantrāntare uktam,- "kuṣṭhaṃ palaṅkaṣāṃ pathyāṃ śuṇṭhīṃ dārvagnipuṣkaram| dvātriṃśatā toyapalaiḥ paktvā pādāvaśeṣitam| pāyayet"- ityādi| yadyapi ‘kvāthasyāñjaliriṣyate’ iti paribhāṣā vidyate, tathā'pi mānānuktau paribhāṣāśrayaṇaṃ na punarukte māne| kecidardhāḍhakaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭipalāni manyante, te ca ṣoḍaśapalonmitaṃ kvāthaṃ pāyayanti; apare kvāthabāhulyāt kramaśaḥ kvāthapānamicchanti na punarekasminneva divase; tanna, samānatantravirodhāt||45||-

ab.seg: mūlakaṃ śuṣkamārdraṃ ca varṣābhūḥ pañcamūlakam ||46||
ārevataphalaṃ cāpsu paktvā tena ghṛtaṃ pacet | tat pīyamānaṃ śāstyugramudāvartamaśeṣataḥ `śamayedudāvartamaśeṣataḥ' iti pā.||47||

udāvarte pānārthaṃ ghṛtamāha- mūlakamityādi| śuṣkamiti mūlārdrakayorviśeṣaṇam| varṣābhūḥ punarnavā| pañcamūlakaṃ bilvādipañcamūlam| ārevataphalaṃ girimālakaphalam| paktveti kvāthapākaparibhāṣayā| tena kvāthena| śāsti hantītyarthaḥ||46-47||
vacāmativiṣāṃ kuṣṭhaṃ yavakṣāraṃ harītakīm | kṛṣṇāṃ nirdahanīṃ cāpi pibeduṣṇena vāriṇā ||48||
vacāmativiṣāmityādi| nirdahanī agnimanthaḥ, gaṇikāriketyanye||48||

div.ab: ikṣvākumūlaṃ madanaṃ viśalyātiviṣe vacām | kuṣṭhaṃ kiṇvāgnikau caiva pibettulyāni pūrvavat ||49|| mūtreṇa devadārvagnitriphalābṛhatīḥ pibet |50|

ab.seg: ikṣvākumūlamityādi| ikṣvākuḥ kaṭutumbī| viśalyā kāṣṭhapāṭalā, indravāruṇītyanye| kiṇvaṃ surābījaṃ; agnikaḥ ajamodā| pūrvavaditi uṣṇodakenetyarthaḥ| mūtreṇa gomūtreṇa| agniḥ citrakaḥ||49||

div.ab: yavaprasthaṃ phalaiḥ sārdhaṃ kaṇṭakāryā jalāḍhake ||50|| paktvā'rdhaprasthaśeṣaṃ tu pibeddhiṅgusamanvitam |51|

yavaprasthamityādi| kaṇṭakārīphalayavayoḥ samuditena samabhāgena prasthaṃ ṣoḍaśapalāni| jalāḍhakaṃ toyasya catuḥṣaṣṭipalāni, vṛddhavaidyavyavahārādatra toyadvaiguṇyaparibhāṣā nādriyate| ardhaprasthaśeṣam aṣṭau palāni| atra kvāthasyāṣṭau palāni bahutvāt kathaṃ pātavyānīti nāśaṅkanīyaṃ, "ṛṣayastveva jānanti drvyasaṃyogajaṃ `yogasaṃyogajaṃ' iti pā. phalam"- ityukteḥ| ye tu pūrvoktadevadārvādipānavadatrāpi toyasya mānādhikyamicchanti, te kaṇṭakāriphalānyapi prasthapramitāni gṛhṇanti| kecit ‘yavaprasthaṃ pale dve ca kaṇṭakāryā’ iti paṭhanti||50||-
madanālābubījāni pippalīṃ sanidigdhikām ||51|| sañcūrṇya pradhamennāḍyā viśatyetadyathā gudam |52|

madanālābubījānītyādi| madanaṃ madanaphalaṃ, tasya bījāni vaitaraṇasaṃvādāt| tathā ca tadvacaḥ,- "madanālābunorbījaṃ kaṇṭakārīkaṇānvitam"- ityādi| nidigdhikā kaṇṭakārī| etāni sañcūrṇya nāḍyā pradhamet mukhādivāyunā kṛtvā gude prerayet||51||-

ab.seg: cūrṇaṃ nikumbhakampillaśyāmekṣvākvagnikodbhavam ||52||
kṛtavedhanamāgadhyorlavaṇānāṃ ca sādhayet | gavāṃ mūtreṇa tā vartīḥ kārayettu gudānugāḥ | sadyaḥ śarmakarāvetau yogāvamṛtasammatau ||53||

cūrṇamityādi| nikumbho dantīvṛkṣaḥ, kampillaḥ rocanikā, śyāmā aruṇamūlā trivṛt, ikṣvākuḥ kaṭutumbī, agnikaḥ ajamodā, kṛtavedhanaṃ kośātakībhedaḥ, māgadhī pippalī, lavaṇāni saindhavādīni, gudānugā gudapraveśayogyapramāṇā| śarmakarau sukhakarau| etau yogāviti madanādicūrṇapradhamanayogavartiyogau| amṛtasammitau amṛtatulyau, jīvanīyātmakatvāt| vartikalpanāṃ kathayati- nikumbhādīnāṃ cūrṇaṃ gomūtreṇa paktvā ghane śītībhūte ca sati vartīḥ kārayet||52-53||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātentre udāvartapratiṣedho nāma (saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) pañcapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||55||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantre udāvartapratiṣedho nāma pañcapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||55||

div.head: visūcikāpratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto visūcikāpratiṣedhamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

udāvartapratiṣedhānantaramudāvartāśritavātapratilomyakṛtamandāgnervisūcikāhetutvādvisūcikāpratiṣedhārambho yukta ityata āha- athāta ityādi| visūciketyatra ādiśabdo lupto draṣṭavyaḥ, tenālasakavilambikayorgrahaṇam||1-2||
ajīrṇamāmaṃ viṣṭabdhaṃ vidagdhaṃ ca yadīritam | visūcyalasakau tasmādbhaveccāpi vilambikā ||3||

visūcyādīnāṃ kāraṇamāha- ajīrṇamāmamityādi| yadīritamiti ‘annapānavidhau’ iti śeṣaḥ| tasmāt ajīrṇāt| yadatra caturthājīrṇasya rasaśeṣasyopādānaṃ na kṛtaṃ tadapariṇāmamātratvena tasya visūcyādyārambhakatvābhāvādekīyamatatvenoktatvācca| visūcyalasakābhyāṃ yadvilambikāyāḥ pṛthagvibhaktinirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ, tattasyā asādhyatvāvabodhanārtham, itarayośca prāyaḥ kṛcchrasādhyatvabodhanārtham||3||
sūcībhiriva gātrāṇi tudan santiṣṭhate'nilaḥ | yasyājīrṇena sā vaidyairucyate ti `tu' iti pā. visūcikā ||4||

visūcyā niruktimāha- sūcībhirityādi| vaidyaiḥ ādyairityarthaḥ| ucyate ti ‘varṇāgama-’ ityādinā ikāralopāt sādhuḥ| ‘tudan’ ityatra ‘bhindan’ iti kecit paṭhanti| yadatra visūcyādīnāṃ prāgrūpaṃ na bhaṇitaṃ tadrūpāṇyevālpānyāsāṃ prāgrūpaṃ, na tu prāgrūpāntaramastīti bodhayati||4||
na tāṃ parimitāhārā labhante viditāgamāḥ | mūḍhāstāmajitātmāno labhante kaluṣāśayāḥ `'śanalolupāḥ' iti pā.||5||

idānīmajīrṇaparivarjane yatnātiśayaḥ kārya iti pratipādanārthamāha- na tāmityādi| parimitāhārā aniṣiddhāśanaṃ bhuñjānāḥ| viditāgamā jñātabhojanopadeśāḥ| mūḍhāḥ paśutulyāḥ, sevyāsevyāhārānabhijñā ityarthaḥ| ajitātmānaḥ ajitendriyāḥ| kaluṣāśayāḥ praduṣṭāmāśayāḥ, āmāśayaduṣṭiśca duṣṭānnasamparkādvātādikopācca; kecit ‘aśanalolupāḥ’ iti paṭhanti||5||
mūrcchātisārau vamathuḥ pipāsā śūlaṃ bhramodveṣṭanajṛmbhadāhāḥ | vaivarṇyakampau hṛdaye rujaśca bhavanti tasyāṃ śirasaśca bhedaḥ ||6||
visūcikālakṣaṇamāha- mūrcchātisārāvityādi| vamathuḥ chardiḥ| udveṣṭanaṃ jaṅghādīnāṃ moṭanaṃ, khallīti loke| tasyāṃ visūcikāyām| śirasaśca bhedaḥ śirovidāraṇamiva vedanā||6||
kukṣirānahyate'tyarthaṃ pratāmyati vikūjati | niruddho mārutaścāpi kukṣau `kukṣāvupari dhāvati' iti pā. viparidhāvati ||7||
vātavarconirodhaśca kukṣau yasya bhṛśaṃ bhavet | tasyālasakamācaṣṭe tṛṣṇodgārāvarodhakau `tṛṣṇodgārau tu yasya tu' iti pā.||8||

alasakalakṣaṇamāha- kukṣirityādi| kukṣiḥ udaram| ānahyate ādhmānayukto bhavati| atyarthamatiśayaṃ yathā tathā| tāmyati tamasi praviśatīva| vikūjati avyaktaśabdaṃ karoti| viparidhāvati viśeṣeṇa samantādgacchati||7-8||
duṣṭaṃ tu bhuktaṃ kaphamārutābhyāṃ pravartate nordhvamadhaśca yasya | vilambikāṃ tāṃ bhṛśaduścikitsyāmācakṣate `tu vivarjanīyāṃ' iti pā. śāstravidaḥ purāṇāḥ ||9||

vilambikālakṣaṇamāha- duṣṭamityādi| bhuktaṃ bhojanam| duṣṭamityatra ‘kaphamārutābhyām’ iti sambandhanīyam| yadyapi vilambikā bāhulyena vidagdhājīrṇājjāyate, vidagdhājīrṇācca pittaṃ duṣṭaṃ na vāyurduṣṭo bhavati na vā śleṣmā, tathā'pi pittaduṣṭyā `pittaduṣṭāvitarayorapi' iti pā. itarayorapi duṣṭiḥ, tasmāt kaphamārutābhyāṃ duṣṭamityuktam; evaṃ bāhulyena āmāviśiṣṭatvotthitayorvisūcyalasakayoḥ `āmāviṣṭabdhocchritayoḥ' iti pā. kaphavātādhikayorapītaradoṣasadbhāvo jñeyaḥ| ‘duṣṭam’ ityatra ‘līnam’ iti kecit paṭhanti| iyameva vilambikā tantrāntare ‘daṇḍālasaka’ iti nāmnā kathyate||9||
yatrasthamāmaṃ virujettameva deśaṃ viśeṣeṇa vikārajātaiḥ | doṣeṇa yenāvatataṃ svaliṅgaistaṃ `śarīraṃ tallakṣaṇairāmasamudbhavaiśca' iti pā. lakṣayedāmasamudbhavaiśca ||10||

idānīṃ pūrvoktalakṣaṇaviśeṣamatideśenāha- yatrasthamāmamityādi| yatrasthaṃ yasmin deśe sthitaṃ, yena ca doṣeṇāvatataṃ vyāptamāmaṃ syāt, tameva deśaṃ yasmādviśeṣeṇa rujet tasmāt kāraṇāttaṃ deśaṃ taddoṣalakṣaṇairvikārajātaistodādibhirāmasamudbhavaiśca liṅgaiḥ stambhādhmānādibhirlakṣayediti piṇḍārthaḥ| nanu, yatrasthamityanena āmasthānakathanena kiṃ prayojanaṃ? yasmādyatra sthito vikṛto doṣo bhaviṣyati tatraiva rujaṃ kariṣyati? satyaṃ, naivaṃ sarvatra, yathā gaṇḍamālādau piṇḍikāsthitasyāpi doṣasya grīvādau vikārakartṛtvadarśanāt| āmapīḍitadeśāvabodhaścātra sukhacikitsākaraṇārthamuktaḥ| arthāt yatra yasmin sthāne sthitamāmamajīrṇaṃ virujedviśiṣṭaṃ rujaṃ kuryāt tameva deśaṃ lakṣayedvaidyaḥ, kairvikārajātaiḥ? āmasamudbhavaiḥ stambhagauravādibhiḥ| brahmadevastu yena doṣeṇa vātādyanyatamenānugatamāmajaṃ doṣaṃ svaliṅgairvātādyanyatamadoṣaliṅgairlakṣayediti vyākhyānayati| apare'nyathā paṭhitvā vyākhyānayanti, tacca śiṣyabuddhivyākulakartutvādgranthagauravabhayācca parihṛtam||10||
yaḥ śyāvadantauṣṭhanakho'lpasañjñaśchardyardito'bhyantarayātanetraḥ | kṣāmasvaraḥ sarvavimuktasandhiryāyānnaraḥ so'punarāgamāya ||11||
asādhyalakṣaṇamāha- ya ityādi| śyāvaśabdo dantādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| alpasañjño mandacetanaḥ| abhyantarayātanetraḥ kṣīṇadṛṣṭiḥ| apunarāgamāya apunarāvṛttaye||11||
sādhyāsu pārṣṇyordahanaṃ praśastamagnipratāpo vamanaṃ ca tīkṣṇam | pakve tato'nne tu vilaṅghanaṃ syāt sampācanaṃ cāpi virecanaṃ ca ||12||

idānīṃ cikitsitamāha- sādhyāsvityādi| sādhyāsu visūcikāsu| pārṣṇidahanamatra sañjñāprabodhanārthamadho'tipravṛttivāraṇārthaṃ ca| agnipratāpanam āmapācanārtham| tīkṣṇaṃ ca vamanamannaśalyanirharaṇārtham| sādhyāsviti padamasādhyaparihārārthaṃ, sādhyajñāne yatnātiśayapratipādanārthaṃ ca| pākābhimukhe'nne doṣaśeṣanirharaṇārthamāha `doṣaśeṣanivāraṇārthamāha' iti pā. - pakva ityādi| pakve pākābhimukhe| vilaṅghanaṃ vividhalaṅghanaṃ, tacca yathāvasthaṃ yojyaṃ; anye viśiṣṭaṃ laṅghanamāhuḥ, taccopavāsaḥ| sampācanamatra svedādibhiḥ| virecanamatra phalavartyādibhiḥ| yadyapi virecanamatra sāmānyenoktaṃ, tathā'pi viṣṭambhe `pakve viṣṭabdhe sati' iti pā. sati jñātavyam| anye tu paṭhanti ‘vānte tato'nne tu vilaṅghanaṃ syāt sampācanaṃ recanadīpane ca’ iti| te ca visūcyāṃ vamane prayukte paścādvilaṅghanādikaṃ yojyamiti manyante| pācanamatīsāroktaṃ ‘devadārvabhayā’ ityādikaṃ, dīpanaṃ pippalyādikaṃ, śeṣaṃ pūrvavat| anye ‘pakṣe tato'nye tu’ iti paṭhanti, te ca pakṣādvirecanaṃ deyamiti kecinmanyanta iti vyākhyānayanti; tatra ṭīkākṛdbhirbahu `ṭīkākudbhiryaduktaṃ' iti pā. vyāhṛtaṃ tacca granthagauravabhayāt parityaktam||12||

div.ab: viśuddhadehasya hi sadya eva mūrcchātisārādirupaiti śāntim |13|
kasmādvisūcyāṃ vamanavirecane prayoktavye ityāha- viśuddhadehasyetyādi| hi yasmāt| upaiti gacchati|13|-

ab.seg: āsthāpanaṃ cāpi vadanti pathyaṃ sarvāsu yogānaparānnibodha ||13||

idānīmāsthāpanasyāpi hitatvaṃ darśayitumāha- āsthāpanamityādi| yadyapi ‘tatronmādabhayaśokapipāsārocakājīrṇārśa-‘ ityādinā'jīrṇe āsthāpananiṣedha uktaḥ, tathā'pyatra pākābhimukhe'nne viṣṭambhanāśanāya pācanapūrvakamāsthāpanamapi śasyate| sarvāsu visūcīṣu; kecit sarvāsu visūcyalasakavilambikāsviti manyante| ‘sarvāsu’ ityatra kecit ‘sarvāṃśca’ iti paṭhanti, te vakṣyamāṇayogaviśeṣaṇaṃ kurvanti| yogānityādi| aparān vakṣyamāṇān| nibodha jānīhi| apakvasya pācanārthaṃ pakvasya cānulomanārthaṃ' iti śeṣaḥ||13||
pathyāvacāhiṅgukaliṅgagṛñjasauvarcalaiḥ sātiviṣaiśca cūrṇam | sukhāmbupītaṃ vinihantyajīrṇaṃ śūlaṃ visūcīmaruciṃ ca sadyaḥ ||14||
tāneva yogānāha- pathyetyādi| kaliṅga indrayavaḥ| gṛñjano rasonabhedaḥ| ajīrṇam āmaśeṣaḥ, na tu taruṇājīrṇaṃ; tatrauṣadhaniṣedhāt| visūcīti śeṣā natu sadyotthā visūcī, tatrāpyauṣadhaniṣedhāt||14||
kṣārāgadaṃ vā lavaṇaṃ viḍaṃ vā guḍapragāḍhānatha sarṣapān vā | amlena vā saindhavahiṅguyuktau sabījapūrṇau saghṛtau trivargau ||15||
kaṭutrikaṃ vā lavaṇairupetaṃ pibet snuhīkṣīravimiśritaṃ tu | kalyāṇakaṃ vā lavaṇaṃ pibetu yaduktamādāvanilāmayeṣu ||16||

kṣārāgadamityādi| kṣārāgadaṃ ‘dhavāśvakarṇaśirīṣa-’ (ka. 6 ) ityādinā dundubhisvanīyoktam| lavaṇaṃ viḍalavaṇam| atrāpyuṣṇāmbunā pibediti sambandhanīyam| guḍapragāḍhānityādi| guḍapragāḍhān guḍāḍhyān guḍotkaṭān' iti pā.| amlenetyādi| amlena kāñjikena| sabījapūrau bījapūrasahitau| saghṛtau tulyapramāṇau| trivargau triphalātrikaṭukau| 'sabījapūrau' ityatra kecit 'saśākabījau' iti paṭhitvā śākavṛkṣabījasahitāviti vyākhyānayanti| yaduktamādāviti 'gaṇḍīrapalāśa' (ci. 4 ) ityādinā vātavyādhicikitsite yaduktamityarthaḥ| 'āmeṣvanilāmayeṣu' iti kecit paṭhitvā āmavāte iti vyākhyānayanti| atrāpi amleneti sambadhyate||15-16||

div.ab: kṛṣṇājamodakṣavakāṇi vā'pi tulyau pibedvā magadhānikumbhau | dantīyutaṃ vā magadhodbhavānāṃ kalkaṃ pibet koṣavatīrasena ||17|| uṣṇābhiradbhirmagadhodbhavānāṃ kalkaṃ pibennāgarakalkayuktam |18|

kṛṣṇājamodetyādi| kṣavaḥ phaṇijjakākāraḥ prāyaśaḥ pāriyātre bhavati| 'kṣavakāṇi vā'pi' ityatra 'kṣavakāgnikān vā' iti kecit paṭhanti| atrāpi amleneti sambadhyate| tulyau pibedvetyādi| nikumbho dantī| atrāpyamleneti sambadhyate| magadhānikumbhapānaṃ viṣṭambhe sati virekārtham| keciduṣṇodakena pānamicchanti| dantīyutamityādi| koṣavatī ghoṣakaḥ| kecit “uṣṇābhiradbhirmagadhodbhavānāṃ kalkaṃ pibennāgaracūrṇayuktam” īdṛśaṃ paṭhanti||17||-
vyoṣaṃ karañjasya phalaṃ haridre mūlaṃ samaṃ cāpyatha mātuluṅgyāḥ ||18|| chāyāviśuṣkā guṭikāḥ kṛtāstā hanyurvisūcīṃ nayanāñjanena |19|

visūcyāṃ pramīlakādiśāntyarthamañjanamāha- vyoṣamityādi| kecinmātuluṅgīṃ madhukarkaṭīmāhuḥ| visūcīśabdena visūcījanitāḥ pramīlakaśirorogādayo gṛhyante, kāraṇe kāryopacārāt; athavā visūcīmevāñjanaprabhāvāt hanyuḥ||18||-
suvāmitaṃ sādhuvirecitaṃ vā sulaṅghitaṃ manujaṃ viditvā ||19|| peyādibhirdīpanapācanīyaiḥ samyakkṣudhārtaṃ samupakrameta |20|

śuddhasya sulaṅghitasya pathyadānārthamāha- suvāmitamityādi| kecidatra “kuṣṭhaṃ cāguru patraṃ ca rāsnāśigruvacātvacam| piṣṭamamlena tacchreṣṭhaṃ visūcyāmaṅgamardanam||citrakaṃ pūtipiṇyākaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ bhallātakāni ca| dvau kṣārau saindhavaṃ caiva śuklaṃ tailaṃ vipācayet|| etadudvartanaṃ kuryāt pradehaṃ vā vicakṣaṇaḥ|” iti yogadvayaṃ paṭhanti; tanna paṭhitavyaṃ, samānatantrādarśanāt||19||-
āmaṃ śakṛdvā nicitaṃ krameṇa bhūyo vibaddhaṃ viguṇānilena ||20|| pravartamānaṃ na yathāsvamenaṃ vikāramānāhamudāharanti |21|
